job.title: Manager, Finance
job.description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Finance Manager to oversee our financial operations, manage financial reporting, and drive strategic financial planning. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in financial management, a keen analytical mind, and excellent leadership skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review monthly and quarterly management reports and prepare presentations for senior management, including variance analyses and financial insights.
  • Collaborate with senior management to develop financial strategies and support business decision-making.
  • Monitor financial performance against targets and prepare variance reports.
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
  • Lead and develop the finance team, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
  • Draft and review technical accounting papers, memos, and policy updates to ensure compliance and address emerging accounting issues.
  • Conduct risk assessments and implement appropriate financial controls.
  • Liaise with external auditors and tax advisors to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.

Qualifications

  • Degree holder in Finance, Accounting or equivalent professional qualifications
  • CPA/ACCA or equivalent certification.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant accounting experience, with initial experience acquired in Big 4 is preferred.
  • Familiar with group accounting policies, tax requirement and internal control procedures. Experience in US GAAP and Sarbanes-Oxley Act compliance is an advantage.
  • Experience in SAP S/4HANA would be advantageous.
  • Self-motivated and high degree of initiative, high level of integrity with a strong sense of urgency
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex financial information clearly.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Service Delivery Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Please note: This is not an IT related role. *

A Snapshot

As the Service Delivery Manager based in Johor Bahru, you will report to the Senior Director, Service Delivery - APJ, and collaborate closely with the broader Operations team, making your mark in several ways:

  • You will be the main point of contact for AirTrunk’s large cloud Customers.
  • You will be the key in supporting our Customers throughout the entire journey – from fit-out through to go-live (RFS) and onboarding – within our hyperscale data centres.
  • You will provide a variety of comprehensive Project Management, Customer engagement, reporting and administrative services to ensure Customer requirements are met with the highest level of satisfaction.

Your Day to Day

As the Service Delivery Manager, your daily responsibilities will include, but not limited to, the following key tasks, along with tackling a variety of other exciting challenges:

  • Act as the primary point of contact with all Customers throughout the build, fit-out and onboarding process.
  • Ensure Early Access, Ready for Service, and other Customer contractual requirements are met by coordinating with internal teams to track and maintain compliance with all Customer contract obligations.
  • Participate in design reviews and project meetings.
  • Work with the design team and the Customer to ensure Customer requirements for fit- out of the data centre are met.
  • Project manage, in conjunction with the development team, fit-outs being delivered by AirTrunk on behalf of Customers; ensure all Customer expectations are met.
  • Work with the development team on programmes, obtaining design and budget approvals, conduct risk analysis, facilitate procurement and provide reporting throughout Customer fit-outs.
  • Coordinate Customer deliveries and installs of racks, servers, network equipment, etc.
  • Support Customer audits and inspections throughout the development and fit-out phases.
  • Provide ongoing BAU operational support to Customers, including preparation of Customer operational reporting, including SLA, security and other reporting as required by the Customer.
  • Conduct audits and inspections with and on behalf of Customers to ensure compliance and quality standards.
  • Work closely with the development and cost team to review and prepare budgets; negotiate costs and contracts with general contractors and equipment suppliers.
  • Maintain Customer project budgets and trackers, to ensure compliance with financial policies and Customer recoveries.
  • Deliver regular progress reports and status updates.
  • Respond promptly to Customer requests and needs and facilitate resolution.
  • Assist facilities management in managing Customer incidents and escalations.
  • Establish and maintain positive relationships and regular interaction with internal teams, external Customers and vendors through proactive communication and collaboration.
  • Schedule and coordinate ongoing Customer meetings and Customer events.
  • Support sales and pre-sales activities by assisting with meetings, documentation and proposal as required.

Requirements

To perform this role successfully, the suitably experienced individual must understand and demonstrate the basic tenets of leadership. The items in the list below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required for satisfactorily meeting the expectations of the role.

  • You have a minimum of 5years overall experience with at least 2+years in Project Management or Service Delivery Management experience in a critical operating environment.
  • You are an excellent communicator who understands commercial and electrical/ mechanical technical concepts.
  • You are Customer-focused and will go above beyond to deliver for the Customer.
  • You have strong time management and organizational skills.
  • Ideally, you are Project Management (PMP) certified.
  • Ideally, you have data centre infrastructure fit-out delivery experience.
  • You can track and synthesize large amounts of data and prepare valuable reports and summaries to management and to Customers.
  • You are proficient in Microsoft SharePoint, Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint and familiar with Visio, MS Project & Bluebeam.
  • You are willing to travel across APAC when required.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer SAM - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The ServiceNow Developer specializing in Software Asset Management (SAM) is responsible for developing and implementing software asset management solutions within the ServiceNow platform. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to enhance software asset management processes, ensuring compliance with licensing agreements, and optimizing software usage across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Development and Configuration: Configure and maintain ServiceNow SAM Pro publisher packs
  • Integration: Integrate ServiceNow SAM Pro with SaaS publisher portals through out-of-the-box and custom integrations to improve usage data availability for license reconciliation
  • Entitlement Upload: Manage and support software entitlement uploads in ServiceNow SAM Pro, including preparing and validating entitlement data from purchase orders, contracts, publisher portals, and procurement records. Ensure accurate mapping to software models using publisher part numbers, normalized publisher/product/version/edition details, license metrics, quantities, contract references, and effective dates
  • Compliance Position Generation: Configure, execute, and troubleshoot ServiceNow SAM Pro reconciliation processes to generate accurate software compliance positions. Validate discovered installation and usage data, normalization results, software models, license metrics, allocations, downgrade/upgrade rights, and publisher-specific rules before reconciliation
  • Reporting and Analytics: Create and maintain standard and performance analytics dashboards and reports to provide insights into software asset utilization, compliance status, and optimization opportunities
  • Workflow Development: Design and develop efficient workflows that streamline processes and enhance user experience
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the technical architect and product owner to align product vision, technical feasibility, and implementation strategies
  • Testing and Quality Assurance: Conduct unit testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure data quality and functionality of developed solutions
  • Documentation: Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for SAM technical implementations and configurations to ensure knowledge transfer and compliance
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor the performance of SAM solutions and make recommendations for improvements to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
  • Participation in Agile Ceremonies: Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives. Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Agile process by providing insights and feedback based on user experiences and testing outcomes
  • Adherence to Code Development Standards: Ensure that all development work adheres to established coding standards and best practices. Engage in code review processes to provide and receive constructive feedback and ensure that code quality meets organizational standards

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • 4+ years of experience in ServiceNow development, and a strong command over SAMPro Module, including configurations, scripting, workflows, and tables
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery, Rest API’s, OOB integrations, IntegrationHub and related applications
  • Experience and command over software licensing and license compliance position creation
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., ServiceNow Certified Application Developer) are a plus

job.title: Senior Software Engineer CMDB - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior CMDB Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing the enterprise Configuration Management Database (CMDB) within ServiceNow. This role ensures high-quality, reliable, and scalable configuration data that powers ITSM, ITOM, SAM, APM, and automation initiatives.

This position requires strong technical expertise, architecture thinking, and hands-on development across CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, and integrations, along with ownership of data governance, health, and lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

1. CMDB Architecture & Development

  • Design and maintain CMDB data models (CSDM aligned), CI class structures, and relationships
  • Develop and enhance ServiceNow CMDB using:Business Rules, Script Includes, Flow Designer, UI Policies

Configure and maintain Discovery, Service Mapping, and CMDB Workspace Implement lifecycle states, CI governance rules, and automation

2. Discovery, Service Mapping & Integrations

  • Build and maintain Discovery patterns, schedules, probes, and MID server configurations
  • Integrate CMDB with enterprise systems (e.g., SCCM, Intune, AWS, Azure, monitoring tools)
  • Define Identification & Reconciliation Engine (IRE) rules and normalization processes
  • Ensure trusted system-of-record integration and deduplication strategies

3. Data Quality & CMDB Health

  • Monitor and improve CMDB health KPIs:Completeness, correctness, compliance

Implement:

  • Data certification
  • Duplicate CI detection
  • Reconciliation automation

Conduct root cause analysis for data issues and drive corrective actions

4. Governance & Process Alignment

  • Define and enforce:

CI naming conventions

  • Data standards and policies
  • Lifecycle and ownership models

Align CMDB with ITIL processes:

  • Incident, Change, Problem, Asset lifecycle

Partner with ITSM, ITOM, SAM, APM, Security teams for cross-domain alignment

5. Automation & Innovation

  • Identify and implement automation opportunities:

CI onboarding

  • Data reconciliation
  • Service mapping enrichment
  • Now Assist for CMDB: Enable AI-driven or rule-based CMDB operations (e.g., duplicate detection, anomaly detection).
  • Predictive Intelligence & AIOps: Integrating the CMDB with ITOM Predictive Intelligence to proactively identify configuration anomalies, duplicates, and data gaps.
  • AI-Driven Service Graph Connectors: Leveraging automated data ingestion pipelines that use ML to map third-party data into the CMDB accurately.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with:

Infrastructure teams (compute, storage, network, cloud)

  • Application owners and architects
  • Asset and procurement teams

Translate business requirements into scalable CMDB solutions Provide technical leadership and mentoring to junior developers

job.title: Lease Accountant - Bengaluru
job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for Lease Accountant to be part of our Leasing Operations team. You will be responsible for the accounting and administration of the Company's global lease portfolio. This role requires strong accounting skills, attention to detail, advanced Excel capabilities, and the ability to effectively partner with cross-functional organizations. The position supports lease accounting compliance, financial reporting, month-end close activities, and process improvement initiatives and reports to the Lease Accounting Senior Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the accounting and review of lease transactions in compliance with US GAAP (ASC 842), IFRS, company policies, and internal control requirements
  • Manage lease accounting activities within Lucernex, including lease setup, modification reviews, and generation of accounting entries
  • Participate in month-end and quarter-end close activities, including preparation and review of lease-related journal entries and account reconciliations
  • Perform balance sheet and income statement flux analyses for lease-related accounts and investigate significant variances
  • Support quarterly and annual financial reporting requirements, including lease disclosures and control certifications
  • Maintain and execute SOX controls related to lease accounting processes and ensure compliance with internal control standards
  • Partner with Real Estate, Finance, and other cross-functional teams to ensure completeness and accuracy of lease data and accounting treatment
  • Support internal and external audits by providing documentation, analyses, and responses to audit inquiries
  • Prepare ad hoc reporting and analysis
  • Participate in special projects and system enhancement initiatives as needed

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in Accounting or Finance functions
  • Knowledge of US GAAP or local accounting standard
  • Strong attention to details and the ability to multi-task and work with limited supervision and within tight deadlines in the fast-paced environment
  • Experienced with Hyperion Essbase, Oracle Cloud, R12 or other ERP systems preferred
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Strong communication skills, both oral and written
  • Self-starter and team player with a positive attitude
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or Finance

Preferred Experience

  • Lease Accounting (ASC842)
  • Oracle Cloud ERP
  • US GAAP

job.title: Data Quality Analyst - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

Position Summary

The Data Quality Analyst supports the Enterprise Data and Analytics Data Governance organization in maintaining high-quality, trusted data across key systems. This role assists with data quality monitoring, issue investigation, documentation, and the execution of data governance processes. The analyst works closely with senior team members, data stewards, and data owners to ensure data quality standards are followed, and issues are resolved in a timely manner.

Responsibilities

Data Quality Governance

Purpose: Support the establishment and maintenance of Data Quality (DQ) rules, standards, and processes to ensure high-quality, trusted data across the organization.

Create and Maintain Data Quality Rules and Standards

  • Help update and maintain data quality rules (DQ FRD), metadata, and standards across data domains
  • Support senior analysts in gathering requirements from data owners and stewards

Ensure Regulatory and Organizational Compliance

  • Work with the Data Governance (DG) team and system owners to ensure rules and processes meet internal policies and standards
  • Help validate consistency of DQ rules across Source Systems (SORs)
  • Help monitor and report Data Quality Metrics and Thresholds
  • Assist data owners and stewards in defining measurable DQ metrics and thresholds
  • Help document KPIs and maintain metadata repositories

Recommend and Implement DQ Process Improvements

  • Participate in process reviews and contribute suggestions to streamline Data Quality workflows and improve governance maturity
  • Support Data Cleansing and Enrichment for LTC Migration
  • Assist in executing cleansing and enrichment tasks as part of the LTC Account and Contact Data Migration
  • Perform data validation, profiling, and documentation activities under guidance

Manage Change Control for DQ Rules and Business Glossary

  • Assist in managing version control for DQ rules, definitions, and glossary updates
  • Document changes and ensure proper review and approval processes are followed

Data Quality Monitoring & Reporting

  • Assist with running automated data quality checks and reviewing results
  • Support dashboard updates by providing data extracts, validation checks, and documentation
  • Monitor DQ rule results and highlight anomalies or trends to senior analysts
  • Help document and track data quality issues, remediation steps, and root-cause insights
  • Collaborate with data owners and stewards to gather information needed for issue investigation and resolution
  • Prepare initial drafts of DQ reports or summaries for review
  • Support Data quality alignment activities with the GMPO Data Quality team
  • Learn and apply data quality best practices through hands-on work and mentorship

Qualifications

Required Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics, Business Analytics, or related field
  • 1–2 years of experience in Data Quality, Data Analytics, or related work (internships and academic projects acceptable)
  • Basic SQL skills and willingness to grow technical proficiency
  • Familiarity with or exposure to data quality concepts, dashboards, or rule-based validations
  • Ability to analyze datasets, identify issues, and communicate findings clearly
  • Strong attention to detail, documentation skills, and eagerness to learn
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Preferred Certifications (Nice to Have, Not Required)

  • Foundational cloud certifications (e.g., Google Cloud Digital Leader, AWS Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals)
  • Introductory SQL certifications (e.g., Microsoft DP-900, Google BigQuery SQL)
  • Entry-level Data Governance or CDMP Associate certification
  • Exposure to any data quality tools (Informatica DQ, Talend, Collibra DQ, etc.)

job.title: SG | Legal Counsel, Legal & Secretariat
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As a Legal Counsel, you will handle the corporate, compliance and corporate secretarial matters of the STTGDC group. You will be reporting to the General Counsel and work closely with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Provide legal advice and support to STTGDC group’s operational matters, including compliance, regulatory, project development (including construction and equipment procurement), financing, vendor and customer contracts.
  • Provide legal advice and support to STTGDC group’s investment activities, including merger & acquisitions and joint ventures matters.
  • Assist in corporate secretarial matters of companies within STTGDC group
  • Instruct and manage external counsel on a variety of legal matters
  • Any other matters as assigned from time to time

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Law, with strong academic credentials
  • Strong legal experience in corporate and commercial matters, including construction/ procurement
  • Minimum 9 years of relevant working experience in law firm and/or in-house
  • Proactive, adaptable and independent and able to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced environment
  • A team player with the ability to work closely and constructively with colleagues across the regions
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with strong written and verbal communication skills in English

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Lead Contract Administrator
job.description:
Oversee Contract Management:

Lead the management and oversight of entire process of contract preparation, review, and modification and ensure that all contracts are executed accurately and within the required timelines by drafting contract terms, coordinating with relevant departments for input, and ensuring that all necessary approvals are obtained before finalizing contracts.

Develop and support business plans related to contracts, focusing on efficiency and effectiveness.

Possess expertise in various contract types, including fixed-price, cost-reimbursable, time and materials, and performance-based contracts.

Apply knowledge to manage and modify contracts according to their specific structure.

Research and Analysis:

Undertake comprehensive research on market trends, best practices, and benchmarks relevant to contracts and service delivery. Oversee the preparation and processing of Non-Financial Assessments (NFA), ensuring all necessary documentation is complete and accurate.

Gather data and insights to support decision-making processes for Service Development and Contract Managers.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Monitor, collate, and analyze contract performance information, producing detailed reports to track contract compliance and effectiveness.

Create and maintain weekly and monthly performance dashboards, presenting data in a clear and actionable format for management review and decision-making.

Prepare and submit financial documents as required by the Airports Economic Regulatory Authority (AERA), ensuring accuracy and adherence to regulatory timelines.

Regulatory Compliance and Risk Assessment:

Ensure that all contracts comply with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as company policies and procedures and monitor compliance with contractual obligations and address any issues promptly to avoid legal or financial repercussions.

Analyze risks associated with specific contract terms, providing recommendations for mitigation strategies.

Tender Management:

Assist in the preparation and submission of tenders by accurately identifying the Bill of Quantities (BOQ) and defining the scope of work, ensuring clarity for potential contractors.

Manage the contractor selection process by floating tenders, facilitating negotiations with bidders, and verifying all submitted documentation for compliance ensuring selection of qualified contractors who meet project requirements effectively.

Claim Management:

Oversee the management of claims related to contracts, ensuring they are resolved in a timely and efficient manner.

Coordinate with relevant departments and legal teams to assess, negotiate, and settle claims while minimizing financial and operational impact.

Letter Writing and Communication:

Review and finalise professional letters and official communications related to contract administration.

Ensure all written communications align with organizational standards and effectively convey necessary information to internal and external stakeholders.

Maintain a strong communication channel with stakeholders to ensure transparency and clarity throughout the contract management process.

Dispute Resolution:

Monitor project activities to identify potential disputes early and facilitate open communication among stakeholders.

Lead mediation sessions, ensuring adherence to contractual terms, maintaining thorough documentation and conducting post-resolution analyses to enhance future processes.

Performance and Quality Systems:

Support the implementation of performance and quality systems across area teams, facilitating consistent monitoring and improvement of contract-related activities.

Collaborate with stakeholders to establish clear performance and quality standards, ensuring these metrics are effectively measured and adhered to, thereby promoting compliance and enhancing overall project outcomes.

Brand Protection and Image Promotion:

Promote and protect the company’s brand and image, advising colleagues on appropriate use and representation.

Ensure timely payments to contractors and vendors, maintaining positive relationships and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations.

Continuous Improvement:

Regularly assess and recommend modifications or renewals of contracts based on project requirements and performance evaluations.

Collaborate with internal teams to identify sources for labour, machinery, and materials, enhancing operational efficiency.

Team Leadership and Management:

Advise on and deliver workforce development initiatives necessary for the successful implementation of contracts.

Organize and hire relevant personnel for contract execution and devise development plans for key team members.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Proven expertise in contract administration within the commercial real estate industry, with a minimum of 15 years of experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing multiple projects in commercial construction, including hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.
  • Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, and relationship management skills.

Educational Background

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Master’s degree in Business Administration or Contract Management is preferred.

Years & Type of Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in contract administration, with a focus on commercial real estate projects.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in the construction of hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.

Domain Expertise

  • In-depth knowledge of contract management principles and practices specific to commercial real estate.
  • Expertise in handling contracts related to city-side development projects, including hotels, malls, and multi-storied buildings.

Digital & Operational Tools

  • Proficiency in contract management software such as SAP Ariba or Oracle Contract Management.
  • Familiarity with project management tools like Primavera P6 or Microsoft Project.
  • Experience with analytics platforms for tracking contract performance metrics.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Environmental Compliance & Regulatory Management

  • Ensure compliance with environmental laws, regulations, and consent conditions issued by CPCB, SPCB, MoEF&CC, and other statutory authorities.
  • Monitor adherence to EC (Environmental Clearance), CTO (Consent to Operate), CTE (Consent to Establish), and other environmental permits.
  • Coordinate with regulatory agencies during inspections, audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Prepare and submit statutory environmental reports within defined timelines.

Environmental Monitoring

  • Monitor stack emissions, ambient air quality, wastewater quality, noise levels, and other environmental parameters.
  • Analyze monitoring data and recommend corrective actions to address deviations.
  • Ensure effective operation and maintenance coordination for environmental control systems such as ESPs, ETPs, STPs, DM plants, and ash handling systems.

Ash & Waste Management

  • Monitor fly ash utilization and ensure compliance with applicable fly ash notification requirements.
  • Oversee hazardous and non-hazardous waste management activities.
  • Maintain records related to waste generation, disposal, transportation, and utilization.

Sustainability & ESG Initiatives

  • Support implementation of sustainability and ESG-related initiatives at the plant.
  • Assist in preparing sustainability reports and environmental performance metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for resource conservation, waste reduction, water conservation, and carbon footprint reduction.

Audits & Documentation

  • Facilitate internal and external environmental audits.
  • Maintain environmental records, permits, licenses, monitoring reports, and compliance documentation.
  • Conduct gap assessments and implement corrective and preventive actions.

Stakeholder Management

  • Liaise with corporate environment teams, plant operations, consultants, and regulatory authorities.
  • Support environmental awareness programs and training sessions for employees and contractors.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor's degree in environmental engineering / environmental science / chemical engineering / civil engineering.
  • Master's degree in environmental engineering or environmental management will be preferred.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in Environmental Management within Thermal Power Plants, Power Generation, Energy, Cement, Steel, or Manufacturing industries.
  • Experience in handling statutory environmental compliances and regulatory interactions.
  • Knowledge of air pollution control, wastewater management, ash utilization, and environmental monitoring systems.

job.title: Manager - Utility
job.description:
Responsibilities

Utility Operations Management

  • Spearhead the efficient operation and management of Water Treatment Plant (WTP), Pump House, Cooling Water Treatment, Fire Fighting Hydrant (FFH), Sewage Treatment Plant (STP), LDO, HSD and LNG systems.
  • Oversee daily operations to ensure optimal performance and reliability of utility systems.
  • Coordinate with the maintenance team to ensure timely and effective maintenance of equipment and systems.
  • Develop and implement strategies to optimize the performance and reliability of utility systems.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Mine Operations
job.description:
1. Shift Management and Coordination

Oversee and manage all mining activities during the assigned shift, including drilling, blasting, loading, and transportation of ore.

Coordinate with the mine planning, engineering, and maintenance teams to ensure all activities are aligned with the overall mining plan and schedules.

Monitor the performance of equipment and personnel, ensuring that operations are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards.

2. Safety and Compliance

Enforce safety protocols and procedures during all mining operations, ensuring compliance with the Mines Act and other relevant regulations.

Conduct regular safety inspections and toolbox talks to promote a culture of safety among all shift personnel.

Ensure that all incidents, accidents, or near-misses are reported and investigated, and that corrective actions are implemented promptly.

3. Production and Performance Monitoring

Monitor production metrics during the shift, ensuring that targets are met or exceeded, and identify areas for improvement.

Ensure that ore extraction, transportation, and processing activities are carried out efficiently, minimizing downtime and maximizing productivity.

Provide regular reports on shift performance, production output, and any operational issues to the mine management team.

4. Equipment and Resource Management

Ensure that all equipment is operated and maintained properly during the shift, coordinating with maintenance teams for any repairs or servicing needed.

Manage the allocation of personnel and resources to optimize operational efficiency and ensure continuous production.

Address any equipment breakdowns or operational issues promptly to minimize impact on production.

5. Communication and Reporting

Maintain effective communication with other shift teams and management to ensure seamless transitions between shifts and alignment with overall mining objectives.

Report any significant issues, challenges, or achievements during the shift to senior management and recommend solutions as needed.

Document and report all shift activities, including production data, safety incidents, and equipment status.

Internal Stakeholders:

*HODs

*Employees

External Stakeholders:

*Relevant Authorities

*Forest Department

Qualifications

Education Qualification

Essential: B.Tech/B.E-Mining with First class Manager's Certificate - iron

Work Experience

10 to 12 years

job.title: Manager - Mechanical (Turbine)
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead preventive, predictive, breakdown, and condition-based maintenance activities of Turbine, Generator, and associated auxiliaries.
  • Ensure high availability and reliability of Steam Turbine systems, Condenser, CEP, BFP, CW Pumps, HP/LP Heaters, Deaerator, Vacuum Systems, and associated equipment.
  • Plan and execute Annual Overhauls, Unit Shutdowns, Capital Repairs, and Major Maintenance activities within approved timelines and budgets.
  • Monitor equipment health and implement reliability improvement initiatives to reduce forced outages and repetitive failures.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical equipment failures and drive sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Develop and execute condition monitoring programs including vibration analysis, thermography, oil analysis, alignment checks, and predictive maintenance techniques.
  • Coordinate closely with Operations, Boiler, Electrical, C&I, CHP, and Engineering teams to ensure optimum unit performance.
  • Ensure effective maintenance planning and execution through SAP PM, work order management, shutdown planning, and spare parts optimization.
  • Supervise and guide maintenance engineers, supervisors, technicians, contractors, and OEM service teams.
  • Monitor and optimize maintenance costs while ensuring equipment reliability and operational safety.
  • Ensure availability and proper management of critical turbine and rotating equipment spares.
  • Drive implementation of Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM), TPM, Lean Maintenance, and best industry practices.
  • Ensure strict compliance with safety procedures, statutory requirements, PTW systems, LOTO procedures, and environmental standards.
  • Participate in commissioning, refurbishment, performance improvement, life assessment, and modernization projects related to turbine systems.
  • Develop team capability through technical coaching, competency development, performance management, and succession planning initiatives.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

Mandatory

  • B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering from a recognized university.

Preferred

  • M.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
  • MBA (Operations) or equivalent management qualification.
  • ### Experience Requirements

12-18 years of Mechanical Maintenance experience.

  • Minimum 7-10 years of dedicated Turbine Maintenance experience in Thermal Power Plants.
  • Experience in utility-scale power units of 300 MW and above.
  • Exposure to Supercritical and Subcritical Turbine technologies.
  • Hands-on expertise in Steam Turbines, Condensers, Feed Water Systems, Pumps, Rotating Equipment, and Turbine Auxiliaries.
  • Experience in major shutdowns, overhauls, refurbishment activities, and reliability enhancement programs.
  • Proven experience in team handling and contractor management.

job.title: Associate MEP Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to Senior MEP Manager. This role will require the candidates to oversee the on-site construction activities related to design coordination, schedule management, construction methodology and sequence, quality assurance, EHS, testing and commissioning for all MEPF services for designated floors/building areas as assigned by Senior MEP Manager. This role will be based at site in Navi Mumbai.

Key responsibilities

  • Single point of contact (SPOC) for MEPF works responsible for the management, coordination, quality and safety execution of works on site from commencement until the completion of IST testing.
  • Technical specialist and link between design/consultants through to contractors vendors and completing with T&C consultants.
  • Accountability of timelines and schedule management start-to-end having to manage resource deployment, material and equipment coordination, sequence of construction to ensure the construction outcome is achieved safely to the required quality standard within the defined time.
  • Provide site related certifications in a timely manner for all MEPF activities including QA/QC checks, install quantification vetting, install methodology review, best practice demonstration.
  • Ensure effective and well managed coordination between engaged agencies LLE suppliers, contractors, subcontractors to ensure well-ordered installation and sequence of activities.
  • Review and provide feedback on mockups, samples, work/ method statement, safety plans, work permits, and risk mitigation plans for electrical equipment installations.
  • Review testing & commissioning plans and scripts, oversee commissioning of electrical and mechanical equipment. Review testing & commissioning results and certify for compliance.
  • Certify running bills, installation compliance with defined quality standards.
  • Actively champion and comply with policies and procedures related to workplace health & safety, information security, environmental, quality, energy management systems, incident management, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Electrical or Mechanical Engineering/ Diploma graduate with Minimum 12 years of onsite experience in installation, testing, commission of MEPF works.
  • Minimum of 5 years of onsite experience in overseeing MEPF activities for a data center is essential.
  • Good knowledge on the latest requirements data center / hyperscale standards is preferred.
  • Good spoken & written communications skills are essential.

job.title: Senior Manager, Business Systems
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role will drive finance systems implementation, integration and process improvement initiatives across the Group, with an initial focus on ERP implementation and integration with other business systems. The role will act as the key bridge between Finance, IT, implementation partners, country teams and other business functions to ensure systems are designed around sound finance processes and meet the Group's accounting, reporting and control requirements.

This is a finance-led systems role rather than a pure IT role. The successful candidate should have a strong accounting and finance background together with hands-on ERP implementation and finance transformation experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive ERP implementation and enhancement projects from the Finance side, including requirements gathering, process design, configuration requirements, testing, implementation and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Act as the key Finance representative between Finance, IT, external implementation partners, country teams and other business functions.
  • Understand and map end-to-end finance processes and translate finance requirements into system requirements.
  • Drive integration between the ERP and other systems across the Group to improve data flow and reduce manual processes and reconciliations.
  • Work with Consolidation & Group Reporting to move the Group from manual Excel-based consolidation toward a system-based consolidation process.
  • Identify opportunities to automate accounting, close, consolidation, reconciliation and financial reporting processes.
  • Ensure system design supports Group accounting policies, reporting requirements and the Group chart of accounts.
  • Lead finance UAT, issue tracking and resolution for system implementations and enhancements.
  • Support finance master data governance, including chart of accounts, legal entities, cost centers and other key finance dimensions.
  • Work closely with Internal Controls & Governance to ensure appropriate system controls, access controls, approval workflows and segregation of duties are embedded in system design.
  • Develop finance system documentation, procedures and training materials.
  • Support country finance teams through system implementation and adoption.
  • Manage and prioritize finance system enhancements and maintain a roadmap for future improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvement following implementation to ensure the intended efficiencies and benefits are realized.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified accountant or strong accounting/finance background.
  • Approximately 7–10 years of relevant experience, including finance systems, ERP implementation or finance transformation.
  • Strong understanding of accounting processes, financial close, consolidation and financial reporting.
  • Hands-on experience implementing or significantly enhancing an ERP system.
  • NetSuite implementation experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Experience integrating ERP with other finance or operational systems.
  • Strong project management skills, including requirements gathering, UAT, issue management and implementation.
  • Ability to translate effectively between Finance requirements and technical/system teams.
  • Strong process improvement mindset with a focus on simplification and automation.
  • Hands-on and comfortable driving projects in an environment where processes and systems are still being developed.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Sydney Inner City | Make Technology Feel Easier
job.description:
advertisedjoblocation, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

At Optus, every great customer experience starts with a conversation. That's how we help millions of Australians stay connected to the people, information and experiences that matter most.

Customers visit our stores for all sorts of reasons. They might be choosing a new phone, setting up internet, exploring new technology or looking for support when something hasn't gone to plan. Technology can be exciting. It can also feel overwhelming when you're comparing options, getting connected or trying to solve an issue. That's why every conversation matters. By taking the time to understand what's important to each customer, we make things easier, build trust and help find the solution that's right for them.

That's where you come in.

Every day, you'll meet people with different needs, experiences and levels of confidence. As a Retail Consultant, you'll listen carefully, explain things simply and help customers feel comfortable making decisions that work for them.

You'll be joining a team that supports one another, works towards shared goals and takes pride in helping both customers and teammates succeed. We're building a talent community across our Sydney Inner City store cluster, including George Street, World Square, Broadway and Zetland, and would love to hear from people interested in casual, part-time and full-time opportunities.

Along the way, you'll build confidence and skills in communication, customer experience, sales, teamwork and problem solving that can support future opportunities within Optus and beyond.

What You'll Be Doing:

Success in this role comes from balancing great customer experiences with the everyday responsibilities that help a store run well, from achieving team goals to following the processes that keep customers and the business safe.

  • Help customers find the right products, services and solutions for their needs
  • Make technology easier to understand through clear conversations and practical advice
  • Guide customers through decisions so they feel informed and confident in their choices
  • Support customers through questions, concerns and unexpected issues with care and professionalism
  • Contribute to customer experience, sales and store goals while following the right processes and standards
  • Work closely with your team and continue learning to create a positive store experience every day

What You'll Bring

  • Enjoy connecting with people and helping them feel confident about their choices
  • Bring curiosity and take the time to understand what someone really needs
  • Feel comfortable talking about products, services and technology and be excited to learn
  • Enjoy balancing great customer experiences with shared team goals
  • Stay positive, adaptable and solution-focused when challenges arise
  • Take pride in following through and doing things the right way
  • Enjoy being part of a team and contributing to shared success
  • Can work across retail trading hours, including weekends and peak trading periods

Why Optus?

A role in retail can be the start of something much bigger.

Every day, you'll build skills in communication, customer experience, sales, teamwork, problem solving and leadership while working alongside people who want to see you succeed. Whether you're starting out, changing direction or growing your career, you'll have the support, training and opportunities to develop skills that can take you further within Optus and beyond.

And because feeling supported helps you do your best work, you'll have access to benefits that support you:

  • Competitive pay, Optus product discounts and exclusive partner offers
  • Two paid Connected Days each year for eligible employees to spend on whatever matters most to you
  • Up to 16 weeks paid gender-neutral parental leave for eligible employees
  • Employee-led networks that foster connection, belonging and inclusion
  • Free wellbeing and counselling support for you and your family, available 24/7
  • Ongoing learning, coaching and career development opportunities

If you're excited by the idea of helping people, learning new skills and creating opportunities for your future, we encourage you to apply.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Manager, Reporting
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Manager, Reporting is a management role responsible for delivering accurate, timely, and compliant financial and management reporting across the business. This position oversees the preparation of monthly close reports, dashboards, and variance analyses, ensuring adherence to company policies and regulatory standards. The role fosters a collaborative and innovative team culture while driving process improvements and data integrity across reporting systems.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Hold end-to-end accountability for the preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly, and annual Group financial statements and management reporting packs, including dashboards and variance analysis for senior leadership.
  • Lead the execution and review of IFRS Group consolidation, including intercompany eliminations, capital consolidation, non-controlling interests, deferred taxes, and first-time consolidations.
  • Oversee the preparation and validation of management, statutory, and regulatory reports, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and full compliance with IFRS and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage the Group reporting calendar, ensuring timely, accurate, and standardized submissions across all business units and geographies.
  • Ensure data integrity across ERP systems, consolidation tools, and BI platforms, investigating anomalies and driving corrective actions.
  • Provide insightful financial analysis, including performance trends, forecasts, and variance explanations, delivering clear recommendations to senior stakeholders.
  • Design and enhance KPI dashboards and reporting frameworks, aligning with FP&A and Accounting to ensure consistent metrics and definitions.
  • Drive continuous improvement and automation initiatives across closing, consolidation, and reporting processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and governance standards, maintaining a strong control environment.
  • Act as a key liaison for external auditors, Group HQ, and international subsidiaries, supporting audits and ensuring alignment across stakeholders.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Financial Reporting and Consolidation team, ensuring quality outputs and professional growth.

Knowledge & Attributes

  • Strong understanding of financial statements, variance analysis, and management reporting principles.
  • Proficiency in ERP systems (SAP/Oracle), consolidation tools (Hyperion/OneStream), and BI platforms (Power BI/Tableau).
  • Excellent analytical skills with ability to interpret complex data and present insights clearly.
  • Strong planning, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to lead a team and foster collaboration across functions.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Academic Qualifications & Certifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field. Preferred: CPA/CMA or equivalent; experience with BI/data analytics tools.

BPC/ SAP

Required Experience

  • 5–7 years in financial reporting or FP&A within a complex, multi-entity environment.
  • Experience managing small teams and driving reporting process improvements.
  • Hands-on experience with ERP and reporting systems.

Other Requirements Travel may be required for up to 20% of the time. Flexibility to support stakeholders across global time zones

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.description:

With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Key Responsibilities

Helps to design, plan, install, and/or maintain mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure. Learns by providing hands on assistance with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Helps to design, plan, install, and/or maintain mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Learns by providing hands on assistance with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Supports the analysis of current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Supports with evaluating facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Learns the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Learns to repair all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Some understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Some understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Some knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Some knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Some knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Some knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field.
  • Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) preferred.
  • Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.) preferred.
  • Experience required:
  • Entry level experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Relevant demonstrated experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Relevant experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Relevant experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Entry level experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: 발전기 필드 서비스 테크니션- 레벨 I
job.description:
작업 요약:

고객 현장에서 최소한의 지도하에 발전기 또는 구성 요소에 대한 예방적 유지보수 및/또는 기본적인 수리 활동을 수행합니다.

주요 책임:

정중하고 전문적인 자세로 고객을 응대합니다. 고객이 요구에 신속하고 효율적으로 대응합니다.

특수한 도구를 사용하고 문서화된 절차 및 정책에 따라 문제를 진단하고 필요한 부품 및 도구의 준비를 포함한 기본적인 수리를 수행합니다.

해결되지 않은 문제를 더 경험이 많은 현장 서비스 기술자 및/또는 직속 상사에게 보고합니다.

문서화된 일정 및 표준에 따라 전력 생산 제품에 대한 예방적 유지보수 활동을 현장에서 수행합니다.

수기 양식 또는 비즈니스 시스템 입력 화면을 통해 서비스 워크시트, 시간 기록표, 보증 청구와 같은 필요한 문서화를 수행합니다.

기술 및 비즈니스 요구 사항에 맞추어 교육을 완료

서비스 차량 및 도구를 깨끗하게, 올바르게 작동하도록 유지합니다.

모든 관련 건강, 안전 및 환경 정책, 절차 및 법규에 부합하도록 확인합니다.

기술:

효과적인 커뮤니케이션 - 다양한 의사소통 방식을 개발∙활용하여 청중의 고유한 니즈에 대한 분명한 이해를 전함.

Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

고객 중심 - 고객과 탄탄한 관계를 형성하고, 고객 중심의 해결 방안을 제공함.

Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

책임수행 확인 - 자신 및 타인이 한 약속에 대해 책임지도록 함.

Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

계획과 조정 - 조직의 목표에 부합하는 의무를 다하기 위해 계획을 수립하고 업무의 우선순위를 정함.

Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

자기 개발 - 공식 및 비공식적 개발 경로를 활용하여 개인의 성장을 도모하는 새로운 방법을 적극적으로 모색함.

Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

보건 및 안전 기본원칙 - 보건 및 안전 향상을 위한 행동을 식별하고 보고하며 그에 참여함으로써 능동적인 보건 및 안전 행동을 장려하고 모델을 정립하여 상호의존적 문화를 조성하고 무사고 작업장 유지에 기여합니다.

진단 적용 - 고객의 불만을 문제해결계획 개발에 반영하고, 장애가 발생한 구성요소를 분리 식별하여 잘 수리할 수 있도록 하기 위해 업무흐름지침, 절차, 기계 및 전자 서비스 도구 등 전문 장비, 진단용 컴퓨터 소프트웨어에 근거하여 현안을 해결하며, 불만 사본을 작성하여 해결 여부를 확인함으로써 수리를 검증하고, 지급 및 이력 추적 업무에 대한 내용을 전달하기 위해 문제해결결과를 비즈니스 시스템에 문서화함.

전자 서비스 도구 적용 - 서비스에 필요한 가용한 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어 도구 세트를 식별하고, 적절한 전자 도구 세트를 활용하여 제품을 유지보수하거나 현안 진단 및 해결을 하며, 전자 도구 결과 또는 권고안을 해석하여 서비스 해결을 위한 다음 단계를 결정함.

전력 발전 시스템 지식 - 안전한 작업 환경 조성을 위해 개인 보호 장비를 포함한 모든 안전 작업 절차를 준수함으로써, Cummins 및 업계 표준에 대한 지식을 입증합니다. 장비와 서비스 발행물(Cummins, 주문자 상표 부착 생산)의 활용, 그리고 효율적이고 정확한 진단과 수리를 위한 치수 측정을 통해, 발전기 시스템 운영 및 통합(개폐기, 전력 시스템 제어 장치, 무정전 전원 공급 장치 등)을 해석 및 분석합니다.

제품 수리 및 유지보수 - 필수 장비를 사용해 표준 수리 시간 내에 지침에 따라 기계/전기 제품을 수리 및 유지보수함으로써 고품질 수리를 보장합니다. 필수 장비를 사용해 지침에 따라 엔진이나 발전기를 분해 및 조립함으로써 청결하고 잘 정리된 환경을 보장합니다. 재사용 지침에 따라 부품과 구성 요소를 검사 및 교체함으로써 고객의 소유 비용을 최소화합니다. 지침에 따라 점진적 손상을 점검하여 장애 전 조건으로 복원합니다.

서비스 문서 - 고객, 장비 및 기술 정보를 생성 및 확인하고, 필수 서비스 도구를 사용하여 구체적인 데이터를 파악하며, 수행한 업무를 정확하게 기록하기 위해 절차에 따라 서비스관리시스템에 필수 정보를 문서화함.

기술 에스컬레이션 - 제품의 기술적 현안 정보를 획득하고 데이터 관리도구 등 가용한 자원을 활용하며, 고객 대응 적시성과 조사 업무 간의 균형을 맞추어 현안을 상위 전문가에게 보고하며, 원활한 인수인계와 적시에 정확한 답변을 보장하기 위해 모든 문제해결단계를 적절한 데이터베이스에 기록함.

다양성 가치 추구 - 서로 다른 관점 및 문화가 조직에 주는 가치를 인식함.

Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Product Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Main focus will include working in business processes of Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI) or Current Product Support (CPS) and executing technical processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) while using tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred
