job.title: AI Lab Infrastructure and Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

  • Provides system operational support ensuring the effectiveness, efficiency, accuracy, and availability of systems for end users. Coaches and mentors less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Performs routine maintenance, facilitates customization and changes, and ensures system disaster recovery.
  • Leads new employee technology setup, including computer setup, delivery, and system access.
  • Resolves non-obvious issues and performs authorized changes and upgrades to existing systems.
  • Performs preventative maintenance on IT systems and networks, and monitors system performance and accuracy.
  • Conducts complex root-cause analysis to identify issues.
  • Coaches and mentors less experienced security analysts, and documents knowledge and solutions for use across the organization
  • Ensures IT services meet agreed performance, availability, and customer satisfaction standards by monitoring service metrics and proactively addressing issues impacting service quality.
  • Collaborates with Service Delivery Leaders and Engineering teams to validate fixes, confirm resolution, and implement preventive measures to avoid future service disruptions.

Competencies:

  • Technical Acumen - Demonstrates broad and adaptable technical expertise to ensure reliable IT service delivery, support, and administration across diverse environments, including enterprise, cybersecurity, and operational technology domains.
  • Process Management and Optimization - Designs, refines, and automates IT operations processes to improve efficiency, consistency, service quality, security, and cost effectiveness across diverse environments.
  • Service Quality and Reliability - Ensures IT services consistently meet performance, availability, and user satisfaction expectations by proactively maintaining service integrity, minimizing disruptions, and driving continuous improvement through collaboration, cost-effective practices, and operational excellence.
  • Risk Management - Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks to IT services, data, and operations by applying structured controls and communication strategies to strengthen resilience, ensure compliance, and reduce business impact through structured controls, cost-aware decision-making, and communication strategies.
  • Incident and Problem Management - Responds to disruptions and recurring issues by restoring service quickly, identifying root causes, and applying structured methods to reduce risk, improve reliability, and prevent recurrence.
  • Standardization and Documentation - Creates and maintains clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IT environments.
  • Reporting and Analytics - Uses data and reporting tools to monitor, analyze, and improve IT operational performance, enabling proactive decision-making, compliance, and service excellence across enterprise and local environments.
  • Demonstrating Domain Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs.
  • Vendor Engagement and Management - Builds and maintains effective relationships with external vendors to ensure IT services, tools, and support meet business needs.
  • Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
  • Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
  • Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • I ntermediate level of relevant work experience required.

AI Lab Infrastructure & Operations Manager

Cummins AI Lab - Artificial Intelligence Laboratory

About Cummins AI Lab

The Cummins AI Lab integrates applied AI research, engineering workflows, manufacturing processes, and enterprise platforms to deliver high-value AI solutions across Cummins' global operations. We build and operate the infrastructure, technology ecosystem, and experimentation environment that enable rapid AI innovation, proof-of-concept validation, and scalable enterprise AI adoption.

Role Overview

The AI Lab Infrastructure & Operations Manager owns the reliable, secure, and efficient operation of the AI Lab environment. The role manages software platforms, AI services, hardware assets, computing resources, lab infrastructure, vendors, contractors, and supporting team members. It ensures that researchers, solution architects, and project teams can access fit-for-purpose platforms, tools, environments, and operational support.

This is a management and technical enablement role. The emphasis is on technology evaluation, introduction, governance, resource optimization, service continuity, and operational excellence rather than deep architecture design, platform engineering, or framework development.

Key Responsibilities

1. Software Platform & AI Service Operations

  • Manage AI cloud environments, AI platforms, hosted AI services, model APIs, and related service subscriptions used by the AI Lab.
  • Coordinate the onboarding, configuration, operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of AI services and platforms.
  • Evaluate and introduce external foundation models, model inference services, deployment frameworks, and technical tools based on lab needs.
  • Conduct fit-for-purpose technical assessments covering usability, compatibility, reliability, security, operational effort, scalability, and cost.
  • Maintain service inventories, ownership records, operating guidance, access models, and support processes for lab software capabilities.
  • Coordinate incident resolution, service changes, renewals, and escalation with internal IT teams and external providers.

2. Hardware Infrastructure & Computing Resource Management

  • Manage AI all-in-one servers, AI mobile workstations, GPU computing resources, lab devices, and related infrastructure assets.
  • Plan and coordinate resource allocation, workload scheduling, capacity usage, and computing availability across AI Lab activities.
  • Monitor utilization, availability, maintenance status, and operational risks, and recommend actions to improve effective resource use.
  • Own hardware inventory, assignment, maintenance coordination, upgrade planning, warranty tracking, and lifecycle management.
  • Coordinate equipment installation, configuration, technical support, and issue resolution with vendors, contractors, and enterprise IT teams.

3. AI Lab Environment, Network & Operational Governance

  • Lead day-to-day management and operations of the AI Lab infrastructure environment.
  • Coordinate lab environment readiness, network connectivity, access, accounts, permissions, storage, and supporting services.
  • Establish and maintain operating standards for resource requests, environment access, equipment usage, change management, incident handling, and asset governance.
  • Maintain operational documentation, service runbooks, inventories, usage records, and management dashboards.
  • Drive service continuity, issue prevention, operational risk management, and continuous improvement for lab infrastructure and services.

4. Data Security, Compliance & Risk Coordination

  • Coordinate data security, cybersecurity, privacy, and compliance requirements for AI Lab platforms, models, devices, networks, and external services.
  • Partner with enterprise IT, cybersecurity, architecture, procurement, legal, and relevant governance teams to complete required reviews and controls.
  • Support access control, data classification, secure configuration, logging, patching, vulnerability handling, and risk remediation processes.
  • Assess operational and security implications before introducing external models, cloud services, inference frameworks, or new devices.
  • Maintain risk, issue, exception, and remediation tracking for the lab infrastructure environment.

5. Technology Evaluation & Lab Enablement

  • Scan and evaluate emerging AI infrastructure technologies, AI services, model deployment options, inference frameworks, hardware solutions, and productivity tools.
  • Organize trials and technical evaluations with solution architects, research scientists, users, contractors, and vendors.
  • Provide practical recommendations on platform selection, service adoption, resource use, operational readiness, and future infrastructure needs.
  • Enable PoC teams by provisioning suitable environments, coordinating computing resources, and resolving infrastructure dependencies.
  • Capture evaluation findings, limitations, operating requirements, and recommendations for reuse across the AI Lab.

6. Vendor, Contractor & Budget Management

  • Manage relationships and operational coordination with cloud providers, hardware suppliers, software vendors, service providers, and technical partners.
  • Define work packages, assign tasks, track deliverables, review service quality, and manage performance for contractors supporting AI infrastructure and lab operations.
  • Coordinate quotations, procurement inputs, contracts, renewals, licenses, warranties, and support arrangements with relevant internal teams.
  • Monitor infrastructure and service spending, usage, commitments, and budget risks, and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Lead issue escalation and resolution across vendors, contractors, internal IT teams, and AI Lab stakeholders.

7. Team Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Lead employees, contractors, and support resources responsible for infrastructure and operations activities.
  • Set priorities, clarify ownership, allocate work, review outcomes, and build a reliable service-oriented operating culture.
  • Develop team capability in platform operations, infrastructure management, lab governance, documentation, and user support.
  • Define service expectations and track relevant availability, utilization, incident, delivery, and customer support indicators.
  • Develop and execute an AI Lab infrastructure and operations roadmap aligned with lab growth and project demand.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, AI, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in infrastructure operations, platform operations, technical operations, IT service management, lab operations, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience managing cloud platforms, enterprise technology services, servers, workstations, networks, or technical environments.
  • Experience coordinating vendors and service providers and managing contractors or technical support resources.
  • People leadership experience, including work planning, delegation, performance follow-up, capability development, and stakeholder management.
  • Working knowledge of security, access control, data protection, asset management, incident management, and operational risk practices.
  • Strong organizational, communication, documentation, problem-solving, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Ability to balance multiple operational priorities in a fast-moving innovation environment.

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Structural and Dynamic Systems Tech Specialist - Experimental 应力力学测试主管
job.description:
Job Summary

This applied science position conducts experiments via third party and in-house tools to determine structural performance of components and systems. Evaluates experimental equipment and methods and provides improvement recommendations. The results from the experiments are used to determine the validity of the design to meet the customer requirements. Design recommendations are then provided as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Obtains input and negotiates with Design, Thermal Sciences, Materials and Product Validation and delivers key structural performance parameters like motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power to Design and Product Validation. Makes decisions in the area of structural design (materials and their processing as well as geometry) that impact structural performance (motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power) of components and systems Applies and improves testing and measurement methods that determine motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power and tools such as vibration analysis, digital signal processing, instrumentation and strain gaging required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Applies Principles of Dynamics and Vibration - Determines motion of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates rigid and flexible body motion, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, velocities, accelerations, friction, and wear to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Fatigue and Durability - Determines life of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates component temperatures, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, strains/stresses, wear, and fatigue life to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Function Based Product Testing of "X" - Selects appropriate equipment and techniques to operate the product and record operational data in a hardware or software based testing environment most often required as part of a product verification or validation plan; evaluates quality and validity of measurement data; analyzes test results using accepted standards to characterize product capabilities in alignment with the requirements of the engineer responsible for making product decisions.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Function Test System Design - Interprets test equipment specifications from test standards or lab customer requirements; selects and integrates appropriate equipment, instrumentation and software to control boundary conditions and collect measurement data; assesses capability of the lab equipment against the requirements and support infrastructure.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Preferred candidates would have a mix of experience using MS Office tools, Matlab, LabVIEW, nCode, Siemens Test.Lab and Windows operating systems.

工作职责

在现有的技术中心测试能力的基础上，规划技术中心应力力学试验室能力发展方向，以适应公司产品开发战略需求；

规划和构建大马力发动机关键零部件疲劳试验能力；

审核分析设计团队提出的产品验证需求，为确定试验方案和试验方法提供技术支持，并在应用力学试验技术方面制定决策。

按照试验需求实施试验项目，协调内外部资源完成项目开发验证目标。

按照试验需求制定试验大纲，指导操作人员实施试验，监督试验过程，确保试验数据结果准确并满足产品验证需求；（内部试验）

征求产品开发人员，试验验证技术人员及零部件供应商意见并与其磋商，制定试验大纲，并向外部试验室技术人员交付试验测试要求，监控试验过程，确保试验数据结果准确并满足产品验证需求；（外部试验）

应用专业软件对试验结果进行分析整理，并和产品工程团队一起分析审核试验结果，对于产品验证结果提出专业性意见和优化建议。

在影响测试设备准确性、可靠性及操作成本的组件选择、校准流程及操作流程方面制定决策。

完善应用力学团队工作流程和系统，同时发展团队技术或产品知识；提高应力力学团队职能能力。

有效促进团队目标、在工作组内产生影响并持续提高对在职位取得成功至关重要的能力。

逐步建立应用力学数据和经验数据库，为新产品试验验证提供决策数据基础。

job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Prospects and develops new opportunities to grow the business. Independently develops/executes account plans to build customer relationships and achieve sales goals within the assigned sales territory, market segment or channel partners.

Key Responsibilities

Develops opportunities to increase sales by identifying, researching and contacting prospective customers. Develops and executes account plans for top prospects and conducts agreed upon face to face sales calls.

Develops new customer relationships and strengthens current customer relationships that enable identification of a customer’s needs, business model and buying process.

Uses understanding of customer needs and priorities to identify and offer Cummins solutions.

Gains agreement on the differential advantage of Cummins solutions by helping the customer understand and evaluate existing data and information and the value proposition.

Brings current and emerging needs of the customer and market to their manager/director.

Conducts negotiations according to company guidelines, including payment terms. Assists with collection of accounts receivables. Maintains acceptable level of past due accounts. Collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve delinquent payments.

Drives sales, achieving sales targets and ensuring customer satisfaction. Maintains and strengthens customer relationships to generate future sales and repeat business. Responds to customer concerns in a timely fashion.

Consistently uses the Cummins Sales Process as well as Cummins tools, processes, and initiatives that support sales, customer satisfaction, and customer value, e.g., Customer Relationship Management and special projects.

Reports activity via the Customer Relationship Management tool per management direction. Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast.

Provides leadership and mentoring to less experienced account executives.

As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.

Competencies:

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc.) in such a way that the target audience (e.g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc.) can understand, retain, and use the information

Developing Account Strategy - Determines current status of account in terms of relationship, financial, product competitiveness, barriers, quality, and service and defining desired future state by balancing customer requirements and business capabilities in order to define achievable targets aligned with the business strategy.

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.

Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.

Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Required: College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales or a related subject, or acceptable sales related work experience, or an acceptable combination of education and experience.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

job.title: 2027 Undergraduate Power Generation Application Engineering
job.description:
Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL . We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what \#LifeAtCummins is all about.

If you are an undergraduate Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics Engineering Student looking to jump start your career, we are offering a 13-month full time internship based at our Wetherill Park office . This is a unique opportunity to gain skills and knowledge while you are working full time commencing 27th January 2027 .

In this role you will make an impact and gain experience in the following ways:

  • Supporting the work of the Power Generation Engineering Team by assisting Power Generation Application Engineers daily on Power Generation projects and product engineering support
  • Cummins products Application Engineering – analysing proposed installations in compliance to Cummins PG products Application manuals
  • Project engineering – including all associated design and documentation preparation work supporting Projects Tender Submissions
  • Product engineering support – supporting PG Application Engineers and SPAC Product Management team with New Products release to the region engineering tasks including new products’ compliance audits and reporting
  • Responding to technical queries to both internal and external customers
  • CAD modelling producing SLDs, Site Layouts etc when required
  • Working in a team environment with internal and external customers across multiple departments

About You

To qualify for this undergraduate internship, it is essential that you:

  • Are currently studying a Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Mechatronics Engineering student , ideally at an undergraduate level
  • Have between 1 and 8 units of study left to complete of your undergraduate degree as of January 2027
  • Are available for the full 13 months and be willing to defer your studies for that duration.

_Note:_ _Applicants that do not meet these qualifying requirements unfortunately will not be considered._

To be successful in this role, you will possess skills/abilities or be able to perform:

  • Working towards a qualification in bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical or mechatronics Engineering
  • Strong results in mathematics and Microsoft Excel skills with Visual Basic experience in macros will be favourably looked at
  • An appreciation and understanding of basic power generation, and application
  • Good Attention to detail, analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to show initiative, operate autonomously & think independently
  • Strong teamwork & communication skills and stakeholder management
  • Driver’s license is beneficial but not mandatory

_This is a 13-month, full time, paid placement and the successful candidate will be required to defer their studies for the duration of the program._

How to apply:

  • For all applications, please submit your resume, cover letter and academic transcript via the link provided.
  • In your cover letter, please specify how many units of study you have remaining on your undergraduate degree and your motivation behind applying both to Cummins and this specific internship.

Note: We will be unable to assess your application without all of the required documents, so please ensure you attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts at the time of application.

job.title: 区域销售 - 现场销售客户经理 - 高级
job.description:
工作总结:

展望并开发新的机遇来发展业务。独立制定/执行客户计划，以便在指定的销售区域、细分市场或渠道合作伙伴内建立客户关系，并实现销售目标。

主要责任:

通过识别、研究和联系潜在客户，开发增加销售的机会。制定和执行最佳潜在客户的客户计划，并执行商定的面对面销售拜访。

发展新的客户关系，加强当前的客户关系，从而能够识别客户的需求、业务模式和购买流程。

利用对客户需求和优先事项的理解来确定和提供康明斯的解决方案。

通过帮助客户了解和评估现有数据和信息以及价值的意义，就康明斯解决方案的差异化优势达成一致。

将客户和市场的当前和新兴需求带给经理/总监。

根据公司指导方针，包括支付条款，开展谈判。协助收取应收账款。维持可接受的过期账款水平。与客户和内部利益相关方合作解决拖欠款项。

推动销售，实现销售目标，确保客户满意度。维持并加强客户关系，促进未来销售和业务再续。及时响应客户的担忧。

坚持使用康明斯销售流程以及康明斯工具、流程和举措，以支持销售、客户满意度、和客户价值，例如客户关系管理和特殊项目。

根据管理方向，通过客户关系管理工具报告活动。维护销售预测，并根据预测跟踪进展情况和准确性。

为经验不足的客户经理提供领导和指导。

如适用，与内部利益相关方和客户合作，根据客户期望平衡组织的库存、服务和交付能力。

机电一体化或相关专业要求，对发电机/电动机的基本原理和应用有一定的了解。

有一定的项目管理经验，有大客户或关键客户管理的经验。

技能:

商业洞察力 - 运用商业和市场知识实现组织目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

阐明价值主张 - 根据相关应用解释内部和外部客户需求；解释及演示产品、解决方案和服务以区分优势和劣势，满足客户的特定需求并在竞争中脱颖而出。

渠道意识 - 解释行业结构、动态和上市方式并将其背景化以推进组织目标。

定价策略 - 通过与各职能部门的主要利益相关者协调并形成共识来制定价格，从而实现业务目标。

谈判卓越 - 在谈判中利用工具和方法，以实现康明斯利益相关者的目标，并在各方之间达成彼此同意的所有合同条款。

客户策划 - 通过审核相对于目标需求的状态，并根据目标跟踪进度来确定推动业务和/或客户战略执行的目标。

适应目标受众 - 解释复杂的主题（重大的技术数据、主题专业知识等），使目标受众（例如销售专员、客户、培训供应商等）能够理解、保留和使用信息

制定客户策略 - 通过平衡客户要求和业务能力来确定客户在关系、财务、产品竞争力、障碍、质量和服务方面的当前状态，并定义所需的未来状态，以便确定与业务战略一致的可实现目标。

整合客户视角 - 结合客户对我们的产品和销售工作的了解，以开发销售内容，提高我们满足客户需求和增加收入的能力。

销售预测 - 从内部和外部来源收集和评估客户数据；与历史数据进行比较，确定有用的信息并创建未来消费模式的预测。

销售渠道管理 - 基于当前渠道提前制定计划，确保成功执行客户/地区级销售策略和计划；评估渠道健康（规模、内容、进度）；相应地调整销售策略、计划或高影响力的活动；在合适的情况下指导销售人员以实现销售目标。

感官体验 - 通过一系列的诊断和探究性的问题和研究，培养和/或支持对客户需求、行为和/或他们的购买旅程的深入了解。综合来自内部和外部资源的复杂信息，为内部或外部客户交付定制的解决方案。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

教育,资格,认证:

要求：需要市场营销、销售、或相关专业的专科、本科或同等学历，或可接受的销售相关的工作经验，或可接受的教育和行业经验组合。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

要求具有中级水平的相关工作经验。

100% On-Site No

Here, you'll have the power to determine your future with innovative technology, a focus on sustainability and with a company positioned for long-term growth.

job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud growing. We support all AWS data centers critical infrastructures, power and cooling equipment supporting all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety, security and quality while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Data Center Capacity Delivery Commissioning (DCCD Cx) is seeking an exceptional Commissioning Manager based in Hyderabad. As the Area Commissioning Manager, you will manage a fast-moving, high-performing team of commissioning professionals delivering data center capacity to support Amazon's growth in India.

The ideal candidate has experience managing a multi-city or international team of highly skilled professionals. They bring strong team and stakeholder management skills, along with a background in mechanical, electrical, construction, or project management. This foundation enables them to hire, develop, and lead a team that delivers world-class data centers. The candidate must think broadly to maximize operational efficiency and remain adaptable to change in support of broader business objectives.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of Commissioning Engineers, with broad responsibility to hire, build, and manage team performance.
  • Create a vision for the team and set priorities aligned with organisational goals.

  • Understand the technology and lifecycle of data center mechanical and electrical infrastructure
  • Utilise knowledge of standards, related disciplines, contractual and business acumens to develop strategies to future proof organization intent.
  • Create standards around which others will operate and build consensus across the organization.

Execution & Process Improvement

  • Identify key value drivers that contribute to commissioning success and lead the development of process improvement strategies aligned with organisational goals.
  • Fix broken processes, convert proven concepts into mechanisms, and iterate existing mechanisms to improve outcomes.

  • Develop and manage metrics that quantify performance and measure the effectiveness of commissioning key value drivers.
  • Establish a cadence to inspect performance, ensure compliance, provide insights, and track improvements to success.

Stakeholder & Financial Management

job.title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
job.description:
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.

AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.

Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
  • Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
  • Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
  • Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
  • Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
  • Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
  • Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment
  • In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
  • Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
  • Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
  • Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

A day in the life As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, AWS DynamoDB
job.description:
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Do you want to work on a product that can do the following?:

Access petabytes of data in single-digit milliseconds Replicate tables across continents Stream terabytes of data updates per hour continuously Back up hundreds of terabytes of data in seconds Encrypt petabytes of data with no performance degradation

Amazon DynamoDB is a NoSQL database service that does all this and more. DynamoDB is a key-value and document database that delivers single-digit-millisecond performance at any scale. DynamoDB can store petabytes of customer data and handle peaks of more than 20 million requests per second.

As a fast growing service at the core of the AWS Cloud, our business and engineering decisions have widespread impact across AWS, Amazon, and beyond. Many of the world's fastest growing businesses, such as Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin, as well as enterprises, such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One, depend on the scale and performance of DynamoDB to support their mission-critical workloads.

DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world, and we continue to believe it is Day 1 for the DynamoDB business. We are constantly improving and adding new capabilities to DynamoDB, and we are looking for a deeply technical, team-first software development engineer to push DynamoDB even further.

DynamoDB engineers are constantly challenged to think of unique and innovative solutions. The quality bar is high. As an engineer here, you will work on the hardest engineering problems in distributed systems at a massive scale and on multiple dimensions. You will exercise your intellectual curiosity, work with motivated teams of sharp individuals, and get insightful guidance from senior and principal engineers.

This is a hands-on position in which you will own everything from end to end: requirements gathering, designs, design reviews, implementations, code reviews, incremental feature launches, operations, mentoring, and the driving of continuous improvement.

job.title: AWS Technical Consultant (TAM), Enterprise Support NZ
job.description:
Join AWS as we invest NZ$7.5 billion in New Zealand over the next 15 years. We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to join our Enterprise Support team and work directly with New Zealand's most ambitious Independent Software Vendors (ISVs) as they build, scale and innovate on AWS.

As a TAM in our ISV segment, you'll be the trusted technical consultant for software companies that are shaping industries across New Zealand and beyond. You'll help ISV customers architect for scale, optimise their cloud operations and accelerate their product roadmaps on AWS. Your day will involve conducting application reviews, leading operational readiness assessments, driving adoption of AWS services that unlock new capabilities and presenting insights at business reviews that influence customer strategy.

This isn't a reactive support role. It's a consulting role where you earn trust through deep technical expertise and deliver measurable impact. You'll work across the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding and migration through to optimisation and innovation, solving complex technical challenges alongside some of the sharpest engineering teams in the country.

You'll be part of a growing Enterprise Support team in New Zealand, backed by the depth of AWS's global technical community. You'll develop your skills across cloud architecture, security, cost optimisation and operational excellence while contributing to Technical Field Communities and earning AWS certifications.

If you want to work at the intersection of cloud technology and software innovation, and you're ready to have a direct impact on how New Zealand's ISVs build and grow, we'd love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to ISV customers, helping them architect, optimise and scale their software products on AWS
  • Conduct Operational Reviews, operational readiness assessments and architecture deep-dives tailored to SaaS and multi-tenant workloads
  • Drive operational excellence across customer environments by identifying risks, reducing cost and improving reliability before issues impact production
  • Lead technical discussions on incident management, trade-offs and risk mitigation, translating complex scenarios into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior leadership
  • Proactively identify opportunities to accelerate customer outcomes through AWS service adoption, cost optimisation and architectural improvements
  • Deliver business reviews that provide actionable insights, track progress against customer goals and strengthen the strategic relationship
  • Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services and Account Managers to deliver coordinated support across the customer lifecycle
  • Enable customer teams through targeted workshops, hands-on labs and technical enablement sessions that build lasting cloud capability
  • Lead service event reviews and pre-launch planning to ensure customers are prepared for critical launches and operational milestones
  • Engage with stakeholders across all levels, from platform engineers to CTOs, earning trust through technical depth and consistent delivery

A day in the life No two days are the same, but here's what a typical day might look like.

Your morning starts by reviewing operational dashboards and findings across your customer portfolio, identifying any emerging risks before they become incidents. You notice one customer's database latency has been trending upward and flag it for a deeper review later in the week.

Mid-morning, you lead an Well-Architected Review with a SaaS customer who is preparing to expand into a new market. You work through their multi-tenant architecture, identify areas where they can improve resilience and reduce cost, and leave them with a prioritised set of recommendations they can action immediately.

Over lunch, you join a cross-functional call with the account team to plan an upcoming business review for one of your largest ISV customers. You pull together operational insights, service adoption trends and risk reduction metrics to ensure the review delivers real strategic value.

In the afternoon, you run a hands-on workshop with a customer's engineering team on observability best practices, helping them instrument their platform so they can detect and resolve issues faster. This is the kind of enablement that builds lasting capability and earns trust.

Later, you spend time preparing a pre-launch review for a customer about to release a major product update. You assess their architecture for readiness, review their scaling strategy and ensure their operational runbooks are solid before go-live.

Between meetings, you're contributing to your Technical Field Community, reviewing a SpecReq from a colleague and catching up with your ESM on a customer risk you've been tracking. Every day is a mix of deep technical work, strategic thinking and relationship building.

This position offers the opportunity to work with highly experienced professionals while developing your skills and advancing your career within one of the most innovative and progressive technology companies in the world.

Your responsibilities will include performing preventive maintenance on various facility equipment (such as electrical and mechanical, control, and fire-fighting systems), managing change processes, creating procedures, and overseeing vendor operations.

This role starts with 12-months contractual term with opportunity to convert to permanent full time employment.

Key job responsibilities The Data Center Engineering Operation Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

  • Meet daily hours of operations, on call requirements and response during rotations.
  • Manage minor and major planned and unplanned site works for critical infrastructure, with a solid understanding of the works involved, risks, mitigation and seeking approvals within relevant SLA’s as required.
  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Prepare reports on all aspects of the data center facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Coordinate with DCO managers (IT), Networking, Logistics, Safety, Security and other business leaders and operating partners to execute projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Review and follow the documentation relevant to technical support of business & facility operations.
  • Implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Support operating partners in the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues

A day in the life

  • Support troubleshooting facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
  • Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility management.
  • Provide operational readings and key performance indicators to make sure uptime is maintained
  • Performance and oversight of maintenance and operations on all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center.
  • Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.

job.title: Sr Product Manager, Technical, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE)
job.description:
95% of enterprise technology pilots deliver zero measurable P&L impact. The technology works — the gap is in the last mile: getting production systems running inside complex enterprises where legacy infrastructure, regulated data, and organizational complexity collide. AWS is making a billion-dollar investment in Forward Deployed Engineering to close that gap.

You are a product manager embedded inside an FDE delivery pod, owning the product lifecycle for customer engagements — from discovery through production delivery. You work directly inside enterprise customers: performing discovery, defining outcomes, writing specs, managing trade-offs, and working hand-in-hand with engineering to ship production systems under compressed timelines.

This is not a traditional AWS PM role. You are field-facing — you work with customers regularly and turn engagement learnings into platform improvements. You own the why and what for your engagements, while engineering owns the how.

Traveling 30-50% is required for this role.

Key job responsibilities Customer Discovery and Scoping

  • Partner with sales and senior PMs to perform customer discovery — mapping business goals, technical landscape, and problems worth solving
  • Engage with Director-level and senior technical stakeholders at enterprise customers to understand how AI technology can address their business challenges
  • Work with your engineering counterparts to define the minimum lovable product, write success criteria, and quantify expected business value

Product Ownership and Delivery

  • Own customer outcomes for your engagements, operating inside customer environments with real constraints — regulated data, brownfield infrastructure, multi-stakeholder governance
  • Follow AI DLC to iteratively define problems, write requirements, and deliver production code in weeks, not months
  • Drive solutions from launch to adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving defined business value
  • Make judgment calls about what simplifications are acceptable and when a product is ready to ship versus when it needs more iteration

Platform Feedback

  • Identify what breaks or slows down across your deployments and surface those findings to senior PMs and engineering
  • Contribute to the feedback loop between field delivery and the product/engineering roadmap
  • Advocate for graduating custom pod work into reusable platform capabilities with supporting data

Industry Learning and Reuse

  • Build domain expertise within your engagement vertical
  • Contribute to industry-specific accelerators, reference architectures, and blueprints that make future engagements faster
  • Document repeatable patterns from your work so solved problems become reusable assets

Go-to-Market Contribution

  • Contribute to customer stories and reference architectures drawn from your engagements
  • Provide field-level input on pricing, positioning, and what it takes to deliver outcomes to sales and marketing partners

job.title: Sr Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
job.description:
A Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDEs write production-grade software and own outcomes end-to-end, from prototype through enterprise-scale deployment combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes. They create reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice.

Key job responsibilities Lead technical delivery across customer engagements

  • Own the technical strategy and execution for complex, multi-workstream customer AI programs. Make architecture decisions that span multiple services and organizational boundaries. Align technical approach with the customer's long-term technology strategy. Requires 30–50% travel.

Architect and build production AI systems at scale

  • Design the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration, enterprise retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — for the most complex customer engagements. Drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology approach is fully defined. Build production systems that handle enterprise-scale traffic and reliability requirements.

Own production excellence across workstreams

  • Define operational standards, evaluation frameworks, and production readiness criteria for AI systems across your engagement scope. Establish mechanisms (testing strategies, observability standards, incident response playbooks) that ensure AI systems remain healthy. Drive operational improvements that raise the bar for the team.

Scale the team's effectiveness

  • Define engineering patterns, contribute to the interview and hiring process, and mentor junior FDEs into independent contributors. Coach others on system design, customer engagement, and production operations. Drive engineering excellence standards within your scope.

Accelerate customer transformation

  • Identify systemic opportunities to expand AI adoption across the customer organization. Create accelerators and reusable platforms that reduce time-to-value from months to weeks. Feed learnings back into AWS services and the FDE practice.

job.title: Senior Counsel
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Counsel

Job Posting Location:

Remote, USA

Posting Start Date:

10/14/26

Req Id:

10842

Required Travel:

0 - 10%

Remote, Onsite or Hybrid?:

Remote

For more than 100 years, Modine has solved the toughest thermal management challenges for mission-critical applications. Our purpose of Engineering a Cleaner, Healthier World™ means we are always evolving our portfolio of technologies to provide the latest heating, cooling, and ventilation solutions. Through the hard work of more than 11,000 employees worldwide, our Climate Solutions and Performance Technologies segments advance our purpose with systems that improve air quality, reduce energy and water consumption, lower harmful emissions, enable cleaner running vehicles, and use environmentally friendly refrigerants. Modine is a global company headquartered in Racine, Wisconsin (U.S.), with operations in North America, South America, Europe, and Asia. For more information about Modine, visit [modine.com](https://www.modine.com/).

Position Description

The Senior Counsel CHVAC serves as a member of the Corporate legal group, providing a broad range of legal support and business advice to the CHVAC business segment. Reporting to the Associate General Counsel, the Senior Counsel will work closely with internal stakeholders to address a wide range of legal matters, business needs, and ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts and ancillary agreements, including commercial playbooks, form purchasing and sales contracts, commercial contracts, supplier and vendor agreements, bid documents, sales representative agreements, licensing agreements, and various other documents.
  • Collaborate with a team of global Legal professionals, supporting global business strategy.
  • Draft, analyze and prepare legal memoranda, training materials, and other legal documents as needed.
  • Assist business clients with commercial disputes that may arise, working to escalate matters to senior-level attorneys as needed.
  • Conduct and oversee specific legal projects for specific Corporate Legal group or Segment by applying expertise in subject area, promoting adherence to all procedures and policies.
  • Analyze legal research to interpret and review legal documents (i.e. contracts, memoranda, and policies), addressing complex research issues, including but not limited to, federal and state laws, rules, and regulations. Escalating highly complex research issues to other senior-level attorneys as needed.
  • Drive legal projects forward and build relationships within legal team and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Work with other internal and external legal partners to make effective business decisions.
  • Recognize and capitalize improvement opportunities, evaluate recommendations, and influence completion of project tasks by others.
  • Support other legal matters as assigned.

Required Education & Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of transactional corporate experience with law firm and/or corporate legal department.
  • Substantial experience in the drafting, reviewing, and negotiation of commercial contracts.
  • For U.S. based positions, current law license in good standing from any U.S. State, or the eligibility to become licensed or practice through in-house authorization in Wisconsin. For European based positions, qualification and registration as a Rechtsanwalt, Syndikusrechtsanwalt, Avvocatos or an equivalent EU categorization.
  • Experience implementing new legal contract management technology systems is preferred.
  • Strong organization, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Fluency in English is required. Additional language skills, especially Spanish and Italian, will be considered.
  • Previous experience representing a global manufacturing company, in-house experience is a plus.
  • Ability to independently work on complex legal matters, while displaying excellent judgment on when to involve more senior legal and business colleagues.
  • High ethical and moral standards.
  • Position will be fully remote unless the successful candidate lives within a reasonable daily commute to one of the corporate offices and desires to have an onsite office. Annual travel of approximately 10% will be required (see below). If remote, preference is for U.S. based candidates who are located in Eastern or Central time zone, and European-based candidates who are located within 2 hours commute of Modine's locations in Germany; Leeds, UK; or Pontevico, Italy. This position is not eligible for relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. The successful candidate will be expected to have legal authority to work in the region of their residence.

Education Requirements:

  • For U.S. based candidates, Juris Doctorate degree from an accredited United States law school
  • For European based candidates, an LLB, LLM or the equivalent law degree

Travel:

  • Travel as necessary for job execution, including to meet with senior management at Modine locations worldwide. The successful candidate is expected to have unrestricted authority to travel inside the US, UK, Europe, and China (with entry visa application).
  • If remote, estimated that travel into a corporate office will be required two to three times a year. Estimated that other travel will be required 10% of the time.

Why Choose Modine?

Health & Well-being:

  • Day One
  • Competitive health, dental & vision insurance coverage
  • Employee Assistance Program

After 90 days of continuous employment

  • Maternity Leave (12 weeks at 100% pay)
  • 8 weeks of short term disability leave paid at 100%
  • 4 weeks of paid parental leave paid at 100%

Paternity Leave (4 weeks at 100% pay)

Financial Benefits:

  • 401k Retirement plan and company paid match
  • Life Insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution
  • Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Short Term Disability (company paid)
  • Long Term Disability

Work-Life Balance:

  • Competitive time-off policies
  • Tuition Reimbursement

To view full benefits information: [MyModine Benefits](https://mymodinebenefits.com/)

Modine is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Modine provides a competitive benefit package, which could include paid vacation, short term disability, 401(k), health, dental, vision, life insurance, flex spending benefits, tuition reimbursement, Health Savings Account and much more. Human Resources will provide more detail upon your hiring.

The salary range for this position is estimated in good faith to be $170,000-$190,000. The specific offer will depend on the candidate's qualifications, experience, and other job-related considerations but will be within the stated range. Where required by applicable law, a general description of benefits and other compensation offered for this role is also provided or made available.

This position is not eligible for any form of sponsorship (e.g. OPT or H1B visa status) now or in the future. Only individuals authorized to work in the United States now and for the foreseeable future will be considered for this position.

job.description:

You will oversee the general maintenance and minor repairs of equipment, facilities in our Serviced Residence. You will have close collaborations with colleagues from the different departments including Guest Service and Housekeeping to provide a smooth and pleasant stay for all our residents. You will report directly to the Manager or Assistant Manager, Engineering.

You will:

  • Conduct general maintenance works such as, painting, patching of walls, plumbing facilities, air-conditioning servicing, electrical switches and other fixtures and equipment to ensure smooth operations
  • Perform routine preventive maintenance programme
  • Check and inspect the building's machinery and equipment
  • Respond and prioritise maintenance requisitions (MWO) and residents' requests to ensure they receive quality service and furnishings
  • Perform related tasks as assigned

Production Engineering Manager

As an Executive Diploma Trainee, you will support business, collaborating with different teams, and contributing to the company's strategic objectives.

Gains knowledge by performing tasks as directed by the program manager /corresponding leader to support ABB's operations.

job.title: Talent Acquisition and Early Talent Partner
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

TA Regional Lead - APAC__

職務内容と責任

このポジションでは、優れた採用体験の実現に貢献するとともに、日本国内における新卒・若手人材向け施策の推進及び中途採用を担っていただきます。日々、HRビジネスパートナーや採用マネージャーと緊密に連携し、新卒採用の両面において効果的な採用戦略の立案・実行かつ中途採用を支援します。また、市場動向、人材供給状況、競合他社の採用活動に関するインサイトを提供し、人員計画および採用意思決定を支援します。

勤務形態

ハイブリッド勤務（Hybrid）

このポジションは、日本におけるABBのタレント戦略を形づくる重要な役割を担います。HRビジネスパートナー、採用マネージャー、事業部門長、グローバル・タレントアクイジションチームなど、多様で影響力のあるステークホルダーと連携しながら、戦略的な採用活動を推進します。競争の激しい市場環境の中で、ABBが優秀な人材を惹きつけ、エンゲージメントを高め、採用するための重要な役割を果たします。

また、以下のような若手人材戦略（Early Talent Strategy）に加えて、中途採用も担当いただきます。

  • 新卒採用
  • インターンシッププログラム
  • 大学とのパートナーシップ構築
  • 採用ブランディング施策

将来の人材パイプラインを構築し、若手人材との接点づくりや革新的な採用施策の展開に意欲のある採用プロフェッショナルにとって、非常に魅力的なポジションです。

主な業務内容

  • 担当ポジションにおける採用プロセス全般（募集から入社まで）を管理し、採用責任者や事業部門のリーダーに対する信頼できるアドバイザーとして活動する。
  • 人事部門および事業部門の関係者と連携し、人材パイプライン、採用プロセス、候補者体験に関する課題を特定・解決する。
  • エンジニアリング、製造、営業、サービス部門およびコーポレート機能部門において、優秀な人材を獲得するためのソーシング戦略を立案・実行する。
  • インターンシップ、新卒採用、大学向け採用活動などの若手人材プログラムを企画・運営する。
  • 大学、教育機関、学生団体、業界ネットワークとの強固な関係を構築・維持し、ABBの将来的な人材パイプラインを強化する。
  • キャリアフェア、大学イベント、ネットワーキングイベント、採用ブランディング活動などでABBを代表し、企業認知度および採用ブランドの向上に貢献する。
  • 採用管理システム（ATS）、ソーシングツール、候補者エンゲージメントツール、Employer Brandingツールなどを活用・管理し、採用成果の向上を支援する。
  • 事業ニーズに沿った採用戦略、人材誘致施策、採用ブランド向上施策、および若手人材向け施策を提案・企画・実行する。
  • 市場動向や人材マーケットに関する情報を採用責任者や人事担当者へ提供し、人員計画や採用戦略の策定を支援する。
  • グローバルのタレントアクイジションコミュニティと連携し、ベストプラクティスの共有や継続的改善を推進するとともに、優れた候補者体験の実現に貢献する。

ABBでは、協力的で成果志向の高い先進的なチームの一員として活躍いただけます。あなたのアイデアが尊重され、成長が支援される環境の中で、ABBのさらなる成功に貢献する機会があります。

応募資格

  • タレントアクイジション（採用）の実務経験3年以上 特にグローバル企業、産業機器、エンジニアリング、製造業、またはテクノロジー企業での経験歓迎
  • 新卒採用、インターンシップ運営、大学との連携、キャンパスリクルーティングの経験
  • ATS（Workday、SAP SuccessFactorsなど）やソーシングツールを活用した採用業務経験および採用手法に関する深い知識
  • エンジニアリング、製造業、産業オートメーション、またはテクノロジー分野の人材市場に関する知識
  • 高いステークホルダーマネジメント能力、関係構築力、および周囲を巻き込む力
  • 候補者に対し、シームレスでインクルーシブかつ魅力的な採用体験を提供することへの情熱と優れたコミュニケーション能力
  • 複数の採用プロジェクトを同時に推進できる高い計画力・プロジェクトマネジメント能力
  • 人事、経営学、心理学などの学位、または同等の採用・人事経験
  • 日本語能力試験（JLPT）N1レベル以上の日本語力
  • ビジネスレベルの英語力があれば尚可（必須ではありません）

ABBについて

ABBの人事部門（HR）の使命は、「人材を通じてABBの競争力を高めること」です。リーダーシップ開発、パフォーマンスマネジメント、タレントマネジメント、報酬制度、人材育成、キャリア開発などを通じて、社員が能力を最大限発揮し、持続的な事業成長を実現できる環境づくりを行っています。

ABBは、世界的な課題の解決に取り組む企業です。「Care（思いやり）」「Courage（勇気）」「Curiosity（好奇心）」「Collaboration（協働）」という4つのコアバリューを基盤とし、多様性・公平性・包摂性（DE&I）を重視しながら、持続可能な社会の実現に向けたソリューション創出を推進しています。

社会と産業の変革を加速し、より生産的で持続可能な未来を実現するグローバルチームの一員として、ぜひABBでご活躍ください。

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to an exceptional talent acquisition experience and help drive our local early talent engagement activities . Each day, you will work closely with HR Business Partners and hiring managers to develop and execute effective hiring strategies across experienced and early talent recruitment. You will also provide valuable insights on market trends, talent availability, and competitor activity to support workforce planning and hiring decisions.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #Hybrid

This role plays a key part in shaping ABB's talent landscape in Japan, partnering with a diverse and influential group of stakeholders including HR Business Partners, Hiring Managers, Business Unit Leaders, and the Global Talent Acquisition Team. You will be at the heart of strategic hiring conversations, driving impactful talent decisions while helping ABB attract, engage, and hire top talent in a highly competitive market.

In addition to experienced hiring, you will support ABB's early talent strategy through graduate recruitment, internship programs, university partnerships, and employer branding initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for a recruitment professional who enjoys building talent pipelines, engaging with future talent, and delivering innovative attraction strategies.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Managing end-to-end talent acquisition processes for assigned requisitions, acting as a trusted advisor to hiring managers and business leaders.
  • Partnering with HR leadership and business stakeholders to identify and resolve challenges across talent pipelines, hiring processes, and candidate experience.
  • Developing and executing sourcing strategies to attract high-quality talent across engineering, manufacturing, sales, service, and functional roles.
  • Managing and coordinating early talent programs, including internships, graduate hiring, and campus recruitment initiatives.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with universities, educational institutions, student organizations, and industry networks to strengthen ABB's future talent pipeline.
  • Representing ABB at career fairs, university events, networking forums, and employer branding activities to enhance ABB's visibility and attractiveness as an employer of choice.
  • Utilizing and maintaining recruitment, sourcing, candidate engagement, and employer branding systems to support effective hiring outcomes.
  • Recommending, developing, and implementing recruitment, sourcing, talent attraction, employer branding, and early talent initiatives aligned with business needs.
  • Providing market intelligence and talent insights to hiring managers and HR stakeholders to support workforce planning and talent acquisition strategies.
  • Partnering with the wider Talent Acquisition community to share best practices, drive continuous improvement, and deliver an outstanding candidate experience.

You will join a collaborative, high-performing, and forward-thinking team where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on ABB's continued success.

Qualifications for the Role

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in talent acquisition, preferably within a global industrial, engineering, manufacturing, or technology-driven organization.
  • Experience managing early talent programs, graduate recruitment, internships, university partnerships, or campus hiring activities.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment tools and methodologies, with experience using ATS platforms (e.g., Workday, SAP SuccessFactors) and sourcing technologies.
  • Good knowledge of the engineering, manufacturing, industrial automation, or technology talent market.
  • Strong stakeholder management, relationship-building, and influencing skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with a passion for delivering a seamless, inclusive, and engaging candidate experience.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple recruitment initiatives simultaneously.
  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field, or equivalent experience in recruitment or HR.
  • JLPT N1 level of Japanese language.
  • Ideally business-level English (preferred but not essential).

More About Us

Our mission in Human Resources (HR) is to help ABB stand out through our people. From leadership, performance, and talent management to rewards, development, and career opportunities, we create the conditions for our people to thrive and deliver sustainable business success. At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values of care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration, combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities, drive us to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.

Join us and become part of a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive and sustainable future

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Senior Team Lead - Intercompany

Role Overview

As a Senior Team Lead - Intercompany, you will play a critical role in supporting and driving the Intercompany closing and reporting processes. This position offers the opportunity to lead a high-performing team while ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance with accounting standards, and efficient service delivery across global operations. The role is part of the Finance organization based in Bangalore (Hebbal).

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership & Service Delivery

  • Lead global service delivery for assigned countries, ensuring achievement of key performance indicators including productivity, cost efficiency, customer satisfaction, and SLA compliance.
  • Drive seamless process transitions and operational excellence while minimizing business disruption.
  • Provide leadership and direction to a team of 15+ professionals, fostering accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Intercompany Accounting & Financial Controls

  • Drive standardization and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance process efficiency and control effectiveness.

People & Performance Management

  • Build and promote a culture of accountability, customer focus, change management, and professionalism within the Finance organization.
  • Manage key people initiatives, including hiring, onboarding, retention, training, development, and performance management.
  • Monitor operational metrics and drive performance improvements through data-driven decision-making.
  • Lead and support global transformation and process improvement projects with a focus on simplification, automation, and productivity gains.

Process Improvement & Governance

  • Contribute to the implementation and enhancement of Intercompany accounting policies, procedures, and controls.

  • Undertake additional responsibilities and strategic projects as assigned by management.

Qualifications & Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of relevant experience in Intercompany Accounting, Record-to-Report (R2R), or similar finance functions within a global organization.
  • Proven experience managing teams of 12 or more professionals.
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP and Intercompany accounting processes.
  • Excellent analytical, financial reporting, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to work effectively across global and cross-functional teams.
  • Willingness to work in flexible shifts to support global operations.

job.title: IS DevOps Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

IS Service Owner -Build & Accelerate

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the organization’s vision and strategic direction. Each day, you will apply IT knowledge and expertise to help solve complex technical or professional activities. You will also showcase your expertise by being a key resource, a definitive source of knowledge about services and solutions, to contribute your expertise to enhance organizational efficiency.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid, Bangalore

This role is contributing to the Acceleration and Modernisation Vertical, under Build and Accelerate team and part of the ABB Technology and Platforms IS Division. Main stakeholders are Internal Business Partners.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on DevOps Engineer to design, automate, and secure our cloud delivery platform on Microsoft Azure. You will own CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, and containerized workloads on AKS. You will also build low-code automations that connect engineering and IT service management. You'll work with development, security, and operations teams to make releases faster, safer, and repeatable.

Key Responsibilities

CI/CD and Release Engineering

  • Design, build, and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines (YAML, templates, environments, approvals, and gates) for build, test, security scanning, and deployment.
  • Standardize reusable pipeline templates and branching strategies to reduce onboarding time and pipeline sprawl.
  • Manage artifact and package feeds (Azure Artifacts, NuGet, npm, Maven, PyPI) with versioning, retention, and upstream source policies.

Infrastructure as Code

  • Provision and manage Azure infrastructure using Terraform: modules, remote state, workspaces, drift detection, and policy-as-code.
  • Implement GitOps-style change control for infrastructure with peer review and automated plan/apply workflows.

Containers and Kubernetes

  • Build optimized, secure Docker images and manage them in Azure Container Registry.
  • Deploy, operate, and scale workloads on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), covering Helm, ingress, autoscaling, networking, RBAC, secrets management, and upgrades.
  • Host and maintain SonarQube on AKS, including persistent storage, database, upgrades, quality gates, and integration with Azure DevOps pipelines.

Security and DevSecOps

  • Embed security into pipelines through code quality (SonarQube), dependency and container image scanning, secret detection, and IaC scanning.
  • Manage identities and secrets with Azure Key Vault, managed identities, service principals, and least-privilege RBAC.
  • Support compliance, audit, and vulnerability remediation efforts.

Automation and Low-Code Integration

  • Build ServiceNow integrations using Azure Logic Apps (incident, change request, and approval automation).
  • Develop Power Automate flows and Power Platform solutions to streamline operational and business processes.
  • Automate repetitive operational tasks with PowerShell, Bash, or Python.

Observability and Reliability

  • Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, and Grafana/Prometheus.
  • Participate in incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of SLAs/SLOs.

Required Skills

  • 8+ years of DevOps or cloud engineering experience on Azure
  • Strong hands-on experience with Azure DevOps Pipelines (YAML, classic releases, service connections, agents)
  • Proficiency in Terraform (modules, state management, best practices)
  • Solid knowledge of Docker and AKS (Helm, ingress, RBAC, networking)
  • Experience with SonarQube administration, quality gates, and pipeline integration
  • Scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash, or Python
  • Working knowledge of Git, branching strategies, and code review practices
  • Good to have knowledge on any one language C#, Python
  • Understanding of Azure core services: VNets, Key Vault, Storage, ACR, Entra ID (Azure AD), Azure Monitor

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Azure Logic Apps with ServiceNow integration
  • Power Platform and Power Automate (flows, connectors, custom connectors)
  • Package management expertise (Azure Artifacts, Nexus, JFrog Artifactory)
  • GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or Flux
  • Policy and governance with Azure Policy, OPA, or Checkov
  • Certifications such as AZ-400 (DevOps Expert), AZ-104, AZ-500, CKA, or HashiCorp Terraform Associate
  • Experience with cost optimization (FinOps) on Azure

Soft Skills

  • Strong ownership and a problem-solving mindset
