job.title: Software Engineer, Google Pay, Growth and Communications
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission at Google Pay is to make digital finance simple, safe, and universally accessible.

Operating at an unprecedented scale, our Singapore-based team is the engine behind the overarching Growth and Communications (Comms) platforms. Our Comms infrastructure powers the high-throughput messaging systems required to reliably engage hundreds of millions of users. Simultaneously, under Growth, we fully own high-volume user acquisition channels including our core referral and reward engines that drive massive-scale traffic and generate multi-million dollar business streams.

In this role, you will design and deploy scalable features ranging from our core referral and reward engines to robust, high-throughput communication infrastructure that shape the financial journey for hundreds of millions of users, while leveraging agentic workflows and generative AI tools to accelerate delivery.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design and deploy features across Google Pay’s mobile, web, and backend ecosystems, focusing on seamless Remote Procedure Call (RPC) integration and UI excellence.
  • Lead technical designs for robust backend services and data processing pipelines that support massive-scale growth experiments.
  • Ensure long-term feature reliability by building comprehensive monitoring, alerting, and automated performance tracking.
  • Contribute to engineering excellence by participating in design reviews, improving code quality, and contributing to technical discussions within the team.
  • Leverage DevAI and agentic coding workflows to accelerate end-to-end development, setting a high standard for AI-assisted engineering productivity within the team.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As an Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) Operations Program Manager, you will play a vital role in driving continuous improvement across Google's EHS operations in the APAC region. You will proactively identify, organize, and lead program activities and stakeholders to deliver impactful business, operational, and technical improvements. You will be responsible for scoping, phasing, and leading ambiguous cross-functional and cross-organizational challenges, ensuring alignment of stakeholders across various departments.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of the EHS programs for data center construction in Thailand and other areas in APAC.
  • Work with developers and contractors to align the EHS values and expectations to deliver the projects. Ensure that Project Management Consultancy (PMC) and contractors provide quality services and issues are identified and corrected quickly.
  • Be responsible for identifying and mitigating environmental and safety risks at construction sites, and transition from design to construction to operational activities.

job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.

Why JCI:

Asia-Pacific LinkedIn: [https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/posts/?feedView=all)

Career:

OpenBlue:**

Job Summary

Highly organized and customer-focused Sales Administrator to support our SaaS/HaaS sales organization. This role is critical in managing subscription renewals, processing sales transactions, and ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle—from quote to post-sale validation.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Legal teams to streamline processes and support retention and growth initiatives.

This role requires adherence to software revenue recognition standards in accordance with accounting procedures and company policy. The position reports to the Manager, Global Sales Administration.**

**What will you do?

Renewals & Sales Operations**

  • Track and manage contract renewal cycles for existing customers.
  • Prepare, issue, and follow up on renewal quotes to ensure timely closure.
  • Process sales orders, quotes, and contracts accurately in CRM systems (Salesforce).
  • Support high-volume transaction processing and deal ﬁnalization, particularly during quarter-end close.
  • Prioritize workload and escalate time-sensitive or high-impact deals as needed.**

Cross-Functional Collaboration**

  • Partner closely with Sales and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to align on renewal strategy, customer status, and account-level risks or opportunities.
  • Act as a liaison between customers and internal teams (Sales, Finance, Legal, CSMs) to resolve order, contract, and billing issues.
  • Support internal stakeholders with pricing, documentation, and contract-related inquiries.

Post-Sale Audit & Quality Control

  • Perform post-sale audits to validate order accuracy, pricing, contract terms, and system alignment.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies between quotes, contracts, and booked orders to ensure clean revenue reporting.
  • Proactively recommend process improvements based on audit ﬁndings to reduce errors and improve operational eiciency.

Customer Experience & Service

  • Deliver timely, accurate responses to internal and external inquiries to support a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Support CSMs in ensuring smooth hando from sales to post-sale lifecycle management.
  • Ensure all renewals and sales transactions are completed on time to support revenue targets and customer retention.

Operational Excellence

  • Support continuous process improvement initiatives to enhance scalability and eiciency.
  • Be available for extended hours and ﬂexible scheduling during quarter-end to support global teams and urgent deal activity.**

What we look for?**

  • Bachelor’s degree with 3+ years of experience in Sales Administration (quoting, order management, contract processing) supporting a sales organization.
  • Experience in subscription-based, SaaS, or HaaS business models.
  • Strong understanding of contract management and revenue recognition principles.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Customer Success (CSMs), Sales, Finance, and Legal teams.
  • Proven attention to detail with strong organizational and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication skills with a customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Experience with Salesforce.com or similar CRM systems.
  • Proﬁciency in Microsoft Oice tools.**

Success in this role will be measured by:**

  • Renewal cycle eiciency and on-time completion rates
  • Accuracy of bookings and reduction in post-sale corrections
  • Quality of audit outcomes and compliance adherence
  • Cross-functional satisfaction (Sales, CSM, Finance)**

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

Diversity & Inclusion Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate.  Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: 電子保安系統技術員
job.description:
職位描述

為客戶提供專業的電子保安系統（ELV）安裝、維修及保養服務，確保系統穩定運行。作為前線技術人員，您將負責故障診斷、設備安裝、測試及維修工作，並向客戶提供技術支援及解決方案，以提升客戶滿意度。

職責範圍

  • 負責電子保安系統（ELV）的安裝、測試、調試、維修及保養工作，包括：閉路電視系統（CCTV） 門禁控制系統（Access Control） 防盜警報系統（Security Alarm） 對講機及其他弱電系統
  • 執行現場故障排查、診斷及緊急維修工作。
  • 負責設備佈線、接線、設備安裝及系統測試。
  • 按維修保養計劃定期進行預防性保養服務。
  • 協助系統升級、翻新（Retrofit）及改善工程。
  • 填寫服務報告、維修紀錄及相關技術文件。
  • 與客戶、分判商及內部團隊協調現場工作，確保工程按時完成。
  • 遵守公司安全守則及工程質量要求。

要求資格

必備資歷

  • 持有電子、電機、機電工程或相關證書／文憑；或具備相關工作經驗。
  • 具 1 至 3 年以上 ELV、電子保安系統或相關工程工作經驗。
  • 具 CCTV、門禁系統、保安警報系統安裝及維修經驗。
  • 懂閱讀基本電路圖、接線圖及施工圖則。
  • 良好粵語，一般英語及中文書寫能力。
  • 持有建造業工人註冊證。
  • 持有建造業安全訓練證明書（平安咭）。

優先考慮

  • 持有保安人員許可證（D 類）。
  • 能獨立處理安裝、維修及保養工作。
  • 具備弱電系統故障排查及分析能力。
  • 具良好客戶服務態度及溝通技巧。
  • 工作積極主動、有責任感及團隊合作精神。
  • 持有香港駕駛執照者優先考慮。

job.title: Technical Engineer - Microsoft 365
job.description:
Position Summary

The Senior Collaboration & Messaging Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, support, and continuous improvement of Johnson Controls' Microsoft 365 collaboration and messaging platforms across the APAC region. The role serves as a technical leader for Microsoft Teams, Exchange Online, Microsoft 365 governance, security compliance, and emerging AI-powered workplace technologies.

This position partners with global engineering, operations, security, and business stakeholders to deliver a modern, secure, and productive digital workplace experience for employees worldwide. The engineer acts as the primary collaboration technical resource for APAC while supporting global initiatives and platform transformations.

Key Responsibilities

Microsoft 365 Collaboration

  • Administer and support Microsoft Teams, Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, and related collaboration services.
  • Support collaboration platform migrations, consolidations, and modernization initiatives.
  • Partner with operations teams to resolve escalated collaboration issues.
  • Maintain service health, operational excellence, and user satisfaction.

Messaging & Exchange Online

  • Administer Exchange Online mail flow, transport rules, shared mailboxes, distribution groups, and messaging policies.
  • Support email security initiatives including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
  • Drive mailbox lifecycle management, retention, and archiving strategies.
  • Assist with mergers, acquisitions, and divestitures involving messaging services.

Security & Governance

  • Implement and maintain Microsoft Purview compliance and retention controls.
  • Support data classification, information protection, and governance initiatives.
  • Partner with Cyber Security teams on messaging and collaboration security controls.
  • Ensure compliance with enterprise standards and regulatory requirements.

AI & Digital Workplace Enablement

  • Support Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption and readiness activities.
  • Assist in AI governance and platform enablement initiatives.
  • Identify automation opportunities using Power Automate and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Develop end-user guidance, training, and adoption materials.

Platform Engineering & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in roadmap planning and Microsoft service change management.
  • Evaluate new Microsoft capabilities and recommend adoption strategies.
  • Develop automation scripts and operational efficiencies.
  • Contribute to global standards, architecture reviews, and service improvements.

APAC Regional Leadership

  • Serve as the primary collaboration engineering contact for APAC stakeholders.
  • Coordinate support activities across regional and global teams.
  • Provide technical leadership during incidents and major platform changes.
  • Support executive communications and business-critical collaboration initiatives.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.

Experience

  • 5+ years supporting Microsoft 365 collaboration and messaging platforms.
  • 3+ years administering Exchange Online and Microsoft Teams.
  • Experience supporting multinational enterprise environments.
  • Experience working with global teams across multiple time zones.

Technical Skills

Required:

  • Microsoft Teams Administration
  • Exchange Online
  • Entra ID (Azure AD)
  • Microsoft 365 Administration
  • PowerShell Automation
  • Email Security (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
  • Microsoft Purview Compliance
  • Messaging Routing and Mail Flow

Preferred:

  • Teams Phone
  • Teams Rooms
  • Power Platform
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot
  • Power Automate
  • M&A Tenant Integration Experience
  • ITIL Service Management

Soft Skills

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Ability to influence globally without direct authority
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting capability
  • Customer-focused mindset
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Cross-cultural collaboration experience

Success Measures (First 12 Months)

  • Maintain collaboration service availability and operational KPIs.
  • Reduce manual effort through automation and self-service improvements.
  • Improve governance and compliance posture across collaboration platforms.
  • Support APAC business units with high customer satisfaction.
  • Contribute to Microsoft 365 Copilot and digital workplace transformation initiatives.
  • Lead at least one major collaboration modernization or optimization initiative.

job.title: System Engineer
job.description:
1) Role Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Identify and develop HVAC modernization opportunities within existing Carrier installed base and targeted third-party equipment.
  • Develop relationships with building owners, developers, consultants, facility managers, property managers and key decision makers.
  • Conduct site surveys and assess existing HVAC systems to identify modernization, replacement, retrofit and energy-efficiency opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain a pipeline of modernization opportunities in line with annual sales and gross profit targets.
  • Prepare account strategies and opportunity plans for key customers and strategic buildings.
  • Drive customer engagement from initial opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation and order closing.
  • Work closely with Service, Sales, Application Engineering and other Carrier business units to maximize cross-selling opportunities.

Technical Solution Development

  • Evaluate existing chillers, AHUs, FCUs, pumps, cooling towers, controls/BMS and associated HVAC systems.
  • Develop technically and commercially viable modernization solutions, including:Chiller replacementChiller plant optimizationAHU/FCU replacementHVAC controls and BMS upgradesVariable-speed drive and pump optimizationEnergy-efficiency improvementsRefrigerant transition/HCFC phase-out related modernizationEquipment retrofit and replacementThird-party equipment modernization
  • Work with Application Engineering/factory resources to develop equipment selection, system design and technical proposals.
  • Prepare technical proposals, cost estimates, ROI/payback calculations and energy-saving assessments.
  • Present technical solutions and value propositions to customers and consultants.

Commercial Management

  • Prepare quotations, commercial proposals and tender submissions.
  • Establish project pricing and ensure appropriate gross margin in accordance with Carrier guidelines.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with customers and support contract finalization.
  • Monitor sales pipeline, forecast, order intake and gross profit performance.
  • Ensure all commercial assumptions, exclusions, scope and risks are clearly documented before order acceptance.

Project Handover

  • Conduct a formal handover of every secured modernization project to the Operations/Project team.
  • Ensure all contractual, technical and commercial information is complete before project execution starts.
  • Prepare and submit a Sales-to-Operations Handover Checklist, including:Signed contract/POScope of workApproved quotationTechnical specificationsDrawings and equipment selectionsProject schedulePayment termsPerformance bondInsurance requirementsWarranty requirementsApproved subcontractorsCustomer/consultant requirementsSite constraintsCommercial assumptions and exclusionsAny outstanding technical or commercial risks
  • Remain responsible for customer relationship and commercial support during execution but not for day-to-day project execution, which sits with Operations/Project Management.

Customer & Market Development

  • Build a database of aging HVAC assets and potential modernization opportunities.
  • Develop relationships with consultants to influence specifications and create early-stage opportunities.
  • Monitor competitor activity, market trends, technology development and regulatory requirements.
  • Promote Carrier modernization technologies, energy-efficiency solutions, controls, digital services and sustainability initiatives.
  • Support seminars, technical presentations, customer workshops and industry events.

2) Role Purpose

The Carrier Modernization Sales Engineer is responsible for driving profitable growth of Carrier's HVAC modernization business by identifying, developing and securing modernization opportunities across existing Carrier and third-party HVAC installations.

The role combines technical HVAC knowledge, consultative selling and commercial acumen to develop solutions that address customers' equipment aging, reliability, energy efficiency, sustainability and operational requirements.

The Sales Engineer will own the opportunity from lead generation through order award, including customer engagement, site assessment, solution development, proposal, negotiation and commercial closure.

Upon order award, the Sales Engineer will conduct a formal sales-to-operations handover to ensure a clear transfer of contractual, technical and commercial responsibilities to the Project/Operations team.

The key objective is to grow Carrier Modernization revenue and gross profit while establishing Carrier as the preferred partner for HVAC lifecycle modernization and energy-efficiency solutions.

3) Minimum Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, HVAC/Refrigeration, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or related discipline.
  • Professional engineering certification or relevant HVAC qualification would be an advantage.

Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in HVAC, building services, mechanical engineering, technical sales, service or modernization.
  • Experience in chiller, AHU, FCU, HVAC controls/BMS or central cooling plant is preferred.
  • Proven experience in B2B technical sales, solution selling, tendering or project-based sales.
  • Experience dealing with building owners, developers, consultants, facility management companies and contractors is preferred.

Technical Competencies

  • Good understanding of HVAC systems and central chilled-water plants.
  • Ability to interpret HVAC drawings, equipment schedules, specifications and technical documents.
  • Ability to conduct basic HVAC site assessments and identify modernization opportunities.
  • Understanding of energy efficiency, lifecycle cost, equipment replacement and retrofit solutions.
  • Ability to develop basic ROI/payback and energy-saving calculations.
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD, Microsoft Office and CRM/SAP systems is an advantage.

Commercial Competencies

  • Strong quotation, tender and proposal preparation skills.
  • Good understanding of project costing, pricing, margin and commercial terms.
  • Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage sales pipeline and achieve revenue and gross-profit targets.
  • Strong customer relationship and stakeholder management skills.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong business development and entrepreneurial mindset.
  • Customer-focused and consultative approach.
  • Able to translate technical problems into commercially viable solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating with Engineering, Service and Operations teams.
  • Results-oriented with strong ownership and accountability.
  • Willing to travel to customer and project sites.

job.title: HVAC Apprentice
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

Role Overview

Carrier Australia is looking for a motivated and reliable Air Conditioning Apprentice to join our team. This is an excellent opportunity to learn from experienced HVAC technicians, gain practical industry experience and work towards becoming a qualified Air Conditioning and Refrigeration Technician.

You’ll combine on-the-job training with formal TAFE studies, gaining exposure to the installation, servicing, maintenance, fault finding and repair of HVAC and air conditioning systems.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with the installation, servicing and maintenance of air conditioning and HVAC equipment.
  • Learn how to fault-find and troubleshoot mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Assist with preventative maintenance and servicing.
  • Support the installation and commissioning of HVAC systems.
  • Learn to safely use hand and power tools.
  • Maintain accurate service records and documentation.
  • Follow Carrier’s health, safety, environmental and quality standards.
  • Attend TAFE and complete all required apprenticeship training and assessments.
  • Develop your technical knowledge and practical skills through hands-on experience.
  • Work professionally with customers and colleagues across a range of customer sites.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

You don't need to have extensive industry experience — we're looking for the right attitude, commitment and willingness to learn.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • Genuinely interested in building a career in Air Conditioning and Refrigeration.
  • Hands-on and enjoys working with tools and equipment.
  • Reliable, punctual and committed to completing their apprenticeship.
  • Willing to learn and take direction from experienced technicians.
  • Safety-conscious and committed to doing things the right way.
  • A good communicator who works well as part of a team.
  • Customer-focused and professional.
  • Able to demonstrate good problem-solving and attention to detail.
  • Willing to travel to customer sites as required.
  • Eligible to work in Australia.
  • Holding a current driver's licence, or willing to obtain one as required.

Why Join Carrier?

At Carrier, you'll be joining a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions while building valuable skills for a long-term career.

You'll have the opportunity to:

  • Complete a formal HVAC apprenticeship with TAFE support.
  • Learn from experienced and qualified technicians.
  • Gain hands-on experience across a diverse range of HVAC equipment and applications.
  • Develop highly valued technical and diagnostic skills.
  • Work with industry-leading technology and equipment.
  • Build a long-term career with a globally recognised organisation.
  • Work within a supportive team environment that values safety, quality and continuous development.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.description:
MANAGER, REGIONAL FACILITIES MANAGEMENT - AMEA

Job Level

P4, Manager

Function

Corporate Real Estate & Facilities Management

Location

Shanghai, China

Position Summary

Carrier is seeking an experienced Facilities Management professional to manage facility operations across the AMEA region (Asia Pacific, Middle East & Africa). The role will drive operational excellence, supplier performance, workplace experience, infrastructure reliability, compliance, and continuous improvement across office, manufacturing, laboratory, and support facilities. Working directly with the Global Facilities Management organization, this position will ensure consistent execution of global standards while addressing regional business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Facilities Operations

  • Lead Facilities Management activities across AMEA locations and serve as the primary regional FM contact.
  • Ensure safe, reliable, compliant, and efficient delivery of facility and workplace services.
  • Implement global FM standards, governance requirements, service delivery models, and KPIs across the region.
  • Support business continuity, operational resilience, and facility risk mitigation initiatives.

Supplier and Service Provider Management

  • Manage Integrated Facilities Management (IFM) partners, contractors, and local service providers.
  • Conduct supplier governance and performance reviews, and drive corrective actions and continuous improvement.
  • Support vendor transitions, service standardization, supplier consolidation, contract execution, and commercial management.

Infrastructure, Compliance and EH&S

  • Oversee facility infrastructure and critical building systems, including HVAC, electrical, mechanical, fire protection, utilities, energy, security, and workplace services.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies, EH&S requirements, local regulations, and applicable audit standards.
  • Coordinate facility risk assessments, audits, incident response, remediation, and escalation of critical issues.

Financial and Performance Management

  • Manage regional FM operating budgets, forecasts, annual plans, and performance reporting.
  • Identify and deliver cost reduction, cost avoidance, service optimization, and operational efficiency opportunities.
  • Track spend, supplier performance, facility reliability, service levels, risks, and improvement initiatives.

Projects, Sustainability and Digital Enablement

  • Support office relocations, site consolidations, workplace improvements, facility upgrades, and infrastructure projects.
  • Coordinate facility-related capital projects with business, engineering, procurement, finance, and EH&S stakeholders.
  • Support sustainability, energy efficiency, CAFM/IWMS, analytics, and other global FM transformation programs.

Stakeholder and Global Collaboration

  • Partner with site leadership, Operations, EH&S, HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Act as the connection between AMEA stakeholders and the US-based Global Head of Facilities Management.
  • Provide clear and timely reporting on FM performance, budgets, risks, priorities, and improvement opportunities.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Facilities Management, Real Estate, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive Facilities Management experience in a multinational company, preferably supporting manufacturing and office environments.
  • Practical knowledge of facility operations, building infrastructure, utilities, workplace services, vendor management, and facilities compliance.
  • Experience managing third-party FM service providers and working across multiple sites or countries.
  • Strong financial, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a global, matrixed organization across multiple time zones.
  • Fluent English required; additional AMEA language capability is an advantage.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing facilities across Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and/or Africa.
  • Experience working with global IFM providers or comparable regional service partners.
  • Knowledge of CAFM/IWMS platforms, facility analytics, sustainability, and energy optimization programs.
  • Experience supporting facility transitions, site consolidation, workplace transformation, or infrastructure projects.

Key Success Measures

  • Facility safety, compliance, reliability, and service-level performance.
  • Budget management, cost optimization, and measurable value delivery.
  • Supplier performance, governance effectiveness, and service consistency.
  • Stakeholder satisfaction and workplace experience.
  • Successful implementation of global FM standards and initiatives across AMEA.
  • Continuous improvement in FM operating maturity, data quality, and reporting.

job.title: Data Domain Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Specialist with strong Master Data Management (MDM) expertise to support an enterprise implementation involving SAP MDG, ServiceNow integration, hierarchy build, and high‑quality data validation. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in designing and governing MDM processes, solid understanding of Procure‑to‑Pay (PTP) and Supply Chain End‑to‑End (E2E) process data, and hands‑on knowledge of complex IT landscapes. You will work closely with business stakeholders, process owners, and operational teams, requiring excellent communication skills, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to work under your own initiative.

🔑 Key Requirements

  • 8–11 years overall experience, including 4–5 years in process‑focused roles working directly with data.
  • Strong Master Data Management (MDM) expertise.
  • Experience with SAP MDG‑S process design and governance, with emphasis on Vendor Master Data.
  • Experience integrating SAP MDG with ServiceNow and working across complex IT environments.
  • Experience with large data handling, validation, and data quality management.
  • Experience implementing standardized End‑to‑End (E2E) Supply Chain processes (Plan‑to‑Produce, Procure‑to‑Pay) and applying best‑practice MDM methodologies.
  • Solid understanding of PTP (Procure‑to‑Pay) processes and related master data.
  • Strong knowledge of Vendor lifecycle management (creation, onboarding, maintenance, deactivation) within SAP MDG.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder‑management skills; ability to influence, collaborate, and drive change.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with structured issue‑resolution capability.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into MDM/MDG process design and leverage metrics/KPIs for improvement opportunities.
  • Customer‑service mindset with focus on quality, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.
  • Broad systems/IT implementation experience across SAP and integrated supply chain platforms (e.g., SAP ECC6,SAP Ariba, SAP S/4HANA Supply Chain, warehouse and logistics systems), with proven ability to collaborate effectively with multiple stakeholders in complex business environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet deadlines consistently and deliver high‑quality outputs.
  • Experience designing robust data foundations in partnership with SMEs and key business stakeholders.

🌟 Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA and understanding of its data model.
  • Familiarity with SAP Ariba and supplier collaboration platforms.
  • Knowledge of global compliance requirements (e.g., GDPR, SOX, data privacy regulations).
  • Experience with workflow automation and integration frameworks (e.g., SAP PI/PO, SAP CPI).
  • Understanding of hierarchy management and complex organizational structures.
  • Experience with cloud‑based MDM solutions and hybrid IT landscapes.
  • Ability to design and implement data governance frameworks across multiple geographies.
  • Strong presentation skills and ability to communicate technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Certification in SAP MDG or related SAP modules is a plus.
  • Experience working in global supply chain transformation programs.

job.title: Project Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1) Project delivery – Manage project delivery milestones.

2) Commissioning (Cx) Ownership (Cx1 - Cx5)

Level 0: Design Review - Objective: Review blueprints and plans against the owner's operational requirements.

Level 1: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)/ Factory Witness Test (FWT) - Objective: Inspect major equipment (like Chillers, FWU/AHU, Pump) at the manufacturing site before delivery.

Level 2: Installation Check - Objective: Verify correct on-site delivery and physical installation.

Level 3: Pre-functional Testing - Objective: Test individual components (e.g., electrical circuits and sensor calibrations) to ensure independent functionality.

Level 4: System Testing - Objective: Test integrated subsystems together, including heat-load simulations.

Level 5: Integrated Systems Testing (IST)

  • Objective: Assist Client and to ensure total system redundancy and fail-safe.
  • Stakeholder Coordination & Meeting Leadership
  • LLE Tracking: Attend Long Lead Equipment meetings to track manufacturing and delivery schedules.
  • Cx Alignment: Drive regular Commissioning Coordination meetings with clients and contractors.
  • Issue Resolution: Track, manage, and close out items in the project Cx Issues Log.
  • Documentation & Drawings Control
  • Script Review: Creating standard operating procedures, Method Statements, and Cx scripts.
  • Engineering Data: Manage submittals, single-line diagrams, and As-Built drawings.
  • Handover: Compile ultimate Operations & Maintenance (O&M) manuals for the operations team.
  • Field Support & Troubleshooting
  • On-Site Guidance: Support field engineers and technicians during active Cx.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in electrical, Mechanical, or Commissioning Engineering.
  • Experience: 3+ years of direct data center engineering or technical commissioning experience.
  • MEP Systems: Deep knowledge of Chilled Water Systems, CRAHs, FWU/AHU and Pumps.
  • Software: Proficiency in AutoCAD, Bluebeam Revu, and Cx management platforms (e.g., BIM 360, CxAlloy, Procore).

job.title: Quality Specialist (Assembly)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Pekerjaan Anda Membangun Dunia di Caterpillar.

Ketika Anda bergabung dengan Caterpillar, Anda bergabung dengan tim global yang peduli tidak hanya tentang pekerjaan yang kami lakukan – tetapi juga tentang satu sama lain. Kami adalah pembuat, pemecah masalah, dan pembangun dunia masa depan yang menciptakan komunitas yang lebih kuat dan berkelanjutan. Kami tidak hanya berbicara tentang kemajuan dan inovasi di sini – kami mewujudkannya, bersama dengan pelanggan kami, di tempat kami bekerja dan tinggal. Bersama-sama, kami membangun dunia yang lebih baik, sehingga kita semua dapat menikmati hidup di dalamnya.

Saat ini, kami sedang mencari Quality Specialist (Assembly) untuk bergabung dengan tim Quality kami di Caterpillar Indonesia Batam.

Sebagai Quality Specialist (Assembly) di Caterpillar, Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas masalah Quality yang terjadi di pabrik dan berkolaborasi untuk melakukan perbaikan. Anda juga bertanggung jawab untuk memenuhi semua standar keselamatan, kualitas, dan produktivitas di area produksi kami.

Informasi Tambahan:

Shift: Rotasi

Lokasi Kerja: Batam, Kepulauan Riau

Jenis Pekerjaan: 6 Bulan Kontrak

Anda akan bekerja di lingkungan kantor maupun di area produksi.

Relokasi domestik tidak tersedia untuk posisi ini.

Sebagai seorang Quality Specialist (Assembly) Anda akan:

  • Bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan pengecekan Assembly dan quality secara umum sesuai dengan requirement .
  • Membuat report dan mengupdate ke AQE (All Quality Event)
  • Menandai setiap komponen yang sudah di inspeksi menggunakan tag sesuai dengan disposisinya.
  • Mengkoordinasikan proses perbaikan untuk masalah dimensional.
  • Melakukan pengecekan ulang setiap issue yang yang sudah di perbaiki.
  • Melakukan 5S harian dan memastikan peralatan dalam kondisi baik.
  • Membuat laporan kerja harian

Kandidat yang berhasil harus memiliki:

  • Minimum pendidikan Sekolah Menengah Atas sederajat.
  • Familiar dan bisa menggunakan aplikasi _Microsoft Office_ dengan baik.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja sebagai operator/inspector manufacturing otomotif di utamakan.
  • Bisa membaca gambar teknik.
  • Bisa menggunakan alat ukur dengan baik (Vernier Caliper, Dial Gage, Micrometer, bore gage dll)
  • Komitmen yang kuat terhadap keselamatan dan kualitas.
  • Sifat teliti dan analitis.

Persyaratan Fisik (Dengan atau Tanpa Akomodasi yang Wajar):

  • Pekerjaan ini mungkin memerlukan banyak gerakan aktif di seluruh pabrik termasuk naik turun tangga dan anak tangga, mengangkat peralatan, serta mendorong dan menarik peralatan.

Detail Akhir

Silakan periksa email yang terkait dengan aplikasi Anda secara berkala, termasuk folder sampah/spam, karena ini adalah metode korespondensi utama. Jika Anda ingin mengetahui status aplikasi Anda, silakan gunakan log-in kandidat di situs karir kami untuk mengetahui pembaruan status Anda.

Harap diingat bahwa dalam proses aplikasi, Caterpillar tidak akan pernah meminta pembayaran dalam bentuk apapun. Kami menyarankan Anda untuk mengabaikan tawaran pekerjaan dari individu yang mengaku bekerja untuk atau berafiliasi dengan Caterpillar.

job.title: Parts Inventory Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Processes job requisitions and provides support for supply chain, sourcing, cost, price analyses and contract/purchase order generation.

The Supply Chain Services (SCS) group part of Product Support & Logistics Division currently has a job opening for a “Parts Inventory Analyst” position located in Bangalore, India facility.

Enterprise Logistics Solutions (ELS):

The Enterprise Logistics Solutions (ELS) being part of SCS group is responsible for seamless execution of critical processes for Caterpillar manufacturing facilities in the areas of New Product Introduction (NPI), Material Requirement Planning (MRP), Electronic Data Interface (EDI), Shipping label and Analytics solutions. Supply Chain Services ELS team delivers value by initiating and participating in business-critical projects and solutions.

This role supports RIOP HMS Product Group by leading Supply Chain Guru (Network Inventory Model) activities, inventory optimization, supply chain analytics, and digital solutions aligned with Caterpillar’s OPACC strategy. Key responsibilities include developing network inventory recommendations, improving material availability, optimizing inventory investments, and delivering business insights through Power BI and Power Apps solutions. Through data-driven decision-making, automation, and cross-functional collaboration, the role enhances operational efficiency, inventory health, product readiness, and customer value.

What You Will Do

  • Lead Supply Chain Guru (Network Inventory Model) activities to develop inventory recommendations and optimize inventory investments across the RIOP HMS Product Group.
  • Analyze demand, supply, and inventory trends to improve material availability and support business planning decisions.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and Power Apps solutions to enhance operational visibility and decision-making.
  • Drive inventory optimization initiatives, including surplus reduction, inventory health monitoring, and exception management.
  • Provide analytical support for S&OP, dealer inventory planning, and product readiness reviews.
  • Deliver business intelligence, performance reporting, and actionable insights to supply chain and product group stakeholders.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve process efficiency and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support OPACC objectives, operational excellence, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Degree Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in commerce/science/engineering or equivalent degree
  • Minimum 8-9 years of experience in Supply chain management, Logistics, 3PL, Warehousing, Service parts Logistics.

What You Have

Business Acumen: Knowledge of business concepts, tools, and processes that are needed for making sound decisions in the context of the company's business; ability to apply this knowledge appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Comments on the organization's business model and financial goals.
  • Communicates key considerations for business decision making process.
  • Cites examples of types of information needed to make sound business decisions.
  • Participates in business tasks to get things done in own unit or area.
  • Caters to key stakeholders and their priorities.
  • Apply Supply Chain Guru to generate network inventory recommendations and optimize inventory investments.
  • Analyze demand, supply, and inventory data to improve material availability and business performance.
  • Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards to enable data-driven decision-making.
  • Build Power Apps and automation solutions to streamline processes and improve efficiency.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to drive inventory optimization and operational excellence.
  • Preferably to have working experience with multiple ERP systems like SAP, Mainframe, etc.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to solve complex problems
  • Ability to prioritize and multi-task various responsibilities
  • Independently work on issue resolution and enhancements to existing solutions
  • Strong customer focus and ability to collaborate with cross functional teams

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events, and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains characteristics and steps in an effective decision-making process.
  • Identifies issues and communicates with others when a decision needs to be made.
  • Names decision makers in own environment and cites examples of past decisions.
  • Describes types of decisions incumbent may and may not make in own job or function.

Logistics Management: Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains how improvements in logistics contribute to competitive advantage in the marketplace.
  • Identifies issues and considerations for inbound and outbound logistics.
  • Documents internal and external informative sources or proprietary materials about logistics management.
  • Describes basic logistical processes and sub-processes.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes basic concepts of materials and capacity management processes and procedures.
  • Describes product life cycle and associated MRP cycle.
  • Identifies parameters and considerations used in making decisions about production runs.
  • Describes the use of bills of materials and other documentation needed to provide supplies.

Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Defines the critical workflow for executing key processes.
  • Identifies process problems that limit performance.
  • Implements methods for improving and establishing controls for critical processes.
  • Focuses on the most significant problems to maximize efficiency gains.
  • Surfaces systemic problems to be addressed at the organizational level.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies project management tools and requirements within own function.
  • Describes the key objectives, phases and deliverables of a current project.
  • Explains the concepts of phase, activity, task, and deliverable.
  • Gives examples of critical paths in projects.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes the typical tasks associated with using and managing suppliers.
  • Defines common terms and conditions of agreements with suppliers.
  • Explains the organizational process for soliciting and selecting suppliers.
  • States the roles and responsibilities of one's own and suppliers' staff.

Supply Chain Management - MFG: Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling the logistical processes.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Locates and interprets walk-throughs of the consumption stream and associated provision stream.
  • Identifies goals and objectives of effective supply chain management.
  • Describes major areas associated with supply chain management.
  • Cites multiple examples of waste, high costs and inefficiencies associated with supply chains.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Job Summary

The Distribution Logistics Analyst is responsible for planning Aftermarket parts for New Product Introductions (NPI). This includes analyzing existing processes, implementing enhancements and quality gates to ensure Aftermarket readiness for successful NPI launches, and maintaining parts availability throughout the NPI lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • The role involves close collaboration with Parts Product Specialists (PPS), Parts Product Analysts (PPA), and cross-functional teams to drive proactive actions that improve parts availability.
  • In addition to strategic planning, the incumbent will perform tactical tasks such as managing work allocation, coordinating with cross-functional teams for issue resolution, and handling escalations related to NPI parts planning.
  • The role also includes leading initiatives to build lean supply chain capabilities by applying lean methodologies.
  • The Distribution Logistics Analyst will participate in global projects as a Subject Matter Expert (SME), working collaboratively with internal and external business partners to enhance the overall value chain.
  • The incumbent will communicate effectively across stakeholders to resolve complex issues impacting parts availability and customer satisfaction. Key internal and external partners include Product Groups, Procurement, Inventory Management, Aftermarket Parts Supply, and Operations—ensuring a smooth transition and alignment across functions.

Additional Information:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering with 8–10 years of relevant industry experience in Service Parts, Supply Chain, Inventory Management, and Procurement.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain effective working relationships with global process partners; excellent interpersonal, oral, and written communication skills are essential.
  • Strong technical proficiency in SAS and Microsoft Office tools, including Power BI and PowerApps.

Partnering for Clients' Success: Knowledge of and insight into clients' key objectives and ability to work and think alongside clients to achieve clients' current and future aspirations and successes. Level Basic Understanding:

Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a WBT Performance Validation Engineer. This person will act as an performance simulation engineer, responsible for the development of WBT performance and validation recipes from concept to production for RIOP China WBT product.

This position is responsible for providing engineering to define and optimize trade-offs for product requirements, virtually develop and down select concepts / performance recipes, define performance development requirements / constraints, satisfy standards, and utilize data analytics to maximize product optimization and robustness. The successful candidate will add value both as an individual contributor and as a project leader.

What You Will Do

  • Virtually develop and down-select concepts and performance for new WBT through the use of performance simulation and detailed data analysis.
  • Provide project leadership to a diverse engineering team to define, optimize, and validate trade-offs for product requirements and development constraints.
  • Ensure products satisfy emissions standards and leverage data analytics for enhanced optimization and robustness.
  • Collaborate with customers and leadership to scope and execute projects that meet the needs of the business
  • Accountable for delivering timely, high-quality simulation and analysis impacting products/processes and providing clear recommendations to stakeholders
  • Partner with design, manufacturing, supply chain and test to robustly deliver new products and improve validation processes
  • Keep up-to-date on new technologies and drive continuous improvement to established techniques

Degree RequirementBachelor’s Degree in related Engineering field

What You Will Have:

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Knowledge of tools and techniques of specialized graphics programs; ability to produce, analyze, simulate and test product design drafts.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

IT Manager – Machines Order Management

Job Description

We are seeking an IT Manager – Machines Order Management to join our Technology, Digital and Data organization.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore – Caterpillar PSN / Chennai - WTC

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule.

Shift Timing: 01:00-10:00PM IST

The IT Manager will provide people, technology, solution, delivery, and operational leadership for technology capabilities supporting Machines Order Management. The successful candidate will lead a team of approximately 4–5 Solution Analysts responsible for supporting, enhancing, and modernizing business-critical Order Management solutions.

This role will establish clear priorities and accountability across the team, develop functional and technical capabilities, partner with business and technology stakeholders to understand evolving needs, and ensure effective delivery and ongoing health of Order Management solutions.

The IT Manager will work closely with business stakeholders, Solution Analysts, Product Owners, Solution Architects, engineering teams, data and integration teams, application support teams, and strategic technology partners. The role requires the ability to understand business processes and technology dependencies across an integrated enterprise landscape while providing leadership from strategy and solution definition through delivery, deployment, and operational support.

The successful candidate will combine strong people leadership, business acumen, technical understanding, delivery discipline, stakeholder management, and a digital and AI mindset to build a high-performing team and deliver measurable business value.

What You Will Do

People and Capability Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4–5 Solution Analysts supporting Machines Order Management capabilities.
  • Establish clear roles, responsibilities, application ownership, business capability ownership, goals, and performance expectations across the team.
  • Develop team capabilities in business-process knowledge, functional analysis, application expertise, solution analysis, data, integration, AI, automation, and emerging technologies.
  • Provide regular coaching, feedback, mentoring, and career-development opportunities.
  • Build functional and technical depth within the team and increase the team's ability to independently own and support Order Management solutions.
  • Promote cross-training, succession planning, knowledge sharing, and documentation to reduce dependency on individual subject-matter experts.
  • Assess team capacity, skills, and capability requirements and proactively address gaps affecting delivery or operational support.
  • Foster an environment of accountability, collaboration, innovation, inclusion, continuous learning, and proactive problem solving.
  • Develop future technology leaders by providing meaningful ownership and opportunities for increased responsibility.

Machines Order Management Technology Leadership

  • Provide technology leadership for assigned capabilities across the Machines Order Management landscape.

  • Provide leadership across capabilities such as product configuration, order intake, pricing, scheduling, fulfillment, shipment, invoicing, dealer collaboration, and order visibility.
  • Ensure technology priorities align with business objectives, enterprise architecture, technology strategy, and operational needs.
  • Establish clear ownership and governance across applications and business capabilities.
  • Ensure business needs are evaluated from an end-to-end process and technology perspective rather than within individual applications.
  • Partner with architecture and engineering teams to drive scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable, and supportable solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify and modernize the Order Management technology landscape.
  • Balance delivery of new capabilities with operational stability, modernization, technical debt, cybersecurity, controls, and application health.

Business Partnership and Technology Strategy

  • Build trusted relationships with Order Management business leaders, process owners, product leaders, and technology stakeholders.
  • Understand business strategy, challenges, and priorities and translate them into appropriate technology capabilities and investments.
  • Provide technology guidance and thought leadership regarding solution opportunities, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
  • Facilitate roadmap, prioritization, process-design, and solution discussions with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Partner with Product Owners and business stakeholders to align technology capacity and investment with the highest-value business priorities.

  • Communicate technology strategy, delivery progress, application health, risks, dependencies, and investment needs to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Provide fact-based recommendations when priorities, business needs, and technology constraints compete.

Solution and Architecture Leadership

  • Guide Solution Analysts in understanding business problems, processes, requirements, and desired outcomes before defining technology solutions.
  • Ensure appropriate analysis is performed across processes, applications, integrations, APIs, data, controls, and upstream and downstream dependencies.
  • Partner with Solution Architects, engineers, and other technology specialists to evaluate solution options and technical trade-offs.
  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, data, integration, and technology standards.
  • Promote reuse, standardization, simplification, and sustainable enterprise solution patterns.
  • Challenge unnecessary customization and technical complexity.
  • Ensure solutions appropriately consider scalability, resiliency, security, performance, monitoring, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Ensure technical debt and architectural risks are understood and incorporated into technology planning.
  • Provide leadership and escalation support for complex issues spanning multiple applications or business capabilities.

Delivery and Execution Leadership

  • Provide leadership and accountability for successful delivery of Order Management technology capabilities.
  • Ensure effective coordination across Solution Analysts, Product Owners, architects, engineers, testers, support organizations, and technology partners.
  • Establish disciplined delivery practices for planning, requirements, decision management, issue resolution, risk management, testing, deployment, and stabilization.
  • Ensure functional requirements and technical objectives remain aligned with intended business outcomes.
  • Monitor delivery progress and proactively address risks, dependencies, resource constraints, and barriers.
  • Coordinate dependencies across Order Management applications and related enterprise capabilities.
  • Ensure appropriate functional, technical, business, security, and operational readiness before production deployment.
  • Promote automation of software delivery and testing where appropriate.
  • Ensure delivered capabilities transition successfully into ongoing application ownership and operational support.
  • Drive continuous improvement in planning, analysis, development, testing, release management, and technology delivery practices.

AI, Automation and Digital Enablement

  • Champion the practical use of Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Agentic AI, machine learning, intelligent automation, workflow automation, and advanced analytics across Order Management processes and technology operations.
  • Identify business and technology processes that can be simplified or improved through AI and automation.
  • Build AI and automation skills within the Solution Analyst team and encourage experimentation within appropriate enterprise controls.
  • Partner with business, architecture, data, engineering, and cybersecurity teams to evaluate AI and automation opportunities based on value, feasibility, scalability, data readiness, security, and operational risk.
  • Incorporate AI, automation, and data-driven capabilities into technology roadmaps and improvement opportunities.
  • Identify repetitive, manual, high-volume, or error-prone activities that are candidates for automation.
  • Explore responsible applications of AI and automation to requirements analysis, testing, production support, monitoring, knowledge management, operational insights, and employee productivity.
  • Promote reusable and sustainable enterprise automation approaches rather than isolated point solutions.
  • Ensure AI-enabled solutions align with applicable enterprise architecture, data, security, governance, and responsible AI expectations.
  • Establish measures for adoption, productivity improvement, operational performance, and business value from AI and automation initiatives.

Operational Excellence and Application Health

Strategic Stakeholder and Partner Management

AI and Automation Skills Required

  • Ability to partner effectively with AI, data, architecture, engineering, cybersecurity, and business teams to implement sustainable enterprise solutions.
  • Strong digital mindset with a demonstrated commitment to learning and applying emerging technologies.

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: SAP Basis Consultant
job.description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

Responsibilities

  • SAP System Administration: Perform daily SAP Basis operations, including system monitoring, performance tuning, background job management and transport management. Administer S/4HANA development, quality, production and sandbox environments, conduct regular health checks, and support kernel upgrades, support packages and patch management.
  • SAP Fiori Administration: Manage the SAP Fiori landscape, including gateway configuration, OData service activation, catalogue and launchpad administration, cache management and front-end performance troubleshooting.
  • SAP BTP and Cloud ALM: Manage integrations and extensions deployed on SAP BTP, configure subaccounts, destinations, Cloud Connector and trust between BTP and S/4HANA, and support deployment of CAP or UI5 applications. Use SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, alerting, dashboards and change management.
  • Shared Services Operations: Own assigned technical incidents and service requests within agreed service levels, maintain monitoring checklists and runbooks, and provide clear handover across regions and time zones.
  • Transport and Change Control: Import transports only against approved change records, maintain transport logs and evidence, enforce production change controls, and support release and deployment windows.
  • Landscape and Integration Support: Maintain and document the SAP landscape across private cloud and connected systems, coordinate with infrastructure, network and security teams, and troubleshoot RFC, IDoc, API and SAP Integration Suite connectivity issues.
  • Vendor and Provider Coordination: Coordinate with SAP and the private cloud operations provider for platform maintenance, upgrades, refreshes, incidents and service requests, understanding the split of responsibilities under RISE with SAP, and track them to closure.
  • Security, Backup and Compliance: Support user administration and privileged access procedures in coordination with the security team, support backup, disaster recovery testing and high availability arrangements, and produce evidence for IT general controls, SOX and audit requests.
  • Projects and Continuous Improvement: Provide technical input to upgrade, migration, rollout and enhancement projects, recommend tools and automation to improve Basis operations, and maintain operating procedures and technical documentation.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field.
  • At least 5 to 8 years of hands-on SAP Basis experience, including S/4HANA administration in production environments.
  • Proven experience managing Fiori, SAP BTP and SAP Cloud ALM environments.
  • Experience in RISE with SAP or S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition landscapes, with a clear understanding of the customer and provider responsibility split, is strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of SAP Basis concepts, including system refresh, client copies, transports, RFCs and background jobs, and SAP HANA administration and performance optimisation.
  • Experience with Fiori Launchpad, OData services and front-end troubleshooting, and familiarity with BTP subaccounts and Cloud Connector.
  • Working knowledge of SAP Cloud ALM, Solution Manager or Focused Run, and of Linux, Windows and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.
  • Understanding of SAP security and authorisation concepts, and experience producing technical evidence for IT general controls and audit.
  • Experience working in a shared services or managed service environment with service level targets, ITIL-aligned processes and multi-country stakeholders.
  • SAP Certified Technology Associate in S/4HANA System Administration, SAP BTP Administration certification and ITIL Foundation are preferred.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication and documentation skills, with ownership, accountability and willingness to support outside standard hours for planned maintenance.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Network Software Engineer - Observability & AI - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Network Software Engineer to join the Network Observability team within Equinix's platform engineering organization. This role sits at the intersection of network engineering, AI-native development, and Observability platform development. You will design and build intelligent Network APIs grounded in real-time observability data, network asset intelligence, and inventory systems — then expose those capabilities via Model Context Protocol (MCP), API’s, Streams and autonomous agents that power self-service experiences for Equinix customers and internal operators.

You will work closely with Network architects, product teams, platform architects, and data engineers to translate raw network telemetry into programmable, AI-consumable services. You will mentor junior engineers and set the technical direction for how network intelligence is surfaced, automated, and governed across Equinix's global infrastructure.

What you will build

In this role, you will have direct ownership over a genuinely novel engineering problem: making Equinix's global network intelligence programmable by both humans and AI. Concretely, you will ship:

  • AI-native Network APIs — high-fidelity, low-latency APIs that expose real-time observability signals and network asset data as structured, agent-queryable surfaces
  • MCP Servers for Network Capabilities — production MCP implementations that let any compatible AI agent safely query network health, inspect topology, validate configurations, and trigger network self-service workflows
  • Autonomous Network Agents — intelligent agents that help Equinix customers and operators accomplish network tasks through natural language: diagnosing circuit issues, modeling capacity scenarios, and automating routine change workflows
  • Observability-Grounded Intelligence — systems that ground every AI inference in live, authoritative network data, ensuring agents operate with current topology, accurate asset inventory, and real-time health signals

Responsibilities

Requirements Analysis

  • Translate complex network and observability requirements into clear API contracts and data models
  • Partner with product managers and business analysts to convert network observability use cases — latency anomaly detection, capacity thresholds, topology drift — into actionable engineering requirements
  • Evaluate feasibility across the full data stack: streaming telemetry pipelines, asset inventory systems, and AI inference layers

Software Architecture & Design

  • Participate in and drive architectural reviews for AI-native Network API platforms
  • Define reference architectures for exposing network intelligence via MCP servers, ensuring agents can safely query, reason over, and act on live network data
  • Design systems that integrate observability data sources (streaming telemetry, SNMP, flow data, topology graphs) with inventory and asset repositories as a unified programmable layer
  • Lead the design of AI-native Network APIs that serve both human developers and autonomous AI agents as first-class consumers
  • Architect MCP tool and resource definitions that expose network capabilities — topology queries, health checks, capacity lookups, change simulations — as structured, agent-callable interfaces
  • Design agentic workflows for network self-service: automated troubleshooting, circuit provisioning assistance, and proactive anomaly remediation
  • Evaluate and recommend open source frameworks (LangGraph, LlamaIndex, OpenTelemetry, gRPC, GraphQL) to accelerate network intelligence delivery

Development & Coding

  • Build production-grade Network APIs in Python or Java that consume observability telemetry, asset inventory, and topology data
  • Implement MCP servers that expose network capabilities as callable tools and data resources for LLM-powered agents
  • Develop agentic pipelines — using frameworks such as LangGraph or similar — that enable customers to perform network self-service tasks through natural language and structured tool calls
  • Integrate across observability stacks (Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Kafka, Grafana Loki) and network asset systems to create coherent, queryable data surfaces
  • Apply AI-native development practices: prompt-engineered tool definitions, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) from network knowledge bases, structured outputs for agent decision loops
  • Participate in peer code reviews and champion standard coding practices across the team

Testing

  • Develop unit and integration tests for Network APIs, MCP server endpoints, and agent tool invocations
  • Build test harnesses that simulate agent interactions with MCP-exposed network capabilities to validate safety, accuracy, and latency bounds
  • Define testing strategies for agentic systems — including adversarial prompts, tool misuse scenarios, and multi-step reasoning failures
  • Recommend and adopt appropriate testing frameworks (pytest, contract testing, LLM evaluation suites)

DevOps

  • Define deployment and release guidelines for AI-native network services, including canary strategies for MCP server rollouts
  • Manage environment planning for observability data pipelines, agent runtimes, and network API backends
  • Document software configuration management practices and educate cross-functional teams on agentic deployment patterns and MCP lifecycle management

Software Reliability & Support Engineering

  • Maintain and continuously enrich the inventory of production network APIs, MCP servers, agent workflows, and observability pipelines
  • Prepare application support documentation covering agent failure modes, tool call error handling, and network API degradation runbooks
  • Troubleshoot production issues across the AI-native stack: data pipeline gaps, agent reasoning failures, and MCP tool contract violations

Customer & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Collaborate with Equinix customers and internal NOC teams to co-design self-service network experiences powered by AI agents
  • Translate customer network pain points — capacity planning friction, manual troubleshooting cycles, slow provisioning — into agent-driven automation capabilities
  • Represent Network Observability engineering in cross-functional forums on AI platform strategy and network developer experience

R&D & Innovation

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and networking technologies: new LLM capabilities, MCP protocol evolution, network foundation models, and vector-native data systems
  • Prototype and evaluate AI-native approaches to network observability: anomaly detection agents, natural language network queries, and predictive capacity agents
  • Contribute to Equinix's internal AI engineering community by sharing learnings from agentic network system design

Qualifications

Skills Required

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a focus on platform, infrastructure, or network software systems
  • Demonstrated experience building APIs that consume observability, telemetry, or network data at scale
  • Proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend API and data pipeline development
  • Hands-on experience with AI/LLM application development: prompt engineering, tool calling, RAG pipelines, or agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, or equivalent)
  • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) — either as a server implementer or consumer — or demonstrated ability to rapidly adopt structured AI tool interface specifications
  • Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, Kafka, or similar streaming/metrics platforms
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred

  • Networking Certification or demonstratable understanding of network concepts: BGP, MPLS, VLANs, IP addressing and similar
  • Familiarity with network inventory systems, CMDB/DCIM platforms, or graph-based topology data stores
  • Background in agentic system design: multi-agent orchestration, tool safety guardrails, and structured agent output validation
  • Experience with vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector, Weaviate) for RAG-backed network knowledge retrieval

job.description:
