Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company, operating 280+ data centers across the globe and providing interconnections to all the key clouds and networks. Businesses need one place to simplify and bring together fragmented, complex infrastructure that spans private and public cloud environments. Our global platform allows customers to place infrastructure wherever they need it and connect it to everything they need to succeed.

We are a fast-growing global company with 20 years of consecutive quarterly growth. Through our innovative portfolio of high-performance products and services, we have created the largest, most active global ecosystem of 10,000+ companies, including 2,100 networks and 3,000+ cloud and IT service providers in 32 countries spanning six continents.

Joining our operations team means that you will be at the forefront of all we do, maintaining critical facilities infrastructure as part of a close-knit team delivering best-in-class service to our data center customers. We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment. that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.

job.title: Manager, Risk & Compliance
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

To provide governance, compliance and para-legal support to the business, including the review of commercial contracts and NDAs, identification and management of contractual and compliance risks, and implementation of effective governance policies and controls, with appropriate escalation of material legal matters to Legal.

Role Purpose

The Governance & Compliance Manager supports the organisation in strengthening its governance, compliance and contractual risk management framework. The role provides para-legal and governance support for the review and administration of commercial contracts, NDAs, MOUs and other business agreements, works closely with business stakeholders to identify and address contractual and compliance risks, and escalates material or complex legal matters to Legal where appropriate.

The role also supports the implementation and monitoring of corporate governance policies, regulatory and compliance requirements, internal controls, and related governance initiatives across the organisation.

**

Key Responsibilities

1. Contract & Para-Legal Support

  • Review and provide comments on commercial contracts, NDAs, confidentiality agreements, vendor/customer agreements and other business documents based on established company policies, templates and risk parameters.
  • Identify key contractual risks, including liability, indemnity, termination, confidentiality, data protection, intellectual property, warranties and compliance obligations.
  • Support contract negotiations and coordinate proposed amendments with relevant business stakeholders.
  • Provide practical guidance to business teams on contractual requirements and obligations.
  • Maintain appropriate contract review records, approvals and supporting documentation.
  • Work closely with Legal and escalate complex, high-risk or material legal issues for formal legal advice.

2. Governance & Compliance

  • Support the development, implementation and continuous improvement of governance and compliance policies, procedures and controls.
  • Monitor adherence to internal policies, delegated authorities and corporate governance requirements.
  • Advise business teams on governance requirements and appropriate approval processes.
  • Support compliance reviews, internal assessments and remediation of identified gaps.
  • Monitor and support compliance with applicable requirements relating to areas such as anti-bribery and corruption, conflicts of interest, data protection, sanctions and trade compliance.

3. Risk & Internal Controls

  • Assist in identifying governance, contractual and compliance risks arising from business activities and transactions.
  • Work with business and functional teams to establish appropriate mitigating controls.
  • Track material compliance issues, exceptions and corrective actions through to closure.
  • Support internal and external audits and respond to governance and compliance-related information requests.

4. Business Advisory & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a governance and compliance point of contact for business teams.
  • Provide practical and commercially balanced guidance while ensuring appropriate governance and risk management.
  • Work closely with Sales, Procurement, Finance, Operations, HR, Information Security and other functions on contractual and compliance matters.
  • Conduct briefings and awareness sessions on governance, compliance and contracting requirements.

Requirements

  • Degree or diploma in Law, Legal Studies, Business, Corporate Governance, Compliance or a related discipline.
  • Approximately 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in governance, compliance, contract management, para-legal or corporate legal support.
  • Practical experience reviewing commercial contracts and NDAs is strongly preferred.
  • Good understanding of contractual principles and the ability to identify commercial and legal risks.
  • Familiarity with corporate governance, compliance, internal controls and risk management frameworks.
  • Strong analytical skills with good attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain contractual and compliance matters in practical business terms.
  • Able to work independently, exercise sound judgement and recognise matters requiring escalation to Legal or senior management.
  • Experience within a technology, ICT, systems integration, engineering or regional business environment would be advantageous.

Key Competencies

  • Contract review and risk identification
  • Governance and compliance
  • Para-legal support
  • Commercial awareness
  • Risk and control mindset
  • Strong judgement and attention to detail
  • Stakeholder management
  • Clear and concise drafting
  • High level of integrity and confidentiality

job.title: Operational Readiness Specialist
job.description:
• Lead the operational readiness and acceptance of major projects, ensuring a seamless transition from delivery into operations!
  • Join a passionate, high-performing organisation, during an exciting period of growth
  • Role location flexible - can be based in Sydney or Canberra

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

Playing a crucial role from within our Operations Engineering team, the Operations Readiness Specialist will be responsible for supporting across assurance frameworks, audit documentation, and site best practice; ultimately ensuring consistent operational readiness across our broader organisation. Through clearly defining compliance criteria and standards, in conjunction with risk analysis and data modelling, this role will see the successful candidate driving quality uplift and reducing variability across our sites and functions.

  • Lead the operational readiness and acceptance of major projects, ensuring a seamless transition from delivery into operations.
  • Coordinate stakeholders across construction, commissioning and operational teams to drive readiness activities, manage risks and achieve key milestones.
  • Manage the Ready for Operations (RFO) process across assigned transition programs, ensuring requirements, documentation and acceptance criteria are met before handover.
  • Monitor and report on project readiness, including risks, actions, compliance obligations and operational acceptance outcomes.
  • Continuously improve operational readiness frameworks, governance processes and assurance activities to support consistent delivery across the portfolio.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

The successful candidate will combine a demonstrated understanding of functional assurance or operational improvement from within an industrial or commercial setting (e.g. construction, building and maintenance services, data centre environments), with a proactive, solutions-focused approach to ultimately drive outcomes. If you possess experience in developing and maintaining frameworks, analysing key operational data, and effectively translating complex, technical requirements into understandable processes and terms - we'd love to hear from you!

  • Previous experience within construction, infrastructure, data centre, facilities, or trade services coordination/program management.
  • Previous experience within designing, implementing, and monitoring performance and assurance metrics.
  • Comfortability in collaborating and coaching internal stakeholders to maintain adherence to compliance requirements.
  • Data-driven, solutions-focused, with a high level of attention to detail both written and verbal.
  • Developed data analytics skillset, with proficiency in dashboard reporting and modelling tools (such as Power BI).
  • Deep understanding of compliance frameworks, audit readiness, and risk management principles.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: 24/7 Service Technician (HVAC/Electrical)
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia’s leading data centres.

  • Sydney's team is expanding with a new Data Centre. Join our team as we continue to grow in 2026.
  • Critical Infrastructure experience or HVAC or Electrical trades are desired
  • Tailored CDC Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are responsive, innovative and trusted in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

Data centre experience isn’t required. We welcome people from a range of hands‑on technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.

Benefits, Training and Offerings:

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You have experience working in environments where reliability, safety, and procedure matter - whether that’s through an electrical, HVAC, mechanical, or broader critical infrastructure background.

You might be a qualified electrician or HVAC technician looking to move away from a traditional tools‑based role and into operations, or someone earlier in their technical career who is curious about how large‑scale, mission‑critical environments operate.

Regardless of background, we value motivation, strong attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and develop within a growing industry.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

  • Australian citizenship and ability to obtain, an NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community, and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: Lead - Treasury
job.description:
Responsibilities

Treasury & Liquidity Management

  • Lead treasury operations, cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, and fund management across the business.
  • Develop short-term and long-term cash flow plans to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
  • Drive working capital optimization initiatives and improve cash conversion cycles.
  • Monitor fund utilization, liquidity positions, borrowing costs, and treasury risk exposure.
  • Coordinate with Group Treasury for fund deployment, cash pooling, and liquidity management strategies.

Fund Raising & Project Finance

  • Lead end-to-end fund-raising activities for existing and upcoming projects.
  • Manage project financing, including lender engagement, financial closure, documentation, drawdowns, and disbursements.
  • Evaluate and implement optimal financing structures through debt, equity, structured finance, and hybrid instruments.

Banking Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with banks, financial institutions, NBFCs, investors, and rating agencies.
  • Negotiate competitive pricing, credit facilities, banking limits, and financing terms.
  • Lead consortium banking arrangements and multi-bank financing structures.
  • Manage enhancement and renewal of working capital and project finance facilities.

Trade Finance & Banking Operations

  • Manage end-to-end trade finance transactions, including: Import & Export Letters of Credit (LCs)
  • Bank Guarantees (BGs)
  • Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs)
  • Buyers' and Suppliers' Credit

Oversee issuance, amendments, negotiations, renewals, and closure of trade finance instruments.Ensure timely settlement of import/export transactions and compliance with banking obligations.Debt Management & Compliance

  • Manage debt portfolio, including drawdowns, repayments, refinancing, interest servicing, and covenant monitoring.
  • Ensure compliance with financing agreements, lender reporting, and debt covenants.
  • Prepare CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, utilization certificates, and banking MIS.
  • Ensure compliance with RBI, FEMA, banking regulations, and trade finance guidelines.
  • Monitor documentation, statutory submissions, and regulatory reporting requirements.

Forex & Risk Management

  • Manage foreign exchange exposures arising from imports, exports, borrowings, and cross-border transactions.
  • Develop and implement hedging strategies through forward contracts and other treasury products.
  • Monitor interest rate and currency risks and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Ensure adherence to treasury risk management frameworks and policies.

Treasury Digitalization & Process Excellence

  • Drive treasury automation initiatives and implementation of digital banking platforms.
  • Improve treasury workflows through technology-enabled solutions and process optimization.
  • Establish treasury controls, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Enhance operational efficiency through dashboarding, automation, and reporting tools.

MIS & Leadership Reporting

  • Prepare treasury dashboards, cash position reports, debt reports, banking MIS, and fund utilization reports.
  • Present key treasury metrics and funding updates to senior management.
  • Provide actionable insights on liquidity, borrowing costs, treasury risks, and capital deployment.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • CA / MBA (Finance) / CFA / FRM from a reputed institution.
  • Additional certification in Treasury, Project Finance, Financial Modelling, or Risk Management will be preferred.

Experience

  • 15-20+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Project Finance, Corporate Finance, or Fund Raising.
  • Proven experience in large manufacturing, metals, mining, natural resources, infrastructure, power, EPC, or capital-intensive industries.
  • Extensive exposure to project funding, structured finance, lender negotiations, and debt management.
  • Experience in handling multi-bank arrangements, consortium financing, and large capital expenditure projects.

job.title: Manager - Banking & Treasury
job.description:
• Manage daily liquidity, cash positioning, and fund availability to ensure uninterrupted business operations.
  • Prepare short-term and long-term cash flow forecasts, including weekly, monthly, quarterly, and rolling forecasts.
  • Monitor and optimize working capital requirements while minimizing borrowing and financing costs.
  • Ensure effective utilization of fund-based and non-fund-based banking facilities, including CC, OD, LC, BG, and SBLC limits.
  • Coordinate with banks for sanction, renewal, enhancement, and monitoring of banking facilities.
  • Manage end-to-end trade finance transactions, including Import/Export LCs, DA/DP Bills, Buyer's Credit, and Supplier's Credit.
  • Handle issuance, amendment, negotiation, advising, renewal, and closure of Letters of Credit (LCs).
  • Manage Bank Guarantees (BGs), Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs), and other non-fund-based banking instruments.
  • Review LC and BG terms to ensure compliance with contractual, commercial, and banking requirements.
  • Ensure timely processing and settlement of import payments, export collections, and trade-related obligations.
  • Drive working capital optimization initiatives through Factoring, Bill Discounting, Supply Chain Finance, and Channel Financing.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with banks and financial institutions for treasury support and cost optimization.
  • Monitor forex exposure arising from import/export transactions and execute hedging strategies to mitigate currency risks.
  • Track banking limits utilization, borrowing levels, and fund deployment to maximize financial efficiency.
  • Prepare and submit CMA data, stock statements, drawing power calculations, and covenant compliance reports to lenders.

  • Monitor bank charges, interest costs, and financing expenses, and recommend measures for cost reduction.

Qualifications

  • CA / MBA (Finance) with relevant treasury experience.
  • 8 years of experience in Treasury, Banking Operations, Working Capital Management, or Trade Finance.
  • Experience in trading, manufacturing, mining, metals, energy, or infrastructure sectors preferred.

job.title: Team Lead - Insurance
job.description:
**

Responsibilities

Risk Transfer Strategy Execution & Insurance Management

  • Lead the assessment of emerging global risks, including climate-related, cyber, and geopolitical risks, to ensure the group’s insurance portfolio remains adaptive.
  • Support the Group Head in the reinsurance procurement process for high-value and complex risks, collaborating with reinsurers to secure optimal coverage for emerging risks.
  • Lead the insurance needs analysis for new assets, acquisitions, and business ventures by coordinating with business units and technical teams to assess operational risks.
  • Ensure proper coverage for all new acquisitions and ventures by engaging with local insurers and reinsurers.
  • Ensure timely endorsements for new assets or additional coverage needs, minimizing exposure to risk by guaranteeing that insurance is in place before assets become operational.

Comprehensive Insurance Renewal

  • Lead the annual insurance renewal process for all assets and liabilities, ensuring that insurance terms are reviewed and adjusted based on changes in asset values and risk profiles.
  • Collaborate with the CFO (Chief Financial Officer) and Financial Controller to ensure approval of the renewal strategy before proceeding to market, and maintain constant communication to update them on any changes.
  • Engage with the market to obtain competitive renewal terms, negotiating directly with insurers and reinsurers to achieve the best possible premium rates and coverage conditions.

Request for Proposals (RFPs) Management

  • Manage the preparation and issuance of Request for Proposals (RFPs) for various types of insurance, ensuring clear communication of the group’s requirements to insurers.
  • Lead the creation of NFAs (Notes for Approval) to ensure adherence with corporate governance standards.

Claims Management & Settlements

  • Lead the claims management process, ensuring efficient assessment, documentation, and settlement in compliance with policy terms.
  • Collaborate with third-party adjusters and surveyors to ensure accurate claims evaluation and timely settlement.
  • Lead the development of data analytics framework for forecasting claims trends, improving decision-making, and reducing the risk of future claims.
  • Lead the digitization of policy and claims documentation, ensuring all records are easily accessible and stored in a central repository.

Market Relations

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with local and global insurers, reinsurers, and InsurTech companies to secure competitive quotes and favourable terms.
  • Negotiate with insurance brokers to ensure alignment between the group’s risk profile and available coverage.
  • Actively engage with facultative reinsurers when necessary, securing reinsurance policies either through direct outreach or intermediaries to cover high-value or complex risks.

Insurance Operations & Process Standardization

  • Lead the execution of standardization of insurance processes across the organization, ensuring consistency in policy procurement, claims reporting, and documentation management.
  • Supervise the development and integration of standardized insurance-related forms, ensuring compliance and efficiency across business units.

Negotiation and Finalization of Insurance Policies

  • Lead multi-round negotiations with insurers to finalize terms for both new policies and renewals, focusing on achieving the best coverage limits, deductibles, and premiums.
  • Ensure accurate communication of risk details and coverage to the insurers.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with insurance regulations, including SEBI, IRDAI, and regional standards, across the group’s insurance activities.
  • Lead preparation of compliance reports, including insurance certifications and auditor reports for statutory filings.
  • Work closely with legal and compliance teams to ensure that all insurance contracts align with corporate policies and regulatory standards.

Risk Identification & Business Interface

  • Lead identification of new and emerging risks across the group’s operations, ensuring effective mitigation strategies are implemented.
  • Lead the establishment of a robust third-party risk management framework, ensuring vendors, suppliers, and contractors working with the group are covered by appropriate liability insurance.
  • Collaborate with business units to update the insurance portfolio, addressing changes in the risk landscape.

Digitization and Automation

  • Lead the digitization of the insurance function, including the development of a centralized bid management system to streamline procurement and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Drive automation of insurance-related processes, including the development of a digital insurance management system to generate automated workflows for claims management, premium payments, and coverage renewals.
  • Integrate AI-driven tools for predictive risk modelling to optimize coverage, minimize premium costs, and improve operational efficiency.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration and Stakeholder Management

  • Align with the Group Head Insurance on market trends, pricing shifts, and underwriting criteria that could impact the group’s strategies.
  • Collaborate with internal departments (finance, legal, technical) to ensure alignment between insurance requirements and business objectives.
  • Liaise with the legal department to ensure policy interpretations are aligned with business interests.
  • Manage the interface between business units and insurers, ensuring seamless communication regarding evolving insurance needs.

People and Team Management

  • Ensure insurance team members are aligned with business strategy and insurance objectives, providing them with career development opportunities.
  • Oversee team performance, supporting continuous development and departmental excellence in line with organizational goals.
  • Cultivate an environment conducive to collaboration, enabling the team to thrive within the dynamic landscape of the energy sector.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • CFO (Chief Financial Officer)
  • Financial Controller
  • Business Unit Heads
  • Legal Team
  • ABEX Team
  • Technical Teams
  • Senior Leadership

External Stakeholders:

  • Local Insurance Companies
  • Reinsurers
  • Insurance Brokers
  • Surveyors and Loss Adjusters
  • Facultative Reinsurance Providers

Qualifications

Qualifications

B.E./ B.Tech., Additional MBA in Insurance or additional insurance qualifications preferred

Experience

Minimum 14 - 16 years of experience in corporate insurance, underwriting, or risk management roles, with significant experience in negotiating with insurers and reinsurers.

Industry Preferred:

Background in Power and Energy sector preferred with an understanding of both local and international insurance markets and the ability to engage with facultative reinsurers for complex risks.

job.title: Critical Facilities Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

This role is responsible for the hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment. The Facility Technician will monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems, carry out preventive maintenance, respond to incidents and alarms, and coordinate with vendors to ensure the facility remains safe, reliable, and aligned with company standards.

This role works in rotating shifts, including nights and weekends, and will work closely with the Facilities and Data Center Operations teams, vendors, contractors, and other internal stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, and BMS.
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections in accordance with schedules and standard operating procedures.
  • Respond to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies, performing initial troubleshooting and escalating issues as required.
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors during planned and unplanned work, including supervising on-site activities.
  • Record shift logs, maintenance activities, and incident reports accurately and on time.
  • Follow change management, permit-to-work, and lockout/tagout procedures for all work on critical systems.
  • Support shift handovers to ensure continuity of operations and clear communication of system status.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity.
  • Perform other facility operations and maintenance-related duties as assigned.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Refrigeration/HVAC, or a related technical field.
  • 1–2 years of experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems; experience in data center, telecom, or other critical environments is preferred.
  • Solid understanding of electrical and mechanical systems, with the ability to read technical drawings and single-line diagrams.
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends.
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions.
  • Detail-oriented, responsible, with a strong safety mindset and the ability to stay calm and act quickly when handling alarms and incidents.
  • Good teamwork and communication skills.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., K3 Listrik, K3 Umum, or HVAC/refrigeration certification) and familiarity with BMS/SCADA systems are an advantage.
  • Fluent in English and proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.

job.title: Health and Safety Manager, India and Malaysia
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Head of Health and Safety, this is a people-leadership role with Country Leads / Managers of Health and Safety reporting directly into the position. The role works closely with Construction, Operations, and regional and country leadership teams to drive consistent execution of Health and Safety standards, strengthen governance and capability, and maintain regulatory compliance across construction and operational lifecycles.

This role will be based in Singapore, with regular travel across the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Provide egional Health and Safety input into project development and transition from design through construction, commissioning, and operations, ensuring key risks and controls are understood and effectively managed.
  • Oversee Health and Safety risk management across construction and operational activities operating concurrently within the same perimeter, ensuring safe segregation, interface management, and coordination between construction and operations teams over multi-year build-out programs.
  • Provide regional Health and Safety input into project handover from design to construction, ensuring key risks and controls identified during design are understood and managed on site.
  • Directly manage Country Leads / Managers of Health and Safety, providing direction, coaching, and performance oversight to strengthen capability and accountability across the region.
  • Build a strong regional Health and Safety team through talent development, training, and succession planning across country-level leadership
  • Drive consistent implementation of corporate Health and Safety systems, standards, and procedures across all covered markets.
  • Monitor regional Health and Safety performance, trends, and leading indicators to identify systemic risks and drive accountability at country level, and communicate key risks and improvement priorities to regional and country leadership.
  • Review significant Health and Safety incidents and high-potential events across the region, ensuring robust investigations, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and cross-country application of lessons learned..
  • Provide Health and Safety input into contractor and vendor prequalification, selection, performance reviews, and ongoing assurance activities across the region.
  • Engage with regional Construction and Operations leadership to manage high-risk activities, emerging risks, and significant Health and Safety issues.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Health and Safety and environmental regulatory requirements, including oversight of ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 management system conformance across covered markets..
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives and strengthen Health and Safety culture, capability, and accountability across the region.
  • Support Health and Safety inputs for customer requirements, lender engagements, and external stakeholder reporting where required.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health and safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline, with recognized professional Health and Safety qualifications or certifications.
  • 15+ years of progressive Health and Safety experience, including significant regional leadership experience across large-scale construction and/or operational environments.
  • Proven experience in Health and Safety leadership and risk management within large-scale, complex, mission-critical or high-risk environments, including data centers, pharmaceutical, chemical, or process industries.
  • Proven experience directly managing and developing Health and Safety teams across multiple sites or countries, including performance management, coaching, and capability building of direct reports.
  • Strong track record influencing senior regional leadership, Construction and Operations teams, contractors, and other stakeholders to achieve measurable Health and Safety performance improvements.
  • Strong knowledge of international Health and Safety standards, risk management principles, and experience navigating regulatory requirements across multiple Asian markets.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide Health and Safety leadership across construction, commissioning, and live operational environments, with regular travel across the region.
  • Fluent in English; additional Hindi / Thai / Indonesian / Malay language capability is an advantage.

“If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.”

job.title: TA Team Lead, Indonesia
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Head of Talent Acquisition, Asia, the Team Lead, Talent Acquisition, Indonesia will lead our in-house TA team in Jakarta and own hiring for Digital Edge and our Fiber business across Indonesia.

  • *

Indonesia is our largest hiring market in Asia Pacific. We are building out multiple data centre sites around Jakarta, and most of our demand is site and shift hiring for operations, alongside engineers, project roles and specialist hires for our Jakarta Centre of Excellence. This is a player coach role. You will lead a small team, carry the senior and critical roles yourself, and run a hiring engine that keeps our sites staffed on time.

  • *

You will also set the standard for how hiring decisions are made in Indonesia. Offers and approvals that are clear, written and transparent, with every open question owned and closed.

  • *

Key responsibilities

  • *
  • Lead the team. Lead, coach and develop 2 TA Partners and a TA Coordinator. Set weekly priorities, review every pipeline and hold the team to clear service standards
  • Balance the book. Allocate requisitions so no recruiter carries more than 20 to 25 live roles. Rebalance early when demand shifts and raise capacity risks before they hit start dates
  • Carry the critical roles. Personally own senior, critical and confidential Indonesia hires from intake to offer
  • Own the hiring plan. Translate the approved headcount budget into a hiring plan by site, function and quarter, and forecast recruiter capacity ahead of demand
  • Run the volume engine. Run career days, job expos and vocational and university partnerships for technician and operations hiring, and keep warm talent pools for repeat roles
  • Source directly. Build direct sourcing and referral pipelines so agencies are used selectively for niche and senior roles, and only through the preferred supplier list
  • Govern requisitions. No hiring against an unapproved requisition. No change to title, band, remit or reporting line without approval. Keep the ATS as the single record
  • Run offers end to end. Present each offer on one email: package against role budget and current pay, a written TA recommendation, the named approver and a deadline. Numbers checked once before sending
  • Make disagreement visible. Hiring managers, HRBPs and Finance raise concerns on the thread or agree an approach before it goes back to TA. No offline changes to a recommendation
  • Close the loop. Every stakeholder question has an owner and an answer within 1 working day. Escalate with a clear ask, not a forward
  • Partner with the business. Work with Indonesia hiring managers, country leadership, HRBPs and Finance. Agree service levels at intake and hold both sides to them
  • Report on what matters. Weekly view of pipeline, time to hire, offer acceptance, source of hire and recruiter load, drawn from system data rather than side spreadsheets
  • Support the region. Support regional TA priorities, including hiring for our Johor Bahru campus in Malaysia when needed
  • Work safely and compliantly. Uphold the TA Policy, data privacy, and our health and safety, information security and environmental management standards
  • *

The successful candidate:

  • *
  • 8 or more years in Talent Acquisition, with at least 2 years leading or coaching recruiters in Indonesia
  • Proven high volume hiring for technical, shift or site based roles in data centres, telco, utilities, manufacturing, energy, construction or facilities
  • Has also closed senior and specialist hires for demanding hiring managers who expect a short, high signal shortlist
  • Commercial judgement on offers, pay structures and a clear recommendation
  • Comfortable with data. Reads a pipeline, forecasts recruiter capacity and spots risks early
  • Hands on with an ATS (SuccessFactors, SmartRecruiters or similar), LinkedIn Recruiter and AI tools in day to day recruiting
  • Direct, transparent communicator who surfaces bad news early, owns the next step and closes loops
  • Builds trust with site leaders and engineers as well as with country and regional leadership
  • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken
  • Based in Jakarta, with regular travel to our sites around Jakarta and occasional regional travel
  • *

If you're ready to lead hiring in our fastest growing market and help shape the next phase of a fast-growing digital infrastructure platform, we'd like to hear from you!

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As Senior Manager, Group Sustainability, you will shape and drive Singtel Group’s social impact agenda, building strategic partnerships and programmes that harness our technology, AI capabilities and regional reach to create meaningful and measurable impact. You will also contribute to broader Group Sustainability and ESG priorities.

How You will Make An Impact

**

Social Impact Strategy & Programme Management

  • Lead Singtel Group AI Future Makers, working across operating companies (OpCos) on challenge statements, partner and start-ups engagement, pilot and scale successful initiatives across the Group and its associates.
  • Build strategic partnerships with government agencies, social service agencies, community organisations and internal business units to develop and scale programmes aligned with Singtel Group’s social impact strategy and “AI for All”.
  • Drive programme governance and impact, including setting outcomes, KPIs and budgets, tracking performance, advising senior management on priorities, investments, risks and scaling decisions, and partnering with Communications and Marketing to amplify impact.

**

Digital Citizenship & Inclusion

  • Shape Singtel’s digital citizenship strategy and develop scalable initiatives that promote responsible, safe and healthy use of digital and AI technologies, addressing emerging AI and online risks.
  • Build and manage partnerships with IMDA, TOUCH, IHLs and community organisations to advance AI and digital literacy, cyber wellness, online safety and scam awareness, particularly for vulnerable communities.

**

Stakeholder Engagement, Impact Measurement & Communications

  • Establish a consistent approach to measuring and reporting the outcomes and impact of major social programmes, using insights to inform programme design, resource allocation and management decisions.
  • Drive the Group-wide approach to employee and skills-based volunteering, developing frameworks, tools and platforms that enable consistent planning, tracking and reporting across the Group and OpCos.

**

Broader Sustainability

  • Lead or co-lead selected cross-functional ESG initiatives, translating emerging sustainability developments into strategic recommendations and practical actions for the Group.
  • Support the annual Singtel Group Sustainability Report and related disclosures, including content development, data coordination, assurance and stakeholder engagement.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Sustainability, Business, Social Sciences, Communications, Public Policy or a related discipline.
  • 8–12 years of relevant experience in sustainability, social impact, strategic partnerships, public policy or programme management, with demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives.
  • Strong programme management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, budgets, timelines and stakeholders.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement, partnership-building skills.
  • Good understanding of social impact programme design, impact measurement and areas such as digital inclusion and responsible AI.
  • Strong communication, writing, research and analytical skills, with sound judgement and problem-solving ability.
  • Experience in sustainability reporting, ESG frameworks such as GRI and ISSB, technology/AI or regional programmes would be an advantage.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

A global network

We are hiring an experienced Staff Forward Deployed Engineer to act as the primary technical bridge between Meta's internal engineering teams and our enterprise clients.

You will lead the architecture and rollout of large-scale AI systems, working side-by-side with engineering leaders at other companies to adapt our AI platform to their specific environments and constraints.

Crucially, you’ll take the friction you encounter in the field—like optimizing inference speeds, resolving interoperability issues, and connecting complex external data sources—and turn it into concrete technical proposals. Your hands-on experience will directly inform and shape the roadmap for Meta's core AI tools and ecosystem. If you want autonomy and the chance to lead complex technical deployments that define how the enterprise uses AI, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Architect Systems: Lead the technical design for major enterprise AI deployments. Ensure the solutions can scale, remain secure, and adhere to strict partner compliance requirements.
  • Build Integrations: Design reliable connections between Meta's AI platforms and client infrastructure, including CRMs, data warehouses, and custom APIs.
  • Drive the Roadmap: Serve as the definitive technical link between field deployments and internal platform teams. Synthesize real-world deployment challenges into strategic decisions that shape Meta's core AI products.
  • Establish Standards: Define deployment patterns, build tooling, and set engineering standards that reduce technical debt and speed up future execution across the team.
  • Lead and Mentor: Set technical direction, drive major cross-functional initiatives, and provide deep technical mentorship to uplevel the team and guide new engineers.
  • Optimize at Scale: Identify and resolve complex performance, latency, and scalability bottlenecks to ensure reliable performance in live production environments.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience utilizing data and analysis to explain technical problems and provide detailed feedback and solutions
  • Demonstrated experience driving change within an organization and leading complex technical projects
  • 8+ years of programming experience in a relevant language OR 4+ years experience with a PhD

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting and deploying large-scale software systems, including taking complex AI applications from early prototypes to enterprise-ready production
  • Experience architecting and scaling GenAI infrastructure across major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), leveraging advanced cloud services (compute, distributed storage, ML frameworks) to optimize model performance, manage compute costs, and ensure enterprise-grade reliability
  • Experience designing and implementing advanced AI testing systems (e.g., automated evaluation loops to proactively catch hallucinations, reasoning gaps, or safety issues in live products)
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare) or navigating enterprise compliance requirements (SOC2, data residency, privacy frameworks)
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical engagements with external engineering teams (e.g., Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Architecture) and translate complex business constraints into robust system designs
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a technical bridge between field deployments and internal engineering, using hands-on customer insights to directly shape core product and platform roadmaps

job.title: Asia Logistics Program Manager
job.description:
Meta is seeking an Asia Logistics Program Manager to manage materials, equipment, and product movement across complex Asia-based supply chains that power Meta's hardware products. In this role, you will manage end-to-end commodity logistics programs spanning freight forwarding, customs compliance, carrier management, and inbound supply chain operations across the supply chain network. You will partner closely with planning, engineering, and operations teams to optimize logistics flows, reduce lead times, and ensure supply continuity for Meta's growing portfolio of consumer hardware.

Responsibilities

  • Manage end-to-end logistics programs for Asia-based manufacturing supply chains, including freight, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery coordination
  • Collaborate with Product Operations, Technical Program Management, and Planning to design logistics networks aligned to the geographic footprint of contract manufacturers and suppliers across Asia
  • Analyze freight cost, transit time, and carrier performance data to identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and third-party logistics providers to ensure that the movement of goods is compliant and on time
  • Develop and maintain logistics program documentation, including standard operating procedures, routing guides, and carrier scorecards
  • Monitor supply chain KPIs and escalate risks related to capacity constraints, port disruptions, or regulatory changes affecting logistics lanes that impact our business
  • Engage cross-functional stakeholders, including finance, trade compliance, and operations, to align on logistics program priorities and trade-offs
  • Support trade compliance activities by ensuring shipments adhere to import and export regulations across relevant jurisdictions
  • Leverage data analysis tools and AI-integrated workflows to model logistics scenarios, forecast costs, and support program decision-making
  • Provide input into team-level logistics strategy and contribute to short-, mid-, and long-term goals aligned to supply chain business objectives

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in logistics program management, freight operations, or supply chain operations globally
  • Experience managing relationships with freight forwarders, customs brokers, or third-party logistics providers across global trade lanes
  • Experience in analyzing logistics data (cost, transit time, carrier performance) to identify issues and propose solutions
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders across sourcing, procurement, operations, or trade compliance functions
  • Experience navigating import and export compliance requirements across multiple jurisdictions

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting logistics programs for consumer electronics, hardware, or infrastructure commodity supply chains
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ability to use data analysis or AI tools to model logistics scenarios and support program planning decisions
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Familiarity with customs classification, duty optimization, or free trade agreement utilization across global markets
  • Experience using supply chain management systems or transportation management platforms to track and optimize freight movements

job.title: SW Product Planning & Management
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

1. Software Financial Planning & Budget Management

  • Lead annual and quarterly software financial planning activities, including labor and non-labor cost forecasting, budget tracking, and variance analysis.
  • Partner with project leaders, finance teams, and stakeholders to ensure alignment between funding, resource demand, and delivery commitments.
  • Monitor project financial performance and proactively identify funding gaps, cost risks, and optimization opportunities.

2. Resource Capacity Planning & Workforce Management

  • Drive software organization capacity planning by balancing project demand, available resources, and strategic priorities.
  • Develop and maintain resource allocation models, headcount plans, and staffing forecasts across multiple software programs.
  • Collaborate with delivery managers to optimize resource utilization and support critical project execution.

3. Portfolio Planning & Governance

  • Establish and maintain portfolio-level visibility of software programs, including budget status, resource allocation, project health, and delivery milestones.
  • Support portfolio prioritization and investment decision-making through data-driven analysis and reporting.
  • Facilitate governance reviews and management reporting for leadership teams.

4. Business Operations & Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve key business metrics related to software delivery efficiency, resource utilization, budget performance, and organizational productivity.
  • Develop dashboards and management reports to provide actionable insights for leadership decision-making.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance planning accuracy and operational effectiveness.

5. Cross-functional Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary interface between Software Delivery, Finance, HR, Procurement, and Business Units regarding planning and resource-related activities.
  • Coordinate funding approvals, purchase order planning, contractor management, and workforce planning processes.
  • Ensure timely communication and alignment across global and regional stakeholders.

6. Strategic Planning & Organizational Development

  • Support annual operating plan (AOP) development, long-range planning, and strategic workforce planning.
  • Analyze future business demand and capability requirements to support sustainable organizational growth.
  • Recommend organizational and investment strategies based on business priorities and capacity analysis.

  • Lead all aspects of financial accounting, management and statutory reporting, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and financial performance reporting, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of financial information.
  • Oversee financial control, audit and compliance, ensuring the Japan operations comply with applicable accounting, tax, legislative and regulatory requirements, as well as Group policies, Finance SOPs and Delegation of Authority.
  • Working closely with Group Treasury in Singapore Head Office to lead local treasury operational matters, which include cash flow and liquidity management as well as management of banking relationships.
  • Partner with the business units on finance matters relating to acquisitions, divestments and other transactions, including transaction structuring and review of commercial arrangements to ensure appropriate financial outcomes.
  • Lead and develop the Japan Finance team, strengthening internal capabilities for flexibility in deploying resources to support the different Japan business verticals.
  • Work closely with Singapore Head Office to implement various initiatives and harmonization under the Digital Transformation.
  • Drive continuous improvements in financial processes, reporting, controls and overall operational effectiveness.

Job Requirements

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or related discipline; professional accounting would be preferred.
  • At least 18 years of relevant finance and accounting experience, with at least last 5 years in similar capacity.
  • Prior experience in the real estate industry and experience with SPC accounting are required.
  • Strong leadership, analytical and stakeholder management skills, with a high level of integrity.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills for frequent communication with Singapore Head Office.

As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. AWS Well-Architected is seeking a Solutions Architect who will build out example scenarios and hands-on labs to demonstrate best practices for deploying workloads in the cloud. Amazon's technology business has a history and tradition of leading the world in Web-related technologies and services. Now with Amazon Web Services (AWS) you have the chance to help individuals and businesses take their computing infrastructures and applications into "the Cloud". As a member of the AWS Support team you will be at the forefront of Cloud technologies with interactions with the full breadth of AWS services.

AWS Managed Services is designed to accelerate cloud adoption. It simplifies deployment, migration, and management using automation and machine learning, backed up by a dedicated team of Amazon employees. AWS Managed Services provides ongoing management of the AWS infrastructure. It automates common activities such as change requests, monitoring, patch management, security, and backup services, and provides full-lifecycle services to provision, run, and support your infrastructure.

We are looking for Operations Engineers to join our Managed Services team based in Singapore. This is an opportunity to join a world class team that is at the forefront of enhancing customer's cloud support experience.

Let's talk about you. So how's your OS and networking skills? Do you have expertise in troubleshooting? Do you know all of the deep corners of the OS? Do you know where the performance bottlenecks hide? Do you know how to monitor infra resources at scale? Do you know how to make the absolute best use of every byte of RAM every CPU cycle?

Have you had other System Engineers say "I don't believe it" when they saw how well a system you tuned was performing in production? Do you always like to dabble with the latest OS version to keep systems running with the latest and greatest features? Do you like to keep the servers in lock down with the best security and auditing tools to keep intruders away? Do you have an insane obsession of making sure your boxes run with 99.999% uptime?

Are you getting excited after reading this?

We have Good news! We're enhancing our teams with deep OS expertise and you should be on it. Come join us—we work hard, have fun, and make history!

Key job responsibilities

  • As a member of Managed Service team, you will be working with our amazing Operation Engineers, Lead Engineers, and other supporting roles to dive in and tackle the hardest technical challenges. You will excel working in an agile environment while collaborating with some of the diverse people in the industry, and you will get excited about owning critical infrastructure services that serve global customers every second of the day!
  • Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  • Operate the Managed Service platform and collaborate with internal service teams to meet our customers' individual needs for their infrastructure and application deployments.
  • Troubleshoot application deployments, recreate customer issues, and build proof of concept applications. Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
  • Work on critical highly complex customer problems that will span multiple AWS services.
  • Help build and maintain Cloud Formation templates and scripts to automate and deploy AWS resources and configuration changes.
  • Collaborate and help build utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow AWS Engineers to operate safely at high speed and wide scale.
  • Leverage your day-to-day experiences to provide the voice of the customer to internal AWS teams.
  • Drive customer communication during critical events.
  • Learn and leverage emerging technologies.

About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of software development, or 2+ years of technical support experience
  • Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information.
