job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to

Business Communications Manager__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the execution of ABB's marketing and communication activities, with a strong focus on digital channels and AI-enabled workflows. Each day, you will contribute to the delivery of integrated campaigns across digital and traditional touchpoints, ensuring alignment with ABB branding guidelines, business priorities, and approved budgets. You will also showcase your skills by leveraging digital platforms, analytics, and AI tools to improve content effectiveness, campaign performance, lead generation, and marketing efficiency.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Measurement & Analytics local division in China. Main stakeholders local customers, local division sales teams, product line teams, and the global Marketing & Communication team.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Support the execution of marketing communication strategies and tactics across digital and traditional touchpoints, in alignment with global/regional growth strategies and local business priorities
  • Manage and optimize owned digital platforms, including WeChat Official Account, Video Account, and the official website
  • Execute digital campaigns across paid feeds, email marketing, influencer and advocacy partnerships, SEO/GEO, and other channels to strengthen customer familiarity with the business, technologies, and products to drive lead generation
  • Use marketing automation and SCRM platforms (primarily Salesforce and BesChannel), to manage content-led lead acquisition and nurturing workflows while improving conversion efficiency
  • Collaborate with local teams, including Sales & Service, Product Management, and Segment, to consolidate and create compelling content while ensuring consistent messaging across all touchpoints
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools and marketing technologies to streamline content creation, campaign execution and optimization, analyze audience insights, and improve workflow efficiency
  • Track campaign performance, marketing KPIs, and market trends to generate actionable insights and drive continuous improvement
  • Support employee engagement through internal communications, mainly via email, employee activities and town hall meetings
  • Coordinate logistics and daily operations for marketing communication activities

Qualifications for the role

  • 2–3 years of experience in digital, marketing communications, or integrated marketing, preferably in a B2B, industrial, automation, or technology-driven environment
  • Practical experience executing digital campaigns across channels such as WeChat, email marketing, search, paid media, webinars, and lead generation
  • Hands-on experience with AI tools for marketing communications and openness to adopting new AI-enabled solutions. Photography and video editing skills are a plus
  • Strong communication, copywriting, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions and communicate clearly with internal teams, external partners, and business stakeholders
  • Proactive, organized, and adaptable, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, perform well under pressure, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment
  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, Business, or a related field, with strong communication skills in both English and Chinese

More about us

The Measurement & Analytics Division is among the world’s leading manufacturers and suppliers of smart instrumentation and analyzers, working at the heart of industrial digital transformation. The Measurement & Analytics Division’s portfolio consists of analyzers measuring compositions of gases and liquids; instrumentation measuring process variables such as temperature, pressure, flow, and level; force measurement solutions measuring parameters such as flatness, thickness, and tension; and advanced digital solutions for device management, device health check and predictive maintenance. The Measurement & Analytics Division serves key industries such as oil and gas, chemical, water and wastewater, power, hydrogen, batteries, as well as the marine industry. The Division enables the optimization of industrial processes by providing and analyzing data collected from sensing and smart measurement devices. Parameters such as emission levels and production inputs are measured by providing ‘before’ and ‘after’ values, enabling efficient operations and environmental sustainability through measurement.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

  • Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities.
  • Review depreciation runs and accounting entries.
  • Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger.
  • Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E).
  • Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies.
  • Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations.

Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal.
  • Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment.
  • Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs.
  • Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable.

Reconciliation & Data Quality

  • Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations.
  • Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records.
  • Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization.
  • Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors.
  • Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives.
  • Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities.
  • Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday, TRIRIGA).
  • Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control.

SME Governance Responsibilities

  • Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members.
  • Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects.
  • Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment.

Key Skills & Competencies:

**

  • Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement.
  • Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls.
  • ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,).
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
  • Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management.
  • Audit support and compliance expertise.
  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA.
  • Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment.
  • Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module.

More about us

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operate with the highest standards

job.title: Senior Member Technical Staff
job.description:
Siemens EDA is a global technology leader in Electronic Design Automation software. Our software tools enable companies around the world to develop highly innovative electronic products faster and more cost-effectively. Our customers use our tools to push the boundaries of technology and physics to deliver better products in the increasingly complex world of chip, board, and system design.

Position Overview

Join our Noida center as a Senior Member of Technical Staff and become part of a dynamic team impacting innovation at a global scale. You'll work in a high-growth environment with an exceptional learning curve, collaborating with teams that push the boundaries of Electronic Design Automation. This is your opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge software solutions while developing expertise in one of the tech industry's most exciting domains.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop robust software solutions using C/C++ and modern design patterns to support EDA product features
  • Design and implement efficient data structures and algorithms to enhance product performance and user experience
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand complex product requirements and translate them into technical implementations
  • Contribute to the architecture and optimization of graph-based algorithms for EDA applications
  • Participate in code reviews and maintain high standards of code quality and best practices
  • Take ownership of assigned features while supporting team members in a collaborative environment

Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency in C/C++ programming languages with solid understanding of design patterns, data structures, and algorithms
  • Knowledge of graph algorithms and their practical applications in software development
  • Ability to understand and work with complex software products, solutions, and architectural problems
  • Self-motivated with strong integrity, discipline, and commitment to continuous learning

At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. job.title: 质量主管
job.description:
Job Description 职位描述

加入西门子智能基础设施集团，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

我们期待您的加入，共同推动业务发展。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

  • 推动质量相关领域内的流程优化改善，评估并执行先进的技术或解决方案
  • 编写及优化质量控制计划、为新产品建立可靠的检验系统、检验指导文件
  • 供应商质量管理；对质量问题进行根本原因分析、并指定改善计划
  • 深入分析、独立完成并解决其职责内的项目或生产复杂需求，对于复杂质量问题牵头进行系统解决并持续改进，结构化和逻辑化地解决问题，并基于产品风险和经验总结，建立/优化合适的过程质量和产品质量控制方法
  • 规范及改善质量控制计划，例如终检（FAT）及测试程序
  • 与丹麦密切合作，实现低压CO2产品的中国本地服务支持
  • 变更管理 及 8D报告，与相关部门通力合作，评价/验证产品和过程变更所带来的风险
  • 为检验员提供相应的新品质量检验方面的培训，提升检验团队能力

你需要具备的品质：

  • 8年以上质量或工程领域相关工作经验，以及3年以上团队管理经验；
  • 熟悉ISO9001质量体系；
  • 有大量的质量改善项目经验，熟练使用SPC, FMEA, Control Plan, 8D等工具；
  • 学习能力强，注重细节，认真严谨，有较强的抗压能力；
  • 有很好的团队合作意识及能力，善于解决问题、及良好的沟通能力；
  • 工作主动，有责任心，以结果为导向；
  • 具备熟练的Office 办公软件等相关技能，熟练使用AutoCAD等EDA工具，具备数字化质量管理能力包含数据分析能力、Power BI等数字化工具能力；
  • 工科以上学历；具备良好的英语听说读写能力。

你将得到这些收获：

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等。
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径。
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进。
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作。
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴。

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 "2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50" 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

job.title: Database Sales Specialist, Google Cloud
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Database Sales Specialist, you will help us grow our operational database business by building and expanding relationships with new and existing customers. You will work with customers to deliver business, demonstrate product functionality and provide a comprehensive overview of business use cases. You will lead day-to-day relationships with cross-functional team members, serving as a solution lead within the sales organization. You will lead go-to-market strategies, sales plays, run campaigns, and execute on the opportunities created.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Make databases a leading conversation in sales discussions/account strategy, develop country and segment specific plans for GCP database services, and work with sub-region leadership team to define databases pen and ramp strategies.
  • Build relationships with customers as a trusted advisor to understand their business drivers/technology footprint, identify appropriate Google databases solution use cases, manage complex business cycles and influence long-term strategic direction.
  • Deliver against quota and achieve strategic business and growth goals while forecasting and reporting territory’s business.
  • Work with account and cross-functional teams (e.g., sales representatives and sales managers, customer engineering, marketing, customer success) to develop go-to-market strategies, generate and progress pipeline, understand the customers, and provide excellent prospect and customer experience.
  • Collaborate with partner team to activate database-specific partners, ensuring sales teams and customers have access to partners.

job.title: Software Engineering Manager, Cloud and Third-Party Platform Security
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes way beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As the Software Engineering Manager for the newly formed software engineering team within the Cloud & Third-Party Security team in Singapore, you will be a foundational lead for our new, high-impact software engineering team. You will act as a technical leader to hire and manage software engineers and work cross-functionally with stakeholders across Google to enable achieving our risk reduction goals.

**

Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a team of software engineers, combining technical leadership and people management to build scalable products that identify and remediate security gaps in Alphabet's usage of public cloud infrastructure, third-party vendors, and SaaS.
  • Drive the technical roadmap to support risk reduction goals by addressing ambiguous problems, identifying future work, and ensuring technical excellence and manageable complexity.
  • Oversee engineering projects, drive key architectural decisions and influence strategies across partner security and software engineering teams while building strong collaborations.
  • Partner with cross-functional roles (e.g., Security Engineers, TPMs) to define requirements and implement systems that enable the rollout of controls to reduce the risk of undermanaged cloud and third-party vendor usage.

job.title: Senior Account Manager, Sensormatic Solutions Japan
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Customer Relationship Management

  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing Tier 1 / Tier 2 Retail clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, retention, and business growth.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers, understanding their business challenges and providing tailored solutions that deliver measurable value.
  • Manage all commercial and operational requirements of assigned customers, ensuring effective support throughout the customer lifecycle.
  • Work proactively to resolve customer issues, coordinate internal resources, and maintain strong executive-level engagement.
  • Drive opportunities to timely closure, ensuring Purchase Orders (POs) are secured within agreed customer timelines and company expectations.

New Business Development

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new logo opportunities within targeted market segments, driving demand generation and revenue growth.
  • Develop and execute account penetration and prospecting strategies to expand the customer base.
  • Qualify and prioritize major opportunities, ensuring alignment with overall sales strategy and regional objectives.
  • Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline capable of delivering sustainable revenue growth.
  • Collaborate with channel partners to identify and develop new customer opportunities across key vertical markets.

Channel Management

  • Recruit, enable, develop, and manage channel partners to maximize market coverage and revenue generation.
  • Support partners throughout the sales cycle, including opportunity identification, customer engagement, solution positioning, and commercial negotiations.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with channel partners to increase pipeline generation and market penetration.
  • Implement core channel programs, tools, and incentive initiatives that drive positive partner performance while minimizing channel conflict.
  • Provide sales mentorship, training, and ongoing support to channel partners to ensure successful execution of sales strategies.

Global Account Coordination & Internal Liaison

  • Act as the primary liaison between Global Account teams, customers in Japan, channel partners, and internal stakeholders to ensure alignment of business priorities and customer expectations.
  • Support the execution of global account strategies within Japan, partnering closely with regional and global leadership teams.
  • Coordinate local customer activities and provide market insights that contribute to global account planning and growth initiatives.
  • Facilitate effective communication between customers, global account teams, solution architects, service delivery teams, operations, and leadership stakeholders.
  • Ensure customer and market requirements from Japan are accurately represented within regional and global business discussions.

Sales Strategy & Execution

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Solution Architects, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Service Delivery to create compelling value propositions and sales strategies.
  • Lead the sales closure process and ensure compliance with Sensormatic Solutions sales methodologies, policies, and practices.
  • Develop strategic account plans and business growth initiatives for key customers and prospects.
  • Drive execution of both direct and indirect sales strategies to maximize territory performance and revenue achievement.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, competitive threats, and industry trends to support business planning.

CRM Excellence & Forecast Management

  • Maintain accurate and current opportunity management within Salesforce.
  • Ensure all opportunities are properly qualified, updated, and advanced through the appropriate sales stages according to established sales processes.
  • Keep account records, pipeline information, account plans, forecasts, and customer data updated and reflective of current business conditions.
  • Deliver accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual forecasts, including pipeline reviews, outlook assessments, and risk evaluations.
  • Support business planning activities through disciplined forecasting and pipeline management practices.

Performance Monitoring & Reporting

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide regular updates to senior leadership regarding sales performance, pipeline status, forecast accuracy, and market developments.
  • Prepare and deliver monthly business reviews, account plans, forecast updates, and strategic growth presentations.
  • Represent Japan during regional and global sales calls, business reviews, and leadership meetings.
  • Provide clear visibility into forecast performance, market opportunities, emerging risks, and customer developments.
  • Maintain accountability for achieving assigned sales targets, growth objectives, and performance metrics.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Operational Excellence

  • Partner closely with Sales Operations, Customer Service, Supply Chain, Finance, Professional Services, and Service Delivery teams to ensure seamless business execution.
  • Facilitate smooth operational processes from opportunity creation through order management, delivery, invoicing, and project completion.
  • Coordinate internal resources to support customer requirements and ensure successful execution of commitments.
  • Promote effective communication across all stakeholders to achieve operational excellence and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive continuous improvements in internal processes, forecasting discipline, and customer engagement practices.

Requirements / Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5-8 years of successful sales, account management, business development, or channel management experience within retail technology, security solutions, SaaS, enterprise software, or related industries.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales quotas, revenue targets, and strategic business objectives.
  • Experience managing strategic enterprise accounts and complex sales cycles.
  • Previous experience working with channel partners, distributors, system integrators, or technology alliances is highly desirable.
  • Experience supporting multinational customers and coordinating with regional and global stakeholders is preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
  • Proven ability to identify customer needs and develop value-based business solutions.
  • Strong business development and prospecting capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to generate new opportunities and drive sustainable pipeline growth.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing contracts, pricing discussions, and commercial negotiations.
  • Solid understanding of sales forecasting, pipeline management, and CRM best practices.
  • Experience using Salesforce or equivalent CRM platforms.
  • Strong analytical, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to effectively navigate and influence stakeholders across multiple organizational levels, including operational teams, senior management, and executive leadership, both internally and externally.
  • Proven ability to operate successfully within complex matrix organizations and global business environments.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to engage effectively with C-level customer executives and senior internal leadership.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Fluent business-level English and Japanese, both written and spoken.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong collaboration skills with a demonstrated ability to work effectively across Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, Professional Services, Customer Success, Service Delivery, and Global Account teams.
  • Proven ability to build strong working relationships across cultures, functions, and organizational levels.
  • Ability to gain alignment, influence decision-making, and drive consensus among internal and external stakeholders.
  • Strong team-oriented mindset with a willingness to support colleagues and contribute to a high-performance culture.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Experience within Retail Technology, Loss Prevention, Electronic Article Surveillance (EAS), RFID, Computer Vision, Inventory Intelligence, Traffic Analytics, or Connected Retail solutions.
  • Experience selling RFID, Loss Prevention, Inventory Intelligence, Computer Vision, Traffic Insights, or related retail technology solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of the retail ecosystem, including retailers, system integrators, technology partners, and channel networks within Japan.
  • Knowledge of omnichannel retail, digital transformation, and store operations is highly desirable.

Personal Attributes

  • Results-oriented with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with broader teams.
  • Highly collaborative team player who actively supports colleagues and contributes to a positive work environment.
  • Customer-centric approach with a passion for delivering measurable business value.
  • Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills.
  • Resilient and capable of performing effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment with demanding deadlines and revenue targets.
  • Ability to maintain professionalism, composure, and sound judgment when managing challenging customer situations and competing priorities.
  • Adaptable and comfortable managing ambiguity, organizational change, and multiple concurrent initiatives.

Success Measures

The successful candidate will be measured on:

  • Revenue and margin achievement.
  • New logo acquisition, share-of-wallet expansion, and pipeline generation.
  • Customer retention and satisfaction.
  • Channel partner growth and productivity.
  • Forecast accuracy and Salesforce data quality.
  • Strategic account growth.
  • On-time order closure and Purchase Order attainment.
  • Effective representation of Japan in regional and global business reviews.
  • Operational excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship development across customers, channel partners, and internal teams.
  • Contribution to a collaborative, high-performance culture while maintaining results under pressure.

job.title: Enterprise Integration Developer
job.description:
Enterprise Integration developer – Azure Integrations Services

Johnson Controls is searching for an Enterprise Integration Developer with expertise in Microsoft Azure Integration Services to design, develop, and support secure, scalable, and cloud-native integration solutions. In this role, you will enable seamless connectivity between enterprise applications, cloud platforms, SaaS solutions, and external partners using Azure's integration capabilities.

Working closely with solution architects, Product Owners, application development teams, and infrastructure engineers, you will help deliver integration solutions that improve business agility, data consistency, and operational efficiency.

.

What you will do

**

  • Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain enterprise integration solutions using Azure Integration Services.
  • Develop workflows using Azure Logic Apps (Consumption and Standard).
  • Build and manage Azure API Management APIs and API policies.
  • Develop Azure Functions to implement custom integration logic.
  • Design event-driven solutions using Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, and Event Hubs.
  • Implement messaging, routing, orchestration, and transformation between enterprise systems.
  • Develop integrations between ERP, ServiceMax/Salesforce CRM and other enterprise applications.
  • Build reusable integration components and shared services aligned with enterprise architecture standards.

How you will do it

**

  • Design and implement RESTful APIs and, where required, SOAP-based services.
  • Secure APIs using OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, managed identities, certificates, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Define API versioning, lifecycle management, and governance standards.
  • Collaborate with application teams to expose reusable business services through Azure API Management.
  • Monitor integration health using Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Log Analytics.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
  • Optimize integrations for scalability, resiliency, reliability, and performance.
  • Participate in incident management and continuous service improvement activities.
  • Maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, and deployment procedures.
  • What we look for

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 3–5+ years of experience developing enterprise integration solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Azure Integration Services, including:
  • Azure Logic Apps
  • Azure API Management
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Azure Event Grid
  • Azure Event Hubs
  • Strong understanding of REST APIs, SOAP services, JSON, XML, and OpenAPI specifications.
  • Experience implementing secure integrations using Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, JWT, certificates, and Azure Key Vault.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps, Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills.

**

Preferred:

  • Experience integrating Oracle R12, Oracle Fusion Cloud, Salesforce, Workday, or other enterprise platforms.
  • Knowledge of Azure Storage Accounts, Azure SQL Database, Cosmos DB, and Azure Data Factory.
  • Experience with Event-Driven Architecture and asynchronous messaging.
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
  • Experience implementing enterprise integration patterns and cloud-native architectures.
  • Microsoft Azure certifications, such as:Azure Developer Associate (AZ-204)
  • Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
  • Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

You will be handling techno-Commercial activities of the projects covering various ELV systems such as Fire Alarm System, CCTV Surveillance & Security System, Access Control System, Public Address System, Parking Management System, Structured Cabling System, network Infrastructure etc. You should own the technical consideration to win the job and should be part of HOTO process to get the D&E and OPS approval for booking.

How you will do it:

  • Review the project inputs and project intake form shared by the Front desk/Sales.
  • Analyze the requirement and initiate the Kick-off call with Front Desk after getting CoE SFDC Code and time frame.
  • Prepare designs on given floor plans to arrive with the BOQ; in case BOQ is unavailable.
  • Identify potential issues/risks and proactively bring them to the customer's knowledge and help to mitigate the identified risks.
  • Initiate the discussion with OEMs & subcontractors and get the right solution and proposal from OEMs.
  • Analyze the proposal and commercials received from the OEM and verify the same based on the past data and benchmark costing available in the SCM Database.
  • Upon completion of cost comparison, prepare the optimized techno-commercial Costing sheet, Proposal, and Compliance Statements.
  • Once the deliverables are ready, perform Self QC and get the 2nd level QC done by the Delivery Manager. Eventually, submit the deliverables to the Front Desk.
  • Update the SFDC regularly, and complete timesheet & assigned training on time.
  • Actively negotiate and follow up with OEMs and Internal OPS/ Post Sales team to get the right kind of prices for the project.
  • Regularly participate in the Daily Call /Cadence Call with the business team.
  • Actively derive the strategy for increasing the win rate.
  • Align with Organization KPIs such as Quality, OTD, Win rate, Productivity, etc.

What we look for

  • BE (Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication)
  • Must have 6+ years of relevant experience in ELV Systems domains.
  • Strong knowledge of ELV & ICT Systems (Fire Alarm System, CCTV, Access Control, PAVA, Intrusion Detection Systems, Intercom Systems, Gate Barriers, Car parking system, Structured Cabling, Network Switches, etc.)
  • Must have India projects' presales and estimation experience on various verticals (Infrastructure, Health Care, Fit-outs, Industries, Data Centers, etc.).
  • Design know-how of the ELV & ICT Systems.
  • Capable of understanding ELV Systems specifications and doing product selections along with the deviation/compliance statements.
  • Must be able to work on complex costing sheets covering Material, Engineering, Operations, and Subcon costs.
  • Skill in articulating offered solutions in a structured way through high-standard technical proposal documents.
  • Must have a strong network with the 3rd party vendors in India.
  • Must be a quick learner & keen on problem-solving techniques.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Must be a good team player.

Preferred

  • Work experience in all leading access control products (e.g., Software House, Lenel, HID, Suprema, Bosch, Honeywell, etc.)
  • Work experience in all leading CCTV products (e.g., American Dynamics, Milestone, Genetic, Pelco, Axis, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Fire Alarm Systems products such as Notifier, Simplex, and EST (Edward).
  • PAVA, Structured Cabling and Network infrastructure know-how is a must.
  • Knowledge of ACAD, Visio, and Excel.
  • Security and fire alarm systems' product certifications will be added advantage.

job.title: Instructional Designer II L&D
job.description:
What You Will Do

The Instructional Designer (ID) II will analyze learning outcomes and collaborate with stakeholders and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) globally to design and develop learning solutions that align with business requirements. The ID, as part of the India L&D team, will work with colleagues in the internal team and the L&D teams globally to gather/create content, design, and develop Instructional Design deliverables for appropriate learning modalities and styles. They will be responsible for working as one team with other IDs, Learning Experience Designers (LXDs), L&D Managers, and cross-functional team members.

The ID will apply Instructional Design theories and practices to design and develop learning solutions, use standard writing styles to make content easy to understand for the target audience and produce well-written audio/video scripts for high-quality course assets.

To be successful in this role, the ID will need to understand the business goals, collaborate with stakeholders, and ask the right questions. The ID is expected to be dependable and trusted by the business partners across JCI teams.

**

How You Will Do It

  • Create compelling and engaging content based on the stakeholder requirements.
  • Design and develop Instructional Design documents, storyboards, mockups, and prototypes for learning solutions.
  • Use appropriate writing styles to make content easy to understand for the target audience.
  • Adhere to training development guidelines and formats to create quality training deliverables for required learning modalities.

What We Look For

**

Qualification and Experience

  • Graduate or PG from a recognized university
  • Preferable certificate course relevant to Instructional Design/Mass Communication/Technical Writing
  • 6-10 years of experience in Instructional Design in a media/e-Learning industry
  • Experience in needs analysis, design, content development, review, and signoff
  • At least 1-2 years of experience in stakeholder communication

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent understanding of Instructional Design principles and methodologies (ADDIE/Bloom’s taxonomy, Gagne’s model, etc.)
  • Sound knowledge of the Instructional Design process (including learning needs analysis)
  • Skills in visual & textual storyboarding
  • Preferred knowledge & skills in Articulate 360 and Adobe Captivate
  • Excellent communication and articulation skills
  • Learning industry knowledge and business acumen
  • Behaviour exhibiting competencies such as customer orientation, collaboration, managing work, execution discipline, digital acumen, and adaptability

job.title: ServiceMax Technical Architect
job.description:
**

Job Description

Technical Architect - ServiceMax

We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect - ServiceMax - with 10+ years of expertise in designing, governing, and delivering enterprise-scale ServiceMax and Salesforce solutions. This role will lead architecture strategy for global field service transformation programs, ensuring scalable, secure, integrated, and business-aligned solutions that support standardized global processes and country-specific rollout needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, and delivery teams to translate field service requirements into scalable ServiceMax architecture, solution designs, and technical specifications.
  • Redesign and standardize field service processes to improve operational efficiency, technician productivity, dispatcher effectiveness, and customer experience.
  • Own end-to-end ServiceMax solution architecture, design governance, and technical decision-making across global programs, ensuring alignment with business requirements, enterprise architecture standards, and industry best practices.
  • Define the global ServiceMax template architecture and manage controlled country-specific localization, including regional process variations, deployment sequencing, training readiness, change management, and hypercare support.
  • Architect enterprise integrations between ServiceMax, Salesforce, ERP platforms, middleware, mobile applications, and enterprise data platforms using appropriate API-led and event-driven integration patterns.
  • Ensure platform capabilities and solution designs meet non-functional requirements, including scalability, performance, security, resilience, monitoring, maintainability, and supportability.
  • Define and govern end-to-end data migration strategies for ServiceMax implementations, including legacy data assessment, cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, cutover planning, and post-migration reconciliation.
  • Drive digital transformation initiatives by modernizing field service operations, enabling automation, improving technician and dispatcher experiences, and aligning ServiceMax capabilities with enterprise transformation objectives.
  • Provide technical leadership to administrators, developers, QA engineers, integration teams, and business analysts, ensuring consistent delivery standards, design quality, and adherence to best practices.
  • Lead cross-functional collaboration across business, IT, integration, data, security, and regional rollout teams to align solution decisions with program priorities and stakeholder expectations.
  • Maintain a forward-looking technology roadmap for ServiceMax and related Salesforce capabilities, identifying opportunities for continuous improvement, innovation, and platform optimization.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in technical architecture, solution design, and enterprise application delivery, with strong expertise in ServiceMax, Salesforce Service Cloud, and field service transformation programs.
  • Proven experience designing and delivering ServiceMax capabilities, including configuration, custom extensions, workflows, integrations, mobile enablement, and global deployment models.
  • Deep understanding of field service management processes, including work order management, installed base, preventive maintenance, dispatching, scheduling, technician mobility, entitlements, and service operations.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform architecture, security model, data model, integration patterns, environment strategy, release management, and governance practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical problem solving, manage architectural risks, and make pragmatic design decisions in large-scale enterprise programs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Quality Engineer - IBMS, Ahmedabad (1-Year Contract Role)

Johnson Controls delivers innovative building technologies that support smarter, healthier, and more sustainable environments. In this role, you will help ensure quality across IBMS project execution with a strong focus on IBMS, CCTV, and ACS, while working on-site in Ahmedabad. This is a one-year contractual opportunity, renewable annually based on performance.

Role Overview

As a Quality Engineer, you will support the quality assurance and quality control of IBMS installations by reviewing workmanship, verifying compliance with drawings and specifications, and coordinating with project stakeholders to close observations efficiently. You will play a key role in maintaining quality standards across site activities, inspections, and system checks.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct site inspections and quality checks for IBMS installations, with emphasis on CCTV and ACS systems.
  • Verify that execution at site aligns with approved drawings, technical specifications, and project quality standards.
  • Monitor installation workmanship and identify deviations, defects, or rework requirements.
  • Coordinate with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to resolve quality-related issues.
  • Support testing, inspection, and documentation activities during implementation and handover.
  • Maintain accurate quality records, site reports, and follow-up actions.
  • Track technical and operational issues through closure and support corrective actions.
  • Ensure safety and compliance requirements are followed during site activities.

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the site and verify work against drawings, specifications, and agreed quality standards.
  • Own issues through to closure by documenting findings, coordinating corrective actions, and confirming that rework meets expectations.
  • Work openly with clients, contractors, vendors, and internal teams to remove obstacles and keep delivery moving.
  • Use disciplined reporting and clear communication to surface risks early and improve quality every day.
  • Apply a practical, detail-focused approach to inspections, system checks, and handover support.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Engineering, preferably in Electrical, Electronics, IT, or a related field.
  • 5 years of experience in IBMS project execution, quality checks, or site supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with IBMS, CCTV, and ACS.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, layouts, and specifications.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
  • Understanding of safety, compliance, and site quality practices.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to large-scale infrastructure or facility management projects.
  • Experience with additional IBMS or ELV systems such as CFS.

Why Join Us

This role offers the opportunity to contribute to quality-focused IBMS delivery in a global company committed to smart and sustainable building solutions. You will work with a collaborative team, strengthen your technical expertise, and gain hands-on exposure to site quality execution in a performance-based contractual role.

If you are ready to bring your IBMS quality experience to a role where your work will be seen and valued, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Staff Engineer
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the new role

A Heat Transfer Staff Engineer is responsible for analyzing, designing, and optimizing heat exchanger and components where heat transfer is a critical factor. This role involves applying principles of heat transfer, refrigeration, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics to ensure efficient thermal performance in Carrier products and equipment.

  • *

Key Responsibilities

As a heat transfer engineer, she or he will be responsible for:

  • Thermal System Design & Analysis

Design and evaluate heat exchangers, cooling systems, insulation, and thermal interfaces.

Perform detailed thermal calculations using conduction, convection, and radiation principles.

Develop simulation models (e.g., CFD) to predict temperature distribution and heat flow.

  • Simulation & Modeling

Use engineering software such as ANSYS Fluent and MATLAB to conduct thermal simulations.

Validate models with testing and refine designs accordingly.

  • Testing & Validation

Plan and execute thermal experiments and bench tests.

Analyze temperature data, heat flux, and performance trends.

Troubleshoot thermal issues in prototypes or existing systems.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with system engineering teams to integrate thermal solutions into products.

Provide thermal expertise during design reviews and engineering decision-making.

  • Documentation & Reporting

Prepare engineering reports, technical documentation, specifications, and test procedures.

Communicate analysis outcomes clearly to engineering and management stakeholders.

Requirements

As a minimum you must have:

  • People who are heat transfer engineer level have a minimum must have:
  • Master’s degree or PHD in Refrigeration Engineering, Thermal Engineering or related field.
  • >4 years work experience in this area.
  • Strong understanding of refrigeration, heat transfer, thermodynamics and fluid mechanics.
  • Experience with thermal analysis tools (ANSYS Fluent etc.)
  • Strong analytical, numerical, and problem‑solving skills.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.title: Field Engineer・フィールドエンジニア（埼玉）
job.description:
Field Engineer・フィールエンジニア

勤務地：埼玉

概要

Carrierのフィールドエンジニアとして、空調設備や冷凍冷却機器の保守・点検・修理業務を担当いただきます。お客様先に訪問し、機器の安定稼働を支えることで、快適な環境づくりと省エネルギー化に貢献する重要なポジションです。高度な技術力と顧客対応力を活かしながら、業界をリードするCarrier製品のサービス品質向上を担っていただきます。

主な業務内容

・空調設備および冷凍冷却機器の保守点検・定期メンテナンス業務 ・機器故障時の診断、修理およびトラブルシューティング対応 ・お客様先での機器立上げ、試運転および性能確認業務 ・保守契約顧客への技術サポートおよび改善提案 ・設備更新や改修工事に伴う技術支援業務 ・フロンガス回収および関連法令に基づく対応業務 ・作業報告書および各種サービス記録書類の作成 ・安全基準に基づく現場作業および品質管理活動 ・営業部門や技術部門との連携による顧客課題解決 ・顧客との関係構築およびサービス品質向上活動

この仕事の魅力

世界的な空調ソリューション企業であるCarrierの先進技術に触れながら、専門性の高いフィールドサービススキルを身につけることができます。お客様の設備安定稼働を支える重要な役割を担い、技術者としての市場価値を高められる環境です。また、多様な案件を通じて幅広い経験を積みながら、長期的なキャリア形成を実現できます。

応募資格・求める人物像

必須条件

・空調業界におけるフィールドサービス、保守、メンテナンス等の実務経験

※未経験の場合でも、機械・設備・電気関連の知識や技術系業務経験をお持ちの方歓迎 ・第二種電気工事士資格をお持ちの方（持っていなければ入社以降でも可） ・普通自動車運転免許をお持ちの方 ・日本語での読み書きおよび業務遂行が可能な方

歓迎する経験・スキル

・空調機器、チラー、冷凍機などの修理、保守経験 ・中央監視システムやビル設備管理に関する知識 ・フロン類取扱技術者資格、ガス溶接技能講習修了資格をお持ちの方 ・冷凍空調関連資格をお持ちの方 ・安全衛生管理に関する知識・経験

求める人物像

・顧客志向を持ち、責任感を持って業務に取り組める方 ・現場で発生する課題に対し、柔軟かつ冷静に対応できる方 ・チームと連携しながら主体的に行動できる方 ・継続的に技術知識を学び、成長意欲を持っている方 ・安全を最優先に考え、正確な作業を遂行できる方

ー

・Our Purpose - 暮らしと世界をもっと豊かに 会社設立以来、Carrierでは、自ら空調事業を切り拓くことで世界を変えてきました。以来、イノベーションの伝統を培い、地球環境に注力し、限界を押し上げながら持続可能エネルギー利用による野心的なソリューションを設計、提供しています。Carrierはイノベーションで業界をリード限界の壁を突破しつつ、世界のエネルギーと環境分野の取り組みにおいて変革をもたらします。

・Our Legacy - 空調の父から受け継ぐDNA 1902年7月17日、創業者であるウィリス・キヤリアが近代空調を発明して以来、Carrierは技術革新を重ねてきました。1929年には、初の海外拠点として日本を選定。その後、東芝との合弁事業を経て、2022年8月に当社はCarrier日本法人として新たなスタートを切りました。「暮らしと世界をもっと豊かに」というパーパスのもと、ゼロカーボン社会の実現に向けて、お客様の支援と自社の事業運営の両面から日々取り組んでいます。

・Our Innovation & Excellence - たゆまぬ技術の進化と変革 1980年代初頭、日本キヤリアは世界初のインバーターエアコンを開発、商業化し、業界の革新を牽引してきました。その技術力はCarrier全社でも評価されています。例えば、モジュールチラーでは、自ら市場を切り拓いて牽引し、ビル用マルチ(VRF)では国内にとどまらず海外市場にも技術を展開し、成長を続けています。こうした研究開発力と製造力を通じて、お客様の多様なニーズに応えてまいります。

job.title: Customer Quality Engineer
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come.   • SCT的客户不仅来自中国市场，也涉及澳大利亚、东南亚、印度、中东、拉美等区域。

Key Responsibilities

As a Customer Quality Engineer, you’ll be responsible for:

  • 支持重点客户和重点服务站的质量沟通，参与客户现场问题调查和失效件分析。

Requirements

As a minimum you must have:

  • 本科及以上学历，机械、制冷、暖通、车辆工程、电气、自动化、质量管理等相关工科背景专业。
  • 5 年以上制造业质量相关经验；3 年以上客户质量、售后质量、市场质量或产品质量改善经验；
  • 熟练掌握质量管理相关工具和方法：8D、VoC、IATF16949/ISO9001、APQP、FMEA、SPC、MSA、PPAP；
  • 英文可用于邮件沟通、口语交流和质量报告编写。

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.title: Associate Engineering Manager – Engineering Design
job.description:
What you will do

  • Lead & Develop a High-Performing Team: You will inspire, mentor, and lead a talented team of mechanical design engineers. Your primary focus will be on fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and innovative environment where team members can thrive. You will manage the full talent lifecycle, including setting clear objectives, conducting performance reviews, and creating robust development and growth plans for every engineer.
  • Drive Project Execution & Excellence: You will be accountable for the team's successful delivery of engineering projects, ensuring they meet critical milestones for quality, on-time delivery, and cost. This includes leading rigorous design reviews, providing expert technical guidance, and ensuring all deliverables are of the highest quality and ready for manufacturing.
  • Champion Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as a key technical partner to other departments. You will collaborate closely with leaders in Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, and Operations to resolve technical challenges, streamline processes, and ensure seamless integration throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Advance Engineering Capabilities: You will stay at the forefront of engineering tools and methodologies, driving the adoption of best practices within your team. This includes championing process improvements, overseeing the use of CAD and PLM systems, and identifying opportunities to leverage new technologies to boost productivity and innovation.
  • Contribute to Strategic Vision: You will play a key role in shaping the future of our engineering function. By managing resources, aligning team priorities with business goals, and contributing to the technology roadmap, you will help ensure our design capabilities remain best-in-class.

What you will bring:

  • Leadership & Experience: A mechanical engineering background with 13+ years of progressive industry experience, including at least 5 years in a direct people management role.
  • Core Engineering Design: Extensive hands-on experience in mechanical design, with demonstrated success in New Product Development (NPD), VAVE (Value Analysis/Value Engineering), and design automation. You should have a strong command of Design for X (DfX) principles, including Design for Manufacturing, Quality, Circularity, and Cost.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in leading 3D CAD software (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks) and a strong command of PLM processes and tools (particularly Teamcenter). Your experience must include demonstrated proficiency in core HVAC or similar mechanical domains, including structural design, refrigeration system components, sheet metal fabrication, and complex piping and tubing layouts.
  • Advanced Methodologies: A solid understanding of integrating advanced capabilities into the design process, such as Model-Based Definition (MBD) and Product Manufacturing Information (PMI), to automate workflows and reduce rework.
  • Innovative Mindset: A passion for staying current with emerging technology trends, including AI-driven generative design, design for additive manufacturing, AR collaboration, and IoT-driven design.
  • Strategic Contribution: The ability to help shape the future of engineering design by experimenting with new technologies and contributing to the strategic roadmap.
  • Exceptional Communication: Superb written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and effectively.

The role requires strong mechanical engineering fundamentals, hands‑on 3D design using Catia (or equivalent), and the ability to collaborate across electrical, manufacturing, and marketing teams to deliver market‑ready solutions quickly.

  • Lead NPD projects for wiring device products from concept through production release.
  • Manage LCM activities, including design revisions, reliability testing, and end‑of‑life planning.
  • Create and validate 3D models and detailed drawings using Catia or equivalent CAD tools.
  • Coordinate cross‑functional teams (electrical, manufacturing, quality) to ensure design feasibility.
  • Develop and maintain product specifications, bill of materials, and technical documentation.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, cost analyses, and risk assessments for new designs.
  • Present design proposals and progress updates to senior management and stakeholders.
  • Support prototype build, testing, and validation activities.
  • Ensure compliance with relevant industry standards and safety regulations.
  • Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in design and documentation.

Qualifications

  • Mechanical Engineering degree (B.E./B.Tech or equivalent).
  • 4–6 years of experience in mechanical design, preferably in the electrical industry.
  • Proficiency in Catia or comparable 3D CAD software (mandatory).
  • Demonstrated experience in new product development and life‑cycle management.
  • Strong understanding of wiring devices, electrical components, and related standards.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work under tight timelines and join with minimal lead time.
  • Problem‑solving mindset with a focus on innovation and quality.
  • Familiarity with GD&T, tolerance analysis, and manufacturing processes.
  • Team player with the ability to influence cross‑functional stakeholders.

job.title: EHS Officer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About the business

A leading provider of rolling stock, infrastructure and advanced technologies for global rail customers. The company delivers locomotives and engines, trackwork, signaling, fasteners, and comprehensive locomotive and freight car services, along with aftermarket parts and recycling. Its technology portfolio includes data analytics, automation, connected assets, predictive maintenance and yard optimization tools.

About the role

Reporting to the EHS Manager, the EHS Officer provides administrative and operational support to the Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) function. The role supports the implementation of EHS programs, compliance activities, inspections, reporting, training, audits and continuous improvement initiatives across the business. The successful candidate will play an important role in promoting a safe, healthy and environmentally responsible workplace while ensuring compliance with local regulations and company standards

About You

  • Diploma qualification with at least 5 years' experience in an EHS role, or a Bachelor's degree with at least 3 years' experience in an EHS role.
  • Certified General Occupational Health and Safety Expert (AK3U) or Intermediate Occupational Health and Safety Expert (AK3 Madya).
  • Knowledge of ISO 14001:2015, ISO 45001:2018 and SMK3 PP 50/2012 requirements.
  • Understanding of Contractor Safety Management Systems (CSMS) and EHS tendering requirements.
  • Experience within manufacturing, rail, mining, oil and gas, or other high-risk industries preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse EHS data and use incident reporting and investigation systems.
  • Strong planning, organisational and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative and solutions-focused approach to work

Responsibilities of the Position

  • Support implementation of EHS policies, standards, procedures and company programs.
  • Assist with hazard identification, risk assessments and environmental impact assessments.
  • Conduct workplace inspections, observations and audits, and assist with corrective actions.
  • Support incident reporting, investigations and follow-up actions.
  • Maintain EHS documentation, records and filing systems.
  • Coordinate EHS reporting, training records and compliance monitoring activities.
  • Deliver EHS inductions and support employee training programs.
  • Assist with customer EHS tender submissions and Contractor Safety Management System (CSMS) requirements.
  • Support operational teams with onshore and offshore EHS matters.
  • Promote a positive safety culture through ongoing communication and engagement with employees.

What We Offer

Our goal is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just a salary because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides benefits along with the potential for an annual bonus.

About Our Process

We’re proud to build a workplace grounded in strong values, collaboration, and opportunity. We’re looking for a motivated individual who not only meet the requirements of the role, but who are excited to contribute to our culture and shared success.

As part of our commitment to safety and excellence, the recruitment process will include background checks such as police history, medical assessments, drug and alcohol testing.

If you’re ready to take the next step in your career and join a growing, dynamic team where your contribution truly matters, we encourage you to apply today.

We look forward to learning more about you!

Final Details

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Engineering Leader to lead the Product Engineering team in India. In this role, you will manage a global team of more than 20 engineers across India and China, with responsibility for delivering new product options (PVR/DTOs), Product change introductions (PCIs), driving continuous product improvement (CPI), and executing material cost reduction initiatives to enhance product competitiveness and business performance.

The Product Engineering team plays a critical role within the REPS Engineering organization, optimizing global products to meet evolving customer requirements while delivering sustained value to the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a global team of more than 20 engineers across India and China, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence.
  • Drive sales growth by enabling timely execution of Product Change Introduction (PCI) initiatives through cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Lead the development and delivery of Design-to-Order (DTO) solutions for FGW and Caterpillar customers, partnering closely with Product Management and Sales teams to secure and support multi-million-dollar business opportunities.
  • Deliver continuous product improvements (CPI) that enhance product quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction, with a strong focus on 2MIS and 12MIS performance metrics.
  • Own and execute the REPS Material Cost Reduction (MCR) strategy, delivering multi-million-dollar annual savings through large-scale, globally coordinated cost optimization projects.
  • Lead major product updates and lifecycle enhancements for existing products, ensuring technical robustness, compliance, and market competitiveness.
  • Drive continuous improvement across engineering value streams, improving efficiency, quality, speed of execution, and business outcomes.
  • Promote effective knowledge sharing, standardization, and best-practice adoption across global engineering teams to maximize organizational capability and scalability.
  • Build strong partnerships with Product, Sales, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and other key stakeholders to deliver customer-focused solutions and business results.

What We’re Looking For

  • Global Leadership: Ability to lead cross-functional teams, build strong partnerships, and influence outcomes across regions.
  • Effective Communication: Communicate clearly and confidently with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Problem Solving: Apply structured thinking to solve complex technical and business challenges.
  • People Development: Build, mentor, and retain a high-performing global engineering team.
  • Customer Focus: Understand customer needs and business priorities while adapting to changing market demands.
  • Product Design & Development: Strong knowledge of product design, NPI, and product lifecycle management processes.
  • Continuous Improvement: Demonstrate a commitment to learning, innovation, and operational excellence.

Top Candidates Will Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or a related Engineering discipline, with 10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Proven leadership experience managing teams and delivering complex engineering projects.
  • Experience in the genset, engine, power generation, or related industries.
  • Strong knowledge of product development, NPI, and product lifecycle processes.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-driven, results-oriented, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Lean and/or Six Sigma experience preferred.

Additional Information

This mid-level leadership role involves managing product design and development for electric power gensets/energy solutions ranging from 20-2500 kVA under the Caterpillar and FGW brands. You will collaborate with various departments and work closely with our operations facilities in the US, Brazil, China, and India.

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Attractive compensation package based on experience and qualifications.
  • Relocation Support: Assistance with in-country relocation to Bangalore, India.
  • Health and Wellness: Comprehensive health insurance plans.
  • Professional Development: Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth, including training programs and certifications.
  • Work-Life Balance: Flexible work hours and policies to support a healthy work-life balance.
  • Paid Time Off: Generous vacation, holiday, and sick leave policies.
  • Employee Assistance Programs: Support for mental health, financial planning, and other personal needs.
  • Global Exposure: Opportunity to work with a diverse, global team and gain international experience.
  • Innovative Environment: Be part of a forward-thinking company that values innovation and excellence.

Company Culture:

Our company culture is built on a foundation of collaboration, innovation, and excellence. Here are some key aspects:

  • Collaborative Environment: We foster a team-oriented atmosphere where collaboration and open communication are encouraged. Our global teams work together to achieve common goals and drive success.
  • Innovation-Driven: We value creativity and innovation, constantly seeking new ways to improve our products and processes. Employees are encouraged to think outside the box and contribute their unique ideas.
  • Commitment to Excellence: We strive for the highest standards in everything we do, from product quality to customer service. Our commitment to excellence drives us to continuously improve and excel in our industry.
  • Diversity and Inclusion: We embrace diversity and believe that a diverse workforce brings different perspectives and ideas, leading to better solutions and a more inclusive workplace.
  • Professional Growth: We support continuous learning and development, offering opportunities for employees to grow their skills and advance their careers. Mentorship and training programs are available to help employees reach their full potential.
  • Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of maintaining a healthy work-life balance and offer flexible work arrangements to support our employees' well-being.
  • Employee Recognition: We recognize and celebrate the achievements and contributions of our employees. Regular feedback and recognition programs ensure that hard work and dedication are acknowledged.

Additional Information: This job requires 5days in a week working from office
