job.title: Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Your Impact Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Senior Analyst – Threat & Vulnerability Management

to join Infrastructure Services -CAT IT Division

The Senior Vulnerability Management Analyst is responsible for leading the identification, prioritization, tracking, and remediation governance of critical security vulnerabilities across the enterprise. This role serves as a key liaison between cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, and business teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within established SLAs and organizational risk thresholds.

The Senior Analyst will leverage ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, security scanning platforms, and advanced reporting capabilities to drive accountability, improve remediation performance, identify systemic risks, and provide executive-level visibility into the organization's security posture. The role requires strong analytical, stakeholder management, and leadership communication skills, along with the ability to influence remediation outcomes across multiple technology teams.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield PSN Office , Bangalore -KA

What you will do

Vulnerability Management & Remediation Governance

  • Lead the end-to-end management of critical and high-risk vulnerabilities, ensuring remediation activities align with organizational SLAs and security policies.
  • Monitor and analyze vulnerability data from ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and vulnerability scanning platforms to identify aged, recurring, and high-impact security risks.
  • Validate vulnerability records, asset ownership mappings, assignment groups, risk scores, and remediation status.
  • Drive accountability by assigning, tracking, and escalating remediation activities across infrastructure, cloud, network, application, and endpoint teams.
  • Evaluate remediation plans, compensating controls, and exception requests to ensure appropriate risk treatment decisions.
  • Support vulnerability prioritization using CVSS scores, exploitability, threat intelligence, business criticality, and asset context.

ServiceNow Administration & Process Optimization

  • Act as a subject matter expert for ServiceNow Vulnerability Response workflows and reporting.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, workflows, reports, and KPIs to improve vulnerability management effectiveness.
  • Identify process inefficiencies and recommend automation opportunities to enhance tracking, reporting, and remediation activities.
  • Partner with platform teams to improve vulnerability response processes and governance controls.

Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Engage directly with technical teams, application owners, infrastructure teams, and business stakeholders to obtain remediation commitments and timelines.
  • Facilitate remediation discussions, risk reviews, and vulnerability governance meetings.
  • Provide guidance to stakeholders on vulnerability remediation best practices and prioritization strategies.
  • Escalate SLA breaches, chronic offenders, and unresolved critical vulnerabilities to leadership and risk governance forums.
  • Mentor junior analysts and provide guidance on vulnerability management processes and cybersecurity best practices.

Data Analytics & Risk Reporting

  • Perform advanced analysis of vulnerability trends, remediation performance, recurring findings, and ownership gaps.
  • Develop metrics and reporting related to:
  • SLA compliance
  • Vulnerability aging
  • Risk exposure trends
  • Remediation effectiveness
  • Business unit performance
  • Executive risk posture
  • Create and maintain dashboards using ServiceNow, Excel, Power BI, or similar reporting tools.
  • Identify systemic issues and strategic improvement opportunities across security and IT operations.

Executive Communication & Leadership Reporting

  • Prepare executive-ready dashboards, scorecards, and presentations for cybersecurity and technology leadership.
  • Present vulnerability trends, key risks, remediation progress, and strategic recommendations during governance and leadership reviews.
  • Provide risk-based insights and recommendations to support decision-making and security investment priorities.
  • Communicate complex technical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

What you will have

  • 10–12 years of overall IT and Cybersecurity experience, with at least 5+ years focused on Vulnerability Management, Security Operations, Risk Management, or Cyber Defense functions.
  • Hands-on experience with ServiceNow Vulnerability Response and/or ITSM platforms.
  • Strong understanding of vulnerability management lifecycle, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation workflows.
  • Experience working with enterprise vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Strong knowledge of:
  • CVSS scoring
  • Common vulnerabilities and exposures (CVEs)
  • Asset criticality
  • Patch management
  • Risk and exception management
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and PowerPoint.
  • Experience interacting with senior leadership and presenting cybersecurity metrics and risk posture updates.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or related field.
  • Industry certifications such as:
  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • GSEC
  • Security+
  • CRISC
  • GIAC Vulnerability Management certifications
  • Experience with cloud security platforms and cloud-native vulnerability management.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards including:
  • NIST Cybersecurity Framework
  • CIS Controls
  • ISO 27001

PCI DSS

  • Experience leading vulnerability governance programs in large enterprise environments.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Risk Management
  • Vulnerability Assessment & Prioritization
  • Executive Stakeholder Management
  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • Data Analytics & Reporting
  • ServiceNow Vulnerability Response
  • Process Improvement & Automation
  • Leadership Communication
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Mentoring & Team Development

Success Measures

  • Reduction in overdue critical and high-risk vulnerabilities.
  • Improvement in remediation SLA compliance across business units.
  • Increased visibility and accountability through executive reporting.
  • Identification and remediation of systemic vulnerability management gaps.
  • Enhanced stakeholder engagement and risk governance effectiveness.

Skills desired:

Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Manages application-related issues, implications, and approaches with clients.
  • Evaluates key interfaces and interdependencies among core applications systems.
  • Explains features and benefits of core applications for consideration by business units.
  • Implements existing and planned application enhancements in major business units.
  • Tracks data flow between own applications and core applications in other business areas.
  • Plans enhancement, conversion, and retirement strategies for core applications.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Ensures capture of lessons to be learned from a problem-solving effort.
  • Organizes potential problem solvers and leads problem resolution efforts.
  • Uses varying problem-solving approaches and techniques as appropriate.
  • Contributes to standard practices for problem-solving approaches, tools, and processes.
  • Analyzes and synthesizes information and devises alternative resolution strategies.
  • Develops successful resolutions to critical or wide-impact problems.

Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Analyzes system requirements and translates them into detailed design specifications.
  • Designs complex application architectures that meet performance, scalability, and reliability requirements.
  • Evaluates and selects appropriate pattern, components, technologies, and tools for application development; integrates them with technical design.
  • Leads application design reviews and walkthroughs to ensure alignment between business requirements and technical solution.
  • Troubleshoots complex design issues and provides innovative solutions.
  • Prepares technical design documents and blueprints for applications.

Implementation: Knowledge of how to run applications for organizations; ability to implement application software within an organization and help end-users perform specific tasks (ex: accounting or graphic design). Level Working Knowledge:

  • Tracks problems associated with the quality and effectiveness of application software.
  • Researches the benefits and drawbacks of an organization's application software.
  • Drafts application software usage for the department's needs.
  • Provides instant support for end users of application software.
  • Implements a specific application software under the supervision of management.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Plays an active or leading role in recording and storing requirement documents in various forms.
  • Ensures the successful completion of all major activities, tasks and deliverables pertaining to the requirement analysis stage.
  • Supervises the advanced use of requirements analysis tools and services, including prototyping and use cases.
  • Produces detailed functional and information requirements models and documentation.
  • Trains others on requirements walkthroughs and quality reviews.
  • Utilizes automated diagramming tools to ensure traceability of requirements.

System and Technology Integration: Knowledge of the features and facilities of systems; ability to integrate and communicate among applications, databases and technology platforms. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Designs and develops applications or technology interfaces and bridges.
  • Documents existing best practices for system or technology integration processes.
  • Identifies and quantifies risks of proposed alternatives to a system or technology integration initiative.
  • Delivers training on major issues, interfaces, considerations and potential pitfalls and risks.
  • Discusses with line areas on data, technology and application integration issues.
  • Advises others in how to integrate projects across multiple technologies.

System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Verifies the proper flow of transactions across all input, output and storage channels or devices.
  • Evaluates interoperability of new systems with existing systems during the beta testing phase.
  • Supervises the testing of complex, multi-platform and distributed applications.
  • Designs processes to ensure that the system meets and maintains requirements and expectations.
  • Coaches end users on the development of test data and test scenarios for system validation.
  • Manages the execution of test plans, including resources, strategies, schedules, processes and tools.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and resolve technical issues on hardware, software, application or operation. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers, analyzes, and resolves hardware, software or application problems.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities.
  • Handles calls related to product features, applications, and compatibility standards.
  • Analyzes code, logs, and current systems as part of advanced troubleshooting.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, solving processes and tools that have been used.

What you will get:

  • Earned and medical leave.
  • Relocation assistance

Holistic Development

  • Personal and professional development through Caterpillar ‘s employee resource groups across the globe
  • Career developments opportunities with global prospects

Health and Wellness

  • Medical coverage -Medical, life and personal accident coverage
  • Employee mental wellness assistance program

Financial Wellness

  • Employee investment plan
  • Pay for performance -Annual incentive Bonus plan.

Additional Information:

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers)

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

job.description:
Job Title: QA/QC Manager – Fit-Out (Data Center)

Company: DAMAC Digital

Location: Indonesia

About the Role

DAMAC Digital is seeking a QA/QC Manager – Fit-Out to lead and manage all quality assurance and quality control activities for data center fit-out works in Indonesia. You will ensure that all construction activities, materials, workmanship, inspections and documentation comply with approved designs, project specifications, applicable standards, client requirements and established quality procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement and maintain project quality plans, inspection and test plans (ITPs) and QA/QC procedures for fit-out works.
  • Lead and manage the QA/QC team, including site inspectors and document controllers.
  • Review and approve material submittals, method statements and contractor quality documentation.
  • Carry out and oversee inspections, testing and commissioning checks to verify workmanship against drawings and specifications.
  • Raise, track and close non-conformance reports (NCRs), corrective actions and snag lists.
  • Conduct quality audits of contractors and suppliers, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Maintain complete quality records and handover documentation.
  • Report quality performance and risks to project and senior management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction or a related field.
  • Proven experience in QA/QC management on construction or fit-out projects; data center experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of international construction standards and quality management systems (e.g. ISO 9001).
  • Experience with MEP, electrical, mechanical and cooling systems in mission-critical environments.
  • Strong leadership, communication and contractor management skills.
  • Professional quality certifications are an advantage.

job.title: MEP Defect Manager
job.description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Defect MEP Manager​ to lead the MEP defect rectification and punch list management​ for our data center projects in Malaysia. You will act as the owner’s representative on MEP quality issues, ensuring all mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems are completed to the highest standards, fully compliant, and ready for commissioning and handover.

Key Responsibilities

1. Defect Identification & Management

  • Lead and coordinate all MEP defect inspections during the construction and commissioning phases.
  • Develop, maintain, and regularly update the MEP defect register, ensuring clear status tracking, priorities, and closure targets.
  • Classify defects by severity, system, and impact on safety, performance, and schedule.

2. Rectification Oversight

  • Review and verify contractor defect rectification proposals, ensuring completeness and compliance with specifications.
  • Supervise and coordinate MEP subcontractors’ repair and rework activities on-site to ensure timely and high-quality closure of all punch list items.
  • Witness and verify re-testing and re-commissioning of affected systems after defect rectification.

3. Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Ensure all MEP defect rectification complies with approved drawings, specifications, industry standards, and client requirements.
  • Conduct random quality checks on completed works to identify potential defects early and prevent recurrence.
  • Support internal and third-party audits related to MEP quality and defect closure.

4. Coordination & Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary liaison between the construction team, MEP subcontractors, consultants, and the client on all MEP defect matters.
  • Participate in regular progress, quality, and defect review meetings with the project team and client representatives.
  • Provide clear and timely reporting to management on defect trends, progress, and potential risks.

5. Documentation & Handover

  • Ensure all defect reports, inspection records, test results, and as-built updates are accurately documented and filed.
  • Support the preparation of final MEP handover documentation, including O&M manuals and warranties.
  • Verify that all punch list items are fully resolved and formally closed out prior to project handover.

6. Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze root causes of recurring MEP defects and recommend preventive actions to improve construction quality.
  • Provide feedback to the design and construction teams to address systemic issues and optimize future project delivery.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Education:​ Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Building Services Engineering (or related field).
  • Experience:Minimum 8–10 years​ of experience in MEP construction, with at least 5 years​ in a leadership role focused on defect management or quality assurance.
  • Proven track record managing MEP defects on large-scale data center or mission-critical facility projects.
  • Experience working on projects in Malaysia or the Southeast Asia region is highly preferred.

Technical Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of MEP systems, including HVAC, electrical distribution, UPS, generators, fire protection, plumbing, and BMS/ELV.
  • Familiarity with relevant codes, standards, and best practices in data center construction.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • Certified Quality Manager (CQM), Certified Construction Quality Manager (CCQM), or equivalent.
  • LEED AP, CDCP, or other relevant certifications are advantageous.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:

job.title: Electrical Specialist Chargeman
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Chargeman (Electrical) within the Tech Ops team, you will support the safe operation, inspection, and maintenance of AirTrunk’s electrical infrastructure across the Johor Bahru data Centre campuses (JHB1 and JHB2).

Working closely with the Critical Environment Specialist (Competent Engineer) and the operations team, you will assist in maintaining reliable operation of electrical systems ranging from low-voltage distribution up to medium-voltage systems, ensuring they are operated safely and in compliance with Malaysian electrical regulations.

You will play a key role in supporting daily electrical operations, inspection activities, and switching operations while helping maintain the reliability of mission-critical electrical infrastructure supporting hyperscale data Centre operations.

Key focus areas include:

  • Supporting the safe operation of electrical infrastructure, including medium-voltage and low-voltage systems across the data Centre campus.
  • Assisting the Competent Engineer in inspection, monitoring, and maintenance of electrical installations.
  • Supporting the Competent Engineer inspection program, including field inspections and preparation of inspection documentation.
  • Performing authorized medium-voltage switching operations and assisting in low-voltage switching activities.
  • Supporting switching activities as part of a buddy system during high voltage switching operations led by the Competent Engineer.
  • Monitoring equipment condition, identifying defects, and supporting rectification activities to maintain system reliability and compliance.
  • Supporting safe electrical operations across JHB1 and JHB2 facilities.

Your Day to Day

  • Monitor the condition and operation of medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, ensuring safe and reliable operation of electrical infrastructure.
  • Perform routine inspections of 22kV medium-voltage equipment, including switchgear installed at High Voltage Plant (HVP) and Kiosk Transformer (KTX) locations.
  • Perform inspections of 415V low-voltage systems, including generator systems and Power Transfer Units (PTU).
  • Support the internal Competent Engineer inspection program by assisting in inspection activities and preparing draft inspection reports for review by the Competent Engineer.
  • Assist the Competent Engineer during high-voltage inspection activities, including statutory inspection of substations, transformers, and high-voltage switchgear.
  • Perform authorized medium-voltage switching operations in accordance with approved switching procedures.
  • Assist with low voltage switching and system isolation activities during maintenance, testing, or operational works.
  • Support high voltage switching operations as a switching assistant under the direction of the Competent Engineer as part of a buddy system.
  • Identify equipment defects, abnormal conditions, and safety concerns, perform minor defect rectification where possible, and coordinate with relevant teams or contractors to ensure timely resolution of outstanding issues.
  • Assist in coordinating maintenance activities, contractor works, and equipment inspections across the electrical infrastructure.
  • Support preparation and implementation of Method of Procedure (MOP) for operational and maintenance works.
  • Maintain accurate operational logs, inspection records, and maintenance documentation for electrical installations.
  • Assist the operations team in maintaining compliance with Malaysian electrical regulatory requirements and internal safety procedures.
  • Provide operational support during electrical incidents, system disturbances, or emergency situations.
  • Record operational parameters and equipment readings during inspections to support condition monitoring and regulatory requirements.
  • Supervise and coordinate contractor works to ensure maintenance and repair activities are carried out safely and in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Support preventive maintenance and corrective maintenance activities for electrical infrastructure across the campus.

Requirements

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in electrical operations, maintenance, or engineering roles within substations, industrial facilities, power plants, or mission-critical environments.
  • Valid Chargeman B4 Certificate issued by Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST), authorized for electrical installations up to 33 kV.
  • Experience in operating and maintaining medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical systems, including switchgear, transformers, generators, and electrical distribution systems.
  • Experience performing electrical switching operations, inspections, and maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Ability to read and interpret single line diagrams (SLD), electrical schematics, and protection system drawings.
  • Familiarity with Malaysian electrical regulatory requirements, including safe operation of electrical installations and compliance with the Electricity Supply Act and Electricity Regulations.
  • Experience working in mission-critical environments such as data centres, substations, power plants, or large industrial facilities is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety practices, operational discipline, and procedural compliance.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team-based operational environment, supporting the Competent Engineer and coordinating with operations, engineering teams, and contractors.
  • Good communication skills in English and Malay.
  • Ability to remain calm and systematic in high-pressure operational situations, including electrical incidents or emergency response scenarios.

The AirTrunk Culture

job.title: Deputy Manager, HSE
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Role Purpose

The Deputy Manager, HSE supports the implementation and continuous improvement of Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) programmes, governance frameworks and management systems across Keppel's divisions/platform portfolios. The role partners business and operational teams to drive regulatory compliance, effective risk management, operational excellence and a positive safety culture across diverse assets, projects and operational environments.

The incumbent is expected to support HSE initiatives across multiple business segments and be adaptable to changing business priorities and deployment requirements.

Key Responsibilities

1. HSE Governance and Assurance

  • Support the implementation and continual improvement of HSE policies, standards and management systems across assigned assets, operations and projects.
  • Coordinate and facilitate HSE committee meetings, management reviews and stakeholder engagements.
  • Plan and conduct workplace inspections, audits and compliance assessments to verify adherence to statutory, corporate and client requirements.
  • Monitor HSE performance indicators and assist in preparing management reports, dashboards and governance updates.

2. Risk Management and Operational Safety

  • Conduct and review risk assessments, safe work procedures and Method Statements to ensure hazards are identified and adequately controlled.
  • Support Permit-to-Work (PTW) processes and verify that critical risk activities are properly assessed and authorised.
  • Provide HSE advice and guidance to operational teams, contractors and project personnel on risk mitigation measures and safe work practices.
  • Participate in design reviews, operational readiness assessments and management of change processes where required.

3. Incident Management and Investigation

  • Support the reporting, investigation and management of incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.
  • Facilitate root cause analysis and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
  • Track and verify the completion and effectiveness of corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Share lessons learnt and promote continuous improvement across business units.

4. Contractor and Stakeholder Management

  • Support contractor pre-qualification, onboarding and performance monitoring processes.
  • Engage contractors, vendors and service providers to ensure compliance with HSE requirements.
  • Participate in site engagements, safety campaigns and leadership walkthroughs to strengthen HSE culture.

5. Regulatory Compliance and Reporting

  • Maintain HSE documentation, records and statutory submissions in accordance with legal and corporate requirements.
  • Monitor changes in HSE regulations and support the implementation of compliance measures.
  • Liaise with regulatory authorities, auditors and external stakeholders as required.

6. HSE Capability Development

  • Support the planning and delivery of HSE training, awareness programmes, emergency drills and campaigns for employees and contractors.
  • Promote proactive reporting of hazards, near misses and improvement opportunities.
  • Contribute to initiatives that enhance HSE culture, workforce competency and operational excellence.

7. General Support

  • Provide operational and administrative support for HSE programmes and strategic initiatives.

job.title: Facilities Caretaker
job.description:
• Hobsonville Location
  • Free onsite Parking
  • Full-time/Permanent Position - Monday to Friday work days 6am -2pm (no evenings or weekends)

About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are responsive, innovative and trusted in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

Facilities Cleaners play a crucial role in upholding the impeccable appearance of CDC facilities, both inside and out. Their responsibilities are vital in supporting the CDC Team's efforts to provide a top-notch customer experience and ensure the continuous, secure functioning of the facilities.

Other duties include:

  • Ensure the data centre maintains an exceptional level of cleanliness and presentation.
  • Regularly inspect the site and facilities, promptly reporting any identified defects.
  • Perform various office maintenance tasks, such as emptying bins, vacuuming, and restocking supplies.
  • Take responsibility for restroom hygiene, including mopping, replenishing paper towels and rolls, and maintaining overall cleanliness.
  • Collaborate with the Operations team, liaise with contractors for routine maintenance, report incidents, and participate in HSE meetings, contributing to a safe and well-maintained environment.

About you

**We’re looking for a reliable and experienced cleaner to join our team. If you have worked as a commercial cleaner or in a similar role—such as aged care or hospitality—you may be a great fit for this position. Our facilities are large and highly secure, so we need someone comfortable working in this type of environment.

All applicants will need to complete a health assessment as part of our commitment to workplace health and safety. This is a general health check, and a report will be shared with the hiring team to ensure we can support you in the role.

This position is ideal for someone looking to move away from shift work, casual roles, or night shifts. There’s no weekend or after-hours work, and you'll be part of a friendly, supportive team. You’ll work alongside another cleaner and the wider facilities team.

Essential:

  • New Zealand Citizenship and ability to obtain a security clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

job.title: Supervisor - Projects - PNG
job.description:
Responsibilities

PNG Projects Engineer - S3

Project Execution and Support:

  • Assist in the execution of PNG, including site preparation, equipment installation, and commissioning, ensuring all tasks are completed according to project plans and timelines.
  • Collaborate with the Projects Lead to ensure that all engineering activities meet design specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
  • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments to monitor progress, identify potential issues, and ensure that all work complies with technical specifications.
  • Prepare and update detailed engineering drawings, technical documents, and project plans, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and services required for project completion.

Technical Support and Problem Solving:

  • Provide technical support to the project team, troubleshooting and resolving engineering issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Analyze and interpret technical data, drawings, and specifications to support decision-making and ensure the successful completion of project tasks.
  • Implement engineering solutions to address on-site challenges, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines and budget.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of engineering best practices, focusing on improving efficiency, safety, and quality in project execution.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, providing input and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Quality Control and Assurance:

  • Monitor and enforce quality control measures throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that all work meets the required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections and tests on materials, equipment, and systems to verify their compliance with project requirements and industry regulations.
  • Document and report any quality issues or non-conformities, working with the project team to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
  • Assist in the development of quality assurance plans and procedures, ensuring that they are effectively implemented and adhered to during project execution.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all engineering activities comply with local, regional, and national safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Provide input on safety protocols and procedures, ensuring that they are followed by all team members and contractors during project execution.
  • Assist in the preparation of safety documentation, including risk assessments, method statements, and safety plans, ensuring they are complete and accurate.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including engineering drawings, technical specifications, progress reports, and inspection records.
  • Prepare regular project status reports for the Projects Lead, highlighting key achievements, challenges, and any areas requiring attention.
  • Assist in the preparation of as-built documentation upon project completion, ensuring that all records reflect the final state of the project.
  • Ensure that all documentation is properly filed and accessible, supporting future project reviews and audits.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in project meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on project planning and execution.
  • Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to resolve any technical issues and ensure alignment on project objectives and timelines.
  • Provide clear and concise technical information to non-engineering team members, ensuring they understand the requirements and constraints of the project.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to PNG or CNG projects.
  • Identify opportunities for improving engineering processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance project performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth and contribution to the project team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the project team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Regional office
  • Corporate office
  • TechnoCommercial Team
  • HSE Team
  • Operations & Maintenance

External Stakeholders:

  • Vendors
  • Contractors
  • Local authorities
  • Regulatory bodies
  • Consultants

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience:

2+ years of experience, preferably in construction project management.

Proven experience in managing large-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

professional certifications/ Project Management Professional (PMP) (Value Addition)

job.title: Communications Advisor - Consumer and Chief Operating Office
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Communications Advisor, this role supports the delivery of clear, practical and engaging communications for Optus Retail and Contact Centre frontline teams. Working across a pooled team model, the role translates operational and business priorities into timely, audience-focused communications across written, visual and video channels. It leverages strong stakeholder engagement and sound judgement to simplify complex information, identify the right audience and select the most effective communication approach. The role also supports content creation, publishing, campaign delivery and frontline engagement initiatives, flexing across teams to meet changing business needs, support peak periods and incidents, and help ensure frontline teams remain informed, aligned and equipped to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Draft and deliver frontline communications, including updates, leader messages, MyHub posts, quick guides, FAQs and campaign materials.
  • Translate complex operational, technical and business information into clear, actionable content for different audiences and channels.
  • Support Retail and Contact Centre priorities through shared planning, agreed sequencing and coordinated delivery of major initiatives such as Your Voice.
  • Create and adapt visual content using Canva or equivalent tools, and produce short-form video using Shootsa or similar platforms.
  • Develop reusable templates and production approaches that improve quality, speed, consistency and team capability.
  • Work with stakeholders to clarify communication needs, recommend appropriate channels, formats and timing, and challenge duplication or unnecessary complexity.
  • Review content for accuracy, clarity, accessibility, brand alignment and tone of voice, escalating operational, reputational or audience risks.
  • Publish, maintain and refresh content across MyHub and other relevant channels, keeping accurate records of approvals, publishing dates and communication rhythms.
  • Monitor frontline feedback and questions, identify themes and gaps, and contribute to measuring and improving communication effectiveness.
  • Work flexibly across Consumer, COO, Retail and Contact Centres, supporting leaders with research, reporting and coordination during peaks, incidents and major launches.

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex information into clear, practical and actionable messages for frontline audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess audience needs and apply sound judgement to select the most effective communication channel, format and delivery approach.
  • Experience creating engaging visual and video content using tools such as Canva, Shootsa or similar digital content platforms.
  • Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships, challenge constructively and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Strong planning, coordination and quality assurance capabilities, with experience managing competing priorities, maintaining content accuracy and using frontline insights to drive continuous improvement.

The good stuff

  • Competitive remuneration and colleague discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and outstanding shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym, and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network, and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Join us for an outstanding career opportunity!

job.title: Director, Carrier Sales
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Be a Part of Something BIG!

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially driven Director, Carrier Sales to lead and accelerate the growth of Singtel's carrier business in Singapore and across the region. Reporting to the VP, Carrier Services, you will lead a team of Account Managers serving telecommunications carriers, global service providers, hyperscalers and service-based operators. This senior sales leadership role is accountable for revenue growth, profitability, new customer acquisition and customer excellence. You will shape regional sales execution and strengthen Singtel's position as a leading connectivity and digital infrastructure partner.

Make An Impact

Sales Leadership & Business Growth

  • Lead the Carrier Sales business with accountability for revenue, operating expenditure and EBITDA performance.
  • Develop and execute sales strategies to accelerate profitable growth, expand market share and strengthen competitive positioning.
  • Win new business and expand existing accounts across carrier, hyperscaler and global service provider segments.
  • Drive regional sales growth through new customer acquisition, commercial opportunities and strategic customer relationships.
  • Oversee carrier sales activities and business performance across Singapore, Malaysia and the Philippines.

Strategic Account & Customer Management

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with key customers and decision-makers.
  • Strengthen engagement with global hyperscalers, telecommunications operators and multinational customers to drive sustainable revenue.
  • Champion customer excellence by improving responsiveness, service delivery and customer satisfaction.
  • Drive disciplined account planning, pipeline management, sales forecasting, commercial negotiations and payment collection.

Commercial & Operational Excellence

  • Optimise sales performance, cost-to-serve and operational efficiency to improve margins in a competitive market.
  • Collaborate with product, network, operations, finance and other business units to deliver compelling customer solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to grow wallet share, monetise existing accounts and introduce new services.
  • Improve sales processes and customer engagement to strengthen commercial effectiveness.

People Leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of Account Managers with clear sales goals and accountability.
  • Build sales capabilities to navigate complex multinational customer organisations and close high-value opportunities.
  • Develop talent, strengthen succession pipelines and foster an engaged, collaborative sales culture.

Skills for Success

  • Extensive experience in B2B, enterprise or carrier sales, with a proven record of delivering significant revenue growth and exceeding targets.
  • Demonstrated success leading substantial sales portfolios and high-performing sales teams, with accountability for revenue, profitability and customer growth.
  • Strong commercial sales experience within telecommunications, ICT, cloud, connectivity or digital infrastructure sectors.
  • Proven ability to acquire customers, expand accounts and build sustainable sales pipelines across regional or multinational markets.
  • Established record of engaging C-suite decision-makers and closing complex, high-value deals.
  • Strong commercial acumen in pricing, contract negotiations, margin management and sales forecasting.
  • Ability to coach and develop sales teams to achieve ambitious business targets.
  • Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management and influencing skills.
  • Results-driven, commercially astute and customer-focused, with strong ownership and accountability.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

At Singtel, you will help shape the future of connectivity and digital infrastructure while working with leading telecommunications operators and global technology companies. Drive meaningful commercial impact, develop high-performing sales teams and contribute to our continued growth across Singapore and the region.

Join us and help shape the next chapter of Singtel’s carrier business.

job.title: Early Careers
job.description:
What you will do

Depending on your assigned pathway, you will:

  • Develop an understanding of Colt’s business, customers, network and operational environment.
  • Support day-to-day activities and projects within your assigned Operations & Engineering team.
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues and stakeholders across different teams and functions.
  • Develop practical knowledge and skills relevant to your chosen pathway through hands-on experience and structured learning.
  • Support the planning, coordination and continuous improvement of operational activities and processes.
  • Analyse information and data to support reporting, decision-making and operational improvements.
  • Contribute to projects and initiatives that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Learn and use the systems, tools and processes relevant to your area.
  • Build effective relationships with internal teams, customers, suppliers and other stakeholders, as relevant to your pathway.
  • Bring fresh ideas and perspectives and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Take ownership of your learning and development throughout the programme.

What we're looking for

Your strengths

  • Bachelor’s degree or above.
  • Native-level Japanese language skills.
  • Conversational English skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with good logical and analytical thinking.
  • Strong interest in developing a career within Operations, Engineering, Telecommunications or Service Delivery.
  • Willingness and ability to learn new skills and technologies.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Collaborative and proactive approach.
  • Flexibility and willingness to take on new challenges.

Depending on the pathway, we may also look for

  • Academic background or interest in Telecommunications, Civil Engineering, Engineering, Technology, Business or another relevant discipline.
  • Interest in telecommunications, network infrastructure and technology.
  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Exposure to project-based work through university, internships or other activities.
  • Ability to work effectively with different stakeholders.
  • Flexibility to work outside standard business hours or in a 24/7 operational environment where the selected pathway requires it.

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

job.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer – Subject Matter Expert
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Principal Infrastructure Design Engineer is a highly skilled subject matter expert, responsible for managing the design and implementation of information systems to support the enterprise infrastructure of the organization.

This role ensures that all systems are working at optimal levels and provides expertise in the development of new technologies and system requirements.

The Principal Infrastructure Design Engineer may be responsible for coaching and mentoring junior resources within the team.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

Leads the maintenance of the ongoing reliability, performance and support of the infrastructure. Leads operating environments, responds to incidents and problems as well as planning for growth

  • Responsible for directing the release of new or upgraded technologies, including the design, installation, configuration, maintenance and performance testing of operating systems, networks.
  • Works cross functionally, using Infrastructure as code approach to write deployment scripts and automation.
  • Accountable for security of system and inter-application information transfers.
  • Works cross functionally to ensure maximum achievable uptime for entire network services and servers.
  • Enhances, plans capacity and designs related to infrastructure engineering projects.
  • Works cross functionally to capacity workload modelling and availability analysis for a variety of platforms, systems, and environments.
  • Recommends changes/enhancements for improved systems availability, reliability, and performance.
  • Develops, maintains, recommends, documents, and supports tools and back-end utilities to provide capacity planning management.
  • Accountable for ensuring participation in testing efforts and coordinating feedback of test results.
  • Leads the analysis and reporting of operational metrics to understand performance and to ensure success in process improvements.
  • Provides direction and insight into ways tasks can be automated.
  • Accountable for documenting, monitoring, reporting and directing the resolution of systemic issues.
  • Monitors production, outputs, and services to ensure that SLAs, and other quality metrics, are being met.
  • Responsible for actively supporting the design and review process of new systems.
  • Partners with internal and external clients when connectivity to client systems is involved.
  • Performs any other related task as required.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Extended understanding of multiple infrastructure solutions.
  • Extended knowledge of systems design and related engineering processes.
  • Extended knowledge of system administration, software development, and expertise to solve complex coding issues.
  • Has business acumen with excellent communication and organizational skills.
  • Excellent ability to effectively deal with stakeholders in challenging situations.

Extended understanding of regulatory requirements and organizational standards including security

  • Extended knowledge of the system design life cycle models.
  • Extended ability to design systems compatible with cloud computing architectures and selection of components.
  • Extended ability to use a variety of design tools.
  • Extended understanding of Infrastructure as Code, containerization technologies, such as Docker/Kubernetes.
  • Extended knowledge of software development practices, including Agile and CI/CD.
  • Extended proficiency in data security and privacy best practices.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Technical, Information Systems or a related field.
  • Relevant certifications, such as Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE), Microsoft Certified System Engineer (MCSE), Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) preferred.
  • Cloud Certifications (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect) preferred.
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) - Cloud Native Computing Foundation preferred.
  • Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) - Cloud Native Computing Foundation preferred.
  • Required Experience:
  • Extended demonstrated experience deploying and/or administrating infrastructure solutions.
  • Extended demonstrated experience in similar IT roles, with a focus on system design / architecture engineering.
  • Extended demonstrated working experience in a large-scale organization.
  • Extended demonstrated experience with software development lifecycles.
  • Extended demonstrated experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Sourcing Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Conducts complex analysis of markets, supply chains, and supply base; applies analysis to sourcing process improvement initiatives. Identifies qualified suppliers and executes sound source selection processes. Has regular interface with suppliers within area of responsibility and maintains the supplier relationship. Understands how key procurement principles are used toward assuring supply. Sources specialized items and executes complex sourcing strategies in accordance with agreed upong sourcing strategy / plans at the optimum cost, quality and relationship.

Key Responsibilities

Independently carries out sourcing activities with full consideration for the impact of those activities on the end-to-end supply chain. Executes sourcing tactics of varying complexity in accordance with established category/commodity strategies reflecting the optimum cost, quality, delivery. Participates in sourcing and category commodity strategy formulation. Analyzes complex sourcing and procurement initiatives and processes in support of the delivery of cost effective and high quality goods and services. Prepares and presents to senior procurement/sourcing leadership recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action. Ensures consistent application of sourcing procedures and processes. Supports procurement/sourcing management in activities such as price benchmarking, vendor management, industry and market analysis, process analysis, and model building. May lead a team of sourcing analysts and specialists at the business unit category and/or international procurement organization (IPO) regional level. Leads analysis projects/initiatives providing coaching to less experienced analysts and specialists. Negotiates select contracts. Develops and maintains effective relationships with suppliers to the benefit of both parties. Understands the importance of compliance and is alert to situations that can pose risk to Cummins Inc.

Competencies:

Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.

Category Strategy Development - Establishes category strategy using Total Value Performance (TVP) approach to define the Supply Base, Tooling and Technology Strategy to meet all current and future Cummins' needs; Manages risk and inclusion of diverse suppliers.

Cost and Value Management - Establishes and controls product and service costs using functional tools to deliver and track product and services at competitive prices. Ensures competitiveness of Cummins products in our markets while preserving desired margins. Utilizes Total Cost Opportunity (TCO) model methodology.

Intellectual Property Management - Assures protection of Cummins Intellectual Property to optimize the use of intellectual property for Cummins future competitive advantage by engaging the Legal and Procurement function; assures Cummins’ intellectual property ownership rights are clearly defined in executed agreements.

Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.

Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.

Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

Sourcing - Utilizes the purchasing functional system to support the Request For Quote process and establish a Total Cost of Ownership comparison of suppliers based on the category strategy and define the supplier that is most likely to meet Cummins and customer's needs.

Supplier Contract Development - Develops contracts based on the templates available that cover commercial and legal relationship between Cummins and supplier; incorporates commercial requirements and legal requirements in the region(s) that are covered by the contracts; drives engagement between stakeholders following the Supplier Agreement Contracting Process (SACP) and negotiations excellence skills.

Supplier Relationship Management - Defines category’s key/strategic suppliers. Manages the relationship of those suppliers using agreed Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) process with established work plan, senior sponsor meetings, and scorecards. Defines and evaluates a collaborative relationship with a category’s key/strategic suppliers to deliver value to Cummins and the supplier.

Supply Base Risk Management - Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1) Continuity of Supply, 2) Reputational Risk, and 3) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in field appropriate for the function required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of related work experience required

经验要求：

  • 5年以上采购及供应商质量管理（SQE）相关工作经验
  • 具备精密机加工或机械系统零部件采购经验
  • 有跨职能协作的领导经验
  • 有参与大型项目（如新产品导入、国产化项目）的采购支持经验优先

知识要求：

  • 精通精密机加工工艺和供应商管理
  • 熟悉机械系统装配件（如减震器、制动器、皮带系统等）相关知识
  • 了解采购流程、合同管理和供应链运营
  • 具备良好的英语沟通能力，能够支持全球项目协调
  • 熟练使用数据分析和采购管理工具

job.title: Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

  • Support Transitioning PSBU products to Phase 35 software (Core 2)
  • Requires collaboration with resources in US, India, UK and China, provides great global experience.
