job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools. Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field. Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor. Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens. Identifies additional service opportunities with customer. Completes training in line with skill and business requirements. Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation. Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.

Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.

Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)

Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution

Locally valid driving permit

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Basic level field service work experience

Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products

Customer service experience

Key Responsibilities

  • Service Delivery Monitoring :
  • Oversee Service Delivery Process (SDP) at dealerships, conduct audits, identify gaps, and drive improvements for a robust process.
  • Daily review and closure of critical breakdown and running-with-problem events by coordinating with customers, dealerships, and process owners.
  • Customer and Dealer Relationship Management :
  • Build strong relationships with key customers, proactively conduct customer visits, and address their concerns effectively.
  • Conduct monthly/quarterly meetings with OEMs/GOEMs and document actions for closure.
  • Performance Management :
  • Monitor Net Promoter Score (NPS) at dealerships, analyze detractors/passives, and implement improvements.
  • Review service KPIs, initiatives like SQM, Service Touch, Warranty, CEIT, and customer escalations with stakeholders.
  • Process Improvement :

  • Technical Support and Knowledge Sharing :

  • Share knowledge via Knowledge Management Systems (KMS), QSOL tickets, and training sessions.
  • Provide onsite technical expertise as needed and assist in field action campaigns and VPI programs.

Competencies:

  • Product Failure Reporting and Corrective/Preventive Action Systems : Defines and leads a process to record, prioritize, and resolve product failures using cross-functional reviews, rigorous problem-solving methods, failed parts transfer processes, data management tools, and project management practices.
  • Product Problem Solving : Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

  • Service Documentation : Creates and verifies customer, equipment, and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system.
  • Technical Escalation : Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database.

job.title: Vice President, Customer Care
job.description:
1. AO Complaint Team Oversight and Direction

  • The VP will serve as a key driver in providing effective oversight of the AO Complaint Team. This includes establishing clear accountability, consistent case-handling standards, appropriate escalation thresholds, and effective performance management across the complaint-handling teams.
  • The VP will provide direction and independent challenge on complex or sensitive AO complaint cases, ensure timely escalation of material issues, and drive ownership of corrective actions by the relevant operational teams. This level of oversight is important to ensure that member concerns are managed fairly, consistently and in line with service standards and regulatory expectations.

**

2. Case Quality, Reopening-Rate Improvement and AI Enablement

  • The VP will strengthen end-to-end case quality by setting clear expectations for investigations, documentation, written responses, and closure decisions. The focus will be on ensuring that complaints are fully investigated, root causes are addressed and member concerns are resolved comprehensively at the first closure.
  • A key objective will be to reduce reopened cases, repeat complaints and unnecessary escalations to uplift the quality and performance of the PCCWS and AO Complaint Teams.
  • The VP will also lead the evaluation and controlled adoption of appropriate AI-enabled tools to support complaint handling. Potential applications include complaint categorisation and prioritisation, case summarisation, identification of missing information or inconsistencies, quality-assurance reviews, trend analysis, root-cause identification, and management reporting. AI may also support the preparation of initial draft correspondence and case summaries, subject to mandatory human review and approval.
  • All AI use will be governed by appropriate controls, including data-security requirements, human oversight, auditability, and clear accountability. Final decisions on investigations, regulatory positions, written responses, and case closure will remain with authorised employees.

3. Governance, Regulatory and Risk Management

  • Complaint handling, particularly for Ombudsman and MPF-related cases, requires appropriate senior oversight due to the associated regulatory, reputational, and member-impact risks.
  • The VP will ensure that complaint investigations, case records, written responses, and closure decisions meet the required standards of objectivity, completeness, timeliness, integrity, and regulatory compliance. The role will strengthen case-data quality, management reporting, risk identification, root-cause analysis, and cross-functional remediation.
  • The VP will also manage sensitive stakeholder expectations and ensure timely escalation to senior management of material customer, operational, conduct, reputational and regulatory risks, supported by clear assessments, recommendations, and decision points.
  • The proposed VP role is a forward-looking investment in risk management, service resilience, and customer trust. It will provide clear senior ownership of complaint management, improve the quality and finality of case resolution, reduce avoidable reopened cases, and strengthen oversight across both the PCCW and AO Complaint Teams.

job.title: Sr. Delivery Consultant - Migrations and Modernization, AWS Professional Services, ASEAN
job.description:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives.

You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. job.title: AWS Partner Leader, Philippines & Thailand
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides companies of all sizes with an infrastructure web services platform in the cloud. With AWS you can requisition compute power, storage, and many other services – gaining access to a suite of elastic IT infrastructure services as your business demands them. AWS is the leading platform for designing and developing applications for the cloud and is growing at a staggering pace in terms of revenue, customers, people, and complexity. Reporting to the ASEAN Partner Leader, the Country Partner Leader owns the entire partner business and strategy for the Philippines and Vietnam. The Country Partner Leader is accountability for the entire partner landscape in the countries they cover, building a partner landscape plan that supports the AWS AGS Leaders strategic priorities and strategies to build the capabilities and capacity we need in our country partner landscape to support the growth priorities for AWS AGS country plans. This is a uniquely integrated role that brings together partner development and partner sales under a single leader responsible for driving revenue growth for AWS by driving new workloads on AWS with partners across identification to launch to delivery by building partner capability and accelerating co-sell across all partner types. They own our partner attach new launch workload goals, marketplace contract signing, AI and large migrations wins won through and with partners. The role directly manages a team of Partner Sales Managers (PSMs), anchored on our largest customer opportunities, and Partner Development Managers (PDMs) managing our ISV and SI partners anchored on our most important partnerships. The leader also serves as the virtual leader of a broader in-country team including Partner Solution Architects (PSA), Distributor PDMs, Partner Development Representatives (PDR), and Specialists. The successful candidate must be a proven leader who combines deep partner network expertise with strong sales execution. They will draw upon experience in account management, practice development, go-to-market solution positioning, relationship building, and working in both a direct and matrix operating structure. The individual must have deep experience managing a broad set of partners that are local and global from cloud-native start-ups and large system integrators to ISVs, consulting and advisory firms, value added resellers, distributors, and specialist solution providers.

Key job responsibilities Strategy & Workload Growth

  • Drive new workloads on AWS with partners, accelerate customer adoption of strategic and foundational workloads through APN consulting and technology partners via AWS Originated (AO), Partner Originated (PO), and Marketplace motions.
  • Define and execute the unified country partner strategy spanning SI, ISV, MSP, VAR, and Distributor across the full partner lifecycle: recruitment, onboarding, enablement, solution build, go-to-market, and co-sell.
  • Lead with industry solutions and GenAI, ensure partners build and deliver industry-specific, AI-enabled solutions that drive measurable business outcomes for customers. Champion the adoption of AWS AI services across the partner ecosystem.
  • Scale AWS Marketplace adoption, drive ISV and consulting partner transaction volume through Marketplace, including Consulting Partner Private Offers (CPPO), PPA demand plans, and customer Marketplace commitments. Position Marketplace as the primary route to market for partner solutions.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop the direct team of PSMs and PDMs (ISV & SI), setting priorities, coaching for performance, and ensuring alignment between partner sales and partner development activities.
  • Serve as virtual leader of the broader in-country partner team, PSA, Distributor PDM, PDR, and Specialists ensuring all partner-facing resources are aligned to country priorities and operating as one cohesive team.

Co-Sell & Pipeline Execution

  • Drive co-sell execution: shape deals early in the sales cycle, accelerate pipeline progression, align the right partners to strategic and foundational workloads, and unlock new Line of Business personas in customer accounts.
  • Architect customer-partner strategy, act as a trusted advisor aligning ISVs and G/SIs to high-priority customer workloads and industry use cases, shaping customers’ long-term partner ecosystems.
  • Orchestrate cross-functional resources (PSA, COE, CSM, MAP BD) to drive sales velocity, remove blockers, and maximize revenue realization across the partner portfolio.

Relationship Management & Governance

  • Manage strategic partner C-level relationships across a wide range of key partners, establishing the country partner team as the single point of contact for partnership management and growth.
  • Own forecast accuracy and operational cadence, lead MBR/QBR rhythm with partners and AWS country sales leadership, providing deep-dive insights into partner pipeline health and business performance.
  • Collaborate with AWS country leadership and represent AWS at industry and partner events to deliver thought leadership and strengthen the AWS partner brand in-market.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of building and leading large teams and working in matrixed operating structures experience
  • 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience working and communicating with multiple stakeholders, C-level executives and cross functional teams or equivalent

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of managing and developing high performance teams experience

job.title: Head of APJ Marketing, Strategic Customer and Partner Marketing
job.description:
As the SCPM Geo Leader for APJ, you will serve as the "Single Threaded Leader” (STL) for AWS marketing in your geography, informing and influencing the full marketing investment across digital, events, partner and ABM to maximize impact in your region. You work backwards to drive key marketing outputs (e.g., perception, Marketing Engaged Framework metrics) from brand to demand across channels. You are an advocate and “voice of the customer” representing the sale leadership and more importantly the growth targets of the Geo. You represent marketing outcomes that deliver revenue to the sales leader on behalf of WW Marketing; you directly own Account Based Marketing and influence the digital; event marketing, partner marketing and other Marketing program/ investments on behalf of your region. You will drive the regional ABM strategy while serving as the single point of accountability for representing your Geo back to all marketing teams.

Key job responsibilities -Ensure the marketing investments across functions (IDC, Events, Partner Marketing, ABM CoE, Industries, Developer, product marketing, andBrand) is aligned with the marketing growth by customer segment that is needed in your Geo.

  • Lead and scale the Account Based Marketing program for your geography, including account selection, coverage strategy, and resource deployment decisions, adapting global ABM playbooks to local market context and building regional ABM capability through hiring, coaching, and upskilling.
  • Represent marketing as a unified growth partner to regional sales leadership by participating in business reviews, annual planning, and governance forums, and by owning the investment framework that categorizes country-level marketing spend using a standardized, data-driven model.
  • Serve as the region's marketing intelligence expert, translating local customer insights, market dynamics, and cultural moments into actionable briefs for product marketing, industry marketing, public relations, public policy, and analyst relations teams.
  • Build and lead an inclusive marketing community across all functions operating in your geography — coaching and developing marketers regardless of reporting line, championing talent progression, and creating collaboration forums that connect global teams to the regional mission.

A day in the life You open the morning reviewing regional demand metrics, spotting a gap in pipeline coverage for an emerging customer segment. You pull together a brief for the digital and events teams proposing a rebalanced investment mix, then jump into a call with sales leadership to align on priorities for the upcoming quarter. After lunch you lead an ABM working session, reviewing account-level engagement data and coaching your team on refining a precision campaign. You close out the day connecting with a global counterpart to share a local customer story that could inform worldwide messaging.

About the team Our team sits at the center of AWS marketing's regional go-to-market motion. We connect worldwide marketing strategy to local execution, ensuring every investment — from large-scale summits to targeted ABM campaigns — is grounded in real customer and market insights. We are an inclusive group of marketers, strategists, and analysts who collaborate across digital, events, partner, and industry functions to drive measurable growth. As AWS continues to expand, this team plays a critical role in shaping how we engage customers and accelerate revenue across geographies.

Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
  • Experience managing teams
  • Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
  • Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
  • Experience working in a matrixed environment, influencing strategy, and achieving goals by working across the organization
  • Track record of developing and implementing strategic marketing plans that drive business impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading across multiple locales
  • Experience defining marketing strategy and executional excellence
  • Experience in leadership roles, overseeing teams conducting data analysis, process improvements, creative problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration

  • Support Contract Managers in delivering contract management services and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations across projects, divisions, and business lines.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and stakeholders to ensure contract requirements, flow-down obligations, purchase orders, and subcontract agreements are effectively implemented.
  • Assist in contract kick-off activities, including contract reviews, preparation of contract summaries, deliverables tracking, risk identification, responsibility matrices, and contract awareness sessions for project teams.
  • Provide support in managing contractual and commercial matters throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with company policies, procedures, and governance requirements.
  • Prepare, maintain, and administer contractual documentation, correspondence, records, notices, communication logs, guarantees, insurance documents, and other project-related contract deliverables.
  • Support risk management, change management, and variation order processes, including the preparation of commercial proposals, claims, and contractual assessments.
  • Contribute to project reporting and closeout activities by ensuring accurate contract and commercial status reporting, while supporting global initiatives and other ad-hoc contractual or commercial assignments as required.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 7 yrs. Experience, with EPC energy/process plants related projects background.
  • Has experience / background in contract management, engineering and construction contracting in EPC environment, system and package equipment contracts, contract lifecycle management.
  • Contractual and commercial knowledge with strong governance awareness to ensure contract compliance, and overall commercial integrity.
  • Good technical background and knowledge of engineering, procurement and construction project management.
  • Ability to multi-task, with excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Bachelor 's degree, preferably quantity surveyor or engineering background with master level in law/contract management.

More about us

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Head of Risk, Compliance & SoD – EL
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of IS Security, Risk and Compliance ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will lead the unified Risk, Compliance & Segregation of Duties (RCS) function for EL IS, covering EL risk and compliance globally and SoD services across ABB Business Areas. Acts as the single point of accountability for global SoD services, IT compliance, IS risk management, and digital regulatory compliance, enabling EL IS to sustain its regulatory “license to operate” while supporting digital strategy.

Defines the RCS strategy, governance, operating model, standards, tools, and reporting framework. Transforms fragmented compliance and SoD activities into a scalable, follow-the-sun service model with strong audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and stakeholder confidence.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the : ELIS

You will be mainly accountable for:

Strategy & Transformation:

  • Integrates Risk & Compliance and Global SoD into one RCS organization under the EL IS Head of SRC.
  • Owns the RCS TOM, service strategy, and roadmap, including follow-the-sun SoD and IS Compliance shared services.
  • Positions RCS as the CoE for SoD, IS risk, IT compliance, and digital regulatory compliance.
  • Drives digital compliance strategy for GDPR, NIS 2.0, Export Controls, CRA, DORA, AI Act, and emerging regulations.

Solutions & Service Delivery:

**

  • Delivers global SoD services across ABB Business Areas through AMEA, Europe, and Americas hubs.
  • Provides EL IS compliance shared services covering ITGC, SOX/ICoR, security controls, vendor compliance, and digital regulatory obligations.
  • Owns SLAs, quality, budget, and delivery performance for compliance and SoD services.
  • Drives automation, UAM rationalization, tooling optimization, and vendor security evaluation processes.

Monitoring & Reporting:

**

  • Provides RCS dashboards, KPIs, compliance scorecards, and risk reporting to EL IS HEAD OF SRC, BA CIOs, and senior leadership.
  • Monitors SoD deficiencies, UAR completion, ICoR testing, audit findings, regulatory obligations, and remediation timelines.
  • Performs top-down IS risk assessments, business impact analysis, and mitigation planning.
  • Investigates critical incidents and drives root-cause-based corrective actions with a “no surprises” culture.

Framework & Digital Compliance:

**

  • Governs the integrated RCS framework covering SoD, ICoR/ITGC, NIST, GDPR, NIS 2.0, CRA, DORA, AI Act, and Export Controls.
  • Leads GDPR, NIS 2.0, and Export Control compliance activities for applicable EL IS systems and entities.
  • Monitors regulatory changes and embeds new digital compliance requirements into systems, projects, and services.
  • Builds compliance capability through training, standards, and stakeholder guidance.
  • Leads internal and external audit readiness, engagement, findings management, and sustainable remediation.

Processes:

**

  • Establishes global RCS processes and operating standards across regional hubs.
  • Collaborate with GBS IS, SAP CoE, Trade Compliance, Privacy Office, and BA IT to deliver integrated compliance processes.
  • Simplifies and improves ICoR, UAM, SoD, and digital compliance processes using automation and tooling.
  • Enforces ABB-aligned IT policies, controls, and global compliance initiatives.

Stakeholder Management:

**

  • Builds trusted relationships with EL IS HEAD OF SRC, BA CIOs, Finance, DPOs, Trade Compliance, Audit, and business leaders.
  • Represents RCS in senior leadership, steering committee, audit, and regulatory forums.
  • Explain complex regulatory and control topics clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Manages multi-BA expectations through transparent communication and proactive risk flagging.

Internal Controls:

**

  • Ensures RCS activities comply with ABB Regulations, Group Guidelines, and internal control requirements.
  • Maintains ICoR controls related to SoD, UAM, risk, compliance, and digital regulatory obligations.
  • Sponsors sustainable remediation of control deficiencies and timely ITGC assertion testing.
  • Ensures compliance with GDPR, NIS 2.0, and export control requirements.

**

People Leadership:

**

  • Leads and develops the global RCS team across three hubs, covering hiring, onboarding, performance, development, and succession.
  • Builds the right structure, staffing, skills, and shared-service operating rhythm.
  • Defines a cost-effective internal/external resourcing strategy for SoD and compliance services.
  • Drives Phase 1 and Phase 2 staffing and go-live readiness.
  • Builds a customer-focused, accountable, diverse, and compliance-led culture.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Law, Business Administration, or related discipline. Bachelor's degree minimum required.
  • Professional certifications strongly preferred: CISA, CISM, CRISC, CISSP, SAP GRC, CDPSE (Data Privacy), or equivalent.

Professional Experience

  • 15+ years in IT Compliance, Information Security, Risk Management, SAP GRC, or SoD in large global organizations.
  • 10+ years leading global, multi-location IS compliance or SoD delivery functions.
  • Proven transformation experience designing operating models, integrating teams, and scaling compliance services.
  • Deep expertise in SoD, UAM, SAP GRC, ICoR, ITGC, SAP access controls, ECC, and S/4HANA.
  • Strong digital compliance experience across GDPR, NIS 2.0, Export Controls, CRA, DORA, and AI Act.
  • Experience managing auditors, regulators, and senior business stakeholders.
  • Prior Head of Function, Director, or Senior Manager experience in a global IS/IT risk, compliance, or SoD role.

Technical Skills

  • Expertise in SAP GRC, SAP security, SoD rulesets, UAM 3.1, SAP authorization, and Fiori access.
  • Strong knowledge of ICoR, ITGC, NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, GDPR, NIS 2.0, and DORA.
  • Understanding of R2R, P2P, O2C, H2R processes and related IT General Controls.
  • Knowledge of Export Control requirements for IT systems, software, and data.
  • Proficiency in GRC dashboards, compliance analytics, risk reporting tools, and MS Office.

job.title: SoD Service Lead – EUR
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of IS Security, Risk and Compliance ###

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this role, you will have to lead the implementation and management of Segregation of Duties (SoD) services for globally EUR region and all supported countries, serving as the operational backbone of ABB's global SOD service model. Accountable for robust access control design, global ruleset governance, and continuous risk assessment across all Business Areas' SAP systems.

Establishes strategies, frameworks and processes for SoD compliance, user access management, control testing and risk mitigation aligned with ICoR and ITGC requirements. Manages a team of 6-7 SoD specialists and drives continuous improvement in access governance, audit readiness, and organizational compliance across the EUR region.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

This role is contributing to the: ELIS** You will be mainly accountable for:**

Strategy & SoD Governance:

Defines and continuously improves the global SoD service delivery framework aligned with ABB Group standards and ICoR requirements. Contributes to SoD automation, and continuous ruleset enhancement. Establishes SoD best practices, methodologies, and governance standards for the global function.

Solutions & SoD Service Delivery:

Manages end-to-end SoD service delivery for all ABB Business Areas from EUR region. Overseeing SAP Role Management (global and local rulesets), User Access Provisioning (UAP), and User Access Review (UAM 3.1). Leads Mitigation Control Review (R2R-9.1-ITM) and SoD conflict resolution. Supports new SAP rollouts, migrations, and M&A integrations. Ensures SLA compliance. Runs special projects for countries as requested.

Monitoring, Reporting & Control Testing:

Delivers regular SoD status reports, KPI dashboards, and deficiency tracking to EL Head of RCS and BA stakeholders. Monitors SoD metrics, escalation rates, and region performance. Performs periodic SoD checks at role and user level. Tracks UAR completion rates and aging. Supports ITGC control testing, ICoR assertions, and audit responses (KPMG, Internal auditors).

Framework & Compliance:

Ensures full compliance with ABB Group SoD standards, ICoR controls, and SAP GRC governance. Manages Deficiency Management lifecycle: identification, root cause analysis, remediation tracking, and closure. Supports ARIC team on management Testing. Proactively evaluates SoD landscape ahead of audit cycles; identifies and mitigates access risk gaps. Ensures compliance with ABB Regulations, Group Guidelines, and applicable data privacy requirements.

Processes & Follow-the-Sun Operations:

Establishes and maintains EUR region SoD processes aligned with global standards. Collaborates with SoD Lead EUR on cross-regional consistency. Shadowing EUR region for continuity and supporting the region in absence.

Stakeholder Management & Audit Support

Serves as primary SoD point of contact for all BA Country IS, BA ARIC team, BA ERP teams and compliance teams. Builds productive relationships with audit teams, finance leads, and SAP support functions. Communicates SoD performance, risk posture, and remediation actions to senior stakeholders. Manage escalations and critical incidents. Delivers training programs for assessors, control owners, and process owners.

Internal Controls:

Ensures work is compliant with all applicable ABB Methodology and ARIC requirements, ABB SOD ruleset and ABB Group policies and standards & Ensures all internal controls are diligently followed.

People Leadership:

Ensures (with HR Manager support) that the area of responsibility is properly organised, staffed, skilled and directed. Guides, motivates and develops direct and indirect reports within HR policies, for the benefit of both the business and the employee.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Education & Certifications:

  • Required: Masters or bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Business, or related discipline.
  • Preferred: Master's degree; Professional certifications: SAP Security, SAP GRC, CISA, CISM, or equivalent.

Professional Experience

  • At least 15 years in User Access Management, Segregation of Duties, and SAP Security.
  • 6–8+ years specific experience with SAP GRC, S/4HANA, and Fiori authorization management.
  • Proven expertise in SAP GRC Access Control (ARM, ARA, BRM), ruleset management, and risk analysis.
  • Demonstrated experience in risk management, internal controls design, and SOX/ITGC compliance.
  • Track record managing global control environments (8–10+ team members) and driving continuous improvement.
  • 5+ years managing and developing high-performing technical teams.

Technical Skills

  • Deep expertise in SAP GRC, particularly SoD management in SAP ECC and S/4HANA.
  • Advanced knowledge of SAP security and access controls (t-codes, Fiori application authorization).
  • Proficiency in SAP GRC Access Control modules (ARM, ARA, BRM).
  • Strong understanding of R2R, P2P, O2C, H2R business processes and ITGC. Expertise in defining and maintaining SoD rulesets.
  • Proficiency in MS Office tools, GRC dashboards, and analytics.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Proven experience managing globally distributed teams with customer-focused service orientation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across multicultural environments.
  • Analytical mindset with demonstrated focus on risk mitigation and operational excellence.
  • Ability to influence and collaborate across organizational boundaries. Commitment to compliance and continuous improvement.
  • Fluent English; open to all candidates; EUR time zone experience preferred.

SFIA V.7 Skills

  • Information Security (SCTY) Level 5 | Security Administration (SCAD) Level 5 | Audit Support (AUDT) Level 5 | Compliance (COPL) Level 5

Risk Management (BURM) Level 5 | Service Level Management (SLMO) Level 5 | Performance Management (PEMT) Level 5 | Process Improvement (BPRE) Level 4

  • People Management (PDSV) Level 5 | Stakeholder Relationship Management (RLMT) Level 5

job.title: Process Lead- Finance & Procurement Services
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We provide extensive high-quality and cost-efficient Finance & Procurement services from purchasing to the processing of outgoing payments, Cash allocation, Fixed Assets accounting, Accounts reconciliation and Closing & Reporting. We work with a strongly integrated system and a highly automated processing environment and digital workforce.

Our customers receive innovative, easy-to-use services. We deliver maximum value to the business by driving process optimization and digitalization using our ambitious approach, and we support our customers’ current and future business requirements with the help of our high level of process and automation competency.**

Position Overview

We are looking for a GST Compliance professional with 2+ years of hands-on experience in GST compliance, e-Way Bill controls and reporting. The role requires strong working knowledge of e-Way Bill reconciliation, GST returns, Input Tax Credit (ITC), tax liability reconciliations with accounting ledgers and turnover, and effective coordination with business stakeholders. Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and disciplined management of statutory timelines are essential

You’ll make a difference by:

E-Way Bill Reconciliation & Controls

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of e-Way Bill data with the Sales Register and GSTR-1 reporting available in SAP reports.
  • Identify invoice transactions where e-Way Bills were required but not generated, and e-Way Bills generated without corresponding transactions in the books/system.
  • Investigate exceptions and collaborate with business teams to obtain appropriate supporting documents.
  • Prepare monthly e-Way Bill exception reports, track open issues, and drive closure with a clear audit trail.
  • Review discrepancies in invoice number/date, document value, GSTIN, HSN, vehicle details, customer information, and place of supply.

E-Way Bill Compliance

  • Manage end-to-end e-Way Bill compliance for movement of goods.
  • Determine applicability based on transaction type, value, movement of goods, and relevant GST requirements.
  • Review e-Way Bills for accuracy and ensure correct completion of Part A and Part B.
  • Validate supplier/recipient GSTIN, document details, HSN, taxable value, dispatch/delivery location, transporter ID, vehicle number, mode of transport, distance, and other transportation details.
  • Monitor e-Way Bill validity and coordinate permitted cancellations, vehicle updates, transporter updates, and other changes.
  • Monitor duplicate, cancelled, expired, or incorrect e-Way Bills and coordinate corrective actions.

Transaction-Specific e-Way Bill Review

  • Review the transaction flow and determine the appropriate e-Way Bill treatment for:
  • Domestic sales; inter-state and intra-state movements
  • Stock/branch transfers; customer and purchase returns
  • Job-work transactions; warehouse movements
  • Imports and exports
  • Bill-to / Ship-to transactions and transporter movements
  • Delivery challan-based movements and other movements without a conventional sales invoice, where applicable**

GST Compliance

  • GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B compliance
  • GSTR-2B reconciliation and Input Tax Credit review
  • Reverse Charge Mechanism (RCM)
  • Debit and Credit Notes and GST amendments
  • GST reconciliations and registrations
  • Basic understanding of blocked/ineligible ITC
  • GST documentation and record retention

E-Invoice Compliance

  • Understand e-Invoicing applicability and monitor IRN generation.
  • Review IRN and QR code-related exceptions.
  • Reconcile e-Invoice data with ERP/SAP transactions.
  • Understand the relationship between e-Invoice, GST invoice, Delivery Challan, and e-Way Bill, including supporting documentation based on the purpose of goods movement.
  • Coordinate resolution of e-Invoice errors with business and IT teams.

Your success is grounded

  • Bachelor’s degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, Taxation, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in GST / Indirect Tax compliance.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in e-Way Bill compliance and working knowledge of Indian GST provisions.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Experience handling large transaction volumes and GST/e-Way Bill reconciliations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high accuracy and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, manage statutory deadlines, and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

Preferred Skill

  • SAP S/4HANA experience
  • Knowledge of e-Invoicing and IRN compliance
  • Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, multinational, or shared-services environments
  • Experience handling multi-state GST registrations
  • Advanced Excel / Power Query skills
  • Exposure to GST audits and departmental queries
  • Experience in process improvement and automation

Key Competencies

  • Strong e-Way Bill technical knowledge and GST compliance expertise
  • SAP proficiency and Excel/data-analysis skills
  • Reconciliation capability and analytical thinking
  • Problem solving and attention to detail
  • Ownership, accountability, and stakeholder management
  • Ability to work effectively under tight compliance deadlines

Join us and be yourself!

This role is based in Bangalore, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 312,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and We encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: 节能业务销售代表
job.description:
加入西门子智能基础设施集团，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

销售团队的成员掌握前沿的数字化技术、产品知识和行业信息，凭借优质的业务能力和服务赢得了客户的高度评价。同时，我们提供完善的培养机制，帮助销售伙伴保持敏锐的市场洞察力，更好发现市场潜在机遇。我们深入了解客户需求，并帮助客户找到真正满足需求的智能系统解决方案。

在智能建筑事业部，我们期待服务销售人才可以推动业务发展。

你将在这个领域发挥影响

  • 负责既有建筑领域的业务开拓，重点推广暖通系统优化及节能改造工程、建筑数字化及楼宇自控系统运维及升级改造业务。主导商务谈判与合同签署，完成公司下达的销售指标；
  • 具备一定财务思维与咨询能力，主导节能项目的投资回报分析与能效对标，为客户决策层提供具备商业吸引力的节能建议书；
  • 负责从商机识别、需求确认、方案推介、商务报价、合同签订、回款跟进等全流程销售工作；
  • 维护客户关系，深入了解客户运营痛点，协同售前技术、方案、交付团队完成方案沟通与价值呈现，确保客户满意度与续约增购。

你需要具备的品质

  • 本科及以上学历，制冷、暖通空调、自动化、楼宇自动化、电气、能源动力等相关专业优先；
  • 5年以上楼宇智能化设备厂家、系统集成公司或节能服务公司的销售 / 服务 / 项目执行经验；
  • 熟悉 DDC / PLC 控制系统，在工业自动化、智能楼宇、弱电智能化、能源管理等至少一个领域有扎实的专业积累；
  • 熟悉公辅设施（空压、冷冻站、锅炉、给排水、洁净空调等）的运行特点及节能改造路径，能看懂基本的暖通系统图或自控逻辑，能与工程技术人员进行初步沟通；
  • 熟悉制药行业、实验室，电子半导体、数据中心、商业综合体、精细化工等行业的自控系统与能源管理系统解决方案者优先；
  • 具备较强的主动性、学习能力、抗压能力、沟通能力与客户服务意识，结果导向。

我们优先考虑

  • 拥有建筑节能改造、楼宇自控、能源管理、智慧运维等相关项目的成功销售案例；
  • 在制药行业、电子半导体、数据中心、商业综合体、大型物业设施管理相关领域有丰富人脉资源者优先；
  • 熟悉西门子、霍尼韦尔、江森自控、施耐德等主流楼宇自控、暖通空调、能源管理品牌及其解决方案；
  • 具备服务型销售、解决方案销售或大客户销售等顾问式方案销售经验；
  • 有系统集成商、设备厂家、工程公司或节能服务公司（ESCO）的工作背景。

你将得到这些收获：**

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作
  • 带薪享超长年假，还有圣诞假等额外福利
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

job.title: Technical Program Manager, Mechanical Data Center Supplier Quality
job.description:
About the job

Google's projects, like our users, span the globe and require managers to keep the big picture in focus while being able to dive into the unique engineering challenges we face daily. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you lead complex, multi-disciplinary engineering projects using your engineering expertise. You plan requirements with internal customers and usher projects through the entire project lifecycle. This includes managing project schedules, identifying risks and clearly communicating them to project stakeholders. You're equally at home explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical trade-offs in product development with engineers.

Using your extensive technical and leadership expertise, you manage projects of various size and scope, identifying future opportunities, improving processes and driving the technical directions of your programs.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with cooling and thermal system equipment suppliers, ensuring proactive quality management throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Lead in-depth power distribution failure investigations, identifying true root causes and implementing systemic corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  • Analyze production metrics, test results, quality audits, and field performance data to establish statistical links and drive proactive quality improvements. Validate supplier build and test processes against Google requirements and relevant industry standards (e.g., PPAP) to ensure compliance and product lifecycle integrity.
  • Conduct supplier audits and inspections, identifying areas for improvement in variability reduction, predictability, lead time optimization, and output quality enhancement.
  • Partner with suppliers and internal SMEs to resolve complex product quality and process issues across the full product lifecycle. Manage quality improvement projects involving both internal and external stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and measurable results.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Community Engagement Partner
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimal bureaucracy between you and the work.

Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Community Engagement Partner leads Firmus’ regional engagement strategy in their dedicated states. The role builds trusted partnerships with communities, government, industry, education providers and local organisations, connecting regional priorities with project delivery and long-term shared value. Working across the asset development lifecycle, the manager brings community insight, local knowledge and stakeholder intelligence into executive decisions, approvals, delivery planning, operational readiness and social licence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set and lead the regional engagement and partnerships strategy for Firmus projects, ensuring community priorities, regulatory commitments and business objectives are addressed through clear plans and accountable delivery.
  • Build and steward community partnerships with local and state government, industry, education and training providers, community organisations and community leaders.
  • Establish forums and collaborative initiatives that bring diverse partners together around regional opportunities, shared challenges and practical outcomes.
  • Provide senior counsel on stakeholder dynamics, community expectations, emerging issues and regional sentiment, translating intelligence into decisions, mitigations and delivery priorities.
  • Lead engagement across planning, construction and operational phases, maintaining consistency while tailoring approaches to the needs and character of each region.
  • Shape partnership investments and administer Firmus’ community grants program to strengthen local capability, workforce pathways, industry participation and enduring regional benefit.
  • Prepare executive briefings, strategic advice and decision papers that connect community perspectives, partnership intelligence and organisational priorities.
  • Represent Firmus in senior stakeholder meetings, public forums and regional networks, building confidence through clear communication, sound judgment and reliable follow-through.
  • Embed respectful, culturally informed engagement with First Nations communities and organisations, recognising the importance of Country, local knowledge and community-led priorities.
  • Develop governance, reporting and evaluation practices that demonstrate partnership value, track commitments and support continuous improvement across the engagement function.

Skills & Experience

  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in community development, communications, public policy, social planning or a related discipline, or equivalent senior-level experience.
  • At least 10 years’ relevant experience leading community engagement, strategic partnerships, stakeholder relations, regional development or corporate affairs, preferably in infrastructure, energy, construction, technology or other complex project environments.
  • A strong record of establishing and sustaining trusted partnerships across government, industry, education, community and advocacy sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience advising executives on complex stakeholder matters, emerging issues, reputation risk and community expectations.
  • Experience designing place-based engagement strategies, partnership programs, community investment initiatives or multi-party forums from concept through to evaluation.
  • Highly developed written, verbal, facilitation and presentation skills, with the judgment to make complex technical and commercial information meaningful to varied audiences.
  • Proven ability to work through influence, create alignment across competing interests and maintain momentum in ambiguous or rapidly changing environments.
  • Commercial and organisational acumen, supported by strong governance, time management, prioritisation and reporting capability.
  • Experience working respectfully with First Nations communities and organisations is strongly valued.
  • IAP2 accreditation or comparable professional development is highly regarded.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic partnership development and stewardship.
  • Regional and place-based engagement leadership.
  • Executive judgment, influence and stakeholder negotiation.
  • Synthesis of evidence, community insight and partner intelligence.
  • Issues, reputation and social licence risk management.
  • Culturally informed and respectful First Nations engagement.
  • Program governance, evaluation and outcomes reporting.

Personal Attributes

  • A credible and composed senior leader who earns trust across communities, partners and internal teams.
  • Naturally collaborative, with the confidence to convene diverse perspectives and create alignment without relying on formal authority.
  • Strategic and pragmatic, able to move between long-term partnership building and immediate project priorities.
  • Curious, perceptive and attentive to local context, with sound judgment in sensitive or contested environments.
  • Accountable and outcome-focused, with the resilience to lead through uncertainty and organisational growth.**

Success Measures

  • Regional engagement strategies are adopted across priority projects and demonstrably improve decision quality, delivery readiness, stakeholder confidence and overall corporate reputation.
  • A strong portfolio of partnerships produces measurable value for Firmus and host regions, including clearer pathways for local capability, participation and community shared benefit.
  • Senior leaders receive timely, balanced advice on community sentiment, stakeholder risk and emerging regional opportunities.
  • Commitments to communities and partners are governed transparently, delivered reliably and reported against agreed outcomes.
  • Engagement risks are identified early, escalated appropriately and addressed through coordinated action across project and corporate teams.
  • Firmus is recognised as a constructive, responsive and long-term regional partner throughout development, construction and operations.

Location & Reporting

Location: Launceston, Tasmania, Australia

Reporting to:  Head of Community Engagement

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Hybrid Working (4 days in office, 1 day at home)

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Principal Engineer, Observability
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Principal Engineer, Observability to own how Firmus operations teams and customers see the AI factory as one system, from site power and cooling to the GPU and the workload running on it. You will own the telemetry standard every team emits to, the platform that collects, stores, and queries it, and the applications that operations teams and customers use. Every team should be able to build its own dashboards and alerts without waiting on yours. Every new site adds millions of samples per second, and the platform must keep up as Firmus grows to hundreds of thousands of GPUs in gigawatt-scale AI factories, without losing critical data or slowing queries.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Architecture and decisions

  • Own the architecture of the observability platform across every data centre and cloud region, from collection and transport to storage, query, alerting, and the applications on top. Set a target architecture two to three years ahead and plan the steps from today's system to it.
  • Design the platform to grow tenfold without a redesign, through sharding, retention tiers, cardinality budgets, and capacity plans. Prove the headroom with load tests before each new site goes live.
  • Design around the same repeatable unit as the estate. Each site keeps observing itself when its link to the rest of Firmus is down, one global view spans every site, and new sites come on through the site deployment kit with no local fork.
  • Own the telemetry standard: what each layer emits and how signals are named, labelled, and versioned, enforced by checks in every team's build pipeline.
  • Lead design reviews for significant changes across the teams, sign off architecture decision records, and settle technical disputes escalated by engineers. Decide at pace with incomplete information, write down the assumptions, and revisit a decision when the evidence changes.

Build and evolve

  • Write production code for the hardest parts, including collection at fleet scale, the telemetry pipeline, query performance, and the observability API and applications.
  • Make observability self-service for every team. Teams onboard a service and build their own dashboards, alerts, and SLOs as code from templates, within the telemetry and alerting standards and their own budgets for cardinality and retention, without filing a ticket.
  • Set delivery guarantees for each class of telemetry. Critical operational and customer-billable signals are never lost, and any loss elsewhere is measured and recoverable.
  • Build and own the live topology model (digital twin) of every site, hall, rack, tray, GPU, network link, and cooling loop. Keep it in step with the inventory source of truth and map every signal to it.
  • Cover all layer customers depend on, from GPU and interconnect health and network fabric events to storage performance per job and Kubernetes control-plane metrics. Run passive and active health checks that signal failing GPUs, links, and nodes for draining before customers notice.
  • Bring facilities telemetry into the same model as compute. Operations teams see power, cooling, and leak events immediately, together with the workloads they affect.
  • Serve telemetry to internal consumers, including the data platform and the intelligence platform, through stable, versioned interfaces with agreed freshness and completeness, and make it usable by AI agents for diagnosis, with scoped access and an audit trail.
  • Deliver telemetry to customers and partner platforms on open standards such as OpenTelemetry, within seconds of collection, with ready-made dashboards, query access, alerts to their own channels, and forwarding to their own tools. Each customer sees only their own tenancy, enforced at every layer.

Reliability, security, and cost

  • Set SLOs and error budgets for observability and use the budget to decide when reliability work comes first.
  • Lead the technical response to major incidents in observability and make sure every post-mortem ends with a fix that stops it happening again.
  • Set the alerting standard. Every alert is actionable, reaches the right responder, and links to a runbook. Prove detection works by injecting faults.
  • Make service-level measurement reproducible. Firmus and a customer should get the same availability from the same data.
  • Design the telemetry stores to upgrade in rolling waves with no gap in data, and keep dependencies and images patched within policy.
  • Keep Firmus' SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls passing at every new site.
  • Own cost at the design level, including retention, cardinality, and data volume.

Technical leadership

  • Grow engineers through mentorship, design review, and code review. Hiring and performance review sit with the Engineering Manager.
  • Set how the team uses AI to build software effectively and securely, with review gates and automated architecture checks that keep AI-generated code within the agreed design.
  • Own the technical interviews and assessments for engineers and hold every candidate to that bar.

Partnership and communication

  • Shape the observability roadmap with operations, infrastructure, facilities, and product, and have telemetry in place before each new site or product launches.
  • Agree ownership in writing at each boundary, including which team emits each signal, which team consumes it, and which team acts on it, and settle disagreements directly.
  • Work with the operations centre and the intelligence platform team to make first-level incident response and root-cause analysis faster and turn the problems they hit into product improvements.
  • Represent observability in customer briefings on telemetry, health, and how service levels are measured.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years in software, infrastructure, or platform engineering, including at least 3 years at principal level or equivalent, setting the technical direction that multiple teams delivered against. You are still hands-on and intend to stay that way.
  • Has designed a metrics, logs, and traces platform handling millions of samples per second and run it in-house on Prometheus-compatible stores such as VictoriaMetrics, Thanos, or Mimir, with high cardinality, long retention, and a global query view across more than one site. Scaled it several times over as load grew, without a redesign.
  • Has run a streaming ingestion layer for telemetry (such as Kafka or Redpanda, with Vector or the OpenTelemetry Collector) and handled consumer lag, backpressure, and broker failures without losing critical data.
  • Has defined a telemetry schema on open standards such as OpenTelemetry or OpenMetrics that other teams relied on as a contract and given those teams self-service to build their own dashboards and alerts on it.
  • Has collected telemetry from hardware or networks, not only applications, through at least one of Redfish, gNMI with OpenConfig models, or DCGM.
  • Production Kubernetes as the runtime for observability: running and upgrading stateful, high-throughput services such as Kafka or a metrics store with no data loss.
  • Strong in Go or Python, with production services, APIs, or applications that other teams or customers use.
  • Has built security into production services: access control, secrets handling, and patching, under SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent control set.
  • Has set an alerting standard across teams that cut noise and measurably reduced time to detect and time to restore, backed by SLOs and incident reviews that changed the system.
  • Clear written and verbal communication in English, able to explain problems, decisions, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and customers.
  • Willing to join the on-call rotation for the services you own and to travel overseas occasionally.

Bonus Points

  • Background at an AI cloud or high-performance compute provider, ideally with GPU health checks, burn-in testing, or failure prediction across a fleet.
  • Integrated facilities or operational technology telemetry, such as OPC UA, Modbus, or data from SCADA and building management systems.
  • Built a digital twin or live topology model of a physical estate from an inventory source of truth.
  • Delivered telemetry to external customers with tenant isolation and access controls.
  • Served telemetry to a data platform or to analytics and machine-learning pipelines used for incident response or root-cause analysis.
  • Wrote or extended Kubernetes operators for stateful services.
  • Led a team's use of AI-assisted and agentic engineering, measured by delivery outcomes and token cost, and kept it secure with sandboxed agents, least-privilege access, and review gates.
  • Certifications such as CKA or CKAD, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry Certified Associate, or Confluent Certified Administrator for Apache Kafka.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Hybrid: 4 days in office, 1 day work from home
  • Report to: Head of Platform Engineering

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. co-ordination with procurement

job.title: NPI Senior Buyer
job.description:
New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer

POSITION PURPOSE Lead procurement activities from concept through production launch, ensuring supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation.

Position Summary

The New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities supporting the successful development and launch of new products. Acting as the primary procurement interface for Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Quality, and Suppliers, the NPI Buyer ensures supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation from concept through production launch.

This role is embedded within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for sourcing strategy execution, supplier selection, quote management, launch readiness, and commercialization of new products. The NPI Buyer plays a critical role in accelerating time-to-market while achieving quality, cost, delivery, and sustainability objectives.

Key Responsibilities

New Product Program Leadership

  • Participate as the Procurement representative on NPI program teams.
  • Support product development from concept through production launch.
  • Drive procurement activities through stage-gate milestones.
  • Ensure sourcing timelines align with engineering and launch schedules.
  • Support Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and product revisions throughout development.

Strategic Sourcing

  • Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers for new product components and assemblies
  • Lead RFQ/RFP processes for prototype and production requirements.
  • Analyze supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms
  • Develop sourcing recommendations based on total cost, quality, risk, capacity, and technology considerations.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers to align NPI sourcing decisions with long-term sourcing strategies.

Supplier Readiness & Launch Management

  • Assess supplier manufacturing readiness and capacity.
  • Coordinate supplier APQP and launch activities working closely with Supplier Development Team.
  • Track tooling, PPAP approvals, first article inspections, and qualification milestones.
  • Conduct supplier readiness reviews and escalate launch risks.
  • Ensure suppliers can support prototype, pilot, and production volumes.

Cost Management

  • Develop should-cost and target-cost analyses.
  • Support value engineering (VE) and value analysis (VA) initiatives.
  • Identify cost reduction opportunities early in product development.
  • Track cost performance versus program targets.
  • Support business case development and program financial reviews.

Risk Management

  • Identify supply chain risks associated with new technologies, capacity constraints, sole-source suppliers, and geopolitical factors.
  • Develop mitigation plans for launch-critical components.
  • Monitor long lead-time material requirements.
  • Drive dual-source strategies where appropriate.
  • Escalate supply continuity risks to procurement and business leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Program Management
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Quality
  • Supplier Quality Engineering
  • Planning & Logistics
  • Category Management
  • Finance

Key Deliverables

The NPI Buyer is accountable for:

  • Sourcing plans for all assigned programs
  • Supplier nomination recommendations
  • RFQ completion and analysis
  • Program BOM cost tracking
  • Supplier launch readiness reviews
  • Capacity and risk assessments
  • Tooling and PPAP status tracking
  • Procurement stage-gate approvals
  • NPI savings and cost optimization initiatives

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's Degree in:

  • Supply Chain Management
  • Business
  • Engineering
  • Operations Management
  • Related discipline

Experience

  • 5+ years of procurement, sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting product launches or new product development programs.
  • Experience working with suppliers in technical or manufacturing environments.
  • Automotive, HVAC, industrial equipment, electronics, aerospace, or other complex manufacturing experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

Technical Skills

  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost modeling and should-cost analysis
  • Contract negotiation
  • Supplier development
  • Manufacturing processes
  • BOM analysis
  • ERP/MRP systems
  • Launch management methodologies
  • APQP / PPAP preferred

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong project management skills
  • Ability to influence without authority
  • Executive communication capabilities
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical problem-solving
  • Risk management mindset
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Category

KPI

Launch Execution

100% sourcing completion prior to launch gates

Supplier Readiness

On-time PPAP and qualification approval

Cost

Achievement of program cost targets

Delivery

Supplier launch OTD

Risk

Number of launch-critical supply disruptions

Productivity

RFQ cycle time

Value Engineering

Cost savings delivered through design phase

Quality

Supplier PPM during launch

Working Capital

Inventory and lead-time optimization

Sustainability

Compliance with supplier sustainability requirements

job.title: PTC/OTC Senior Analyst, Oracle Fusion Americas
job.description:
Job Title: PTC/OTC Functional Lead, Oracle Fusion Americas
