job.title: NPI Sr Buyer
job.description:
New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer

POSITION PURPOSE Lead procurement activities from concept through production launch, ensuring supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation.

Position Summary

The New Product Introduction (NPI) Buyer is responsible for leading procurement activities supporting the successful development and launch of new products. Acting as the primary procurement interface for Engineering, Program Management, Operations, Quality, and Suppliers, the NPI Buyer ensures supplier readiness, cost competitiveness, component availability, and risk mitigation from concept through production launch.

This role is embedded within cross-functional product development teams and is accountable for sourcing strategy execution, supplier selection, quote management, launch readiness, and commercialization of new products. The NPI Buyer plays a critical role in accelerating time-to-market while achieving quality, cost, delivery, and sustainability objectives.

Key Responsibilities

New Product Program Leadership

  • Participate as the Procurement representative on NPI program teams.
  • Support product development from concept through production launch.
  • Drive procurement activities through stage-gate milestones.
  • Ensure sourcing timelines align with engineering and launch schedules.
  • Support Engineering Change Notices (ECNs) and product revisions throughout development.

Strategic Sourcing

  • Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers for new product components and assemblies
  • Lead RFQ/RFP processes for prototype and production requirements.
  • Analyze supplier quotations and negotiate commercial terms
  • Develop sourcing recommendations based on total cost, quality, risk, capacity, and technology considerations.
  • Collaborate with Category Managers to align NPI sourcing decisions with long-term sourcing strategies.

Supplier Readiness & Launch Management

  • Assess supplier manufacturing readiness and capacity.
  • Coordinate supplier APQP and launch activities working closely with Supplier Development Team.
  • Track tooling, PPAP approvals, first article inspections, and qualification milestones.
  • Conduct supplier readiness reviews and escalate launch risks.
  • Ensure suppliers can support prototype, pilot, and production volumes.

Cost Management

  • Develop should-cost and target-cost analyses.
  • Support value engineering (VE) and value analysis (VA) initiatives.
  • Identify cost reduction opportunities early in product development.
  • Track cost performance versus program targets.
  • Support business case development and program financial reviews.

Risk Management

  • Identify supply chain risks associated with new technologies, capacity constraints, sole-source suppliers, and geopolitical factors.
  • Develop mitigation plans for launch-critical components.
  • Monitor long lead-time material requirements.
  • Drive dual-source strategies where appropriate.
  • Escalate supply continuity risks to procurement and business leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Engineering
  • Product Management
  • Program Management
  • Manufacturing Operations
  • Quality
  • Supplier Quality Engineering
  • Planning & Logistics
  • Category Management
  • Finance

Key Deliverables

The NPI Buyer is accountable for:

  • Sourcing plans for all assigned programs
  • Supplier nomination recommendations
  • RFQ completion and analysis
  • Program BOM cost tracking
  • Supplier launch readiness reviews
  • Capacity and risk assessments
  • Tooling and PPAP status tracking
  • Procurement stage-gate approvals
  • NPI savings and cost optimization initiatives

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's Degree in:

  • Supply Chain Management
  • Business
  • Engineering
  • Operations Management
  • Related discipline

Experience

  • 5+ years of procurement, sourcing, commodity management, supply chain, or engineering experience.
  • Experience supporting product launches or new product development programs.
  • Experience working with suppliers in technical or manufacturing environments.
  • Automotive, HVAC, industrial equipment, electronics, aerospace, or other complex manufacturing experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills

Technical Skills

  • Strategic sourcing
  • Cost modeling and should-cost analysis
  • Contract negotiation
  • Supplier development
  • Manufacturing processes
  • BOM analysis
  • ERP/MRP systems
  • Launch management methodologies
  • APQP / PPAP preferred

Leadership Competencies

  • Strong project management skills
  • Ability to influence without authority
  • Executive communication capabilities
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Analytical problem-solving
  • Risk management mindset
  • Strong sense of urgency and accountability

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Category

KPI

100% sourcing completion prior to launch gates

job.title: Oracle/ServiceMax Techno Functional Engineer

Oracle/ServiceMax Techno-Functional Engineer

Johnson Controls creates smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings and connected operations. In this role, you will help support the business systems that keep service teams, internal users, and integrated enterprise processes running effectively.

You will work across Oracle and ServiceMax/SalesForce environments, combining functional understanding with hands-on technical troubleshooting. The successful candidate will possess strong technical expertise in Oracle E-Business Suite R12 and Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications, along with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical and functional solutions. This role is well suited to an experienced professional who enjoys solving complex platform issues, improving processes, and partnering with both business and technology teams.

Role Overview

As an Oracle/ServiceMax Techno-Functional Engineer, you will support day-to-day operations, incident resolution, enhancements, and system stability across Oracle-related and ServiceMax processes. You will be an Oracle ERPs expert that extends the scope of this role to Salesforce and ServiceMax processes to ensure smooth processes execution through the ecosystem. You will translate business needs into practical solutions, validate fixes through testing, and help ensure reliable performance across integrated systems.

Key Responsibilities

**

**

How You Will Do It

  • Stay close to the business process and user impact, removing friction for service and operations teams by prioritizing work that matters most.
  • Use structured analysis, testing, and follow-up to improve every day through clear problem-solving, candor, and root-cause thinking.
  • Collaborate across Oracle, ServiceMax, and integration stakeholders, working as one team and balancing functional insight with technical detail.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Inventory

  • Manufacturing

  • Experience with Lightning components, SOQL, SOSL, or web services.
  • ServiceMax or Salesforce administration certifications.

job.title: Finance and Commercial Excellence Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

**

Role Overview

**We are seeking a high-impact finance professional to join the Australia leadership team in a hybrid role spanning Financial Planning & Analysis and Commercial Excellence. This role is designed to strengthen financial rigor while materially improving sales effectiveness by embedding disciplined pipeline management, forecasting accuracy, and performance cadence across the sales organization.

The role partners closely with the Finance Business Partner and Sales leadership, acting as the connective tissue between financial outcomes, commercial execution, and sales predictability.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

**

  • Financial Planning & Analysis – Lead and support forecasting, budgeting, monthly close and financial planning activities, partnering with the Finance Business Partner and regional FP&A teams.
  • Financial Performance & Insights – Analyse P&L, balance sheet, cash flow, orders, backlog, pricing, costs and segment profitability to identify trends, risks and opportunities and support informed business decisions.
  • Executive & Management Reporting – Prepare accurate and insightful financial and commercial reporting, dashboards and presentations for senior leadership and regional stakeholders.
  • Finance Integration & Process Improvement – Support financial system and process integrations, including data migration, validation and harmonisation, while driving improvements in automation, reporting accuracy and efficiency.
  • Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management – Drive pipeline health, sales forecast accuracy and early identification of commercial risks and opportunities to improve revenue predictability and business performance.
  • Commercial Excellence & Sales Governance – Establish and maintain disciplined sales processes, opportunity definitions, pipeline inspection rhythms and governance aligned with regional commercial excellence standards.
  • CRM, Data & Performance Ownership – Own CRM governance, sales dashboards and commercial data quality, ensuring reliable information is available to support sales performance, forecasting and strategic decision-making.
  • Sales Performance & Commercial Execution – Partner with sales leaders to establish targets, strengthen performance review cadences and translate pipeline and backlog insights into actionable sales priorities, while leading the local execution and change management of commercial excellence initiatives.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • Strong FP&A and financial analysis capability, with demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting, variance analysis and translating financial data into meaningful business insights.
  • Commercially focused mindset with the ability to understand key business drivers, including revenue, margin, pricing, costs, orders and backlog, and provide recommendations that support profitable growth.
  • Experience partnering with sales and commercial teams highly regarded, including exposure to CRM platforms, sales pipeline management, forecasting, sales performance metrics and commercial reporting.
  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills, with the ability to work confidently with complex datasets, develop robust financial models and improve reporting through automation and analytical tools.
  • CPA, CFA or equivalent professional finance qualification preferred, supported by approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience across FP&A, commercial finance, business partnering or a related finance discipline.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities and confidently engage with senior finance, sales and business leaders.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better.

This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

job.title: Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth
job.description:
Role: Product Manager – Product Strategy & Growth

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**

About the role: This role defines product strategy and drives business growth by translating market and stakeholder needs into actionable priorities. The Product Manager identifies growth opportunities through adoption analysis, assesses product potential, and develops commercial strategies, including pricing and offering tiers. The role oversees the product lifecycle—from roadmap prioritization and development tracking to launch and post-launch feedback—while connecting stakeholders, engineering, sales, marketing, and customer success. It also monitors competitors and market trends to identify opportunities for differentiation.

Job Responsibilities:

1. Product Strategy & Business Case

  • Define the product vision, strategy, and value proposition aligned to business objectives.
  • Build business cases covering market opportunity, customer need, competitive positioning, revenue potential, investment, and ROI.
  • Develop financial models, pricing scenarios, and commercialization strategies.
  • Present investment recommendations to leadership; track market trends and emerging technology to drive innovation.

**

2. Pricing & Commercial Strategy

  • Define pricing, packaging, and monetization models; benchmark against competitive pricing.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Finance, and business leaders to optimize commercial models.
  • Monitor profitability, ARR, margin, adoption, and customer lifetime value, and recommend pricing adjustments.

3. Roadmap & Prioritization

  • Own and maintain the product roadmap; translate opportunities into initiatives, epics, and releases.
  • Facilitate prioritization workshops balancing customer need, business value, technical feasibility, and strategy.
  • Apply prioritization frameworks based on ROI, customer impact, and market demand.
  • Drive alignment across engineering, UX, customer success, sales, and executive stakeholders.

4. Requirements Management

  • Gather, analyze, and document business and customer requirements.
  • Author PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional/non-functional specifications.
  • Work with UX and Engineering to refine solutions and validate technical feasibility.
  • Participate in backlog grooming, sprint planning, release planning, and product reviews.

job.title: Manager Manufacturing Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with global and local product, technology, operations, and manufacturing teams. You will be responsible for manufacturing process readiness and execution for New Product Introduction (NPI) and New Site Introduction (NSI), oversee the early planning, implementation, and continuous optimization of manufacturing processes, and drive the integration of modern manufacturing methods with automation and digital systems. You will ensure that manufacturing capabilities, product engineering, and business objectives remain aligned.

What You Will Do

  • Lead recruitment, performance management, capability building, and talent development for the team, ensuring workforce capabilities align with plant operations and business growth needs.
  • Lead manufacturing readiness for New Product Introduction (NPI) and New Site Introduction (NSI), including assembly and manufacturing process planning, cost estimation, capacity and systems planning, plant layout, standards development, and the development and commissioning of tooling, gauges, and inspection equipment.
  • Lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of manufacturing methods, equipment, systems, and related infrastructure, advancing lean, automation, and digital capabilities to support operational objectives.
  • Coordinate equipment delivery and commissioning plans, capacity readiness, and material requirements to align project milestones with production demand; promote the adoption of new technologies and verify the safety, stability, and effectiveness of equipment and systems.
  • Develop and manage manufacturing-related capital investment and expense plans, strengthening budget control and resource allocation to ensure investments align with company strategy, capacity plans, and business priorities.

What Skills You Will Have

  • Capacity Planning and Management—Working Knowledge: Interpret demand forecasts and business plans, assess actual and projected capacity requirements, analyze key demand-chain inputs, and develop or support short-term capacity plans for products and facilities.
  • Manufacturing Processes—Extensive Knowledge: Select and optimize manufacturing methods, establish best practices, train others, monitor new processes and technologies, and evaluate alternative solutions.
  • Lean Manufacturing—Extensive Knowledge: Drive the adoption of lean principles, advise on work-cell and plant layout, integrate lean practices across functions, and coach others on lean methods and performance measures.
  • Smart Manufacturing—Extensive Knowledge: Apply a strong understanding of manufacturing automation and digital architecture, systems integration, and project implementation methods; evaluate and select appropriate equipment and technologies, coordinate multi-vendor environments, integrate manufacturing data with business processes, and continuously improve manufacturing infrastructure based on equipment performance.
  • Performance Management—Working Knowledge: Set behavior-focused goals and checkpoints, identify development opportunities, provide objective feedback, and support formal performance reviews and recognition programs.
  • Problem Solving—Extensive Knowledge: Lead cross-functional problem-solving efforts, apply fit-for-purpose methods, synthesize information, develop alternative strategies, and capture lessons learned.
  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking—Working Knowledge: Gather and organize relevant information, clarify priorities and stakeholders, apply structured methods, and assess risks, benefits, and alternatives.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, or equivalent relevant experience sufficient to perform the responsibilities of the role.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate professionally in a global working environment.
  • Strong cross-team communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align different functional teams and drive shared objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in manufacturing engineering or manufacturing project management, with knowledge of equipment, processes, systems planning, plant layout, tooling, standards, and continuous improvement; experience with NPI or NSI projects is preferred.
  • Experience leading facility capacity enhancement, process optimization, or smart manufacturing projects, with the ability to translate business needs into executable technical and operational solutions.
  • Experience developing and managing facility capital investment plans, including budget control, resource allocation, project prioritization, and investment-benefit tracking.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and change management capabilities, with the ability to align product, technology, operations, and manufacturing stakeholders and drive resolution of critical or broad-impact issues.
  • Experience in team leadership, performance management, and talent development.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Posting Dates:

October 12, 2026 - October 23, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore-Shared Services, Whitefield -KA

What you will do

  • Manages the financial record keeping, reporting, tax filing and other accounting functions for the organization. Provides timely and accurate financial record keeping and reporting as directed by management.
  • Maintaining financial records in accordance with GAAP and organizational standards.
  • Creating reports on financial performance and providing insightful analysis for internal and external use.
  • Upon request, take part in special projects and ad hoc reporting requests.
  • Maintain, implement, and adhere to internal controls while ensuring that accounting procedures comply with GAAP.

What you will have

  • Qualified CA with 3-5 Years relevant work experience, or Qualified CMA/MBA/CA Inter with 7-10 Years relevant work experience in RTR accounting, month end closings, balance sheet reconciliations, etc. This includes application of accounting standards (US GAAP/IFRS/IND AS), especially in the areas pertaining to Loans, Leases, Financial Instruments, Borrowings, etc.,
  • Experience of working in Oracle ERP is highly preferable.
  • Experience of working in captive accounting service centres or large corporates with Financial Services nature of business is preferable
  • Experience in Data Analytical skills and AI Tools like PowerBi, MS-Copilot will be considered useful.
  • Experience in understanding accounting/business issues and doing accounting investigation for identifying root cause analysis will be considered useful.
  • Flexibility to work in shift timings (EAME/US Shifts) - EAME (1 PM to 10 PM), US (Non MEC – 3 PM to 12 PM / MEC - 6 PM to 3 AM)
  • Additional Information:This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office
  • Should be open to work in shifts.

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights.
  • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.
  • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy.
  • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned.
  • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free.Analytical Thinking:Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.Judgment and Decision Making:Knowledge of the decision-making process; ability to carefully evaluate the impact of emerging business situations and choose the best path forward communicating actions and activities that maximize organizational performance.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discerns between "signal" and "noise" when considering courses of action.
  • Selects the right activities to work on from a range of competing priorities.
  • Stands by decisions in the face of conflict or unexpected outcome.

job.title: 宽体车（WBT）无人驾驶系统工程师
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

宽体车（WBT）无人驾驶系统工程师

Position Summary

负责宽体车（WBT）无人驾驶系统的需求定义、系统集成、功能开发、测试验证及现场部署支持工作。

作为无人驾驶系统核心工程师，与车辆、软件、系统、产品和现场团队紧密合作，推动自动驾驶宽体车从概念开发到商业化落地，确保系统满足安全性、可靠性和生产效率要求。相关职责与WBT自动驾驶平台、ODD定义、系统集成和现场部署工作一致。

Key Responsibilities

1. 系统需求与方案开发

  • 基于客户应用场景及ODD， 生成autonomous 卡车的细节需求
  • 参与无人驾驶宽体车系统需求定义和架构设计
  • 定义自动驾驶车辆功能需求和性能指标

2. Base Machine与线控化开发

  • 定义Base Machine自动驾驶改造需求
  • 支持车辆线控化（DBW）系统开发与集成
  • 协调转向、制动、动力及液压系统接口开发
  • 推动车辆满足Autonomy Ready要求

3. 无人系统软硬件集成

  • 负责无人驾驶系统软硬件集成与验证
  • 集成感知、定位、规划、控制等核心模块
  • 支持车载系统、远程控制系统及后台平台联调
  • 解决系统集成过程中的技术问题

4. 系统验证与现场部署

  • 支持实验室、测试场及客户现场验证
  • 开展功能、性能及可靠性测试
  • 支持Site Readiness评估及项目部署
  • 参与客户验收和问题闭环

5. 平台与网络集成

  • 支持车辆与调度、车队管理及后台平台系统集成
  • 支持RTK、LTE/5G、V2X等网络系统集成与测试
  • 确保车辆与平台实现稳定数据交互

6. 产品生命周期管理

  • 负责无人驾驶车辆BOM与配置管理
  • 支持产品变更管理和版本发布
  • 支持已部署无人驾驶车辆持续优化和后续产品升级

Required Qualifications

Education

本科及以上学历，专业包括：自动化； 车辆工程；电气工程；机械工程；控制工程；机器人

Experience

  • 5年以上相关工作经验
  • 具备以下一个或多个领域经验：

自动驾驶系统；工程机械；智能矿山；无人矿卡；系统集成

Technical Skills

熟悉以下领域中的多个方向：

  • 系统工程与需求管理； 自动驾驶系统架构； 车辆电控及CAN网络；Drive-by-Wire（DBW）系统；软件与硬件集成测

Preferred Qualifications

  • 无人驾驶系统，
  • 宽体车或矿卡开发经验
  • 良好的中英文沟通能力

job.title: Customer Value Agreement (CVA), Condition Monitoring (CM) Operations Consultant
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar's Asia Pacific Distribution Division (APD) is seeking a Customer Value Agreement (CVA) / Condition Monitoring (CM) Operations Consultant to join our team in Singapore. In this role, you will drive cross-functional collaboration across the matrix to improve how CM-enabled solutions and CVAs are executed. You will work with internal business units to set dealer engagement priorities, lead the development of corrective action plans, and help industry teams and districts carry out these plans across Asia Pacific to deliver measurable customer outcomes.

What You Will Do

Customer Value Agreement

  • Guide Caterpillar field representatives in assessing dealers' end-to-end CVA processes to identify and resolve execution gaps.
  • Serve as primary point of contact for Caterpillar field representatives on CVA operations and CVA Execution (Differentiated Dealer Capabilities -DDC)
  • Lead dealer CVA capacity and capability analyses so dealers can deliver the uptime, productivity and lifecycle value customers expect from their agreements.
  • Own APD Product Support Operations reporting (CVA, CM, Technician Capacity & Capability and Service Response), delivering timely insights that improve dealer performance and customer outcomes.

Condition Monitoring

  • Lead the execution and deployment of Condition Monitoring (CM)-Enabled Solutions Capacity & Capability initiatives.
  • Guide Caterpillar field representatives in assessing CM operations at priority dealers to identify and resolve execution gaps.
  • Work with the CSGR Uptime team to align APD CM priorities with global Uptime programs and drive dealer adoption.
  • Build dealer CMA capability through gap assessments, training and certification so CM insights become customer actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Performance Management

  • Strategic Alignment: Drive collaboration across the matrix to make CM-enabled solutions and CVA execution more effective.
  • Prioritization: Work with internal business units to set dealer engagement priorities based on potential impact.
  • Execution: Lead the development of corrective action plans and help industry teams and districts carry them out.
  • Governance: Represent APD in regular collaboration and performance reviews with business partners.
  • Reporting: Own APD Product Support Operations reporting (CVA, CM, Technician Capacity & Capability and Service Response), delivering timely insights that improve dealer performance and customer outcomes.

What you have:

  • Bachelor Degree with 10 years of Caterpillar or dealer experience.
  • Experience with dealer-facing or Cat dealer customer-facing roles, with Operations, Equipment Management, Products and Commercial expertise.
  • Influence: Ability to coordinate CVA specialists across SFM, lead generation, digital and service operations.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive issues and drive change with dealers and Caterpillar teams.
  • Project Management: Experience leading dealer assessments and gap-closure projects.
  • Business Acumen: Established dealer relationships with commercial and operational expertise.

Additional Info: ​

  • Willingness to travel up to 30%
  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.
  • Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).
  • International Assignment / Relocation is not available.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

October 12, 2026 - October 21, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: 高级现场客户端平台工程师 (Flutter)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

主要职责

1. 多终端客户端应用开发

  • 负责 Linux 车载协同终端、Android/iOS 现场管理平板等移动终端应用的需求分析、技术设计、核心功能开发和持续迭代。
  • 围绕车辆与设备状态、任务执行、作业协同、告警处置、现场巡检、消息通知、审批和运营概览等场景交付稳定应用。
  • 根据车载固定屏、手持平板和手机的尺寸、输入方式、使用时长和角色差异进行自适应体验设计。

2. Flutter 客户端架构与资产复用

  • 建设 Flutter 应用 Shell、路由导航、组件库、主题、国际化、状态管理、配置、权限和错误处理等公共能力。
  • 推动业务模块、数据模型、Agent Cards 和 Design System 在三类终端之间复用，同时隔离终端特有的平台能力。
  • 定义 Flutter 与原生 Linux、Android、iOS 能力之间的插件、FFI 或 Platform Channel 接口，并维护接口稳定性。

3. 实时数据与业务状态管理

  • 对接 Fleet、Mission、Traffic、Alert、Identity、Media、Agent 和 Digital Twin 等平台服务。
  • 通过 RESTful API、WebSocket、MQTT 或其他批准接口实现状态订阅、任务交互、指令确认、异常重连和数据一致性处理。
  • 建立前端状态模型、缓存策略、增量更新、消息去重、顺序处理和接口向后兼容机制。

4. 弱网、离线与现场可靠性

  • 设计离线优先、本地持久化、断点续传、冲突处理、网络切换和恢复同步机制。
  • 优化应用启动、页面切换、高频刷新、地图容器、复杂列表、内存和电量使用，支持长时间稳定运行。
  • 建设客户端日志、诊断信息、崩溃采集、健康指标和远程问题定位能力。

5. Digital Twin 与地图能力集成

  • 集成 Native Twin View、地图 SDK、场景 API 和业务 Overlay 接口。
  • 负责三维/二维视图与任务、告警、设备详情、Agent 建议等应用界面的布局协同、手势协调和生命周期管理。

6. Agent 原生交互体验

  • 开发 Agent Chat、推荐卡片、解释面板、语音入口、审批确认、工具执行结果和人机协同工作流。
  • 确保高风险操作具备明确上下文、权限校验、二次确认、执行反馈、失败恢复和审计入口。
  • 与 Agent Platform 团队共同定义结构化响应、动作 Schema、流式输出和异常状态的客户端规范。

7. 工程质量与现场交付

  • 落实代码规范、代码评审、自动化测试、依赖治理、CI/CD、签名打包和版本发布。
  • 参与实验室、车辆、矿山现场和客户环境联调，分析日志、网络、平台接口和终端资源问题并推动闭环。
  • 编写并维护客户端架构、接口、部署、诊断、测试和发布文档。

任职资格

学历与专业：计算机科学、软件工程、电子工程、自动化、人机交互或相关专业本科及以上学历。

工作经验：通常具备 5 年及以上客户端、移动端、跨平台应用或工业 HMI 开发经验，并具有复杂生产级应用的完整负责或核心贡献经验。

核心技术能力

  • 熟练掌握 Flutter 和 Dart，具备模块化架构、组件化、路由、状态管理、依赖注入和自动化测试经验。
  • 熟悉 Android、iOS/iPadOS 平台特性、应用生命周期、权限、后台任务、原生插件及发布流程。
  • 具备 Linux 应用开发或嵌入式 Linux HMI 适配经验，能够处理启动、进程、文件、网络、输入设备和系统集成问题。
  • 熟悉 HTTP/HTTPS、RESTful API、WebSocket、MQTT 等通信机制，能够开发实时数据密集型应用。
  • 具备弱网、离线、本地持久化、缓存、同步、重试、幂等和异常恢复相关经验。
  • 具备性能分析与优化能力，覆盖启动、渲染、内存、网络、长时间运行和资源受限设备。
  • 熟悉 Git、CI/CD、代码评审、单元/组件/集成测试、日志与崩溃分析等工程实践。

综合能力

  • 能够把复杂矿山作业流程转化为清晰、低认知负担、可验证的应用交互。
  • 具备系统思维和边界意识，能够与平台、数字孪生、嵌入式、UX、测试及现场团队共同定义接口。
  • 具备良好的中文沟通和英文技术资料读写能力，能够编写技术方案、接口说明、测试与故障分析文档。
  • 能够适应实验室、试验场和矿山现场的联调与问题闭环工作。

优先条件

  • 具有智能座舱、工业平板、工程机械、矿山科技、自动驾驶、机器人、车联网或 IoT 应用经验。
  • 具备车载 HMI、工业 HMI、现场作业 App、设备管理或任务协同应用经验。
  • 具有地图/GIS 应用集成经验，理解位置、轨迹、区域、图层和时空数据的应用方式。
  • 有 Flutter 与 C/C++ Native SDK、Texture/Surface、Platform View 或 FFI 集成经验。
  • 有 Agent/Copilot 产品、结构化卡片、语音交互或人机审批工作流开发经验。
  • 了解 CAN、V2X、DDS、OPC UA、GNSS/RTK、视频或设备遥测概念。

October 12, 2026 - October 25, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

多传感器标定工程师（激光雷达/相机/毫米波雷达/ RTK）

岗位职责

负责激光雷达、相机、毫米波雷达、IMU 及 GNSS/RTK 的内参与外参标定算法开发。

负责激光雷达-相机、激光雷达-IMU、IMU-GNSS/RTK 等跨传感器联合标定，实现传感器到车体坐标对齐。

设计多传感器时间同步与时间戳对齐方案，处理硬同步、PPS/GPS 授时及延迟补偿。

研究无标定物（Targetless）标定方法，并针对扬尘、振动、大温差等矿山环境提升鲁棒性。

负责车辆运行中的在线自动标定与外参漂移检测，异常时触发重标定或告警。

建设覆盖数据采集、标定计算、结果评估与参数管理的标定工具链与验证系统。

建立外参、内参、算法版本与车辆/传感器序列号的关联与版本管理，支持参数安全下发与回滚。

设计并落地面向产线及矿山现场的标定作业流程（SOP），支持批量车辆快速标定。

任职要求-基本要求

计算机、自动化、机器人、车辆工程、测绘等相关专业本科及以上学历。

3 年以上多传感器标定、SLAM 或多传感器融合开发经验。

熟练掌握 C++ 和 Python，熟悉 Linux 及 ROS/ROS2。

扎实的坐标变换、刚体运动（四元数、李群/李代数）与非线性优化基础。

标定方向

具备内参、外参及跨传感器联合标定的实际落地经验。

熟悉相机内参标定、相机-激光雷达外参标定等经典方法与工具。

理解并能实现基于标定物与无标定物（Targetless）的标定方法。

能够设计标定精度评估方法，分析误差来源与标定退化问题。

多传感器与时间同步方向

熟悉点云、相机成像模型、毫米波雷达及 IMU/GNSS 数据处理。

熟悉多传感器时间同步机制（硬同步、PPS/GPS 授时、时间戳对齐）。

熟悉 PCL、OpenCV、Eigen、Ceres/g2o 等点云与优化库。

熟悉 LiDAR-IMU、VIO 标定或紧/松耦合融合定位者优先。

加分项

矿山、港口、园区等封闭场景自动驾驶经验。

在线自动标定、外参漂移检测与自诊断经验。

GNSS/RTK、组合导航及 CAN 总线时间戳解析经验。

产线标定或大规模车辆现场标定的工程落地经验。

4D 毫米波雷达标定或数据处理经验。

Caterpillar's Asia Pacific Distribution Division (APD) is seeking a Customer Value Agreement (CVA) / Condition Monitoring (CM) Operations Consultant to join our team. In this role, you will drive cross-functional collaboration across the matrix to improve how CM-enabled solutions and CVAs are executed. You will work with internal business units to set dealer engagement priorities, lead the development of corrective action plans, and help industry teams and districts carry out these plans across Asia Pacific to deliver measurable customer outcomes.

What You Will Do

Customer Value Agreement

  • Guide Caterpillar field representatives in assessing dealers' end-to-end CVA processes to identify and resolve execution gaps.
  • Serve as primary point of contact for Caterpillar field representatives on CVA operations and CVA Execution (Differentiated Dealer Capabilities -DDC)
  • Lead dealer CVA capacity and capability analyses so dealers can deliver the uptime, productivity and lifecycle value customers expect from their agreements.
  • Own APD Product Support Operations reporting (CVA, CM, Technician Capacity & Capability and Service Response), delivering timely insights that improve dealer performance and customer outcomes.

Condition Monitoring

  • Lead the execution and deployment of Condition Monitoring (CM)-Enabled Solutions Capacity & Capability initiatives.
  • Guide Caterpillar field representatives in assessing CM operations at priority dealers to identify and resolve execution gaps.
  • Work with the CSGR Uptime team to align APD CM priorities with global Uptime programs and drive dealer adoption.
  • Build dealer CMA capability through gap assessments, training and certification so CM insights become customer actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Performance Management

  • Strategic Alignment: Drive collaboration across the matrix to make CM-enabled solutions and CVA execution more effective.
  • Prioritization: Work with internal business units to set dealer engagement priorities based on potential impact.
  • Execution: Lead the development of corrective action plans and help industry teams and districts carry them out.
  • Governance: Represent APD in regular collaboration and performance reviews with business partners.
  • Reporting: Own APD Product Support Operations reporting (CVA, CM, Technician Capacity & Capability and Service Response), delivering timely insights that improve dealer performance and customer outcomes.

What you have:

  • Bachelor Degree with 10 years of related work experience.
  • Experience with dealer-facing or customer-facing roles, with Operations, Equipment Management, Products and Commercial expertise.
  • Influence: Ability to coordinate CVA specialists across SFM, lead generation, digital and service operations.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to handle sensitive issues and drive change with dealers and Caterpillar teams.
  • Project Management: Experience leading dealer assessments and gap-closure projects.
  • Business Acumen: Established dealer relationships with commercial and operational expertise.

Additional Info: ​

  • Willingness to travel up to 30%
  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

job.title: Design Engineer- Mechanical
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition: Designs, develops, builds, and implements new components, products, or technologies.

Responsibilities

  • Create 3D-models and technical drawings for plant equipment and systems
  • Design mechanical components
  • Design piping systems
  • Perform design calculations
  • Coordinate technical activities with customers and suppliers
  • Support procurement activities by reviewing supplier drawings and documentation
  • Assist troubleshooting and resolving technical issues during manufacturing and installation
  • Supervise on-site installation activities
  • Creating Specification of Powerplant
  • Reviewing Customer Specification

Degree Requirement:

Requires a degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, or Materials Science curriculum.

Skill Descriptors: Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Recognizes changing demands and priorities; validates changes with management.
  • Obtains information about how current assignments contribute to organizational goals.
  • Completes current work according to assigned priorities.
  • Responds to day-to-day operational priorities while still making progress on project work.
  • Performs at least 2-3 concurrent activities without reducing productivity.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Computer-Aided Design & Engineering: Knowledge of tools and techniques of specialized graphics programs; ability to produce, analyze, simulate and test product design drafts. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Generates specifications for parts or components with CAD software.
  • Reuses design components via reusable libraries following standard procedures.
  • Uses CAD to perform basic drafting such as wire frames, solid objects and array of objects.
  • Performs routine changes to computerized schematics or drawings.
  • Creates views of objects in 2 and 3 dimensions; creates perspective drawings and orthogonal views.

Product Design - MFG: Knowledge of processes, approaches, tools and techniques of product design; ability to convert customer and market requirements into product design. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in the conception process of a manufacturing product vision.
  • Collects and analyzes customer and market requirements, and generates reports.
  • Utilizes design methods to implement the construction of a new design model.
  • Uses automated tools to design or modify the design of a product.
  • Assists in the testing and refinement of a new product design.

Product Design and Development: Knowledge of product features; ability to design, build, and develop a new product, technology, or service from concept through to production. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Builds three-dimensional models with basic materials.
  • Communicates with professionals to understand various requirements of product design.
  • Tests and evaluates alternative means of production being considered for use.
  • Uses automated tools to design or modify the design of a product.
  • Assists in building a complex prototype of product.

Job Summary

Responsible for scheduling, planning, and oversight of material procurement, production, and delivery.

What You Will Do

  • Coordinating flow of materials within the manufacturing facility. Coordinating transfer of materials (premium freight) to and from inventory or warehouse.
  • Developing and executing material planning for a product line. Ensuring that all material requirements for assigned programs are satisfied within the allocated time frame.
  • Scheduling and controlling the release of materials. Monitoring material inventory in the plant, in the warehouse, and by critical suppliers.
  • Building up and following up procurement plan realization to ensure they align with business objectives.
  • Tracking and analyzing supplier performance metrics. Collaborating and negotiating with supplier to deliver materials per requirements.

What You Have:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the importance of accuracy in own function or unit.
  • Identifies tasks or outputs that require accuracy and detail-level attention.
  • Identifies the procedures for making sure that results are mistake-free.
  • Describes consequences of errors within own unit or function.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Names specific tools or techniques that can be used to support the analytical thinking process.
  • Describes specific software applications or products used for business analytics.
  • Gives examples of how analytical thinking has been used to resolve problems.
  • Helps others research and learn more about business analytics tools and applications.

Distribution Center Management: Knowledge of distribution center management; ability to operate a warehouse or distribution center that handles the flow of goods from supplier to production to customer.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Describes the role of a distribution center in the supply chain.
  • Cites examples of disruptions to the distribution process and common resolutions to these.
  • Explains basic performance measurements for a distribution center.
  • Demonstrates understanding of the processes for managing an inventory distribution center.

Forecasting: Knowledge of forecasting tools, approaches and practices; ability to determine product demand and estimate production requirements and loads.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Identifies common forecasting tools and techniques.
  • Describes the roles and responsibilities of demand forecasting staff.

Inventory Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods of inventory management; ability to effectively manage local or distributed inventories of raw materials, work-in-progress and finished goods.

  • Describes basic functions and reports needed for inventory management.
  • Cites examples of seasonal considerations and adjustments to planned versus actual inventory.

Manufacturing Requirements Planning (MRP): Knowledge of the processes, practices and systems used in manufacturing requirements planning (MRP); ability to optimize planning for manufacturing cycles and ensure capacity and materials availability.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the value of a disciplined approach to problem solving.
  • Describes problem reporting and escalation practices.
  • Utilizes accepted procedures for problem analysis and resolution.
  • Identifies key aspects of problem-solving techniques used in own area.

Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Senior Engineering Manager, MineStar

Your Work Shapes the World

Whether it is groundbreaking products, best-in-class solutions or creating a lifelong career, you can do work that matters at Caterpillar. When you join Caterpillar, you join a global team of makers, innovators and doers who turn progress and innovation into outcomes for customers and communities.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior Engineering Manager to provide product and technical leadership for MineStar development. This role leads engineering teams responsible for developing, integrating, enhancing, maintaining and supporting mining technology solutions that deliver measurable value for customers.

The Senior Engineering Manager operates across a broader product and organisational scope than an Engineering Manager while providing direct leadership to engineering managers and supervisors in the organization. The role translates MineStar product strategy into executable engineering priorities, develops leaders and technical talent, and ensures teams deliver safe, reliable, supportable and competitive solutions.

This leader will partner closely with product management, commercial and product support organisations, process owners, suppliers, dealers and mining customers. Success requires strong engineering judgement, disciplined program execution, customer focus, global collaboration and the ability to influence complex decisions through technical and business expertise.

What You Will Do

  • Lead a portfolio of MineStar product development, integration, enhancement, maintenance work, aligning engineering outcomes with product strategy and business priorities.
  • Translate strategic direction into department objectives, roadmaps, resource plans, budgets and measurable delivery commitments across multiple teams or technical workstreams.
  • Provide leadership and performance management for engineering managers, technical leaders and product development staff. Build succession strength and a high-performing leadership pipeline.
  • Coordinate technical feasibility assessment, architecture and design optimisation, validation planning, cost and schedule management, risk assessment, mitigation and ongoing production support.
  • Own or influence engineering investment decisions and manage the research and development budget for the assigned MineStar portfolio, balancing new capability, modernisation, quality, reliability and customer support.
  • Establish governance and operating rhythms that provide stakeholders with clear visibility into scope, decisions, dependencies, risks, financial performance and delivery status.
  • Guide the resolution of complex, cross-component and field issues by bringing together internal experts, suppliers, dealers and customer teams. Ensure that lessons learned improve future product and process decisions.
  • Champion systems and software engineering discipline, technical excellence, cybersecurity, safety, quality, reliability, scalability and lifecycle support across MineStar solutions.
  • Monitor customer needs, market dynamics, competitor movement and technology developments. Recommend product, capability and engineering responses that strengthen MineStar customer value and competitive position.
  • Build strong partnerships across Caterpillar business units and functions and with external suppliers. Reconcile competing priorities and create shared accountability for outcomes.
  • Represent MineStar with customers, dealers, suppliers and senior leaders, communicating complex technical and business issues clearly and serving as a trusted engineering adviser.
  • Foster innovation, operational excellence, inclusion and continuous improvement while maintaining urgency and accountability for commitments.

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree in an accredited Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering or closely related technical curriculum.
  • An advanced technical or business degree is preferred.

What Skills You Will Have

Planning: Tactical and Strategic

Develops integrated plans across multiple teams; converts product strategy into sequenced engineering priorities; allocates people and funding against the highest-value outcomes; and adjusts plans using data, risks and changing business conditions.

Technical Excellence

Creates an environment that rewards technical excellence; provides recognised leadership on complex systems and software challenges; engages the appropriate subject-matter experts; and ensures decisions reflect sound architecture, engineering evidence and lifecycle considerations.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Frames ambiguous problems, evaluates alternatives with multiple stakeholders, distinguishes facts from assumptions, anticipates second-order effects and makes timely decisions during high-impact or customer-critical situations.

Product Design and Development

Leads cross-functional development from concept through production and support; strengthens development methods and governance; and balances customer value, speed, quality, cost, reliability and technical debt.

Customer and Market Focus

Maintains a direct understanding of mining customer needs and success criteria; responds proactively to market and competitive shifts; resolves difficult customer issues; and converts field insight into prioritised product and engineering action.

Influencing Through Expertise

Explains complex concepts clearly to technical and non-technical audiences; challenges decisions constructively with evidence; builds trust across organisational boundaries; and develops others as credible technical advisers.

Collaborating Globally

Builds networks across functions, regions, dealers, suppliers and customers; reconciles conflicting interests; uses collective expertise to solve complex problems; and creates shared ownership for business results.

People Leadership and Career Development

Develops managers and technical leaders, establishes business-driven development plans, identifies mission-critical capability gaps, supports targeted rotations and learning, and links talent decisions to long-term MineStar needs.

Program, Financial and Risk Management

Manages a portfolio of commitments, budgets, dependencies and risks; establishes transparent operating mechanisms; and intervenes early when delivery, quality, cost or customer outcomes are at risk.

Troubleshooting and Production Support

Directs the structured resolution of complex and non-recurring failures, coordinates internal and external experts, establishes mechanisms for problem tracking and organisational learning, and ensures corrective actions address root causes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Typically fifteen or more years of progressively responsible experience in engineering, software, systems or product development, including significant leadership responsibility. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
  • Demonstrated experience leading managers, technical leaders or multiple engineering teams delivering complex products or integrated systems.
  • Experience managing product development scope, schedules, budgets, risks and production-support priorities.
  • Experience working across organisational boundaries and communicating with senior leaders, customers and external partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, make evidence-based decisions and deliver outcomes through others.

Top Candidates Will Also Have

  • Experience with MineStar, mining technology, autonomy, fleet management, site systems or related digital products.
  • Experience with software-intensive and systems-of-systems product development, including cloud and on-premises deployments and integration with machine or site technology.
  • Experience implementing Gen AI development tools and practices.
  • Knowledge of Caterpillar product development and new product introduction processes, or comparable lifecycle governance in a complex industrial environment.
  • Experience modernising established products while maintaining compatibility, quality and customer continuity.
  • Demonstrated success developing engineering managers and senior technical talent across global teams.
  • Direct experience engaging mining customers, dealers, suppliers and product support organisations.

Additional Information

  • Location, relocation support and travel requirements will be confirmed for the final posting.
  • The role is expected to include regular interaction with global teams, suppliers, dealers and mining customers.
  • Final experience requirements and internal job classification should be validated with Human Resources before posting.

What You Will Get

A career with a global team whose engineering work helps customers build a better, more sustainable world, together with Caterpillar total rewards and development opportunities applicable to the position and location

job.title: Battery System Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

PF Battery System Engineer

Position Title

Battery System Engineer

Location

Wuxi, China

Job Summary

The PF Battery Engineer will be responsible for the engineering development, integration, validation, and continuous improvement of PF (Purchased Finished) Battery systems for Caterpillar electrification products.

This role serves as the primary technical interface between battery suppliers and machine development teams, ensuring battery solutions meet application requirements for performance, safety, reliability, durability, manufacturability, and cost.

The engineer will work closely with global battery teams, ePowertrain system engineers, software teams, validation teams, machine integration engineers, and battery suppliers to successfully deliver battery products for electrified construction and mining equipment.

Key Responsibilities

Battery Product Development

  • Lead PF battery engineering activities from concept through production implementation.
  • Define battery system technical requirements based on machine application needs.
  • Manage technical development and issue resolution with battery suppliers.
  • Support battery architecture evaluation, benchmarking, supplier selection, and technical assessments.
  • Review battery design documentation, specifications, DFMEA, DVP&R, test reports, and production readiness.

Battery System Integration

  • Support integration of battery systems into machine platforms.
  • Collaborate with machine integration project team leaders on packaging, mounting, cooling, HV routing, and serviceability.
  • Evaluate battery interfaces including:
  • Electrical
  • Mechanical
  • Thermal
  • Communication
  • Functional Safety
  • Ensure compatibility between battery, inverter, charger, motor, and machine control systems.

Battery Validation & Testing

  • Develop battery validation plans and test strategies.
  • Review supplier validation activities and test results.
  • Support:
  • Functional testing
  • Environmental testing
  • Thermal performance testing
  • Durability testing
  • Abuse testing
  • Vehicle/Machine-level validation
  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective actions for battery-related issues.

Supplier Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary engineering focal point for PF battery suppliers.
  • Conduct technical design reviews with suppliers.
  • Drive issue resolution and risk mitigation.
  • Monitor supplier development progress, technical maturity, and readiness.
  • Support APQP, PPAP, and production launch activities.

Battery Performance & Optimization

  • Evaluate battery performance including:
  • Energy capacity
  • Power capability
  • Charging performance
  • Thermal behavior
  • Efficiency
  • Aging characteristics
  • Drive continuous improvement in:
  • Cost
  • Reliability
  • Performance
  • Manufacturability

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Battery System Team
  • BMS Engineering
  • Power Electronics Team
  • Controls & Software Team
  • Machine Integration Team
  • Validation Team
  • Procurement Team
  • Product Support Team
  • External Battery Suppliers

to ensure successful delivery of electrification programs.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or above in:
  • Electrical Engineering
  • Electrochemical Engineering
  • Mechanical Engineering
  • Energy Storage
  • Automotive Engineering
  • Related Engineering Discipline

Experience

  • 5+ years of battery engineering experience.
  • Experience developing lithium-ion battery systems.
  • Experience with supplier-managed battery products preferred.
  • Experience in automotive, commercial vehicle, construction equipment, mining equipment, or energy storage industries preferred.

Technical Skills

Strong understanding of:

  • Lithium-ion battery technology
  • Battery pack architecture
  • Cell/module/pack design
  • Battery thermal management
  • Battery safety requirements
  • Battery degradation mechanisms
  • High-voltage systems
  • Battery testing and validation

Experience with:

  • CAN communication
  • Battery diagnostics
  • BMS fundamentals
  • DFMEA/PFMEA

APQP / PPAP

  • Root Cause Analysis
  • System engineering processes

Knowledge of standards:

  • ISO 26262
  • IEC 62619
  • UL 2580
  • GB/T battery standards
  • UN38.3

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly with battery suppliers such as CATL, BYD/FinDreams, Sunwoda, EVE, Ganfeng, etc.
  • Experience with off-highway electrification applications.
  • Experience supporting battery sourcing and localization projects.
  • Experience with machine-level electrification programs.
  • Familiarity with charging systems and HV architecture.

Key Competencies

  • Strong technical leadership
  • Systems thinking
  • Problem solving and root cause analysis
  • Supplier management
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Effective communication in English and Chinese
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

October 12, 2026 - October 29, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Manager ELV-Design (Jakarta)
job.description:
We’re Hiring: Manager-ELV Design-Data Centers

Location: Jakarta

We are seeking an experienced Manager-ELV Design to lead the design and engineering of ELV, ICT, and security systems for mission-critical data center projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead ELV design from concept and detailed design through construction, commissioning, and handover.
  • Oversee structured cabling, fiber optics, CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, BMS/DCIM interfaces, and other ELV systems.
  • Ensure system reliability, redundancy, scalability, security, and compliance with applicable standards and UAE regulations.
  • Manage design consultants, engineers, BIM teams, contractors, and technology vendors.
  • Lead multidisciplinary coordination, BIM/clash detection, technical reviews, and design risk management.
  • Support site activities, testing, commissioning, Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and final handover.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronics, Telecommunications, ICT, or a related discipline.
  • 10–15+ years of ELV/ICT design experience, preferably in data centers or mission-critical facilities.
  • Proven experience in ELV design management, structured cabling, security systems, and system integration.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Revit, and Navisworks.
  • Knowledge of relevant ISO, IEC, TIA, BICSI, NFPA, BS/EN standards and UAE regulations.
  • BICSI/RCDD or relevant professional certifications are an advantage.

job.description:
APAC Data Center Sourcing & Procurement Director - DSJ Global, Singapore

DSJ Global is seeking an experienced Procurement Director to lead strategic sourcing, procurement operations, supplier management, and commercial negotiations for a rapidly expanding data center business across Asia Pacific. This role will develop procurement strategies that support both data center development projects and operational facilities, ensuring cost optimization, supply continuity, risk mitigation, and successful project execution.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic sourcing and procurement operations for a rapidly expanding data center business across APAC
  • Develop procurement strategies that support both data center development projects and operational facilities
  • Ensure cost optimization, supply continuity, risk mitigation, and successful project execution
  • Manage supplier relationships and commercial negotiations across the APAC region
  • Oversee procurement operations including sourcing, tendering, and contract management
  • Drive supplier management and performance monitoring
  • Support data center development projects with procurement expertise
  • Ensure supply continuity for operational facilities and critical equipment
  • Manage procurement risk identification and mitigation strategies
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams including construction, engineering, operations, and finance
  • Drive procurement governance, compliance, and best practices
  • Support market analysis and supplier benchmarking

Requirements:

  • Extensive experience in procurement leadership, preferably in data center or mission-critical infrastructure
  • Proven track record of leading strategic sourcing and procurement operations across APAC
  • Strong supplier management and commercial negotiation expertise
  • Experience supporting both construction projects and operational facilities
  • Knowledge of procurement governance, compliance, and risk management
  • Excellent stakeholder management and leadership skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or related field

job.title: Senior Principal Energy Manager APAC
job.description:
Senior Principal Energy Manager APAC - Oracle, Singapore

Oracle is seeking a Singapore-based Senior Principal Energy Program Manager, reporting to the Vice President of APAC site and energy acquisition. As an energy procurement leader, you will have day-to-day responsibility for shaping and driving Oracle's approach to energy procurement, as well as supporting broader team efforts around energy innovation, hedging strategies, renewable energy and sustainability. Sustainable and scalable energy procurement is growing in focus across our business and this role will provide critical expertise and execution across Oracle Cloud data centers.

At Oracle, we are committed to maintaining 100% carbon-free electricity for our offices and public cloud offerings. Additionally, we are setting a new goal to achieve 100% carbon-free electricity for Oracle Custom AI Data Centers by 2035.

Responsibilities:

  • Source and negotiate strategic power agreements with utility providers and independent power providers
  • Responsible for day-to-day management of Oracle Cloud's data center energy strategy across APAC region (Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Australia, India)
  • Create and manage requirements around energy sourcing including leveraging expertise of power markets regulation, financial modeling and analysis, managing RFPs, contract negotiations, development and execution of forward purchasing strategies
  • Work closely with retail energy providers, energy suppliers, regulated utilities, and internal stakeholders to monitor real-time market conditions
  • Engage with energy and sustainability consultant(s) to evolve strategy and reporting
  • Monitor energy markets and specific utilities, IPPs, and electric grids for opportunities and risks
  • Cross-functionally develop and manage relationships across Oracle including with capacity planning, data center infrastructure build, site selection, supply chain management, data center engineering, data center operations, and corporate sustainability
  • Coordinate with onsite generation and other solution providers to ensure seamless power delivery across utility grids, behind-the-meter solutions, gas plants, renewables
  • Partner with finance on developing annual energy budgets based on knowledge of current and future footprint and changing energy prices
  • Support team delivering power to new DC sites including electricity supply equipment, utility tariffs, contract negotiations, financial modelling, RFPs, and supplier onboarding

Qualifications:

  • 10-15 years professional experience; 6-10 years managing corporate (C&I) power procurement or utility/IPP power origination
  • Understanding of regulated and deregulated energy markets, power hedging, energy supply agreements and power purchase agreements
  • Experience with mark-to-market accounting and managing market exposure
  • Experience developing annual energy budgets and working with finance teams to project the cost of power
  • Familiarity with sustainability frameworks: Global Reporting Initiative (GRI), Science-based Targets
  • Desire to work in the fast-paced environment of AI/GPU computing and hyperscale data center design, construction, and operations

  • Analyze, accept or reject alternate designs and mitigation measures developed by the local physical security teams when the standard design can't be applied
  • Act as a subject matter expert to support implementation of new technologies
  • Work regionally but also support the global PSA team to ensure alignment on decisions and standards
  • Interpretation of Risk Assessments and Threat Analysis and AWS Physical Security Standards to assure the proper security technologies are selected

Requirements:

  • 4+ years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Professional Engineer License
  • Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

job.title: Network Security Engineer
job.description:
Network Security Engineer - Kyndryl, Singapore

As a Network Security Engineer, you will be responsible for the operational delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise network security services. You will manage firewalls, VPNs, IPS/IDS technologies, segmentation controls, cloud network security, vulnerability remediation, and security incident response activities across a complex managed services environment. You will collaborate closely with network, cloud, systems, and security teams to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant operations.

What you will do:

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain enterprise firewall, VPN, IPS/IDS, and network security technologies
  • Implement approved security policy, firewall, segmentation, and VPN changes
  • Support threat monitoring, incident triage, containment, and investigation activities
  • Manage vulnerability remediation, compliance findings, and audit actions
  • Support cloud network security services and landing zone controls
  • Maintain system configurations, documentation, evidence, diagrams, and operational records
  • Monitor performance, availability, capacity, and resilience of security platforms
  • Develop automation, orchestration, and operational improvements that enhance service quality
  • Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, carriers, and client stakeholders on service delivery activities

Required skills and experience:

  • Hands-on experience administering enterprise firewall, VPN, IPS/IDS, NAT, and network security technologies
  • Strong understanding of routing, segmentation, high availability, application flows, and network security principles
  • Experience implementing controlled changes with governance, testing, rollback, and validation procedures
  • Ability to analyze security events, investigate security incidents, and coordinate remediation activities
  • Experience working with incident, change, problem, audit, and service reporting processes
  • Ability to support planned after-hours activities, incidents, and resilience exercises

Preferred skills:

  • Experience across multiple firewall vendors such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Cisco, or equivalent technologies
  • Experience with cloud network security, remote access, anti-DDoS, and SIEM platforms
  • Network security automation experience using scripting, APIs, or orchestration tools

job.title: Network Engineer, Security
job.description:

Jane Street's numerous distributed systems are built on an agile, reliable, multi-vendor network infrastructure that supports all traffic profiles, from trading to internet connectivity.

  • Collaborate with our Cybersecurity team on the detection and mitigation of threats and vulnerabilities on our network
  • Interface with application owners and traders to enable business workflows securely
  • Proactively enhance support by improving network infrastructure observability and scripting
  • Improve our network security processes and documentation

Requirements:

  • Have 7+ years of experience operating and deploying network infrastructure
  • Experienced with routing and network protocols (OSPF, BGP, PIM-SM)
  • Experienced with troubleshooting transport protocols (TCP/UDP)

job.title: Cluster Security Manager

Candidate Requirements:

  • Professional certification such as CISSP, PSP, or similar is preferred
  • Proven experience in security management, preferably in a data centre or similar high-security environment
  • Strong knowledge of security protocols, systems, and best practices
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills
  • Proficiency in security management software and tools

Vantage Data Centers APAC Pte. Ltd seeks a regional Sustainability Director to lead APAC sustainability programs, partnering with cross-functional teams to align global strategy with local priorities.   • Support customer RFP responses, audits and strategic conversations with hyperscalers
  • Build regional goals and roadmaps that hold up to scrutiny
  • Feed quality data into global reporting and assurance processes
  • Build sustainability literacy across regional teams
  • Engage with local government, NGOs, and community stakeholders on sustainability matters
  • Support policy engagement alongside Public Policy colleagues
  • Manage greenwashing risk and ensure disclosure credibility

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, finance, sustainability or data science
