  • Collaborate with vendors, telecom operators, industry alliances, GSMA, TM Forum and technology partners to identify new capabilities and best practices.

  • Experience in technical and commercial RFP/tender evaluation.
  • Knowledge of price benchmarking, cost modelling and TCO analysis is as advantage.

  • Programme and project management capabilities. Experience coordinating cross-functional or strategic technology programmes is an advantage.
  • Collaborative, team-oriented mindset and self-starter. Capable of working independently, taking a hands-on approach, and demonstrating flexibility in a challenging, fast-paced environment.

  • Engineering degree in Electrical & Electronics, or Telecommunication or in related field. Professional certifications is an advantage.

job.title: Senior AI FinOps Engineer #AIDA
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

Powering the Future with AIDA

AIDA - Intelligence meets Impact.

At AIDA (Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics), you will design and scale AI and data solutions that power Singtel’s transformation into a global, AI-first telco of the future. Together, we will redefine the telecommunications industry in a culture where intelligence empowers people, and human potential sits at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

  • Own the FinOps framework for Central AI Kitchen, providing full visibility and control of cloud, on-prem OpenShift, GPU infrastructure and GenAI token consumption
  • Drive optimization of AI token usage, GPU/compute utilization and OpenShift resources to achieve sustainable unit economics while meeting application performance requirements
  • Establish chargeback/showback, cost allocation and governance standards to ensure accurate attribution of platform costs to projects, teams and applications
  • Administer platform budgets, forecasts and procurement plans, proactively identifying budget risks, cost anomalies and capacity requirements
  • Partner engineering, infrastructure, procurement and finance teams to continuously optimize cloud and on-prem infrastructure costs
  • Champion FinOps best practices across AIDA, ensuring AI platform investments are aligned with utilization, business value and financial efficiency

How You will Make An Impact

  • Own and maintain the centralized FinOps framework for tracking cloud, OpenShift, GPU infrastructure and GenAI token consumption across projects, teams and applications
  • Drive GenAI token cost optimization through model selection, routing, caching, prompt/token efficiency, usage controls and analysis of cost per request/use case
  • Optimize OpenShift infrastructure consumption through resource right-sizing, utilization analysis, workload scheduling, quota management and identification of under-utilized CPU, memory, storage and GPU resources
  • Drive cloud cost optimization across Azure services through right-sizing, reservation/commitment planning, workload scheduling, storage optimization and elimination of idle or unnecessary resources
  • Establish and operate chargeback/showback models, tagging, cost allocation and governance standards for accurate project and use-case level attribution
  • Administer Central AI Kitchen operating and infrastructure budgets, including forecasting, budget tracking, variance analysis and regular management reporting
  • Support infrastructure, software and cloud procurement activities including demand forecasting, quotation evaluation, commercial analysis, contract/commitment planning and purchase requirements
  • Build dashboards, alerts and unit-cost metrics to monitor actual and forecasted spend, utilization, token cost and cost efficiency, including anomaly detection for budget risks
  • Partner Platform Engineering, ML/LLMOps, IT Infrastructure, Finance and Procurement teams to identify and implement cost optimization opportunities without compromising platform performance and reliability
  • Drive adoption of FinOps practices across Central AI Kitchen and provide recommendations to management on investment, capacity, sourcing and cost optimization decisions.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 6 years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, FinOps, technology cost management and/or related operations
  • Hands-on experience managing and optimizing cloud infrastructure costs, including budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation and commercial commitments
  • Experience working with Kubernetes/OpenShift environments and analyzing infrastructure resource utilization and cost
  • Experience partnering Finance, Procurement and engineering teams on technology budgets, procurement and cost optimization
  • Strong knowledge of cloud FinOps practices including budgeting, forecasting, cost allocation, chargeback/showback, anomaly management and unit economics
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes/OpenShift resource management including CPU, memory, storage and GPU utilization, requests/limits, quotas and workload scheduling
  • Knowledge of Kubernetes/OpenShift cost management tools such as Kubecost/OpenCost and observability platforms such as Grafana
  • Understanding of GenAI/LLM cost drivers including input/output tokens, model serving, GPU utilization, context size, model routing and inference economics
  • Ability to analyse AI token consumption and identify optimization opportunities across prompts, models, applications and LLM endpoints
  • Experience developing dashboards and management reports using Grafana or equivalent tools
  • Experience in technology budgeting, procurement analysis, vendor quotations and commercial/cost modelling
  • Strong communication skills to explain technical cost drivers in business-oriented language
  • Problem-solving and innovation mindset to find creative ways to balance performance vs cost in AI workloads

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

**

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous

learning, and real impact.

**

Take the leap with Singtel to shape what’s next and accelerate your growth.

job.title: Associate Engineer-Electrical (Solar/BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Engineer will be responsible for supporting the electrical design and engineering of utility-scale solar PV (Photovoltaic) power plants through proposal, FEED (Front-End Engineering Design), and detailed engineering stages. The role requires sound technical knowledge of solar electrical systems, design calculations, equipment selection, technical documentation, and effective coordination with designers and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and review SLDs (Single-Line Diagrams), cable schedules, load lists, equipment schedules, and other electrical engineering deliverables.
  • Perform DC (Direct Current) and AC (Alternating Current) system design, including PV string and inverter configuration, cable sizing, voltage-drop calculations, transformer sizing, and MV (Medium Voltage) collection-system design.
  • Prepare and review lightning-protection calculations, equipment specifications, datasheets, and BOQ/MTO (Bill of Quantities/Material Take-Off).
  • Perform solar PV system modeling, energy-yield assessment, and design optimization using PVsyst.
  • Provide technical inputs to the PVcase designer, review PVcase-based layouts and outputs, and coordinate design revisions to ensure alignment with electrical design requirements.
  • Provide design inputs to designer, review drawings, and coordinate revisions to ensure technical accuracy and consistency with project requirements.
  • Support substation and grid-interconnection engineering at the POI (Point of Interconnection).
  • Review vendor documents, technical bids, RFIs (Requests for Information), and equipment submissions.
  • Coordinate with civil, structural, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), Protection and Control, and other engineering disciplines.
  • Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, and resolution of project-related engineering queries.

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in utility-scale solar PV power plant design and engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with PVsyst for solar PV modeling and energy-yield assessment.
  • Working knowledge of PVcase, with the ability to provide technical inputs, review outputs, and coordinate effectively with the PVcase designer.
  • Experience in DC and AC system design, MV systems, transformers, switchgear, cables, grounding/earthing, and electrical protection.
  • Familiarity with applicable IEC (International Electrotechnical Commission), IEEE (Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers), NEC (National Electrical Code), NFPA (National Fire Protection Association), and utility requirements.
  • Strong technical documentation, communication, coordination, and review skills.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to ETAP (Electrical Transient Analyzer Program) for Load Flow, Short Circuit, or other applicable power-system studies would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge of or exposure to BESS (Battery Energy Storage System) applications and integration would be advantageous.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 1 year related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Certifications

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Enterprise AI (Singapore)
job.description:
We help global enterprise partners integrate Meta's foundation models and AI tools directly into their core products and infrastructure. We are hiring a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer to independently lead complex technical integrations directly with top enterprise clients.

You will embed closely with external partner engineering teams to deploy, test, and optimize large-scale AI solutions. This is a hands-on role where you will be responsible for ensuring smooth implementations across our platform.

You will tackle ambiguous deployment challenges head-on—like reducing latency, resolving interoperability issues, and building secure data connectors. You will then translate those technical hurdles into actionable feedback, working together with other engineering teams to iterate and refine the AI ecosystem. If you are a highly skilled engineer passionate about solving complex constraints and driving immediate, measurable impact, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Own Deployments: Embed directly with client engineering teams to manage the complete deployment lifecycle of AI solutions, from technical scoping to production handoff.
  • Build Integrations & Workflows: Design and implement robust connections between Meta's AI platforms and complex client systems (e.g., CRMs, inventory systems, messaging infrastructure), configuring workflows to meet specific partner needs.
  • System Optimization: Architect scalable solutions, analyze code quality, and resolve complex performance and latency bottlenecks in real-world AI workloads.
  • Develop Reusable Tooling: Act as a force-multiplier by turning one-off deployment patterns into reusable software components and playbooks that accelerate future work.
  • Implement Evaluation Frameworks: Build and configure rigorous testing frameworks tailored to client environments to ensure AI reliability, safety, and output quality.
  • Provide Technical Leadership: Lead complex technical efforts and cross-functional workstreams while mentoring peer engineers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Track record of setting technical direction for a team, driving consensus and successful cross-functional partnerships
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Experience building maintainable and testable code bases, including API design and unit testing techniques
  • 6+ years of programming experience in a relevant language or 3+ years of experience + PhD

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building and scaling large-scale software systems, including successfully deploying complex AI applications from proof-of-concept into production environments
  • Experience collaborating directly with external partners, enterprise clients, or cross-functional teams to unblock integrations and solve complex technical constraints
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable solutions on major cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP), including leveraging core cloud services (compute, storage, machine learning) to optimize AI workflows, reduce inference latency, and manage compute costs
  • Experience implementing rigorous testing and evaluation frameworks for AI systems (e.g., establishing quality benchmarks, mitigating hallucinations, conducting safety reviews)
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, insurance, healthcare) or navigating enterprise compliance requirements (SOC2, data residency, privacy frameworks)
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead technical projects and translate field challenges into actionable feedback (e.g., identifying integration gaps, proposing feature improvements) to guide internal engineering teams
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: 5282 Senior Team Lead, Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Data Centre Operations leadership role responsible for supervising Data Centre and Facilities Technicians and ensuring reliable, safe, and efficient critical facility operations. Oversees electrical, mechanical, cooling, fire and life-safety systems, maintenance scheduling, shift assignments, training, compliance, and customer installations while maintaining Five 9’s uptime and budget expectations. Develops and reviews MOPs, SOPs and SMPs and supervises their execution. Requires strong expertise in electrical and mechanical systems, data centre infrastructure, PLCs, generators, UPS, HVAC, chillers, fire protection, safety standards and regulatory compliance. Requires a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent, solid data centre/critical facilities experience, and developing leadership experience in operations and maintenance teams.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities: Supervises the Data Centre Technicians and the Facilities Technicians. Operates and maintains data centre in such a condition as to assure the most optimal uptime to customers for facilities services (electrical, cooling, etc. measured by Five 9’s). Tasks out the CFOps team in such a way that complies with all local, state, and federal requirements for fire, health and Life Safety. Provides tasking for the daily operations and maintenance scheduling of non-critical and critical maintenance. Ensures the CFOps team works effectively to achieve the CFOps goals, reviewing budget, staff planning, NPS, efficiency, etc. Analyzes data centre equipment to obtain maximum effectiveness and efficiency; safety, cost, equipment longevity, and reliability. Conducts in-depth training with the Data Centre Technicians on equipment, PM’s, QA and CFOps procedures/processes. o Manages and maintains all training documentation; provides documentation to HR. Ensures data centre operates at maximum efficiency, including: analyzing existing operating conditions, recommending new technologies, maintaining customer SLA requirements, and improving overall efficiency while maintaining budget expectations. Works with customers to provide successful installs that exceed expectations – delight the customer. Supervises the safety and well-being of all CFOps team. Responsible for shift assignments, timekeeping review & approval and PTO approval for all assigned Data Centre Technicians and Facilities Technicians. Writes and Reviews non-critical and critical Method of Procedures (MOP’s), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Standard Method of Procedure (SMP) and provides input. Supervises the execution of non-critical and critical Method of Procedures and ensures their thorough completion. Performs other duties as assigned. Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Strong background in electrical and mechanical systems design review, layout, installation, commissioning and operations Expert knowledge of low voltage systems, including fire, security and PLCs Expert knowledge of NFPA Electrical, Fire and Life Safety and building codes Expert knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 72, NFPA 25 and compliance issues Expert knowledge in industrial safety best practices (i.e. lockout/tag out, arc flash protection, OSHA and state regulations) Experienced with data trending / tracking and analysis and ability to rapidly learn and use PC based, integrated critical monitoring systems Strong supervisor skills Excellent communication skills, both written and oral Extensive hands-on experience installing, maintaining and troubleshooting large commercial and industrial mechanical & electrical systems including: o 12kV switchgear o 480/277 and 208/120 volt electrical generation and distribution systems o Diesel powered AC generator plants up to 2MW o Static UPS systems o Multi-string flooded cell batteries and monitoring systems o Static switches o PLC and relay logic controls o Power monitoring systems o Data centre power distribution and management systems o VFD Drives o Large Centrifugal Chillers o Cooling Towers o Water Treatment Systems o HVAC equipment o Computer Room AC Units (CRACs) o Kyoto Cooling Units (where applicable) o Operating Building Management and Industrial PLC Control Systems o Emergency Standby Diesel Generator Systems o Fuel/Oil systems, Fuel/Oil Day tanks and Fuel/Oil Storage Tanks o Knowledge of NFPA 25, sprinkler and dry-stand pipe systems, including Emergency Fire Pump where applicable o Chilled/Condenser Water Pump o Well/Vault or Sump Pumps o Domestic Water systems, including BackFlow Prevention devices Proficient with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) Ability to train the electrical and mechanical teams on the systems and the procedures Ability to conduct power & fire system capacity, safety and code compliance assessments Ability to operate in and promote a rigorous process-driven, team environment Ability to logically analyze and solve problems Ability to multi-task multiple projects Detailed oriented Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Engineering or similar field required Required Experience: Solid experience in data centre and/or critical facilities Developing experience managing and motivating critical facilities operations and maintenance teams

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior Associate Specialist, Procurement - Indirect
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Associate Specialist, Procurement – Indirect supports the procurement team in managing indirect spend categories such as IT, professional services, marketing, and facilities. This role is responsible for executing transactional sourcing activities, processing requisitions and purchase orders, coordinating supplier onboarding, and ensuring compliance with procurement policies and approval workflows. The incumbent will assist in RFx events for low-to-medium complexity purchases, maintain accurate vendor and catalog data, and provide first-line support to stakeholders on P2P processes. Additionally, the role contributes to spend reporting, cycle time monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and cost-effectiveness.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Requisition-to-PO Processing (R2P)
  • Validate requisitions: cost centers, GL codes, budget availability, and buying channels (catalogue vs. non-catalogue).
  • Convert approved requisitions into clean, compliant Purchase Orders (POs); monitor confirmations and delivery dates.
  • Resolve PO issues (quantity, price mismatches, missing receipts) with users and suppliers.
  • Tactical Sourcing & RFx Support
  • Run 3-quote competitive events for low-to-medium spend buys per threshold policy.
  • Prepare RFQ packs: requirements, delivery terms, SLAs, evaluation criteria; consolidate responses.
  • Conduct total cost of ownership (TCO) comparisons; recommend preferred supplier(s) for approval.
  • Support spot buys and small, non-complex renewals (e.g., SaaS seats, licenses) under guidance.
  • Supplier Enablement & Master Data
  • Coordinate supplier onboarding: tax docs, banking details, code of conduct, ESG/DEI questionnaires.
  • Maintain accurate vendor master data, catalogue content, pricing updates.
  • Track supplier compliance: insurance certificates, data privacy/security docs, signed agreements.
  • Contract & Policy Compliance
  • Ensure purchases adhere to Procurement Policy, DoA (Delegation of Authority), and Spend Thresholds.
  • Route standard contracts to Legal; manage redlines via the contract repository; track expiries.
  • Log policy deviations and obtain required approvals.
  • Stakeholder Support & Ticket Handling
  • Act as first-line support for end users on P2P, catalogues, GRNs, and invoicing.
  • Monitor and resolve procurement tickets and workflow exceptions within SLA.
  • Provide quick reference guides and FAQs to improve adoption and reduce errors.
  • Spend & Performance Analytics
  • Maintain dashboards: cycle times, savings, compliance (off-contract %, no-PO invoices).
  • Prepare weekly/monthly report packs for category teams and finance.
  • Identify low-value recurring buys suitable for cataloguing or blanket POs.
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Propose process streamlining (forms, templates, auto-approvals, catalogue expansions).
  • Participate in policy refreshes, tool enhancements, and training rollouts.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Understanding of indirect procurement processes, requisition-to-PO workflows, and tactical sourcing.
  • Hands-on experience with procurement platforms such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or equivalent for requisition, PO creation, and catalogue management.
  • Familiarity with standard agreements (MSAs, SOWs) and compliance requirements.
  • Ability to maintain accurate vendor master data and catalogue content.
  • Proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, lookups, conditional formatting) for spend analysis and performance dashboards.
  • High accuracy in data entry and compliance checks.
  • Ability to resolve PO discrepancies and workflow exceptions promptly.
  • Clear and professional interaction with internal teams and suppliers.
  • Adherence to procurement policies, Delegation of Authority (DoA), and audit requirements.
  • Willingness to identify and suggest process enhancements.
  • Exposure to SaaS/software procurement and renewals.
  • Awareness of ESG/DEI supplier compliance requirements.
  • Basic understanding of data privacy and security standards in supplier onboarding.

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (Commerce, Business, Supply Chain, Finance or equivalent).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 3-5 years in procurement/P2P/AP/operations; internship experience considered.
  • Certifications (preferred): CIPS Level 2–3, or equivalent foundational procurement coursework.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Regularly moves equipment and other hardware up to 25 lbs.
  • Frequently move about inside and outside of data center / facility
  • Remain stationary for long periods of time.
  • Ascend / Descend a ladder and perform duties atop a raised platform.
  • Position self in small spaces.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during US business hours and time zones.

WORK CONDITIONS AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS

  • May work onsite at a data center location occasionally.
  • Exposure to varying temperatures and loud noises.
  • Exposure to outdoor weather conditions.
  • Travel required 10% of time.
  • Hybrid role; may perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Your role at a glance

​​NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Development Execution (Japan). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

​

​This is a full time hybrid role based in Japan. ​

What we are looking for

KEY responsibilities

  • ​​Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.

  • ​Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.

  • ​​Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.

  • ​Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.

  • ​Understanding of design and engineering.
  • ​Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment.
  • ​Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • ​Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • ​Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • ​Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

​​

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • ​​Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

​​

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • ​​Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing. ​

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • ​​Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • ​Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.

job.title: Skilled Technician - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

The Skilled Technician – Level II performs skilled technical activities that support manufacturing business needs. This role is responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, repairing, and improving electrical, automation, robotics, and industrial control systems to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing operations. The technician works with limited supervision while applying Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) standards, quality procedures, and continuous improvement practices.

Key Responsibilities Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, breakdown, and emergency maintenance activities to maximize equipment uptime and operational reliability.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain electrical systems, PLCs, control panels, industrial drives, motion systems, automation equipment, and electronic systems.
  • Diagnose faults in relay logic, contactor circuits, electrical wiring, machine controls, and industrial automation systems.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, control diagrams, machine drawings, operation manuals, and technical specifications.
  • Repair and maintain production, assembly, and testing equipment in accordance with defined procedures and standards.

Automation, Robotics & System Integration

  • Maintain and troubleshoot Siemens S7-1500 PLC-based automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • Perform PLC programming, modifications, upgrades, and system improvements to optimize manufacturing performance.
  • Support operation and troubleshooting of industrial robots including ABB, Yaskawa, FANUC Robots, FANUC Cobots, and Universal Robots Cobots.
  • Work with industrial motion and drive systems such as Siemens and Festo technologies.
  • Maintain machine communication and connectivity using industrial protocols including PROFINET, OPC UA, and TCP/IP.
  • Support integration of manufacturing systems, process data, CMES, and machine vision inspection systems.

Tools, Equipment & Asset Care

  • Maintain and troubleshoot assembly and testing tools such as Atlas Copco nut runners and Tohnichi torque tools.
  • Perform routine inspections, testing, and calibration checks to ensure proper equipment functionality.
  • Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning activities.
  • Support spare parts planning and inventory management for automation, robotics, and electrical components.

Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze equipment breakdowns and conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence.
  • Identify manufacturing constraints and support process optimization and equipment improvement initiatives.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations into Preventive Maintenance (PM) systems.
  • Participate actively in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and continuous improvement activities.
  • Support process improvements focused on safety, quality, productivity, and reliability.

Health, Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Stop work and immediately report unsafe conditions, hazards, incidents, or near misses.
  • Follow Cummins Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) policies, Lockout-Tagout (LOTO) procedures, and electrical safety standards.
  • Conduct Job Safety Assessments (JSA) and apply safe work practices in all activities.
  • Perform work according to quality standards, process documentation, and workmanship expectations.
  • Perform quality inspections and escalate issues to minimize quality, safety, and cost risks.
  • Recognize environmental impacts of work activities and support sustainability initiatives.

Planning, Coordination & Teamwork

  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and internal support teams for issue resolution and project execution.
  • Collaborate with Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, IT, and Maintenance teams to support operational goals.
  • Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Mentor and support junior technicians and team members when required.
  • Complete required technical, safety, and professional development training programs.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma, secondary education certificate, technical diploma, or equivalent experience as permitted by applicable regulations.
  • Additional technical certifications in Electrical, Automation, PLC Programming, Robotics, or Industrial Maintenance are preferred.
  • Licensing or authorization may be required for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Drives Results
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness
  • Nimble Learning
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Controls Safety
  • Manufacturing Knowledge
  • Values Differences

Skills and Experience

Technical Skills

  • Electrical system troubleshooting and industrial fault diagnosis.
  • PLC programming, automation system maintenance, and industrial controls expertise.
  • Experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7-1500 PLC systems.
  • Knowledge of robotics systems including ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, and Universal Robots.
  • Industrial communication protocols such as PROFINET, OPC UA, and TCP/IP.
  • Factory automation, vision systems, motion control systems, and machine integration.
  • Preventive, predictive, corrective, and reliability-centered maintenance practices.
  • Experience with Root Cause Analysis (RCA), TPM, and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation.

Behavioral & Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure during critical equipment breakdowns.
  • Strong communication and teamwork capabilities.
  • Proactive mindset focused on safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize work, and adapt to changing operational requirements.
  • Strong learning agility and willingness to adopt new technologies.

Education, Licenses & Certifications

  • High school diploma, technical certification, or equivalent relevant experience required.
  • Technical certifications in PLCs, Robotics, Electrical Systems, Industrial Automation, or Maintenance are advantageous.
  • Compliance with export control or sanctions regulations may be required for this position.

Experience

  • Requires relevant work experience or intermediate-to-advanced technical knowledge obtained through education, specialized training, or hands-on industrial experience.
  • Prior experience in manufacturing, industrial maintenance, automation, robotics, or electrical systems environments is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing operations and automation systems is an added advantage.

Organization Cummins Inc.

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Shop

Relocation Package Yes

100% On-Site Yes

Due to the operational nature and specific job duties of this role, work is required to be completed 100% in person/On-site.

job.title: Supply Chain Coordinator - Level II - SHOP
job.description:
Job Summary

Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations.
  • Engages in HSE training.

Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Delivery

  • Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months.
  • Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research.
  • Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results.
  • Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule.
  • Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved.
  • Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan.
  • Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs.
  • Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies.
  • Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals.

Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals.
  • Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.

Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

​Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

​Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins' strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.

  • This position will be handling the supplier schedules for Suppliers in F&A - MM Cluster having commodity of TBH, S&F, Valves and some part of E&E etc.
  • Ensuring on time material availability to meet KEP production requirements.
  • Collaborate with Supply Continuity, Purchasing, SQE, Plant Quality teams to resolve supply related issues
  • Provide feedback to planning team on material availability to plan the production.
  • Do analysis for E&O, OTD miss parts, Respond to Er's & SRC's as per requirement.
  • Co-ordinate with Logistics & Warehouse teams for vehicle placements and unloading.
  • Close co-ordination with the cross-functional teams.

job.title: Technical Specialist - SQE - 2437213
job.description:
Job Summary

  • The Supplier Quality Engineer - Technical Specialist concentrates his/her product specific quality and technical skills to develop complex suppliers and products that can meet customer requirements; requires strong partnerships with the external supply base, with supply chain teams and with engineering to achieve results

Key Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with all critical partners to improve quality and business outcomes, including: external suppliers, external customers, and internal customers and stakeholders, such as Purchasing, Manufacturing and Engineering; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to strengthen the soft skills required to develop effective relationships.
  • Support the cross-functional development of external supply base strategies and the cross-functional supplier selection process for any given component; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products.
  • Provide manufacturing consultation to external suppliers in order to design a Right First Time manufacturing process that enables conformance to the engineering print, engineering standards and customer specific requirements; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products.
  • Apply industry common Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) tools, and Cummins specialty tools to develop zero defect components within the external supply base; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of APQP execution; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products.
  • Embrace continuous improvement in the external supply base by leading complex product and process focused projects that utilize industry proven methodologies, such as lean and six-sigma.
  • Conduct external supplier audits in support of supplier risk mitigation, supplier readiness, and supplier performance improvement; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to improve auditing effectiveness.
  • Lead increasingly complex quality improvement plans within the external supply base in order to improve supplier performance. Ensure resolution of increasingly complex external supplier related quality challenges, by leading root cause analysis, by supporting development of corrective actions and by verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of problem resolution.

Competencies:

  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Auditing - Applying auditing skills and techniques and Quality Management Systems knowledge to effectively appraise a manufacturing process for quality and safety risks and non-conformances.
  • Interpreting Technical Requirements - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and Engineering Standards to correctly interpret the technical requirements of an engineering drawing; Applying knowledge to improve a product’s design for manufacturability and measurability.
  • Manufacturing Process Design - Applying knowledge of manufacturing technology (methods, techniques, tools, equipment, etc) to design a Zero Defect manufacturing process that can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.
  • Manufacturing Process Validation - Applying core Automotive tools (i.e. DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Source Release and PPAP) to validate that a manufacturing process can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.
  • Measurement Process Design - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and knowledge of measurement technology (standards, techniques, equipment, etc) to design a measurement system that can consistently meet industry and customer requirements.
  • Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  • Quality Influence - Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.
  • Quality Standards - Applying knowledge of quality standards, such as ISO9001:2015 and IATF16949, to develop procedures, processes, and external suppliers in a manner that aligns with regulatory requirements.
  • Statistical Foundations - Applies statistical tools and technique to influence decision making; leverages understanding of data collection methods, key statistics, graphical and analytical methods to describe process performance, gain insights and drive improvement action
  • Supplier Performance Improvement - Improving supplier performance by developing and executing an effective quality improvement strategy that consists of a project team, glidepath, reduction of manufacturing issues and improvement of systemic deficiencies.
  • Supplier Quality Project Planning and Execution - Applying Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) skills to develop and execute a quality plan that enables external suppliers to meet customer expectations; Requires facilitating communication and collaboration across cross-functional activities, when a program, initiative, or project concerns external suppliers.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Supplier Product Reliability - Ability to evaluate the supplier's product design, supplier's manufacturing process design and product validation process to ensure the supplier is capable to meet reliability expectations.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject required
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Preferably 7 years experience in a Manufacturing or Engineering role in the automotive industry, or a similarly regulated industry.

job.title: IT Service Delivery Leader - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for the management, operations, delivery and support of defined IT applications and/or infrastructure services; directs and coordinates the efforts of people to accomplish goals and objectives using available resources.

Key Responsibilities

Contributes to the delivery and support of specific IT services. Supports the development and maintenance of services and ensures that tools and resources are capable and available (i.e. IT Service Catalog, Asset Management system) Generates and reports service delivery metrics and drives standards across regions and locations (i.e. Scorecards, Service Level Agreement (SLAs) and Customer Satisfaction or Net Promoter Scoring). Acts as a point of contact for customers for service related inquiries and maintains relationships with key customers and suppliers. Is familiar with SLA / Operational Level Agreements between other IT Services Provided. Encourages root cause analysis using the formal problem solving approach for recurring issues. Champions the use of Six Sigma to reduce costs and improve processes. Identifies opportunities for service improvements, discuss with the customer and raise the request for change for assessment if appropriate Maintains the accuracy of service related standards, procedures and work instructions in a knowledge management system. Able to support the Service Owner when needed. Champions the use of ITIL Standards for IT Service Deliverables Maintain strong relationships to deliver business value using relevant Business Relationship Management practices.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

IT Supplier Relationships - Leverages a vendor management framework to manage strategic supplier relationships and supplier performance based on business need throughout the contract life using the required processes and tools to control costs, drive service excellence, mitigate risks, and gain increased value from the suppliers.

Request Fulfillment - Manages a service request through its life cycle with efficiency and professionalism using the required processes and tools to maintain customer satisfaction.

Service Asset and Configuration Management - Manages service assets and configuration items by maintaining accurate configuration records to support other service management processes with documented and verifiable information.

Service Catalog Management - Maintains a service catalog that contains all details of active and approved services in service operations using the required processes and tools to provide clear and relevant information to users.

Service Level Management - Ensures the quality of the services delivered meet agreed levels using the required processes and tools in order to maintain customer satisfaction.

Troubleshooting - Diagnoses and resolves the customer-identified issue by utilizing appropriate department standards to satisfy customer expectations.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required. 3-5 years of experience.

Core Responsibilities Unique to the Role

* Establish scalable operating models for enterprise data products by defining support, reliability, and sustainment practices that enable data products to be consumed consistently across analytics, applications, and AI use cases throughout their lifecycle.

* Lead data product operational excellence initiatives by partnering with Product Managers, Data Engineering Managers, and Solution Engineering teams to improve data availability, observability, quality, lineage visibility, and platform reliability across the enterprise data ecosystem.

Drive operational transparency and value realization through portfolio-level reporting of service health, data product adoption, SLA/SLO attainment, incident trends, operational risks, and business impact metrics to support prioritization and investment decisions.

Required Skills, Education, or Experience

* Experience supporting enterprise data, analytics, or platform-based solutions with accountability for operational readiness, service stability, and continuous improvement.

* Strong understanding of operational governance including service onboarding, support transitions, release readiness, incident trend analysis, and problem management.

* Ability to collaborate across Product Management, Data Engineering, Architecture, and Business teams to balance operational stability, customer experience, and product evolution.

* Experience establishing operational metrics and dashboards that provide visibility into service performance, reliability, usage patterns, and business outcomes.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred (Nice to Have) Skills, Education, or Experience

We are looking for a detail-oriented Administrative Associate to join our team in Auckland and support the Quantum project. Working closely with workshop staff, operations and planning, you'll play an important role in coordinating administrative activities, managing documentation, maintaining accurate data and bookings, and supporting business operations in a fast-paced workshop environment.

This newly created 12-month contract opportunity offers exposure to manufacturing administration, ERP systems and planning support within a global organisation, with training provided to help you build your skills and career at Cummins.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Provide administrative and document support across the team and department.
  • Compile, verify, and enter data to support accurate reporting.
  • Manage workshop job opening and closing, invoicing, data entry and purchase orders.
  • Support front reception and respond to or redirect internal and external enquiries, including customer enquiries.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, correspondence, and departmental documentation.
  • Coordinate meetings, conference calls, visitor reception, and schedules.
  • Respond to or redirect internal and external enquiries.
  • Process supplier documentation and payment requests and assist with accounts payable enquiries.
  • Maintain departmental policies, procedures, and records.
  • Support improvement initiatives, projects, and routine administrative activities.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • A positive, easygoing and team-oriented approach, with the ability to build effective working relationships with workshop staff, customers and other stakeholders.
  • Strong organisation and attention to detail, with confidence managing routine administration and competing priorities
  • Clear communication skills and a willingness to provide backup support across the team
  • Responsive customer service skills and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced workshop environment.
  • Experience in administration, manufacturing support, inventory, logistics, parts, warehousing or planning will be well regarded
  • Experience with data entry and Microsoft Office Suite
  • ERP experience, ideally Movex or SAP, is advantageous but not essential as training will be provided

Compensation and Benefits

  • Comprehensive Cummins training provided

job.title: 电工 - 三级
job.description:
工作总结:

使用所有必要的工具对电气系统进行故障排除、组装、安装、测试和维护，以确保设备可用并正常运行。学习并了解使用工业设备安全操作电力和其他能源的协议。可以独立工作并指导或教导他人。

主要责任:

健康、安全和环境 (HSE)

停止工作并立即报告任何重大伤害危险。

报告任何与工作有关的伤害、疾病、事件或危害。

遵守 HSE 标准、政策、程序和规定。

使用合适的个人防护装备。

通过互相关照来促进互相依存。

在您的控制和能力范围内消除危害。

认识到您的工作可能对环境产生影响，并努力减少负面影响。

参加 HSE 培训。

质量部

应用高标准的工艺和技术。

支持设备正常运行时间和停机时间故障分析。

使用各种工具、测量和测试仪器，根据图表、草图、操作手册和规格执行工作。

提供反馈并将其整合入预防性维护系统。

遵循所有流程文件和质量程序。

提出问题以最小化成本和质量风险。

执行质量检查。

交付

熟练地执行故障排除、电气维修和设备维护。

遵守适用法规和标准以维护、安装和操作电气系统。

指导和辅导其他人，并作为能力较弱的团队成员的非正式资源。

保持整洁有序的工作区域，包括日常清洁和机器清洁工作。

根据需要履行其他职责以实现业务目标。

与同事合作并支持员工：

识别并减少制造限制

按照生产要求安排维护活动

解决问题并改进流程

参与持续改进活动

团队协作

与指派的团队和所有支持团队进行有效沟通。

按照业务要求完成培训和个人发展。

积极与当地的全面生产维护 (TPM) 团队合作，促进质量、安全、流程、物流和员工发展。

1需要有电工证

2负责生产设备、电气系统故障排查、分析和维修。

3快速定位并解决断路器、继电器、变频器、电机、PLC等电气故障。

4保证设备正常运行，提高设备可开动率

5按照点检、保养计划执行预防性维护工作。

6参与设备状态监测、故障分析和改善措施制定。

7向预防性维护系统反馈设备问题及改善建议。

8参与设备安装、调试、搬迁和技术改造项目。

9负责电气回路接线、控制系统调试及项目交付支持。

10能根据现场需求修改控制逻辑和电气线路图。

11维护PLC、变频器、人机界面(HMI)等自动化控制系统。

12修改和调试基础PLC程序。

13严格执行LOTO（挂牌上锁）及电气安全操作规程。

14正确使用个人防护用品(PPE)。

15发现安全隐患及时整改和上报。

16严禁带电违规作业，确保人员和设备安全。

17指导和帮助初级维修人员开展维修工作。

18分享故障处理经验，提升团队技术能力。

19作为团队内部技术资源支持现场问题解决。

20保持维修现场5S管理。

21编写维修记录、点检记录及故障分析报告。

22跟踪设备问题整改效果。

技能:

协作 - 建立合作伙伴关系并与他人协作，以达成共同目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

灵活学习 - 在解决新问题时通过尝试积极学习，将成功和失败都当作学习的源泉。

健康与安全基本知识 - 识别、报告并参加能够改善健康与安全的行动，倡导积极的健康与安全行为并发挥楷模作用，以营造相互依存的企业安全文化，促进实现无伤害的工作场所。

控制安全 - 识别制造环境（电气、液压、气动）中的控制相关危险，将安全实践和程序作为日常工作计划的一部分，以减少伤害并营造安全的机器环境。

电力系统故障排除 - 分析电气控制系统以解决和修复电气问题，使系统恢复到正常运行状况。

工厂自动化和控制系统 - 利用现有技术、编程技术，确定完成项目所需的材料和资源，以执行变更并进一步实现制造流程自动化，为制造环境提供最佳自动化。

机器编程 - 通过设计和实施解决方案来改进机器的使用和整体操作，从而制定工厂车间机器程序。

制造知识 - 通过正确实施当前流程、设备和应用程序的变更来展现制造知识，以满足职能部门的需求并为持续改进做出贡献。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

教育,资格,认证:

高中毕业证书或中等教育毕业证书或同等经验，只要这些经验符合适用法规。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

需要通过教育、培训或在职经历获得重要的相关工作经验或专业技能。

100% On-Site No

job.title: Territory Sales - Inside Sales Representative - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

As a Senior Inside Sales Representative , you will provide end-to-end sales and customer support for Cummins products and services throughout the sales cycle. The role combines direct inside sales, opportunity development, account support, quotation and RFP management, customer relationship management, sales forecasting, and coordination with internal stakeholders.

You will manage more complex customer requirements that may require adaptation, detailed research, or cross-functional coordination. The role is also expected to independently identify and develop opportunities for additional sales through repeat business, cross-selling, up-selling, and proactive customer engagement.

The position plays an important role in delivering customer satisfaction, achieving revenue and margin objectives, maintaining sales pipeline and forecast accuracy, and supporting the continued growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities

1. Direct Sales & Business Development

  • Handle inbound and unsolicited prospect enquiries and convert qualified opportunities into sales.
  • Develop new sales opportunities through telephone, digital technologies, lead follow-up, and targeted outbound/cold-calling activities.
  • Drive incremental revenue through repeat business, cross-selling, up-selling, and proactive follow-up with existing customers.
  • Conduct customer negotiations in accordance with company guidelines, commercial policies, and approved pricing parameters.
  • Achieve assigned revenue, margin, sales activity, and customer satisfaction targets.
  • Execute the sales cycle from lead identification through opportunity development, quotation, negotiation, and closure using the Cummins Sales Process.

2. Sales Support & Opportunity Management

  • Generate and deliver qualified leads to field sales representatives where appropriate.
  • Support sales teams with quotation, RFP, proposal, and other sales-cycle activities.
  • Provide timely and accurate responses to complex or escalated customer and internal enquiries, including matters requiring detailed research.
  • Analyse customer enquiries to identify recurring issues, trends, and opportunities for improved products, processes, or customer support.
  • Support more complex customer accounts and coordinate appropriate internal resources to resolve customer requirements.

3. Customer & Account Management

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships that encourage loyalty, retention, repeat business, and future sales.
  • Understand customer needs, applications, buying behaviour, and business priorities and translate these insights into appropriate Cummins solutions.
  • Support account development and account strategy by assessing customer relationships, financial considerations, product competitiveness, service requirements, quality issues, and potential barriers to growth.
  • Support new customer account creation and ensure Cummins is established as an approved supplier in accordance with company guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate customer master data and update account information in corporate systems.
  • Support accounts receivable activities as required.

4. Sales Operations, CRM & Forecasting

  • Maintain accurate sales opportunities, activities, reporting, and forecasts using Cummins systems, CRM platforms, and established sales processes.
  • Monitor pipeline health, opportunity progress, forecast accuracy, and performance against sales targets.
  • Collect and analyse relevant customer and market information to support sales forecasting and identify future consumption or demand patterns.
  • Identify opportunities to improve sales processes, procedures, tools, and customer value.
  • Ensure appropriate and consistent use of relevant sales systems, processes, and procedures across Inside Sales.
  • Evaluate results and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, revenue, customer value, and loyalty.

5. Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Maintain effective communication and coordination across Sales and other functions to support customer satisfaction, sales objectives, and Cummins culture goals.
  • Coordinate input from sales teams and internal stakeholders to develop proactive customer communications.
  • Work with relevant internal stakeholders and customers, where applicable, to balance inventory, service, delivery capabilities, and customer expectations.
  • Support negotiations and commercial activities in line with company policies and guidelines.

6. Senior-Level Leadership & Development

  • Plan, prioritize, and schedule Inside Sales activities and resources to maintain continuity and quality of customer service.
  • Provide guidance, coaching, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to Inside Sales colleagues.
  • Support the achievement of team sales-support targets and service-level expectations.
  • Share best practices and contribute to continuous improvement across the Inside Sales function.

Core Competencies

  • Customer Focus: Builds strong customer relationships and delivers solutions aligned to customer needs and expectations.
  • Effective Communication: Communicates clearly and effectively across different channels and adapts communication to different audiences.
  • Persuasion & Negotiation: Uses compelling, fact-based arguments to influence stakeholders, negotiate effectively, and secure commitment.
  • Planning & Alignment: Plans and prioritizes activities to meet business commitments and sales objectives.
  • Value Proposition Development: Understands customer applications and clearly communicates the strengths, benefits, and differentiation of Cummins products, solutions, and services.
  • Channel Awareness: Understands industry structure, market dynamics, customer channels, and routes to market.
  • Pricing Strategy: Works with relevant stakeholders to develop commercially appropriate pricing aligned with business and customer objectives.
  • Account Planning: Identifies account objectives, priorities, actions, and measures to drive execution against agreed targets.
  • Account Strategy Development: Assesses current account status, customer requirements, competitiveness, financial considerations, quality, service, and barriers to growth to define achievable account objectives.
  • Customer Perspective: Incorporates customer insights into sales strategies, content, solutions, and engagement approaches that improve customer value and revenue.
  • Sales Forecasting: Analyses internal and external customer data, historical trends, and market information to develop reliable sales forecasts.
  • Sales Pipeline Management: Proactively manages pipeline size, quality, progress, and conversion and adjusts sales priorities based on business requirements.
  • Sense Making & Problem Solving: Uses probing questions, research, and analysis to understand complex customer needs and translate information into practical solutions.
  • Audience Adaptability: Explains complex technical, commercial, or business information in a way that is clear and relevant to the intended audience.
  • Values Differences: Recognizes and leverages diverse perspectives, cultures, and experiences to strengthen collaboration and business outcomes.

Qualifications

  • University or college degree in Sales, Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field , or an acceptable combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Prior professional experience in sales, inside sales, sales support, customer account management, quotation management, or a related commercial function.
  • Experience as a quote analyst or in another sales-support role is desirable.
  • Experience working with customer relationship management (CRM) systems is desirable.
  • Experience using software-based sales, business, reporting, forecasting, or customer-management tools is desirable.
  • This position may require applicable licensing or compliance requirements related to export controls or sanctions regulations.
  • Limited travel may be required depending on business and customer requirements.

Skills & Experience

Required / Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated experience in inside sales, territory sales, sales support, customer service, account management, or business development .
  • Experience managing customer enquiries and progressing opportunities through a structured sales cycle.
  • Experience with quotations, RFPs, proposals, pricing, negotiations, or order-related sales activities.
  • Experience developing new business and identifying opportunities for repeat sales, cross-selling, and up-selling.
  • Experience managing multiple customer requirements and prioritizing activities in a target-driven environment.
  • Experience working collaboratively with field sales, operations, finance, supply chain, service, and other internal functions.
  • Experience supporting sales forecasting, pipeline management, reporting, and performance tracking.
  • Experience handling complex or escalated customer issues and conducting research to determine appropriate solutions.

Key Skills

  • Consultative and solution-oriented selling
  • Customer relationship and account management
  • Lead generation and opportunity qualification
  • Telephone, email, and digital sales engagement
  • Cross-selling and up-selling
  • Commercial negotiation and persuasion
  • Quotation and RFP management
  • Sales pipeline and opportunity management
  • Sales forecasting and reporting
  • CRM and sales technology proficiency
  • Data analysis and problem solving
  • Pricing and value proposition development
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Stakeholder and cross-functional collaboration
  • Planning, prioritization, and time management
  • Ability to explain complex technical or commercial information clearly
  • Coaching and mentoring capability
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Success in the Role

Success in this role will be demonstrated through profitable sales growth, strong customer relationships, accurate forecasting and pipeline management, effective conversion of leads and opportunities, high-quality sales support, timely resolution of complex customer requirements, and effective collaboration across Cummins functions.

The successful candidate will combine commercial acumen and customer focus with the ability to independently manage sales opportunities, analyse complex requirements, influence stakeholders, and contribute to the development of both customers and the Inside Sales team.

Responsible for addition of Key Customers into CAMC Contract and generate business opportunities through key customers in the assigned area. Execute the contract through cross functional team s. Maintain contract SLAs with customers

  • Plan and achieve annual sales target as per monthly and quarterly plans.
  • Identify potential new CAMC customer by interacting with all stakeholders (Dealer, service team, PSBU, etc.,) & through data mining and create strong CAMC Pipeline.
  • Plan and implement business initiatives to achieve sales and new customer addition targets.
  • Achieve New Customer addition targets as per AOP.
  • Create strong Out Of Scope work pipeline & order board by focusing on various initiatives for the year
  • Coordinate with all stake holders and cross functional team to delivery contract services as per SLA.
  • Timely & persistent payment follow-up to ensure Receivables under control as per plan
  • Maintain 100% renewals of contracts

Hands on experience in MS office (Word, Excel, Power Point), knowledge of DG set operations, Key Account Management skills, familiar with Sales Force operation platform. Data Analysis, Presentation and assertive communication skills ( Spoken and Written). Ability to work with various stake holders to achieve results.

Knowledge and Experience on after market service support.

job.title: Service Advisor
job.description:
We are looking for a Customer Service Advisor to coordinate and schedule customer repairs for our automotive and industrial customers at our Wodonga branch.

Whether you have previous Service Advisor experience or are looking to step into the role, we are happy to train the right person!

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways

  • Act as the first point of contact for customers, providing a high level of service throughout the repair process
  • Communicate clearly with customers regarding repairs, job progress and expected timelines
  • Quote customers, plan jobs, create work orders and schedule vehicles for service
  • Check parts availability and coordinate with technicians and the Parts team to keep jobs moving
  • Process invoices, accounts and purchase orders, ensuring accurate and timely administration
  • Maintain accurate records and follow procedures within the service management system
  • Build positive relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to ensure a smooth experience from start to finish

To be successful in this role you will need the following

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with solid IT capabilities
  • Strong customer service skills and the ability to build positive customer relationships
  • Previous Service Advisor, automotive, warranty or similar customer-facing experience is desirable

job.title: Electrician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Troubleshoots, assembles, installs, tests and maintains electrical systems using all necessary tools to keep equipment available and capable. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment. May work independently and instruct or coach others.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, electrical repairs and maintenance of equipment . Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems. Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less capability. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Performs other duties as required to meet business goals. Work with peers and support staff to: Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.
