You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Creating and maintaining procedures and guidelines for export control, sanctions, and customs compliance, and ensuring an up-to-date overview of relevant trade policies, processes, and tools.
  • Providing guidance and periodic updates to local business management and employees on ABB’s Global Trade Program and significant changes in export control and customs laws and regulations.
  • Implementing trade compliance awareness and training programs, supporting local trade reviews/self-audits, and identifying improvement areas and corrective actions.
  • Supporting day-to-day trade compliance activities, including customs and export control authorizations, trade records, product classification, SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) where applicable, and cross-functional continuous improvement.

Our team dynamics

You will join a collaborative and cross-functional team, where you will work closely with business and functional stakeholders to support effective trade compliance across the end-to-end business process.

Qualifications for the role

  • You have several years of experience within a business environment, with a good understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, risk management, and logistics.
  • You have knowledge of export control, sanctions, customs rules, and regulations, or demonstrate a great willingness and ability to learn these areas.
  • You have experience or knowledge of trade compliance processes, including export/import compliance, documentation, record keeping, product classification, and trade reviews/self-audits.
  • You are familiar with or willing to work with SAP Global Trade Services (GTS) and other relevant trade compliance systems and tools, where applicable.
  • You have business acumen, ownership, initiative, and an organized working style, with the ability to provide practical guidance across the local business.
  • You have effective communication and collaboration skills and are comfortable working with stakeholders across different levels and functions.
  • You are proficient in English and the local language required for communication with relevant authorities, both verbally and in writing.

More about us:

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of deep knowledge delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

In this role, you’ll help run what runs the world, by taking on meaningful work that drives real impact. You will contribute significantly to successful project outcomes within technology, product, and solution development, including associated Intellectual Property (IP). You will act as a key point of expertise in Research & Development, troubleshooting, and product engineering support. You will also apply your deep technical knowledge to propose and implement innovative ideas that strengthen our technology roadmap.

Our product portfolio spans Battery Energy Storage Systems, and UPS systems, ranging from 150 kVA to 30+ MVA. Your focus will be on developing and enhancing Power Conditioning core technologies, driving innovation to improve performance, reduce cost, and increase operational efficiency, mainly around Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS).

The work model for the role is: onsite #LI-onsite

Location: Napier, New Zealand.

This role is contributing to the Critical Power product group in New Zealand.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Lead the hardware design and development of the Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and Uninterruptable Power Supply​ (UPS).
  • Contribute to the analysis and validation of low and medium-voltage energy management systems, including system protection schemes, power quality optimisation, energy storage integration, and evaluation of magnetic components.
  • Perform electrical design activities including cable and harness dimensioning, selection, routing and layout, and definition and selection of protection devices, sensors and power supplies.
  • Conduct comprehensive functional, performance, and safety testing on BESS and UPS, ensuring compliance with industry standards (IEC/UL certifications).
  • Develop, improve, and maintain accurate technical documentation including test procedures and plans, commissioning guides, user manuals, product drawings, and interface specifications for battery systems.
  • Plan and execute system commissioning activities on customer sites, including pre-commissioning inspections, power-up sequences, functional verification, performance optimization, and troubleshooting across all product lines.
  • Troubleshoot and diagnose electrical faults, power quality issues, and system performance problems; develop improvement strategies and provide technical guidance to support customer applications.
  • Develop deep expertise in ABB's power conditioning portfolio (BESS and HiPerGuard) and stay current with emerging power and energy management technologies.

Qualifications for the role

  • Strong understanding of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and power converters >200kW.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience designing/maintaining power electronic systems within specialist teams; capable of leading engineering projects and guiding junior colleagues.
  • Solid understanding of three-phase systems and power electronics, including inverter and converter operating principles, practical application and integration into systems, and the ability to interpret product specifications and operate within defined performance and safety margins.
  • Knowledge of grid compliance requirements, including grid codes, power quality standards (harmonics, THD, power factor), fault ride-through, frequency and voltage regulation, and anti-islanding protection, with familiarity with relevant IEC and IEEE standards is desirable.
  • Foundational knowledge of electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) principles, including conducted and radiated emissions, immunity requirements, and common mitigation techniques such as filtering and shielding, with familiarity with relevant standards.
  • Foundational knowledge of thermodynamics, including heat management and airflow optimization within electrical cabinets to ensure reliable and safe equipment operation.
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD and circuit simulation tools (e.g., PSCAD, Matlab/Simulink) is a plus.
  • Understanding of control methods with ability to communicate effectively with control engineering teams to ensure seamless system integration.
  • Proven ability to apply innovative thinking and technical creativity across complex R&D assignments and challenging engineering problems.
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering and/or Power Electronics Engineering; postgraduate qualifications are desirable.
  • Strong English communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions, technical domains, and multi-site engineering teams.

More about us

ABB's Critical Power product group, within the Smart Power Division, is a global leader in advanced UPS and energy storage solutions serving mission-critical applications worldwide. We protect the world's most demanding operations – from data centers and semiconductor fabrication plants to pharmaceutical manufacturing, cable production, aerospace facilities, and critical infrastructure. Our solutions enable 24/7 uptime and energy efficiency for the world's largest hyperscale data centers and enterprise customers, directly supporting the digital transformation of society.

Our engineering expertise spans over 50 years of innovation in power conversion technology. We design and deploy cutting-edge UPS systems ranging from 150 kVA to 30+ MVA, featuring advanced modular architectures and the latest energy storage technologies including traditional VRLA batteries, next-generation lithium-ion solutions, and innovative nickel-zinc battery systems. Our products achieve industry-leading efficiency exceeding 95-99%, with exceptional reliability standards including full online double-conversion architecture and redundant modular designs for mission-critical applications.

The Napier facility is home to our power electronics engineering hub and represents ABB's commitment to innovation in the Asia-Pacific region. We are actively developing next-generation technologies to support the global energy transition, including PowerExchanger grid support services that unlock revenue streams from UPS energy storage assets and enable broader renewable energy integration. Our focus on sustainability is evidenced by our comprehensive portfolio of environmentally certified solutions and our commitment to helping customers achieve their carbon reduction targets.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

job.title: AI Engineer – Physical AI & Digital Twin Systems
job.description:
Position Summary

Siemens Energy Gas Services (GS) seeks an AI Engineer to build production-grade Physical AI and Digital Twin systems for advanced manufacturing. The role centers on robot perception, reasoning, control, simulation, and deployment across cloud, edge, and real-world operations.

You will design, train, evaluate, and deploy AI models that enable autonomous and semi-autonomous robotic workflows across simulation and physical environments, owning the lifecycle from data and experimentation to inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Working at the intersection of robotics, industrial software, and AI, you will partner with product, controls, robotics, and domain teams to deliver reliable, observable, and scalable systems that improve autonomy, safety, and productivity.

How You’ll Make an Impact (key responsibilities of role)

  • Build and operate data and training pipelines for collection, labeling, augmentation, versioning, and evaluation across simulation and real-world datasets.
  • Develop and deploy AI models for robot perception, reasoning, and action, including computer vision, multimodal models, and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) systems.
  • Apply sim-to-real methods using synthetic data, domain randomization, imitation learning, transfer learning, and benchmark-driven validation.
  • Integrate models with Digital Twin and robotics platforms such as NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, robot middleware, and orchestration services.
  • Deploy scalable inference and control services on cloud and edge environments using containers, Kubernetes, APIs, and event-driven workflows.
  • Establish observability for model and system performance, including experiment tracking, evaluation, drift detection, telemetry, and safe rollback mechanisms.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate industrial use cases into production-ready AI capabilities with measurable reliability and productivity impact.

What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, AI, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • 2–5 years of experience building, training, evaluating, and deploying AI/ML systems in production.
  • Strong Python engineering skills, including packaging, testing, APIs, and performance-oriented development; C++ is a plus for robotics integration.
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and with computer vision or multimodal model development.
  • Experience with robotic AI concepts such as perception, planning support, control integration, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or Vision-Language-Action models.
  • Practical knowledge of MLOps and deployment, including experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, containers, and cloud or edge inference.
  • Experience with simulation and Digital Twin workflows, including sim-to-real validation and evaluation using telemetry, sensor, and vision data.
  • Ability to define metrics, benchmarks, and safety-minded validation processes for reliable deployment in industrial environments.

Good-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, or similar robotics simulation platforms.
  • Familiarity with world models, synthetic data generation, diffusion policy methods, or foundation-model-based robotics workflows.
  • Exposure to edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson and to latency-, compute-, or power-constrained deployment.
  • Understanding robot middleware, telemetry pipelines, and distributed or real-time robotic system architectures.
  • Experience in manufacturing, industrial automation, or other safety-critical operational environments.

Key Attributes

  • Strong problem solving mindset and ability to work with team members from different domains.
  • Excellent communication skills and willingness to support others across the team.
  • Hands‑on engineering mindset with focus on practical development & deployment.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex technical concepts to non‑experts.
  • High ownership and accountability.
  • Comfortable working across R&D, engineering, and service organizations.

job.title: Business Program Manager
job.description:
About the job

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Data Center Operations Business Program Manager, you will support facilities operations in Singapore and across the APAC region. In this role, you will oversee daily business operations, manage site budgets, guide procurement and supplier agreements, and direct non-critical infrastructure projects. By driving strategic initiatives, negotiating with partners, and leading cost-effective maintenance, you will ensure our data centers run safely and efficiently. You will work closely with site teams to manage vendor agreements, review financial performance, and maintain high operational standards. As a proactive problem solver, you will establish purchase orders, approve invoices, and hold contractors accountable to key performance goals. You will also develop AI skills and leverage innovative tools to enhance performance and drive operational excellence. You will help Google data centers maintain quality, delivery, and value.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Prepare Statements of Work (SoW) for critical and non-critical facility operations agreements.
  • Obtain facilities-related vendor price quotes, negotiating, preparing purchase orders, and reviewing/approving invoices.
  • Manage facilities system operation and maintenance expenses, including forecasting and budgeting (OPEX and CAPEX).
  • Work with support service vendors to resolve conflicts and issues under the direction of the facility manager.
  • Act as the point of contact for small to medium projects as assigned by the facility manager.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

This is an opportunity to join Firmus at an exciting stage of hyper growth and help shape the teams behind some of the most important AI infrastructure projects ahead of us.

The Talent Acquisition Partner will play a key role in building the teams that enable this growth. This role will partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers across AI Infrastructure Engineering, Deployment and Operations functions to deliver high-quality hiring outcomes at speed.

This is a hands-on Talent Acquisition role with strong business ownership. You will not simply fill roles; you will become the hiring partner for critical business functions, advising hiring managers, shaping sourcing strategies, building market pipelines and ensuring delivery stays on track.

This is a one-year fixed-term full time role, with strong potential for conversion to permanent employment, subject to performance and business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Hiring Partnership

  • Build trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders across assigned portfolios.
  • Partner with hiring managers to understand workforce plans, role requirements, and hiring priorities.
  • Provide market insights, talent availability updates and hiring recommendations to support business decision-making.
  • Provide advisory insights to hiring managers on role briefing, assessment alignment, candidate experience and timely decision-making.

High-Volume Hiring Delivery

  • Manage an average of 15-20 active roles, at any given time, across AI Infrastructure Deployment & AI Factory Operations, or other assigned portfolios with business scales
  • Maintain weekly pipeline discipline across sourcing, screening, interview progress, feedback, offer and close-out.
  • Prioritise urgent and high-impact roles while keeping broader hiring activity moving.
  • Build and maintain strong shortlists against agreed timelines.

Industry Talent Mapping and Sourcing

  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies for Deployment, Operation and Project Management talent.
  • Build proactive talent pools for recurring and business-critical roles.
  • Identify relevant industry channels, competitors, networks and referral pathways.
  • Use direct sourcing, LinkedIn, referrals, applications and selective agency engagement to build candidate pipelines.

Recruitment Operations and Data Discipline

  • Maintain accurate recruitment data and pipeline updates in Greenhouse.
  • Track activity, conversion and bottlenecks across assigned roles, contribute to weekly hiring reporting and pipeline review rhythms.
  • Use recruitment data to drive outcomes, prioritise actions and identify risks
  • Participate in TA projects and process enhancements as part of the broader People and Talent team.
  • Work with the TA Coordinator on interview scheduling, reference checks, job posting, contract support and onboarding handover.

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources Management or related fields
  • Eight to ten years of experience as an advisory Talent Acquisition Partner, 360 Recruiter or similar role in a fast-paced hiring environment.
  • Proven track records in recruiting for Data Centre Infrastructure, Infrastructure deployment & Project Management, Electrical & Mechanical engineering related functions are highly desirable
  • A strong understanding of the ASEAN region is essential for this role, including in-depth knowledge of regional talent markets, talent availability and attraction, and country-specific employment laws and regulatory requirements.
  • Strong capability managing high-volume hiring while maintaining quality and stakeholder confidence.
  • Strong sourcing capability across LinkedIn, direct sourcing, referrals, talent pooling and market mapping.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, urgent roles and multiple hiring processes at once.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management and candidate engagement skills.

Location & Reporting

  • Based in Singapore
  • Hybrid working mode: 4 days in the office
  • Reports directly to the Chief People Officer

Employment Basis

This is a one-year fixed term full-time role.

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Project Engineer, HVAC
job.description:
What you will do

Project Engineer (HVAC) is responsible for managing and coordinating the engineering, technical, and site execution aspects of HVAC works for large‑scale data center and critical facility projects. The role supports the Project Manager to ensure safe, timely, compliant, and high‑quality project delivery, from design coordination through installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.

How you will do it:

Engineering & Technical Management

  • Coordinate HVAC design development, shop drawings, material submissions, and method statements
  • Review and ensure compliance with project specifications, drawings, codes, and standards
  • Resolve technical issues related to chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC units, AHUs, ducting, pipework, and ventilation
  • Interface with consultants and clients to address technical queries and design clarifications

Site Execution & Coordination

  • Manage day‑to‑day HVAC site activities to ensure works are executed according to approved drawings and schedules
  • Coordinate with main contractor, MEP trades, CSA teams, vendors, and subcontractors
  • Monitor work progress and ensure alignment with the approved project program
  • Support site supervision teams to ensure installation quality and workmanship standards

Testing, Commissioning & Handover

  • Coordinate pre‑commissioning, testing, and commissioning (T&C) activities
  • Work closely with commissioning agents, vendors, and client representatives
  • Ensure proper preparation of as‑built drawings, O&M manuals, and handover documentation
  • Support final inspections, snag clearance, and client acceptance

Cost, Procurement & Contract Support

  • Assist the Project Manager in cost control, variation evaluation, and progress claims
  • Track material procurement, deliveries, and vendor schedules
  • Identify potential variation orders and schedule risks early

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with QA/QC procedures, inspection and test plans (ITP), and quality records
  • Enforce site HSE requirements and safe work practices
  • Support audits, inspections, and authority submissions as required

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports
  • Track RFIs, technical submissions, approvals, and site instructions
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in HVAC project engineering
  • Experience delivering large‑scale commercial, industrial, or data center projects is preferred.
  • Hands‑on experience in HVAC installation, coordination, and commissioning
  • Data center or mission‑critical project experience is a strong advantage
  • Strong knowledge of Chilled water systems (air‑cooled & water‑cooled), CRAH / CRAC units, AHUs, FCUs, ventilation systems
  • Familiar with project schedules and reporting tools (e.g. MS Project, Excel)

Preferred Skills

  • Strong coordination and communication skills
  • Proactive problem‑solver with attention to detail
  • Able to work independently and under tight project schedules
  • Good stakeholder management and teamwork mindset

job.title: Plug Assembler I
job.description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Assembler to join the Power & Thermal Management division in Singapore. The Assemblers manufactures and assembles a variety of configurations of mechanical and basic electrical assemblies used in electrical distribution systems.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

  • Read shop drawings and wiring diagrams.
  • Read Bills of Materials (BOMs) to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units.
  • Make electrical connections according to specifications.
  • Assemble parts, and position, align, and fasten assemblies, subassemblies, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Modify parts by drilling, tapping, countersinking, etc. machine tools, power and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
  • Measure parts to determine tolerances, using tape measures and precision measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers.
  • Attach labels and mark identifying information on parts.
  • Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices including the SECRIT values.
  • Cross training to work in other functional department of the plant.
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Tool selection — determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Oral Comprehension – The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Ability to operate cordless hand tools, power tools and pneumatic tools.
  • Ability to read shop drawings and wiring diagrams preferred.
  • Ability to read standard tape measure.
  • Ability to work in a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • O Level/A Level/ ITE or High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in manufacturing preferred

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Lifting: Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs often.
  • Finger Dexterity: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
  • Manual Dexterity: The ability to quickly move hand, hand together with arm, or two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Arm-Hand Steadiness: The ability to keep hand and arm steady while moving arm or while holding arm and hand in one position.
  • Vision: The ability to see details at a close range and have the ability to tell the difference in the colors of wires.

  • Our team consists of a diverse group of individuals with backgrounds across consulting, tax, accounting, and analytics.

Work on testing VAT related internal controls

  • Analyse and validate compliance data, flagging issues and collaborating with teams to resolve them efficiently.

  • Ensure adherence to indirect tax processes and update procedures as needed to reflect evolving business requirements.
  • Prepare and review month-end reconciliations and journal entries, maintaining comprehensive audit documentation.
  • Leverage technology to streamline and automate tax calculations, ensuring compliance and accuracy.
  • Degree in finance, accounting, tax, or related field.
  • Strong English written and verbal communication skills.

  • Robust knowledge of MS Excel
  • Ability to analyse large data volumes to identify key insights.
  • Self-driven with a critical and positive 'can-do' attitude.
  • Comfortable collaborating with various subject matter experts.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment with minimal supervision.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

job.title: Business Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

We are looking for a skilled Business Analyst with 6+ years of experience to join the team building MineStar Office, Caterpillar's large-scale mining fleet-management and autonomy platform. You will act as the bridge between business stakeholders, product owners, and engineering teams — translating complex operational needs into clear, testable requirements that drive the delivery of fleet management, equipment monitoring, and geospatial visualization capabilities.

You should be comfortable working in a large, multi-team Agile environment, valuing clarity, minimal ambiguity, and the Principle of Least Astonishment in every artefact you produce.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office

Responsibilities

  • Eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements from mining operations stakeholders, product owners, and UX designers.
  • Translating business needs into well-structured user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications in Azure DevOps (ADO) work-item tracking.
  • Conducting gap analysis between current-state business processes and proposed system capabilities across fleet management, equipment monitoring, and geospatial visualization features.
  • Facilitating workshops, interviews, and collaborative sessions with cross-functional teams including UX designers, software engineers, QA, and DevOps engineers in an Agile/Scrum delivery model.
  • Supporting backlog refinement and sprint planning by ensuring stories are well-defined, prioritized, and accompanied by clear acceptance criteria before entering a sprint.
  • Collaborating with frontend (Angular 18) and backend (Java / Spring Boot) engineers to validate that implemented features meet stated requirements, including real-time WebSocket/STOMP messaging channels and RESTful API behaviours.
  • Partnering with the QA team to define test scenarios, participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), and verify that delivered software meets functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Maintaining traceability between business requirements, user stories, and test cases throughout the software development life cycle.
  • Supporting both cloud-deployed (web) and on-premises (Electron desktop) distribution targets by understanding and documenting the functional parity expectations for each delivery channel.
  • Diagnosing and documenting production issues by analyzing business impact, working with engineering to establish root cause, and communicating resolution timelines to stakeholders.
  • Producing and maintaining process models, data-flow diagrams, and feature documentation to support onboarding and long-term maintainability.

Degree Requirement

  • Bachelor's or master’s in business Analysis, Information Systems, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.

Highly Desirable / Nice-to-Have

  • Exposure to Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-deployed service architectures — sufficient to understand deployment impact on feature availability.
  • Familiarity with geospatial or GIS concepts (coordinate reference systems, spatial queries) relevant to map-based fleet visualization.
  • Domain exposure to mining, telemetry, autonomy, or industrial IoT / real-time systems.
  • Experience with data-visualization tooling (Deck.gl, Power BI, or similar) from a requirements and acceptance perspective.
  • Understanding of internationalization (i18n) requirements and locale-aware UI design.
  • Experience writing BDD-style scenarios (Gherkin / Cucumber) as a bridge between business requirements and automated test suites.

Skill Descriptors

Industry Knowledge: Knowledge of the organization's industry group, trends, directions, major issues, regulatory considerations, and trendsetters; ability to apply industry knowledge appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discusses industry-specific flagship products and services (mining fleet management, equipment monitoring, machine autonomy).
  • Demonstrates current knowledge of the regulatory and safety environment for the mining and industrial automation segment.
  • Describes the contribution of the Business Analyst function as it relates to fleet-management and autonomy product delivery.
  • Participates in major industry professional associations; subscribes to industry-specific publications.
  • Currently works within a major industry segment and understands its associated operational functions and feature requirements.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific business problems and resolution alternatives, including impact on fleet operations and data integrity.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder (operations, engineering, product, QA).
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of requirements and acceptance criteria.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtains stakeholder agreement on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques, process mapping, and diagnostic information to identify and articulate problems clearly.

Software Development Life Cycle: Knowledge of software development life cycle; ability to use a structured methodology for delivering and managing new or enhanced software products to the marketplace. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Describes similarities and differences of life cycle for new product development vs. new release (including regression scope and backwards-compatibility considerations).
  • Identifies common issues, problems, and considerations for each phase of the life cycle (discovery, design, development, testing, release).
  • Works with a formal Agile/Scrum methodology with Azure DevOps work-item tracking (epics, features, user stories, tasks, bugs).
  • Explains phases, activities, dependencies, deliverables, and key decision points across the backlog-to-production pipeline.
  • Interprets product development plans and functional documentation; flags inconsistencies or missing acceptance criteria before development begins.

Software Product Testing: Knowledge of software product testing; ability to design, plan, and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure software product quality and adherence to stated requirements. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in test readiness reviews, functional, volume, and load testing planning sessions.
  • Describes key features and aspects of unit testing (Jest, JUnit), BDD with Cucumber, and Playwright E2E testing as they relate to acceptance-criteria validation.
  • Defines and reviews test scenarios that confirm software components comply with functional requirements and design specifications.
  • Explains procedures for documenting test activities and results (errors, non-conformance, traceability matrices).
  • Conducts and coordinates user acceptance testing (UAT) on aspects of assigned product features.

Application Development Tools: Knowledge of application and system development; ability to utilize a variety of specific tools and toolkits relevant to the BA role. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows standards and guidelines for using Azure DevOps work-item tracking, Nx build pipelines (read-only awareness), and Git branching conventions relevant to requirements traceability.
  • Documents the uses of BA-relevant toolkits (ADO Boards, wikis, query editors, test-plan modules).
  • Differentiates between web (Angular / cloud) and desktop (Electron) delivery targets and their implications on feature scope and acceptance criteria.
  • Works with most ADO Board components including backlog management, sprint planning, test plans, and reporting.
  • Discusses the capabilities, features, and uses of the project's toolchain from a requirements and quality-assurance perspective.

Artificial Intelligence: Knowledge of the concepts, technologies, and methodologies of artificial intelligence (AI); ability to engage with AI-driven product capabilities and apply AI tools to improve BA productivity. Level Basic Understanding:

  • Explains the methodology and technologies of AI and machine-learning as they apply to fleet optimization and autonomy features in MineStar Office.
  • Describes the concepts, functions, and features of AI relevant to mining-domain use cases (predictive maintenance, route optimization, autonomous haulage).
  • Locates relevant resources to stay current on AI trends in industrial IoT and mining automation.
  • Cites examples of successful implementation of AI technologies in comparable fleet-management or industrial systems.

Business Analysis Core: Knowledge of business analysis frameworks, elicitation techniques, and requirements management; ability to produce clear, testable artefacts that drive software delivery. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Elicits requirements using structured interviews, workshops, observation, and document analysis.
  • Writes user stories in the format _"As a [role], I want [capability], so that [business value]"_ with clear, testable acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then).
  • Maintains a requirements traceability matrix linking business goals to user stories, test cases, and delivered features.
  • Produces process models (swimlane diagrams, data-flow diagrams) to communicate workflows to both business and technical audiences.
  • Manages scope changes through a defined change-control process, assessing impact on sprint commitments and release timelines.

Technical Troubleshooting: Knowledge of technical troubleshooting approaches, tools, and techniques; ability to anticipate, recognize, and communicate technical issues affecting business operations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Discovers and documents business impact of software defects across fleet management, equipment monitoring, and geospatial visualization features.
  • Works with engineering teams using vendor-specific diagnostic guides and Azure DevOps bug work-item workflows to track resolution.
  • Handles stakeholder inquiries related to product features, application

behavior, and compatibility expectations.

  • Analyzes user-reported symptoms, application logs (SLF4J/Log4j2 at an awareness level), and system behavior to articulate defect details clearly for engineering.
  • Records and reports specific technical problems, reproduction steps, and resolution outcomes for audit and knowledge-base purposes.

October 9, 2026 - October 22, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Service Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition

Performs installation and maintenance of equipment while ensuring safety and performance standards.

Responsibilities

*I. Equipment Inspection and Diagnosis*

  • Visual Inspection
  • Conduct a thorough visual inspection of the exterior of the gas internal combustion engine generator set, including the casing, piping, valves, and connectors. Look for any obvious deformations, cracks, or leakage points. For example, check for minor cracks in the gas piping that may result from corrosion or external forces, which could lead to gas leaks and pose safety hazards.
  • Examine the identification and labels on the equipment to ensure they are intact and legible, including equipment nameplates and operational instruction labels. This ensures accurate equipment information for subsequent operations and repairs.
  • Performance Parameter Monitoring
  • Utilize professional testing instruments, such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and pressure sensors, to monitor key performance parameters of the generator set in real-time. These parameters include electrical parameters (voltage, current, power factor, etc.), gas pressure, lubricating oil pressure, and coolant temperature. Compare these readings with the normal operating parameter ranges of the equipment to promptly detect any anomalies. For instance, if the output voltage of the generator set is significantly lower than the rated value, it may indicate a fault within the generator.
  • Analyze the operational data records of the generator set, such as running time, start-stop frequency, and fault alarm records. These data can help the engineer assess the equipment's operational status trends and predict potential faults. For example, if the generator set is frequently starting within a short period, it may indicate issues with the control system or abnormal load fluctuations.
  • Fault Diagnosis
  • Based on the inspection and monitoring results, use professional knowledge and experience to accurately diagnose equipment faults. For common faults, such as reduced power output due to insufficient gas supply, quickly identify the root cause, which could be a clogged gas pipe, a malfunctioning gas pressure regulating valve, or a problem with the gas supply source.
  • Employ fault tree analysis and other methods to delve into complex faults. Start from potential causes of the fault (such as mechanical, electrical, or gas system issues) and systematically troubleshoot to determine the underlying cause. For example, when a generator set fails to start properly, sequentially check the battery charge level, starter motor, and gas supply system among other components.

*II. Repair Work*

  • Mechanical Component Repair
  • Inspect and repair mechanical components of the gas internal combustion engine, such as the crankshaft, connecting rods, and pistons. If severe wear is detected, such as piston rings that have worn down and compromised cylinder sealing, promptly replace the worn components. During replacement, strictly follow the equipment's technical requirements for assembly to ensure proper clearances and torques. For example, when installing piston rings, pay attention to their orientation and elasticity to ensure good sealing performance.
  • Repair or replace components of the cooling system, including the radiator, cooling fan, and coolant pipes. Ensure the cooling system functions properly to prevent engine overheating and damage. For instance, clean the surface of the radiator to remove dust and debris, and check for any blockages or leaks in the coolant pipes.
  • Electrical System Repair
  • Examine electrical components of the generator set, such as the generator, starter motor, and control cabinet. For the generator, check the insulation of the windings. If the insulation resistance falls below the specified value, it may indicate moisture or aging of the windings, requiring drying or rewinding. Also, check the excitation system of the generator to ensure stable power output.
  • Repair or replace damaged electrical wiring, including wires, cables, and connectors. During repairs, ensure that electrical connections are correct and secure, adhering to electrical safety standards. For example, when replacing aged wiring, select wires that meet the equipment's voltage and current requirements and properly insulate the connections.
  • Gas System Repair
  • Clean or replace gas filters to ensure the cleanliness of the gas supply. If the filter is clogged, it can disrupt the gas supply and affect the performance of the generator set. At the same time, check the integrity of the gas pipes and repair any detected leaks. For example, use appropriate sealing materials to address leaks at pipe connections.
  • Maintain the gas pressure regulating device to ensure the gas pressure remains within the appropriate range. If the pressure is too high or too low, it can affect the combustion efficiency and operational stability of the gas internal combustion engine. Regularly check the sensitivity and accuracy of the regulating device, and calibrate or replace it if necessary.

*III. Maintenance Work*

  • Cleaning Maintenance
  • Regularly clean the gas internal combustion engine generator set, removing dust, oil stains, and debris from the surface. Use specialized cleaning tools to clean dust accumulation inside the equipment. For example, use compressed air to blow out dust from inside the generator to prevent it from affecting the equipment's heat dissipation and operational performance.
  • Clean the cooling system of the equipment, including the coolant tank, radiator, and cooling fan. Regularly replace the coolant to ensure its cleanliness and anti-freeze and anti-corrosion properties. For example, before the onset of winter, check the freezing point of the coolant to ensure it meets local climatic conditions and add antifreeze if necessary.
  • Lubrication Maintenance
  • In accordance with the equipment manual, regularly change the lubricating oil and grease. Inspect the quality of the lubricating oil, such as its color and viscosity. If the oil has deteriorated, replace it promptly. Also, check the lubrication system, including the oil pump, oil pipes, and oil filter, to ensure proper operation and smooth delivery of lubricating oil to all lubrication points.
  • Lubricate the lubrication points of the equipment, such as bearings and gears. During lubrication, control the amount of lubricating grease to avoid over or under-lubrication. For example, for rolling bearings, determine the appropriate amount of lubricating grease based on the bearing size and rotational speed.
  • Preventive Maintenance
  • Develop a preventive maintenance schedule based on the equipment's operating hours and usage. For example, after a certain number of operating hours, conduct a comprehensive inspection and maintenance of the equipment, including checking the tightness of fasteners and adjusting operational parameters. Regularly update the control system software and optimize parameters to improve the equipment's operational efficiency and reliability.

*IV. Field Service and Communication*

  • Field Service Response
  • Respond promptly to equipment failure reports and arrive at the site in a timely manner. Before arriving, preliminarily assess the potential issues based on the failure report and prepare the necessary repair tools and spare parts. For example, if the report indicates that the generator set fails to start, prepare some common spare parts for the starting system, such as the starting battery and starter motor.
  • At the repair and maintenance site, adhere to safety operating procedures to ensure the safety of oneself and others. Use repair tools correctly to avoid equipment damage or safety accidents due to improper operation.
  • Customer Communication
  • Maintain good communication with customers to understand the equipment's usage and their requirements. Explain the causes of equipment faults, repair and maintenance plans, and costs to the customers. For example, after completing the repair, provide a detailed explanation of the issues found during the repair process, the replaced components, and subsequent usage precautions.
  • Collect customer feedback on equipment operation and repair and maintenance services. Timely improve work methods and service quality based on the feedback. Provide personalized repair and maintenance service suggestions according to the customer's special needs.

Degree Level:

  • Preferred: major in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field. This provides a strong foundation in the principles of engine mechanics, electrical systems, and thermodynamics, which are crucial for understanding the complex interactions within a gas internal combustion engine generator set.
  • Acceptable: An associate degree in a technical field such as automotive technology, diesel mechanics, or industrial maintenance, combined with relevant certifications (e.g., ASE Certification for automotive technicians) can also be sufficient. These programs often include hands-on training that is directly applicable to the maintenance and repair of mechanical and electrical systems.

Certifications (Prefer):

  • Gas Handling Certification: Given the involvement with gas systems, certification in gas handling and safety is essential. This ensures compliance with safety regulations and best practices when working with potentially hazardous gas systems.
  • Electrical Safety Certification: Certifications such as the NFPA 70E (Electrical Safety in the Workplace) are beneficial for safely working with electrical systems, which are a significant part of generator sets.
  • Professional Certifications: Certifications from organizations which can enhance qualifications and demonstrate specialized knowledge in engine repair and maintenance.

Skills

  • Mechanical Skills
  • Engine Repair: Experience in repairing and maintaining internal combustion engines, including troubleshooting mechanical issues such as worn pistons, faulty crankshafts, and malfunctioning valves.
  • Piping and Fittings: Proficiency in working with gas and oil piping systems, including installation, repair, and leak detection. Knowledge of proper sealing techniques and materials is crucial.
  • Cooling Systems: Experience with cooling systems, including radiator maintenance, coolant replacement, and troubleshooting overheating issues.
  • Electrical Skills
  • Electrical Troubleshooting: Ability to diagnose and repair electrical faults in generator sets, including issues with alternators, starters, and control panels.
  • Wiring and Circuitry: Experience with electrical wiring, circuit diagrams, and the use of multimeters and other diagnostic tools to identify and fix electrical problems.
  • Control Systems: Familiarity with electronic control systems used in modern generator sets, including programmable logic controllers (PLCs) and digital control panels.
  • Gas System Skills
  • Gas System Maintenance: Experience in maintaining gas supply systems, including gas filters, pressure regulators, and gas lines. Knowledge of gas safety standards and procedures is essential.
  • Leak Detection: Proficiency in using gas leak detection equipment and methods to identify and repair leaks in gas systems.
  • General Skills
  • Diagnostic Tools: Experience using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, pressure sensors, and vibration analyzers to assess the condition of equipment and identify potential issues.
  • Safety Practices: Strong adherence to safety protocols and practices, especially when working with high-voltage electrical systems and flammable gases.
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to analyze complex problems and devise effective solutions. This includes the ability to work under pressure and make quick decisions to resolve equipment failures.
  • Customer Service: Experience in providing technical support and maintenance services to customers, including clear communication of technical issues and solutions.

job.title: Graduate Engineer
job.description:
At Johnson Controls, we're transforming the way buildings and businesses operate. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable solutions, we help organisations improve efficiency, enhance safety, optimise energy consumption, and reduce environmental impact across industries including healthcare, education, infrastructure, commercial real estate, manufacturing, and government.

With more than 140 years of innovation and a presence in over 150 countries, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology with deep industry expertise to create smarter, safer, and more connected environments.

About the Role

As a Graduate Engineer, you will join our NSW Systems team and gain hands-on experience in the design, programming, testing, commissioning, and delivery of Building Management and Control Systems (BMCS). Working alongside experienced engineers and technical specialists, you will contribute to a range of exciting projects while building your technical expertise in smart building technologies, automation systems, and energy-efficient solutions.

This role offers an excellent opportunity to develop your engineering career within a global organisation, with structured training, mentoring, and exposure to industry-leading technologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design, programming, testing, and commissioning of Building Management and Control Systems (BMCS) in accordance with customer specifications, Johnson Controls standards, and quality requirements.
  • Support the development and implementation of control strategies for both new and existing installations across Johnson Controls and third-party systems.

  • Participate in software testing and validation activities to ensure system performance meets customer requirements and quality standards.

  • Assist the pre-sales and engineering teams by providing technical input for system designs, project layouts, and proposal development.
  • Continuously develop technical knowledge through training, mentoring, self-learning, and practical project experience.
  • Demonstrate a proactive commitment to workplace health, safety, and environmental standards.
  • Maintain full compliance with Johnson Controls Safety, Health & Environment Management System (SHEMS) requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • Recently completed or currently completing a Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Electronic, Control Systems, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • Strong interest in building automation, smart buildings, HVAC controls, industrial automation, or control systems.
  • Basic understanding of control systems, instrumentation, networking, or software programming principles.
  • Exposure to engineering software, IT systems, or server environments would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a willingness to learn.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team environment.
  • Full Australian working rights.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Structured graduate development program with mentoring from experienced engineers and industry specialists.
  • Hands-on exposure to industry-leading Building Management and Control Systems technologies.
  • Opportunities to work on high-profile commercial, healthcare, education, infrastructure, and government projects.
  • Ongoing technical training, professional development, and career growth opportunities.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Access to global resources, expertise, and career pathways within a world-leading organisation.
  • The opportunity to contribute to creating smarter, safer, healthier, and more sustainable buildings.

Eligibility Requirements

Only applicants with Australian working rights will be considered.

Pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, form part of our recruitment process.

job.title: Senior Manager, Pipeline Management, APAC
job.description:
**

ROLE OVERVIEW

Senior Manager, Pipeline Management, APAC is responsible for the health, discipline, and predictability of the region's commercial pipeline. Reporting directly to VP Pricing and Commercial Operations, APAC. The role owns regional visibility of pipeline coverage, conversion, velocity, and quality; deploys the global pipeline management framework across markets; and converts pipeline and quota attainment data into clear performance narratives and agreed countermeasures with market leadership

Key Responsibilities

Pipeline Performance & Insights

Analyzes pipeline KPIs across the region to generate actionable insights on coverage, conversion, velocity, and quality. Translates data into clear performance narratives that highlight risks, opportunities, and the specific actions required at both market and regional level, laying the foundations for leadership actions.

Market Liaison & GM Engagement

Acts as the primary liaison with market teams to align on pipeline health, priorities, and execution. Leads structured engagements with GMs – including preparation and facilitation of pipeline reviews – focused on root cause analysis of performance gaps and agreement of concrete countermeasures with named owners and timelines.

Quota Attainment & Performance Improvement

Owns regional visibility of quota attainment performance by market and by seller. Drives disciplined follow-through on improvement actions, ensuring markets execute targeted plans to close gaps versus plan and that committed actions are tracked to completion and measurable effect.

Productivity & Risk Management

Conducts productivity analysis at market and sales-team level to understand where capacity, coverage, and effectiveness constrain attainment. Identifies early risk signals to attainment and proactively drives mitigation actions in partnership with market leaders, escalating where regional intervention is required.

Pipeline Management Framework & Discipline

Deploys the global pipeline management framework consistently across APAC markets. Embeds pipeline discipline through clear governance, a regular review cadence, common data definitions, and ongoing performance tracking, so pipeline management operates to a single standard.

Sales Leadership Coaching & Enablement

Partners with L&D to provide coaching and capability development for sales leaders, focused on pipeline management, forecasting rigor, deal execution, and performance leadership. Reinforces best practices through data-driven coaching, feedback loops, and targeted training interventions tied to observed performance gaps.

Required:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in sales operations, commercial enablement, or sales performance management, with regional or multi-country responsibility in APAC.
  • Proven track record improving pipeline health and quota attainment across multiple markets, driving adoption and influencing leaders who do not report directly.
  • Strong capability in pipeline and sales performance analytics – coverage, conversion, velocity, quality, forecast accuracy – and in structured root-cause analysis of performance gaps.
  • Proven ability to define and deploy KPIs, dashboards, and a governance and review cadence across a multi-country sales organization.
  • Able to work effectively in a matrix organization structure, with strong leadership, influencing, and relationship and conflict management skills.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Experience deploying a global or regional pipeline management framework and embedding it through governance and review discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with CRM and sales analytics platforms (e.g. Salesforce, Power BI) and with seller-level productivity measurement.
  • Experience designing or delivering sales leadership capability programs in partnership with L&D.

Core Knowledge Expectations:

  • Pipeline management fundamentals: stage definitions, coverage ratios, conversion and win rates, sales cycle velocity, and pipeline quality and hygiene standards.
  • Quota and attainment mechanics: target setting, attainment tracking by market and seller, forecast accuracy, and gap-to-plan analysis.
  • Performance analytics: data definitions, KPI frameworks, dashboard design, and translating analysis into executive-ready performance narratives.
  • Root-cause problem solving methodologies, countermeasure design, and closed-loop action tracking applied to commercial performance.
  • Sales governance and review design, forecasting rigor, deal execution discipline, and the interfaces between Sales, Finance, and Enablement across APAC markets.

job.title: PLM Solution Developer
job.description:
PLM Solution Developer

Location: Pune, Maharashtra, India

Role Overview

As a PLM Solution Developer, you will design and deliver high-quality Windchill customizations and enhancements that improve product lifecycle management processes and support business growth.

You will combine hands-on development with technical leadership, workflow automation, system integration, and performance optimization to deliver stable, scalable PLM solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement PLM strategies and solutions that improve product development efficiency.
  • Develop, configure, and enhance Windchill solutions across key technical areas, including Windchill APIs and services, OData and REST integrations, Workflow and lifecycle configuration, data utilities, UI customization, Business rules, Jasper reporting, Integrations and visualization configuration/customization.
  • Work effectively in an Agile delivery environment, actively participating in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, and IT teams to integrate PLM processes across the organization.
  • Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into clear PLM system specifications and technical solutions.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and drive continuous improvement in application stability and usability.
  • Support system upgrades, enhancements, and release activities.
  • Develop and maintain documentation for PLM processes, policies, configurations, and procedures.
  • Stay current with PLM industry trends and best practices, recommending solutions that enhance business operations.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 8–10 years of experience in PLM, product development, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing and managing PLM solutions in a manufacturing environment.
  • Strong knowledge of PLM platforms and methodologies, preferably Windchill.
  • Strong analytical, and problem-solving skills along with AI practical knowledge.
  • Effective communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with stakeholders at all levels.

Good to Have Skills

  • Experience in Windchill upgrade, migration, and deployment activities.
  • Knowledge of Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD pipelines, and release management practices.
  • Experience working with Oracle/SQL Server databases and performance optimization.
  • Understanding of CAD integrations (Creo preferred) and CAD data management processes.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools and automation technologies.
  • Windchill certification and/or PLM domain certifications are preferred.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
  • A comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continuous learning.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
  • Hybrid WFH / WFO culture

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on any protected categories.

job.title: Project Manager - HVAC
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

Job Description –Project Manager – Applied (Chillers)

Grade: 169/170 Location: Mumbai Reporting To: Senior Project Manager – Applied Projects Experience: 5–8 Years

Role Summary

The incumbent will be responsible for managing the execution of multiple HVAC and chiller projects simultaneously, ensuring successful delivery in line with customer requirements, contractual commitments, and company objectives. The role will focus on project planning, coordination, schedule management, commercial follow-up, and driving projects through defined toll gates from HOTO to closure.

The incumbent will work closely with customers, vendors, site teams, and internal stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution & Coordination

  • Manage HVAC/chiller old, ongoing and new projects at different stages of execution.
  • Ensure projects are executed as per approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate with customers, consultants, contractors, vendors, factories, and internal teams to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Track project milestones and drive closure of pending activities.

Schedule Management

  • Prepare and maintain project schedules in coordination with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Obtain customer approval for schedule baselines during HOTO.
  • Monitor progress against planned schedules and initiate corrective actions for delays.
  • Drive timely completion of project milestones and support toll gate movement.

Commercial & Financial Management

  • Monitor project costs, committed costs, and revenue realization.
  • Support achievement of forecasted revenue for assigned projects.
  • Ensure timely preparation and submission of invoices as per contractual milestones.
  • Follow up with customers for payment collections and resolution of commercial issues.
  • Maintain Unbilled Revenue (UBR) within prescribed limits.

Risk & Issue Management

  • Identify project risks and implementation challenges at an early stage.
  • Maintain project risk and issue logs.
  • Escalate critical risks, delays, and customer concerns to the Senior Project Manager in a timely manner.
  • Work with stakeholders to implement mitigation and recovery plans.

Customer Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects.
  • Maintain regular communication with customers regarding project status, schedules, deliveries, and outstanding actions.
  • Address customer concerns promptly and coordinate internal support for resolution.
  • Ensure customer expectations are effectively managed throughout the project lifecycle.

Material & Resource Coordination

  • Coordinate with procurement, logistics, factory, and service teams to ensure timely deliveries.
  • Track material availability and installation readiness.
  • Monitor resource deployment requirements at project sites.

Reporting & Governance

  • Update project status, forecasts, and financial metrics regularly.
  • Participate in project review meetings and provide accurate project performance updates.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational project management processes and documentation requirements.
  • Support movement of projects through defined stage gates and successful project closure.

Desired Skills & Competencies

  • Good understanding of HVAC systems, chillers, and applied projects.
  • Knowledge of project management fundamentals including:

Planning and Scheduling

  • Cost Monitoring
  • Risk Management
  • Quality Compliance
  • Customer Management

Strong coordination and stakeholder management skills.

Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Good communication and negotiation skills.

Proficiency in MS Project, Excel, ERP, and project tracking tools.

Strong problem-solving and follow-up skills.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or related discipline.
  • PMP/Project Management certification would be an added advantage.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • On-time achievement of project milestones.
  • Successful movement of projects through toll gates.
  • Revenue realization against forecast.
  • Timely invoicing and collection performance.
  • UBR maintained within target limits.
  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Schedule adherence.
  • Quality and safety compliance.
  • Timely closure of project risks and issues.

job.title: Senior Executive, Marketing & Partnerships (Learning Solutions & Programmes)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Catapult by CapitaLand is Singapore's premier executive education and leadership development campus. More than a venue, Catapult brings together corporates, learning providers, industry partners and business leaders through executive programmes, leadership offsites, conferences, corporate events and networking experiences. Located within Rochester Commons, Catapult provides a purpose-built environment designed to support collaboration, innovation, learning and business transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on and execution-focused marketing professional to support the growth of Catapult's enterprise learning solutions and programmes portfolio. This role combines programme marketing, event execution, lead generation, partnership coordination and proposal development.

The Role

Reporting to the Director, Marketing & Partnerships (Catapult), the Senior Executive, Marketing & Partnerships (Learning Solutions & Programmes), plays a key role in supporting the growth and delivery of Catapult's learning solutions, programmes and events to enterprises and organizations in Singapore.

Working closely with knowledge partners, facilitators, corporate clients and internal stakeholders, the role is responsible for developing customized proposals for learning solutions, driving event marketing initiatives, and coordinating the successful execution of programme marketing campaigns.

This is a highly hands-on and execution-focused role suited for someone who enjoys partnering with stakeholders, managing multiple projects concurrently, translating client requirements into learning solutions, and supporting business development efforts through effective marketing, programme coordination, and sales enablement.

The successful candidate will play an important role in helping Catapult create impactful learning experiences while contributing to the conversion of learning opportunities into tangible business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Client Proposal Development for Learning Solutions and Programmes**
  • Assist in the preparation of customised learning proposals, pitch decks and client presentations
  • Gather programme information, pricing and learning solutions from knowledge partners
  • Support responses to RFPs, corporate training enquiries and partnership opportunities
  • Coordinate inputs from internal stakeholders to ensure timely submission of proposals

2. Knowledge Partner Coordination

  • Serve as the primary coordinator for assigned knowledge partners and programmes
  • Work with partners to obtain and update programme information, speaker profiles, marketing assets and schedules in a timely manner
  • Support the onboarding and launch of new programmes and learning initiatives
  • Coordinate joint marketing activities and promotional campaigns with partners
  • Maintain and update database of knowledge partners, where required

3. Programme Marketing & Events

  • Coordinate the end-to-end planning and execution of Catapult’s Masterclasses with knowledge partners, executive roundtables, networking sessions and signature learning events.
  • Coordinate invitation campaigns for Masterclasses, executive events and thought leadership sessions.
  • Liaise with speakers, facilitators, knowledge partners and internal teams on the curation of learning events, programme logistics and requirements.
  • Manage participant registration, communications, attendance tracking and post-event surveys.
  • Prepare event briefs, run sheets, attendee materials and presentation decks.
  • Support outreach initiatives to prospective clients, including HR, L&D and business leaders.
  • Support onsite event execution and ensure a positive participant experience.
  • Maintain and update prospect and attendee databases within CRM systems for the Sales team to follow-up, where required
  • Track enquiries and support reporting on lead generation performance where needed.

4. Administrative & Reporting Support

  • Maintain programme schedules, marketing trackers and learning event budgets
  • Track programme registrations, attendance and participant feedback
  • Prepare post-event reports and campaign performance summaries where necessary
  • Support procurement, vendor coordination and administrative processes where required

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Human Resources or a related discipline.
  • 2 to 5 years of relevant experience in marketing for corporate training providers, executive education institutions, learning and development companies, leadership development consultancies, teambuilding providers, business events and conference organisations.
  • Experience in a client-facing, account management, programme management, marketing or business development role is preferred.
  • Experience preparing proposals, presentations and client-facing materials will be advantageous.
  • Strong project coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel, CRM and email marketing tools.
  • Comfortable engaging knowledge partners, facilitators and corporate clients.
  • Able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

To succeed in this role, you will ideally:

  • Have experience on the commercial side (“sell-side”) of L&D, corporate training, executive education or teambuilding industry, with a strong understanding of client needs and buying processes
  • Be familiar with developing and customising learning solutions, leadership development programmes and corporate training proposals for diverse client audiences
  • Have a proven track record of executing event marketing campaigns and driving registrations for workshops, conferences, executive programmes or learning events
  • Be comfortable preparing customized proposals, presentations and pitch materials in partnership with Sales and Business Development teams
  • Demonstrate strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and programmes concurrently
  • Thrive in a hands-on, execution-focused environment, taking ownership of campaign delivery, programme coordination, event execution and follow-through
  • Be highly organised, detail-oriented and responsive, with a commitment to delivering high-quality work within tight timelines
  • Enjoy engaging with internal and external stakeholders and contributing to the conversion of learning opportunities into meaningful business outcomes

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
