job.title: Commercial Analyst
job.description:
About Us

There’s something special about working for a company like Macquarie Telecom. We’re not the biggest in the industry, where you’re just a number. We’re not tiny enough that you’ve never heard of us. We’re in that sweet spot where we’re strong enough to punch above our weight. And we definitely do! Because of this, you have the opportunity to make a difference.

The Opportunity

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Commercial team as a Commercial Analyst and play a key role in shaping the commercial performance of our Telecom business.

This is more than a reporting role. You’ll own the rolling forecast and month-end close, turn financial results into meaningful commercial insight, and provide the modelling and analysis that supports decisions across pricing, products, vendors and strategic initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams to understand what is driving performance, identify risks and opportunities, and help shape what comes next.

With Macquarie Telecom investing heavily in AI and automation, you’ll also have the opportunity to apply emerging technology to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of commercial analysis — building valuable skills for a broader commercial career.

Based in Sydney, you’ll report to the Commercial Manager, with exposure to senior commercial leadership and a passionate team focused on making a difference.

The Opportunity

Join Macquarie Telecom’s Commercial team as a Commercial Analyst and play a key role in shaping the commercial performance of our Telecom business.

This is more than a reporting role. You’ll own the rolling forecast and month-end close, turn financial results into meaningful commercial insight, and provide the modelling and analysis that supports decisions across pricing, products, vendors and strategic initiatives.

You’ll work closely with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance and Commercial teams to understand what is driving performance, identify risks and opportunities, and help shape what comes next.

With Macquarie Telecom investing heavily in AI and automation, you’ll also have the opportunity to apply emerging technology to improve the quality, speed and efficiency of commercial analysis — building valuable skills for a broader commercial career.

Based in Sydney, you’ll report to the Commercial Manager, with exposure to senior commercial leadership and a passionate team focused on making a difference.

About You

  • 3–5 years’ experience in finance, commercial or analytical roles, ideally within telecommunications or a similar commercial environment
  • Strong experience across forecasting, budgeting, financial modelling and month-end
  • Commercially curious — you naturally ask why the numbers have moved and what should be done about it
  • Confident working with large datasets and translating financial information into clear, actionable insights
  • Comfortable building and reviewing business cases and constructively challenging assumptions
  • Strong stakeholder skills, with the ability to communicate financial outcomes to non-finance audiences
  • Advanced Excel modelling skills, including forecasting and scenario analysis
  • CA/CPA qualified or working towards qualification is desirable, but not essential
  • Experience with AI, automation, SQL or Power BI is advantageous
  • Someone who enjoys improving processes, learning new technology and finding better ways to work

Why Macquarie?

At Macquarie Telecom, you’ll be part of an ASX-listed Australian technology business where you can make a genuine impact.

You’ll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, technology and commercial strategy, while building capability in AI and automation that will shape the future of how commercial teams operate.

If you’re looking for a role where you can go beyond the numbers, influence decisions and grow into a broader commercial career, this could be the opportunity for you.

job.title: Critical Facilities Engineer, Japan
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Site Operations Department

The Site Operations Department is responsible for the overall health of all mechanical and electrical systems, building maintenance, and performance of all data modules in our data centers. The team is staffed 24 x 7 onsite with Critical Facilities Engineers (CFEs) working on shift. This team is the face of Vantage to our customers and the guaranty of business continuity and excellence of Operations of our campus as well as the performance of our customer installations. Using a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to plan and track maintenance activities, the Site Operations department is responsible for all preventative and corrective maintenance. Our culture expects and rewards team performance that engages directly with the customers and the facility infrastructure.

Position Description

The Critical Facility Engineering team plays an integral role in maintaining the overall health of the critical infrastructure systems to ensure best-in-class data center services for our customers. Critical Facility Engineers are Vantage’s front-line responder for dealing with critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure operations, includes capacity management, performance optimization, and responding to, troubleshooting, and affecting repairs when unplanned events occur. Providing best-in-class services requires proficiency in mission critical facility management including change management, event management, incident management and problem management.

Essential Job Functions

  • Ensure the completion of the maintenance activities to the highest quality level of planification, preparation, execution, and reporting.
  • Ensure the full reliability of the infrastructures with the focus on continuity of services, energy efficiency and budgetary constraints.
  • Use the BMS (Building Management System) and all available systems and do regular walkthroughs to keep up to date, at all times, the appropriate monitoring on site.
  • Strict adherence to safe work practices for all work activities, at all times.
  • Strict compliance with physical processes and procedures.
  • Conduct daily walk-through of facility documenting parameters such as power availability, temperature and humidity, alarm status, etc. for identification of discrepancies and trends.
  • Provide hands on support for customer needs, includes installation/decommissioning of racks.
  • Compile Method of Procedures (MOP), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Emergency Response Procedures (ERP) and preventive maintenance programs.
  • Perform periodic technical and quality reviews of all MOP, SOP and ERP to ensure the most “up-to-date” techniques and safety guidelines are utilized as well as compliant with government regulations.
  • Supervise contractors to ensure all maintenance activities are performed in accordance with approved MOPs and Vantage’s Mission Critical Facility work rules.
  • Utilize internal CMMS to manage maintenance workflows and spare part inventory.
  • Ensure availability targets are achieved and maintained for data centers and technical infrastructure for all Vantage Data Center facilities.
  • Monitor and report load capacities of critical infrastructure to mitigate overload conditions during equipment failover between primary and redundant systems.
  • Maintain a strong technical knowledge of the critical infrastructure design intent, sequence of operations, fault conditions and associated corrective action.
  • Perform periodic site-specific crisis management drills to ensure full preparedness to respond effectively to an unplanned change-of-state event.
  • Perform post event analysis includes report compilation; to establish root cause, lessons learned and implement mitigation and or remediation activities in a timely manner.
  • Participate in operations and technical compliance audits and ensure timely completion of improvement plans.
  • Actively contribute to all improvement actions in the site PUE.
  • Work with Construction team to ensure construction activities do not impact operations, participate in commissioning activities, and drive timely closure of construction defects.
  • Perform other services determined that are necessary to maintain and operate all mission-critical related infrastructure in an approved manner.

Physical Working Conditions

  • The position is subject to extreme cold and extreme heat. Activities occur inside and outside.
  • The position is subject to noise such as vibration and high volume of air movement.
  • The position is subject to hazards. Includes a variety of physical conditions, such as proximity to moving mechanical parts, moving vehicles, electrical current, working on scaffolding and high places, exposure to high heat or exposure to chemicals.

Job Requirements

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or relevant discipline.
  • 3-5 years of Experience in operating, maintaining, repairing, inspecting, and testing of electrical distribution systems, and or HVAC systems, and or building management/automation systems.
  • Prior experience in Data Center operations or equivalent mission critical facility.
  • Supervision of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.
  • Locking out / making installations safe after incidents.
  • Reactivation of circuit breakers in low-voltage electrical equipment.
  • Readings and measurements on equipment.
  • Ability to demonstrate a proactive approach and the capacity to generate new ideas.
  • Problem solver.
  • Proven skills in the use of software, such as, BMS, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems and MS Project.
  • Candidates must possess reliable transportation for reporting to work for shifts, or emergencies.
  • Travel is expected to be less than 5%, occasionally for training purposes.

クリティカル・ファシリティーズ・エンジニア（日本）

Vantage Data Centers について

Vantage Data Centers は、世界を代表するハイパースケーラー、クラウドプロバイダー、大企業のテクノロジーを「電力供給・冷却・保護・接続」することで支えています。北米、EMEA、アジア太平洋地域においてデータセンターの開発・運営を行い、市場の要求に応じて迅速に拡張可能な柔軟な環境の中で、信頼性・効率性・サステナビリティを飛躍的に向上させる革新的なデータセンター設計を進化させてきました。

サイトオペレーション部門

サイトオペレーション部門は、データセンター内のすべての機械設備および電気設備の健全性、建屋メンテナンス、ならびにすべてのデータモジュールの性能に対して総合的な責任を負います。本部門には、24時間365日オンサイトでシフト勤務を行うクリティカル・ファシリティーズ・エンジニア（CFE）が配置されています。

このチームは、お客様にとっての Vantage の「顔」であり、キャンパス全体の事業継続性とオペレーションの卓越性、ならびにお客様設備のパフォーマンスを保証する存在です。

サイトオペレーション部門は、CMMS（コンピュータ化保全管理システム）を使用して保全活動の計画および進捗管理を行い、すべての予防保全および是正保全に責任を持ちます。私たちのカルチャーは、お客様および設備インフラと直接関わり、チームとして成果を上げるパフォーマンスを重視し、評価します。

職務内容

クリティカル・ファシリティ・エンジニアリングチームは、重要インフラシステム全体の健全性を維持し、お客様に世界最高水準のデータセンターサービスを提供するために不可欠な役割を担います。

CFE は、電気・機械の重要インフラ運用における最前線の対応者であり、キャパシティ管理、性能最適化、予期せぬ事象発生時の対応、トラブルシューティング、修復作業を担当します。

最高水準のサービス提供には、変更管理、イベント管理、インシデント管理、問題管理を含むミッションクリティカル施設管理に関する高度な知識と経験が求められます。

主な業務内容

  • 計画、準備、実行、報告のすべての段階において、最高品質で保全活動を完遂する
  • サービス継続性、エネルギー効率、予算制約を重視し、インフラの完全な信頼性を確保する
  • BMS（ビル管理システム）および利用可能なすべてのシステムを活用し、定期的な巡回を通じて常に適切な監視状態を維持する
  • すべての作業において、安全作業手順を厳守する
  • 物理的プロセスおよび手順を厳格に遵守する
  • 電力余力、温湿度、アラーム状態などのパラメータを記録する日次点検を実施し、異常や傾向を特定する
  • ラックの設置および撤去を含む、お客様要望に対するハンズオン対応を行う
  • MOP（作業手順書）、SOP（標準作業手順書）、ERP（緊急時対応手順書）、予防保全プログラムを作成する
  • 最新技術および安全ガイドライン、ならびに法規制への適合を確保するため、MOP・SOP・ERP の定期的な技術・品質レビューを実施する
  • 承認済み MOP および Vantage のミッションクリティカル施設作業ルールに従い、請負業者を監督する
  • CMMS を活用して保全ワークフローおよび予備品在庫を管理する
  • すべての Vantage データセンターにおいて、可用性目標の達成および維持を確保する
  • 冗長系切替時の過負荷を防ぐため、重要インフラの負荷容量を監視・報告する
  • 設計意図、運転シーケンス、故障モードおよび是正措置に関する高度な技術知識を維持する
  • 不測の状態変化事象に備えるため、サイト固有の危機管理訓練を定期的に実施する
  • 事後分析およびレポート作成を行い、根本原因、教訓を特定し、是正・再発防止策を迅速に実施する
  • オペレーションおよび技術コンプライアンス監査に参加し、改善計画を期限内に完了させる
  • サイト PUE 改善活動に積極的に貢献する
  • 建設チームと連携し、建設作業が運用に影響を与えないよう調整し、試運転（コミッショニング）に参加し、是正事項の迅速なクローズを推進する
  • 承認された方法に従い、ミッションクリティカル関連インフラの運用・維持に必要と判断されるその他の業務を遂行する

#

物理的な作業条件

  • 極寒および高温環境にさらされる場合があり、屋内外での作業があります
  • 振動および大量の空気流動による高騒音環境があります
  • 可動機械部品、走行車両、電流、高所作業、化学物質への暴露など、さまざまな危険要素を伴います

応募要件

  • 電気工学、機械工学、または関連分野の学位もしくはディプロマ
  • 電力配電設備、HVAC システム、建物管理／自動化システムの運転・保守・修理・点検・試験における 3～5 年の実務経験
  • データセンターまたは同等のミッションクリティカル施設での業務経験
  • 予防保全および是正保全活動の監督経験
  • 事故後のロックアウト／安全確保対応
  • 低圧電気設備における遮断器の再投入対応
  • 機器の測定および記録作業
  • 主体的に行動し、新しいアイデアを生み出す能力
  • 課題解決能力
  • BMS、CMMS、MS Project などのソフトウェア使用経験
  • シフト勤務や緊急時に出勤可能な、信頼できる交通手段を有すること
  • 出張は研修目的などで年 5% 未満

私たちの文化と提供する価値

私たちは「ノー・エゴ、ノー・アロガンス（自我や傲慢さを持たない）」を大切にし、互いの強みを尊重し、弱みを補い合いながら成長します。仕事と仲間の両方に喜びを見いだし、日々の業務に楽しさを取り入れる機会を積極的に探しています。

私たちの努力と効率的な働きは、市場平均を上回るトータル報酬として評価され、充実した健康・福利厚生、退職金制度、有給休暇制度を提供しています。

年間を通じて、Vantage チームの一員であることの価値は、各種ベネフィット、表彰制度、トレーニングおよび成長機会を通じて実感できます。あなたの貢献が、会社および地域社会に価値をもたらすことを私たちは誇りに思います。

応募について

すべての要件を満たしていなくても、本ポジションに適していると感じられる方はぜひご応募ください。私たちは、ミッションと価値観に共感する方々とお話しすることを常に歓迎しています。

Vantage Data Centers は機会均等雇用主です。

また、契約のない人材紹介会社からの履歴書の提出は受け付けておりません。そのような履歴書に基づき採用が行われた場合でも、紹介手数料は支払われず、当該履歴書は Vantage Data Centers の単独所有物とみなされます。

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Transaction Manager, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage is committed to being a workplace of inclusion, equity, respect, and acceptance. We celebrate diversity and intentionally seek opportunities to learn from one another’s experiences.

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects, and connects the technology of the world’s best-known hyperscalers, cloud providers, and large enterprises. Operating across five continents, 18 markets, and 26 campuses — with 1.5 GW of power and 10M square feet, and growing — Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency, and sustainability. Our environments are flexible and able to scale as quickly as the market demands. Vantage’s business is growing exponentially through a combination of greenfield market expansion and acquisitions across North America, Europe, and APAC.

Site Selection and Acquisitions Department

The Site Selection & Acquisitions team is responsible for delivering quality sites for Vantage’s data center development. The team sources, evaluates, pre-qualifies, and completes initial due diligence leading to site acquisitions that support Vantage’s data center business across APAC. We work closely with Market Strategy, Sales, New Site Development, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Legal, Finance, and the Vantage Senior Leadership Team.

Due to the ambitious growth of our core business, the Site Selection and Acquisitions team is hiring top talent internationally. Our expanding headcount brings exciting opportunities within Site Selection and Acquisitions. Join our team and your career will accelerate with exposure to high-impact responsibilities and the variety that comes with being part of a fast-growing organization.

##

Position Overview

This role will manage and track site selection activities in assigned markets across APAC, conduct due diligence activities, manage the site acquisition process, and align internal and external stakeholders to support timely, within-scope, and within-budget transaction closings. The successful candidate will also be expected to build and establish systems, tools, and processes to manage dashboards, contracts, metrics, feedback, and monitoring systems related to site acquisitions.

Duties

  • Track and monitor a high volume of large, complex real estate transactions, including freehold and leasehold acquisitions, developments, and other deal structures.
  • Execute transaction strategies for a given region or market:

Act as the initial scout for identified markets and sites; travel to potential locations, complete initial site assessments, prepare travel reports, and work with the New Site Development team to prepare diligence packages for internal review.

  • Manage transactions from inception to close, including securing necessary easements and ROWs.
  • Serve as the Point of Contact for all informational inquiries (inbound/outbound) from third parties.
  • Track and monitor all acquisition opportunities across a region or allocated sub-region. Conduct analysis to identify areas of improvement and work closely with Site Selection Managers to update the status of each opportunity.
  • Track, monitor, and report the status of all acquisitions and support report development per the internal acquisition process.
  • Draft Letters of Intent (LOI) using standard templates, working alongside the legal team.
  • Maintain templates through ongoing process improvement.
  • Engage with local brokers, consultants, or others as needed to comply with Know-Your-Client and other legal requirements. Complete all third-party due diligence reports for new vendors.
  • Support closing activities: oversee survey processes; procure title, environmental, and other necessary insurance; ensure payment terms and conditions are met by internal teams; coordinate with internal and external legal teams to file required documents (e.g., transfer of deeds of trust, title, property) in compliance with the Sales and Purchase Agreement and local legal requirements.

Manage all pre-diligence and due diligence materials, checklists, and dashboards for Site Selection tasks, and support the New Site Development team in areas such as:

  • Power, telecom, and fiber studies
  • Environmental and risk surveys
  • Topographical and geotechnical studies
  • Title and legal due diligence
  • Entitlements, permitting, planning, and other requirements impacting site development

Administer Professional Services contracts, Non-Disclosure Agreements, Powers of Attorney, and other documents needed to engage third-party consultants, agencies, and economic development groups, including obtaining internal approvals for scope, schedule, and budget.

Support economic development incentive programs through research, business case analysis, project inputs, and related documentation needed for government and non-government agencies, along with the Public Policy team.

  • Prepare economic impact deliverables for presentation to local authorities when needed.
  • Manage incentives programs to ensure compliance with grant requirements.

Manage external/internal meetings, create agendas, track open issues, and maintain action items through minutes and other key deliverables.

Ensure that qualified professional firms carry out Broker Opinion of Value and/or detailed valuation reports for all shortlisted sites.

Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science degree in commercial real estate, surveying, or Business Management is preferred.
  • More than 5 years of experience in commercial real estate/property transactions across APAC markets.
  • Land and building acquisition experience is essential.
  • Data center or technical facility experience is preferred but not required.
  • Strong IT skills, including proficiency with communication tools, Excel (advanced), Power BI, Smartsheet, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent analytical skills with an understanding of real estate finance, project IRR, and discounted cash flow analysis.
  • Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills; must be a strong team player.
  • Ability to analyze complex business concepts and documents.
  • Ability to respond effectively to sensitive issues, complex inquiries, or complaints.
  • Ability to deliver effective presentations on general topics.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work with limited information.
  • Ability to interpret various instructions provided in written, oral, diagrammatic, or schedule formats.
  • Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills across all organizational levels and with external stakeholders.
  • Flexible, adaptable, and self-directed; able to work remotely, while traveling, across time zones, cross-functionally, and by project.
  • Strong understanding of commercial metrics that drive successful development projects.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize work, perform under pressure, and work with minimal supervision.
  • Commitment to Vantage’s core values: Trust, Agility, Respect, and Accountability.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Vice President, Commercial Contracts and Operations Procurement (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary Objective

Lead the commercial, contract management, supplier management, and operations procurement functions across APAC Critical Operations. Accountable for maximizing value from operational suppliers, strengthening strategic partnerships, managing commercial risk, and ensuring suppliers enable safe, reliable, and customer-focused service delivery across the region.

A core member of the APAC leadership team with shared accountability for customer experience, operational performance, resilience, and business outcomes.

Essential Functions

Commercial Management

  • Commercial strategy for operational services and suppliers.
  • Vendor commercial performance and value realization.
  • Commercial governance and financial optimization.
  • Supplier relationship management.

Contract Management

  • Contract negotiation and execution.
  • Contract lifecycle governance.
  • Commercial risk management.
  • Contract compliance and performance management.
  • Supplier dispute and escalation management.

Operations Procurement

  • Procurement of operational services and support contracts.
  • Maintenance and facilities service sourcing.
  • Operational supplier onboarding and governance.
  • Procurement controls and compliance.

Supplier Management

  • Strategic supplier partnerships.
  • Supplier performance management and scorecards.
  • Vendor governance forums.
  • Supplier innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Critical supplier resilience planning.

Contributes To

Customer Outcomes

  • Customer satisfaction and trust.
  • Achievement of service commitments.
  • Resolution of customer-impacting supplier issues.
  • Continuous improvement of service delivery.

Operational Performance

  • Service reliability and availability.
  • Operational efficiency.
  • Incident reduction.
  • Cost-effective service delivery.

Business Growth

  • Scalable supplier ecosystem.
  • Commercial value creation.
  • Operational readiness for expansion.
  • Strategic partnerships that support business objectives.

Key Interfaces and Ways of Working

Customer Success

Shared objective

Deliver exceptional customer outcomes through reliable services, strong supplier performance, and proactive issue resolution.

Customer Partnership model

Customer ownership is shared across the leadership team. Commercial, Operations, Engineering, Delivery, and Customer Success each play distinct but interdependent roles in delivering customer outcomes.

Primary accountability

Customer Success

  • Customer relationships.
  • Customer engagement and communications.
  • Customer advocacy.
  • Service review coordination.

Commercial, Contracts & Procurement

  • Supplier performance supporting customer commitments.
  • Commercial remediation and recovery where supplier performance impacts service.
  • Supplier alignment to customer requirements.

Joint accountability

  • Customer satisfaction.
  • Major customer escalations.
  • Service improvement initiatives.
  • Customer retention and trust.

VP APAC Operations

Shared objective

Deliver safe, reliable, and efficient operations that consistently meet customer expectations.

Primary accountability

Operations

  • Service delivery.
  • Operational performance.
  • Incident and event management.
  • Workforce execution.

Commercial

  • Supplier performance.
  • Vendor governance.
  • Commercial management of operational services.
  • Supplier contract compliance.

Joint accountability

  • Operational reliability.
  • Service quality.
  • Customer outcomes.
  • Operational cost effectiveness.

Engineering & Design

Shared objective

Ensure operational services and suppliers support technical standards, long-term reliability, and customer commitments.

Primary accountability

Engineering & Design

  • Engineering standards.
  • Technical authority.
  • Technology selection.
  • Asset strategy.

Commercial

  • Supplier commercial management.
  • Contract structuring.
  • Sourcing processes.
  • Commercial governance.

Joint accountability

  • Supplier capability assessment.
  • Technology partner selection.
  • Long-term vendor performance.
  • Innovation and technology roadmaps.

Delivery

Shared objective

Ensure seamless transition of assets and capabilities into operations while maintaining customer commitments and operational readiness.

Primary accountability

Delivery

  • Capital project execution.
  • Construction supplier management.
  • Project delivery performance.
  • Asset handover.

Commercial

  • Operational support contracts.
  • Long-term service agreements.
  • Vendor continuity post-handover.
  • Operational supplier readiness.

Joint accountability

  • Operational readiness.
  • Smooth transition to operations.
  • Customer confidence during expansion and transition activities.

Security, Risk & Resilience

Shared objective

Protect customers, operations, people, and assets through effective management of supplier and operational risks.

Primary accountability

Security, Risk & Resilience

  • Risk frameworks.
  • Business continuity standards.
  • Security governance.
  • Enterprise resilience.

Commercial

  • Supplier compliance with risk requirements.
  • Third-party commercial risk management.
  • Contractual resilience obligations.

Joint accountability

  • Third-party risk mitigation.
  • Supplier resilience.
  • Critical vendor continuity.
  • Regulatory compliance.

Operational Systems

Shared objective

Enable operational excellence through reliable systems, data, automation, and high-performing technology partners.

Primary accountability

Operational Systems

  • Systems strategy.
  • Technology roadmap.
  • Platform ownership.
  • Operational data and automation.

Commercial

  • Vendor agreements.
  • Licensing and support contracts.
  • Technology supplier governance.
  • Commercial negotiations.

Joint accountability

  • System availability.
  • Technology partner performance.
  • Digital transformation outcomes.
  • Operational efficiency.

Shared Customer Commitment

The Commercial, Contracts & Operations Procurement function recognizes that customer success is a shared responsibility across all leadership functions. While each team has defined areas of accountability, every decision regarding suppliers, contracts, procurement, and commercial risk should be made with the objective of improving customer outcomes, operational excellence, and long-term business performance.

Other Duties

Duties, responsibilities and activities may change as the business grows and operational requirements evolve.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Legal Counsel (Projects) (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role purpose

  • This role will be based in Singapore and will support STACK Infrastructure’s APAC business across markets including Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • This role will support STACK Infrastructure APAC on development, construction, procurement, long-lead equipment, operations vendor contracting and project delivery workstreams.
  • The role is intended to provide dedicated legal coverage for the project execution side of the business: building the asset, procuring the equipment and services required for the asset, and supporting the contracts needed to operate the asset once live.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with the General Counsel, development / delivery team, engineering team, procurement team, operations team, finance team, project managers and external counsel across APAC.

Key responsibilities: The role will cover:

Development and construction

  • Support legal review, drafting and negotiation of construction and delivery contracts across APAC.
  • Review and negotiate early contractor involvement agreements, advance orders, letters of intent, letters of award, GC contracts, demolition contracts, substation contracts, core & shell contracts, MEP fitout contracts, works contracts, design contracts and consultant appointments.
  • Support review of delivery-stage issues, including variations, delay, EOT, LDs, defects, payment disputes, notices, practical completion, handover, commissioning and claims avoidance.
  • Support project teams on contract interpretation and risk management during delivery.
  • Escalate material legal, commercial, delivery, claims, bankability or termination issues to the General Counsel.

Procurement and long-lead equipment

  • Support procurement and vendor contracting for long-lead equipment and OFCI procurement.
  • Review and negotiate MSAs, order forms, supply contracts, supply-and-install contracts, services contracts and vendor terms.
  • Support procurement of generators, chillers, switchgear, electrical equipment, mechanical equipment, spares, fuel and other critical data centre equipment and services.
  • Advise on title and risk transfer, delivery risk, delay remedies, warranties, defects, acceptance, testing, liquidated damages, security, insurance, liability, termination and supplier insolvency risk.
  • Maintain procurement templates, playbooks and fallback positions.

Construction ancillary and financing-related documents

  • Support review of construction ancillary documents, including tripartite deeds, cooperation deeds, insurance policies, performance bonds, parent guarantees, novation agreements, statutory declarations, completion / handover certificates and collateral warranties.
  • Support project finance flow-downs into GC, construction, procurement and operations contracts.
  • Work with the General Counsel and finance team to ensure relevant project documents are financeable and compatible with lender requirements.
  • Track key deliverables needed for financing CPs, such as executed project documents, insurance, bonds, consents, certificates and ancillary documents.

Operations vendor contracts

  • Support operations-stage vendor contracts, including critical equipment maintenance services agreements, operations services agreements, manpower services, MEP scheduled maintenance, managed services, general housekeeping, security services, cleaning services, spare parts supply, fuel supply, customer works, minor works and site services contracts.
  • Advise on service levels, KPIs, service credits, maintenance obligations, renewal / termination, vendor default, access control, safety obligations, incident support and customer-impacting operational issues.
  • Support alignment between operations vendor obligations and customer commitments, SLAs, site rules, security requirements and live-site risk.

Ideal candidate profile: We are looking for a lawyer with:

  • Approximately 8+ years’ PQE, although we are open to strong candidates outside that range.
  • Strong front-end construction, infrastructure, engineering, procurement, projects or development experience.
  • Experience with GC contracts, D&C contracts, EPC contracts, works contracts, services contracts, supply contracts, supply-and-install arrangements, consultant appointments or major procurement contracts.
  • Exposure to construction delivery issues such as variations, EOT, LDs, defects, payment, completion, handover and claims management.
  • Experience in data centres, infrastructure, industrial projects, logistics, real estate development, or major construction projects would be preferred.
  • Familiarity with project finance interface, lender requirements, direct agreements, performance bonds, insurance and bankability would be highly attractive.
  • Ability to support technical, engineering, delivery, procurement and operations teams.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and contract interpretation skills.
  • Practical commercial judgment and ability to separate legal risk from delivery / commercial risk.
  • Ability to operate independently while escalating material deviations to the General Counsel.

Useful backgrounds to consider: Candidates may come from:

  • Construction / infrastructure / projects teams at major law firms.
  • In-house legal teams at data centre platforms, construction companies, infrastructure developers, industrial platforms, telecoms infrastructure companies, real estate developers or engineering / EPC contractors.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK Infrastructure provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Legal Counsel (Real Assets) (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role purpose

  • This role will be based in Singapore and will support STACK Infrastructure’s APAC business across markets including Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • This role will support STACK Infrastructure APAC on site acquisition, development, power, utilities, transmission, distribution, grid connection and related infrastructure workstreams.
  • The role is intended to provide dedicated legal capability across the land / power interface, which is foundational to data centre development. It will support the business from early-stage site evaluation through due diligence, transaction structuring, acquisition documentation, power procurement, connection arrangements, approvals, and completion.
  • The successful candidate will work closely with the General Counsel, investment and acquisitions team, development team, power / utilities team, finance team, local business teams and external counsel across APAC.

Key responsibilities: The role will cover:

Site acquisition and real estate

  • Review and negotiate NDAs, LOIs, HOAs, term sheets, exclusivity arrangements, option agreements, sale and purchase agreements, contracts of sale, leases, licences and brokerage agreements.
  • Support legal due diligence on title, zoning, land use, easements, access rights, encumbrances, environmental issues, planning constraints, development approvals, utilities access and subdivision / amalgamation issues.
  • Support transaction execution, including CP structure, CP satisfaction, completion / settlement, closing mechanics, funds flow, payment mechanics, completion deliverables and post-closing obligations.
  • Coordinate with external real estate, planning, tax, foreign investment and local counsel.

Power, utilities and grid connection

  • Support power, utility, transmission and distribution workstreams for data centre developments.
  • Review and negotiate electricity design services agreements, substation construction agreements, electricity supply agreements, transmission services agreements, transmission design contracts, transmission works contracts, distribution works contracts and utility connection agreements.
  • Support the business on grid connection, power availability, capacity reservation, energisation milestones, security deposits, connection obligations, termination rights, suspension rights, fees and charges, outage / interruption rights and regulatory interface.
  • Support legal review of land / power interface issues, including easements, cable routes, substation land, access rights, utility corridors, step-in / assignment rights, third-party consents, landlord / utility / government interface.

External counsel and stakeholder management

  • Manage external counsel on local real estate, power / regulatory, foreign investment, tax / structuring, title and land / utility matters.
  • Translate local legal advice into practical commercial decision points for management.
  • Work closely with the General Counsel on escalation of material legal, commercial, regulatory, or execution risk.
  • Build and maintain templates, playbooks, and checklists for site acquisition, power and related real asset workstreams.

Ideal candidate profile: We are looking for a lawyer with:

  • Approximately 8+ years’ PQE, although we are open to strong candidates outside that range.
  • Strong real estate, infrastructure, power, utilities, development or projects background.
  • Experience with land acquisition, site development, real estate due diligence, leases, easements, planning / zoning or development approvals.
  • Experience with power, grid connection, transmission, distribution, electricity supply or regulated infrastructure would be highly attractive.
  • Experience in data centres, renewables, infrastructure, utilities, industrial real estate, or major development projects would be preferred.
  • Strong external counsel management skills across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong ability to work with commercial, development, finance, technical and engineering stakeholders.
  • Practical, commercially minded and able to give clear recommendations rather than purely technical legal advice.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation and issue-spotting skills.
  • Comfortable operating in a lean, fast-moving in-house environment.

Background: Candidates may come from:

  • Real estate / development teams at major law firms from Singapore, UK, Australia.
  • Infrastructure / energy / utilities teams.
  • Data centre, renewables, logistics, industrial or real estate platforms.
  • In-house legal teams at infrastructure developers, real asset funds, data centre operators or large property developers.
  • Private practice candidates are acceptable, but they must show clear commercial maturity and ability to transition into an in-house environment.
  • Must have law degree from either Singapore, UK, or Australia university.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Head - Project Safety
job.description:
Strategic Safety Planning:

Develop and enforce safety management systems, policies, procedures, and programs focusing on preventive measures and proactive risk assessments ensuring a safe working environment across all projects.

Align safety initiatives with organizational goals, ensuring that safety practices are continuously optimized for evolving project needs.

Budget Management:

Manage the safety budget, ensuring that resources for safety initiatives, training, and equipment are allocated effectively.

Implement cost-effective safety solutions without compromising safety standards, ensuring optimal use of financial resources.

Project Safety Monitoring:

Conduct regular safety audits and site inspections to identify hazards and ensure compliance with safety protocols.

Implement real-time safety tracking systems to monitor safety metrics and drive corrective actions promptly.

Provide specialized safety input to engineering, construction, and contracts, thus ensuring that safety requirements are properly integrated into project planning, design criteria, construction plans and specifications and contracts

Ensure a robust construction safety framework is in place by defining Health & Safety minimum requirements during pre-sanction phase, pre-construction phase, construction phase of construction projects

Regulatory Compliance:

Ensure full compliance with local, national, and international safety regulations and standards.

Engage with regulatory bodies and ensure that all safety documentation is up to date, accurate, and accessible.

Incident Management and Reporting:

Lead investigations for any safety-related incidents, ensuring thorough root cause analysis and preventive action plans.

Utilize digital tools for incident reporting, enabling real-time tracking, data collection, and reporting automation.

Risk Assessment:

Identify and mitigate potential project risks through thorough analysis and preventive measures.

Review and approve project-specific safety plans.

Stakeholder Management:

Act as the primary liaison with regulatory agencies and external safety organizations

Communicate safety performance metrics and initiatives to senior management and stakeholders

Team Leadership and Development:

Mentor and train the safety team, fostering a strong safety culture across all project teams.

Implement training programs on digital safety tools and advanced safety management techniques for continuous skill development.

Digital Insights in Safety Management:

Leverage digital platforms, such as Building Information Modeling (BIM) and IoT-based safety monitoring tools, to enhance real-time risk identification and management.

Integrate AI-driven predictive analytics to foresee potential safety risks and optimize safety decision-making.

Stay updated with industry trends, best practices, and emerging safety technologies to continuously improve safety performance

Chief Project Officer

Chief Airport Officer

Functional Heads

Project Management Team

Construction Engineers

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Operations Team

Legal Department

Finance Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Regulatory Authorities

Contractors and Subcontractors

Safety Inspectors

Local Government Entities

Community Representatives

Independent Engineers

AAI

DGCA

BCAS

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Occupational Health & Safety, or a related field. Safety certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, or equivalent are mandatory.

Work Experience:

18+ years of experience in project safety management, with a focus on large-scale civil construction projects. Familiarity with digital safety tools and experience in the airport is preferred.

Certification Required:

NEBOSH Certification in OHSAS/Health & Safety

American Society of Safety Professionals (ASSP)/National Safety Council (NSC)/ISO 45001/14001 Certifications

job.title: Senior Engineer - C&I Maintenance - Korba
job.description:
Lead - Field instrumentation (Turbine)

Operational Excellence and Equipment Reliability:

Monitor the availability and functionality of all Control & Instrumentation (C&I) systems related to Turbine including UPS, DCS, SWAS, CPU systems, Governing system, ETS, HPLP Bypass, Turbine, and Auxiliaries.

Troubleshoot and resolve equipment breakdowns promptly to ensure continuous operations.

Follow equipment checklists meticulously to maintain high standards of operation and maintenance.

Ensure compliance with safety audit observations and implement corrective actions as needed.

Utilize the work permit system guidelines to manage and control work-related risks effectively.

Ensure adherence to statutory compliances and regulations.

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies and automation solutions to optimize operational efficiency across the department.

Implement process and system improvements by adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Ensure the integration of advanced technology and digitization in daily operations to improve system performance.

Drive the adoption of digital tools and platforms to streamline workflows and enhance data-driven decision-making.

Environment & Sustainability

Techno Commercial

Operations & Maintenance

Security

Stores

Support Functions

ENDORSE

ENOC

Vendor

8+ years of experience in control and instrumentation within the power generation or related industry.

Experience in power generation, or related process industries with a focus on control and instrumentation systems.

job.title: Executive - ASTI
job.description:
Training Delivery and Implementation:

Deliver aviation security training for airport staff and relevant personnel, ensuring adherence to NCASTP, BCAS, and other regulatory requirements.

Prepare training calendars, handouts, notes, and individual development plans for trainees.

Accurately present validated training courses, ensuring materials are relevant and up to date with current aviation security regulations.

Sound knowledge of the Avsec regulations and procedures.

Maintain up-to-date records of training sessions, attendance, test results, feedback, and completion certifications in accordance with BCAS requirements.

Security Risk Management and Compliance:

Conduct security risk assessments (SRA) related to aviation security training. Implement mitigation measures based on the findings.

Ensure all training programs comply with regulatory guidelines, including the BCAS National Civil Aviation Security Training Programme (NCASTP), and other national and international aviation security standards.

Support the Head - ASTI during audits, ensuring that training records, systems, and processes meet compliance standards. Address any audit findings to improve training quality.

Administrative Support for Budgeting:

Maintain financial records for training expenses and external agency training revenue.

Assist in the preparation of ASTI budgets, procurement processes, and bill processing.

Prepare and disseminate MIS reports related to training activities and performance to stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement:

Act as a point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, facilitating communication regarding training initiatives and schedules.

Participate in collaborative projects with industry partners and regulatory bodies to enhance training offerings.

Technology Integration:

job.title: Manager - Mechanical (CHP)
job.description:

job.title: Project Manager – Exhibition Design Execution
job.description:
Responsibilities

1. BOQ Validation & Design-to-Execution Translation

  • Review and validate Bills of Quantities submitted by the exhibition design consultant at each design milestone (from schematic design onward) for completeness, technical accuracy, cost reasonableness and alignment with the approved design intent.
  • Identify discrepancies, scope gaps or ambiguities in BOQs and work with the design consultant to resolve these before procurement is initiated.
  • Build and maintain cost and scope benchmarks for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media, lighting and specialty finishes to sense-check BOQ submissions against market rates.

2. Procurement Coordination & Partner Onboarding

  • Act as the primary interface between the exhibition design team and internal procurement to convert validated BOQs into clearly scoped procurement packages.
  • Define technical requirements and vendor-qualification criteria for each package (artists, specialty fabricators, AV/technology vendors, content production houses, lighting specialists, etc.) in partnership with internal procurement.
  • Drive identification, evaluation and onboarding of the right partners, leveraging existing relationships with exhibition fit-out, art and specialist production vendors, and proactively scouting new or niche partners where the project calls for novel, first-of-kind execution capability — working jointly with the exhibition design consultant on this search.
  • Support commercial negotiations and contracting in coordination with procurement and legal/commercial teams.

3. Timeline & TAT Management

  • Establish and track turnaround times (TATs) for each vendor/partner package, aligning procurement and fabrication schedules with the overall project master timeline.
  • Proactively flag schedule risks arising from design changes, vendor delays or supply constraints, and drive mitigation plans jointly with the design consultant and procurement.
  • Maintain an integrated exhibition execution schedule, and report progress, risks and decisions required to project leadership.

4. On-ground Execution Supervision

  • Supervise on-site execution of exhibition fit-out, fabrication, installation and commissioning works, ensuring strict adherence to approved designs, specifications and quality standards.
  • Coordinate closely with the exhibition design consultant, execution/fabrication partners and the building construction execution team to sequence exhibition works with ongoing civil and MEP construction.
  • Conduct quality checks and inspections at key milestones, and manage snag/defect closure through to handover.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, statutory and regulatory requirements on site.

5. Stakeholder & Cross-functional Coordination

  • Serve as a key coordination point among the exhibition design consultant, internal procurement, execution partners and the building construction team to ensure integrated, conflict-free delivery.
  • Escalate risks, budget deviations and critical decisions to project leadership in a timely manner.

Prepare periodic status reports/dashboards covering BOQ validation status, procurement progress, partner onboarding, TAT adherence and on-ground execution

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Architecture, Interior/Exhibition Design, Engineering, or a related field; a background in Project Management is an advantage.
  • 10–15 years of experience managing exhibition design and fit-out execution for museums, experience centers, flagship retail, or other large-scale cultural/experiential projects, including at least one project of comparable scale and complexity.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and validating BOQs for exhibition fit-out, fabrication, AV/media and specialty finishes.
  • An established network of, and prior working experience with, exhibition fabricators, artists, AV/technology vendors and specialist content/production houses, with the ability to identify and onboard new partners for novel or first-of-kind requirements.
  • Hands-on experience in vendor/procurement coordination, commercial negotiation and contract management.
  • Proven track record of on-ground supervision of exhibition installation and commissioning, including coordination with civil/construction teams.
  • Strong project management skills, including scheduling, budgeting and risk management.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Technical understanding of exhibition design, fabrication methods, materials, lighting and AV/technology integration.
  • Strong commercial acumen — able to scrutinize BOQs and costs, and negotiate effectively with vendors and partners.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with strong documentation and reporting discipline.
  • Problem-solving mindset, comfortable operating in a dynamic, evolving project environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple vendor streams simultaneously while maintaining an integrated project schedule.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work seamlessly across design, procurement and construction teams.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
job.description:
Assistant Manager - Regulatory & Commercial

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

job.title: Senior Engineer - Compute, Container & AI Infrastructure
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

At Singtel, your work unlocks BIG Possibilities.

We are building an AI-first telco of the future — connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, digital services and next-generation technology. From everyday consumer experiences across mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services, to enterprise solutions in 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, AI, data centres and digital platforms, we create the infrastructure and experiences that power how people live, work, play and do business.

You will be part of teams shaping intelligent networks, secure digital ecosystems, sovereign AI cloud platforms, sustainable data centres and seamless customer experiences at scale. Together, we combine technology, innovation and human potential to empower every generation to thrive in a more connected, resilient and AI-enabled future.

Be part of something BIG!

As part of our Infrastructure Engineering team, you will design, operate, and enhance Singtel's enterprise AI infrastructure powered by Red Hat OpenShift AI, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps practices. You will play a critical role in enabling container and VM workloads at scale while ensuring platform reliability, performance, security, and automation.

How You Will Make an Impact:

OpenShift Container, Virtualization and RHOAI Platform Engineering

  • Administer and support enterprise Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) environments, including Openshift Virtualization, Containerization and AI variations
  • Manage platform operations including cluster health, node management, networking, storage, monitoring, logging, security, and upgrades.
  • Troubleshoot Kubernetes and OpenShift issues across large clusters, workloads, networking, and authentication layers, as well as Operators necessary to build, develop and operate the platform efficiently and reliably.
  • Support Hosted Control Plane (HyperShift) environments, including HostedCluster and NodePool lifecycle management.
  • Manage multi-cluster OpenShift environments and enterprise integrations such as DNS, identity, storage, certificate management, and security services.
  • Support OpenShift Service Mesh (Istio), OpenShift Virtualization, and other cloud-native platform capabilities.
  • Maintain operational standards, runbooks, and documentation while ensuring SLA compliance.

GitOps, DevOps & Platform Automation

  • Manage and support OpenShift GitOps (Argo CD) for platform and application deployments.
  • Implement GitOps-based deployment and configuration management practices.
  • Support CI/CD pipelines spanning source control, security scanning, container registries, and OpenShift deployments.
  • Manage Helm-based application deployments and lifecycle management.
  • Drive DevSecOps practices including vulnerability scanning, access controls, secrets management, and policy enforcement.
  • Automate platform operations using Infrastructure-as-Code and Configuration-as-Code principles using Ansible scripts, Powershell or Unix Bash scripts as appropriate.
  • Develop reusable deployment templates, standards, and automation frameworks.

Infrastructure & GPU Server Engineering

  • Manage enterprise x86 server infrastructure supporting OpenShift, OpenShift AI, and private cloud platforms.
  • Support NVIDIA GPU servers for AI/ML and accelerated computing workloads.
  • Perform infrastructure lifecycle management including installation, upgrades, firmware updates, capacity planning, health monitoring, maintenance, and hardware replacement.
  • Monitor and optimize server, storage, networking, and GPU performance.
  • Troubleshoot hardware and infrastructure issues across compute, storage, networking, firmware, and GPU layers.
  • Work with vendors on support, maintenance, and infrastructure refresh initiatives.
  • Support data center operations and future infrastructure expansion projects.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, or enterprise IT environments.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience managing Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform in production environments.
  • Strong background in running Kubernetes, container technologies, Linux/RHEL, and cloud-native infrastructure at scale, with a proven track record being able to troubleshoot complex container and infrastructure issues.
  • Experience with platform operations, troubleshooting, patching, upgrades, automation, and capacity planning.
  • Experience with enterprise DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD, and service management practices.
  • Hands-on experience supporting x86 servers and NVIDIA GPU infrastructure.
  • Good understanding of AI/ML workloads and concepts, including model serving, inferencing, MIG, RAG.

Technical Expertise

  • Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (OCP) and RedHat Openshift Virtualization
  • Red Hat OpenShift AI (RHOAI)
  • Kubernetes and container technologies
  • OpenShift GitOps / Argo CD
  • NVIDIA GPU Operator and GPU-accelerated workloads
  • NVIDIA Multi-Instance GPU (MIG)
  • OpenShift Networking, Security, RBAC, and Storage
  • Linux / RHEL administration and troubleshooting
  • Bare metal server and storage design, build and operations.
  • Automation using Ansible, Python, Bash, or similar technologies
  • Monitoring, logging, observability, and platform performance management

Nice to Have

  • Hosted Control Plane (HyperShift)
  • OpenShift Service Mesh / Istio
  • OpenShift Virtualization (KubeVirt)
  • DevSecOps and AI Security experience
  • Disconnected/OpenShift private environments
  • Private Cloud Platform software
  • Red Hat certifications (RHCSA, RHCE, OpenShift)
  • Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD)

job.title: Service Centre Technical Analyst
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

The Service Centre Technical Analyst at Optus is an opportunity to demonstrate your technical skills while supporting customer service. This role is vital in ensuring customer happiness by handling incidents and service requests with impeccable delivery.

Based in Macquarie Park, Sydney, this role offers the flexibility of a 5-day working week within a 24/7 rotating roster. You'll be part of a dynamic team environment, with shifts scheduled across weekdays, weekends, and public holidays, flexibility and availability across all rostered hours are essential.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide specialist technical support for customers by detecting, diagnosing, testing, isolating, and resolving network problems across all Optus product and network platforms.
  • Maintain a high level of technical expertise across the supported Optus products, including Mobile, Fixed, and ICT.
  • Ensure fault management procedures are strictly followed and keep key collaborators informed of customer and network faults as required.
  • Act as the technical lead for major incidents or outages impacting Enterprise customers, providing mentorship and support to internal collaborators.
  • Primary responsibility for all Enterprise customer Incidents and Service Requests, ensuring tickets meet defined SLAs.

job.title: Specialist, IT Infrastructure (Database)
job.description:
What you will do

  • Act as a technical SME for Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server platforms.
  • Design, implement, and support database solutions for business-critical workloads across Production, Development, Test, and Disaster Recovery environments.
  • Own and provide technical direction for Oracle RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, and Enterprise Manager solutions.
  • Own and provide technical direction for SQL Server Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication, log shipping, backup, recovery, and monitoring solutions.
  • Deliver against database platform strategy and roadmap, including upgrades, migrations, consolidation, modernisation, and remediation of end-of-life or end-of-support platforms.
  • Drive platform stability, performance, capacity, availability, and resilience, ensuring database services meet operational and business requirements.
  • Lead complex performance tuning, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution of major incidents and recurring problems.
  • Develop and maintain robust backup, recovery, disaster recovery, and business continuity capabilities, including regular validation and failover testing.
  • Identify and deliver cost optimisation opportunities across database licensing, infrastructure utilisation, consolidation, storage, and support models.
  • Develop automation and standardisation using Ansible, PowerShell, Shell scripting, Python, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices.
  • Ensure database security through patching, vulnerability remediation, privileged access controls, hardening, encryption, auditing, and compliance evidence.
  • Collaborate closely with application owners, operating system teams, cloud engineering teams, architecture, security, network, storage, vendors, and wider Infrastructure & Operations teams.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation, including platform designs, standards, build guides, runbooks, operational procedures, capacity reports, and audit artefacts.
  • Provide technical leadership for major changes and projects, including planning, risk assessment, implementation, validation, and rollback.
  • Participate in the on-call rota to support critical incidents.

What we're looking for

  • Strong hands-on experience administering enterprise-scale Oracle Database and Microsoft SQL Server environments.
  • Deep Oracle expertise covering RAC, ASM, Data Guard, GoldenGate, RMAN, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Deep SQL Server expertise covering Always On Availability Groups, clustering, replication, log shipping, backup and recovery, performance tuning, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Proven experience supporting highly available, business-critical production database services.
  • Experience leading database upgrades, migrations, consolidations, platform refreshes, and disaster recovery implementations.
  • Strong knowledge of database monitoring, capacity management, alerting, incident management, and proactive problem prevention.
  • Experience working in hybrid environments, integrating on-premises database platforms with Azure, OCI, AWS, or GCP services.
  • Solid knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, compute, storage, networking, clustering, and virtualisation fundamentals.
  • Strong troubleshooting capability across complex, multi-layered database and infrastructure environments.
  • Experience with automation tools such as Ansible and scripting technologies such as PowerShell, Shell, or Python.
  • Working knowledge of ITIL processes, change governance, audit controls, security compliance, and vulnerability remediation.

Technical Competencies

  • Deep technical expertise and recognition as a go-to SME for Oracle and SQL Server platforms.
  • Ability to independently lead technical delivery of complex database changes, migrations, upgrades, and recovery activities.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, resiliency, backup, recovery, replication, and disaster recovery design.
  • Advanced database performance analysis, optimisation, capacity planning, and root cause analysis skills.
  • Experience with automation, standardisation, optimisation, and platform engineering practices.
  • Ability to define database standards, reference architectures, operational controls, and lifecycle roadmaps.
  • Ability to contribute to design and technology decisions in partnership with architecture, security, cloud, and application teams.

Behavioural & Professional Skills

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for database platform stability, security, and technical outcomes.
  • Technical Leadership: Influences engineering direction and mentors colleagues without requiring direct line management responsibility.
  • Outcome-Driven: Focuses on measurable improvements in availability, performance, cost, security, and resilience.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across infrastructure, cloud, security, architecture, application, and supplier teams.
  • Communication: Clearly articulates complex database concepts, risks, options, and recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identifies opportunities for automation, optimisation, simplification, and service improvement.

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

Job highlights

  • Graduate or master’s in finance/accounting with 12-15 years managerial experience in multinational credit collections experience with international client exposure
  • As the Manager, you will lead Collections , Cash Application and Dispute Management. You'll oversee a team of professionals, ensuring delivery against KPIs and SLAs while maintaining a strong internal control framework.

  • Present AR dashboards, Unapplied Cash, UAC, Collection insights, and risk summaries to senior leadership.
  • Guide the team on customer communication etiquette, call handling, and escalation management.

3. Team Leadership & 24/7 Operations Management

  • Advanced knowledge of Aging Analysis, DSO calculation, CEI, collections strategy, UAC Reductions
  • Expertise in Oracle, SAP, Movex, AS 400, High Radius

  • Ability to handle escalations with calmness and clarity

Qualifications & Experience
