job.title: Production Scheduling Coordinator - Level II
job.description:
Position Summary

The Controls Engineer (Electrical & Electronic Maintenance) & LOTO Leader is responsible for developing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing electrical, electronic, controls, and automation systems across manufacturing operations. The role provides technical expertise for PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, drives, robotics, sensors, and automated equipment to support safe, reliable, and efficient manufacturing.

In addition, this role serves as the plant Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) Leader and Subject Matter Expert (SME), responsible for governing hazardous energy control programs, ensuring machine safety compliance, conducting audits and risk assessments, and promoting a proactive, zero-incident safety culture.

The role also provides technical leadership, coaches and mentors less experienced Controls Engineers and maintenance personnel, and drives continuous improvement across manufacturing processes and equipment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Electrical, Electronics & Controls Engineering

  • Provide expert technical support and troubleshooting for PLCs, HMIs, industrial networks, servo/VFD drives, sensors, robotics, and automated manufacturing equipment.
  • Diagnose complex electrical, electronic, and controls-related machine breakdowns and implement effective containment and permanent corrective actions.
  • Develop, modify, and maintain control systems, machine programs, electrical schematics, software, calibration files, and program version revisions.
  • Support the installation, commissioning, and technical support of PLC-based hardware and software.
  • Develop and implement bench tests and modify software and equipment to ensure sensors, actuators, and control systems function according to specifications.
  • Support and debug complex technical problems, engineering changes, and change requests.
  • Partner with production, maintenance, engineering, and cross-functional teams to support automated machining, assembly, and testing operations.

2. Equipment Reliability & Manufacturing Automation

  • Support Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), preventive maintenance, and predictive maintenance activities for electrical and control systems.
  • Analyze downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and Pareto trends to identify recurring equipment and automation failures.
  • Implement hardware, software, and logic modifications to improve Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), cycle time, equipment availability, and reliability.
  • Implement automation improvements using available technologies, programming techniques, and appropriate materials and resources.
  • Develop and implement solutions to improve machine utilization and overall manufacturing performance.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies.

3. LOTO & Hazardous Energy Control

  • Serve as the plant Champion and Subject Matter Expert for Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) and hazardous energy control.
  • Develop, review, update, and validate Machine-Specific Energy Control Procedures for new, modified, and existing manufacturing equipment.
  • Lead hazardous energy risk assessments and safety reviews for equipment modifications, installations, commissioning, and maintenance activities.
  • Conduct periodic LOTO inspections, field compliance audits, and competency evaluations for authorized and affected personnel.
  • Conduct qualification and training programs for authorized LOTO employees and contractors.
  • Promote proactive safety behaviors, risk identification, reporting, and compliance with EHS standards.

4. Machine Safety, Audits & Incident Investigation

  • Verify and maintain machine safety systems including safety PLCs, interlocks, light curtains, emergency stops, and guarding systems.
  • Identify electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-related hazards and ensure appropriate safe work practices are incorporated into daily activities.
  • Lead or participate in electrical and machine safety incident and near-miss investigations using structured root cause analysis methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and other RCA tools.
  • Participate in internal, external, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001 audits and support compliance with applicable electrical, machine safety, and corporate HSE requirements.
  • Champion a safe and injury-free manufacturing environment through proactive identification and mitigation of hazards.

5. Controls Engineering, Projects & Governance

  • Develop and design control systems and support new equipment installations, upgrades, and manufacturing projects.
  • Specify, review, and approve company-owned or supplier-provided controls designs for new equipment and upgrades to existing equipment.
  • Investigate project requirements and develop technical solutions considering cost, resources, personnel, safety, and environmental requirements.
  • Prepare cost estimates and compile equipment and technical information required for appropriation requests.
  • Support controls system security by reviewing and implementing appropriate security requirements for manufacturing controls and systems.
  • Manage critical electrical and automation spare parts to minimize equipment downtime and operational risks.

6. Training, Coaching & Collaboration

  • Develop and deliver technical training for maintenance and engineering teams on electrical troubleshooting, controls systems, schematic interpretation, and safe diagnostic practices.
  • Coach and mentor less experienced Controls Engineers and technical personnel.
  • Build effective partnerships with production, maintenance, engineering, EHS, suppliers, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Communicate technical information effectively to different audiences and maintain technical continuity across shifts.
  • Promote collaboration, inclusion, and the value of diverse perspectives within the organization.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related STEM discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Relevant experience in electrical, electronic, controls engineering, automation, and manufacturing maintenance.
  • Experience in an automated manufacturing, industrial, or automotive environment is preferred.
  • Experience in a technical leadership or LOTO leadership role, with demonstrated responsibility for hazardous energy control and safety compliance.
  • This position may require applicable licensing or authorization for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Core Competencies

  • Collaborates – Builds partnerships and works collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.
  • Communicates Effectively – Delivers clear and effective communication based on the needs of different audiences.
  • Health & Safety Fundamentals – Champions proactive health and safety behaviors and contributes to a safe and injury-free workplace.
  • Controls Engineering Knowledge – Applies controls hardware and software expertise to manufacturing systems and equipment.
  • Controls Networking – Implements technologies and methods to connect machines and manufacturing systems.
  • Controls Safety – Identifies controls-related hazards and incorporates safe practices into manufacturing activities.
  • Controls System Security – Supports the security of manufacturing controls and systems.
  • Electrical System Troubleshooting – Analyzes and resolves electrical control system issues.
  • Factory Automation & Control Systems – Implements automation and controls solutions to improve manufacturing processes.
  • Sensor Technology & Measurement – Applies sensor technologies and measurement techniques to support manufacturing and quality requirements.
  • Machine Programming – Develops and implements machine programs to improve equipment utilization and performance.
  • Manufacturing Knowledge – Applies manufacturing knowledge to equipment, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Values Differences – Recognizes and values different perspectives and cultures.

Skills & Experience

Controls & Automation

  • Strong knowledge of PLCs, HMIs, industrial communication networks, motor controls, servo/VFD drives, robotics, sensors, actuators, and safety circuits.
  • Hands-on experience with machine programming, controls hardware and software, and factory automation systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical and controls systems and restore equipment to proper operating conditions.
  • Knowledge of controls networking and technologies used to connect machines and manufacturing systems for process optimization.
  • Understanding of sensor technology, measurement systems, and data interpretation for manufacturing and quality applications.

Electrical & Machine Safety

  • Strong understanding of electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and controls-related hazards in manufacturing environments.
  • Knowledge of machine safety systems, risk assessment methodologies, hazardous energy control, and LOTO requirements.
  • Ability to conduct safety reviews, audits, and compliance assessments and implement appropriate corrective actions.

Problem Solving & Continuous Improvement

  • Strong structured problem-solving and root cause analysis skills, including 5 Whys, Fishbone/Ishikawa, and other RCA methodologies.
  • Experience using Lean, Six Sigma, TPM, and continuous improvement techniques.
  • Ability to analyze equipment performance, downtime, MTBF, MTTR, and OEE data to identify improvement opportunities.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across functions and influence stakeholders.
  • Ability to train, coach, and mentor technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical priorities and provide effective support during equipment breakdowns, projects, and process changes.
  • Demonstrates proactive health and safety behaviors and contributes to an injury-free workplace.
  • Demonstrates the ability to work effectively with diverse teams and value different perspectives.

job.description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Join us in driving transportation excellence through reliable, cost-effective, and customer-focused logistics operations. As a Transportation Coordinator, you will oversee inbound and outbound transportation activities, ensuring compliance with customs regulations, seamless shipment execution, and on-time delivery. Working closely with freight forwarders, brokers, transport providers, and customs authorities, you will play a key role in optimizing logistics performance while maintaining the highest standards of safety, compliance, and operational efficiency.

What will you do?

Operation – Shipment Handling

  • Manage the import and export activities to ensure on time delivery
  • Liaise with Broker, Freight Forwarder and Local Custom Department for smooth custom clearance of shipments
  • Adherence to the shipping procedures to ensure compliance to the countries shipping rules and regulations and ISO standard
  • Annual Customs audit by Customs Authorities
  • Contributor of Tax Audit
  • Contributor of Certification Audit
  • Contributor of Project Solution and FS team SME

  • Origin (Factory/DC1) for the import delivery respecting incoterm (i.e FCA)
  • Ensure billing accuracy of freight payment and import duties declaration
  • Conduct supplier performance review to ensure supplier adherence to the committed lead time
  • Work jointly with freight forwarders on global/regional transport plan deployment to minimize transition difficulties during implementation
  • Manage Licenses related to import/trading
  • Vendor invoice management and improvement process, Forwarder and warehouse PO management
  • Improving and maximizing productivity as per target for FTA Saving with join working with factory, DC1 and Regional Customs.
  • Last Mile Delivery for dropship (TT4 to the site) for project solution

Customer Management

  • Liaise with internal and external customers on transport matters to ensure smooth operation
  • Improve service level by identifying optimization of processes and procedures
  • Customer knowledge sharing related to the transport

Reports

  • To compile shipping data for management reporting (ASR, FTA Saving, inbound transport cost) and flow formulating
  • Perform analysis of transport cost and shipping tonnage in order to assist the inventory team in determining the best mode of transport (air/sea ratio)
  • Vendor KPI review (Forwarder and Customs Brokerage)
  • Reports related with Government regulation

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in shipping, freight forwarding, or logistics operations.
  • Proven experience managing the full customs, taxation, and certification audit cycle.
  • Certified for PPJK is preferred but not required
  • Solid understanding of shipping industry practices and customs procedures.
  • Knowledge of Letter of Credit (LC) processes is an advantage.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Computer literate with proficiency in standard business applications.
  • Good knowledge of shipping and transportation management principles.

job.title: Startup Account Manager - Greenfield, India Startups Team
job.description:
Trusted by more startups around the world, AWS makes the power of cloud computing accessible for all. We give founders everywhere access to the same technology that powers the world’s largest companies. With nearly two decades of experience, gained from supporting hundreds of thousands of startups, the AWS Startups team helps founders prove that their world-changing ideas are possible, at any stage of growth, and any level of funding. This is why more startups, and over 80% of unicorns, choose to launch on AWS.

AWS continues to rapidly grow and we seek a Startup Account Manager to earn trust and help drive growth with well-funded and high-potential startups. In this fast-moving business, the core responsibility is to ensure that new and high-potential startups choose AWS as their cloud platform to transform and accelerate their business. We work backwards from the customer and partner with technical team members, business development, and stakeholders to lead scaled Go-to-Market strategies, accelerate adoption and drive customer success.

The ideal candidate has a passion to work with innovators and new technologies, has a strong sales background, and has the technical aptitude to learn and discuss the latest technologies, such as generative AI, machine learning, artificial intelligence, data services, and sustainable computing. This is a fast-paced role. We work at the speed of startup founders, are able to engage personas from developers to technical founders and CXOs. You will work along side Solution Architects and Product Specialists, Inside Sales, Business Development, and technology and services partners. You will be a self-starter, travel for in-person meetings, and attend events. You will develop and execute against a territory coverage plan and consistently deliver on quarterly revenue targets and measurable business objectives.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure customer success with early and mid stage startups
  • Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory or industry vertical
  • Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed sales engagements and successful GTM Strategy
  • Meet or exceed quarterly revenue and goal targets.
  • Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
  • Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CxO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
  • Work with partners to extend reach & drive adoption.
  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.
  • Expect moderate travel.

About the team About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 7+ years of technology sales experience
  • Experience working within a high-growth, technology company
  • Experience selling cloud/AI solutions to Startups

Preferred Qualifications

  • Indepth understanding on Startup & VC Ecosystem in India
  • Startup Founder/ Startup operating experience in business development, venture capital, or in leadership roles
  • Extensive skills in leveraging tools and technology to increase efficiency in your day-to-day activities
  • Demonstrated ability to own projects and events from design to execution

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Sr Partner Solutions Architect
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Partner Solutions Architect (PSA) to join our Partner Solutions Architecture team in India. In this role, you will be working directly with our managed SI partners to accelerate customer outcomes across India.

As a Sr. Partner Solutions Architect, you will act as a trusted technical advisor to partners and their customers, helping them solve complex business challenges by designing scalable, secure, and resilient solutions on AWS. You will combine deep technical expertise with strong relationship-building skills to influence architectural decisions, shape partners' technical strategies, and drive broad adoption of AWS services. You will bring visible and measurable impact to partner growth ambitions, helping them dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.

The ideal candidate will possess deep technical skill in enterprise architecture, software development, cloud, data and AI, along with demonstrated customer-facing skills at all levels of a partner organization. You will think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges, and act as an influencer whom partners and customers are eager to engage with.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the technical relationship with strategic partners in India as their trusted advisor on cloud/AI adoption, architecture, and strategy.
  • Lead solution design and technical strategy, creating scalable architectures and helping partners grow their AWS offerings to accelerate go-to-market.
  • Design and deliver enablement at scale — workshops, reference architectures, and best-practice guides that uplift partner technical capability.
  • Evangelize AWS technology through whitepapers, blogs, presentations, bootcamps, meetups, and conferences to drive partner and customer innovation.
  • Capture and share best practices with the broader SA community, contributing to mechanisms that scale technical excellence across the organization.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Account SAs, Sales, TAMs, BD, and service teams to accelerate customer adoption of partner solutions.
  • Act as technical liaison between partners and AWS product teams, channeling feedback to shape the roadmap while championing partner value propositions internally and externally.
  • Grow the SA organization by hiring, coaching, and mentoring talent, raising the bar across the team.

A day in the life As a strategic member of the AWS India Partner Solutions Architects team, you will act as a trusted advisor to our managed systems integrators. This includes:

  • Provide the architectural guidance and recommendations necessary to promote successful partner engagements in India.
  • Build Partner capacity and capability by defining technical strategies that will enable partners to build deep, differentiated expertise and well defined GTMs.
  • Capture and share best-practice knowledge with our broader Solution Architecture community
  • Share customer feedback to internal product management and engineering teams to help drive the future of AWS

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience

job.title: Data Center Engineering Operations, DC Communities
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operation Senior Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within third party Colocation facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

Key job responsibilities The DCEO Engineer will be responsible for Data Center Engineering Operations within an Amazon Data Center including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

Responsibilities may include:

  • Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
  • Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
  • Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
  • Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
  • Establish documentation relevant to business & facility operations (SOP, EOP, MOP, SWMS)
  • Responsible for the installation of the racks and namely the provision of power/cooling hand off.
  • Review and manage planned and unplanned maintenance and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switch gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
  • Assist in the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
  • Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
  • Management of the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management.
  • Participate in regular operational meetings
  • Review Work Order compliance & ensure all contractual SLA’s are achieved.
  • Interface with Infra Ops Management for day to day operational requirements.
  • Assist in recruiting efforts.
  • Manage the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
  • Delivery of exceptional customer service and satisfaction.

Participate in a 24 x 7 rotating shift roster and cover shifts as required.

About the team Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

job.title: Sr: Migrations & Modernization SA, ASEAN
job.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Migration and Modernization Solutions Architect to join our ASEAN team, based in Singapore. This role sits at the intersection of enterprise migration & transformation, modern cloud architecture, and the rapidly evolving world of AI-driven workload modernization.

As a senior member of the ASEAN Migrations and Modernization SA team, you will lead enterprise customers through the full spectrum of transformation — from migrating legacy estates to AWS, to modernizing applications and architectures to become AI-ready, and ultimately enabling agentic AI deployments that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will advise on both dimensions of AI-era modernization: using AI to accelerate and automate migration and modernization programs at scale, and modernizing architectures so they are structurally capable of running and benefiting from AI and Agentic AI workloads.

You will work across the breadth of enterprise legacy environments - monolithic applications, commercial databases, VMware estates, and aging on-premises infrastructure — defining transformation pathways that are technically sound, commercially viable, and aligned to each customer's AI ambitions. You will collaborate closely with Migration and Modernization business development teams, partner development managers, and customer solution managers to drive revenue through successful migrations and modernizations across the region.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on architecture experience with a genuine passion for the emerging AI and agentic AI landscape. They understand that every modernization decision today is an AI enablement decision — and they are able to articulate this clearly to both technical and executive audiences. Strong judgment, a customer-first mindset, and the ability to operate effectively across diverse enterprise cultures in ASEAN are essential to success in this role.

Key job responsibilities Migration Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end cloud migration strategies for enterprise customers across ASEAN with hands-on technical depth — covering infrastructure, applications, databases, mainframes, and legacy on-premises estates — evaluating both technical feasibility and commercial viability of each program to drive successful outcomes on AWS.
  • Build repeatable migration mechanisms, reference architectures, playbooks, and toolkits that systematically reduce time, cost, risk, and complexity for future engagements across the region.
  • Drive deep adoption of AWS-native migration tooling — including AWS Transform (ATX), cloud assessment platforms, and agentic discovery tools including ISV tools — with the technical credibility to guide customers through real implementation challenges, compressing migration timelines from months to wee.
  • Work with customers navigating complex multi-tower transformations: legacy application modernization, commercial software-to-open-source transitions, VMware exits, and large-scale data center consolidations.

Modernization and AI-Ready Architecture

  • Design and deliver modernization architectures that move customers from monolithic, tightly coupled systems to decoupled, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures that are structurally ready for AI and Agentic AI workloads.
  • Advise customers on the right modernization pathway for each workload — rehosting, replatforming, re-architecting, containerization, open-source migration, or managed database adoption — based on business value, complexity, and AI readiness impact.
  • Articulate why every modernization decision is an AI enablement decision — helping customers understand that architecture choices made today directly determine what AI capabilities they can unlock tomorrow.
  • Guide customers in building agentic-ready foundations: decoupled services, clean API and MCP interfaces, isolated data domains, independent deployment pipelines, and observable systems that support reliable autonomous AI agent operation.
  • Identify and address AI-on-legacy failure patterns — context overload, hallucination risk, cascading failures, and latency amplification — that emerge when Agentic AI is deployed on unmodernized infrastructure, and define the modernization path that resolves them.

AI-Driven Modernization Delivery

  • Champion the use of AI-powered tooling to execute migration and modernization programs — leveraging AWS Transform (ATX) for code transformation, automated dependency analysis, containerization, and continuous modernization at scale.
  • Apply agentic assessment capabilities — including AI-driven discovery, automated portfolio analysis, and intelligent workload classification — to significantly compress the assessment and planning phases of enterprise transformation programs.
  • Lead adoption of emerging standards and tooling in the agentic ecosystem — MCP, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, multi-agent orchestration patterns, and the Strands Agents SDK — as practical technical foundations for customer AI transformation programs.
  • Help customers build and validate their Agentic AI Readiness posture, assessing current architecture across agent platform maturity, data and knowledge infrastructure, and operational governance.

Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory

  • Customer Engagement and Technical Advisory
  • Build trusted advisor relationships with CTO, CIO, and enterprise architect stakeholders — credible on both migration strategy and AI transformation roadmap.
  • Lead hands-on discovery workshops, accelerator deliveries, architecture envisioning sessions, and multi-day modernization assessments; translate findings into prioritized transformation roadmaps with clear risk profiles and milestones.
  • Articulate ROI, TCO, and business value to executive audiences; connect modernization investment directly to AI capability and competitive agility outcomes.
  • Drive POCs through to completion and use outcomes to de-risk and accelerate broader program commitments.

Community, Enablement and Thought Leadership

  • Capture and share best practices across the SA community; contribute to whitepapers, playbooks, and customer-facing guidance on migration, modernization, and AI-ready architecture.
  • Develop and deliver workshops and enablement content for customers, partners, and internal teams — focused on agentic AI architecture patterns and AI-driven modernization tooling.
  • Provide structured customer feedback to AWS product and engineering teams to influence the AWS Transform and migration toolset roadmap.
  • Collaborate across AWS — services, marketing, professional services, partner development — to co-create GTM motions that accelerate customer transformation journeys.

Basic Qualifications

  • 10+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 5+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture for large-scale public cloud migrations (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including multi-tower transformations programs.
  • Hands-on experience with legacy application environments: monolithic architectures, mainframe systems, commercial databases, and aging on-premises infrastructure — and the modernization patterns that transform them.
  • Broad architecture knowledge across: cloud migration, microservices, containers, serverless, relational and NoSQL databases, data engineering, networking, security, CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native infrastructure, experience with AI and Agentic AI concepts in an enterprise architecture context: multi-agent systems, LLM application patterns, retrieval-augmented generation, MCP-based integrations, and the infrastructure requirements for reliable autonomous AI operation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Cloud Technology Certification
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, engineering or a related technical field, with 10+ years of experience architecting and delivering complex solutions for enterprise customers, including large-scale data center transformation and application migration programs.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Transform (ATX), or equivalent AI-driven modernization and migration acceleration platforms and tooling including ISV solutions for Migrations and Modernizations.
  • Enterprise architecture background with demonstrated ability to build and articulate cloud-native and AI-ready technology roadmaps for large organizations.
  • Experience operating across diverse ASEAN enterprise markets — with cultural sensitivity and adaptability, international enterprise customer experience with F500 organizations and global systems integrators or consulting partners.

job.title: Technical Sales Engineer - Data Centres
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Technical Sales Engineer – Data Centre Thermal Solutions. This role serves as the primary technical interface between Johnson Controls and key Data Centre customers across the Pacific region, with a specific focus on chilled water plants, precision cooling, and advanced thermal management solutions.

The TAM provides deep technical leadership across chiller systems, liquid cooling, and thermal plant architectures, while also taking ownership of technical pricing strategy and bid development for complex opportunities. This ensures solutions are not only technically robust but also commercially competitive and aligned with customer value expectations.

A core element of the role is supporting the Strategic Account Manager (SAM) to drive commercial growth. The TAM brings thermal engineering expertise, early-stage cooling design influence, and bid/pricing leadership that strengthens Johnson Controls’ commercial strategies and opens new business opportunities.

Operating within a matrixed organisation, the TAM aligns technical, commercial, and delivery stakeholders to ensure chiller and cooling plant solutions are positioned, designed, priced, and delivered to win in a competitive market.

Key Responsibilities

Trusted Technical Advisor – Thermal Systems

  • Act as the trusted advisor for data centre cooling and thermal plant solutions, with a focus on chillers, CRAH/CRAC, and liquid cooling
  • Provide guidance on cooling strategies for hyperscale and high-density environments
  • Support customers in achieving resilience, redundancy, and energy efficiency targets

​

Solution Design & Architecture Governance

  • Lead the design of chilled water systems and central plant architecture
  • Develop integrated solutions covering chillers, pumps, heat rejection, and BMS integration
  • Own system performance, efficiency (PUE), and lifecycle optimisation
  • Identify and mitigate technical risks across capacity, redundancy, and control strategies

​

Early Engagement & Cooling Design Influence

  • Influence cooling plant design, chiller selection, and system architecture at pre-RFP stage
  • Lead Johnson Controls’ contribution to Basis of Design (BoD)
  • Position high-efficiency and next-gen cooling technologies within project designs

​

Pricing, Bid Management & Commercial Ownership

  • Own the technical pricing strategy for thermal solutions, including chilled water plants and liquid cooling systems
  • Lead and coordinate end-to-end bid development, ensuring alignment between engineering, procurement, and commercial teams
  • Develop accurate cost models, equipment selections, and solution configurations that balance performance, risk, and competitiveness
  • Drive value engineering to optimise cost while maintaining technical integrity and customer requirements
  • Ensure proposals clearly articulate total cost of ownership, energy efficiency savings, and lifecycle value
  • Support commercial negotiations by providing technical justification for scope, pricing, and solution differentiation
  • Maintain governance over bid quality, margin integrity, and risk management across all submissions

​

Opportunity & Technical Sales Support

  • Partner with SAMs on major pursuits from early-stage through award
  • Develop compelling technical and commercial value propositions
  • Support high-quality proposals with cooling system design, narratives, and performance insights

​

Market & Domain Expertise – Cooling

  • Maintain deep expertise in:Chillers (air & water-cooled)
  • Free cooling and heat rejection
  • Liquid cooling (direct-to-chip, immersion)

Stay current with AI-driven high-density cooling demands and sustainability trends​

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Align engineering, product, supply chain, and delivery teams
  • Support seamless handover ensuring clarity on thermal system design and performance expectations

​

Pipeline & Technical Governance

  • Build and qualify pipeline focused on cooling infrastructure opportunities
  • Ensure technical and commercial accuracy in CRM, pricing tools, and proposals
  • Maintain compliance with Johnson Controls governance standards

​

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering (preferred) or related discipline
  • 10+ years’ experience in HVAC/chiller systems and thermal plant solutions, ideally within data centres
  • Demonstrated experience in technical sales, bid management, and pricing of complex engineered solutions
  • Strong expertise in:Chilled water systems and central plant design
  • Chiller selection and optimisation
  • Cooling strategies for high-density environments

job.title: Sales Engineer, Industrial Refrigeration
job.description:
What you will do

As a Sales Engineer, you will work at the intersection of field service and sales. You will engage with customers to understand plant condition, service needs, and performance expectations, then help shape service proposals, maintenance solutions, warranty support, and performance guarantees for industrial refrigeration systems. You will collaborate with sales, service, and project teams to deliver practical solutions that support long-term customer relationships and dependable system performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by understanding site priorities, service requirements, and long-term asset performance goals.
  • Identify service opportunities through customer visits, plant audits, technical discussions, and review of operating conditions.
  • Prepare and support proposals for service, maintenance, commissioning support, troubleshooting, overhaul, installation, and warranty repair activities.
  • Collaborate with the sales team and buyers to develop and manage new or expanded performance guarantees for implemented or deployed products.
  • Work with service engineers and internal stakeholders to scope work accurately, clarify technical needs, and ensure smooth handover from sale to execution.
  • Review plant condition and translate field findings into clear recommendations, customer reports, and commercially sound actions.
  • Monitor assigned customer activity and support consistency with contractual obligations, service commitments, and performance expectations.
  • Coordinate with operations on smaller projects and service assignments to help deliver agreed outcomes on time and to quality standards.
  • Communicate progress, findings, and next steps clearly with customers and internal teams throughout the sales and service process.

How You Will Do It:

  • Own outcomes with safety, integrity, and accountability from the first customer conversation through to handover and follow-up.
  • Stay close to the work and the customer so your recommendations reflect real plant conditions and what matters most on site.
  • Use disciplined problem-solving and root-cause thinking to turn technical observations into reliable service solutions and practical commercial actions.
  • Share candid updates and clear recommendations so customers and colleagues can act quickly and transparently.
  • Win as one team by partnering closely with sales, service, and project colleagues to align on scope, timing, and delivery.
  • Improve every day by learning from each visit, each proposal, and each customer outcome to strengthen future performance.

What we look for:

  • Technical diploma or bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, refrigeration, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in industrial or process refrigeration service, service sales, technical sales support, commissioning, maintenance, or troubleshooting.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration systems, compressors, controls, and field service practices.
  • Ability to read and work from technical drawings and documentation such as P&IDs, SLDs, and MCC diagrams.
  • Experience preparing technical recommendations, service scopes, reports, or customer-facing presentations.
  • Good customer communication skills and the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Understanding of safe working practices in industrial environments.
  • Willingness to travel to customer sites and work independently in the field.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ammonia single and double stage systems.
  • Exposure to plant audits, performance guarantees, or warranty repair activities.
  • Knowledge of ASHRAE standards, PLCs, DCS systems, relay-based controls, or compressor overhaul work.
  • Familiarity with screw, centrifugal, or reciprocating compressors.
  • Prior experience supporting service quotations or aftermarket sales in industrial refrigeration.

job.title: Application Engineer
job.description:
**

Job Description

What you will do

As part of a Global Complex Engineering (GCE) - Fire Suppression Team, the purpose of this role is to design sprinkler and gas suppression systems in accordance with BSEN / NFPA / FM / IS codes and standards. The Fire Suppression Design Team supports Fire Life Safety Sales & Design, including : Fire Protection & Gas Suppression Systems. Primary responsibility will include Project take-offs, specification interpretation, scope of work creation, risk analysis, building code compliance, and value engineering ideas. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it:

  • Complete input study with the help of input checklist and raise the RFIs.
  • Prepare Fire Suppression Layout & Engineering BOM.
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free Fire Suppression Drawings delievery.
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline.
  • Learn and use company design, bid, and quote tools

What we look for:

Required

  • BE /M.Tech (Mechnical / Chemical / Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics)
  • 4-8 Years’ experience in relevant field
  • Prefer NFPA certified ,CFPS & LPCB Certification attain within 12 months of hire date
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Should have strong domain knowledge of Fire Fighting & Gas Supression System
  • Should be able to independently carry out Designing Of Gas supression systems like Novec, FM200, Inergen ,Co2 systems, Sprinkler, Hydrant, Water Spray & Special Hazards, Software Hydraulic Calcualtion,Value Engineering and Pump room design, Water Demand calcaultion & Co-ordination part etc.
  • Knowledge on BSEN ,NFPA & Relevant codes & standards.
  • Proficient digital literacy on AutoCad, FireCad,SprinkCad, Revit, Navisworks.
  • Suppression System & Product knowledge will be an added advantage.
  • Understanding the tender documents & specifications.
  • Must be a quick learner and team player.
  • Highly organized and able to optimally lead multiple simultaneous projects.

job.title: Sr Manager - Instrumentation & Electrical Engineering
job.description:
Who we are ?

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What will you do?

  • Lead, motivate and develop team of young electrical & instrumentation engineers in executing refrigeration packages which involve API 619 Machines, Heat exchangers, pressure vessels, piping, motors etc.
  • Actively participate in the continuous & progressive development of the team
  • Continuously work towards a more efficient, leaner, transparent, digital and operationally reliable processes
  • Interact with various internal disciplines like Projects, SCM, Quality & Factory
  • Interact & maintain good relations with customers
  • Actively involve in Sub-vendor qualification & control during procurement and project execution stages
  • Follow the engineering execution process and align with the other functions within team to meet the on time in full deliveries with Quality
  • Release of Technical specification & Purchase requisitions required for sub-orders procurement
  • Lead critical Project meetings like KOM, PIM, HAZOP, SIL etc. and actively engage team to close the punch items on time in order not to impact the contractual obligations
  • Prepare and maintain the BOM and Engineering drawings with respect to change management system.
  • Review and validate the technical offers from vendors and provide engineering comments and approvals after detailed technical evaluation
  • Extend support required on shop floor & site. Attend and provide appropriate solution for the problems on shop floor & site related to engineering.
  • Follow Lessons learnt from previsions projects, take appropriate action, and maintain lessons register during the execution.
  • Extend support to pre-sales team for E&IC related scope as needed
  • Shall have working knowledge of relevant IEC, ISA, UL, API, NFPA, ISO etc. international standards relevant to Electrical and instrumentation.

What we look for?

  • Candidates should be able to understand process and accordingly design implements instruments, control, and electrical Philosophy/activity.
  • Reviewing P&IDs and service diagram/electrical single line diagram for various processes, and/or Equipment using Autocad Electrical / Eplan.
  • Review software and hardware design specifications, Switchgear & Instruments sizing and selection, Panel layout design, Wire Harness design, Cable selection, Instruments sizing and selection in line with IEC/UL/CSA/ATEX/CE standard.
  • Review of Instrument hook up diagrams along with BOMs
  • Review of JB & Cable Schedule, E & I Cable tray layouts, Earthing layouts, Panel, JB, Instrument location layouts
  • Review of IO List, Alarm / Trip List, Control Narrative, Logic Diagrams, C & E, Loop diagrams
  • Practical exposure to different starter types, panel, VFD, soft starter, LV/MV/HV motors
  • Analyze Customer Requirements & Expectations from the product in terms of Product Design
  • shall be well versed with hazardous area classification (ATEX/ IECEx) and selection of instruments, JB and control panel.
  • Shall be well versed with the concepts of Program designing, Testing, executing & verifying the PLC & Panel, and the complete gamut of Design and Drafting of Electrical wiring diagrams and logic Diagrams.
  • Experience in field trouble shooting, commissioning and start-up of control systems is required.

What we offer

We offer an exciting and challenging position. Joining us you will become part of a leading global multi-industrial corporation defined by its stimulating work environment and job satisfaction. In addition, we offer outstanding career development opportunities which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents

job.title: Engineering Manager (Java, .NET, Kafka, Angular): Building Management & Controls
job.description:
Location: Pune, India

Reports to: Senior Engineering Manager Team size: 5-6 direct reports; 15-20 indirect (via leads/senior engineers) Employment type: Full-time Experience: 10+ years total

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead a team building software for building management and controls, including platforms that connect, monitor, and optimize HVAC, energy, lighting, and other building systems. You'll manage 5-6 direct reports and provide technical and delivery leadership across a broader group of 15-20 engineers, using Java, .NET, Kafka, and Angular. You'll partner with Product, Architecture, QA, and Embedded/Controls teams to deliver reliable, scalable, and secure solutions.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, coach, and grow direct reports (leads and senior engineers) and extend your influence to the wider 15-20 member team through them
  • Hire, onboard, and retain strong talent, and build a high-trust, high-performance culture in the Pune team
  • Own end-to-end delivery: roadmap planning, sprint execution, risk management, and dependency management across teams
  • Guide architecture and design across Java and .NET services, Kafka-based event streaming, and Angular front ends
  • Oversee design and operation of Kafka pipelines handling telemetry and events from building devices and controllers (topic design, partitioning, schema management, consumer lag, fault tolerance)
  • Drive integration with building automation protocols and systems (e.g., BACnet, Modbus, MQTT, OPC UA) and IoT/edge gateways
  • Ensure quality, reliability, and security for systems that interact with physical infrastructure, including alarms, scheduling, and device commissioning workflows
  • Champion engineering best practices: code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and secure coding
  • Manage technical debt, modernization, and migrations (e.g., legacy .NET to modern .NET, monolith to microservices)
  • Work with global stakeholders and distributed teams, aligning priorities across time zones
  • Report on delivery, team health, and engineering metrics to the Senior Engineering Manager and leadership

What We're Looking For

Required

  • 10+ years of total software engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineers or leading teams
  • Experience managing or leading a team of 15-20 engineers, including through leads/managers
  • Strong hands-on background in Java (Spring / Spring Boot) and .NET (C#, ASP.NET Core)
  • Solid experience with Apache Kafka (event-driven architecture, stream processing, Kafka Connect, Schema Registry)
  • Working knowledge of Angular and modern front-end practices (TypeScript, RxJS)
  • Experience designing microservices, REST APIs, and distributed systems
  • Domain experience in building management systems (BMS/BAS), building controls, or IoT/industrial automation
  • Proven record of delivering complex projects with cross-functional and globally distributed teams
  • Strong coaching, performance management, and stakeholder communication skills

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of building protocols (BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, MQTT, OPC UA) and HVAC/energy management concepts
  • Experience with time-series data, telemetry platforms, and analytics/fault detection
  • Cloud experience (Azure, AWS, or GCP), Docker, and Kubernetes
  • Familiarity with SQL/NoSQL databases and time-series stores (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL, InfluxDB, TimescaleDB)
  • Understanding of cybersecurity standards for OT/IoT environments (e.g., IEC 62443)
  • Experience with edge computing or firmware/controls team collaboration
  • Agile/Scrum experience at scale

job.title: General Manager, The Workshop
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

The Workshop is a collaborative industrial coworking and business community platform managed by CapitaLand Ascendas REIT. As General Manager, The Workshop, you will lead the overall business, operations and growth strategy across multiple locations. You will be responsible for driving occupancy and revenue performance, enhancing member experience, building a vibrant business community, and leading a team of Community Development professionals.

  • Lead, coach and develop the Community Development team, fostering a high-performance and customer-centric culture.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with members, business partners and key stakeholders to create a vibrant ecosystem that supports collaboration, networking and business growth.
  • Spearhead marketing, branding, partnership and community engagement initiatives to enhance market positioning, occupancy performance and brand awareness.
  • Oversee business planning, budgeting, forecasting and cost management to optimise financial performance and maximise value creation.
  • Oversee facilities, infrastructure and vendor management to ensure operational reliability, workplace excellence and customer satisfaction
  • Identify and implement new business opportunities, service enhancements and process improvements to strengthen competitiveness, operational efficiency and member value proposition.

Requirements

  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Real Estate or a related discipline.
  • Relevant experience in coworking, flexible workspace, commercial real estate, hospitality, business development or customer-focused operations.
  • Proven track record in driving business growth, occupancy and customer engagement.
  • Strong commercial, financial and operational management skills.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to build and lead high-performing teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism

job.title: Executive, Client Experience (Catapult)
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Catapult by CapitaLand is Singapore's premier executive education and leadership development campus. More than a venue, Catapult brings together corporates, learning providers, industry partners and business leaders through executive programmes, leadership offsites, conferences, corporate events and networking experiences. Located within Rochester Commons, Catapult provides a purpose-built environment designed to support collaboration, innovation, learning and business transformation.

We are looking for a hands-on and service-oriented executive to support clients in delivering successful meetings, conferences, executive programmes and corporate events at Catapult.

The Role

The Executive, Client Experience (Catapult), plays an important role in ensuring a seamless experience for clients, participants and guests from pre-event planning through on-site support and post-event follow-up.

Reporting to the Director, Sales & Business Development, the successful candidate will work closely with clients, vendors and internal stakeholders to coordinate venue requirements, operational arrangements and service delivery, ensuring clients have the support they need to execute successful events at Catapult.

This is a highly operational and execution-focused role suited for someone who enjoys engaging clients, managing multiple projects concurrently, solving issues proactively and delivering exceptional service experiences. The successful candidate will contribute directly to client satisfaction, repeat business and Catapult's reputation as a premier destination for executive learning and corporate engagement.

Key Responsibilities

1. Client Experience & Event Support

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned clients following booking confirmation.
  • Coordinate client requirements and event needs from planning through completion.
  • Conduct venue walkthroughs, planning meetings and pre-event briefings with clients.
  • Provide guidance on venue capabilities, facilities, processes and available service offerings.
  • Ensure client requirements are accurately documented and communicated to relevant stakeholders.
  • Build positive client relationships and deliver a high standard of customer service throughout the client journey.
  • Anticipate client needs and proactively address issues to ensure a seamless experience.
  • As events may be scheduled outside normal business hours, the role requires flexibility to support evening, weekend and public holiday event operations when required.

2. Venue & Operational Coordination

  • Coordinate venue preparations and operational arrangements to support client events.
  • Liaise with internal teams and service partners on room setup, catering, AV requirements, access arrangements, signage and logistics.
  • Prepare event orders, operational briefs, schedules and run sheets.
  • Ensure event spaces and facilities are ready and aligned with client requirements.
  • Monitor event-day operations and coordinate prompt resolution of operational issues.
  • Provide onsite support to clients and serve as the key liaison throughout their event.
  • Ensure service delivery standards are consistently maintained across all events and programmes.

3. Participant & Guest Experience

  • Coordinate guest arrivals, reception services and VIP support arrangements.
  • Ensure participants and guests experience a welcoming and professional environment.
  • Attend to enquiries, requests and feedback promptly and professionally.
  • Support the collection of client and participant feedback following programmes and events.
  • Identify opportunities to enhance the overall client and guest experience.

4. Stakeholder & Vendor Coordination

  • Work closely with Sales & Business Development and Marketing & Partnerships teams to ensure smooth delivery of client engagements.
  • Coordinate with external vendors, service providers and contractors to fulfil event requirements.
  • Monitor vendor performance and escalate service issues where necessary.
  • Support procurement, purchase requisitions and administrative processes where required.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with key stakeholders and service partners.

job.title: Senior Tax Analyst- Asia
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Role Summary

Reporting to the General Manger - Tax, the Senior Tax Analyst will play a key role in supporting the Group's tax function across the Asia Pacific region. The role is responsible for managing tax compliance and reporting obligations, supporting transfer pricing and tax accounting activities, driving tax technology initiatives, and providing practical tax advice to business stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced tax professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, high-growth, multinational environment and wants to contribute to building a best-practice tax function across multiple jurisdictions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Tax Compliance & Reporting – Manage direct and indirect tax compliance obligations for Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia entities, including review of tax returns, payment calculations, forecasts, and deferred tax calculations. Provide technical analysis in support of statutory audits. Oversee and coordinate tax compliance activities outsourced to external service providers.
  • Tax Technology – Drive the implementation and adoption of tax technology solutions to improve efficiency and accuracy
  • Transfer Pricing – Ensure transfer pricing obligations (e.g., documentation, filings) are met under local laws and regulations
  • Tax Accounting – Support quarterly tax accounting and reporting, including calculation and tracking of transfer pricing corrections and Uncertain Tax Positions
  • Tax Audits – Manage and support tax audits across the region, liaising with tax authorities and advisors as needed
  • Business Advisory – Partner with the General Manager, Tax to advise business teams on tax implications and opportunities
  • Stakeholder Engagement – Build strong relationships with regional business, finance, legal, and policy leaders to proactively share tax insights and information

Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Commerce, Law, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6 years of experience in corporate tax, international tax, transfer pricing, or tax advisory.
  • Experience working in a multinational corporate environment and/or a Big 4 accounting firm.
  • Strong understanding of APAC tax compliance and reporting requirements.
  • Experience managing external tax advisers and compliance providers.
  • Knowledge of tax accounting principles and transfer pricing concepts.
  • Experience using ERP systems and tax technology solutions.

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience supporting tax audits and tax authority reviews.
  • Familiarity with tax automation, reporting tools, and data analytics platforms.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Reporting to General Manager, Tax

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Software Engineer, Content Safety
job.description:

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. Beyond keeping users safe at scale, we also play a key role in accelerating Google's product launches by providing product teams with the right tools to explore new ideas and products following our Responsible AI principles. In this role, you will keep society safer. You will work on problems like transformer architecture, and find comfort in an ever-changing landscape, anticipating threats that don't exist yet.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

82527

Location:

Verna, Goa, India

Role Purpose

Create a reliable packaging-compliance data and reporting capability by gathering, validating, reconciling and combining information from multiple internal and external sources. Convert raw packaging data into repeatable customer, distributor and authority-ready outputs, with clear assumptions, source traceability and quality controls, while adapting the data model to new jurisdictions and future requirements.

Core Responsibilities

  • Extract and reconcile packaging data from SAP/BI reports, Excel files, contract manufacturers, suppliers and other approved systems.
  • Build repeatable datasets and reporting workflows that combine product, material, supplier, market and packaging-component information.
  • Prepare Declarations of Conformity, reports with packaging weights for EPR reporting, recycled-content summaries, material-reduction progress and design-optimization analyses.
  • Track emerging packaging regulations with Regulatory and Sustainability teams, translate new obligations into data requirements, and update reporting models and templates.
  • Perform quality checks, investigate gaps and coordinate corrections across Packaging Engineering, Operations, Procurement, IT and external partners.
  • Maintain version control, reporting calendars, audit trails and supporting evidence so outputs are reproducible and defensible.
  • Develop dashboards showing completeness, deadlines, compliance risks, packaging-weight trends and reduction opportunities.
  • Standardize templates and automate recurring work where practical without compromising control.

Key Deliverables

Trusted data foundation

Governed dataset with documented sources and definitions.

On-time reporting

Accurate recurring and ad hoc market-specific reports.

Regulatory readiness

Flexible models that support new fields, countries and deadlines.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Data Analytics, Information Systems, Business, Statistics or a related field.
  • 4+ years of data analysis, BI, reporting or master-data experience in manufacturing, supply chain, product or compliance.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including Power Query, pivot tables, lookups, cleansing and structured models.
  • Experience with Power BI or a comparable tool; ability to work with SAP-derived data and large, imperfect datasets.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data transformation; experience with automation tools for consolidating data, performing quality checks, and streamlining recurring reports is an advantage.

Packaging materials or Bills of Material

job.title: Director, CSAME Segment FP&A
job.description:
About This Role

Reporting to the VP, CSAME Finance, the FP&A Director is a senior finance leader responsible for shaping financial strategy, enabling data-driven decisions, and driving sustainable performance across Climate Solutions Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa (CSAME).

The role leads long-range planning, annual operating plans, forecasting, performance management, and monthly and quarterly business reviews, while serving as a trusted partner to regional business and finance leaders.

The Director will strengthen FP&A capabilities, improve planning disciplines and insights, and build an effective, high-performing organization across a complex, multi-country matrix.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic planning: Lead the regional FP&A agenda, including long-range planning, annual operating plans, quarterly forecasts, scenario modeling, and target setting aligned with CSAME strategic priorities.
  • Performance management: Own monthly and quarterly business-review processes, delivering clear analysis of results, key drivers, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions.
  • Business partnership: Serve as a trusted finance partner to regional and business leaders, providing independent challenge, commercial insight, and decision support to drive profitable growth, cash generation, and productivity.
  • Decision support: Translate complex financial and operational data into concise, forward-looking insights and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Risk and opportunity management: Establish rigorous mechanisms to identify, quantify, track, and mitigate financial risks while accelerating actions to capture upside opportunities.
  • FP&A transformation: Partner with the broader Carrier FP&A organization to simplify and standardize processes, strengthen governance, improve forecast accuracy, and advance automation, analytics, and centralization where appropriate.
  • Financial governance: Ensure planning, reporting, and performance-management activities are timely, accurate, well controlled, and consistent with company policies and leadership expectations.
  • Organizational leadership: Build and lead a high-performing regional FP&A organization, including implementation of the FP&A Center of Excellence model, capability development, succession planning, and timely performance feedback.
  • Enterprise leadership: Model strong collaboration across businesses, functions, and geographies, and undertake other responsibilities aligned with the scope and seniority of the position.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline; MBA, CPA, CMA, or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.
  • Typically 12 or more years of progressive finance experience, including significant leadership responsibility in FP&A within a large, complex, global organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading long-range planning, annual operating plans, forecasting, management reporting, and executive business reviews.
  • Strong commercial and operational acumen, with the ability to connect financial performance to business drivers and influence resource-allocation decisions.
  • Proven experience operating across multiple countries and cultures and leading effectively in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Track record of driving FP&A transformation, process standardization, digital enablement, productivity, integration, or operational-improvement initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving capability, with the judgment to synthesize complex information into clear insights, choices, and actions.
  • Advanced financial-modeling and data-analysis skills; experience with enterprise planning, ERP, business-intelligence, and reporting platforms preferred.
  • Strong executive presence and communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to constructively challenge and influence at all levels.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, including building diverse teams, developing talent, managing performance, and fostering an inclusive, accountable culture.

Success Measures

  • Accurate, timely, and insightful plans, forecasts, and business reviews that improve management decisions and accountability.
  • Improved forecast accuracy and early visibility of risks and opportunities, supported by clear actions and ownership.
  • Achievement of regional financial commitments, including growth, profitability, cash flow, and productivity objectives.
  • Effective strategic partnership with business leaders, reflected in the quality, speed, and commercial impact of finance support.
  • Sustained simplification, standardization, and automation of FP&A processes, with strong governance and timely reporting.
  • A high-performing, engaged FP&A team with stronger capabilities, clear succession plans, and effective talent development.

job.description:
**Role : Staff Tech, Product & Technical Support

Location : Bangalore Position : FullTime

**About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role:**

The Remote Commissioning Engineer will be responsible for remote commissioning, validation, integration, and troubleshooting of Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC control systems. The role requires deep technical understanding of Niagara Framework, control logic, field devices, and building equipment, with the ability to diagnose system-level issues and optimize performance remotely

Key Technical Responsibilities :

Perform remote commissioning of BMS and HVAC control systems using Niagara N4, NexRev, and Novar platforms.

Validate controller configurations, control logic, point databases, graphics, alarms, schedules, and trends.

Commission and verify field devices such as sensors, actuators, VFDs, dampers, valves, meters, and controllers.

Monitor and analyze live system data, alarms, trends, and logs to identify functional and performance issues.

Troubleshoot control logic, network communication, and application-level issues across BMS subsystems.

Diagnose integration issues across BACnet, Modbus, LON, and IP-based protocols.

Provide technical support through calls, emails, and remote sessions for live customer issues.

Support testing of HVAC systems including AHU, RTU, Heat Pump, VAV and lighting systems.

Coordinate remotely with site teams, commissioning agents, and internal engineering teams.

Prepare detailed commissioning reports, as-built documentation, and technical advisory notes.

Track commissioning issues, punch points, and action items to closure using project trackers.

Provide post-commissioning support and assist during system handover and stabilization phases.

Support critical commissioning and troubleshooting activities outside normal business hours when required.

Minimum Requirements

Strong hands-on knowledge of Niagara Framework (N4) including station setup, backups, restores, and upgrades.

In-depth understanding of BMS architecture, controllers, and supervisory systems.

Strong expertise in HVAC control sequences and building equipment operation.

Ability to troubleshoot application, controller, and network-level issues.

Knowledge of electrical and mechanical fundamentals related to HVAC and building automation.

Experience in BMS integrations and third-party device communication.

Ability to interpret control drawings, wiring diagrams, and functional descriptions.

Strong verbal and written communication skills for technical discussions with Technicians and stakeholders.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.
