All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Transportation Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Manages a team of transportation professionals located across multiple India facilities and owns transportation operations within the assigned region or country, including associated Caterpillar manufacturing plants. Oversee transportation networks and related supply-chain processes to maximize efficiency while serving internal department or business/service unit customers and external customers.

What You Will Do

  • Optimizing shipments and communications between distribution centers, manufacturing facilities, and suppliers, including Caterpillar India manufacturing plants.
  • Organizing, operationalizing and monitoring surface, air and ocean transportation networks for global supply chain solutions.
  • Collaborating with the procurement category and managing relationships and processes with key freight partners to ensure optimal service performance, improve on-time delivery performance and drive process improvements.
  • Overseeing carrier selection and renewals and participating in contract negotiations. Seeking new carriers and transportation routes.
  • Ensuring transportation operations comply with applicable customs, trade, regulatory, safety, and corporate requirements, while maintaining appropriate controls, documentation, and corrective-action processes.
  • Accountable for day-to-day transportation operating results against agreed key performance indicators (KPIs), ensuring process effectiveness and timely corrective action.
  • Investigate complex supply-network issues, evaluating alternative solutions and recommend / develop most effective transportation response.
  • Managing transportation and related supply-network processes for Caterpillar India manufacturing plants.
  • Owning parts-expediting processes and procedures for inbound shipments and transportation planning for outbound shipments.
  • Managing a work unit primarily comprising management and professional employees, including monitoring and reviewing work, training, developing and mentoring team members.
  • Managing personnel matters and team performance evaluations.

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Degree or equivalent experience desired
  • A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience is typically required, with knowledge of transportation and supply chain management desired.
  • Background in inventory management and control, purchasing and parts distribution, together with strong analytical skills, is desired.
  • Strong interpersonal skills are required to build and maintain effective working relationships across the organization and with external process partners.
  • Frequent travel is required, up to one full week per month.

What You Have:

Continuous Transformation

Knowledge of evolving the business to remain competitive; ability to understand, adapt oneself to respond to and proactively seek changes and innovation in the business environment to improve the competitive advantage of an organization.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Implement new systems, procedures and tools efficiently when changes occur in the work environment.
  • Adjust current working processes or adopt new approaches in response to changes in the business environment.
  • Seeks challenging opportunities or assignments to grow and develop one's own knowledge, skills and abilities.
  • Explain lessons or experiences learned from mistakes and failures as well as successes.
  • Communicates and analyzes assumptions about a particular issue with colleagues to gain new perspectives or more effective solutions.

Data Gathering & Analysis

Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Participates in gathering and analyzing an organization's data based on requirements.
  • Follows proper data gathering and analysis processes and policies.
  • Utilizes basic data collection and evaluation tools and techniques.
  • Reports problems that arise in the data collection process.
  • Documents data from various sources and in various formats.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking

Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participate in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.
  • Independently evaluates complex problems, reviews multiple possible solutions, selects an appropriate option and develops solutions where needed.

Logistics Management

Knowledge of logistics and management; ability to follow proper processes and run operations for effective and efficient movement of materials and finished products.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Assists in the development of process flows to track lead time by activity.
  • Uses tools, with guidance, to forecast delivery times, determine costs and assess performance.
  • Maintains records of all shipments and invoices using an established system.
  • Participates in integrating logistics processes and developing effective networks.
  • Works with logistics in a domestic environment.

Planning and Organizing

Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Raises awareness of potential bottlenecks and disruptions to the schedule.
  • Breaks tasks into manageable steps that can be incorporated into a personal work plan.
  • Escalates concerns over competing or conflicting priorities.
  • Monitors progress continuously and adjust tactics for handling situations on a case by case basis.
  • Creates action plans that ensure the accomplishment of responsibilities.

Project Management

Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
  • Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
  • Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
  • Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
  • Produces standard project status reports.

Supply Chain Management - MFG

Knowledge of functions, principles and techniques used in supply chain management; ability to develop and use, strategies, practices and tools for controlling logistical processes.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Discusses considerations for integrating partner and supplier transactions.
  • Recognizes software systems or components used to manage supply chain.
  • Summarizes supply chain considerations for different types of products or components.
  • Participates in supply chain analysis and uses it to spot trends and improvement opportunities.
  • Works with a specific part of supply chain management process.

Transportation - MFG

Knowledge of transportation; ability to transport materials and goods to and from suppliers, distribution centers, manufacturing facilities and customers.

_Level Working Knowledge:_

  • Participates in arranging transportation of goods.
  • Ensure shipments on time; anticipate and resolve shipping problems.
  • Assists in calculating costs; uses associated billing and freight payment procedures.
  • Follows process for issuing bids and analyzing responses from carriers.
  • Works with at least one type of transportation mode and carrier.

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of India which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

What You Will Get:

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details:

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

If you are interested in joining our team, please apply using an English version of your CV. We look forward to meeting you!

It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

Job Summary

The incumbent will bring strong functional expertise across engineering and manufacturing domains with hands-on knowledge of ERP systems, PLM integration, product structures, manufacturing master data, and business process transformation. The ideal candidate should possess deep experience in Package Bill of Materials (BoM), Multi-Site BoM Management, Windchill Release-to-Production processes, Item Master setup, Routing configuration, Engineering Change Management, and Manufacturing Operations. The role requires the ability to gather business requirements, define functional solutions, support ERP implementations, and drive process improvements across engineering and manufacturing operations.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore PSN Office, KA-India.

What You Will Do

Manufacturing Engineering & ERP Process Expertise

  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of engineering and manufacturing business processes, including item setup, BoM management, routing configuration, engineering change processes, and production release workflows.
  • Analyze and document end-to-end Engineering-to-Manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for process optimization and standardization.

  • Work with technical teams to define integration requirements between PLM, ERP, and other enterprise applications.

Testing, Validation & Deployment

  • Support functional design reviews, system configuration, testing, and solution validation activities.
  • Develop and execute User Acceptance Testing (UAT) plans and test scenarios.
  • Coordinate defect management, issue resolution, and deployment readiness activities.
  • Support cutover planning, deployment execution, and post-go-live stabilization.

Change Management & User Enablement

  • Assist in organizational change management activities associated with process transformation initiatives.
  • Develop user training materials, process documentation, and standard operating procedures.
  • Conduct end-user training sessions and provide post-deployment support.
  • Drive adoption of new business processes and ERP capabilities across engineering and manufacturing teams.

Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze process and system performance metrics to identify opportunities for efficiency improvements.
  • Recommend process enhancements and technology solutions that improve operational effectiveness.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on manufacturing productivity, quality, and supply chain performance.

job.title: Senior Software Developer - D365 F&O
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Caterpillar is seeking a candidate with strong expertise in X++ development, D365 F&O technical architecture, and integration strategies. The successful candidate will confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies and D365 F&O template creations, ensuring seamless implementation, integrations and optimized performance, while mentoring engineers and guiding teams toward delivery excellence.

This role includes the design, development, and support of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) solutions. You will be involved in core development work, SSRS, Power BI & MS Fabric report building, platform upgrades, and supporting code deployments across multiple environments.

What You Will Do

Technical Delivery & Development

  • Deliver Dynamics 365 F&O implementations, upgrades, integrations, and customizations.
  • Own and drive X++ development, customizations, and extensions using best practices.
  • Perform customization and extension development using X++, Visual Studio, and the D365 Extension framework.
  • Ensure adherence to Microsoft D365 standards, extensibility framework, and upgrade‑safe customizations.
  • Review and optimize code for performance, scalability, and compliance with technical guidelines.

Integration Engineering

  • Design and implement integrations with third‑party systems using:
  • OData
  • REST / SOAP APIs

AIF / DMF

  • Azure Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory
  • Dual Write
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Collaborate with functional consultants and project teams to align integration solutions with business needs.

Data Management, Security & Performance

  • Support data migration strategies and execution using DMF / Data Management Framework, acting as the primary technical SPOC.
  • Configure and manage security roles & privileges, workflows, batch jobs, and performance tuning.
  • Review technical designs, code, and deployment strategies to ensure compliance with best practices and security standards.

Technical Assets & Automation

  • Develop reusable templates, frameworks, and accelerators to standardize solution delivery.
  • Drive automation initiatives using Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows.
  • Prepare TDD based on the FDD and requirements.
  • Prepare python code to perform testing automations.
  • Develop Technical Design Documents (TDDs) based on Functional Design Documents (FDDs) and business requirements, ensuring clarity and alignment between functional needs and technical solutions.
  • Build and maintain Python scripts to automate testing processes, improving efficiency, accuracy, and repeatability across development and deployment cycles

DevOps & Environment Management

  • Apply strong knowledge of DevOps pipelines, CI/CD, D365 templates, and environment management for F&O projects.
  • Manage build, release, and deployment activities across environments.
  • Oversee version control and branching strategies to ensure upgrade‑safe delivery.
  • Manage version control and code merges using GitHub repositories, ensuring proper branching strategies, conflict resolution, and upgrade‑safe delivery across environments.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Confidently engage in technical discussions, implementation strategies, and template creation.
  • Provide technical guidance to peers and junior developers to ensure delivery excellence.
  • Participate in workshops, demos, and discussions with finance, supply chain, IT, and dealer stakeholders.

Continuous Learning & Improvement

  • Stay current with Microsoft technologies, Azure services, and industry trends to inform technical decisions.
  • Ensure adherence to best practices in software engineering, DevOps, and solution governance.

What You Will Have

Technical Expertise

  • Deep hands‑on experience with Dynamics 365 F&O modules (Finance, Supply Chain, Project Operations).
  • Expert‑level knowledge of X++ development, SSRS reporting, and D365 F&O layered architecture.
  • Strong understanding of customization, configuration, and upgrade‑safe extensions.
  • Skilled in performance tuning, workflows, batch jobs, and security role configuration.

Tools & Frameworks

  • Proficiency in Visual Studio, D365 Extension framework, and developer workbench tools.
  • Skilled in integration strategies using OData, REST/SOAP APIs, AIF/DMF, and Azure services (Logic Apps, Service Bus, Data Factory).
  • Experience with Common Data Services (Dual Write) for integration with Dynamics 365 Sales, Field Service, and Project Operations.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server Management Studio, DMF tools, and ETL techniques for data migration.
  • Hands‑on experience with Copilot Studio, AI Builder, and AI‑driven workflows for automation.

DevOps & Environment Management

  • Expertise in Azure DevOps: Git, pipelines, CI/CD, release management, and test plans.
  • Skilled in environment management, version control (GITHUB), and branching strategies.
  • Experience managing build, release, and deployment activities across Dev/UAT/Prod environments.
  • Familiarity with Lifecycle Services (LCS) and Power Platform Admin Center (PPAC).

Considerations for Top Candidates

  • Advanced Debugging Skills – Ability to troubleshoot complex X++ code issues, identify root causes, and implement optimized fixes without impacting upgrade safety.
  • Database Proficiency – Strong knowledge of SQL Server, indexing strategies, query optimization, and handling large transactional datasets within D365 F&O.
  • Testing Automation – Experience building automated test scripts (e.g., using Python or other frameworks) to validate customizations, integrations, and performance benchmarks.
  • API Development & Management – Skilled in designing custom APIs, managing authentication/authorization flows, and ensuring secure data exchange between F&O and external systems.
  • Performance Engineering – Hands‑on expertise in profiling system performance, tuning batch jobs, and optimizing heavy workloads in production environments.
  • Upgrade & Hotfix Readiness – Ability to assess Microsoft cumulative updates, apply hotfixes, and validate compatibility of customizations during platform upgrades.
  • Cross‑Module Technical Depth – Practical exposure to Finance, Supply Chain, and Project Operations with the ability to extend functionality across multiple modules.
  • Code Review & Quality Assurance – Experience conducting peer reviews, enforcing coding standards, and ensuring compliance with Microsoft best practices.
  • Environment Troubleshooting – Skilled in diagnosing environment issues (Dev/UAT/Prod), resolving deployment failures, and managing dependencies across builds.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing – Ability to prepare clear technical design documents (TDDs), integration specifications, and reusable developer guides for team adoption.
  • Integration & Reporting Proficiency –Demonstrated expertise in leveraging Microsoft Fabric and other middleware platforms to design scalable integration pipelines, enable real‑time data exchange, and deliver advanced reporting solutions across Dynamics 365 CE Sales and Field Service.
  • Test Automation Expertise – Extensive experience with modern testing frameworks and tools for Dynamics 365 F&O applications. Preferred exposure to Leapwork, Azure App Testing, Playwright, with accepted proficiency in JMeter, Ranorex, Selenium, or equivalent platforms to validate customizations, integrations, and performance across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail & Commerce & Project Operations modules.

Experience

  • 8–10+ years of demonstrated work experience in ERP technologies with 6+ years in Dynamics 365 F&O/AX technical development.
  • Proven experience as a Technical Developer in at least 5 full‑cycle D365 F&O implementations.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and manage technical delivery.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • MB‑500: Finance & Operations Apps Developer
  • Experience with Power Pages (portals) or AI‑powered Copilot Studio

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. At Caterpillar, trade compliance is more than meeting regulatory requirements - it is about enabling the business to move with confidence in a complex global environment. As part of the Trade Center of Excellence (TCOE) within Law, Security & Public Policy, the Regional Trade Compliance Analyst will help turn trade requirements into practical solutions for Singapore and Australia.

Working alongside world class compliance, legal, and business leaders, the successful candidate will act as a trusted business partner - strengthening controls, supporting strategic decisions, and embedding compliance into day-to-day operations.

For a trade compliance professional looking to solve complex challenges and make a meaningful regional impact, this role offers the opportunity to help shape the future of trade compliance at Caterpillar.

What You Will Do

  • Risk assessment and mitigation: Support customs and trade compliance risk assessments, identify potential gaps, and help implement appropriate mitigation actions.
  • Compliance program support: Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining trade compliance policies, procedures, controls, and processes.
  • Business partnership: Work closely with business divisions, legal, and compliance teams to provide practical trade compliance guidance across the India region.
  • Training and capability building: Deliver training on applicable trade, customs, and regulatory requirements relevant to Caterpillar’s products, services, and technologies.
  • Stakeholder communication: Communicate risks, recommendations, progress, and outcomes clearly and effectively to relevant stakeholders.

What You Have

  • Trade and customs compliance: Strong understanding of international trade regulations, customs processes, import/export controls, and compliance program requirements.
  • Analytical judgment: Ability to evaluate complex issues, identify root causes, assess risk, and recommend practical solutions.
  • Problem solving: Ability to resolve operational or compliance challenges and improve processes, controls, and ways of working.
  • Stakeholder management: Ability to build trusted relationships across business, legal, compliance, and external stakeholders.
  • Communication and training: Ability to explain regulatory requirements clearly, deliver effective training, and communicate recommendations across levels and functions.

Top Candidate Will Also Have

  • Demonstrated expertise in trade compliance, customs, import/export operations, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting, developing, or managing compliance processes, controls, or procedures.
  • Strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and ability to support leadership priorities.

Additional Information

  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance. (prorated based upon hire date).

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. Location: Chh Sambhajinagar, MH

Role Definition

Participates in the design, implementation and maintenance of Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) programs and associated policies and regulations.

Responsibilities

  • Performs inspections and tests planned to monitor specific EHS issues, regulations and company practices.
  • Assists in training employees on EHS guidelines, company policies and procedures, and regulations pertaining to EHS.
  • Making and maintaining necessary EHS records according to established guidelines.
  • Contributes to the development of EHS policies and procedures.

Educational Qualification & Experience Requirements (EHS / Industrial Safety)

Diploma in Engineering (DME) or Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (B.E. / B.Tech.) in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or Automobile Engineering with a minimum of 7 years of experience in Industrial Safety / Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).

OR

Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, or Statistics with a minimum of 9 years of experience in Industrial Safety / Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).

Preferred Additional Qualifications:

ADIS / PDIS or equivalent Industrial Safety qualification from MSBTE/ CLI/RLI

Thorough knowledge of statutory EHS compliance, risk assessment, incident investigation, contractor safety, and safety management systems, Manufacturing Industry safety management

Skill Descriptors

Process Management: Knowledge of business process improvement tools and techniques; ability to understand, monitor, update, control, or enhance existing business or work processes.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Employs process flows, cycle time, process time and waste concepts as appropriate.
  • Walks through steps, decisions, measurements, dependencies and hand-offs for a specific process.
  • Creates process flow or work flow diagrams.
  • Documents types of process decisions and potential impact of each decision.
  • Identifies and monitors common process bottlenecks.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Influencing: Knowledge of effective influencing tactics and strategies; ability to impact decisions within and outside own organization.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Develops basic persuasive arguments.
  • Discusses organizational culture around providing input on decisions.
  • Uses active listening skills and probing techniques to surface opportunities to influence.
  • Identifies who the decision makers are and how they receive information.
  • Regularly presents ideas or suggestions to associates in persuasive terms.

Initiative: Being proactive and committing to action on self-identified job responsibilities and challenges; ability to seek out work and the drive to accomplish goals.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and exploits own strengths; minimizes limitations.
  • Provides appropriate degrees of attention to both personal and professional priorities.
  • Explains how own motivation relates to the workplace.
  • Utilizes available tools or approaches for increasing knowledge of self-motivation.
  • Learns and uses resources the organization has to assess and enhance team motivation.

Managing Multiple Priorities: Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Recognizes changing demands and priorities; validates changes with management.
  • Obtains information about how current assignments contribute to organizational goals.
  • Completes current work according to assigned priorities.
  • Responds to day-to-day operational priorities while still making progress on project work.
  • Performs at least 2-3 concurrent activities without reducing productivity.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Policy Compliance: Knowledge of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies; ability to implement EHS policies to ensure that provided products and services are safe for people and the environment and in compliance with legal requirements and standards.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses safety or personal protective equipment, e.g. safety boots and protective eyewear.
  • Prepares for emergency situations according to EHS policy.
  • Replaces hazardous materials with environmentally friendly ones where appropriate.
  • Conducts risk assessments to identify hazards in the business, work areas and work processes.
  • Completes incident report forms after detecting risks or hazards in the workplace.

job.title: Product Manager, Enterprise Mobile

Job Description

Role Purpose

Responsible for the end-to-end product management and lifecycle development of StarHub Enterprise Mobile products, (including Mobile Device Management) and services. The role covers product strategy, proposition development, pricing, commercial performance and service enhancement across enterprise mobile connectivity, value-added services (VAS) and related mobile solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and evolving enterprise customer needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management: Develop and manage product roadmaps, propositions and lifecycle plans for enterprise mobile products and services, from concept development through launch, enhancement and retirement.
  • Product Development & Innovation: Identify market opportunities and develop new mobile products, services and VAS to address evolving enterprise customer requirements and support business growth.
  • Commercial & Financial Management: Drive revenue, margin and portfolio performance through pricing strategy, product packaging, commercial modelling and ongoing performance reviews.
  • Enterprise Proposition Development: Develop differentiated mobile solutions covering enterprise mobile connectivity, mobile data, roaming, enterprise mobility solutions, VAS and emerging mobile service capabilities.
  • Sales & Customer Support: Work closely with Sales, Solutions and other customer-facing teams to support enterprise opportunities, tenders, customer proposals and product-related enquiries.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Coordinate with Network, IS/IT, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Procurement and other stakeholders to deliver product initiatives and resolve service or commercial issues.
  • Market & Competitor Analysis: Monitor industry developments, customer requirements and competitor offerings to identify opportunities for product enhancement and differentiation.
  • Product Performance & Governance: Track key product and financial performance ndicators, identify improvement opportunities, and ensure appropriate product documentation, governance and commercial controls.
  • Business Planning & Reporting: Prepare business cases, financial assessments, management reports and strategic proposals to support portfolio planning and decision-making.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve product processes, operational efficiency, customer experience and overall portfolio profitability.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecommunications, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, with strong commercial and business acumen
  • At least 6 years of relevant experience in product management, telecommunications, enterprise mobility, roaming or related B2B technology/product roles.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise mobile services, mobile connectivity and roaming; experience with Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM/MDM) solutions would be advantageous.
  • Demonstrated experience in product lifecycle management, including proposition development, pricing, commercialisation and portfolio management.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate customer and market requirements into viable product propositions.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a telecommunications or technology environment.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple products, priorities and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Digital Transformation Engineer
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. As DayOne's footprint grows across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, the client relationships behind that infrastructure need the same level of accountability as the build itself — this role owns that.

Across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Hong Kong, DayOne operates some of the region's most active hyperscale campuses — from Johor's largest LEED-certified data center footprint to Thailand's build toward its first 1GW platform. This role can be based in any of these markets, working alongside local delivery teams on live client accounts.

About the Role

You'll combine hands-on software development, enterprise integration and technical support across our Digital Transformation platforms. Your initial focus will be supporting the CSP platform and implementing a customer relationship management (CRM) solution for CS. You'll progressively bring together customer, service and operational information to build Customer 360 capabilities.

Beyond the initial CS implementation, you'll help extend the CRM platform to other business functions and connect it with the wider enterprise ecosystem. The roadmap includes internal digital solutions, process automation and, over time, approved artificial intelligence (AI) and analytics capabilities.

Responsibilities

Support and Improve CSP

  • Investigate, troubleshoot and resolve CSP Level 2 (L2) incidents, perform initial technical and root cause analysis, and monitor recurring issues.
  • Identify improvements and automation opportunities to address recurring CSP issues.
  • Escalate issues requiring code changes or deeper intervention to Level 3 (L3), where the Information Technology (IT)/Software Engineering team can resolve them.

Implement CRM and Build Customer 360

  • Develop, configure, integrate, test and enhance the CRM solution to meet CS business and operational needs.
  • Lead technical workshops, system integration testing (SIT) and user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate the CRM solution against CS requirements.
  • Consolidate relevant customer, service and operational information to progressively build Customer 360 capabilities.
  • Establish a scalable CRM platform that can support wider enterprise requirements beyond CS.

Connect Business Functions and Digital Platforms

  • Extend CRM capabilities after the initial CS implementation to support business requirements in functions such as Billing and Procurement.
  • Develop workflows and integrations across CRM, CSP, Security, Operations and enterprise systems to improve cross-functional information flow.
  • Integrate utilization, consumption, customer and service information, memos, notifications and other relevant operational data to improve information flow and reduce fragmented processes.
  • Represent Digital Transformation in cross-department projects to address integration needs involving these platforms.
  • Support longer-term integration with the SAP S/4HANA enterprise platform to enable relevant enterprise processes and data exchange.

Develop Internal Solutions and Automation

  • Build internal applications, workflows and digital solutions for CS, digitalizing and automating manual processes where applicable.

job.title: Customer Success Manager, Data Center Delivery
job.description:
About DayOne Data Centers

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. Behind every app, every AI tool, every connected experience, there is a data center. DayOne builds them. In Hong Kong, we build them where it is hardest and most valuable to do so. DayOne operates a 66MW carrier-neutral cluster in Kwai Chung, ISO 9001, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 certified, serving hyperscalers and enterprises across APAC from one of the world's most land-constrained and connectivity-rich markets. Backed by US$4.5B+ in Series C funding, live and growing since 2023.

About the Role

You'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers across project delivery and ongoing service operations, owning outcomes from initial construction through to live SLA performance. This is a senior, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of project management, technical delivery, and client relationship management. You'll lead virtual delivery teams, manage the full lifecycle of data center construction and customization projects, and be accountable for service quality once the facility is live.

Client Relationship and Delivery Ownership

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers across all aspects of project delivery and ongoing service operations.
  • Build trust-based client relationships and act as a strategic advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Manage service delivery in line with SLAs and agreed delivery costs, leading a virtual delivery team to drive customer satisfaction.

Project Delivery

  • Lead data center construction and customization projects end to end, working closely with Sales, Presales, Design, Construction, and Testing and Commissioning teams.
  • Manage project schedules, quality, costs, risks, and escalations through to timely closure and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate internal resources for both project implementation and service operations in line with company standards and customer requirements.

Service Operations and Continuous Improvement

  • Manage SLA performance and customer satisfaction during the ongoing operations phase, working with data center operations, network, and IT service teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement and proactive risk mitigation across live service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with internal processes including procurement, audit requirements, and ITIL standards.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 7 or more years of experience in the data center industry, MEP consultancy, or construction, with direct exposure to project delivery and client management.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure, ITIL frameworks, and SLA management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects across the full delivery lifecycle, from construction through to live operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English, required for client and stakeholder engagement across DayOne's Mandarin-speaking customer base.

Soft Skills

  • Manages client relationships with the credibility of a trusted advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Mediates competing priorities and stakeholder conflicts without losing sight of the customer outcome.
  • Communicates clearly in writing, producing reports and updates that keep clients and internal teams aligned without follow-up questions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing hyperscale or mission-critical data center accounts across multiple markets simultaneously.
  • Exposure to cross-border or multi-entity service delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with data center construction customization and handover processes.

Why DayOne? DayOne in Hong Kong means working at the intersection of global infrastructure and APAC's most connected market. Our Kwai Chung cluster serves the region's most demanding clients, which means the work is precise, the results are visible, and the standard you build here travels. You will have structured development, 40+ training hours per year, and access to a global network across seven markets.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Data Center Shift Lead- Woodlands
job.description:
Job Summary

The successful candidate will deliver high calibre maintenance services within critical environments. Responding speedily to fault/breakdown requests, efficiently undertaking routine daily checks and scheduled maintenance of plant or equipment are of paramount importance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Adhere and support the facilities management strategy for the agreed client contract.
  • Oversee the facilities management service, which encompasses ad hoc maintenance, fire, mechanical, electrical support and, following environmental safety guidelines to ensure business continuity is maintained.
  • Manage site operations to ensure continuity of property services with minimum disruption to the client’s business operations.
  • Manages the on-site activities of shift/day technicians, and where required vendors and contractors.
  • Supervise and manage and mentor the technicians on site to ensure exceptional performance is being achieved. Shift Lead is responsible for supporting the Senior Engineer in setting and attaining performance goals, as well as responsible for the development, coaching, and counselling of the rest of the site technicians.
  • Perform hours of operations to provide site coverage as necessary, including working shift rosters to achieve full staff coverage of sites.
  • Raise work permits (including Tag out, Confined spaces, High Voltage, Fire Isolation, and Hot Works requirements), sign off work permits and collaborate with various groups to optimize the work schedule.
  • Where required conduct and document client meetings with appropriate work stream leaders, contractors
  • Conduct required property and operational inspections and review property operations to ensure cost effectiveness and business continuity is maximized.
  • Report and recommend technical and operational initiatives.
  • Perform risk assessments where required to support site risk reduction strategies
  • Articulate and live the CBRE culture, set an example by modelling the required behaviors and hold others (employees and peers) accountable for their actions by identifying and acting on behavior which is inconsistent with agreed standards.
  • Comply with all CBRE systems used to meet its health and safety obligations.
  • Work safely and not put themselves or anyone else’s health or safety at risk by their acts or omissions.
  • Comply with CBRE Environmental policies and adhere to procedures and work instructions that are relevant to their activities.
  • Operate in a manner that will minimize any adverse environmental impacts associated with their activities.
  • Ability to research, learn, and perform operational duties (switching, isolating, fault rectification, incident recovery, etc) to ensure equipment viability with minimum supervision.
  • Create and nurture on-site Client and stakeholder relations.
  • Some routine maintenance and monitoring tasks, Examples of items (Various Meter and UPS readings, Chiller Plant Monitoring, Replacement of Lights, New Tap Off Boxes, Basic Facility Repairs and Maintenance etc.)
  • Update site log of all incidents and happenings during shift and update next shift Technician and Senior Engineer(s).
  • Maintain awareness of current operating procedures, general site instructions and site safety guidelines and implement and monitor where required.
  • Perform system isolations and switching of supplies, change duties cycles or shut down equipment for maintenance.
  • Operate emergency plants such as generators, redundant chillers, cooling towers and take logs operating whilst in test or emergency operation.
  • Supporting the maintenance of electrical & mechanical infrastructure per manufacturers’ recommendation and client/contract statements of Work (SOW’s)
  • Develop, review, implement and audit local Method of Procedures (MOP’s), Standard Operating Procedures (SOP’s), and Emergency Operating Procedures (EOP’s).
  • Develop a comprehensive understanding of the building(s) infrastructure and their layouts, functions and complexities
  • Endorse day to day and future compliance to safe working practices, quality standards conformity and best practice methods
  • Volunteer ideas / initiatives that contribute to the service levels and delivery
  • Undertake other tasks, as required by the site management team, in accordance with experience and competencies
  • Provide escorting/vendor management when/where required including supporting internal day technicians with planned and reactive maintenance works.
  • Support the shift lead(s) during their absence.
  • 12 hour rotating shift 4 on 4 off (2 days, 2 nights), though subject to change.

Required Knowledge and Skills:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Essential

  • Unrestricted Electrical or Air conditioning and Refrigeration License (Trade qualifications in electrical, mechanical, with strong preference for A Grade Electricians)
  • Good building services knowledge
  • Experience in critical environments
  • Good Customer relationship skills
  • Working knowledge of “Permit to work” systems
  • Understand and interpret technical drawings / processes
  • Experience of CMMS and BMS systems
  • Computer skills in Microsoft Office and a relevant Computerized Maintenance Management System
  • Strong technical background electrical, mechanical background or engineering related discipline.
  • Client relationship experience.
  • Knowledge in one of the major core areas, facility management or corporate real estate.

Desired

  • HV Operator/switching qualification and experience
  • 3 -5 years’ experience in a Data Centre environment
  • Experience of Microsoft Office, and mobile workorder applications

About CBRE Group, Inc.CBRE Group, Inc. (NYSE: CBRE), a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 company headquartered in Dallas, is the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm and a premier provider of critical infrastructure services. The company has more than 155,000 employees serving clients in more than 100 countries. CBRE serves clients through four business segments: Advisory (leasing, sales, debt origination, mortgage servicing, valuations); Building Operations & Experience (facilities management, property management, flex space & experience, critical infrastructure); Project Management (program management, project management, cost consulting); Real Estate Investments (investment management, development). Please visit our website at [www.cbre.com](http://www.cbre.com/).

Dashboard & Report Development

Role Purpose

The Assistant Manager, Corporate & Workplace Services is responsible for ensuring the efficient management of workplace operations, office facilities, procurement activities, corporate governance support, ISO management system coordination, and sustainability reporting. The role serves as a key coordinator between internal stakeholders, service providers, and regulatory bodies to ensure workplace effectiveness, operational excellence, compliance, and continuous improvement.

The incumbent will oversee office administration, facilities management, procurement activities, workplace experience initiatives, ISO certification maintenance, and Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) reporting requirements while ensuring adherence to corporate policies, audit requirements, and governance standards.

Key Accountabilities

1. Office Administration & Procurement

  • Manage the procurement of office supplies, furniture, equipment, and workplace services in accordance with company procurement policies.
  • Source, evaluate, and manage vendors and service providers to ensure quality, cost-effectiveness, and timely delivery.
  • Monitor office operating expenses and support annual budgeting and cost management initiatives.
  • Maintain inventory records and asset registers for workplace-related equipment and supplies.
  • Support contract administration, vendor performance reviews, and service renewals.

2. Workplace & Facilities Management

  • Oversee the day-to-day management of office facilities to ensure a safe, functional, and productive work environment.
  • Coordinate maintenance, repairs, renovations, office moves, and workplace improvement projects.
  • Manage facilities service providers including cleaning, security, pest control, office maintenance, and building management teams.
  • Ensure workplace compliance with safety, health, environmental, and building regulations.
  • Support business continuity initiatives and workplace emergency preparedness programs.
  • Drive workplace efficiency and employee experience enhancement initiatives.

3. ISO Management Systems & Compliance

  • Coordinate and maintain ISO management systems including documentation, records management, and compliance requirements.
  • Support internal and external ISO audits, surveillance audits, and certification renewals.
  • Monitor corrective and preventive actions arising from audit findings and ensure timely closure.
  • Facilitate management review meetings and maintain audit readiness across departments.
  • Work closely with process owners to ensure continuous compliance with ISO standards and corporate governance requirements.
  • Support policy development, process reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

4. Sustainability & ESG Reporting

  • Coordinate data collection and validation for sustainability reporting requirements.
  • Consolidate environmental, workplace, operational, and governance performance data from relevant stakeholders.
  • Support the preparation of sustainability reports, ESG disclosures, and regulatory submissions.

5. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Build effective partnerships with internal stakeholders to support workplace and operational requirements.
  • Manage vendor performance against contractual obligations and service level agreements (SLAs).

Qualifications

  • Degree in Business Administration, Facilities Management, Building Management, Engineering, Sustainability, Environmental Management, or related disciplines.

Experience

  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in office administration, facilities management, corporate services, workplace management, sustainability reporting, or ISO management systems.

We’re growing, not slowing, here at Macquarie Technology Group because we’re passionate about doing things differently. We want to challenge the industry and look for better ways of doing things. What you'll do

  • Own and grow a strategic Tier 1 Government account, building relationships across executive, technology, commercial and procurement stakeholders.
  • Develop and execute multi-year account and transformation strategies aligned to customer priorities.
  • Identify, shape and lead complex, high-value transformation opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and senior government executives.
  • Lead major sales engagements, tenders, proposals, business cases and commercial negotiations.
  • Mobilise internal technical, commercial and delivery teams around customer outcomes.
  • Build strategic pipeline, identify growth opportunities and drive long-term account value.
  • Navigate complex government procurement, governance and stakeholder environments.

What you'll bring

  • Proven experience selling into Tier 1 Federal Government or large enterprise environments.
  • A strong track record in complex strategic transformation and multi-year technology programs.
  • Executive-level relationship and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and senior government leaders.
  • Strong commercial acumen and a track record of delivering against ambitious sales targets.
  • Experience across cloud, cyber security, networking, telecommunications, data centre or managed services.
  • Deep understanding of government procurement, tenders and complex commercial negotiations.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to connect business strategy, technology transformation and commercial outcomes.
  • An Australian Government security clearance, or previous experience holding one.

This is an opportunity to shape major technology transformation within one of Australia's most significant government organisations — working at executive level, influencing strategy and building a partnership that extends well beyond a traditional technology sale.

If you're energised by complex environments, strategic transformation and high-impact customer relationships this role is for you.

If this excites you, apply now, we'd love to hear from you!

job.title: Regional Due Diligence Director, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.
  • Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.
  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.
  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.
  • Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development and commercial recommendations and risk mitigation strategies to support acquisitions.
  • Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design, Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.
  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.
  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.
  • Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.
  • Champion continuous improvement by incorporating lessons learned, market intelligence, industry trends, and best practices to enhance development processes, strengthen governance, and support Vantage's long-term growth strategy across APAC.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

  • Proven experience managing complex development, infrastructure, construction, or real estate projects, ideally in a client-side environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and competing priorities, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience across APAC markets, particularly Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, and Australia, is highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of site acquisition, due diligence, planning, permitting, and utility infrastructure (power and fibre).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior leaders and external partners.
  • Degree in Engineering, Construction, Real Estate, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • Flexibility to travel regularly across APAC.
  • Adaptable, self-motivated, and comfortable working across multiple time zones, cultures, and remote environments.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Facility & Maintenance
job.description:
About Business:

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organisation in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Solar: Adani Solar is India's 1st and largest vertically integrated solar PV manufacturer with 4 GW cells & modules and 2 GW of ingots & wafers manufacturing capacities

Job Purpose: The Lead - Gas & Chemical, PEX is responsible for overseeing the safe and efficient management of bulk gases and specialty chemicals. This includes ensuring compliance with safety regulations, optimizing system performance, and leading a team to maintain operational standards. The role involves coordinating with internal and external stakeholders to manage handling, storage, and distribution processes effectively.

Responsibilities

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Conduct audits and risk assessments to identify hazards, implement corrective actions, and mitigate risks.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Organizational & Culture Building:

  • Fostering a collaborative, agile culture that aligns with company values, driving employee engagement, and ensuring organizational growth and development.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

Bulk Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the management of bulk gas systems, including their handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure adherence to safety protocols, and conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and maintain operational efficiency.

Specialty Chemicals Handling:

  • Supervise the storage, handling, and application of specialty chemicals. Ensure compliance with relevant regulations and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

Gas System Management:

  • Direct the operation and maintenance of gas systems to ensure safe and efficient handling. Perform regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and ensure safety compliance.

Chemical Process Oversight:

  • Oversee chemical processes, including their handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Process Innovation:

  • Lead the development of efficient, eco-friendly chemical and gas processes to boost yield and sustainability.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and reduce costs.

Training and Development:

  • Develop and deliver training programs on safe gas and chemical handling and emergency procedures. Conduct drills and ensure that personnel are well-versed in safety protocols.

 

Team Development:

  • Foster a respectful and safe work environment. Lead effective teams, mentor team members, and promote professional growth and success.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Engineer - Gas & Chemical
  • Package Incharge - O&M (CAS & PCW)
  • Area Incharge - Chemical
  • Lead - C&I
  • Lead - Mechanical

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Regulatory Agencies (e.g., OSHA, EPA)
  • Gas Suppliers
  • Chemical Vendors
  • Regulatory Agencies
  • External Maintenance Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering is essential. Master's degree in Engineering Management or a related field would be advantageous. Strong academic foundation in mechanical engineering principles, maintenance management, and operations is crucial.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Minimum of 12-15 years of experience in operations and maintenance within a large-scale manufacturing environment. Proven track record in managing maintenance teams, implementing maintenance strategies, and driving operational efficiency. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop maintenance teams.

job.title: Shift Engineer EMD
job.description:
Lead Electrical BoP/CHP

Maintenance Strategy Execution:

Execute proper electrical maintenance activities for BoP, CHP, including RO Plant, Sea Intake, FGD, Hydrogen plant, DM plant, Conveyor belts, Crusher house, Stacker Reclaimers, etc. and associated areas to ensure continuous operational reliability.

Prepare and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Job Safety Analyses (JSAs), and Standard Maintenance Plans (SMPs) for BoP/CHP and associated areas to reflect current best practices and operational requirements.

Support the implementation of improvement projects for BoP, CHP, and associated areas.

Execute comprehensive maintenance strategies, including preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance, to minimize downtime and extend equipment life.

Conduct annual overhauling and manage maintenance during outages, focusing on safe, timely, and efficient project completion and adherence to established protocols and standards.

Perform execution of AOH and COH within budgets and allotted manpower.

Troubleshoot equipment failures and conduct equipment failure analysis to prevent recurrence and improve system reliability.

Maintenance and System Enhancement Operations:

Execute proactive maintenance and testing to ensure equipment operates within permissible limits and suggest corrective actions, as needed.

Monitor business associates performance, bill certifications, and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

Perform timely completion of Preventive Maintenance (PM), Corrective Maintenance (CM), and condition monitoring activities.

Identify and act on opportunities for process and system enhancements to meet evolving operational needs and directives from leadership.

Engage in repairing and refurbishment activities for associated area equipment, ensuring that all maintenance work is carried out to the highest standards.

Perform the effective use of SAP for tracking maintenance activities, managing spare parts inventory, and ensuring the timely closure of notifications.

Inventory and Resource Management:

Monitor the condition and availability of all BoP/CHP equipment, ensuring that Service Transformers, HT and LT Switchgear, HT and LT motors, DC Systems, DG Sets, Lifts in Chimney and Chimney lightings, Stacker Reclaimer Electrical Auxiliaries, Wagon Tripler are functioning optimally.

Assist in the spares inventory management and development of vital indigenous spares for BoP/CHP equipment.

Perform timely testing of electrical equipment for BoP, CHP and associated areas.

Create PRs for materials and services and prepare SES (Service Entry Sheets) for completed services.

Business Sustainability:

Implement and follow IMS, AWMS, DISHA, ABEM and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Maintain compliance with legal and statutory requirements, including electrical license renewal and certifications for elevators.

Mitigate hazardous processes, participate in mock drills, and ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Digitalisation and Automation:

Execute comprehensive Digitalisation strategies to optimize operational efficiency.

Implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas.

Monitor data from digital systems to identify trends and opportunities for improvement.

All depts

Head Office

ENDORSE

Service depts.

Techno Commercial

Key Stakeholders - External:

Vendors

Contractors - Material and services

Educational Qualification:

BE/B.tech in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

11+ years of experience in electrical maintenance within power plants or heavy industries.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power generation industry, specifically with BoP/CHP operations.

job.title: Head -Techno Commercial
job.description:
Techno-Commercial Planning & Implementation:

  • Translate BU-wide Techno-Commercial strategies into actionable plans for airport sites and clusters.
  • Ensure alignment of site-level processes with BU governance, aviation regulations, and operational needs.

Category Planning & Strategic Sourcing Execution:

  • Develop category strategies for airport procurement (terminal systems, airside equipment, ICT, utilities, services).
  • Lead sourcing cycles including vendor evaluation, commercial bid analysis, and recommendation notes as per DoA.

Contract Development & Lifecycle Management:

  • Draft and refine contracts, rate agreements, and service-level frameworks for site-specific CapEx/OpEx procurements.
  • Ensure contractual adherence, renewals, variations, and compliance monitoring for assigned categories.

Vendor Engagement & Performance Management:

  • Drive approved vendor engagement models and manage performance evaluation for site and cluster-level vendors.
  • Identify and evaluate new vendors/contractors relevant to airport asset requirements.
  • Conduct capability assessments, technical/commercial qualification checks, and recommend onboarding to BU Head.
  • Ensure supplier performance frameworks incorporate ESG parameters such as safety compliance, environmental responsibility, ethical labor practices, and sustainability metrics.
  • Implement BU-defined standard vendor lists across PTB, Cargo, Fuel Farm, Runways, Ancillary Buildings, and Airport Systems.
  • Ensure uniform application of qualification standards, documentation, and performance criteria at all assigned airport assets.

Logistics & Inventory Oversight:

  • Coordinate logistics planning for inbound airport equipment, ensuring customs clearance, documentation, and timely delivery.
  • Oversee inventory accuracy, stock reconciliation, asset tagging, and disposal recommendations.
  • Implement ESG-aligned logistics practices including route optimization, reduction of emissions, green handling processes, and waste-minimized packaging.

Data Analytics, Reporting & Value Improvement:

  • Analyze procurement, logistics, and consumption data to identify cost-saving opportunities, efficiency improvements, and risk flags.
  • Prepare dashboards, category insights, and performance reports for BU leadership.

Team Leadership & Capability Enablement:

  • Lead techno-commercial teams across airport sites, ensuring goal-setting, performance reviews, and skill development.
  • Promote collaborative, safe, and compliant working practices within the techno-commercial function..
