job.title: Senior Robotics SALES & Application Consultant
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager

Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

The Robotics Sales & Application Consultant is responsible for creating and developing business opportunities for ABB Robotics in Vietnam. The role combines consultative B2B sales with a practical understanding of manufacturing processes. The successful candidate will work directly with factories, machine builders, system integrators and technology partners to identify automation needs, shape technically and commercially viable solutions, and guide opportunities from initial discussion through order closure and subsequent customer development.

This is not a quotation-only sales role. Candidates are expected to understand how customers manufacture products, ask the right operational and technical questions, connect production challenges with suitable robotic applications, and clearly communicate the business value of automation. The work model for the role is: hybrid working

You will be mainly accountable for:

1. Market and Customer Development

  • Build and execute a territory and industry development plan for the assigned market, with clear target accounts, applications, partners and sales actions.
  • Proactively identify new factories, expansion projects, modernization programs and production challenges that may create demand for robotics and automation.
  • Approach and develop relationships with business owners, plant directors, factory managers, production, engineering, maintenance, procurement and finance stakeholders.
  • Create new leads and qualify whether the customer has a genuine automation need, an addressable application, an investment path and a realistic project timeline.
  • Develop existing accounts by identifying additional production lines, plants, applications and lifecycle opportunities.

2. Customer Discovery and Factory Assessment

  • Visit customer sites and study the current manufacturing process, product flow, cycle time, production volume, quality requirements, labor content, ergonomics, safety risks and space constraints.
  • Ask structured questions to clarify the customer problem, expected output, technical requirements, decision criteria, budget process and project stakeholders.
  • Identify repetitive, hazardous, quality-sensitive or capacity-constrained tasks that could benefit from robotic automation.
  • Document the existing process and define the desired future state together with the customer.
  • Determine what information, samples, drawings, layouts, process data or trials are required before a solution can be proposed.

3. Application and Solution Consulting

  • Translate production needs into an automation concept and application requirement that can be evaluated by ABB Application Engineering and qualified partners.
  • Help select the appropriate robot family, payload, reach, mounting arrangement, controller, software and major peripheral requirements at the sales concept level.
  • Advise customers on relevant applications including arc welding, spot welding, machine tending, material handling, palletizing, assembly, dispensing, grinding, polishing, deburring, painting, inspection and packaging.
  • Coordinate technical feasibility reviews, simulations, cycle-time checks, demonstrations, sample testing or proof-of-concept activities when required.
  • Explain solution assumptions, limitations, interfaces, responsibilities and required customer inputs in clear business language.
  • Position the complete value of the proposed solution, including productivity, quality consistency, safety, flexibility, scalability, uptime and total cost of ownership.

4. Sales Opportunity Management

  • Own the opportunity from lead qualification through solution development, proposal, negotiation, order closure and commercial handover.
  • Maintain a healthy pipeline and convert customer activities into clearly defined next steps, owners and target dates.
  • Prepare opportunity strategies, stakeholder maps, competition assessments and win plans for important projects.
  • Update customer, activity, opportunity, forecast and follow-up information accurately and on time in Salesforce in accordance with ABB processes.
  • Conduct regular pipeline reviews, identify order shortfall risks and implement recovery actions.
  • Provide timely and realistic forecasts based on customer evidence, project maturity and decision progress.

5. Proposal, Pricing and Commercial Negotiation

  • Prepare or coordinate technical-commercial proposals with Application Engineering, Product Marketing, Service, Operations, Finance, Legal, Project Management and external partners.
  • Ensure each offer clearly defines scope, technical assumptions, exclusions, delivery responsibility, schedule, pricing, margin, payment terms, validity and commercial conditions.
  • Communicate delivery times, payment requirements and general terms and conditions accurately and consistently.
  • Negotiate based on customer value while protecting profitability, contractual position and execution feasibility.
  • Identify commercial, technical and contractual risks early and escalate them through the appropriate ABB review process.
  • Support order clarification, internal handover, delivery follow-up, payment collection and issue resolution when required.

6. Partner and System Integrator Development

  • Identify and develop System Integrators, Machine Builders, OEMs and specialist technology partners that can support the priority industries and applications.
  • Conduct joint customer visits and align the partner, ABB Robotics and customer on application scope, responsibilities, solution architecture and commercial approach.
  • Support partners with product positioning, application discussions, opportunity planning, workshops, demonstrations and proposal development.
  • Build an effective solution ecosystem covering welding, vision, grippers, end-of-arm tooling, force control, safety, PLC/control and other required peripherals.
  • Monitor partner capability, responsiveness and opportunity progress, and involve the appropriate ABB resources where additional support is needed.

7. Market Intelligence and Demand Generation

  • Monitor manufacturing investments, factory expansion, customer technology priorities, competitor activity and changes in market demand.
  • Share customer feedback, win/loss insights and application trends to support ABB Robotics go-to-market planning and portfolio positioning.
  • Work with Marketing to define target audiences, campaign topics and follow-up actions for the priority industries.
  • Participate in exhibitions, seminars, Tech Days, customer workshops and other demand-generation activities, and convert relevant leads into qualified opportunities.
  • Contribute practical application knowledge to customer presentations, case stories and industry-focused content.

8. Customer Experience, Compliance and Safety

  • Provide a professional and consistent customer experience throughout the sales process and remain accountable for coordination until a clear handover is completed.
  • Act with integrity and comply with the ABB Code of Conduct, HSE requirements, information security rules, applicable laws and internal policies.
  • Recognize safety considerations during factory visits and application discussions, and engage qualified safety or engineering specialists for detailed risk assessment.
  • Protect confidential customer and ABB information and avoid commitments outside the approved technical, commercial or contractual authority.

Our team dynamics (Optional) You will join a dynamic, talented, high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role (Mandatory)

Education and Industrial Background

  • ·Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Practical exposure to industrial machinery or manufacturing processes such as CNC machines, plastic injection molding, metalworking machinery, welding equipment, packaging machines, assembly lines or factory automation is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to understand technical drawings, layouts, specifications and process descriptions sufficiently to coordinate with customers and engineering teams.

##

##

Experience

  • At least 3 years of experience in B2B technical sales, solution consulting, business development or application sales within industrial machinery, equipment, automation or manufacturing technology.
  • Experience serving customers in Metal Fabrication, Automotive & Auto Parts, Electronics, Plastics & Packaging or General Manufacturing is preferred.
  • Experience working with factories, engineering teams, production teams, maintenance departments, procurement, System Integrators, Machine Builders or OEMs is an advantage.
  • Previous robotics experience is beneficial but is not mandatory for candidates who demonstrate strong industrial knowledge, consultative selling ability and learning agility.

Skills and Behaviors

  • Fluency in English is required; proficiency in additional languages, such as Chinese or Japanese, is an advantage.
  • Consultative and value-based selling, including discovery, qualification, value articulation and business-case development.
  • Prospecting, account development, pipeline management, forecasting, proposal management, negotiation and closing.
  • Structured problem solving and the ability to convert complex production issues into clear actions.
  • Confident communication and presentation skills with both technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and external partners without losing ownership of the customer outcome.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office; Salesforce or comparable CRM experience is an advantage.
  • Professional English for technical documents, email, presentations and regional or global meetings.
  • Willingness to travel within Vietnam and internationally as required.
  • High standards of integrity, ownership, customer focus, teamwork and continuous learning.

job.title: APC Engineer for Digital Solutions
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Digital Solution Engineering Spec ###** Your role and responsibilities:**

This is a Project Engineer- Advanced Process Control role, reporting to the Engineering Manager in business area Process Automation located in Bangalore. You will be responsible for delivering APC projects for Cement customers across the globe. You will be part of Process Industries operations/development team within INOPC-PA. As a project Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and delivering APC scope for process industry Cement. Your responsibility will be to ensure the project deliverables are met in terms of application quality performance & budget, while working with a team of automation project engineers.

The work model for the role is: #LI_Hybrid

This role is contributing to the Process Automation business for Process Industries division based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for

  • Work on APC/APCA projects end-to-end for Cement. Carry out independently activities of basic and detailed engineering of APC solutions.
  • Carry out Engineering and commissioning of APC Product for Cement plant
  • Study of process operation and process control requirements and definition of suitable simple, complex and advanced regulatory control strategies to be implemented at DCS.
  • Ensure the engineering workflow is adhered and project is executed as per the Quality Management System.
  • Prepare periodic reports (like weekly commissioning report, time sheet, SAT) and update the relevant stakeholders.
  • Ensure Time Sheets are maintained periodically.
  • Ensure customer queries are resolved on time & maintain customer relationship through professional approach.
  • Efficient in Process Analysis and estimating the areas where optimization is required to enhance productivity.
  • Responsible for providing remote assistance to installed base. Ensures the activities at site are in line with company health, safety, and environmental policies.
  • Take required support from L2/ L3 support line and resolve issues on time. Provide required inputs for L2/L3 support line for issues raised.

Qualifications for the role

  • B. Tech/ B.E from a reputed University with First Class in Chemical engineering
  • 10+ years of relevant work experience in APC implementation
  • Experience in Advance Process Control Technology and Automation principles .
  • Domain expertise in Cement
  • Basics of Control System & OPC Communication with PLC/DCS
  • Availability to travel for either short or long term assignment (50 % to 60 % travel )

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

Transfer Pricing Manager ###

Job Summary

As a member of transfer pricing (TP) subject matter experts’ team, you will support and manage transfer pricing compliance, documentation, for ABB entities across multiple jurisdictions. The role requires close collaboration with global and local tax teams, business stakeholders, finance functions, and external advisors to ensure efficient and compliant transfer pricing operations while driving continuous process improvements.

Main accountabilities

**

  • Prepare and maintain transfer pricing compliance deliverables, including Local Files, Master Files, TP forms, and supporting analyses for ABB entities.
  • Support global transfer pricing initiatives, including benchmarking studies, policy implementation, documentation standardization, and business-specific projects.
  • Assist in transfer pricing audits, controversy matters, and tax authority inquiries in collaboration with global and local tax teams.
  • Partner with business, finance, accounting, tax stakeholders, and external advisors to ensure timely and accurate TP compliance.
  • Maintain robust documentation, audit trails, SOPs, and governance frameworks to support compliance and audit readiness.
  • Drive process improvements through standardization, automation, digitalization, and data quality enhancements.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, stakeholder training, and awareness of OECD guidelines and evolving transfer pricing regulations while serving as a trusted TP business partner.

Qualification for the role

  • Master’s/bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, economics or related field required
  • Good understanding of OECD Transfer Pricing guidelines
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Hands-on experience on global databases (e.g., Orbis) for benchmarking studies
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a global environment
  • 3 to 5 years of experience in transfer pricing within a multinational corporation, Big Four accounting firm, or tax advisory environment.
  • Experience supporting global transfer pricing compliance, documentation, benchmarking studies, and tax audits

job.title: Senior Engineer - 800xA
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Senior Engineering Manager ###

This role will be working as Senior Project Engineer and will be part of Automation Business Area for Energy Industries division based in Bangalore, India. In this role you will be reporting to Engineering Manager and will be responsible for designing and executing DCS engineering activities in Service or Greenfield projects with medium to large complexity, according to standard work instructions, quality standards and safety guidelines. Delivering quality customer service to satisfy customers.

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries for INOPC based in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Execute assigned automation and control system projects, including control logic development, HMI configuration, testing (IFAT/FAT), commissioning, and site acceptance activities.
  • Prepare and review engineering deliverables such as design specifications, technical documentation, test procedures, and bill of materials while ensuring compliance with engineering standards.
  • Provide technical leadership to project teams, resolve technical queries, conduct design reviews, and ensure high-quality project deliverables.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders to monitor project progress, manage risks, address technical challenges, and meet contractual commitments.
  • Support customer-facing activities by participating in commissioning, troubleshooting, technical discussions, and maintaining strong customer relationships.
  • Contribute to proposal development, continuous improvement initiatives, design reviews, and implementation of best engineering practices to enhance project execution efficiency.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

Qualifications for the role:

  • 8-10 years of experience in Process Automation within Oil & Gas, Refineries, Petrochemicals, Chemicals, or Batch industries, with hands-on ICSS experience (PCS, SIS/ESD, PMS).
  • Strong knowledge of control system architecture, DCS application engineering, graphics engineering, and industry standards such as IEC 61508, IEC 61511, IEC 61131-3, IEC 61850, IEC 104, and IEC 101.
  • Experience with field instrumentation, industrial communication protocols (Profibus, Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850, IEC 104, etc.), and networked control systems.
  • Ability to interpret and work with engineering documents including P&IDs, Control Narratives, SAMA diagrams, I/O Lists, Functional Design Specifications (FDS), Cause & Effect matrices, and Interlock/Protection documents.
  • Commissioning experience in process industries and willingness to travel internationally (up to 40-50%) as required by project needs. Exposure to ABB 800xA and ABB DCS hardware/software engineering is an added advantage.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation, Electronics & Communication, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline.

More about us

ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.

job.title: Territory Sales Manager - ACVS Security Products
job.description:
Who we are?

About Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward.

Visit [johnsoncontrols.com](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/) for more information and follow @Johnsoncontrols on social platforms.**

Work Location : Mumbai, India** What will you do?**

Responsible for driving revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion for the ACVS (Access Control, Video Surveillance & Security) product portfolio across the assigned territory. The role focuses on developing strategic customer relationships, strengthening channel partnerships, expanding market presence, and positioning the company's security products and solutions across key verticals including Commercial Buildings, Data Centers, Manufacturing, BFSI, Transportation, Healthcare, Education, Retail, Power, and Critical Infrastructure.

You will lead business development initiatives, manage key accounts, work closely with consultants and system integrators, and ensure consistent achievement of sales targets while enhancing brand visibility and competitive positioning within the security industry.

**

**

What will you do?

You will execute the territory growth strategy through effective customer engagement, partner development, and disciplined sales execution, including:

  • Achieve assigned revenue, booking, and margin targets for ACVS product lines including Video Surveillance, Access Control, and Integrated Security Solutions.
  • Drive new customer acquisition while expanding wallet share within existing enterprise, government, and strategic accounts.
  • Develop and manage a robust sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, consultant engagement, channel development, and market coverage.
  • Build strong relationships with End Users, Consultants, PMC firms, Architects, System Integrators, EPC Contractors, and Channel Partners to identify and influence projects at an early stage.
  • Position the company's security products and integrated security solutions in key projects and specifications to drive long-term business opportunities.
  • Work closely with channel partners and distributors to improve coverage, capability, and market penetration across the assigned territory.
  • Identify emerging market opportunities, competitive threats, customer trends, and technology requirements, providing regular market intelligence to management.
  • Collaborate with Presales, Product Management, Marketing, Operations, and Leadership teams to develop winning solution strategies and customer value propositions.
  • Review project specifications, RFPs, and tender documents to ensure appropriate product positioning and competitive differentiation.
  • Deliver technical and commercial presentations, product demonstrations, and consultative discussions with customers and influencers.
  • Develop and execute account plans for strategic customers and large opportunities to maximize long-term growth.
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts, opportunity tracking, and customer records within SFDC or CRM systems.
  • Ensure timely project follow-up, commercial closure, payment collection support, and customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle.
  • Build and promote the company's reputation as a trusted OEM and security solutions provider by maintaining strong customer engagement and industry visibility.
  • Drive consultant and specification-led business by ensuring inclusion of company products in project designs and approved vendor lists.**

What we look for?**

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Electronics, Electrical, IT, or related discipline.
  • MBA in Marketing or Business Management preferred.

Experience

  • upto 15 years of experience in Security Industry sales, business development, or channel management.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in ACVS products including CCTV/Video Surveillance, Access Control, and Security Software Platforms.
  • Proven experience managing large projects, enterprise accounts, consultants, and channel partners.
  • Experience working with OEMs, security solution providers, or system integrators is highly preferred.

**

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of Video Surveillance, VMS platforms, AI Analytics, Access Control, Intrusion Detection, and Integrated Security Solutions.
  • Ability to drive specification and consultant-led business.
  • Strong knowledge of project sales cycles, tendering processes, and commercial negotiations.
  • Excellent customer relationship management and consultative selling skills.
  • Strong presentation, communication, and influencing abilities.
  • Ability to engage with CXOs, Security Heads, IT Teams, Facility Heads, and Procurement stakeholders.
  • Strong business acumen with focus on revenue growth, margin management, and market expansion.
  • Experience in managing channel partners, distributors, and system integrator networks.
  • Proficiency in CRM tools, sales forecasting, and pipeline management.
  • Highly self-driven, result-oriented, and capable of operating in a competitive market environment.**

What we offer

We offer a challenging and exciting position as part of a global, multi-industrial corporation. Joining us provides a stimulating work environment, career development opportunities, and the chance to make a significant impact on society.**

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion stems from our core values. We lead with integrity and aim for a future aligned with our customers' vision for success. Our culture fosters engagement, innovation, and collaboration, ensuring every employee contributes to our collective mission.

job.title: Java Devloper
job.description:
**

Job Description

Role Overview

We are looking for a Java Developer with 5-9 years of experience to design, build, and support scalable backend services. In this role, you will work on robust application components, contribute to high-quality delivery, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to turn requirements into reliable software.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop backend services using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Build and maintain RESTful APIs for web and application integrations.
  • Work with relational databases such as PostgreSQL and write efficient SQL queries.
  • Develop microservices and support containerized deployments using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Participate in code reviews, testing, debugging, and production support activities.
  • Collaborate with product, QA, DevOps, and engineering teams to deliver features on time.
  • Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability through clean engineering practices.
  • Document technical solutions, updates, and implementation details clearly.

How You Will Do It

  • You will take ownership of quality, delivery, and maintainability, with a strong focus on accountability and integrity in every commit.
  • You will stay close to the code, the requirements, and the customer problem so you can remove friction and build what matters most.
  • You will use continuous improvement, candid feedback, and structured problem-solving to strengthen the platform every day.
  • You will collaborate across engineering, QA, and DevOps as one team, bringing trust, shared responsibility, and diverse perspectives into delivery.
  • You will follow agile ways of working, communicate progress clearly, and raise risks early when support is needed.
  • You will use code reviews, testing, and automation to keep standards high and releases dependable.
  • You will approach troubleshooting methodically, using data and root-cause analysis to resolve issues quickly.

Qualifications

  • 5-9 years of professional experience in backend software development.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience designing and building RESTful services and microservices.
  • Solid knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and query optimization.
  • Experience working with Docker and Kubernetes in development or deployment workflows.
  • Good understanding of Linux or Ubuntu-based environments.
  • Experience with code reviews, unit testing, and CI/CD practices.
  • Ability to work effectively in an Agile or Scrum environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Exposure to performance tuning and scalability improvements in high-volume applications.
  • Experience with legacy code modernization or SaaS application development.
  • Python scripting experience for automation or support tasks.

job.title: Salesforce Technical Lead
job.description:
Salesforce Technical Lead

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Lead with mandatory hands-on expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce and proven experience building custom websites using Salesforce Experience Cloud. In this role, you will own the technical direction for enterprise B2B ecommerce storefronts and customer-facing digital experiences on the Salesforce platform, leading solution design, development, integration, performance optimization, and delivery across commerce capabilities such as catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and self-service experiences. You will partner with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, and onshore/offshore engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable commerce and Experience Cloud solutions while mentoring developers and enforcing Salesforce engineering best practices.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of scalable Salesforce Commerce Cloud B2B ecommerce solutions and Experience Cloud-based customer portals.
  • Build and customize Salesforce Experience Cloud websites, storefronts, portals, and self-service experiences using Experience Builder, custom themes, page templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
  • Own solution architecture for B2B commerce capabilities, including product catalogs, pricing, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, account management, order workflows, and personalized buyer experiences.
  • Develop and customize commerce and Experience Cloud experiences using Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), Flow, SOQL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, and Experience Builder.
  • Integrate Salesforce Commerce Cloud with ERP, payment, tax, search, shipping, inventory, product information, and order management systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, middleware, and event-driven architecture.
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, Technical Architects, UI/UX Leads, Delivery Leads, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into well-architected commerce and Experience Cloud solutions.
  • Provide technical leadership to onshore and offshore developers through design reviews, code reviews, estimation, troubleshooting, coaching, and delivery planning.
  • Establish and enforce Salesforce development standards for code quality, security, performance, governor-limit awareness, accessibility, release readiness, and platform governance.
  • Analyze existing commerce and Experience Cloud implementations and optimize performance, scalability, usability, accessibility, and maintainability across storefront, portal, and backend components.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, integration specifications, data models, deployment notes, website configuration details, and operational support guides.
  • Stay current with Salesforce Commerce Cloud, B2B Commerce, Experience Cloud, Experience Builder, LWR, and platform release updates, recommending improvements that reduce technical debt and improve customer experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum of 7+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience, including experience leading technical delivery for enterprise Salesforce implementations.
  • Must have hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud for B2B ecommerce, including storefront configuration, catalog, pricing, cart, checkout, buyer groups, entitlements, and order-related workflows.
  • Must have proven experience building custom websites, portals, and self-service experiences using Salesforce Experience Cloud, including Experience Builder, custom themes, templates, branding, navigation, and reusable components.
  • Strong expertise in Salesforce B2B Commerce on Lightning Experience, Experience Cloud, Lightning Web Runtime (LWR), and Commerce storefront development.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing B2B ecommerce capabilities such as catalogs, price books, buyer groups, entitlements, cart, checkout, reorder, account hierarchy, purchase workflows, and order management integrations.
  • Advanced proficiency with Apex, LWC, Flow, SOQL, SOSL, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, SLDS, Salesforce data models, security, sharing, and governor limits.
  • Experience integrating Salesforce with enterprise systems such as ERP, PIM, OMS, tax, payment, shipping, inventory, search, identity providers, and middleware platforms using REST/SOAP APIs, Platform Events, JSON/XML, and event-driven patterns.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead developers, run technical design discussions, perform code reviews, estimate work, resolve escalated issues, and guide onshore/offshore teams in Agile delivery.
  • Strong understanding of scalable architecture, reusable component design, website performance tuning, accessibility, secure coding practices, release management, and Salesforce DevOps.
  • Proficiency with version control and CI/CD tools such as GitHub, Azure Repos, Salesforce DX, Azure Pipelines, or equivalent DevOps tooling.
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum practices and tools such as Azure Boards or Jira.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II, Salesforce B2B Commerce Developer, Experience Cloud Consultant, Application Architect, or System Architect are highly preferred.

job.title: HR Functional Applications Analyst
job.description:
What you will do

As an HR Technology Analyst, you will be responsible for supporting configuration requests and participating in projects. You will be a strategic business partner who applies technology to support business requirements.

Demonstrating Workday expertise, the HR Technology team partners with HR Centers of Expertise and the HR community to answer functionality questions, resolve issues, work with vendors on system‑related concerns, and test new functionality. The team is involved in many different projects, enabling the HR Technology Analyst to work across the business to ensure successful HR processes.

You will also support and manage day‑to‑day operations with Paradox and HiredScore to ensure smooth recruiter workflows and high‑quality candidate engagement.

The Analyst will be involved in the deployment of new Workday features as well as operational improvements; this includes implementing new security roles, leading configuration changes, and executing end-to-end testing for Workday upgrades.

How you will do it

  • Configure changes in Workday based on business requirements.
  • Configure and maintain Workday Recruit processes, including job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, and offer workflows to support a seamless recruiting lifecycle.
  • Project team member/lead for the design and implementation of new Workday functionalities, including business process configuration, testing, interface and integration support, implementation through deployment, and postproduction support.
  • Support processes within Workday, with a particular focus on recruiting workflows and TA related functionality.
  • Develop strong relationships with internal partners, including the Talent Acquisition CoE, to gain an understanding of business requirements and translate them into effective system solutions.
  • Create custom Workday reports as needed to meet business needs/objectives.
  • Plan, coordinate, and implement testing efforts for changes within Workday, including recruiting related enhancements and integrations.
  • Support the design, development, and performance of Workday and related business data and processes. Focus on identifying trends, resolving root causes, predicting future implications, and finding solutions to drive effective business decisions.
  • Proactively identify and assist in prioritizing opportunities to streamline business and/or system processes, especially within the recruiting lifecycle.
  • Lead biyearly Workday upgrades, including end-to-end testing of Workday Recruit functionality.
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition CoE to analyze and enhance the candidate journey, using Workday Recruit configuration and supporting technologies to streamline application flow and improve candidate experience.
  • Oversee daily operations and optimization of Paradox and HiredScore, including troubleshooting issues, monitoring performance, driving adoption, and identifying enhancements that improve recruiter efficiency and candidate engagement.

What we look for

Required

  • Degree in business or management information systems, HR (CIPD), or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with case management, specifically ServiceNow.
  • Experience with Human Capital Management systems, ideally Workday.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to prioritize and find solutions in a timely manner.
  • Self-motivated and self-organized working style with the ability to work effectively on diverse project teams.
  • Customer service focus and flexibility in supporting business unit needs.
  • Demonstrated competence in presenting concepts clearly and accurately with strong written and verbal interpersonal skills. Able to positively represent Johnson Controls and communicate with others at varying managerial and technical levels.
  • Commitment to quality and continuous improvement.
  • History of significant customer satisfaction, building rapport, and influencing decisions while working in a consultative role with customers.

Preferred

We’d ideally love you to have experience as a contributing team member within HR operational projects and new implementations, including the full change request lifecycle (solution design, configuration, testing, communication, etc.). An overall understanding of HR data, HR processes, and the change/implementation life cycle is important.

Workday experience is highly desirable, particularly in configuring and supporting:

  • Workday Recruit (job requisitions, job postings, candidate stages, screening steps, offer workflows, and recruiting related security)
  • Payroll
  • Compensation
  • Time Off
  • Reporting
  • Security

job.description:

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects
  • Device project implementation methodology
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions
  • Establish effective communication with customer
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control. Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per CIS.
  • Managing reports and documents
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.
  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner
  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.
  • System applications, drafting, data base generation and commissioning
  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 8 years relevant experience in BMS System
  • Excel, Word and Project essential
  • 2 years of supervisory experience
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Manager - Zero Trust
job.description:
Job Code:

Job Code Name:

Business Title: Manager – Zero Trust

Region: APAC – Bengaluru/Pune

Country: India

Grade: 175

What you will do

As Manager – Zero Trust, you will own the Zero Trust strategy and roadmap, aligned to NIST SP 800-207 and the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model. You will drive measurable removal of implicit trust across identity, devices, networks, applications and data, and approve the designs that go to production. You will lead and grow a multi-disciplinary team through structured Zero Trust training, clear performance management and real delegation. You will deliver concurrent programs with sprint discipline, operational SLAs and audit readiness. You will also act as the organization's Zero Trust advocate with IT partners.

What we look for

Required

  • 10+ years in cybersecurity, across network security, identity, cloud or security architecture, with meaningful hands-on depth rather than oversight only.
  • 6+ years of direct people management. We mean line management with hiring, development, performance, retention and succession accountability, not technical leadership of a project team.
  • Practical Zero Trust experience in role. You have designed, implemented or led Zero Trust initiatives in an enterprise, and can describe what you changed, how you measured it and what went wrong.
  • Strong grounding in Zero Trust principles and frameworks, including NIST SP 800-207, the CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model or equivalent, and the judgment to apply them to a real, imperfect estate.
  • Working knowledge across several Zero Trust domains:

o ZTNA and SSE/SASE

o Microsegmentation

o Identity and access management

o Privileged access

o Conditional access and MFA

o Device trust

o Application and developer-environment access

o Data protection

  • Experience developing security strategies, architectures and roadmaps, and owning their delivery from design through build, operation and automation.
  • Enough technical depth to credibly review and challenge designs from senior network and identity engineers.
  • Experience leading the response to high-severity security incidents. This means coordinating IT, legal and business teams through containment, remediation and post-incident control improvement.
  • Experience building or scaling a team, not only inheriting one, including managing across regions and planning capacity.
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills. You can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences and defend a technical position to senior leadership.

Preferred

  • Zero Trust certification, such as the CSA Certificate of Competence in Zero Trust (CCZT), Forrester Zero Trust Strategist, or a vendor Zero Trust certification.
  • Broader security or architecture certification, such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, SANS (GIAC) or TOGAF.
  • Hands-on experience with leading Zero Trust platforms, for example:

o SSE/ZTNA: Zscaler or Netskope

o Microsegmentation: Guardicore or Illumio

o Identity and IDaaS: Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, Ping Identity or Google Cloud Identity

o Identity governance: SailPoint, Saviynt or equivalent

o Privileged access management

  • Network security background across on-premises and cloud:

o On-premises: firewall policy and rule management, IDS/IPS, network access control, remote access VPN and internet proxies.

o Cloud: cloud proxies, cloud web application firewall and API protection (WAF/WAAP), and Azure or GCP security services.

  • Cloud security posture management across multi-cloud environments (CSPM/CNAPP).
  • Security operations experience, including SIEM tools such as Splunk for log analysis and event correlation, and risk-based vulnerability management.
  • AI security experience, either securing enterprise use of AI or applying AI to security operations.
  • Exposure to OT and IoT security, including IEC 62443.
  • Automation experience, such as Python, PowerShell, low-code platforms or ITSM integration.
  • Experience in a large, regulated enterprise with a legacy estate, M&A activity and real technical debt.
  • Working knowledge of security and regulatory frameworks, such as NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001, SOX, PCI DSS, GDPR and HIPAA.

Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view[ EEO is the Law](https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/migrated_files/employers/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf). If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers](https://www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers).

job.title: Anaplan Scrum Master
job.description:
Anaplan Scrum Master

Johnson Controls is looking for an experienced Scrum Master to support Anaplan-driven planning work across business and technology teams. In this role, you will help teams deliver with clarity, keep priorities aligned, and improve how planning solutions move from ideas to release.

Role Overview

This role is focused on guiding Agile delivery for Anaplan initiatives in a collaborative enterprise environment. You will partner with Product Owners, business stakeholders, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to keep delivery organized, transparent, and moving forward. We are looking for someone with 7+ years of experience who can bring structure, momentum, and steady facilitation to complex planning work.

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, backlog refinement, and release planning.
  • Partner with Product Owners to keep the backlog prioritized, clear, and ready for sprint execution.
  • Translate business needs into user stories, epics, and acceptance criteria that support Anaplan delivery.
  • Coordinate across business users, Product Owners, model builders, analysts, and technical teams to maintain alignment on scope, dependencies, and delivery goals.
  • Support UAT activities by helping validate delivered solutions against acceptance criteria and business expectations.
  • Track impediments, risks, and delivery blockers, and help drive timely resolution.
  • Protect the team from unnecessary scope creep and external disruptions while keeping stakeholders informed.
  • Support transparency through delivery updates, sprint health indicators, and progress reporting.
  • Encourage continuous improvement in planning, collaboration, and release readiness.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability and integrity by keeping commitments visible, raising risks early, and following through on agreed actions.
  • Stay close to the work by understanding the details of Anaplan delivery, removing blockers quickly, and helping the team focus on what matters most.
  • Improve every day by using retrospectives, candid conversation, and practical problem-solving to strengthen flow, quality, and predictability.
  • Win as one team by building trust across business and technology partners, respecting diverse perspectives, and supporting shared goals.
  • Use Agile ceremonies and delivery data to keep the team aligned, informed, and ready for the next sprint.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional experience, including proven experience as a Scrum Master in an Agile environment.
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, and Agile frameworks.
  • Experience translating business requirements into user stories, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria.
  • Experience supporting Anaplan initiatives or enterprise planning solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to influence without authority and navigate change effectively.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-moving environment.
  • Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with financial forecasting, commercial planning, workforce planning, or other enterprise planning processes in Anaplan.
  • Exposure to Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Miro, or similar collaboration tools.
  • Experience supporting UAT, release readiness, and delivery metrics reporting.
  • Familiarity with The Anaplan Way or similar structured planning delivery methods.

Why Join Us

You will have the opportunity to work at the intersection of planning, technology, and business delivery, helping teams turn requirements into practical Anaplan solutions. This role offers meaningful collaboration, visibility across functions, and the chance to strengthen Agile ways of working in a supportive environment.

job.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
job.description:
Salesforce Technical Architect - Bangalore

Johnson Controls is looking for a Salesforce Technical Architect in Bangalore to design scalable, secure Salesforce solutions and guide technical delivery across the platform.

Role Overview

In this role, you will own the technical architecture for complex Salesforce initiatives, translating business needs into practical, well-designed solutions. You will work closely with technical teams and stakeholders to shape integrations, data design, security, and deployment practices that support long-term platform success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and architecture of scalable Salesforce solutions for complex business requirements.
  • Translate business needs into well-architected technical solutions aligned to strategic goals.
  • Mentor Salesforce tech leads, developers, data analysts, and integration developers.
  • Conduct technical design reviews and code reviews to support quality and maintainability.
  • Architect integrations between Salesforce and external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Define the system architecture landscape, identify gaps, and deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Implement platform security best practices for authentication, data sharing, and encryption.
  • Collaborate with DevOps, QA, and Change Management teams for deployments and performance.

How You Will Do It

  • Own outcomes with accountability, security, and integrity, while making sound technical decisions that stand up to enterprise use.
  • Stay close to the work, remove blockers early, and keep the focus on solutions that matter for the customer.
  • Use candor, root-cause thinking, and continuous improvement to strengthen the platform over time.
  • Win as one team by collaborating with developers, QA, DevOps, change management, and business stakeholders.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10-12 years of experience with Salesforce platform architecture and development across multiple cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of scalable, performance-driven solutions and design patterns for large data volumes.
  • Deep knowledge of data modeling, governance, and management within Salesforce.
  • Experience architecting integrations with external systems using REST and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience with authentication and authorization, including SSO.
  • Experience with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation tools.
  • Experience leading technical teams.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Fluent in English.

Nice to Have

  • Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or Service Cloud experience.
  • Active Salesforce certifications such as Application Architect, System Architect, or Technical Architect.

Why Join Us

Join a collaborative team where you can shape enterprise Salesforce architecture, mentor others, and contribute to secure, high-performing solutions that support business growth. If you enjoy solving complex problems and working across teams, this role offers the chance to make a real impact.

If this sounds like the right next step for you, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Intern, Investor Relations & Communications (Jan 27 - Jun 27)
job.description:

job.title: Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning, is a hands-on team player who will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient deployment, test, and operation of our HyperCube systems. The ideal candidate will be involved in the commissioning and remediation of the latest AI cluster platforms including compute, network, and storage components, provide high-quality technical support, troubleshoot issues, and work with vendors and partners to resolve them in a timely manner. This role requires hands-on work in demanding data center environments, including equipment installation, hardware replacement, structured cabling, and physical infrastructure remediation activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the deployment, commissioning, and remediation of large-scale AI clusters comprising thousands of GPUs, high-speed networks, and high-performance storage systems.
  • Support site teams during commissioning, testing, and equipment setup.
  • Assist with system installations, modifications, and setup as part of the commissioning team.
  • Assist with network cabling and integration.
  • Diagnose server, GPU, storage, and networking failures.
  • Collect logs and diagnostic information, support technical teams during failure investigations, and assist engineering teams in identifying recurring failure patterns and root causes.
  • Perform component-level replacement and remediation.
  • Execute hardware validation procedures and acceptance tests.
  • Verify firmware, cabling, and system configurations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely updates and technical support to project and operations teams, ensuring smooth collaboration.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Keep accurate service records, equipment logs, and submit required documentation promptly.
  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols.
  • Training & Development: Stay current on equipment, processes, and industry standards through ongoing learning.
  • Inventory & Quality Control: Maintain tools, spare parts, and equipment inventory.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Diploma or equivalent, technical certification, trade qualification.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role, including hands-on experience with IT equipment maintenance and repair.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills. Proven to be able to work effectively under direction.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required during system commissioning.
  • Must hold an unrestricted driver’s license.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with high-density GPU server and rack environments.
  • Experience with data center networking and structured cabling.
  • Experience performing hardware diagnostics and component replacement.
  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line troubleshooting.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift and move IT equipment.
  • Ability to work in data center environments for extended periods.
  • Comfortable working in confined spaces and around high-density equipment racks.
  • Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel for deployment and commissioning activities.

Employment Basis

Full-time

job.title: Staff Information Security Engineer, Product Security
job.description:
About the job

Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

The Information Security Engineer (ISE) team mission is to make it easy for Google and the world to ship secure products. The Singapore-based team is focused on scaling our operations and risk reduction efforts through advanced automation and remediation. Our mission is to safeguard billions of users by efficiently triaging external security reports and proactively eliminating classes of vulnerabilities across Google's products and infrastructure. We aim to evolve into a self-sustaining, Artificial Intelligence (AI)-motivated operation that provides deep insights into vulnerability trends while fostering a community of security researchers.

In this role, you will lead a team of security engineers to scale our capacity to perform research, conduct analysis, derive risk insights and drive large-scale remediation projects across Google. You will also guide the development of AI agents to automate root cause analysis, variant analysis and trend analysis of vulnerabilities. You will be a technical leader, able to mentor, and guide other engineers, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve collective goals. You will have a technical foundation and exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills to manage complex security tests and operations. You will have a breadth of application security experience: web security, mobile security, Application Programming Interface (API) security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to teammates. Understand and advise others on complex processes and workflows related to product security response and remediation efforts.
  • Foster global collaboration and maintain a high level of operational independence while collaborating with Global Leads in the United States (US) and Zurich to align on remediation efforts.
  • Drive end-to-end development of Artificial Intelligence (AI) agents and infrastructure to automate root cause analysis, variant analysis, trend analysis, remediation to reduce manual workloads.
  • Build and maintain a unified vulnerability analysis pipeline and dashboarding system to provide executive-level insights into emerging threats and program Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Drive large-scale remediation efforts that eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities across Google’s products and infrastructure.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Product Manager, Google Wallet
job.description:
About the job

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

As a Product Manager on the CPX Surfaces team, you will help shape the Google Wallet Android app, used by hundreds of millions of people around the world. You will own a significant piece of the product, driving new features from early discovery through launch. You will partner directly with an engineering team in Singapore, while collaborating with our global teams, to drive Wallet and Google Pay forward. **

Responsibilities

  • Define the product goal and roadmap for your specific surface areas within the Wallet Android app, guiding features from early ideation through launch and iteration.
  • Work day-to-day with your engineering team in Singapore and global User Experience (UX) teams to design, build, and ship high-quality consumer experiences.
  • Translate Wallet’s broader account-based goal into tangible mobile features that bring real value to our user's everyday lives.
  • Leverage user research, market insights, and product metrics to prioritize what we build, balance trade-offs, and measure success.
  • Align with Product Managers (PMs) and cross-functional teams across San Francisco/Mountain View/New York (SFO/MTV/NYC) to ensure your features integrate seamlessly into the broader Google Wallet and Google Pay ecosystem.

job.title: PCB Engineer

job.title: Quality Technician
job.description:
At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Quality Technician to join the Power & Thermal Management division in Tuas, Singapore.

The Quality Technician position is responsible for ensuring that all purchased material is reviewed & inspected for conformance against defined criteria using the necessary measurement and inspection equipment. He/She also responsible for resolving the nonconforming materials with the vendors, and provide the support to production ensuring manufacturing processes are followed along with identifying and aiding in the troubleshooting of quality related issues.

Responsibilities

Main Job Duties:

  • Inspection of all incoming material to determine conformance with applicable drawings, specifications, and/or instructions
  • Perform First Article Inspections (FAI) on new part submissions
  • Records inspection results into defined repository
  • Responsible for controlling, processing & resolving any conformance related materials issue with proper documentation
  • Creates and updates test plans as required
  • Identifies the need for increased or reduced sampling based on historical inspection data.
  • Proactively seeks out opportunities to improve the incoming inspection process
  • Material movement of inspected items
  • Assists in the Quality team in investigating, containing, and controlling material that is nonconforming
  • Review operations' build processes and provide constructive feedback as necessary

  • Ensure that employees are using the correct tools, parts, and information they need to be fully productive

Qualifications

Education

  • Quality experience in a technical background required
  • 2 years minimum manufacturing experience preferred

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • Ability to run reports, effectively present information and respond to questions
  • Strong communication and relationship building skills
  • Ability to use Syteline/ERP, MQ1 and other systems
  • Ability to learn Microsoft office
  • Exposure to Lean Manufacturing Concepts preferred

  • Ability to stand for prolonged periods of time.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs (34kg). occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs (11kg). daily.

Role: Lead Data Engineer/Modeler

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full time

About Carrier

**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the centre of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

**

About the role

The Senior Data Modeler is responsible for designing and maintaining enterprise data models that enable scalable analytics, governed data products, AI/ML initiatives, and self-service reporting across Carrier's data platforms. The role serves as a bridge between business stakeholders, data engineering teams, governance teams, and analytics consumers to ensure consistent, reusable, and business-aligned data structures that support enterprise reporting, operational insights, and AI-powered solutions.

Role Responsibilities

Data Modeling & Architecture

  • Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models for enterprise data products and analytics platforms.
  • Develop dimensional, canonical, and semantic data models to support reporting, AI, and business intelligence use cases.
  • Create scalable and reusable data structures for Snowflake, Big Query, and cloud-based Lakehouse environments.
  • Establish and maintain enterprise data modeling standards, naming conventions, and design best practices.
  • Partner with data engineering and architecture teams to optimize data structures for performance, scalability, and maintainability.

Business & Data Product Engagement

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business processes, KPIs, and reporting requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into governed and reusable enterprise data models.
  • Support the design and evolution of enterprise data products and semantic layers.
  • Drive consistency of business metrics and definitions across domains and reporting platforms.
  • Participate in solution design sessions and data architecture reviews to ensure alignment with business objectives.

Governance, Quality & AI Enablement

  • Partner with Data Governance teams to define master data, reference data, business glossaries, and metadata standards.
  • Incorporate data quality, lineage, and governance requirements into model design.
  • Support enterprise metadata management and catalog initiatives.
  • Design AI-ready data structures that support machine learning, generative AI, RAG, and agentic AI use cases.
  • Contribute to enterprise standards for data discoverability, reuse, and compliance.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in Data Modeling, Data Architecture, or Enterprise Data Management.
  • Strong expertise in: Dimensional Modeling (Kimball) Enterprise Data Modeling, Data Vault Modeling Semantic Layer Design, Master and Reference Data Management
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong understanding of relational and analytical database concepts.
  • Hands-on experience with modern cloud data platforms such as: Snowflake, Google Big Query, Cloud Data Warehouses and Lakehouse architectures
  • Experience supporting enterprise analytics, reporting, and data product initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data quality principles.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Atlan, Collibra, or similar governance platforms.
  • Experience with Looker, Power BI, Qlik, Tableau, or enterprise semantic modeling tools.
  • Exposure to AI/ML, GenAI, and enterprise data platforms.
  • Experience in Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, ERP, or Product Engineering domains.
  • Familiarity with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, PLM, or other enterprise systems.

Target Experience Level

**8-12 years | Senior Data Modeler / Lead Data Modeler

**Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees, and enhancing our programs when necessary.

  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.
