Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled and experienced Senior Tax Analyst to join our Compensation Tax -Global Finance Services Division.

The incumbent would play a key role in supporting accounting, expatriate taxation, and payroll functions. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with diverse business partners across global operations, ensuring compliance and accuracy in expatriate tax and U.S. payroll tax processes.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield Office, Bangalore, India

What you will do

Expatriate Tax Compliance:

  • Assist the Manager in globally managing the expatriate tax compliance process across nearly 50 host countries to ensure timely filing of tax returns and adherence to tax equalization policies.
  • Collaborate with internal and external partners to coordinate expatriate tax filings, payments, and settlements for approximately 1,500 current and repatriated expatriates.
  • Analyse & compile data and respond to U.S. federal and state tax authority notices and communicate with tax authorities to address and resolve tax notices/audits
  • Lead the Global Tax Equalization Acceptance process, manage tax files with external service providers, create supporting documentation for U.S. federal and state income tax payments.
  • Lead tax-related accounting activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and providing detailed tax information.
  • Analyses and opines on proposed changes to U.S. tax legislations and regulations with regard to the impact on compensation compliance requirements or calculations, requiring in-depth experience, knowledge and judgment. Participates on teams within or outside of the U.S. on tax and business initiatives.

Payroll Tax Compliance:

  • Support the daily import of payroll tax payment files for all U.S. payroll entities.
  • Review daily tax payments and assist with the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual federal, state, and local tax filings, including Forms 940 and 941 for all payroll entities.
  • Communicate with tax authorities to address and resolve tax notices, facilitate the application process for tax identification numbers, and manage related correspondence
  • Phone call to tax authorities to resolve tax notices, applying for tax identification numbers etc.
  • Assist the Manager to support the U.S. Federal/state Reporting & Analysis team (1120 team) with compensation/payroll related information including Schedule M for Executive Officer Aircraft, Executive Compensation 162(m) and payroll apportionment for state tax allocation.

Key Partnerships:

  • Collaborate with business partners such as Ernst & Young, Cartus, eTrade, Global Payroll, the Global Mobility team (HR), Legal, Treasury, Compensation & Benefits, Executive Compensation, and Legal Entity/Business Unit Accounting teams across global operations.

What you will have

  • Bachelor's or master’s level degree related to Accounting or Finance
  • 4-6 years of tax related experience at Big 4 public accounting firm and/or large multinational corporation would be preferred
  • Experience with HR, payroll, and tax processes/systems/software (MasterTax, WorkDay, G/L, CorpTax, Excel)
  • Enrolled Agent Certification or CPA, would be an added advantage
  • Understanding of accounting and business processes, and enterprise operations
  • Research and opine on complex tax technical issues
  • Broad technical knowledge of tax laws and regulations
  • Proven ability to work with a team and eager to take on new challenges
  • Demonstrate high levels of initiative, good judgment, excellent analytical and communication skills

Additional Information:

  • This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Analytical Thinking:Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Seeks discrepancies and inconsistencies in available information; explains variances.
  • Organizes and prioritizes the sequence of steps to be taken to remedy the situation.
  • Identifies many possible causes for a problem based on prior experience and current research.
  • Quantifies the costs, benefits, risks and chances for success before recommending a course of action.
  • Approaches a complex problem by breaking it down into its component parts.
  • Chooses among a diverse set of analytical tools according to the nature of the situation.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking:Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications:Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Delivers helpful feedback that focuses on behaviors without offending the recipient.
  • Listens to feedback without defensiveness and uses it for own communication effectiveness.
  • Makes oral presentations and writes reports needed for own work.
  • Avoids technical jargon when inappropriate.
  • Looks for and considers non-verbal cues from individuals and groups.

Managing Multiple Priorities:Knowledge of effective self-management practices; ability to manage multiple concurrent objectives, projects, groups, or activities, making effective judgments as to prioritizing and time allocation. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Clarifies and handles multiple concurrent and diverse activities.
  • Shifts focus among several efforts as required by changing priorities.
  • Addresses potential conflicts that impact current delivery commitments.
  • Works with or leads others to re-prioritize work and reschedule commitments as necessary.
  • Responds to shifting priorities while maintaining progress of regularly scheduled work.
  • Demonstrates an expectation that there will be ongoing shifts in demands and priorities.

Accounting:Knowledge of accounting methods, processes, and tools; ability to maintain and prepare financial statements and reports using accounting methods and processes. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Utilizes cost monitoring practices, techniques and considerations.
  • Works with financial transactions and related documentation within the organization.
  • Participates in accounting practices of classifying and recording financial data.
  • Maintains existing charts of accounts.
  • Follows regulations for entering and reporting the financial content in major accounting systems.

Financial Analysis:Knowledge of tools and approaches of financial analysis; ability to read, interpret and draw accurate conclusions from financial and numerical material. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Anticipates the potential impact of decisions based on financial data analysis.

Financial Reporting:Knowledge of processes, methods, and tools of financial reporting; ability to create and maintain accurate and thorough financial reports. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Uses basic tools to create simple financial reports.

This position manages customer and dealer relationships, delivers the assigned territory business plan, improves customer onboarding, and advances growth across the complete BCP portfolio within a collaborative, accountable, and customer-focused team environment.

job.title: Senior Software Developer - Front End
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About the Opportunity

MineStar is transforming the way mines operate through automation, digitisation, analytics and AI.

As a Senior Software Developer, you will play a key technical role in designing and delivering modern, intuitive digital experiences that help mining customers improve safety, efficiency and operational performance.

Working within the Product & Platform team, your primary focus will be front-end application development using React, Angular and TypeScript, creating responsive, scalable and user-focused applications. You will work closely with UX specialists, Product Owners, architects and other engineers to translate customer needs and designs into high-quality digital products.

While this role is primarily front-end focused, you will also bring practical Python backend development experience, enabling you to develop or modify APIs and backend services when required and work effectively across the full application stack.

This is a hands-on senior development role for someone who combines strong front-end engineering skills with good software design principles, an eye for user experience and enough backend capability to deliver end-to-end solutions when needed.

What you will be involved in:

  • Design, develop, test and maintain modern web applications using React, Angular and TypeScript.
  • Build responsive, intuitive and accessible user interfaces that deliver high-quality customer experiences.
  • Translate UX designs, prototypes and business requirements into scalable and maintainable front-end solutions.
  • Develop reusable front-end components, patterns and libraries that improve consistency and development efficiency across products.
  • Contribute to front-end architecture, application structure, technology choices and engineering standards.
  • Optimise applications for performance, reliability, usability and maintainability.
  • Integrate front-end applications with APIs, data services, MineStar capabilities and other enterprise platforms.
  • Develop and maintain Python backend services and APIs when required, supporting end-to-end application delivery.
  • Work with AWS cloud services to develop and deploy scalable digital applications.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Owners, UX specialists, architects and engineers to translate customer and business needs into practical technical solutions.

What We're Looking For

Job Description

We are seeking an experienced Manager Transportation (Senior Finance Analyst)to join our GLBL BusSvcs – Freight Payable Mgt – ITP - -Global Finance Services Division.

The preference for this role is to be based out of Whitefield, Bangalore-KA, India

What you will do

The Freight Payables Center of Excellence (COE) is responsible for leading freight invoice-to-pay operations, process governance, controls compliance, transformation initiatives, stakeholder management, and service delivery across APAC and India operations. The role drives operational excellence, standardization, automation, quality improvement, productivity enhancement, and compliance within the Freight Payables organization.

Key Responsibilities

Operational Leadership

•Lead end-to-end Freight Payables operations across multiple regions and business units.

•Ensure timely processing, validation, approval, and payment of freight invoices.

•Drive service level achievement, backlog reduction, aging management, and productivity targets.

•Manage daily operational reviews and governance routines.

Process Ownership & Governance

•Act as process owner for Freight Payables processes.

•Establish and maintain SOPs, control frameworks, process maps, and governance standards.

•Drive standardization across regions and operating units.

•Ensure compliance with Caterpillar financial policies and procedures.

Team Leadership

•Lead a team of Freight Payables professionals and outsourced service providers.

•Develop employee capability, succession plans, and cross-skilling programs.

•Conduct performance coaching and career development discussions.

•Foster accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement culture.

Stakeholder Management

•Partner with regional finance teams, transportation teams, carriers, procurement, logistics, and business partners.

•Represent Freight Payables in leadership reviews and governance forums.

•Manage escalations impacting supplier payments, transportation providers, and business operations.

Controls & Compliance

•Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, approval matrix controls, audit requirements, and policy governance.

•Drive remediation plans, root cause analysis, and corrective actions.

•Partner with Internal Audit, Controllers, and Compliance organizations.

Continuous Improvement & Transformation

•Lead transformation initiatives including:

•Blue Yonder implementation

•Freight process automation

•OCR and smart invoice processing

•Workflow optimization

•Reporting and analytics enhancement

•Identify opportunities for cost reduction and process simplification.

Quality Management

•Establish quality-control framework and operational scorecards.

•Monitor processing accuracy and service quality.

•Implement preventive and corrective actions for recurring defects.

Reporting & Analytics

•Own operational KPI dashboards and management reporting.

•Analyze volume trends, backlog performance, aging, productivity, quality, and compliance metrics.

•Present business insights and recommendations to leadership.

Vendor & Carrier Relationship Management

•Manage carrier payment escalations and supplier concerns.

•Ensure timely resolution of payment disputes and invoice exceptions.

•Partner with transportation teams to drive carrier satisfaction.

Project & Change Management

•Lead transitions, migrations, stabilization activities, and organizational change initiatives.

•Coordinate training, knowledge transfer, UAT, and process rollout activities.

What you will have:

Education

•Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Business, or related field.

•MBA or professional certification preferred.

Experience

•10+ years of Accounts Payable / Freight Payables / ITP experience.

•5+ years managing global operational teams.

•Experience leading shared services or COE organizations.

•Experience working with freight, logistics, transportation, or supply chain processes.

Technical Skills

•ERP Systems (SAP preferred)

•Blue Yonder / TMS exposure

•Power BI

•Microsoft Excel Advanced

•Workflow & Automation tools

•Financial controls and audit processes

This position requires candidate to work a 5-day -a -week schedule in the office.

Skills desired:

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Accurately gauges the impact and cost of errors, omissions, and oversights.
  • Utilizes specific approaches and tools for checking and cross-checking outputs.

Data Gathering & Analysis:Knowledge of data gathering and analysis tools, techniques, and processes; ability to collect and synthesize data from a variety of stakeholders and sources in an objective manner to reach a conclusion, goal, or judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

Import/Export -MFG: Knowledge of issues, procedures, tools and practices of importing and exporting; ability to import and export goods to and from international locations. Level Basic Understanding:

Planning and Organizing:Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way. Level Working Knowledge:

job.title: Senior Software Developer - Full Stack
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About the Opportunity

MineStar is transforming the way mines operate through automation, digitisation, analytics and AI. As a Senior Software Developer, you will play a key technical role in designing, developing and delivering digital productivity solutions that help mining customers improve safety, efficiency and operational performance.

Working within the Product & Platform team, you will develop modern, scalable applications using AWS cloud services, Python backend technologies and React-based front-end technologies. You will work closely with Product Owners, architects, engineers, UX specialists and other MineStar teams to take solutions from concept through to production.

This is a hands-on senior development role for someone who enjoys solving complex problems, contributing to technical direction and helping build high-quality solutions that can operate reliably at scale.

What you will be involved in:

  • Design, develop, test and maintain scalable digital applications and services using AWS, Python and React.
  • Build robust backend services and APIs using Python and modern software engineering practices.
  • Develop responsive, intuitive and maintainable user experiences using React and modern front-end technologies.
  • Design and implement cloud-native solutions using AWS services and established architectural patterns.
  • Contribute to solution architecture, technical design and technology decisions across the product portfolio.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, architects, UX specialists and engineers to translate customer and business needs into effective technical solutions.
  • Integrate applications with MineStar, enterprise platforms, data services and other internal and external systems.
  • Build solutions that incorporate automation, analytics and AI capabilities where they provide meaningful customer value.
  • Apply strong software engineering practices across code quality, testing, security, performance, observability and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical design reviews, providing constructive guidance to other developers.
  • Troubleshoot complex application and production issues and drive problems through to resolution.
  • Support continuous improvement of development practices, tools, standards and reusable components.
  • Provide technical mentoring and support to other developers while contributing to a collaborative engineering culture.
  • Work with globally distributed teams and delivery partners to deliver reliable, supportable solutions.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking an experienced Senior Software Developer with a strong combination of cloud, backend and front-end development experience ideally with a background in the Miningindustry.

You will bring:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Significant professional software development experience delivering production applications in complex enterprise environments.
  • Strong backend development experience using Python, including the development of APIs, services and application business logic.
  • Strong front-end development experience using React, JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web application development practices.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and developing cloud-based solutions using AWS.
  • Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, data services and distributed application components.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, design patterns and maintainable software engineering practices.
  • Experience with automated testing, source control, code review and modern CI/CD development practices.
  • Understanding of cloud security, application security, authentication and authorisation principles.
  • Experience diagnosing application performance, reliability and production issues.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product Owners, architects, UX specialists and other engineering teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to turn complex requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts, design decisions, risks and trade-offs clearly.
  • Experience supporting and mentoring other developers and contributing to engineering standards and practices.

Highly regarded experience includes:

  • Experience with serverless, containerised or event-driven architectures on AWS.
  • Experience working with SQL Server and PostgreSQL, including database integration and querying.
  • Experience with data, analytics, machine learning or AI-enabled applications.
  • Experience developing solutions that integrate with large enterprise or industrial technology platforms.
  • Experience with mining, industrial technology, operational technology or asset-intensive industries.
  • Knowledge of MineStar™ or comparable mining technology platforms.
  • Experience working with globally distributed software engineering teams and external development partners.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help build the digital solutions supporting the future of mining through cloud technology, automation, analytics and AI.

You'll work on real-world engineering challenges with a global impact, alongside experienced mining, product and technology professionals. You will have the opportunity to influence how solutions are designed and built, introduce modern engineering practices and see your work translated into measurable customer outcomes.

Additional Information

  • Full-time position based in Redcliffe, Perth.
  • Travel requirements up to 10%.
  • Domestic relocation maybe on offer to the ideal candidate
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Employee Benefits

  • Competitive remuneration, including bonus and share options.
  • Generous parental leave with flexible payment options.
  • Strong commitment to diversity, inclusion and equal opportunity.
  • Employee discounts across health, wellbeing, travel and retail.
  • Global career progression and development opportunities within Caterpillar.

How to Apply

If you're ready to take on a challenging and rewarding software engineering role with a global industry leader, apply via: www.caterpillar.com/careers

Join a global leader and build a career with real impact.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

_Role Definition_

_To provide leadership, mentoring and direction to hourly, salaried and management personnel engaged in Environmental, Health, and/or Safety (EHS) activities and Facilities Engineering, Maintenance related activities to a large facility._

Responsibilities

_

  • Identifies common and more complex safety/health/environmental hazards inherent in the organization's operations and establishes guidelines for protection from those hazards._

_

  • Ensures EHS training is completed to comply with regulatory requirements or in support of facility, division, or enterprise objectives._

_

  • Audits safety/health/environmental programs for compliance with company standards, government regulations, and adequacy relative to local conditions._

_

  • Monitors periodic performance reports for trends and conditions, alerts line management to problems and makes recommendations for improvement._

_- Directing staffing, development and performance management programs for all facilities management staff; managing, motivating and developing management team._

_

  • Maintaining communications and relationships with customers, local community, service providers, and utilities._

_

  • Developing plans and strategies for infrastructure and processes needed to run a manufacturing facility in accordance with regulatory procedures and environmental standards._

_

  • Planning the implementation and use of programs and databases for effectively managing properties, physical assets and equipment._

_Skill Descriptors_

_Sustainability: Knowledge of sustainability strategy; ability to integrate sustainability into the overall business strategy of the organization to build a sustainable business model._

_Level Basic Understanding:_

_

  • Contributes to timely and accurate data collection and analysis at the corporate and site level._

_

  • Describes the basic concepts and objectives of Sustainability._

_

  • Supports research and general administrative requirements for our sustainability efforts._

_

  • Understands various sustainability practices adopted by the organization._

_Risk Management: Knowledge of processes, tools and techniques for assessing and controlling an organization's exposure to risks of various kinds; ability to apply knowledge of risk management appropriately to diverse situations._

_Level Extensive Experience:_

_

  • Debates the pros and cons of various risk management models._

_

  • Implements function-wide risk management processes and tools._

_

  • Designs cross-functional risk management processes, tools, and audit mechanisms._

_

  • Measures key benefits and drawbacks for specific risk management practices._

_

  • Relates risk assessment models and analysis tools and processes to own business._

_

  • Establishes key business-specific risk management benchmarks._

_Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner._

_Level Extensive Experience:_

_

  • Demonstrates experience engendering collaborative processes that lead to problem solving and the achievement of business goals._

_

  • Establishes shared goals to foster collaboration._

_

  • Ensures that everyone can access the same data and provide input into how business is conducted._

_

  • Redesigns physical areas to allow for collaboration and private time._

_

  • Deemphasizes divides; focuses on collaboration across generations, functions, regions, and levels._

_

  • Implements methods for people to come together on the fly to make decisions, solve problems, and develop products/services._

_Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment._

_Level Expert:_

_

  • Analyzes and discusses alternatives with multiple stakeholders._

_

  • Monitors developments in critical-thinking and decision-making models for potential use by organization._

_

  • Coaches others in decision-making models, processes, and practices._

_

  • Anticipates special issues and considerations for effective decision-making during a crisis._

_

  • Shares experiences regarding optimal timing and circumstances for refraining from or making decisions._

_

  • Differentiates between content and context of a decision._

_Interpersonal Relationships: Knowledge of the techniques and the ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a constructive and collaborative manner._

_Level Expert:_

_

  • Coaches others in developing and maintaining cooperative and satisfying relationships._

_

  • Intervenes with highly difficult people and situations._

_

  • Creates initiatives that foster communication, directness and spirit of cooperation._

_

  • Arbitrates difficult situations with high stakes._

_

  • Sets the tone for interacting with other business functions or units._

_

  • Encourages others to build partnerships with other functions or departments._

_Overcoming Resistance to Change: Understanding and insight into the futility of refusing to accept the inevitable and ability to overcome resistance and adapt to a complex and changing environment._

_Level Expert:_

_

  • Demonstrates experience overcoming resistance to anticipated and unanticipated changes in a wide variety of realms._

_

  • Identifies and provides training for new values, skills, and behaviors required for the change._

_

  • Develops strategies for overcoming resistance to change._

_

  • Fosters an attitude of anticipation and graciousness toward change; welcomes change as an opportunity._

_

  • Conceptualizes methods for dealing with the emotions and mental attitude toward change; recommends techniques for dealing with associated anxiety._

_

  • Sets goals associated with change acceptance; acknowledges successful acceptance._

_Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations._

_Level Expert:_

_

  • Gains agreement on the problem-solving process, risk assessment, decision points, and criteria._

_

  • Trains others in the process of eliciting alternatives and assessing their impact._

_

  • Orchestrates the resolution of high-impact and cross-functional problems._

_

  • Successfully organizes problem solvers and stakeholders for high-impact problems._

_

  • Predicts and explains long-term trends and implications for alternatives._

_

  • Monitors industry for best practices and new techniques in problem-solving._

_Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Policy Compliance: Knowledge of Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies; ability to implement EHS policies to ensure that provided products and services are safe for people and the environment and in compliance with legal requirements and standards._

_Level Extensive Experience:_

_

  • Determines criteria for assessing vendors which may have potential environmental impact._

_

  • Formulates health and safety plans and policies, e.g. a fire safety plan and road safety policy._

_

  • Trains employees on HSE policy compliance and measures understanding._

_

  • Designs an incident report form and reporting procedures for EHS management._

_

  • Collaborates across multiple departments to facilitate EHS management._

_

  • Controls pollution and minimizes waste of materials, energy and water within the organization._

_Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice._

_Level Working Knowledge:_

_

  • Follows procedures in carrying out routine supplier management tasks._

_

  • Uses electronic systems or tools to record/retrieve supplier information and carry out transactions with suppliers._

_

  • Resolves routine supplier issues; escalates non-routine issues up chain of command._

_

  • Researches alternative vendors or suppliers; participates in supplier selection._

_

  • Works with suppliers to ensure that purchases meet delivery date and quality specifications._

_Plant Facilities Management: Knowledge of processes, methodologies and techniques used to manage plant facilities; ability to handle the full spectrum of activities for managing and maintaining physical facilities and infrastructure._

_Level Extensive Knowledge:_

_

  • Works with the installation, maintenance and upkeep for a large or multiple facilities._

_

  • Monitors environmental, safety and equipment requirements and conditions._

_

  • Participates in the development of change, contingency and back-up or recovery plans._

_

  • Deals effectively with customers and vendor support staff to resolve routine problems._

_

  • Manages space planning processes and establishes requirements for staff and equipment._

_

  • Monitors processes and procedures for developing and maintaining building security to ensure regulatory compliance._

job.title: AVP, Corporate Enterprise Identity Systems
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Make identity StarHub’s enterprise control plane: one canonical identity, Google Workspace / Cloud Identity as the workforce front door, planned AD retirement, and accountable governance of all identities.

Own the end-to-end identity roadmap across architecture, authoritative sources, migration, lifecycle and operations, enabling Zero Trust, AWS, M&A and safe AI adoption.

Accountabilities

  • Own the Identity-Led Enterprise strategy and 18-month roadmap, delivering approved scope, budget and milestones.
  • Own the canonical identity model (Global Person ID), authoritative sources and attribute precedence across SuccessFactors and legacy M&A sources.
  • Establish Google Workspace / Cloud Identity as the sole workforce authentication and SSO front door.
  • Retire AD as a workforce authority: inventory dependencies, then migrate, federate, retire or time-bound exceptions.
  • Govern privileged, non-human and AI-agent identities so privileged/autonomous actions remain attributable to an accountable human.
  • Implement CISO-set identity policy; BTS operates it, while the CISO owns policy, risk acceptance and exceptions.
  • Report status, risks and decisions to the CIO, ISLT and ICC, and own the Identity OKR.

Strategy & Architecture

  • Translate the Identity-Led Enterprise position paper into a phased architecture covering authoritative sources, canonical identity, Google front door, access enforcement, workload access and telemetry.
  • Define AD-to-Google coexistence, including event authority, JML and exit criteria for every AD dependency.
  • Select IGA/PAM tooling that supports the Google-first model without creating a second identity authority.
  • Set integration and onboarding standards for applications, AWS, endpoints, integration and AI platforms.

Delivery & Migration

  • Lead matrixed architecture, security, engineering, project resources and partners; control scope, sequencing, RAID and budget.
  • Deliver migration waves with identity clean-up, role/group rationalisation, orphan-account testing and validated deprovisioning.
  • Automate JML from SuccessFactors and approved contractor/guest workflows, including sponsors, end dates and revalidation.
  • Reconcile MyRepublic, JOS and Strateq under the canonical model using match logic, confidence thresholds, adjudication and merge/unmerge controls.

Governance & Controls

  • Separate standard and privileged personas; enforce named approvals, break-glass controls and quarterly access certification.
  • Maintain a non-human identity registry covering owner, purpose, environment, credentials, review and decommission trigger.
  • Enforce zero net-new unmanaged shared/generic accounts and reduce existing account debt to a published schedule.
  • Govern AI agents as non-human identities with approved purpose, data domains, actions and act-as/on-behalf-of modes, aligned to the IMDA Model AI Governance Framework for Agentic AI.
  • Feed GWS, AWS, endpoints and critical applications into the SIEM using common identity identifiers.
  • Provide audit evidence for identity controls, including CCoP and internal audit.

Qualifications

Team, Vendors & Stakeholders

  • Lead and develop the IAM Specialist across identity engineering, governance and controls.
  • Own the IAM managed-service vendor, including scope, SLAs/KPIs, reviews, change and commercial performance.
  • Retain StarHub design authority and control ownership; build internal capability and reduce vendor dependency under the IS Best Team insourcing strategy.
  • Partner with HR and application/platform owners on data quality, lifecycle, roles, approvals and provisioning.
  • Optimise Google/Microsoft licensing as AD retires; track business-case benefits and report realisation to Finance.

Areas of Impact

  • Zero Trust enforcement across the corporate estate.
  • Single-provider SSO and improved employee/partner sign-in.
  • AD retirement and associated Microsoft licence savings.
  • Fewer orphaned, shared and ownerless accounts and cleaner audits.
  • Safe, attributable AI-agent adoption.
  • Faster, lower-cost future M&A integration.
  • Move Identity from Legacy to Intelligent on the IS estate map by FY30, and Identity & Access from L2 to L4.

Ideal Track Record

  • 12+ years in identity and access management, security architecture or enterprise platforms, including leading at least one enterprise IAM programme end to end.
  • Has led at least one large directory migration or consolidation (for example on-premises AD to a cloud IdP such as Google Cloud Identity, Entra ID or Okta) in an organisation of several thousand identities.
  • Hands-on depth in identity lifecycle and JML automation, IGA, PAM, SSO / federation (SAML, OIDC, SCIM) and access certification.
  • Experience governing non-human identities: service accounts, workload identity, secrets and certificate-based patterns, ideally including AWS IAM.
  • Working knowledge of Zero Trust architecture and emerging identity controls for AI agents.
  • Experience reconciling identities across multiple HR systems or after mergers and acquisitions.
  • Has presented to C-level or board committees and won funding and decisions with clear business cases.
  • Delivers through a lean team and influence: managed-service vendors, system integrators and matrixed teams, with a track record of holding vendors to SLAs and outcomes.
  • Has coached and developed junior engineers or specialists.
  • Familiarity with Singapore requirements (CSA Cybersecurity Code of Practice, PDPA, IMDA AI governance) preferred.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, IDPro CIDPro, Google Cloud or AWS security) are an advantage.

job.title: Solution Sales Director, CyberSecurity
job.description:
Job Description

Primary purpose

Lead, plan, manage and develop a team of experienced Cyber Solution Sales specialists. The role provides pre-sales technical expertise to Account teams and customers, leads the team through the full sales cycle, and participates directly in complex cybersecurity opportunities.

The Director is responsible for short-, medium- and long-term plans that achieve the Cybersecurity business’s strategic objectives, using resources across the organisation to maximise revenue. The role also handles escalations and ensures customer satisfaction.

Current role emphasis

  • Lead Cyber Solution Sales specialists to achieve sales, revenue, order-book and margin objectives.
  • Execute the Cybersecurity GTM through an integrated SI + telco model.
  • Work with the Technology Services Tribe to support platform-led initiatives.
  • Collaborate closely with Enterprise Sales, other service lines, Delivery and Governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver the team’s revenue, order-book and margin-dollar targets.
  • Run sales forecasting, demand generation and deal-strategy development.
  • Maintain proper planning, monitoring and accurate revenue and order-book forecasts.
  • Coach, performance-manage and develop the Cyber Solution Sales team.
  • Engage customer stakeholders, including C-level executives, and lead negotiations and closure of large, complex deals.
  • Work with internal functions and external partners to develop and implement strategies, plans and business models.
  • Manage customer escalations and maintain strong customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in IT, Computer Science or a related field with at least 10 years’ cybersecurity sales experience across pre-sales, business development and/or account management within the telecommunications or IT industry.
  • ICT sales-management experience is preferred.
  • Experience selling Managed Security Services.
  • Proficiency in at least three relevant cybersecurity technologies, vendors or solution areas, including Palo Alto, Trend Micro, Check Point, McAfee, RSA, Symantec, Fortinet, Cisco, CASB, IAM, APT and SIEM.
  • Strong self-motivation, commitment and results orientation.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Independent, resourceful and collaborative, with a strong commitment to internal and external customer support.

job.title: Data Center, Contract Commercial Manager
job.description:
About the role

  • To own contract governance and contracting for a designated contract or line of business within CBRE Data Center Solutions (DCS)- Direct Line Business, making sure every agreement is issued on approved templates, reviewed, agreed, executed, and filed correctly.
  • The Contract Commercial Manager is the day-to-day contracting contact for the client and works with the operational team so that quotations are submitted in a form that allows contracts to come through cleanly and quickly.
  • The role operates within the commercial frameworks, templates, and delegations of authority set by the Divisional Commercial Director

What You’ll Do:

Contract Governance and Execution

  • Ensure all contracts, statements of work, purchase orders, variations, and change orders for the contract or line of business are issued on CBRE-approved templates and the agreed framework terms.
  • Review contract documents once issued by the client, checking scope, pricing, payment terms, and key provisions against the approved template, the agreed framework, and the quotation submitted.
  • Identify departures from the approved position and liaise with the client to correct them, escalating material deviations as required.
  • Manage documents through internal review and delegation of authority approval to execution, making sure the correct version is signed by the correct signatory.
  • File executed contracts and supporting records in the designated repository and keep the contract register complete and current.
  • Track key dates and obligations, including expiry, renewal, notice periods, insurance, and security requirements, and flag them to the business in time to act.

Client Liaison

  • Act as the primary commercial contact for the client on contracting matters for the assigned contract or line of business.
  • Build working relationships with the client's procurement, and contracts teams to keep documents moving and turnaround times short.
  • Resolve contracting queries and administrative issues, such as version control, missing information, or purchase order mismatches, before they delay execution or payment.
  • Attend client and account governance meetings where contracting matters are on the agenda.

Quotation Quality and Team Support

  • Work with operational and account teams so that quotations are prepared on the approved templates, reference the correct framework terms, and set out the scope, assumptions, and exclusions needed for a clean contract.
  • Review quotations before submission for compliance with commercial policy, pricing rules, and delegations of authority.
  • Give the team practical feedback where a quotation has caused contracting delays or disputes, and fix the process issue behind it.
  • Maintain standard assumptions, exclusions, and quotation guidance for the contract or line of business.

Commercial Policy / Procedure Compliance

  • Promote compliance with CBRE governance policies, procedures, and delegations of authority.
  • Maintain and advise on the use of standard documentation and templates, and recommend updates to the Commercial Director where templates no longer fit the work.
  • Check and challenge business processes for compliance, and report exceptions.
  • Provide accurate contract data for Business Reviews, audits, and commercial reporting.

Educate and Advise

  • Advise the operational team on contractual obligations, including scope, change control, notices, and invoicing requirements.
  • Deliver briefings and training on the quotation-to-contract process and the correct use of templates.
  • Raise commercial awareness across the team through day-to-day guidance and team meetings.

In-Life Contract Management

  • Administer change control and variations in line with the contract, making sure changes are documented and agreed before work proceeds.
  • Identify commercial risk arising in delivery, such as scope creep or work performed without a signed contract or valid purchase order, and escalate with options.
  • Support the Commercial Director on renewals, claims, and disputes by providing contract history, correspondence, and supporting documentation.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Contracts issued on approved templates, with deviations identified and resolved or approved before signature.
  • Contracts executed before work starts; no work performed without a signed contract or valid purchase order.
  • Contract review and execution turnaround times met.
  • Contract register and filing complete, accurate, and audit ready.
  • Quotations submitted in the correct format, reducing rework and contracting delays.
  • Key dates and obligations flagged in time; no missed renewals or notice periods.
  • Positive client feedback on responsiveness and quality of contracting support.
  • Operational team understands and follows the quotation-to-contract process.

What You’ll Need:

  • These are the capabilities we consider essential for success in this role.
  • Strong attention to detail, with the discipline to spot where a contract departs from the approved template or the quotation it reflects.
  • Sound working knowledge of services contracts, including scope, pricing and payment terms, change control, liability, insurance, and termination.
  • Organised and process driven, able to manage a high volume of documents through review, approval, execution, and filing without losing track.
  • Confident dealing with client procurement and contracts teams, and able to explain contractual requirements to operational colleagues in plain terms.
  • Sound judgement on when to resolve an issue directly and when to escalate.

Person Specification

  • The following describes the background our ideal candidate will bring. We welcome applications from those who are strong across most of these areas.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Working knowledge of commercial contracts in facilities management, Project/Construction -engineering services, outsourcing, or professional services environments.
  • Understanding of common pricing approaches, including fixed price, schedule of rates, and cost-plus, and how they translate into contract terms.
  • Familiarity with contract registers, document control, and contract lifecycle management systems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word (tracked changes and document comparison) and Excel.
  • Typically, 4-6 years in contract administration, contract management, or commercial roles.
  • Experience reviewing client contract documents against templates or standard terms and managing them through approval and execution.
  • Experience working with operational teams on quotations, pricing submissions, or tender documentation.
  • Experience liaising directly with client procurement or contracts teams.
  • Degree qualified or equivalent experience. A qualification in law, commerce, contract management, quantity surveying or a related discipline is an advantage.

Location:

  • Based in Singapore - HQ Office (Tanjong Katong, PLQ)
  • Office base role - 5 days per week

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

You will coordinate technicians, vendors and contractors; respond to faults and incidents; oversee planned and reactive maintenance; and help maintain safe, reliable and continuous site operations.

This role requires strong electrical, mechanical or refrigeration expertise, sound judgement and the ability to operate critical plant with minimal supervision.

Role Details:

  • 12-hour rotating roster: four days on and four days off, comprising two-day shifts and two-night shifts. The roster may be subject to change.
  • Requires site coverage across operating hours and flexibility to support planned works, incidents and business-continuity requirements.

Shift Leadership & Operations

  • Knowledge of permit-to-work systems and technical drawings
  • Experience with CMMS, BMS, and Microsoft Office
  • Strong troubleshooting and risk assessment skills
  • Excellent stakeholder and customer management skills
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Procurement Project Manager
job.description:
About Us

Macquarie Data Centres are Australia's most experienced Data Centre Provider and experts in seriously secure, sovereign and compliant data centres.

Our AI and cloud data centres are trusted by the world’s biggest hyperscalers, Global Fortune 500 companies and 42% of the Australian Federal Government. All our campuses are Certified Strategic by the Australian Federal Government and backed by a highly experienced cohort of government cleared engineers.

We are an owned by the ASX listed Macquarie Technology Group.

Step into one of Australia’s most secure, high-performance Data Centres and launch your engineering career supporting mission-critical infrastructure for cloud, defence and enterprise customers.

The Opportunity

We're building Australia's next generation of hyperscale and enterprise data centres, and we're looking for an experienced Contracts Manager to play a pivotal role in bringing these critical infrastructure projects to life.

Reporting to the Executive General Manager – Commercial, you'll be responsible for the commercial and contractual management of major project agreements from procurement through to execution and handover. You'll act as the central point of coordination across Procurement, Legal, Finance, Project Delivery, Engineering and our key vendors, ensuring contracts are commercially robust, compliant and executed seamlessly.

This is a highly visible role where you'll influence the successful delivery of multi-million-dollar infrastructure projects by managing long-lead equipment contracts, supporting main contractor engagements, administering commercial events and driving strong contractual governance throughout the project lifecycle.

If you thrive in complex project environments, enjoy negotiating commercial outcomes and want to work on some of Australia's most significant data centre developments, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

We're building Australia's next generation of hyperscale and enterprise data centres, and we're looking for an experienced Contracts Manager to play a pivotal role in bringing these critical infrastructure projects to life.

Reporting to the Executive General Manager – Commercial, you'll be responsible for the commercial and contractual management of major project agreements from procurement through to execution and handover. You'll act as the central point of coordination across Procurement, Legal, Finance, Project Delivery, Engineering and our key vendors, ensuring contracts are commercially robust, compliant and executed seamlessly.

This is a highly visible role where you'll influence the successful delivery of multi-million-dollar infrastructure projects by managing long-lead equipment contracts, supporting main contractor engagements, administering commercial events and driving strong contractual governance throughout the project lifecycle.

If you thrive in complex project environments, enjoy negotiating commercial outcomes and want to work on some of Australia's most significant data centre developments, we'd love to hear from you.

Why Us?

We're Great Place to Work Certified 2023, 2024 and 2025. Australia's #1 [Great Place To Work](https://www.linkedin.com/company/great-place-to-work-us/) in Technology, 2026. For the third year in a row, we have been named a Global Winner of the 2026 Gallup Exceptional Workplace Award! We have the highest Net Promoter Score on the ASX, the [World's best customer experience](https://www.businessthink.unsw.edu.au/articles/macquarie-telecom-tudehope-customer-experience) & [crowned in 2020 at the World Communications Awards](https://www.scoop.co.nz/stories/BU2010/S00476/macquarie-telecom-group-wins-best-customer-experience-in-the-world.htm). You’ll make an impact: Enjoy being part of a driven team with a collaborative culture that values decision-makers and action. We Invest in you: Accelerate your career through our learning and development opportunities - think Gallup strengths-based training, defined career pathways and fantastic internal mobility opportunities across the group.

About You

  • Extensive experience managing contracts on large-scale construction or infrastructure projects.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to negotiate favourable contractual outcomes while managing risk.
  • Confident working across Legal, Procurement, Finance, Engineering and Delivery teams to achieve common objectives.
  • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail and a passion for maintaining robust contract governance.
  • Comfortable managing competing priorities in fast-paced project environments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence senior leaders, contractors and suppliers.
  • A proactive communicator who identifies contractual risks early and drives practical commercial solutions.
  • Passionate about delivering projects safely, compliantly and on schedule.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Law, Commerce, Engineering, Property or Project Management.
  • 10+ years' experience in contract administration or commercial management on major construction or infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex contracts across procurement, negotiation, execution and contract administration.
  • Experience administering Australian standard forms of contract including AS4000, AS4902 and bespoke Design & Construct agreements.
  • Strong understanding of supply agreements for long-lead equipment and major construction contracts.
  • Proven experience managing contract variations, claims, extensions of time, payment applications and commercial correspondence.
  • Experience establishing and maintaining contract registers, governance processes and audit-ready documentation.

Collaboration and integration in the construction lifecycle process is integral to the role. Coordination and translation of requirements from Vantage’s internal subject matter experts ensures long term operational sustainability is preserved while driving towards optimized construction delivery. The Senior Manager, Project Delivery will manage the project delivery, along with external delivery parties (i.e., external PM’s, Quantity Surveyor, Architect and Engineers and consultants as required).

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the delivery of project activities including utility interfacing, budgets, schedules, procurement strategies and ECI interface.
  • Act as a leader with vision and drive coordination and integration of internal partners within the project.
  • Act as a safety leader while empowering a culture of safety, security and compliance in all aspects of data center commissioning and integration.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams such as NSD, D&E, Construction, Procurement and Critical Operations to deliver data centers.

Duties

  • To implement, and standardize as far as practically possible, Vantage-DC's highest standards of cost, quality and programme control throughout the design, build phase, commissioning and transition phases.
  • Lead, implement and review onsite safety management procedures to ensure compliance to all mandatory and industry standards. Lead safety management process in construction, design and handover to operations teams.

  • Identify, track and pursue opportunities to innovate design (in conjunction with the D&E team), de-risk programme, manage budget and project quality delivery.
  • Lead and coordinate multiple internal and external consultants for the design, construction and delivery of the data centers.
  • Assist in preparation of contracts in conjunction with internal legal counsel and procurement and assist with negotiating revisions, changes and additions to contractual agreements with architects, consultants, clients, suppliers and subcontractors.

  • Advise and maintain standards for monitoring design and construction programme, cost control and project information systems to ensure the successful project delivery in conjunction with the project controls support teams.

  • Ensure timely resolution of issues and deficiencies and develop and implement contingency plans to recover project costs and schedule slippage when appropriate.

  • Participate in a culture of team work and continuous improvement.

  • Ensure Vantage DC policies and procedures are followed.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science in Construction Management, Architecture, Engineering, or similar field, or equivalent experience
  • 10 to 12 years of experience in a management role required.
  • Complex and technical construction experience is required.
  • Data Center experience is preferred.
  • Experience in CSA (civil, structural, architectural) and/or MEP (mechanical, electrical, plumbing) construction management is a requirement.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and project management tools like MS Project or P6.
  • Experience developing executive level presentations.
  • Substantial project management experience preferred with PMP certification.

job.title: Tax Director (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role overview

STACK APAC is seeking an experienced, commercially minded Tax Director to lead its regional tax function. Based in Singapore and reporting to the CFO, APAC, the Tax Director will be responsible for tax strategy, structuring, governance and compliance across the Group’s operations in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.

This will be an individual contributor role working closely with local finance teams and regional finance leadership.

Key responsibilities

Tax strategy, structuring and advisory

  • Lead the development and implementation of the Group’s APAC tax strategy, aligned with the Group’s commercial, investment and financing objectives.
  • Advise on the tax-efficient structuring of investments, development projects, acquisitions, disposals, reorganisations, financing arrangements and intercompany transactions.
  • Provide practical, timely advice on cross-border tax matters, including withholding taxes, permanent establishment risk, treaty access, repatriation of profits, indirect tax and transfer pricing.
  • Support Legal and commercial teams in reviewing contracts, customer arrangements, procurement structures and other transactions with material tax implications.
  • Identify tax risks and planning opportunities arising from changes in legislation, tax authority practice, business operations and new markets.
  • Manage external tax advisers on material advisory, structuring and transaction work, ensuring advice is commercially focused, proportionate and implemented effectively.

Tax compliance, reporting and governance

  • Own and oversee the regional tax compliance calendar and ensure accurate, complete and timely filing, payment and reporting across Australia, Japan, Malaysia and Singapore.
  • Oversee corporate income tax compliance and provisioning, including current and deferred tax reporting, tax disclosures and coordination with the financial reporting and audit process.
  • Oversee indirect tax compliance, including GST, consumption tax, sales and service tax, stamp duty and other transaction taxes, as applicable.
  • Oversee employment tax compliance, including payroll taxes, fringe benefits tax, employee share plan tax matters, social security-related obligations and expatriate tax matters where relevant.
  • Lead the Group’s transfer pricing framework, including intercompany pricing policies, local-file/master-file documentation, country-by-country reporting where applicable, and implementation of intercompany agreements.
  • Establish and maintain a robust regional tax control framework, tax risk register, policies, documentation standards and governance processes.
  • Ensure appropriate tax accounting positions are taken, documented and supported, including uncertain tax positions and tax contingencies.

Tax authority, audit and stakeholder management

  • Lead tax audits, reviews, enquiries, rulings and disputes, working with local finance teams and advisers to resolve matters efficiently and protect the Group’s position.
  • Develop constructive working relationships with relevant tax authorities, where appropriate.
  • Act as the central tax contact for the CFO, senior leadership, external auditors, lenders, investors and advisers on APAC tax matters.
  • Present concise tax updates, material risks, cash tax forecasts and key decisions to senior management and governance forums.

Team, process and capability building

  • Build a scalable regional tax operating model, including clear ownership between the central tax function, country finance teams and external advisers.
  • Drive process improvement, automation and use of technology to improve the quality, efficiency and visibility of tax compliance and reporting.
  • Manage the tax budget and adviser spend across the region.

Experience and qualifications

  • 10+ years’ relevant tax experience, gained in a combination of a Big Four or leading professional services firm and an in-house regional or multinational environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of corporate income tax, international tax, transfer pricing and indirect taxes in an APAC context.
  • Demonstrated experience advising on cross-border structuring, financing, acquisitions, disposals and complex intercompany arrangements.
  • Experience managing tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, including tax accounting and audit processes.
  • Direct experience in Australia, Japan, Malaysia and/or Singapore is strongly preferred. Experience navigating tax matters in Japan and Malaysia, including working effectively with local advisers, would be particularly valuable.
  • Experience in infrastructure, real estate, data centres, energy, construction or another capital-intensive project environment is advantageous.

Equal Opportunity Employer

job.title: Insurance & Treasury Operations Manager (APAC)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Role Overview

STACK APAC is seeking an Insurance & Treasury Operations Manager to manage the Group’s regional insurance programme and provide hands-on operational support for its debt, hedging and treasury activities.

The role will be within the Finance team and work closely with Delivery, Operations and external advisers to structure, place and administer insurance coverage across the APAC platform. It will also coordinate debt drawdowns, maintain debt and hedge records, administer interest and swap settlements, and support the timely delivery of lender reporting and financing obligations.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role requiring strong organisation, commercial judgment and the ability to work across multiple jurisdictions.

Key responsibilities

Insurance programme management

  • Manage STACK APAC’s insurance programme across the region, including construction, operational, corporate and specialty policies.
  • Work with brokers to structure, market, negotiate, place and renew insurance programmes, including:

Construction All Risks / Erection All Risks;

  • Delay in Start-Up / Advance Loss of Profits;
  • Property Damage and Business Interruption;
  • Public and Products Liability;
  • Professional Indemnity;
  • Directors’ and Officers’ Liability;
  • Cyber, Crime, Marine Cargo and other project- or business-specific covers.
  • Prepare underwriting submissions, coordinate data collection, analyse quotations and policy terms, and prepare renewal and placement recommendations for management approval.
  • Review policy terms, limits, deductibles, exclusions, endorsements and programme structures; identify coverage gaps, overlaps and opportunities to improve the cost of risk.
  • Coordinate with internal teams on insurance requirements for development projects, construction contracts, colocation arrangements, leases, procurement arrangements and financing documents.
  • Support the review of contractual insurance provisions, indemnities, liability caps, waiver-of-subrogation requirements and other risk-transfer provisions.
  • Manage the notification, coordination and resolution of material claims, working with brokers, insurers, loss adjusters, legal advisers and internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate insurance records, including policy schedules, certificates, endorsements, claims registers, premium allocations, renewal calendars and insurer risk-engineering recommendations.
  • Prepare regular management reporting on coverage, premiums, claims, material exposures and renewal outcomes.

Treasury operations and financing administration

  • Maintain comprehensive registers of debt facilities, security documents, guarantees, letters of credit, hedging instruments and related financing obligations.
  • Coordinate debt drawdowns, including management of conditions-precedent checklists, collection of supporting documentation, preparation of drawdown notices and tracking of funds received.
  • Maintain debt-service calendars and coordinate the timely processing of interest, commitment fee, principal and other financing-related payments.
  • Maintain hedge registers covering interest-rate swaps and other hedging instruments, including notional amounts, maturities, reset dates, payment dates and counterparty confirmations.
  • Reconcile interest and swap payment notices against internal records and support the preparation of settlement instructions for authorised approval.
  • Monitor deadlines for lender reporting, compliance certificates, financial statements, project reporting and other financing deliverables; coordinate input from internal teams and external advisers.
  • Support debt-service and interest cash-flow forecasting, including reporting on near-term funding requirements and debt-service obligations.
  • Liaise with lenders, facility agents, hedge counterparties, banks, legal advisers and internal project-finance stakeholders on operational financing matters.
  • Support the preparation of management reporting on debt balances, liquidity, funding utilisation, interest expense, hedge positions and key financing obligations.

Experience and qualifications

  • 5+ years’ relevant experience in corporate insurance, insurance broking, treasury operations, project finance administration, banking or risk management.
  • Experience in infrastructure, construction, real estate, data centres, energy or another capital-intensive business is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience with commercial insurance placement and administration, claims management or contract risk transfer.
  • Familiarity with construction and operational insurance, including CAR/EAR, DSU, property damage/business interruption, liability and financial-lines coverage.
  • Experience administering debt facilities, loan drawdowns, interest calculations, lender reporting and interest-rate hedging is preferred.
  • Experience with insurance markets and practices in Australia, Japan and Malaysia is favourable; broader APAC experience is advantageous.
  • Degree in finance, accounting, business, risk management, insurance or a related discipline preferred.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines across jurisdictions.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical insurance and financing matters in practical commercial terms.

job.title: Team Member - FP&A - Planning, Budgeting and Business Performance Reporting
job.description:

  • Support the preparation of financial presentations, business review decks, and management reports for leadership discussions and decision-making.
  • Coordinate with business, finance, and cross-functional stakeholders to obtain timely information and ensure accuracy of reporting deliverables.
  • Maintain financial databases, reporting models, and planning templates while ensuring data integrity and compliance with established processes.
  • Analyze operational and financial KPIs to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improving business performance.
  • Support process improvement and automation initiatives by identifying manual activities, enhancing reporting efficiency, and adopting digital tools.
  • Ensure timely completion of reporting calendars, adherence to governance requirements, and compliance with internal financial controls.

Qualifications

IT

job.title: Senior Engineer - Testing & Certification
job.description:

Data Analysis and Performance Monitoring

  • Monitor condition-based data, such as vibration and temperature readings, to detect early signs of component wear and prevent performance drops.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Participate in internal training programs and knowledge-sharing sessions to enhance skills and contribute to team development.

  • Adhere to organizational ethical standards in data handling, analysis, and reporting, ensuring transparency and objectivity in performance assessments.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Proficient in data analytics, SCADA data interpretation, and applying continuous improvement methodologies to enhance turbine performance.

  • Strong understanding of API/data-product design, data governance, security, quality, provenance and SLO-based service management.
  • Strong cloud-native and container-platform knowledge, including Kubernetes/OpenShift, CI/CD/DataOps and infrastructure/platform automation.
  • Experience translating AI/analytics/automation use cases into reusable data and context capabilities, including RAG/agent context patterns where applicable.
  • Working knowledge of TM Forum ODA/Open APIs and information models, or equivalent telecom standards.
  • Strong technical leadership and ability to influence across teams without relying solely on hierarchy.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and negotiation skills across engineering, operations, architecture, AI and business teams.
  • Strategic and systems thinking with strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex data/knowledge concepts to senior stakeholders.
  • Product mindset, ownership and commitment to developing engineering capability and reusable solutions.
  • Network knowledge plane, ontology/semantic modelling, data-product management, Autonomous Network architecture and responsible use of AI context/data.
