job.title: Operation Infrastructure Solution Specialist (Malaysia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

The Position:

Reporting to the Senior Technical Operations Manager (Australia)

The Operational Infrastructure Solutions Specialist is responsible for the managing deployment, operation, maintenance, and controlled change of IT / OT infrastructure supporting STACK’s Australian data centre operations.

The role supports critical platforms and services including BMS, EPMS, data centre ICT systems, security applications, CCTV, access control, network infrastructure, server platforms, cloud-integrated services, monitoring systems, and associated management tooling. This will also include managing IT/OT changes into relevant environments and working with the Managed Service Provider (MSP) & CAB teams to ensure all implementations are smooth and without errors.

This is a hands-on technical role operating in a high-availability, customer-critical data centre environment supporting critical workloads with strict SLA, security, compliance, and operational resilience expectations. The role requires disciplined adherence to ITIL-aligned operational processes, CAB governance, approved Method of Procedure documentation, incident and problem management, configuration control, audit evidence capture, and operational risk management.

The role works closely with Critical Operations, ICT, Cybersecurity, Facilities Operations, APAC SMEs, MSPs, vendors, and customer-facing teams to ensure ICT/OT systems are secure, resilient, supportable, accurately documented, and changed only through approved processes.

This is a unique opportunity to join STACK Infrastructure at the early stages of the business growth in Australia and APAC, a fast-growing global Hyperscale Data Centre provider and leader. We are an energetic, collaborative and dynamic team offering a tremendous career opportunity in an organisation that values work life balance.

Areas of Responsibility:

  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather and analyse technical requirements and constraints for infrastructure projects.
  • Operate, maintain, and support ICT/OT infrastructure required for the reliable operation of STACK’s Australian data centres, including BMS, EPMS, monitoring platforms, security applications, CCTV, access control, servers, storage, network infrastructure, cloud-integrated services, and management systems.
  • Monitor ICT/OT system health, alerts, availability, capacity, performance, backup status, security posture, and operational risks, ensuring timely investigation, escalation, remediation, and documentation.
  • Ensure ICT/OT platforms remain resilient, supportable, patched, backed up, recoverable, and aligned with approved architecture and operational standards.
  • Prepare, review, and execute ICT/OT change records, MOPs, implementation plans, rollback plans, validation steps, stakeholder communications, and post-change evidence in accordance with STACK’s infrastructure regulations and governance.
  • Participate in CAB and emergency change processes, ensuring change risk, customer impact, operational impact, security impact, dependencies, and maintenance-window requirements are clearly assessed and approved before execution.
  • Ensure changes are executed exactly as approved, with deviations stopped, escalated, and documented in accordance with change governance requirements.
  • Participate in the 24/7 on-call roster and provide timely response for Severity 1, 2, and 3 ICT/OT incidents in accordance with defined response, escalation, communication, and restoration SLAs.
  • Triage, investigate, escalate, and resolve ICT/OT incidents in accordance with defined SLAs, OLAs, escalation paths, and major incident procedures.
  • Support major incident management, including technical investigation (RCA), restoration actions, communications input, evidence capture, incident timelines, and post-incident reviews.
  • Implement and maintain security controls across ICT/OT infrastructure, privileged access controls, secure administration, logging, monitoring and vendor remote access controls.
  • Maintain accurate ICT/OT configuration, asset, warranty, licensing, support, and lifecycle records in FreshService or the approved ITSM platform.
  • Design, develop and document IT/OT infrastructure solutions that align with STACK APAC architecture, security standards, operational support models, resilience requirements, and long-term technology strategy.
  • Recommend and execute improvements and solutions. Provide a clear resource planning and timeline for all OT related improvement projects. List and resource plans shall be fortnightly.
  • Manage MSP and vendor activities affecting ICT/OT infrastructure, ensuring work is governed through approved access, change, incident, security, and site procedures.
  • Managing and following up on Service Desk Tickets (OT related ones only) to ensure smooth operation of infrastructure systems, troubleshooting issues, and providing support to end-users using OT systems.
  • Maintaining tools and critical spare parts where necessary and keeping track within ITSM.
  • This role is a very hands-on approach role, and being an all-rounder is essential.

job.title: Maintenance Systems & Planning Coordinator (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Maintenance Systems & Planning Coordinator supports the safe, compliant and reliable operation of STACK’s mission-critical infrastructure by administering the Computerised Maintenance Management System (CMMS), coordinating maintenance schedules, and governing the change management workflow. This role chairs the weekly Change Advisory Board (CAB) to ensure disciplined process execution, while technical approvals remain with the ACOM and COM. The position ensures no conflicting maintenance activities occur across mechanical, electrical, controls and supporting systems and prevents excessive change stacking on the same day. The Coordinator also administers the rotating shift roster, annual/sick leave entries, and relief coverage planning to maintain continuous staffing for 24/7 operations.

This role directly supports STACK’s commitment to 100% uptime and a concierge-level customer service experience, ensuring risk is proactively managed, planned works are executed safely, and customer communications are clear, timely and professional.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Uphold STACK’s 100% uptime objective by maintaining accurate, reliable CMMS data to support operational decision-making.
  • Administer the CMMS system including asset hierarchies, PM schedules, work order creation, close-out documentation, service reports and evidence accuracy.
  • Ensure maintenance plans are reflected correctly in the 52-week schedule and updated promptly after changes, deferrals or engineering adjustments.
  • Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB), ensuring every submission meets STACK procedural standards (MOP/SOP/ITP, rollback, risk assessments, communication plans).
  • Maintain the Change Calendar, applying freeze windows, preventing high-risk clustering and ensuring changes do not conflict across systems.
  • Identify and prevent conflicts between maintenance and change activities (e.g., electrical + cooling + controls) to protect redundancy, safety and availability.
  • Ensure ACOM and COM remain the technical and operational approvers for all changes; accurately record decisions and required actions.
  • Link change records to the correct assets, PM tasks and work orders to preserve data integrity and operational traceability.
  • Track deferred changes, overdue actions, incomplete close-outs and escalate procedural non-compliance to the CFM.
  • Support vendor scheduling by ensuring all works are accurately recorded, do not conflict with site operations and include required compliance documentation.
  • Maintain audit-ready CMMS and change documentation for internal reviews, customer audits and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and issue weekly/monthly reporting: PPM compliance, overdue work orders, change volumes, risk categories, conflict flags, and CAB action closure.

People

  • Demonstrate professional conduct, clear communication and strong organisational discipline.
  • Collaborate closely with the COM, ACOM, and FM team to coordinate maintenance, change and scheduling activities.
  • Work with the CFM and HR to administer roster coverage, leave planning and Award-related tracking.
  • Maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring coordinated scheduling, document submission and compliance with STACK processes.
  • Support new starters with CMMS onboarding, change management process education and roster familiarity.
  • Promote teamwork and operational consistency across all shifts and disciplines.

Competencies

  • Strong understanding of CMMS/EAM systems, asset structures, work order flows and preventive maintenance programs.
  • High attention to detail with disciplined record-keeping and documentation control.
  • Ability to chair structured meetings (CAB), maintain accurate minutes and enforce procedural quality.
  • Scheduling and planning capability, with ability to detect and resolve conflicts between maintenance and change activities.
  • Clear communication skills for interacting with engineers, supervisors, vendors and operations leadership.
  • Proficiency with Excel for roster tools, coverage metrics and operational reporting.
  • Process-driven approach aligned to safety, compliance and availability.
  • Strong organisational discipline and reliability under time-sensitive conditions.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • Primarily Monday–Friday with occasional extended hours during high-activity periods or major change windows.
  • Participation in operational readiness reviews, maintenance pre-briefs, CAB meetings and vendor coordination tasks.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in mission-critical environments (data centre, hospital, utilities, transport, Defence or similar).
  • Experience administering CMMS/EAM systems and coordinating maintenance or change schedules.
  • Familiarity with operational change management workflows (CAB, MOP/SOP/ITP, PIR).
  • Exposure to technical systems (electrical, mechanical, HVAC or controls) is desirable but not essential. Engineering or trade background preferred but not essential.
  • Understanding of rostering, Award considerations and staffing coverage models for 24/7 operations.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.
  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements (as applicable), including right-to-work checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific area.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Officer, Cost Control
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Malaysia and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

This role is responsible for supporting the monitoring, tracking, and reporting of costs across the organization’s data center construction, operations, and capital projects. The Cost Control Officer will assist in maintaining accurate budget records, tracking expenditures against approved budgets, and flagging variances to support disciplined cost management.

This role is based in Jakarta and will work closely with Finance, Procurement, Project Management, and other internal stakeholders to support day-to-day cost tracking and reporting across projects and operations.

Key responsibilities

**

  • Track and record project and operating costs against approved budgets, updating cost tracking sheets and systems on a regular basis.
  • Assist in monitoring actual expenditure versus budget and forecast, and highlight variances to the Cost Control Manager or supervisor.
  • Prepare routine cost reports, cash flow updates, and cost tracking summaries for management review.
  • Check and verify vendor and contractor invoices and payment requests against purchase orders, contracts, and approved budgets.
  • Assist in preparing cost estimates and budget inputs for new projects, purchase requests, and change orders.
  • Support coordination with Procurement on purchase orders, contract values, and change request cost implications.
  • Maintain and update cost control registers, commitment logs, and accrual records to keep financial data accurate and current.
  • Assist with month-end and project cost reconciliation, ensuring records align with finance and accounting systems.
  • Compile data for cost analysis, benchmarking, and variance reporting as requested by supervisors.
  • Maintain proper filing and documentation of cost records, invoices, and supporting schedules for audit purposes.
  • Support internal and external audits by preparing and organizing requested cost data and documentation.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization's policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity.
  • Perform other cost control and administrative duties as assigned.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Quantity Surveying, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 1–3 years of experience in cost control, cost administration, or a similar finance/project support role; experience in data center, construction, or infrastructure projects is an advantage.
  • Basic understanding of budgeting, cost tracking, and project financial reporting processes.
  • Comfortable reviewing invoices, purchase orders, and basic contract documents.
  • Good numerical and analytical skills, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with ERP or project control systems is a plus.
  • Good communication skills and a proactive, organized approach to work.
  • Able to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluent in English and proficiency in Bahasa Indonesia is preferred.

**

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.

job.title: Associate, Project Engineering
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in 2020, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Head of Projects, this role will be responsible for supervising and coordinating all civil and structural works throughout the project lifecycle ensuring quality, compliance with design specifications, structural requirements, and critical infrastructure standards. This role demands precision, adherence to safety standards, maintaining tight timelines, and collaboration with multidisciplinary teams to deliver a mission-critical facility. This role will be based in Cikarang.

Key responsibilities

  • Site Supervision & Execution:

Oversee the civil and structural works including foundations, slabs, steel structures, and equipment support systems.

  • Ensure alignment with Digital Edge’s design specifications.
  • Validate method statements, shop drawings and ITPs.
  • Support the testing and commissioning as well as integrated system tests process.
  • Ensure that planned construction activities are carried out promptly in accordance with the project’s program.

Quality Assurance & Quality Control:

  • Verify compliance with the relevant local building codes, international standards, and project specifications.
  • Witness and conduct inspections on civil and structural works ensuring structural integrity and tolerance levels etc are as per design intent.

Coordination & Liaison:

  • Work closely with the project team, especially the MEP team to coordinate the MEP work.
  • Liaise with design consultants and contractors to resolve technical issues promptly.

Documentation & Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate records of site activities, material certifications, and QA/QC documentation.
  • Prepare weekly quality reports, and follow up on a timely manner to close out NCRs etc.
  • Prepare progress reports and highlight risks impacting critical path activities.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

**

  • Experience: 5-10 years in civil and structural engineering with site supervision (preferably with Data Centre or critical infrastructure projects).
  • Specific people skills: Good communicator, with site supervision experience, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Education level: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering or Structural Engineering.

Systems and Tools: Knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, MS Project, and other relevant software

job.title: Small Business Specialist, Canelands
job.description:
Canelands, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is proud to be one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, supporting over 11 million customers every single day with mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for an energetic, commercially minded Small Business Specialist to join our Canelands team. If you love supporting local businesses, enjoy solving complex challenges, and thrive in a collaborative team environment, this could be the perfect next step in your retail or business focused personal and career growth.

At Optus, we collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we grow, tackle challenges and build genuine connections with our customers, our communities and with each other.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Act as the Small Business subject matter expert instore, identifying business customers early and matching them with solutions that support their business growth.
  • Build and maintain strong capability across products and processes, including mobile, broadband, fixed services, credit and activation, plus share this knowledge with your wider team.
  • Deliver confident, consultative conversations by understanding business customer needs and providing tailored solutions that solve real operational challenges.
  • Mentor and support your team to spot opportunities, offer the right solutions and elevate the overall business customer experience across the store.
  • Stay up to date with small business updates, tactical offers and market trends, sharing insights through daily huddles, coaching moments and store updates.
  • Own business enquiries using calm professionalism and strong problem solving skills, while supporting operational excellence by managing compliance and merchandising requirements.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Business Savvy Outlook: You understand the needs of small business customers and enjoy helping them find solutions.
  • Consultative Service Skills: You ask the right questions, listen deeply and provide thoughtful, tailored recommendations that support business outcomes.
  • Product Expertise: You’re keen to grow into a subject matter expert across mobile, broadband, fixed services and small business care.
  • Mentoring & Collaboration: You share knowledge openly, support your teammates, and help build store capability so everyone can confidently identify business opportunities.
  • Calm & Professional: You manage complex and unique business enquiries with empathy, good judgement and a steady, solutions focused approach.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products, and exclusive discounts with our retail partners, making life easier and more affordable.
  • Supportive leave options, including an additional Connected Day to focus on culture, family, health, community or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer neutral paid parental leave of up to 14 weeks to support growing families.

job.title: Regulatory Escalations Manager
job.description:
Meta's Regulatory Escalations team sits at the intersection of platform integrity, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. As a Regulatory Escalations Manager, you will own the resolution of Meta's most complex, time-sensitive regulatory escalations across the Family of Apps - spanning government inquiries, content regulation mandates, and cross-jurisdictional compliance incidents. You will work at the boundary of human judgment and AI-assisted operations, translating regulatory complexity into decisive action and scalable workflows that protect Meta and the people who use its platforms.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate and resolve high-priority regulatory escalations end-to-end, including government inquiries, content regulation mandates, and cross-jurisdictional compliance incidents, ensuring timely resolution within defined SLAs
  • Coordinate cross-functional response strategies across Legal, Policy, Communications, Engineering, and other partners on escalations carrying regulatory, reputational, or legal risk, translating complexity into clear decisions and accountable next steps
  • Synthesize regulatory context, case findings, and risk assessments into structured executive-level communications that enable informed decision-making by leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Identify systemic patterns across regulatory escalations and surface root-cause hypotheses that inform upstream policy, product, and operational improvements
  • Design and iterate on AI-assisted workflows, decision trees, and runbooks specific to regulatory escalation case types, reducing manual handling time and improving consistency of outcomes
  • Critically evaluate AI-generated assessments and recommended actions on regulatory cases, documenting failure patterns and feeding structured corrections back into workflow systems
  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in applicable regulatory frameworks, including content moderation obligations and platform accountability requirements, to support rapid and accurate decision-making
  • Contribute to on-call coverage within a global team, maintaining readiness to respond to urgent regulatory incidents across time zones and outside standard business hours
  • Document investigation methodologies and resolution approaches for novel regulatory case types, building institutional knowledge that scales beyond individual expertise
  • Support peers through case reviews and real-time calibration on regulatory judgment, contributing to the team's collective capability and quality standards

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, escalations management, trust and safety, legal operations, government affairs, or a related operational field involving regulatory risk
  • Experience managing time-sensitive, high-stakes situations with sound judgment and the ability to drive resolution with minimal supervision
  • Experience synthesizing complex regulatory, legal, or policy information into clear written communications for varied audiences, including leadership and cross-functional partners
  • Experience building effective working relationships and collaborating across teams with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Active, daily proficiency with AI tools - including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and workflow automation - with the ability to critically evaluate and override AI outputs

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with structured AI evaluation practices such as prompt testing, failure mode analysis, or rubric-based quality review
  • Track record of identifying systemic issues from individual case patterns and translating findings into actionable recommendations for policy or process improvement
  • Familiarity with content moderation frameworks or platform accountability requirements across multiple jurisdictions
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience designing or improving AI-assisted workflows, decision trees, or automation that measurably improved operational efficiency or outcome quality
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Data Science - APAC - Product Analytics
job.description:
As a Data Scientist at Meta, you will shape the future of people-facing and business-facing products we build across our entire family of applications (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Oculus). By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to one of the richest data sets in the world, you will help define the experiences we build for billions of people and hundreds of millions of businesses around the world. You will collaborate on a wide array of product and business problems with a wide range of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Research, Data Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Finance and others. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve product development's biggest challenges. You will influence product strategy and investment decisions with data, be focused on impact, and collaborate with other teams. By joining Meta, you will become part of a analytics community dedicated to skill development and career growth in analytics and beyond.

Product leadership: You will use data to shape product development, quantify new opportunities, identify upcoming challenges, and ensure the products we build bring value to people, businesses, and Meta. You will help your partner teams prioritize what to build, set goals, and understand their product's ecosystem.

Analytics: You will guide teams using data and insights. You will focus on developing hypotheses and employ a varied toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, different methodologies, frameworks, and technical approaches to test them.

Communication and influence: You won't simply present data, but tell data-driven stories. You will convince and influence your partners using clear insights and recommendations. You will build credibility through structure and clarity, and be a trusted strategic partner.

Responsibilities

  • Defining new opportunities for product impact
  • Influencing product and sales to solve the most impactful market problems
  • Apply your expertise in quantitative analysis and the presentation of data to look beyond the numbers and understand how our users interact with our growth products
  • Work as a key member of the product team to solve problems and identify trends and opportunities
  • Inform, influence, support, and execute our product decisions and product launches in partnership with Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams
  • Set KPIs and goals, design and evaluate experiments, monitor key product metrics, understand root causes of changes in metrics
  • Exploratory analysis to discover new opportunities: understanding ecosystems, user behaviors, and long-term trends
  • Identifying levers to help move key metrics

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Statistics, a relevant technical field, or equivalent
  • 4+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python), and/or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R)
  • 4+ years of experience solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches, understanding ecosystems, user behaviors & long-term product trends, and leading data-driven projects from definition to execution (including defining metrics, designing experiments, and communicating actionable insights)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies

job.title: AI Research Scientist
job.description:
Meta's Fundamental AI Research lab is seeking a Research Scientist to drive foundational research aimed at advancing physical AI capabilities. We seek to generate advanced engineer designs such as robotic hardware, mobile vehicles, and novel semiconductors. This role will involve heavy software research engineering, such large-scale data manipulation and simulator integration.

Responsibilities

  • Explore and develop novel post-training paradigms for LLMs using reinforcement learning
  • Explore and develop novel LLM post-training recipes using 3D data
  • Integrate large-scale simulation into LLM post-training
  • Explore mechanical, aerospace, civil, and other engineering disciplines and how to enable LLMs to solve key problems in these domains

Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • Currently has or is in the process of obtaining a PhD degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Vision (3D), Physical AI, Machine Learning, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience. Degree must be completed prior to joining Meta
  • Research experience in at least one of the following research areas: reinforcement learning, representation learning, self-supervised learning, multimodal learning, robotics policy development, computer vision (3D), egocentric perception, embodied AI and/or LLMs, control theory, optimization algorithms
  • Experience in C/C++ and Python and deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proven track record of achieving significant results as demonstrated by grants, fellowships, patents, as well as first-authored publications at leading workshops or conferences such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AAAI, JMLR and Computer Vision (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, TPAMI)
  • This position will require knowledge of post-training for LLMs using reinforcement learning techniques. It will also involve novel modalities such as 3D and engineering domain-specific simulators, so computer vision expertise in 3D is welcome as well
  • Experience integrating and debugging prototype/scientific software-hardware systems including mechanical, aerospace, or civil engineering domain-specific simulation
  • Experience working and communicating cross-functionally in a team environment
  • Prior work experience in the fields of mechanical, aerospace, civil engineering or other engineering domains

job.description:
Job Summary

Leads projects for design, development and maintenance of a data and analytics platform. Effectively and efficiently process, store and make data available to analysts and other consumers. Works with key business stakeholders, IT experts and subject-matter experts to plan, design and deliver optimal analytics and data science solutions. Works on one or many product teams at a time.

Key Responsibilities

Designs and automates deployment of our distributed system for ingesting and transforming data from various types of sources (relational, event-based, unstructured). Designs and implements framework to continuously monitor and troubleshoot data quality and data integrity issues. Implements data governance processes and methods for managing metadata, access, retention to data for internal and external users. Designs and provide guidance on building reliable, efficient, scalable and quality data pipelines with monitoring and alert mechanisms that combine a variety of sources using ETL/ELT tools or scripting languages. Designs and implements physical data models to define the database structure. Optimizing database performance through efficient indexing and table relationships. Participates in optimizing, testing, and troubleshooting of data pipelines. Designs, develops and operates large scale data storage and processing solutions using different distributed and cloud based platforms for storing data (e.g. Data Lakes, Hadoop, Hbase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Accumulo, DynamoDB, others). Uses innovative and modern tools, techniques and architectures to partially or completely automate the most-common, repeatable and tedious data preparation and integration tasks in order to minimize manual and error-prone processes and improve productivity. Assists with renovating the data management infrastructure to drive automation in data integration and management. Ensures the timeliness and success of critical analytics initiatives by using agile development technologies such as DevOps, Scrum, Kanban Coaches and develops less experienced team members.

Competencies: Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.

Programming Principles - Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable.

Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.

Modern Development Practices - Applies modern engineering practices and tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC.

Solution Design - Translate business requirements into integrated designs, architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and align with enterprise standards and subject-matter platforms.

Demonstrating Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs.

Strategic and Innovative Thinking - Evaluates business and technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost-aware innovation.

Technical Passion & Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.

Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.

Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.

Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.

Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in relevant technical discipline, or relevant equivalent experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience: Intermediate experience in a relevant discipline area is required. Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in data engineering are highly preferred and includes:

  • Familiarity analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and/or data regulations
  • Background in processing and managing large data sets
  • Design and development for a Big Data platform using open source and third-party tools
  • SPARK, Scala/Java, Map-Reduce, Hive, Hbase, and Kafka or equivalent college coursework
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Experience developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment and other data extraction tools and methods from a variety of sources
  • Experience in building analytical solutions

Intermediate experiences in the following are preferred:

  • Experience with IoT technology
  • Experience in Agile software development
  • Experience with continuous improvement across cost optimization, performance tuning and scalability of Data Engineering pipelines.
  • Experience with enabling self service data engineering pipeline implementation capabilities for end users preferred.
  • Experience with using Co-pilot/AI capabilities to improve the productivity of Data Engineering pipeline development/testing activities.

Experience

5 to 8 years of experience in data engineering, with strong expertise in building and optimizing scalable data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and data integration solutions. Skilled in designing robust architectures that support advanced analytics, reporting, and data-driven applications.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Knowledge of the latest technologies and trends in data science is highly preferred.
  • Hands on experiences in the following are preferred:- Exposure to Big Data open source- Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Familiarity analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and/or data regulations
  • Understanding of AI/ML concepts and tools
  • Experience in ETL/ELT Data Engineering Technologies
  • Background in processing and managing large data sets
  • Design and development for a Big Data platform using open source and third-party tools
  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, and Spark (PySpark preferred).
  • Hands-on experience integrating with platforms like Palantir, Snowflake, Neo4j, etc.
  • Solid knowledge of machine learning workflows, model deployment, and advanced analytics (regression, clustering, time-series analysis).
  • Understanding of data governance, data cataloging tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Alation), and metadata management.
  • SQL query language
  • Clustered compute cloud-based implementation experience
  • Experience developing applications requiring large file movement for a Cloud-based environment and other data extraction tools and methods from a variety of sources
  • Take full ownership of the developed data pipelines, providing ongoing support for enhancements and performance optimization

Nice to have

  • Experience with graph data modeling and graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, TigerGraph) and familiarity with Palantir Ontology is a strong plus
  • Understanding of data governance, data cataloging tools (e.g., Azure Purview, Alation), and metadata management.

Additional Key Responsibilities:

  • Stay current with AI trends and suggest improvements to existing systems and workflows
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

job.description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join our high performing team in Carole Park, QLD.

In this role, you will complete repairs and rebuilds on engine products across all market segments (predominantly heavy diesel) in a service workshop under supervision

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Complete repairs and maintenance of heavy diesel products
  • Diagnose and repair engines
  • Disassemble, inspect, and clean engines and /or engine components
  • Engine rebuilding and reconditioning
  • Maintain work area and tools for cleanliness and proper operation
  • Assist with completion required documentation, such as work completed documentation, time sheets, warranty claims and quality forms, via handwritten forms or business system input screens
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health, Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to their supervisor

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • Rotational Shifts (Day/Afternoon)
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • Local Valid Drivers License

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Qualified - Heavy Vehicle Technician
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Basic level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Heavy Vehicle Experience preferred
  • HR License preferred

Critical Competencies:

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Promotes a proactive safety culture by identifying risks, driving safe behaviours, and supporting an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Diagnoses faults using structured troubleshooting processes, service tools, and technical information to achieve effective repairs.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Utilises electronic service tools to diagnose issues, interpret results, and determine appropriate repair actions.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Applies knowledge of engine and related systems to accurately diagnose and resolve mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Performs quality repairs and preventative maintenance in line with technical standards, procedures, and customer expectations.
  • Service Documentation - Accurately records service activities, technical findings, and repair outcomes in business systems.
  • Technical Escalation - Effectively escalates complex technical issues while maintaining clear documentation and timely customer support.
  • Values Differences - Recognises and values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences to strengthen team and business outcomes.

job.description:
Job Description

Position: Manager - Product Application Engineer - L1 Technical Support (East Zone)

Location: Kolkata

Reporting To: Regional Sales Manager

Position Summary

The L1 Technical Support Engineer will provide pre-sales and application support for Industrial Automation products including Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), Soft Starters, PLCs, HMIs, Industrial Communication, and related automation solutions. The role will serve as the first level of technical expertise for channel partners, sales teams, and customers across the South Zone, ensuring timely support, product selection guidance, application development assistance, and effective customer engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Pre-Sales Technical Support
  • Provide technical compliance evaluation against customer specifications and tender requirements.
  • Support product selection and sizing for automation solutions.
  • Review customer inquiries, specifications, BOQs, and application requirements.
  • Prepare technical comparisons against competitor offerings.
  • Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concept presentations.
  • Assist sales and channel partners in preparing technically compliant proposals.
  • Support technical discussions with consultants, OEMs, system integrators, EPCs, and end users.
  • Training & Technical Enablement
  • Conduct regular product and application training programs for:
  • Authorized Channel Partners
  • System Integrators
  • Sales Teams
  • Application Engineers
  • Develop training materials, presentations, and application notes.
  • Organize hands-on workshops and demonstration sessions.
  • Drive technical competency enhancement programs across the region.
  • Ensure channels remain updated on new product launches and feature enhancements.
  • Advanced Technical Support & Escalation Management
  • Act as first-line technical support for complex application issues.
  • Coordinate with service teams to resolve chronic and recurring field problems.
  • Analyze root causes of technical issues and recommend corrective actions.
  • Support troubleshooting of:
  • VFD applications
  • Soft Starter applications
  • PLC/HMI systems
  • Industrial communication networks
  • SCADA systems
  • Interface with product management teams for unresolved cases.
  • Maintain records of technical cases, solutions, and learnings.
  • Application Development Support
  • Support channel partners and system integrators in application development.
  • Assist in software configuration, commissioning logic, and application programming.
  • Support proof-of-concept testing and validation.
  • Share best practices and application know-how with customers and channels.

Key Deliverables (KPIs)

  • Technical inquiry response time.
  • Number of technical trainings conducted.
  • Channel competency development index.
  • Pre-sales support conversion rate.
  • First-time resolution percentage.
  • Reduction in recurring service escalations.
  • Number of application support cases closed.
  • Customer and channel satisfaction ratings.
  • Technical support coverage across South Zone.

Required Qualifications

Education

  • BE / B.Tech or Diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechatronics, or Industrial Automation.

Experience

  • Min 2 to 6 years of experience in Industrial Automation, Drives, Motion Control, PLC, or related fields.
  • Experience supporting OEMs, System Integrators, EPCs, or Industrial End Users preferred.

Technical Skills

  • VFDs and Soft Starters
  • PLC Programming
  • HMI/SCADA Systems
  • Industrial Ethernet & Fieldbus Communication
  • Motor Control Applications
  • Industrial Networks
  • Application Engineering
  • Electrical Drawings & Schematics
  • Automation System Troubleshooting

Preferred Knowledge

  • Water & Wastewater
  • HVAC
  • Material Handling
  • Process Industries
  • Food & Beverage
  • Metals & Mining
  • Cement
  • General Manufacturing

Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Customer-oriented approach
  • Effective presentation and training skills
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities
  • Technical documentation and report writing
  • Team collaboration and stakeholder management

This role is ideal for engineers passionate about automation technology, customer engagement, technical problem-solving, and application development.

What's in it for me?

  • Be part of meaningful work that drives energy transition and digital transformation
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including sales, engineering, and product experts

job.title: Senior Engagement Manager, AWS Strategic Industries
job.description:
Are you energized by leading complex technical programs that transform how organizations operate in the cloud? As a Senior Engagement Manager within Amazon Web Services (AWS) Professional Services, you will guide customers through their most ambitious cloud initiatives, turning strategic vision into measurable business outcomes. You will own the full lifecycle of large-scale engagements, orchestrating teams of technical consultants, customer stakeholders, and partners to deliver results that matter.

This role puts you at the intersection of technology and business strategy. You will navigate ambiguity, align competing priorities, and build trusted relationships with executives and technical leaders alike. If you are a collaborative, adaptable program leader who thrives on solving hard problems and helping customers realize the full value of cloud adoption, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of large, multi-workstream cloud engagements by creating and maintaining comprehensive project plans, defining quality standards, and aligning AWS, customer, and partner resources to achieve agreed-upon business outcomes.
  • Build and manage strategic customer relationships across technical and executive stakeholders, proactively identifying risks, clearing blockers, and driving timely decisions to keep programs on track — including redirecting distressed engagements toward successful delivery.
  • Facilitate release planning, workshops, and discovery sessions using multiple delivery and cloud frameworks (such as Agile, Waterfall, Well-Architected Framework, and Cloud Adoption Framework) to translate customer strategy into executable roadmaps.
  • Lead complex business and technical discussions, harmonize conflicting perspectives, and guide customers to define and expand on their cloud adoption strategy while identifying opportunities to maximize engagement value through scope and financial negotiations.

job.title: IT Solution Expert - SAP S-4HANA with AI Enablement Consultant
job.description:
**

Dear Aspirant!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

We are looking for: IT Solution Expert - SAP S/4HANA Finance & AI Enablement Consultant

Siemens IT is looking for a highly motivated SAP S/4HANA Finance & AI Enablement Consultant to join a globally connected team driving Finance transformation across Siemens. This role combines deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance with a passion for artificial intelligence, digital innovation, and intelligent automation. You will play a key role in shaping the future Finance landscape by leveraging SAP capabilities, emerging AI technologies, and modern enterprise architectures to drive business value at scale. This position offers the unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Finance transformation, SAP innovation, and AI adoption, helping Finance organizations become more efficient, data-driven, and future-ready.

You’ll make an impact by

  • Drive AI enablement within the Finance transformation landscape, identifying and implementing AI-powered use cases that increase productivity, automation, and business value across Finance processes.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on emerging AI technologies, helping business and IT stakeholders understand and leverage capabilities such as AI agents, LLMs, SAP Business AI, and intelligent automation.
  • Configure, implement, and support SAP S/4HANA Finance solutions, including system configuration, enhancement, and process optimization aligned with SAP best practices.
  • Contribute to Finance transformation initiatives within the SHERPA X Record-to-Report (R2R) workstream, specifically in the area of organizational restructuring and Finance transformation, supporting process harmonization and digital transformation across Siemens.
  • Support Finance transformation and integration activities related to segment reorganizations, company code consolidations, profit center realignments, and organizational structure changes, assessing impacts across SAP S/4HANA Finance and integrated MM and SD processes.
  • Evaluate opportunities to combine SAP and AI capabilities to create intelligent workflows, improve decision-making, and streamline Finance operations.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders across Finance, IT, and project teams to gather requirements and translate them into scalable SAP and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Support testing and change activities, including unit testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing, and deployment readiness.
  • Support financial period-end and year-end closing activities, ensuring stable and compliant Finance operations.
  • Document configurations, processes, and solution designs to support knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Stay current with SAP S/4HANA and AI innovations, proactively identifying opportunities to enhance Finance processes and user productivity.

You’re excited to build on your existing expertise, including

  • AI & Digital Innovation

o Demonstrated interest and practical experience in AI, digital transformation, and emerging technologies, with a proven track record of driving AI-related initiatives, pilots, or business use cases.

o Good understanding of Generative AI, AI agents, API connectivity, and enterprise AI architectures.

o Awareness of concepts such as Model Context Protocol (MCP), Knowledge Graphs, semantic retrieval, and modern AI ecosystems is highly desirable.

o Familiarity with SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP AI Foundation, or related SAP AI capabilities is considered a strong advantage.

  • SAP S/4HANA Finance Expertise

o 7+ years of SAP Finance experience, including at least 4 years in SAP S/4HANA Finance.

o Strong functional knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance modules, Finance processes, and end-to-end integration across the enterprise landscape.

o Proven experience in SAP S/4HANA implementations, migrations, or transformation programmes.

o Solid understanding of finance business processes and core accounting principles.

o Hands-on experience in Finance configuration, solution design, testing, and process optimisation.

o Experience with organizational restructuring initiatives such as company code consolidations, segment reorganizations, profit center realignments, master data harmonization, and the impact of organizational changes on Finance processes and reporting structures.

o Exposure to integration topics between SAP Finance, Materials Management (MM), and Sales & Distribution (SD) is beneficial.

o Knowledge of integration technologies such as APIs, IDocs, BAPIs, and middleware solutions is an advantage.

o Strong stakeholder management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills in a global, cross-functional environment.

o Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

This role is based in Pune, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 300,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We’re dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

Qualifications for the role

job.title: Proposal Specialist
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places, and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe.

job.title: Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Hardware Engineer, AI Cluster Commissioning, is a hands-on team player who will play a crucial role in ensuring the efficient deployment, test, and operation of our HyperCube systems. The ideal candidate will be involved in the commissioning and remediation of the latest AI cluster platforms including compute, network, and storage components, provide high-quality technical support, troubleshoot issues, and work with vendors and partners to resolve them in a timely manner. This role requires hands-on work in demanding data center environments, including equipment installation, hardware replacement, structured cabling, and physical infrastructure remediation activities.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the deployment, commissioning, and remediation of large-scale AI clusters comprising thousands of GPUs, high-speed networks, and high-performance storage systems.
  • Support site teams during commissioning, testing, and equipment setup.
  • Assist with system installations, modifications, and setup as part of the commissioning team.
  • Assist with network cabling and integration.
  • Diagnose server, GPU, storage, and networking failures.
  • Collect logs and diagnostic information, support technical teams during failure investigations, and assist engineering teams in identifying recurring failure patterns and root causes.
  • Perform component-level replacement and remediation.
  • Execute hardware validation procedures and acceptance tests.
  • Verify firmware, cabling, and system configurations.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Provide timely updates and technical support to project and operations teams, ensuring smooth collaboration.
  • Documentation & Reporting: Keep accurate service records, equipment logs, and submit required documentation promptly.
  • Safety & Compliance: Adhere to safety protocols.
  • Training & Development: Stay current on equipment, processes, and industry standards through ongoing learning.
  • Inventory & Quality Control: Maintain tools, spare parts, and equipment inventory.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Required

  • Diploma or equivalent, technical certification, trade qualification.
  • At least 3 years of relevant experience in a similar role, including hands-on experience with IT equipment maintenance and repair.
  • Good problem-solving and communication skills. Proven to be able to work effectively under direction.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, as required during system commissioning.
  • Must hold an unrestricted driver’s license.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with high-density GPU server and rack environments.
  • Experience with data center networking and structured cabling.
  • Experience performing hardware diagnostics and component replacement.
  • Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line troubleshooting.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift and move IT equipment.
  • Ability to work in data center environments for extended periods.
  • Comfortable working in confined spaces and around high-density equipment racks.
  • Willingness to undertake domestic and international travel for deployment and commissioning activities.

Employment Basis

Full-time

job.title: Data and Technology Lead, Large Customer Sales
job.description:
About the job

Businesses of all shapes and sizes rely on Google’s unparalleled advertising solutions to help them grow in today's dynamic marketing environment. You bring a passion for sales, knowledge of online media, and commitment to maximize customer success. You act like an owner, move with velocity through change, finding innovative and strategic ways to consistently deliver extraordinary and incremental outcomes for both Google and your customers. You build trusted relationships with customers, uncovering their business needs and translating them into powerful solutions to achieve their most ambitious goals. You achieve as a team with sellers, shape the future of advertising in the AI-era, and make a real impact on the millions of companies and billions of users that trust Google with their most important goals. Google's Large Customer Sales (LCS) teams are strategic partners and industry thought leaders to the world's leading brands and agencies. We continuously challenge how customers think about their business and how Google can support growth. We focus on helping these players navigate profound industry shifts and drive outsized business performance by competitively selling Google's full suite of advertising solutions across Search, YouTube, Measurement, and more. As a member of our LCS team, you'll have the unique opportunity to sell at the forefront of technology, collaborating with executives, influencing market-shaping strategies, and delivering tangible results that significantly impact major global businesses and drive the growth of Google.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to senior analytics, IT, and marketing decision-makers. Guide them through complex privacy, data protection, and security reviews to implement secure data-sharing setups.
  • Lead the strategic roadmap and business cycle for client-side signal foundations. Project-manage the implementation and adoption of privacy-durable infrastructure, including Google Tag Gateway (GTG), Enhanced Conversions (EC) for Web and Leads, and Google Ads Data Manager.
  • Partner closely with client analytics teams and internal Measurement leads to ensure data foundations are technically sound to support, fuel, and calibrate advanced media effectiveness models (including Media Mix Modeling (MMM), first-party econometric modeling via Meridian, and causal incrementality testing).
  • Identify repetitive technical bottlenecks and collaborate with product, engineering, and global support teams to build, deploy, or scale repeatable automation tools and frameworks across the market.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Android Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Android Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) manages the mission-critical infrastructure powering the global Android ecosystem of devices. The mission is to bridge the reliability gap between mobile and web platforms, building user trust through availability. We empower Product and Development teams to scale securely and seamlessly.

**

Responsibilities

  • Write product or system development code.
  • Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).
  • Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.
  • Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

job.title: Data Centre Plan & Spec Manager
job.description:
Build a career with confidence!

We are a global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

**

Role Overview

**The Data Center Plan & Specification Manager is responsible for driving early-stage influence with data center owners, developers, design consultants, and engineering stakeholders to ensure Carrier’s thermal management solutions are positioned effectively in project specifications. The role requires strong technical understanding of data center HVAC and high-density cooling requirements, including chilled water systems, air-side solutions, liquid cooling readiness, energy efficiency, redundancy, sustainability, and lifecycle cost considerations. The successful candidate will develop technical and budgetary proposals, conduct lifecycle and value-based analysis, and translate evolving customer requirements into differentiated plan and specification strategies.

Key Responsibilities Key Responsibilities

**

  • Build Strategic Industry Relationships – Develop strong partnerships with data centre owners, developers, consultants, engineering firms and key specification influencers across the region.
  • Shape Projects from the Start – Position Carrier solutions early in the design cycle, influencing concepts, specifications and tender requirements before projects reach procurement.
  • Engineer Future-Ready Cooling Solutions – Support high-density and AI-ready data centres with chilled water, air- and water-cooled chillers, liquid cooling enablement, CDUs and hybrid cooling strategies.
  • Turn Technical Expertise into Value – Develop compelling technical proposals, basis-of-design recommendations, lifecycle cost analysis and TCO solutions that address customer and project requirements.
  • Champion Sustainable Data Centre Design – Drive energy and water optimisation, PUE improvement, lower-carbon solutions, heat recovery opportunities and efficient plant design.
  • Stay Ahead of the Data Centre Market – Track hyperscale and colocation trends, consultant preferences, competitor specifications and emerging cooling technologies to strengthen Carrier’s market position.
  • Connect Strategy, Sales & Execution – Partner with sales, application engineering, product, factory and service teams while managing the project pipeline, specification progress and key opportunities across the region.

Required Competencies & Qualifications

  • Drive Consultant & Stakeholder Engagement – Build trusted relationships with data centre owners, developers, consultants, contractors and key technical decision-makers to position Carrier as a preferred cooling solutions partner.
  • Influence Plans & Specifications – Engage early in the project lifecycle to shape cooling strategies, equipment selections and technical specifications, supporting opportunities from concept through to order conversion.
  • Develop Mission-Critical Cooling Solutions – Translate customer requirements into reliable, scalable and energy-efficient HVAC solutions covering chilled water systems, airflow management, redundancy and high-density cooling.
  • Support AI-Ready Data Centre Design – Promote future-ready thermal solutions including direct-to-chip liquid cooling, CDUs, rear-door heat exchangers and hybrid air/liquid cooling architectures.
  • Deliver Technical & Commercial Value – Develop compelling technical recommendations and value propositions that balance performance, reliability, sustainability, lifecycle cost and commercial requirements.
  • Champion Sustainability & Compliance – Ensure proposed solutions align with relevant HVAC and data centre standards while supporting PUE improvement, energy efficiency and broader sustainability objectives.
  • Identify & Develop the Project Pipeline – Track market activity, consultant engagements and early-stage projects, identifying opportunities and supporting progression from specification through to award.
  • Collaborate Across the Region – Partner with sales, application engineering, product, factory, service and leadership teams across Asia Pacific and the Middle East to deliver coordinated solutions and share market and competitive intelligence.

Benefits

We are committed to offering competitive benefits programs for all of our employees and enhancing our programs when necessary.

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better.

This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!
