job.title: SaaS Technical Lead
job.description:
Job Description

Role overview

Lead the operations, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise SaaS platforms. The role is responsible for ensuring platform stability, security, compliance, and supporting migration from on-premise systems to AWS Cloud while leading a team of platform engineers.

Job Description

  • Lead and mentor a team of SaaS/Platform Engineers.
  • Manage day-to-day operations of enterprise SaaS platforms, ensuring high availability, reliability, performance, and SLA compliance.
  • Drive platform governance, including security, RBAC, compliance, audit readiness, disaster recovery, and vulnerability management.
  • Lead platform upgrades, patching, automation, monitoring, and continuous operational improvements.
  • Support and lead migration of legacy on-premise systems to AWS Cloud.
  • Administer observability platforms and tools (e.g., Splunk, Dynatrace) and their integrations.
  • Manage incident, problem, change, and release management, including RCA and service improvement initiatives.
  • Manage vendor relationships, software licensing, and support contracts.
  • Maintain platform documentation, operational runbooks, and knowledge base.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to align platform roadmap, operational priorities, and cost optimisation.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Enterprise Platform Engineering, SaaS Operations, IT Infrastructure, or System Engineering within medium-to-large or regulated environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing enterprise SaaS and on-premise platforms, including AWS Cloud and on-premise to cloud migration.
  • Strong knowledge of AWS (EC2, RDS, IAM, VPC), observability tools (Splunk/Dynatrace), automation scripting (Python/Bash/PowerShell), ITIL processes, RBAC, and security/compliance.
  • Experience leading or mentoring platform engineers, driving operational excellence, automation, and platform reliability.
  • Proven experience managing vendors, software licensing, escalations, and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders (Security, DevOps, Operations, Business).

job.title: Financial Analyst

Job Summary

The required expertise in this role is instrumental in maintaining financial discipline throughout the project life cycle, minimizes the risk of budget overruns, enhances overall project profitability and ensuring successful project delivery.

Responsibilities

Cost Estimation and Budgeting:

  • Development of accurate cost estimates for Data Center construction projects,

considering factors such as materials, labour, equipment, subcontractor costs, and overhead expenses.

  • Review quantity take-offs from project plans and specifications to determine quantities of materials required for construction activities.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders including Product, Design, Construction, Procurement teams to review project

plans, specifications, and scopes of work to ensure comprehensive cost coverage.

  • Develop project budgets based on cost estimates, ensuring alignment with client requirements, project timelines, and profit margins.
  • Monitor project budgets throughout the lifecycle of projects, identifying and

addressing variances and deviations from planned costs.

Cost Analysis and Control:

  • Support in establishing and maintaining cost standards/index for materials, labour, and overhead expenses.
  • Monitor pricing performance and conduct pricing reviews to ensure alignment with overall business goals and financial objectives.
  • Develop and implement robust cost control measures for project assigned to accurately track and manage project costs effectively without compromising quality and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and control project costs throughout the construction lifecycle, tracking expenses, analysing variations, and implementing appropriate measures to keep costs within approved budgets.
  • Conduct regular cost variance analysis to identify areas of cost inefficiencies and opportunities for cost optimization to improve project profitability.
  • Provide insights and recommendations to project teams on cost-related matters, including cost trends, cost drivers, and cost implications of project decisions.
  • Identify opportunities for value engineering and cost-saving initiatives, proposing alternative construction methods or materials without compromising project quality.
  • Assess the impact of design changes and contract variations on project costs, preparing change orders and cost estimates accordingly.
  • Prepare regular cost reports, including budget forecasts, cost variances, and cash flow projections, providing accurate and timely financial information to project stakeholders.
  • potential cost risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize financial impacts on the project.
  • Conduct periodic cost audits to ensure compliance with established cost control procedures, contract terms, and industry regulations.

Financial Planning and Forecasting:

  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of financial data related to construction

projects, including revenue recognition, cost accruals, and project profitability.

  • Collaborate with finance teams to integrate project cost data into financial

reporting systems and models.

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to costing and profitability
  • Provide insights into project financial performance, highlighting key drivers, risks,

and opportunities for improvement

Contract Administration:

  • Monitor and manage contract performance to ensure compliance with terms and conditions of contract.
  • Coordinate with project stakeholders to resolve contract related issues.
  • Provide guidance and interpretation of construction contract terms.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of contract administration related procedures and policies.
  • Handle contractual claims, disputes and negotiations related to contract changes or issues.
  • Liaise with legal counsel to ensure all contractual matters are addressed and resolved effectively.

Compliance and Continuous Improvement:

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance costing accuracy, efficiency, and effectiveness.
  • Support in identifying opportunities to streamline processes, automate tasks, and leverage technology solutions to optimize costing practices.
  • Stay abreast of industry best practices, regulatory requirements, and emerging trends in cost accounting and pricing.
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, industry standards, and company policies related to project costing, accounting practices, financial reporting and contract administration.

Requirements:-

  • Degree in Quantity Surveying/Cost Engineering/Construction Management/Mechanical Engineering/Electrical Engineering.
  • Minimum 5- 8 years of experience in cost control, quantity surveying, or project control within the industrial, construction or data center sector.
  • Experience with Indonesia, international or APAC projects.
  • Strong knowledge of cost control principles, techniques, and methodologies, with a proven track record of managing construction/industrial project costs effectively.
  • Proficiency in reviewing quantity takeoffs, preparing detailed cost estimates, and conducting cost analysis.
  • Solid understanding of construction materials, methods, and processes, with the ability to interpret project plans and specifications accurately.
  • Experience working with industry-standard cost estimating software and tools (e.g., CostX, RSMeans, Primavera, Excel) to perform accurate cost calculations and produce detailed reports.
  • Excellent financial analysis skills, including the ability to interpret financial data, identify trends, and provide insights for decision-making.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia (Chinese would be an advantage) to effectively collaborate with project teams, contractors, suppliers, and clients.
  • Meticulous attention to detail to ensure accuracy in cost calculations, reports, and documentation.
  • Effective teamwork and interpersonal skills to collaborate within Indonesia and international project structures.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a face-paced environment.
  • Experience in SAP or similar ERP solutions is advantageous.
  • Professional certification (e.g., RICS) is a plus.

job.title: Senior Manager, Finance
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the Senior Manager, Finance, you will report to the Senior Director, Group Financial Controller in managing statutory and management reporting, financial governance, accounting policy matters and business strategic projects across Australian jurisdictions. This will be a 6 to 8 month fixed term contract role covering parental leave.

You will play a key leadership role in overseeing complex accounting matters, guiding the AU finance team, and supporting strategic transactions and asset monetization projects in partnership with Group and regional stakeholders.

What You'll Do

Leadership and Team Management

  • Lead and develop the Australia finance reporting team, providing coaching, direction, and technical guidance to ensure delivery of high-quality reporting outputs.
  • Build capability and drive maturity in reporting processes, strengthening controls, timelines, and alignment with Group standards.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement within the AU finance function.

Statutory and Management Reporting

  • Oversee the statutory and management reporting obligations for all Australia entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with Group policies and AASB/IFRS.
  • Lead month-end close activities, ensuring key deliverables are met, intercompany balances are reconciled, and reporting packs are submitted on time.
  • Review financial results, identify variances, and provide commentary and insights to management and Group stakeholders.
  • Oversee the preparation and audit of statutory financial statements, managing external auditor relationships and ensuring smooth year-end sign-off.

Process and Transformation

  • Drive process standardization and improvement across AU reporting, focusing on efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Partner with Group Reporting and Systems teams to support automation and system enhancements for consolidation and statutory and management reporting tools.
  • Strengthen governance, documentation, and control frameworks to support sustainable reporting excellence.
  • Champion a continuous improvement mindset and lead initiatives that align with the Group’s finance transformation agenda.

Cross Functional Team Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cross functional teams; Group Reporting, Finance Operations, FP&A, Tax, Legal, Treasury, and regional Financial Control teams to drive alignment across deliverables.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement, proactive-problem-solving, and operational excellence within Finance.

What You'll Bring

  • Qualified Accountant (CA/CPA or equivalent) with 10-15 years’ experience in financial reporting, controllership, or technical accounting, preferably with multinational or high-growth organizations.
  • Strong knowledge of AASB and IFRS, with experience in accounting for complex transactions and preparing accounting position papers.
  • Proven experience in team leadership and coaching, managing small, high-performing teams.
  • Demonstrated capability in statutory reporting, month-end close, and audit management.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with Group, Tax, Legal, Treasury and external auditors.
  • Strategic mindset with a passion for process improvement, transformation, and team development.
  • Hands-on, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

**

Payroll expertise and governance

  • Apply expert payroll knowledge across multiple countries to guide operational decisions, resolve complex matters, and represent payroll in regional or global cross-functional forums.

Payroll operations, controls, and vendor delivery

  • Implement consistent payroll processes across the team, with standardized controls, documentation, calendars, hand-offs, and approval points.

People leadership and stakeholder management

  • Lead and develop managers, senior specialists, and team members through workload planning, coaching, performance management, and succession planning.
  • Manage team assignments based on business priorities, skill sets, development needs, and capacity.
  • Build strong partnerships with HR, Finance, Stock Services, global payroll teams, external vendors, and other stakeholders across APAC.

Issue management and risk ownership

  • Manage escalation resolution decisions for the regional team, ensuring alignment with internal stakeholders, external vendors, and compliance requirements.

Documentation, audit readiness, and budget management

  • Drive standardization of payroll processes, controls, SOPs, process maps, work instructions, and documentation across the team.

Transformation, projects, and continuous improvement

  • Identify automation-ready work and coordinate implementation across the region, while balancing project commitments with business-as-usual payroll requirements.
  • Prioritize improvement opportunities based on enterprise value, compliance risk, employee impact, and implementation complexity.

**

  • Expert understanding of regional payroll processes, statutory requirements, payroll controls, vendor governance, audit readiness, and multi-country operating models.
  • Experience leading payroll transformation, system implementation, process standardization, continuous improvement, or vendor transition initiatives across APAC or other multi-country environments.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence HR, Finance, Legal, IT, vendors, global payroll teams, and senior business leaders.

  • Strong understanding of compliance frameworks including SOX controls, internal audit expectations, data confidentiality, and payroll documentation standards.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, with high cultural awareness and the ability to lead across diverse markets.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, issue management, and risk assessment skills.
  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, automation, or continuous improvement methods preferred.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities III - Singapore
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Critical Facilities Engineer III supports the operation, maintenance, and reliability of mission-critical data center infrastructure. This role performs a broad range of maintenance and operational activities while applying technical knowledge and established procedures to resolve issues and support site operations. Working as part of a collaborative team, the engineer helps ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operations while continuing to develop expertise across critical facility systems.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on facility systems and equipment to support reliable operations.
  • Carry out repairs, inspections, and installation activities across facility infrastructure in accordance with established procedures and safety standards.
  • Monitor the Building Monitoring System (BMS) and respond to alarms by investigating issues and supporting resolution efforts.
  • Support the operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, plumbing, fire suppression, and life-safety systems.
  • Assist with energy efficiency and sustainability initiatives by identifying opportunities and supporting implementation activities.
  • Perform day-to-day operational tasks independently while seeking guidance on more complex or unfamiliar situations.

Vendor Support

  • Coordinate with vendors and service providers performing maintenance activities within the data center.
  • Support the work approval process, including pre-work briefings, monitoring activities, and confirming completion of work.
  • Ensure vendor activities are conducted in accordance with site procedures, safety requirements, and operational standards.
  • Assist in maintaining accurate technical documentation, records, and asset information.

Site Administration & Incident Support

  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, permits, logs, and records, including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs) and operational scripts.
  • Identify potential infrastructure risks and Single Points of Failure (SPOFs) and raise recommendations for review.
  • Respond to site incidents, equipment failures, and operational issues in accordance with established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations and documentation activities to improve operational reliability and resilience.
  • Apply operating procedures and compliance requirements to support safe and effective site operations.

Work Orders & Additional Projects

  • Complete operational work orders and support system installations related to facility infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot and maintain auxiliary systems and supporting equipment to minimize operational impact.
  • Support approved changes to mechanical, electrical, and specialized systems.
  • Participate in infrastructure upgrades, maintenance programs, lifecycle replacement initiatives, and site improvement projects.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement efforts that enhance operational performance and reliability.

Collaboration

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support operational activities and resolve facility issues.
  • Share knowledge and support team members during maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Communicate inventory and spare-parts requirements to maintain operational readiness.
  • Participate in training and development activities to expand technical capabilities and support career growth.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or equivalent qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent practical experience is also valued.
  • Typically 1–3 years of experience in critical facilities, facilities operations, data center operations, industrial facilities, building operations, or a related technical environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Understanding of electrical, mechanical, cooling, or building systems.
  • Familiarity with maintenance procedures, facility monitoring systems, and safe work practices.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
  • Commitment to safety, operational excellence, and continuous learning.

Work Requirements

job.title: Application Support Developer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, develop, test, deploy and maintain enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  • Translate business requirements into scalable, secure and maintainable application designs.
  • Support application integrations, APIs, databases and enterprise systems.
  • Ensure applications meet performance, reliability, security and compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with business users, project teams and technical stakeholders throughout project delivery.
  • Support application troubleshooting, incident resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of application architecture, coding standards and development practices.
  • Ensure solution documentation, technical specifications and operational guides remain current and accurate.

Core Responsibilities

1. Application Design & Development

  • Analyse business and functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
  • Design, develop and enhance web, mobile or enterprise applications.
  • Create reusable, scalable and maintainable application components.
  • Develop APIs, microservices and system integrations where required.
  • Ensure adherence to software development standards, architecture principles and best practices.
  • Participate in code reviews and technical design sessions.

2. System Integration & API Development

  • Develop and maintain application integrations with internal and external systems.
  • Build and support RESTful APIs and service-oriented integrations.
  • Ensure application interfaces are secure, reliable and scalable.
  • Support integration testing and troubleshooting activities.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, security and architecture teams during implementation.

Development references highlight enterprise software development, REST-based integrations, full-stack development, enterprise application platforms and cloud-native architectures.

3. Database Development & Data Management

  • Design and develop database structures, queries, stored procedures and reports.
  • Ensure data integrity, accuracy and performance optimisation.
  • Support database troubleshooting and performance tuning activities.
  • Work closely with data teams on data migration and synchronization requirements.
  • Ensure proper backup, recovery and security controls are implemented.

4. Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Develop and execute unit testing, system testing and integration testing activities.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and defect resolution processes.
  • Ensure applications meet quality, performance and security standards.
  • Assist in release testing and deployment validation.
  • Promote automated testing and quality assurance best practices.

5. Application Support & Maintenance

  • Provide Level 2 / Level 3 application support where required.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and perform root cause analysis.
  • Support change requests, enhancements and system upgrades.
  • Monitor system performance and recommend improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain system documentation and operational procedures.

Application support, system maintenance, production support and troubleshooting responsibilities are reflected across internal development references.

6. DevOps & Cloud Deployment

  • Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Participate in cloud deployment and cloud-native application initiatives.
  • Collaborate with DevOps teams on release automation and environment management.
  • Ensure applications are designed with scalability, resilience and observability considerations.
  • Support monitoring and incident management activities.

Cloud-native development, DevSecOps, microservices, CI/CD and automated deployment practices are highlighted within internal application modernization initiatives.

7. Documentation & Continuous Improvement

  • Prepare technical specifications, design documents and support documentation.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning and solution reviews.
  • Recommend technical improvements, development standards and process enhancements.
  • Keep abreast of emerging technologies, frameworks and development approaches.
  • Contribute to technical knowledge sharing and capability building.

Qualifications, Experience & Knowledge

  • Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant application development experience.
  • Experience building enterprise applications, web applications, APIs or mobile solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum or DevOps delivery practices.
  • Experience with modern programming languages such as:Java
  • C#
  • .NET
  • JavaScript
  • TypeScript
  • Python
  • Node.js

Experience with frameworks such as:

  • Spring Boot
  • .NET Framework / .NET Core
  • Angular
  • React
  • Vue.js

Experience working with relational and non-relational databases.Familiarity with cloud technologies such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud Platform would be advantageous.Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.Effective communication and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: DevOps Engineer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Key Accountabilities

  • Design, implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient application build, testing, release and deployment activities.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration and deployment using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible or equivalent.
  • Support cloud infrastructure operations across AWS, Azure or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Manage containerised application deployment using Docker, Kubernetes or related orchestration platforms.
  • Monitor infrastructure and application health, identify performance issues and implement proactive improvements.
  • Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment quality, system scalability, reliability and resilience.
  • Support incident resolution, root cause analysis, documentation and continuous improvement of operational processes.
  • Ensure DevOps practices are aligned with security, governance, compliance and operational standards.

Core Responsibilities

1. CI/CD Pipeline Management

  • Design, build, maintain and optimise CI/CD pipelines for application deployment.
  • Automate build, test, release and deployment processes to improve delivery speed and consistency.
  • Integrate source code repositories with deployment tools and quality checks.
  • Support pipeline troubleshooting, deployment issue resolution and release coordination.
  • Ensure deployment processes are repeatable, auditable and aligned with release management standards.

2. Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Operations

  • Provision, configure and maintain cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure or equivalent platforms.
  • Support migration from on-premises environments to cloud or hybrid cloud platforms.
  • Manage compute, storage, networking, security groups, load balancing and related cloud services.
  • Monitor cloud resource usage and support cost optimisation activities.
  • Maintain cloud infrastructure reliability, availability, performance and scalability.

3. Infrastructure as Code & Automation

  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation or equivalent.
  • Automate system build-outs, environment provisioning and configuration management.
  • Develop automation scripts to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
  • Maintain reusable infrastructure modules, templates and deployment scripts.
  • Ensure automation practices follow security, governance and documentation standards.

4. Containerisation & Orchestration

  • Build, manage and support containerised application environments using Docker.
  • Deploy and manage workloads on Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration platforms.
  • Support container image management, registry usage and deployment automation.
  • Monitor container platform health, resource utilisation and application performance.
  • Work with development teams to improve container readiness, scalability and resilience.

5. Monitoring, Incident Support & Reliability

  • Implement monitoring, alerting and logging solutions for infrastructure and applications.
  • Track system health indicators, performance trends and anomaly detection.
  • Respond to incidents, perform troubleshooting and support root cause analysis.
  • Document technical resolutions, operational procedures and lessons learned.
  • Recommend improvements to enhance system stability, availability and recoverability.

6. Security, Governance & Compliance

  • Apply security best practices across cloud infrastructure, pipelines and deployment workflows.
  • Support access control, secrets management, patching and vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Ensure DevOps processes comply with internal governance, audit and security requirements.
  • Maintain documentation for configurations, access controls, deployment processes and operational support.
  • Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to improve DevSecOps practices.

7. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with developers, infrastructure engineers, security teams and business stakeholders.
  • Provide technical input during solution design, deployment planning and production readiness reviews.
  • Recommend improvements to DevOps processes, automation frameworks and platform reliability.
  • Support Agile delivery practices and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Share knowledge, document best practices and contribute to team capability building.

Qualifications, Experience & Knowledge

  • Diploma or degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, system administration, infrastructure engineering or application deployment support.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI/CD or equivalent.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or equivalent.
  • Strong knowledge of Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform, Ansible or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes or container orchestration platforms.
  • Good understanding of Linux / Windows server administration, networking, security and cloud infrastructure concepts.
  • Experience with source code version control tools such as Git.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as CloudWatch, Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana or equivalent.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced technology environment.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical solutions clearly.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

'

job.title: Critical Operations Coordinator (Japan)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

As a member of STACK’s Operations team, the Critical Operations Coordinator supports the Critical Operations Manager in ensuring the smooth and efficient operation of a hyperscale data center. This role coordinates third-party facility management services, assists with administrative and vendor processes, and helps track budgets, maintenance tasks, and site improvement projects.

Responsibilities

  • Promote a consistent culture of safety across all STACK data centers.
  • Support the day-to-day coordination of facility operations and vendor activities.
  • Assist with scheduling and tracking preventative and corrective maintenance tasks.
  • Monitor and report general site conditions, escalating abnormalities to senior staff when needed.
  • Support implementation of site improvement and efficiency initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate records for preventative and predictive maintenance programs.
  • Coordinate training logistics and documentation for staff and vendors.
  • Assist with managing vendor relationships, service contracts, and performance tracking.
  • Support procurement activities, including obtaining quotes and processing purchase requests.
  • Track and verify invoices related to facility services.
  • Assist with site budgeting and forecasting by preparing supporting data and documentation.
  • Help draft and maintain standard operating procedures and checklists for soft services.
  • Coordinate with project and engineering teams to ensure construction and commissioning activities
  • Align with ongoing operations.
  • Maintain training records and competency documentation for on-site personnel.
  • Provide administrative and communication support for facility-related customer requests.
  • Assist with incident reporting and post-incident documentation.
  • Support internal and external audit activities by preparing and organizing records.
  • Coordinate soft services such as cleaning, landscaping, waste management, and office support.
  • Maintain inventory of office and facility supplies.
  • Use site management systems (e.g., CMS or BMS dashboards) to log and track operational data as directed.
  • Support after-hours or emergency response activities as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Competencies

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Positive and proactive attitude toward safety, teamwork, and customer service.
  • Basic understanding of facility systems (electrical, mechanical, and life safety) with a willingness to learn.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with vendors, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Reliable, punctual, and able to work independently once trained.
  • Adaptable to changing priorities and business needs.
  • Eager to participate in ongoing learning and development.
  • Commitment to upholding STACK’s standards for safety, operational excellence.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel is required for this role.

Required Education and Experience

  • 1-3 years of experience supporting operations, facilities, or vendor management in a data center or similar environment.
  • Familiarity with data center, telecommunications, or other technical or mission critical environment is a plus.
  • Experience administering and managing facility preventive maintenance programs.
  • Experience supporting vendor coordination and basic project administration.
  • Intermediate English communication skills (written and verbal).
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and standard business applications.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Technical or vocational training in electrical, mechanical, or building services disciplines.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience
  • Business-level English communication skills

Additional Eligibility Requirements

Must be willing to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays, and on-call support.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Lead - Fire Officer
job.description:
Lead Safety & Fire

Operational Management and Readiness:

Manage fire safety manpower, ensuring adequate staffing and readiness for all shifts.

Attend to all rescue/fire calls during the shift within premises and site.

Ensure the fitness and readiness of fire tenders, accessories, and other firefighting equipment.

Assist seniors in the performance of various fire prevention/firefighting duties, as required.

Communicate administrative/firefighting matters to the seniors, as needed and ensure effective communication systems from the fire station are maintained.

Check and ensure all outsourced fire staff or other contracting agencies are reporting for duty as per requirement.

Equipment and System Maintenance:

Maintain and check fire safety systems regularly to ensure efficient operations.

Conduct periodic and standard tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and breathing apparatus sets.

Responsible for the monthly checks and quarterly maintenance of fire extinguishers as per schedule.

Oversee the refilling of fire extinguishers and maintain records of occurrences and equipment status.

Ensure periodic tests of all fire station equipment, appliances, and BA sets during shifts as per station check sheet requirements.

Training and Campaigns:

Conduct Safety induction Training and vertigo test for new staff and workers of agencies and support in safety campaigns and participate in mock drills to prepare staff for emergency situations.

Conduct various EHS Training programs and track training data and ensure the completion of mandatory training hours as per CEA regulation.

Provide support and required information for investigation of near-miss incidents and incidents to identify root causes and implement preventive measures.

Conduct awareness sessions for agency workmen to reinforce safety standards.

Track and ensure monthly safety virus campaigns to highlight and mitigate potential safety risks.

Provide support for audits and inspections- daily, weekly, monthly to maintain high safety standards and continuous improvement.

Monitoring and Reporting:

Upload daily safety observations for the whole plant in GENSUITE.

Conduct weekly initiatives at assigned areas, prepare reports, and monitor compliance.

Ensure the display of safety signages to maintain awareness and compliance.

Manage the availability and usage of PPEs by staff and workers of agencies at the site as per service order.

Compile and report critical observations for fire safety of the entire plant.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department.

Conduct various audits and surveys, including night vigilance, dry grass survey, and critical area audits.

Ensure the safety of personnel and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols.

Release and monitor Hot work permits in the plant for its compliances.

Ensure adherence to compliances as per KRONOS.

Conduct stand-down meetings and conduct trainings for Rapid Response Team (RRT) members.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

All departments - Station/Plants

Key Stakeholders - External:

Audit Agencies

Contractors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (preferably in Fire Safety or Chemical Engineering) or related field and mandatory Advanced/Post Diploma in Industrial Safety or Degree (BSc/MSc) in PCM; MSc. in Chemistry + Post Diploma/Advance Diploma or B.Sc. in Fire Engineering/ B.tech Fire Engineering.

Work Experience (Range of years):

8+ years of experience in fire safety management and operations within the power or heavy industry sector.

Preferred Industry:

Power Generation or Energy sector

job.title: Director, Service Delivery
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company

Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to coach and mentor Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Associate Director, Service Delivery should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management

job.title: Principal Solution Architect
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

The Principal Solutions Architect in the IP SDN and Tooling team is the primary design authority for Optus's API-first, AI-assisted network automation platform. This role bridges commercial product engineering with zero-touch network automation. It is responsible for architecting the end-to-end automation stack to support Optus Business (EGW) growth, accelerating product development cycles, and securely migrating services from the Essential network onto the new IPM declarative pipeline. The role operates at the intersection of carrier-grade network design, intent-based modelling, and software engineering. You will lead the transition from manual, CLI-driven operations to a software-defined operating model, acting as an evangelist to upskill our traditional networking workforce.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and deliver the end-to-end automation architectures required to hit our program target of automating 80% of recurring IP changes by December 2027.
  • Execute the safe, at-scale migration of enterprise services (including NBN and fibre business services) off legacy networks and onto the new IPM pipeline.
  • Design scalable, multi-vendor abstraction layers (spanning Cisco, Ciena, Fortinet) to prevent vendor lock-in and protect commercial margins.
  • Embed NetBox as the authoritative source of truth for network design and inventory.
  • Translate Optus Business product intent (Carrier IP-Line, IP-VPN, MEF E-Line/E-LAN, SD-WAN) into structured service inventory models and executable automation workflows.
  • Serve as the design authority for Fixed Enterprise Networks automation, translating commercial product requirements into deployable network models (YANG, OpenAPI, JSON Schema).
  • Introduce and scale zero-touch service provisioning systems (such as Cisco NSO) and intent-based modelling, ensuring automated handling of custom customer specifications.
  • Actively mentor and upskill traditional network engineers, embedding a culture of software-driven network operations, CI/CD methodology, and psychological safety.
  • Ensure adherence to Optus engineering governance frameworks, TM Forum Open API standards, and IETF-aligned network modelling practices.
  • Design and validate solutions against non-functional requirements including availability, scalability, security posture, observability, and operational runbook coverage.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration between Sales, Product, Architecture, and Technology teams to accelerate time-to-market.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years’ experience building, scaling, and automating tier-1 carrier networks, ideally supporting commercial product portfolios (EGW/Enterprise & Government).
  • A proven track record architecting and executing large-scale, high-stakes network migrations (e.g., 100,000+ IP-Line links).
  • Extensive hands-on experience with Cisco NSO, zero-touch provisioning, and replacing legacy OSS stacks with agile automation pipelines.
  • Deep product architecture experience across Carrier IP-Line, IP-VPN, MEF E-Line/E-LAN, SD-WAN, and SIP Voice.
  • Practical experience establishing and enforcing NetBox or equivalent systems as an authoritative source of truth.
  • Multi-vendor network engineering expertise (Cisco routing cores, Ciena equipment, Fortinet SD-WAN).
  • Working knowledge of container-based delivery and modern software engineering practices (GitOps, CI/CD).
  • Demonstrated ability to build, motivate, and retain high-performing engineering teams within tight capital constraints.
  • A Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences.

We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

job.description:

Full time

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic and highly motivated Business Development Executive – Resources Sector, including Mining, Energy and Utilities to join our ANZ Sales team based in Perth. In this dedicated vertical role, you will be responsible for leading executive-level relationships, orchestrating portfolio growth, and managing the full sales cycle for large, complex enterprise accounts across the resources sector, including Mining, Energy and Utilities.You will own the overall account strategy to drive long-term revenue growth, client retention, and strategic solution adoption across top-tier resources accounts.

What You'll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Lead Account Management and Planning : Own overall account strategy, defining the vision, white space mapping, competitive landscape, and stakeholder mapping. You will also act as the quarterback for accounts, accountable for everything from opportunity identification to issue resolution.

job.title: Data Scientist, Product
job.description:
Meta is seeking a Data Scientist to operate at the forefront of product intelligence, shaping how billions of people experience Meta's family of apps and platforms. In this role, you will serve as a company-level expert in product data science, partnering with product, engineering, and business leaders to define strategy, uncover high-impact opportunities, and drive decisions that influence the direction of Meta's core products. You will pioneer analytical frameworks, experimental designs, growth strategies, and establish best practices that elevate data science across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the analytical strategy for complex, ambiguous product areas, translating business questions into rigorous research designs and measurable hypotheses
  • Develop and own advanced predictive and causal models that generate actionable product insights at scale, serving as an industry-level expert in model design and evaluation
  • Establish and champion organization-wide standards for data preparation, visualization, and self-service analytics interfaces that enable cross-functional decision-making
  • Synthesize outputs from statistical models, experimentation frameworks, and qualitative analyses into clear, data-driven narratives tailored to executive and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Identify and size strategic product opportunities by evaluating business impact, prioritizing across competing initiatives, and aligning analytical investments with long-term product goals
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, design, and operations partners to co-develop success metrics, monitor operational performance, and track trends that inform future-focused product strategy
  • Pioneer novel applications of forecasting, machine learning, and experimentation methodologies to solve previously intractable product problems and drive organization-wide adoption
  • Build and maintain production-quality data pipelines and analytical codebases, ensuring reliability, efficiency, data privacy compliance, and scalability
  • Serve as a recognized internal thought leader and trusted advisor across multiple product and business areas, influencing key leaders and shaping functional data science strategy
  • Mentor other data scientists and cross-functional partners by sharing analytical frameworks, reviewing methodologies, and developing shared tools and resources that raise the overall quality of data science practice

Minimum Qualifications

  • 12+ years of experience in data science, applied statistics, or a related quantitative field within a product or technology organization
  • Experience designing and executing end-to-end research plans including hypothesis formulation, data collection strategy, statistical modeling, and stakeholder communication for large-scale product decisions
  • Experience developing and evaluating predictive models, causal inference frameworks, and experimentation methodologies (such as A/B testing and quasi-experimental designs) at production scale
  • Experience writing and maintaining production-quality code in Python, SQL, or equivalent languages, including data pipeline development and statistical analysis
  • Experience influencing product or business strategy through data-driven narratives delivered to executive and cross-functional audiences

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Experience establishing data science standards, reusable frameworks, or self-service analytics platforms adopted broadly across an organization or business domain
  • Experience applying machine learning or advanced forecasting methods to product growth, engagement, monetization, or user behavior problems at internet scale
  • Experience partnering with product and engineering leaders to define long-term roadmaps and translate ambiguous strategic questions into structured analytical programs
  • Experience in causal inference techniques such as difference-in-differences, instrumental variables, or synthetic control methods applied to observational product data

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

job.title: Business Support Engineer - AdTech
job.description:
We are looking for an engineer to play a key role in providing technical, engineering support to Meta’s Advertising partners, Customers and clients globally. You will have the opportunity to work together with a global team of Business Support Engineers who are expert in Meta’s Adtech to provide proactive and reactive support for partner issues and integrations while partnering with our broad cross functional teams to ensure a high quality for our products and satisfactory experience for our partners and customers. We work directly with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve issues reported by our partners, to properly assess and agree on actions to be taken for necessary fixes and continuous improvements in our products and deployments.

As a Business Support Engineer working on Ads at Meta, you will primarily support on Meta’s Ads Products but also have the opportunity to work cross-functionally in several of our key business areas across Business Messaging, Telecommunications and combine your experience with customer service skills with a product focus to ensure that key insights are communicated to our product teams. We are looking for people who have subject-matter knowledge in managing and maintaining integrations with 3rd-party services, who help foster developer/business relationships, who demonstrate critical thinking & blending systems design with business needs, and who have a desire to improve the support experience of our customers. You will understand industry trends, partner solutions/integrations and their implications for our product roadmap. You will work closely with other regional offices and partnership teams to support a broad range of partners across the globe to integrate Meta’s Business Products into their offering.

Responsibilities

  • Provide proactive and reactive engineering support for partners, independently managing complex outages to ensure high partner satisfaction
  • Troubleshoot large-scale distributed systems and partner integrations, maintaining reliable systems through thorough debugging, root-cause analysis, and follow-up improvements
  • Leverage AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, automate repetitive tasks, and scale your impact with an 'AI native' mindset
  • Build, launch, and optimize AI solutions using Llama and other LLMs, owning the full lifecycle from prototype to production
  • Develop performance monitoring systems for partner integrations to ensure high availability; leverage metrics to proactively identify issues and drive improvements across teams
  • Provide 24/7 oncall support coverage via a rotation schedule (including weekends)
  • Collaborate with Platform and Infrastructure teams to investigate issues, align on fixes, and drive continuous product improvement
  • Create clear documentation, specs, guides, and presentations to communicate complex AI concepts to diverse audiences, scaling the team's knowledge internally and externally
  • Drive end-to-end execution, using sound judgment to manage stakeholder expectations and ensuring clear alignment. Develop and share AI/ML expertise, actively coach and mentor other engineers on technical troubleshooting and project executions
  • Proactively and independently analyze information to identify specific trends/opportunities, recommend appropriate and relevant tactical improvements, anticipate future business needs to improve the overall support experience, and share this knowledge across the team

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering or site reliability engineering or support engineering
  • Proven experience in API development on cloud-based infrastructures, with the ability to debug, identify root causes, and independently resolve outages impacting Meta partners
  • Experience with the full web stack, REST APIs, Python, PHP/Hack, and JavaScript/React development, along with debugging and bug management
  • Knowledge of fine-tuning and optimization of PyTorch models and with at least one LLM, such as LLaMA, GPT, Claude, Falcon, etc
  • Experience in communicating with technical and business audiences, and writing technical documentation
  • Experience in assessing, analyzing, and resolving operational issues using data analysis (SQL)
  • Experience in managing multiple concurrent projects and driving initiatives in a cross-functional environment
  • Professional working proficiency in English is required because this role involves close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external customers whose primary business language is English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Open Source cloud stacks like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, Docker containers
  • Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
  • Experience transforming data, model selection/training/optimization, and deployment at scale
  • Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies
  • Hands-on experience working with large language models and AI agents
  • Experience building and deploying solutions on cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Experience working in engineering environments with geographically distributed, cross-cultural teams and international stakeholders
  • Experience in partner-facing or customer-centric engineering roles
  • Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

job.title: Product Engineering Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions. Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress. Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team. Competencies:

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.

Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.

Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.

Skills

  • Strong understanding of ADS components like Doser, Mixers and/or fuel systems components.
  • Proficiency in 3D modeling tools (Creo) and engineering drawing standards (GD&T).
  • Knowledge of design tools and methodologies (DFMEA, DFM, DFA, DV&V).
  • Familiarity with Cummins processes (VPI, PPT, CPS) and tools (Windchill, RV&S).
  • Ability to interpret simulation results (structural and flow analysis).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Effective communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and product validation techniques.

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in CES products or Fuel Systems product lines
  • 8–10 years of product design and development experience preferred.
  • Experience in cross-functional design reviews and product lifecycle processes.

Job Engineering

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.description:
Job Description

Schneider Electric SE is a French multinational company that specializes in digital automation and energy

management. Schneider Electric is a publicly traded Fortune Global 500 company, the company posted revenues

of €34.2 billion. It addresses homes, buildings, data centers, infrastructure and industries, by combining energy

technologies, real-time automation, software, and services. Schneider Electric is the parent company of APC,

Aveva, L&T E&A among so many.

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy

of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage

switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes,

agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

Position Title: Manager – New Product Industrialization

Education: B.Tech ( Electronics) with 5 – 8  years of experience in DFM + FMEA + LabVIEW + PLC + SQL

Location: Vadodara

Key Responsibilities

  • PCBA Assembly & Process Engineering
  • PCBA Assembly Process Ownership:
  • Define, implement, and optimize PCBA assembly processes including SMT, THT, reflow soldering, wave soldering, and selective soldering to meet quality, cost, and throughput targets.
  • DFM / DFA & Manufacturing Support:
  • Review PCB designs for Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA), collaborate with design teams to resolve layout, footprint, and solderability issues before production release.
  • Production, Yield & Quality Improvement:
  • Analyze assembly defects (solder bridges, tombstoning, insufficient solder, component misalignment), drive root cause analysis (RCA), and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) to improve FPY and reduce rework.
  • Create LabVIEW applications for data acquisition, instrument control, and automation.
  • Design and develop electrical panels, including schematics and component selection.
  • Test and debug LabVIEW code and electrical panels to ensure functionality and performance.
  • Implement error handling and corrective actions for both software and hardware components.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to integrate LabVIEW applications and electrical panels with other system components.
  • Participate in design reviews and provide technical input to ensure seamless integration.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of LabVIEW projects and electrical panel designs, including block diagrams, wiring diagrams, and technical specifications.
  • Ensure documentation is comprehensive, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.
  • Conduct safety analyses and audits to ensure LabVIEW applications and electrical panels comply with relevant standards and regulations.
  • Perform regular audits to verify compliance and implement necessary safety measures.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to team members and end-users for both LabVIEW applications and electrical panels.
  • Conduct training sessions on the operation and maintenance of LabVIEW applications and electrical panels.
  • Stay updated with the latest technologies and techniques in LabVIEW programming and electrical panel design.
  • Conduct research and development to improve existing solutions and develop innovative new ones.

Functional Competencies:

  • Expertise in PCBA assembly processes (SMT, THT, reflow, wave, selective soldering) with focus on quality, cost, and throughput optimization.
  • Strong capability in DFM/DFA reviews, ensuring manufacturing readiness and first-time-right production.
  • Proven skills in production yield improvement, defect analysis, RCA, and CAPA to enhance FPY and reduce rework.
  • Proficient in LabVIEW-based test automation and electrical panel design, including schematics, integration, and debugging.
  • Effective in cross-functional collaboration, documentation, safety compliance, and technical support across the product lifecycle.
