job.title: Supply Chain Inventory Planner
job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Supply Chain Inventory Planner is responsible for ensuring the availability, accuracy, and strategic management of spare parts and materials required to support Schneider Electric’s Solar Utility Scale service operations. This role plays a critical part in securing service continuity for our customers by managing end‑to‑end order flows, optimizing inventory levels, and collaborating closely with regional operations teams. The Planner acts as the Supply Chain Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for the service organization within the assigned geographic area.

Key Responsibilities

Order & Fulfillment Management

  • Oversee the entire order management cycle, including converting purchase requisitions (PRs) into purchase orders (POs), tracking order status, and coordinating deliveries with the service center and service dispatcher teams.
  • Maintain clear visibility on all spare parts ordered for offline inverters and ensure strict prioritization to prevent customer production losses.

Operational Coordination

  • Act as the Supply Chain SPOC for the local service operations leader, service dispatchers, and service technicians.
  • Develop a strong understanding of preventive maintenance schedules, associated spare parts requirements, and inventory needs for corrective maintenance.

Inventory Optimization

  • Monitor and control inventory levels at the local service center.
  • In collaboration with business operations, establish and update safety stock parameters and replenishment processes twice per year for critical corrective‑maintenance spare parts.
  • Identify inventory excess and propose corrective actions to optimize working capital and overall warehouse efficiency.

Planning & Forecasting

  • Manage large‑volume preventive maintenance orders, ensuring they are placed up to one year in advance to provide a firm forecast signal to the factory.
  • Share regional operational insights with the Supply Chain Operations Leader and the SIOP Leader to support accurate forecasting and regional demand planning.
  • Ensure alignment between regional planning and global supply chain objectives and strategies.
  • Monitor production plans and collaborate closely with manufacturing sites—particularly the Bangalore factory—to ensure timely capacity adjustments and proactively drive production ramp‑ups when required.

Qualifications & Competencies

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning, Inventory Management, or Service Operations Supply Chain, ideally within industrial, energy, or field‑service environments.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, data analysis).
  • Strong data orientation with the ability to analyze and deep-dive into ERP systems (NetSuite / Oracle) to extract, validate, and interpret data.
  • Proven ability to generate reports, dashboards, and data-driven recommendations.

Behavioral & Communication Skills

  • Excellent communication skills, capable of building strong working relationships with service leaders, technicians, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational abilities, with a structured and anticipatory approach to workload.
  • Comfortable working under pressure, managing urgent priorities, and maintaining clarity and accuracy in execution.

Mindset & Problem-Solving

  • Proactive, initiative-driven, and solutions-oriented — not just an executor.
  • Demonstrated capacity to identify problems, analyze root causes, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable challenging the status quo and proposing innovative approaches to enhance processes and operational performance.

What's in it for you:

  • Btech Any

job.title: Associate Critical Facilities Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Associate Critical Facilities Maintenance Engineer is support the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and installation of critical facility infrastructure, including electrical, HVAC, mechanical, plumbing, cooling, fire, and life safety systems in data centers or other high-reliability environments. The role assists with preventive maintenance, monitoring, emergency response, work orders, asset management, and continuous improvement of facility operations while ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Candidates should hold a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field, with relevant technical certifications preferred. Experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, facilities maintenance, CAD drawings, or data center environments is advantageous. Strong communication, analytical, organizational, and teamwork skills are required.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Helps to design, plan, install, and/or maintain mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Learns by providing hands on assistance with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Supports the analysis of current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Supports with evaluating facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Learns the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Learns to repair all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Some understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Some understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Some knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Some knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Some knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Some knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field.
  • Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) preferred.
  • Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.) preferred.
  • Experience required:
  • Entry level experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Relevant demonstrated experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Relevant experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Relevant experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Entry level experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Head of Marketing, India, AWS , Field Marketing-APJ
job.description:
Amazon Web Services is seeking a senior marketing leader to define and execute the marketing strategy for India — one of the fastest-growing and most strategically important markets in the Asia Pacific region. This is a player/coach role: you will set the long-term marketing direction for India while staying deeply connected to execution across demand generation, Account-Based Marketing (ABM), events, digital marketing, and public relations.

As the Head of Marketing for India, you will be the single-threaded owner of marketing strategy, planning, and campaign execution targeting startups, developers, digital natives, SMBs, enterprises, and public sector customers across India. You will lead and develop a high-performing regional marketing team, drive orchestration across global marketing functions — including the Integrated Demand Centre (IDC), digital marketing, and events (Flagship and Cohort) — and deliver locally resonant programs that accelerate customer acquisition, pipeline growth, and brand awareness.

You will partner closely with the India sales leadership team, cross-functional marketing leaders across Asia Pacific & Japan (APJ), and global corporate teams to ensure marketing programs are tightly aligned to business priorities and deliver measurable impact.

The ideal candidate combines strategic vision with executional rigor, has a proven track record of building and scaling marketing functions in India's technology landscape, and brings a genuine passion for cloud technology and an entrepreneurial mindset.

Key job responsibilities

  • Create compelling, results-driven marketing plans, complete with market assessments that deliver identified objectives to the business
  • Overseeing implementation of the Marketing strategy for India - including campaigns, events, digital marketing, and PR.
  • Lead overall implementation of marketing programs including lead generation activities,

eMarketing campaigns, product & solutions sales support, reference programs, customer & developer marketing programs, etc.

  • Organize, assist and implement marketing events, including the AWS Summits, exhibitions, seminars, tradeshows and product launches.
  • Day to day management and development of the marketing team.
  • Work closely with the company’s Sales team; enabling them to meet their commercial objectives by providing them with appropriate tools, materials and presentations.
  • Develop and execute customer-driven, locally oriented marketing strategies and programs that will increase customer demand, sales, and positively impact Amazon Web Services brand equity.

A day in the life The Head of Marketing for India will be responsible for building and executing marketing plans that deliver customer acquisition and retention programs necessary to power AWS's continued growth in India. The role's core responsibility is to use a combination of strong strategic planning and hands-on execution skills to successfully plan, develop, execute, and measure demand generation programs that deliver marketing contribution to the sales pipeline. You will operate at the intersection of strategy and action — setting the quarterly roadmap in the morning, reviewing campaign performance data over lunch, and joining a customer event debrief in the afternoon. No two days look the same, and that's what makes this role exciting.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of team management experience
  • 15+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
  • Experience driving direction and alignment with large cross-functional teams and agency partners
  • Experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
  • Experience in leadership roles, overseeing teams conducting data analysis, process improvements, creative problem solving, and cross-functional collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in traditional and emerging media channels including TV, OOH, cinema, digital display, online video and paid social
  • Experience leading across multiple locales
  • Experience working cross-functionally with partner teams to drive adoption and usage of brand assets and messaging
  • Experience in strategic marketing management and market analysis and demonstrated ability to build and execute a strategy with clear goals and objectives to align to business and service objectives, and support portfolio objectives
  • Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
  • Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
  • Experience in B2B technology marketing, cloud computing, or SaaS industries
  • Deep understanding of the India technology and enterprise market landscape
  • Experience in traditional and emerging media channels including digital display, online video, paid social, and event marketing
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred

job.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support, ES – APJC-ASEAN
job.description:
The AWS Enterprise Support team is growing to meet the demands of a portfolio of always-on, latency-sensitive enterprise customers whose production workloads run across global AWS regions. As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the named technical point of accountability for some of the team's largest accounts — owning architectural guidance, operational strategy, and proactive support delivery end to end. The team is investing in three areas where you will have immediate impact: converting recurring support patterns into reusable automation and documented procedures, deepening technical expertise in databases, containers, networking, and capacity planning, and shifting the delivery mix from reactive case work to proactive resilience reviews, cost planning, and measurable customer outcomes. If you want to own a customer relationship where every interaction matters and your contributions raise the bar for the whole team, this is the role.

Key job responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end technical relationship for a portfolio of enterprise customers, advising on cloud architecture, operational strategy, and launch readiness across global AWS regions.
  • Assess customer environments for architectural risks and scaling constraints, then build actionable plans that maintain business continuity for workloads with 24/7 uptime requirements and unpredictable demand patterns.
  • Collaborate with account teams, Solutions Architects, and AWS service teams for compute, database, container, and networking services to resolve complex issues and drive product improvements informed by real customer patterns.
  • Analyze operational metrics and deliver periodic performance reviews to customer leadership, translating data into clear recommendations that strengthen security posture, cost efficiency, and system reliability.
  • Contribute to the team's shared knowledge base, standard operating procedures, and reusable automation, and mentor fellow Technical Account Managers to raise the collective capability of the group.

A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an operational dashboard for a customer whose traffic can spike without warning, then jump into a call with their engineering team — in Mandarin — to walk through a scaling plan for an upcoming product release. After lunch you could be partnering with an AWS service team to troubleshoot a networking issue that spans a complex multi-account topology, and later in the afternoon you present a quarterly architecture review to a customer's leadership, highlighting risks mitigated and opportunities ahead.

About the team We are a cross-border Enterprise Support team within AWS that serves enterprise customers headquartered in Singapore while their production infrastructure runs in global AWS regions. Our closest partners are the account teams and Solutions Architects on our shared accounts, along with AWS service teams in compute, database, container, and networking. As our customer portfolio grows and workloads become more demanding, we are looking for a senior engineer ready to take designated ownership of key accounts and help us scale proactive delivery through better mechanisms, deeper technical expertise, and shared tooling.

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of technical engineering experience
  • Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Proficiency in Mandarin is required as the role involves liaising with Mandarin-speaking clients/business partners/stakeholders/customers who predominantly communicate in Mandarin.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

job.title: Principal Strategist, Energy & Water Infrastructure, Energy & Water - Asia Pacific Region
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Principal-level strategic leader to define and orchestrate the energy and water regulatory and community strategy across the Asia-Pacific region. This is a high-visibility role that operates at the intersection of regulatory policy, energy markets, and community engagement, requiring industry expertise to shape the environment in which AWS deploys critical infrastructure at scale.

You will orchestrate regulatory and community strategy across interconnected pillars: energy and water regulatory strategy that informs advocacy and prepares organizations for changing policy landscapes; and community strategy that builds social license to operate and positions AWS as a responsible, transparent infrastructure partner. You will work closely with Public Policy teams and will serve as the external face of AWS energy and water infrastructure in APAC, representing the organization at industry conferences, in media engagements, and before regulatory forums.

Key job responsibilities

  • Regulatory Strategy: Own the APAC energy, water, and sustainability regulatory strategy; monitor and forecast policy changes across markets, and proactively shape frameworks before they crystallize.
  • Advocacy Direction: Set the strategic direction that informs Public Policy priorities; providing the technical analysis, impact assessments, and positions that determine where and how AWS engages regulators and industry bodies.
  • Regulatory Readiness: Prepare internal teams to anticipate and respond to changing regulations, translating regulatory risk into practical action.
  • Community Strategy & Social License: Own a proactive community engagement framework, treating social license as a critical path for infrastructure delivery, and mitigate sentiment risk through transparent messaging on sustainability, clean energy, and water stewardship

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
  • Experience communicating and presenting to senior leadership
  • 10+ years of experience in energy, water, utilities, infrastructure, regulatory affairs, industry strategy, or related fields
  • Experience working with external stakeholders such as regulators, government agencies, or industry bodies in one of the markets in Asia Pacific region
  • Track record of public speaking, conference presentations, or media engagement in energy, water, or sustainability
  • Comfortable representing the organization in external settings, such as industry events or public forums

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing and executing regulatory or stakeholder engagement strategies across multiple Asia Pacific markets
  • Background in data center infrastructure, cloud computing, or large-scale technology infrastructure
  • Deep technical knowledge of energy systems (grid operations, power procurement, renewable energy) and/or water infrastructure (treatment, supply, licensing, recycling)
  • Experience engaging with industry associations, advisory boards, or equivalent industry bodies
  • Experience developing community engagement strategies and obtaining social license for large infrastructure projects
  • Experience building coalitions across industry, government, community, and academic stakeholders
  • Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent in Energy Policy, Engineering, Environmental Management, Business, or related field

job.title: Backbone Technical Business Developer, APAC Backbone
job.description:
AWS operates one of the world's largest and most complex backbone networks, connecting Regions and Availability Zones across 190+ countries to deliver highly available, fault-tolerant, and scalable cloud infrastructure. Behind this global footprint is a network that must continuously scale to meet exponential demand while maintaining the highest levels of reliability and cost efficiency.

We are seeking a highly motivated Backbone Network Business Developer with strong commercial and technical acumen to join our Asia Pacific (APAC) team within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Development (GCID) organization. In this role, you will develop innovative solutions to scale and expand the AWS backbone network across the APAC region, operating at the intersection of network engineering, commercial strategy, and vendor management. You will be responsible for planning, sourcing, and delivering the network infrastructure that powers AWS operations and connects AWS to the rest of the world.

As a subject matter expert in the telecommunications marketplace, you will bring deep experience with vendors, physical network infrastructure, optical technologies, and backbone network engineering. You will drive end-to-end commercial and technical vendor strategy across the region, developing solutions for wavelengths, dark fiber, and submarine cable capacity. Partnering with capacity planners, network engineers, and finance teams, you will ensure the most efficient and cost-effective network topology is delivered on time and within budget. You will also track telecommunications market trends, evaluate emerging technologies, and apply a unique blend of industry and technical expertise to find creative solutions that meet AWS's ongoing growth needs.

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive end-to-end supplier identification, evaluation, and contracting for backbone capacity, wavelengths, dark fiber, colocation, and submarine cable infrastructure across the APAC region.
  • Develop and negotiate technical and commercial solutions that optimize total cost of ownership while ensuring long-term scalability, route diversity, and network resilience.
  • Build strategic backbone network plans and investment business cases aligned with long-term capacity forecasts, and present actionable recommendations to senior stakeholders for approval.
  • Organize, track, and coordinate across multiple suppliers and internal teams to deliver new backbone capacity on time, within budget, and in compliance with operational standards.
  • Partner with capacity planners and network engineers to design the most efficient and cost-effective network topology across longhaul, metro, and subsea paths.
  • Collaborate with finance partners on business case development, operational budget planning, and end-to-end financial tracking of projects and supplier commitments.
  • Track telecommunications market trends, emerging technologies, supplier diversity, pricing benchmarks, and commercial frameworks to continuously inform sourcing strategy and surface new opportunities.

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience working in a network planning, network construction/implementation, or commercial implementation role at an ISP, telecoms operator, or Hyperscaler
  • Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
  • 3+ years of experience in the telecommunications or network infrastructure industry, with a focus on solving complex technical and commercial challenges
  • Experience leading or contributing to the architecture, design, and deployment of large-scale network systems, with a focus on capacity scaling, reliability engineering, and operational readiness
  • Experience developing financial models, business cases, and investment analyses that drive measurable business impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of IP networking fundamentals such as BGP, OSPF and other R&S technologies
  • Experience working in large-scale backbone or long-haul networking environments, including terrestrial and subsea infrastructure
  • Strong knowledge of optical transport technologies, DWDM systems, fiber optic cable types, and network test equipment
  • Experience negotiating and managing contracts with telecommunications suppliers, including pricing structures, SLAs, and capacity agreements
  • Knowledge of the APAC telecommunications landscape, including key carriers, submarine cable systems, and regulatory environments
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to model complex trade-offs across cost, capacity, route diversity, and risk

job.title: Technical Account Manager - Strategic Accounts
job.description:
Technical Account Manager – Strategic Accounts

Siemens Limited is seeking an experienced Technical Account Manager (TAM) to drive strategic technical engagements and support business growth across the Renewable Energy, Green Hydrogen Ecosystem, Power, Data Centers, Ports and Cement industries.

The role will focus on understanding customer challenges, shaping integrated automation and digitalization solutions, and developing long-term relationships with key stakeholders, including End users and Consultants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive strategic pre-sales and business growth by identifying opportunities, shaping technology roadmaps and supporting sales teams to achieve profitable growth and expand Siemens’ footprint across assigned key accounts.
  • Act as the strategic technical advisor to key customers, building trusted relationships with technical, business and CxO-level stakeholders and providing thought leadership on industry trends, technology adoption and business challenges.
  • Engage early in project lifecycles to understand customer requirements, project scope and business objectives, and develop integrated strategies covering Instrumentation, Drives, Automation, Digitalization, AI and Cybersecurity.
  • Influence specifications and vendor selection, establish Siemens as an approved/preferred technology partner, and strengthen Siemens’ positioning with End Users and Consultants
  • Co-create digital transformation roadmaps with customers, supported by relevant value propositions, real use cases and scalable technology solutions.
  • Understand the complete scope of the project and position the possible portfolio elements by engaging with multiple stakeholders and stitching the data-fabric across systems to provide unified view of the operations to End-users / Consultant as a differentiator
  • Lead technical discussions, discovery workshops, solution workshops, customer presentations, demonstrations, PoCs and technical training to accelerate opportunity development and conversion.
  • Develop optimized technical proposals, system architectures and BoMs, balancing customer requirements, technical compliance, solution value and commercial competitiveness, in close coordination with Sales and relevant stakeholders.
  • Fully understand the portfolio (Instrumentation, VFDs, Automation, Digitalization & AI and Cybersecurity) and effectively use available opportunities to articulate Siemens’ value-added propositions and create sustainable business growth
  • Collaborate with Sales teams, technical experts, channel partners, consultants and end users to align strategies, qualify opportunities and accelerate deal closure.
  • Maintain a strong opportunity pipeline and forecast in alignment with the Sales organization and actively contribute to opportunity conversion and target achievement.
  • Analyzing markets, customer needs, technology trends and competing portfolios to identify strategic opportunities, value creation, support to do pilot project and scale

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Engineering (Electronics / Electrical / Instrumentation & Control / Information Technology); postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  • 10+ years of practical experience in Industrial Automation; Proven track records of 6+ years of experience in Technical Sales / Pre-sales, supported as Solution Consultant for Industrial Automation systems
  • Experience in consultative selling, solution development and strategic account engagement, including interaction with senior technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong experience in developing and articulating Digital Transformation roadmaps, value propositions and industry-specific use cases.
  • Expertise and deep understanding of Renewable Energy, Green Hydrogen Ecosystem, Power, Data Centers, Cement and Ports, with proven experience working with large End users, Consultants across complex industrial projects.
  • Strong technical knowledge of Instrumentation, VFDs/Drives, PLC, SCADA, DCS and Industrial Communication.
  • Good understanding of IT/OT integration, Industrial Digitalization, IIoT, Industrial AI and Cybersecurity.
  • Ability to develop solution concepts, system architectures, technical proposals and optimized BoMs, translating technical solutions into tangible customer and business value.
  • Strong analytical and systemic problem-solving skills with a clear passion for addressing business needs & add new dimensions to the strategy
  • A winning combination of engineering experience and strong interpersonal skills: you communicate clearly, listen carefully, present convincingly, and influence stakeholders at every level up to C-suite executives.
  • The ability to collaborate across functions, manage several bids or opportunities simultaneously
  • This role requires travelling to customer locations across India for meetings & account development activities

job.title: Compressor Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: Compressor Service Engineer

Objective: To perform efficient troubleshooting, maintenance, overhauling, testing, and commissioning of HVAC compressors, including screw, centrifugal, and magnetic bearing compressors, ensuring maximum equipment reliability, operational efficiency, customer satisfaction, and adherence to quality and safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities Compressor Overhauling & Repair

Establish and lead a world-class HVAC Compressor Overhaul & Service Center capable of independently handling Screw, Centrifugal, and Magnetic Bearing Compressors through development of overhaul processes, troubleshooting expertise, tools & test facilities, technical documentation, spare part management, and customer support, ensuring high equipment reliability, reduced turnaround time, and superior service quality.

Perform complete dismantling, inspection, overhauling, and assembly of: o Oil Flooded Screw Compressors o Centrifugal Compressors o Magnetic Bearing Oil-Free Compressors

Conduct detailed inspection of: o Rotors o Impellers o Diffusers o Bearings o Shafts o Couplings o Seals o Motor components

Measure critical dimensions and clearances using precision instruments.

Prepare inspection reports with recommendations for component repair or replacement.

Execute compressor rebuilding as per OEM standards. Magnetic Bearing Compressor Expertise

Diagnose and troubleshoot magnetic bearing systems.

Understand operation of: o Active Magnetic Bearings (AMB) o Variable Speed Drives (VSD) o Position Sensors o Magnetic Bearing Controller Systems

Perform health checks and analysis of magnetic bearing compressor data logs.

Support commissioning and fault diagnosis of oil-free centrifugal chillers. Troubleshooting & Failure Analysis

Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for: o Bearing failures o Rotor damage o Surge conditions o High vibration o Motor failures o Refrigerant leakage o Oil contamination. Analyze vibration spectra and performance parameters.

Develop corrective and preventive action plans. Assembly, Testing & Commissioning

Precision assembly of compressor rotating components.

Rotor runout and clearance verification.

Alignment and balancing activities.

Witness and perform: o Leak Tests o Hydro Tests o Pneumatic Tests o Mechanical Run Tests o Performance Tests

Support commissioning and startup of chillers and compressor packages. Field Service Activities

Attend customer sites during planned shutdowns and emergency breakdowns. Execute annual maintenance contracts (AMC) and preventive maintenance activities.

Prepare service reports and customer recommendations.

Provide technical guidance to service technicians and customers. Required

Qualifications

Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

Minimum 7 ~9 years hands-on experience in HVAC compressor overhaul.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead the commissioning and operational readiness of large-scale AI cluster deployments. This role is responsible for planning, coordinating, and managing all commissioning activities from installation of compute, network, and storage components through cluster integration, phased bring-up, validation testing, benchmarking, acceptance testing, and transition to operations.

Working across internal engineering teams, operations, facilities, suppliers, and technology partners, the Project Manager will ensure that complex AI infrastructure systems are delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with defined performance and reliability requirements.

The successful candidate will have strong experience in large scale IT/HPC/AI/hyperscale projects, with the ability to manage multiple teams, vendors, and partners, technical packages, and complex project schedules to ensure successful delivery of critical environments.

This role combines project management, stakeholder management, and technical commissioning leadership for some of the world's most advanced AI computing environments.

Key Responsibilities

AI Cluster Commissioning

  • Manage the deployment and commissioning of large-scale AI clusters including compute, network, storage systems, integration with power and cooling systems, bring-up, component and system testing, benchmarking, and acceptance testing.
  • Manage internal teams as well as vendors and partners responsible for hardware deployment, executing defined test plans, remediation work, and acceptance testing.
  • Coordinate closely with infrastructure teams to ensure readiness of power, cooling, and network connectivity prior to and during commissioning.
  • Ensure commissioning follows the defined processes and executes the planned schedule for successful and on-time delivery of the project.
  • Success in this role is measured by delivery of fully commissioned AI clusters meeting performance, reliability, schedule, safety, and operational acceptance requirements.

Vendor and Partner Management

  • Manage relationships with suppliers, contractors, partners, and internal stakeholders delivering various technical work packages.
  • Review and manage project schedules, Statements of Work (SOWs), resource plans, and deliverables.
  • Monitor vendor performance against schedule, budget, quality, safety, and contractual requirements.
  • Coordinate activities across multiple teams and resolve dependencies, conflicts, and execution risks.
  • Ensure supplier deliverables meet project objectives, technical requirements, and operational readiness standards.

Project Planning & Controls

  • Develop and maintain integrated project schedules for AI cluster deployment and commissioning activities.
  • Identify project risks, dependencies, and constraints and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Lead issue management, escalation processes, and recovery planning when required.
  • Monitor project progress against key milestones and coordinate corrective actions where necessary.
  • Provide regular reporting, forecasts, and status updates to senior leadership and stakeholders.
  • Support project budget tracking, forecasting, scope management, and change control processes.
  • Ensure project documentation is maintained, organized, and communicated appropriately throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Project Management, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of project management experience delivering large-scale IT, cloud, data center, HPC, AI, hyperscale infrastructure, or critical facilities projects.

job.description:

This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.

Responsibilities

Program Ownership

  • Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
  • Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
  • Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

Customer and Horizontal Leadership

  • Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
  • For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
  • For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

KPI Definition and Governance

  • Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
  • Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
  • Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
  • Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
  • Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator, and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
  • Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

Continuous Improvement

  • Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
  • Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
  • Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

Expected Outcomes

  • Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement.
  • Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
  • Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.

job.title: Logistics Technician
job.description:
Overview

*The working location for this position will be in Kanagawa prefecture.

[As a Microsoft Data Center Inventory & Asset Technician (DIAT), you will perform cycle audits, e](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001961?hl=en?timeout=20)xecute incoming/outgoing deliveries, [coordinate security escorts for third-party vendors](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557001961?hl=en?timeout=20), and document inbound and outbound deliveries as instructed by management. You will initiate warranty claims and process returns on failed equipment. This opportunity will allow you to build working knowledge of inventory management principles, warranty process management, data bearing device destruction, and advance your career in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DIAT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate with suppliers to initiate warranty claim and process failed vendor hardware devices. This includes information processing, packaging, shipment, and receipt of return for Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) devices following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) related to RMA warranty process.
  • Develop working knowledge of stock control and inventory management practices and procedures.
  • Ensure accurate documentation of incoming and outgoing deliveries as well as records.
  • Become familiar with guidelines set by Microsoft contractual agreements with suppliers and maintain a strong customer focus.
  • Perform cycle audits and data corrections to ensure all inventory controls are met.
  • Ensure detailed physical inventory tracking and staging.
  • Under the supervision of more experienced Data Center colleagues, destruction of data bearing devices (DBD) following all Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Microsoft policies.
  • Comply with all security and data management policies.
  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma AND 6 months experience or an internship in inventory management, retail, warehouse management, or a related field
  • OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Overview

Carrier is seeking a strategic and hands-on Total Rewards Lead, Japan to oversee compensation, benefits, mobility, and reward programs across Japan. Reporting directly to the APAC Total Rewards team, this standalone senior-level position will play a critical role in driving market-competitive and data-driven rewards strategies while leading key projects and influencing business decisions. This role offers extensive exposure to regional stakeholders and opportunities to contribute to initiatives across Asia.

Key Responsibilities

Why Join This Role?

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate as the Total Rewards expert for Japan while working closely with a global and regional HR organization. The position provides significant exposure to APAC leadership, opportunities to lead cross-country projects, and the ability to influence strategic business decisions through data-driven insights. Candidates will benefit from a strong learning environment, international collaboration, and the opportunity to challenge existing practices while driving meaningful change within a global organization.

job.title: EHS specialist
job.description:
Job Description: EHS Specialist – Carrier HVAC Vietnam

Role Level: P2-P3 (Junior Specialist) Reports to: Associate Director EH&S HVAC APAC Sales and Aftermarket Service Location: Carrier Vietnam (CVN)

Position Summary

The EHS Specialist is responsible for the day-to-day operational execution of Environment, Health, and Safety programs for Carrier HVAC in Vietnam. This role focuses on maintaining local legal compliance, conducting routine inspections, coordinating training, and ensuring accurate data management. It is a hands-on role designed to support the APAC EHS Leader (Service and aftermarket) by handling the essential administrative and field-level safety tasks.

Key Responsibilities

1. Legal Compliance & Safety Officer Duties

  • Serve as the legally designated Safety Officer for the Vietnam entity in accordance with the Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene.
  • Maintain the local EHS Legal Register and ensure all statutory records (training logs, health checks, equipment certifications) are audit ready.
  • Coordinate mandatory inspections for fire safety, pressure vessels, and environmental permits with local authorities.

2. Inspections, Audits & Risk Assessment

  • Conduct regular site safety inspections to identify hazards and ensure adherence to Carrier’s EHS standards.
  • Track corrective actions (CAPA) to closure, ensuring that findings from audits or inspections are resolved by department heads.
  • Support the Field service team in facilitating Job Safety Analyses (JSA) and Hazard Identification & Risk Assessments (HIRA).

3. Training & Awareness

  • Deliver EHS Induction training for all new employees, contractors, and visitors.
  • Coordinate mandatory external legal training for specialized groups (e.g., electrical safety, forklift, chemical handling).
  • Maintain the site EHS Training Matrix to ensure 100% compliance with internal and local requirements.

4. Incident Management & Data Entry

  • Facilitate the reporting of all near-misses and incidents; assist in root cause analysis and documentation.
  • Perform accurate data entry into Carrier’s EHS management systems, Enablon (e.g., tracking KPIs, waste data, and energy usage).
  • Prepare monthly EHS performance summaries for the Vietnam business unit.

5. Emergency Preparedness & Operational Support

  • Coordinate fire drills, evacuation exercises, and first-aid responder training.
  • Manage the inventory and distribution of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safety signage.

6. Statutory Flexibility & Business Support

  • Regulatory Adaptability: Proactively undertake additional EHS-related duties, reporting, or certifications as required by evolving Vietnamese legislation (e.g., Environmental Protection, Fire Safety, or Labor laws) to ensure the Vietnam business unit remains fully compliant and licensed to operate.
  • Local Representation: Act as the primary point of contact for local authorities during routine administrative filings and certification renewals, ensuring all business-specific EHS permits are maintained in line with local provincial requirements.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Occupational Safety & Health, Environmental Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Certification: Must hold (or be eligible to obtain) the Vietnam Legal Safety Officer Certification (Group 2/Group 1 as per Decree 44/2016/ND-CP).
  • Experience: 1–3 years of experience in an EHS role, preferably within the HVAC, manufacturing, or service/logistics industry.
  • Skills:Strong understanding of Vietnamese EHS laws and Decree 44 requirements.
  • Disciplined in administrative tasks and data entry.
  • Proactive "on-the-floor" presence; ability to engage with technicians and warehouse staff.
  • Native Vietnamese speaker; basic English proficiency for reporting and system usage.

Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Compliance: 100% completion of legally mandated training and inspections.
  • Reporting: Zero late submissions for monthly EHS data and incident reports.
  • Action Tracking: >90% on-time closure of inspection findings.
  • Engagement: Regular completion of scheduled safety walks and toolbox talks.

job.title: Platform & Product Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About The Opportunity:

The Manager, Platform & Product leads the multidisciplinary teams responsible for designing, developing, delivering and sustaining digital solutions that help customers achieve measurable performance improvements from MineStar.

The team owns the Productivity Solutions product portfolio, using automation, digitisation and AI across analytics, reporting, simulation and related capabilities to extend MineStar and improve customer outcomes globally. The team does not own the core MineStar products.

This role leads product ownership, engineering, architecture, business analysis and user experience capabilities across internal teams and external delivery partners.

You will set product and platform direction, prioritise and build a product-led operating model with clear accountability for customer value, delivery and the full product lifecycle.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the Product & Platform team, establishing clear direction, priorities, decision rights and accountability.
  • Define and maintain product and platform strategies and roadmaps aligned with customer needs, MineStar capabilities and business objectives.
  • Own the Productivity Solutions product portfolio across discovery, investment, delivery, adoption, sustainment and retirement.
  • Prioritise investment and delivery by balancing customer value, strategic alignment, capacity, risk, technical health and long-term supportability.
  • Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams across product, engineering, architecture, business analysis and user experience.
  • Lead external delivery partners, managing outcomes, quality, cost and risk.
  • Empower Product Owners and technical leaders to make timely decisions within clearly defined accountabilities and governance.
  • Partner with MineStar product and technology teams to ensure solutions complement and integrate with core MineStar capabilities while avoiding unnecessary duplication.
  • Manage cross-product dependencies, remove delivery barriers and escalate material risks and trade-offs.
  • Ensure solutions meet agreed standards for scalability, reliability, security, data integrity, deployment readiness and supportability.
  • Use customer insight, product data, field feedback and benefits evidence to guide priorities and continuous improvement.
  • Partner across Data Engineering & Reporting, Product Adoption & Support,
  • Content Development and other business and technology teams to deliver integrated customer outcomes.
  • Build team capability through workforce planning, development, performance management and succession planning.

How Success Will Be Measured:

  • Customer value: Priority products have agreed outcome measures and demonstrate verified customer or operational value against approved business cases.
  • Roadmap delivery: Portfolio commitments are delivered predictably against approved scope, milestones, budget and quality expectations, with material variances actively managed.
  • Product health: Products meet agreed reliability, security, performance, data quality and supportability expectations, with critical risks and technical debt reduced to plan.
  • Portfolio value: Investment is regularly directed toward the highest-value opportunities, with clear remediation, consolidation or retirement decisions for underperforming or duplicative products.
  • Stakeholder alignment: Product Owners, MineStar partners and dependent teams have clear priorities, decision rights and dependency plans, with unresolved issues escalated promptly.
  • Team capability: Critical roles are filled, succession and development plans are active, and team engagement, performance and retention remain within agreed targets.

What Skills Will You Bring?

  • Leadership & People Development: Experience leading multidisciplinary teams and developing people, leaders and organisational capability.
  • Product & Portfolio Leadership: Experience translating customer needs into product priorities and roadmaps, with the ability to make effective portfolio investment and lifecycle trade-offs.
  • Customer & Performance Focus: Ability to connect product decisions to customer performance, operational outcomes and measurable business value.
  • Technology Leadership: Broad understanding of software, cloud, data, digital platforms and architecture, with the ability to lead effectively through technical specialists.
  • Change & Cross-Functional Leadership: Experience establishing product-led ways of working and aligning diverse teams around common priorities and outcomes.
  • Decision Making & Communication: Ability to make clear decisions, manage competing priorities and communicate direction, risks and trade-offs effectively.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Required: Significant experience leading product, engineering, platform or digital technology teams in a complex enterprise environment.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience leading Product Owners, people leaders, technical specialists and external delivery partners.
  • Required: Experience defining product strategy, managing roadmaps and making product lifecycle decisions.
  • Required: Broad understanding of modern software, cloud, data, analytics, integration and architecture practices.
  • Required: Experience delivering products that integrate with or extend enterprise technology platforms across globally distributed teams.
  • Desirable: Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Mining, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Desirable: Experience establishing or maturing product-led and platform-based operating models.
  • Desirable: Mining, industrial technology, analytics or operational performance experience.
  • Highly desirable: MineStar or comparable mine-site technology experience.

Additional Information:

  • This position requires the successful candidate to work full-time in our Redcliffe Perth office.
  • This position may require up to 25% travel.
  • Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

Posting Dates:

October 1, 2026 - October 16, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

As a Lead DevOps Engineer at StarHub, you will own the end-to-end DevOps strategy, platform reliability, and release governance for mission-critical platforms. You will lead the design and evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platform architecture, cloud infrastructure, observability, and production operations practices that support high-volume telco customer journeys across charging, billing, and network activation.

This role requires strong working knowledge of end-to-end telco flows. You will work across engineering, operations, product, vendor, and business teams to ensure customer-impacting journeys are delivered safely, monitored effectively, and operated with a strong RCA and revenue-assurance mindset.

The role goes beyond execution. You will drive DevOps best practices, establish SRE capabilities, improve production stability, and guide engineers in delivering faster, safer, and more reliable platform changes across high-availability telco environments.

**

Responsibilities

  • Drive DevOps strategy and operating model, CRM/OM, and charging-adjacent platforms, acting as the technical escalation point for complex production issues.
  • Telco customer journeys across CRM, order orchestration, charging, billing, mediation, and network activation flows.
  • Support and improve integrations with telco network and charging systems, mediation platforms, and external partner APIs.
  • Lead design reviews and operational readiness for flow design, order orchestration, service activation, service modification, suspension, restoration, termination, and charging-triggered workflows.
  • Support production incidents, charging mismatches, balance or rating defects, revenue leakage investigations, reconciliation gaps, and high-severity operational escalations.
  • Architect and govern end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Pipeline-as-Code, GitLab CI, and GitOps practices such as Argo CD or Flux, enabling safe and repeatable releases.
  • Lead trunk-based development adoption, automated testing, quality gates, deployment validation, rollback controls, and release safety mechanisms across microservices.
  • Design and operate multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms such as EKS and OpenShift, including networking, RBAC, scaling, resilience, workload standardization, and platform governance.
  • Govern AWS cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation, ensuring security, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.
  • Apply SRE practices by defining SLOs/SLIs, improving reliability and performance, leading incident management, and driving structured root-cause analysis and problem management.
  • Establish observability and operational excellence using Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK, alerting, reconciliation dashboards, SLA monitoring, and on-call tooling.
  • Drive automation for operations, incident response, reconciliation, release validation, and platform maintenance.
  • Contribute to code improvements, architecture reviews, operational governance, engineering standards, runbooks, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  • Mentor engineers and influence cross-functional teams to improve delivery quality, platform maturity, and production ownership.

**

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience across DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, software engineering, or telco operations, with at least 2-3 years in a senior or technical leadership role.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end telco flows across CRM, order management, charging, billing, mediation, and network systems.
  • Hands-on experience supporting production incidents, charging mismatches, reconciliation issues, revenue assurance investigations, SLA breaches, and high-severity escalations.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with hands-on experience supporting microservices-based and distributed architectures.
  • Good understanding of APIs, middleware, orchestration patterns, event-driven integrations, SOAP/REST services, Kafka, and real-time integration troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with telco protocols and charging/network concepts such as Diameter, CAMEL, real-time rating, balance management, PCRF/PCF policy flows, and subscriber data management.
  • Deep understanding of scalability, reliability engineering, high availability, production system performance, and operational governance.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with:
  • Kubernetes, preferably EKS and/or OpenShift, Helm, and container orchestration
  • CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitLab CI and GitOps practices
  • AWS cloud services and cloud-native architecture
  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation
  • Observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, ELK, and alerting platforms
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on PostgreSQL administration, query analysis, and performance tuning experience.
  • Proficiency in Python and shell scripting for automation, operational tooling, and platform maintenance.
  • Experience implementing reconciliation, SLA monitoring, observability, dashboarding, and alert tuning across business-critical workflows.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with strong stakeholder management, communication, vendor coordination, and technical leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, production-critical, high-availability telco environment.

job.title: Senior Specialist, Compliance
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

The Senior Specialist, Compliance supports the Compliance function by carrying out day-to-day operational compliance activities, including screening and monitoring, maintaining compliance registers, tracking remediation actions, and supporting implementation of internal compliance reports/registers. The role is focused on reliable execution, accurate recordkeeping, timely follow-up, and escalation of issues where required, while contributing to a culture of ethics and integrity across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Policy and Procedures Support: Support the review, update, dissemination, and tracking of policies, procedures, and compliance/risk operations and assessments. Assist with monitoring key policy areas such as gifts and hospitality, conflicts, related party transactions, personal account dealing, and insider trading, including maintaining supporting records and reporting.
  • Screening and Monitoring: Perform screening, monitoring, and tracking of vendors, customers, and other relevant third parties in conjunction with the onboarding teams. Maintain clear records of screening outcomes, follow up on required information, performing periodic monitoring along with escalation of higher-risk matches or unresolved items in line with internal procedures.
  • Risk Assessment: Support compliance risk assessments projects to identify potential compliance vulnerabilities and implement corrective actions. Maintain compliance risk assessments/dashboards.
  • Regulatory/Requirements Monitoring: Track and analyze new and evolving local and international laws and regulations affecting the business. Support affected business units in implementation of such key requirements across relevant jurisdictions
  • Training: Support compliance training development for employees and management. Carry out periodic training for key policies (e.g. annual Conflicts of Interest training and attestations) and tracking for completion.
  • Incident Management: Investigate compliance breaches, handle whistleblower reports, and maintaining audit trails and mitigation follow-up.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Education: A recognized bachelor’s degree in business, finance, auditing, law or a related field.
  • Experience: 5–8 years of progressive experience in corporate compliance, operational/business risk management or audit roles.
  • Skills: Superior analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication abilities, organized and able to manage multiple priorities. High ethical standards and the ability to handle confidential information with discretion.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

At Equinix, our Critical Facilities Specialists operate, manage, maintain, and repair critical and non-critical power systems, HVAC, BMS, plumbing, fire control & suppression, and all site services. Our critical facilities specialists also perform all related vendor support in a mission critical environment.

This fast-paced role supports the overall functioning of the data center by focusing on maintaining and improving the facility’s critical infrastructure. This includes all regularly scheduled maintenance and ad hoc repairs/troubleshooting. We have a role for an Electrical specialist based at Derrimut and are looking to interview immediately for the position.

This role will be suitable for an individual with positive attitude who is willing to go beyond a job description and a written process to contribute to the success of our data center operations. As the critical facilities specialist will work in a highly collaborative environment, a team-first mindset will be crucial in navigating through the workdays.

Responsibilities

  • Completes all maintenance protocols, plans, activities on time and accurately, including daily, weekly, and monthly site checks
  • May manage and oversee specialist vendors for all major works, planned repairs and maintenance, electrical, and special systems
  • Ensures that sufficient spare parts are available on site for frequently used parts or parts with long lead times and maintains critical spares register
  • Monitors for and responds to BMS (Building Monitoring System) alarms in accordance with engineering policies and procedures, escalating to and working with Controls Engineering team where required
  • Participate in an on-call roster to act as the first responder for sites’ incidents, managing, resolving, and/or escalating critical issues outside of regular working hours
  • Oversee plumbing, security and fire suppression systems vendor activities
  • Coordinates/oversee work with vendors to ensure that maintenance activities are carried out as per Equinix's requirements
  • Commissioning and project work that will vary in scale and scope over time
  • Edits and tracks the work approval process for service providers (including briefing at the start of work, control of work during the day, final review of the work carried out)
  • Recommend changes/updates to technical files for plants and equipment in cooperation with vendor, and the supervisors, ensuring as built are up to date
  • Creates engineering scripts (switching schedules) and undertake safe switching practice.
  • Ensures that all Equinix safety standards are followed, as well quality procedures related to maintenance, including all Incident Management
  • Reviews processes, procedures, systems. Communicates process deviations and proposed changes to a higher level so that relevant follow-up measures can be carried out
  • Develops training and supports training of other Data Center (International Business Exchange) employees in relevant engineering topics and processes
  • Provides guidance and mentoring to other team members while being mentored on any areas of improvement

Qualifications, key skills, and attributes required:

  • Understanding through practical experience of critical facility operations and equipment, particularly electrical systems and infra
  • Trade qualification or Degree Certified with previous hands-on or service work experience
  • Sound knowledge or understanding of Controls would be a bonus
  • Proficiency in troubleshooting and repairing complex mechanical and electrical systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in time-sensitive situations
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Proven ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload effectively
  • Capability to execute tasks through effort and collaboration without formal written process
  • Collaborative mindset but also with the drive to complete assigned tasks autonomously when required

Benefits of the role:

  • Monday-Friday role based at a static site with flexible work arrangements
  • Salary package containing shares, annual bonus, healthcare allowance
  • Onsite gym, EV chargers and access to wide range of company wellness, financial and employee benefits
  • Career development opportunities and access to Equinix Global Ops Academy

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

Equinix is an Equal Employment Opportunity and, in the U.S., an Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to unlawful consideration of race, color, religion, creed, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, place of birth, citizenship, sex, pregnancy / childbirth or related medical conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital or domestic partnership status, age, veteran or military status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, political / organizational affiliation, status as a victim or family member of a victim of crime or abuse, or any other status protected by applicable law.

We use artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Learn more [here](https://careers.equinix.com/equinix-ai-guidance-for-candidates).

This posting is for a backfill position, meaning it is to fill an existing vacancy within our organization.**
