job.title: AI Data Centre Solutions Architect - Asia Pacific
job.description:
AI Data Centre Solutions Architect - Asia Pacific

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

You'll make a difference by

  • Representing Siemens' AI Factory Architecture organisation across Asia Pacific: Serve as the regional technical architecture representative, communicating Siemens AI Factory reference architectures across power, cooling, automation, digital, and compute infrastructure while adapting them to local market requirements.
  • Engaging strategic customers and leading architecture discussions: Support hyperscalers, AI infrastructure providers, colocation operators, enterprises, developers, EPCs, and technology partners through workshops, design reviews, technical presentations, RFIs/RFPs, and solution-development activities.
  • Translating global reference architectures into APAC-ready solutions: Localise architectures based on regional regulations, electrical standards, grid characteristics, operating environments, supply chains, and customer requirements across Asia Pacific.
  • Partnering with sales teams to drive integrated solution opportunities: Enable account teams through technical guidance, architecture training, value-based messaging, and support for opportunities that combine multiple Siemens technologies into a single customer solution.
  • Acting as a bridge between global expertise and regional execution: Leverage knowledge from global specialists while sharing customer requirements, competitive intelligence, technology trends, and market insights back to the global architecture organisation.
  • Driving the adoption of next-generation AI infrastructure architectures: Support the deployment and continuous improvement of solutions for AI factories, hyperscale data centres, liquid cooling, microgrids, digital twins, BMS/EPMS/SCADA platforms, modular infrastructure, and emerging electrical architectures.

Your defining qualities

  • Extensive experience in data centres or critical infrastructure environments: Approximately 10+ years of experience in data centres, electrical infrastructure, industrial automation, mission-critical facilities, or related technology sectors.
  • Strong customer-facing solution architecture expertise: Experience supporting technical sales, consulting, application engineering, pre-sales engineering, or solution architecture engagements with hyperscale, colocation, enterprise, or developer customers.
  • Deep electrical infrastructure knowledge with APAC market expertise: Strong understanding of MV/LV electrical systems, regional codes and standards, utility/grid requirements, and the localisation of global architectures for Singapore and wider Asia Pacific markets.
  • Broad technical understanding across multiple infrastructure domains: Working knowledge of electrical distribution, cooling systems, controls and operational technology, digital solutions, and AI compute infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across organisations and disciplines: Experience collaborating with engineering, commercial, and partner organisations to deliver integrated customer solutions throughout the data centre lifecycle.
  • Strong AI and automation fluency: Experience leveraging AI tools, workflow automation, and productivity technologies to improve architecture development, customer engagement, knowledge management, and sales-support processes.

In return, we offer you

  • Flexible Work Environment: Including a mobile working policy that supports your well-being and allows you to prioritize what matters most.
  • Competitive Compensation & Benefits: A comprehensive package to reward your contributions.
  • Values-Driven Culture: An inclusive workplace that prioritizes diversity and belonging.
  • Continuous Learning & Development: Opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening
  • If shortlisted, a session with our TA Consultant to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 2-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage

Transform the everyday with us!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

job.title: セールススペシャリスト/Sales Specialist for renewable market（再生エネルギー市場担当）
job.description:

Sales Manager__

職務内容（Your role and responsibilities）

本ポジションでは、事業部戦略に基づき、担当マーケット／部門における製品販売を担当していただきます。持続的な受注拡大、売上、収益性、市場シェア、顧客満足の向上を目的に、定量・定性の両面での営業目標達成を担います。あわせて、新たな販売機会の特定および開拓も行います。

本ポジションはハイブリッド勤務となります。

主な業務内容

  • ### 蓄電池、太陽光、風力発電など、再生可能エネルギー市場の企業に対するソリューション提案（新規開拓営業）

###

応募資格（Qualifications）

  • ### 高専卒以上
  • ### BtoB市場における新規開拓または深耕営業経験3年以上（製造業での経験歓迎）
  • ### 電気製品に関する基礎知識
  • ### 日本語：JLPT N1レベル以上
  • ### 英語：読み書きが可能なレベル（ビジネス基礎レベル）
  • ### 革新志向およびオーナーシップを持ち、継続的改善を推進できるマインド

###

会社概要（More about us）

ABBのエレクトリフィケーション事業は、電力の供給から利用までを効率的かつ信頼性高く実現するグローバルテクノロジーリーダーです。

当社は、電力配電およびエネルギー管理分野における世界的課題の解決に向けて、顧客およびパートナーと連携しています。

ポートフォリオには、低圧・中圧電気インフラ向けのデジタルおよびコネクテッド技術が含まれ、モジュール型変電所、配電自動化、電力保護、配線機器、スイッチギア、EVインフラ、エンクロージャ、ケーブリング、センシング、制御などを提供しています。

また、電気システムの信頼性、可用性、予測性、持続可能性を向上させる各種サービスも展開しています。

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be esponsible for the sales of products within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Achieves both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. Responsible to identify and develop new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • ### You will be making solution proposals (new sales) to companies in the renewable energy market, such as storage batteries, solar power, and wind power generation.
  • ### We will bundle ABB switchgear and ring main units with other companies' transformers at our factory in Vietnam and sell them as a package. You will combine multiple products and make proposals while thinking about what will best meet the customer's needs.
  • ### Initially, you will approach companies that have not yet been covered by existing members who have collected customer information. There are various other ways to develop business, such as searching on Salesforce, searching online, exchanging business cards at exhibitions, direct mail, and telemarketing.
  • ### Work with cutting-edge technology and top experts to engineer solutions that shape the future.

###

Qualifications for the role

  • ### College of Technology graduate or above
  • ### 3+ years of new or deep sales experience in B to B market (preferably in manufacturing industry)
  • ### Basic knowledge of electrical products
  • ### 【Japanese】JLPT N1 level or above in Japanese language
  • ### 【English】Good English reading and writing skills （Reading and writing level (English)
  • ### A mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement

###

More about us

[会社概要と組織](https://go.insideplus.abb.com/jp/ja/about-abb-in-japan/our-profile-and-organization)

###

ABB’s Electrification business area is a global technology leader enabling the efficient and reliable distribution of electricity from source to socket. We collaborate with our customers and partners to solve the world’s greatest challenges in electrical distribution and energy management.Our portfolio encompasses digital and connected innovations for low- and medium-voltage electrical infrastructure, including modular substations, distribution automation, power protection, wiring accessories, switchgear, electric vehicle (EV) infrastructure, enclosures, cabling, sensing and control. We also offer services to improve reliability, availability, predictability and sustainability of electrical systems.

###

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

FSE & Engineering Manager__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to provide general administrative services at the business level. Each day, you will perform general administrative activities. You will also showcase your expertise by providing backup support to the team in case of workload.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #LI-Hybrid, Onsite #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification Service Business and based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Preparing documentation and assisting in researching, compiling, proofreading and editing reports, presentations, organization charts, correspondence and other relevant documents.
  • Responding to manager and/or employee queries and managing both incoming and outgoing correspondence for the business.
  • Coordinating service operations activities including FSE scheduling, work order administration, asset management, purchase requisition processing, HSE reporting, quality management system compliance, audit support and warranty case administration.
  • Acting as location support for all administration activities.
  • Implementing ABB processes and engaging with other team members for continuous improvement of processes and procedures to maximize efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Maintaining records/databases/filing systems/archives in electronic and/or hard copy format.
  • Performing general administrative activities and providing backup support to the team in case of sickness/absence/workload.

Qualifications for the role

  • Diploma in Business Administration, Office Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2-5 years of experience in administration, business support, or office coordination roles.
  • Strong documentation, data entry and reporting skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records, databases and filing systems.
  • Proven ability to coordinate meetings and events, manage correspondence and provide effective administrative support to internal stakeholders.
  • Experience in process improvement, quality management and driving operational excellence within an administrative environment.
  • Good communication skills in English, Bahasa and proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with the ability to support budget tracking, performance reporting and day-to-day business operations.

What's in it for you?

Be part of a purpose-driven organization making a real impact on global energy efficiency and sustainability through innovative electrification solutions.

Grow your career in a high-performing, collaborative team with access to world-class learning, development, and leadership programs.

Enjoy a flexible hybrid work environment that values work-life balance, inclusion, and a safety-driven culture.

Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Attractive remuneration along with incentives based on performance
  • Comprehensive medical and insurance coverage
  • Learning, development programs
  • Hybrid/flexible work practices
  • Inclusive and safety-driven work culture

More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Project Manager - BMS
job.description:
Join a global leader shaping smarter, more sustainable buildings

At Johnson Controls, we're redefining how the world's most critical facilities operate. As a global leader in smart buildings, building automation, HVAC solutions, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help some of the world's most complex environments perform at their best.

From data centres, healthcare facilities, and pharmaceutical plants to advanced manufacturing and higher education campuses, our technologies create safer, smarter, and more sustainable spaces where reliability and performance are non-negotiable.

With over 140 years of industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines cutting-edge technology, world-class lifecycle services, and one of the industry's strongest field services networks to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and communities.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Permanent full-time position
  • Competitive salary package plus superannuation and car allowance
  • Career progression within a global organisation
  • Ongoing technical training and professional development
  • Exposure to large-scale, complex BMS and HVAC projects
  • Be part of a collaborative, high-performing project delivery team

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Project Manager to join our Adelaide-based Projects team.

This role is ideal for a project professional with a strong background in Building Automation Systems (BMS), Building Management Systems, Controls, or HVAC solutions who enjoys leading projects from inception to completion while building strong customer relationships.

You will take ownership of project delivery, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. Working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders, you'll play a key role in delivering innovative and sustainable building solutions across a diverse portfolio of projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of assigned projects from initiation through to handover.
  • Drive successful project outcomes by managing scope, schedule, budget, quality, and risk.
  • Monitor and report on project financial performance, ensuring profitability and cost control.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, quality, and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage project reviews, commissioning activities, and customer acceptance processes.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement and drive operational efficiencies.
  • Champion a culture of professionalism, accountability, and customer excellence.
  • Support innovation and digital transformation initiatives across project delivery.

What We're Looking For

We're keen to connect with professionals who have experience within the Building Automation, Controls, HVAC, Smart Buildings, or Critical Infrastructure industries.

Ideally, you will bring:

  • Trade qualification in Electrical, HVAC, Refrigeration, or an Engineering degree.
  • Proven experience managing BMS, Building Automation, Controls, HVAC, or related building services projects.
  • Strong understanding of Building Automation Systems, control strategies, system architecture, and design intent.
  • Experience overseeing Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), commissioning, and project close-out activities.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience managing project budgets and financial performance.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and customer engagement skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, MS Project, and project management tools.
  • Experience with BIM and AutoCAD will be highly regarded.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment.

Build Your Career with Johnson Controls

If you're looking to join an industry leader at the forefront of smart buildings, sustainability, and critical infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and help deliver the next generation of intelligent building solutions.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute. Our culture is built on integrity, collaboration, and continuous growth, ensuring every employee has the opportunity to thrive and make a meaningful impact.

You have the talent. You have the voice. Together, we'll shape the future.

job.title: Project Manager - CPM - HVAC
job.description:
Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

###

Job Title: CPM – Project Manager (HVAC – Chiller Plant)

Location: Mumbai Experience: 15+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced CPM – Project Manager (HVAC) with a strong background in Chiller Plant projects. The candidate will be responsible for end-to-end management of large-scale HVAC projects, including installation, testing, commissioning, and successful delivery of chiller systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead complete project management (CPM) of HVAC projects with a focus on Chiller Plant systems
  • Oversee installation, testing, and commissioning (ITC) of chiller plants
  • Manage project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution
  • Drive coordination with clients, consultants, vendors, and internal stakeholders
  • Ensure adherence to quality standards, safety norms, and technical specifications
  • Monitor project performance, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies
  • Lead and mentor project teams, site engineers, and subcontractors
  • Ensure timely project delivery, billing milestones, and cost control
  • Drive client satisfaction and smooth project closure

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 15+ years of experience in HVAC industry (Chiller Plant mandatory)
  • Strong expertise in project execution and management of chiller plant projects
  • Hands-on experience in installation, testing, and commissioning
  • Proven ability to manage large-scale and critical infrastructure projects
  • Strong leadership, team management, and stakeholder management skills
  • Excellent client handling and coordination abilities

Preferred:

  • Experience in Data Center / Industrial / Large Commercial HVAC projects
  • PMP or equivalent project management certification

job.title: Senior Project Engineer, HVAC
job.description:
What you will do

The Senior Project Engineer (HVAC) is responsible for managing and coordinating the engineering, technical, and site execution aspects of HVAC works for large‑scale data center and critical facility projects. The role supports the Project Manager to ensure safe, timely, compliant, and high‑quality project delivery, from design coordination through installation, testing, commissioning, and handover.

How you will do it:

Engineering & Technical Management

  • Coordinate HVAC design development, shop drawings, material submissions, and method statements
  • Review and ensure compliance with project specifications, drawings, codes, and standards
  • Resolve technical issues related to chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC units, AHUs, ducting, pipework, and ventilation
  • Interface with consultants and clients to address technical queries and design clarifications

Site Execution & Coordination

  • Manage day‑to‑day HVAC site activities to ensure works are executed according to approved drawings and schedules
  • Coordinate with main contractor, MEP trades, CSA teams, vendors, and subcontractors
  • Monitor work progress and ensure alignment with the approved project program
  • Support site supervision teams to ensure installation quality and workmanship standards

Testing, Commissioning & Handover

  • Coordinate pre‑commissioning, testing, and commissioning (T&C) activities
  • Work closely with commissioning agents, vendors, and client representatives
  • Ensure proper preparation of as‑built drawings, O&M manuals, and handover documentation
  • Support final inspections, snag clearance, and client acceptance

Cost, Procurement & Contract Support

  • Assist the Project Manager in cost control, variation evaluation, and progress claims
  • Track material procurement, deliveries, and vendor schedules
  • Identify potential variation orders and schedule risks early

Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with QA/QC procedures, inspection and test plans (ITP), and quality records
  • Enforce site HSE requirements and safe work practices
  • Support audits, inspections, and authority submissions as required

Reporting & Documentation

  • Prepare and maintain daily, weekly, and monthly progress reports
  • Track RFIs, technical submissions, approvals, and site instructions
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in HVAC project engineering

job.title: Site Reliability Technical Operations Manager
job.description:
Summary

The Site Reliability Engineering team at Johnson Controls is seeking a Technical Reliability & Support Manager to lead cloud product reliability, operational support, and production stability across global cloud applications and platforms. This role will be responsible for managing day-to-day technical operations, L2/L3 support coordination, incident response, service reliability governance, and continuous improvement for cloud products hosted across platforms such as Azure (primarily), Google Cloud, Ali Cloud, and other cloud environments.

The role will partner closely with Engineering, SRE, Security, Observability, and external support partners to ensure production issues are resolved quickly, recurring problems are eliminated, support processes are standardized, and operational risks are proactively identified and addressed.

Primary Duties:

  • Lead technical operations and support management for cloud products across global environments
  • Manage day-to-day L2/L3 support activities, incident response, escalations, and production issue resolution
  • Own service reliability governance for assigned cloud products, including availability, incident trends, MTTR, recurring issues, and operational risks
  • Partner with Engineering, SRE, Security, Observability and Platform teams to improve service stability and operational readiness
  • Drive incident management, problem management, RCA/PCA reviews, and corrective action tracking for production issues
  • Ensure timely communication during incidents, including stakeholder updates, executive summaries, customer-impact statements, and resolution updates
  • Establish and manage support processes aligned with ITIL practices, including incident, problem, change, service request, and escalation management
  • Define, track, and report operational KPIs such as availability, MTTR, incident volume, severity trends, backlog, service requests, alert noise, and SLA performance
  • Identify recurring operational pain points and drive permanent fixes through engineering backlog, automation, monitoring improvements, and process enhancements
  • Collaborate with Observability teams to ensure critical application, infrastructure, database, and integration components are properly monitored and alerted
  • Support implementation and adoption of SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, error budgets, and reliability / supportability scorecards for cloud products
  • Ensure production readiness for new product releases, migrations, infrastructure changes, and platform transformations
  • Lead operational reviews with internal teams, vendors, and external support partners to ensure accountability and continuous improvement
  • Drive automation of manual support tasks, ticket workflows, reporting, and operational runbooks to improve efficiency and consistency
  • Ensure support activities, incidents, changes, and action items are properly documented and tracked in tools such as Jira, ServiceNow, Confluence, or equivalent platforms
  • Manage support handoffs across global teams and ensure clear ownership, escalation paths, and communication protocols
  • Provide technical leadership during high-severity incidents, major outages, migrations, and critical customer-impacting events
  • Ensure compliance with security, audit, operational, and IT governance standards for cloud product support
  • Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, support models, and knowledge base articles
  • Mentor support engineers and technical teams on reliability practices, incident handling, RCA quality, and operational excellence

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in technical operations, production support, SRE, cloud support, or reliability engineering.
  • Strong experience managing cloud-hosted applications and support operations.
  • Good knowledge of Azure (preferred), with exposure to AWS, GCP, or Ali Cloud.
  • Experience with incident management, problem management, change management, and operational governance.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native technologies, microservices, APIs, databases, containers, and Kubernetes.
  • Understanding of observability tools such as Grafana, Datadog, ELK, Logz.io, Azure Monitor, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of reliability practices including SLIs, SLOs, SLAs, monitoring, alerting, and automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across applications, infrastructure, networking, databases, and cloud services.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and vendor coordination skills.
  • Ability to lead high-severity incidents and drive operational excellence in a fast-paced environment.

Mandatory Skills:

  • Cloud Operations / SRE leadership
  • L2 production support (good to have L2 Production Support)
  • Incident & escalation management
  • RCA/PCA and problem management
  • Azure cloud and cloud-native platforms
  • Observability, monitoring & KPI reporting
  • ITIL-based support processes
  • Automation and runbook development
  • Executive communication & stakeholder management
  • Leadership in high-pressure production environments

job.title: Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, Google Photos Web
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As the Tech Lead Manager of the Photos Web team, you will lead the Sydney-based team holistically responsible for Google Photos on mobile web and desktop. You will guide the team to ship features which capitalize on the unique advantages of the Web form factor, showcase Artificial Intelligence (AI) magic and bring key mobile features to the web, while maintaining service health and stability and building an effective team. Google Photos is a photo sharing and storage service developed by Google. Photos is one of the most sought after products at Google and is looking for both client-side (web and mobile), with server-side (search, storage, serving) and machine intelligence (learning, computer vision) Software Engineers. We are dedicated to making Google experiences centered around the user.

Responsibilities

  • Define and influence technical direction and long-term strategy in conjunction with other Engineering Managers and Tech Leads, helping the team make balanced trade-offs, and prioritize engineering excellence investments in a systemic way.
  • Provide career management and coaching to help your team grow in directions that are exciting to them.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional peers such as Product and User Experience (UX) to collaboratively define the goal and strategy for Google Photos on web.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Consumer Payments, Growth
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Consumer Payments Growth engineering team’s mission is to accelerate the adoption, everyday usage, and long-term retention of Google Wallet and Google Payments globally.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the team in Singapore, you will set technical direction and own end-to-end engineering workstreams for global growth initiatives from real-time decisioning pipelines and financial rewards settlement to stateful quest engines and low-latency signal aggregation. You will partner closely with cross-functional teams to transform growth strategies into resilient, highly scalable production systems.You will be a technical leader in the codebase: writing clean, scalable code, establishing high standards through architectural design reviews, driving technical simplification across distributed dependencies, and mentoring engineers across the Singapore and Tokyo engineering sites.Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Build high-performance communications infrastructure that delivers personalized, contextual in-app messages and lifecycle notifications across mobile, web, and checkout surfaces.
  • Architect resilient, idempotent financial settlement workflows and digital voucher vaulting systems with strict transactional consistency and anti-abuse controls.
  • Design low-latency feature stores and telemetry pipelines to support high-velocity A/B testing, counterfactual logging, and causal attribution in close partnership with data science. Implement stateful milestone quest engines and gamified reward mechanics that drive sustainable user engagement and positive unit economics.
  • Drive technical execution for complex multi-quarter projects, mentor junior and mid-level engineers, conduct rigorous design reviews, and advocate Artificial Intelligence (AI)-assisted development to accelerate velocity.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embodies our [culture](https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

Background Check Requirements:

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • This position requires verification of Thailand Citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions applicable to the role and as a result, you will need to provide a valid Thailand passport to verify your Thailand Citizenship.
  • This position is based in Chonburi, Thailand. Candidates must be willing and able to be assigned to and work at the Chonburi site as required by the role.

While not required, we also look for the following _Preferred Qualifications:_

  • 1+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Hands-on experience with server deployment, rack-and-stack, cabling, and datacenter operations, including installation, decommissioning, and physical infrastructure support.
  • Proven break-fix and hardware troubleshooting experience, including component replacement and maintenance of servers, storage systems, and network devices.
  • Experience supporting customer-facing IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking equipment, cabling, and physical troubleshooting in a datacenter or enterprise environment.
  • Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Preferred: Candidates currently working as Datacenter Technicians, IT Operations Engineers, or Smart Hands Engineers in Chonburi, Thailand.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about [requesting accommodations.](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

Coordinate and schedule supplier/vendor on-site activities and recognizes circumstances when to stop supplier work to address potential and/or identified concerns.

  • Assesses and identifies appropriate resources and equipment necessary to fully support environmental health and safety (EH&S) objectives.
  • Participates in required meetings, trainings, and necessary handoffs.

Other

  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values)

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 3+ years mission critical services work/applied learning experience (e.g., high availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)
  • OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • Citizenship Verification: This position requires verification of Australian Citizenship to meet federal government security requirements.You will need a valid Australian passport to verify your citizenship.
  • NV1/2, PV Clearance Assessment: This position may require an enhanced background check conducted through the Australian Government Security Vetting Agency.

While not required, we also look for the followingPreferred Qualifications:

  • High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent AND 6+ years mission critical services experience (e.g., high-availability assembly/manufacturing/critical infrastructure environments such as data centers, oil and gas refineries, hospitals, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or related fields)

  • OR equivalent experience.
  • 1+ year(s) people management experience.
  • 1+ year(s) experience in a specialized area (e.g., mechanical field, electrical field, controls field) or related field.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

job.title: Senior Tax Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical and inquisitive Senior Tax Analyst to support the Caterpillar Indirect Tax Advisory team for Caterpillar entities in Singapore. This role involves extensive communication with the various Caterpillar businesses to understand new and existing business operations with the aim of providing advice and guidance on the key indirect tax requirements including tax treatment, invoicing and GST reporting.

The Senior Tax Analyst will be part of an established indirect tax team and work closely other members of the team, as well as the Caterpillar businesses.

What You Will Do

Indirect Tax Advisory & Compliance

  • Liaise with Caterpillar businesses to understand new and existing business operations, to ensure indirect tax relevant information is gathered and potential indirect tax implications are analysed.
  • Support indirect tax advice required for Caterpillar entities in Singapore with oversight by management.
  • Support and advise Caterpillar Global Business Services and accounting staff in their GST compliance processes.
  • Review selected GST returns, including carrying out high level reasonableness and credibility checks and providing advisory support on any matters arising to the Caterpillar businesses.
  • Analyze and develop responses to support tax authority inquiries with oversight by management.
  • Support the Caterpillar Indirect Tax Team in monitoring and evaluating legislative updates throughout the region.
  • Lead or support indirect tax projects.
  • Lead the periodic renewal of existing incentive schemes such as Major Exported Scheme via the GST compliance programme such as Assisted Self-Help Kit and Assisted Compliance Assurance Program (including coordinating with Accounting, Finance, Logistic and HR teams to obtain the required information).

What You Have

Indirect tax Technical Knowledge & Experience

o This position requires a detailed understanding of Singapore GST principles, gained via successful 5-10 years’ experience with indirect tax matters, either with a professional legal or accountancy firm and/or in industry.

o Fluency in English is required.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail:Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. An appreciation of the critical information required to manage the indirect tax risks within an organization.

o The ability to quickly gain a very good understanding of Caterpillar’s business, the transactional flow of goods and services, both inter-company and to third parties.

o High level of organization and audit readiness

Effective Communications:Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

o Good communication skills are essential, as dealing with senior business personnel will be expected.

o The ability to explain complex issues to diverse audiences.

o The ability to liaise with Caterpillar businesses to understand current and planned transaction flows.

o The ability to manage relationships with and gain the trust of Caterpillar staff at all levels.

o Strong collaboration skills across tax, finance and shared services teams.

o Clear and professional written and verbal communication.

Problem Solving:Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

o Ability to apply structured methodologies to gather facts.

o Strong analytical skills required to identify and document specific problems and resolution alternatives, including risk / benefit analysis of alternative approaches.

o Ability to examine a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.

Tax Management:Knowledge of Singapore tax laws, organizational tax practices, obligations; ability to manage organization tax related issues.

o Analyzes Singapore GST implications of alternative approaches of business projects or transactions. .

o Represents the organization in GST defense actions.

o Compares an organization’s GST practices and strategies against the GST laws and regulations.

o Consults on a variety of GST related matters.

Tax Operations:Knowledge of Singapore GST practices and regulations; ability to prepare and file GST returns.

o Advises others on GST requirements and their inter-relationships.

o Facilitates resolution of all outstanding items, problems and issues with tax authorities.

o Evaluates issues and considerations in integrating GST information across lines of business.

o Evaluates pending legislation and its impact on GST reporting and operations.

o Resolves common GST-related errors and problems.

Top Candidates Will Also Have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, ACCA/CPA Australia or equivalent

Additional Information

  • This position requires working onsite five days a week.

How We Support You (Employee Benefits)

Our goal at Caterpillar is for you to have a rewarding career. Our teams are critical to the success of our customers who build a better world. Here you earn more than just wage, because we value your performance, we offer a total rewards package that provides day one benefits along with the potential of a variable bonus. Additional benefits include paid annual leave, flexi leave, medical and insurance. (prorated based upon hire date).

Final Details

Caterpillar is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status; however, as a global company, Caterpillar offers many job opportunities outside of Singapore which can be found through our employment website at [www.caterpillar.com/careers](http://www.caterpillar.com/careers).

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

September 30, 2026 - October 13, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Software Engineering Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Us

The CTCT division (a joint venture between Trimble and Caterpillar) develops positioning and control products for earthmoving and paving machines in the construction and mining industries, using technologies such as GPS, optical total stations, lasers and sonics. The products are used in a range of applications where the operator of the machine benefits from having accurate horizontal and vertical guidance.

About The Opportunity:

Analyses, designs, programs, debugs, and modifies software enhancements and/or new products used in local, networked, cloud-based or Internet-related computer programs. Code may be used in commercial or end-user applications, such as materials management, financial management, HRIS, mobile apps or desktop applications’ products. Using current programming language and technologies, writes code, completes programming, and performs testing and debugging of applications. Completes documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance. May interact with users to define system requirements and/or necessary modifications.

As a Specialist, serves as a subject matter expert driving architectural directions, cross-team technical alignment, continuous organizational improvements, and global team initiatives.

Key Accountabilities & Key Outcomes:

Operational & Technical Leadership

  • Collaborate with tech stewards and architect solutions for challenging problems.
  • Lead process changes and continuous improvements across the organization, driving global teams to adopt best practices.
  • Possess specialized depth and/or breadth of technical expertise across the job family.
  • Interprets internal/external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes, or services.
  • Leads others to solve complex problems; works on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors; resolves complex issues using sophisticated analytical thought to exercise judgment and identify innovative solutions.
  • Works independently, receiving guidance in only the most complex situations.
  • Leads organization function teams or projects with resource requirements, risk, and/or complexity; determines methods and procedures on new assignments.
  • Impacts the achievement of customer, operational, project, or service objectives; work is guided by organization function policies.
  • Communicates difficult concepts and negotiates with others to adopt a different point of view; networks with key contacts outside own area of expertise.

Health and Safety

  • Demonstrates participation in the hazard reporting process.
  • Demonstrates participation in the accurate reporting of incidents.
  • Contributes to a positive health and safety culture within the team.
  • Maintains a safe and clean work environment at all times.
  • Reads, understands, and follows all Safe Work Procedures.
  • Ensures access to and wears the appropriate PPE.
  • Always works within the guidelines of the Trimble Health and Safety Policy or that of other PCBUs if off-site.
  • Undertakes training as directed to ensure competency to safely operate equipment.

Other Duties

  • Any other duties directed by Management as and when required.

Skills / Competencies:

  • Architect and design robust solutions for complex and challenging software engineering problems in collaboration with technical stewards.
  • Drive continuous process improvements and software quality standards across multi-disciplinary global teams.
  • Develop and maintain machine control applications by writing high-quality code in C++.
  • Develop and maintain web applications written in Angular and TypeScript. Write automated tests and unit tests to prove correctness of the software.
  • Review and provide valuable feedback in code changes of peers, mentoring engineers across global locations.
  • Collaborate with application domain experts and software developers across multiple international sites to deliver identified customer value.
  • Demonstrate a set of fundamental software engineering skills that result in predictability in engineering, scheduling, and the quality of products developed.
  • Debug software and investigate customer reports to solve complex product issues.

Qualifications / Experience:

  • Relevant tertiary qualification in computer science, engineering, mechatronics, or equivalent.
  • Extensive experience (typically 7+ years) developing web applications or applications written in C++ within a Windows or Linux environment, including technical leadership roles.
  • Proven track record of collaborating with tech stewards to architect solutions for complex engineering problems.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead process improvements and technical changes driving global cross-site teams.
  • Exposure to communication and networking protocols such as CAN, Ethernet, and other automotive protocols is an added advantage.
  • Experience with Android application development is an advantage.
  • Experience with web browser-based UI software development would be an advantage.
  • Experience with Golang would be beneficial.

About Your Location:

Based at Trimble’s NZ headquarters in Christchurch, enjoy free parking, an onsite gym, an active social club, and a great team environment where people love working with leading technology solutions.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

job.title: Finance Manager (Revenue)
job.description:
Job Description

The Finance Manager will lead the Group’s revenue accounting team and oversee revenue assurance controls. The role works closely with Product, Billing, IS and other stakeholders to assess new and bundled sales arrangements, determine the appropriate accounting treatment, resolve reconciliation issues and improve the systems and processes that support accurate reporting.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee revenue and direct cost accounting, monthly closing and financial reporting in accordance with IFRS and Group policies.
  • Monitor revenue assurance controls and reconciliations; investigate discrepancies, assess their impact and drive corrective actions.
  • Maintain a record of revenue assurance issues and report key findings to stakeholders.
  • Work with Product, Billing and IS teams to assess new products and ensure accounting processes and controls are in place before launch.
  • Review accounting treatment papers and process documentation for revenue and direct costs.
  • Oversee revenue assurance tools and support improvements to finance systems and reporting processes.
  • Manage and develop the revenue accounting team, and undertake other projects as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy or an equivalent qualification, preferably with at least six years’ experience in audit, accounting or finance, including three years in a managerial role.
  • Strong working knowledge of IFRS, particularly IFRS 15. Experience in product and telecommunications revenue accounting is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel. Experience with SAP or other ERP systems is preferred; knowledge of Power BI, SQL, R or Python is an advantage.
  • Ability to investigate complex issues, assess their financial impact and develop practical solutions that account for business, system and accounting requirements.
  • Confident communicator who can work across teams, present findings clearly and drive stakeholders towards resolution.
  • Organised, resourceful and able to lead a team while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

job.title: Senior Engineer I, Software Test
job.description:
Job Description

Company Overview: Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, committed to providing innovative solutions that ensure Life Is On everywhere, for everyone, and at every moment. We are looking for a V&V Security Engineer to perform baseline security Verification & Validation of web applications and APIs. The role sits between Security-focused QA and Application Security and is intended for someone who can independently perform structured security validation without requiring hardcore penetration testing expertise. The engineer will work closely with QA, Development and Product Security teams to validate security controls, identify common security weaknesses, document findings and escalate advanced security issues when required.

Key Responsibilities

  • V&V Security Testing
  • Perform security validation for application features and APIs as part of the V&V lifecycle.
  • Understand feature functionality, user roles and expected security controls before testing.
  • Validate security requirements across authentication, authorization, input validation, business logic, APIs, sessions, file handling and security headers.
  • Verify security controls at the backend/API level, not only through the UI.
  • Identify, reproduce and document security weaknesses.
  • Web & API Security Testing

Perform baseline testing for:

  • Authentication: login, password reset, authentication enforcement and bypass scenarios.
  • Authorization & Access Control: RBAC, horizontal/vertical access control, IDOR, object ownership, user/site/device/tenant access and restricted APIs.
  • Input Validation: mandatory fields, null/empty values, datatype, length, boundaries, IDs, dates, enums and unexpected parameters.
  • Business Logic: workflow bypass, date/quantity restrictions, duplicate requests, invalid state transitions and frontend-only restrictions.
  • Session Management: logout, expiry, token/session reuse and privilege changes.
  • REST APIs: request/response validation, HTTP methods, headers, JSON bodies, authorization and parameter manipulation.
  • File Security: upload/download validation, file types, MIME types, size restrictions and access control.
  • Security Headers: CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy and other project-required headers.
  • Error Handling & Information Disclosure: stack traces, internal paths, sensitive data, tokens, credentials and other unintended information exposure.
  • Reporting & Collaboration
  • Create clear and reproducible security findings.
  • Capture request/response evidence and screenshots.
  • Explain security/business impact and remediation.
  • Assign severity/CVSS where required.
  • Track findings through Jira or equivalent systems.
  • Perform security retesting after fixes.
  • Work with developers and QA to explain security issues clearly.

Qualifications & Required skills:

Required Technical Skills

Application Security

Understanding of:

  • OWASP fundamentals
  • Authentication & Authorization
  • Broken Access Control / IDOR
  • Input Validation
  • XSS
  • SQL Injection fundamentals
  • Path Traversal
  • CSRF/CORS fundamentals
  • Session Management
  • Business Logic vulnerabilities
  • File Upload/Download security
  • Security Headers
  • Information Disclosure

API Security

  • REST APIs
  • HTTP methods and status codes
  • JSON request/response structures
  • Headers and cookies
  • Bearer tokens
  • JWT fundamentals
  • API authentication and authorization
  • Backend validation

Tools

Burp Suite

  • Proxy
  • HTTP History
  • Repeater
  • Decoder
  • Request/response analysis
  • Basic request manipulation

Experience

Typically, 5–7 years in:

  • Application Security
  • Security V&V
  • Web/API Security Testing

Education

Bachelor's degree in:

  • Computer Science

Key Competencies

The ideal candidate demonstrates:

  • Strong application-security fundamentals.
  • Good QA/testing mindset.
  • Analytical and curious approach.
  • Ability to understand application workflows.
  • Strong API/request analysis skills.
  • Ability to distinguish functional bugs from security vulnerabilities.

job.title: DGM Direct Procurement Sourcing Management
job.description:
Job Description

INTRODUCTION

  • The Busway business is one of the fast-growing product lines within Low Voltage Power Products, manufacturing sheet-metal fabricated busway enclosures, housings, joints and copper/aluminium bus-bar assemblies for power distribution.
  • This position is a Strategic Sourcing Buyer for the Busway category who will also act as the Procurement Manager, owning end-to-end procurement for the plant – sheet metal, fabrication, bus-bar/conductor materials, hardware, insulation and packaging.
  • The role requires deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing (clean-sheet / should-cost), press-shop and fabrication processes (laser cutting, CNC punching/bending, welding, powder coating), and sourcing from vendors in switchgear, busway, panel-building or similar sheet-metal-intensive industries.

The incumbent will design and implement the annual procurement operating plan for the plant, driving cost, quality, delivery and localization targets while managing the local supplier base end-to-end.

RESPONSIBILITIES

1\. CATEGORY BUYER / PROCUREMENT MANAGER:

Spend Management:

  • Own the full procurement spend of the plant for sheet metal, fabricated parts, bus-bar/conductor material, hardware and consumables – supplier selection, development and Supplier Qualification (SAM).
  • Manage supplier performance management, spend analytics, needs preparation and Annual Procurement & Purchasing Planning (APOP) for the Busway category.
  • Coordinate effectively with Regional and Global Busway/sheet-metal category teams to formulate and execute category strategies at plant level.
  • Own contract management and procurement risk management, including single/mono-source mitigation.

Sheet Metal & Part / Component Development:

  • Lead RFQ/RFP issuance, negotiations, PPAP/APQP coordination, pricing agreements and MSA/LTC/QTC coordination with fabrication and sheet-metal suppliers.
  • Drive tooling and capex negotiations for press tools, dies and fixtures with fabrication vendors.
  • Validate supplier quotes using clean-sheet costing / should-cost models for sheet metal (material yield, cycle time, press tonnage, tooling amortization, surface treatment/powder coating cost build-up).

Cost Reduction / Productivity:

  • Deliver annual cost reduction targets through negotiation preparation, should-cost analysis, external benchmarking, multi-year agreements, change of supplier, Value Engineering/Value Analysis (VAVE) and localization.
  • Identify and implement design-for-sourcing and design-for-manufacturing opportunities in sheet metal parts jointly with Engineering.

Plant Procurement Management & Supply Continuity:

  • Act as the single point of contact for all plant-level procurement activities, ensuring uninterrupted material flow to the shop floor (line-side feeding, inventory norms, VMI where applicable).
  • Collaborate with the plant Supply Chain team to ensure smooth material flow from suppliers and resolve day-to-day supply escalations.
  • Drive alternate sourcing / change of supplier initiatives to secure supply continuity and avoid single-source or mono-source risk.

Collaboration with Cross Functions:

  • Partner closely with Plant Operations, Quality and Engineering to improve productivity, quality and on-time delivery for the Busway line.

REQUIRED COMPETENCIES

  • Proven, hands-on experience in the Busway business or a closely related sheet-metal-intensive electrical/switchgear industry.
  • Deep, practical understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet costing, press-shop processes, laser cutting, CNC bending, welding, fabrication and powder coating/surface finishing.
  • Working knowledge of busway/switchgear components – enclosures, bus-bar assemblies (copper/aluminium), joints, insulation and their supplier base.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning plant-level supply continuity, vendor management and cross-functional coordination.
  • Strong negotiation, project management and cross-functional leadership skills in a matrix, multi-BU environment.
  • Entrepreneurial, customer-focused, comfortable challenging status quo and driving change.
  • Digitally savvy – keen to apply digital tools to improve procurement efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills; fluent in English.

REQUIREMENTS

B.Tech / B.E. – Mechanical Engineering (Electrical background also considered)

  • Minimum 10-15 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing / Procurement, with substantial exposure to the Busway business or a similar sheet-metal-fabrication-intensive industry (switchgear, panel building, enclosures, electrical equipment manufacturing).
  • Deep, hands-on understanding of sheet metal costing and sourcing – clean-sheet cost methodology, press shop economics, tooling investment, laser cutting, CNC bending/punching, welding and powder coating.
  • Strong knowledge of buy analysis, should-cost/clean-sheet costing and BOM-level cost breakdowns for fabricated and bus-bar/conductor parts.
  • Prior experience acting as a Plant Procurement Manager – owning end-to-end plant procurement, supplier management and supply continuity.
  • Hands-on experience with rebalancing / localization of critical sheet metal and fabricated parts.
  • Experience working in a matrix environment across organizations and functions.
  • Strong leadership, negotiation and performance management skills.

Domain expertise in Busway / Sheet Metal Fabrication and technically sound in cost engineering

job.title: Senior Associate, People Technology Services
job.description:
Job Description

As a Senior Associate, People Technology Services, you implement and manage Human Resources (HR) technology platforms, optimize digital HR processes, and ensure data integrity and security. You troubleshoot technical issues, train teams on new digital solutions, and support the seamless integration of HR systems across the organization. Your mission is to improve the efficiency and user experience of HR technology, enabling the organization to leverage digital tools for enhanced people management and strategic decision-making. Your work directly influences the effectiveness of HR operations, the employee experience, and the organization’s ability to derive insights from workforce data. You serve as an individual contributor within the People Technology Services function, focused on executing operational and functional strategies. You spend the majority of your time delivering and implementing HR technology solutions, applying professional judgment and specialized knowledge. You apply a working knowledge of HR systems and technology to deliver outcomes that impact your immediate work area and occasionally beyond. Your decisions typically involve selecting appropriate methods and processes to complete technical assignments related to HR systems. You address routine and non-routine problems, and influence others by explaining relevant facts, practices, and policies. You work independently with general direction, adhering to established procedures, compliance requirements, and quality standards, seeking guidance for more complex issues.

Additional Detail:

Leadership & Autonomy

  • Works under little guidance due to previous experience/breadth and depth of knowledge on technical processes and organizational objectives
  • Works independently to determine methods and procedures on new assignments using engineering-related knowledge
  • Checks own work for accuracy and possibly the work of level below
  • May be advised by levels above

Decision Making & Impact

  • Decisions typically focus on methods, tactics, and processes to complete technical tasks
  • Exercises discretion and judgment in prioritizing requests and interpreting/adapting procedures, processes, and techniques
  • Makes some regular decisions independently, sometimes subject to approval
  • Decisions may have some impact on results, productivity, and/or expenditures. Work impacts the achievement of operational/technical tasks and possibly the overall workflow/team efficiencies. Errors may cause moderate loss of time or customer/user cost/dissatisfaction

Innovation & Problem Solving

  • May make recommendations on new technical processes for own work area
  • Solves unique technical and operational challenges within defined parameters and escalates, as needed
  • Escalates matters and complex problems as needed

Complexity & Independent Judgement

  • With guidance, work on fundamental to moderately complex assignments by applying related knowledge while beginning to understand more advanced subject matter knowledge

job.description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You are part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

We are now hiring interns for our H1 2027cohort! Internships will start in January2027. Students who can commit full-time will be preferred.

Join us as a Power QualityIntern to make an impact!

Location: Kallang

Kickstart your career by gaining hands-on experience in power quality solutions. As a Power Quality Intern, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to support audits, analyze system performance, and contribute to innovative solutions that improve electrical power quality and reliability.

What will you do:

Power quality activities support

  • Analyse power quality measurement data and technical findings to identify system disturbances, assess operational risks, determine root causes, and recommend effective mitigation solutions to improve electrical network reliability and performance.
  • Collaborate with crossfunctional engineering teams to develop technical proposals, solution architectures, engineering studies, and customerfacing presentations that promote power quality solutions, services, and best practices.
  • Support power quality audits, site assessments, and diagnostic activities by evaluating electrical system performance and providing datadriven recommendations to enhance power quality solutions and services.

Power quality initiative support

  • Support the planning, development, and execution of strategic power quality initiatives aimed at advancing technical capabilities, innovation, and business growth.
  • Drive the exploration and evaluation of emerging technologies, including ETAP Digital Twin for power quality analysis, advanced monitoring platforms, simulation tools, and digital solutions to improve system visibility and decisionmaking.
  • Contribute to the development of new tools, methodologies, and value-added services that strengthen power quality offerings, accelerate digital transformation, and deliver measurable benefits in reliability, efficiency, and sustainability for customers.

What qualifications will make you successful:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Diploma, Bachelor's, or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Strong foundation in electrical engineering concepts, including power systems and power quality, with the ability to apply engineering principles to technical problem-solving.
  • Knowledge of programming and analytical tools such as MATLAB, ETAP, SKM, AI Builder tools, and Microsoft Office applications, complemented by strong business acumen.

What's in it for me:

  • Real-world engineering experience on projects that make a difference
  • Mentorship and guidance from professionals who care about your success
  • Exposure to advanced tools, technologies, and industry best practices
  • A collaborative culture that values curiosity, questions, and continuous learning
