job.title: Principal Electrical Engineer (Data Center)
job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The position is for a Regional Principal Electrical Engineer providing consulting and design services for mission critical facilities across the C&SP, Colocation, IT, Telecoms, Financial Services sectors and other key industries.

This role is responsible for the end-to-end design of electrical system for mission-critical environments, including Data Centres and Command Centres. You will ensure all technical solutions are optimized for project success, compliance to standards and highest customer satisfaction.

The successful candidate must demonstrate engineering excellence in electrical systems for mission-critical facilities. The person should show leadership and ability to conduct effective communication at senior levels with key customers and industry partners and maintain a high profile within the business and project community to solidify Schneider Electric’s reputation as a premier, trusted business partner.

The incumbent will play a pivotal role in scaling Schneider’s M&E design and consulting capabilities by providing mentorship and fostering technical development within the team. As a subject matter expert, you will provide technical leadership for mission-critical projects across diverse sectors, including IT, Financial Services, Government and other industry segments.

The successful candidate must hold a Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering and have a minimum 10 years of relevant industry experience. This role requires a self-motivated leader with strong communication and business consulting skills who is comfortable engaging with customers at all levels. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative team player with proven project management expertise and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with a diverse group of internal stakeholders to drive project success and organizational alignment.

This includes:

  • Countries Pre-sales and Solutions Managers
  • Global Solution Architects
  • Account Managers and Sale Representatives
  • Key Functional Leaders

What will you do?

Electrical System Design

  • Stakeholder Engagement: Liaise with client project teams, external consultants and internal stakeholders to comprehensively define project requirements, scope and technical objectives.
  • Solution Development: Convert project requirements into optimized engineering solutions that fulfill customer needs and provide a competitive advantage through right design and equipment selection.
  • Compliance: Ensure all proposed solutions adhere strictly to local standards, regulation, codes and safety requirements.
  • Technical Documentation: Produce comprehensive engineering packages, including capacity and design calculations, technical drawings, single line diagrams, layouts and specifications.
  • Value Proposition: Develop solution presentations, value propositions and compliance matrices to demonstrate technical alignment.
  • Project Lifecycle Oversight: Design solutions should ensure successful project implementation and customer satisfaction.
  • On-site Engineering Support: Provide technical guidance to the teams during installation regarding engineering processes, tools, procedures, regulatory compliance while ensuring quality control and accurate technical interpretation.

Bid Management

  • Proposal Development:  Provide bid management support through the preparation of technical solution proposals, including the development of detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQ) and Bills of Materials (BOM).
  • Vendor Strategy and Costing: Identify and qualify third-party vendors. Establish preliminary cost estimates and ensure alignment with project budgetary requirements.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Participate in customer meetings to provide updates on proposal status and address any technical or logistical challenges.
  • Risk Mitigation and Reporting: Proactively identify and escalate roadblocks during the proposal phase to internal stakeholders, providing consistent status reports to the Country Solutions Manager.
  • Process Governance: Maintain strict adherence to Schneider Electric’s project methodologies, internal processes and approval procedures throughout the bid lifecycle.

Customer Care and Quality

  • Quality Assurance: Ensure alignment between the proposed technical solution and the project scope to deliver high-quality and high-performance outcomes.
  • Pre-sales Excellence: Deliver engineering services during the pre-sales phase to drive highest customer satisfaction and trust.
  • Issue Resolution and Escalation: Escalate customer concerns to the Solutions Manager, maintaining accountability for the successful resolution and closure of all issues.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify solution or process enhancements, documenting and communicating to the respective owners and stakeholders to drive organizational excellence.

Partner Management

  • Vendor Qualification and Compliance: Identifying, qualifying, and managing third-party partners to ensure they strictly adhere to Schneider Electric’s methodologies, safety standards, and code of conduct.
  • Performance and Strategic Selection: Monitor partner performance and select service providers based on their ability to deliver high quality results and enhance overall customer satisfaction.

Training and Development

  • Competency Building : Lead the training and development of internal staff and external partners to ensure the high level technical competency required for successful service delivery.
  • Continuous Professional Growth: Proactively maintain and update personal expertise in emerging technologies, industry tools, and evolving regulatory and industry standards.

What qualifications will make you successful for this role?

  • Bachelor’s Degree Electrical Engineering
  • Minimum 10 years in Engineering or related discipline, particularly in mission critical applications and consulting engagement skills
  • Travel requirement: International (25%)
  • Technical Skills:
  • Electrical Expertise: In depth understanding of electrical distribution system design, including knowledge of electrical system components such as transformers, HV, MV, LV switchboards, electrical switchboard design standards, grounding, generator systems, etc.
  • Industry Standards: Demonstrate a thorough understanding of global best practices for the design, installation and operation of electrical systems.
  • Engineering Documentation and Procurement: Possess proven skills in project engineering and the development of technical documentation, supported by strong capabilities in vendor qualification and commercial negotiation.
  • Stakeholder Management: Confidently engage and build professional relationships with senior IT directors, facility managers, external consultants and executive-level stakeholders within major corporations
  • Leadership and Mentorship: Demonstrate exceptional leadership qualities with a structured methodology for developing, mentoring and motivating the Engineering and Project team.
  • Effective Communication: A strong communicator capable of articulating complex technical and non-technical information effectively, both in writing and verbally, to diverse audiences.
  • Customer Advocacy and Professionalism: Maintain a professional, customer-centric approach when engaging with both internal and external clients.
  • Operational Excellence: Exhibit superior time management and the ability to consistently meet project deadlines under pressure.
  • Ethics and Cultural Agility: Uphold the highest standards of business ethics and integrity, with the flexibility to adapt operational styles within a multi-cultural environment.

Let us learn about you! Apply today.

The QVE (Quality Value Engineering) Technical Lead role at Schneider Electric is a specialized leadership position focused on driving cost optimization, quality improvements, and value engineering initiatives across product lines.

  • Collaborate with global HUBs and regional teams (e.g., China, France) to ensure alignment and knowledge transfer.

Fair knowledge on manufacturing processes (e.g., molding, stamping, machining, moulding etc..) & assembly processes  with decent knowledge on materials selection.

Good communication and presentation skills—both verbal and written—with the ability to prepare necessary status reports and technical presentations to stakeholders.

Proven track record of successfully launching new product development, QVE (quality value engineering), customizations, localization of products & part and product transfer project.

Familiarity with industrial costing and supply chain optimization

Roles & mission

The role of a Line Localization Engineer at Schneider Electric is responsible for providing Engineering Support for all assigned Line localization/duplication projects defined with GSC (International). Here's a consolidated overview of the key responsibilities and qualifications:

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all engineering aspects of complex line localization and industrialization projects, ensuring timely delivery of business so as to meet quality, cost, and delivery targets.
  • Collaborate with various departments including Global Supply Chain (GSC), Offer Strategy teams, League Leaders to ensure alignment and seamless project execution.
  • Align with all stakeholders (Quality, Indus, GSC..) to ensure smooth execution and meet the project schedules
  • Collaborate with other  global Hubs (e.g., China, France,NAM) for all aspects of Engineering documentation and support, Gate approvals, know how and knowledge transfer.
  • Planning & Execution- Develop project plans using Work Breakdown Structures, Manage project schedules and monitor KPI achievements for all Line localization projects.
  • Work closely with Product Owners on product technical specifications and Offer Technical Leaders for Engineering documentation, Testing plans,Certification requirements
  • Develop and test product qualification, certification and reliability requirements. Provide technical guidance to cross functional teams esp GSC assigned to Localization project.
  • Coordinate product qualification and documentation for handover to production facilities. Help ensure readiness of local production lines, including tooling, process validation.
  • Manage execution of Manufactured samples build, validation and testing in close co-ordination with GSC Technical & Quality Team
  • Prepare all the artifacts, documents, results, presentations for the stage reviews to meet the stage gates criteria. Provide input into project gate reviews (e.g., Do Gate), and help define the best industrial/supply chain scenarios.
  • Develop and update product documentation including drawings, BOM's and design guides.
  • Ensure timely reporting and updates to all stakeholders on project status and risks.
  • Troubleshoot and perform root cause analysis to resolve design related failures during localization completion and stabilization.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in product design, testing, and validation processes.
  • Drive process optimization and standardization across localized lines.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, Electrical, or Electromechanical Engineering
  • Experience: Minimum 4-8 years in a similar industry
  • Certifications in PMP, dFSR, Quality tools desired.

Preferred: Preferred experience in LV domain, with understanding of ACB, MCCB, MCB, CTR ( overload relay, contactor, MPCB), Busways; LV panel.  Deep knowledge on 2 (compulsory) or more is desirable.

Skills

Experience in product life cycle  product design & development, production, costing, quality, value engineering,

Fair knowledge on continuous Engineering process with good Project management skills.

Good knowledge on design tools PDM/PLM/Creo. Past experience in SE tools (PDM/Symphony/MCSV/3D/2D drawing release) & SE process is an added advantage

job.description:
Job Description

Ready to drive a meaningful IMPACT in shaping how we bring offers to market? This role bridges global offer strategy with India market execution for IDPAC Activity within Industrial Automation BU, combining portfolio ownership and roadmap, go-to-market leadership, commercial performance, and customer-backed innovation across industrial automation segments.

Responsibilities-

  • Lead and grow IDPAC Offer portfolio for Greater India with ownership of offers across ePAC Controllers, DCS, Open SDA, connectivity and related software’s.
  • Translate global PAC Process Automation Controllers offer roadmaps into India-relevant portfolio choices, unique value propositions, launch priorities, pricing actions and sales enablement.
  • Build a differentiated offer strategy for target segments with sharp focus on growth, profitability and market-share expansion.
  • Champion OPEN software-defined open automation by positioning hardware-independent, interoperable and application-centric architectures that reduce vendor lock-in and improve agility for customers.
  • Act as the strategic and operational reference point between Global teams, India Sales, Segment Marketing, Prescription, Channel Ecosystem and customers to drive end-to-end offer lifecycle performance.

Requirements-

  • BE/BTech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation or equivalent engineering discipline.
  • Discrete & Process Automation Exposure (Good to have)
  • MBA / PGDM, product management certification, commercial strategy exposure, or specialization in industrial software / digital transformation (Good to have)
  • 8 Years of overall experience
  • 6+ years in PLC/DCS/SCADA, process control architectures, automation software, portfolio management, go-to-market execution, or customer-facing solution positioning.

COMPETENCIES REQUIRED

Technical Competencies

  • Strong understanding of PLC, DCS, SCADA, industrial networks, cybersecure architectures and process control applications.
  • Ability to position integrated IDPAC architectures across EcoStruxure Plant layers.
  • Domain knowledge of software-defined open automation concepts: decoupling software from hardware, open standards, interoperability, reusable libraries and modular application design.

Functional Competencies-

  • Offer strategy, portfolio lifecycle management, product launch, go-to-market planning, pricing, forecast/pipeline governance and business performance tracking.
  • Ability to convert market intelligence, competitor activity and customer pain points into offer gaps, roadmap asks, value propositions and sales plays.
  • Strong presentation, stakeholder management and influencing skills across sales, global teams, prescription, channels, SI partners and customers.

Behavioral Competencies-

  • Customer-first & mission-based mindset, strategic clarity, ownership, collaboration, structured execution and ability to influence without authority.
  • Self-learner with curiosity for digital automation shifts, comfort with ambiguity, strong communication discipline and ability to simplify complex automation topics for commercial teams.

Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead

Job Description

The Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead serves as the primary technical point of contact across product development teams, driving the design, development, integration, validation, and delivery of complex multi-technology products. This role combines expertise in Electronics Hardware, Embedded Systems, Connectivity Technologies, and System Engineering to ensure successful execution throughout the product lifecycle.

The role is responsible for influencing technical architecture, ensuring design feasibility, driving cross-functional collaboration, managing technical risks, and leading system integration efforts across multiple engineering domains. The Technical Lead works closely with R&D, Product Management, Program Teams, Quality, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders to deliver innovative, reliable, and scalable solutions that meet customer and business requirements.

About the Role (Mission)

As a Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead, your mission is to provide technical leadership for the development of next-generation multi-technology products by leveraging expertise in electronics hardware, embedded systems, electrical engineering, software integration, connectivity solutions, and system architecture. You will drive innovation, technical excellence, and cross-domain collaboration to deliver high-quality products that create meaningful value for customers and the business.

What will you do?

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Serve as the primary technical lead throughout the product lifecycle from concept to commercialization.
  • Define and influence product architecture, technical roadmaps, and system-level design strategies.
  • Lead cross-functional technical discussions and drive key engineering decisions.
  • Ensure alignment between product requirements, system architecture, and business objectives.

Electronics Hardware & System Design

  • Lead the development and integration of electronics hardware systems, including analog, digital, mixed-signal, power electronics, control systems, and embedded platforms.
  • Review hardware schematics, PCB designs, component selection, and system-level interfaces.
  • Ensure hardware reliability, safety, manufacturability, and compliance with applicable industry standards.
  • Support design verification and validation activities for electronic and electrical systems.

Multi-technology Product Integration

  • Drive seamless integration across hardware, firmware, software, mechanical, electrical, communication, and cloud-connected systems.
  • Ensure interoperability between subsystems and platforms.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve complex system integration challenges.
  • Define interface requirements and integration strategies for connected products.

Program Execution & Technical Planning

  • Define technical scope, development plans, resource needs, and engineering effort estimates.
  • Prioritize technical activities based on business and shared team backlog priorities.
  • Monitor technical progress and proactively address project risks and dependencies.
  • Support product release readiness reviews and milestone achievements.

Validation, Testing & Quality

  • Develop system validation strategies, test plans, and verification methodologies.
  • Lead system integration testing, qualification activities, and root cause investigations.
  • Ensure compliance with performance, reliability, safety, EMC/EMI, and regulatory requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement in quality, reliability, and customer satisfaction.

Innovation & Problem Solving

  • Investigate emerging technologies and industry trends.
  • Conduct technical research and feasibility studies for new products and features.
  • Identify, analyze, and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Recommend innovative solutions that improve product performance, cost, quality, and scalability.

Mentorship & Collaboration

  • Mentor and guide engineers across multiple technology domains.
  • Provide technical reviews, coaching, and knowledge sharing.
  • Foster a collaborative and innovation-driven engineering culture.
  • Partner effectively with product management, program management, quality, manufacturing, and customer-facing teams.

What qualifications will make you successful for this role?

Education

  • BE / B.Tech / ME / M.Tech / MSc in:
  • Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE)
  • Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE)
  • Electronics Engineering
  • Embedded Systems
  • Systems Engineering

Experience

  • Proven experience leading complex multi-technology product development programs.
  • Experience in electronics hardware design, embedded systems, electrical systems, and product integration.
  • Demonstrated success in driving technical decisions across multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Experience managing system validation, verification, and product qualification activities.
  • Strong background in product development from concept, design, integration, testing, and product launch.

Technical Skills

  • Electronics Hardware Design and Development
  • Analog, Digital, and Mixed-Signal Electronics
  • Embedded Systems and Microcontroller-based Architectures
  • Power Electronics and Control Systems
  • PCB Design, Hardware Validation, and Debugging
  • Electrical Systems Integration
  • Firmware and Software-Hardware Interface Design
  • System Architecture and Systems Engineering
  • Signal Integrity, EMC/EMI, Reliability, and Safety Engineering
  • IoT, Industrial Automation, Smart Connected Products
  • Communication Protocols (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Modbus, Ethernet, USB)
  • Wireless Technologies (Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Zigbee, LoRa, Cellular)
  • Product Lifecycle Management and Engineering Change Processes
  • Requirements Management, Risk Assessment, and Root Cause Analysis
  • Agile and Hybrid Product Development Methodologies

Leadership & Professional Skills

  • Strong technical leadership and decision-making capabilities.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders across engineering and business functions.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently and navigate ambiguous technical challenges.
  • Proven experience mentoring engineers and building high-performing technical teams.
  • Strong project planning, prioritization, and execution capabilities.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

Join us in developing innovative, next-generation products that combine electronics hardware, embedded systems, and system technologies. As a Senior Engineer II, Multi-technology Product Technical Lead, you will play a pivotal role in shaping technical strategy, driving engineering excellence, and delivering impactful solutions that advance technology and create meaningful value for customers worldwide. Your expertise and leadership will help transform ideas into industry-leading products while mentoring the next generation of engineering talent.

job.title: Engineer II, Package Substation Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

Senior Mechanical Design Engineer

Package Substation Solutions

Location: Bangalore, India

About the Role

Schneider Electric is expanding its portfolio of outdoor package substation solutions to support customers across global markets. We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer to join our Package Substation Solutions team to play a key role in the design and delivery of reliable and field-proven substation solutions.

The role offers the opportunity to work on international projects, collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering teams. Specific projects initially in India and Australia working directly with the UK technical expert and product owner for Package Substations.

Role Purpose

The Mechanical Design Engineer will be responsible for the end-to-end mechanical design of package substations and outdoor enclosure & work closely with the global PSS OTL. The role focuses on delivering robust, manufacturable, and compliant solutions that meet customer requirements while ensuring structural integrity, operational safety, ease of installation, and cost-effective fabrication.

The successful candidate will contribute to both project execution and continuous product improvement by leveraging existing designs and developing new package substation platforms for global applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop detailed 3D models and assemblies for package substations, enclosures, and associated equipment using Creo.
  • Create efficient equipment layouts that optimise accessibility, maintainability, ventilation, safety clearances, and installation requirements.
  • Adapt and enhance existing package substation designs to improve speed, quality, and standardisation.
  • Design new package substation structures and enclosure solutions based on customer-specific technical requirements.
  • Specify structural materials, sheet metal components, steel grades, coatings, and corrosion protection systems.
  • Generate manufacturing-ready engineering drawings incorporating GD&T principles and applicable fabrication standards.
  • Prepare technical documentation and engineering data packages for seismic, vibration, and finite element analysis activities.
  • Support manufacturing, sourcing, and project teams during design reviews and product industrialisation activities.
  • Collaborate with global engineering teams across India, the UK, and Australia to deliver customer projects on schedule and to quality standards.

Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on design standardisation, cost optimisation, and product reliability

job.title: Service Desk Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

The Service Desk Analyst provides support for basic incident resolution and requests reported by APAC Schneider Employees. Responsibilities include initial assessment, research, and resolution of basic incidents and requests regarding use of applications, software and infrastructure components. The Service Desk Analyst would be responsible for collecting information through a customer conversation, probing, accessing support tools, and additional support teams if needed. Problems beyond the scope of their ability or responsibility are resolved by engaging other support teams in a timely manner.

Responsibilities:

1) Addresses and resolves basic incidents and requests; logs all incidents and requests; engages

other service desks or appropriate support teams to resolve incidents that are beyond the scope of

their ability or responsibility.

2) Uses the appropriate CTI categories for logging incidents and requests.

3) Creates a positive customer support experience and builds strong relationships through deep

problem understanding, ensuring timely resolution or escalation, communicating promptly on

progress, and handling customers with a professional attitude.

4) Ensures the end-to-end customer experience and acts as a single point-of-contact for the

customer.

5) Analyzes and resolves incidents and requests regarding use of application, software or hardware.

Logs and tracks incidents/requests from identification through resolution. Follows up with other

support teams involved in resolution to ensure incidents are resolved, requests are filled, and the

customer communication is complete. Documents resolutions and updates self-help knowledgebase.

6) Gains knowledge on applications, processes, and support to increase ability to resolve requests on

first contact.

7) Provides after hours and on-call support as needed.

8) Adheres to and supports ITIL standards and procedures.

9) Adheres to Companies Code of Conduct and Mission and Value statements.

10) Flexible to perform other adhoc duties/shifts assigned as per operational requirement.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (Required):

Demonstrates and desire to learn processes, application, and technology.

Demonstrates good customer handling skills and techniques.

Good communication and negotiation skills.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Preferred:

Competency in MS Office O365 Suite.

ITIL Foundation certification (not Mandatory)

Prior experience in supporting customers in Technical Service Desk environment.

Prior experience voice, chat & email support.

Proficiency in using support software tools –Outlook,O365, Active Directory, VPN, Service Now,

Windows 8/10 and above, iOS & Android devices.

job.title: Senior Treasury Financing Operations Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Role Overview

As the Senior Treasury Financing Operations Specialist, you will provide execution support to the Malaysia treasury function across financing documentation, internal coordination, and compliance administration. Reporting to the Treasury Manager, you will support the operational backbone of financing activities — preparing submissions, maintaining trackers and records, and ensuring information flows accurately between internal teams, bankers, lawyers, and valuers.

This is a hands-on, on-site role suited to someone who is organised, detail-oriented, and want exposure to managing large financing facilities.

Key Responsibilities

Financing Documentation & Submissions

  • Prepare drawdown notices, rollover notices, utilisation requests, and supporting schedules for the Treasury Manager’s review.
  • First level compilation to support KYC documentation, account opening packs, and routine information requests from banks.
  • Draft and manage routine correspondence with bankers, lawyers, and valuers under the Treasury Manager’s direction.
  • Maintain the financing document repository, ensuring executed copies, schedules, and side letters are properly filed and retrievable.
  • Where applicable, follow up on signature workflows to completion.

Loan Administration & Documentation

  • Maintain and update the internal trackers eg. asset DCs register, monitor renewal/expiry of guarantees, offtaker agreements, notice of assignments, and valuation reports.
  • Coordinate with valuers, surveyors, and consultants for land or asset valuations required to support financing and loan reviews.
  • Compile periodic lender requests, including supporting invoices, certifications, and architect/engineer sign-offs for project drawdowns.

Compliance Tracking & Reporting Compilation

  • First level oversight of ongoing Conditions Precedent (CP) and Conditions Subsequent (CS) trackers and escalate to Treasury Manager where deadlines are at risk.
  • Compile inputs and draft data packs for periodic reporting (monthly loan reports, compliance certificates, utilisation reports, project progress updates, sustainability-linked KPI/green certificate submissions).

Internal Coordination

  • First level gathering of financial and operational information from Finance, Projects, and Legal teams to satisfy periodic /ad-hoc banker requests and ongoing reviews.
  • Coordinate calendar scheduling of site visits and document handoffs.

Operational Support & Improvement

  • Support account / process documentation, and treasury automation initiatives.
  • Perform other ad-hoc treasury and financing tasks as directed.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in corporate treasury, corporate/wholesale banking, transaction banking, or audit.
  • Working knowledge of loan documentation, security documentation, and the BNM regulatory framework.
  • Good Excel skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English; working Mandarin is an advantage.

job.title: Senior Manager, Brand
job.description:

This is a strategic role responsible for defining the brand vision, ensuring consistent execution across markets, and overseeing the creative quality of DayOne’s global presence — from corporate identity and digital experiences to flagship events and thought leadership exposure. job.title: Staff AI Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As a Staff AI Engineer at AirTrunk, you will lead the design and delivery of agentic AI applications and the software that brings them into everyday use. This hands-on role combines applied AI, software development and architectural judgement. You will build systems that plan, use tools and carry out multi-step work, taking them from experimentation to reliable production operation. Working with Product, Data, Platform and Security teams, you will shape technical direction, mentor engineers and improve how our teams work.

What You'll Do

You’ll design and build AI agents that can plan tasks, use tools and adapt to results. You’ll choose the right agent approach, give agents the context and memory they need, connect them securely to enterprise systems, and test them against realistic tasks to improve their reliability. You’ll also write and review production code, shape application architecture, and work with Product and Data teams to turn business needs into useful software.

You’ll take AI applications from early prototypes through to production and ongoing support. You’ll establish automated tests, agent evaluations and controlled release processes, then monitor task success, speed and cost to identify and resolve issues. Working with Platform engineers, you’ll support deployment and operational readiness across Azure, Databricks and related services, making sure applications can recover safely when interrupted and avoid repeating actions.

You’ll build privacy, security and responsible AI controls into agent design, including appropriate access permissions, protected credentials and human review for consequential actions. You’ll work with Security and business teams to assess risks, test for unsafe or unreliable behaviour, and agree practical safeguards. You’ll also lead complex technical work, make architectural decisions, mentor engineers and share reusable tools and lessons with AirTrunk’s Data and AI community.

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years’ experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related discipline, with hands-on delivery and operation of complex production systems, including agentic applications using tools, orchestration and context management.
  • Strong software architecture skills across APIs, backend services, distributed systems and enterprise integrations, with sound judgement about complexity and trade-offs.
  • Advanced Python skills and strong engineering fundamentals, including automated testing, code review, version control and maintainable design; working knowledge of SQL and data access patterns.
  • Practical understanding of context engineering, memory and agent evaluation, including how to assess task completion, tool behaviour and failure recovery.
  • Experience delivering secure cloud applications using CI/CD, containers and observability, in partnership with platform teams; understanding of application security, privacy and Responsible AI, including identity, authorisation and risks from model outputs and tool execution.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership, including guiding architectural decisions, planning pragmatic delivery, influencing across teams, mentoring engineers and improving quality through reusable patterns and shared practices.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with Azure and Databricks, or comparable cloud and AI platforms, is beneficial.
  • Experience with TypeScript or JavaScript and web application development is beneficial, particularly for delivering complete AI user experiences.
  • Experience with agent SDKs, MCP integrations and AI-assisted software development is beneficial, with strong review and verification practices.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Associate GCP Data Engineer - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Job Summary

As a key member of the Data Team at Equinix, we are seeking a skilled GCP Data Engineer who will be responsible for end-to-end development of Data Engineering use cases, Equinix Data Lake platform and tools. You will design, build, and maintain scalable data infrastructure and analytics solutions on Google Cloud Platform. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in cloud-native data technologies and a passion for building robust, efficient data pipelines that drive business insights.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Cloud Dataflow, Cloud Composer (Apache Airflow), Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Build real-time streaming data pipelines using Cloud Pub/Sub, Kafka and Dataflow
  • Implement automated data quality checks and monitoring across all data workflows
  • Optimize pipeline performance and cost efficiency through proper resource allocation and scheduling
  • Architect and implement data lake and data warehouse solutions using Dataproc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, and Cloud SQL
  • Design optimal data models, partitioning strategies, and clustering for analytical workloads
  • Manage data lifecycle policies and implement automated archival and retention strategies
  • Ensure data security, encryption, and access control across all storage layers
  • Build and optimize BigQuery datasets for analytics and reporting use cases
  • Create and maintain dimensional models and fact tables for business intelligence
  • Implement data marts and aggregation layers for improved query performance
  • Support self-service analytics through proper data cataloging and documentation
  • Having good knowledge of Dataplex and Analytics hub
  • Integrate data from various sources including databases, APIs, SaaS applications, and file systems
  • Implement change data capture (CDC) solutions for real-time data synchronization
  • Work with third-party data providers and external data feeds
  • Implement comprehensive monitoring and alerting using Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging
  • Troubleshoot data pipeline issues and implement robust error handling mechanisms
  • Maintain data lineage documentation and impact analysis capabilities

Qualifications

Technical Skills

  • GCP Services: 2+ years hands-on experience with BigQuery, Cloud Dataflow Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage, Cloud Pub/Sub, Dataform/dbt and Cloud Functions
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python/Java and SQL; experience with Spark/Beam development
  • Data Technologies: Strong understanding of Apache Beam, Apache Airflow, and distributed computing concepts
  • Database Systems: Experience with both RDBMS (Cloud SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (Bigtable, Firestore) databases
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, or similar tools

Professional Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field
  • 2+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles
  • 2+ years of specific experience with Google Cloud Platform
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of data modelling techniques and dimensional modelling

Preferred Qualifications

  • Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer certification
  • Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE)
  • Experience with data governance and compliance frameworks (GDPR, HIPAA, SOX)
  • Familiarity with business intelligence tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI)
  • Experience with streaming technologies beyond GCP (Kafka, Spark Streaming)

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. job.title: Plant Head (PSP Hydro- O&M)
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Ensure reliable, safe, and efficient operation of all generating units, auxiliaries, and balance of plant systems.
  • Develops and maintains safe system of work (SSOW) procedures, including HIRA, PTW, LOTO, JSA etc.
  • Ensures full compliance with Statutory HSS, environmental and technical requirements from central and state governmental bodies (i.e. CEA, CERC, DSA, SCEI, AP/CPCB, Cybersecurity etc. compliances).
  • To provide oversight of all operational & maintenance activities, management of the operational and maintenance teams, financial control, contract management, environmental compliance, regulatory compliance, technical compliance, risk evaluations and relationship management.
  • Achieve generation targets, pumping schedules, and meet SLDC / RLDC instructions. Liaison with SLDC/RLDC, DISCOMs, OEMs, regulatory bodies and government agencies, as and when required.
  • Strategic oversight of reliability centered maintenance (RCM), including preventive, predictive, condition based and corrective maintenance approach.
  • Maintaining and sharing complete plant operation & maintenance records, including daily, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting needed to corporate office management team.
  • Prepare and manage plant O&M budget and P&Ls, work to optimize the costs and maximize production. This includes developing and tracking the monthly, quarterly, and annual budgets and keeping them within approved limits.
  • Responsible for overseeing end‑to‑end O&M contract management, including contractor performance monitoring, compliance, service delivery, budgeting, and risk mitigation.
  • Responsible for local co-ordination with Government authorities / clients / Vendors and local community representees. Effective Coordination and dispute settlements with O&M contractor, local community and other stakeholders, as and when required.
  • Ensure availability of critical spares inventory to meet the exigencies, in co-ordination with plant maintenance heads.
  • Support billing, PPA compliance, DSM management, and settlements, as and when required.
  • Define and monitor O&M Plans to achieve yearly Generation targets (including minimization of APC) and yearly agreed of Plant/Machines Availability targets.
  • Delegates and assigns work tasks to Plant O&M team to maintain optimum plant operations.
  • Assess plant operational procedures to identify areas of inefficiency and formulate action plan for continuous improvements.
  • Lead plant improvement projects, modernization initiatives, digital transformation, and automation upgrades.
  • Lead, train and develop a multi-disciplinary team at Plant level: i.e. for operations, mechanical, electrical, C&I, safety, civil and other support functions.
  • Develop and execute risk management strategies to mitigate O&M risks and ensure compliance with internal audits.
  • Ensure implementation on approved CSR plan at plant level.
  • IMS implementation at Plant and coordination with central IMS team.

Qualifications

  • B.E/B.Tech in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.
  • 20+ years of experience in operations and maintenance within the hydro power generation sector.
  • Strong knowledge of Statutory and regulatory requirements pertaining to Hydro and PSS Plants.
  • Must have O&M experience in large-scale hydropower plants/ pump storage plants.
  • Experience leading a team of managers, engineers and technicians for large scale hydro/pump storage power Plants operations and maintenance works.
  • Experience with CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management Systems) for Plant Operations and Maintenance works.
  • Knowledge of analytics tools for performance optimization and risk assessment.
  • Advanced certifications in operations management or power generation technologies are preferred

job.title: Senior Manager, Project Delivery, Korea
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

**

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

The Senior Manager, Project Delivery (Korea) will be accountable for the execution of assigned data centre project(s) in Korea, delivering from pre-construction through construction, commissioning and customer handover. The role reports to the Country Head, Project Delivery – Korea and forms part of the in-country project delivery team.

This role drives schedule adherence, cost control, and execution excellence on the ground, directing the external PMCM team and supported by the platform’s Design Delivery, Commercial, Procurement, and Testing & Commissioning (T&C) teams. The Senior Manager ensures each assigned project is executed safely, efficiently, and in line with the business’s Required Ready-for-Service (RFS) timeline and approved budget.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery

  • Lead day-to-day delivery of assigned project(s) across the full lifecycle – pre-construction planning, tendering support, mobilization, construction, commissioning and customer handover.
  • Act as the accountable owner for schedule, cost, quality and safety outcomes on assigned project(s), escalating key risks and decisions to the Country Head, Project Delivery.
  • Coordinate inputs from platform teams (Design Delivery, Commercial, Procurement, T&C) and local stakeholders to ensure integrated, timely delivery.
  • Administer project change control – ensure changes to scope, cost, schedule and design are assessed, reviewed, approved, documented and communicated in line with Digital Edge governance.

Schedule Management

  • Develop and maintain the project master schedule with the contractor and PMCM team, identifying key milestones, critical path and dependencies.
  • Drive schedule adherence, recovery and acceleration to meet or improve business RFS targets.
  • Run schedule governance – regular progress tracking, look-ahead reviews, risk assessment and mitigation planning.

Procurement & Contract Management

  • Support the Country Head and Commercial team in shaping the procurement strategy and contract packaging for assigned project(s).
  • Participate in bid evaluation, technical clarification and contractor / vendor selection with the Commercial and Procurement teams.
  • Administer the construction contract(s) day-to-day – instructions, variations, claims, progress payment reviews and contractual correspondence – ensuring procurement timelines align with construction phasing.

Construction Execution

  • Direct the external PMCM team, contractors, consultants and key vendors to ensure safe, timely and high-quality execution.
  • Resolve site-level issues, RFIs and design conflicts in collaboration with the Design Delivery team and in-country Project Engineers.
  • Ensure strict adherence to HSE, QA/QC and Digital Edge construction governance standards, including Korean statutory, permitting and inspection requirements.

Testing, Commissioning & Handover

  • Coordinate with the T&C team and Project Engineers on testing, integrated systems verification and handover documentation.
  • Drive readiness for customer handover aligned with technical specifications, customer requirements, SLAs and business RFS milestones.

Stakeholder & Team Management

  • Lead and develop the in-country project team assigned to the project(s) (Project Engineers and support staff), providing direction, clarity and problem-solving support.
  • Report regularly to the Country Head, Project Delivery on progress, risks, mitigations, cost position and commercial implications.
  • Build strong working relationships with customer project teams, local authorities, utilities, contractors and internal platform leads.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Candidate Profile:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience delivering large-scale construction projects, preferably data centres or mission-critical facilities in Korea.
  • Proven track record in managing contractors and multiple stakeholders, and leading project delivery teams.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, schedule management, contract administration and construction governance.
  • Working knowledge of Korean construction regulations, permitting and statutory processes, and international standards (NFPA, ASHRAE, IEC, ISO).
  • Fluent in Korean and English (written and spoken).
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential is advantageous.

job.title: Lead, AI & Agent Operations #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

Lead the Day 2 AI & Agent Operations function, accountable for operating, monitoring, evaluating and governing the organisation’s production AI estate — GenAI agents and traditional classical AI/ML models. Manage agent operations and evaluation / observability team and the traditional classical machine-learning operations team. Own the operating model that takes AI from build to dependable production — handover gates, 24×7 monitoring and incident response, evaluation and observability, and safe model operations. Ensure defined standards of reliability, safety and quality. Serve as the senior operational point of accountability for AI in production, and as the primary partner to the Day 1 build organisation, platform, data and business stakeholders.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own the Day 2 operating model end to end — handover gates, evaluation and observability, 24×7 agent operations, and traditional ML operations — across both locations.
  • Lead and develop both the Singapore and India team of agent operations & evaluation and ML operations.
  • Manage a distributed, cross-border operation: define how Singapore and India work together, ensure clear ownership and handoffs, and safeguard coverage, quality and team wellbeing across time zones.
  • Hold gate and go/no-go authority for the AI estate, and protect the integrity of evaluation decisions — ensuring that even where the same engineers both run and evaluate agents, quality judgments remain evidence-based and are not compromised by delivery pressure.
  • Own incident governance for the estate — severity standards, escalation, rollback and the contact-centre fallback for customer-impacting events — and represent major incidents and remediation to senior stakeholders.
  • Govern deployment and change discipline for agents and ML models (regression gating, rollback authority, change coordination) with the platform and Day 1 build teams.
  • Own the function’s service-level objectives, error-budget policy and KPIs (availability, proactive-detection rate, mean-time-to-resolve, model performance, cost) and report AI reliability and value to the Chief AI Officer and the board.
  • Set the growth and maturity roadmap for the function — scaling coverage, tooling and headcount as the AI estate grows.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
  • 10+ years in technology with experience leading production operations, SRE, or ML/AI functions
  • Experience leading teams, including remote or offshore / cross-border teams
  • Track record operating or governing ML/AI systems in production
  • AI/ML operations, reliability engineering and observability
  • Evaluation, gating and quality governance for AI
  • Understanding of both LLM/agent and traditional ML lifecycles and their failure modes
  • Incident management, service-level objectives and error budgets
  • People leadership across cultures, locations and time zones, with care for team wellbeing
  • The independence and integrity to protect quality and safety under pressure
  • Clear, decisive judgment under incomplete information and during incidents
  • Strong stakeholder management and executive communication
  • Telco consumer, enterprise (B2B) and network operations and their customer-impact considerations

job.title: Senior Agent Operations & Evaluation Engineer​ #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

An engineering role that operates the live GenAI agents and builds the evaluation and observability that proves they are accurate, safe and improving.

On the operations side, keeps agents healthy, performs first-level triage and incident response, and minimises downtime.

On the evaluation and observability side, builds the operational dashboard for each use case, defines the metrics that matter, runs the evaluation suites, and proactively detects issues before customers do.

Works closely with the Day 1 build teams, solution architects and business owners across Singtel Singapore.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Build and maintain the operational observability dashboard for each AI / agent and Classical AI ML use case, across system health, performance, quality, safety and business-outcome metrics.
  • Define, with build teams and solution architects (technical metrics) and product / business owners (outcome metrics), what needs to be measured per use case; consume the telemetry the platform provides.
  • Build and run the evaluation suites (offline before launch and continuous evaluation on sampled production traffic after) and drive proactive detection of drift and quality decay.
  • Monitor live agents, using the dashboards and automated safeguards, and act on alerts and proactive signals.
  • Perform first-level triage and in-scope fixes (restart, safe-listed configuration, cache reset, routing fallback) per the runbooks.
  • Manage incidents — classify severity, route by fault domain, escalate with a full evidence bundle, and verify-and-close in production — while owning the incident throughout.
  • Contribute to the handover gate — verifying operability and evaluation evidence before an agent is accepted into full operation.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field
  • 6 - 10 years across software / SRE / data or ML engineering
  • Hands-on production operations experience AND hands-on evaluation, data-analysis or quality experience
  • Experience with LLM / agentic systems
  • Monitoring, alerting and observability; log / trace analysis
  • Evaluation methods and metric design for AI systems
  • Dashboarding tools and Python
  • Understanding of LLM / agent architectures and failure modes
  • LLM observability and evaluation tooling (e.g. tracing, eval harnesses)
  • Incident management practice
  • Composure and clear communication under incident pressure
  • Analytical rigour and attention to detail
  • Ability to context-switch and prioritise across two disciplines
  • Clear technical writing for gate findings
  • Ability to influence build teams on quality
  • Understanding of telco customer intents and journeys

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Electrician - Level II
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship. Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis. Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments. Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system. Follows all process documentation and quality procedures. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Delivery Performs electrical repairs and maintenance of manufacturing equipment . Demonstrates a high level of competency in core work skills. Performs and documents preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities. Conforms to applicable codes and standards to maintain, install, and operate electrical systems. Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks. Performs other duties as required to meet business goals. Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Electrical System Troubleshooting - Analyzes an electrical control system to resolve and repair electrical issues to return the system to proper operating conditions.

Factory Automation and Control Systems - Implements changes to further automate manufacturing processes using available technology, programming techniques, and identifying needed material and resources for project completion to provide the optimum automation for the manufacturing environment.

Machine Programming - Creates factory floor machine programs by designing and implementing solutions to improve usage of machine and overall operation.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires some work experience or intermediate level knowledge obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Education, Licenses & Certifications

  • High School Diploma / Secondary Education Certificate or equivalent experience as per applicable regulations.
  • May require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.
  • Diploma in Electronics, Electrical, or Instrumentation Engineering.
  • 3–4 years of relevant maintenance experience in a manufacturing environment.

Experience & Technical Skills

  • Hands-on maintenance experience with CNC machines, robots, SPMs, washing machines, conveyors, nut runners, and other production equipment.
  • Strong working knowledge of FANUC and Siemens controllers.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens, Mitsubishi, and B&R PLC systems.
  • Familiarity with hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
  • Experience in preventive, predictive, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities.

Responsibilities

  • Perform day-to-day maintenance activities and troubleshoot equipment breakdowns in the machine shop.
  • Diagnose and resolve machine and equipment-related issues to ensure maximum uptime.
  • Execute Preventive Maintenance (PM), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), Corrective Maintenance (CM), and Emergency Maintenance (EM) activities.
  • Update maintenance records and work orders in the Cummins MAXIMO system.
  • Monitor and improve equipment performance indicators such as Uptime, MTBF, and MTTR.
  • Maintain and analyze machine breakdown history and prepare maintenance reports.
  • Undertake maintenance improvement projects to enhance KPIs and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with LOTO procedures, risk assessments, work permits, and safety practices.
  • Adhere to all safety regulations, PPE requirements, and workplace discipline standards.
  • Maintain 5S standards in the Machine Shop and Plant Engineering Department.
  • Drive housekeeping improvements and ensure a disciplined work environment.
  • Support maintenance operations across all three shifts as required.

job.title: Sourcing Manager-2437647
job.description:
Job Summary

  • Conducts complex analysis of markets, supply chains, and supply base; applies analysis to sourcing process improvement initiatives. Identifies qualified suppliers and executes sound source selection processes. Has regular interface with suppliers within area of responsibility and maintains the supplier relationship. Understands how key procurement principles are used toward assuring supply. Sources specialized items and executes complex sourcing strategies in accordance with agreed upong sourcing strategy / plans at the optimum cost, quality and relationship.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently carries out sourcing activities with full consideration for the impact of those activities on the end-to-end supply chain.
  • Executes sourcing tactics of varying complexity in accordance with established category/commodity strategies reflecting the optimum cost, quality, delivery.
  • Participates in sourcing and category commodity strategy formulation. Analyzes complex sourcing and procurement initiatives and processes in support of the delivery of cost effective and high quality goods and services.
  • Prepares and presents to senior procurement/sourcing leadership recommendations of improvement opportunities and alternative courses of action. Ensures consistent application of sourcing procedures and processes.
  • Supports procurement/sourcing management in activities such as price benchmarking, vendor management, industry and market analysis, process analysis, and model building.
  • May lead a team of sourcing analysts and specialists at the business unit category and/or international procurement organization (IPO) regional level. Leads analysis projects/initiatives providing coaching to less experienced analysts and specialists. Negotiates select contracts.
  • Develops and maintains effective relationships with suppliers to the benefit of both parties. Understands the importance of compliance and is alert to situations that can pose risk to Cummins Inc.

Competencies:

  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.
  • Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
  • Data Analytics - Discovers, interprets and communicates qualitative and quantitative data; determines conclusions relying on knowledge of business or functional frameworks; simultaneously applies statistics, data validity, data visualization, and problem solving approaches to effectively extract meaningful patterns and business insights; presents conclusions and outcomes that enable data driven business decisions.
  • Category Strategy Development - Establishes category strategy using Total Value Performance (TVP) approach to define the Supply Base, Tooling and Technology Strategy to meet all current and future Cummins' needs; Manages risk and inclusion of diverse suppliers.
  • Cost and Value Management - Establishes and controls product and service costs using functional tools to deliver and track product and services at competitive prices. Ensures competitiveness of Cummins products in our markets while preserving desired margins. Utilizes Total Cost Opportunity (TCO) model methodology.
  • Intellectual Property Management - Assures protection of Cummins Intellectual Property to optimize the use of intellectual property for Cummins future competitive advantage by engaging the Legal and Procurement function; assures Cummins’ intellectual property ownership rights are clearly defined in executed agreements.
  • Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.
  • Procurement Ethics - Avoids supplier engagement that may compromise supplier sourcing, selection, and management processes and seeks counsel to ensure compliance.
  • Procurement Policies, Procedures, Tools - Understands all of the relevant Procurement policies and procedures and complies with them in daily work; Masters all tools required to conduct procurement work. Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.
  • Sourcing - Utilizes the purchasing functional system to support the Request For Quote process and establish a Total Cost of Ownership comparison of suppliers based on the category strategy and define the supplier that is most likely to meet Cummins and customer's needs.
  • Supplier Contract Development - Develops contracts based on the templates available that cover commercial and legal relationship between Cummins and supplier; incorporates commercial requirements and legal requirements in the region(s) that are covered by the contracts; drives engagement between stakeholders following the Supplier Agreement Contracting Process (SACP) and negotiations excellence skills.
  • Supplier Relationship Management - Defines category’s key/strategic suppliers. Manages the relationship of those suppliers using agreed Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) process with established work plan, senior sponsor meetings, and scorecards. Defines and evaluates a collaborative relationship with a category’s key/strategic suppliers to deliver value to Cummins and the supplier.
  • Supply Base Risk Management - Minimize supplier risk to Cummins by proactively mitigating risks through use of risk analysis tools and risk mitigation playbook to manage three key risk: 1) Continuity of Supply, 2) Reputational Risk, and 3) Risk to our Margins of parts. By minimize disruption and services throughout supply chain. Manage and leverage supplier selection and dual sourcing opportunities as a first line of defense against supplier risk.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in field appropriate for the function required.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Intermediate level of related work experience required

Proficient in spoken English and capable of independently conducting conference calls with global teams.

Organization Cummins Inc.

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.title: Technical Specialist - SQE
job.description:
Job Summary

  • The Supplier Quality Engineer - Technical Specialist concentrates his/her product specific quality and technical skills to develop complex suppliers and products that can meet customer requirements; requires strong partnerships with the external supply base, with supply chain teams and with engineering to achieve results

Key Responsibilities

  • Build strong relationships with all critical partners to improve quality and business outcomes, including: external suppliers, external customers, and internal customers and stakeholders, such as Purchasing, Manufacturing and Engineering; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to strengthen the soft skills required to develop effective relationships.
  • Support the cross-functional development of external supply base strategies and the cross-functional supplier selection process for any given component; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products. Provide manufacturing consultation to external suppliers in order to design a Right First Time manufacturing process that enables conformance to the engineering print, engineering standards and customer specific requirements; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products.
  • Apply industry common Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, Automotive Industry Action Group (AIAG) tools, and Cummins specialty tools to develop zero defect components within the external supply base; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of APQP execution; experience and skills will be utilized to support increasingly complex products.
  • Embrace continuous improvement in the external supply base by leading complex product and process focused projects that utilize industry proven methodologies, such as lean and six-sigma.
  • Conduct external supplier audits in support of supplier risk mitigation, supplier readiness, and supplier performance improvement; coach and mentor Cummins professionals on how to improve auditing effectiveness.
  • Lead increasingly complex quality improvement plans within the external supply base in order to improve supplier performance. Ensure resolution of increasingly complex external supplier related quality challenges, by leading root cause analysis, by supporting development of corrective actions and by verifying the effectiveness of corrective actions; coach and mentor Supplier and Cummins professionals on how to improve effectiveness of problem resolution.

Competencies:

  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Auditing - Applying auditing skills and techniques and Quality Management Systems knowledge to effectively appraise a manufacturing process for quality and safety risks and non-conformances.
  • Interpreting Technical Requirements - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and Engineering Standards to correctly interpret the technical requirements of an engineering drawing; Applying knowledge to improve a product’s design for manufacturability and measurability.
  • Manufacturing Process Design - Applying knowledge of manufacturing technology (methods, techniques, tools, equipment, etc) to design a Zero Defect manufacturing process that can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.
  • Manufacturing Process Validation - Applying core Automotive tools (i.e. DFMEA, PFMEA, Control Plan, SPC, MSA, Source Release and PPAP) to validate that a manufacturing process can consistently meet technical and customer requirements.
  • Measurement Process Design - Applying knowledge of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing principles and knowledge of measurement technology (standards, techniques, equipment, etc) to design a measurement system that can consistently meet industry and customer requirements.
  • Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.
  • Quality Influence - Ability to recognize stakeholders, create a forum to professionally extract stakeholder perspectives, drive and engage in constructive conflict, and to influence outcomes in order to ensure Cummins makes a balanced decision inclusive of Quality priorities.
  • Quality Standards - Applying knowledge of quality standards, such as ISO9001:2015 and IATF16949, to develop procedures, processes, and external suppliers in a manner that aligns with regulatory requirements.
  • Statistical Foundations - Applies statistical tools and technique to influence decision making; leverages understanding of data collection methods, key statistics, graphical and analytical methods to describe process performance, gain insights and drive improvement action
  • Supplier Performance Improvement - Improving supplier performance by developing and executing an effective quality improvement strategy that consists of a project team, glidepath, reduction of manufacturing issues and improvement of systemic deficiencies.
  • Supplier Quality Project Planning and Execution - Applying Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) skills to develop and execute a quality plan that enables external suppliers to meet customer expectations; Requires facilitating communication and collaboration across cross-functional activities, when a program, initiative, or project concerns external suppliers.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Supplier Product Reliability - Ability to evaluate the supplier's product design, supplier's manufacturing process design and product validation process to ensure the supplier is capable to meet reliability expectations.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Engineering or a related technical or scientific subject require
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Preferably 7 years experience in a Manufacturing or Engineering role in the automotive industry, or a similarly regulated industry.

Ensures competitiveness of Cummins products in our markets while preserving desired margins. Utilizes Total Cost Opportunity (TCO) model methodology.
  • Intellectual Property Management - Assures protection of Cummins Intellectual Property to optimize the use of intellectual property for Cummins future competitive advantage by engaging the Legal and Procurement function; assures Cummins’ intellectual property ownership rights are clearly defined in executed agreements.

Knows how to access documents in the appropriate Document Management System (DMS) and/or who to ask if clarification or expansion of the information contained in each document is needed.

We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better. Thank you for your interest in continuing to grow your Cummins career!

Supports the account team and account strategies to build customer relationships and grow our share of the customer's wallet with an assigned set of customers or a geographic region.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
