  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Finance Business Partner to join our Powergen team in Scoresby, VIC.

This is a permanent role supporting our APAC Powergen business, working across a growing and increasingly complex portfolio of customers, deals and projects.

Powergen is experiencing significant growth, making this an exciting time to join the business. As the business expands, this role will help provide the financial and commercial support needed to manage that growth effectively and sustainably.

It is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys getting close to the business and applying their finance experience to real commercial and operational questions. job.title: L4-Product support Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Company Overview

Schneider Electric is a global leader in energy management and automation, delivering innovative solutions that ensure _Life Is On_ for everyone, everywhere, and at every moment. As part of our growing digital ecosystem, we are strengthening our technical support capabilities for EcoStruxure Building Activate (EBA)—a cloud-connected, nextgeneration building automation platform used worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled L4 Product Support Engineer to join our advanced support organization and ensure the reliability, stability, and continuous improvement of our building automation solutions in the field.

Role Overview

The Level 4 Product Support Engineer provides expert-level technical support, advanced troubleshooting, and system-level diagnostics for complex issues that go beyond the scope of L3 support. This role serves as the technical escalation point for global support teams, partners, and country front-office engineers.

You will work closely with R&D, QA, product management, and field teams to analyze defects, replicate issues, propose corrective actions, and contribute to long-term product improvements. This role requires strong system thinking, analytical depth, and the ability to investigate issues spanning hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile components.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

  • Investigate and resolve complex system-level issues across hardware, firmware, cloud, and mobile platforms.
  • Analyze logs, traces, network captures, system metrics, and API interactions to identify root causes.
  • Reproduce field issues in lab environments to validate hypotheses and support engineering teams.
  • Own critical escalations from L3 teams, ensuring timely and high-quality resolution.
  • Provide RCA documentation, corrective action proposals, and long-term recommendations.

System-Level Analysis & Integration Support

  • Perform deep-dive analysis of EBA system architecture, including controllers, gateways, cloud components, and mobile workflows.
  • Support integration efforts across different layers of the EBA platform and its external integrations.
  • Validate end-to-end workflows to ensure subsystem interoperability and performance.
  • Troubleshoot integration protocols such as BACnet, Modbus on the edge side and MQTT, REST APIs, HTTPS, and other IoT communication layers for the cloud communication
  • Identify system bottlenecks, performance issues, and configuration defects.

Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Serve as the bridge between field support teams and R&D engineering groups.
  • Provide detailed field insights to influence product roadmaps and design decisions.
  • Document troubleshooting guides, diagnostic procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Deliver post-escalation briefings and contribute to continuous improvement loops.
  • Mentor L3 engineers and help elevate the technical competence of the product support team.

Support for Senior L4 Initiatives

  • Contribute to product quality improvement initiatives, including failure mode analysis and test coverage enhancements.
  • Participate in cross-functional reviews, defect triages, and technical deep-dive sessions.
  • Support the development of troubleshooting tools, diagnostic frameworks, and automation scripts.
  • Recommend improvements in escalation workflows, documentation structure, and customer experience practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, Instrumentation, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in system-level troubleshooting, advanced technical support, or product integration roles.
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills with experience diagnosing complex behaviours across distributed systems.
  • Hands-on experience with building automation, HVAC systems, IoT devices, or industrial automation platforms.
  • Proficiency in Python or similar scripting languages for automation, data extraction, and analysis.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows/Linux fundamentals, networking (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, certificates), and API-level debugging.
  • Excellent communication skills and ability to explain complex technical topics clearly.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with HVAC systems and building controls.
  • Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Grafana, and Jenkins.
  • Hands-on experience with lab equipment (oscilloscopes, multimeters, analyzers).
  • Knowledge of agile methodologies and collaborative workflows.
  • Experience working in global, multiregional support environments.

Performance Objectives:

  • Deliver timely and effective resolution of escalated critical issues within defined SLAs.
  • Improve product reliability by contributing RCAs, reproducible defect scenarios, and engineering-quality test cases.
  • Reduce repeat escalations through robust analysis and knowledge sharing.
  • Strengthen team capabilities through mentorship, documentation, and diagnostic tool improvements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer experience and system stability.

Why Schneider Electric

At Schneider Electric, you join a company committed to sustainability, innovation, and inclusion. You will collaborate with global teams, work on mission-critical building automation solutions, and directly influence product quality and customer satisfaction worldwide. Your work will help ensure resilient, intelligent, and energy-efficient buildings across the globe.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our  IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

job.title: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development
job.description:
Job Description

Lauritz Knudsen Electrical and Automation is a pioneering electrical and automation brand with a rich legacy of over 70 years in India. We offer comprehensive portfolio of low-voltage switchgear, medium-voltage switchgear, automation solutions, software, and services catering to diverse segments, including homes, agriculture, buildings, infrastructure, and industry.

This position will be for Vadodara Plant for Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation (A unit of Schneider Electric India Pvt. Ltd.)

Designation: GM – Organization-Wide Technical Skill Development

Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations.

Position Summary

The Lead for Technical Skill Development will spearhead the creation and implementation of a comprehensive, company-wide technical competency framework. This role is responsible for upskilling the technical workforce (engineering, R&D, manufacturing, and field service) in Low Voltage switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, MCB, Panels, Switchboards) and modern manufacturing processes (IoT, automation). The goal is to build a high-performance culture, reduce R&D-to-production transfer time, improve quality, and standardize technical processes across all plants in India.

Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities:

Strategic & Technical Leadership

  • Competency Mapping: Define role-based technical competencies for engineering, production, quality, and R&D roles (e.g., design engineers, testing technicians, assembly line workers).
  • Technical Roadmap: Develop a multi-year technical skill development strategy aligned with the company’s product roadmap, focusing on IEC standards, 61439 panel solutions, and digital switchgear technologies.
  • Knowledge Management: Create a structured repository for technical knowledge, standardizing design practices, and ensuring "lessons learned" are implemented across projects.

Training Design & Implementation

  • Curriculum Development: Design, curate, and implement technical training modules for LV Switchgear design, manufacturing, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on Training: Lead practical, hands-on sessions for technicians on switchgear assembly, testing protocols, and safety procedures.
  • Modern Training Methods: Implement hybrid learning solutions, including e-learning platforms, virtual reality (VR) simulations for complex assembly, and classroom workshops.
  • Onboarding: Develop a rigorous technical induction program for new engineering and production hires.

Operational & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Location Coordination: Coordinate training across different plants and R&D centres in India to ensure consistency and standardize operating procedures.
  • Subject Matter Expert (SME) Liaison: Work closely with R&D, QA, Manufacturing, and Engineering heads to ensure training content is up to date with new product introductions and engineering changes.
  • External Training: Collaborate with external industry experts, technical institutes, and consultants for specialized training.

Assessment & Effectiveness Measurement

  • TNA (Training Needs Analysis): Conduct individual and team skills gap analyses regularly.
  • ROI/Impact Measurement: Evaluate training effectiveness through metrics, such as reduced rework, faster troubleshooting, and improved productivity in manufacturing.
  • Certification: Implement certification programs to recognize technical expertise within the organization.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Percentage of employees certified under the technical competency framework.
  • Reduction in manufacturing rework or quality issues attributed to skill gaps.
  • Reduction in time-to-market for new products (R&D to production training efficiency).
  • Training hours per employee (technical).
  • Adherence to the Annual Training Calendar.

Required Candidate Profile:

Education & Experience

  • Education: B.E./ B.Tech in Electrical/Electronics/Mechanical/Production Engineering (essential). M.Tech in Power Systems/Electrical Engineering/Mechanical Engineering is a plus.
  • Experience: 15-18+ years of experience in the Switchgear Industry, with at least 5 years in a leadership role, either in Technical Training, R&D, or Manufacturing Operations.
  • Knowledge: Deep understanding of Low Voltage Switchgear products (ACB, MCCB, Switchboards) and IEC/IS standards (especially IEC 61439).

Skills & Competencies

  • Technical Expertise: Strong background in design, testing, and troubleshooting of switchgear components and panels.
  • Training Skills: Expertise in instructional design, adult learning principles, and modern training technologies.
  • Leadership: Proven ability to manage teams and drive initiatives across multiple locations.
  • Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills to engage both shop-floor technicians and senior R&D management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification in Training & Development.
  • Six Sigma Black Belt
  • Experience with Learning Management Systems (LMS) and e-learning creation tools.
  • Understanding of LEAN and Six Sigma methodologies in manufacturing

What's in it for you:

  • Opportunity to lead strategic quality initiatives across multiple manufacturing sites
  • Platform to implement innovative quality improvement programs that drive organizational success
  • Professional growth through exposure to diverse manufacturing processes and systems
  • Collaborative environment that values continuous learning and development
  • Chance to make a significant impact on organizational excellence and customer satisfaction

job.title: Systems Design, Architecture Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role is responsible for leading the design, implementation, and operation of IT infrastructure across servers, networks, and cloud environments supporting data center and enterprise systems.

This role requires advanced technical expertise and strong architectural design capability to ensure infrastructure solutions meet business, operational, and security requirements. The engineer will play a critical role in shaping the infrastructure architecture, overseeing project execution, and making key technical decisions to deliver stable, scalable, and efficient systems.

Beyond day-to-day operations, the role is also accountable for driving continuous improvement, ensuring system reliability, and aligning all infrastructure initiatives with Global IS standards and organizational objectives.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, implementation, and management of server, network, and cloud infrastructure—particularly Hyper-V virtualization and Microsoft Azure environments—to meet technical and functional requirements.
  • Design and manage secure network environments integrating Palo Alto firewalls, Aruba switches, routers, and Wi-Fi, ensuring network reliability and strong data protection.
  • Build and maintain high-availability, scalable server environments using Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) and Hyper-V clustering technologies.
  • Manage and support telephony (VoIP) systems within the data center environment.
  • Design and implement hybrid infrastructures that integrate on-premises and cloud-based systems.
  • Perform security hardening, incident response, patching, and performance tuning to ensure reliability and compliance with internal and external standards.
  • Ensure all infrastructure design, deployment, and operations comply with Global IS architecture blueprints and security guidelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Global IS teams to maintain consistency and standardization across regional and global environments.
  • Plan and lead infrastructure projects, including requirements gathering, vendor coordination, implementation, and rollout.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers, fostering knowledge-sharing and skill development.
  • Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure efficiency and resiliency through proactive architectural enhancements.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • In-depth knowledge of Windows Server and Linux administration, including Hyper-V virtualization, clustering, and storage management.
  • Experience in managing Active Directory, DNS, and Group Policy.
  • Proficiency in network monitoring tools (e.g., Zabbix, Nagios, CheckMK) and system health monitoring.
  • Strong understanding of routing protocols such as OSPF and BGP and experience designing VPN and hybrid connectivity.
  • Required expertise in network design, implementation, and operations; experience with Aruba switching and Palo Alto firewalls is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, and familiarity with AWS or GCP is an advantage.
  • Strong troubleshooting and incident response skills across network, server, and virtualization layers.
  • Ability to prepare technical documentation, including design diagrams, operation manuals, and implementation reports.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work in cross-functional and multicultural teams.
  • Bilingual proficiency in English and Japanese preferred.
  • Academic Qualifications and Certifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
  • Candidates must have hands-on experience with Hyper-V and Azure. Experience with Palo Alto and Aruba solutions is highly desirable.
  • Professional certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator (AZ-104), Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Engineer (PCNSE), Aruba Certified Switching Professional (ACSP), or equivalent are highly desirable.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: Sr. Worldwide Specialist – Amazon Quick, Data & AI GTM
job.description:
The Sr. Worldwide Specialist – GenAI for Amazon Quick is a strategic business development leadership position within the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Generative AI team. This role is responsible for driving customer adoption, market positioning, and go-to-market strategy for Amazon Quick's generative AI capabilities across enterprise and mid-market customers in Asia ANZ – Australia & New Zealand ASEAN – Southeast Asian nations (Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, Philippines, Thailand, Vietnam) Korea (South Korea) South Asia / India – India & Sri Lanka Priority Countries (large, mature geographies) Australia India Japan Singapore South Korea Emerging & Fast-Growing Markets Indonesia Malaysia New Zealand Philippines Thailand Taiwan Vietnam

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive adoption of Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities (Amazon Q Business, Q Developer, and AI-powered analytics) with key enterprise and mid-market customers
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and technical leaders, helping them understand how generative AI transforms business intelligence, data analytics, and decision-making
  • Develop and execute customer engagement strategies that accelerate proof-of-concept to production deployment
  • Build deep relationships with customers across industries (financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, retail, etc.) to understand their GenAI challenges and opportunities

Market Positioning & Messaging

  • Develop positioning, messaging, and value propositions for Amazon Quick relative to competitive alternatives
  • Create and refine sales plays, customer case studies, and industry-specific use cases that demonstrate Quick's GenAI capabilities
  • Track market evolution and competitive landscape; provide insights to product and marketing teams on market trends and customer needs
  • Synthesize customer and partner feedback to inform product roadmap prioritization and service evolution

Sales Enablement & Team Leadership

  • Educate and enable regional AI/ML specialists, account teams, and sales organizations on Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities, assets, and go-to-market strategies
  • Develop training materials, workshops, and enablement content for sales teams
  • Collaborate with Solutions Architects and Technical Account Managers to support complex customer engagements
  • Mentor junior specialists and build a high-performing specialist team

Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem

  • Engage with system integrators, consulting partners, and technology partners to co-develop solutions and accelerate customer adoption
  • Identify partnership opportunities and develop joint go-to-market strategies
  • Present to partner audiences at industry events and summits
  • Build and maintain relationships with key industry analysts and thought leaders

Business Development & Growth

  • Identify and pursue new market opportunities for Amazon Quick's GenAI capabilities
  • Develop industry-specific strategies and vertical-focused initiatives
  • Track key metrics: customer adoption, pipeline generation, revenue influence, and market share
  • Contribute to quarterly business reviews and strategic planning with leadership

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C-level executives experience
  • Deep understanding of generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and enterprise AI applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in large teams or at a national/multinational organization
  • Experience with AWS services, particularly Amazon Quick, QuickSight, Amazon Q, or related AI/ML services
  • Background in financial services, manufacturing, healthcare, or other key vertical markets

job.title: Senior Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist, Amazon WorkSpaces
job.description:
The workspace is no longer just for humans. Enterprises are moving from traditional virtual desktops to intelligent, cloud-native environments where people and AI agents work side by side — governed by design, observable by default, and delivered anywhere. Amazon WorkSpaces is leading this transformation with WorkSpaces for Agents (now generally available), alongside WorkSpaces Personal, WorkSpaces Core, and WorkSpaces Applications. Together with services like AWS Context and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, we're building the operating environment for the next enterprise workforce — one where AI agents navigate applications, automate workflows, and build institutional knowledge inside trusted boundaries. The companies that lead won't just have the smartest AI — they'll build the most trustworthy place for intelligence to work.

AWS is seeking a Worldwide (WW) GTM Specialist to accelerate adoption of Amazon WorkSpaces' AI and agentic capabilities. You will be part of a dedicated team focused on bringing these emerging solutions to market — defining the vision for agentic workspaces, building GTM motions around AI-enhanced features, and helping customers understand how governed cloud workspaces become the operating environment for their human + agent workforce. You'll be charting new territory at the intersection of end-user computing and enterprise AI — identifying early adopters, shaping lighthouse engagements, and building repeatable plays that scale.

You are a strategic thinker who operates with urgency. You combine deep business acumen with enough technical depth to be credible with CIOs and IT leaders navigating the shift to agentic work. You understand that the hardest problem isn't teaching an agent to click — it's making sure those clicks happen inside an environment the organization can trust. You've built GTM strategies in emerging technology categories, rallied cross-functional teams around a shared vision, and delivered measurable business results. You're energized by ambiguity — because that's where the biggest opportunities live.

Key job responsibilities

  • Define and execute the GTM strategy for Amazon WorkSpaces AI and agentic solutions — identifying high-value customer segments where agents can drive immediate productivity gains, and building programs that accelerate early adoption of WorkSpaces for Agents, AI-enhanced desktop experiences, and governed agentic environments.
  • Shape the narrative around the future of agentic workspaces — positioning AWS as the leader in trusted environments where humans and AI agents work together, with built-in governance, observability, and identity management that enable enterprises to scale autonomous work confidently.
  • Engage directly with enterprise leaders and partners to articulate how governed cloud workspaces solve the trust, security, and compliance challenges that keep agentic AI stuck in pilots — connecting agentic workspace capabilities to measurable business outcomes.
  • Build and scale lighthouse engagements with early adopters deploying AI agents in enterprise environments — generating compelling proof points around agent governance, productivity, and the human + agent operating model, then operationalizing those wins into repeatable plays.
  • Develop deep fluency in the WorkSpaces AI portfolio (WorkSpaces for Agents, integration with AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, AWS Continuum) to articulate how the pieces fit together for customers across industries.
  • Establish data-driven mechanisms to measure adoption of agentic features, track program effectiveness, and continuously optimize the path from pilot to production-scale agent deployment.
  • Evangelize the agentic workspace vision externally through thought leadership, events, and industry engagement — and internally across AWS to drive mindshare and investment in this emerging category.
  • Orchestrate field uptake of AI-focused sales plays, equipping the broader sales organization to identify and qualify agentic workspace opportunities and deliver value through repeatable mechanisms.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • 2+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • 5+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
  • Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations across leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
  • Experience in selling nascent products/services into new markets
  • Experience leading complex, multi-year initiatives that may be cross-functional and/or span business and technology
  • Understanding of enterprise desktop/workspace environments and the security, compliance, and identity requirements that govern them

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Senior Customer Success Specialist, Amazon Connect
job.description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing millions of customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung.

AWS is seeking an experienced Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Customer Success Specialist for Amazon Connect. Connect was born out of Amazon’s own need for the best CCaaS solution that works at scale, while improving customer experience. Today, Connect is one of AWS's fastest growing services, leveraging native generative AI capabilities to improve customer and employee experiences. As a Connect Customer Success Specialist, you will act as a strategic advisor to customers, helping them innovate and optimize their contact center and customer experience through adoption of the Connect capabilities. You will lead cross-functional field teams in sales, solutions architecture, partner sales, product, and will work at the CxO level with customers to maximize the value of their Connect investment.

The ideal candidate will have enterprise sales and/or consulting experience in Contact Center as a Service or similar SaaS solutions in areas such as telecommunications, VoIP, and/or or CRM/ERP applications. You will be passionate about customer experience and advocacy and bring the voice of the customer into the product development process. You will enjoy solving complex problems; our customers will rely on your guidance to scale Connect across their complex global businesses, overcoming technical and organizational roadblocks on the way.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, managing relationships and being a strategic advisor, driving enterprise-wide adoption of Connect.
  • Deliver compelling presentations, product demos, sample solutions and programs, events, and discussions to enable customer success.
  • Build customer skills and proficiency with Connect.
  • Engage with C-level stakeholders to understand the value proposition of Connect and uncover new areas of business value.
  • Develop account plans in conjunction with field teams.
  • Meet annual revenue targets through increased adoption of Connect.
  • Work with partners and ISVs to extend reach & drive adoption of AWS solutions.

A day in the life The Amazon Connect Customer Success Specialist (CSS) will create a matrix environment with resources from our partner community, Professional Services, AWS account teams, and Connect service team members to drive customer success. A CSS will run attach service plays, customer engagements to drive adoption of migrating services, work with our partner community to scale and align key members of the services team for optimization and retention efforts. Last, a CSS will uncover cases that align to Connect unique business value to be shared with AWS Marketing.

About the team Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience
  • 2+ years of customer-facing work, engaging with customer executives, technologists or partners to solve business problems with advanced technologies experience
  • Bachelor's degree in science, technology, engineering, math, business or equivalent
  • Experience leading technical and non-technical transformation project teams with a proven ability to work across broad functional teams
  • 2+ years of experience leading and advising customers through complex contact center migrations and/or customer experience journeys

Preferred Qualifications

  • PMP certification, or SCRUM/Agile, SAFe certification
  • Experience implementing cloud services including migrations and modernization projects or similar

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Senior Marketing Executive Digital Marketing Focus
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a proactive, creative, and analytical Senior Marketing Executive (Digital Marketing Focus) to drive our Group branding and elevate our digital presence. In this role, you will take ownership of our official social media channels, website content management, and search optimization strategies (SEO/GEO) to strengthen Group brand equity, visibility, and corporate reputation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media & Channel Management: Plan, manage, and execute high-quality content calendars across key Group channels, including Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, and WeChat, ensuring brand consistency and active audience engagement.
  • Search & AI Discovery (SEO & GEO): Oversee organic search strategy, optimizing Group website performance across both traditional search engines (SEO) and emerging AI search/answer engines (GEO).
  • Website Management: Regularly update and maintain Group website content, landing pages, and digital touchpoints to maintain high standards of corporate presentation and user experience.
  • Corporate Campaigns & Event Marketing: Support Group-level branding campaigns and corporate events through digital asset creation, landing page setups, pre/post-event promotion, and digital collateral design.
  • Analytics & AI Workflow Optimization: Track and report on digital performance metrics using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and native platform insights. Leverage modern AI-powered marketing tools to streamline content workflows and improve execution efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams and external creative agencies/vendors to ensure seamless delivery of Group marketing initiatives.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Digital Media, Communication, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in digital marketing, social media management, corporate branding, or content strategy. Agency experience is a plus.
  • Platform Experience: Proven track record of managing and growing brand presence across Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn, and WeChat.
  • SEO/GEO Literacy: Solid understanding of search engine optimization (SEO) principles and awareness of modern AI-driven search trends (GEO).
  • Technical & Design Tools: Hands-on experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), web CMS platforms, and design software (Canva and Adobe Creative Suite such as Photoshop/Illustrator/InDesign).
  • Skills & Mindset: Self-motivated, creative, detail-oriented, and eager to adopt emerging digital tools/AI applications into daily workflows.
  • Language Proficiency: Excellent command of written and spoken English and Chinese.

We offer competitive salary package and career development opportunity. Interested parties, please apply with full resume, present and expected salary, by clicking "APPLY NOW".

_We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified candidates. Information provided will be treated in strict confidence and only be used for consideration of your application for the relevant post within HGC Global Communications Limited. Personal data provided by job applicants will be used strictly according to our Personal Information Collection Statement, a copy of which will be available upon written request. Information of unsuccessful candidates will be destroyed within six months._

job.title: Power Diagnostics® Center, Control Systems Engineer
job.description:
Looking for challenging role? If you really want to make a difference - make it with us

Can we energize society and fight climate change at the same time?

At Siemens Energy, we can. Our technology is key, but our people make the difference. Brilliant minds innovate. They connect, create, and keep us on track towards changing the world’s energy systems. Their spirit fuels our mission.

Our culture is defined by caring, agile, respectful, and accountable individuals. We value excellence of any kind. Sounds like you?

The Analytic Services Operations Team within Siemens Energy is looking for Engineer to monitor, maintain and troubleshoot data processing based on the Data Acquisition Platform WIN_TS and the Power Diagnostics® Centers. Additionally, one will have to handle project instrumentation & control engineering for large turbines. The WINTS is a Windows based diagnosis server which is connected to the control system of the turbine (e.g.: SPPA-T3000) to collect I&C signals and messages. Furthermore, there are several 3rd-party systems connected to the WINTS network (e.g.: Vibration Analysis, Delphin Data Logger, Argus…) collecting detailed information and exchanging data with WINTS. With the Siemens standard remote solution cRSP (common Remote Service Platform) the WINTS is securely connected to the internet and reachable from all over the globe. The collected data is transferred to Siemens Energy data centers where already twenty years of hundreds of turbine data is stored. Beyond pure data storage the collected data is processed on daily basis and engineers in SE GP G SV TI PA and other organizations are supplied with automated analysis results on operational data and related information or alarm notifications.

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

  • You will be working closely with our teams in Erlangen, Mülheim and Orlando to monitor data processing in the Power Diagnostics® datacenters and take action to support data related requests or troubleshooting for the whole data chain from power plant to Power Diagnostics® center. For troubleshooting you will be also in contact with site staff to figure out local problems. The maintenance of local and backend systems is also part of this job. You will be working closely with our teams in Germany & USA to perform the data acquisition tasks. This position is based in Gurgaon (India) and will involve working in morning or night shifts.
  • Monitoring of data processing in the Power Diagnostics® datacenters and execution of regular system maintenance task to ensure continuous operation.
  • Thermodynamics (TDY) data processing and system or process troubleshooting.
  • Acquisition of partial data files, Sequence of Event files and control system data upon request of Operations Engineers and Service Engineering.
  • Troubleshooting of data acquisition and connection issues to restore data availability and quality
  • Communication & collaboration with site staff and colleagues in Mülheim, Erlangen and Orlando
  • Maintenance of local data acquisition, data transmission and backend server systems
  • Coordinate cross-functional problems related to data acquisition and data processing including management of incoming requests via support mailbox/distribution list
  • Contribution to 24/7 on call duty
  • Contribution to 24/7 hotline support for customer phone calls and track issues for managed Power Diagnostics® sites

Your new role – challenging and future-oriented

•Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Controls/ Electronic Engineering or a closely related subject

  • 6+ years of relevant experience
  • Advanced handling of Windows Server OS (e.g.: Windows Server 2012 R2, 2016, 2019)
  • Experience in basic IP networking (routing, switches…)
  • Experience in industrial standard communication and OPC classic and OPC UA
  • Turbine Thermodynamics behaviour knowledge
  • Ability and willingness to work non-standard shifts, including nights.
  • Being able to work in global team
  • Communication skills

Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience

  • CCNA/ CCNP/MCSE/ MCSA Certification preferred
  • Strong knowledge in VPN
  • CRSP router & Terminal Server configuration
  • Experience on Siemens DCS SPPA-T3000
  • Knowledge of major components of power plants
  • Practical knowledge of database and scripting tools like MS Access, Python, Visual basic etc.
  • Solid experience with working in a global team
  • Experience in handling of large data and analytical screening.
  • Ability and willingness to learn new fields, Committed to personal development and continuous improvement
  • High flexibility in taking new tasks/responsibilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We’ve got quite a lot to offer. How about you?

This role is based in Gurgaon. You’ll also get to visit other locations in India and beyond, so you’ll need to go where this journey takes you. In return, you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager__

職務内容

###

本ポジションでは、事業部戦略に基づき、担当市場・事業領域における製品／システム／サービスの営業活動全般を担っていただきます。日々の業務を通じて、定性的・定量的な営業目標を達成し、持続的な受注成長、売上、収益性、市場シェア、および顧客満足度の向上に貢献していただきます。

また、新規ビジネス機会の創出・開拓を通じて、ご自身の営業力と専門性を発揮していただきます。

勤務形態：ハイブリッド

主な職務内容

  • 半導体業界における既存顧客のアカウントマネジメント
  • 定期訪問およびニーズヒアリングを通じた既存顧客との関係構築・強化
  • ユーティリティ業界向けの新規ビジネス開発
  • キーパーソンの特定
  • 顧客ニーズの発掘
  • 将来的には既存顧客アカウントのさらなる拡大・深耕を担うことを想定
  • 新規ビジネス機会の創出および提案資料の作成
  • 営業予算の管理および営業実績のレポーティング
  • 営業チーム内での情報共有およびベストプラクティスの展開

以下製品の提案・販売：

  • 低圧／高圧スイッチギア（LV/HV Switchgear）
  • 変圧器（Transformer）
  • UPS（無停電電源装置）
  • SCADAシステム

応募資格

  • BtoB営業経験3年以上（新規開拓および／または既存顧客深耕の経験必須）

※製造業での経験があれば尚可

  • 特定顧客に対するアカウントマネジメント経験を有し、技術部門・購買部門・経営層など幅広いステークホルダーとの関係構築が可能な方
  • 顧客ニーズを的確に引き出し、それを社内に共有・展開できるコミュニケーション能力
  • 高専卒以上（文系・理系・工学系いずれも歓迎）

語学要件

  • 日本語：ビジネスレベル（JLPT N1相当）
  • 英語：読み書きレベル

※日常的なメールは翻訳ツールの利用可。ただし海外工場との定期的なコミュニケーションが発生します。

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Account management for existing customers in the semiconductor industry
  • Manage relationships with existing customers through regular visits and needs assessments
  • Responsible for new business development targeting the utility industry sector. Strong account management-level proposal capabilities are essential, including key person identification and needs discovery.
  • Future development toward existing account management responsibilities is anticipated.
  • You will be offering the producsts such as LV/HV Switchgear, Transformer, UPS, SCADA System.
  • Develop new business opportunities and prepare compelling sales proposals
  • Manage sales budgets and report on sales performance metrics
  • Share information and disseminate best practices within the sales team

Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B market with new business development and/or account deepening sales (manufacturing sector preferred)
  • Account management experience with the ability to engage key stakeholders across technical, procurement, and executive levels at specific customer accounts.
  • Proficiency in eliciting and uncovering customer needs, combined with the ability to communicate and share these insights internally with the organization.
  • Technical college diploma or above (liberal arts, science, or engineering backgrounds all welcome)
  • language requirement:

【Japanese】N1 level 【English】Reading and writing proficiency ※Daily emails can be handled with translation tools; however, regular communication with overseas factories will be required.

More about us

[ABB Group | Helping industries outrun – leaner and cleaner | ABB](https://www.abb.com/global/en)

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: プロジェクトエンジニア
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

ELDS Project Solutions Manager__

■職務内容

【業務内容】 ・受注後キックオフの打ち合わせ時におけるテクニカルサポートを担当 ・インフラビジネス、データセンター等向けに製品ソリューションを提供 ・仕様についてStake holderと調整、およびサプライヤー・施工側との仕様確認を実施 ・仕様インテグレーションのリードを担当 ・Stake holderはInternal / External双方あり ・プロジェクト構成

  • 7〜8割：大型案件
  • 2〜3割：小～中規模プロジェクト

【製品】 ・高圧製品等：モジュラーシステム、スイッチギア、構成機器、保護継電器、サービス https://new.abb.com/medium-voltage/ja ・低圧機器等：配電機器、制御機器、電設資材、エネルギー管理と保護 https://new.abb.com/low-voltage/ja

■MUST要件

【学歴】 ・高専卒以上（工学系）

【言語】 ・日本語：ネイティブレベル ・英語：読み書き可能レベル（TOEIC600点以上目安）

【経験】

同業種（受配電設備業界）で10年以上の経験

チームリーダーとしての経験

■WANT要件

【学歴】 ・工学系（特に電気系）

【言語】 ・英語：ビジネスレベルの会話力

■求める人物像

・協調性があり、解決策重視でコミュニケーション能力が高い方（文書・会話） ・多国籍環境およびマトリックス組織で働ける方 ・新しいことに前向きで行動力のある方 ・スピード感を持って自発的に行動できる方

You will be mainly accountable for:

Job Responsibilities

  • ### Provide technical support during post-order project kick-off meetings, ensuring smooth alignment between requirements and execution.
  • ### Deliver technical solutions related to electrical and power distribution products for infrastructure projects, including data centers and other large-scale facilities.
  • ### Lead specification integration by coordinating with various stakeholders, clarifying technical requirements, and ensuring alignment between internal teams, external suppliers, and on-site installation partners.
  • ### Act as a key point of contact for both internal and external stakeholders. Internal stakeholders include overseas manufacturing and engineering teams, while external stakeholders include construction-related partners and subcontractors involved in project execution.
  • ### Work primarily on large-scale projects, which account for the majority of the portfolio, alongside involvement in renewable energy–related projects as part of a diversified project mix.

###

Qualifications for the role

  • ### Minimum of a technical college degree (engineering-related)
  • ### Over 10 years of experience in the same industry (power distribution equipment industry)
  • ### Experience as a team leader
  • ### 【Japanese】JLPT N1 level or above in Japanese language
  • ### 【English】 reading and writing level (TOEIC score 600 or higher).
  • ### A mindset to innovate, take ownership, and drive continuous improvement

###

Key Attractions and Features of This Role

###

As demand in Japan continues to grow for products aligned with Western, globally driven standards, our company conducts product development under the strong leadership of our global headquarters. By being involved in a rapidly growing business, you will have the opportunity to build a broad and flexible foundation for long-term career development.

###

By collaborating with global technology leaders that continuously drive innovation, you will gain exposure to a wide range of cutting-edge insights. In addition, working with a diverse group of stakeholders will enable you to develop highly transferable communication skills and effectively operate in a complex, global environment.

###

Products

Medium-Voltage Products: Modular systems, switchgear, components, protection relays, and related services

[https://new.abb.com/low-voltage/ja](https://new.abb.com/low-voltage/ja)

###

Low-Voltage Products: Power distribution equipment, control devices, electrical installation materials, and energy management and protection solutions

[https://new.abb.com/medium-voltage/ja](https://new.abb.com/medium-voltage/ja)

###

More about us

ABB is a technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. The company’s solutions connect engineering know-how and software to optimize how things are manufactured, moved, powered, and operated. Building on over 140 years of excellence, ABB’s more than 105,000 employees are committed to driving innovations that accelerate industrial transformation.

[www.abb.com](http://www.abb.com)

ABB in Japan The roots of the group go back to 1907 when its predecessor opened the first office in Yokohama. Through its over 110-year history, ABB in Japan devoted to the Japan market and established its local service network, while keeping ABB's solid global background. Today, we operate with about 400 employees and offer our unique products, systems, solutions and services to local customers with our expertise.

[ABB |社会と産業の変革に活力を与える世界をリードするエンジニアリング企業 | abb.com/jp](https://new.abb.com/jp)

###

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: 調達マネージャー/Procurement Manager
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to

Head of Procurement and Logistics, Hub Asia__

職務内容

本ポジションでは、ビジネスを支援する調達および物流戦略を主体的に管理・実行し、コスト・品質・供給の信頼性を最適化する機会があります。また、ビジネス要件に沿った効果的な購買戦略を策定・実施し、現在および将来のニーズを満たせるサプライヤー能力の確保に貢献していただきます。

勤務形態：オンサイト／ハイブリッド

勤務地は静岡県伊豆の国市です。または東京都品川区を勤務地として、伊豆の国市まで週3回出張ベースで勤務する働き方も可能です。(出張頻度は選考プロセスの中でご相談させて頂きます）

主な職務内容

  • 定められた要件に基づき、プロジェクトにおける競争力のある調達およびサプライヤーマネジメント戦略を策定し、ローカル調達活動と部門戦略の整合性を確保する
  • ビジネスおよびオペレーションチームと早期に連携し、コスト・品質・納期改善のための調達戦略を計画・実行する（グローバルおよび事業部のガイドラインに準拠）
  • 担当国のプロジェクトにおける調達活動の実行・進捗管理を行い、リスクの特定・分析・対応する（適切なリスク軽減策の実施）
  • 輸出入許可、税務、通関、輸送書類など、地域の貿易・物流要件へのコンプライアンスを確保する
  • ステークホルダーへの物流プロセスおよびインコタームズに関する知識共有と、プロジェクト期間中の円滑な実行を支援する
  • 調達の標準・ツール・プロセスを適用し、品質・納期・コスト・サステナビリティを確保する

応募資格

学歴

  • 工学系、またはファイナンス／経営学の学士号

経験

  • 約8〜10年の経験（プロジェクト調達、購買、サプライチェーン）
  • 自動化および電気機器・サービス分野での経験

スキル・知識

  • 関連するサプライ市場に関する知識
  • 調達プロセス、P2Pシステム、ローカル物流要件の理解
  • 強い交渉力と契約・法務の理解

ソフトスキル

  • 異文化理解力と優れたコミュニケーション能力
  • 論理的で結果志向、主体性・当事者意識が高い
  • 自発的かつプロアクティブに行動できる
  • 技術的・分析的な理解力

言語

  • 日本語：日本語能力試験1級レベル必須
  • 英語：中級レベル必須
  • 韓国語：尚可

このポジションの魅力

  • 主体的に挑戦し、リードできる環境
  • 継続的な学習と成長の機会
  • 個々の目標に応じたサポート
  • 自身のアイデアや行動がビジネスに直接貢献できる環境

私達の事業

[ABB Bailey Japan | プロセスオートメーション事業本部](https://new.abb.com/jp/energy_industries)

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to pro-actively manage and execute the Procurement and Logistics strategies that support the business by optimizing costs, quality, and reliability of suppliers and supplied products. You will also showcase your expertise by implementing effective sourcing strategies in line with business requirements to ensure that suppliers have the capability and capacity to meet current and future business requirements.

The work model for the role is: onsite/hybrid

※The location will be Izunokuni-shi, Shizuoka or Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo. If the location is Tokyo, company asks you to have business trip to Izunokuni-shi 3 days a week. (The frequency of business trips will be discussed during the selection process.)

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Developing competitive sourcing & supplier management solutions in projects within the defined requirements, ensuring alignment between local procurement activities and division strategy.
  • Early engagement with Business and Operations team in planning sourcing strategies and implementing initiatives to drive improvement in cost, quality, and delivery, in accordance with group/business area procurement guidelines and global division/business area objectives.
  • Execution and tracking of procurement activities to identify, analyze, and address procurement risks across all projects in the assigned country/s, ensuring proper and necessary mitigating actions are put in place.
  • Compliance towards local trade & logistics requirements on import/export permits, tax, custom clearance, shipping documents, etc. Transfer of knowledge on logistic process and incoterms policy to the stakeholders and ensure seamless execution during project phase.
  • Applying and implementing procurement standards, tools, and processes in area of responsibility to secure quality, delivery, cost, and sustainability.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an engineering discipline or finance/business administration, strong technical and analytical understanding
  • About 8 - 10 years of experience in project sourcing, procurement and supply chain covering
  • automation and electrical equipment and services.
  • Good knowledge of commodity / business relevant supply markets.
  • Strong knowledge of business, policies and organization including Purchase-to-Pay (P2P) systems and local Logistics processes and requirements.
  • Good cultural understanding with excellent communication skills, structured, results oriented, self-driven, proactive, takes ownership.
  • Strong negotiation skills with contractual/legal understanding.
  • JLPT N1 level in Japanse language skill is mandatory.
  • Proficiency in English language communication is needed. Additional understanding of Korean language is preferred.

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: セールススペシャリスト/Sales Specialist for power protection
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager__

##

職務内容（Your Role and Responsibilities）

本ポジションでは、事業部の戦略に基づき、指定された市場・担当エリアにおける製品／システム／サービスの販売を担っていただきます。日々定性的・定量的な販売目標の達成を通じて、受注成長、売上、利益率、市場シェアおよび顧客満足度の持続的な向上に貢献していただきます。

また、市場および製品に関する専門知識を活かし、新たな販売機会の発掘と事業拡大にも積極的に取り組んでいただきます。

###

主要顧客セグメントおよび営業フォーカス

以下を含む多様な業界・顧客セグメントへの営業活動：

  • 半導体製造工場
  • データセンター
  • 病院・医療施設
  • 食品・飲料メーカー
  • 商社
  • ゼネコンおよびサブコン
  • 新規および既存のあらゆる顧客にアプローチし、市場拡大および戦略的パートナーシップの構築を推進

製品・ソリューション営業

  • 電圧変動・瞬低等の課題を解決する AVC（Active Voltage Conditioner） の提案・販売。
  • 製品の特長、技術的な優位性、導入効果を顧客に分かりやすく説明。
  • ABBの方針および戦略に沿って、納期、支払条件、一般取引条件等に関する顧客対応を実施。

事業開発およびマーケティング

  • 効率的な営業・マーケティング活動を企画・実行し、顧客に対して価値提案を的確に伝達。
  • 担当市場・業界における新規ビジネス機会を特定・開拓・推進。
  • 顧客ニーズや市場情報を収集し、社内関係者へ共有することで戦略立案に貢献。

営業オペレーション

  • 見積、契約、社内手続き等の営業関連事務を適切に管理。
  • 必要に応じて、入金管理（キャッシュコレクション）やプロジェクトマネジメント業務をサポート。
  • 社内関係部署と連携し、円滑な業務遂行と高い顧客満足度を実現。

応募資格（Qualifications for the Role）

経験・営業スキル

  • B2B営業経験3年以上（新規開拓ビジネスの経験必須）
  • 新規顧客開拓に強みを持つハンター型営業としての実績
  • テレアポ、飛び込み営業などのアウトバウンド型営業経験
  • 主体的に行動し、成果創出までやり切る推進力

スキル・人物像

  • 高い自主性と行動力を持つセルフスターター
  • 顧客の潜在・顕在ニーズを引き出し、社内に的確に共有できる能力
  • 優れたコミュニケーション力および関係構築力

学歴

  • 高等専門学校卒以上
  • 文系・理系・工学系いずれのバックグラウンドも歓迎

語学要件

  • 日本語：ビジネスレベル（日本語能力試験 N1 相当）
  • 英語：読み書きレベル

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will achieve both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your expertise by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Primary Customer Segments & Sales Focus:

Engage with diverse customer segments across multiple industries including data centers, semiconductor facilities, hospitals, food & beverage manufacturers, trading companies, general contractors, and subcontractors.

  • Approach all customer types to expand market presence and build strategic partnerships.
  • You will be mainly offering AVC(Aactive voltage conditioner) designed specifically to solve voltage disturbance problems.Communicating to the customers about details related to delivery time, payments, and general terms and conditions, in line with ABB’s offering and strategy.
  • Ensuring efficient marketing activities and communicates value proposition to customers.
  • Identifying and driving the development of new market opportunities in the designated market.
  • Managing administrative procedures in sales processes and supports cash collection and project management activities, when needed.

Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in B2B market with new business development
  • Proactive self-starter with strong drive for customer acquisition
  • Hunter-type sales mentality with proven track record
  • Experience with cold calling and door-to-door sales approaches
  • Self-motivated individual who takes initiative in sales activities and drives results
  • Proficiency in eliciting and uncovering customer needs, combined with the ability to communicate and share these insights internally with the organization.
  • Technical college diploma or above (liberal arts, science, or engineering backgrounds all welcome)
  • language requirement:【Japanese】N1 level【English】Reading and writing proficiency

job.title: プロダクトマーケティングスペシャリスト/Product Marketing Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Manager (이사)__

業務内容

担当分野において、グローバル製品戦略に沿った製品マーケティング戦略を実行し、事業目標の達成を支援します。また、マーケティング活動の推進と営業組織の支援を通じて、担当製品およびサービスの販売拡大に貢献していただきます。

主な役割

  • 担当エリア・市場セグメントにおける製品マーケティング戦略を実行し、グローバル戦略に基づく製品価値提案（Value Proposition）および市場ポジショニングを策定・展開する。
  • 製品マーケティングの目標および予算達成に向けて進捗を定期的に管理し、必要に応じて改善施策を立案・実行する。
  • 受注目標の達成に注力するとともに、顧客推奨度（NPS: Net Promoter Score）の継続的な向上を推進する。
  • 関連事業部や製品グループと協力し、年間マーケティング計画を実行する。
  • 特定市場の事業拡大を目的としたビジネスプランを策定する。
  • 営業チームと連携して市場分析を実施し、製品マーケティングに関する予測および計画を立案する。

The HR Analyst plays a critical role in enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role is responsible for transforming complex HR and workforce data into actionable insights that support strategic HR initiatives, talent management, and organizational effectiveness. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with business acumen and excellent communication skills to partner with global HR and business stakeholders.

The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.

This role is contributing to the to the Quality Division for INOPC based in Bangalore, India You will be mainly accountable for:

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Partner with HR and business stakeholders to gather, understand, and translate workforce and business requirements into actionable analytics solutions.
  • Perform advanced workforce data analysis to identify trends, patterns, correlations, and key insights that support business decision-making.
  • Apply data mining and statistical techniques to uncover hidden patterns, validate hypotheses, and measure the impact of HR initiatives.
  • Develop and maintain predictive analytics models to forecast workforce metrics including attrition, retention, hiring demand, absenteeism, diversity, succession, and workforce planning.
  • Leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) technologies to automate insight generation, identify key drivers, and provide proactive recommendations.
  • Deliver executive-level dashboards, reports, and ad hoc analyses to support strategic planning and workforce management decisions.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.

  • Strong knowledge of statistical methods, predictive modeling, and machine learning techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

Engineering Manager ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as a design authority for an engineering discipline with low to medium complexity. Each day, you will complete assignments on small projects or portions of larger projects in a cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by applying basic design thinking/design for excellence concepts in projects.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Electrification business in Distribution Solution division at Nashik, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Responsible for preparing, reviewing and approving engineering designs, ensuring safety, quality, and compliance with customer and contractual requirements
  • Support Mechanical Engineering of ABB MV Switchgear and equivalent product and solution portfolio(s) across the Global factories. Collaborate closely with customers and project teams to clarify technical needs, define solutions, and resolve issues throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Utilizing checklists to perform design verification according to applicable standards and engineering guidelines
  • Strong coordination with supply chain, manufacturing, testing, commissioning, and service teams to ensure designs are correctly built, installed, and updated.
  • Accountable for identifying risks and driving continuous improvement, standardization, and optimization of engineering processes

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical engineering (should be full time)
  • You have 2 to 5 Years of experience in Mechanical Design, Design to Order (DTO), or Project Engineering.
  • Hands-on experience with CAD tools such as SolidWorks, AutoCAD, or other 3D CAD software, along with proficiency in engineering drawings, sheet-metal design, and Bill of Materials (BOM) preparation.
  • Good knowledge of engineering materials, material standards, and manufacturing processes, including IS, EN, ISO, DIN, ASME, and related standards.
  • Experience or exposure to Medium Voltage Switchgear product portfolios, with knowledge of applicable IEC/ANSI standards.
  • Familiarity with international standards such as IEC and IEEE and their application in product design and engineering.
  • Ability to work effectively in a virtual and multicultural organization, collaborating with teams across different geographies and cultures.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with and influence internal and external stakeholders.

More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. The Division offers segment-specific products and solutions that largely serve utilities, industry and infrastructure segments, often providing the requisite medium-voltage link between high-voltage transmission systems and low-voltage users. With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions at its core, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 66 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, reclosers, fuses, contactors, relays, instrument transformers, sensors, motor control centers, as well as low-voltage switchgear for the ANSI standard markets.

job.title: Baan Functional Consultant
job.description:
Baan Functional Consultant (Open) - Bangalore | 4 to 7 Years

Johnson Controls helps create smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, and this role supports the ERP platforms that keep business operations running smoothly. As a Baan Functional Consultant, you will help business users and support teams maintain stable ERP processes, resolve functional issues, and improve the day-to-day experience across Baan IV and ERP LN environments.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Baan Functional Consultant with hands-on experience in ERP functional support and user issue resolution. In this role, you will work closely with business users, functional teams, and technical teams to analyze issues, support production operations, validate process changes, and help ensure reliable ERP performance across the Baan landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for Baan IV, ERP LN FP3, and LN 10.4 ERP applications.
  • Analyze user incidents, identify functional gaps, and support timely resolution with the right teams.
  • Work with business users to clarify process issues, reproduce problems, and confirm expected outcomes.
  • Support production issues, change activities, and functional testing for ERP process updates.
  • Coordinate with technical teams on fixes, enhancements, and interface-related issues.
  • Validate data and process integrity across ERP transactions and support root-cause analysis for recurring issues.
  • Document resolutions, process notes, and functional changes clearly for continuity and knowledge sharing.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership of issues end to end, keeping user impact, accountability, safety, and integrity in focus until the process is restored or the right workaround is in place.
  • Stay close to the business process and the people using it so you can understand the real problem, not just the symptom.
  • Use structured analysis and candid root-cause discussion to prevent repeat issues and improve support quality over time.
  • Work as one team with functional, technical, and business partners to move changes forward smoothly and remove obstacles quickly.
  • Document clearly and follow through on commitments so fixes, decisions, and process changes are easy to trace and support.

Qualifications

  • 4 to 7 years of experience in Baan functional support, ERP consulting, or application support.
  • Hands-on experience with Baan IV, ERP LN FP3, and LN 10.4 ERP environments.
  • Strong understanding of ERP business processes and functional issue handling in a production support setting.
  • Experience working with business users to analyze issues, validate solutions, and support testing or process changes.
  • Ability to coordinate effectively with technical teams and communicate clearly with stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to problem-solving.

Nice to Have

  • Exposure to Baan development, customization, or integration support.
  • Working knowledge of Baan technical architecture, SQL, or data extraction activities.
  • Experience supporting third-party interfaces or Baan EDI-related activities.

Why Join Us

At Johnson Controls, you will be part of a collaborative environment where practical problem-solving, reliability, and teamwork matter. This role offers the opportunity to support core ERP systems that help keep operations running effectively and to build deeper expertise in the Baan and ERP LN ecosystem.

If you are ready to bring your Baan functional experience to a role that values ownership, teamwork, and continuous improvement, we would like to hear from you.

job.title: ServiceMax Functional Lead
job.description:

In this senior techno-functional role, you will lead the functional design and delivery of ServiceMax capabilities that support field service operations, connect business needs with technical execution, and help teams work more effectively.

You will partner with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and support teams to translate operational needs into scalable solutions, improve service processes, and ensure strong delivery from design through handover.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end ServiceMax solution design, development coordination, and implementation support.

  • Prepare and maintain technical and operational documentation, including support runbooks and training materials.

How You Will Do It

  • Work as one team with architects, developers, analysts, QA, and support partners so delivery stays aligned from design to production support.
  • Improve every day through candid feedback, root-cause problem-solving, and continuous refinement of the solution, documentation, and handover process.

Qualifications

job.title: Senior Controls Automation Engineer
job.description:
Johnson Controls is seeking a Senior Controls & Automation Engineer to support the development, testing, commissioning and troubleshooting of PLC/HMI control systems for Hydraulic Power Units (HPU) and CAFS / INERT Fire Suppression Systems.

This is a hands-on role focused on PLC software development, HMI configuration, FAT/iFAT/SAT execution, commissioning and operational support across supplier facilities, JCI sites and project locations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, modify and troubleshoot PLC software using Siemens TIA Portal & Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.
  • Configure and support HMI/SCADA applications such as WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or similar platforms.
  • Execute and support Pre-FAT, FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Implement and verify Cause & Effect Matrices, interlocks, alarms, shutdowns and control sequences.
  • Troubleshoot PLC, HMI, I/O, instrumentation and communication issues.
  • Support controlled software updates, testing and issue resolution.
  • Work closely with engineering teams, suppliers and client representatives to achieve project milestones.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Electrical, Automation, Control or Instrumentation Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years' hands-on PLC programming experience.
  • Strong experience with Siemens TIA Portal and Studio 5000 (mandatory).
  • HMI development experience with WinCC, WinCC Unified, FactoryTalk or equivalent.
  • Proven experience delivering FAT, iFAT, SAT and commissioning activities.
  • Knowledge of industrial communications including Profinet, Modbus TCP/IP and Ethernet/IP.
  • Experience implementing control philosophies, Cause & Effect requirements, interlocks and permissives.

Desirable Experience

  • Oil & Gas, Marine or Offshore projects.
  • Fire Suppression Systems, HPU packages or safety-related control systems.
  • Functional Safety awareness (IEC 61508 / IEC 61511).
  • OT Cyber Security awareness (IEC 62443).
  • Rockwell Studio 5000 and FactoryTalk experience.

What We're Looking For

A practical, hands-on Controls Engineer who can quickly understand control systems, solve automation problems, support project delivery, and work effectively with suppliers, clients and multidisciplinary engineering teams.

Travel within the UK, Turkey and Vietnam will be required for FAT, commissioning and project support activities.
