job.title: People & Culture Generalist
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the P&C Generalist based in our Tokyo Office (Roppongi), you will report to the Senior Director, Regional People Business Partner and work closely with People Operations, Payroll, Legal and other stakeholders across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Taking ownership of Japan’s end-to-end P&C operations and becoming the trusted subject matter expert for employees, managers and the business.
  • Building and improving scalable People processes in a fast-growing organisation, with the opportunity to shape how the employee experience is delivered in Japan.
  • Gaining broad regional exposure by partnering across functions and countries on HR transformation, systems, payroll, compliance and broader P&C initiatives.

What you’ll do

  • Provide day-to-day P&C advice and support on performance, conduct, attendance, and workplace concerns, escalating complex matters to the Senior Director of HR as appropriate.
  • Coach managers on the fair, consistent and legally compliant application of policies, employment practices and employee relations processes.
  • Support the delivery of AirTrunk’s P&C programs, including goal setting, performance reviews, promotions, workforce planning, employee engagement, talent development and broader talent management initiatives.
  • Provide end-to-end HR operations support to employees throughout the employment lifecycle, from onboarding through to termination, acting as the subject matter expert for Japan.
  • Execute, administer and continuously improve AirTrunker lifecycle processes, ensuring a consistent and high-quality employee experience.
  • Maintain current knowledge of Japanese employment legislation and support compliance with local employment, occupational health and safety, quality and environmental requirements.
  • Coordinate local compliance activities, including Health and Safety Committee processes, engagement with the corporate doctor and delivery of Stress Check requirements.
  • Support payroll, attendance, social insurance and employee benefits administration, working closely with payroll vendors, social security attorneys and other external providers.
  • Partner with the Legal team to support the preparation and maintenance of labour agreements, work rules, policies and other employment documentation.
  • Maintain accurate employee records, personnel files and HR documentation, ensuring data integrity and compliance with internal requirements.
  • Provide operational support for regional HRIS, payroll and process-improvement projects, including system testing, upgrades and enhancements.
  • Support background checks, employment verification, immigration matters and other core People Operations activities.
  • Provide cross-country coverage for People Operations colleagues and share knowledge of Japan-specific processes with regional team members.
  • Provide face-to-face support to employees regarding the Japan rent program, including eligibility, applications, amendments and cessation of benefits.
  • Support onboarding data validation in partnership with ATHQ Payroll, including following up on incomplete or inaccurate information across HRIS and related platforms.
  • Support offboarding activities by ensuring requirements are clearly documented and communicated, including employee choices regarding future tax collection and the use of outstanding leave up to the last working day.
  • Prepare and provide payroll-related WHS reporting, including overtime heat maps for WHS Committee meetings.
  • Contribute to ad hoc P&C initiatives and operational priorities in a fast-scaling organisation.

What you’ll bring

  • 5-8 years’ experience in an HR Generalist, People Operations or similar role, ideally within a fast-growing organisation.
  • Strong knowledge of Japanese employment practices, payroll, benefits, social insurance and employee relations.
  • Experience working in a multinational, matrix environment, with the ability to communicate confidently and build effective relationships in English.
  • Experience supporting the full employee lifecycle, from onboarding through to offboarding.
  • The confidence to work independently, manage competing priorities and make sound decisions within established frameworks.
  • Strong communication and relationship-management skills, with the ability to advise employees and coach managers effectively.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to partner closely with the Senior Director of HR, Payroll, Legal, vendors and regional People teams.
  • A practical, continuous-improvement mindset, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering a high-quality employee experience

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

OT / ICS Operations & Security Management

  • Support the company's ICS/OT operations, including networks, systems, endpoints, and cybersecurity tools.
  • Maintain OT system and network monitoring to ensure availability and reliability.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and provide day-to-day operational support for cybersecurity solutions within the ICS environment.
  • Support day-to-day control system operations and troubleshoot issues to ensure reliable plant performance.
  • Monitor systems for unusual or suspicious activities and respond to cybersecurity incidents, alerts, and threats.
  • Maintain and enhance security controls for critical systems to meet operational and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Manage CII system and network backup processes to ensure business continuity and recovery readiness.

Information Security Governance & Compliance

  • Manage and maintain the organization's Information Security Management System (ISMS).
  • Conduct annual reviews and updates of ISMS policies, procedures, and supporting documentation.
  • Implement and maintain cybersecurity requirements in compliance with CSA, PSO, EMA, CCOP, ISO 27001:2022, and other applicable standards and regulations.
  • Take ownership of ISMS-related activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Serve as the key liaison between the organization, customers, auditors, service providers, and internal information security stakeholders.

Risk, Vulnerability & Security Assessment

  • Conduct annual cybersecurity risk assessments for Critical Information Infrastructure (CII) systems.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate cybersecurity risks to ensure critical systems remain secure and resilient.
  • Perform vulnerability management and patch management activities for OT/ICS environments.
  • Plan and execute cybersecurity activities including:Vulnerability Assessments (VA)
  • Penetration Testing (VAPT)
  • Threat Hunting
  • Purple Team Exercises
  • Tabletop Exercises
  • Security Reviews and Assessments

Review cybersecurity advisories and implement mitigation measures where necessary.Audit & Regulatory Management

  • Support and coordinate internal and external cybersecurity audits.
  • Plan and execute annual cybersecurity audit programs.
  • Coordinate CSA audits, vulnerability assessments, compliance reviews, and mandated regulatory audits.
  • Ensure audit findings are tracked, remediated, and closed within agreed timelines.
  • Support information security requirements during both internal and external audits.

Security Projects & Technology Improvement

  • Review existing technology architecture and identify vulnerabilities, weaknesses, and improvement opportunities.
  • Plan, implement, and oversee cybersecurity technology upgrades, enhancements, and major system changes.
  • Develop technical solutions, cost estimations, budgets, and proposals to meet cybersecurity requirements for internal and external projects.
  • Support the delivery, commissioning, and cybersecurity assurance of new projects and plant systems.
  • Ensure all new systems meet operational, cybersecurity, and regulatory requirements before deployment.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with business units, service providers, and external stakeholders to ensure OT cybersecurity requirements are met.
  • Collaborate with internal IT security personnel and Site Information Security Officers (SITSO) on cybersecurity initiatives.
  • Evaluate and monitor cybersecurity service performance and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) of third-party vendors and contractors.
  • Coordinate cybersecurity activities with the EC&I Department and support departmental objectives.

Training & Awareness

  • Develop and deliver cybersecurity awareness programs and training sessions for employees.
  • Promote cybersecurity best practices across the organization.

Provide guidance and support to users on cybersecurity policies, procedures, and compliance requirements.'

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or Diploma in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, or a related discipline.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Senior/Technical Officer
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

You will support the Operations Engineer in ensuring smooth daily operations by performing the following duties:

  • Carry out routine checks and testing of plant equipment and propose job cards in a proper manner
  • Monitor plant parameters and make adjustments/troubleshoot via DCS or in the site to ensure parameters are within limits, including temperature, pressure, flue gas emissions, etc
  • Manage boiler water condition and level, including monitoring and controlling water consumption
  • Perform the necessary equipment switch-over, like feed water pumps, flue gas treatment compartment, chemical dosing silo, etc.
  • Optimize refuse incineration throughput based on operating conditions
  • Ensure chemicals and consumables optimization
  • Record and document changes in work procedures accurately and precisely according to plant ISO standards and quality management procedures
  • Update plant status – informing equipment failure or situation in time to immediate superior
  • Ensure that incidents (if any) are well-handled and properly documented with minimum disruption to operations
  • Enforcement of Permit-to-Work (PTW) System with good Risk Assessment System in line with identified Work Inventory. Administer PTW system and LOTO well
  • Assist in isolation and normalization of equipment safely based on plant P&ID drawings
  • Assist the Operations Engineer in management of activities for Operations with regard to Central Control Room (CCR), Weighbridge, Water and Wastewater Treatment Plant, Overhaul, reception hall, bunker management and other general plant matters
  • Handle and resolve all technical issues related to operations of boilers, turbo-generators, Flue gas treatment and its auxiliaries
  • Ensure smooth and efficient operation of turbo-generators and associated common equipment
  • Work with Maintenance team on carrying out Boiler and Turbo-Generators overhaul and any ad hoc work activities in SWTE
  • Have a safety mindset and participate actively in safety initiatives and events
  • Contribute to improvement and optimization projects
  • Liaise with contractors on matters relating to operations and solid waste management
  • Supervise refuse/ash crane and ash-handling operations that are carried out by contractors
  • Ensure contractor compliance to in-house rules and HSE protocol. Ensure adequate supervision is provided and jobs are carried out safely
  • Any other ad-hoc duties assigned by supervisor / plant management

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • At least a Higher NITEC in Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical Engineering or equivalent
  • Working knowledge of the principles and mechanics of plant equipment and DCS functions is essential
  • At least a Class 2 Boiler Attendant Certificate is preferred but not mandatory
  • Preferably have attended training relating to HAZMAT/First Aid/Incident Management/Work-at-Height/Confined Space. Trainings will be planned for those who have not been trained
  • Strong safety mindset and can-do attitude
  • Meticulous with good interpersonal and communication skills
  • Good team-player with high initiative
  • An interest in process or Waste-to-Energy (WTE) Plant operations. Must be able to get accustomed to WTE environment
  • Committed to 12-hour shift work and willing to provide support on off/rest day when required
  • This is a 2 years contract position

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Infrastructure

PLATFORM

Operating Division

job.title: Senior Manager, Managed Roaming Pre-Sales & Customer Success
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help shape global roaming and travel connectivity solutions, bringing together deep telecommunications expertise, solution architecture and customer engagement to accelerate new opportunities from concept to launch.

##

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Senior Manager, Managed Roaming Pre-Sales & Customer Success, you will lead the Managed Roaming (MR) Pre-Sales function and champion Customer Success for strategic accounts, owning the customer lifecycle from solution discovery and onboarding through service adoption, operational performance, issue resolution, account growth and renewal.

You will act as a trusted advisor and orchestration point across MR Business/Sales, Product, Network, IT/MVNE, Operations and vendors, translating customer business and technical needs into scalable, secure and commercially viable solutions while protecting revenue and identifying new growth opportunities.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and coach the MR Pre-Sales team and champion the Customer Success team, setting account coverage, priorities, solutioning standards, service governance, KPIs and capability development.
  • Own the end-to-end success of strategic MR accounts across technical, commercial and operational dimensions, from onboarding and adoption through ongoing service management, growth and renewal.
  • Develop and execute customer success and account plans based on customer business outcomes, with clear milestones, adoption targets, account health indicators, revenue retention and growth objectives, risks and governance cadences.
  • Build trusted relationships with customer executives and operational stakeholders, understand their strategy and act as the senior coordination point for complex needs and escalations.
  • Partner with MR Business/Sales to qualify opportunities, conduct discovery, shape requirements before RFI/RFP and support commercial reviews, business cases, renewals and expansion proposals.
  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for Managed Roaming, MRaaS and related global travel connectivity offerings.
  • Lead technical RFI/RFP/RFQ responses, proposals, workshops, demonstrations, PoCs/UAT, technical due diligence and objection handling to support complex deal closure.
  • Orchestrate Product, Network, IT/MVNE, Security, Operations and vendors to validate feasibility, dependencies, sizing and cost inputs, delivery plans, operational readiness and ongoing service performance.

job.description:

job.title: Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

**

The IA Manager, Investigation is responsible for conducting and supporting investigations into allegations of fraud, corruption, whistleblower matters, misconduct and other breaches of Group policies involving Singtel, NCS and their respective subsidiaries. The role supports Singtel Group’s efforts to prevent, detect, investigate and respond to fraud and corruption risks, while strengthening internal controls and promoting a strong culture of integrity and accountability. This includes supporting the referral of appropriate matters to law enforcement agencies where warranted.

The IA Manager, Investigation also assist business and line management in discharging their responsibility for fraud risk management by developing and implementing proactive programmes and processes to reduce the risk of fraud and corruption. This includes but not be limited to methodologies and processes to prevent detect and assess fraud across all Business Units, their products services and processes and assisting in fraud prevention for new products, business channels and opportunities.

In addition, the IA Manager, Investigation supports other ad hoc internal audit projects and special reviews as directed by the Group Chief Internal Auditor and/or Head, Financial & Operational Audit and Investigation. The position reports directly to Head, Financial & Operational Audit and Investigation.

**

Make An Impact By

  • Independently plan and conduct investigations into allegations of fraud and other serious misconduct involving Singtel employees, contractors, agents or other representatives, securing and preserving appropriate evidence in a lawful manner to facilitate potential criminal prosecution by law enforcement agencies and maximise the recovery of losses incurred by the Company.
  • Manage multiple investigations simultaneously and effectively prioritise case workloads to ensure that matters are investigated, reported and resolved expeditiously in accordance with agreed timelines.
  • During investigations, identify weaknesses in processes and internal controls that have led, or could lead, to fraudulent activities, recommend appropriate remedial actions to management and secure management’s commitment to implement the agreed actions, and follow up on their implementation.
  • Recommend appropriate actions to HR in respect of employee found to have committed fraud.
  • Prepare high-quality and concise investigation reports that clearly present the relevant facts, evidence, findings, conclusions and recommendations arising from the investigations.
  • Assist in development and delivery of fraud awareness programmes for employees, contractors, agents and other representative across Singtel, NCS and its subsidiaries, as applicable.
  • Conduct internal and external environmental scanning to identify and analyse new and emerging fraud trends. Disseminate findings across Singtel and its subsidiaries in the form of advice and actionable intelligence.
  • Proactively identify and address control gaps and high-risk weaknesses in existing policies and procedures that may increase exposure to fraud and/or organised criminal activity.
  • Assist in managing all notifications and referrals of actual or suspected fraud, corruption or serious misconduct received through various reporting channels.
  • Collaborate with management to implement best practices in fraud prevention, detection and control.
  • Act as a liaison with law enforcement agencies on cases investigated and provide updates, as required.

Skills for Success

  • Tertiary qualifications in Fraud Risk Management, Investigations, or other related disciplines or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrable investigative and police liaison experience (minimum 5 years required).
  • Demonstrable experience in applying innovative analytical techniques.
  • A good understanding of Singapore criminal legislation.
  • Demonstrable innovative problem-solving skills, critical analysis of complex issues, and formulation of business solutions.
  • Strong Project Management skills.
  • Thorough knowledge of Forensic Accounting.
  • Exceptional communication skills in liaising with all levels of management, verbally and in writing allowing communication of complex material to audiences with varying levels of understanding.
  • Ability to articulate risk strategy and policy coherently and convincingly at a high level.
  • The ability to adapt to a changing work environment, comprehend complex issues, determine core issues and provide solutions within demanding time constraints.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

**

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Sr Engineer-I/C-Industrial Water
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Engineer – Instrumentation & Controls (I&C) to lead the execution and delivery of global Industrial Water and Wastewater projects. In this role, you will provide technical leadership, manage project teams, and drive engineering excellence across Instrumentation, Control Systems, Automation, and Functional Safety aspects.

You will work closely with project managers, engineering managers, discipline & sub-discipline leaders, global engineering teams, and resource managers to deliver high-quality engineering solutions while contributing to team development, talent growth, and organizational objectives. The position combines project execution responsibilities with people leadership and strategic resource planning.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Instrumentation and Control engineering activities for industrial water and wastewater projects.
  • Provide expertise in Instrumentation systems, Process analyzers, PLC, DCS, SCADA, and HMI systems, Industrial communication networks, Functional Safety, ESD systems, and interlocks.
  • Apply advanced engineering principles and innovative approaches to solve challenging technical problems.
  • Develop, review, and approve complex I&C engineering deliverables throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables meet quality, challenging schedule, budget, and client requirements.
  • Conduct technical evaluations and submittal reviews of vendor proposals, drawings, and documentation.
  • Collaborate effectively with clients, project teams, suppliers, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution.
  • Promote compliance with company quality standards, engineering procedures, and industry best practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, knowledge-sharing programs, risk management, and lessons-learned implementation.
  • Staff supervisory responsibilities as assigned.
  • Build and develop high-performing engineering teams in collaboration with global and regional leaders.
  • Career development along with talent development and training.
  • Support the India/APAC IC&C chief engineer with resources to drive efficient processes and tools.

job.title: Senior Director, Site Selection
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

This role leads site selection portfolio management, land acquisition, entitlement, and pre-development activities while supporting the delivery of strategic growth objectives for NTT Global Data Centers. The position is responsible for managing the full development lifecycle from site origination and acquisition through permitting, infrastructure coordination, due diligence, and transition to construction. This role is highly cross-functional and requires close collaboration with Infrastructure and design, Product, Finance, Legal, and Operations teams, as well as external stakeholders including landowners, brokers, utility providers, government authorities, consultants, and local communities. The role provides executive leadership across internal and external stakeholders, influencing strategic decisions and enabling market expansion initiatives. The successful candidate will combine strong real estate transaction experience with development execution capabilities, financial analysis skills, and stakeholder management expertise. The individual will also demonstrate leadership in capital allocation, portfolio optimization, organizational development, and complex commercial negotiations.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Identify, evaluate, and secure land acquisition opportunities for future data center developments.
  • Develop and execute site acquisition strategies aligned with long-term business objectives.
  • Establish and maintain relationships with landowners, real estate developers, brokers, government agencies, and infrastructure providers.
  • Lead negotiations related to land purchases, option agreements, easements, utility rights, and other real estate transactions.
  • Coordinate and manage technical, commercial, legal, tax, environmental, and regulatory due diligence activities.
  • Partner with Power, Design, and Engineering teams to evaluate site suitability and infrastructure availability.
  • Analyze data center and digital infrastructure market trends, develop business cases, perform investment evaluations, and support strategic investment decision-making.
  • Build and maintain acquisition pipelines and land portfolio strategies.
  • Lead discussions and negotiations with landowners, real estate developers, government authorities, and joint venture partners to secure land acquisitions and obtain the rights necessary for development.
  • Provide executive-level reporting, strategic insights, and decision-making support to senior management and key stakeholders.
  • Represent GDC Japan with government officials, utilities, energy providers, and other external stakeholders in Japan.

Knowledge and Attributes:

  • Strong understanding of real estate transactions, land acquisition processes including Japanese real estate regulations, and development delivery.
  • Experience working in global organizations with regional interfaces and cross-cultural dynamics.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Fluency in Japanese and English (written and spoken); proficiency in additional languages is an advantage.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align across functions, regions, and seniority levels.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Successfully completed university degree (Master’s or equivalent Diploma).
  • Relevant Professional certifications related to real estate (e.g., project management or development) is desirable.

Required Experience:

  • 10+ years of professional experience in data center development, commercial real estate, infrastructure development, industrial development, or related sectors.
  • Experience in executive leadership role in real estate or data center companies.
  • Proven track record managing site selection and due diligence processes for Data Centers.
  • Experience supporting entitlement, permitting, and infrastructure development activities.

Physical Requirements

  • Confident use of standard office equipment.
  • Completion of work during local business hours, willingness to support meeting in different time zones.

Work Conditions and Requirements:

  • Willingness and ability to travel domestically as required.
  • Ability to work remotely with a reliable and stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Associate Critical Facilities Maintenance Engineer
job.description:

Associate Critical Facilities maintenance Engineer is responsible for operating, monitoring, maintaining, and troubleshooting critical data centre facility systems, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, fire life safety, and building control systems. The position supports preventive and predictive maintenance, system upgrades, operational efficiency, and emergency response activities while ensuring maximum uptime and reliability. Responsibilities include managing cooling systems, power distribution, HVAC, UPS, generators, plumbing, and fire protection systems, as well as coordinating with contractors and internal teams. The role also involves data analysis, technical documentation, inventory management, and maintaining data floor infrastructure. Candidates should possess basic technical knowledge, problem-solving skills, teamwork, and the ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Assists with the management of data centre systems to avoid unplanned, customer-impacting events.

  • Performs data trending / tracking and analyse the data.

  • Develops technical writing skills in regard to the research and development of procedures for preventative or corrective maintenance activities.
  • Installs hot and cold aisle isolation barriers.

  • Orders, tracks and restocks facility related consumable items and parts ensuring performance at the lowest possible cost.
  • Ensures a regular, predictable attendance which is essential for satisfactory performance.

Has a demonstrated technical ability applicable to data centre operations as well as, innovative thinking cross functionally, including integrated systems and information technology (IT) experience Entry level knowledge of the electrical and mechanical systems used in a data centre environment, including, but not limited to the following: electrical distribution and layout, transformers, PLC's, Generators, Switchgear, UPS systems, STS', ATS' PDU's, Chilled Water Systems, CRAC/CRAH's, Pre-Action Sprinkler Systems Entry level knowledge of NEC, NFPA 70E, NFPA 72, NFPA 25, and compliance issues as well as building codes in regard to fire life safety Entry level knowledge in industrial safety best practices (i.e. lockout/tag out, arc flash protection, OSHA and state regulations) Ability to rapidly learn and use PC based, integrated critical monitoring and control systems

  • Proficient with computers to include the utilization of Microsoft programs such as Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook.
  • Ability to work in a team environment.
  • Ability to work in a high stress, fast paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Ability to respond to emergency situations at the data centre.
  • Ability to work outside normal business hours, including weekends, late nights, holidays and on-call support.

Ability to communicate effectively with verbal, visual and listening skills Good problem-solving skills. Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Relevant high school diploma or equivalent required Relevant advanced qualification or equivalent work related experience required o CPR/First Aid and NFPA70E Certified (can be gained during course of employment) o Possession of an OSHA approved forklift certification or the ability to obtain one after hire required Required Experience: Entry level or basic demonstrated experience in a similar role, preferably gained within a data centre facilities environment

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: Mining Application Engineer- Technical Specialist
job.description:
This dual customer/product focused position serves as the senior technical liaison between OEMs and represents our customers during new product development programs. Applying Cummins’ products to customer vehicles requires the development of technical specifications, implementing new design configurations, and delivering high performance, low-cost equipment and system solutions integrated with customers’ products in a variety of applications. Integrating high quality and optimized customer solutions requires the interaction with sales and marketing teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Obtains input and negotiates with Subject Matter Experts and Value Package Introduction (VPI) Teams and delivers product data and installation requirements to Application Engineers and OEMs Makes decisions in the areas of product selection, design, and integration that impact OEM machine performance, optimization and quality.
  • Applies and improves processes such as Installation Quality Assurance, OEM integration and product selection and tools such as Advisor, Cummins OnLine Specifications (COLS) and Global Customer Engineering (GCE) required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making.
  • Develops strong working relationships with customer technical counterparts to serve as their primary liaison to deliver specialized product technical information, manage product specifications, communicate product change information, conduct complex installation issue resolutions and facilitate customer requests.
  • Applies technical expertise in the areas of product, application and market knowledge to support OEM product selection and equipment design Leads the translation of customer needs and "voice of the customer" into functional product requirements to provide input on program-related decisions Serves as customer/market advocate inside Cummins during participation in new product development programs, design reviews and product change request processes.
  • Ensures products are applied and installed correctly to meet customer system requirements and environments Assures installation quality by validating prototype machine performance and ensuring installations meet Cummins requirements Utilizes Analysis Led Design (ALD) and Six Sigma tools to optimize product and system performance Proposes innovative customer-focused initiatives and projects.
  • Assists with the transfer of knowledge through coaching and mentoring less experienced engineers Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team.
  • Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site.
  • Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers.
  • Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

.

Competencies:

  • Machine Integration and Optimization - Combines various parts or sub-systems into a whole to achieve the output most desired by the customer; applies Cummins' installation requirements using our standard tools, processes and identified best practices to ensure optimization of performance, reliability, cost and quality; analyzes technical issues using proven problem-solving and troubleshooting techniques for rapid resolution.
  • Product Application Support - Ensures new product information is available by developing and managing accurate and complete technical content in a timely manner to support our customers and the business; provides new options through management of technical systems to support sales to all of our markets; defines installation requirements and develops innovative tools with in-depth, cross-system knowledge and industry experience for successful design and integration.
  • Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  • Product Installation Quality - Identifies and applies ways to improve machine integration to minimize rework and deliver the best product; applies standard Cummins processes based on the experience and knowledge of product installation experts; ensures that products are installed correctly and meet requirements through an installation review process.
  • Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
  • Product Selection - Guides customers to the best product offerings for their markets and applications; offers best-fit solutions to customers by optimizing product specifications to make Cummins' offerings easy to install into new applications; represents features and benefits of products in terms that customers understand; ensures Cummins' products aren't misapplied through using Cummins' technical information systems, local and application requirements.
  • Technical Customer Management - Represents Cummins to our customers by being the interface for all technical aspects; provides engineering data, documentation and training to customers to support the design and integration of equipment; ensures that the customer's business is not interrupted by managing Cummins' product changes through the use of our change processes and regular communications with Product Development and the customer.
  • Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

  • Ensure compliance with safety, environmental and statutory requirements including Factory Inspector, Electrical Inspector, PESO and MPCB.
  • Drive energy-efficiency initiatives and continuous improvement.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.

Drives engagement - Creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

Equipment/Capital Procurement - Selects manufacturing equipment which meets the Cummins manufacturing specifications and meets the project or program needs.

Manufacturing Prognostics - Applies prognostics techniques by collecting real time equipment conditions and then use advanced analytics and artificial intelligence technologies to project future failures to eliminate unplanned equipment and systems down time.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Preventative and Predictive Maintenance - Interprets machine and tool maintenance records and data to develop and execute preventative and predictive management strategies to drive continuous improvement within the manufacturing process.

Balances stakeholders - Anticipating and balancing the needs of multiple stakeholders.

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

18–22 years of plant engineering / maintenance experience

  • Strong exposure to Diesel Engine / Powertrain / Automotive manufacturing.
  • Hands-on experience in Machining + Engine Assembly + Test/Dyno.
  • Strong knowledge of CNC/VMC/SPM, TPM, SAP PM/Maximo, vibration analysis and thermography.
  • Experience with CAPEX/OPEX, facility management and large maintenance teams.
  • Knowledge of IATF 16949, ISO 45001/14001/50001 and statutory compliance.
  • Strong shop-floor orientation with a 24x7 manufacturing mindset.

Key Deliverables

  • Reduction in breakdowns and maintenance costs.
  • Effective execution of CAPEX and strategic projects.
  • Improved maintenance process maturity and stakeholder satisfaction.
  • Optimized spare parts inventory and manufacturing overhead management.
  • Safe, compliant, and efficient facility operations.

You will work closely with counterparts in business development, marketing, solution architecture and partner teams to lead execution of BD plays.

  • Ensure customer success with early and growth stage startups in India
  • Drive growth and market share in a defined territory
  • Accelerate customer adoption through well-developed BD engagements
  • Develop and execute against a comprehensive account/territory plan.
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services.
  • Accelerate customer adoption by engaging Founders, CXO, Board of Directors and VC influencers
  • Work with AWS partners to manage joint selling opportunities
  • Assist customers in identifying use cases for priority adoption of AWS as well as best practices implementations
  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with key accounts.

About the team The AWS Startups team partners with startups around the world to build, launch, grow, and help scale their business. We don’t just support startups with cloud infrastructure, but also partner with our startup customers throughout their journey by providing resources to tackle challenges from early stage fundraising to building technical teams and developing startup culture.

  • Experience proactively growing customer relationships within an account while expanding their understanding of the customer's business
  • Experience working within a high-growth, technology company

job.title: Principal Solutions Architect
job.description:
Are you passionate about cloud computing? Do you have a unique combination of deep technical knowledge, business acumen and strong interpersonal skills? Are you passionate about building the world's best technology teams?

Amazon aims to be the most customer centric company on earth. Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers critical applications for hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. This job opening is for a Senior Leader, Solution Architecture role focused on building solutions for customers around AWS platform services and industry solutions. It sits within the Public Sector team of Amazon Web Services India Private Limited. We work with central government ministries, state and local governments, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs), education institutions, EdTech startups (including India-based unicorns), non-profits, and healthcare organizations. job.title: GFOCC Tech, GFOCC
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the Role

As an GFOCC Tech at ADSIPL, you will get to maintain and operate the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure across a number of local and remote locations. The technicians are responsible for carrying out GFO infrastructure monitoring and servicing servers, network and telecommunication equipment remotely from a centralized location. This requires the ability to drive change while maintaining excellent communications.

Key job responsibilities As an GFOCC Tech at ADSIPL, you will get to maintain and operate the world’s largest cloud computing infrastructure across a number of local and remote locations. The technicians are responsible for carrying out GFO infrastructure monitoring and servicing servers, network and telecommunication equipment remotely from a centralized location. This requires the ability to drive change while maintaining excellent communications. A day in the life Your day job will include: •Remote troubleshooting of GFO sites network and compute Infrastructure •Remote triaging and repairing server & network hardware in coordination with on ground hands and eye support •The role has 24X7 shift rotation. •Coordinate in resolving data center facility issues •Coordinating remote hands & eyes for any site issues •Participating in small to mid-size site improvement projects •Building relationships with remote facilities to ensure swift response times to events.

  • Improving Safety and Security operational processes

•Participate in team/service provider meetings for metric and performance analysis •Assist senior techs in quality check of the new site and edge network scaling projects handed over to operations •Guide vendor resources on AWS GFO standards, policies and guidelines providing remote hands and eye support

About You

•You are someone who is highly autonomous, very detail oriented and possesses a very strong written & verbal communication skills. You are a high performing individual with a "can do" attitude. •Supervise with Colocation operators performing servicing or preventive maintenance •Assist in performing root cause analysis for operational issues •Perform first level trouble-shooting for facility and rack level events •You will have experience building relationships with internal and external teams/customers along with innovating effective solutions to resolve issues & problems as they arise. •You will have previous hands on technical troubleshooting experience and a proven ability solving complex problems. •Create CMs (Change Management Tasks) to enable changes and maintenance at sites •You will be required to provide remote support required by our internal teams. •Perform basic support concepts such as ticketing systems, root cause analysis, and task prioritization.

About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

job.title: Physical Security Architect, Data Center Engineering
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

AWS Design Engineering team is looking for a highly talented and motivated Physical Security Architect/Engineer to work with our enterprise data centre design team, designing the data centres of tomorrow to maximize the effectiveness of the physical security program.

The duties include extra-low voltage system design and engineering, working with the data centre architectural and engineering team to assure security best practices are observed, drafting new systems into the design teams build plans, and coordinating with regional and local physical security leaders to understand the new building and security system designs, adhering to the products on the AWS approved parts list.

A successful candidate will be responsible for interpretation of Risk Assessments and Threat Analysis and AWS Physical Security Standards to assure the proper security technologies are selected to meet the unique challenges to be found in a global security program. After a new technology is inducted into the data centre physical security plan, this position will be responsible for assuring the new system is incorporated into the larger data center basis of design.

Key job responsibilities

  • Design and engineer low voltage security systems
  • Using Blue Beam and other drafting technologies to work in collaboration with the design teams to produce designs in Revit/CAD
  • Creation of specifications and scope of work documentation template for local project managers to use for vendor bids
  • Provide technical and design support for local physical security teams
  • Coordinating with all the other disciplines in the design process of a new building (architectural, mechanical, electrical, civil, IT)
  • Supervise and approve all designs deliverables developed by the local physical security team for projects at each milestones of a project. Analyze, accept or reject alternate designs and mitigation measure develop by the local physical security teams when the standard design can’t be applied
  • Act as a subject matter expert to support implementation of new technologies
  • Work regionally but also support the global PSA team to ensure alignment on decisions and standards
  • Domestic and international travel for up to a week at a time

About the team AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • 4+ years of commissioning experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
  • Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
  • Experience researching new designs, technologies, and construction methods of data center equipment and facilities
  • Experience in commissioning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer License
  • Experience with building codes and regulations for your region
  • Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
  • Experience reading, interpreting, and creating construction drawings, specifications, and submittal documents

job.title: Head Of Project Management And Governance
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Project Management and Governance to lead the project delivery and governance function across ICT, telecom, network infrastructure, managed services, cloud, data centre, and enterprise customer implementation projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the Project Management Office (PMO), project governance framework, and delivery standards.
  • Oversee the end-to-end portfolio of ICT, telecom, cloud, data centre, managed services, and customer implementation projects.
  • Manage, coach, and develop a team of project managers and coordinators.
  • Drive project delivery performance, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to quality standards.
  • Establish and enhance project management methodologies, processes, reporting, and governance controls.
  • Engage stakeholders, customers, vendors, and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.
  • Monitor project risks, issues, resources, and dependencies, and drive timely resolution and escalation management.
  • Prepare portfolio and governance reports for senior management and executive review.
  • Oversee resource planning, vendor management, cost control, and delivery capacity.
  • Ensure compliance with internal governance, security, risk management, and quality assurance requirements.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Management, IT, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • 20+ years of progressive experience in project, program, or portfolio management, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role managing project teams and complex delivery portfolios.
  • Proven track record in delivering complex ICT, telecom, network infrastructure, cloud, managed services, data centre, security, or system integration projects for enterprise customers.
  • Strong experience in project governance, PMO operations, portfolio reporting, risk management, customer escalation handling, and cross-functional delivery coordination.
  • Strong leadership and people management skills with the ability to guide project teams, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and drive delivery accountability.
  • Excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Hands-on familiarity with tools such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Microsoft Project/Planner, Power BI, Jira, Smartsheet, ServiceNow, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, or similar AI-assisted PMO, workflow automation, dashboarding, and portfolio governance platforms is preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as PMP (Project Management Professional), PgMP, PRINCE2, or PMI-ACP (Agile) are strongly preferred.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced SAP GRC Process Control CCM Solution Architect to lead the design, implementation, and continuous enhancement of Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM) solutions to join our CFIN team. The role will be responsible for driving control automation, governance, and monitoring initiatives across P2P, O2C, R2R, ITGC processes. Drive onboarding, automation, and optimization of ITGC, P2P,O2C,R2R business process controls to strengthen governance, risk management, and compliance monitoring.
  • Manage the complete CCM implementation lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment, hypercare, and ongoing support. Design and implement CCM rules by defining monitoring logic, execution frequency, thresholds, scope, and exception criteria.

  • Monitor and report CCM performance through defined KPIs, including control coverage, execution success rates, exception trends, and remediation metrics. Guide control owners in exception analysis, root cause identification, and remediation activities.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of broader SAP GRC Process Control capabilities beyond Continuous Controls Monitoring (CCM), including Surveys and Assessments, Policy Management.
  • Identify opportunities to improve governance, risk management, and compliance processes by leveraging the full suite of SAP GRC Process Control capabilities.
  • Facilitate solution design workshops and governance forums, providing guidance on CCM capabilities, monitoring approaches, implementation best practices, and optimal monitoring/reporting solutions aligned with business, compliance, scalability, and maintainability requirements.

.

  • Proven experience designing and implementing CCM solutions across Finance, Procurement, Sales, Master Data, and IT processes. Strong understanding of SAP business processes, including P2P, O2C, R2R, ITGC, and compliance frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience with CCM rule configuration, data sources, business rules, exception management, report logic validation, and SAP GRC Process Control integrations with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, BW, and other enterprise applications. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

#

Good to Have

  • Knowledge of SAP Central Finance (CFIN) and its integration with S/4HANA.
  • Understanding of SAP Finance (FI/CO) module processes.

job.description:

This Position reports to:

Head of Channel- India & Southeast Asia ###

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to support engineering activities in all types of project sizes and complexities, under the supervision of senior engineers. Each day, you will complete the tasks cost-effectively and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards. You will also showcase your knowledge by collecting data and supporting production of the engineering design.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Hybrid

This role is contributing to the machine automation within ABB's Automation division in Ahmedabad-India region. Main stakeholders include Customers, Application Engineering Team, Project Management Team, Testing & Commissioning Team, and Product Development Team.**

You will be mainly accountable for:**

  • Programming, Development, commissioning, Planning, monitoring, and executing application development tasks, including new product development, incremental modifications, and timely closure of assigned work.
  • Providing technical support for testing, installation, commissioning, debugging, and diagnostics activities.
  • Translating conceptual designs into detailed engineering documentation through modelling, prototyping, simulation, and calculations, while applying design thinking and best practices.
  • Assisting in preparing engineering proposals and presentations and maintaining effective communication with customers and stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

**

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical / Instrumentation / Automation/Mechatronics or related discipline).
  • Minimum 3-8 years of application development and support experience.
  • Well-developed understanding of Industrial Automation systems like PLCs, motors, drives, motion control and robotic systems
  • Demonstrable experience in building strong and enduring customer relationships within highly dynamic and competitive markets
  • Good communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in a global environment.
  • Willing to travel for site support and commissioning as required.

**

More about us:

B&R Industrial Automation is a manufacturer of automation technology and ABB's global center for machine and factory automation. B&R was founded in 1979 by Erwin Bernecker and Josef Rainer and has its headquarters in Eggelsberg, Upper Austria. job.title: 结构专家及报价经理（E-House业务）
job.description:
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. You'll make an impact by

  • Consult with customers on technical solutions in cooperation with Sales, Key Account managers, and other business units to deliver integrated E-House systems.
  • Develop E-House project pipeline and support sales colleagues with comprehensive technical expertise during the pre-sales phase to identify and pursue new opportunities.
  • Provide high-level technical cooperation with customers, deeply engaging Siemens in the co-creation, planning, and design of customer's future-oriented electrification solutions (automation, thermal management, etc.), enabling value selling for Data Center projects.
  • Prepare bidding documents according to customer requirements for E-House Business, including structural calculations, CFD simulations, air conditioning load analysis, and electrical design specifications.

  • Follow Siemens project management processes to control costs, manage cash flow within budget, and ensure on-time delivery of all project milestones.
  • Develop project resource plans and coordinate with various functional managers to ensure sufficient and qualified resources for successful project execution.
  • Monitor project quality issues proactively and implement corrective actions to maintain Siemens quality standards.
  • Ensure supplier selection and negotiation in close collaboration with the Supply Chain Management (SCM) team to optimize cost and delivery performance.
  • Manage customer expectations and satisfaction throughout the project lifecycle to build long-term partnerships.

Your defining qualities

  • Bachelor's Degree or above in Engineering, Architecture, or related field
  • 5+ years of working experience in project management within the automation or industrial infrastructure industry
  • Proficiency in structural calculations, FEM (Finite Element Method) analysis, CFD (Computational Fluid Dynamics) simulation, air conditioning load analysis, E-House electrical design, and related disciplines such as fire alarm systems and security systems
  • Fluent in English for both oral and written communication
  • Strong communication, coordination, teamwork, and leadership skills with proven ability to manage cross-functional teams and stakeholder relationships
  • Experience in technical pre-sales support, solution design, and customer engagement
  • Knowledge of contract management and commercial negotiation in technical projects

The skills you are expected to have

Sales Support & Solution Design: Ability to provide technical consultation, support pre-sales activities, participate in solution design workshops, and contribute to value-based selling strategies aligned with customer business objectives.

Supplier & Contract Management: Experience in supplier selection, contract negotiation, commercial discussions, and cost optimization while maintaining quality and delivery commitments.
