job.title: Senior Critical Operations Technician (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

The Senior Critical Operations Technician is the senior on-shift technical role responsible for ensuring safe, stable and consistent operation of critical electrical, mechanical, cooling, controls and life-safety systems. The role provides elevated technical capability, supports first-response incident actions, verifies plant condition after maintenance or resets, and guides technicians in executing operational tasks with accuracy and discipline. This position supports STACK’s 100% uptime commitment through strong operational judgement, trend awareness, structured troubleshooting and the ability to stabilise plant conditions within authorised boundaries. The Senior Technician also enhances shift performance by coaching team members, refining documentation quality and maintaining a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Essential Functions

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

Critical Operations

  • Support STACK’s 100% uptime objective through disciplined operational control, proactive monitoring and accurate technical response.
  • Maintain real-time awareness of plant condition through BMS/EPMS, alarms and inspections, taking timely actions within authorised limits.
  • Provide senior technical support to shift technicians, assisting with prioritisation, procedural clarity and execution quality.
  • Operate and monitor critical electrical and/or mechanical systems, including UPS, PDUs, switchboards, generators, CRAC/CRAH, CDU/FWU, chilled water systems, pumps and associated plant, strictly within approved procedures and authorisations.
  • Perform structured diagnostics on abnormal conditions, apply permitted stabilisation actions and escalate with clear technical detail and recommended next steps.
  • Support operational event response, including immediate containment actions, technical communication and accurate event documentation.
  • Conduct enhanced rounds including thermal, capacity, vibration/noise, leak detection and set-point verification, ensuring findings are recorded and actioned.
  • Identify trends, weak signals and reliability concerns using BMS/EPMS data and provide recommendations to prevent recurrence.
  • Manage on-shift work execution with strict adherence to permit-to-work controls, isolations/LOTO, vendor access and operational handbacks.
  • Coordinate vendor activities during shift, ensuring safe execution, clear understanding of plant impacts and thorough return-to-service verification.
  • Validate operational readiness following maintenance, resets or configuration changes, confirming alarms, redundancy, load paths and expected operating conditions.
  • Review and improve the quality of shift logs, event notes, CMMS entries and handovers to ensure accuracy, clarity and traceability.
  • Raise and escalate recurring defects, reliability risks and improvement opportunities through appropriate channels.
  • Contribute to procedure reviews, readiness activities, drills and documentation improvements with practical, shift-based insights.
  • This role does not perform licensed electrical, mechanical or refrigeration work. All trade-restricted activities are completed by appropriately qualified and licensed personnel. The Senior Technician focuses on operational system management, first-response stabilisation, verification and coordination.

People

  • Set a high standard for safety behaviour, operational discipline and professional conduct across the shift.
  • Support technicians through on-the-job coaching, demonstrations and constructive feedback to improve capability and consistency.
  • Assist with onboarding and familiarisation of new team members, reinforcing authorised boundaries and operational expectations.
  • Strengthen team communication by ensuring clear handovers, accurate escalation details and calm coordination during events.
  • Participate actively in briefings, toolbox talks, training and operational discussions, offering practical observations and improvement ideas.
  • Build collaborative relationships with Security, Projects and vendor personnel to support safe, coordinated site operations.
  • Demonstrate a concierge-level customer service approach in all interactions with customers, visitors and stakeholders.

Competencies

  • Strong operational discipline and sound judgement in a critical facility environment.
  • High technical capability in electrical and/or mechanical systems within authorised boundaries.
  • Effective structured troubleshooting and stabilisation capability under pressure.
  • Ability to interpret alarms, telemetry, trends and technical documentation.
  • Proficiency with BMS/EPMS, CMMS and operational workflow tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication for shift documentation, incidents and customer updates.
  • Contractor coordination skills with strong permit-to-work and LOTO awareness.
  • Ability to coach others and improve team execution quality.
  • Calm, methodical approach during alarms and operational events.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with focus on reliability and operational quality.

Preferred Education and Experience

  • Experience in critical environments such as data centres, hospitals, utilities, defence or industrial facilities.
  • Demonstrated capability operating and monitoring critical power and cooling systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, PDUs/PMMs, ATS/STS, CRAC/CRAH, chilled water systems, pumps, controls and fire systems.
  • Hands-on experience conducting operational inspections and first-response stabilisation actions.
  • Experience using BMS/EPMS and CMMS/workflow tools for monitoring, work management and operational documentation.
  • Ability to read and interpret single-line diagrams, technical drawings and OEM documentation.
  • Familiarity with permit-to-work, isolations/LOTO and basic operational risk assessment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication suitable for logs, handovers and customer-facing updates.

Work Environment / Conditions

  • Role operates on a 24/7 rotating shift roster including nights, weekends and public holidays.
  • Work occurs in data halls, plant rooms, electrical/mechanical spaces and external plant areas; PPE is required in accordance with site policy.
  • Participation in emergency response activities and incident exercises is required.

Travel Required

  • Minimal travel is expected; occasional travel between local STACK facilities may be required based on operational needs.

Additional Eligibility Requirements

  • Completion of STACK onboarding and required safety/compliance training.
  • Ability to meet site authorisation requirements for system operation and system access.
  • Physical capability to perform inspections, rounds and emergency response tasks.
  • Ongoing compliance with STACK policies, procedures and behavioural standards.

Work Authorisation/Security Clearance Requirements

  • Legal entitlement to work in Australia.
  • Ability to satisfy pre-employment screening requirements, as applicable, including right-to-work checks, background checks and reference checks.
  • Ability to meet data centre security requirements, including badging, access control and adherence to customer-mandated security protocols.
  • Security clearance is not required unless specified for a customer-specific facility.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, redundancy, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Other Duties

Please note that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required of the employee for this role. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Projects - ATGL - PNG
job.description:
Responsibilities

PNG Projects Engineer - O3

Project Execution and Support:

  • Assist in the execution of PNG, including site preparation, equipment installation, and commissioning, ensuring all tasks are completed according to project plans and timelines.
  • Collaborate with the Projects Lead to ensure that all engineering activities meet design specifications, safety standards, and quality requirements.
  • Conduct on-site inspections and assessments to monitor progress, identify potential issues, and ensure that all work complies with technical specifications.
  • Prepare and update detailed engineering drawings, technical documents, and project plans, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards.
  • Coordinate with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to ensure the timely delivery of materials and services required for project completion.

Technical Support and Problem Solving:

  • Provide technical support to the project team, troubleshooting and resolving engineering issues that arise during the project lifecycle.
  • Analyze and interpret technical data, drawings, and specifications to support decision-making and ensure the successful completion of project tasks.
  • Implement engineering solutions to address on-site challenges, ensuring minimal disruption to project timelines and budget.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of engineering best practices, focusing on improving efficiency, safety, and quality in project execution.
  • Participate in technical meetings and reviews, providing input and recommendations to optimize project outcomes.

Quality Control and Assurance:

  • Monitor and enforce quality control measures throughout all phases of the project, ensuring that all work meets the required standards and specifications.
  • Conduct regular inspections and tests on materials, equipment, and systems to verify their compliance with project requirements and industry regulations.
  • Document and report any quality issues or non-conformities, working with the project team to implement corrective actions and prevent recurrence.
  • Assist in the development of quality assurance plans and procedures, ensuring that they are effectively implemented and adhered to during project execution.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure that all engineering activities comply with local, regional, and national safety regulations and industry standards, minimizing the risk of accidents or incidents.
  • Participate in safety audits and inspections, identifying potential hazards and implementing measures to mitigate risks.
  • Provide input on safety protocols and procedures, ensuring that they are followed by all team members and contractors during project execution.
  • Assist in the preparation of safety documentation, including risk assessments, method statements, and safety plans, ensuring they are complete and accurate.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date project documentation, including engineering drawings, technical specifications, progress reports, and inspection records.
  • Prepare regular project status reports for the Projects Lead, highlighting key achievements, challenges, and any areas requiring attention.
  • Assist in the preparation of as-built documentation upon project completion, ensuring that all records reflect the final state of the project.
  • Ensure that all documentation is properly filed and accessible, supporting future project reviews and audits.

Collaboration and Communication:

  • Work closely with other engineers, project managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth communication and coordination throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Participate in project meetings, providing updates on engineering activities and contributing to discussions on project planning and execution.
  • Liaise with contractors, suppliers, and vendors to resolve any technical issues and ensure alignment on project objectives and timelines.
  • Provide clear and concise technical information to non-engineering team members, ensuring they understand the requirements and constraints of the project.

Continuous Improvement and Learning:

  • Stay informed about the latest developments in engineering practices, technologies, and industry standards relevant to PNG or CNG projects.
  • Identify opportunities for improving engineering processes and practices, proposing and implementing changes that enhance project performance.
  • Participate in training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge, ensuring continued growth and contribution to the project team.
  • Share knowledge and insights with the project team, contributing to a culture of continuous learning and improvement.

KEY STAKEHOLDERS

Internal Stakeholders:

  • Regional office
  • Corporate office
  • TechnoCommercial Team
  • HSE Team
  • Operations & Maintenance

External Stakeholders:

  • Vendors
  • Contractors
  • Local authorities
  • Regulatory bodies
  • Consultants

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience:

3+ years of experience, preferably in construction project management.

Proven experience in managing large-scale infrastructure projects from inception to completion.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the gas distribution, oil and energy, or utilities sectors.

job.title: Associate Manager - Finance & Account
job.description:
Responsibilities

Adani Group: Adani Group is a diversified organization in India comprising 10 publicly traded companies. It has created a world class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. Over the years, Adani Group has positioned itself to be the market leader in its logistics and energy businesses focusing on large scale infrastructure development in India with O & M practices benchmarked to global standards. With four IG rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.

Adani Airports Holding Limited: Adani Airports Holding Limited is reshaping the aviation landscape, transforming airports into dynamic hubs of connectivity, innovation, and service excellence. By prioritizing passenger experience, leveraging state-of-the-art technology, and enhancing operational efficiency, we are redefining airport infrastructure across India. Our vision is to create world-class airports that serve as gateways to regional development and global connectivity, positioning Adani Airports as a leader in the aviation sector with a focus on sustainable growth and community impact.

1. Capex Financial Management

  • Lead Project and Capex budgeting, financial planning, and controlling for all capex projects.
  • Prepare and review detailed financial projections, Financial KPI IRR/NPV analysis, and sensitivity assessments for capital projects.
  • Develop, monitor, and control project cash flows, ensuring alignment with approved budgets and funding plans.
  • Oversee billing, payouts, milestone-based disbursements, and ensure adherence to financial controls and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure timely and accurate MIS reporting on capex performance, cash flows, and budget variances.

2. Procurement & Financial Prudence

  • Establish and enforce financial discipline, governance frameworks, and prudence for all large‑scale capex procurement decisions.
  • Actively participate in procurement decisions for projects above ₹10 crore, jointly with the Technical and Commercial (TC) teams.
  • Review business cases, cost estimates, and commercial terms to ensure value for money and risk mitigation.
  • Provide financial oversight and advisory support for smaller capex projects in consultation with the respective BU.

3. Project Oversight & Performance Audit

  • Support Business Units in financial close‑out of capex projects, ensuring timely completion of all financial actions and reports.
  • Conduct post‑implementation and performance audits of capex projects to assess efficiency, cost control, and value realization.
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities and lead or support commercial and financial negotiations with vendors and contractors.
  • Ensure lessons learned from completed projects are institutionalized into future capex governance frameworks.

4. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

  • Work closely with CFOs, CPOs, Group Finance, and Procurement teams to align capex strategies across business units.
  • Partner with Business Unit Heads and Project Teams to ensure capex objectives are achieved in line with approved financial KPIs.
  • Act as a key finance interface for senior management, providing clear, data‑driven insights on capex performance and risks.

5. Reporting, Governance & Accountability

  • Ensure accurate, transparent, and timely reporting of capex financial performance to the CFO, CEO and CHMO.
  • Maintain high standards of governance, audit readiness, and accountability across all capex‑related financial decisions.
  • Monitor performance against approved financial KPIs and initiate corrective actions where deviations are identified.
  • Strengthening internal controls and compliance mechanisms for capex planning, execution, and closure.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related discipline.
  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in financial management, with strong exposure to:

Large scale capex project finance

  • Procurement finance and commercial negotiations
  • Financial controls, audits, and governance

Proven experience in managing financial oversight for capex intensive industries (infrastructure, manufacturing, energy, logistics, etc.). Strong expertise in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and cash flow management, Presentation. Enabler of automation with group, Power BI, MIS

job.title: Manager - ETP
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities of Role

Manager - ETP – Copper

Production Planning and Execution:

  • Oversee and coordinate daily ETP activities, ensuring efficient and smooth operations during the shift.
  • Plan and oversee ETP operations during the shift to ensure optimal treatment of effluent water.
  • Prevent overflow and manage the discharge process in compliance with operational targets.
  • Ensure efficient handling of reject water, effluent overflow, and treated water within the shift time frame.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor and optimize ETP processes to ensure efficiency and minimum environmental impact.
  • Identify and implement process improvements during the shift to enhance throughput and reduce waste.
  • Lead continuous improvement efforts to improve reject handling and spillage prevention.

Quality Assurance and Control:

  • Ensure that all treated water and by-products meet the required quality standards.
  • Supervise reject water handling and hazardous cake management, ensuring zero spillage during operations.
  • Conduct inspections and enforce quality control protocols for all treated outputs.

Equipment Monitoring and Troubleshooting:

  • Monitor the operational performance of ETP equipment and address any malfunctions.
  • Conduct preventive maintenance checks and troubleshoot equipment issues to minimize downtime.
  • Collaborate with maintenance teams to ensure timely repairs and equipment readiness.
  • Supervise reject water handling and ensure the proper disposal of waste products.
  • Prevent overflow of reject water and take immediate corrective actions in case of any deviations.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure that all operations within the shift comply with health, safety, and environmental (HSE) regulations.
  • Lead safety audits and inspections, addressing any potential hazards within the shift.
  • Ensure reject handling complies with environmental and regulatory standards.
  • Liaise with government bodies during inspections to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Monitor chemical consumption, energy usage, and other cost-related factors during the shift.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce operational costs while maintaining process efficiency.
  • Work within the allocated budget for shift operations and suggest cost-saving measures.

Resource and Workforce Management:

  • Lead and supervise a team of operators and technicians to ensure efficient shift operations.
  • Allocate resources effectively to meet operational demands during the shift.
  • Conduct regular training sessions for shift employees on ETP processes, safety, and regulatory compliance.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Prepare and submit daily shift reports on ETP performance, compliance, and maintenance activities.
  • Analyze data from shift operations to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for improvement.
  • Ensure accurate record-keeping of plant operations and maintenance tasks.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Use digital tools and monitoring systems to track ETP processes in real-time.
  • Leverage technology for process optimization, equipment monitoring, and report generation.

  • Plant Operations Manager
  • Maintenance Department
  • Quality Assurance Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Government Regulatory Bodies
  • Equipment Vendors
  • Service Providers

Education Qualification:

BE in Chemical Engineering or M.Sc Chemistry

Work Experience (Range of years):

6-15 years of experience in the Effluent Treatment Plant industry

job.title: Security Operations Lead
job.description:
Asset Protection and Loss Reduction:

Ensure the implementation of effective security measures to protect assets and minimize losses across plant operations.

Foster a culture of safety and security by conducting regular audits and assessments to identify vulnerabilities and address them promptly.

Collaborate with the Head Office team to build security capabilities and enhance operational efficiency.

Safeguard company assets through strict monitoring of unsafe acts and conditions, implementing proactive measures to avert and reduce incidents.

Strengthening Security Setup:

Oversee the establishment and maintenance of robust security protocols and systems at the plant.

Implement and monitor adherence to approved budgets for manpower deployment, ensuring resource optimization.

Ensure no additional security manpower deployment at existing O&M sites after completion of physical security measures.

Develop security parameters and implement them at the site in consultation with Cluster Security Head.

Crisis Management and Safety Initiatives:

Develop and maintain a comprehensive crisis management plan, ensuring readiness for potential security incidents.

Ensure 100% Security compliance at the main gate of all sites, conducting regular training sessions and mock drills to prepare personnel for emergency situations.

Ensure no accidents or incidents occur at the site while adhering to Security requirements.

Financial Performance Management:

Strive for a 5% reduction in security operational expenditure through effective resource management and proactive risk mitigation strategies.

Monitor vendor performance, ensuring timely submission of invoices and payments while adhering to approved budgets.

Ensure retention of key talent among operational management personnel (OMPs) while providing additional responsibilities.

Training and Capability Building:

Ensure all OMPs receive an average of three days of training annually to enhance their security awareness and response capabilities.(Training Calender of OMPs share to VSH Office)

Conduct security awareness sessions & Briefings to improve the effectiveness of newly joined OMPs and monitor their efficiency.

Implement a minimum of one technology initiative at the sites (Budgetory support from Business) to enhance security measures.

Performance Monitoring and Reporting:

Maintain oversight of security operations, ensuring 100% compliance with established Security and operational protocols.

Prepare and present performance reports to senior management, highlighting achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement.

Regularly liaise with police and civil authorities for smooth functioning of Site and ensure compliance with audit points.

I&V Development:

Drive a performance driven culture by implementing effective I&V mechanism for reduction of theft cases.

Strategic Planning and Implementation:

Create a long-term strategy for security, focusing on technology initiatives, analytics, and business processes.

Ensure continuous optimization drives at sites to balance operational efficiency and loss reduction, targeting a 5% optimization of OPEX in FY.

Coordinate with project teams to ensure timely completion of automation projects and the development of basic security infrastructure at sites.

Chief Security Officer (CSO)

Plant Manager

Operations Team

Human Resources Team

IT Security Team

Key Stakeholders - External:

Local Law Enforcement Agencies

Security Service Providers

Regulatory Authorities

Emergency Services (Fire Department, Medical Services)

Community Leaders and Local Government Officials

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or a related field.

Master’s degree or postgraduate qualification in relevant fields is preferred.

Certifications such as Certified Protection Professional (CPP), Physical Security Professional (PSP), or Certified Fraud Examiners (CFE) are advantageous.

Strong academic foundation in security strategy, risk management, and crisis management.

12-16 years of experience in security management, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role within industrial or manufacturing organizations.

Proven track record in developing and implementing security protocols, conducting risk assessments, and managing security operations.

Experience in managing budgets, cost optimization, and vendor management in security operations.

job.title: Site Operations Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We optimize for success.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

Reporting to the Data Centre Operations Director, this role will perform the fundamental function to keep operational readiness of Digital Edge Data Centre environment during 24/7 daily operation shift. This role will be based in Digha, Navi Mumbai site office.

Key responsibilities

  • Maintain 100% uptime of the datacenter.
  • Ensure service delivery as per agreed SLA with Customer.
  • Governance on vendor management.
  • Responsible for 100% Safety compliance.
  • Responsible for DC physical security.
  • Preparation and Implementation of SOP, EOP, MOP for all types of work.
  • Supervise and Support installation for Racks and stacks customer equipment
  • Build, assess and continually improve internal and externally facing controlled documentation
  • Finishes the assigned task and training in a timely manner.
  • Responsible for monitoring customer applications and Digital Edge’s operational architecture
  • Respond to alarms in accordance with Digital Edge procedures. Incident reporting and route cause analysis.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinating with DC Director to ensure the All-Statutory forms were followed for the disposal of hazardous waste at the site level.(ex: DG used oil, batteries & E-Waste}.
  • Day to day maintenance activities related to electrical/ Mechanical equipment. Ensure 100% PPM compliance. Attend all breakdown calls.
  • Operation and maintenance of transformer, DG sets and electrical panels, UPS Systems, Server room, WTP, STP & Firefighting, HVAC systems like water cooled AC & Air cooled air conditions.
  • Monitoring and operating the Equipment’s through BMS / SCADA.
  • Ability to interact with customer and own staff.
  • Coordinating with customers internal/ External Audit with respect to ISO and Technical.
  • Spare management tracking with customers, weekly updates and follow—up with vendors for timely delivery of required critical spares.
  • MOP, PTW & Risk Assessment preparing with Shift manager for Offline Pm Activity & Critical Activities and planning and implementation of Site Energy Savings.
  • Responsible to maintain datacenter neat and clean.
  • Strong in customer engagement having good understanding of customer expectations and meeting the requirement with decided path. Maintain transparency in communication with customer.
  • Customer interaction and handling of incident, RCAs, SLA compliance and Space & Power Management.
  • Work closely with PMO Team for effective new projects handover and takeover.

The successful candidate:

**

  • Diploma / Degree in Electrical, engineering
  • 15+ years’ experience in DC site operations
  • Experience in customer service, operation centers or data centers
  • Experience of copper / fiber cabling techniques (Installation, Termination & Testing)
  • Basic knowledge of network.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Technical Specialist, Fixed Voice
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company

Singtel Group

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

As the Technical Specialist, Fixed Voice, you’ll be accountable for the operation, maintenance, technical support and continual improvement of Optus’ Fixed Voice network infrastructure. You’ll work across Ribbon voice switching and SBC platforms to maintain network availability, performance, resilience and operational compliance, while helping modernise our Network Operations tooling through improved observability, trusted data, OSS integration and automation.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Operate and maintain Ribbon Fixed Voice nodes, including DMS300, CS2000 (CS2K), C20, SBC, PSX, IN and associated sub-elements.
  • Provide Level 2 fault management, incident resolution and technical support for Fixed Voice platform outages, service degradations and complex operational issues in line with ITIL best practices.
  • Manage escalated and complex customer-related faults across Enterprise and Wholesale environments.
  • Perform structured fault diagnosis and root-cause analysis, identifying corrective actions and validating the effectiveness of permanent remediation.
  • Configure and manage C20 elements, including GWC, SP2K, G9, MAS, SST, SSL/SESM/A2, CBM, CMT, IEMS, MG15K and NDM.
  • Manage SIP trunking, routing and policy rules through Ribbon NMS, including SIP/TDM interworking and service validation.
  • Investigate voice network faults using SIP, INAP, Diameter, RTP and C7/ISUP protocols, together with OSIX and Wireshark.
  • Execute software upgrades, patch management and planned maintenance on Ribbon platforms, including implementation, testing, rollback and post-change verification.
  • Monitor Fixed Voice network KPIs using Grafana and Kalix, proactively addressing degradation trends affecting call completion, ASR, NER and MOS.
  • Develop, review and maintain Methods of Procedure, implementation plans, risk assessments, technical change records, network documentation and knowledge articles.
  • Collaborate with Network Operations, Engineering, Service Management, NOC, Network Enablement & AI Ops, vendors and suppliers to restore services, improve reliability and support the transformation and rationalisation of Network Operations tooling.

**

What You Bring

  • 15+ years of wireline or Fixed Voice telecommunications experience, with hands-on operational experience across Ribbon or GENBAND platforms.
  • Deep technical expertise in CS2000 (CS2K), C20 and SBC platforms, including call control, provisioning, trunk management, signalling configuration and fault resolution.
  • Strong operational knowledge of Ribbon Fixed Voice architectures and SBC platforms, including SIP trunking, media policy and SIP/TDM interworking.
  • Advanced knowledge of SIP, SS7/ISUP, SIGTRAN, TDM E1/PRI, RTP/RTCP, G.711/G.729, DTMF, LNP/ENUM and IPv4/IPv6.
  • Practical experience with Grafana, Kalix/OSIX, Wireshark, Ribbon EMS/RAMP, ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platforms, and Unix/Linux command-line tools.
  • Ability to interpret Fixed Voice KPIs, including call completion rate, ASR, NER and MOS, and act on emerging degradation trends.
  • Proven experience in incident management, root-cause analysis, planned maintenance, software upgrades, patching, MOP development, change governance and vendor TAC engagement.
  • A Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Electronics, Computer Science or equivalent experience. Ribbon certifications, CCNA/CCNP Voice and ITIL v4 Foundation are preferred.
  • Knowledge of observability, operational analytics, automation and safe AI-assisted operations is desirable.
  • Strong technical ownership, accountability and a disciplined approach to operational risk, with the ability to communicate complex issues clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders in high-pressure incident, outage and escalation environments.

**

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • Free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences.

We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.

We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive.

If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Senior Procurement Analyst
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Senior Procurement Analyst is accountable for the procurement, implementation, management, and day-to-day execution of the Construction Services and/or Owner Furnished Contractor Installed (OFCI) equipment program supporting regional data center construction. Construction Services can include General Contractors, Architect/ Engineers, Commissioning, Controls, and related 3rd Party support services. The OFCI Program can include critical mechanical, electrical and power systems, ensuring quality, on-time, and on-budget delivery to construction projects worldwide. The Supply Chain Manager represents the Supply Chain organization and actively engages with the project team on all project strategy and project delivery activities to ensure supply chain strategies are aligned and meet all project build schedules, cost, design and capacity targets. This role requires an understanding of both construction project delivery and capital supply chain management in mission-critical environment.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Lead supplier relationship management and own the supply chain lifecycle for the respective Category, including sourcing, qualifying, RFx, evaluation, commercial negotiations, contract negotiations, award, change management support, management escalation, supplier business reviews, closeout, and claims mitigation/ management.
  • Plan, implement, and manage all project specific supply chain construction services and/ or OFCI equipment logistic activities and procedures including, but not limited to, multi-year project forecasts, sourcing, production planning, negotiations, procurement, logistics, quality, distribution, and heavy communication/ alignment with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ensure all construction services and/or OFCI equipment orders are made on time to meet schedule, actively mitigate late performance and deliveries and ensure high rate of on time execution.
  • Partner with project controls and finance to share procurement status, budget utilization, construction/ installation progress, ensuring transparency and cost accountability.
  • Manage impact of project specific design changes with suppliers and ensure fair and reasonable construction services and/or equipment pricing as a core business function
  • Anticipate issues in advance to prevent potential impacts, internally and externally to drive business decisions. This includes an in-depth understanding of the market environment and current events.
  • Monitor and populate key performance indicators (KPI’s) in support of the respective Category being managed. Measure performance against these KPIs and collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate supplier performance and drive continuous improvement.
  • Employ an analytics-based approach to support executive briefings and decision making along with capturing complex project data into program dashboard outputs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify demand, qualify, and execute selection of suppliers to deliver equipment and services to construction portfolio; support development of supplier allocation methodologies and regular business reviews with vendors to provide feedback and continuously improve supplier performance.
  • Be the first level escalation for all project construction and/or OFCI concerns including vendor or overall supply chain issues (change orders, late deliveries, disputes, invoice accuracy, etc.); investigate, respond, and bring closure to suppliers, buyer’s agent, or other internal stakeholders.
  • Team with Critical Facilities Engineering and Operations groups to communicate extending lead times and obsolescence of components within supply chain activities. Be in the loop and ahead of upcoming or pending design changes which will impact OFCI equipment.
  • Support internal team(s) to renegotiate, extend options, renew, and discontinue supplier framework agreements as required and issue equipment orders under those framework agreements.
  • Ensure suppliers’ readiness and capability for all commissioning schedule and quality requirements.
  • Ensure supplier clarity, alignment, and ability to deliver on all project deliverables

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Experience working in fast-paced, high-value capital projects.
  • Familiarity with international contracting standards and cross-border procurement.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

ACADEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Master’s degree in relevant field of required qualification.
  • LEAN/Six Sigma Certification
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • CPSM (Certified Professional in Supply Management)
  • Knowledge of FIDIC contracts

Required Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, engineering, business administration, or relevant field.
  • Minimum of ten years of procurement and supply chain management required, preferably in a product/ category/ construction, and program management level.
  • Demonstrated success managing multimillion-dollar projects.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

The Skilled Technician - Level III performs advanced manufacturing and maintenance activities that support production and operational excellence. The role is responsible for operating, troubleshooting, maintaining, and improving manufacturing equipment while ensuring compliance with safety, quality, delivery, and productivity standards. Working with a high degree of proficiency, the technician supports continuous improvement initiatives, coaches team members, and collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Promote a safe working environment by complying with all Health, Safety and Environmental (HSE) policies, procedures, and regulations.
  • Stop work immediately and report unsafe conditions, hazards, incidents, injuries, or environmental risks.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) and follow safe work practices when working with electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and other industrial systems.
  • Identify and eliminate hazards within area of responsibility and actively participate in HSE training and safety improvement initiatives.

Quality

  • Perform manufacturing, maintenance, and inspection activities with high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Execute work in accordance with engineering drawings, operation manuals, technical specifications, and process documentation.
  • Perform quality inspections and identify opportunities to reduce quality risks and manufacturing defects.
  • Support equipment uptime through preventive, predictive, corrective, and emergency maintenance activities.
  • Provide feedback to preventive maintenance systems and contribute to equipment reliability improvements.

Production & Operations

  • Perform skilled manufacturing and maintenance activities using appropriate tools, machinery, measuring instruments, and specialty equipment.
  • Support daily production targets while maintaining safety, quality, cost, delivery, and productivity objectives.
  • Monitor equipment performance, troubleshoot issues, and participate in downtime and failure analysis.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning.
  • Identify manufacturing constraints, solve operational problems, and support process improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) and continuous improvement activities to enhance manufacturing performance.

Team Leadership & Collaboration

  • Provide guidance, coaching, and technical support to team members with less experience.
  • Coordinate effectively with production teams, maintenance, quality, engineering, and other support functions.
  • Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders to achieve operational goals.
  • Support workforce engagement and effectively collaborate within a unionized manufacturing environment where applicable.
  • Contribute to employee development through knowledge sharing and on-the-job coaching.

Administrative & Systems

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, production, and quality documentation.
  • Utilize manufacturing and enterprise systems such as Oracle, QSOL, Ariba, or equivalent platforms to support operational activities.

job.description:
Job Summary

The Engine Field Service Technician – Level III is the primary technical specialist and customer support contact responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, repairing, and maintaining Cummins engine products at customer sites. This role independently performs complex repairs, preventive maintenance, and advanced diagnostics while ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction, safety, quality, and operational excellence. The technician serves as a technical mentor, supports critical customer accounts, drives issue resolution through cross-functional collaboration, and contributes to continuous improvement by sharing technical expertise and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Service & Field Support

  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and execute complex mechanical and electrical repairs on Cummins engine products and related systems using specialized diagnostic tools and established service procedures.
  • Perform scheduled preventive maintenance and inspections in accordance with Cummins service standards.
  • Interpret customer concerns, develop troubleshooting plans, validate repairs, and ensure successful restoration of equipment performance.
  • Escalate complex technical issues to product specialists or engineering support while maintaining complete troubleshooting documentation.

Customer Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships by providing professional, responsive, and technically sound service.
  • Act as the primary technical contact for assigned customer accounts, providing regular service updates and ensuring timely resolution of maintenance and breakdown activities.
  • Identify additional service, maintenance, and aftermarket opportunities that enhance customer value and equipment reliability.
  • Support customer satisfaction by proactively communicating repair progress, parts availability, and service status.

Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing

  • Coach, mentor, and provide technical guidance to technicians and apprentices to develop technical capability and service excellence.
  • Review repair plans, parts requirements, and technical approaches to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Share technical knowledge, field learnings, and best practices to support continuous improvement across the service organization.
  • Facilitate regular technical discussions and cross-functional reviews to improve visibility of open service issues and drive timely resolution.

Service Coordination & Documentation

  • Complete service documentation, including service worksheets, inspection reports, warranty claims, quality records, and timesheets using Cummins business systems.
  • Prepare technical summaries, service reports, and presentations for critical issue reviews and customer updates.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to track open service cases, parts availability, and project status to ensure effective service delivery.
  • Maintain accurate service history and documentation to support warranty administration, compliance, and future maintenance planning.

Health, Safety & Compliance

  • Demonstrate leadership in Health, Safety, and Environmental (HSE) practices by conducting job safety assessments (JSA) before commencing work and promoting a strong safety culture.
  • Ensure compliance with Cummins safety standards, environmental policies, regulatory requirements, and customer site procedures.
  • Report hazards, incidents, and unsafe conditions promptly while implementing appropriate corrective actions.
  • Maintain service vehicles, tools, diagnostic equipment, and work areas in a clean, safe, and operational condition.

Continuous Improvement & Operational Excellence

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing recurring technical issues and recommending corrective actions.
  • Participate in technical training to maintain expertise in Cummins products, emerging technologies, and service practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve service quality, response times, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to project reviews and critical issue resolution activities by providing technical expertise and performance insights.

Competencies:

  • Customer Focus
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Develops Talent
  • Manages Complexity
  • Manages Conflict
  • Self-Development
  • Values Differences
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Diagnostics Application
  • Electronic Service Tool Application
  • Engine Systems Interactions
  • Product Repair and Maintenance
  • Service Documentation
  • Technical Escalation
  • Problem Solving
  • Technical Leadership
  • Collaboration
  • Continuous Improvement

Qualifications

  • Vocational Diploma, ITI, or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Diesel Mechanics, or a related technical discipline.
  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician certification preferred.
  • Valid local driving license required.
  • Additional certifications in diesel engine diagnostics, power generation, or heavy equipment service are advantageous.
  • May require licensing or eligibility to comply with export controls or sanctions regulations where applicable.

Skills

  • Advanced engine diagnostics and troubleshooting
  • Mechanical and electrical repair of diesel engines and power systems
  • Preventive maintenance and field service operations
  • Electronic diagnostic and service tool proficiency
  • Engine systems analysis and fault isolation
  • Technical documentation and warranty administration
  • Customer relationship management
  • Technical coaching and mentoring
  • Project and service coordination
  • Presentation and technical reporting skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management
  • Problem-solving and analytical thinking
  • Planning and prioritization
  • Health, safety, and environmental compliance
  • Microsoft Office and service management system proficiency

Experience

  • Significant experience in field service, engine repair, or heavy equipment maintenance.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Cummins or equivalent diesel engine products and systems.
  • Proven experience diagnosing and resolving complex engine failures and technical issues in customer environments.
  • Strong customer-facing experience managing service activities and maintaining long-term customer relationships.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing critical service issues, and supporting project execution.
  • Experience coaching, mentoring, and providing technical guidance to junior technicians is preferred.
  • Doing JSA by Anvl App before start work and educate team to stay focused on Safety practices
  • Visiting other key customers in and around Chennai for relationship building.
  • Regular connect and updates of status to L&T Project on parts, maintenances and breakdowns.
  • Organizing weekly telecon with internal team to bring visibility on open complaints and parts status on projects
  • Preparing the PPT / Critical issue resolution in Equinix & L&T Project

job.title: Mechanical Maintenance - Level III
job.description:
Job Summary

Troubleshoots, assembles, installs, tests and maintains mechanical systems using all necessary tools to keep equipment available and capable. Learns and understands the protocols of working safely with electricity and other energy sources with industrial equipment. May work independently and instruct or coach others.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards.
  • Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard.
  • Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures and regulations.
  • Use appropriate personal protective equipment.
  • Promote interdependence by looking out for one another.
  • Correct hazards within your control and capabilities.
  • Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact.
  • Engage in HSE Training.

Quality

  • Applies high standards of workmanship and craftsmanship.
  • Support equipment uptime and downtime failure analysis.
  • Performs work in accordance with diagrams, sketches, operation manuals and specifications using various tools, measuring and testing instruments.
  • Provide feedback into the Preventive Maintenance system.
  • Follows all process documentation and quality procedures.
  • Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures.
  • Performs quality inspections.

Delivery

  • Fully proficient performing troubleshooting, mechanical repairs and maintenance of equipment .
  • Instructs and coaches others and acts as an informal resource for team members with less experience.
  • Perform and documents preventive, emergency, corrective and predictive maintenance activities.
  • Maintains clean and orderly work area, including routine housekeeping and machine cleaning tasks.
  • Performs other miscellaneous duties as required to meet production goals.

Identify and reduce manufacturing constraints Schedule maintenance activities around production requirements Solve problems and improve processes Participate in continuous improvement activities Teamwork

  • Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams.
  • Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements.
  • Participates actively with local Total Productive Maintenance (TPM) teams in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Nimble learning - Actively learning through experimentation when tackling new problems, using both successes and failures as learning fodder.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Controls Safety - Recognizes controls related hazards in a manufacturing environment (Electrical, Hydraulic, Pneumatic) to incorporate safe practices and procedures as part of the daily work plan to reduce injuries and create a safe machine environment.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training or on-the-job experience.

Education & Experience:

Diploma in Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering with 8 to 10 years of experience in ATPU ()

Job Description

  • Technical knowledge of ATPU Equipment – e.g. Nut Runners, Test Cells, Wash Booth, Paint Booth, TOD, Turn Table, PRCs.
  • Thorough knowledge of mechanical maintenance of all equipment in both ATPU – NK & KV.
  • First priority should be for “Zero Engine Loss” .
  • Sound technical knowledge of all Nut Runners, their mechanisms, TODs, Wash Booth, Paint Booth, etc.
  • Should have good technical knowledge of all Test Cells, Dyno maintenance, Butterfly Valve maintenance, etc.
  • Sound technical knowledge of all types of Smoke Meters, Heat Exchangers and Coolant Conditioning Units.
  • Should have sound technical knowledge of all types of Tuggers used for engine movement.
  • Should be fully conversant with CMES projects.
  • Sound technical knowledge of all types of Paint Pumps – pneumatic as well as electrically operated.
  • Should be conversant with all types of Goods Lifts used in both ATPU.
  • Should be fully conversant with Kardex machines, Dock Levelers and Goods Lifts.
  • Sound technical knowledge of Fast Acting Doors, Ovens, Dryers, etc.
  • Maintaining all Plant Engineering KPIs – MTTR, MTBF, PM Compliance, Craft Utilization, etc.
  • On-time reporting of all types of Near Hits and Spill Incidents in the ATPU Maintenance area.
  • Carrying out all improvement projects related to HSE, Quality, Maintenance, etc.
  • Good Communication and Presentation skills.
  • Should have good people connect – internal stakeholders as well as external suppliers/customers.
  • Conduct regular meetings once a month with ATPU Leader & PE Leader.
  • Good connect with ATPU Process Team as well as Quality Team.
  • Manage installation and commissioning of machines/equipment at ATPU.
  • Interfacing of automated material handling systems with the machines at ATPU.
  • Consistently maintain and improve Housekeeping standards.
  • Implementation of safety systems – Job Safety Analysis, Risk Assessments, Work Permits and LOTO related to maintenance activities in Machine Shop.
  • Maintain discipline of the workforce.
  • Spare parts planning and inventory management based on VED or other analysis tools.
  • Giving timely feedback on progress/issues to BU / Maintenance Leader.
  • Knowledge of Assembly Lines and Manufacturing Fundamentals.
  • Good Communication skills and Knowledge of Computers.
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in Hydraulics and Pneumatics is a must.
  • Should have thorough knowledge of AVL Smoke Meter operation, maintenance, calibration and troubleshooting , including sampling systems, AUTO mode, flow, leakage, grey value and communication-related issues.
  • Should have good technical knowledge of Dyno F47 and F35 systems , including dyno operation, loading/unloading, speed and torque control, calibration, interlocks and troubleshooting.
  • Sound technical knowledge of ASU Blower systems , including blower operation, VFD control, pressure/flow monitoring, dampers, interlocks and troubleshooting.
  • Should have sound technical knowledge of Test Cell instrumentation and control systems , including PLC, HMI/SCADA, sensors, transducers, RTDs, thermocouples, Analog/Digital I/O and DAQ systems.
  • Should have good knowledge of Test Cell utilities and associated equipment , including Heat Exchangers, Coolant Conditioning Units, pumps, valves, Butterfly Valves and associated control systems.
  • Ability to troubleshoot Test Cell interlocks, engine safety systems, emergency shutdown systems and equipment permissive to minimize engine downtime.
  • Should be capable of analyzing and troubleshooting Test Cell load variation, pressure/flow fluctuations, temperature variation, instrumentation and communication-related issues .
  • Ensure maximum Test Cell availability and minimum Engine Loss through effective PM, breakdown response, RCA and reliability improvement activities.
  • Should coordinate effectively with Test Cell Process, Quality, Engineering, PE teams and external OEMs/Suppliers for troubleshooting, calibration, maintenance and improvement activities.

job.title: IAM Operations Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for leading the organization’s cybersecurity operations team, with a primary focus on incident response, threat monitoring, and the execution of cybersecurity strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. The manager serves as a coach and mentor to security professionals, builds operational processes aligned with best practices and industry standards, and partners with engineering, IT, and business to protect critical systems, infrastructure, and data from evolving threats. Serves as an accountable leader for the people, processes, and technologies that prevent, detect, investigate, and contain cyber threats across enterprise, cloud, and OT environments. Owns SecOps outcomes (24×7 monitoring & incident response), the detection engineering program (use-case lifecycle, signal quality, automation), and the threat hunting program

Key Responsibilities

Leads the execution of complex responses to computer security incidents in alignment with organizational policies and industry best practices. Coordinates and communicates with multiple business units during incidents, providing updates and actionable recommendations. Oversees root cause analysis and ensures that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protections. Leads teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities. Monitors security-related intelligence sources (e.g., SANS, BugTraq) to maintain situational awareness of current attacks and trends. Collaborates with Cybersecurity Engineering teams and business to communicate risks and recommend security enhancements. Ensures that security technologies employed by the operations and incident response teams support and enhance operational processes. Identifies opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Leads the application of recognized cybersecurity and IT frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO, ITIL, COBIT) in alignment with organizational processes and controls. Manages, coaches, and mentors cybersecurity operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement. Defines team objectives, evaluates performance, and supports professional growth through training and development. Participates in industry task forces and working groups to stay informed on evolving threats and best practices, and fosters a culture of continuous improvement in cybersecurity practices and awareness. Contributes to organizational situational awareness by managing and leveraging cybersecurity data sources.

  • Competencies: Process Management and Optimization - Designs, refines, and automates IT operations processes to improve efficiency, consistency, service quality, security, and cost effectiveness across diverse environments.
  • Service Quality and Reliability - Ensures IT services consistently meet performance, availability, and user satisfaction expectations by proactively maintaining service integrity, minimizing disruptions, and driving continuous improvement through collaboration, cost-effective practices, and operational excellence.
  • Risk Management - Proactively identifies, assesses, and mitigates risks to IT services, data, and operations by applying structured controls and communication strategies to strengthen resilience, ensure compliance, and reduce business impact through structured controls, cost-aware decision-making, and communication strategies.
  • Incident and Problem Management - Responds to disruptions and recurring issues by restoring service quickly, identifying root causes, and applying structured methods to reduce risk, improve reliability, and prevent recurrence.
  • Standardization and Documentation - Creates and maintains clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IT environments.
  • Technical Passion and Drive - Models curiosity and excitement for technology by self-initiating continuous development, experimenting with emerging technologies, and identifying insertion opportunities that accelerate business performance.
  • Security and Compliance - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
  • Driving Effective Outcomes - Takes ownership, acts with urgency, and initiates action to turn goals into clear plans, decisions, guardrails, and cadences while navigating ambiguity and change to drive momentum and deliver consistent results.
  • Engaging with Impact - Communicates with clarity and purpose to align stakeholders, foster collaboration, build trust, and influence coordinated action across teams and functions to accelerate outcomes.
  • Values Differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Ensuring Customer Success - Embraces a customer-first mindset to deliver outcomes by linking customer needs and business priorities to aligned solutions, delivery, adoption, satisfaction, and realized value through sustained engagement that builds partnership and trust.
  • Managing People and Teams - Builds inclusive teams that empower ownership, deepen capabilities, and ensure fair, timely performance accountability, creating an environment where people can deliver their best work and top performance.
  • Directs Work - Creates conditions for team success with clear goals, priorities, work plans, standards, effective processes, resourcing, and governance to enable fast, empowered, accountable, and quality execution.

Education, Licenses, Certifications: College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related subject, or relevant equivalent experience required. Global Information Assurance Certification (GIAC) Security Essentials Certification, GIAC Security Leadership Certification, Information Systems Audit and Control Association (ISACA) Certified Information Security Manager, Microsoft Certified Systems Engineer: Security, or Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification preferred. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. Experience: Understanding of the capabilities and configuration of industrial cybersecurity controls and solutions across multiple facets; for example: asset management, vulnerability management, anomaly detection, identity and access management, network security, endpoint security, application security, IDS/IPS, deep packet inspection, SIEM, data analytics, security and/or risk management and product development.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, manage budgets, and build organizational capability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence policy and advocate for cybersecurity best practices.
  • Proven experience in cybersecurity management or equivalent leadership role.

Primary Function : The IAM Operations Manager is responsible for leading the organization’s IAM operations team across all IAM functions, with a primary focus on incident and problem response, general administration, monitoring, system availability, and compliance tasks. This role will also be responsible for execution of IAM strategies, policies, and risk management practices to safeguard the organization’s systems, data, and infrastructure. Key duties include managing team workflows, enforcing service-level agreements, and running security tools like Saviynt, MS Entra, CyberArk etc.

Core Responsibilities

  • Manage ongoing IAM operations and lead internal and multiple supplier teams in assessing severity, developing mitigation strategies, and prioritizing risk reduction activities
  • Oversee maintenance and specific problem resolution. Anticipate, identify, track and resolve technical issues. Oversee delivery assurance, quality, and architectural governance
  • Coordinate and communicate with multiple business units and various stakeholders at all levels during incidents. Provide updates and actionable recommendations
  • Oversee root cause analysis and ensure that lessons learned are integrated into improved processes and protection
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, standard operating procedures, and incident response playbooks. Create and maintain clear, accessible documentation and standardized procedures to ensure consistent practices, traceability, and knowledge sharing across IAM functions
  • Establish policies for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Access Management (AM).
  • Integrate IAM solutions with enterprise applications, cloud platforms, and hybrid IT infrastructures
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and business leaders to translate identity requirements into scalable, compliant solutions that are clearly understood
  • Work across functions to improve IAM solutions to enhance compliance requirements and best practices
  • Manage, coach, and mentor IAM operations staff, fostering a culture of learning, accountability, and continuous improvement
  • Define team objectives, evaluate performance, and support professional growth through training and development
  • Conduct industry and market research and maintain a working knowledge of technologies and emerging trends in the IAM space
