job.title: Tendering Manager – EHV Substations
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS & GIS Substation Projects)

As the Tendering Manager – HV/EHV AIS & GIS Substation Projects, you will lead the end-to-end tendering and bid management activities for High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substation projects, transmission and distribution infrastructure, EPC packages, and related power system solutions. You will be responsible for identifying business opportunities, developing winning bid strategies, managing techno-commercial proposals, and ensuring competitive positioning across utility and private sector markets.

In this leadership role, you will collaborate closely with engineering, procurement, project management, finance, legal, and supply chain teams to deliver high-quality and profitable bids. You will engage with customers, utilities, consultants, and EPC partners while leveraging market intelligence, risk assessment, and pricing strategies to maximize business success. We are looking for an experienced tendering professional with deep expertise in AIS/GIS substations, power infrastructure projects, and business acquisition who can combine technical knowledge, commercial acumen, and market insight to drive sustainable growth and successful project acquisitions.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Drive business growth by identifying and evaluating tender opportunities across HV/EHV AIS & GIS substations, transmission lines, switchyards, EPC projects, and power infrastructure developments.
  • Monitor utility tenders, government procurement portals, private sector RFQs, and emerging market opportunities to support strategic business expansion.
  • Lead bid/no-bid evaluations by assessing project viability, competitive landscape, risk profiles, customer requirements, and organizational capabilities.
  • Build and strengthen relationships with utilities, consultants, EPC partners, renewable developers, industrial customers, and key industry stakeholders.
  • Lead the complete tendering lifecycle from opportunity identification through bid submission and contract award.
  • Review tender documents, technical specifications, BOQs, drawings, contractual conditions, and commercial requirements to ensure comprehensive bid compliance.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including engineering, procurement, finance, legal, projects, and supply chain functions for successful bid preparation.
  • Develop and submit technical proposals, commercial offers, prequalification documents, and supporting credentials in line with customer requirements.
  • Conduct detailed techno-commercial assessments, evaluating project scope, engineering solutions, execution methodologies, delivery schedules, and resource requirements.
  • Identify project risks, commercial exposures, contractual deviations, and mitigation strategies to protect business interests.
  • Prepare management approval notes, bid strategy documents, and executive summaries to support informed decision-making.
  • Develop competitive project costing models, pricing strategies, and profitability assessments while maintaining strong win probability.
  • Perform market intelligence studies, competitor benchmarking, pricing analysis, and commodity trend assessments to strengthen bid competitiveness.
  • Coordinate with vendors, OEMs, and suppliers to obtain optimized quotations, technical inputs, and commercial support.
  • Prepare project cash-flow analyses, margin evaluations, and business case assessments to support commercial decision-making.
  • Analyze transmission, distribution, renewable integration, AIS/GIS technology, and utility investment trends to support strategic growth initiatives.
  • Maintain bid databases, pricing benchmarks, and competitive intelligence repositories to enhance future tendering effectiveness.
  • Conduct customer meetings, technical discussions, pre-bid clarifications, and tender negotiations to position Siemens Energy as a preferred partner.
  • Participate in site visits for scope validation, feasibility assessment, logistics evaluation, constructability reviews, and risk identification.
  • Review contractual terms and conditions, identify commercial and contractual risks, and recommend negotiation strategies and risk mitigation measures.
  • Support post-tender activities including customer clarifications, techno-commercial discussions, contract finalization, and project handover to execution teams.
  • Drive lessons learned and post-bid reviews to continuously improve bid quality, competitiveness, and business acquisition success rates.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering (B.E./B.Tech).
  • MBA in Marketing, Operations, Finance, or a related discipline is preferred.
  • 12-20 years of professional experience in tendering, estimation, proposal engineering, business acquisition, or bid management within the power sector.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of experience specifically focused on HV/EHV AIS and GIS substation projects.
  • Strong expertise in AIS substations up to 765 kV and GIS substations up to 400 kV/765 kV.
  • Deep understanding of transmission line projects, switchyards, EPC contracting, and power system infrastructure projects.
  • Strong knowledge of protection and control systems, power transformers, reactors, HV switchgear, GIS equipment, SCADA, SAS, and communication systems.
  • Proven experience managing tenders for utility customers including PGCIL, State Utilities, SEBs, DISCOMs, Railways, Metro projects, and other government entities.
  • Demonstrated experience in bidding for private sector customers including industrial facilities, renewable energy developers, data centers, oil & gas companies, and commercial infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of utility tendering procedures, contractual frameworks, project execution models, and regulatory requirements.
  • Expertise in project costing, pricing strategy development, margin optimization, and financial risk assessment.
  • Experience conducting competitor analysis, market intelligence studies, benchmark assessments, and business opportunity evaluations.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance competitiveness, profitability, and project execution risks.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders across all organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric approach.
  • Proven experience working within cross-functional, multicultural, and matrix organizations.
  • Professional proficiency in English with excellent verbal, written, presentation, and business communication skills.
  • Willingness to travel as required for customer meetings, site assessments, bid discussions, and business development activities.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio offering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

job.title: Senior Database Reliability Engineer
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

ROLE SUMMARY

Firmus Technologies is seeking a Senior Database Reliability Engineer to join our Engineering and Technology team. You will own and evolve the operational datastore platform that Firmus AI Cloud and our internal platform services depend on. The work sits on bare-metal and self-hosted infrastructure as well as cloud, with proven recovery and measurable reliability as first-class product qualities. You build a paved road so product teams can provision and change databases safely, with low cognitive load, instead of waiting on a ticket queue.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architecture & Standards

Set and improve how we run databases for customer-facing and internal platform workloads. Choose the right pattern for the job: relational, document, NoSQL, or cache. Define connection pooling and database proxies. Define how we scale with vertical growth, read replicas, sharding or partitioning, and multi-site setups. Set HA and failover standards for shared multi-tenant systems. Keep tenant isolation clear and limit blast radius when something fails.

  • Automation & Lifecycle

Own provisioning, config, upgrades, backup, restore, and decommissioning with infrastructure as code and solid automation. Set RPO and RTO. Prove restore and failover with regular drills. Give product teams safe self-service for routine database work so they do not wait on you for every change.

  • Reliability & Performance

Own production health across on-premises and cloud database: SLOs, capacity, query performance, and database monitoring. Fix hard production issues such as lock contention, replication lag, memory or storage pressure, slow queries, and storage or network bottlenecks. Join on-call, lead post-mortems, and turn fixes into automation or better runbooks. Track storage and compute cost when you plan capacity.

  • Security & Compliance

Own access control, encryption in transit and at rest, audit logging, and change control for the databases. Extend Firmus SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 controls as we add sites and services. Keep backup, restore, and recovery evidence ready for audit. Keep privileged access tight.

  • Partnership & Escalations

Work with software and platform engineers on schema design, safe migrations, data modelling, and performance reviews before release. Work with data engineering and observability where your databases connect to their systems, such as CDC (Change Data Capture), read replicas, and database telemetry. Run design reviews that raise the bar. Join customer escalations when the issue is database reliability, performance, or recovery.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years in database reliability engineering. At least 3 years owning PostgreSQL in large-scale production, such as high concurrency, large datasets, or multi-tenant services. That includes replication, failover, backup and restore, query tuning, and incidents you owned.
  • Deep PostgreSQL performance troubleshooting under load, including planner behaviour, locking, bloat, and connection storms.
  • Hands-on with a PostgreSQL HA and backup stack such as Patroni-style HA, pgBackRest or WAL-G, and pgBouncer or a similar pooler. Has shipped schema or major version changes under load.
  • Production Redis or Memcached ownership. Has run it with HA or clustering, managed memory and eviction under load, and made clear persistence and failover choices.
  • Production experience with at least one document or NoSQL store such as MongoDB, Cassandra, DynamoDB, or similar. Includes HA or replica setup, backup and restore, and at least one failure mode you diagnosed yourself.
  • Automates database work with infrastructure as code and Python or Go. Experience with stateful databases on Kubernetes and operators is valued.
  • Has defined RPO and RTO, run restore and failover drills, and owned SLOs, on-call, and post-mortems that led to lasting fixes.
  • Understands the Linux storage and network path that affects database performance. Has used Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar for database monitoring.
  • Has operated databases under compliance such as SOC 2 Type 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Willing to take part in the incident-response on-call rotation for the databases you own.
  • Willing to travel overseas occasionally when the role requires it.
  • Clear and effective written and verbal communication in English.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Singapore
  • Report to: Senior Manager, Platform Engineering

Employment Basis

Full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionize the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: IT Support Specialist, PLM
job.description:
IT Support Analyst – Creo & Windchill

Experience: 3-4 Years Location: Wuxi China Department: Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) / Engineering Systems

Role Summary

As a PLM Analyst, you will support Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes with a strong focus on PTC Creo and Windchill. You will work closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to ensure effective management of product data, CAD models, engineering changes, and product documentation throughout the product lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will possess hands-on experience in Creo design tools and Windchill PLM processes, helping drive product development efficiency, data integrity, and process standardization across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and maintain product data, CAD models, drawings, and engineering documentation within Windchill.
  • Create, modify, and validate 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using PTC Creo.
  • Support engineering teams in product development, design modifications, and product release activities.
  • Coordinate Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), Engineering Change Notices (ECNs), and Change Orders through established workflows.
  • Manage CAD document lifecycles, version control, revisions, and product structures (BOMs).
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain teams to resolve product data and process-related issues.
  • Utilize PLM tools and best practices to streamline product design and development processes.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational CAD standards, PLM governance policies, and engineering procedures.
  • Support data migration, CAD validation, system upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Provide end-user support and training for Creo and Windchill applications.
  • Assist in troubleshooting PLM/CAD issues and perform root cause analysis for recurring problems.
  • Contribute to the enhancement and standardization of PLM processes and engineering workflows.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Technology, or a related field.
  • 3-4 years of experience in PLM, Engineering Design, Product Development, or CAD Administration roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PTC Creo Parametric.
  • Experience working with PTC Windchill or a similar PLM platform.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and global teams.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.

Technical Skills

PTC Creo

  • Part Modeling
  • Assembly Design
  • Drawing Creation & Detailing
  • Sheet Metal Design
  • Family Tables
  • GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing)
  • Top-Down Design Concepts
  • Engineering Drawing Interpretation
  • Design Change Management

Windchill / PLM

  • CAD Document Management
  • WTPart & BOM Management
  • Lifecycle & Workflow Management
  • Version and Revision Control
  • Product Data Management (PDM)
  • Engineering Change Management
  • Product Structure Management
  • Document Release Processes

Preferred Qualifications / Good to Have Skills

  • Experience supporting global engineering or manufacturing organizations.
  • Exposure to Windchill upgrades, migrations, and system enhancement projects.
  • Knowledge of ERP integrations, preferably SAP.
  • Understanding of CAD data governance, quality management, and engineering processes.
  • Familiarity with Agile and project management methodologies.
  • Experience with CAD data migration and validation activities.
  • Basic knowledge of PLM customization, reporting, or workflow automation.
  • Knowledge of Autodesk products such as AutoCAD, Inventor, and Vault is an added advantage.
  • Experience working in a multi-CAD environment supporting both PTC and Autodesk solutions.
  • Understanding of CAD-to-PLM integrations and engineering data exchange processes.

Competencies

  • Customer-focused mindset.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Continuous improvement orientation.
  • Effective stakeholder management.
  • Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Exposure to global engineering and product lifecycle management initiatives.
  • A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work environment.
  • Opportunities to work on leading PLM and engineering technologies.

job.title: senior supply quality engineer
job.description:
主要职责：

1.遵守公司道德政策、公司制度、政策和流程，遵守与本岗位相关的质量要求

2.执行公司的安全环保健康管理规定；对本岗位的环境因素和危险源进行辨识及整改，熟记公司的重大风险和重要环境因素；有效实施公司的安全环保健康管理目标和管理方案。

3.承担公司对零部件供应商的质量管理职责，全面系统的提升供应商供货质量水平。

4.建立完整的供方的质量档案，对供方的设备能力，工艺流程，测量方法和频次，已完成和正在进行的质量改善项目等要有一套完整的档案资料。

5.参与PUR部门组织的新供方开发工作，要在质量角度给出结论性意见。

6.新零部件的验证过程中，参与和供方的技术交流工作，制定或会签样品验证方案，统一检验标准，与供方共同解决样品试制过程中出现的质量问题。

7.熟悉所负责零部件的国标，企标，采购要求等，有较强的失效分析能力。

8.根据项目开发不同阶段的需求，负责零部件PAPSO要求的提出，审核，审批，归档及动态管理工作。

9.承担零部件质量的日常管理工作，及时、准确的向供方反馈日常质量问题，跟踪8D的回复和关闭。

10.岗位职责范围内的零部件指导书的编制，审核和培训。

11.根据末五位供方的质量绩效改进状况，提出召开MQR会议的要求。

12.负责与零部件质量相关的供方SCR申请的受理工作，负责ECN后第一批零件的质量确认工作

13.根据上一财年的供方质量绩效，制定下一年度的《供方质量改进Roadmap》，并每季度回顾一次。

14.组织供方开展质量改进项目和质量主题活动，每年度制定供方改善项目并跟进实施。

15.推动新工艺，新技术，新测量方法在供方和JCI应用及推广。

16.负责组织年度供方的过程审核工作，跟进供方整改计划的制定与实施。

17.对供应商实施不定期的飞行抽检，监督其产品的实物质量和生产过程。

18.根据供方质量问题造成的JCI工时损失和Warranty损失，向供方进行索赔。根据《质量协议》相关条款的规定，执行对供方的质量奖惩。

  • 跟进供方每月需要向JCI提交的相关质量报表的完成情况。

20.完成上级交办的其它任务；

任职条件：

  • 5年以上制造行业质量管理工作经验，有CDU行业工作经验优先
  • 本科以上学历，机械自动化或电气工程自动化专业, 具备质量管理知识及实践经验，掌握8D、PAPSO等质量工具的应用
  • 能熟练使用各种办公软件，良好的沟通能力、组织协调能力和解决问题能力；良好的英文沟通能力和学习能力

job.title: EUT Platform Engineer
job.description:
Job Title: End User Technology (EUT) Platform Engineer - Windows & macOS

Job Summary

The End User Technology (EUT) Platform Engineer is responsible for the design, deployment, administration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise end-user computing environments across both Windows and macOS platforms. This role provides advanced technical support, manages device lifecycle and software deployment processes, delivers platform engineering and packaging services, and ensures security, compliance, performance, and user experience across desktop and mobile technologies.

The engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Security, Infrastructure, Networking, and Service Management, to support global end-user technologies and drive automation, standardization, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Engineering & Administration

  • Design, deploy, administer, and maintain Windows 10/11 and macOS environments, ensuring high availability, performance, and security.
  • Manage endpoint lifecycle activities including provisioning, imaging, deployment, configuration, upgrades, patching, and decommissioning.
  • Administer endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune and other Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain endpoint policies, configurations, and compliance standards.
  • Manage software distribution processes, application updates, and deployment strategies.
  • Develop deployment automation and packaging solutions using scripting languages such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python.
  • Collaborate with business and technical teams to validate application compatibility and deployment readiness.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

  • Provide Level 3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents involving hardware, operating systems, applications, and device management technologies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Windows, macOS, mobile devices, software deployments, and endpoint security.
  • Participate in major incident management, root cause analysis, problem management, and service restoration activities.

Identity & Collaboration Services

  • Administer and support Microsoft Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), and Microsoft 365 services.
  • Support authentication, device enrollment, access management, and endpoint integration with enterprise services.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement and maintain endpoint security controls and compliance requirements.
  • Monitor system health, vulnerabilities, patch compliance, and security posture across managed devices.
  • Partner with Security teams to remediate risks and maintain compliance with corporate standards.

Operations & Service Improvement

  • Monitor platform performance, capacity utilization, and operational metrics.
  • Identify opportunities for automation, process improvements, and user experience enhancements.
  • Participate in change management, release management, and service improvement initiatives.
  • Support onboarding activities, technical projects, and strategic transformation efforts.

Documentation & Knowledge Management

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge base articles.
  • Document solutions, best practices, deployment methodologies, and known issues.
  • Provide training, guidance, and mentoring to end users and IT teams on platform technologies and processes.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 6+ years of experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Windows 10/11 and macOS administration and troubleshooting.
  • Experience with endpoint management solutions such as Microsoft Intune, and equivalent MDM platforms.
  • Experience with application packaging, deployment, and software lifecycle management.
  • Knowledge of Active Directory, Azure AD (Entra ID), Microsoft 365, and identity management concepts.
  • Strong understanding of endpoint security, compliance, and device management best practices.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes including Incident, Problem, Change, and Configuration Management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, and customer service skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively within global cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with scripting and automation using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Knowledge of virtualization and modern endpoint management practices.
  • Understanding of network fundamentals and endpoint connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting cloud-first workplace technologies and modern device management strategies.
  • Exposure to Zero Trust security principles and endpoint compliance frameworks.

Key Personal Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical mindset.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Customer-focused with a commitment to delivering exceptional user experiences.
  • Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills.
  • Continuous learner with a passion for emerging end-user technologies.
  • Proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented.

  • Consults with APAC Supervisor on performance reviews for building leads; lead and motivate leads in human resources activities (such as raising retention rates).
  • Contribute to building the infrastructure, personnel, and client base in their respective region.
  • Works cohesively with APAC Supervisor to maintain and improve region profitability.
  • Modeling excellent relations between the business and the community.
  • Generate regional business reports (including invoicing), collect statistics, and ensure paperwork is properly completed in a timely manner.
  • Provide information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data and trends.
  • Protect organization's value by keeping information confidential.
  • Engage and follow, systems, process’ and procedures implemented by the PMO.
  • Other duties and projects as assigned, including hands on tasks on tools as required.

job.title: Sr. Application Engineer I
job.description:
Job Description

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.

We are a Great Place To Work-Certified organization. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

What you will do

The primary responsibility for this role is to support pre-sales engineering for Fire Detection System global projects as per country specific standards. Basic knowledge about bill of material preparation, cost estimation to come up with competitive bid. Follow processes, maintain required quality standards and on time deliveries to ensure customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review project inputs and specifications; should be able to capture the scope and understand the complete requirements of the project.
  • Review MEP drawings, specification, SOP and identify equipment related to Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Preparation and participation for project kick-off / review meetings with technical queries, compliance / deviations log, risk logs and record minutes of meeting.
  • Adherence to standard estimation process and guideline to select proper combination of hardware, software, equipment, materials and services to come up with the optimum budget.
  • Creation of bill of material, selection of Fire Alarm Panels, Controllers, Field Devices, Software Identification, Network connection, Cable Type and Length Calculations related to Fire Detection System.
  • Preparation of Costing Sheet including Preliminaries and other costs, Cost comparison charts, Checklist, Technical Write-up, Block Diagram, Deviation Chart etc.
  • Ensure quality assurance, defect free deliverables, on time deliveries and customer satisfaction.
  • Escalate issues in the right time, so as not to affect the project delivery schedule; any escalations with respect to scope-creep must be clearly backed up with evidences.
  • Keep operational parameters at desired level for all assigned projects.
  • Ensure timesheet compliance with respect to entry and review for self and team.
  • Weekly/Monthly customer reporting for project progress.
  • Active participation in organization employee engagement initiatives

What we look for

  • BE (Instrumentation / Electrical / Electronics / Electronics & Communication).
  • Strong knowledge of Fire Detection System (Fire Alarm, VESDA, Linear Heat Detection, Fireman Intercom, Detection part of Gas Suppression System, Gas Detection etc)
  • Knowledge on Simplex & Zettler fire alarm product along with Xtralis, Securiton & Wagner product for Aspirating Smoke Detection system
  • Simplex & VESDA certifications will have added advantage
  • Expertise in Fire Alarm Code and Guidelines. Should be familiar with local code requirement for Singapore, Hong Kong & Malaysia region.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, MS Office tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio, etc.), Blue Beam
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, Modbus, and other protocols.
  • Should have good experience for subcon/vendor engagement keeping close

co-ordination with procurement

  • Must be a quick learner, team player & should have a keen eye for problem solving.
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication.
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills.

Preferred

10+ years of relevant experience in Fire Detection System’s Desing and Estimation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: Mgr, Logistics
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

1.Target of the position / 职位定位

Lead the overall management and strategic development of Carrier CHVAC warehousing and logistics operations. Ensure safe, efficient, accurate and reliable execution of warehousing, transportation, inventory management and customer fulfillment activities.

全面负责开利商用CHVAC仓储物流运营管理与能力建设，确保仓储、运输、库存管理及客户交付活动安全、高效、准确、稳定运行。

Strategic logistics transformation initiatives to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, logistics productivity and cost competitiveness. Drive logistics integration & optimization project, digital transformation and process standardization through cross-BU collaboration and project management.

负责相关物流变革项目，通过跨业务单元协作和项目管理推动物流仓储整合、数字化转型及流程标准化，持续提升客户体验、运营效率、物流生产率及成本竞争力。

Drive operational excellence, cost competitiveness and customer satisfaction through team leadership, supplier management, digitalization and continuous improvement.

通过团队领导、供应商管理、数字化和持续改善，持续提升运营卓越水平、成本竞争力与客户满意度。

2. Main tasks / 主要工作

2.1 Warehousing & Logistics Operations Leadership / 仓储物流运营管理

Own the overall performance and business results of CHVAC warehousing and logistics operations, and establish annual operating plans, governance routines and performance review mechanisms.

全面负责CHVAC仓储物流运营绩效与业务结果，制定年度运营计划，建立日常管理机制及绩效回顾机制。

Ensure effective execution of receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, shipping, transportation and return processes, with timely and accurate both internal and external customer fulfillment.

确保收货、上架、存储、拣货、包装、发运、运输及退货等流程有效执行，实现及时、准确的内外部客户交付。

Define and monitor key operating indicators, including service level, delivery performance, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, logistics cost, quality and customer complaints.

制定并监控关键运营指标，包括服务水平、交付表现、库存准确率、仓库生产率、物流成本、质量及客户投诉。

2.2 Inventory Management & Supply Chain Collaboration / 库存管理与供应链协同

Own inventory accuracy and inventory age health; establish cycle count and annual physical inventory mechanisms, investigate variances and drive corrective actions.

负责库存准确率与库龄健康度，建立循环盘点及年度盘点机制，分析库存差异并推动纠正措施。

Collaborate with Factory ops, Procurement, Customer Service, Sales, Finance and other functions to improve end-to-end supply chain efficiency and manage excess or obsolete inventory risks.

与工厂运营、采购、客户服务、销售、财务等团队协作，提升端到端供应链效率，并管理过剩及呆滞库存风险。

2.3 Logistics Network & Supplier Management / 物流网络与供应商管理

Manage warehouse, transportation and other logistics service providers; establish service-level agreements, performance scorecards, review and escalation mechanisms.

管理仓储、运输及其他物流服务供应商，建立服务水平协议、绩效评价、回顾及升级机制。

Support supplier sourcing, contract negotiation, commercial review and annual performance evaluation in collaboration with Procurement and relevant functions.

协同采购及相关职能，支持供应商寻源、合同谈判、商务评审及年度绩效评价。

Drive logistics network, warehouse footprint, transportation mode and route optimization according to business growth and customer requirements.

根据业务增长及客户需求，推动物流网络、仓库布局、运输模式及线路优化。

2.4 Budget, Cost & Productivity Management / 预算、成本与生产率管理

Own warehousing and logistics budget planning, forecasting and spending control; provide regular cost analysis and management reporting.

负责仓储物流预算编制、预测及费用管控，定期开展成本分析并输出管理报告。

Develop and deliver annual productivity and cost optimization plans while balancing service, quality, compliance and business continuity requirements.

制定并落实年度生产率及成本优化计划，同时平衡服务、质量、合规及业务连续性要求。

2.5 Process Excellence, Digitalization & Data Analytics / 流程卓越、数字化与数据分析

Establish, maintain and continuously improve standard operating procedures in line with business development and company policies.

根据业务发展及公司政策建立、维护并持续优化标准操作流程。

Drive process improvement and digitalization initiatives involving SAP, WMS, TMS, online ordering or other relevant systems.

推动涉及SAP、WMS、TMS、在线订单及其他相关系统的流程改善与数字化项目。

Use data analytics to identify risks and improvement opportunities, support decisions and enhance warehouse utilization, productivity and customer service.

运用数据分析识别风险和改善机会，支持管理决策，并提升仓库利用率、生产率及客户服务水平。

2.6 Logistics Transformation Program Management / 物流变革项目管理

**

Make sure the annual logistics productivity target can be achieved through logistics transformation projects from opportunity identification through solution design, implementation and benefit realization.

主导相关的物流变革项目，覆盖机会识别、方案设计、落地实施及收益实现全过程，确保年度物流生产率目标的实现。

Develop project charters, business cases, implementation plans, milestones, risk assessments and governance mechanisms.

制定项目章程、商业案例、实施计划、里程碑、风险评估及项目治理机制。

Coordinate stakeholders across business units and functions to ensure alignment, resource commitment and successful delivery.

协调各业务单元及职能部门相关方，确保目标一致、资源投入及项目顺利交付。

Monitor project performance and keep track on cost, communicate progress and risks through regular reviews.

跟踪项目成果与成本，并定期沟通项目进展和风险。

2.7 Compliance, Quality, EHS & Risk Management / 合规、质量、EHS与风险管理

Ensure operations comply with applicable laws, company policies, quality standards, trade compliance, security, environmental, occupational health, safety and fire protection requirements.

确保运营符合适用法律法规、公司政策、质量标准、贸易合规、安保、环境、职业健康、安全及消防要求。

Lead risk identification, business continuity planning, internal and external audit support, corrective actions and timely escalation of material issues.

领导风险识别、业务连续性规划、内外部审计支持及整改，并对重大问题及时升级。

2.8 Business Partnership & Customer Service / 业务伙伴与客户服务

Act as the logistics business partner for CHVAC, translate business requirements into operational solutions and maintain effective communication with internal and external stakeholders.

作为CHVAC物流业务伙伴，将业务需求转化为运营解决方案，并与内外部相关方保持高效沟通。

Resolve major operational exceptions and customer concerns, drive root-cause analysis and preventive actions, and continuously improve customer satisfaction.

解决重大运营异常及客户问题，推动根因分析及预防措施，持续提升客户满意度。

2.9 Team Leadership & Capability Development / 团队领导与能力建设

Lead the CHVAC warehousing and logistics team, set clear objectives, manage performance and allocate resources according to business priorities.

领导CHVAC仓储物流团队，设定清晰目标，开展绩效管理，并根据业务优先级合理配置资源。

Build organizational capability through coaching, training, succession planning and cross-functional collaboration, and foster a high-performance, team according to Carrier Way.

通过辅导、培训、继任计划及跨部门协作提升组织能力，以开利之道为原则建立高绩效团队。

2.10 Objectives & Other Duties / 目标及其他职责

Complete annual objectives and key results on time and as required.

按时并按要求完成年度工作目标和关键成果。

Perform other duties assigned by the Line Manager.

完成直属经理安排的其他工作。

3.Requirements / 要求

3.1 Educational degree / 教育程度

Bachelor degree or above in Logistics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering or a related field.

物流、供应链、工业工程或相关专业全日制本科及以上学历。

3.2 Job experience / 工作经验

At least 10 years of relevant experience in warehousing, logistics or supply chain, including at least 3 years of team or operational management experience. Experience in factory line logistics management is preferred.

10年以上仓储、物流运营相关经验，其中至少3年团队或现场管理经验；具备工厂线边物流管理经验者优先。

3.3 Personal abilities / 个人能力

Strong leadership, strategic thinking, business acumen, stakeholder management, communication, collaboration, conflict resolution, problem-solving and change management capabilities.

具备较强的团队领导、战略思维、商业敏感度、相关方管理、沟通协作、冲突解决、问题解决及变革管理能力。

3.4 Knowledge / 知识背景

Warehouse and transportation operations, inventory control, supplier and contract management, budgeting, cost control, continuous improvement, project management and data analytics.

精通仓储与运输运营、库存控制、供应商及合同管理、预算与成本控制、持续改善、项目管理及数据分析。

3.5 Systems & tools / 系统与工具

Hands-on experience with SAP, WMS, TMS or related logistics systems; proficient in Microsoft Office and analytical tools.

具备SAP、WMS、TMS或相关物流系统实践经验；熟练使用Microsoft Office及分析工具。

3.6 Language / 语言

Strong written communication skills in both Chinese and English.

具备良好的中英文书面沟通能力。

4. Interfaces / kind of contact / 沟通 / 沟通种类

Internal: CHVAC leadership, Customer Service, Factory ops, Procurement, Sales, Finance, Quality, EHS, IT and other supply chain functions. External: customers, logistics service providers and relevant authorities.

内部：CHVAC管理层、客户服务、工厂运营、采购、销售、财务、质量、EHS、IT及其他供应链职能；外部：客户、物流服务供应商及相关主管部门。

5. Competences / 权能

The position holder is entitled to request the data, information and resources required to perform the role, and to initiate reasonable actions within delegated authority. Material decisions shall follow the applicable approval and escalation processes.

任职者有权申请履行岗位职责所需的数据、信息及资源，并在授权范围内采取合理措施；重大事项应遵循适用的审批及升级流程。

6. Obligation of information flow / 信息传递义务

Provide timely and accurate information to the Line Manager, directly assigned employees and relevant stakeholders.

及时、准确地向直属经理、直接下属及相关方传递信息。

7. Signature authorization / 签字权限

Subject to the company delegation of authority.

遵循公司授权体系。

Our commitment to you

Our greatest assets are the expertise, creativity and passion of our employees. We strive to provide a great place to work that attracts, develops and retains the best talent, promotes employee engagement, fosters teamwork and ultimately drives innovation for the benefit of our customers. We strive to create an environment where you feel that you belong, with diversity and inclusion as the engine to growth and innovation. We develop and deploy best-in-class programs and practices, providing enriching career opportunities, listening to employee feedback and always challenging ourselves to do better. This is The Carrier Way.

Join us and make a difference.

Apply Now!

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: Senior Engineer– Digital Risk Management
job.description:
Position Title: Senior Engineer– Digital Risk Management (P3)

Location: Bangalore / Hyderabad

Reports To: Associate Manager, Digital Risk Management - Carrier Global Capability Center (GCC), Digital Team

Position Summary: To lead the identification, assessment, management, and governance of IT risks across Carrier’s enterprise environment. This role is critical to ensuring the resilience of IT services and the integrity of Carrier's information assets by embedding a robust IT risk management framework aligned with global standards and Carrier's strategic goals. This role acts as the strategic owner of risk governance while working closely with IT Risk Analysts who are responsible for day-to-day execution and operationalization of controls, assessments, and reporting, with close coordination and frequent interaction across internal subject-matter-expert (SME) teams and Risk owners to ensure risk management process is followed.

Key Responsibilities

  • IT Risk Governance & Framework Management
  • Design, implement, and maintain the IT Risk Management Framework aligned with Carrier based Digital Risk Framework which is derived from NIST CSF and ISO 27001.
  • Define IT risk taxonomy, thresholds, and escalation protocols for consistent enterprise-wide adoption.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for IT risk matters across Carrier's global business units, infrastructure, and application teams.
  • Serve as the primary record creator for risks in ServiceNow GRC application.

Key person contributing to the design, configuration, and rollout of the ServiceNow GRC framework, covering the Policy, Risk, Issue, Compliance and Exception Management modules end-to-end.2. Risk Identification, Assessment & Prioritization

  • Conduct and oversee IT risk assessments (inherent and residual) across critical applications, infrastructure, and projects.
  • Guide IT Risk Analysts in executing risk analysis, evidence collection, and scoring processes.
  • Facilitate scenario-based and targeted risk assessments for high-impact areas including cloud migrations, system upgrades, and M&A.
  • Maintain and update risk registers, scoring models, and risk heatmaps using GRC tools - ServiceNow IRM
  • Control Management & Monitoring
  • Define and implement key risk indicators (KRIs) and key control indicators (KCIs) for ongoing risk monitoring.
  • Supervise IT Risk Analysts in evaluating control effectiveness and documenting evidence.
  • Develop action plans for control deficiencies, monitor remediation, and report control maturity metrics.
  • Exception & Deviation Handling
  • Lead the end-to-end management of risk exceptions, waivers, and deviations from IT policy.
  • Oversee the workflows managed by analysts and ensure that exceptions are timely reviewed and approved by appropriate stakeholders.
  • Automate exception workflows and integrate them with CMDB and audit logs for traceability.
  • Stakeholder Engagement & Risk Reporting
  • Prepare and present monthly/quarterly risk dashboards to senior leadership, Risk Council, and DCC.
  • Conduct regular stakeholder sessions to capture risk concerns, share insights, and promote risk ownership.
  • Provide risk insights to inform IT strategic decisions, budget allocations, and project prioritization.
  • Awareness, Training & Culture Building
  • Develop and deliver IT risk training modules to application owners, support teams, and project managers.
  • Promote a risk-aware culture through playbooks, campaigns, and collaborative learning sessions.
  • Partner with HR and L&D to integrate IT risk content into employee training journeys.
  • Mentor and coach IT Risk Analysts to build operational maturity and grow internal expertise.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related field.
  • Minimum 8-10 years in IT risk management, audit, or cyber governance.
  • Strong knowledge of risk frameworks (NIST, ISO 27001, COBIT), internal controls, and security policies.
  • Hands-on experience with GRC platforms, specifically ServiceNow IRM / GRC (Risk, Issue, and Exception Management modules), RSA Archer or any other platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate and interact frequently with internal SME teams and external stakeholders to drive risk topics and strengthen the risk management portfolio.
  • Working knowledge of AI risk frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001) and hands-on ability to leverage AI tools — including building lightweight risk-reporting apps, dashboards, or chatbots — to automate risk triage, scoring, monitoring and stakeholder queries.

Certifications (Preferred):

  • CRISC.

**

Key Attributes:

  • Strategic thinking with tactical execution.
  • Strong interpersonal, influencing, and negotiation skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to simplify complex risk narratives for business audiences.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multi-country risk engagements.
  • Strong coordination skills, with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across internal SME teams and external stakeholders for effective risk management outcomes.

Why Join Us? At Carrier, you will be part of a world-class, diverse workforce that is driving innovation and creating solutions that matter. This role provides an exciting opportunity to shape the future of communications at Carrier Digital, offering high visibility and strategic influence within the organization.

Carrier is An Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status, age or any other federally protected class.

job.title: QA Software Engineer
job.description:
Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a QA Software Engineer to join the Power and Thermal Management Division in Bengaluru, Karnataka/India. As a QA Software Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our software products through manual and automated testing. You will create and maintain test plans, test cases, automation scripts, and defect reports, while collaborating closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, and other QA team members throughout the development lifecycle.

You will also contribute to test automation strategy, analyze automated test results, troubleshoot failures, and participate in technical and architecture discussions. AI-assisted engineering tools will be an important part of the role, supporting activities such as test design, automation development, debugging, defect investigation, and continuous improvement of QA processes.

Responsibilities

  • Design, maintain, and execute test plans, test cases, and test scenarios.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and reduce repetitive manual testing.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, exploratory, negative, boundary, compatibility, and system testing.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, and track software defects throughout their lifecycle.
  • Analyze automated test results, logs, and failures to identify product, automation, or environment issues.
  • Debug and troubleshoot network protocols, APIs, services, and system behavior.
  • Maintain clear and accurate QA documentation.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Product Management, and QA teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Participate in technical, design, architecture, and code review discussions from a quality and testability perspective.
  • Integrate and maintain automated tests within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Use AI-assisted tools to support test case generation, automation development, debugging, log analysis, defect investigation, and technical documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to apply AI and automation to improve test efficiency, coverage, reliability, and overall QA productivity.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, automation frameworks, and engineering practices.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in Software QA, Software Testing, or a related engineering role.
  • Strong understanding of Software QA methodologies, testing techniques, and Agile software development practices.
  • Experience creating and executing both manual and automated test cases.
  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, negative, boundary, compatibility, and concurrency testing.
  • Experience developing, maintaining, or contributing to automated test frameworks.
  • Experience working with CI/CD environments and automated test execution pipelines.

负责平台后台架构设计与核心服务建设，参与系统架构规划、模块拆分、技术方案设计、接口与数据模型定义，以及关键后端能力的研发与落地。该岗位需面向复杂工业平台场景，构建高可靠、高可用、可扩展、易维护的后台系统，并协同产品、前端、算法、车端、测试和运维团队，推动平台功能从需求分析到工程交付的闭环实现。

  • 参与需求评审、架构评审、技术方案评审、详细设计评审、关键代码评审，以及研发过程中的需求澄清与技术问题支持，确保产品需求与工程实现保持一致。
  • 指导后端开发人员完成关键模块实现，解决研发过程中的核心技术问题，支持测试、部署、交付和项目移交。
  • 建立平台级工程规范，包括接口设计规范、数据库设计规范、日志规范、错误码规范、版本兼容策略、安全要求和文档模板。
  • 持续优化平台的可扩展性、可靠性、性能、可维护性、可观测性和交付效率。
  • 与产品、前端、算法、车端、测试、运维和项目团队协作，推动复杂平台功能从需求澄清、方案设计到开发交付的闭环落地。
  • 学历要求：计算机、软件工程、自动化、应用数学等相关专业本科及以上学历。
  • 经验要求：具备5年以上后端或平台系统开发经验，有平台架构设计、微服务架构、分布式系统或工业软件平台经验者优先。
  • 核心能力要求：
  • 具备扎实的Java后端开发能力，熟悉JVM、多线程、集合、并发控制、IO及常用设计模式。
  • 熟练掌握Spring Boot、Spring Cloud、Spring MVC、MyBatis/JPA，熟悉服务治理、注册发现、网关、配置管理、负载均衡、熔断降级与容错机制。
  • 熟练掌握Python后端开发及脚本开发能力，熟悉FastAPI/Flask等常用框架，具备数据处理、自动化脚本、服务集成和性能问题排查能力。
  • 熟悉C++、C#，了解其在服务开发、SDK集成、算法服务封装、性能敏感模块或跨语言集成场景中的应用。
  • 具备平台架构设计能力，能够完成系统分层、模块边界、领域建模、DDD设计、接口集成、数据流转、部署拓扑、高可用、可扩展性和架构演进规划设计。
  • 熟练掌握MySQL/PostgreSQL数据库设计、SQL优化、索引设计、事务控制、数据一致性、分布式一致性及大数据量存储策略。
  • 熟悉Redis、消息队列、MQTT/Kafka/RabbitMQ、WebSocket、RESTful API及异步事件驱动架构。
  • 熟悉Linux、Docker、Nginx、CI/CD、日志、监控、告警、部署、备份及生产环境问题排查。
  • 能够参与PRD需求澄清与评审，并能够按照规范主导或参与撰写和维护TRD、架构设计文档、接口规范、数据库设计文档、部署文档和开发规范。
  • 具备需求分析、业务抽象和方案拆解能力，能够将业务场景转化为功能模块、用户故事、验收标准、技术方案和开发任务。
  • 有无人驾驶、矿山、AGV/AMR调度、物联网、数字孪生、GIS地图平台、车辆数据平台或工业自动化系统经验者优先。

As a Pre-field Rep – Marketing & Sales Operations Representative (MSOR), you will join a structured 18–24 month Field Rep development program designed to accelerate your career at Caterpillar.

Through a combination of hands-on rotations, training, and global exposure, you will build the skills needed for a future field-based role supporting dealers and customers. You will learn directly from senior leaders and subject matter experts while gaining practical experience across the business.

What Marketing & Sales Means at Caterpillar

At Caterpillar, Marketing & Sales focuses on helping dealers optimise marketing and sales operations to improve customer outcomes, and business performance.

While this role supports Marketing & Sales functions, it is not a traditional sales representative or marketing specialist role. The focus of this position is to collaborate with Cat dealers to build capability, drive process improvement, and execute Marketing and Sales Operations related strategies.

What the Field Rep Program Offers

  • A 12-week intensive onboarding and training experience
  • International exposure, including travel across Asia and Europe on learning trips
  • Rotational assignments across key business functions
  • Mentorship from experienced leaders and subject matter experts

What you will learn in the program:

  • Build foundational knowledge of Caterpillar's products, customers, industries, and dealer network
  • Develop commercial, analytical, consulting, and professional skills
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams across dealer management, marketing, sales, product, and strategic business functions
  • Gain exposure to business planning, customer experience, growth strategies, process improvement, and operational excellence practices
  • Rotational Assignments through various Caterpillar Divisions to (i) develop industry and product application knowledge, (ii) build a strong understanding of the Cat dealer network and (iii) strengthen your capabilities for future roles within the organisation

Your Future Role

Upon successful completion of the program, you will have the opportunity to move into a field role, where you will:

  • Partner with Cat dealers to strengthen marketing and sales operations and improve business performance
  • Build dealer capability and support strategic growth and process improvement initiatives
  • Champion customer experience and support initiatives that improve market coverage and customer engagement
  • Use data and insights to identify opportunities and develop solutions that improve customer outcomes and commercial performance
  • Act as a trusted advisor to dealers, helping them improve performance and deliver exceptional customer experience
  • We’re looking for candidates who:
  • Hold a degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, Project Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline
  • Have experience managing or supporting projects, process improvement initiatives, business development activities, or operational improvements
  • Are strong communicators and relationship builders
  • Enjoy solving problems and working with data
  • Demonstrate commercial curiosity, a growth mindset, and adaptability
  • Are open to travel (up to 30%) and relocation within Australia
  • You may also have up to 3 years of experience in marketing, business, analytics, project management, operations, sales support or change management.

Additional Information**

Whilst applicants will be considered from across Australia, you may be required to relocate upon completion of your developmental period. Company support is provided with relocation.

Must have full Australian working rights

Testimonials from Field Rep Program Graduates

“It was one of the best early‑career experiences I’ve had. You get to travel through Asia and Europe, spend time in world‑class facilities, and build real technical and leadership skills - all while working for a global industry leader”

  • Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

"Being a part of this program was a once in a lifetime opportunity for me, and it provided me with immense growth both professionally and personally." - Program Graduate, Marketing & Sales

“The program has been a valuable part of my development. It has broadened my understanding of Caterpillar products, systems, and dealer operations, enabling me to provide more effective support to Cat dealers and customers and deliver greater value in my role every day.”

  • Program Graduate, Product Support

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Title : 嵌入式软件工程师（Linux / MCU）-OTA

Job Responsibilities

负责 OTA（Over-the-Air）和 OTW（Over-the-Wire）软件升级方案在 Linux 和 MCU 平台上的设计、开发、集成和维护。确保安全、可靠、可扩展的软件升级能力，支持当前产品迭代需求以及未来平台演进。涵盖升级流程设计、签名校验、安全校验、回滚机制、分发管理和版本维护。

  • 负责 OTA/OTW 升级方案的设计与实现，覆盖 Linux 平台和 MCU 平台。
  • 设计并实现安全可靠的升级流程，包括包制作、校验、签名、安装、回滚和状态管理。
  • 与底层平台、应用层及测试团队协同，推动升级功能在目标硬件上的稳定集成。
  • 优化升级传输、断点续传、失败重试和异常恢复机制，提高升级成功率和可靠性。
  • 维护升级包版本管理、发布流程和生命周期管理，确保不同版本之间兼容与回退性。
  • 分析生产环境和实验环境中的升级问题，定位根因并持续优化升级方案。
  • 配合软件发布、质量管理和现场支持，确保升级方案可用于量产和后续维护。

Qualifications

  • 计算机、软件工程、电子工程、自动化或相关专业，本科及以上学历。
  • 5年以上嵌入式软件开发经验。
  • 熟练掌握 C/C++ 编程语言，具备 Linux 平台以及MCU开发经验。
  • 熟悉 Linux 和 MCU 的嵌入式软件开发流程，具备 OTA/OTW 相关工程实践经验。
  • 了解软件分发、升级包格式、签名校验、安全验证和回滚策略。
  • 具备嵌入式系统调试能力，能够利用日志、串口、抓包和版本分析定位问题。
  • 具备良好的跨团队协作能力，能够与硬件、平台、测试和产品团队沟通协作。
  • 具备较强的文档和问题分析能力，能够输出清晰的设计说明、测试方案和故障复盘。

job.title: Autonomous & Remote-Control Site Connectivity Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Responsible for the assessment, planning, deployment, testing, and optimization of site communication networks for autonomous mining and remote-control applications, including 4G/LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi, Starlink, RTK, and related wireless infrastructure. The role supports project implementation, customer delivery, and reliable network operations.

负责矿山自动驾驶及远程控制项目现场通信网络的评估、规划、部署、测试及优化，包括4G/LTE、5G、Wi-Fi、Starlink、RTK及相关无线基础设施，支持自动驾驶和远程控制系统稳定运行，为项目实施、客户交付及网络运营提供技术支持。

Key Responsibilities

1. Network Assessment & Solution Design

  • Conduct site network assessments and analyze existing communication infrastructure
  • Evaluate 4G/LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi, Starlink, and RTK network availability
  • Develop wireless coverage and RF spectrum utilization plans
  • Generate Network Readiness Assessment reports

2. Network Deployment & System Integration

  • Design, deploy, and support wireless network environments
  • Support Wi-Fi, Private 5G, Cellular, Microwave, and Wireless Mesh technologies
  • Support connectivity for autonomous and remote-control systems
  • Coordinate deployment activities with suppliers, carriers, and customers

3. Network Testing & Validation

  • Develop and execute network test plans
  • Conduct coverage, bandwidth, latency, roaming, and reliability testing
  • Utilize spectrum analyzers, site survey tools, and drive-test tools
  • Generate network performance reports

4. Infrastructure Support & Reliability Improvement

  • Manage and maintain site wireless infrastructure
  • Support LTE, 5G, and Private 5G network optimization
  • Perform root cause analysis and drive corrective actions
  • Improve network reliability and availability

5. Technical Support & Documentation

  • Prepare site assessment reports, test reports, and technical documentation
  • Support customer training and project delivery
  • Support field implementation and technical support activities

主要职责

1. 网络评估与方案设计

  • 负责客户现场网络评估及网络现状分析
  • 评估4G/LTE、5G、Wi-Fi、Starlink等低轨宽带星座及RTK网络可用性
  • 制定网络覆盖策略及RF频谱规划
  • 输出Network Readiness评估报告

2. 网络部署与系统集成

  • 设计、部署并支持矿区无线网络环境
  • 支持Wi-Fi、Private 5G、Cellular、Microwave及Wireless Mesh网络部署
  • 支持自动驾驶及远程控制系统网络集成
  • 协调供应商、运营商及客户完成现场部署

3. 网络测试与性能验证

  • 制定并执行网络测试计划
  • 开展覆盖率、带宽、时延、稳定性及切换性能测试
  • 使用频谱分析仪、Site Survey及Drive Test工具开展网络评估
  • 输出测试报告及性能分析结果

4. 网络运维与可靠性提升

  • 管理和维护现场无线网络基础设施
  • 支持4G/LTE、5G及Private 5G网络优化及运维
  • 开展网络问题根因分析及整改闭环
  • 提升网络可靠性及系统可用性

5. 技术支持与文档管理

  • 编写网络评估报告、测试报告及技术文档
  • 支持客户培训及项目交付
  • 支持现场实施及技术支持活动

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Telecommunications, Electronics Engineering, Computer Networking, Automation, or a related discipline
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in wireless communications, networking, systems administration, or related technical operations
  • Experience supporting enterprise networking and wireless technologies
  • Ability to support activities at customer sites, proving grounds, and mining operations

Technical Skills

  • Knowledge of 4G/LTE, 5G, Wi-Fi, Starlink, and RTK technologies
  • Experience in wireless network planning, deployment, testing, and optimization
  • Familiarity with TCP/IP, Ethernet, and common network testing tools
  • Understanding of network reliability, wireless coverage planning, RF spectrum utilization, and troubleshooting methodologies

Soft Skills

  • Strong communication and customer relationship skills
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities
  • Good technical documentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in autonomous mining or remote-control applications
  • Experience deploying Private 5G, Wi-Fi, or Starlink solutions
  • Familiarity with network coverage testing and optimization methods
  • Experience working with telecom carriers, network vendors, or system integrators

任职资格

学历与经验

  • 本科及以上学历，通信工程、电子工程、计算机网络、自动化或相关专业
  • 3年以上无线通信、工业网络、系统运维或相关技术领域工作经验
  • 具备企业级网络、无线通信或基础设施运维经验
  • 能够适应矿区、试验场及客户现场工作环境

技术能力

  • 熟悉4G/LTE、5G、Wi-Fi、Starlink等低轨宽带星座及RTK等无线通信技术
  • 具备无线网络规划、部署、测试及优化经验
  • 熟悉TCP/IP、Ethernet等网络基础知识及常用网络测试工具
  • 了解网络可靠性、无线覆盖规划、RF频谱管理及问题分析方法

通用能力

  • 良好的沟通协调及客户关系管理能力
  • 较强的问题分析与解决能力
  • 良好的技术文档编写能力

优先条件

  • 有矿山自动驾驶或远程控制项目经验
  • 有Private 5G、Wi-Fi或Starlink等低轨宽带星座接收部署经验
  • 熟悉网络覆盖测试及性能优化方法
  • 有运营商、网络设备商或系统集成项目经验

job.title: Senior Client Acquisition Manager (Public Sector)
job.description:
Responsibilities

As a Challenger, you will play a key role in driving sales growth by challenging customers' thinking, providing valuable insights, and guiding them toward innovative solutions. The ideal candidate is assertive, confident, and excels in complex sales environments.

  • Challenge customer assumptions by proactively engage customers in thought-provoking conversations to challenge their assumptions and broaden their perspective.

job.title: Cluster Operations Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Operational Management:

  • Oversee the day-to-day operations of multiple data centres within the cluster, ensuring all systems and infrastructure function optimally, and achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customers' SLAs.
  • Implement and maintain operational policies, procedures, and best practices to ensure data centre efficiency and reliability.
  • Manage incident response, troubleshooting, and resolution to minimize downtime and service disruptions.
  • Measure operational metrics, analyse data and identify risks.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of operations and technical staff, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.
  • Coordinate with shift teams to ensure seamless 24/7 coverage and effective handovers between shifts.
  • Conduct regular training sessions and performance evaluations to enhance team capabilities and productivity.

Maintenance and Upgrades:

  • Plan and oversee preventative and corrective maintenance activities, ensuring all equipment and systems are serviced according to manufacturer and company standards.
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors for maintenance and upgrade projects, ensuring minimal impact on operations.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure all data centre operations comply with relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation and records to support compliance audits and certifications.
  • Ensure compliance with site-held accreditations, including, but not limited to ISMS, SOC2, and PCI DSS.

Customer Support:

  • Collaborate with the customer support team to provide “smart hands” services for retail customers, ensuring prompt and professional service delivery.
  • Address customer queries and issues related to data centre operations, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction.

Strategic Initiatives:

  • Support the Campus Director in developing and implementing strategic initiatives to enhance data centre performance and support business growth.
  • Participate in budget planning and cost management activities to ensure operational efficiency and financial performance.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of experience in data centre operations, with at least 3-5 years in a managerial role.
  • Strong knowledge of data centre infrastructure, including power, cooling, and network systems.
  • Proven experience in managing technical teams and 24/7 operations.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to manage complex operational challenges.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, or similar are highly desirable.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: ICT Engineer (Loyang)
job.description:
About the Role

As CBRE Information & Communications Technology Service Delivery Technician, you will provide on-site support for the ICT and Engineering services within the Data Center environment.

This job is part of the Critical and Technical Services job function. They are responsible for technical maintenance services in critical client environments.

What You’ll Do:

  • Receive, review, and complete IT equipment installation, relocation and decommission requests within timeframes and to industry standards.
  • Provide problem-solving support. This includes server reboots, backups, visual inspections, etc.
  • Escort third-party engineers and ensure their compliance with the site standards.
  • Receive, respond, and assign break and fix tickets within the agreed timeframe or escalate if they cannot be resolved.
  • Ensure that on-site documentation including work-related standard operating procedures are created, reviewed & updated whenever there is an instruction or process change.
  • Receive, assess, and complete patching and de-patching requests.
  • Develop a good working relationship with all members of staff and client representatives.
  • Provision and fault diagnosis and rectification of network channel connectivity, installation, relocation & decommissioning of IT equipment, and general engineering maintenance & housekeeping of the critical services.
  • Ensure a safe and healthy working environment while maintaining a professional image.
  • Use existing procedures to solve straightforward problems.
  • Impact through clearly defined duties, and methods and tasks are described in detail.

What You’ll Need:

  • Training in a Technical discipline having served an apprenticeship or equivalent with 1-2 years of job-related experience. In lieu of a diploma, a combination of experience and education will be considered.
  • Must meet the physical requirements of this role.
  • Ability to follow basic work routines and standards in the application of work.
  • Communication skills to exchange straightforward information.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Office products. Examples include Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.
  • Strong organizational skills with an inquisitive mindset.
  • Basic math skills. Ability to calculate simple figures such as percentages, discounts, and markups.

job.title: Solutions Engineering Manager - Global Switch
job.description:
About the Role

As Solutions Engineering Manager, you will lead the regional translation of Global Switch’s engineering strategy into high‑quality, commercially robust technical solutions. You will set technical direction through early design stages of new‑build and redevelopment projects, ensuring alignment with Global Switch Reference Designs, sustainability objectives, and investment criteria. Acting as a trusted technical authority, you will support site feasibility, masterplanning, pre‑sales solutions, and capacity planning, while partnering closely with investment, delivery, operations, and sales teams to enable informed decision‑making and long‑term value creation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously review and maintain technical intelligence on customer requirements, competitor facilities, and emerging market demands to inform strategic design decisions.
  • Conduct in-depth research on new technologies, sustainable engineering approaches, and innovative solutions, engaging with manufacturers and industry partners to stay ahead of product development and best practices.
  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of global and regional industry trends, regulatory requirements, and efficiency standards for data centre design, ensuring alignment with sustainability and operational excellence goals.
  • Perform detailed test fits and feasibility assessments for potential acquisition sites identified by the Investment team, evaluating technical constraints and opportunities.
  • Support internal and external teams in due diligence processes, providing technical insights and risk analysis for new development opportunities.
  • Embed sustainable design principles into all planning and development activities, identifying opportunities to reduce environmental impact and improve operational efficiency.
  • Analyse and compare technical solutions particularly power and cooling infrastructure against key parameters such as efficiency, operability, total cost of ownership (TCO), and design complexity.
  • Work closely with group delivery and site teams during design and construction phases to incorporate lessons learned and design improvements into future proposals, ensuring continuous enhancement of technical standards.
  • Identify key risks and help to plan and mitigate against the risks associated with a technical proposal.**

About you

You’re a technically authoritative and commercially astute leader with deep experience in data centre engineering and solution design. You excel at translating strategic engineering intent into practical, high‑quality technical solutions that balance performance, sustainability, operability, and long‑term value. With a strong understanding of power, cooling, capacity planning, and reference design principles, you’re confident taking ownership of early‑stage design decisions that shape investment outcomes and project success.

You thrive at the intersection of strategy, technology, and collaboration working closely with investment, delivery, operations, and sales teams to support feasibility, masterplanning, and pre‑sales opportunities. A natural communicator, you’re comfortable presenting complex technical concepts to both technical and non‑technical audiences, influencing senior stakeholders, and acting as a trusted advisor throughout the project lifecycle. As a people leader, you inspire and develop high‑performing engineering teams, lead with clarity through ambiguity, and champion continuous improvement, innovation, and sustainability in everything you do.

Key Requirements:

  • Lead and mentor a team of engineers, driving technical excellence and ensuring timely delivery of projects.
  • Full management responsibility for people within team, both performance and pastoral.
  • Demonstrate advanced communication and negotiation skills, engaging confidently with internal stakeholders at senior levels to influence decisions and align technical strategies with business objectives.
  • Deliver compelling technical presentations tailored for both technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring clarity and engagement in complex solution discussions.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple, concurrent projects from initiation through completion, ensuring adherence to timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  • Skilled in coordinating cross-functional team including engineering, operations, and commercial groups to achieve project milestones and deliverables.
  • Experienced in resource allocation, risk management, and workflow optimisation to maximise efficiency and minimise delays.

About Global Switch

You might not know it, but you use a data centre like Global Switch every day. Whether you're browsing the web, streaming, playing a game, or simply making a purchase, you are relying on data centres around the world. Global Switch is a trusted name in the industry, with over 20 years of experience and a commitment to long-term partnerships and sustainability.

We value excellence and teamwork, and we always strive to deliver the best customer service and satisfaction. We are a team of skilled and passionate professionals, proud of who we are and what we do. Joining us means becoming part of a team that values learning and growth.

As an equal-opportunity employer, Global Switch is committed to providing a working culture that values diversity and inclusion and is committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a barrier-free recruitment process and working environment.

Design

About Global Switch

Global Switch owns and operates 4,200,000 sq ft (388,000 sq m) of exceptional large-scale, multi customer, carrier and cloud neutral data centre space across Europe and Asia-Pacific. Established in 1998 our longevity in the market place and impressive track record prove we deliver best in class solutions.

Global Switch data centres are operated to a Tier III standard or higher and provide resilient and secure solutions to customers who include global system integrators, telecommunication and cloud providers, enterprises, financial institutions, government organisations, managed service providers and other hosting businesses.
