job.title: Service Now Jr Admin
job.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Senior Administrator

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow Senior Administrator to manage the day‑to‑day health, stability, and configuration of our ServiceNow platform. This role requires strong hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM, solid understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to support enhancements, troubleshoot issues, and guide junior team members. You will work closely with developers, process owners, and platform stakeholders to ensure the system runs smoothly and follows best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee daily administration of the ServiceNow platform, including user management, roles, groups, and access controls.
  • Maintain and improve core modules such as ITSM and CMDB; experience with ITAM, ITOM, HRSD, or SecOps is a plus.
  • Configure and manage forms, fields, lists, UI policies, UI actions, and basic workflow or Flow Designer logic.
  • Support platform upgrades, patches, regression testing, and general maintenance activities.
  • Monitor data quality across key tables, including CMDB, ITSM, SAM/HAM, and ITOM‑related records.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement long‑term fixes.
  • Assist with catalog items, record producers, notifications, and workflow automation.
  • Work with cross‑functional teams to understand requirements and translate them into configuration tasks.
  • Maintain clear documentation for configuration changes, processes, and platform updates.
  • Provide guidance to junior admins and support teams on platform standards and best practices.

Core Skills & Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of ServiceNow platform architecture, tables, forms, ACLs, and role‑based access.
  • Hands‑on experience with ITSM and ITAM (required).
  • Working knowledge of Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and Flow Designer.
  • Familiarity with Script Includes, Glide APIs, and basic scripting (JavaScript).
  • Understanding of integrations, Scripted REST APIs, and data exchange concepts.
  • Good awareness of CMDB relationships, data models, and data quality practices.
  • Experience with Service Portal or UI customization is helpful.
  • Understanding of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow.

Qualifications

  • 4–6+ years of hands‑on experience administering or developing in ServiceNow.
  • Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field (or equivalent experience).
  • Experience supporting upgrades, maintenance, and platform improvements.
  • Background working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • ServiceNow CSA certification required or in progress; additional certifications (ITSM, CMDB, HRSD, ITAM) are a plus.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business teams.
  • Ability to mentor junior team members and support platform governance.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
Product Owner Data and Integrations

Location: Bangalore

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced and business-focused Product Owner to lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of data and integrations teams for an enterprise eCommerce application. This role will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders, technology teams, data engineering, architecture, and external partners to translate business needs into scalable data flows, APIs, integration requirements, and prioritized product backlogs. The Product Owner will drive outcomes that improve data quality, system interoperability, operational efficiency, and user adoption while ensuring solutions meet security, governance, performance, and compliance expectations. The role requires techno-functional skills to analyze data, write SQLs, create and update field mappings, and debug issues with cross-platform teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain the product vision, roadmap, and prioritized backlog for data and integrations teams.
  • Be the SME for APIs, and data process flows.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to understand objectives, pain points, reporting needs, process gaps, and integration requirements, translating them into clear user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Collaborate with data engineering, application development, architecture, security, and QA teams to design and deliver scalable, reliable, and secure data and integration solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, lineage, governance, privacy, and compliance considerations are embedded into product requirements and delivery decisions.
  • Manage sprint planning, backlog refinement, release planning, demos, and stakeholder reviews in alignment with Agile delivery practices.
  • Evaluate technical feasibility, business value, risk, and dependency impacts when prioritizing features, enhancements, defects, and technical debt.
  • Work with teams to establish performance, reliability, monitoring, and support expectations for data pipelines, APIs, and integration services.
  • Support user acceptance testing by validating that delivered capabilities meet business objectives, functional requirements, and defined acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate cross-functional dependencies across internal teams, external vendors, and enterprise platforms to ensure successful end-to-end delivery.
  • Communicate product status, roadmap priorities, delivery risks, decisions, and outcomes clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Drive adoption and continuous improvement by gathering feedback, monitoring usage, measuring product success, and identifying opportunities to enhance data and integration capabilities.

Qualifications

  • 6-8 years of experience in product ownership, business analysis, solution delivery, data platforms, integrations, or enterprise application delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience defining product roadmaps, managing backlogs, writing user stories, and prioritizing work based on business value, technical feasibility, and stakeholder impact.
  • Functional understanding of APIs and data integration concepts, including APIs, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, batch and real-time processing, data mapping, and system interoperability.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, ERP, CRM, data warehouses, data lakes, middleware, iPaaS, or integration platforms.
  • Ability to translate complex business processes and data needs into clear functional and technical requirements for engineering and delivery teams.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, data privacy, master data management, lineage, security, and compliance considerations.
  • Experience working in Agile Scrum teams, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, demos, retrospectives, and release planning.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with business users, technical teams, vendors, architects, QA teams, and leadership.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain data and integration concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to balance strategic product direction with day-to-day delivery decisions.
  • Experience with product management and delivery tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, or similar platforms.
  • Knowledge of cloud data platforms, API management, event streaming, middleware, or modern integration architecture is preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Scrum Product Owner, SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager, Salesforce, cloud, data, or integration certifications are preferred.

job.title: Logistics Senior Specialist
job.description:
Build a career with confidence

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions is committed to creating solutions that matter for people and our planet for generations to come. From the beginning, we've led in inventing new technologies and entirely new industries. Today, we continue to lead because we have a world-class, diverse workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do.

About the role

1.Target of the position / 职位定位

Lead the management of Carrier RLCS light commercial warehousing and logistics operations. Ensure safe, efficient, accurate and reliable execution of warehousing, transportation, inventory management and customer fulfillment activities.

负责开利区域仓库轻商仓储物流运营管理，确保仓储、运输、库存管理及客户交付活动安全、高效、准确、稳定运行。

2. Main tasks / 主要工作

2.1 Warehousing & Logistics Operations Leadership / 仓储物流运营管理

Own the performance and business results of warehousing and logistics operations, monitor and assess logistics service suppliers’ performance.

负责区域仓库仓储物流运营绩效与业务结果，对物流服务商绩效进行跟踪、监控与考核。

Ensure effective execution of receiving, put-away, storage, picking, packing, shipping, transportation and return processes, with timely and accurate customer fulfillment, including system order processing, report and documents;

确保收货、上架、存储、拣货、包装、发运、运输及退货等流程有效执行，实现及时、准确的客户交付，包括系统订单操作、报告、文案工作等。

Monitor key operating indicators, including service level, delivery performance, inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, logistics cost, quality and customer complaints.

监控关键运营指标，包括服务水平、交付表现、库存准确率、仓库生产率、物流成本、质量及客户投诉。

Daily customer（internal & external） logistics and warehouse requirements response and issue quick solving.

日常内外部客户对物流仓储的需求响应及客户问题的解决。

2.2 Inventory Management & Supply Chain Collaboration / 库存管理与供应链协同

Own inventory accuracy and inventory age health; execute cycle count and annual physical inventory mechanisms, investigate variances and drive corrective actions.

负责库存准确率与库龄健康度，执行循环盘点及年度盘点机制，分析库存差异并推动纠正措施。

Collaborate with Factory ops, Procurement, Customer Service, Sales, Finance and other functions to improve end-to-end supply chain efficiency and manage excess or obsolete inventory risks.

与工厂运营、采购、客户服务、销售、财务等团队协作，提升端到端供应链效率，并管理过剩及呆滞库存风险。

2.3 Logistics Supplier Management / 供应商管理

Manage warehouse, transportation and other logistics service providers; establish service-level agreements, performance scorecards, review and escalation mechanisms.

管理仓储、运输及其他物流服务供应商，建立服务水平协议、绩效评价、回顾及升级机制。

2.4 Process Excellence, Digitalization & Data Analytics / 流程卓越、数字化与数据分析

Develop, roll out, maintain and continuously optimize standard operating procedures (SOPs), aligned with business development needs and corporate policies, ensure SOP compliance in daily operation.

结合业务发展与公司制度，制定、推行、维护并持续迭代标准作业流程 SOP，保障日常运营流程合规落地。

Leverage data analytics to identify operational risks and improvement opportunities; provide data driven decision support, improve warehouse space utilization, labor productivity and overall customer service experience.

运用数据分析识别运营风险与改善机会，输出数据支撑管理决策，提升仓库库容利用率、作业人效及整体客户服务体验。

2.5 Compliance, Quality, EHS & Risk Management / 合规、质量、EHS与风险管理

Ensure operations comply with applicable laws, company policies, quality standards, trade compliance, security, environmental, occupational health, safety and fire protection requirements.

确保运营符合适用法律法规、公司政策、质量标准、贸易合规、安保、环境、职业健康、安全及消防要求。

业务连续性规划、内外部审计支持及整改，并对重大问题及时升级。

job.title: Sr Mgr, Pricing Excellence
job.description:
Role summary

The Senior Manager, Pricing Excellence will lead the development and deployment of Carrier's pricing excellence capability across the Asia, Middle East and Africa (AME) region. The role is responsible for driving sustainable margin expansion through pricing analytics, governance, deal support, commercial processes, and capability building.

This position will partner closely with business leaders, sales teams, product line leaders, finance, and commercial operations teams to improve pricing discipline, increase price realization, strengthen margin management, and establish pricing as a strategic lever for profitable growth.

Role Responsibilities:

  • ### Pricing Strategy & Governance

Develop and deploy regional pricing frameworks, policies, and governance processes.

  • Establish pricing guardrails, Delegation of Authority (DOA) structures, review forums, and escalation processes.
  • Drive consistency in pricing decision-making across countries and business segments.
  • Support leadership in balancing growth, competitiveness, and profitability objectives.

Pricing Analytics & Insights

  • Build and manage pricing dashboards and analytical tools to improve commercial decision-making.
  • Identify price leakage, margin erosion, discounting trends, and pricing opportunities.
  • Analyze pricing performance by market, product line, customer segment, channel, and country.
  • Develop recommendations to improve margin realization and commercial effectiveness.

Deal Review & Commercial Support

  • Support large, strategic, and complex deal reviews.
  • Partner with commercial teams to evaluate pricing scenarios and profitability implications.
  • Facilitate pricing war rooms and deal review forums for key opportunities.
  • Drive adoption of value-based pricing principles across the region.

Commercial Performance Management

  • Define and track pricing KPIs including: Price realization Discount leakage Margin improvement Approval cycle times Pricing compliance Win rate by margin band
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to regional and country leadership teams.

Capability Building & Change Management

  • Lead pricing excellence training programs for commercial and product management teams.
  • Develop playbooks, tools, and standard methodologies to improve pricing maturity.
  • Build organizational capability in pricing analytics, negotiation, and value selling.
  • Act as the regional subject matter expert for pricing and margin optimization.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Commercial Excellence, and General Managers.
  • Influence senior stakeholders to drive adoption of pricing best practices.
  • Lead regional pricing initiatives and continuous improvement programs.

Minimum Experience:

  • 10+ years of experience in pricing, commercial excellence, strategy, sales operations, finance, consulting, or related commercial leadership roles.
  • Experience in industrial, HVAC, building solutions, engineered products, manufacturing, or B2B environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated success driving pricing initiatives, margin improvement, and commercial transformation programs.

Minimum Skills:

  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong financial acumen and business judgment.
  • Experience with pricing analytics and dashboard development.
  • Executive-level communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority across multiple countries and business units.
  • Strong project management and change leadership skills.

job.title: Building Services Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

POSITION OVERVIEW

Reporting to the Data Centre Cluster Operations Manager, the Building Services Manager is responsible for overseeing the security and soft services across multiple buildings within a data centre cluster. Soft Services include: cleaning services, waste management, landscaping, pest control, handyman repairs, and all front-of-house facilities such as lifts, gates, and roller shutters. The role ensures that the data centre cluster operates smoothly and securely, providing a safe and efficient environment for all employees and visitors.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Security Management:

  • Develop and implement security policies, protocols, and procedures across all buildings.
  • Manage security staff and ensure all personnel are trained and compliant with security standards.
  • Oversee access control systems, CCTV, and alarm systems in all buildings.
  • Conduct regular security audits and risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities.
  • Respond to security breaches and incidents promptly and effectively.

Cleaning Services:

  • Manage the cleaning staff and ensure all areas of the facility are maintained to a high standard of cleanliness.
  • Develop and monitor cleaning schedules and ensure compliance with health and safety regulations.
  • Liaise with cleaning contractors to ensure service levels are met across all buildings.

Waste Management:

  • Implement effective waste management and recycling programs for the entire data centre cluster.
  • Ensure compliance with environmental regulations and sustainability goals.
  • Coordinate with waste disposal vendors for timely and efficient waste removal.

Landscaping:

  • Oversee the maintenance of the facility's outdoor areas, including gardens, lawns, and green spaces.
  • Manage landscaping contractors to ensure the grounds are well-maintained and aesthetically pleasing across all buildings.

Pest Control:

  • Implement and manage pest control measures to prevent infestations in all buildings.
  • Coordinate with pest control services to conduct regular inspections and treatments.

Handyman Repairs:

  • Manage a team of handymen to address minor repairs and maintenance tasks within the facility cluster.
  • Ensure all repairs are carried out promptly and to a high standard.

Front-of-House Facilities:

  • Oversee the maintenance and operation of lifts, gates, roller shutters, and other front-of-house facilities.
  • Ensure these facilities are regularly inspected and maintained to prevent downtime or malfunctions.

Vendor Management:

  • Liaise with external contractors and service providers for various facility management services.
  • Negotiate contracts and ensure services are delivered in accordance with agreements.

Health & Safety:

  • Ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations.
  • Conduct regular safety audits and risk assessments.

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Proven experience in facilities management, preferably in a data centre or similar environment.
  • Strong knowledge of security protocols and experience managing security personnel.
  • Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations.
  • Proficiency in facilities management software and tools.

job.title: DCS/BMS Service Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As the DCS (Distributed Control System)/BMS (Building Management System) Service Engineer, you will report to the DCS Regional Manager (who is based in Australia), and work closely with the rest of the Technical Operations team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Providing technical expertise relating to the DCS with a heavy emphasis on maintenance, system optimisation and root cause analysis
  • Ensuring that the existing systems are maintained to the highest possible standards with the ultimate goal: a fine-tuned control system that provides information that can be heavily relied on and quickly address, prevent and/or anticipate any system errors that may arise
  • Lead and manage small-scale improvement projects aimed at enhancing system performance and efficiency.
  • Being part of a wider in-sourced DCS Service & Support Team supporting infrastructure across the whole of Asia, Australia and India.

What You'll Do

  • DCS and CMS Maintenance: Fully maintain the Distributed Control System (DCS) and Central Monitoring System (CMS) from servers to field devices across multiple sites, ensuring efficient operation as per the maintenance scope of works. This includes conducting system backups, ensuring ICT and cybersecurity compliance, and updating firmware/software in collaboration with 3rd party providers.
  • Optimization and Risk Mitigation: Provide risk-mitigated plant optimization strategies, including system optimization and energy efficiency initiatives. Analyze vast amounts of data to generate actionable insights and recommendations, using analytics-based approaches to enhance system performance and reliability.
  • Incident Management and Technical Support: Attend to controls-related incidents, including event investigations, root cause analysis, and problem management. Provide L1 to L3 technical support across site teams and other locations as required, ensuring adherence to response priority SLAs.
  • Niagara Diagnostics and Communication Protocols: Address performance issues within Niagara applications, ensuring optimal functionality. Maintain communication protocols at peak efficiency, resolving issues that cause lags or high processor utilization.
  • Collaboration and Site Confidence: Work closely with site operations teams during maintenance activities, ensuring open communication and integration with site teams to build strong relationships and confidence in system operations. Contribute to the successful resolution of post-construction controls-related defects.
  • Continual Improvement and Project Delivery: Lead and support DCS-related projects aimed at system optimization and operational improvements that benefit data center facilities. Ensure adherence to system baselines, safe work practices, and change management procedures.

**

What You'll Bring

**

  • 3+ years experience in the maintenance, programming, and integration of Tridium Niagara based control systems (essential); data centre experience preferred
  • Awareness of mission critical Data Centre infrastructure such as redundant electrical systems and chilled water plant control strategies
  • A working knowledge of HVAC, Electrical, UPS, and associated plant and the different automation protocols, e.g. BACnet, Modbus, DNP3, etc.
  • Ability to construct PLC code from scratch and fully understand existing code including industrial PLC ladder logic and DDC visual logic
  • Ability to interpret mechanical and electrical drawings and specifications
  • Possess strong technical implementation background in DDC/PLC logic, Bacnet/Modbus configuration, ICT/networking and server administration
  • Experience working with a range of DDC, BMS and SCADA products and platforms such as Distech Controls, Johnson Controls, Schneider Electric, Honeywell, Moxa and so forth.
  • Familiarity with relevant codes and standards such as ASHRAE, BCA, AS.
  • Hands-on experience in plant optimisation and tuning
  • Strong computer and networking skills
  • Strong communicator with the ability to interact with all professional levels within an organisation
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Billings Consultant
job.description:
The Opportunity:

Join our Finance team as a Billing Consultant, where you’ll play a key role in resolving complex customer billing enquiries and disputes while delivering a high standard of customer service.

You’ll investigate billing issues from end to end — analysing invoices, contracts, pricing, account information and billing data to understand what has happened, determine the right outcome and communicate it clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

Working closely with Credit, Account Management, Service Delivery, Sales, suppliers and carriers, you’ll help resolve complex billing matters while identifying the root causes behind recurring issues and finding ways to prevent them happening again.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys solving problems, working with data and getting to the bottom of complex issues. You’ll also have the opportunity to improve processes, reporting and ways of working, including leveraging AI and modern technology to make billing resolution smarter and more efficient.

Based in our Sydney office, you’ll work across Macquarie Technology Group’s business and government customer base in a role where your work has a direct impact on customer experience and our NPS.

The Opportunity:

  • You’re highly detail-oriented and comfortable working through complex invoices, contracts, pricing and account information.

job.title: Senior Manager, Design Delivery
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1 billion in committed capital.

Our mission is to bridge the digital divide across Asia Pacific by building the sustainable digital ecosystems of the future. Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making digital infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical.

Founded in 2020 the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across China, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, and the Philippines.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Grit: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

  • *

We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Senior Design Delivery Manager with a strong electrical/mechanical engineering background to lead the design and delivery process for our data centre projects across the APAC region. This leadership role is responsible for managing the successful implementation of the overall design, with particular focus on mechanical systems such as HVAC, chilled water systems, and liquid cooling readiness.

The ideal candidate will work cross-functionally to ensure the electrical/mechanical design is integrated effectively into the full MEP design and executed in line with project objectives, quality standards, and schedule commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Electrical/Mechanical Design Leadership:

Drive the mechanical design development, including HVAC, cooling distribution systems, chilled water plants, and white space air management, ensuring alignment with performance, efficiency, and operational goals; Contribute to initializing cooling plant or various equipment standard operating procedures (SOPs) and producing clear, comprehensive technical advice to support technical review process across different manufacturers.

  • End-to-End Design Delivery:

Oversee the delivery of the full data centre design scope—from concept to IFC—ensuring technical quality, timely execution, and alignment with customer and business requirements.

  • Integrated Design Management:

Lead coordination across disciplines—mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, architectural, structural, and security—to ensure seamless integration of the design.

  • Consultant and Vendor Management:

Manage design consultants and key vendors, reviewing deliverables and resolving technical challenges to ensure compliance and constructability.

  • Design Assurance & Technical Reviews:

Conduct design reviews and risk assessments to validate that mechanical systems meet internal requirements, regulatory standards, and operational best practices.

  • Documentation & Standardization:

Maintain and improve internal design guidelines, technical specifications, and standard details to ensure consistency and quality across projects.

  • Construction & Commissioning Support:

Interface with construction and commissioning teams to ensure mechanical systems are installed and tested as per design intent. Review and validate the Sequence of Operations (SOO) during T&C.

  • Continuous Improvement:

Stay informed on industry trends and evolving cooling technologies (e.g. liquid cooling, hybrid solutions) to drive innovation and future-proof our designs.

  • Stakeholder Engagement:

Communicate design concepts, progress updates, and risks effectively with internal stakeholders, customers, and senior management.

  • Mentoring Process

Contributes to mentoring junior team members and supports the identification and development of training programs for new team members as the team grows.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

Candidate Profile:

**

  • Bachelor’s Degree in relevant Engineering studies or equivalent.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in electrical/mechanical system design and delivery, with at least 3 years in hyperscale or colocation data centres.
  • Strong knowledge of mechanical systems design, including HVAC, chilled water, free cooling, and white space environmental control.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, Excel, PowerPoint; Revit or BIM coordination experience is advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage consultants and lead design integration across disciplines.
  • Familiar with APAC regional design codes and international standards (ASHRAE, ISO, etc.).
  • Strong analytical, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license or equivalent certification is preferred.
  • Experience with liquid cooling or AI workload readiness is a plus.

If you’re passionate about driving innovative design solutions and want to help shape the future of digital infrastructure in Asia, we’d love to hear from you.

job.title: Finance Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

  • *

Reporting to the Financial Controller, the Finance Manager will be responsible for the day-to-day

financial controllership and accounting activities of the Malaysia business, ensuring accurate and timely

financial reporting, strong financial discipline and compliance with Group policies and local statutory

requirements. The role will work closely with the local operations, commercial and project teams as well

as Group Finance to support the continued growth and operation of Digital Edge's data centre platform

in Malaysia.

This is a hands-on in-country role covering financial close and reporting, statutory and tax compliance,

cash and working capital management, capex and fixed asset accounting, controls and audit support.

The Finance Manager will also help strengthen local finance processes as the business scales and

support the transition of new data centre projects from construction into operations.

This role will be based in Malaysia.

Key responsibilities

  • Manage the monthly, quarterly and annual financial close for the Malaysia entities, ensuring timely
  • and accurate reporting in accordance with Group timelines and accounting policies.
  • Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, accruals, prepayments, provisions and other key accounting schedules, and drive timely resolution of reconciling items.
  • Review the Malaysia trial balance, profit and loss and balance sheet, investigate significant or unusual movements and ensure issues are appropriately resolved or escalated.
  • Prepare local management reporting and supporting analysis, and provide clear explanations of
  • financial performance and key balance sheet movements.
  • Work closely with Group Finance on consolidation, reporting submissions and accounting matters requiring Group-level review or technical guidance.
  • Oversee accounting for data centre development and operating capex, including project cost tracking, construction-in-progress, capitalisation and fixed asset records.

The successful candidate:

Experience in data centres, infrastructure, real estate, telecommunications, utilities or another capital-intensive environment would be advantageous.

job.title: Warehouse Supervisor Thailand
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge DC (Digital Edge) is a leading data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. We seek to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve.

Through building and operating state-of-the-art, energy-efficient data centers rich with connectivity options, we bring new colocation and interconnect options to the Asian market, making infrastructure deployment in the region easy, efficient and economical. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed capital.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, with 30+ data centers in operations and under construction, and this role is an exciting opportunity to join the team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

  • Responsibility: We take ownership of our actions and outcomes.
  • Innovation: We embrace change and create bold solutions.
  • Strive: We show grit, resilience and relentless drive.
  • Excellence: We pursue the highest standards in all we do.
  • Respect: We act with integrity and treat others with dignity.

What we need:

Reporting to the Operations Support Manager, the Warehouse Specialist is responsible for managing warehouse operations and maintaining accurate inventory records to ensure the availability, integrity, and timely accessibility of critical spare parts, consumables, and operational assets that support Data Center Operations.

The role plays a key part in maintaining operational readiness by ensuring inventory is available to support service delivery, preventive maintenance, incident response, and business continuity, helping the organization meet service level commitments and operational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate inventory records and warehouse documentation for spare parts, consumables, tools, and operational assets.
  • Receive, inspect, store, and issue materials in accordance with established warehouse procedures.
  • Process inventory transactions, including receipts, issuances, transfers, returns, adjustments, and disposals.
  • Monitor inventory levels and maintain appropriate stock of critical spare parts to ensure operational readiness, timely incident response, and business continuity.
  • Coordinate with Operations, Facility and Procurement and Vendors to support inventory requirements.
  • Perform cycle counts, stocktakes, and inventory reconciliations, and investigate inventory discrepancies.
  • Prepare warehouse reports, Goods Receipt Notes (GRNs), and other inventory documentation.
  • Support asset tracking, internal and external audits, and inventory compliance activities.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized warehouse environment in compliance with company policies and HSSE requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes, inventory accuracy, and operational efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with inventory control procedures, company policies, and health & safety requirements

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Accounting, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Warehouse Operations, Inventory Control, Logistics, or Supply Chain, preferably in a critical facility, manufacturing, industrial, telecommunications, or data center environment.
  • Good understanding of warehouse operations, inventory control principles, and material handling practices.
  • Experience managing critical spare parts inventory and maintaining inventory accuracy.
  • Hands-on experience using ERP systems.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong analytical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good organizational, planning, and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple requests in a fast-paced operational environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively across Operations, Engineering, Procurement, and Project teams.
  • Basic understanding of ISO management systems and audit requirements is an advantage.
  • Basic English proficiency, both written and spoken.

If you are interested, please apply via LinkedIn or send your CV to me directly.

job.title: Project Manager

Outside Plant Operations

End-to-End Construction & Project Management

Underground Infrastructure Operations, Access & Asset Stewardship

  • Assume responsibility for operation, maintenance, access governance and infrastructure integrity.

  • Coordinate onsite access where works may affect telecommunications infrastructure; maintain access records and GIS/as-built information.
  • Safeguard infrastructure integrity and resolve operational disputes.

Commercial, Contractual & Stakeholder Negotiation

  • Lead technical, commercial and contractual negotiations with stakeholders.
  • Review ownership interfaces, cost-sharing arrangements, charges and commercial obligations.
  • Apply operational knowledge so contractual terms are practical and enforceable; work with Legal, Risk and Procurement on agreements and risk exposure.
  • Manage commercial commitments, billing and payment obligations; resolve disputes and recommend escalation where exposure is significant.

**

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor Degree in Civil, Electrical, Mechanical or related Engineering discipline
  • At least 3 years of relevant telecommunications, underground utility or infrastructure project experience
  • Outside Plant operations, maintenance and incident / restoration management.
  • Common / Utilities Service Duct feasibility, alignment planning, detailed design, underground-space optimisation and cost estimation.
  • Construction and project management covering scope, schedule, cost, quality, risk, contractor performance and close-out.
  • Underground infrastructure access governance, asset integrity, GIS / as-built information and third-party works coordination.
  • Technical, commercial and contractual negotiation, including claims, cost sharing, charges and commercial obligations.
  • Stakeholder coordination and negotiation; incident leadership; engineering judgement; dispute resolution.
  • Safety and operational compliance; contractor performance auditing; field inspection and risk assessment.
  • Tender requirements and evaluation participation.

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

Full time

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Iron Mountain is seeking a vision-driven Grid Connection Lead (Malaysia) to join our Data Center Operations team.

As our primary on-the-ground interface in Kuala Lumpur and Johor, you will drive high-voltage power delivery and navigate complex energy regulatory frameworks to secure crucial grid infrastructure for our expanding data center footprint. In this role, your technical leadership and local market insight will directly power our sustainable digital transformation and secure the foundational energy capacity our regional operations rely on.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

In this role, you will:

  • Stakeholder & Relationship Management: Build high-trust, face-to-face relationships with Malaysian utility authorities and task forces, including Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB) and the Data Center Task Force (DCTF), to gain early visibility into regulatory and grid developments.
  • Grid Connection & Power Delivery: Lead the operational lifecycle of high-voltage power delivery (including 275kV/132kV connections) and execute Electricity Supply Agreements (ESA) to meet target energization schedules.
  • Cross-Functional & Regional Coordination: Serve as the local generalist bridging Global Energy and Sustainability teams with local Design & Construction (D&C), project management, and site delivery teams.
  • Site Management & Mobility: Travel frequently between headquarters in Kuala Lumpur and the project site in Johor to monitor milestone readiness, align local dependencies, and coordinate with site leadership.
  • Risk & Lifecycle Management: Proactively identify potential grid, site, and easement delays while navigating local approval frameworks to prevent project slippage and commercial exposure.

What You’ll Bring (Skills & Qualifications)

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 8 to 10+ years of hands-on experience in high-voltage electrical assets or energy infrastructure development.
  • Deep background handling high-voltage electricity infrastructure within utility networks, renewable energy developers, rail/transit infrastructure, or data center developments.
  • Solid baseline understanding of high-voltage grid interconnections, substation requirements, and data center or industrial power architecture.
  • Proven relationship-first operational mindset in the Malaysian business environment, prioritizing consistent personal contact and local presence.
  • Bilingual fluency in both Bahasa Malaysia and English for seamless communication with local utility teams and global executive leadership.

What We Offer (Benefits)

  • Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (with frequent travel to Johor)
  • Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with experience.
  • Number of days - paid time off/ holidays
  • Flexible work options/alternative work options to support work–life balance.
  • Comprehensive health, wellness, and retirement plans.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Ready to power the infrastructure of tomorrow? Apply today to lead our energy expansion in Malaysia.

job.title: Specialist - Data Center Operations
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The role of Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for working with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.

This role designs, plans, installs, and / or maintains mechanical, electrical, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability data center environments.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Designs, plans, installs, and/or maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.
  • Works with all major systems within a facility or building such as electrical and HVAC systems and performs regular maintenance on all systems.
  • Ensures proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.
  • Evaluates facility standards and practices to improve maintenance procedures and ensure optimal operational efficiency.
  • Complies with organizational and governmental safety standards and coordinates response to emergency situations and ensures that corrective measures are rapid and thorough.
  • Participates in the planning and installation of new facility systems and may work with multiple components including HVAC systems, air or liquid cooling systems, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution units, fire systems, life safety systems, etc.
  • Repairs all systems and monitoring and troubleshooting systems as problems arise.
  • Coordinates with building administration to ensure common area services are properly provided to client and list services.
  • Manages the feedback, response and corrective action (if any) process to address any client feedback and concerns on all facility matters.
  • Assists in ensuring facility assets and installations are accounted for and monitored within the relevant policies and reporting procedures.
  • Completes work order requests accurately and on time and within budget.
  • May be required to order parts and supplies for maintenance and repairs.
  • Assist in scheduling and supervising vendors/subcontractors during equipment / systems maintenance and service.
  • Provides recommendation of improvements to the operations and maintenance program on an on-going basis.
  • Provides any other engineering activities as required by the Critical Facilities Operations and Maintenance management team.
  • Knowledge and Attributes:
  • Seasoned understanding of safe work practices, which are set by safety regulations and legislation.
  • Seasoned proficiency of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel and Outlook.
  • Seasoned knowledge of CMMS systems.
  • Seasoned knowledge of critical facilities operations and maintenance.
  • Seasoned knowledge of mechanical, electrical, and life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional working relationship with cross functional teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Demonstrates good analytical skills, having an ability to analyze, refine, summarize, and clearly present data and information.
  • Possesses passion for service, self-motivated, proactive by going beyond the call of duty and has an ability to handle multiple tasks.
  • Ability to prioritize and meet tight deadlines and is comfortable working in a fast-paced and constantly evolving environment.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering or related field Trade Certification or state license in Electrical or Mechanical (HVAC) Professional affiliations (7x24 Exchange, IFMA, Data Center Pulse, etc.)

  • Experience required:
  • Seasoned experience working in a similar engineering role, preferably a data center environment.
  • Seasoned experience in electrical, HVAC, mechanical, controls, or other technical engineering and maintenance field.
  • Seasoned experience interpreting blueprints/CAD drawings.
  • Seasoned experience in facilities / building maintenance.
  • Seasoned experience in designing, planning, installing and / or maintaining mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and other infrastructure systems in mission-critical, high-risk, or high-reliability environments such as data centers or utilities infrastructure.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior AI Engineer
job.description:

Design, modify, develop, write and implement software programming applications. Support and/or install software applications. Key participant in the testing process through test review and analysis, test witnessing and certification of software.

Key Responsibilities

Develop software solutions by studying information needs; conferring with users; studying systems flow, data usage and work processes; investigating problem areas; following the software development lifecycle; Document and demonstrate solutions; Develops flow charts, layouts and documentation Determine feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, solution development and proposed solutions; Understand business needs and know how to create the tools to manage them Prepare and install solutions by determining and designing system specifications, standards and programming Recommend state-of-the-art development tools, programming techniques and computing equipment; participate in educational opportunities; read professional publications; maintain personal networks; participate in professional organizations; remain passionate about great technologies, especially open source Provide information by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing development and issues while protecting IT assets by keeping information confidential; Improve applications by conducting systems analysis recommending changes in policies and procedures Define applications and their interfaces, allocate responsibilities to applications, understand solution deployment, and communicate requirements for interactions with solution context, define Nonfunctional Requirements (NFRs) Understands multiple architectures and how to apply architecture to solutions; understands programming and testing standards; understands industry standards for traditional and agile development Provide oversight and foster Built-In Quality and Team and Technical Agility; Adopt new mindsets and habits in how people approach their work while supporting decentralized decision making.

  • Competencies: Security & Compliance Principles - Applies standards, tools, and best practices to embed security, privacy, and compliance into the design/build/test/operate lifecycle for products, services, apps, systems, software, and configurations—balancing protection, efficiency, and cost.
  • Programming Principles - Applies programming languages, frameworks, and patterns to design, write, configure, test, and maintain software/solutions/systems that are efficient, secure, scalable, and reliable.
  • Data Principles - Governs, models, secures, implements, and observes data flows to ensure integrity, quality, and compliance—enabling trusted, scalable, cost-conscious data use.
  • Modern Development Practices - Applies modern engineering practices and tools—such as Agile/DevSecOps, CI/CD, automated testing, and infrastructure as code—to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and reduce risk across the SDLC.
  • Solution Design - Translate business requirements into integrated designs, architectures, patterns, and system interactions that deliver customer value and align with enterprise standards and subject-matter platforms.
  • Demonstrating Mastery - Maintains essential knowledge and proficiency in relevant domains, tools, technologies, methodologies, or frameworks through targeted credentials and rigorous proficiency, future-proofing organizational skills against strategic needs.
  • Strategic and Innovative Thinking - Evaluates business and technology trends, anticipates future needs, develops creative approaches, and frames innovations to shape strategy and create durable value with cost-aware innovation.

job.title: Structural and Dynamic Systems Engineer - Analytical
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position conducts numerical computations via third party and in-house tools to determine structural performance of components and systems. The results from the computer models are used to determine the validity of the design to meet the customer requirements. Design recommendations are then provided as needed.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product and system problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members Main focus is on the execution and improvement of established processes primarily documented in detailed local and global work instructions (EPs) that are required in Engineering Standard Work (ESW) and/or Design Validation Plans (DVP&R). This is accomplished through standard, as well as development of specialized computational tools and methods that are required to support the Design and Validation processes and enable high confidence decision making. Obtains input from Design, Thermal Sciences, Materials and Product Validation and delivers computer models and results for key structural performance parameters like motion, load, natural frequencies, stress, design margin, life, sound power to Design and Product Validation. Uses formal training like Statics, Dynamics, Machine Design, Mechanics of Materials, Failure Analysis, Engineering Materials and others along with tool specific training (ANSYS, FE-Safe, GT, AVL) to make Design decisions based on numerical predictions of structural performance of components and systems. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Applies Principles of Dynamics and Vibration - Determines motion of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates rigid and flexible body motion, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, velocities, accelerations, friction, and wear to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Fatigue and Durability - Determines life of components and systems via numerical modeling and/or physical measurements; evaluates component temperatures, natural frequencies, mode shapes, displacements, strains/stresses, wear, and fatigue life to draw conclusions that influence design decisions with internal and external customers.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Systems Modeling and Simulation - Identifies representation of a system or system element by using suitable analytical tools and techniques in order to derive knowledge about the real system; defines the strategy for modeling, simulation, and analysis of a system or system element by considering specifics of a given situation or nature of the system of interest in order to derive insights for making quality decisions.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Preferred candidates would also have a mix of experience using MS Office tools, Matlab, Python, APDL-ANSYS, FORTRAN or C programming, Windows/Linux operating systems, and desktop/remote high performance computing hardware systems.

  • Perform structural, dynamics and thermal finite element analysis (FEA) on mechanical components and systems in ANSYS Mechanical.
  • Interpret analysis results to identify risks and recommend design improvements.
  • Collaborate with design, testing, and manufacturing teams to ensure product reliability.
  • Document and present analysis methodologies, results, and recommendations in English.
  • Continuously learn and adopt new simulation techniques, tools, and industry best practices.

  • Bachelor’s / master’s degree in computer science, electronics or electrical engineering, or related field with 10-13 years of experience with expert level knowledge in programming with C++, particularly C++ 17 & CMake.
  • Intermediate level knowledge in programming with python.
  • Experience in Embedded Linux or Yocto based Linux distributions with solid understanding of concepts of bootloaders, kernel modules and cross compilation.
  • Experience working with Linux based software development environment including familiarity with Linux command line, file system hierarchy, and shell scripting.
  • Good understanding of computer networking basics such as DNS, DHCP, Proxies, Subnets etc.
  • Good knowledge in IoT protocols such as MQTT and networking protocols such as HTTP, TCP/IP and experience working with IOT devices.
  • Good understanding of cyber security best practices.
  • Excellent problem solving and debugging skills and Ability to mentor and lead fellow team members.

More about us :

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Solution and Tendering Manager, Cheonan
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Manager (본부장/상무)__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to adapt and implement sales support strategy using specific technical capability for the designated area in line with the global support strategy and focus on supporting configuration and quotation requirements. Each day, you will oversee estimations, bids, and proposals, ensuring alignment with ABB standards and targets. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring that inputs for editing activities related to bid, estimate, and quotation preparation are provided in a timely manner and in accordance with the established quality procedures.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid #LI-hybrid

This role is contributing to the Electrification Services Division in Cheonan, South Korea.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Formulating competitive bids, estimates, and quotations by considering the best available product mix and appropriate technical and commercial aspects for each situation.
  • Ensuring tenders are well-documented in a timely manner and with an appropriate level of detail, including full and accurate costs.
  • Leading and managing the planning and preparation of technical, financial, and, if required, project management aspects of the bid, estimate, and quotation, indicating prices and trading conditions.
  • Managing the collection and archival of documentation regarding the offer/order and recording of assumptions and decisions made during development; and ensuring the status of the bids, estimates, and quotations are reported regularly.

Qualifications for the role

  • Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in solution engineering, tendering, proposal management, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Strong technical understanding with the ability to analyze customer requirements and propose appropriate products, solutions, and technical specifications.
  • Solid experience in tendering, cost estimation, quotation, and proposal preparation.
  • Strong commercial mindset and financial acumen, with a good understanding of pricing and costs.
  • Proven experience in people management and team leadership.
  • Business-level proficiency in English (verbal and written) and fluency in Korean.

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Dynamics 365 Technical Architect
job.description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly evolving world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent handled company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. The Information Technology (IT) department has the global responsibility for the internal IT of Siemens Mobility. Its goal is to provide a robust and efficient IT landscape derived from business and market demands. Your personality and individuality make the difference. In our team, we increase business performance and point the way into the digital age. Is that exactly your thing? Then live your passion in a cross-location team in which you can actively craft the future of our company. You open up new possibilities for our customers with your competence. Connected with this is an exciting career path that leads you to ever new projects and solutions in the field of IT for Siemens Mobility.

We are looking for a Dynamics 365 Technical Architect

We are looking for a highly skilled Dynamics 365 Technical Architect to lead the design, development, integration, and technical governance of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and Power Platform solutions.

The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on expertise in Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement, Power Platform, Azure integrations, and application lifecycle management while being capable of guiding development teams, defining architecture standards, and engaging with business stakeholders

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Solution ArchitectureDesign scalable and secure Dynamics 365 solutions.
  • Define technical, integration, and deployment architecture.
  • Review solution designs and ensure adherence to agreed standards.

Technical Leadership
