  • Conduct architecture and code reviews.
  • Mentor team members and establish development best practices.

Development Oversight

  • Provide guidance on plugins, custom APIs, JavaScript, PCF controls, and Power Automate.
  • Ensure high-quality, maintainable, reusable, and supportable solutions.

Integration Architecture

  • Design integrations between Dynamics 365 and enterprise applications.
  • Define API-based, event-driven, synchronous, asynchronous, and batch integration patterns.

ALM and DevOps

  • Implement CI/CD pipelines.
  • Define branching and release strategies.
  • Support parallel development streams and controlled production releases.

Production Support

  • Troubleshoot critical issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis.
  • Drive performance, stability, and reliability improvements.

You’ll win us over by:

Must-Have Skills (Mandatory)

  • Dynamics 365 and Power PlatformDynamics 365 Customer Engagement, particularly Sales, Marketing & Project Operations
  • Microsoft Dataverse and model-driven apps
  • Power Automate and Power Platform solution management
  • Dynamics 365 security model

Technical Development

  • C# and.NET
  • Plugin development and custom APIs
  • JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Dynamics 365 Web API
  • Power Apps Component Framework controls (Good to Have)

Architecture and Design

  • Solution architecture and technical design
  • Dataverse data modelling
  • Non-functional requirements covering performance, scalability, security, and reliability

Integrations

  • REST APIs
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure Logic Apps
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Integration with enterprise applications

DevOps and ALM

  • Azure DevOps and Git
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Managed and unmanaged solutions
  • Release management and environment strategy

Leadership

  • Technical design reviews
  • Team mentoring
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Requirement analysis and estimation

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Functional KnowledgeDynamics 365 Project Operations
  • Dynamics 365 Field Service
  • Dynamics 365 Marketing or Customer Insights

Microsoft Ecosystem

  • Power BI
  • SharePoint integration
  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Copilot Studio
  • AI Builder

Enterprise Integration

  • SAP integration
  • ServiceNow integration
  • Azure API Management
  • Azure Event Grid

Architecture and Governance

  • Enterprise architecture frameworks such as TOGAF
  • Power Platform Center of Excellence
  • Security governance
  • Data governance

Industry Experience

  • Manufacturing
  • Mobility
  • Engineering
  • Professional services

Certifications

  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Solution Architect Expert
  • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.

Join us and be yourself!

We value your outstanding identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and build a better tomorrow with us.

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.

This role is based in Pune and is an Individual contributor role. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and encouragement and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: 研发项目经理
job.description:
加入西门子智能基础设施集团，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

西门子楼宇产品全球研发中心，位于高科技企业林立的北京市海淀区后厂村中关村1号地区，是西门子智能基础设施集团楼宇产品在亚太的研发中心，承担了智能楼宇产品全球研发任务。亚投行总部、水立方、国家速滑馆（冰丝带）、港珠澳大桥、上海环球金融中心、大兴国际机场等建筑里都使用了我们研发的产品。我们期待硬件研发岗位人才可以推动楼控领域发展。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

  • 理解并管理客户需求，控制项目范围、预算和开发周期
  • 与客户及项目团队成员进行周期性的有效沟通，与生产团队紧密合作以确保新产品顺利交付量产
  • 制定并维护更新详细项目工作计划以及项目预算；获取合适的资源并给项目成员分配清晰准确的工作内容和方向
  • 项目进行中的日常管理，按照项目计划监督项目成员的工作绩效、识别并解决项目中出现的问题。向管理层周期更新项目状态，做好项目会议记录及项问题记录
  • 评估项目风险，指定相应的应急相应计划。识别、评估并监督所有影响产品及项目质量的事项，确保满足所有要求的质量标准
  • 评估项目成员在项目全周期的表现并给予反馈。支持项目成员和组织的能力提升
  • 支持质量部门改善流程以便提高项目执行的效率
  • 在工作中帮助和培养其他Junior项目经理
  • 其它由研发项目经理交付的任务

你需要具备的品质：

  • 精通产品生命周期管理流程（或新产品开发管理）
  • 良好的沟通技巧，可以与内部及外部的客户已经项目成员有效沟通
  • 具备与项目管理相关的基本财务知识
  • 具备良好的中英文（口头及书面）沟通技巧
  • 本科，工程或者技术专业背景
  • 项目管理认证者优先
  • 量产产品的生产知识

你将得到这些收获：

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

为什么选择我们？

处于行业风口，职业前途广阔

在“2030碳达峰、2060碳中和”的国家战略下，楼宇已成为最重要的绿色低碳和可持续发展的实践场景。加入我们，你将和全球智能楼宇产品研发团队一道，持续站在行业风口，收获广阔的职业前途.

公司历史悠久，技术沉淀深厚

北京西门子楼宇产品全球研发中心成立至今，研发人员300+人，其中软件研发80+人，西门子全球技术专家4人，技术涉及工业物联网、自动化机器人、网络安全、数字孪生与仿真、数据分析和人工智能、智能楼宇、能源管理等高科技领域，员工职业发展前景广阔。

国际研发视野，完善项目流程

我们研发的产品主要服务于欧美市场和亚太六十余个国家和地区，你将主导中国本土核心技术平台并与海外团队协同配合，使用先进的开发流程，向全球客户高效、高质量地提供丰富的智能化产品。

培训资源丰富，工作生活平衡

我们向所有员工提供免费的海量网课资源，涵盖专业技能、语言、人际关系、领导力等多个门类。同时，我们还会定期安排内外部讲师授课。在这里，没有996，你可以在业余时间持续学习，充分发展自我。

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 “2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50” 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

job.title: Account Manager
job.description:
At Siemens, we’re continuing to grow - and we’re looking for an ambitious and customer-focused Territory Sales Manager to help us take our Medium Voltage business to the next level across Newcastle and the broader NSW market.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a global technology leader and play a key role in growing our presence across some of Australia’s most important and rapidly evolving industries, including Renewables, Water, Transportation, Data Centres and Resources.

You’ll take ownership of a high-potential territory, combining new business development with strategic account management to identify opportunities, build trusted customer relationships and deliver sustainable revenue growth.

You’ll represent Siemens’ market-leading Medium Voltage portfolio, including primary and secondary switchgear, ring main units up to 33kV, protection relays, Fusesaver, CMR overhead reclosing products and packaged electrical solutions.

Why Siemens?

At Siemens, we believe our people are at the heart of our success.

You’ll join a supportive, collaborative and rewarding environment where you’re encouraged to bring your ideas, develop your strengths and build a career that goes beyond your current role.

We place a strong focus on employee wellbeing, professional development and creating an environment where people can thrive. You’ll have access to training and development opportunities, exposure to a global organisation and the opportunity to work alongside talented people across different areas of the business.

Whether you want to deepen your industry expertise, broaden your commercial capabilities or progress into future leadership opportunities, we’ll support you in developing your career.

What you’ll do

  • Build and nurture long-term relationships with customers, consultants, EPCs and contractors, balancing new business acquisition with strategic account growth.
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities across Renewables, Water, Data Centres, Transportation and Resources.
  • Develop and maintain a strong sales pipeline, driving opportunities from initial engagement through to successful conversion.
  • Develop and execute 3–5 year strategic growth plans to expand Siemens’ market presence and pipeline across the territory.
  • Understand customer needs and develop tailored Siemens solutions across our Medium Voltage product and service portfolio.
  • Lead commercial and contract negotiations and work collaboratively with internal teams to deliver the right outcomes for customers.
  • Become a trusted point of contact for key customers, proactively addressing challenges and ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders across the infrastructure and industrial ecosystem.
  • Represent Siemens at industry events, seminars and roadshows, showcasing our technology and solutions.
  • Conduct face-to-face customer meetings, presentations and discussions to identify opportunities and drive adoption of Siemens solutions.
  • Provide market intelligence and regular updates to senior leadership on emerging opportunities, customer needs and competitive activity.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a commercially minded sales professional who is confident building relationships, opening doors and turning opportunities into results.

You’ll ideally bring:

  • 5+ years’ local sales experience within the Medium Voltage, electrical infrastructure or related industrial sector.
  • A strong understanding of the NSW industrial and infrastructure market. Experience across renewables, water, data centres, resources or major projects would be highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, new customer acquisition and account management.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to develop trusted, long-term partnerships with customers and industry stakeholders.
  • Experience with contract, commercial and tendering processes.
  • Strong negotiation, presentation and communication skills, with the confidence to engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • An understanding of relevant Australian Standards and statutory requirements within the electrical industry.
  • A proactive, results-driven approach and the ability to work collaboratively across a diverse organisation.

What we offer

At Siemens, your career and wellbeing matter.

You’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive salary and bonus scheme
  • A supportive, inclusive and collaborative workplace culture
  • Genuine opportunities for career development and progression
  • Comprehensive training and development programs supporting both professional and personal growth
  • Opportunities to work with global teams and industry-leading technology
  • A strong focus on employee wellbeing
  • Volunteer days to give back to the community
  • The opportunity to make a meaningful contribution to projects shaping Australia’s future infrastructure

Diversity & Inclusion

At Siemens, we believe that diversity makes us stronger.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, feel valued and have the opportunity to succeed. Our recruitment process is based on fair and balanced selection criteria, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and experiences. If you require any reasonable adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know.

job.title: Sales Manager Fire Suppression - Pan India
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solution.

Job Role -

Sales Manager – Fire Suppression will be responsible for driving the growth of the Fire Suppression business across India. The role will focus on Gas Suppression and High-Pressure Water Mist (HPWM) solutions across key market segments.

Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve Order Intake, Revenue and business growth targets.

Build strong relationships with key End Users, particularly in Data Centers and Industrial verticals.

Develop and maintain strong engagement with Consultants, EPCs, PMCs and System Integrators.

Leverage relationships with State Fire Departments and other key stakeholders.

Provide technical and application expertise on Fire Suppression systems, designs and relevant standards.

Identify new market opportunities, strategic projects and applications to expand the business geographically.

Develop partners and strengthen the Fire Suppression ecosystem across India.

The ideal candidate should be a go-getter with 15+ years of relevant experience, strong market relationships and a proven track record of building and growing project-based Fire Suppression business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Business Growth & Sales

o Develop and execute the national sales strategy for the Fire Suppression portfolio to achieve Order Intake and Revenue targets.

o Identify new market opportunities, applications and verticals to expand the Fire Suppression business.

o Develop a healthy sales funnel and ensure effective conversion of opportunities into orders.

o Drive business growth through direct engagement with end users, consultants, EPCs, system integrators and strategic partners.

o Identify and develop large projects in Data Centers, Industrial, Infrastructure, Transportation, Energy and other high-value segments.

  • End-User & Key Account Management

o Build and maintain strong relationships with key end users, especially in the Data Center and Industrial sectors.

o Develop strategic account plans for major customers and identify opportunities for specification and standardization of Siemens Fire Suppression solutions.

o Engage with decision makers at CXO, technical, project and procurement levels to create business opportunities.

  • Consultant & Stakeholder Engagement

o Establish strong relationships with Fire & Life Safety consultants, MEP consultants, EPCs and project management consultants.

o Drive product and system specifications with consultants and key influencers.

o Conduct technical presentations, solution workshops and product demonstrations.

o Develop relationships with government and infrastructure stakeholders including State Fire Departments to create opportunities and support project approvals/specifications.

  • Technical & Solution Knowledge

o Develop in-depth understanding of Fire Suppression systems, applications, design requirements and relevant codes/standards.

o Demonstrate strong technical knowledge of Gas Suppression systems and High-Pressure Water Mist solutions.

o Understand system architecture, hydraulic/design considerations, application suitability, equipment selection and project execution requirements.

o Work closely with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Product Management and HQ teams to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions.

  • Market & Competition

o Continuously monitor market trends, customer requirements, competitor activities and pricing dynamics.

o Develop strategies to improve Siemens' competitiveness and market penetration.

o Identify portfolio gaps and communicate market requirements to Product Management and HQ.

o Develop a clear understanding of competitors and their offerings in Gas Suppression and Water Mist markets.

  • Partner & Channel Development

o Identify, onboard and develop suitable Fire Suppression partners/System Integrators across key regions.

o Build partner capability through technical training, product training and joint customer engagement.

o Develop a scalable partner ecosystem to support national business growth.

o Monitor partner performance and develop corrective actions where required.

  • Project & Opportunity Management

o Drive strategic opportunities from lead generation through specification, tendering, negotiation and closure.

o Develop project strategies covering key stakeholders, competition, commercial positioning and win strategy.

o Ensure accurate opportunity management and funnel hygiene in Siemens Sales systems.

o Coordinate with internal stakeholders for pricing, technical support, approvals and project execution.

  • Business Development & Market Expansion

o Identify emerging applications for Fire Suppression, including Data Centers, BESS, Industrial facilities, tunnels, transportation, critical infrastructure and other high-risk applications.

o Expand the geographical footprint of the business by developing new customers, consultants and partners.

o Generate new business opportunities beyond the existing customer base and create a sustainable long-term growth pipeline.

  • Internal Collaboration

o Work closely with Regional Sales teams to drive execution of the national Fire Suppression strategy.

o Coordinate with Pre-Sales, Engineering, Operations, SCM, Finance, Product Management and HQ teams.

o Provide regular market intelligence, sales forecasts, funnel reviews and business updates to management.

Candidate Profile

  • Experience: 15 years of relevant experience in Fire Suppression / Fire & Life Safety / Building Safety solutions.
  • Strong experience in Gas Suppression and/or High-Pressure Water Mist systems; exposure to both portfolios will be preferred.
  • Strong technical understanding of Fire Suppression systems, design principles, applications, codes and standards.
  • Proven experience in selling complex project-based Fire Suppression solutions.
  • Strong existing network with Data Center and Industrial end users.
  • Experience working with consultants, EPCs, PMCs and system integrators.
  • Experience and established connect with relevant government/infrastructure stakeholders such as State Fire Departments will be highly valuable.
  • Strong commercial understanding, negotiation skills and ability to manage large strategic opportunities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Key Competencies

  • Strong hunter / business development mindset
  • Go-getter with a strong ownership mentality
  • Strategic account development
  • Consultative and solution selling
  • Technical & application knowledge
  • Strong networking and stakeholder management
  • Commercial and negotiation skills
  • Ability to influence consultants and end users
  • Strong execution orientation
  • Ability to work independently and build a business from the ground up Success Measures

The role will be measured on:

  • Fire Suppression Order Intake and Revenue growth
  • New customer and end-user acquisition
  • Data Center and Industrial business development
  • Strategic project wins
  • Sales funnel creation and conversion
  • Consultant/specification development
  • Partner development and productivity
  • Geographic expansion
  • Growth of Gas Suppression and HPWM businesses
  • Market share and competitive positioning

This role is based in Mumbai/ Gurgaon/ Thane where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries - and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about Smart Infrastructure at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/company/topic-areas/smart-infrastructure.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

job.title: Regional Manager Sales - West Region
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place - where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solution.

Role Overview

Siemens Smart Infrastructure is looking for an experienced Regional Manager – Sales to drive the Fire Safety business across the West Region. The role will be responsible for sales and business development of Fire Alarm Systems and Fire Suppression solutions through Channel Partners, Distributors and System Integrators. The candidate should have 15+ years of relevant experience with a proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing a team of 4–5 members. Strong relationships with MEP Consultants, Architects, EPCs and Key Customers are essential. Experience in growth verticals such as Data Centers, Healthcare, Pharma, Industries and Transportation will be preferred. The role requires strong leadership, strategic thinking, problem-solving and execution capabilities. The candidate should be passionate about business growth, customer engagement and developing channel partnerships. Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills and the ability to lead the team through challenging situations are key requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Regional Sales & Business Development
  • Develop and execute the regional sales strategy for Fire Alarm and Fire Suppression portfolios in line with Siemens' business objectives.
  • Own and deliver regional Order Intake, Revenue, profitability and growth targets.
  • Identify new business opportunities, markets, customers and applications to expand the regional footprint.
  • Develop and maintain a healthy sales funnel and ensure effective conversion of opportunities into orders.
  • Drive strategic initiatives to increase Siemens' market share across the region.
  • Lead negotiations with key customers, partners and stakeholders for strategic projects.
  • Channel & Partner Management
  • Develop, manage and strengthen relationships with Channel Partners, Distributors, System Integrators and Solution Partners.
  • Identify and onboard new partners in strategic geographies and market segments.
  • Develop partner capabilities through training, technical enablement and joint business development initiatives.
  • Establish clear partner strategies, targets and action plans for sustainable growth.
  • Ensure effective channel coverage across the West Region while minimizing channel conflicts.
  • Drive partner engagement for both Fire Alarm and Fire Suppression businesses.
  • Consultant & Key Customer Engagement
  • Build strong and long-term relationships with MEP Consultants, Architects, PMCs, EPCs, Developers and Key Customers.
  • Influence specifications and create preference for Siemens Fire Safety solutions.
  • Develop strategic relationships with key stakeholders involved in large infrastructure and industrial projects.
  • Lead engagement with decision-makers and influencers for major opportunities.
  • Represent Siemens in customer, consultant and industry forums.
  • Focus on Growth Verticals

Drive business development and strategic account penetration in high-growth segments such as:

  • Data Centers
  • Healthcare
  • Pharmaceutical
  • Industrial & Manufacturing
  • Transportation – Metro, Railways, Airports and Tunnels
  • Commercial & High-Rise Buildings
  • Infrastructure and other emerging verticals

Develop focused account and vertical strategies to identify and capture new business opportunities.

  • Team Leadership & People Development
  • Lead, coach and develop the regional sales team to achieve business objectives.
  • Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer centricity and execution.
  • Set clear objectives and priorities for team members and monitor performance.
  • Develop the team's sales, technical and business development capabilities.
  • Demonstrate strong leadership during challenging business situations and provide direction to the team.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders across Sales, Presales, Project Management, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain and Headquarters.
  • Strategic Planning & Market Development
  • Analyze market trends, competition, customer requirements and emerging technologies to identify growth opportunities.
  • Develop strategic plans to address market gaps and improve Siemens' competitive position.
  • Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, channel movements and market dynamics.
  • Develop long-term strategies for geographical and vertical expansion.
  • Translate market intelligence into actionable business initiatives.
  • Opportunity & Sales Governance
  • Ensure disciplined opportunity management and accurate sales forecasting.
  • Review regional sales funnel, pipeline coverage, order intake and revenue performance.
  • Drive timely closure of key opportunities and remove execution bottlenecks.
  • Maintain high-quality sales data and ensure compliance with Siemens sales processes and governance requirements.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with the sales team and channel partners.

Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be a high-energy sales leader with a strong track record of business growth and team leadership.

Experience

  • Minimum 15+ years of relevant experience in Fire & Life Safety, Building Technologies, Building Automation, Electrical/MEP, Industrial Automation or a related industry.
  • Strong experience in selling Fire Alarm Systems and/or Fire Suppression solutions.
  • Proven experience in managing Channel Partners, Distributors, System Integrators and Solution Partners.
  • Prior experience managing and leading a team of approximately 4–5 sales professionals.
  • Experience in developing large project businesses and strategic accounts is highly desirable.

Market & Customer Network

  • Strong established relationships with MEP Consultants, Architects, PMCs, EPCs, Developers and Key Customers.
  • Good understanding of the Fire Safety market, competitive landscape and channel ecosystem.
  • Strong network across key accounts and growth verticals such as Data Centers, Healthcare, Pharma, Industries and Transportation.

Key Competencies

  • Sales Leadership & Business Acumen
  • Business Development & Market Expansion
  • Channel & Partner Management
  • Strategic Account Management
  • Customer & Consultant Relationship Management
  • People Leadership & Team Development
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
  • Negotiation & Influencing Skills
  • Strong Execution Orientation
  • Commercial Acumen
  • Resilience and Leadership in Challenging Situations

Leadership Expectations

The successful candidate should be someone who:

  • Has a demonstrated track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Is passionate about driving sales, business growth and market development.
  • Takes ownership and demonstrates a strong bias for action and execution.
  • Can navigate complex and challenging business situations with maturity and confidence.
  • Acts as a problem solver, bringing practical and commercially viable solutions.
  • Can think strategically while maintaining strong focus on execution.
  • Inspires and develops the team to deliver high performance.
  • Builds trusted relationships with customers, consultants, partners and internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates integrity, accountability and a strong customer-centric approach.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • MBA/PGDM in Sales/Marketing or Business Management would be an advantage.

Success in the Role

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Regional Order Intake and Revenue growth
  • Achievement of sales and profitability targets
  • Growth in Fire Alarm and Fire Suppression business
  • Channel partner productivity and expansion
  • New customer and account acquisition
  • Growth in strategic verticals

job.title: Critical Environment Technician Intern
job.description:
Overview

Join Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) team – the engine behind our global cloud services. As a Critical Environment Technician Intern, you’ll play a vital role in supporting the infrastructure that powers products like Microsoft Azure, Office 365, Xbox, and OneDrive.

At Microsoft, we live our values by fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. This internship offers hands-on experience, professional growth opportunities, and access to training programs.

Our global network includes hundreds of datacenters and millions of servers serving over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in more than 90 countries. Sustainability and operational excellence are at the heart of everything we do, and we’re looking for passionate individuals to help us deliver world-class cloud solutions.

Ready to make an impact? Join us and be part of the team that empowers billions worldwide.

Responsibilities

As a CET Intern, you will:

  • Work onsite at our datacenters in Melbourne.
  • Carry out basic operational tasks such as site rounds, recording observations, and taking measurements under supervision.
  • Learn to operate critical systems safely and professionally, with the opportunity to earn your Microsoft CET Level 1 certification.
  • Monitor and inspect facility equipment (HVAC, electrical, mechanical, fire/life safety systems) and report abnormal conditions.
  • Use our Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS) to track assets and manage work orders.
  • Assist with emergency monitoring and response following established procedures.
  • Support incident investigations by gathering data and contributing to root-cause analysis.
  • Participate in planned, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities, including preparing materials and administrative tasks.
  • Collaborate with senior technicians to troubleshoot complex systems.
  • Document maintenance and troubleshooting activities and escalate issues as needed.
  • Contribute to developing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for safe operations.
  • Conduct technical research on relevant topics to enhance your knowledge.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • You need to be an Australian National or, have residency and you must be eligible to work in Australia.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Completed or studying towards a qualification in Facilities Management, Mechanical, Electrical engineering or related qualification.
  • Electrical or mechanical engineer diploma level 2
  • Ability to support frequent standing, walking, lifting, and working at heights with or without equipment assistance.
  • Able to communicate effectively with multiple stakeholders.
  • Proficient in written and oral English communication to support regional and global teams.
  • Desire to learn, grow, and develop new technical skills.
  • Flexibility to work non-standard business hours that may include weekends and/or holidays.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. job.description:

How you will do it:

  • Serve as the regional champion for digitally enabled marketing programs, including SEO, paid media, marketing automation, social media, webinars, events, account-based marketing, and lead nurturing.
  • Partner with regional general managers, commercial leaders, in-country leaders to deliver impactful campaigns that deliver results along all stages of the customer lifecycle and drive demand across all channels to market including build and execute integrated go-to-market plans that drive awareness, pipeline, revenue growth, and customer retention.
  • Develop localized campaigns that translate global value propositions into market-relevant programs aligned to business, customer, and industry priorities.
  • Lead and develop a team of APAC-based marketing professionals.
  • Build and execute marketing programs that support the full customer lifecycle, including demand creation, lead generation, lead conversion, customer expansion, and account growth.
  • Collaborate with direct sales teams and channel partners to improve lead quality, lead management, pipeline progression, and revenue conversion.
  • Drive account-based marketing strategies for strategic accounts and priority customer segments.
  • Define and execute regional event strategies including virtual events, webinars, tradeshows, partner events, proprietary events, and networking activities.
  • Partner with channel leaders to develop partner marketing, co-marketing, and enablement programs that accelerate demand generation and business growth through distributors, resellers and other channel partners.

  • Report out regularly on KPIs, results and progress related to each stage of funnel.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience leading teams and initiatives around digital marketing.
  • Deep understanding of demand generation disciplines including lead scoring, lead nurturing, MQL/SQL management, funnel optimization, CRM systems, in a distributed, multi-line of business environment.
  • Experience supporting both direct sales organizations and indirect/channel partner business models.
  • Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, campaign execution, account-based marketing, and customer lifecycle marketing.
  • Proven ability to develop and execute marketing programs that drive measurable pipeline, revenue growth, and customer engagement.
  • Excellent analytical and interpersonal skills and presents convincingly to peers, executives, partners, and customers.
  • Exceptional leadership and stakeholder management capabilities within a matrixed global organization.
  • Strong project and budget management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and workstreams simultaneously.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to translate complex concepts into actionable business recommendations.
  • Effective relationship builder with experience leading geographically distributed teams.
  • Willingness to travel.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent).
  • Experience working across the APAC region and managing multi-country marketing programs.
  • Experience with channel marketing, partner ecosystem development, and account-based marketing in a B2B environment.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Labour Compliance Executive
job.description:
Labour Compliance Executive (Contractual)

Johnson Controls is looking for a Labour Compliance Executive to support project compliance and subcontractor compliance activities across customer assignments. In this role, you will help prepare, submit, track, and close compliance documentation while working closely with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams.

Role Overview

You will be responsible for managing statutory and project-related compliance documentation end to end. The role combines customer coordination, subcontractor guidance, document control, audit support, and follow-up on remarks and approvals to help ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.

Key Responsibilities

  • Arrange initial calls or meetings with customers to understand their compliance process requirements and gather information on document submissions.
  • Prepare and provide compliance documents as per customer requests.
  • Ensure timely preparation, submission, and maintenance of all required compliance documents, both online and offline, in line with regulatory guidelines and internal policies.
  • Track customer remarks on submitted compliance documents and coordinate the required corrections or responses.
  • Obtain audit reports related to compliance submissions from the customer site and maintain the related records.
  • Conduct introductory calls with subcontractors to explain the billing process and compliance expectations.
  • Guide subcontractors in accordance with JCI HR SOP and customer requirements.
  • Review subcontractor compliance documents against the checklist and identify gaps or non-compliance.
  • Coordinate with the JCI Project Team, SCM Team, and subcontractors to address non-compliance and drive closure.
  • Obtain Compliance Manager approval for reviewed compliance documents and share the approved status with the subcontractor.
  • Support BOCW, CLRA, and ISMW related licenses and returns.
  • Maintain knowledge of minimum wages, labour laws, PF, ESIC, PT, LWF, and related compliance requirements.
  • Support implementation of the new wage code for subcontractors and vendors.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership from intake to closure, keeping every compliance case accurate, traceable, and submitted on time.
  • Stay close to the work by clarifying requirements directly with customers and subcontractors before issues become delays.
  • Work with discipline and attention to detail when handling checklists, registers, remarks, approvals, and audit records.

job.title: BMS Technician
job.description:
Join the Global Leader in Smart Buildings

**

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. For over 140 years, we've partnered with some of the world's most recognised organisations to deliver advanced building automation, energy efficiency, and critical infrastructure solutions across data centres, healthcare, pharmaceutical, education, and commercial sectors.

Our technology powers some of Australia's most complex and high-profile facilities, and we're continuing to invest in our people, our customers, and the future of building automation.

If you're an experienced BMS Technician looking to work with industry-leading technology, challenging projects, and a company that genuinely invests in career development, we'd love to speak with you.

Why Experienced BMS Professionals Choose Johnson Controls

Johnson Controls offers the opportunity to broaden your technical expertise while working on some of the most sophisticated building management systems in the market.

You'll be supported by a highly experienced engineering and technical team, gain exposure to diverse customer environments, and have genuine opportunities to progress into senior technical, engineering, project delivery, or leadership positions.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package + fully maintained company vehicle
  • Overtime opportunities and additional earning potential
  • Work-life balance with flexible work arrangements
  • Ongoing technical training and certification programs
  • Access to specialist local and global engineering support
  • Exposure to complex and mission-critical facilities
  • Career pathways into Engineering, Projects, Commissioning and Leadership
  • Stability and long-term career growth with a global market leader

About the Role

Due to continued growth across Victoria, we're seeking a skilled BMS Technician to join our Melbourne Service Team.

This role will see you working across a portfolio of commercial buildings, healthcare facilities, critical infrastructure, industrial sites, and other complex customer environments. You'll be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, optimising, and supporting Building Management Systems that play a critical role in our customers' operations.

You'll enjoy a high level of autonomy while being backed by one of the strongest technical support networks in the industry.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service, maintain and troubleshoot Building Management Systems (BMS) and HVAC control systems
  • Deliver small/medium projects
  • Diagnose and resolve system, network and communication faults
  • Deliver preventive maintenance and reactive service activities
  • Optimise system performance and identify improvement opportunities
  • Support minor upgrades, retrofits and enhancement projects
  • Commission and validate control system modifications
  • Develop trusted customer relationships through exceptional technical service
  • Adhere to all safety, quality and compliance requirements

What We're Looking For

We're interested in hearing from technicians who have experience working within Building Automation, Building Controls, HVAC Controls, Electrical Controls, or related industries.

Ideally You Will Have

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in Building Management Systems or Building Automation
  • Experience with BMS platforms such as Metasys, Siemens, Schneider Electric, Delta Controls, Alerton, Tridium Niagara, Honeywell, Distech, Schneider EcoStruxure or similar systems
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC systems and mechanical services
  • Electrical Disconnect/Reconnect Licence (or equivalent)
  • Experience with IP networking, communications protocols, and system integration
  • Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills
  • Excellent customer engagement and communication skills
  • Commitment to safety and continuous improvement
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence

Build a Long-Term Career with Johnson Controls

Many of our leaders, engineers, and technical specialists started their careers in field service. We actively promote from within and provide clear pathways for career progression.

If you're looking for more complex systems, better career opportunities, stronger technical support, and the backing of a global organisation that values its people, this is an excellent opportunity to take the next step in your career.

Only applicants with Australian working rights will be considered.

Pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, form part of our recruitment process.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to succeed.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Title:Engineering Manager

Overview: Johnson Controls is seeking an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the design, development, delivery, and ongoing support of a .NET-based web application. This role will provide both people leadership and technical direction for a team of software engineers, partnering closely with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, high-quality digital capabilities. The Engineering Manager will be accountable for team performance, engineering execution, technical standards, delivery commitments, and continuous improvement across the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, RESTful APIs, Azure platforms, modern web application architecture, Agile delivery, and a proven ability to mentor engineers, manage priorities, resolve technical risks, and align engineering outcomes with business goals.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing engineering team responsible for building, enhancing, and supporting the application.
  • Own engineering execution across the software development lifecycle, including solution design, development, code quality, testing, release readiness, deployment, support, and production stability.
  • Provide technical direction for application architecture, development, RESTful APIs, integrations, database design, security, scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, and business stakeholders to translate business priorities into clear technical plans and delivery milestones.
  • Drive engineering best practices, including clean code, design patterns, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, source control, observability, documentation, and secure development standards.
  • Manage delivery commitments, sprint or release planning, dependency resolution, risk mitigation, resource allocation, and workload balancing for the engineering team.
  • Review technical designs and implementation approaches to ensure solutions are maintainable, extensible, performant, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards.
  • Support troubleshooting of complex application issues, production incidents, performance bottlenecks, integration failures, and quality defects.
  • Coach engineers through regular feedback, career development conversations, goal setting, performance reviews, skills development, and succession planning.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, team planning, vendor coordination, and capability building to ensure the team has the right skills and capacity to meet delivery objectives.
  • Promote a collaborative, accountable, inclusive, and continuous improvement-oriented engineering culture focused on customer value and operational excellence.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering, including hands-on development of enterprise web applications using Microsoft technologies.
  • 3+ years of experience leading, mentoring, or managing software engineering teams, including performance management, delivery ownership, and technical guidance.
  • Strong proficiency with .NET framework and Azure platform, RESTful services, object-oriented programming, design patterns, and asynchronous programming.
  • Experience designing, developing, and operating scalable, secure, maintainable web applications and backend services in a modern enterprise environment.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL Server or other relational databases, including data modeling, query optimization, stored procedures, and application data access patterns.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure, including services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure SQL, storage, identity, monitoring, or related platform capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines, Git-based source control, branching strategies, automated testing, build and release practices, DevOps tooling, and application monitoring.
  • Ability to review architecture and code, guide technical decision-making, address technical debt, and ensure engineering standards are consistently applied.
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments with Product Owners, Architects, QA, UX, DevOps, security, operations, vendors, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, prioritization, problem-solving, coaching, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Preferred qualifications include Microsoft Azure or .NET certifications, experience with microservices, containerization, frontend frameworks such as Angular, React, or Blazor, and ecommerce or B2B web application experience.

Join us and make a difference.

job.title: Staff Engineer, NPI Process Engineer
job.description:
82562

Location:

Suzhou, Jiangsu, China

In our “always on” world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

Based in Suzhou, China, the Staff Engineer, NPI Process Engineer supports the development and implementation of manufacturing processes for new products. Working within the New Product Introduction team, you will collaborate with design, manufacturing, quality, and other cross-functional teams to improve product manufacturability and support an effective transition from product concept and prototyping to production.

How You'll Help Us Connect the World

You will support new product introductions by developing scalable manufacturing processes, providing Design for Manufacturing input, and resolving process-related issues during prototyping and production preparation. Your contributions will help enable timely product launches, improve manufacturing efficiency and yield, and ensure that process documentation remains accurate and complete.

  • Collaborate with design engineers and manufacturing teams to develop scalable manufacturing processes for new products.
  • Provide Design for Manufacturing (DFM) input to improve product manufacturability, production efficiency, quality, and process reliability.
  • Support prototype builds, engineering trials, and pilot production activities by identifying process risks and coordinating practical solutions.
  • Analyze manufacturing process issues using structured problem-solving methods and support the implementation of corrective and preventive actions.
  • Participate in continuous improvement activities to enhance process capability, efficiency, yield, and production readiness.
  • Create and maintain accurate process documentation, including work instructions, process specifications, process flow documents, and relevant manufacturing records.
  • Support NPI project activities and help coordinate the transition of new products from concept and prototype stages into production.
  • Communicate technical information clearly and work collaboratively with cross-functional stakeholders to support project objectives.

Required Qualifications for Consideration

  • A bachelor’s degree in engineering or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of related experience in manufacturing engineering, process engineering, new product introduction, or a comparable technical field.
  • Working knowledge of manufacturing processes and Design for Manufacturing principles.
  • Experience supporting prototype builds, process development, production introduction, or manufacturing process improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze technical or manufacturing problems and contribute to practical, data-informed solutions.
  • Ability to prepare and maintain clear manufacturing or engineering documentation.
  • Ability to communicate technical information and collaborate effectively with colleagues from different functions and backgrounds.

You Will Excite Us If You Have

  • Experience supporting NPI projects in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience with structured problem-solving or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Knowledge of process capability, yield improvement, risk assessment, or manufacturing validation.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams, including design engineering, manufacturing, quality, operations, or supply chain.
  • Familiarity with tools or methods such as DFM, PFMEA, process flow development, control plans, root cause analysis, or statistical process control.
  • Experience supporting the transfer or scale-up of products and processes into volume production.
  • The ability to communicate in English and Chinese in a technical working environment.

We recognize that experience can be gained through different professional and educational pathways. If your experience is relevant to the role but does not align with every preferred qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

What Happens After You Apply

Learn how to prepare yourself for the next steps in our hiring process by visiting https://jobs.commscope.com/content/How-We-Hire/?locale=en_US

Why CommScope?

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn. Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables groundbreaking discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere. With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.

If you want to grow your career alongside forward-thinking, hardworking, and caring people who strive to create what’s next, come connect to your future at CommScope.

CommScope is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans. If you are seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process, please contact us to submit your request at talentacquisition@commscope.com.

job.title: O&M - Wind - Performance/Diagnostics
job.description:
Performance Monitoring & Analytics

  • Monitor WTG Availability, Fleet Availability, Generation Performance, and Productivity KPIs against targets.
  • Perform daily, weekly, and monthly fleet performance analysis using SCADA and operational data.
  • Identify generation losses due to turbine faults, deration, yaw misalignment, blade degradation, pitch issues, and operational inefficiencies.
  • Monitor underperforming WTGs and recommend corrective actions.
  • Develop performance dashboards, reports, and management MIS for fleet review.
  • Benchmark fleet, turbine models, sites, and OEM performance.

Diagnostics & Failure Analysis

  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for major failures and repetitive breakdowns.
  • Analyze turbine alarms, fault logs, event histories, and SCADA trends.
  • Review blade, gearbox, generator, pitch, yaw, converter, hydraulic, and main bearing performance data.
  • Identify early warning signs of equipment deterioration and failure.
  • Support closure and validation of OEM diagnostic findings.
  • Develop diagnostic frameworks and standard methodologies for fleet-wide application.

Reliability & Condition Monitoring

  • Monitor condition monitoring systems (CMS) and health indicators.
  • Track equipment reliability KPIs including MTBF, MTTR, failure frequency, and recurring defects.
  • Identify bad actors and reliability concerns across the fleet.
  • Support predictive maintenance and condition-based maintenance initiatives.
  • Maintain failure databases and reliability performance records.

Fleet Improvement Initiatives

  • Drive generation enhancement and availability improvement programs.
  • Identify and quantify performance loss opportunities.
  • Support implementation of engineering modifications and retrofit recommendations.
  • Track effectiveness of corrective actions and improvements implemented across the fleet.
  • Facilitate knowledge sharing and replication of best practices across sites.

Technology & Data Analytics

  • Drive implementation of advanced analytics and digital diagnostic tools.
  • Develop automated dashboards and visualization tools using Power BI and analytics platforms.
  • Support AI/ML based predictive maintenance initiatives.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and integrity across SCADA and monitoring systems.
  • Evaluate new technologies and proof-of-concepts related to turbine diagnostics and performance improvement.

Audits & Governance

  • Support fleet performance audits and technical assessments.
  • Track closure of performance-related observations and action items.
  • Maintain documentation of RCAs, diagnostic reports, and performance studies.
  • Ensure adherence to internal performance monitoring and reporting standards

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

B.E./B.Tech/Diploma - Electrical or Electronics or relevant to Energy Sector

MBA - Advantageous

Work Experience:

6-8 years of experience ( If Diploma holder: additional 2-3 Y Exp. req.)

job.title: Senior Manager, Pre-Sales, Managed Roaming
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help shape global roaming and travel connectivity solutions, bringing together deep telecommunications expertise, solution architecture and customer engagement to accelerate new opportunities from concept to launch.

##

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Senior Manager, Pre-Sales, Managed Roaming , you will lead the Managed Roaming (MR) Pre-Sales function, translating customer business and technical requirements into scalable, secure and commercially viable solutions.

You will partner closely with MR Business/Sales, Product, Network, IT/MVNE, Operations and vendors from customer discovery and solution design through proposal, technical validation and onboarding handover, helping accelerate revenue growth and time-to-launch.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and coach the MR Pre-Sales team, setting solutioning standards, priorities, quality controls and capability development.
  • Partner with MR Business/Sales to qualify opportunities, conduct customer discovery and shape requirements ahead of RFI/RFP engagements.
  • Own end-to-end solution architecture for Managed Roaming, MRaaS and related global travel connectivity offerings.
  • Lead technical RFI/RFP/RFQ responses, proposals, solution designs, customer workshops, demonstrations, PoCs/UAT and technical due diligence.
  • Act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, resolving technical objections and solution trade-offs to support complex deal closure.
  • Coordinate across Product, Network, IT/MVNE, Security, Operations and vendors to validate solution feasibility, dependencies, effort, cost inputs and delivery plans.
  • Support business cases and commercial proposals through technical sizing, costing, risk assessment and service-impact considerations.
  • Ensure structured handover to onboarding and Operations teams with clear requirements, acceptance criteria, ownership and operational readiness.
  • Translate customer and market feedback into reusable solution modules, automation opportunities and product/platform roadmap enhancements.
  • Track Pre-Sales effectiveness and capacity and represent Managed Roaming in key customer and industry engagements.
  • Travel internationally as required to support customer, partner and industry engagements.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Telecommunications, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of telecommunications experience, including at least 5 years in Pre-Sales, Solution Engineering or Technical Sales.
  • Strong experience in international roaming, together with team and solution leadership experience.
  • Strong knowledge of 4G/5G roaming architecture and interfaces, including SS7, Diameter, GTP, IPX, IMS, VoLTE/VoNR, eSIM and IMSI.
  • Strong solution architecture capabilities across provisioning, charging/billing, APIs and MVNE/cloud platforms.
  • Experience leading RFI/RFP/SoW responses, proposals, workshops, demonstrations, PoCs/UAT and technical objection handling.
  • Experience in technical sizing, costing and business case support.
  • Strong people leadership and consultative customer engagement capabilities.
  • Strong executive communication, structured problem-solving and stakeholder influencing skills.
  • Able to prioritise effectively and collaborate across global and cross-cultural teams.
  • Good understanding of the global roaming ecosystem and partner/vendor management.
  • Experience with onboarding, operational handover and service assurance.
  • Awareness of relevant regulatory, KYC and privacy requirements.
  • Willing and able to travel internationally when required.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: 供应商质量工程师 - 技术专员
job.description:
工作总结:

供应商质量工程师 - 技术专员将其产品特定质量和技术技能集中在发展能够满足客户要求的复杂供应商和产品上；需要与外部供应基地、供应链团队和工程部门建立牢固的合作伙伴关系，以取得成果。

主要责任:

与所有关键合作伙伴建立牢固的关系，以改善质量和业务成果，包括外部供应商、外部客户、内部客户和利益相关方，如采购、制造和工程；辅导和指导康明斯专业人员如何加强发展有效关系所需的软技能。

支持外部供应基础战略的跨职能发展以及任何给定组件的跨职能供应商选择流程；经验和技能将用于支持日益复杂的产品。

为外部供应商提供制造咨询，以便设计一次成功制造流程，使其符合工程打印、工程标准和客户特定要求；经验和技能将用于支持日益复杂的产品。

应用行业通用的先期产品质量计划 (APQP) 流程、汽车工业行动组织 (AIAG) 工具和康明斯专业工具，以在外部供应基地内开发零缺陷组件；就如何提高先期产品质量计划执行效率对供应商和康明斯专业人员进行辅导和指导；经验和技能将用于支持日益复杂的产品。

通过领导复杂产品和处理重点项目，利用行业成熟的方法，如精益和六西格玛，实现外部供应基地的持续改进。

进行外部供应商审计，以支持供应商风险缓解、供应商准备和供应商绩效改进；辅导和指导康明斯专业人员如何提高审计效率。

领导外部供应基地中日益复杂的质量改进计划，以提高供应商绩效。

通过领导根本原因分析，支持制定纠正措施并验证纠正措施的有效性，确保解决日益复杂的外部供应商相关质量挑战；辅导和指导供应商和康明斯专业人员如何提高问题解决的有效性。

具有铸铝件、铸铁件品类供应商管理经验8年以上，懂铸造工艺、机加工工艺、测量技术等，主观能动性强、善于运用逻辑思维解决问题，精通汽车业5大质量工具。

技能:

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

审计 - 运用审计技能和技巧以及质量管理体系知识，有效评估制造流程的质量和安全风险及不合格项。

解释技术要求 - 运用几何尺寸和公差原理以及工程标准知识，正确解释工程图纸的技术要求；运用知识改进产品的可制造性和可测量性设计。

制造工艺设计 - 运用制造技术知识（方法、技术、工具、设备等）设计零缺陷制造流程，以始终满足技术和客户要求。

制造工艺验证 - 运用核心汽车工具（即 DFMEA、PFMEA、控制计划、SPC、测量系统分析、来源发布和生产零件审批流程）验证制造流程是否能够始终如一地满足技术和客户要求。

测量过程设计 - 运用几何尺寸和公差原理知识和测量技术（标准、技术、设备等）知识，设计出能够始终如一地满足行业和客户要求的测量系统。

解决问题 - 通过利用行业标准方法来创建问题可追溯性并保护客户，使用系统分析流程解决问题，并可以指导他人有效解决问题；确定可指定的原因；实施完善、基于数据的解决方案；识别系统性根源并采取建议措施防止问题再次发生。

质量影响 - 能够识别利益相关方，创建一个论坛，以专业地提取利益相关方的观点，推动和参与建设性的冲突，并影响结果，以确保康明斯做出包含质量优先事项的平衡决策。

质量标准 - 运用 ISO9001:2015 和 IATF16949 等质量标准知识，以符合监管要求的方式开发程序、流程和外部供应商。

统计基础 - 运用统计工具和技术来影响决策；利用对数据收集方法、关键统计、图形和分析方法的理解来描述流程绩效、获得洞察和推动改进行动

供应商绩效改进 - 通过制定和执行有效的质量改进战略来提高供应商绩效，该战略包括项目团队、降低路径、减少制造问题和改善系统性缺陷。

供应商质量项目规划和执行 - 运用先期产品质量计划 （APQP） 技能来制定和执行质量计划，使外部供应商能够满足客户期望；当计划、举措或项目涉及外部供应商时，需要促进跨职能活动的沟通和协作。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

供应商产品可靠性 - 能够评估供应商的产品设计、供应商的制造工艺设计和产品验证流程，以确保供应商能够满足可靠性期望。

教育,资格,认证:

要求具有工程学或相关技术或科学专业的专科、本科或同等学历。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

最好在汽车行业或类似监管行业中担任制造或工程职务 7 年。

100% On-Site No

As Cummins continues to grow, you'll be provided with continuous learning opportunities, supportive benefits and a culture that values your wellbeing, safety and work-life balance. Here, you'll have the power to determine your future with innovative technology, a focus on sustainability and with a company positioned for long-term growth.

job.title: Specialist, Lead (Revenue) Generation
job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The Role:

We are looking for a Specialist, Lead (Revenue) Generation to make an impact!

What will you do?

  • Manage leads from sources (i.e. inbound, marketing, campaigns), involving profiling, qualifying and converting of leads to opportunities through inbound and outbound calls.
  • Identify, manage, close or pass opportunities – follow up on leads, quotes, service and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Monitor accounts and opportunities passed to sales and partners to ensure timely follow-up till closure.
  • Establish strong collaboration with Sales & Marketing organization especially sales and channel teams to ensure quality leads and clarity routing matrix for prompt actions.
  • Execute lead processing and routing for Sales- and Partner-covered accounts per the Coverage and Engagement Governance (CEG) rules. Where appropriate (per CEG), work to complete customer transactional needs by directing them to the appropriate fulfillment channel(s).
  • Support Sales Growth and capture market share of the company products and services through targeted sales programs, events and campaigns.
  • Work closely with peers of other Business Units, Operational Marketing Leaders, Marketing Teams and CCC to further align and maximize the overall leads and opportunity management efficiencies.
  • Manage reporting on performance & operational KPIs and presentation of business review.
  • Present Leads performance & opportunities in Marcom and BU regular cadence meetings.
  • Carry out other related tasks assigned to support the team and other department to achieve company’s objectives.
  • Use Social Selling and digital engagement skills to increase influence and drive customer engagement.
  • Assist in the development and implementation of local promotional activity to drive sales growth in support of goals and objectives.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of electricity and electronics, SE products and product families, pricing, relevant competitive products and their strengths / weaknesses, and applications for identified segments. Use knowledge to apply SE products to customer's needs with a focus to drive growth and / or competitive conversions.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Degree in Engineering / IT or any other related engineering discipline.
  • Min 2 to 4 years’ experience in leads management, sales support, sales & marketing, customer service or similar capability.
  • Multilingual capabilities are an advantage e.g. English, Malay, Mandarin, various local dialects
  • Understand leads management and sales cycle.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills are required.
  • Ability to multi task (logging queries and orders while speaking withcustomers);
  • Organized, fast, resilient, coachable and has good time management.
  • Passionate, self-motivated, results-driven professional.
  • Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
  • Demonstrate aptitude for problem solving and of urgency.
  • Digital Acumen & Digital influence skills.
  • Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel and Salesforce (or any CRM) would be an advantage.

Ready to bring your customer care expertise to a team that values your contribution? Apply today!

Rewards designed for you

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our [Career Page](https://www.se.com/careers).

\\* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our  IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue

+9% organic growth

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

Your Career, Your Way​ \| Schneider Electric Careers

job.title: Finance Analyst
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Finance Manager__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to collect, analyze, and interpret financial data. Each day, you will update budgets and forecasting models and identify trends and problems. You will also showcase your expertise by communicating insights and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive financial performance and optimize business outcomes.

The work model for the role is: onsite

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Performs analyses of business performance versus plan and proposes improvement actions. Supports the preparation of the relevant organization’s financial reporting, business planning, budgeting, and forecasting.
  • Prepares financial modelling for various hypotheses and assesses impact to factory with special focus on product / business line profitability, product costing, production variances, over/under-absorption analysis / inventory analysis.
  • Provides information to the management by gathering and summarizing data, preparing reports, and making presentations of findings, analyses, and recommendations.
  • Champion automation and digitalization of processes, leveraging tools such as Power BI, Power Automate, Power Query. Drive continuous improvement in reporting, planning, and analysis processes to increase efficiency and reduce manual effort.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in finance, accounting, tax and other related majors; Manufacturing background is preferred.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience
  • Strong analytical skill and ability to work independently
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills with all levels of organization
  • Be able to multi-task and perform well in fast-paced
  • Strong English listening and speaking ability
  • Have digital-competency in the finance domain

More about us

The IEC Low Voltage Division is a technology leader delivering a full range of energy-efficient low voltage motors, including ultra-efficient solutions such as IE5 SynRM (synchronous reluctance motors). Through a global footprint, domain expertise and rugged designs, the Division provides reliable technology that improves efficiency and productivity even in the most demanding applications.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
Role Summary

Partners closely with Global Strategic Account Managers (GSAMs) to align technical solutions with account strategy, drive customer engagement, and accelerate deal conversion. Serves as a global customer advocate, ensuring alignment between customer needs, solution delivery, and long-term partnership objectives. Leads architecture, positioning, and technical execution of advanced thermal and cooling solutions for global data center customers (Global Strategic Accounts). Acts as a trusted advisor aligning customer requirements with optimized, scalable, and energy-efficient architectures across chiller, liquid cooling, and central plant systems.

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect end-to-end thermal solutions (air-cooled, liquid cooling, hybrid systems) aligned with hyperscale and colocation requirements
  • Translate customer technical requirements into optimized system designs, including capacity modeling and performance trade-offs
  • Lead technical components of proposals, including system architecture, energy efficiency modeling, and solution differentiation
  • Partner with Global Strategic Account Managers (GSAMs) to align solution strategy with account priorities, customer engagement plans, and pipeline development
  • Serve as a global customer advocate, representing customer requirements internally across engineering, product, and operations to drive alignment and delivery
  • Lead and support program management of complex, multi-region data center initiatives, ensuring coordination across stakeholders, timelines, and deliverables
  • Support pricing and commercial strategy through technical value articulation (TCO, PUE, lifecycle cost)
  • Act as technical interface between customer engineering teams and JCI product/engineering organizations
  • Drive innovation adoption (e.g., high-density liquid cooling, advanced chillers, heat reuse)

Operating Rhythms

  • Joint engagement with GSAMs in strategic account planning, global customer governance, and executive technical discussions
  • Lead global customer advocacy forums to align technical roadmaps, performance expectations, and long-term partnership objectives
  • Program management cadence across large-scale deployments, ensuring alignment on scope, schedule, and delivery milestones
  • Technical design workshops with customers focused on future state architectures and AI workloads
  • Proposal development cycles with cross-functional engineering, product, commercial teams, and GSAM leadership
  • Quarterly solution and program reviews aligned to customer roadmap, capacity plans, and technology evolution
  • Ongoing engagement with product teams to influence roadmap based on customer requirements

Key Skills & Expertise

  • Data center cooling systems (chillers, CDU, CRAH/CRAC, liquid cooling)
  • Thermal system design and capacity planning
  • Energy efficiency optimization (PUE, WUE, sustainability targets)
  • Global customer advocacy and stakeholder management
  • Program and project management across complex, multi-region deployments
  • Hyperscale and colocation design standards
  • Technical sales and solution positioning in partnership with GSAM organizations
  • Cross-functional leadership across engineering, sales, and operations
