job.title: Solution Sales Engineer
job.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including [Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and [Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world.

Learn about our [benefits](http://careers.tranetechnologies.com/global/en/benefits) designed for you to Thrive at work and at home.

We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

工作概述：

根据业务发展及增长需求，开展空气侧工程销售，达成业务指标并促进业务持续增长。以直销形式，与内部团队跨部门协作，通过与业主的关系维护与拓展，为生物制药，芯片半导体等行业客户提供空气侧产品工程的方案设计。在满足客户需求的情况下，实现爱科空气侧产品在区域内的推广和销售的任务。

关键岗位职责：

  • 与业主进行沟通交流，挖掘客户需求，并协同技术支持团队为客户定制有竞争力的空气侧技术解决方案。
  • 跟踪区域市场及竞争对手的发展情况，拓展新空气侧产品服务领域及服务内容，推广空气侧产品技术系统解决方案，实现并超越既定的销售和利润目标。
  • 按照公司既定策略，积极寻求项目机会，扩大市场覆盖，增强爱科空气侧产品的市场影响力。 收集市场及同类产品信息，帮助公司提升产品性能、质量及应用，并创造积极的客户体验。
  • 按照公司的销售流程追踪项目进程。
  • 按照公司设定的销售目标完成各项业绩指标，完成项目合同执行及收款工作。 定期分析和总结销售工作，并按要求调整工作方向。

任职资格:

  • 本科以上学历，暖通空调、建筑环境与设备工程、机电一体化等理工科专业毕业；
  • 3年及以上生物制药行业工程销售经验, 生物制药行业有良好的业务和设计院资源，有工程销售经验及资源；
  • 有直接跟业主进行沟通并提供解决方案的经验及能力；
  • 熟悉工程前期设计及施工管理；能独立完成工程售前沟通；
  • 对洁净厂房需求有清晰的认知；能独立完成中小方案的前期空调系统设计（如冷量，风量，水管，风管设计）。

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: ICT Support Specialist
job.description:
About us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia's leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities.

Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities in the ACT, NSW, VIC and New Zealand, CDC's diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone's unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world's best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the role

The ICT Support Specialist works across a broad range of technologies, providing advanced technical support to end users while contributing to the administration and maintenance of CDC ICT environment. The role combines senior service desk responsibilities with systems administration capability, ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently while supporting the ongoing reliability, security and performance of the organisation's IT infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide advanced IT support for hardware, software, network, application, and end-user issues, including managing escalations and ensuring excellent customer service.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex incidents and service requests while maintaining accurate ticketing, documentation, and communication.
  • Administer and support core infrastructure, including Windows Server, Active Directory/Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, networking, file services, and endpoint management.
  • Manage and support corporate ICT assets, including laptops, desktops, printers, mobile devices, MDM solutions, and business applications such as Microsoft Office.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to deliver projects, upgrades, migrations, technical documentation, and continuous service improvements.
  • Provide leadership and mentoring within the ICT team, supporting junior staff, sharing technical knowledge, and contributing to a positive team culture.

About you

  • Minimum five years' experience in senior Service Desk, ICT Support or Systems Administration role
  • Strong experience with Microsoft 365, Entra IS (Azure AD), Exchange Online, SharePoint, Intune and supporting Windows 10/11 desktop environments
  • Sound understanding of networking fundamentals (LAN, WAN, DNS and TCP/IP)
  • Experience managing ICT assets and endpoint devices, participating in infrastructure projects and technology implementations.
  • Strong analytical and problem solving capabilities

Essential:

Australian Citizenship and ability to obtain an NV1 Security Clearance. This role is a fully onsite role.

What's in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Mark your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC's offers staff and their family's inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: National Head – Trade Channel Development
job.description:
**

Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Expansion

  • Formulate and implement strategies to ensure maximum utilization of increasing production capacity, balancing supply and demand effectively.
  • Identify new markets for entry and create detailed market penetration plans, including geographic expansion and new customer segments.

Market Development

  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to understand regional demand trends, competitor activities, white spaces, and customer preferences.
  • Establish strategic partnerships with key industry players, including construction companies, government bodies, and large-scale infrastructure projects.

Sales Management

  • Set sales targets for different regions and market segments in alignment with the expanding capacity.
  • Implement robust sales performance monitoring systems to track progress and identify areas for improvement.

Channel Management

  • Collaborate with the Head Channel Management & Micro Markets to develop and refine channel strategies, ensuring a balanced and efficient dealer network.
  • Strengthen relationships with existing dealers and identify new dealer partners to enhance market reach.
  • Implement mechanisms to resolve channel conflicts and ensure smooth operations.

Project Management

  • Oversee the planning and execution of strategic projects, particularly those related to market expansion and capacity utilization.
  • Establish governance frameworks and best practices for project management, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within budget.

Innovation and Digital Transformation

  • Oversee the development and implementation of digital sales platforms and streamline sales processes.
  • Utilize advanced data analytics to gain insights into customer behaviour and market trends, driving data-driven decision-making.

Risk Management

  • Work closely with the Specialist Credit & Risk to develop and implement robust credit policies, ensuring financial stability while expanding sales.
  • Continuously assess market risks, including economic downturns, regulatory changes, and competitive pressures.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing sales and market development team, fostering a culture of excellence and accountability.
  • Foster an engaging and motivating work environment, encouraging innovation and collaboration among team members.

Commercial Acumen

  • Drive commercial success by contributing to the development and implementation of strategies that enhance revenue and market position.
  • Identify and leverage new business opportunities to maximize organizational growth.

Compliance with Legal and Regulatory Standards

  • Ensure adherence to all relevant laws, regulations, and corporate policies within Sales & Marketing.
  • Conduct regular compliance audits to monitor adherence to legal and regulatory standards.
  • Prepare and submit detailed compliance reports to senior management, highlighting areas of concern and improvement.

Corporate Governance

  • Establish a clear framework for ethical decision-making within the department, providing guidance on ethical dilemmas.
  • Ensure departmental activities align with corporate governance principles and organizational values.
  • Set up mechanisms for reporting unethical behaviour, ensuring issues are addressed promptly and fairly.

Ethical Standards

  • Use ethical reasoning to guide decisions, considering the broader impact on the organization and stakeholders.
  • Ensure all communications, both verbal and written, reflect the organization’s commitment to integrity and ethics.

Ethics and Governance Integration

  • Ensure that ethical guidelines are integrated into all aspects of departmental planning and operations.
  • Align departmental activities with the organization’s governance framework, ensuring compliance with established policies.
  • Establish accountability measures to ensure adherence to governance and ethical standards across the department.

Innovation and Continuous Improvement

  • Promote a culture of innovation by encouraging team members to propose new ideas and approaches.
  • Pilot new technologies and approaches to determine their effectiveness and scalability within the department.
  • Implement feedback mechanisms to gather insights and make iterative improvements to processes and practices.

Internal Controls and Risk Management

  • Develop and implement robust internal control systems to safeguard against financial and operational leakages.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments to identify potential threats to departmental operations.
  • Monitor internal controls through regular audits and reviews, ensuring compliance and effectiveness.

Policy Adherence and Development

  • Implement and enforce organizational policies to maintain consistency and alignment with corporate objectives.
  • Contribute to policy development by providing feedback and insights from departmental operations.

Internal Stakeholders

  • Chief Sales & Marketing Officer
  • Head Channel Management & Micro Markets
  • Cluster Manager - Channel Management
  • Channel Relationship Manager
  • CSO

External Stakeholders

  • Industry Partners
  • Sales Promoters
  • Dealers
  • Government and Regulatory Bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Master's degree/ MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years)

  • 10+ years in sales and market development with extensive PMO experience.

Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of sales strategies, market dynamics, and project management methodologies in channel sales setup.

job.title: Engineer - BESS
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Lead EMS and SCADA system design for utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Develop system architecture, control philosophies, and operational strategies.
  • Design and configure SCADA applications, HMI screens, alarms, and reporting dashboards.
  • Integrate EMS with BMS, PCS, SCADA, PPC, weather stations, meters, and utility systems.
  • Define communication architecture using industry-standard protocols.
  • Develop energy optimization, peak shaving, load shifting, and frequency regulation strategies.
  • Coordinate with Electrical, PCS, Controls, Cybersecurity, and Commissioning teams.
  • Support FAT, SAT, commissioning, and site performance validation activities.
  • Ensure grid code compliance and utility communication requirements.
  • Analyze operational data and recommend system performance improvements.
  • Manage EMS/SCADA vendors and review technical deliverables.
  • Troubleshoot operational issues and provide technical support during project execution.

Qualifications

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • M.Tech in Power Systems, Control Systems, Energy Systems, or Automation preferred.

job.title: Field Medical Officer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the on-site medical center, ensuring it is equipped and staffed to handle emergencies and routine health issues effectively.
  • Develop and implement health and wellness programs aimed at improving employee well-being and reducing absenteeism.
  • Conduct regular health check-ups and maintain accurate medical records for all employees and contractors.
  • Provide immediate medical care and first aid in case of workplace injuries or emergencies, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Collaborate with the Site HR Head to design and execute health awareness campaigns, focusing on occupational health risks specific to thermal power plant operations.
  • Ensure the medical center complies with all internal standards and aligns with Adani Power’s focus on operational excellence and sustainability.
  • Train and guide first responders and safety teams on emergency medical procedures and protocols.

job.title: Data Center Technician (Shift pattern)
job.description:
Overview

Location: Schiphol

This role involves working a 6 day shift rotation covering shifts 06:00-14:30, 14:30-12:00(midnight) and 12:00(midnight) - 06:00.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process. Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services.

As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, and complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.
  • Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
  • Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data centre facilities.
  • Embodies our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Education: Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience, with basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.
  • Work Schedule: Ability to work shifts, including evenings, nights, weekends, and holidays.
  • Transportation: Valid driver’s licence and access to a personal vehicle for travel to client sites and company locations as part of shift responsibilities._*This role requires you to be on-site and the location has limited public transport. Your own form of transport is advised._

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is mandatory for this role. These include, but are not limited to:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: Must be passed upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications such as:
  • CompTIA: A+, Server+, Network+
  • Basic Structure Cabling (BSC)

Data Center Technicians ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Netherlands is € 42,600.00 - € 55,000.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

job.title: Officer - Tool Room
job.description:
To ensure maximum availability, reliability, and performance of plastic injection moulds by effectively managing preventive maintenance, breakdown maintenance, spare parts planning, mould life monitoring, and technical improvements. The role will provide dedicated toolroom support for critical projects and ensure timely resolution of mould-related issues to minimize production downtime and improve tooling life.

Responsibilities

  • Perform timely preventive and corrective maintenance on plastic injection molds.
  • Prioritize and attend to mold breakdowns, coordinating with internal and external resources to minimize downtime.
  • Conduct systematic troubleshooting and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for repetitive mold failures.
  • Maintain accurate records of mold history, maintenance, breakdowns, and life data, adhering to ISO documentation standards.
  • Monitor mold life and cavity condition, preparing renewal or refurbishment plans as needed.
  • Plan and manage critical mold spare parts to ensure quick availability during breakdowns and maintenance.
  • Coordinate with external toolrooms and vendors for mold repairs, modifications, and technical improvements.
  • Review and assess the technical feasibility of mold modifications in collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Support mold trials after repairs or modifications, ensuring successful handover for production.
  • Develop contingency plans for critical molds to maintain production continuity during major breakdowns.

Qualifications

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the plastic injection molding industry.
  • Strong knowledge of mold systems, including cores, cavities, sliders, lifters, and hydraulic components.
  • Proficiency in reading and interpreting 2D mold drawings, assembly drawings, and component drawings.
  • Familiarity with basic toolroom manufacturing processes such as grinding, milling, drilling, and EDM.
  • Understanding of ISO systems, maintenance standards, and safety requirements.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA).
  • Effective communication and coordination skills to collaborate with internal and external teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Willingness to support emergency and off-shift activities to ensure production continuity.
  • A proactive approach to continuous improvement and a commitment to maintaining high toolroom standards.

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Customer Success Specialist, Data Center

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. In Malaysia, that means real scale on the ground. As Johor's largest LEED-certified data center operator, we run two campuses at Nusajaya Tech Park and Kempas Tech Park, at the heart of the SIJORI cross-border digital corridor connecting Singapore, Johor, and Batam. Across both campuses, the infrastructure supports some of the world's most advanced AI and digital technology, and the client partnerships behind it need the same precision as the build itself.

About the Role

You'll support the Customer Success Manager in delivering DayOne's client-facing services and projects. This will involve coordinating daily operations, tracking service performance, and keeping documentation audit-ready across a portfolio of hyperscale infrastructure projects. This is a structured, entry-to-early-career role with genuine exposure to how client relationships and project delivery work in a live data center environment.

Customer Engagement and Support

  • Prepare customer-facing documentation and maintain accurate records to support the relationship the Customer Success Manager owns.

Service Delivery Monitoring

  • Track service performance against SLAs and prepare regular reports and dashboards.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to keep service operations running smoothly and resolve issues on time.

Project Coordination

  • Support the Customer Success Manager on project schedules, documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track project milestones, procurement activities, and flag risks early.

Compliance and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain organized records of service and project activity in line with audit and compliance requirements, including ITIL standards.
  • Liaise with operations, network, IT services, and construction teams to keep tasks moving, and coordinate meetings and follow-ups across teams.

Requirements

job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. Johor is where DayOne's Malaysian operations are concentrated, at the heart of the SIJORI corridor connecting Singapore, Johor, and Batam.

In 2026, DayOne committed RM28+ billion to Malaysia and secured a landmark partnership with TNB for over 1GW of renewable energy. Functions based here work close to live campuses, which means the work connects directly to the infrastructure it supports rather than sitting at a distance from it.

About the Role

You'll own invoice issuance and collection follow-up for DayOne's billing operations, working closely with Sales, Operations, Project teams, and customers to keep billing accurate and disputes resolved on time.

Billing and Collection Operations

  • Issue invoices based on validated charges, coordinating with relevant departments to confirm billable items.

Dispute Resolution

Process and Compliance

  • Flag recurring billing issues and recommend process fixes.
  • Support month-end closing and reporting.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 1 to 2 years of experience in billing, AR, collections, or finance operations.
  • Diploma in Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with AR systems and SAP is preferred.
  • Experience with billing disputes and escalation is an advantage.
  • Proficient in Excel and standard reporting tools.

Soft Skills

  • Escalates aging accounts through the right channel rather than letting them sit.
  • Manages multiple billing cycles and deadlines without losing accuracy.
  • Keeps disputes moving toward resolution through clear communication with internal teams and customers.

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in a data center or large corporate billing environment.

Why DayOne? DayOne is scaling fast across nine markets, and billing accuracy at this stage directly protects cash flow for a company deploying capital at pace. You'll work closely with Sales, Operations, and Project teams on live client accounts, with clear ownership of your portfolio.

A key responsibility will be end-to-end ownership of data migration and data readiness required for new ordering journeys and system enhancements.

job.title: 24/7 Data Centre Technician (Industrial Electrical/HVAC) - Relocate to Melbourne
job.description:
Make your mark in this exciting opportunity to work at Australia and New Zealand's leading data centres.

With CDC continuing to grow across Australia, we're expanding our search to New Zealand and are keen to connect with trade-qualified candidates who are actively looking to relocate to Melbourne, Australia.

We're seeking qualified Electricians and HVAC/Refrigeration Mechanics with experience in commercial or industrial environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure, mission-critical facilities, or data centres will be highly regarded.

We also have a growing footprint in Auckland, New Zealand. While we are not actively recruiting for these positions in Auckland at this stage, we're always keen to connect with strong candidates and build our talent pipeline for future opportunities.

Please note, due to security restrictions we can only pursue applicants who hold current New Zealand Citizenship.

  • Relocation assistance will be provided for successful applicants.
  • Tailored CDC Learning Academy and hands-on training provided
  • 24/7 Shift Roster over 8 days - 2 days, 2 nights- 4 days off (Hours are 6-6)
  • Location: Laverton in Melbourne's Western Suburbs**

About Us

CDC Data Centres is Australasia’s leading operator of sovereign, secure, world-class data centre facilities. Headquartered in Canberra with multiple facilities across ACT, NSW, VIC, WA and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide secure data centre configurations that support co-location, containerised and hyperscale compute environments with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team. Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

At CDC, our Service Technicians work in live data centre environments, supporting the operation of mission‑critical infrastructure.

If you’ve spent time in electrical, HVAC, or industrial environments, a lot of this will feel familiar. Working to procedures, taking safety seriously, and understanding the impact of your work is critical. A data centre applies those same principles to power, cooling, fire systems and monitoring, all operating continuously. The difference is the environment, the scale, and the opportunity to apply your skills in a stable, growing industry.

We welcome people from a range of technical backgrounds and provide training and support to help you apply your existing skills in a more operational, monitoring‑focused environment.

What you’ll be doing day‑to‑day:

  • Monitoring and responding to alarms and alerts across power, cooling, and fire systems
  • Performing physical inspections to ensure equipment and infrastructure are operating within defined parameters
  • Responding to faults and incidents, prioritising actions, and determining when escalation or contractor support is required
  • Carrying out operational switching and control activities to prevent unplanned outages
  • Supporting planned maintenance and monitoring contractors on site, ensuring strict adherence to safety procedures and approved methods of operation
  • Documenting incidents, maintenance activities, and observations to support continuous improvement

This role works on a rotating 24/7 shift roster (2 days, 2 nights, 4 off) and suits individuals who are comfortable making decisions, following defined processes, and working calmly in high‑reliability environments.** Benefits, Training and Offerings:**

Our training program provides tailored content through our CDC Academy, specifically designed for individuals starting out in this role. You'll learn hands-on by shadowing and working alongside our experienced Service Technicians, gaining essential knowledge to develop your skillset.

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy -Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.**

About You

We're looking for individuals who are in a position to move to Australia as soon as possible, or ideally before the end of the year.

Ideally, you'll be a qualified Electrician or Refrigeration Mechanic with proven experience in large-scale industrial or technical environments. Experience working in critical infrastructure is highly regarded and will be a strong advantage.

Desirable experience:

  • A trade or technical background in Electrical, Refrigeration/HVAC, Mechanical, or a related field (highly desirable)
  • Experience working in critical or high‑availability environments with strong safety and compliance requirements
  • Exposure to monitoring or control systems such as BMS, EMS, or SCADA‑type platforms
  • Familiarity with complex infrastructure or plant equipment (e.g. HVAC systems, power systems, generators, fire systems)
  • Strong fault‑finding, problem‑solving, and situational awareness skills
  • The ability to produce clear documentation, logs, and post‑incident reports

Essential:

New Zealand Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NZ Security Clearance.** How to Apply:**

If you're looking to be part of Australia and New Zealand's leading large-scale data centre innovator, submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and we encourage everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.** Closing Date:** Applications close on Sunday, 4th October 2026. job.title: TA Operations - HR
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

1. Background Verification (BGV) Operations

  • Manage end-to-end background verification processes for all new hires across business verticals.
  • Coordinate with empaneled BGV vendors for timely initiation, tracking, escalation management, and closure.
  • Ensure verification of education, employment, address, criminal checks, identity validation, and reference checks as per company policy.
  • Monitor BGV turnaround time (TAT), discrepancies, red-flag cases, and exception approvals.
  • Drive governance and compliance standards aligned with internal audit and legal requirements.
  • Prepare periodic MIS dashboards and analytics on BGV status, aging, vendor performance, and risk indicators.
  • Handle confidential and sensitive employee information with high integrity and data privacy compliance.

2. Pre-Medical Health Checkup (PMHC) Management

  • Lead the operational management of pre-employment medical examinations for candidates.
  • Coordinate with hospitals, diagnostic centers, and occupational health partners.
  • Ensure medical appointments are scheduled within defined timelines for smooth onboarding.
  • Monitor medical fitness reports, escalations, and special case handling in consultation with HR and medical teams.
  • Maintain compliance with occupational health, safety, and company medical standards.
  • Track PMHC completion metrics and improve candidate experience through process efficiency.

3. Onboarding Operations

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding activities from offer acceptance to Day-1 joining.
  • Ensure timely documentation, system updates, joining formalities, and induction coordination.
  • Collaborate with HRBP, TA, IT, Admin, Payroll, Compliance, and Business stakeholders for seamless onboarding.
  • Ensure all onboarding documentation complies with company policies and statutory requirements.
  • Drive automation and process improvements in onboarding workflows and employee lifecycle management.
  • Maintain onboarding SLAs and improve joining experience for new hires.

4. Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholders and external service providers.
  • Conduct regular governance reviews with BGV and medical vendors.
  • Negotiate service standards, monitor vendor KPIs, and ensure operational efficiency.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition teams to support high-volume and critical hiring initiatives.

5. Process Excellence & Compliance

  • Develop SOPs, operational controls, and process documentation.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives, automation, and digitization of onboarding operations.
  • Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy, information security, and audit requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits related to onboarding, BGV, and medical compliance.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of Background Verification and onboarding operations
  • Expertise in pre-employment medical processes and compliance
  • Vendor management and stakeholder coordination
  • Process governance and operational excellence
  • HRMS / ATS / onboarding platform knowledge
  • Analytical and MIS reporting capabilities
  • Strong communication and escalation management skills
  • High attention to detail and confidentiality handling
  • Ability to manage high-volume operations and tight timelines

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • BGV completion TAT
  • PMHC completion timelines
  • Joining success rate
  • Candidate onboarding experience score
  • Vendor SLA adherence
  • Compliance and audit closure rate
  • Documentation accuracy and process efficiency

Preferred Attributes

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, matrix organization
  • Strong problem-solving and operational leadership skills
  • Process automation and transformation mindset
  • High ownership and execution orientation
  • Experience in GCC/shared services environment preferred

Educational Qualification

Experience

  • 10–15 years of experience in HR Operations, Talent Acquisition Operations, or Employee Lifecycle Management

Reporting to the Financial Controller, this role will be responsible for driving accounting quality and consistency across the Group. The role will provide financial accounting leadership to country finance teams, review country financials before they flow into Group consolidation and ensure consistent application of Group accounting policies and accounting treatments across all entities. The role will also oversee the holding company accounting team and Group-wide AR governance.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead the review and challenge of country financial results before submission into Group consolidation, including detailed balance sheet and P&L reviews, significant movements, unusual transactions and accounting issues.
  • Drive consistent application of Group accounting policies and accounting treatments across all countries and entities.
  • Identify differences in accounting practices across countries and work with country finance teams to align accounting treatment across the Group.
  • Provide day-to-day accounting guidance and support to country finance teams and act as a key escalation point for accounting and close-related matters.
  • Identify new, complex or judgmental accounting matters and work with the Consolidation & Group Reporting team to determine and document the appropriate technical accounting position.
  • Ensure technical accounting conclusions and Group accounting policies are appropriately implemented across all relevant entities.
  • Establish consistent month-end close and accounting practices across the Group, including minimum standards for reconciliations, supporting schedules, review and sign-off.
  • Review the quality and completeness of balance sheet reconciliations and drive resolution of long-outstanding, unsupported or material reconciling items.
  • Review significant accruals, provisions, fixed assets, CIP, leases and other material balance sheet areas.
  • Review the profitability and financial performance of individual data centers, including performance through to the P&L bottom line.
  • Oversee Group-wide AR, including aging, collections, overdue balances, provisioning and escalation of significant collection issues.
  • Develop Group-level AR reporting and drive accountability with country finance teams for collection performance.
  • Lead the holding company close and oversee the holding company accounting and AP team.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes, close efficiency and overall quality of financial reporting.

The successful candidate:

  • Qualified accountant (CPA, CA, ACCA or equivalent).
  • Approximately 10–15 years of relevant financial accounting experience.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS and practical application of accounting standards.
  • Strong experience in financial close, balance sheet management and financial statement review.

  • Hands-on, practical and comfortable operating in a growing organization where processes are still developing.

job.title: Associate Director, PropTech Innovation & Strategic Partnerships
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

The Associate Director, PropTech Innovation & Strategic Partnerships will support Singtel Group Property to shape and drive its property technology innovation programme and strategic partnerships, and co-create new Enterprise and Consumer solutions and business opportunities.

The role leads the development of technology-enabled innovations and solutions, commercial models and ecosystem partnerships, with a flagship mandate under the Workplace28 technology programme and the new Comcentre HQ as a lighthouse for innovation.

Technology and data are leveraged as enablers to enhance workplace, people and tenant experience, and improve asset performance - not as ends in themselves. The role will connect Singtel’s built environments with its operating businesses and people, using Singtel’s properties and workplaces as real-world platforms to co-create, test and validate new solutions, and translate proven solutions into customer propositions and commercial opportunities.

The incumbent will manage opportunities from discovery and business case through partnership, funding, validation and operationalisation, and scale successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio. Working across Group Property, Workplace, Consumer, Enterprise, IT, Digital, other business units and ecosystem partners, the role will establish a disciplined Innovation Framework and Partnership Ecosystem to prioritise, develop and scale opportunities that deliver meaningful people, customer, operational and commercial value.

Make An Impact By

Workplace28 Technology & Property Innovation

**

  • Lead the technology innovation agenda for the Workplace28 programme and new Comcentre HQ.
  • Translate Workplace28 user experience ambitions into prioritised use cases and innovation workstreams, working with Workplace, IT, Tech, AI and Robotics specialists to develop appropriate solutions.
  • Use existing Singtel commercial sites and workplaces as real-world innovation platforms to co-create, pilot and validate solutions for customers and future tenants of One Comcentre.
  • Identify opportunities to extend the innovation approach and deploy successful solutions across Singtel’s wider property portfolio.

Innovation Strategy, Framework & Portfolio

**

  • Shape and manage Group Property’s innovation strategy, framework and portfolio, aligned with business, workplace and customer priorities.
  • Establish a structured approach from opportunity discovery and prioritisation through business case, experimentation, validation, operationalisation and scale.
  • Assess opportunities based on customer/user value, business impact, strategic relevance, scalability and commercial potential, working with technical teams to assess feasibility.
  • Establish clear governance, stage-gates and go / no-go criteria, and track innovation investment, progress and realised benefits.
  • Drive strong idea-to-pilot, pilot-to-scale discipline, progressing successful initiatives while stopping or redirecting those that do not demonstrate sufficient value.

Customer Solutions & Use-Case Development

**

  • Ensure innovation starts with a real customer or business problem, rather than with the technology.
  • Identify and understand the needs of our customers - employees, businesses and future tenants, translating them into high-value use cases and solution opportunities.
  • Develop customer journeys, solution concepts, value propositions, business requirements and measurable outcomes.
  • Work across Workplace, Group Property, Consumer and Enterprise to identify opportunities that improve customer experience and asset performance.
  • Validate propositions with users and stakeholders before significant investment or deployment

New Technology Discovery & Ecosystem Development

**

  • Identify technologies and ecosystem partners that can address defined customer or business needs, working with technical specialists to assess feasibility.
  • Explore how Singtel’s in-house solutions, deep capabilities and broad ecosystem can complement externally sourced technologies to create differentiated customer solutions.
  • Maintain visibility of emerging technologies and market developments relevant to Property, Workplace and customer experience.
  • Build an innovation ecosystem across technology companies, start-ups, OEMs, research institutions, government agencies and strategic partners.
  • Facilitate co-creation, prototypes and pilot initiatives with ecosystem partners.
  • Connect external innovation with relevant Singtel capabilities and business opportunities.

Strategic & Commercial Partnerships

**

  • Identify, develop and manage strategic innovation and commercial partnerships that accelerate Singtel’s innovation and business agenda.
  • Lead the development of MOUs, collaboration agreements, co-innovation and partnership arrangements, working with Legal, Procurement and relevant stakeholders.
  • Develop partnership models spanning co-creation, co-development, co-investment and go-to-market collaboration.
  • Structure partnerships around clear customer, strategic and commercial outcomes, rather than conventional buyer-vendor relationships.
  • Build long-term ecosystem relationships that provide access to new capabilities, innovation and business opportunities.

Customer Solutions & New Business Development

**

  • Identify opportunities to translate Property and Workplace innovations into scalable customer and business solutions.
  • Partner with Consumer and Enterprise to identify customer needs, market opportunities and differentiated propositions.
  • Develop customer-led solutions, value propositions, business and operating models, and routes to market.
  • Use Singtel’s physical environments as real-world platforms to validate solutions and demonstrate customer value.
  • Identify opportunities to create new value through enterprise adoption, external customer solutions and new business models.

Business Cases, Commercial Models & Innovation Funding

**

  • Develop robust business cases covering customer value, investment, business impact, scalability and commercial potential.
  • Develop commercial and partnership models that enable viable deployment and scale, including co-investment, fee-based, subscription, revenue-sharing and platform models where relevant.
  • Identify and develop innovation funding opportunities, including internal investment, partner co-funding, grants and other funding sources.
  • Evaluate and recommend where Singtel should invest, partner, pilot, scale, commercialise or stop.
  • Track innovation investment and realised benefits, ensuring continued funding is supported by measurable outcomes and evidence of scalability.

Innovation Delivery, Scale & Commercialisation

**

  • Drive innovation from business case and pilot through implementation, adoption, scale and commercialisation.
  • Structure pilots around clear customer needs, business outcomes and measurable success criteria.
  • Orchestrate business, Property, Workplace, IT and ecosystem partners to translate concepts into operational solutions.
  • Develop the business and operating readiness required to move successful pilots into production, working with technology specialists on technical readiness.
  • Identify pathways to replicate and scale proven solutions across Singtel’s property portfolio and into Consumer and Enterprise opportunities.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on innovation, customer solutions, partnerships and new business opportunities.

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Business, Economics, Real Estate, Technology, Innovation or related discipline**
  • 12–15+ years of relevant experience in real estate, commercial strategy, innovation, customer solutions, business development.
  • Strong experience working across real estate, digital solutions, property technology and partnership management.
  • Domain knowledge in Property with experience in real estate functions such as asset management, marketing, leasing or operations.
  • Track record developing new businesses, products, platforms or technology-enabled solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience taking opportunities from business case and concept through implementation, scale and commercialisation

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

  • Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
  • Conduct engineering analysis and research designs and methods of data center equipment and facilities.
  • Ensure designs and installations meet requirements (e.g., predicted cooling, structural, operational concerns, etc.
  • Develop data center vulnerability remediation playbooks for control system designs in conjunction with IT teams.

Experience

Experience of 10+ years in designing, configuring, programming, installing, troubleshooting or servicing HVAC Controls and Electrical SCADA systems application specific controllers, Building Management System (BMS) Controls software and networks.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent understanding of industry-standard electrical and mechanical systems used in data centers, as well as controls/monitoring systems.
  • Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
  • Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
  • Project coordination experience with multiple teams or vendors to meet project requirements for data centers.
  • TCP/IP, MQTT, BACnet and/or MODBUS communication protocol experience.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite and project management software.

At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

job.title: IT Operations Lead - BDx Data Centers
job.description:
Role Summary

The Senior IT Operations Lead will provide technical leadership and operational ownership of the organization's internal IT infrastructure and OT technology environment supporting Data Center operations. This is a senior hands-on individual contributor role within a captive Data Center organization, responsible for the reliability, security, availability, governance, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement of the organization's own technology environment.

Duties and Responsibilities

1. IT Infrastructure Operations & Reliability

  • Provide technical and operational leadership for the organization's enterprise IT infrastructure supporting corporate and Data Center operations.
  • Ensure the availability, reliability, performance, and security of infrastructure operating on a 24x7x365 basis.
  • Oversee networking, servers and compute, virtualization, storage, backup, firewalls, security infrastructure, wireless, telephony, collaboration systems, end-user computing, and monitoring platforms.
  • Drive proactive monitoring, capacity planning, performance optimization, technology lifecycle management, and operational KPI tracking.

2. OT Security & Data Center Technology Environment

  • Support and govern IT and OT security procedures relevant to Data Center operations.
  • Work closely with Data Center Operations, Engineering, Security, Automation, and Technology teams to ensure appropriate protection and segregation of IT and OT environments.
  • Develop and maintain procedures for secure access, privileged access, remote connectivity, patching, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
  • Support security assessments, audits, vulnerability remediation, risk mitigation, incident response, and root cause analysis involving IT and OT-related systems.

3. IT Service Management & Operational Governance

  • Lead and continuously improve Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Configuration, and Asset Management processes.
  • Analyse recurring incidents and operational trends and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Drive service reviews, KPI reporting, risk tracking, root cause analysis, and continual service improvement.

4. Infrastructure Architecture & Technology Lifecycle

  • Participate in infrastructure reviews and assess the impact of new systems, technology changes, and infrastructure enhancements.
  • Provide recommendations for scalability, resilience, security, operational supportability, and risk mitigation.
  • Support infrastructure modernization including cloud, hybrid infrastructure, software-defined networking, automation, and Infrastructure-as-a-Service models.

5. SDLC, Change & Release Governance

  • Demonstrate strong awareness of SDLC and its impact on infrastructure and production environments.
  • Work with application, automation, engineering, and technology teams to ensure infrastructure readiness for development, testing, deployment, and production releases.
  • Ensure appropriate testing, documentation, rollback plans, approvals, risk assessments, and operational readiness before production implementation.

6. Information Security, Compliance & Documentation

  • Support compliance with ISO 27001 and ISO 20000 requirements and maintain relevant operational documentation and evidence.
  • Maintain infrastructure standards, procedures, architecture diagrams, Configuration Items (CIs), CMDB records, and IT asset documentation.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure timely closure of audit findings and compliance actions.

7. Security, Monitoring & Critical Incident Management

  • Provide technical oversight for routers, switches, Layer 2/3 networks, firewalls, IPS/IDS, VPN, WAN, Wi-Fi, and connectivity infrastructure.
  • Improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, operational visibility, and proactive issue detection.
  • Lead technical investigations for major incidents, root cause analysis, and corrective action planning.

8. Vendor & Internal Stakeholder Management

  • Manage technical relationships and escalations with infrastructure, security, telecommunications, and technology vendors.
  • Partner with internal Data Center Operations, Engineering, Information Security, Automation, Applications, Corporate IT, Facilities, and business stakeholders.
  • Communicate technical risks, operational performance, improvement initiatives, and infrastructure status to senior stakeholders.

9. Individual Contributor Technical Leadership

  • Act as a senior technical owner and subject matter expert, leading through technical expertise, governance, influence, and operational ownership.
  • Work independently on complex technical and operational issues and mentor engineers where required.
  • This is primarily a hands-on senior individual contributor role and is not intended to be a traditional service delivery, customer account management, or managed services role.

Experience

15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise IT infrastructure, infrastructure operations, or IT operations leadership.

  • Experience supporting business-critical, highly available, 24x7x365 infrastructure environments.
  • Strong experience operating internal enterprise or captive technology environments; experience should not be limited to external customer managed services delivery.
  • Strong technical experience across enterprise networking, Layer 2/3 infrastructure, routers, switches, firewalls, WAN, VPN, Wi-Fi, servers, virtualization, monitoring, infrastructure security, backup, and configuration management.
  • Strong experience in Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis, KPI reporting, trend analysis, and continual service improvement.
  • Practical understanding of IT and OT security principles, access management, vulnerability remediation, patching, infrastructure hardening, and operational security procedures.
  • Strong awareness of SDLC, production change governance, release management, testing, risk assessment, rollback planning, and operational readiness.
  • Experience with monitoring platforms such as Zabbix, Nagios, SolarWinds, Cacti, or similar tools.
  • Experience conducting infrastructure architecture reviews and developing mitigation plans for technical and operational risks.
  • Strong vendor management, stakeholder management, analytical, problem-solving, documentation, written, and verbal communication skills.

Qualification and Experience

Good-to-Have Skills

  • Experience working in a Data Center operator or other mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Exposure to OT environments supporting critical infrastructure, including Data Center automation, BMS, DCIM, SCADA, or similar operational technologies.
  • Knowledge of OT/ICS security principles and industrial cybersecurity practices.
  • Experience with public cloud, hybrid cloud, software-defined networking, infrastructure automation, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, or DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with Zero Trust, SIEM, SOC, EDR, vulnerability management, or security monitoring platforms.
  • Experience with disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

Preferred Certifications

  • CCNP or equivalent Cisco certification.
  • CISSP, CISM, or equivalent information security certification.
  • ITIL certification.
  • Microsoft infrastructure, cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), OT/ICS security, or Six Sigma/process improvement certifications.

At BDx, we believe that our success lies in the hands of our talented and dedicated employees. Together, we are shaping the future of the data center industry and making a positive impact on the world.

job.title: Account Management Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible for managing the relationship and business strategies for less complex accounts (regional, single business unit, internal, etc.). May have responsibility for larger, more complex accounts when paired with a more senior Account Manager. Responsibilities include selling the organization's products to assigned business customers to achieve sales goals, expanding existing customer relationships and executing account sales plans in support of business strategy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develops, manages, and maintains business relationships with assigned accounts supporting the organization's sales strategy.
  • Supports revenue growth by identifying and contacting new business opportunities and participating in cost reduction initiatives.
  • Extends and expands sale of products and services to existing clients.
  • Leads, manages and coordinates communication and interfaces with the customer at appropriate levels. Negotiates and implements contracts with accounts as authorized.
  • Manages production and distribution issues associated with accounts.
  • Responsible for establishing and maintaining positive customer relations. Acts as champion for the voice of the customer within the business.
  • Supports account strategy and works with key stakeholders in the business to achieve optimum results.
  • Responsible for measuring customer satisfaction and creating action plans to improve satsifaction on data.
  • Manages accounts receivable deliverables including discussing and negotiating payment terms.
  • Drives Customer Focus Six Sigma initiatives to strengthen relationship with customer.
  • Drives cross business unit account development in support of account strategy.
  • Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast.
  • As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.

Can speak and listen Japanese as Native speaker level

Understand properly Japanese Business culture

Have experience B to B deal and/or service sales of actual products

Have knowledge diesel engine generator or similar products

Competencies:

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.
  • Instills trust - Gaining the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity, and authenticity.
  • Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.
  • Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.
  • Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.
  • Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.
  • Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc.) in such a way that the target audience (e.g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc.) can understand, retain, and use the information
  • Developing Account Strategy - Determines current status of account in terms of relationship, financial, product competitiveness, barriers, quality, and service and defining desired future state by balancing customer requirements and business capabilities in order to define achievable targets aligned with the business strategy.
  • Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.
  • Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.
  • Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.
  • Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in marketing, sales, technical or a related subject or equivalent industry experience required.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Significant level of relevant work experience, including previous customer and/or product experience required.
  • Purchasing/commercial contract negotiation preferred.

job.title: アカウント管理スペシャリスト - シニア
job.description:
仕事の概要:

より単純なアカウント（地域、単一事業部、社内など）との関係や事業戦略の管理に責任を負う。より上級のアカウントマネージャーと組んで、より大口の、より複雑なアカウントに対する責任を負う場合もある。担当範囲には、自分が担当する企業顧客に自社製品を営業し営業目標を達成すること、既存の顧客との関係を拡充すること、事業戦略を支えるアカウント営業計画を実行することが含まれる。

主要な責務:

組織の営業戦略を支える、担当アカウントとの取引関係を築き、管理し、維持する。

新しいビジネス機会を特定して連絡し、コスト削減イニシアチブに参加することで、収益成長をサポートする。

既存のクライアントへの製品およびサービスの売上を拡張、拡大する。

コミュニケーションの指揮、管理、調整を行い、適切なレベルの顧客とやり取りする。

承認されたアカウントとの契約を交渉し、実施する。

アカウントに関連する生産、流通の問題を管理する。

建設的な顧客関係の確立および維持に関する責任を負う。

ビジネスにおいて「お客様の声」を大切にする推進者の役割を果たす。

アカウント戦略をサポートし、最適な結果を得るために事業の主要なステークホルダーと協力する。

顧客満足度の測定、およびデータにおける満足度向上のためのアクションプランの策定に対する責任を負う。

売掛金担当の成果物を管理する。これには、支払条件に関する討議および交渉を含む。

顧客中心のシックスシグマイニシアティブを推進し、顧客との関係を強化する。

アカウント戦略をサポートする、事業部横断的なアカウント開発を推進する。

販売予測を維持し、予測に対する進捗状況と精度を追跡する。

必要に応じて、社内のステークホルダー、顧客と協力して、顧客の期待に沿って在庫、サービス、および配送機能をバランスさせる。

スキル:

多様性の尊重 - 異なる視野や文化が組織にもたらす価値を理解する。

効果的なコミュニケーション - 多種多様なコミュニケーションを展開して、さまざまな相手のニーズを明確に理解する。

顧客志向 - 顧客と強固な関係を構築し、顧客の立場に立った解決策を提供する。

責務の遂行 - 約束 （コミットメント） を果たすために、自分で責任を持ち、他の人にも責任を持たせる。

信頼の獲得 - 正直で、誠実、率直な行いで他の人からの信用と信頼を獲得する。

明確な価値の提示 - 関連する要望に基づいて、内外の顧客ニーズを明らかにする。競合他社と差別化するため、特定の顧客ニーズを満たし、強みと弱みを明確にした製品、ソリューション、サービスを説明し、実践する。

販路（チャネル）認識 - 組織目標を改善するため、業界の構造、力学、市場への行程を説明し、状況に当てはめる。

価格戦略 - ビジネス目標を達成するため、部門を超えて主要なステークホルダーとのコンセンサスを調整、形成することにより、価格を決定する。

アカウントプランニング - 目的を明確にし、目的が必要となる場面の状況について検討し、その達成までの進み具合を追跡できるようにすることで、経営戦略またはアカウント戦略のいずれか、あるいはその両方を実行する。

ターゲットオーディエンスへの適応 - ターゲットオーディエンス（営業担当者、顧客、トレーニングベンダーなど）が情報を理解、保持、および使用できるようなやり方で、複雑なトピック（重要な技術データ、対象事項の専門知識など）を説明する。

アカウント戦略の開発 - ビジネス戦略に沿った達成可能な目標を定義するため、関係性、財務、製品競争力、障壁、品質、サービスに関する現状評価を判断し、顧客要件とビジネス能力のバランスをとることによって、望ましい将来像を定義する。

顧客視点を組み入れる - 当社製品および販売活動に対する顧客の視点を理解し、それらを組み入れて販売コンテンツを開発し、顧客ニーズへの対応力および収益改善能力を向上させる。

セールス予測 - 内外の情報源から顧客データを収集し、評価する。過去のデータと比較して、有用なインプットを判断し、今後の消費動向について予測を作成する。

販売パイプラインマネジメント - 現在のパイプラインに基づいて、取引先や地域レベルで販売戦略や販売計画の実行を成功させるため、積極的に計画を策定する。パイプラインの健全性（規模、内容、進捗）を評価する。それに応じて、販売戦略、計画、影響力が大きな活動を調整する。必要であれば、販売目標を達成するために販売人を指導する。

意味を成す - 一連の診断およびプロービングの質問と調査を通じて、顧客のニーズ、行動、購買過程を深く理解し、および/または支援する。社内外のリソースから得られる複雑な情報を統合し、社内外の顧客のためにカスタマイズしたソリューションを提供する。

学歴、免許、資格:

マーケティング、営業、技術または関連する分野におけるカレッジ/大学または同等教育機関の学位、もしくは関連する業界での実務経験が必須。

この役職では、輸出管理または制裁規則を遵守するためにライセンスが必要になる場合があります。

職歴:

かなりの実務経験が必須。これには、以前の顧客や製品に関する経験が含まれる。購買/商業契約交渉の経験があれば望ましい。

job.title: Product Engineering Specialist 动力系统附件
job.description:
Job Summary

  • This product focused position performs established technical tasks at the sub-system and/or component level for current and future products within a given business unit or corporate area. This involves work across many steps in the product life cycle. Because of the product centered nature of this position, they are very often a central point of coordination and decision making between product line engineers, customer teams, systems engineers, purchasing, suppliers and manufacturing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Obtains input from stakeholders such as technical managers, project leaders, other product and manufacturing engineers and supplier partners to deliver information and recommendations that lead to quality product decisions.
  • Applies academic knowledge and existing experience to take action and make decisions that progress projects forward without sacrificing project quality expectations. Examples of these decisions include day to day project details, analysis or test work instruction details, coordination across discipline areas that are necessary to make quality progress.
  • Applies and improves processes such as Engineering Standard Work (ESW), iDFMEA, Failure Incident Review Group (FIRG) and tools such as 7-step problem solving, design review checklist and other specialized tools required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making.
  • Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team.
  • Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site.
  • Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers.
  • Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

  • Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.
  • Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.
  • Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.
  • Product Interface Management and Integration - Identifies and analyzes the interfaces and interactions across system boundaries by specifying the requirements and limits to ensure that the product meets requirements; controls the interactions across the system element boundaries by making sure that they remain within specified limits; integrates system elements by creating an integration plan, including identification of method and timing for each activity to make it easier to find, isolate, diagnose, and correct.
  • Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.
  • Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.
  • System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.
  • Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  • Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.
  • Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.
  • Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.
  • Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  • Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.
  • Product Configuration and Change Management - Establishes a baseline of identified product artifacts to be placed under configuration management; releases, tracks, controls and communicates changes from concept to obsolescence often through work requests; establishes and maintains the integrity of the product artifact baselines.
  • Mechanical Design of Mechanical Systems - Acquires and applies an in-depth understanding of mechanical systems through working knowledge that guides a designer’s ability to create innovative and sound design concepts to meet Cummins and customer expectations; designs for requirements of all lifecycle stages by considering the customer requirements in different operating environments to ensure a robust system.
  • Mechanical Design Specification - Creates complete specifications in the form of solid models, configured engineering bill of materials and detailed drawings that cross-functionally communicate the information required to manufacture and inspect a product per its design intent; considers national, international, industry, and Cummins’ standards that accurately and concisely define the part specification.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.
  • Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.
