job.title: 2027 Undergraduate Financial Control Internship
job.description:
Our culture believes in POWERING YOUR POTENTIAL . We provide global opportunities to develop your career, make your community a better place and work with today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems.

We believe in flexibility for you to explore your passions while making an impact through meaningful work within our inclusive workforce. That’s what \#LifeAtCummins is all about.

If you are an undergraduate Accounting student looking to jump start your career, we are offering a 13-month full time internship based our Scoresby office . This is a unique opportunity to gain skills and knowledge while you are working full time commencing 27th January 2027 .

In this role you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Assisting in month end closing (journals and reconciliations)
  • Assisting in compilation of reporting information
  • Provide an accounting support and financial analysis for Business Leaders
  • Leading small process improvement projects
  • Assist in internal/external audit process

About You

To qualify for this undergraduate internship, it is essential that you:

  • Are currently studying a degree Majoring in Accounting
  • Have between 1 and 8 units of study left to complete of your undergraduate degree as of January 2027
  • Are available for the full 13 months and be willing to defer your studies for that duration.

_Note:_ _Applicants that do not meet these qualifying requirements unfortunately will not be considered._

To be successful in this role, you will possess skills/abilities or be able to perform:

  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to work autonomously
  • Inquisitive nature
  • Confidence in communicating with a range of stakeholders
  • Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills

_This is a 13-month, full time, paid placement and the successful candidate will be required to defer their studies for the duration of the program._

How to apply:

  • For all applications, please submit your resume, cover letter and academic transcript via the link provided.
  • In your cover letter, please specify how many units of study you have remaining on your undergraduate degree and your motivation behind applying both to Cummins and this specific internship.

Note: We will be unable to assess your application without all of the required documents, so please ensure you attach your resume, cover letter and academic transcripts at the time of application.

job.title: JSM 2 Controls
job.description:
Job Summary

The Electrical Maintenance & Automation Technician is responsible for troubleshooting, installing, maintaining, testing, and optimizing electrical and automation systems to ensure manufacturing equipment availability, reliability, and operational efficiency. This role supports preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities while working with PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, MES integration, vision systems, and advanced automation technologies. The position contributes to improving equipment performance, reducing downtime, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and maintaining compliance with Cummins' Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), Quality, and operational standards. The role may also provide technical guidance and mentoring to less experienced team members.

Key Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot, repair, install, test, and maintain electrical systems, industrial automation equipment, and manufacturing machinery to maximize equipment uptime and reliability.
  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities on manufacturing equipment and electrical control systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve faults related to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA systems, drives, sensors, industrial controls, and electrical components.
  • Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize Siemens TIA Portal applications, PLC programs, HMIs, vision systems, and automation equipment.
  • Support MES integration and smart manufacturing technologies to improve operational efficiency and equipment performance.
  • Perform machine programming modifications, electrical system upgrades, and automation improvements to enhance productivity and reliability.
  • Read and interpret electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, machine drawings, and technical documentation to execute maintenance activities effectively.
  • Ensure electrical systems comply with applicable electrical codes, safety standards, and manufacturing requirements.
  • Conduct equipment downtime analysis, root cause investigations, and corrective actions to eliminate recurring failures.
  • Maintain preventive maintenance schedules, equipment history, maintenance records, and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate maintenance activities with production schedules to minimize equipment downtime and production interruptions.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Collaborate with manufacturing, engineering, quality, maintenance, and support teams to improve equipment reliability, productivity, and manufacturing performance.
  • Maintain a safe, clean, and organized work environment by adhering to Cummins Health, Safety, Environmental (HSE), and Quality standards.
  • Coach and provide technical guidance to technicians and team members, supporting skill development and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma, ITI, Diploma, or equivalent technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or a related technical discipline.
  • Additional certifications in PLC programming, Siemens automation technologies, industrial automation, or electrical maintenance are preferred.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electrical maintenance of industrial and manufacturing equipment
  • Preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance
  • PLC programming and troubleshooting, preferably using Siemens TIA Portal
  • HMI, SCADA, MES integration, and industrial automation systems
  • Vision systems and smart manufacturing technologies
  • Machine programming and automation optimization
  • Electrical system troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
  • Industrial control systems, motors, drives, sensors, and instrumentation
  • Reading and interpreting electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical documentation
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and structured problem-solving methodologies
  • Preventive maintenance planning and maintenance documentation
  • Basic understanding of hydraulic and pneumatic control systems
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Effective communication and cross-functional collaboration
  • Customer focus and results orientation
  • Sound decision-making and problem-solving capability
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to mentor and coach team members
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn emerging automation technologies
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams

Experience

  • 5–8 years of relevant experience in electrical maintenance, industrial automation, or manufacturing maintenance within a high-volume manufacturing environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens TIA Portal , PLC programming, HMIs, SCADA systems, and industrial automation.
  • Experience with vision systems , MES integration, and factory automation technologies.
  • Experience supporting high-volume assembly line maintenance and improving equipment reliability and uptime.
  • Proven experience in electrical troubleshooting, machine programming, preventive maintenance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, 5S, and manufacturing process optimization is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring technicians or supporting team capability development is an added advantage.

job.title: QA Intern
job.description:
We are looking for a talented QA Intern to join our team in Pandan Ave, Singapore. This is an onsite role. Internship period will be 6 months or longer, depending on Singapore colleges/universities session. Internship period will start from Jan 2027 onwards.

The internship with the Cummins Quality Assurance department will provide the intern exposure to real business operations regarding quality systems, compliance standards, process improvement, and continuous improvement initiatives in maintaining operational excellence and product quality. The intern will be given hands-on opportunities to understand, analyze, and improve current operational and quality-related processes while supporting cross-functional teams in achieving quality objectives.

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

Key Responsibilities

  • Work with operations functional managers and team leaders on process and system improvements related to quality assurance, operational efficiency, and compliance standards.
  • Support quality inspection activities, process monitoring, and documentation review to ensure compliance with company quality requirements and procedures.
  • Assist in compiling, analyzing, and maintaining quality-related metrics, reports, and dashboard tracking to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop and update quality dashboards and visual reports to support data-driven decision-making and operational monitoring.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as process optimization, waste reduction, and standardization activities.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective/preventive action activities for operational or quality-related issues.
  • Collaborate and communicate effectively with cross-functional teams including operations, warehouse, engineering, and other stakeholders to improve workflow efficiency and product/service quality.
  • Promote a quality-first mindset by supporting quality awareness sharing, communication initiatives, and best practice discussions across teams.
  • Assist in preparing quality documentation, reports, SOP reviews, presentations, and audit-related materials.
  • Support internal inspections, compliance reviews, and quality improvement projects assigned by the QA team.
  • Be trained to understand quality management systems, operational procedures, dashboard reporting, and process compliance requirements.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Communicates effectively – Developing and delivering clear communication that supports collaboration across different teams and stakeholders.
  • Ensures accountability – Taking ownership of assigned tasks and meeting commitments effectively.
  • Plans and aligns – Managing priorities and coordinating work aligned with organizational goals and operational requirements.
  • Problem solving and analytical thinking – Identifying issues, analysing data, and supporting process improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous improvement mindset – Participating actively in initiatives that improve operational quality, efficiency, and compliance.
  • Quality mindset and collaboration – Promoting quality awareness, teamwork, knowledge sharing, and proactive improvement culture within the organization.
  • Values differences – Recognizing and respecting diverse perspectives and cultures within the organization.

Preferred Qualification

  • Education: Diploma and/or Nitec in Engineering, Quality Management, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing, Environmental Engineering, or related fields.
  • Experience: Knowledge of warehouse, manufacturing, or operational processes is an advantage.
  • Technical skills: Competent in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and dashboard reporting tools (Power BI is an advantage); able to perform data analysis and reporting. Knowledge of quality tools, process improvement methodologies, or risk assessment is a plus.
  • Soft skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, teamwork, transversal collaboration, presentation, and communication skills.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Operations Excellence
job.description:
Assistant Manager, Customer Relations (eMPF)

Location: Hong Kong

Department: Customer Relations & Operations Excellence

Role purpose

This role is ideal for a proactive and resilient professional who is motivated by solving problems, improving customer outcomes, and making a visible impact in a dynamic eMPF environment. The Assistant Manager, Customer Relations (eMPF) is responsible for managing end‑to‑end complaint cases related to eMPF services and customer experience, ensuring timely, fair and professional resolution in line with internal policies and external regulatory requirements, while helping to drive service excellence and continuous improvement.

Your role

  • Handle and resolve customer complaints related to eMPF received via phone, email, written correspondence and other service channels in accordance with internal guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Manage complaint communication through both verbal and written channels, ensuring responses are clear, accurate, professional and empathetic.
  • Conduct detailed investigations into complaint cases, gather facts from relevant systems and stakeholders, and identify the root cause of each issue.
  • Assess operational, compliance, regulatory and reputational risks arising from complaint cases, and promptly escalate sensitive, urgent or high‑risk matters to senior management.
  • Liaise with internal departments, trustees, service providers, vendors and external parties to facilitate thorough investigation and timely case resolution.
  • Support liaison with the MPFA and other relevant parties on complaint cases, information requests, case updates and reporting matters where required.
  • Recommend practical and sustainable resolutions that balance customer fairness, regulatory expectations and operational feasibility.
  • Monitor and achieve assigned complaint handling KPIs, including turnaround time, response quality, case accuracy and closure effectiveness.
  • Identify recurring issues and complaint trends, and work with stakeholders to implement remedial actions and process improvements that enhance customer experience and reduce repeat complaints.
  • Prepare regular and ad hoc management reports, case summaries, trend analysis and briefing materials for management review.
  • Support the review and enhancement of complaint handling policies, guidelines, templates and procedures to ensure alignment with business needs and regulatory expectations.
  • Conduct service quality checks and share knowledge with team members and frontline staff to strengthen complaint handling standards and uplift service capability.
  • Participate in incident management, service recovery and project activities related to eMPF customer issues, and contribute positively in a fast‑paced environment where teamwork and initiative matter.

To succeed in this role:

  • University degree in Business Administration or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in complaint handling or customer relations, preferably in pensions, insurance or banking.
  • Experience in handling complex or escalated complaint cases, with sound judgement and the ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines without compromising quality, accuracy, or compliance.
  • Detail‑minded with strong analytical and investigative skills, and able to review facts carefully, identify gaps and maintain high‑quality documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Chinese, including the ability to draft clear complaint replies, case summaries and management or regulatory correspondence.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across operations, technology, compliance, legal and external counterparties.
  • Good understanding of complaint handling principles, customer fairness, service recovery, and risk awareness.
  • Knowledge of MPF operations, pension administration or relevant regulatory expectations is an advantage.

The qualities that will help you succeed:

  • Self‑motivated, positive, and proactive, with the drive to take ownership and move cases forward with minimal supervision.
  • Calm, resilient and mature, with the confidence to manage difficult conversations and challenging situations professionally.
  • Strong sense of ownership, urgency, accountability, and commitment to case closure.
  • Customer‑centric mindset with a passion for fair outcomes, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • High integrity and discretion in handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Growth‑oriented and open to learning, with the mindset to contribute ideas, strengthen processes and build capability over time.

job.title: Manager, Reporting & Analytics
job.description:
Manager, Reporting & Analytics

Role Purpose

We are seeking a highly analytical, proactive, and customer-centric Manager to lead Customer Service-related reporting, data analysis, system enhancement, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The successful candidate will oversee the delivery of accurate, timely, and meaningful management information, while identifying operational trends, risks, and opportunities to improve service performance and customer outcomes. This role requires a strong leader with a positive, hands-on can-do attitude who takes ownership, drives change, develops team capabilities, and collaborates effectively with stakeholders across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the preparation and governance of BAU operational and management reports using Excel, SQL, and Power BI or Qlik Sense.
  • Oversee the development and enhancement of dashboards, KPI packs, and reporting materials covering service performance, customer enquiries, complaints, backlog, turnaround time, productivity, quality, and other operational indicators.
  • Drive data validation, reconciliation, and analytical reviews across multiple data sources; investigate significant variances, trends, exceptions, and data-quality issues.
  • Establish reporting controls and governance processes to ensure reported figures are accurate, reliable, and supported by appropriate validation mechanisms.
  • Translate complex data into meaningful management insights, highlighting key trends, root causes, customer impacts, operational risks, and recommended actions.
  • Lead reporting automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, reporting quality, and decision-making capabilities.
  • Manage and support system enhancements, UAT, data migration, and transformation initiatives; oversee requirement gathering, test execution, defect management, and implementation activities.
  • Prepare and present management reports, business reviews, and performance updates to senior management and key stakeholders.
  • Partner closely with operations, customer relations, technology teams and other business functions to resolve issues, improve reporting standards, and support business objectives.
  • Lead ad hoc analysis, strategic initiatives, and special projects, ensuring timely delivery and measurable business outcomes.
  • Coach and develop team members, foster a high-performance culture, and ensure effective resource allocation and prioritization of deliverables.**

Requirements

  • Degree holder preferred, with at least 10 years of experience in management information, operations reporting, business analysis, data analytics, operational excellence, or service operations.
  • Experience in pension, insurance, banking, financial services, or another regulated environment is highly preferred.
  • Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup functions, formulas, data reconciliation, data cleansing, trend analysis, forecasting, and management reporting.
  • Strong SQL capability, including data extraction, table joins, aggregation, filtering, reconciliation, and data validation.
  • Hands-on experience in Power BI or Qlik Sense for dashboard development, visualization, and performance reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of reporting governance, data quality management and operational performance measurement.
  • Highly analytical and detail-oriented with the ability to identify emerging risks, unusual trends, material variances, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations and business actions.
  • Customer-centric mindset, with a strong understanding of how operational performance, service quality, and process improvements impact customer experience.
  • Proven leadership capability with experience in stakeholder management, influencing decisions, managing competing priorities and leading teams through change.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including the ability to prepare concise, management-ready insights and recommendations for senior stakeholders.
  • Proactive, resilient and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership and commitment to continuous improvement.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English and Chinese, including Cantonese and Putonghua.

job.title: Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT GDC APAC - Global Infrastructure Development is looking to recruit a Senior Technical Site Due Diligence Manager. The role will support data centre expansion and construction projects across specific regions.

You will play a key role in the site selection and development stage with accountability for the technical due diligence process & master planning for new and existing NTT GDC regions. Alongside Test Fits, this role will involve inputting into the permitting strategy and compiling and analysing site information to identify any impact / risks on development costs & schedule or present a risk to the operation of the data center. You will be expected to engage, instruct, direct, and manage internal resource alongside external consultants, contractors, and experts to ensure technical due diligence & master planning is complete, whilst compiling & mitigating risks and reporting these to the NTT GDC stakeholders.

You will have a strong track record of program management, a demonstrated ability to deliver multiple high priority projects simultaneously and the ability to drive alignment across teams with competing priorities.

You will help develop and promote adoption of best practice process and procedures for site due diligence in the design and engineering, and wider construction and expansion teams.

What we are looking for

Key Role and Responsibilities:

Site Selection and Technical Due Diligence:

  • Present a regional progress report on all projects
  • Lead the Technical Due Diligence process, collaborating with internal stakeholders to guide the expansion of NTT GDC facilities in new and existing regions, by conducting site selection risk analysis and due diligence assessments.
  • Utilize technical expertise to assess and validate the suitability of potential sites, considering factors such as infrastructure, environmental impact, and regulatory compliance.
  • Engage with internal resources and external consultants on power requirements for the sites and ensuring that a clear demonstratable timeline for power is developed as part of the TDD report.
  • Ensure that the constraints of each site are identified with documentary evidence for any limiting factors such as zoning plans and planning requirements.
  • Create and Manage TDD criteria/checklists to enable, and be accountable for, Go/No Go recommendations and decisions.
  • Work with the construction teams and the consultants to create project specific permitting strategies.
  • Develop the project timeline with an explanatory note against each timeline duration giving the next team in the development lifecycle an understanding of assumptions made.
  • Write scope of works for consultants to execute technical assessments and reports.
  • Assess proposals and evaluate them for completeness and manage all correspondence and invoices.
  • Brief consultants on the sites and the requirements to be executed for a red flag report.
  • Hold a site safety briefing ahead of site walks to ensure risks are discussed and protocols understood.
  • Accountable for coordinating site visits, specialist reviews and associated reports and debriefs.
  • Act as the primary contact for external consultants and vendors as well as internal stakeholders, involved in technical due diligence processes.
  • Assess and draw conclusions from a wide range of real estate, engineering, construction, policy, planning, and business development considerations.
  • Responsible for production of compliant test-fits for new sites using Sketchup, also use of CAD and other software to scale and dimension drawings for stage one test fit development.
  • Be proficient in power point to develop presentations to communicate to external stakeholders potential solutions.
  • Brief consultants on 3D flythroughs and drone footage requirements
  • Collaborate with the internal global reference design team and the regional design managers to ensure specific regional inputs are made to make test fits work.
  • Work in conjunction with the associated Site Acquisition Manager (owner of the purchase deal) and Development Manager (owner of pre-construction development) for each site to ensure TDD delivery is progressing in line with the agreed budget and programme.
  • Ensure regular reporting of progress against agreed plans to senior members of Design and Engineering, Delivery and the associated Expansion managers.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance, quality and value for money received through third party appointments.
  • Ensure that NDA’s are executed and consultants are briefed on the confidential nature of projects.
  • Technical & Process Improvement
  • Ability to use technical drawings and scale drawings to develop test fit library for the global team.
  • Contribute to the development of tools, processes, and procedures to enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of the site selection, test fits and due diligence functions.
  • Develop and manage long term relationships with internal stakeholders, key consultants and external subject matter experts to ensure optimal performance.
  • Interface with peers in other departments within the region and with peers in site selection teams globally.
  • Reporting & Quality Control:
  • Develop and maintain a dashboard which represents all projects in region and update the status weekly
  • Ensure that collaboration between all due diligence staff in region is aligned with the global standards
  • Review all consultant reports and work before presenting to internal and external stakeholders
  • Work with site acquisition managers, development manager and construction teams to define and track critical metrics that measure progress towards strategic goals on sites.
  • Analyse data from the seller's data rooms to ensure concise and informative reports are produced by the team.
  • Present findings clearly and effectively to stakeholders, including senior leadership members, and investors when required.
  • Build relationships and a network in region of consultants and trusted advisors that contribute to successful due diligence outcomes.
  • Proactively investigate and address any significant deviations from the global reference design
  • Streamline reporting procedures to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
  • Implement data visualization tools to improve the clarity and impact of reports.
  • Leverage automation to reduce manual data entry and improve reporting frequency.
  • Establish and maintain robust data quality controls to ensure the accuracy and reliability of all reported information.
  • Conduct regular data audits and implement corrective actions as needed.

Knowledge and Key Attributes:

  • You will have a broad understanding of normal and abnormal concepts associated with data centre site development at scale.
  • You will have a solid understanding of cost and time drivers associated with site development e.g., Remediation, Cut and Fill, Utilities connections etc.
  • You will be able to evaluate and assess initial vendor or real estate agent information packs and identify gaps against a prescribed schedule of technical site selection due diligence activities.
  • You will be able to write scope of works for consultants to execute their engineering assessments of land and buildings.
  • You will possess a high-level knowledge of the planning and permitting issues associated with large format industrial buildings such as height restrictions, boundary setbacks, perimeter security, vehicle reticulation analysis, requirements for stormwater attenuation, easements, power routing etc.
  • Able to procure and build a database of exemplar scoping documents for technical site selection studies e.g., topographical assessments, ground condition, environmental risk assessments, etc.
  • Possess familiarity with the concept of progressive de-risk and able to compile, update and maintain RAG reports individually and or on a consolidated basis.
  • Hold a University Degree in Construction, Architecture, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Engineering or equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience in technical due diligence for mission critical and/or similar hi-tech content M&E led industries (e.g., Pharmaceutical, Food and Drink manufacturing, Oil and Gas, Energy, etc.)
  • Experience working within site acquisition teams, preferably in a leading role on the buy side.
  • International experience and outlook both in type of company (multi-national Consultant/Operator) and project experience
  • Clear and concise written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Demonstrate self-management by supporting and developing teams, fostering a positive team atmosphere, overcoming obstacles, and embracing challenges confidently.
  • Exhibit rounded thinking, self-awareness, and a collaborative approach.
  • Possess organizational skills with a can-do/will-do attitude and a consistent ability to translate ideas into impactful actions.
  • Able and happy to travel within region and internationally up to 35% of working time.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Associate Solutions Architect, Startup (Vietnamese Speaking), APJ ECT SA
job.description:
Are you interested in cloud computing and helping customers build on AWS? We have a role you might find interesting.

The AWS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with customers as they build and grow their businesses on AWS. We're here to make sure they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible — and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so.

Key job responsibilities We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with customers to help them succeed. In this role, you'll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You'll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor.

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you'll also get plenty of time to "sharpen the saw" and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories, and it's important that we can help customers take advantage of the right ones. You'll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the customers you work with. And for the customers you don't get to work with on a 1:1 basis, you'll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events.

A day in the life Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the fastest-growing companies to Global 500 enterprises trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

About the team AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest-growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience with one of the following programming languages: Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C++
  • Experience with two or more of the following: networking fundamentals, security, storage or databases (relational or NoSQL), operating systems (Unix, Linux, or Windows)
  • 2+ years of Information Technology (IT) experience
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in Vietnamesse

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience implementing a cloud-based technology solution
  • Experience in any of the following: Cloud Architecture, Systems Design, Software Development, Infrastructure Architecture, Data Engineering or DevOps

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

job.title: Network Operations Engineer
job.description:
Job Duties & Requirements

Job Responsibilities:

  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting assistance to a diverse customer base utilizing a wide range of network products and services.
  • Perform regular network health checks to ensure optimal network performance, availability, and reliability.

  • Min. 2-4 years of hands-on experience in NOC.
  • Solid understanding of routing and switching protocols and TCP/IP fundamentals.
  • Willing to take shift role.

job.title: (SSLS)生产IE工程师 闵行
job.description:
加入西门子智能基础设施集团，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

在西门子电气及自动化业务单元，我们期待生产岗位人才可以推动中压开关设备制造领域发展。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

  • 精益分析及改善，优化生产线的工艺布局，平面布置，运用精益生产理念及工具，对设备布局，工艺路线实现提供改善方案。对于生产过程中的七大浪费，组织相关生产班组成员，进行定期分析和持续改善，持续提升生产效率；
  • 分析生产产能现状，根据销售预测进行生产能力分析，根据分析结果配合各个，不断优化生产效率及设备利用率，从而达到降低生产成本的目的及相关人力配置，对标准化生产管理流程进行优化；
  • 标准化工时管理，配合工艺部门，核实并更新各个生产过程的标准工时；
  • KPI 指标管理，配合生产经理，分析和制定提高劳动生产率，产能，成本控制等生产相关的KPI指标，持续追踪并优化；
  • 推动生产标准化，实施现场标准化工作，并定期对进行现场考评实施效果，将标准化工作展开到培训等辅助工作中。

你需要具备的品质：

  • 拥有机械、工程、生产管理或相关领域的本科或以上学历。
  • 五年及以上工业工程、流程优化，产能分析等相关工作经验
  • 具备良好的问题解决能力，能够识别问题的根本原因，运用精益工具和方法来解决问题，并制定预防措施以防止问题再次发生。
  • 具备良好的团队合作能力，能够与多个利益相关者合作，包括生产工人、管理人员和其他部门的人员。能够有效地沟通、协调和协作，以实现共同的目标。
  • 具备良好的沟通和领导能力，能够清晰地传达精益理念和方法，并激励和引导团队成员参与和支持改进活动。
  • 具备持续学习和适应能力，能够跟踪行业的最新趋势和发展，并不断更新和发展自己的专业知识和技能。
  • 至少能用英语进行读写，英语口语流利是加分项。

你将得到这些收获：

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作
  • 带薪享超长10天年假，还有圣诞假等额外福利
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 “2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50” 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

job.title: Design Engineer - Drives, Cheonan
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Project Engineering Manager (부장)__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to create and modify the standard designs of equipment, systems, or installations, including standard specifications for manufacturing, fabrication, or construction, using standard design concepts. Each day, you will design engineering solutions, including drawings and calculations according to contract specifications. You will also showcase your expertise by contributing to design reviews and design verification and modifying the design, as necessary.

The work model for the role is: Onsite # LI-onsite

This role is contributing to the Motion High Power Division in South Korea.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contributing to the preparation of specific aspects of design assignments to meet the contractual obligations, adhering to relevant standards, safety, cybersecurity, and quality requirements.

  • Using standard processes and tools and assisting in developing new processes and tools for the reuse of technical solutions.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Power Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or related field

More about us

ABB Motion keeps the world turning, while saving energy every day. Our pioneering drives, motors, generators, traction converters and mechanical power transmission products are driving the low-carbon future for industries, cities, infrastructure and transportation. Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

job.title: Solution Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Digital Solution Engineering Manager ###

What we believe in

ABB's Process Automation business area enables customers to operate some of the world's largest and most complex industrial infrastructures, helping them outrun – leaner and cleaner. We are an international pioneering technology leader writing the future of industrial digitalization. At the forefront is our Software Development Center, which provides industry-leading software and deep domain expertise to help the world's most asset-intensive industries solve their biggest challenges. We offer a broad range of automation, electrification, and digital solutions for process, hybrid, and maritime industries, including industry-specific integrated control systems, software, measurement, analytics, and services.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, we are looking for software professionals to join our Industrial Automation Digital Organization. The role requires being part of a team with experience in a DevOps environment, focused on software lifecycle automation, build and release management, and CI/CD. You will primarily focus on engineering modern and agile environments using various DevOps and automation tools to support Application Lifecycle Management, while contributing to the development of enterprise platforms and solutions on on-premise and cloud platforms such as Azure.

The work model for the role is: Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Establish and maintain suitable DevOps channels, CI/CD pipelines, and continuous build environments across platforms to accelerate software development and deployment processes.
  • Develop and maintain test automation frameworks (PyTest, Unittest), covering UI automation (Selenium, Playwright), API testing, regression, smoke testing, and database validation using Python.
  • Collaborate with the ABB project team in requirement gatherings, design discussions, documentation, and reviews, reporting daily activities, expected deliverables, and progress to the technical lead or manager.
  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and generative AI platforms to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and intelligent automation workflows.

Qualifications for the role

  • Strong Python programming skills including Flask, metadata management, PL/SQL scripting, database packages, procedures, functions, triggers, views, and materialized views, with solid experience in data-driven and keyword-driven testing frameworks (PyTest, Unittest).
  • Proven experience in Web UI automation (Selenium, Playwright), API test automation, test case design and execution, automated regression and smoke testing, and test reporting and logging.
  • Solid experience with database systems (SQL/NoSQL) including MS SQL, Oracle, MongoDB, and Realtime DB, with capabilities in DB processing (partitioning, indexes), database validation, SQL testing, data quality tests, and basic UNIX scripting.
  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD integration (Jenkins, Azure DevOps), source control management (Git), and establishing DevOps channels and continuous build environments across platforms.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure, cloud platform concepts, and application containerization tools (Docker, Docker Swarm, Kubernetes), along with familiarity with dashboards, language, database, and test technologies.
  • AI/ML integration experience, including working with GitHub Copilot, AI-powered code generation, automated testing, log analysis, and observability platforms to enhance development productivity and software quality.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills in English, with good customer-facing and coordination abilities, adherence to software development methodologies, and a proven track record of delivering solutions in complex customer system landscapes within predictable timelines and quality standards.

More about us

ABB is a leading global technology company that energizes the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future. The Process Automation (PA) business area (>$6B revenue in 2021, 22,000 employees) automates, electrifies, and digitalizes some of the most complex industrial infrastructures on this planet. Through its five divisions, we serve customers in the energy, process, and hybrid industries – from hydrocarbons, chemicals, water, mining, minerals, pulp & paper to marine and ports, and many more. PA stands at the heart of some of the most important shifts in society, helping energy-intense industries achieve safer, smarter, and more sustainable operations to enable a prosperous, low-carbon society.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry leadership, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, premium service delivery, and a highly skilled technical workforce to create safer, smarter, and more sustainable buildings.

Based in Lismore, you will be responsible for servicing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and commissioning security systems across a portfolio of customer sites. This is a hands-on position that offers a mix of service, technical problem-solving, customer engagement, and project delivery.

Working alongside experienced technicians and industry experts, you'll play a key role in ensuring customers' critical security systems remain reliable, compliant, and operating at peak performance.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Collaborate with subcontractors, project teams, and service colleagues to ensure successful project delivery.

  • Contribute to a strong safety culture by identifying and addressing hazards and ensuring compliance with company safety standards.
  • Achieve and maintain full compliance with Johnson Controls' Safety, Health & Environment Management System (SHEMS).

About You

We're interested in hearing from security professionals, electricians, HVAC technicians, communications technicians, fire technicians, and other technically skilled tradespeople with experience in building technologies and critical infrastructure environments.

You will ideally have:

  • Minimum 2 years' experience in a Security Technician or similar field service role.
  • Trade qualification in Security, Electrical, HVAC, Electronics, Communications, or a related discipline.
  • Current NSW Security Licence.
  • Strong experience in the maintenance, fault-finding, repair, and commissioning of security systems.
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, schematics, and service documentation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Customer-focused approach with excellent problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively.
  • Willingness to travel within the region as required.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with Gallagher Security Management Systems.
  • Exposure to Building Management Systems (BMS) or integrated building technologies.
  • Experience working in healthcare, industrial, commercial, government, or critical infrastructure environments.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

  • Competitive remuneration package and overtime opportunities.
  • Career development and ongoing technical training.
  • Exposure to market-leading security and building technology solutions.
  • Work across a diverse range of industries and critical facilities.
  • Supportive team culture backed by a global organisation.
  • Stable, long-term career opportunities with an industry leader.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants will be required to complete:

  • Pre-employment medical assessment
  • Criminal history check
  • Drug and alcohol screening

Apply Now

If you're looking to take the next step in your security technology career and join a global leader in smart building solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: People and Workplace Coordinator
job.description:
About Goodman

At Goodman, your career is more than just a job – it’s about growth, innovation, and making a lasting impact. Whether you’re building your career in property, data centres, finance, legal, or beyond, we value diverse perspectives and seek individuals who are passionate about driving our business forward.

As providers of essential infrastructure for the digital economy, Goodman has been developing its data centre capability since 2005. Since then, we have grown to become a large owner of powered sites globally. Our global power bank of 5.0GW includes completed facilities, secured power and potential data centre projects across 13 major international cities. This has been built up over time through our expertise in securing land, planning and power in highly sought after locations in major global cities.

We are seeking a highly organised and service-focused People and Workplace Coordinator to support the day-to-day operation of our Melbourne office and help deliver a positive employee and workplace experience.

The Opportunity

This is a broad and varied role that plays a central part in creating a workplace that is professional, welcoming and easy to work from.

As the local face of the Melbourne office, you will coordinate office operations, workplace services, employee onboarding, recruitment logistics, supplier relationships, events and administrative activities. You'll work closely with employees, leaders, building management and service providers to ensure the office operates smoothly and efficiently.

This role would suit someone who enjoys variety, takes pride in delivering exceptional service and is proactive in identifying and resolving issues before they arise.

Key Responsibilities

Workplace and Office Operations

  • Coordinate the day-to-day operation of the Melbourne office.
  • Act as a key point of contact for workplace-related requests and support.
  • Maintain office standards to ensure the workplace is organised, professional and welcoming.
  • Manage office administration, documentation and workplace processes.

Facilities and Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate building services, maintenance, security, cleaning and workplace contractors.
  • Manage office supplies, kitchen consumables, stationery and workplace amenities.
  • Support workplace health, safety and wellbeing activities.
  • Assist with workplace improvements, upgrades and office projects.

Employee Experience and Recruitment Support

  • Coordinate onboarding logistics for new employees, including workspace setup, office orientation and access arrangements.
  • Liaise with People & Culture, IT and hiring managers to support a seamless onboarding experience.
  • Coordinate interview logistics, candidate visits and recruitment events.
  • Support employee movements, seating plans, office records and workplace communications.

Events and Hospitality

  • Coordinate meetings, catering, visitor management and room readiness.
  • Support team events, wellbeing initiatives, celebrations and corporate functions.
  • Assist with property tours, customer events and internal activities.

Administration and Financial Support

  • Coordinate purchase orders, invoices, expense coding and supplier administration.
  • Support travel bookings and related administration.
  • Assist with office budgets, reporting and approval processes.
  • Maintain accurate records and handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

About You

You are an organised and proactive coordinator who enjoys supporting people and creating great workplace experiences.

You will bring:

  • Experience in office coordination, workplace operations, people operations or corporate administration.
  • Experience supporting a professional corporate office environment.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Experience coordinating suppliers, facilities, events and workplace services.
  • Confidence using Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with invoicing, purchase orders and administrative processes.
  • A proactive, solutions-focused approach and a strong attention to detail.
  • High levels of professionalism, discretion and customer service.

The Benefits

At Goodman we know that our people are integral to our company success. That’s why we have implemented some fantastic benefits for all to experience, these include:

  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Study assistance for postgraduate and undergraduate courses
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Eligibility to participate in Goodman’s share scheme
  • Wellness program that focuses on the health and wellbeing, including exercise classes, meditation, yoga, social events, exclusive discounts, cooking classes, financial wellbeing seminars and more.

About Goodman

Goodman is a provider of essential infrastructure. We own, develop and manage high quality, sustainable logistics properties and data centres in major global cities, that are critical to the digital economy.

job.title: Lead Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Mentors teams and leads the architecture of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems. Identifies and removes performance/scalability bottlenecks for hyper‑scale workloads; defines scalability requirements with stakeholders; and designs elastic, high‑impact systems while advancing innovation in data plane platforms. Engineers and oversees fault‑tolerant, in‑service‑upgradable designs; optimizes resilience mechanisms (load‑shedding, throttling, rate‑limiting); and sets SLO‑aligned durability and availability standards across dependent services. Establishes KPIs and advanced telemetry; applies formal verification for complex features; and develops robust replication/synchronization strategies. Advises and leads resolution of complex production issues, sets operational readiness and SOP standards, and directs incident response and RCAs. Architects advanced security controls, drives remediation and compliance, and delivers enterprise‑level automation (IaC) and change strategies enabling safe, automated patching, updates, and rollbacks.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

System Design & Architecture - System Scalability:

–Mentor the team in the architecture and design of highly scalable, interdependent distributed systems, ensuring horizontal and vertical scalability and overall performance, including leveraging distributed state management tools.

–Lead the identification of performance and scalability bottlenecks and recommend solutions to optimize code and/or systems for large-scale data processing and high-throughput requirements to improve performance for hyper-scale systems.

–Lead collaboration with stakeholders to define system scalability requirements, ensuring the defined requirements meet customer expectations.

–Leverage deep expertise to design high-impact, interdependent systems to scale with elasticity (e.g., effectively scaling both up and down).

–Drive innovation in the use of data plane platforms.

–Evaluate whether systems are meeting nonfunctional scalability requirements, and proactively anticipate growing business needs within the business unit.

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Design:

–Design and oversee the implementation of fault-tolerant, interdependent systems capable of withstanding in-service updates by implementing sophisticated redundancy, replication, and automatic failover capabilities.

–Lead the design and implementation of systems that effectively handle service disruptions (e.g., network partitions) by prioritizing consistency, availability, or partition tolerance.

–Guide the optimization of advanced mechanisms to handle network unreliability, including load-shedding, throttling, and rate-limiting.

–Design interdependent systems that are durable and adhere to service level objectives (SLOs), driving standards for availability and durability of other computing services within the organization

System Design & Architecture - System Reliability Performance:

–Define key performance indicators (KPIs) and telemetry to identify risks, gaps, or cyclical dependencies in running, interdependent systems.

–Drive the creation and customization of highly complex dashboards, telemetry systems, and alerting mechanisms, proactively ensuring system health and reliability.

System Design & Architecture - Correctness / Availability:

–Maintain expertise in industry standards for verifying correctness and apply existing techniques to interdependent systems.

–Formally verify complex features (e.g., via TLA+) to ensure system design correctness for various interdependent systems.

–Develop advanced strategies for data replication and synchronization, ensuring robust data integrity and availability

Operational Troubleshooting & Incident Management:

–Advise on efforts to diagnose, debug, and resolve complex issues in active, interdependent systems to support ongoing operation.

–Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to prevent interruptions, ensuring no maintenance windows are required for customers and users when resolving issues.

–Maintain expertise in dependencies, dependents, and owned systems to drive effective troubleshooting and performance.

–Set standards for operational readiness and standard operating procedures within the department, and hold third-party partners accountable for meeting those standards.

–Oversee operational support rotations, providing expert guidance in incident response and leading root cause investigations to prevent future occurrences.

Compliance & Security:

–Architect advanced security measures to protect data and applications in multi-tenant environments, and lead initiatives to enhance data and application protection.

–Guide the execution of comprehensive remediation plans to address identified security vulnerabilities.

–Ensure cloud infrastructure is in compliance with industry standards and regulations, and guide documentation efforts across projects.

Automation & Change Management:

–Develop enterprise-level automation tools and strategies (e.g., Infrastructure as Code (IaC)) and oversee their implementation.

–Drive alignment of change management plans and organizational initiatives for patching, updating, and rolling back applications, and design interdependent systems to allow for automation of these processes.

Core Responsibilities

Planning & Execution:

–Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Collaboration & Partnership:

–Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Problem Solving:

–Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

–Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions). Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

Continuous Improvement:

–Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization. Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals. Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

Performance and Development:

–Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy. Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

About Us

Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing [accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com](mailto:accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com) or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI (Thai, English)
job.description:
About the job

As a Generative AI (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customers. You will function as an innovator-builder, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment. You will address blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management challenges that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve dual purpose, providing white glove deployment of complex AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
  • Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including Application Programming Interface (APIs), legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
  • Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
  • Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for engineering teams. Be able to co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
  • Translate technical concepts to non-technical executive and Thai-speaking audiences.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Territory Manager- Sales (Trade)
job.description:
Legrand India is looking for a dynamic, results-driven Territory Manager – Trade Sales to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for accelerating revenue growth by managing and expanding our retail and distribution network. You will drive primary, secondary, and tertiary sales within your assigned territory, ensuring Legrand remains the preferred brand for dealers, retailers, and electrical contractors.   • Industry Background: Prior experience in Electrical (FMEG/Switchgear), Lighting industry is highly preferred.

job.title: Senior Service Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Willing to work in Shift available to work on Holidays & public holidays to meet agreed SLA
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.

job.title: Senior Associate - IT SOX Compliance
job.description:
What you will do

  • Drive and executes IT SOX 404 assessments, including risk assessment, walkthroughs, and testing of IT General Controls (viz. Access Management, Logical Security Settings, Change Management, and Computer Operations)
  • Work in a collaborative team environment and contribute to the successful delivery of IT SOX Compliance and Internal Controls review engagements, including preparing high-quality, accurate, well-supported documentation, and reports.

. Evaluate the design and operating effectiveness of ITGC’s controls. Maintain up-to-date documentation, IT SOX Narratives, and process flowcharts.

  • Drive and execute the IT General control testing around inscope Servers and Databases around Privilege User Access Review, Logical Security Settings, Back-up scheduling and Monitoring, Back-up Integrity, etc.

. Contribute and support the IT Automated Control testing, assess the completeness and accuracy of Annual User Access review at Enterprise level

  • Perform thorough reviews to analyze the adequacy of IT controls, internal controls over financial reporting, compliance with corporate standards, policies, and regulatory requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 1/2, ISO, NIST).
  • Prioritize and assign tasks to ensure effective use of team resources and completion of work according to schedules and engagement objectives.
  • Assist in the evaluation of system implementations/upgrades by performing the System Development Life Cycle (SDLC) reviews.
  • Evaluate the IT control environments of the newly acquired entities to ensure adequate controls are in place to support the complete and accurate financial reporting.
  • Present findings to management at the conclusion of engagements, discuss deficiencies, and recommend remediation actions and opportunities for improvement.
  • Consult with IT clients to redesign/re-engineer processes; identify opportunities for optimizing operational efficiencies, strengthening internal controls, and reducing overall IT and Non-IT risk.
  • Opine on the adequacy of remedial actions taken to correct deficiencies and assist with issue closure processes.
  • Maintain adequate and current technical knowledge in areas such as IT general controls, business process controls, cybersecurity, and other areas as required.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Respond to complex, escalated inquiries and ensure outstanding IT Audit & SOX issues are cleared.
  • Collaborate with other functions of global Assurance & Advisory Services and support ad-hoc activities and engagements as needed.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Management Information Systems, Computer Science, Chartered Accountant, or related IT graduates
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) certification preferred.
  • Minimum of 6 years’ combined experience in IT SOX Compliances, with strong exposure to SOX compliance framework, internal controls review, IT risk and governance.
  • Knowledge of relevant IT domains including automated controls testing, system development lifecycle, SOC-1 report review, and identity and access management at Application and Operating System level (i.e., Servers and Databases).
  • Demonstrated ability for independent thinking and multi-tasking under aggressive deadlines with a high degree of accuracy in a complex “matrix” environment.
  • Proven ability to plan proactively, anticipate issues, and have excellent problem resolution records with little or no input or assistance.
  • Proficiency in computer applications including MS Word, MS Excel, and MS Outlook.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. job.description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. 高级软件工程师（自动驾驶数据闭环与AI智能故障诊断平台）

岗位职责

负责车端故障事件检测与数据自动切片、回传工具开发，支持感知、定位、规划、控制等节点故障信号触发。

建设企业级自动驾驶数据闭环平台，统一管理多矿山、多车辆、多版本回传数据，并打通数据标注平台。

负责基于 VLM 的自动化问题诊断能力开发，将图像、点云、轨迹、日志、故障码等多模态信息组织为模型上下文，自动输出故障现象、根因分析与排查建议。

结合 RAG、工具调用或 Agent 工作流完成复杂诊断，并建立证据引用与人工确认机制以控制模型幻觉。

负责 VLM 领域微调与评估体系建设（SFT、LoRA/QLoRA），持续沉淀现场数据实现闭环迭代。

建设 MLOps Pipeline，支持感知、融合等模型的一键训练、验证、导出（ONNX/TensorRT）与车端部署。

负责平台架构设计与核心开发，保障系统可扩展、高可用、可观测。

任职要求-基本要求

计算机、软件工程、人工智能、自动化等相关专业本科及以上学历。

5年以上软件平台、自动驾驶数据平台或 AI 工程系统开发经验。

熟练掌握 Python，并掌握 C++、Go 或 Java 之一。

熟悉 Web 后端、RESTful API、数据库设计及 Docker、Linux、CI/CD。

AI / VLM方向

具备 VLM 或多模态大模型实际项目经验，能独立完成从方案到部署的全过程。

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Description

We are building the future. Caterpillar’s Integrated Drivetrain Energy Solutions (IDES) Division will focus on delivering advanced electrified power train, zero-emissions products/technologies, and the solutions and services associated with these technologies. Focus areas include batteries, fuel cells, motors, inverters, micro grid controllers, charging, energy storage systems, lifecycle solutions/services and integration of components for ePowertrain solutions across industries. We are looking for top talent to build and scale the next generation of technologies, products, and services to help our customers build a better—more sustainable—world.

Job Purpose

IDES currently has an opening for a Manufacturing Quality Lead. This position is located in Wuxi, China with responsibility for the in-process quality, pre-delivery quality, and quality issues related to battery manufacturing at customer side. The incumbent will report to the Director of Battery Manufacturing. The incumbent will partner with and provide technical manufacturing and assembly quality process guidance to global engineering and supplier partner teams, recognizing that this position faces ongoing change – increased competitive pressures, increasing product complexity, and ever-increasing customer demands. You will lead the quality management of complex projects, continually monitor internal and external supplier quality. You will mentor, coach, and assign daily tasks to team members and suppliers to improve both incoming and outgoing quality.

Job Duties/Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to:

  • Performing quality reviews and internal audits; evaluating data and writing reports to validate or indicate deviations from existing standards.
  • Monitoring engineering processes and products for adherence to company and regulatory standards and practices; participating in quality improvement initiatives and projects.
  • Analyzing statistical data and product specifications to determine standards and establish quality and reliability objectives of finished product.
  • Recommending modifications to existing quality or production standards and manufacturing process and equipment/tooling to achieve optimum quality.
  • Conducts investigations and analyses which contribute to the development and implementation of methods, procedures and equipment that ensure quality standards for parts and prime products.
  • Supporting quality metrics across multiple product families such as battery module, strings, and pack / groups, inverters, chargers, and other power electronics.

Degree Requirement Four-year Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a related Industrial, Manufacturing, Quality, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering/Technology curriculum

Skill Descriptors Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Working Knowledge:
