  • Processes limited amounts of detailed information with good accuracy.
  • Learns from mistakes and applies lessons learned.
  • Develops and uses checklists to ensure that information goes out error-free.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Flexibility and Adaptability: Knowledge of successful approaches and techniques for dealing with change; ability to adapt to a changing environment and be comfortable with change. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Adjusts to new or changing assignments, processes, and people.
  • Demonstrates willingness to listen to other opinions.
  • Provides examples of shifting from task to task.
  • Identifies and considers alternative approaches to situations or problems.
  • Accepts new or radical ideas with an open mind; avoids snap reactions.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Identifies and documents specific problems and resolution alternatives.
  • Examines a specific problem and understands the perspective of each involved stakeholder.
  • Develops alternative techniques for assessing accuracy and relevance of information.
  • Helps to analyze risks and benefits of alternative approaches and obtain decision on resolution.
  • Uses fact-finding techniques and diagnostic tools to identify problems.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
  • Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
  • Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
  • Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
  • Produces standard project status reports.

Quality Management System (QMS): Knowledge of Quality Management System's (QMS) functions, features, and capabilities; ability to design, implement, test, and maintain Quality Management Systems to consistently meet customer requirements and regulatory compliances. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Adheres to the process, requirements, and documentation associated with QMS.
  • Contributes to the development of business case analysis for a new QMS functionality in the system.
  • Explains and analyzes quality indicators and metrics relevant to one's business unit or function.
  • Monitors key interfaces and criticalities related to QMS.
  • Reviews various QMS products and service providers available in the market and lists their applications.

Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Alerts own team to problems in client satisfaction.

As an integral part of the Continuous Improvement (CI) Center of Excellence, the Finance Transformation Manager – Tax will lead and support global tax transformation initiatives focused on optimization, digitalization, and supporting large efficiencies initiatives.

This role partners closely with Operations Tax, Finance, IT, and GBS stakeholders to modernize tax processes, enable regulatory compliance, improve data quality, and leverage digital solutions across direct and indirect tax domains. The position plays a key role in shaping roadmap-driven transformation aligned with Caterpillar’s global operating model.

job.title: Assistant Growth Manager, MVNO
job.description:
Job Description

Role Overview

We are seeking a driven and entrepreneurial Growth Manager to join our MVNO team. This role will be responsible for accelerating subscriber growth and revenue performance through strategic engagement with existing partners and the development of new partnerships. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, you will take a data-driven and experimental approach to unlock growth opportunities, collaborating closely across brand, product, and operations. We are looking for someone with a strong challenger mindset—curious, bold, and always willing to test new ideas and bring fresh thinking to the team.

1. Growth Strategy & Performance

  • Develop and execute strategies to drive subscriber acquisition, retention, and ARPU growth.
  • Own and report on key growth metrics including partner acquisition, customer base expansion, and revenue KPIs.
  • Monitor performance dashboards and continuously optimize the business model through experimentation and iteration.
  • Lead competitive benchmarking and market analysis to identify emerging opportunities.

2. Product & Commercial Optimization

  • Collaborate with product managers to refine pricing, packaging, and value propositions.
  • Work with MVNOs and wholesale partners to test and iterate on offers, bundles, and promotions to improve conversion and upsell.

  • Pitch wholesale offers to potential MVNO and wholesale partners, tailoring proposals to diverse market segments.

  • Strong track record in growth management, with measurable results in subscriber acquisition and revenue scaling.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, agile environment with cross-functional collaboration.
  • Data-driven with strong analytical, financial modelling, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in digital-first or challenger brand environments.
  • Familiarity with subscription-based or telecom business models.
  • Experience in partnership development with MNOs, MVNOs, or digital ecosystem players.
  • Exposure to international markets and regulatory frameworks in telecom.

Skills & Competencies

Decision Making

Collaboration

Customer Orientation

Learning Agility

Developing People

Transdisciplinary Thinking

job.title: Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

ROLE SUMMARY

Network Engineer is responsible for stable, secure, and efficient network operations for enterprise customers through proactive Day 2 support and Level 2 technical expertise. The role focuses on timely incident resolution, maintaining high service availability, supporting changes and maintenance activities, and strengthening operational capability across Huawei NCE Campus and other supported network and security platforms.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Provide Level 2 support for Huawei NCE Campus network infrastructure and other supported enterprise networking platforms.
  • Ensure timely incident resolution and service restoration for customer environments, with clear diagnostics and escalation where required.
  • Perform root-cause analysis, implement corrective actions, and recommend preventive measures to reduce recurrence.
  • Maintain accurate network configurations, operational records, and technical documentation.
  • Collaborate with Day 1, cybersecurity, service management, and project teams to ensure seamless service delivery and effective handovers.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network incidents involving switching, routing, wireless, access control, and firewall environments.
  • Perform configuration updates, firmware upgrades, and planned maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures and change controls.
  • Conduct periodic health checks, monitoring, and performance analysis to identify and address potential service disruptions.
  • Support integration and interoperability testing with additional network platforms and products where required.
  • Provide technical reports, update service tickets, maintain operational records, and contribute to service reviews and operational meetings.

Qualifications

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • At least 5 years of experience in network operations, managed services, or medium-sized campus / enterprise network environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of Huawei NCE Campus, with practical experience supporting network incidents, changes, and day-to-day operations.
  • Working knowledge of LAN, WAN, WLAN, IP addressing, VLANs, switching, routing, network access control, and enterprise connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Hands-on exposure to one or more of Aruba, Cisco Meraki, Palo Alto, and Fortinet environments is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to perform structured troubleshooting, log and evidence collection, root-cause analysis, and effective escalation to vendors or higher-level engineering teams.
  • Experience with firmware upgrades, configuration changes, preventive maintenance, and operational change procedures.
  • Comfortable working with ticketing systems, monitoring tools, network documentation, and service management processes.
  • Good communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with engineers, service management, project teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.

job.title: Senior Manager, Mechanical (GERA)
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Regional Mechanical Operations Leadership: Lead and coordinate mechanical operations support across South East Asia data center sites, ensuring consistent operating standards, maintenance practices, risk controls, and performance expectations.
  • Liquid Cooling Operations: Own regional operational readiness for liquid cooling systems, including CDUs, secondary cooling loops, manifolds, heat exchangers, leak detection, water quality management, commissioning support, and maintenance procedures.
  • Technical Support to Site Operations: Provide second-level technical support to local DCO and facilities teams for complex mechanical issues, including chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC units, cooling towers, pumps, valves, controls, fire protection interfaces, and high-density cooling environments.
  • Reliability and Availability: Drive mechanical system reliability through preventive and predictive maintenance programs, failure trend analysis, root cause investigation, corrective action tracking, and lessons learned implementation.
  • Standards and Governance: Develop and maintain regional mechanical operating standards, Basic of Design review & regional maintenance playbooks
  • Commissioning and Handover: Support new site commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness reviews, and handover from project delivery teams to operations, with particular attention to cooling system resilience and maintainability.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor mechanical system performance, identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency, PUE, water usage, cooling capacity, redundancy, and lifecycle cost while maintaining uptime and customer commitments.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Coordinate with OEMs, service providers, consultants, and contractors to ensure maintenance quality, technical compliance, timely issue resolution, and safe execution of works in live data center environments.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Safety: Ensure mechanical activities comply with applicable local regulations, health and safety requirements, environmental obligations, permit-to-work processes, and DayOne operational risk controls.

Experience with critical electrical facility architectures, switching operations, commissioning, energization, and operational readiness.Proven experience leading complex incident response, performing advanced fault diagnosis, protection system analysis, forensic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and driving permanent corrective and preventive actions across regional operations.Strong understanding of international standards and industry best practices, including IEC, IEEE, NFPA 70/70E, as well as local electrical regulations across Southeast Asia. Conduct workshops, interviews, and analysis to define comprehensive functional requirements.
  • Solution Design: Translate business requirements into scalable SAP Group Reporting solutions. Configure and maintain consolidation units and groups, financial statement items, versions, subitems, document types, breakdown categories, validation and substitution rules, reclassification methods, currency translation, intercompany matching and eliminations, consolidation of investments, and reporting structures in line with business requirements and SAP best practices.
  • Implementation: Lead or support the implementation and enhancement of SAP Group Reporting solutions, including master data setup, data collection, data mapping, integration with the Universal Journal and source systems, opening balance and historical data migration, cutover, user training, and deployment activities.
  • Consolidation Operations: Support period-end, quarter-end, and year-end consolidation cycles. Work with Group Finance to monitor data collection, validation, currency translation, intercompany eliminations, equity and investment consolidation, non-controlling interests, cash flow reporting, and consolidated financial statement production.
  • Testing: Plan and execute unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, and user acceptance testing. Validate consolidation results, postings, eliminations, reporting outputs, and end-to-end integration, and ensure that defects are documented and resolved.
  • Support and Maintenance: Provide ongoing functional support to end-users, troubleshoot incidents, perform root-cause analysis, coordinate SAP support cases, and implement sustainable fixes and enhancements to improve system stability, controls, and usability.

Review Group Reporting substitutions, validations, master data, and consolidation rules to improve data quality and prevent recurring reporting issues.
  • Continuous Improvements: Proactively analyse consolidation results, incident trends, system performance, and business workflows to identify bottlenecks, manual workarounds, control weaknesses, and automation opportunities. Work with business stakeholders to prioritize and implement improvements that increase close efficiency, reporting accuracy, user experience, and business value.

Qualifications

  • SAP S/4HANA certification in Finance or Group Reporting is preferred.
  • At least 5-7 years of hands-on SAP functional experience, including strong experience in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting configuration, implementation, integration, and support.
  • At least 2 full life-cycle implementations or major transformation programmes involving SAP Group Reporting or SAP consolidation solutions, with direct responsibility for business blueprinting, solution design, testing, cutover, or stabilization.
  • Strong knowledge of financial consolidation processes, including data collection, currency translation, intercompany matching and elimination, reclassification, consolidation of investments, non-controlling interests, cash flow reporting, and consolidated financial statements.
  • Good working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA Finance and integration between accounting data, the Universal Journal, and Group Reporting. Experience with SAP Group Reporting Data Collection and SAP Analytics Cloud is an advantage.
  • Ability to diagnose complex consolidation and reporting issues, perform structured root-cause analysis, and translate findings into sustainable system, process, or control improvements.
  • Experience managing business stakeholders at Head of Department or Group Finance leadership level, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly and facilitate decisions.
  • Experience in setting up and nurturing a key user network and producing clear process documentation, operating procedures, training materials, and user guidance.
  • Experience working in a hybrid project and application maintenance environment. Able to manage multiple priorities and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, implementation partners, and external vendors.

job.title: Executive Assistant & Office Manager, APAC
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Overview

The Executive Assistant & Office Manager, APAC is a senior strategic support role providing trusted partnership to Asia Pacific leaders, combining executive assistance with regional office management oversight across Sydney.

This role sits at the heart of the organization and interacts with employees at all levels, as well as external stakeholders. The successful candidate is highly organized, adaptable, service-oriented, and thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. They bring a strong “can-do” mindset, excellent judgment, and a proven track record supporting senior leadership while managing office operations effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Executive & Administrative Support

  • Manage complex calendars for Executives, including meetings across time zones
  • Proactively manage email, correspondence, call screening, and follow-ups on behalf of leaders
  • Provide end-to-end administrative support, including records management and confidential documentation
  • Prepare meeting agendas, attend meetings, capture minutes, and track action items to completion
  • Serve as a key point of contact between Executives, internal teams, clients, and external partners
  • Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage expenses
  • Anticipate executive needs, manage competing priorities, and support effective time management

Office Management & Operations

  • Oversee daily office operations, space management, access cards, and office supplies
  • Partner with facilities on maintenance, repairs, and workplace improvements
  • Manage vendor relationships, contracts, and service quality
  • Implement and support health, safety, and workplace compliance initiatives

Communication, Collaboration & Events

  • Act as a liaison to ensure clear, timely communication across stakeholders and departments
  • Partner with teams to support business initiatives and cross-functional collaboration
  • Support planning and execution of company events, town halls, and special projects
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with internal and external partners

Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience as an Executive Assistant supporting C-level Executives and/or VPs
  • Minimum 3+ years of experience in an Office Manager or Office Administrator role
  • Experience working with diverse, multicultural stakeholders across multiple time zones
  • Proven ability to handle highly confidential information with discretion
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills (formal and informal)
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • High proficiency with Microsoft tools, including Outlook calendaring
  • Energetic, adaptable, solutions oriented, and quick to learn

Preferred

  • Experience using SharePoint
  • Experience with global travel platforms

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage.

job.title: Engineer - Asset Commissioning
job.description:
Commissioning Plan Formulation and Project Coordination:

Develops and implements detailed commissioning plans for wind, solar, and hybrid projects, ensuring alignment with engineering specifications and regulatory standards.

Coordinates with project stakeholders to address all necessary technical aspects and comply with project requirements.

Gathers information related to connectivity, LTA/GNA, and project commissioning for efficient execution of upcoming renewable energy projects.

System Testing and Performance Validation:

Executes rigorous system testing and validation protocols to confirm that all systems meet performance specifications and function correctly under operational conditions.

Conducts power performance analysis for wind turbines and ensures the commissioning of turbines as handed over by the project team.

Ensures 100% turbine healthiness for continuous operation and addresses any discrepancies to maintain optimal performance.

Technical Issue Identification and Rectification:

Diagnoses and resolves technical issues encountered during the commissioning phase, applying advanced troubleshooting methods and collaborating with engineering teams to address root causes.

Develops and implements effective solutions to technical problems, ensuring all issues are resolved promptly to prevent disruptions.

Provides technical training to team members and supports in resolving error fault breakdowns for turbines.

Regulatory Compliance and Safety Assurance:

Ensures that all commissioning activities adhere to established industry regulations, safety standards, and project specifications, maintaining high levels of quality and compliance throughout the process.

Develops a safety culture at sites by ensuring workplace safety and adherence to SOPs, targeting zero accidents and Lost Time Injuries (LTIs).

Verifies compliance with safety protocols during construction and operation of EHV and 33KV lines.

Documentation and Reporting:

Prepares comprehensive documentation and reports on commissioning activities, including test results, performance data, and compliance verification.

Maintains detailed records of all commissioning activities, providing essential documentation for ongoing monitoring and regulatory compliance.

Prepares and submits site-wise budgets for operational and capital expenditure as per the project timeline.

Collaboration and Business Performance Monitoring:

Works closely with engineering teams to coordinate commissioning activities and address technical issues that arise, ensuring effective collaboration and problem resolution.

Monitors business performance against goals and identifies cost optimization opportunities in running projects.

Ensures timely closure of audit points and compliance with management systems, contributing to organizational transformation and change management.

Industry Associations

Contractors

Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering is required.

Strong academic foundation in power systems, electrical machines, control systems, and instrumentation. Proficiency in commissioning procedures and testing methodologies.

3-4 years of experience in commissioning of power plants or industrial equipment.

Hands-on experience in equipment installation, testing, and commissioning. Knowledge of safety protocols, quality standards.

  • Negotiate and manage relationships with IT vendors, ensuring the delivery of quality services and adherence to contractual obligations.

Digital Mindset:

  • Drive the adoption of innovative digital technologies like BIM, IoT, and data analytics to enhance efficiency in construction projects.

Team Leadership and Development:

  • Lead and mentor team members by providing constructive feedback, helping them develop their technical and project management skills.

job.title: Facility Engineer (Electrical)
job.description:
Who we are

Digital Edge is a trusted and forward-looking data center platform company, established to transform digital infrastructure in Asia. Backed by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has in excess of US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital with investors including some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Digital Edge’s vision is to be the leading provider of sustainable, next generation digital infrastructure in Asia. Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering populations they serve.

Founded in late 2019, the company has grown rapidly across multiple markets in the region, and currently provides data center and fiber services across Japan, South Korea, India, Indonesia, the Philippines, Thailand and China. The Company now owns and operates 21 data centers with over 500 MW of critical IT load in service and under construction and development, with another 300 MW held for future development,

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

Roles Open for This Intake:

**

We are hiring 3 job families and roles across our Jakarta site. All roles are shift-based and site-based. Full job descriptions will be shared with registered candidates ahead of the event, but the high-level summary are provided below.

  • Facility Technician

Hands-on operation and maintenance of critical electrical, mechanical, and HVAC systems in a 24/7 data center environment.

What you'll do

  • Monitor and maintain power, cooling, and control systems
  • Carry out preventive maintenance and routine inspections
  • Responding to incidents, alarms, and equipment anomalies
  • Coordinate with vendors during planned and unplanned work

What we're looking for

  • 1–2 years' experience in mechanical, electrical, or HVAC systems (data center, telecom, or other critical environments preferred)
  • Vocational diploma (SMK) or higher in a relevant technical field
  • Willing to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends
  • Physically capable of equipment handling in operational conditions
  • Customer Care Assistant, Site Operations

First point of contact for customer inquiries, incident handling, and service coordination on site. This is a customer-facing operations role, not an engineering role.

**

What you'll do

  • Manage customer tickets and service requests end-to-end
  • Coordinate with internal technical teams to resolve incidents within SLA
  • Maintain accurate documentation and reporting
  • Contribute to process improvements across the customer journey

What we're looking for

  • Prior customer service experience, ideally in data center, telco, or tech environments
  • Diploma or degree (business, operations, or related fields preferred)
  • Basic understanding of data center operations (advantage, not required)
  • Strong written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English
  • Team Lead, Facility Operations

Leads a team of Facility Technicians across shifts, with day-to-day ownership of site operations, incident response, and maintenance execution.

**

What you'll do

  • Supervise and develop a team of technicians across rotating shifts
  • Own incident response, escalation, and root-cause follow-through
  • Ensure compliance with safety, operational, and vendor standards
  • Partner with the Facility Manager on planning, reporting, and continuous improvement

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in data center, mission-critical facilities, or industrial operations, with at least 2 years leading a team
  • Strong technical grounding in electrical and/or mechanical systems
  • Proven track record managing incidents in a 24/7 environment
  • Diploma or degree in engineering or a related technical discipline

Why Digital Edge:

**

  • Work on infrastructure that matters: you'll operate the facilities powering Indonesia's largest digital platforms
  • Regional scale, local ownership: part of a 30+ site platform across Asia, with decisions made close to the ground in Jakarta
  • Backed for the long term: Stonepeak-funded with over US$1.6B in committed capital
  • Clear technical career paths in one of the fastest-growing data center markets in the region

Career Day Format:

**

  • Confirmation of invites will be sent to shortlisted candidates only.
  • Full day session with option for AM/PM sessions including role briefing, technical conversation, and meeting with hiring managers.
  • Same day outcomes
  • Venue shared only after registration is confirmed.
  • Registration window: 3rd July to 28th July

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Customer Marketing Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll help create meaningful engagements with enterprise customers and senior decision-makers, turning conversations, insights and relationships into opportunities for deeper partnership and business growth.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As the Customer Marketing Manager, you will translate Singtel Enterprise’s marketing priorities into high-impact customer engagement programmes that strengthen strategic relationships, generate customer insights, support pipeline progression and build customer advocacy.

You will connect account-level customer activation with senior-leader platforms such as the Customer Advisory Council (CAC), executive roundtables, industry forums and CE/CXO engagements. Working closely with Sales, Business Development, Client Solution & Transformation (CST), Enterprise Product and senior leadership, you will ensure every engagement is purposeful, coordinated and followed through to measurable business outcomes.

How You will Make An Impact:

Customer Engagement Strategy & Programme Management

  • Develop and execute integrated customer engagement plans aligned to Enterprise growth priorities, strategic accounts, vertical programmes and the annual marketing calendar.
  • Translate Enterprise marketing priorities into targeted programmes across priority accounts, customer segments and growth sectors.
  • Develop annual and quarterly activation plans covering executive engagements, customer events, workshops, forums, roundtables, exhibitions and account-based sessions.
  • Design engagements around clear business objectives, target personas, account priorities and intended customer outcomes.
  • Apply the Connect–Converse–Convert–Champion framework to support relationship development, opportunity progression and customer advocacy.
  • Maintain an integrated calendar across customer engagements, senior-leader platforms and strategic industry touchpoints.

CE/CXO & Senior-Leader Engagement

  • Identify opportunities to engage priority customers through CAC sessions, executive roundtables, industry forums, leadership dinners and other CE/CXO platforms.

  • Coordinate senior-management participation, executive hosting, briefing requirements and customer protocols.
  • Prepare executive briefs, customer profiles, account context, talking points and run-of-show documents.
  • Track relationships and opportunities arising from senior-leader engagements and ensure disciplined account-level follow-through.

Customer Events & Engagement Execution

  • Lead end-to-end planning and delivery of customer events, executive forums, workshops, roundtables, exhibitions, networking sessions and appreciation programmes.
  • Develop detailed project plans, timelines, budgets, responsibility matrices, checklists and contingency plans.
  • Manage venues, agencies, vendors, speakers, event production, branding, technical requirements, hospitality and on-site operations.
  • Manage internal approvals, procurement, purchase orders, contracts, invoicing and governance requirements.
  • Conduct post-event reviews covering customer feedback, lead outcomes, stakeholder observations and improvement actions.
  • Ensure customer experiences meet the standards expected for senior executives, strategic customers and VIP guests.

Customer Insights & Business Outcomes

  • Capture Voice of Customer insights from events, senior-leader platforms, surveys and stakeholder feedback.
  • Monitor customer trends, industry developments, competitor activity and emerging executive topics.
  • Translate customer insights into actionable recommendations for GTM messaging, customer engagement, solution positioning and future programmes.
  • Strengthen governance and follow-through of marketing-generated leads and customer actions.
  • Maintain dashboards and trackers covering account engagement, leads, follow-up progress and business outcomes.
  • Partner with Sales to support the progression of customer engagement into qualified conversations and opportunities.
  • Monitor MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline influence and account progression where attributable.

Stakeholder, Vendor & Governance Management

  • Work independently across Sales, Enterprise Product, CST, Business Development, Marketing, senior management and external partners.
  • Manage agencies, vendors, speakers, facilitators and ecosystem partners against agreed scopes and service standards.
  • Maintain accurate programme documentation, budgets, customer records, trackers and approvals.
  • Ensure programmes comply with brand, legal, procurement, finance, data-protection and internal governance requirements.
  • Proactively identify risks, dependencies and operational issues and drive them through to resolution.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related discipline.
  • At least 6–9 years of relevant experience in B2B customer marketing, executive engagement, events, corporate communications or stakeholder management.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex customer programmes from concept through execution and post-event follow-up.
  • Experience supporting senior-executive, C-suite or VIP engagements.
  • Experience partnering with Sales and business teams on account-based customer engagement.
  • Strong programme and project management capabilities.
  • Proven ability to manage agencies, vendors, budgets and multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong written communication and executive-briefing skills.
  • Able to maintain structured trackers, dashboards, budgets and reports, including leveraging AI tools and capabilities.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, marketing automation, event platforms and customer-data tools.
  • Able to interpret customer engagement, lead and pipeline-performance metrics.
  • Highly organised, resourceful and able to work independently.
  • Strong ownership with the ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced environment.

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Sourcing Manager
job.description:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Singtel Group

**

Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL (Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre.

We are looking for a Sourcing Manager to support Singtel's Sales and Pricing teams in sourcing competitive last-mile services across international markets. You will play an important role in strengthening the competitiveness of our international data services by developing market benchmarks, working with partners to optimise cost structures and supporting sourcing requirements across multiple countries.

You will also contribute to automation, AI and process-improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing productivity and sourcing effectiveness.

**

**

Make an Impact by:

  • Manage sourcing requirements across multiple countries and markets.

  • Participate in joint discussions with Account Managers to better understand customer requirements.

**

**

  • Establish and maintain last-mile market benchmarks to assess the competitiveness of partner costs.

job.title: Lead AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization #AIDA
job.description:
About the Role

This is a highly visible role at the centre of Singtel’s enterprise AI transformation. The AI Portfolio Management & Commercialization Lead will own integrated portfolio performance across more than eight value pools and over 50 AI use cases, ensuring investments are strategically prioritised, delivery risks are actively addressed and the strongest capabilities are positioned for enterprise scale and commercialization.

A defining requirement of the role is the ability to convert complex portfolio performance, technology and business information into clear, compelling executive narratives. The role will support the Chief AI Officer and senior leadership forums with decision-ready insights, strategic recommendations and a credible view of progress, value, risks and trade-offs.

Success requires an uncommon combination of strategic thinking, structured problem solving, portfolio leadership, commercial acumen and exceptional communication. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in ambiguity, navigating a complex stakeholder environment and influencing senior leaders without relying on formal authority.

Make an Impact By:

  • Enterprise AI Portfolio Leadership
  • Lead the integrated management of Singtel’s enterprise AI portfolio connecting strategy, investment, delivery, adoption and value realization.
  • Drive portfolio prioritisation, sequencing and governance, balancing strategic impact, execution readiness, risk, dependencies and resource constraints.
  • Establish a clear, decision-ready view of portfolio health and identify systemic issues, trade-offs and interventions required to protect outcomes.
  • Orchestrate senior cross-functional interventions across business, product, technology, data, finance, legal and risk teams, acting as the escalation point for material portfolio issues.
  • Strengthen portfolio disciplines, decision rights, management information and operating cadence as AIDA scales.
  • Executive Portfolio Narrative & Strategic Influence
  • Translate complex portfolio performance, value realization, technology developments and strategic risks into concise, compelling narratives for Executive/ Senior leadership forums.
  • Develop high-impact executive read-outs, strategic reviews, investment cases and decision papers that clearly frame progress, implications, trade-offs and recommended actions.
  • Synthesize multiple value pools and workstreams into a coherent enterprise story, ensuring leadership has the right level of insight.
  • Use structured problem solving and fact-based analysis to challenge assumptions, sharpen recommendations and accelerate executive alignment and decision-making.
  • Shape the broader narrative of Singtel’s AI transformation for selected internal and external engagements.
  • Commercialization
  • Identify selected AI and Agentic AI assets with potential for broader productisation or external commercialization.
  • Shape commercialization pathways and business cases, including market opportunity, customer need, value proposition, packaging, go-to-market options and commercial model considerations.
  • Partner with Enterprise, Consumer, Product, Commercial, Technology, Finance, Legal and Risk stakeholders to assess opportunity attractiveness and commercialization readiness.
  • Develop and nurture a qualified pipeline of opportunities, moving promising concepts from initial exploration toward structured validation and accountable ownership.
  • Engage strategic customers and ecosystem partners, including hyperscalers, startups and industry participants, where partnerships can accelerate capability development, adoption or market reach.

Skills for Success

Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in strategy, management consulting, enterprise transformation, portfolio management, digital or technology strategy, or comparable leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional portfolios and influencing senior executives in a matrixed organisation.
  • Strong track record of structuring ambiguous problems, developing actionable recommendations and driving outcomes without direct line authority.
  • Experience developing executive-level narratives, presentations and decision materials for C-suite or senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience in commercialization, business-case development, productisation, partnerships or go-to-market strategy.

Professional Capabilities

  • Enterprise portfolio strategy, prioritisation, governance and performance management.
  • Consulting-calibre structured problem solving, synthesis and strategic judgement.
  • Exceptional written communication, narrative development and executive presentation skills.
  • Commercial acumen and the ability to connect AI investments to business value, customer outcomes and growth opportunities.
  • Working understanding of AI, data and technology transformation, with the ability to translate technical complexity into business implications.
  • Executive presence, stakeholder navigation and the ability to build alignment across competing priorities.

Preferred

  • Experience in a top-tier or leading management consulting firm, corporate strategy office or high-performing transformation environment.
  • Experience supporting a Chief AI Officer, C-suite office, enterprise transformation office or senior steering forum.
  • Exposure to telecommunications, enterprise technology, digital platforms, AI commercialization or ecosystem partnerships.
  • MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification.

What Success Looks Like

  • Senior leaders have a clear, credible and decision-ready view of portfolio progress, value, risks and actions required.
  • AI initiatives are prioritised and governed with stronger discipline, clearer accountability and faster resolution of enterprise-level issues.
  • Complex portfolio information is consistently converted into sharp executive narratives that drive alignment and decisions.
  • Selected AI capabilities progress toward enterprise reuse, productisation or external commercialization through well-structured opportunities and partnerships.
  • The AI Value Realization Team is recognised as a trusted strategic partner to AIDA leadership, business units and enterprise governance forums.

job.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
job.description:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Singtel Group

Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, driven by innovation, digital transformation and the use of technology to create a more sustainable and connected future.

We are looking for a Senior Information Security Specialist to provide independent security architecture and risk assurance across technology initiatives. In this role, you will help identify information security risks early, assess them consistently and ensure they are managed effectively throughout the system lifecycle. You will act as a trusted security risk and architecture advisor to Singtel IT, Telco Networks and Enterprise stakeholders, supporting secure and timely delivery while strengthening the organisation's overall security posture.

Make an Impact by:

1. Security Risk Assessment & Assurance

  • Perform comprehensive information security risk assessments for new and existing systems, applications, infrastructure changes and third-party engagements.
  • Assess design documents, architecture diagrams and technical controls to confirm that technology risks are identified and mitigated before go-live.
  • Articulate and document residual risks, define appropriate compensating controls and support formal risk acceptance where required.
  • Conduct project security reviews and provide security sign-off within the role's delegated authority.

2. Security Architecture & Control Design

  • Review and validate security control designs across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, network security, identity and access management, data protection and application security.
  • Apply recognised security frameworks and Zero Trust architecture principles to evaluate design decisions and recommend risk-based mitigations.
  • Define, review and promote secure architecture and security design patterns that enable consistent, scalable and risk-aligned controls.
  • Validate systems and solution designs against security and compliance baselines, identify gaps and recommend appropriate remediation measures.

3. Threat Modelling & Security Advisory

  • Conduct threat modelling for critical systems and application deployments, identifying attack paths, threat scenarios and control weaknesses.
  • Provide risk advisory to IT, application teams and business stakeholders for projects, solution reviews and ad hoc security assessments.
  • Translate technical security issues into clear business and risk implications to support informed decision-making.
  • Guide application and technology teams on security requirements and recommended controls.

4. Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure technology initiatives and controls comply with internal security policies, standards and governance requirements, proactively highlighting gaps and recommending remediation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security risk assessment and design review frameworks, processes and templates to improve consistency, quality and efficiency.
  • Interpret security baselines and standards and translate them into appropriate architecture and control requirements aligned with regulatory, enterprise and technology contexts.
  • Stay current with evolving cybersecurity threats and regulatory changes relevant to the telecommunications environment.

5. Emerging Risk & Security Control Enhancement

  • Recommend new or enhanced security controls and architecture patterns based on emerging threats, risk assessment outcomes, regulatory changes and industry best practices.
  • Work with stakeholders to support implementation of agreed security improvements and risk treatments.

job.title: Manager, Talent Acquisition
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Talent Acquisition & Business Partnership

  • Partner Hiring Managers and HR stakeholders to understand business strategy, workforce priorities and emerging capability requirements to translate business needs into practical and forward-looking talent acquisition strategies.
  • Advise stakeholders on talent availability, market conditions, compensation expectations, competitor activity and realistic hiring timelines.
  • Challenge hiring requirements constructively and help Hiring Managers differentiate between critical skills, trainable capabilities and traditional credential requirements.
  • Translate business strategy, technology transformation and purpose into compelling talent narratives.

2. End-to-End Recruitment Excellence

  • Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from intake and sourcing through assessment, offer and onboarding.
  • Develop differentiated sourcing strategies for specialist, niche and high-volume requirements.
  • Drive strong recruitment discipline including timely feedback, pipeline management and closure of aged vacancies.
  • Ensure recruitment practices remain compliant with applicable employment legislation, internal policies and fair hiring principles.

3. AI, Automation & Digital Recruitment

  • Champion the adoption of AI and automation across Talent Acquisition to improve speed, quality and recruiter productivity.
  • Use AI-enabled tools to support areas such as talent sourcing, CV screening, job description development, candidate engagement and interview preparation.
  • Identify repetitive recruitment activities that can be automated or redesigned.
  • Maintain appropriate human oversight and responsible use of AI in hiring decisions.

4. Talent Intelligence & Proactive Sourcing

  • Build talent pipelines before vacancies arise, particularly for critical and emerging skills.
  • Conduct external talent mapping and competitor intelligence to identify where key capabilities reside.
  • Develop talent communities for recurring and difficult-to-hire skill areas, and utilise market intelligence to advise the business on talent scarcity, location strategy, skills adjacency and alternative talent pools.
  • Convert sourcing insights into actionable recommendations for business and workforce planning.
  • Provide Hiring Managers and leadership with clear insights on recruitment performance and talent-market conditions.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • Approximately 6–10 years of Talent Acquisition or recruitment experience, preferably within a complex, fast-moving organisation.
  • Strong end-to-end recruitment and direct sourcing capability for evolving, specialist or difficult-to-hire capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders and influence Hiring Managers.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret recruitment data and translate insights into action.
  • Familiarity with ATS platforms, sourcing technologies, recruitment analytics and utility of AI-enabled recruitment tools.
  • Good understanding of fair and responsible hiring practices.
  • Experienced in talent mapping, workforce planning, employer branding and TA transformation work.

job.title: Pricing Executive
job.description:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Singtel Group

**

Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL (Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre.

We are looking for a Pricing Executive to support Singtel's Sales team with competitive and commercially viable pricing for International Data, Domestic Internet and Managed Services.

You will support quotation requests, conduct pricing and commercial analysis, benchmark pricing across different solution types and work with multiple stakeholders to develop pricing recommendations that balance competitiveness with target margins.

**

**

Make an Impact by:

1. Pricing & Quotation Support

  • Provide timely day-to-day responses to Sales quotation requests and pricing-analysis requirements.
  • Support agreed commercial KPIs, including win rate, total contract value and quotation turnaround time.
  • Independently manage routine pricing requests and support moderately complex opportunities within established pricing guidelines.
  • Ensure pricing submissions are accurate, complete and supported by the required commercial information.

**

2. Pricing & Commercial Analysis

  • Develop pricing recommendations for International Data, Domestic Internet and Managed Services.
  • Ensure proposed pricing is aligned with overall win-price objectives and target margins.
  • Review individual solution components to support sustainable margins.
  • Apply pricing and commercial analysis to identify suitable options for customer and business requirements.
  • Escalate pricing exceptions, cross-subsidy requirements and opportunities outside approved pricing or margin parameters for appropriate review.

3. Pricing Benchmarking & Market Competitiveness

  • Conduct pricing benchmarks across relevant solution types.
  • Analyse historical, market, cost and commercial information to support competitive pricing decisions.
  • Identify pricing differences and opportunities to improve competitiveness.
  • Apply appropriate judgement when customer requirements, service configurations or market conditions vary.

**

4. Stakeholder Coordination & Negotiation

  • Work closely with Sales and other internal stakeholders to obtain timely cost, technical and commercial inputs required for quotations and approvals.
  • Negotiate effectively with relevant internal and external stakeholders to support improved margins while maintaining price competitiveness.
  • Clearly communicate pricing rationale, commercial considerations and required approvals.
  • Serve as the pricing point of contact for assigned key accounts.

**

5. Commercial Governance

  • Prepare pricing recommendations for standard and moderately complex opportunities within approved pricing, margin and discount guidelines.
  • Ensure pricing decisions comply with established commercial and governance requirements.
  • Escalate larger network opportunities, multi-service deals and pricing cases requiring higher-level approval.
  • Maintain appropriate pricing information and supporting documentation for commercial decisions.

**

Skills for Success

  • Diploma or degree in Marketing, Business Studies, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in pricing, commercial, finance, sales operations or business analysis.
  • Good Microsoft Excel and data-analysis skills.
  • Understanding of pricing and commercial analysis.
  • Good financial acumen and ability to interpret commercial information.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and stakeholder-coordination skills.
  • Ability to prioritise multiple pricing requests and deliver within tight timelines.
  • Strong accountability and ownership of assigned work.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Sales and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Sound analytical and problem-solving ability when working within established pricing guidelines.
  • Exposure to the telecommunications, ICT or managed-services industry.
  • Telecommunications product knowledge.
  • Commercial mindset and an understanding of margin and price competitiveness.
  • Negotiation skills.
  • Proactive approach to identifying and resolving pricing or commercial issues.

**

**

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Staff Engineer- I&C Scada (BESS)
job.description:
Job Summary

Black & Veatch is seeking a SCADA engineering professional with a strong focus on Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) to support the design, integration, and commissioning of utility-scale energy storage projects.

This role emphasizes end-to-end SCADA engineering for BESS facilities, including integration with Energy Management Systems (EMS), Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), and utility communication systems. The candidate will support conceptual and detailed engineering activities including controls architecture, network design, communications, telemetry, data mapping, and system integration across the full project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop engineering design documents and deliverables for SCADA systems supporting BESS projects.
  • Design and coordinate SCADA system architecture integrating BMS, EMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Develop control narratives, data mapping, alarms, and monitoring strategies.
  • Lead and participate in design reviews (30%, 60%, 90%, IFC).
  • Coordinate SCADA scope with utility interconnection and grid compliance requirements.
  • Support vendor selection, specifications, and design reviews.
  • Provide leadership and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Support FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities.
  • Perform testing, validation, and troubleshooting during commissioning.
  • Provide field and remote support to construction teams and clients

Management Responsibilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Familiarity with EMS, BMS, PCS, and PPC systems.
  • Experience with SEL RTAC and related hardware.
  • Knowledge of DNP3, Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850.
  • Knowledge of NERC CIP, PRC-028, IEEE 2800 standards.
  • Experience with SCADA network and fiber systems.
  • Experience with commissioning multi-vendor systems.
  • Experience with HMI platforms such as Ignition or AVEVA.
  • Strong communication and teamwork skills.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • 5+ years SCADA engineering experience.
  • 3+ years experience with utility-scale BESS projects.
  • Experience with SCADA design and commissioning activities.

Minimum Qualifications

Requires a bachelor's degree in engineering from either a recognized accredited program in their home country or the country in which the professional is practicing. Minimum of 5 years related work experience. All applicants must be able to complete pre-employment onboarding requirements (if selected) which may include any/all of the following: criminal/civil background check, drug screen, and motor vehicle records search, in compliance with any applicable laws and regulations.

Full time

J0105763

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Job Summary Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic and experienced Senior Manager – Site Acquisition to join our Data Center Development team.

In this role, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end site acquisition lifecycle—from identification, due diligence, and commercial negotiations through to final transaction closure—to secure high-quality, expansion-ready sites for data center developments. You will work closely with an interdisciplinary network of real estate, legal, engineering, power, regulatory, and finance experts to drive scalable infrastructure growth across target markets.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Collaborate with internal cross-functional partners—including legal, finance, engineering, and power procurement—as well as external utilities, brokers, landowners, and government authorities to execute transactions and validate site viability.
  • Ensure compliance with company investment frameworks, governance standards, statutory approvals, land-use zoning, and environmental risk requirements throughout the site selection process.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 15+ years of experience in site acquisition, commercial real estate, or large-scale infrastructure development, with a strong background in data center or hyperscale projects.
  • Strong knowledge of data center site selection, power and utility infrastructure assessment, land due diligence, and commercial transaction management.
  • Proven ability in high-stakes negotiations, risk mitigation, financial evaluation, and navigating complex government and local stakeholder relationships.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field (a Master of Business Administration or Post Graduate Diploma in Management is an advantage)

job.title: Marketing & Sales Leader - On-Highway
job.description:
Job Summary

Effectively manages the relationship and business strategies for large, complex assigned accounts (cross-regional, global, etc.) to grow our share of the customer's wallet and achieve sales goals. Strengthens existing customer relationships and builds additional relationships within accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Develops, manages, and expands business relationships with assigned accounts, for example by understanding and using their industry terminology and understanding their business model and buying process.

Identifies current and emerging customer needs. Develops and executes account strategies to grow share with existing accounts and supports new business opportunities.

Gains agreement to the benefits of Cummins products and solutions by helping customers make sense of available data and information.

Grows Cummins’ share of the customer’s business. Negotiates and implements contracts with accounts as authorized, for example by managing customer questions and managing escalations for accounts receivable and/or payment terms.

Leads, manages and coordinates communication and interfaces with the customer at all levels. Assures good communication, coordination and alignment across sales roles, supports cross-business account development strategies, and works with key internal stakeholders to achieve results.

Achieves revenue and share goals associated with revenue and profit targets.

Champions the voice of the customer within the business. Measures customer satisfaction and loyalty. Creates and/or implements projects intended to improve customer relationships, customer value, and grow the business with assigned accounts.

Models (and manages, for direct reports) use of the Cummins Sales Process. Provides timely and accurate reports and forecasts on the assigned schedule, using Cummins tools and processes and Customer Relationship Management systems.

Develops and executes account sales plans in support of business strategy. Develops growth or new business opportunities jointly with accounts and supports initiatives to increase customer value.

Mentors, motivates, and develops less experienced sales and/or account team staff.

If he/she has direct reports, conducts the following activities or ensures they are conducted by another manager: sets goals for their training and development, performance, and career planning and provides ongoing, consistent coaching and development. Delegates work assignments considering employee skills and development needs. Identifies department issues, problems, and opportunities to support continuous improvement initiatives.

As applicable, works with team, internal stakeholders, and customers to manage organization's inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations

Competencies:

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Builds effective teams - Building strong-identity teams that apply their diverse skills and perspectives to achieve common goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.

Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.

Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.

Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.

Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc.) in such a way that the target audience (e.g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc.) can understand, retain, and use the information

Developing Account Strategy - Determines current status of account in terms of relationship, financial, product competitiveness, barriers, quality, and service and defining desired future state by balancing customer requirements and business capabilities in order to define achievable targets aligned with the business strategy.

Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.

Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.

Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.

Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales, technical or a related subject or an acceptable combination of education and experience required. This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Significant level of relevant work experience required, including previous customer and/or product experience required. Purchasing/commercial contract negotiation preferred.

job.title: VPI 项目经理
job.description:
工作总结:

支持项目负责人管理、开发和实施满足客户和业务需求的中小型价值包引进 (VPI) 项目交付成果。

主要责任:

从开始到完成，管理拥有中小业务影响的价值包引进 (VPI) 项目。

管理定义有形和可衡量的客户期望和业务结果，并支持项目实现这两个目标。

与关键的跨职能、跨业务部门和外部利益相关者一起，管理确定范围、进度和资源，并获得利益相关者对项目合同的承诺和批准。

确保项目符合价值包引进 (VPI) 流程。

根据项目合同，酌情管理与内部利益相关者进行的跟踪和沟通。

管理跨职能识别和解决项目风险和问题。根据需要恰当地上报风险和问题。

管理跨职能识别和解决项目合同变更（范围、时间表、资源）。

教导和培养同行项目经理。

采用并分享最佳实践。

技能:

平衡利益相关者 - 预见并平衡多个利益相关者的需求。

建设高效团队 - 建立有高度的认同感的团队，利用团队成员多元化的技能和观点实现共同的目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

确保承担责任 - 确保自己和他人为实现承诺负责。

建立信任 - 做到诚实、正直和真实，赢得他人的信任和信赖。

管理复杂情况 - 领会复杂的、大量的，有时甚至是相互矛盾的信息，以有效地解决问题。

计划和协调 - 制定工作计划并安排工作优先顺序，以达成与组织目标一致的承诺。

项目问题和风险管理 - 管理流程，以使用推荐的工具和方法来识别、评估问题和风险并进行优先排序。推动采取行动，最大限度地减少、监控和控制风险和问题，并尽可能地取得最积极的成果。

项目管理 - 为临时工作（“项目”）建立和维持范围、进度和资源的平衡。确保尽可能充分地实现临时工作的结果/影响。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

教育,资格,认证:

必须具有专科、本科或同等学历。

具有项目管理培训和/或经验者优先。

具有新产品开发培训和/或经验者优先。

经历:

3-5 年相关新产品开发经验。具有价值包引进 (VPI) 流程经验者优先。

job.title: Regional HSE Manager – Northern
job.description:
In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Providing leadership to multi sites across Northern Region – comprising of 12 locations across Queensland, New Zealand and Papa New Guinea to promote Work Health, Safety & Environment best practices and continuous improvement.
  • Builds strong relationships across functions to ensure the organization drives a strong interdependent HSE culture.
  • Manages planning actions to set targets and objectives for the site and drives actions to completion.
  • Leads an effective support model throughout the site through training, skills development and internal communications.
  • Provide support with risk management and risk mitigation to ensure effective controls are in place.
  • Managing workers' compensation matters, including rehabilitation, case management, and return-to-work programs.
  • Engage in visible leadership with site presence and engagement to ensure compliance with Safe Systems of Work.
  • Leads work cross-functionally as required to resolve work-related incidents, non-compliances, non-conformities, corrective and preventive actions driving continual improvement within the site(s).
  • Supports the business with legal and internal auditing programs.
  • Actively seeks opportunities for self-development through professional health, safety and environmental organizations, as a champion of emerging trends

This is a unique opportunity to influence regional strategy, partner with senior leaders, and lead meaningful initiatives that reduce environmental impact. You'll have the opportunity to make a tangible difference through projects focused on our Destination Zero commitment

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Lead the delivery of Cummins' APAC environmental and sustainability strategy, aligning regional priorities with our global sustainability vision.
  • Partner with leaders across the business to strengthen environmental accountability and embed sustainable practices into day-to-day operations.
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders to enhance environmental programs, governance frameworks, policies, and best practices.
  • Identify emerging environmental, sustainability, and climate-related risks, translating them into practical business solutions.

job.title: Sr. Mechanical Design Engineer, APAC Mech DE
job.description:
Be part of a team that’s responsible for designing and delivering capacity for the world’s best data centre services across the globe. You’ll have the opportunity to work with a constant stream of new technologies and products, and experience opportunities to learn and grow while being surrounded by a motivated and diverse team.

In this role you will drive Mechanical Engineering services design, construction and implementation of enterprise data centers, which meet quality and performance levels across the globe. You will work directly with our Design Engineering Stakeholders, Construction, Operations, and Commissioning teams within your assigned region in APAC. You will be the Mechanical Engineering representative on behalf of the Data Center Engineering Team responsible for the successful delivery of projects. You will assist in Data Center site selection, planning, development. You will maintain the highest performance standards and utilize innovation to reduce PUE, water consumption, CAPEX and increase efficiency. As an experienced Mechanical Engineer you will evaluate different cooling systems and make a data driven decision about a suitable solution based on our guidelines. You will be an integral part of our work to change the world through technology.

Responsibilities

  • - Participate in site selection reviews, work with local utilities to understand and define site utility requirements, and work with internal teams to understand user requirements.
  • Design and collaborate with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
  • Create designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
  • Work with regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate mechanical equipment including Air Handling Units, Computer Room Air Handling Units, Chillers, Cooling Towers, Sequence of Operations & Controls systems, Fire Detection/Suppression systems
  • Review and approve equipment submittals.
  • Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
  • Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of mechanical systems.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers and Operations. This position will involve 20% travel within APAC region and occasionally globally.

About the team The Data Center Design Engineering team at Amazon Web Services consists of Architects, Structural, Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Fire Protection and Controls Engineers working to design the next generation of Data Centres. The team is committed to achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and strives to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, and efficiency, while finding new ways to meet our growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make directly to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an integral member of the team, you will have the opportunity to directly impact our business and create positive change.

Basic Qualifications

  • 6+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineering or Architectural License

The position encompasses comprehensive ownership of both new and existing colocation agreements, including pricing structures, terms, and service level agreements, while developing and implementing market expansion strategies across existing and new markets.

The role focuses on structuring deals and serves as the primary contact with colocation providers. At Amazon, career progression is part of our environment. We want you to progress. If your career path is in Systems, Network or Database Engineering, Software Development or maybe AWS Support, Technical Operations or perhaps Project Management, we will create a development plan to enable you to succeed reaching those goals. This begins on Day One! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company.

The Opportunity: Data Center Linux & Hardware Engineer

This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most data centers in the world. Amazon data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in the region.

A Data Center Linux & Hardware Engineer may be the primary point of contact for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Database Engineers, Technical Operations) and external customers (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

  • Escalation point and technical troubleshooter for all Systems and Network hardware problems
  • Deep diving into Linux server issues
  • XEN service virtualization troubleshooting

  • Remediation of physical layer outages, both

Systems & Network

  • Participate in Data Center power & cooling events

  • Triage & resolve trouble tickets for all devices in your region
  • Data Center point of contact for all High Severity issues
  • Physical replacement of server and network device parts
  • Ensure correct rotation of parts & spares
  • Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime
  • Enforcing Amazons Security Best Practices
  • Interact with third party vendors & contractors
  • Contribute ideas to improve operational efficiency

Project Management:

  • Participate in and deliver on a number of high impact small to mid-scale projects

Mentoring:

Hiring:
