job.title: Gas Turbine: Turbine Airfoils Casting Simulations Engineer
job.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

Turbine Airfoils Casting simulation engineer plays a pivotal role in transforming how we design and manufacture complex turbine hardware design. You will lead the development and validation of conventional cast & cutting-edge DS (directionally solidified) process modeling, core breakage prediction, and foundry process modeling capabilities. Working at the intersection of design, simulation, and manufacturing, you will focus on upstream design simulation to embed manufacturability early in the development cycle, significantly reducing defects, lead times, and costs while improving component reliability.

Job requires regular interaction with global teams hence engineer should have persuasive communication skills and cross-cultural knowledge.

How You'll Make an Impact (Gas Turbine, R& D, India)

  • Develop and validate advanced DS process modeling methodologies with a strong emphasis on core breakage prediction and mitigation.
  • Practice Siemens Energy high fidelity, extensively validated, and equiaxed casting simulation modeling methodology to provide expert foundry process modeling support to ensure robust, high-yield casting designs.
  • Drive upstream design simulation initiatives that integrate manufacturability directly into the turbine component design process.
  • Develop new cooling technologies within the constraints of manufacturability, balancing performance, thermal management, and casting feasibility.
  • Collaborate closely with design, materials, and manufacturing teams to create and implement new simulation-driven design-for-manufacturing (DFM) workflows.
  • Identify and resolve critical casting challenges through innovative modeling techniques, data analysis, and real-world validation.
  • Contribute to methodology development that pushes the boundaries of casting simulation accuracy and speed.
  • Be a point of contact, speaking partner and provide expertise regarding hot gas path heat transfer related topics in a project.
  • Developing new concepts and building CAD models using NX, design internal cooling and perform Conjugate Heat Transfer analysis of Turbine Airfoils and Heat Shields using CFX & Star CCM+, performing Casting Simulation using ProCAST.
  • Understanding of fundamental concepts in fluid mechanics (pressure drop) & heat transfer discipline (using non-dimensional correlations).
  • Able to understand physics, apply relevant assumptions, interpret and post process results.
  • Collaborating with project leads in understanding the project requirements, finding solutions to design challenges, and delivering results within agreed timeline & quality.
  • A fraction of time will be dedicated to advancing the technical expertise of other team members and mentoring.

What You Bring

  • Mechanical engineer with an MTech in Mechanical engineering (major in Metallurgy and Foundry, Material Science, Fluid & Thermal Science) and demonstrated expertise in the field of Casting, Solidification physics, heat transfer and fluid mechanics.
  • 5 years of experience with parametric CAD modeling in NX.
  • Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in thermal analysis and design of internal cooled gas turbine components.
  • Ability to generate thermal boundary conditions and perform Flow & Heat Transfer engineering calculations under steady state, transient heat transfer (involving all modes i.e. conduction, convection and radiation) and multi-phase CFD/CHT simulations using Star CCM+. (minimum 4 years of experience).
  • Understanding Investment Casting & Solidification physics and experience of running casting simulations using ProCAST and experience of working in foundry would be an advantage. (minimum 2 years of experience).
  • Good knowledge of Design for Manufacturability (DFM) for gas turbine airfoils.
  • Basic knowledge of Finite element analysis & ability to review the results. Good Familiarity with FE codes like Sim center 3D, ANSYS or general-purpose FEA tool.
  • Basic knowledge of Turbomachinery Aerodynamics, Mechanical Integrity (Fatigue, Creep, Fracture).
  • Exposure to SAP and Teamcenter PLM.
  • Programming skills like Python and NX Open.
  • A balance between scientific rigor and engineering judgement.
  • An attitude of curiosity, perseverance in the face of uncertainty, and a desire for engineering excellence as well as patience.

Personality

  • Strong interpersonal skills i.e., collaborator, quick learner, energetic, imaginative, innovative, ability to adapt quickly & effectively etc.
  • Willing to collaborate & work with colleagues located in multiple time zones (Europe & the US).
  • Self-driven in work tasks with a willingness to learn and try new methods to solve a problem.
  • Align with Organization Purpose, Values & Behavior & adhere to business compliance guidelines.
  • Effective communicator both verbal and non-verbal.
  • Ability to write clear and descriptive reports in English.

This is a rare opportunity to work on high-visibility, high-impact programs where your technical contributions will directly influence turbine performance, production efficiency, and long-term competitiveness. You will have the autonomy to innovate, the resources to validate your methods, and the chance to see your work move from simulation to actual hardware in some of the most advanced gas turbines in the world. If you are passionate about simulation, manufacturability, and solving complex engineering problems that matter, this is the role where you can make a lasting technical impact.

About the Team (Power Generation)

In the large steam and gas turbine domain, we offer services and solutions for gas turbines, large steam turbines, large generators, and associated control technology. Our portfolio serves customers such as power utilities, Independent Power Producers (IPPs), Engineering Procurement and Construction (EPC) firms, and industrial clients. We provide a comprehensive range of offerings including maintenance, operation, digital services, modernization and upgradation, plant flexibilization, as well as control and digitalization solutions (digital control systems, field instruments, and equipment) and professional consulting.

Our power generation portfolio also includes industrial steam turbines (ranging from 10 kW to 250 MW), condensers, and service offerings designed to extend the lifespan and efficiency of industrial steam turbines through heat recovery solutions. We cater to a wide range of process industries—including oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, paper & pulp, sugar & ethanol, and marine—helping customers reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. A key focus area is delivering integrated industrial decarbonization solutions built on electrification, automation, and digitalization, while supporting sustainability through carbon-optimized energy systems and hydrogen generation.

Who is Siemens Energy India?

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customers installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping the countries navigate their energy transition and achieve its net zero targets.

SEIL is a pure play energy technology company, oﬀering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain to go through their energy transition journey and achieve their net zero targets. Our portfolio oﬀering includes low to zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and decarbonization of the industry. More information on: www.siemens-energy-india.com

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by #TeamPurpleIndia. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

job.title: Engineer – Plant Utilities & Electrical O&M | Switchyard, HT/LT & Chillers
job.description:
Position: Engineer – Plant Utilities & Electrical O&M

Grip Position: Service Engineer Employment Type: Siemens Direct Contract Location: Near Shirur, Pune, Maharashtra

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced Electrical Engineer with 4–6 years of hands-on experience in plant utility operations and maintenance. The role will be responsible for the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of plant switchyards, HT/LT electrical systems and utility equipment, along with team leadership, EHS compliance, KPI monitoring and site coordination.

Qualification & Experience

  • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering with 4–6 years of relevant experience in operation and maintenance of plant utility equipment.
  • Valid Electrical Supervisory License from CEIG is mandatory.
  • Hands-on experience in plant switchyard and electrical utility maintenance.
  • Good understanding of EHS requirements and procedures applicable to service projects and service businesses.

Key Technical Responsibilities

  • Operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of plant switchyard and utility systems.
  • Maintenance of Air Compressors, Dryers, Chillers, LPG/HSD Yard, HT/LT Panels, APFC Panels, and other plant utility equipment.
  • Plan and monitor daily maintenance activities.
  • Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) of breakdowns and prepare reports for the customer.
  • Monitor and plan spares and critical maintenance requirements.
  • Monitor site KPIs and implement corrective actions to achieve targets.
  • Ensure preventive and corrective maintenance activities are executed safely and efficiently.

Team & Site Responsibilities

  • Lead the maintenance team and demonstrate effective site leadership.
  • Conduct skill mapping of team members and identify development requirements.
  • Ensure 5S is maintained across the work area.
  • Ensure adherence to EHS standards and safety procedures at site.
  • Prepare MIS reports and ISO documentation.
  • Coordinate and monitor site commercial activities.
  • Monitor and coordinate site HR-related activities.

Preferred Candidate Background

Candidates from the following industries/backgrounds are preferred:

  • Facility Management / O&M companies handling Chillers and Plant Utilities
  • Automobile and Automotive Ancillary manufacturing plants
  • 220 kV Switchyard operations and maintenance
  • Data Center Utility Maintenance

Language Requirements

Marathi, Hindi and English – candidates should be comfortable communicating with site teams and customers in the required languages.

Key Skills:

Plant Utilities, Electrical O&M, Switchyard, 220 kV, HT/LT Panels, APFC Panels, Chillers, Air Compressors, Dryers, LPG/HSD Yard, CEIG Supervisory License, Preventive Maintenance, Breakdown Maintenance, Root Cause Analysis, EHS, 5S, KPI, MIS, ISO Documentation, Team Leadership.

job.title: Expert- Product Configuration and Data Management
job.description:
Key Expert- Product Configuration and Data Management: HV Switchgear Products

What this role offers:

This role is responsible for ensuring robust product configuration and data management across the HV Switchgears product portfolio (AIS and GIS), enabling accuracy, consistency, and compliance throughout the product lifecycle. The position closely interfaces with PLM, R&D/ Engineering, Offer Management, Finance and IT systems to maintain configuration rules, product structures, and master data integrity.

Key responsibilities include driving configuration accuracy, managing product data updates aligned with design and regulatory changes, and supporting digital tools for efficient product selection and offer generation. The role also involves identifying opportunities for process optimization, standardization, and automation within configuration and data management frameworks.

In addition, the role contributes to the development and maintenance of a centralized Knowledge Center, ensuring structured documentation, best practice sharing, and capability enhancement across teams. This supports organizational efficiency, reduces dependency risks, and strengthens overall product and process governance.

Key Responsibilities

A) Product Configuration and Data Management:

  • Development of Product Configuration system by establishing a robust knowledge base.
  • Ensure accurate and robust product configuration aligned with technical specifications, business rules, and customer requirements.
  • Maintain and govern product master data, configuration logic, and documentation across systems, ensuring integrity and consistency.
  • Support the adoption and integration of self-learning and self-improving AI technologies to enhance configuration accuracy, speed, and decision-making. The configurator platform should be progressively enhanced based on number of configurations created and customized.
  • Enable precise product costing within configurations, ensuring alignment with the latest cost structures and commercial frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, PLM, Offer/Order Management, and IT teams for seamless integration of product data and lifecycle updates.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable business rules, technical standards, and regulatory requirements within configuration systems.

B) Process enhancement and Digitalization:

  • Drive process improvements focused on efficiency, standardization, and reduced response time to customer enquiries.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities within configuration and data management processes.
  • Develop and maintain a structured database for cost monitoring, analysis, and benchmarking across products and variants.
  • Provide insights to support cost optimization, competitive positioning, and strategic decision-making.

C) Knowledge Center:

  • Lead a ‘Knowledge Center’ subfunction to support Offer and Order Management teams with technical expertise and structured documentation.
  • Provide technical support for complex product configurations, bid preparation, and customer requirements.
  • Support development of AI based self-learning and self-improving query management system, with self-answering and expert involvement decision making.
  • Develop and deliver product trainings for internal teams and external partners to enhance technical competence and product understanding.
  • Maintain and regularly update bid support documents, technical catalogs, and product literature. Develop an exhaustive documents library/ repository including technical documents, type test certificates, compliance documents, and product certifications to ensure readiness for customer and regulatory requirements.

We don’t need superheroes, just super minds

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • 15-20 years of working experience encompassing:

o Strong technical knowledge of High Voltage (HV) Switchgear products, including design principles, configurations, and applications.

o Solid understanding of product structures, technical specifications, costing principles, and compliance requirements.

o Hands-on experience in developing and managing Product Configurator solutions, supported by relevant tools and specialized training.

o Proficiency in handling configuration logic, master data, and integration with PLM/ERP/CPQ systems.

o Exposure to digitalization initiatives, automation, and AI-driven technologies for improving configuration accuracy and efficiency is highly desirable.

o Experience in market-facing roles (Sales, Offer Management, or Engineering) is an added advantage.

o Ability to understand and translate customer requirements into product configurations, ensuring alignment with product capabilities and business offerings.

o Strong capability in driving process improvements, standardization, and automation for faster and error-free responses.

o Experience in cost data management, benchmarking, and maintaining accurate product-related databases.

o High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy, integrity, and governance.

o Strong collaboration and networking skills to effectively engage with internal teams, global functions, and external stakeholders.

o Ability to align across diverse stakeholders on business requirements, product configuration rules, technical parameters, and regulatory standards.

o Excellent communication and influencing skills to drive alignment and knowledge sharing.

o Experience in developing and maintaining knowledge repositories, technical documentation, and training materials.

o Ability to conduct product trainings and share technical knowledge effectively with internal teams and external partners.

About us

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 377,000 minds building the future, one day at a time. We're dedicated to quality and equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. Bring your curiosity and imagination and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: Graduate Engineer (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Launch Your Engineering Career with Australia's Industrial Refrigeration Leader

Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI), part of the Johnson Controls (JCI) family, is Australia's largest industrial refrigeration company and a trusted partner to some of the nation's most critical industries.

With over 100 years of engineering excellence and offices all across Australia, GBI specialises in the design, construction, commissioning, service, and maintenance of complex industrial refrigeration systems.

Supporting industries including food and beverage manufacturing, cold storage, pharmaceutical production, healthcare, advanced manufacturing, and distribution, GBI delivers innovative solutions that improve safety, reliability, efficiency, and sustainability.

As part of Johnson Controls, a global leader in industrial cooling, energy efficiency, and decarbonisation solutions, GBI combines local expertise with access to world-class technologies, resources, and innovation. Together, we help customers optimise operations, reduce environmental impact, and meet the demands of an increasingly sustainable future.

Why Join Gordon Brothers Industries?

This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to develop into a well-rounded engineer while working alongside industry experts on large-scale industrial refrigeration and engineering projects.

You'll gain hands-on exposure to:

  • Industrial refrigeration system design and engineering
  • Project management and project delivery
  • Manufacturing and construction environments
  • Client engagement and technical consulting
  • Site commissioning and operational support
  • Safety, compliance, and risk management
  • Emerging sustainability and energy-efficiency technologies

Whether your long-term goal is technical leadership, project management, design engineering, or consulting, this role provides a strong foundation for a successful engineering career.

What We Offer

  • Exposure to diverse engineering disciplines and projects
  • Structured training and professional development
  • Mentorship from highly experienced engineers and industry specialists
  • Competitive salary package
  • Career progression opportunities within GBI and the broader Johnson Controls network
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment

About the Role

Due to continued business growth, we are seeking a motivated Graduate Engineer to join our Brunswick-based team.

Working closely with experienced Engineers, Project Managers, and Service Teams, you'll play an important role in supporting the design, delivery, and ongoing optimisation of industrial refrigeration solutions for leading Australian businesses.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with engineering calculations and refrigeration system design.
  • Support the preparation of estimates, tenders, and project proposals.
  • Evaluate existing refrigeration systems and identify improvement opportunities for clients.
  • Participate in project management activities, including procurement, scheduling, stakeholder coordination, and project administration.
  • Assist with cost control and successful project delivery.
  • Contribute to risk assessments, safety planning, and compliance activities.
  • Develop knowledge of Australian and international engineering standards and ensure adherence across projects.
  • Prepare engineering drawings and documentation using AutoCAD and other drafting tools.
  • Conduct site inspections, engineering audits, and technical assessments.
  • Prepare clear and professional client reports.
  • Support commissioning activities for new refrigeration installations.
  • Collaborate with the Service team to deliver technical support and engineering solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and project management processes.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, contractors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic graduate who is eager to learn, technically curious, and excited by the opportunity to work in a specialised and highly regarded engineering sector.

Essential Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Process, or Chemical Engineering
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong understanding of thermodynamics and heat transfer principles
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation
  • Current Australian driver's licence
  • Full working rights within Australia

Desirable

  • Experience using AutoCAD or similar design software
  • Exposure to refrigeration, energy, manufacturing, or process industries
  • Previous engineering internship or industry placement experience

Build Your Future with GBI

This is an outstanding opportunity to join an industry leader and gain exposure to the full engineering project lifecycle, from concept and design through to commissioning and operational support.

If you're looking to kick-start your engineering career with a company that invests in its people, values innovation, and offers genuine long-term career opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

To learn more about Gordon Brothers Industries, visit: [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au)

Only applicants with current Australian work rights will be considered.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug & alcohol testing, will form part of the recruitment process.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

job.description:
Instructional Designer/Learning Experience Designer (Commercial, Products, and Service Solutions - Sales Focus)

What you will do

Do you have experience leading projects supporting commercial or sales organizations? Do you want to turn all those great ideas you have into tangible results that make a difference? Do you have experience designing multi-media learning solutions to drive business outcomes? Are you adept at project management? If that’s the case, Johnson Controls Inc (JCI) has an amazing opportunity for you!

The future is being built today, and Johnson Controls is making that future more productive, secure, sustainable, and far safer. We are harnessing the power of the cloud, the Internet of Things, and user-design thinking to deliver intelligent buildings and smart cities that connect communities in ways that make people’s lives – and the world – better. Are you excited about enabling an organization transforming the buildings industry?

Your challenge, if you wish to accept it, will be to create innovative and effective enablement materials that support Johnson Controls’ sellers to understand customer needs throughout a building’s lifecycle , communicate value, and position our broader building systems and services portfolio with confidence. You will do this by working collaboratively with colleagues and business leaders, immersing yourself in the fascinating business, bringing creativity and hard work to every project you do, and being open to learning new skills and technologies every single day. Requirements include a strong learner-focused mindset, business acumen, a willingness to act amid ambiguity, strong project management skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. Does this sound like you? If so, keep reading!

How you will do it

Focus on Johnson Controls’ expanding portfolio of technology-based anproducts impacting our customers’ daily life

What we look for

  • Experience:5-10 years of designing and developing learning solutions preferred (exposure to Commercial / Sales, Industrial Tech B2B solutions preferred)

  • At least 1-2 years of experience in stakeholder communication

Education

Technical: JCI’s product and services portfolio is complex, so we need someone who is quick to grasp how building environments are created and business lines organized. Don’t worry, we’ll help you with that!Quality: Produces content and materials with the highest polish when required, but knows when to create fast and informalProfessional: Has personal ethics, does quality work, and has a positive attitudeArticulate: Has strong writing and communication skills

Specialized skills:

  • Flexible – Can change course if needed

job.title: iScala Analyst
job.description:
iScala ERP Analyst

At Johnson Controls, you will join a global organization focused on helping customers improve performance, safety, and efficiency across critical environments. In this role, you will support iScala ERP users and help keep core business processes running smoothly through reliable functional support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.

Role Overview

The iScala ERP Analyst will provide day-to-day application support across iScala ERP and connected solutions, helping users resolve issues, maintain stable operations, and improve how the system supports business processes. This role is well suited for someone with 4-6 years of hands-on experience in ERP support or techno-functional analysis who enjoys solving problems, working with cross-functional teams, and supporting end users in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide functional support for iScala ERP users and resolve application issues, service requests, and support tickets.
  • Support troubleshooting and hyper care activities across iScala ERP and the Edge Apps ecosystem.
  • Work with business and technical teams to analyze issues, identify root causes, and coordinate fixes or workarounds.
  • Assist with functional deployment across Build, SIT, UAT, and end-user training activities.
  • Support localization, electronic invoicing, advanced functions, and statutory or regulatory compliance needs within the ERP environment.
  • Develop and maintain reports, interfaces, and workflow integrations using relevant Epicor and database technologies.
  • Document solutions, user guidance, and support outcomes to improve system understanding and future issue resolution.
  • Contribute to upgrades, testing, and process improvements that strengthen overall ERP performance.

How You Will Do It

  • You will take ownership of issues end to end, working with urgency and accuracy to restore service and support business continuity.
  • You will stay close to the work by partnering with users, understanding process flows, and removing obstacles before they affect customers or operations.
  • You will use structured problem-solving and root cause analysis to move beyond quick fixes and help prevent repeat issues.
  • You will collaborate openly across functional and technical teams, sharing knowledge and contributing to solutions that improve the system for everyone.
  • You will look for continuous improvements in support, documentation, testing, and automation so the ERP environment becomes more efficient over time.

Qualifications

  • 4-6 years of experience in iScala ERP support, techno-functional analysis, or a similar ERP application support role.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of iScala ERP and related business processes.
  • Experience supporting functional configuration, troubleshooting, deployment, and user issue resolution.
  • Working knowledge of MS SQL Server 2019, SQL Programming, SSRS Report Development, and SSIS Development.
  • Experience with database management, complex SQL scripting, and investigation of ERP interfaces.
  • Familiarity with Epicor Service Connect or similar integration tools is strongly valued.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with users and cross-functional stakeholders in English.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting iScala localization, electronic invoicing, or compliance-related ERP functions.
  • Prior exposure to hyper care support, system upgrades, Build/SIT/UAT cycles, or end-user training.
  • Experience creating user documentation, support guides, or process notes for business users.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a collaborative environment where your work directly supports business users and operational stability. Johnson Controls offers a competitive salary and benefits package, along with opportunities for professional growth and development.

If you are ready to bring your iScala ERP experience to a role where your problem-solving skills can make a real impact, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Servicenow Platform Architect
job.description:
Job Title: ServiceNow Architect

About the Role

We are looking for a ServiceNow Architect to lead the overall design, architecture, and governance of the ServiceNow platform. This role requires deep hands‑on experience across multiple ServiceNow products, strong understanding of platform architecture, and the ability to guide development teams while working closely with process owners, business leaders, and technical stakeholders. You will define standards, design scalable solutions, and ensure the platform supports long‑term business needs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the end‑to‑end architecture of the ServiceNow platform across ITSM, CMDB, and at least one additional product such as ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps.
  • Design scalable, maintainable solutions aligned with platform best practices and organizational standards.
  • Translate business requirements into technical designs, data models, workflows, and integrations.
  • Lead technical design sessions, solution reviews, and architecture discussions with developers and stakeholders.
  • Oversee complex configurations: Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, and Flow Designer logic.
  • Guide integration design using Scripted REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and external systems.
  • Ensure CMDB structure, relationships, and data quality support service mapping and operational processes.
  • Support platform upgrades, patching, regression testing, and long‑term platform roadmap planning.
  • Troubleshoot high‑impact issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and recommend permanent fixes.
  • Provide technical leadership to developers and administrators; review code and ensure adherence to standards.
  • Define governance, naming conventions, documentation practices, and development guidelines.
  • Partner with security, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure compliance and platform stability.
  • Drive automation, workflow optimization, and platform performance improvements.
  • Maintain clear documentation for designs, integrations, data models, and architectural decisions.

Core Technical Skills

  • Deep understanding of ServiceNow architecture, data models, tables, ACLs, and role‑based access.
  • knowledge of Data Fabric and Creator Pro addon.
  • Strong expertise in ITSM, ITAM and ITOM (required).
  • Hands‑on experience with at least two additional modules: ITOM, ITAM (SAM/HAM), HRSD, SecOps, SPM, or ATF.
  • Advanced scripting skills: JavaScript (server and client), Glide APIs, Script Includes, and UI scripting.
  • Strong knowledge of Flow Designer, Workflow Editor, and process automation.
  • Experience designing and maintaining Scripted REST APIs, integrations, and data exchange patterns.
  • Solid understanding of CMDB relationships, discovery patterns, service mapping, and data governance.
  • Familiarity with Service Portal, widgets, and UI customization.
  • Understanding of ATF for automated testing.
  • Strong grasp of ITIL processes and how they map to ServiceNow modules.
  • Experience with Scoped Apps, custom tables, and application lifecycle management.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of hands‑on ServiceNow experience, including development and administration.
  • Proven experience designing enterprise‑level ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong understanding of platform best practices, architecture principles, and governance.
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery environments.
  • ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS (ITSM/CMDB/HRSD), or CTA are preferred.
  • Ability to mentor developers and admins and lead technical discussions.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with both technical and business stakeholders.

JCI is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any protected categories.

job.title: Senior Security Engineer, Enterprise SaaS Security - Singapore
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

As a Senior Security Engineer on this team, you will act as a technical leader and mentor. You will be responsible for securing Google’s enterprise usage of third-party Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) platforms. You will help scale our capacity for incoming security vulnerabilities, build automated tooling to reduce manual workloads using AI, and drive risk insights and remediations. You will ensure all new SaaS launches are secure by performing security assessments and ensure the adoption of required security controls. You will mentor and guide other engineers, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve collective goals. With your technical foundation and exceptional cross-functional collaboration skills, you will manage complex security issues and operations. You will have a breadth of application security experience such as SaaS or cloud security, API security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end security strategy for high-risk third-party SaaS platforms, identifying and driving solutions for complex, ambiguous security issues.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding the development of scalable security controls and fostering a culture of engineering excellence.
  • Architect and engineer advanced SaaS Security Posture Management (SSPM) solutions, leveraging AI/ML automation to reduce manual toil and improve operational visibility.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional security assessments to derive actionable risk insights, ensuring Google's enterprise usage of SaaS remains resilient against evolving threats.
  • Influence the broader SaaS security roadmap by collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to define policies and drive the adoption of required security controls.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Mobile Software Engineer, Google Pay, Client Infrastructure
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will help to scale Google Pay India to 400M users and beyond by building a high performing, secure, and robust client foundation. You will take end-to-end ownership of the core architecture, release systems, and developer ecosystem that power our entire Flutter application.

Whether it is paying online with Autofill, using tap and pay in stores, or using the Google Pay app, the Payments team at Google is focused on making payments simple, seamless, and secure. In addition to consumer payment technologies, the Payments team also powers the money movement between Google and its consumers and businesses.

Responsibilities

  • Design core application architectures, optimize critical app health metrics (such as Application-Not-Responding, startup latency, app size, memory usage, and frame rates), and build secure platform integration layers.
  • Build and maintain release pipelines, automated testing infrastructure, and developer tools, leveraging Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered solutions to automate diagnostics, optimize workflows, and boost overall developer velocity.
  • Collaborate with executive engineers, Product Managers, User Experience (UX), and other teams (like Photos and Gmail intelligence teams) to understand requirements and deliver solutions.
  • Work with technologies such as Dart, Flutter, Android, iOS, Java/Kotlin, Objective-C/Swift, and build/automation tools.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud (Thai)
job.description:
About the job

As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, you work as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, engineering liaison and technical delivery manager. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic AI accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. Aligned with our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) organization, you will architect how these technical assets actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints).

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with Account teams and Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
  • Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
  • Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
  • Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
  • Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Marketing Manager, AI Go-To-Market, JAPAC
job.description:
About the job

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and evolve their business through the use of Google’s global network, web-scale data centers and software infrastructure. The Cloud Marketing team is looking for people who can help us write and tell the story of our customer's journey. Understanding the power of our products and how they impact businesses, you will help share how we provide our customers with the best solutions for innovation. If you’re as excited about building what’s next as we are, Google Cloud is the place for you.

We are looking for a strategic and execution-driven Marketing Manager to shape and lead our regional Artificial Intelligence Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy across Japan and Asia-Pacific (JAPAC).

In this role, you will bridge global product narratives and regional market realities. You will define the marketing mental model for taking AI solutions to market across JAPAC sub-regions, working collaboratively with Global Product Marketing, Campaigns Teams, Regional Leadership, and Country Marketing teams. You do not need to be a deep technical engineer or product marketer; instead, you will serve as a high-impact commercial Subject Matter Expert (SME) on AI, capable of demystifying AI value propositions for buyers across segments, orchestrating integrated multi-touch campaigns, localizing global initiatives, and building regional GTM plays from scratch where critical white space exists. This will bridge global product narratives and regional market realities.

Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.

Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the JAPAC AI GTM framework and marketing narrative across sub-regions, partnering closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Country Marketing Leads to directly accelerate pipeline growth and agreement velocity.
  • Adapt global flagship campaigns to local commercial contexts while building bespoke, region-specific programs, events, digital assets, and customer advocacy initiatives to address market gaps.
  • Serve as the primary regional subject matter expert for AI positioning, translating complex technical capabilities into tangible business value and enabling field teams with engaging messaging and objection-handling.
  • Bridge global and in-country teams to architect and land high-touch customer engagements like seminars and roundtables to showcase compelling customer AI transformations.
  • Measure, analyze, and optimize campaign ROI, pipeline contribution, and market sentiment across priority accounts and segments.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Overview

*The working location for this position will be in Chiba prefecture.

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will develop an understanding of standard processes and procedures for preparing, installing, performing diagnostics, troubleshooting, replacing, and/or decommissioning equipment under the guidance of more experienced Data Center colleagues. This opportunity will allow you to develop an understanding of our Data Center environment, familiarize yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

_Required_Qualifications

  • Completed High/Secondary School, GED, an apprenticeship/vocational qualification, or equivalent experience and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components.

While not required, we also look for the following_Preferred Qualifications:_

  • 1+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Qualifications

  • Contributes to issue tracking through escalations, asking questions, and seeking guidance on timely resolution of issues from more experienced technicians.
  • Participates in daily safety briefings, completes required training aligned to the role and workload including safety training, complies with safety procedures (e.g., equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Completes assigned tickets efficiently and in alignment with Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) while meeting established Service Level Agreements (SLAs) with guidance from other technicians.
  • Complies with security and data management procedures and policies with guidance from other technicians and completes the required security training.
  • Maintains a strong client focus to understand the impact of their work when completing tickets and assigned tasks.
  • Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • [Embodies our](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393557000175?hl=en?timeout=20)[culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

job.title: Data Center Technicians Manager
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT) Manager, you will lead a team of technicians, providing expert guidance on performing hardware deployments, diagnostics on equipment, and hardware decommissions. You will support technician performance, prioritizing technician tasks while monitoring Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). This opportunity will allow you to model leadership principles, provide training to technicians, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Delivering success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring while promoting a positive and effective team culture.
  • Accountable for overall data center service compliance and quality.
  • Provide guidance on and holds team accountable for compliance with Data Center Services (DCS) business unit and service-level policies, procedures, deadlines, and service-change policies.
  • Ensures technicians are trained on procedures for installation, deployment, replacement, and post-execution quality check processes.
  • Verify post-execution quality checks have been performed appropriately by technicians and takes corrective action as needed.
  • Escalate issues through appropriate channels and follow up on issue resolution, sharing knowledge related to issue resolution with appropriate teams.
  • Review process changes to evaluate impact on service execution and share relevant information about change with stakeholders across functions and disciplines.
  • Lead team and triage meetings, prioritizing work across your team, and rebalance priorities to respond to changes.
  • Complete required safety training, conduct daily safety briefings, and participate in on-site safety committees.
  • Ensure technicians and vendor resources comply with all safety procedures (e.g., Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) usage, equipment use, lifting, electrical hazards, ladder/rolling stair use).
  • Promote a culture of safety and empower technicians to take action, speak up, and report safety concerns and/or incidents.
  • Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience, displaying accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embody our [culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution AND 5+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or related experience working with technical teams.
  • 2+ year(s) experience directing, supervising, or managing others.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • Associate degree in Computer Science or related field and/or equivalent work experience.
  • 4+ years’ experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • 3+ years’ experience working in a production, mission-critical 24x7x365 data center environment.
  • Applicable certifications: Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Foundation, ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC), Certified Data Center Professional (CDCP), Microsoft Certified Professional (MCP), Six Sigma Green Belt).
  • 2+ years’ experience leading diverse, technical, or IT workforce of up to ten employees.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

job.title: Critical Environment Operations Manager
job.description:
Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Infrastructure and Operations (MCIO) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a Critical Environment Operations Manager, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive and the Microsoft Azure platform. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Empower a culture of safety, security,and compliance in all aspects of our Datacenter operations
  • Lead a team of Mechanical, Electrical and Control System professionals supporting Microsoft's online services
  • Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our Datacenters
  • Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability to ensure optimal operational efficiency
  • Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE)incidents year over year
  • Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
  • Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
  • Establish working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and business partners
  • Work with regional and global peers to share and build practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Qualification or equivalent AND 3+ years experience of mission-critical service management (e.g., providing IT services, manufacturing, warehouse, retail, military, or managing physical operations in an IT and/or critical environment infrastructure)
  • OR equivalent experience

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Enterprise-level experience managing large scale and complex projects/programs AND 6+ years experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU) AND
  • Experience in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) AND Experience managing budget $1M+.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field.
  • Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, CCNA Certifications, ITIL v3 Foundation, Microsoft Operations Framework (MOF) Certifications, Leadership Development Certifications, PMP, CDCP.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
  • Experience working on large scale CE projects
  • Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.

job.title: Territory Manager - Sales
job.description:
As a Territory Manager, you will play a crucial role in our sales strategy, focusing on channel sales and retail operations. Your primary objective is to develop and maintain strong relationships with our primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution and market penetration. You will be working closely with our retail partners to understand their needs and provide excellent support.

Responsibilities

  • Manage and develop sales territories, focusing on channel sales and retail partnerships.
  • Build and maintain relationships with primary and secondary distributors, ensuring effective product distribution.
  • Expand our numeric reach and market presence by identifying new sales opportunities.
  • Track and analyze sales data, providing regular reports and insights to the sales team.
  • Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and execute sales campaigns and promotions.
  • Provide excellent customer service and support to our retail partners and end-users.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and competitor activities, offering insights to the team.
  • Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent NEDS and build our brand presence.
  • Work closely with the product team to understand product features and benefits, ensuring effective communication to distributors and customers.

Qualifications

  • A proven track record in sales, with experience in channel sales and retail operations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret sales data and market trends.
  • Knowledge of primary and secondary distribution channels and their dynamics.
  • Familiarity with collection tracking and management processes.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple territories effectively.
  • Proficiency in using sales and CRM tools for data tracking and analysis.
  • A proactive and results-driven approach to sales and territory management.
  • Willingness to travel within the assigned territories as required.
  • A positive and collaborative attitude, with a passion for sales and customer satisfaction.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Perform routine servicing and preventive maintenance of HVAC equipment, mainly chillers, under Service Agreements.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, controls, and operational issues and provide appropriate technical recommendations.
  • Execute and supervise repair, commissioning, and service activities.

  • Conduct technical and product training for customers, contractors, and in-house technicians.
  • Liaise with factory technical teams and follow up on technical issues, service bulletins, and product-related matters.
  • Support the Service Manager in daily operational and technical activities.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience in chiller servicing, commissioning, troubleshooting, or repair.
  • Knowledge of centrifugal, screw, or water-cooled chiller systems.
  • Experience in reading electrical/control drawings and interpreting equipment operating parameters.
  • Familiarity with BMS, IoT/remote monitoring, or smart service platforms is an advantage.
  • Experience working in data centres, industrial facilities, commercial buildings, or large-scale HVAC projects is highly desirable.
  • Strong report-writing, coordination, and project execution skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as lead and support technicians on site.

job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and contribute to strategic modernization initiatives across Helios platforms, including transformation of legacy Java/J2EE applications to cloud-native(AWS) and scalable architectures
  • Guide implementation approach for modernization initiatives, ensuring alignment between architecture intent and delivery execution
  • Define and guide target architecture patterns and design principles for modernization efforts
  • Drive experiments and proof-of-concepts (POCs) to evaluate new technologies, frameworks, and architectural patterns, enabling data-driven technology decisions
  • Translate successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions and drive adoption across teams
  • Influence engineering practices, standards, and architectural decisions across the broader Helios development community
  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and code reviews, enforcing coding standards, best practices, and maintainable design patterns
  • Mentor and coach engineers on low-level design, object-oriented design, and modern software engineering practices, elevating overall engineering capability
  • Deep-dive into complex legacy modules, identifying constraints, and proposing optimal modernization or refactoring strategies
  • Partner with DevOps and platform teams to ensure build, release, deployment readiness, and adoption of modern CI/CD and containerization practices
  • Identify and drive opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows, improving developer productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Required Skills & Experience

  • 15+ years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on development and technical leadership experience
  • Proven experience in Java/J2EE-based application development, including leading design and delivery of scalable services
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, design patterns, object-oriented design, and low-level design principles
  • Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and transitioning to microservices-based architectures
  • Hands-on experience with Spring frameworks, REST/JSON APIs, and distributed system design
  • Comprehensive knowledge of database technologies, including Postgres, SQL, and NoSQL, with proven ability to design, optimize, and troubleshoot data solutions.
  • Strong experience with data access technologies (JPA/Hibernate/JDBC)
  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit) and building high-quality, testable software
  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, tagging), Maven or equivalent build tools, and strong debugging skills
  • Experience leading or contributing to POCs, innovation initiatives, or modernization programs
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional and global teams, influencing without direct authority
  • Excellent technical communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • ​Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and working with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes for orchestration of containerized applications
  • Experience working with software systems in autonomous vehicles, mining, construction, or similar industrial domains
  • Understanding of onboard (machine) and offboard (cloud/office) system architectures and their integration in distributed autonomy platforms
  • Familiarity with communication protocols and networking concepts used in distributed systems (e.g., TCP/IP, messaging systems, telemetry pipelines)
  • Experience designing or integrating systems involving machine-to-cloud or edge-to-cloud communication

Job Summary

The Fleet Monitoring Center (FMC) Supervisor leads the China FMC team, overseeing the proactive monitoring of connected customer equipment using telematics, SOS, inspection, and service history data. The role is responsible for transforming machine data into actionable recommendations that improve customer uptime, productivity, reliability, and total cost of ownership.

As the local leader of the FMC operation in China, this position supports Caterpillar's Customer Solutions strategy while ensuring compliance with China data residency requirements. The role drives operational excellence, customer value delivery, and team development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Fleet Monitoring Analysts to deliver proactive fleet monitoring services.
  • Oversee machine health monitoring and provide recommendations to prevent equipment failures and improve performance.
  • Establish service standards and ensure timely response to customer and dealer needs.
  • Serve as the escalation point for complex machine health, reliability, and fleet performance issues.
  • Partner with customers, dealers, and internal teams to improve equipment uptime and operational efficiency.
  • Drive data-driven decision making through analysis of telematics, inspection, SOS, and service history data.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and enhanced customer value.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance and operational requirements within China.
  • Foster a culture of customer focus, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and teamwork.

Required Skills

  • Customer Focus
  • Service Excellence
  • Data Gathering & Analysis
  • Problem Solving
  • Relationship Management
  • Effective Communication
