job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission: The QA Engineer will ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications through comprehensive testing strategies, automation, and continuous quality improvement. This role is responsible for designing and executing test plans, developing automated test frameworks, identifying defects, and collaborating closely with development and product teams to deliver high-quality software solutions. The engineer will champion quality assurance best practices, integrate testing into CI/CD workflows, and drive continuous improvements in software quality, security, and user experience across the organization.

Accountabilities

Ensure software quality through effective test planning, execution, and defect management.

Develop and maintain automated test frameworks and test suites to improve testing efficiency and coverage.

Integrate quality assurance processes within CI/CD pipelines to support continuous delivery.

Monitor and report on software quality metrics, ensuring timely defect resolution and release readiness.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve testing practices, product quality, and customer satisfaction.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for functional, integration, regression, performance, and user acceptance testing.

Create and maintain automated testing frameworks and scripts using industry-standard tools.

Participate in requirements reviews and provide feedback to ensure testability and quality standards are met.

Identify, document, track, and verify software defects through to resolution.

Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and rapid releases.

Perform API, database, and end-to-end testing across applications and platforms.

Monitor test results, analyze quality trends, and recommend process improvements.

Ensure compliance with quality standards, security requirements, and testing best practices.

Stakeholders

Collaborate with Software Engineering teams to ensure quality is embedded throughout the development lifecycle.

Partner with Product Owners and Business Analysts to understand requirements and define acceptance criteria.

Work closely with DevOps and Platform Engineering teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

Engage with Security teams to validate security testing requirements and compliance standards.

Support Business stakeholders by ensuring software releases meet quality expectations and customer requirements.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

3 or more years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Test Engineering, or related roles.

Strong experience in manual and automated testing methodologies.

Hands-on experience with test automation tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, or similar frameworks.

Experience testing APIs using tools such as Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent.

Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Actions.

Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, Zephyr, TestRail, or equivalent.

Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile, and DevOps practices.

Knowledge of database testing and SQL queries.

Experience with scripting or programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Digital Designer
job.description:
ROLE OVERVIEW

The Digital Designer is a hands-on production-focused designer responsible for executing high-volume digital campaign assets across performance marketing and automated ad workflows. Responsible for product image processing and preparing all digital assets for automated ad generation through our automation platform. The role requires strong layout, typography, and compositional skills, with the ability to work efficiently and accurately under fast-paced production timelines. The ideal candidate is highly organised, detail-oriented, and comfortable working within structured design systems while maintaining strong visual quality and brand consistency at scale.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Interpret campaign production briefs and execute digital creatives across approved template systems and format families
  • Populate dynamic creative templates with campaign content including copy, pricing, product imagery, and CTA elements
  • Generate digital ad variants across all required placements using the ad automation platform, understanding template logic and catching layout anomalies proactively
  • Adapt and optimise assets for platform-specific specifications using Adobe Creative Suite
  • Ensure layout accuracy, brand consistency, copy integrity, and technical compliance across all outputs
  • Export and package final deliverables across required formats including static and animated assets
  • Maintain organised asset management, naming conventions, version control, and production file structures
  • Identify layout inconsistencies, formatting issues, or outputs outside approved templates and escalate when necessary
  • Support scalable production workflows and contribute to operational efficiency improvements
  • Undertake other duties, responsibilities, and projects as assigned by the supervisor or management, in line with evolving business and operational needs

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in digital production, graphic design, advertising production, or performance marketing creative environments
  • Portfolio demonstrating strong digital campaign execution and high-volume production capability
  • Experience working in fast-paced agency, in-house, or commercially driven production environments
  • Experience producing creatives for sales campaigns, festive campaigns, product launches, and promotional events
  • Strong understanding of layout, typography, composition, and visual hierarchy
  • Experience adapting digital creatives across multiple placements and format requirements
  • Able to work accurately within established template systems and brand guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail and self-review discipline before final submission
  • Experience handling multiple deliverables and timelines within fast-moving production environments
  • Able to work independently while maintaining consistency and production accuracy

REQUIREMENTS

  • Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, particularly Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with ad automation and dynamic creative workflows is advantageous
  • Basic motion or After Effects skills is advantageous
  • Basic proficiency in AI-assisted creative tools is advantageous
  • Solid understanding of digital ad specifications across social and display platforms
  • Strong file management and version control discipline

job.title: HR Business Partner
job.description:
Job Description

Job purpose

The HR Partner acts as a strategic advisor and consultant to business leadership, translating business priorities into practical people plans. In this role, you will independently manage a broad range of people matters to deliver workforce outcomes that strengthen organisational capability, employee engagement and business performance. The ideal candidate balances high-level strategic thinking with hands-on HR executive to foster a high-performing, inclusive culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Business Partnership
  • Partner with executive leadership and department heads to understand business priorities, identify workforce needs and translate them into practical people strategies and action plans
  • Lead organisational design, change management, and restructuring initiative to ensure business teams are optimised for agility and scale
  • Analyse workforce trends, employee feedback and key HR metrics to develop insights and recommend data-informed interventions and process improvements
  • Talent & Workforce Planning
  • Lead workforce and organisational planning activities, including headcount management, role design, succession planning and capability development
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to define hiring requirements to ensure a strong pipeline of diverse, qualified candidates
  • Partner with Total Rewards to ensure competitive compensation, promotions, and incentive structures
  • Employee Relations
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on workplace issues, conflict resolution, and policy interpretation
  • Manage employee matters with sound judgement, appropriate confidentiality, and timely escalation of complex or high-risk cases
  • Performance Management
  • Oversee the annual performance review cycle, guiding manager through objective goal setting, fair performance appraisals and structured feedback sessions
  • Coach managers on effective feedback, performance improvement plans (PIP), and career development discussions

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organisational Psychology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
  • Approximately 4 to 6 years of relevant HR experience, preferably in a dedicated HRBP or HR generalist role supporting business units
  • Working knowledge of core HR disciplines, including employee relations, performance management, talent management, recruitment and rewards
  • Sound knowledge of applicable employment legislation and HR Practices

Key Competencies Advisory and influencing: Builds credibility, provides clear advice and constructively challenges stakeholders when required Judgement and problem solving: Assesses people matters objectively and develops practical, balanced solutions Data literacy: Interprets workforce data and employee insights to identify trends and guide decisions Execution and ownership: Manage multiple priorities independently and follows through on agreed outcomes Collaboration: Works effectively across the HR team to deliver integrated solutions Communication: Communicates clearly and sensitively with stakeholders at different organisational levels Integrity and confidentiality: Handles employee information and sensitive matters with discretion and professionalism

job.title: Mechanical Engineer - Data Center Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

The Lead Mechanical Engineer will be responsible for leading the design, development, and implementation of mechanical systems for Data Centers and Cable Landing Stations (CLS). This includes HVAC, cooling, fire suppression, and other mechanical systems. The role requires ensuring that systems are energy-efficient, scalable, reliable, and compliant with client specifications, regulations, and industry standards. The Lead Mechanical Engineer will also collaborate with internal teams and external consultants/contractors to ensure smooth integration and successful implementation across all engineering disciplines.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and implementation of mechanical systems for data centers and Cable Landing Stations (CLS), including HVAC, cooling solutions, fire suppression, and other mechanical systems.
  • Ensure that mechanical systems are energy-efficient, scalable, flexible, reliable, and compliant with customer specifications, regulations, and industry standards.
  • Collaborate with the Data Center Design Manager, Data Center CSA Lead, Lead Electrical Engineer, and other departments to ensure the integration of mechanical systems with electrical, ICT, and structural systems.
  • Provide technical leadership ensuring best practices are followed and design challenges are effectively addressed.
  • Work closely with the Project Management team during execution to resolve any issues related to the installation and operation of mechanical systems.
  • Oversee the commissioning and testing of mechanical systems to ensure optimal performance and compliance with safety standards.
  • Ensure ongoing optimization and efficiency improvements of mechanical systems during the operation phase of data centers and CLS.
  • Provide guidance and support for troubleshooting and continuous improvement of system performance during the operational phase.
  • Escalation: In the event of issues, escalate them first to the Data Center Design Manager for resolution. If the issue remains unresolved, the Design Manager will escalate to the VP & Head of Data Center Planning and Development for intervention.
  • Other responsibilities as assigned by the line manager.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.
  • 1 - 3 years of consulting experience in electrical engineering, with a focus on data centers or Cable Landing Stations (CLS) projects.
  • Proven experience in designing and developing HVAC, cooling, fire suppression, and other mechanical systems for data centers and CLS.
  • Strong proficiency in performing engineering calculations (e.g., thermal load calculations, airflow, pump head, system sizing, etc).
  • Proficiency in mechanical design software (AutoCAD, Revit, HAP, Trace, CFD, etc.) and thermal modeling tools.
  • Knowledge of industry standards and codes, including Uptime, ASHRAE, NFPA, and local building codes.
  • Solid understanding of energy-efficient and mission critical design and sustainability practices.
  • Experience collaborating with external consultants and contractors to ensure successful project delivery.
  • Strong project management, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Registered Mechanical Engineer is a must, Professional License is preferred but not required.

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventive Maintenance: Perform routine maintenance on generators, transformers, UPS, and other electrical systems, auxiliaries like FDAS, FSS, access control, cctv's, HVAC systems, pumps, blowers, and other electro-mechanical support equipment to prevent malfunctions.
  • Corrective Maintenance: Diagnose and repair equipment failures, which may involve working with generator sets, AC units, pumps, and motor controls and all electrical systems such as generators, transformers, UPS, etc. and other auxiliary systems like CCTV, FSS, FDAS, Access Control, etc.
  • Equipment Monitoring: Conduct daily monitoring of equipment performance, including load monitoring of electrical distribution systems and checking temperatures and water levels in tanks.
  • Troubleshooting: Use knowledge of hydraulic, electrical, and robotic systems to diagnose and resolve issues with complex machinery.
  • Repairs: Utilize hand tools and power tools to repair or rebuild defective parts in electrical devices and mechanical equipment.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain maintenance records, track changes to equipment, and prepare documentation for reports.
  • Safety and Compliance: Adhere to strict safety protocols, security procedures, and operational standards of the data center.
  • 24/7 Support: Be prepared to work extended hours and respond to emergency calls to provide extra manpower coverage when necessary.

Qualifications

  • Technical Knowledge: Possess a strong understanding of both electrical and mechanical principles and systems.
  • Blueprint Reading: Ability to read and interpret blueprints and schematics to understand equipment functionality.
  • Precision Measurement: Proficient in using precise measuring instruments to inspect and test equipment.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose and resolve technical issues.
  • Communication: Effective communication skills to report site situations, collaborate with IT teams, and provide guidance to other technicians.
  • Physical Stamina: Capable of performing physical tasks associated with maintenance and repair of equipment.
  • Adaptability: Willingness to work in a 24/7 environment and respond to emergency calls as needed.
  • Certifications: A vocational diploma or relevant short course certificate in a technical field is often required.

job.title: EHS Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

The EHS Specialist supports the EHS Manager in the governance and assurance of General Contractor (GC) EHS performance across DayOne Data Centre operations and construction projects. The role is execution-focused: it drives the day-to-day processes that keep GC governance running — onboarding and qualification support, compliance tracking, field data management, audit and inspection support, and site observation tracking — so that risks are identified early, controls are verified in work-as-done, and EHS performance is reported accurately and on time.

The Specialist works closely with the EHS Manager, GC site teams, and the wider EHS function, providing the analytical and administrative backbone that enables consistent, data-driven EHS oversight across projects and regions. The role influences EHS outcomes through diligence, presence, and clear reporting rather than through direct authority.

Key Responsibilities

1. GC Onboarding & Qualification Support

  • Support the EHS Manager in administering the GC EHS onboarding and pre-qualification process from initial engagement through to site mobilization.
  • Perform first-pass review of GC EHS management systems, plans, risk assessments, method statements, and emergency preparedness documentation, flagging gaps and inconsistencies for the EHS Manager’s decision.
  • Assess GC submissions against DayOne EHS Minimum Requirements and project-specific criteria, and maintain a clear record of qualification status for each GC.
  • Develop and consolidate project-specific EHS risk and compliance requirements at the global stage, aligning them with DayOne standards and local regulatory obligations; communicate these to GC and internal stakeholders and follow up to confirm understanding and closure.
  • Track identified capability or documentation gaps through to closure, escalating stalled or high-risk items to the EHS Manager.

2. Compliance Process & Documentation Governance

  • Maintain and administer the GC EHS compliance framework, ensuring required documents, permits, certifications, and statutory records are current, complete, and correctly filed.
  • Operate document control for EHS governance materials — version control, distribution, and retrieval — so the EHS Manager and site teams work from a single source of truth.
  • Monitor compliance status against DayOne standards and local regulatory obligations, and prepare compliance status summaries and reminders ahead of expiry or renewal dates.
  • Support the translation of DayOne EHS Minimum Requirements into clear, workable site-level checklists and process artefacts.

3. Site EHS Data Management & Analysis

  • Collect, consolidate, and quality-check EHS data from project sites — leading and lagging indicators, inspection findings, permits, training records, and incident/near-miss data.
  • Maintain EHS data trackers, dashboards, and registers, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of submissions from GC site teams.
  • Analyse data to surface recurring risk conditions, behavioural or cultural patterns, and capability gaps across sites and regions, and highlight these to the EHS Manager.
  • Safeguard data integrity and confidentiality, and drive continuous improvement in how site data is captured and reported.

4. Audit & Inspection Support

  • Support the planning, scheduling, and logistics of EHS audits and inspections aligned with DayOne standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Assist during audits and inspections — evidence gathering, note-taking, and documentation — and help draft clear, factual audit and inspection reports.
  • Maintain the corrective and preventive action (CAPA) register, tracking actions to effective closure and following up with GC teams on overdue items.
  • Help verify that corrective actions address root causes rather than symptoms, escalating recurring or systemic issues to the EHS Manager.

5. Site Observation & Field Assurance Tracking

  • Administer the site observation and field engagement programme — logging, categorising, and trending safety observations, stop-work events, and field findings.
  • Maintain the observation tracking system so that trends in high-risk and high-energy activities, and the effectiveness of critical controls, are visible and reportable.
  • Participate in site walkthroughs and field observations alongside the EHS Manager to understand real work conditions and reinforce a supportive stop-work culture.
  • Ensure observation data feeds cleanly into performance reporting and continuous improvement reviews.

6. EHS Performance Reporting

  • Prepare periodic and ad-hoc EHS performance reports, packs, and dashboards for the EHS Manager, presenting risks, trends, and priority actions clearly and concisely.
  • Consolidate cross-site and cross-regional performance data into a coherent view of GC EHS performance.
  • Ensure reporting is timely, accurate, and decision-ready, with underlying data traceable and auditable.

7. Continuous Improvement & Learning Support

  • Support learning-focused reviews of incidents and near misses, capturing system- and condition-based factors and maintaining the lessons-learned repository.
  • Help share lessons learned and good practices across DayOne projects and regions.
  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement of DayOne’s GC EHS governance processes, tools, templates, and trackers.

Qualifications & Experience Essential

  • Degree or diploma in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 3–5 years’ EHS experience in construction, project, or industrial environments.
  • Sound working knowledge of EHS management systems, regulatory requirements, and contractor/GC EHS processes.
  • Strong data management, tracking, and reporting skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheets, dashboards, and document control tools.

Highly Desirable

  • ISO 45001 / 14001 Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualification.
  • NEBOSH Certificate (or equivalent) or working towards NEBOSH Diploma.
  • Nationally recognised safety competency relevant to the base location (e.g. WSQ / WSHO for Singapore; DOSH-registered Safety & Health Officer (SHO) / CIDB Green Card for Malaysia).
  • Exposure to data centre, mission-critical, or large-scale construction environments.
  • Experience supporting audits, compliance programmes, or EHS data/reporting systems.
  • Experience developing ISO-compliant safety procedures and documentation.
  • Hands-on experience setting up a safety management system, including its procedures, communications, and audit compliance.

Key Competencies

  • Strong organisational discipline — reliable tracking, follow-up, and closure of actions.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to turn raw site data into clear trends and insights.
  • Accurate, factual, and concise written reporting.
  • Practical, field-focused EHS approach; comfortable engaging on site and with GC teams.
  • Cross-cultural awareness and adaptability across regional and site contexts.
  • Collaborative, dependable, and able to work with limited supervision within a defined framework.
  • Integrity in handling EHS data and confidential information.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Design Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Design Manager, you will report to the Director, Design, based in Tokyo and work closely with the rest of the Technology team, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Lead the design for the world’s largest cloud technology companies
  • Contribute to developing the largest hyperscale data centre campuses in Japan and outside of Japan
  • Drive continuous engineering solutions across the business, including moving forward to a carbon free sustainable industry and incorporating leading edge technologies, such as liquid cooling, battery storage and AI solutions

Your Day to Day

  • Lead a project design team from inception to delivery of multi-MW hyperscale solutions attending design and construction meetings
  • Interface with our top cloud and enterprise customers and communicate presentations on all aspects of design
  • Develop high level master planning, space planning and engineering solutions for potential new developments (feasibility stage)
  • Produce Basis-Of-Design BOD documents in the project definition stage
  • Produce consultant’s briefs to develop designs from feasibility stage through concept, scheme and detailed design stages, ensuring continuity of design philosophy and approach
  • Oversee the technical aspects of direct procured equipment and facilitate their interface with the design team
  • Understand the commercial implications of engineering decisions and build cost models for customers
  • Provide technical assistance in the site election process and engage with service providers and local authorities

Requirements

  • Minimum 7+ years’ experience in MEP design, preferably with at least 3 years in data centre or mission-critical environments.
  • Fluent in English and Japanese (reading, writing, and presentation
  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering or relevant experience in product design or commissioning
  • Project life-cycle experience within the Japanese construction industry is a must
  • Incredibly flexible and forward-thinking as you must be ready for a continuous change of directions
  • Willing to make decisions and be accountable for them
  • Excel at communication; you can deliver effective presentations on data centre design to customers, peers and management
  • Good leadership acumen to lead multi-disciplinary teams

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

As the Legal Counsel, Capital Projects, you will report to Senior Director, Capital Projects, and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • You will work closely with the AirTrunk Legal, Site Selection and Development teams and other key business stakeholders, applying your broad expertise and knowledge to lead and drive key site selection, property, planning, leasing and acquisition workstreams across the APJ region.
  • You will advise on new, significant and unique initiatives, strategies and processes being developed across the site selection, property, planning, land acquisition space to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ, utilising your conceptual thinking to understand advanced issues and implications and convey them appropriately.

Your Day to Day

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Lead the strategy, product development, transformation, onboarding, orchestration, and engineering evolution of the Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) portfolio, encompassing SD-WAN, Secure Service Edge (SSE) and Secure Internet Access.

SASE Product Strategy & Portfolio Management

  • Oversee bulk gas handling, storage, and distribution. Ensure safety protocols and efficient operations. Perform regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks.

Handle Specialty Chemicals:

  • Supervise specialty chemicals' storage, handling, and application. Ensure regulatory compliance and develop safe use and disposal procedures.

Gas System Management:

  • Oversee the operation and maintenance of gas systems to ensure safe and efficient gas handling. Conduct regular inspections and maintenance to prevent leaks and comply with safety regulations.

Coordination of Maintenance Activities:

  • Coordinate maintenance schedules and activities across chemical systems and equipment, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure timely execution of maintenance tasks while minimizing disruption to operations and ensuring safety compliance.

Chemical Process Oversight:

  • Supervise chemical processes, including handling, storage, and application. Develop procedures for safe use and waste management to meet environmental and safety standards.

Safety and Compliance:

  • Ensure gas and chemical operations meet safety regulations and industry standards. Perform audits and risk assessments to identify hazards and implement corrective actions.

System Optimization:

  • Enhance the efficiency and performance of gas and chemical systems through data analysis and process improvements. Collaborate on system upgrades to boost reliability and cut costs.

Training and Development:

  • Train staff on safe gas and chemical handling and emergency procedures. Develop training programs and conduct drills to ensure personnel are well-versed in safety protocols.

Documentation and Reporting:

  • Maintain records of gas and chemical system operations, including maintenance and compliance reports. Prepare detailed management reports on system performance and safety.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Gas & Chemical
  • Area Incharge - Chemical
  • Package Incharge - O&M (CAS & PCW)
  • Engineer - Chemist
  • Lead - C&I
  • Area Incharge - Electrical

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Chemical Suppliers
  • Gas System Providers
  • Regulatory Authorities
  • Environmental Agencies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or a related field is essential. Additional certifications in hazardous materials management or environmental compliance would be beneficial. Strong understanding of chemical properties, handling procedures, and regulatory requirements is crucial.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in handling and managing gases and chemicals within an industrial setting. Proven track record in ensuring chemical safety, maintaining chemical inventory, and complying with environmental regulations. Demonstrated ability to lead and develop chemical handling procedures.

job.title: Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Sr. Account Manager
job.description:
ID

Company: Digital Edge DC

Established in 1994, Indonet is a pioneer and leading digital infrastructure service provider in Indonesia, delivering mission-critical solutions that support business sustainability and digital acceleration. Our services include reliable connectivity, data centre, and cloud solutions tailored to meet the evolving needs of modern enterprises.

With over three decades of experience, Indonet has consistently supported customers in building secure, scalable, and efficient digital infrastructure. Since 2021, Indonet has officially become part of Digital Edge, a pan-Asia Pacific data centre platform company, strengthening our commitment to supporting Indonesia’s digital transformation and digital economic growth.

We are currently opening an opportunity for the position of Sr. Account Manager position to join our team

What we need:

The Account Manager Strategic Sales is responsible for driving business growth by managing and developing Enterprise accounts across the following industry segments:

  • Financial Services Industry (FSI) – Banking & Insurance
  • Oil & Mining
  • Transportation
  • Hospitality
  • Healthcare
  • Education

This role is responsible for maintaining customer relationships, acquiring new customers, identifying new business opportunities, and generating revenue through the company's ICT, connectivity, cloud, data center, and managed service solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop new business opportunities across Enterprise market segments, including FSI (Banking & Insurance), Oil & Mining, Transportation, Hospitality, Healthcare, and Education.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with existing customers to ensure customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Identify customer business needs and propose appropriate ICT, connectivity, cloud, data center, and managed service solutions.
  • Generate new revenue through new customer acquisition, upselling, and cross-selling opportunities.
  • Build, manage, and maintain a healthy sales pipeline to achieve sales targets.
  • Conduct customer meetings, presentations, solution discussions, and business reviews.
  • Manage the end-to-end sales process from prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, to contract closing.
  • Coordinate with Presales, Product, Operations, Finance, and other internal stakeholders to deliver the best customer solutions.
  • Prepare sales forecasts, pipeline reports, account plans, and business updates.
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and industry developments to identify potential business opportunities.
  • Ensure timely follow-up on customer inquiries and maintain a high level of customer service.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Information Technology, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Enterprise Sales within the ISP, ICT, Telecommunications, Cloud, Data Center, or Technology industry.
  • Proven track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
  • Strong understanding of cloud technologies (Public, Private, Hybrid Cloud).
  • Experience in managing Enterprise accounts and handling complex sales cycles.
  • Strong understanding of ISP, Connectivity, Cloud, Data Center, Managed Services, and ICT solutions.
  • Strong network within Enterprise customers, preferably in FSI, Oil & Mining, Transportation, Hospitality, Healthcare, or Education sectors.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to identify customer needs and recommend appropriate solutions.
  • Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and CRM/Sales Management tools.

ID

Company: Digital Edge DC

Sr. Engineer, Cloud Solution Architect

Who we are

Founded in 1994, PT Indointernet Tbk (Indonet) is one of Indonesia's pioneering digital infrastructure companies, providing connectivity, cloud, managed services, and data center solutions to enterprises across the country.

Over the years, Indonet has played an important role in supporting Indonesia's digital transformation by delivering reliable and scalable technology solutions that help businesses operate and grow in an increasingly connected world.

Today, Indonet is part of Digital Edge, a leading data center platform in Asia backed by global infrastructure investors. Together, Indonet and Digital Edge are strengthening digital infrastructure capabilities across the region to support the growing demands of enterprises, cloud providers, and the digital economy.

The Sr. Engineer, Cloud Solution Architect will work closely with customers and internal stakeholders to develop cloud solutions that address business and technical requirements.

  • Design cloud solutions based on customer business and technical requirements
  • Support customer meetings, workshops, and technical discussions
  • Prepare technical proposals, solution documentation, and architecture diagrams
  • Conduct technical assessments and solution feasibility reviews
  • Collaborate with sales and technical teams to support customer opportunities

  • Maintain knowledge of cloud technologies and industry best practices
  • Support proposal development and solution costing activities
  • Ensure solution designs align with company standards and capabilities

The successful candidate:

  • Education: Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in cloud engineering, cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, or presales consulting
  • Strong understanding of cloud platforms, virtualization, and infrastructure technologies
  • Experience creating solution designs and technical proposals
  • Strong presentation and communication skills
  • Cloud certifications are preferred
  • Good competence in English is preferred

Singapore, Singapore

To support Record to Report (RTR)’s process optimization initiatives, this role will be responsible for identifying process gaps and improvement opportunities, simplifying, and standardizing activities and driving automation and system enhancement across RTR.

The role partners with business users, IT and transformation/Group Digital Office teams to translate business needs into practical solutions, support implementation and change, and sustain benefits post-implementation.

The role is also expected to provide operational support for RTR activities, including month-end close, financial accounting and reporting, and other assignments based on business priorities and resource needs.

Make an impact by

  • Review existing RTR processes and identify opportunities for simplification, standardisation and automation.
  • Work with process owners and users to understand business requirements and support process improvements.
  • Coordinate and track process improvements and transformation initiatives, including timelines, issues and deliverables.
  • Work with IT and automation teams on business requirements, solution design and development.

  • Monitor post-implementation results and identify areas for further improvement.
  • Provide guidance and ongoing support to team members for assigned initiatives

**

  • Good finance and accounting process knowledge
  • Process mapping and root-cause analysis
  • Experience supporting process improvement, automation or transformation initiatives

job.title: Lead Agent Evaluation & Instrumentation #AIDA
job.description:
Role Summary

Lead the Agent Evaluation & Instrumentation function as the independent quality authority for the telco’s production AI estate. Own the Day 1 → Day 2 handover process and hold go/no-go gate authority over every AI agent and AI/ML model entering production.

Define what “good” means through the metrics catalogue, evaluation suites, and instrumentation standards, and ensure the organisation can prove agent quality, safety, and reliability before and after launch.

Lead a team of evaluation and instrumentation engineers and analysts, safeguarding evaluation independence from delivery pressure.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Own, publish, and continuously improve the Day 1 → Day 2 handover process, operability gates, and shadow-run exit criteria across all agent archetypes (RAG, SQL, task-based autonomous, AI/ML models, voice overlay).
  • Chair operability gate reviews and issue independent go/no-go decisions with written findings; track remediation of conditional passes to closure.
  • Set instrumentation and telemetry standards (trace schema, required events, dashboards) and certify telemetry completeness before shadow-run exit.
  • Lead, coach the Agent Eval & Instrumentation team to build specific AI/Agent use case operational and evaluation dashboards in consultation with Agent Capabilities Services and Business/Product Owners.
  • Drive the improvement engine: convert production signals into a prioritised optimisation backlog routed to Agent Capabilities Services, Data & Harness Engineering, and AI/Agent Operations, and evidence that shipped improvements moved the target metric.
  • Represent Agent Eval & Instrumentation with cross-functional partners such as (Agent Capabilities Services, Data & Harness Engineering, Central AI Platform & Ops, AI Lab) and provide quality and reliability inputs to CAIO/board reporting.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the Agent Eval & Instrumentation team; manage evaluation independence, workload prioritisation, and performance.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or related field
  • 10+ years in software/ML/quality with 3+ years leading technical teams
  • Experience operating or evaluating ML/LLM systems in production
  • LLM/agent evaluation methods (offline & online, LLM-as-judge)
  • Metrics design and observability/instrumentation for AI systems
  • Understanding of RAG, SQL agents, autonomous agents and AI/ML model lifecycles
  • Strong stakeholder management and the independence to hold a line
  • Clear written communication for gate findings and executive reporting
  • People leadership and coaching

job.title: Vulnerability Management Technical Lead
job.description:
What you will do

  • The development and implementation of the Colt Vulnerability Management Framework.
  • Enhancing the scope and efficiency of current vulnerability scanning and management tools and integration between them.
  • Design and manage the periodic penetration testing exercise.
  • Collaborating with identified stakeholders to provide specialist guidance and support, ensuring effective vulnerability identification, prioritisation and remediation activity definition.
  • Perform Vulnerability scans using Vulnerability Management tool
  • Responsible for working with leading team to assist with understanding threat data and vulnerabilities found on client’s network
  • Prepare and send error free Vulnerability Management reports to respective stakeholders
  • Send scan notification and completion emails as per defined timelines.
  • Configuration of vulnerability scans and reporting
  • Troubleshooting in case of scan failures or tool-based issues
  • Identify false positive and connect with vendor and support teams to resolve it
  • Drive remediation connects with multiple stake holders / resolver groups

What we're looking for

  • Self-driven individual with vulnerability management function experience.
  • Proven experience with products dealing with vulnerability management services which include - Rapid7, Qualys, Nessus etc.
  • Strong understanding on Windows systems, Linux systems
  • Strong understanding on Networking
  • Should have completed certifications like CEH, ECSA or other equivalent security certifications
  • Degree in Information Technology, Engineering or similar
  • In-depth knowledge of and experience in security concepts such as cyberattacks and techniques, risk management, incident management, threat management, etc.
  • Depth insight on all latest vulnerabilities and highlight the risk to client environment
  • Proficient in preparation of reports, dashboards and documentations.
  • Knowledge /Experience of security technologies such as Cisco/Juniper Firewalls, Application Firewalls, IPS, SIEM, Proxy, NAC, etc.

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

job.title: Administrative Associate - Sales
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better. Thank you for your interest in continuing to grow your Cummins career!

We are looking for a talented Administrative Associate - Sales to join our team in Tuas, Singapore location. This will be following Onsite with Flexibility work model.

Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Performs activities under a moderate degree of supervision.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine information requests.
  • Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets.
  • Assists with data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities.
  • Assists with associate functions such as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings.
  • Responds to, or redirects, routine inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately.
  • Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees.
  • Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures.
  • Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed.
  • Performs other routine administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.
  • Action oriented - Taking on new opportunities and tough challenges with a sense of urgency, high energy, and enthusiasm.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

job.title: Project Manager - Facilities
job.description:
Job Summary

Manages, develops, and implements project(s) of varying complexity and size in assigned functional area. Partners with business stakeholders to ensure a successful project completion.

Key Responsibilities

Leads multiple projects from inception to completion; facilitates project planning sessions with internal stakeholders to determine the scope and objectives of each project; works with business stakeholders to establish project performance goals; designs project plan, develops timeline, identifies project milestones, and tracks performance against performance goals and timeline. Identifies, tracks, and works with others to resolve project issues. Monitors and communicates project status to project team. Plans and monitors project budget, conducts research and analysis; provides input into the design and development of project plans and timelines. Manages project risk; uses quality tools to identify areas of risk; works with others on the team and outside the team to identify alternatives or solutions. Documents and shares team learning's with other teams; draws on other project team experiences to enhance the success of the project. Maintains project notes, databases, and other records; monitors measures and communicates with Project Sponsor and other stakeholders on status of specific projects and assignments. Identifies and assigns appropriate resources to accomplish various project tasks; guides and coaches team members through various stages of the project; provides developmental feedback to team members.

Competencies:

Financial acumen - Interpreting and applying understanding of key financial indicators to make better business decisions.

Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Manages conflict - Handling conflict situations effectively, with a minimum of noise.

Plans and aligns - Planning and prioritizing work to meet commitments aligned with organizational goals.

Project Issue and Risk Management - Manages the process to identify, assess and prioritize issues and risks using recommended tools and disciplines. Drives actions to minimize, monitor and control risks and issues and to maximize the most positive outcomes possible.

Project Resource Management - Develops resource (expense and headcount) plans using recommended project management tools and processes to manage resources effectively.

Project Schedule Management - Manages the planned schedule using the recommended schedule management tools and processes to drive completion within the agreed timeline.

Project Scope Management - Manages a list of project deliverables (scope) using the recommended project management tools and processes to ensure that the project includes all the work required and only the work required to complete the project successfully.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent degree required (Engineering background preferred)

Experience

5 to 7 years of relevant experience required.

job.title: Manager, Customer Relations
job.description:
This role is ideal for a proactive and resilient professional who is motivated by solving problems, improving customer outcomes, and making a visible impact in a dynamic eMPF environment. The Manager, Customer Relations (eMPF) is responsible for managing end‑to‑end complaint cases related to eMPF services and customer experience, ensuring timely, fair and professional resolution in line with internal policies and external regulatory requirements, while helping to drive service excellence and continuous improvement.

Your Role

  • Handle and resolve customer complaints related to eMPF received via phone, email, written correspondence and other service channels in accordance with internal guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Manage complaint communication through both verbal and written channels, ensuring responses are clear, accurate, professional and empathetic.
  • Conduct detailed investigations into complaint cases, gather facts from relevant systems and stakeholders, and identify the root cause of each issue.
  • Assess operational, compliance, regulatory and reputational risks arising from complaint cases, and promptly escalate sensitive, urgent or high‑risk matters to senior management.
  • Direct and monitor the daily operations of the Customer Relations (eMPF), providing guidance and support to ensure the high performance of team members.
  • Liaise with internal departments, trustees, service providers, vendors and external parties to facilitate thorough investigation and timely case resolution.
  • Support liaison with the MPFA and other relevant parties on complaint cases, information requests, case updates and reporting matters where required.
  • Recommend practical and sustainable resolutions that balance customer fairness, regulatory expectations and operational feasibility.
  • Monitor and achieve assigned complaint handling KPIs, including turnaround time, response quality, case accuracy and closure effectiveness.
  • Identify recurring issues and complaint trends, and work with stakeholders to implement remedial actions and process improvements that enhance customer experience and reduce repeat complaints.
  • Prepare regular and ad hoc management reports, case summaries, trend analysis and briefing materials for management review.
  • Support the review and enhancement of complaint handling policies, guidelines, templates and procedures to ensure alignment with business needs and regulatory expectations.
  • Conduct service quality checks and share knowledge with team members and frontline staff to strengthen complaint handling standards and uplift service capability.
  • Participate in incident management, service recovery and project activities related to eMPF customer issues, and contribute positively in a fast‑paced environment where teamwork and initiative matter.

To Success in this Role

  • University degree in Business Administration or related discipline.
  • 6-8 years of relevant experience, including 5 years in complaint management or customer relations, preferably in the pensions, insurance, or banking industry.
  • Minimum 3 years of people management experience.
  • Experience in handling complex or escalated complaint cases, with sound judgement and the ability to manage sensitive situations professionally.
  • Strong ability to work under pressure, manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines without compromising quality, accuracy, or compliance.
  • Detail‑minded with strong analytical and investigative skills, and able to review facts carefully, identify gaps and maintain high‑quality documentation.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and Chinese, including the ability to draft clear complaint replies, case summaries and management or regulatory correspondence.
  • Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across operations, technology, compliance, legal and external counterparties.
  • Good understanding of complaint handling principles, customer fairness, service recovery, and risk awareness.
  • Knowledge of MPF operations, pension administration or relevant regulatory expectations is an advantage.

job.title: Principal Deal Pursuit Leader, Strategic Accounts, APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales
job.description:
AWS is seeking an exceptional Senior Deal Pursuit Leader to drive our most consequential transformational opportunities across our largest enterprise accounts. This is a high-intensity, time-bound pursuit role with a singular objective: to close $200M+ Total Contract Value (TCV) deals, within a twelve-month sprint across a portfolio of strategically selected accounts. You will operate at the intersection of business development, executive relationship management, complex deal orchestration, and cross-functional leadership, answering one question every day: what must happen today to move these deals forward?

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and drive a portfolio of mega-deal pursuits across APJC’s most strategic enterprise customers.
  • Orchestrate 10+ cross-functional stakeholders including AWS Industry Specialists, GTM Specialists, Pan- Amazon Strategic Business Development, Solution Architects, Strategic Contracts team, Cloud Economics teams and AWS Partners through complex deal cycles.
  • Drive Think Big during Prospecting and Qualification stages, identifying transformational outcomes tailored to each customer’s unique business context, that helps achieve CEO / LOB CxO leader’s business transformation objectives, and for AWS unlocks deal sizes beyond what incremental consumption growth would deliver.
  • Build and own C-suite executive relationships with customer decision-makers, developing trust-based partnerships that reimagine existing relationships beyond consumption-based pricing.
  • Leading the weekly deal-room cadence, run by deal execution leads, maintaining rigorous deal execution discipline with clear progression gates at 60-day, 120-day, and 180-day marks.
  • Make decisive go/no-go calls — if an account has not reached Technical Validation stage by day 90, execute pivot triggers and rotate in pre-qualified replacement accounts to maintain three active pursuits at all times.
  • Deliver monthly business reviews to APJC senior leadership with clear deal progression metrics, risk assessments, and acceleration recommendations.

About the team AWS’s APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales team serves the top strategic enterprise customers across Asia-Pacific, Japan, and Greater China. This role is central to an initiative that will drive APJC’s top-account growth rate - unlocking the next wave of growth across our most consequential customer relationships. You will report directly into APJC Enterprise Sales leadership and operate with full executive sponsorship from APJC senior leaders.

Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneer cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, compute, storage, and database services that help organizations of every size transform their businesses. At AWS, you will work backwards from the customer, think big, and have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud computing across the world’s most dynamic markets.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
  • 7+ years of professional or military experience
  • 7+ years of working with Core Cloud Technology Services, including, but not limited to Compute, Edge, Hybrid, Security, and/or Networking experience
  • 7+ years of working with Business Application Technologies, including, but not limited to End User Compute (EUC), Supply Chain, Contact Center as a Service, Consumer Data Applications, Encrypted Communications, and/or Communication Developer Services experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Healthcare/Life Sciences Industry experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Media & Entertainment Industry experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Global Financial Services Industry experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Telecommunications industry experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Automotive & Manufacturing industries experience
  • 7+ years of solving problems with technology in the Energy & Utilities industries experience
  • 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • 7+ years of working with Advanced Compute technologies including, but not limited to: Accelerated Compute, High Performance Compute, Visual/Spatial Compute, and/or IoT. experience
  • 7+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
  • 7+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as a founder or executive focused on related segments, or as a practice leader or business unit owner
  • Experience selling to Fortune 1000 or Global 2000 organizations

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Regional Environmental Engineer, AWS Environmental - DCC Communities
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS's growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS's global operations, including physical data centres and other AWS facilities. The team has responsibility for architecting and implementing AWS's environmental programmes, including defining and implementing risk management and compliance systems; setting and refining policies and procedures; overseeing the development of standards, tools, auditing and metrics; and engaging with all AWS business units to provide scalable and effective compliance strategies that support current and future business objectives while ensuring compliance with environmental regulations.

The Regional Environmental Engineer (REE) will be responsible for environmental compliance at data centers in Jakarta Indonesia. The REE will develop standards and policies to support regulatory compliance and provide environmental compliance guidance for regional operations and construction teams. The individual will complete environmental performance analysis, establish and monitor metrics, and guide the teams in implementation of Amazon environmental standards. The REE will work with internal and external partners (through respective teams) that include government entities, contractors, consultants, design, construction, operations and other key stakeholders. This position is based in the Jakarta region and will require regular domestic travel and occasional international travel. Bahasa and English speaking and writing proficiency is required.

The REE must have excellent communication skills, strong environmental regulatory knowledge, particularly with respect to Indonesian regulations and standards, demonstrated success in program management, and experience leading teams in complex and technical projects.

Key job responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee compliance with local and federal environmental regulations of Indonesia and Amazon standards and policies.
  • Develop regional strategic programs by integrating with engineering, construction, and operations. Drive an environmentally responsible culture within the organization.
  • Function as a leader regarding assistance with Indonesian regulatory agency interactions, permit evaluation and processing, and new process and technology introduction
  • Ensure work performed by contractors, consultants, and employees is completed in accordance with Amazon standards.
  • Develop environmental metrics to measure, monitor and forecast performance
  • Conduct thorough and accurate environmental audits of data centers in the Jakarta region for continuous improvement.
  • Prioritize and manage multiple technically complex assignments concurrently.
  • Assist legal and/or public policy teams at appropriate levels with governmental agencies.
  • Build collaborative relationships with various stakeholders to ensure risks are identified early and managed appropriately.
  • Submit time critical reports to the public policy team, which will be interacting with various governmental agencies
  • Complete thorough and accurate environmental incident investigations and associated regulatory reports and develop appropriate corrective actions

Basic Qualifications

  • A completed Bachelor’s Degree in chemistry, chemical or environmental engineering or related field of study.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience serving as an environmental technical resource, environmental manager, program specialist, or environmental consultant
  • Experience with environmental permit evaluations and applications, planning approvals, environmental authorisation, regulatory compliance with air and noise emission, water discharge and waste management in Indonesia
  • Proficient with MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Broad knowledge of global environmental regulations and programs
  • Experience leading change in multiple site environments and the ability to influence those that are not direct reports or within your organization
  • Experience successfully implementing environmental systems
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills: excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong relationship builder, solid influencing and negotiation skills, and the ability to coach at multiple levels and comfort interfacing with senior leaders inside and outside the company
  • Experience in a fast paced, changing/growing organization
  • Strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem solving ability
  • Experience working in data center infrastructure sector

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: FSI Senior Account Manager, Thailand, FSI Thailand
job.description:
AWS is a place where thousands of different personalities with the same customer obsession come to turn can’t-be-done into done. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join AWS, and we encourage our employees to bring their own voice and chart their own path.

As a Senior Account Manager with Amazon Web Services (AWS) focused on Thailand customers in Financial Services sectors, you will have the exciting opportunity to help promote the growth and shape the future of an emerging technology. Your responsibilities will include increasing adoption, and market penetration across Thailand.

This role focuses on developing and executing AWS strategies to transform the relationship with named financial services customers into a trusted, sustainable partnership enabled by Cloud and AI.

The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of financial services customers in Thailand, with experience selling to and partnering with them. They bring direct sales experience leading teams that exceed targets by growing revenue within existing accounts and acquiring new ones. They understand the technical requirements involved and have experience building teams with those skills. Above all, they drive engagement at the CxO level and across technical, IT, alliance, marketing, and sales functions. This person is a natural influencer – someone customers and partners are eager to engage with.

We are looking for candidates with a proven track record of success in delivering results, with ability to engage CxO’s with confidence, ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams (internally and externally), great communication skills, and must be able to explain cloud computing and infrastructure solutions at Level 100 (minimum).

Key job responsibilities

  • Drive revenue and market share in a defined territory (FSI accounts)
  • Work with Thailand and regional cross-functional teams to define account strategies, identify opportunities and drive AWS business expansion.
  • Develop and execute account plans to consistently meet and exceed revenue targets, applying a Think Big perspective to position AWS as a trusted business transformation partner.
  • Collaborate with customers’ technology and lines-of-business (LOB) teams to bolster strategic relationships – articulating a clear vision, generating enthusiasm, and driving impact across all business groups.
  • Engage at the most senior levels, earning trust with C-level executives and business owners to secure buy-in, while also partnering with IT stakeholders to deliver on initiatives.
  • Drive both new opportunities and strategies that earn customer acceptance and accelerate AWS adoption.
  • Effectively coordinate all relevant AWS resources – Executive Solutions Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service teams, and Professional Services – to foster a unified approach aligned with the account plan.
  • Articulate compelling value propositions for AWS services across all organizational levels in lending, corporate banking, payments, and other business areas.
  • Partner with our partner ecosystem to extend reach and drive adoption.
  • Manage mid-size to large commercial accounts concurrently & strategically
  • Create & articulate compelling value propositions around AWS services
  • Possess the technical ability to explain (not implement) Cloud Computing, Infrastructure Solutions (Server, Storage, DC Services) & Internet Architectures (firewalls, load balancers, etc).
  • Initiate customer case studies and references
