job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

As a Senior Welding Engineer at Caterpillar, you will lead and participate in the design and process development of structural components to ensure outstanding strength and fatigue performance in CWL. You will also have the opportunity to contribute to the advancement of welding automation in Caterpillar’s China facilities, ensuring high welding efficiency and low welding costs.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provided on side welding technology service for CWL automatic welding line building & upgrading, and BCP structure welding process development.
  • Possess strong expertise in advanced welding assembly of construction machinery structural components and automated production in welding plants, and drive the application of new welding technologies in Caterpillar’s China facilities.
  • Understand the production processes of welded structural components in Caterpillar China plants, and support upgrades in welding plant layout and material flow in Caterpillar China structural component facilities.
  • Support Caterpillar’s structural component engineering design team by optimizing structural component designs based on welding characteristics and practices in China.
  • Analyze failed welded components to identify the direct causes of failure, and assist in benchmarking competitors’ welded parts to better understand their quality levels and cost control practices.

Skill Descriptors

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Knowledge of the decision-making process and associated tools and techniques; ability to accurately analyze situations and reach productive decisions based on informed judgment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Applies an assigned technique for critical thinking in a decision-making process.
  • Identifies, obtains, and organizes relevant data and ideas.
  • Participates in documenting data, ideas, players, stakeholders, and processes.
  • Recognizes, clarifies, and prioritizes concerns.
  • Assists in assessing risks, benefits and consideration of alternatives.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Reviews others' writing or presentations and provides feedback and coaching.
  • Adapts documents and presentations for the intended audience.
  • Demonstrates both empathy and assertiveness when communicating a need or defending a position.
  • Communicates well downward, upward, and outward.
  • Employs appropriate methods of persuasion when soliciting agreement.
  • Maintains focus on the topic at hand.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides effective technical solutions to routine functional challenges via sound technical competence, effectively examining implications of events and issues.
  • Effectively performs the technical job aspects, continuously building knowledge and keeping up-to-date on technical and procedural job components.
  • Applies technical operating and project standards based on achieving excellence in delivered products, technologies and services.
  • Applies current procedures and technologies to help resolve technical issues in one's general area of technical competence.
  • Helps others solve technical or procedural problems or issues.

Project Management: Knowledge of effective project management strategies and tactics; ability to plan, organize, monitor, and control projects, ensuring efficient utilization of technical and administrative resources to achieve project objectives.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Provides input for Gantt or PERT charts or their equivalent to track project progress and status.
  • Under guidance, plans and estimates simple projects.
  • Assists in detailed project plans including cost, schedule, and resource requirements.
  • Obtains information from stakeholders during the planning stage of a project.
  • Produces standard project status reports.

Manufacturing Standards, Procedures and Policies: Knowledge of organizational standards, procedures and policies in manufacturing activities; ability to plan, guide, and monitor manufacturing processes for compliance.

Level Basic Understanding:

  • Discusses the relevance of standards for a manufacturing environment.
  • Researches process and product blueprints for own area.
  • Describes and follows all policies, standards and procedures.
  • Obtains documentation and information on standards and their usage.

Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing.

Level Extensive Experience:

  • Coordinates execution of test plans, including resources, strategy, schedules, processes and tools.
  • Collaborates with design team to ensure testing considerations are incorporated into system design.
  • Recommends tools and techniques for automating, simplifying and enhancing product testing.
  • Compares and contrasts alternative testing methodologies and tools.
  • Matches testing methodology and tools to product being tested; develops test scenarios and scripts.
  • Estimates time, effort and resources required for thorough testing.

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing or product development environment.

Level Working Knowledge:

  • Documents common hardware, software and communications problems and likely resolutions.
  • Troubleshoots typical technical problems in a specific area.
  • Works with vendor-specific diagnostic guides, tools and utilities to discover application problems.
  • Adheres to standard troubleshooting procedures to ensure effectiveness of resolutions.
  • Participates in setting evaluation standards and criterion for troubleshooting.

Prefer Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Metallurgical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field.
  • Good project management skills, especially for welding line building and structure welding process development.
  • Familiarity with welding standards for construction machinery components, including GB, ISO, ASTM, etc.; strong expertise in advanced welding assembly of structural components and automated welding production; solid understanding of the relationship among steel materials, welding processes, and the strength and fatigue performance of welded components.
  • Experience in welding of engineering structural components.
  • Good command of English in listening, speaking, reading, and writing, with strong communication skills.
  • Basic programming capability, such as Python, C, C++, etc.

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

  • Lead architecture and design reviews, and code reviews, enforcing coding standards, best practices, and maintainable design patterns
  • Mentor and coach engineers on low-level design, object-oriented design, and modern software engineering practices, elevating overall engineering capability
  • Deep-dive into complex legacy modules, identifying constraints, and proposing optimal modernization or refactoring strategies
  • Partner with DevOps and platform teams to ensure build, release, deployment readiness, and adoption of modern CI/CD and containerization practices
  • Identify and drive opportunities to embed AI and automation into engineering workflows, improving developer productivity, quality, and delivery speed

Required Skills & Experience

  • 12+ years of experience in software engineering, including strong hands-on development and technical leadership experience
  • Proven experience in Java/J2EE-based application development, including leading design and delivery of scalable services
  • Strong expertise in software architecture, design patterns, object-oriented design, and low-level design principles
  • Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications and transitioning to microservices-based architectures
  • Hands-on experience with Spring frameworks, REST/JSON APIs, and distributed system design
  • Comprehensive knowledge of database technologies, including Postgres, SQL, and NoSQL, with proven ability to design, optimize, and troubleshoot data solutions.

  • Experience with testing frameworks (e.g., JUnit) and building high-quality, testable software
  • Proficiency with Git (branching, merging, tagging), Maven or equivalent build tools, and strong debugging skills
  • Experience leading or contributing to POCs, innovation initiatives, or modernization programs
  • Strong experience working with cross-functional and global teams, influencing without direct authority
  • Excellent technical communication, mentoring, and stakeholder engagement skills
  • ​Experience with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and working with DevOps/CI-CD pipelines
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes for orchestration of containerized applications
  • Experience working with software systems in autonomous vehicles, mining, construction, or similar industrial domains
  • Understanding of onboard (machine) and offboard (cloud/office) system architectures and their integration in distributed autonomy platforms
  • Familiarity with communication protocols and networking concepts used in distributed systems (e.g., TCP/IP, messaging systems, telemetry pipelines)
  • Experience designing or integrating systems involving machine-to-cloud or edge-to-cloud communication

job.title: Senior Solutions Architect (Network and 5G)
job.description:
Job Description

  • Partner with large deal pursue team and Account Teams to shape account strategies and build pipeline through a consultative selling approach, supporting strategic pursuits and new customer acquisition.
  • Lead customer discovery and architecture workshops; translate business, technical, operational and service requirements into end-to-end network architectures, defined scope, assumptions and measurable outcomes.
  • Act as the design authority for complex solutions covering campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery and managed network services.
  • Architect telco connectivity solutions across internet, DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet and local or international connectivity, addressing bandwidth, latency, QoS, carrier and access diversity, last-mile resilience, failover and SLA requirements.
  • Apply network security by design, including segmentation, NGFW/firewall, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection, secure management and traffic visibility.
  • Evaluate architecture options and technology choices based on performance, availability, scalability, interoperability, operational supportability, commercial viability and risk, while maintaining vendor-neutral judgement.
  • Own the technical solution package, including reference architecture, high-level design, bill of materials, compliance responses, statement of work, assumptions, dependencies, risks, customer presentations and proof-of-concept approach.
  • Lead technical workstreams for complex bids and architecture reviews, coordinating specialists, product teams, delivery, operations and technology partners to ensure the solution is complete, deliverable and aligned with customer outcomes.
  • Provide technical input to pricing, licensing and total-cost-of-ownership considerations, and ensure alignment among the architecture, service model, implementation schedule, SLA and contractual commitments.
  • Lead the transition from presales to delivery and provide architecture assurance during implementation, reviewing major design changes and governing deviations from the approved solution.
  • Coach and mentor network presales consultants and engineers through discovery, design and proposal reviews, opportunity support and structured knowledge sharing.
  • Lead internal initiatives to develop reusable network offerings, reference architectures, design standards, playbooks and enablement materials, and monitor relevant market and technology developments. *

Qualifications

  • Degree in Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline, with at least 12 years of relevant ICT experience and substantial experience in network presales, solution architecture or technical consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience acting as the technical authority for complex, multi-site and multi-technology network solutions, including leadership of strategic bids and cross-functional solution teams.
  • Strong architectural knowledge of campus and data centre networking, wired and wireless networks, routing and switching, WAN/SD-WAN, application delivery, network automation, network observability and managed network services.
  • Have experience in telco connectivity design, including internet/DIA, MPLS/IP VPN, Ethernet, local and international connectivity, access selection, carrier diversity, bandwidth and QoS planning, latency, resilience and SLA considerations.
  • Strong understanding of network security architecture, including segmentation, NGFW, IPS/IDS, NAC, secure remote access, SASE/ZTNA, DDoS protection and secure network management.
  • Ability to define and evaluate non-functional requirements covering availability, resilience, scalability, performance, interoperability, operability, observability and supportability.
  • Sound solutioning knowledge of major networking platforms such as Cisco, Huawei, Aruba, Palo Alto Networks, Check Point, F5 and Arista, or equivalent technologies; depth in selected platforms and vendor-neutral judgement are expected.
  • Strong capability in high-level design, proposal development, bill-of-materials building and validation, statement-of-work definition, risk and dependency management, proof-of-concept planning and commercial solutioning.
  • Proven ability to coach and develop technical professionals, lead initiatives without relying solely on formal authority, and influence senior business and technical stakeholders.
  • Relevant professional certification such as CCIE, HCIE, Aruba ACE, PCNSE or equivalent is preferred.
  • Exposure to private 5G and 5G integration with enterprise networks is an added advantage.
  • Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple strategic pursuits in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.

job.title: Product Functional Test Technology Specialist 试验技术主管
job.description:
Job Summary

This laboratory test focused position designs or specifies test systems that allow operation of Cummins’ products in a laboratory environment for engineering evaluation to optimize our product designs. This position also involves the specification, design, implementation, validation and support of test systems including mechanical, electrical, plumbing, instrumentation, data acquisition and control systems.

Key Responsibilities

Obtains input and negotiates with product engineers, product validation engineers, and equipment manufacturers and delivers working test systems, processes and documentation to lab operations personnel and product engineers Makes decisions in the areas of appropriate technologies, equipment sourcing and quality processes that impact accuracy, reliability, operating cost, and compliance to standards and regulations. Applies and improves processes such as test equipment design, maintenance and calibration and tools such as measurement systems analysis, 7 step problem solving, fault tree analysis, and process hazard analysis required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Acts as a local subject matter expert on specific equipment of sub-systems, providing guidance to less experienced engineers and collaborating on with other sites to drive common processes and tools. Provides independent leadership of smaller business impact projects or ownership of complex components, products, systems or services with greater elements of ambiguity over the senior or lead engineer level and with full accountability to the project team. Delivers independent execution of established and emerging work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across a functional discipline area within a business unit site. Coordinates and directs work amongst technicians and temporary student employees, assists in the transfer of knowledge to lesser experienced engineers through either indirect (scope of influence) or direct management of a small, local group of engineers. Provides support and guidance to influence technical direction within a project team and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Operates as a recognized specialist in a discipline or product area within the immediate team.

Competencies:

Function Based Product Testing of "X" - Selects appropriate equipment and techniques to operate the product and record operational data in a hardware or software based testing environment most often required as part of a product verification or validation plan; evaluates quality and validity of measurement data; analyzes test results using accepted standards to characterize product capabilities in alignment with the requirements of the engineer responsible for making product decisions.

Laboratory Equipment Safety - Evaluates hazards specific to laboratory test equipment that may result from fuels, kinetic energy, toxins, electrical or other risks in the test environment; analyzes risk factors and potential impacts to personnel and property; applies appropriate techniques or safeguards to mitigate risks; collaborates with various laboratory areas to understand risks within a facility or site.

Product Function Test System Design - Interprets test equipment specifications from test standards or lab customer requirements; selects and integrates appropriate equipment, instrumentation and software to control boundary conditions and collect measurement data; assesses capability of the lab equipment against the requirements and support infrastructure.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Resourcefulness - Securing and deploying resources effectively and efficiently.

Data Quality - Identifies, understands and corrects flaws in data that supports effective information governance across operational business processes and decision making.

Measurement Science - Analyzes measurement processes throughout the relevant traceability chain to identify and quantify sources of measurement uncertainty relevant to the appropriate applied measurement science, “Metrology” e.g. Chemical, Dimensional, Electrical, Mechanical, Optical and Radiation and Physical.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

Demonstrated aptitude is required. College, university, or equivalent Associate's degree or certification in an appropriate STEM field is required.

Equivalent Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Senior or Lead Engineer equivalent work experience in a relevant discipline area is required with a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving and quality decision making. Knowledge of MS Office tools is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and planning of new testing capabilities and laboratory layouts.
  • Develop technical specifications and support equipment sourcing and procurement.
  • Oversee equipment installation and commissioning activities.
  • Create operating procedures and ensure effective equipment utilization.
  • Manage laboratory facilities and equipment to maintain operational readiness.
  • Develop new test systems and methodologies to support product development and validation.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering; Master's degree preferred.
  • Solid experience in laboratory setup, engine testing, equipment selection, installation and commissioning, and test fixture design.
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal.

工作职责

新试验能力设计和规划及试验室布置设计；

编制主要关键设备技术要求及并参与设备选型和采购；

跟踪新设备系统安装和调试，确保设备安装调试符合技术要求并按照既定计划实施安装调试；

新设备操作规程编制，确保操作人员正确操作试验中心设备；

试验中心设施设备管理，确保设备处于正常使用状态。

根据产品开发需求，设计新的试验系统和试验方法以达到新产品试验验证需求；

教育背景：工程本科学位，硕士优先

工作经验：试验室建设方面工作经验及发动机试验工作，包括试验室基础建设，设施设备选型，设备安装调试，试验工装设计及发动机试验相关工作经验

语言：英语听说读写能力

Brisbane, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Elanora team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.

job.title: ILHBS Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Lead - ILHBS/ Duty Manager - ILHBS/ Sr Screener

Terminal Operations

IT

HR Department

Compliance and Regulatory Teams

Other Airport Departments (e.g., Operations, Customer Service)

Key Stakeholders - External:

Transportation Security Administration (TSA)

Aircraft Operator

Airport Authorities

Passengers

ASG

BCAS

Local Police

Service Providers

Law Enforcement Agencies

Regulatory Bodies

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Factory Medical Officer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Oversee and manage the on-site medical center, ensuring it is equipped and staffed to handle emergencies and routine health issues effectively.
  • Develop and implement health and wellness programs aimed at improving employee well-being and reducing absenteeism.
  • Conduct regular health check-ups and maintain accurate medical records for all employees and contractors.
  • Provide immediate medical care and first aid in case of workplace injuries or emergencies, ensuring compliance with safety protocols.
  • Collaborate with the Site HR Head to design and execute health awareness campaigns, focusing on occupational health risks specific to thermal power plant operations.
  • Ensure the medical center complies with all internal standards and aligns with Adani Power’s focus on operational excellence and sustainability.
  • Train and guide first responders and safety teams on emergency medical procedures and protocols.
  • Monitor and manage health-related KPIs, such as incident response times and employee health indices, to support the site’s operational goals.
  • Liaise with external medical facilities and specialists to ensure advanced care when required.
  • Stay updated on the latest medical practices and technologies relevant to industrial health services

Qualifications

  • MBBS degree from a recognized medical institution.
  • AFIH - Associate Fellow of Industrial Health (Mandatory)
  • Additional certification in Occupational Health or Industrial Medicine is preferred.

job.title: Screener
job.description:
Baggage Screening and Threat Detection:

Attend all the regulatory trainings and clear trainings as per the regulatory attempts

Operate X-BIS equipment for image analysis to detect Dangerous Goods, Prohibited Articles, Weapons, or Ammunition in check-in baggage as per Avsec circulars/ orders /guidelines and SOPs.

Perform physical inspections and ETD tests for baggage flagged during X-ray screening.

Maintain a high standard of TIP (Threat Image Projection) scores to reflect strong image interpretation capabilities.

Compliance with Aviation Security Directives:

Follow BCAS and DGCA guidelines to ensure strict compliance during baggage handling and inspection tasks.

Record and document all findings and operations to meet audit and inspection requirements.

Equipment Maintenance and Pre-Operational Checks:

Conduct routine pre-operational checks of X-BIS, ETD, CT-EDS other security equipment to confirm their readiness and functionality.

Report equipment malfunctions or downtime and assist in maintaining operational registers.

Stakeholder Interaction and Coordination:

Work collaboratively with CISF and Airlines staff during physical baggage inspections or suspicious item resolutions.

Provide timely updates to supervisors about ongoing operations or issues that may require intervention.

Time Management and Efficiency:

Ensure baggage screening and inspection are completed within strict timelines to avoid operational delays.

Balance thoroughness and speed to maintain operational flow without compromising safety.

Workplace Conduct and Decorum:

Maintain professionalism and discipline at all times, contributing positively to the team environment.

Uphold organizational standards in workplace behavior, ensuring compliance with company policies.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

CSO

Lead Avsec Audit & Compliance

Pass Section

Passengers

BCAS

Industry Associations

Qualifications

Educational Qualifications:

High school diploma or equivalent.

Bachelor’s or equivalent degree

Certifications: TSA certification required; Desirable to have cleared AVSEC basic course by BCAS, standalone / Inline Screeners certification by BCAS, DGR CAT 12 certification by DGCA Approved training center

NCC – “C” or “B” Certificate Holder will be preferred

Work Experience:

Freshers or 1-2 years of experience in security screening or a related field, preferably within an airport setting.

Experience operating screening equipment and familiarity with security protocols.

Physical Qualification:

Visual accuracy - Eyesight shall be equal or better than 20/60 in both eyes without glasses /

lenses or equal or better that 20 / 20 in one eye and 20 / 30 in the other when using glasses

or contact lenses. Adequate color perception shall be required.

Hearing – Hearing loss in each ear should be less than 30 dB when tested by audio graph for

frequencies below 2000 Hz.

Speech – There shall be clear ability to communicate orally efficiently and effectively.

Movement-of-crisis communication necessitates that screening personnel be free from any

pronounced speed impediment.

Sense of smell – Security personnel shall have the ability to sense Oduor

Deportment & Appearance - Security personnel must demonstrate a high standard of civility,

deportment, appearance and sobriety as well as offer the public all appropriate courtesies.

job.title: Head - Training Delivery - Ports & Logistics (Other than Gujarat Cluster)
job.description:
Responsibilities

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

  • Own the training delivery strategy, annual training calendar, governance framework, and capability roadmap for ports and logistics operations across assigned regions.
  • Lead the delivery of technical, operational, safety, compliance, supervisory, and leadership training programs for frontline workforce, technicians, operators, supervisors, and management personnel.
  • Drive capability development across cargo handling, terminal operations, marine activities, warehousing, logistics, equipment operation, maintenance, and operational excellence domains.
  • Establish competency frameworks, certification pathways, training standards, assessment systems, and refresher training mechanisms for all critical roles.
  • Manage training centers, simulators, laboratories, practical learning infrastructure, and deployment resources across locations.
  • Build, mentor, and manage a cadre of internal trainers, SMEs, external faculty, and partner agencies to ensure training quality and scalability.
  • Partner closely with Business Heads, Operations Leaders, HR, Safety, Maintenance, and Functional Excellence teams to align capability-building initiatives with business priorities.
  • Ensure training effectiveness through assessments, workplace observations, operational KPIs, certification compliance, and post-training performance tracking.
  • Lead deployment planning, trainer allocation, budget utilization, training audits, governance reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
  • Drive standardization of content, delivery methodology, competency assessments, and reporting systems across all assigned locations.
  • Identify future capability requirements emerging from automation, digitalization, new equipment deployment, and business expansion projects.
  • Represent Adani Skills & Education in capability-building discussions with OEMs, industry bodies, technology partners, regulators, and external institutions.

Qualifications

a { text-decoration: none; color: #464feb; } tr th, tr td { border: 1px solid #e6e6e6; } tr th { background-color: #f5f5f5; }

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Marine Engineering, Logistics, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or related discipline.
  • MBA, PGDM, M.Tech., Maritime Management, Port Management, or related postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of relevant experience in Ports, Logistics, Maritime Operations, Terminal Operations, Heavy Equipment Operations, Industrial Operations, or Technical Capability Development.
  • Minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing large-scale workforce capability-building, technical training, competency development, or learning operations.
  • Strong exposure to cargo handling systems, port operations, terminal processes, safety management, workforce productivity, and operational excellence practices.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing multi-location training delivery, large trainer pools, certification systems, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Experience in competency mapping, capability frameworks, training governance, assessment architecture, and performance measurement.
  • Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, program management, communication, and execution capabilities.
  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned port locations outside Gujarat.

job.title: Data Loss Prevention Lead
job.description:
Strategic Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Manage a comprehensive DLP program, including data discovery, classification, and protection policies.
  • Conduct DLP and DSPM assessments to identify, mitigate, and report data protection risks.
  • Ensure compliance with data protection regulations across multiple geographies.
  • Collaborate with legal teams to review contracts and MSAs for DLP compliance.
  • Oversee deployment and tuning of disk encryption technologies (e.g., BitLocker).
  • Understanding of Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and evaluate vendor risks from a DLP perspective.
  • Participate in Architecture Review Board (ARB) reviews to ensure DLP/DAM/DSPM considerations are integrated.
  • Manage and respond to data breaches and DLP incidents.
  • Stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

People Management

  • Foster an environment of learning, excellence, and innovation within the team and across teams.
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members.
  • Conduct performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  • Ensure continuous professional development of team members.

Qualifications

Educational qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or related field.
  • 10–12 years of experience in data loss prevention, data discovery/classification, and database/data security.
  • Experience with DSPM tools and integration in hybrid environments.
  • Familiarity with security standards and frameworks such as GDPR, ISO 27001, and NIST.
  • Experience with DLP, DSPM, disk encryption tools and automation.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CEH, or OSCP are a plus.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to stay up to date with the latest DLP trends, threats, and technologies.

job.title: Wind BOP
job.description:
Operational Support and Performance Monitoring:

Monitor the performance of solar systems, ensuring that energy production targets are being met and all equipment is functioning efficiently. Assist in the analysis of operational metrics such as Performance Ratio (PR), Capacity Utilization Factor (CUF), Plant Availability (PA), and Grid Availability (GA). Collect performance data and identify potential areas for improvement, reporting findings to senior team members.

Safety and Compliance Support:

Adhere to safety protocols and ensure safe working conditions by following operational and safety guidelines. Participate in safety training sessions, toolbox talks, and safety audits to ensure compliance with safety regulations. Help maintain safety documentation and ensure timely submission of reports, including Joint Meter Readings (JMR) and other regulatory compliance reports.

Operational Procedure and Policy Support:

Follow established procedures and assist in recommending improvements for operational efficiency. Support the implementation of operational policies by providing feedback on procedures and identifying inefficiencies. Assist in collecting and analyzing feedback to suggest improvements in processes and procedures for better operational outcomes.

Team Collaboration:

Work closely with operations, maintenance, and engineering teams to ensure smooth and efficient operations. Assist in supporting cross-functional team efforts to improve system performance and resolve operational challenges. Provide support to senior team members in troubleshooting, data collection, and problem-solving.

Continuous Improvement and Innovation Support:

Participate in continuous improvement activities by suggesting minor process enhancements and providing input on operational best practices. Assist in the testing and adoption of new technologies or tools aimed at enhancing wind energy production or operational efficiency. Collect data and provide insights that contribute to optimizing solar operations and improving system reliability.

Documentation and Reporting:

Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of performance data, maintenance activities, and safety compliance. Prepare reports on system performance, operational issues, and maintenance logs as required by the operations team. Assist in compiling data for senior management presentations, providing feedback on system performance and areas for improvement.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Regional Head / Station Head

Central Cluster Head

Head - Operation

HO & Site O&M team

Supporting department - Project, Engineering, Safety, BD, Projects, MAAS, HSE, ESG, Techno-commerical, HR, Admin, Finance, BEx, Land, Legal, Insurance, etc.

Clients

Investors

Other IPP

Regulatory Agencies

Local Communities

Vendors/Suppliers/Contractors/OEMs

Grid Authoritirs-NRLDC/SLDC

Govt. officials

Local communities

B.E./B.Tech/Diploma - Electrical or Mechanical or relevant to Energy Sector

1-5 years of experience in Energy Sector is must.( If Diploma holder: additional 2-3 Y Exp. req.)

job.title: Lead- Transport Services
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Design and implement a Group-wide transportation strategy aligned with business goals.

job.title: Site Head
job.description:
Site Head Projects-Tx

Project Management:

Drive quality project execution by monitoring project progress against established benchmarks for cost, resources, and timelines, thereby achieving project milestones within approved budgets.

Ensure timely completion of specific projects by managing time, cost, resource allocation, and specifications.

Implement and standardize project management systems across locations by ensuring consistent execution and proper usage of these systems for all projects.

Ensure complete adherence to safety protocols by providing a safe work environment for all employees and workmen at the site.

Promote quality and safety compliance by guiding contractors on safety standards and enforcing departmental adherence to regulatory requirements.

Protect the company’s interests by effectively managing Right of Way (ROW) issues and securing necessary project clearances and approvals from relevant authorities.

Build and nurture relationships with authorities (ROW, state administration, police, district collector, forest departments) by ensuring timely communication and securing necessary project clearances.

Improve project execution efficiency by integrating advanced project management tools and systems, fostering seamless communication and collaboration among project teams.

Drive innovation in project delivery by encouraging the adoption of new technologies and best practices, resulting in optimized processes and enhanced project outcomes.

Drive continuous learning by facilitating training sessions, skill development programs, and coaching to strengthen team capabilities.

Resolve conflicts and promote teamwork by handling interpersonal issues effectively and fostering a respectful, cohesive team culture.

job.description:

  • Collaborates with executive leadership to define the organization's long-term mission and goals, identifying ways to support this mission through talent management.
  • Identifies and executes key performance indicators for the organization on commercial, operations, finance, human resource, etc. to ensure relevant KPIs are executed and reviewed on a quarterly basis.

  • Actively participates in addressing internal and external audit findings by working with relevant stakeholders and taking necessary corrective action promptly.
  • Lead the Executive Committee [ExCom] and hold meetings at least once a month by focusing on the company’s overall priorities and goals from a City and Country level.
  • ExCom must define specific strategic plans and actions that will be undertaken to drive and increase revenue, profit, productivity, market share, staff development, technology and attach them to measurable KPIs. The minutes of ExCom meetings will be shared between the leadership Steering Committee members.

Revenue, Growth and Profit Maximization

  • Sets comprehensive goals for department performance and growth
  • Liaises with Commercial Leadership to develop and execute commercial strategies in each location.
  • Directly accountable for driving the budget and forecast by implementing a commercial strategy and business plan through execution, utilizing all available business tools and intelligence.
  • Ensures the delivery of budgeted revenues across all revenue streams.
  • Utilizes Business Intelligence tools to analyze data and performance, providing actionable information for making informed business decisions.
  • Optimizes manpower costs by analyzing trends and costs, setting systemic standards for teams to follow, and tracking the results of planned efforts.
  • Prepares the annual business plan and budgets including but not limited to manpower, etc.
  • Works with the various airport General Managers, Assistant General Managers, Finance PIC, Human Resources PIC including Operations PIC to ensure profits are maximized in line with budgeted revenue and profit targets set.
  • Ensures regular business reviews are conducted with all relevant stakeholders, including pricing and rate strategies are in place to achieve positive business results.

Pre – Opening

  • Drives collaboration across all departments and stakeholders to ensure pre-opening, refurbishment, or delisting projects are opened or closed within the set time frame.
  • Communicate with the Project Team and Project Manager for the project completion timeline.
  • Review the Pre-Opening critical path to schedule key project milestones, work streams, and activities.
  • Manage and approve resources requirements for pre-opening as needed.
  • Communicate and liaise with leadership to define project priorities and implementation opportunities and challenges and keep them up to date with project risks and opportunities.
  • Ensure company standards are reflected in the projects in terms of Marketing, Branding, IT, F&B, HR requirements/standards.

Financial and Commercial Acumen

  • Supports the country finance teams with clear guidelines, responsibilities and ways of working that benefit the Corporate, Shared Services and Country-Level Finance team
  • Reviews, monitors and analyses financial performance in collaboration with the Country Finance against established goals and benchmarks by managing relevant revenue workstreams including driving cost efficiency and savings without impacting customer or brand experience.
  • Supports the collection of accounts receivable by collaborating with respective Country Finance and Commercial teams, including HQ and other stakeholders.
  • Conducts necessary monthly meetings covering commercial and revenue management strategies, credit collection, operational, strategic planning and execution, etc.
  • Manages underperforming or loss-making outlets, developing short-to-long action plans for each business unit to restore profitability.

Business Development

  • Represents the business units in presentations to the Investment Committee, Steering Committee, and other relevant entities as necessary.
  • Forges strategic partnerships and relationships with clients, vendors, agencies, venue partners, and all other professional business relationships.
  • Be a key stakeholder collaborating with the legal team on contract management, including but not limited to contributing to the development of effective and efficient contract terms and conditions.
  • Growth Management aggressively promotes the business unit maximizing its utilization and negotiating lease agreements as determined necessary and in the best interest of the company.
  • Conducts frequent sales and calls with clients to stay updated on the business status and trends.
  • Develops and maintains strong relationships with all internal and external stakeholders including but not limited to airport authorities, owners, business units, etc.
  • Develops and aligns with Country and HQ business development teams on strategic plans for expansion and growth of the country’s business
  • Works with business development and finance stakeholders to analyze ROI for capital projects before committing funds and assesses if anticipated results were achieved upon completion.
  • Works with various stakeholders to provide efficient and accurate assessments on project leads and opportunities including inherent risk in the event of underperformance or early termination.
  • Proposes relevant new concepts and designs to various stakeholders for review and consideration with the objective to expand and grow the business through quality product differentiation.

Qualifications

  • Degree or relevant qualification in a relevant field to the role.
  • 15–20 years of progressive industry experience across business development, revenue generation, P&L management, and operations, with a proven track record of driving business growth and operational excellence.
  • Minimum 15+ years in a senior management role within the Travel, Airline or Hospitality Industry.
  • A mix of experience from management to operations of Airports, Hotels, F&B and/or Travel industry.
  • Proven prior experience in a leadership role with analytical, strategic and tactical decisions making including evaluating and identifying business opportunities.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience presenting financial, commercial and operational plans.
  • Working experience in various countries and regions would be an advantage.
  • Strong and proven leadership skills with an emphasis on leading, engaging, recognizing, developing and mentoring employees.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, handle pressure, and establish clear expectations.
  • Experience working in a collaborative and hierarchal environment.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English as well as other key languages.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Morayfield
job.description:
Morayfield, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital experiences that help people feel more connected.

We’re searching for positive, customer focused Retail Service Consultant to join our Morayfield team in a Part-Time capacity. If you love helping people, thrive in a supportive team environment, and bring energy to every conversation, we’d love to have you on board.

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships, with our customers and with each other.

Your day to day:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Build strong product knowledge and become an expert across the full range of tech solutions, explaining everything in a friendly, simple and accessible way.
  • Use your personality, listening skills and service centric approach to understand customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Support customers through all enquiries, anything from general questions to complex issues, using empathy, clear communication and calm de‑escalation.
  • Contribute to a welcoming, customer first environment by working closely with your team and helping create memorable moments for every visitor.
  • Stay adaptable and proactive, stepping up in periods of high activity and jumping in where needed to keep the store running smoothly.

It starts with you!

  • Service Superpower: You naturally focus on customer needs, offer genuine support, and let great service lead to phenomenal outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers understand technology, breaking it down simply and guiding them to the right solution.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with genuine curiosity and integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You stay steady during tricky situations, easing tension with care and working toward the best result for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support and educate one another, stay accountable and create a space where everyone succeeds together.

What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and access to exclusive discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Embrace what matters most with a paid Connected Day each year to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • Build meaningful connections through people-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • We support growing families, with inclusive paid parental leave (up to 14 weeks for primary caregiver).

We encourage you to apply, even if this is something new to you! None of us fits every requirement, and we all learn, grow and develop together. This could be the excellent next step in your retail or customer service journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

Job Summary

The User Experience (UX) Designer champions the user perspective across all stages of the digital product lifecycle. This role leads and supports user research, facilitates design thinking activities, and creates intuitive, user‑centered digital experiences. Working in an agile environment, the UX Designer translates business objectives, user needs, and technical requirements into high‑quality designs that elevate customer and partner experiences and drive consistency across the organization.

Responsibilities

  • Design user experiences for new and existing digital applications.
  • Collaborate with product owners, developers, testers, stakeholders, and other UX team members in an agile environment.
  • Communicate design decisions, rationale, and best practices to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Contribute to design principles, guidelines, and pattern libraries.
  • Support and help govern a unified enterprise design system.
  • Stay informed on UX trends, research methods, and user preferences.
  • Partner with the UX Research team to interpret analytics, conduct usability testing, and support user research.
  • Work independently with strong ownership, initiative, and accountability.
  • Advocate for design thinking, user‑centered design, and user research within the organization.
  • Produce UX deliverables including personas, journey maps, sitemaps, flows, wireframes, prototypes, and style guides.

Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of experience in user experience or interactive design for web and mobile applications within an agile environment.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human‑Computer Interaction, or related field.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Figma, Axure, Sketch, Adobe XD, or similar platforms.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating user experience design expertise.
  • Ability to work effectively with research partners, design agencies, and implementation vendors.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality work.

Key Competencies:

  • Strong user‑centered design and design thinking capabilities.
  • Ability to facilitate design studios, workshops, and research activities.
  • Ability to balance business needs, user goals, and technical constraints.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and collaboration skills.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to produce clear, actionable design artifacts.
  • Adaptability, initiative, and ability to work independently.
  • (Preferred) Experience in HVAC or manufacturing, responsive mobile design, Salesforce or Adobe Experience Manager, B2B and B2C experience design, visual design, industrial design, or content writing.

  • Define the architectural direction for machine learning platforms, ensuring scalability, security, performance, and alignment with organizational standards.

  • 9–12 years of experience in AI/ML development, advanced analytics, or data‑driven software engineering.

job.title: Customer Service Consultant - EBI
job.description:
Job Summary

Customer Consultants are dedicated to serve customers and act as their representative to check on our work to ensure they are completed in good quality and on time. They must understand our internal escalation process to ensure customers’ issues are being escalated and handled promptly by respective stakeholders to quickly resolve issues, especially Hot Jobs. They act as customers’ consultant by understanding their needs and working out various options of solutions to meet those needs.

Customer Consultants act as a Customer Advocate who relentlessly drive resolution which may require resources and/or agreement across several departments. They have the customer's best interest in mind, and their goal is to address the immediate customer issue in a highly responsive manner, proactively identify the root-cause and provide recommendations for resolution.

Consistently delivering good service and care that keeps customers coming back and results in a competitive edge for our organization.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Act as customers’ representative. Operate as the lead point of contact for all matters specific to the customers.
  • Managing a portfolio of accounts and utilizes account management process to identify key customers and to develop specific action plans to grow identified accounts.
  • Identifies potential options that would be required to meet customer needs and work closely with Technical Support Team to make those options available to customers.
  • Identifies potential opportunities with existing and new customers and update customers on Service Agreement Contract and Valued Added Service Options like Trance Care Service, Chiller Renewal etc.
  • Identify sales opportunities, elaborate proposals, and coordinate other processes to ensure high level of customer satisfaction to build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships.
  • Encourage customer growth and loyalty to the company through continuous support and customer assistance.

job.title: Asst Project Manager_DC
job.description:
What will you do:

As a Senior Service Engineer, you will deliver advanced service, commissioning, and troubleshooting expertise for chiller systems in mission-critical data center environments. You will:

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective repairs on Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.

  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.

  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific operational protocols.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies)

  • Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
  • Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
  • Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
  • Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P&IDs, and OEM manuals.
  • Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
  • Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.

job.description:

job.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including [Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and [Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. We boldly go.

Where is the work:

Monday to Thursday, work onsite with your colleagues. Fridays, choose your work location, balancing what your work requires.

Essential skills:

New Technology Projects (NTP), New Product Development, Productivity (VAVE), Q&R

  • Develop products by studying customer requirements and criteria
  • Proficient in Electrical Component Specifications, Selection, Analysis, Testing (Functional & Reliability) of followings:
  • Electrical Components: Contactor, Relay, Primary and Secondary Protection devices, Transformer
  • LV Motors (AC Induction, Brush DC, BLDC, Stepper, Servo, Permanent Magnet)
  • LV Motor Controllers (Drives, VFD, Inverter)
  • Design and development of control panels
  • Hands-on experience on UL and IEC STDs for Electrical system development & qualification
  • Responsible for developing Product Level Electrical design, Wiring & Harness Design
  • Work along with Multi-Disciplinary (Structural, Electronics, Software and Reliability) Team to develop System or Component Level Functional, Reliability & Qualification Requirements and Design
  • To Foster an Environment conducive for Innovation & Change with good Analytical Thinking and must make design trade-offs to ensure high reliability and best performance & low cost
  • Work closely with Supply Management to Source and Evaluate / Qualify the purchased Components and Assemblies
  • Make Tradeoff analysis of circuits and components with respect to performance, cost, quality and design flexibility
  • Manage multiple technical requirements in parallel as lead of the Electrical team
  • Mentor & Guide team members on technical areas
  • Good understanding of safety and protection standards and their implementation
  • Thorough understanding of various electrical codes and country standards
  • Knowledge in PLM and system level activities
  • Good Communication Skills – Ability to work with onsite Teams and engineers
  • Experience in hiring and leading contract resources & interns
  • Strong problem solving and analysis skills
  • Vendor identification, co-ordination and follow up
  • Knowledge in Electrical design tool – preferred
  • Developing strategic projects, and proof of concepts on futuristic cutting-edge technologies, towards future readiness
  • Diagnose electrical faults and identify root causes
  • Troubleshoot low‑voltage and line‑voltage electrical systems. Understand and interpret electrical schematics, diagrams, and blueprints
  • Assess system performance and detect issues. Test systems thoroughly and document results.
  • Perform testing and diagnostics using multimeters, megohmmeters, and other instruments
  • Strong understanding of electrical circuits, power electronics, and control systems
  • Familiarity with electrical failure modes (shorts, opens, drift, thermal stress, EMI/ESD issues)
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) using tools such as 5 Whys, Fishbone diagrams, Fault tree analysis, Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)

Experience/Skills and Education:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, Power Electronics or related fields
  • Work experience: 11+ years in the relevant field of Electrical system development for HVAC and other Industrial products development for Global market
  • Experience in HVAC Electrical Systems, HVAC equipment and controls is desirable
  • Must be an innovative self-starter capable of setting and meeting goals and deadlines, and of making critical business decisions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are necessary
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and industrial awareness, capable of applying advanced approaches, technologies, and innovations in Electrical system development, and Decarbonization for organizational advancement
  • Experience in coaching & mentoring technical know-how to others is preferred.

  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy-efficiency improvements in existing cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and equipment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer-specific operational protocols.
  • Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface regularly with customers to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure timely project and service completion.
  • Conduct root-cause analysis and implement corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with internal teams including sales, engineering, and project management to ensure seamless service delivery.
  • Submit RCA and 8D reports in a timely manner.
  • Attend Monthly MOR and Quarterly QBR meetings with data center clients.

What you will bring: (Skills & Competencies)

  • Strong expertise in Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, ideally in data center environments.
  • Deep understanding of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and redundancy concepts.
  • Proficiency in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and controls issues using diagnostic tools and software.
  • Ability to interpret wiring diagrams, technical drawings, P&IDs, and OEM manuals.
  • Strong communication skills to operate effectively in mission‑critical customer environments.
  • Sound knowledge of safety standards and best practices.
  • Strong problem-solving capability and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical data centers or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific training or certifications (Trane, Carrier, Daikin) preferred.
  • Knowledge of energy-efficiency programs, retrofits, and performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

job.title: Associate Tech Lead-Controls Modelling & MBD
job.description:
What you will do

In this role you will:

  • Develop and implement complex control algorithm models to perform transient analysis, supporting key strategic areas like advanced control optimization, electrification and decarbonization, power electronics, HVAC units, building management and data centers.
  • Demonstrate good understanding of software engineering concepts, Model based development for controls, auto code generation, etc. Apply this expertise to develop and analyze control system models for HVAC equipments.
  • Participate in long term technology roadmap development discussions and help build new external partnerships for Trane Technologies.
  • Work with internal and external partners in technical execution of short & long term externally funded new technology, & new product development projects.
  • Work closely with global team members, cross-functional associates and internal customers in dynamic environment, to understand the implications of modeling results and drive system level optimization and answer critical design questions through modeling results.
  • Lead the evaluation of new and innovative technologies as they appear for potential commercial value, either as disruptive competition or prospective new products or services for the company.
  • Develop and communicate clear understanding of customer requirements and meet or exceed those expectations.
  • Conceptualize & develop project ideas leading to new advanced capability development in related domain areas to keep Trane Technologies to the leading edge of technology.
  • Network across the organization and externally to identify and communicate opportunities to apply controls modelling, system modeling and simulation to product design, applications & processes.
  • Develop team, competencies and skillset in Controls modelling, algorithms development for HVAC and transport refrigeration systems.
  • Developing strategic projects, and proof of concepts on futuristic cutting-edge technologies, towards future readiness.

What you will bring:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Work experience: 8+ years in the relevant field of Matlab/Simulink for Model Based Development.
  • Experience with Auto Code Generation.
  • Experience in software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), and agile methodologies.
  • Good knowledge of control systems with practical experience in closed-loop control.
  • Experience with Model In-Loop (MIL) and Hardware In-Loop (HIL) simulation.
  • Emphasis on computer programming or related experience is beneficial, particularly in C, C++ and Python.
  • Experience and knowledge in advanced nonlinear control disciplines such as adaptive or variable structure/sliding mode control, intelligent control schemes such as neural networks or fuzzy logic control.
  • Understanding reinforcement learning, machine learning, and predictive maintenance is desirable.
  • Experience in HVAC systems modeling, building energy management systems, or HVAC equipment and controls is desirable
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.
  • Experience with CUDA and GPU Computing is a plus.
  • Understanding of Containers, HPC and Cloud technologies is a plus.
  • Expertise in communication protocols such as CAN, MODBUS, and EtherCAT is preferred.
  • Must be an innovative self-starter capable of setting and meeting goals and deadlines, and of making critical business decisions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are necessary.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and industrial awareness, capable of applying advanced approaches, technologies, and innovations in modeling and simulation for organizational advancement.
  • Knowledge in Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) on controls development is plus.
  • Experience in coaching & mentoring technical know-how to others is preferred

Career Break:

  • We have a Relaunch Program for professionals looking to restart their careers after a break. If you come with a career break of at least 12 months and match the work experience requirements mentioned, you are welcome to apply.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. Job Summary

The Senior Accountant is a vital role in the financial reporting function within the organization. The role drives financial reliability in all reporting aspects of general accounting and financial analysis. The role also requires analytical and critical thinking, a sense of urgency in completing deliverables, and an ability to work at a fast pace. job.title: Salesforce Delivery Leader
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Salesforce Delivery Strategy & POD Oversight

  • Provide governance and direction to multiple Salesforce PODs within the Bangalore Global Practice.
  • Ensure each POD delivers against milestones, velocity expectations, and quality KPIs.
  • Define and enforce global delivery and architectural standards aligned with Trane Technologies’ Salesforce guidelines, including Apex, LWC, Flows, integrations, and platform security.
  • Own sandbox strategy and release governance, ensuring stable and repeatable deployments through CI/CD pipelines such as Copado, Gearset, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
  • Act as the top-level escalation point for delivery risks, technical bottlenecks, integration issues, and architectural challenges.

##

2. Operational Excellence & P&L Accountability

  • Manage the financial performance of Salesforce delivery in Bangalore, ensuring productivity, budget adherence, and predictable margins.
  • Establish robust reporting mechanisms (weekly and monthly) providing insight on sprint performance, velocity, technical debt, and resource utilization.
  • Support Trane Technologies’ innovation roadmap by driving adoption of Salesforce advancements such as Salesforce AI/Einstein, Data Cloud, DevOps Center, and automation tools.

##

3. Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Serve as a senior delivery leader representing the Bangalore practice for global stakeholders.
  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with cross-functional business partners, product owners, and global delivery teams.
  • Partner with Sales and Solution Architects to assess feasibility, estimate complex Salesforce work, and support global pre‑sales initiatives.

##

4. People Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, coach, and develop POD Leads, Technical Architects, Senior Developers, and Analysts.
  • Drive career development, technical upskilling, and continuous learning within the Bangalore Salesforce talent community.
  • Facilitate knowledge-sharing and promote engineering excellence, focusing on areas like Apex best practices, LWC, Integration Patterns, Flow Orchestration, and platform governance.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 17+ years of total IT experience, with 10+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience in development, analysis, architecture, and delivery leadership.
  • Proven expertise in Apex, LWC, Aura Components, Integration Patterns, and platform security.
  • Strong background in translating complex business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
  • Minimum of 5 years leading multi-disciplinary delivery teams or PODs in a global delivery model.
  • Deep experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies tailored to Salesforce delivery.
  • Strong financial acumen with experience handling P&L, forecasting, and resource planning.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across geographies.

Desired Skills

  • Ability to align Bangalore Salesforce delivery operations with Trane Technologies’ global roadmap and strategic priorities.
  • Experience driving organizational change and adoption of new Salesforce tools and delivery frameworks.
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving skills, particularly in high-stakes or time-sensitive environments.
  • A passion for emerging Salesforce technologies and continuous improvement.
