job.title: Associate Tech Lead - Controls Modelling and MBD
job.description:
What you will do

In this role you will:

  • Develop and implement complex control algorithm models to perform transient analysis, supporting key strategic areas like advanced control optimization, electrification and decarbonization, power electronics, HVAC units, building management and data centers.
  • Demonstrate good understanding of software engineering concepts, Model based development for controls, auto code generation, etc. Apply this expertise to develop and analyze control system models for HVAC equipments.
  • Participate in long term technology roadmap development discussions and help build new external partnerships for Trane Technologies.
  • Work with internal and external partners in technical execution of short & long term externally funded new technology, & new product development projects.
  • Work closely with global team members, cross-functional associates and internal customers in dynamic environment, to understand the implications of modeling results and drive system level optimization and answer critical design questions through modeling results.
  • Lead the evaluation of new and innovative technologies as they appear for potential commercial value, either as disruptive competition or prospective new products or services for the company.
  • Develop and communicate clear understanding of customer requirements and meet or exceed those expectations.
  • Conceptualize & develop project ideas leading to new advanced capability development in related domain areas to keep Trane Technologies to the leading edge of technology.
  • Network across the organization and externally to identify and communicate opportunities to apply controls modelling, system modeling and simulation to product design, applications & processes.
  • Develop team, competencies and skillset in Controls modelling, algorithms development for HVAC and transport refrigeration systems.
  • Developing strategic projects, and proof of concepts on futuristic cutting-edge technologies, towards future readiness.

What you will bring:

  • Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical, Electronics, Computer Science, or related fields.
  • Work experience: 8+ years in the relevant field of Matlab/Simulink for Model Based Development.
  • Experience with Auto Code Generation.
  • Experience in software development best practices, including version control (e.g., Git), and agile methodologies.
  • Good knowledge of control systems with practical experience in closed-loop control.
  • Experience with Model In-Loop (MIL) and Hardware In-Loop (HIL) simulation.
  • Emphasis on computer programming or related experience is beneficial, particularly in C, C++ and Python.
  • Experience and knowledge in advanced nonlinear control disciplines such as adaptive or variable structure/sliding mode control, intelligent control schemes such as neural networks or fuzzy logic control.
  • Understanding reinforcement learning, machine learning, and predictive maintenance is desirable.
  • Experience in HVAC systems modeling, building energy management systems, or HVAC equipment and controls is desirable
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to think critically and creatively.
  • Experience with CUDA and GPU Computing is a plus.
  • Understanding of Containers, HPC and Cloud technologies is a plus.
  • Expertise in communication protocols such as CAN, MODBUS, and EtherCAT is preferred.
  • Must be an innovative self-starter capable of setting and meeting goals and deadlines, and of making critical business decisions. Excellent communication and teamwork skills are necessary.
  • Demonstrate intellectual curiosity and industrial awareness, capable of applying advanced approaches, technologies, and innovations in modeling and simulation for organizational advancement.
  • Knowledge in Model Based System Engineering (MBSE) on controls development is plus.
  • Experience in coaching & mentoring technical know-how to others is preferred

job.title: Technical Lead – Applied Mechanics
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute structural and FEA simulations for Thermo King components and systems across truck, trailer, bus, rail, and marine applications.
  • Analyze static, dynamic, fatigue, and vibrational loads that reflect real-world harsh transport conditions, including road-induced vibration, shock, mounting stresses, and thermal structural interactions.
  • Build high-fidelity finite element models for complex assemblies such as compressors, frames, mounts, enclosures, brackets, refrigerant line supports, and other mechanical subsystems within Thermo King units.
  • Provide clear, actionable design recommendations to global engineering teams to improve durability, manufacturability, reliability, and weight efficiency.
  • Partner with Reliability Engineering, Product Engineering, and Test Labs to align analysis assumptions with actual duty cycles, test profiles, and validation plans specific to transport refrigeration.
  • Develop and maintain simulation methods tailored for Thermo King’s dynamic, vibration, and shock‑load environments , including vibration durability, road load simulation, fatigue estimation, and structural integrity assessments.
  • Support new product development (NPD) programs with early-stage design evaluations and simulation-driven insights to accelerate development and reduce physical test iterations.
  • Prepare high-quality technical documentation summarizing analysis approach, boundary conditions, correlations, and engineering recommendations.
  • Contribute to capability growth within the Modeling & Simulation team through method development, knowledge-sharing, and informal mentoring of early career analysts.
  • Collaborate with global Thermo King stakeholders to understand program priorities, feasibility risks, and analysis needs.
  • Leverage experience with physical test techniques—such as single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related methods—to improve model correlation and enhance simulation accuracy.
  • Provide technical leadership within projects, influencing decisions, guiding analysis strategies, and coordinating simulation activities across cross-functional teams (without formal people management).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 8–12+ years of hands-on experience in structural/FEA analysis, ideally in automotive, off-highway, refrigeration, or transport-related industries.
  • Strong proficiency in FEA tools such as ANSYS, Abaqus, or similar platforms.
  • Solid grounding in mechanical behavior under vibration, impact/shock, fatigue, and nonlinear material/structural response.
  • Proven expertise building and validating complex models that correlate well with physical testing.
  • Ability to convert simulation results into clear engineering guidance for multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

Preferred Technical Background

  • Experience with mobile equipment or transport-related engineering (automotive, rail, off-road equipment, refrigeration units, etc.).
  • Familiarity with Thermo King product categories or similar ruggedized HVAC/transport cooling systems.
  • Exposure to vibration spectrum analysis, random vibration, harmonic response, and durability methodologies aligned with transport environments.
  • Experience with scripting (Python, APDL, etc.) to automate workflows or develop reusable modeling templates.
  • Understanding of thermal-structural coupled simulations or refrigerant system component behavior is a plus.
  • Experience with single and multi-axes shaker table testing, accelerated life testing, strain measurement/strain gauging, and related structural validation techniques.
  • Technical project leadership, task leadership, or cross-functional technical coordination experience.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:

  • Design, develop, and deploy AI and GenAI applications that address business needs using machine learning, large language models, and intelligent workflow orchestration.
  • Build and optimize predictive, statistical, and time series models for business and operational use cases.
  • Develop robust data pipelines, ETL workflows, and feature engineering processes using SQL and Python to support AI/ML applications.
  • Lead Python-based application development for automation, data transformation, model integration, API development, and AI-powered workflows.
  • Develop LLM-powered solutions such as copilots, knowledge assistants, summarization tools, search-and-retrieval solutions, and domain-specific recommendation systems.
  • Apply Generative AI techniques including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), orchestration frameworks, grounding strategies, response evaluation, and workflow integration.
  • Prototype and productionize AI application architectures, including integrations with vector databases, model APIs, cloud services, and enterprise systems.
  • Contribute to the evaluation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of AI systems, including model quality, hallucination reduction, latency, cost, and user experience.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, analysts, domain experts, and business stakeholders to define, prioritize, and deliver AI-driven solutions.
  • Translate business problems into scalable AI/ML and GenAI use cases, technical designs, and implementation roadmaps.
  • Develop and enhance dashboards, reports, and BI solutions using Tableau where needed to support model insights and business decisions.
  • Ensure strong data quality, governance, security, compliance, and responsible AI practices across solution development and deployment.

Technical Skills/ Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, AI, or a related field; master’s degree or advanced certification preferred.
  • 5–7 years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, AI engineering, or related roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Python for data science, API integration, automation, and AI application development.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex querying, performance tuning, data transformation, and data modeling.
  • Strong knowledge of statistics, machine learning algorithms, applied mathematics, and time series analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with Generative AI and large language model applications, including prompt engineering, RAG patterns, model evaluation, and practical enterprise use case implementation.
  • Experience building AI applications using frameworks and libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, and exposure to modern GenAI frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating with foundation model APIs and deploying AI solutions in production environments.
  • Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, document retrieval, and knowledge-grounded AI applications.
  • Understanding of MLOps / LLMOps, CI/CD pipelines, model versioning, testing, and release management.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, including AI/ML services and scalable deployment patterns.
  • Experience with Git and version control best practices.
  • Experience with Dataiku is an advantage.
  • Expertise in Tableau or similar BI tools for reporting and stakeholder communication is desirable.
  • Desirable domain awareness of industrial systems such as compressors, motors, power systems, refrigeration systems, and IC engines.
  • Strong understanding of responsible AI, data governance, security, and compliance considerations in AI solution development.

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a structured, methodical approach.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to explain complex topics clearly.

  • Strong collaborative and team-oriented mindset with a proactive, customer-focused, and results-driven approach.

job.title: Salesforce - Technical Manager
job.description:
Salesforce Technical Manager

Global Salesforce Practice

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Technical Manager to lead technical delivery, grow team capability, and support the continued expansion of the CX Salesforce Practice at ITC, Trane Technologies. This role combines people leadership, solution development, and hands-on technical oversight across Salesforce core platform capabilities.

The ideal candidate brings 12+ years of overall experience with strong expertise in Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Apex, LWC, integrations, and Salesforce B2B Commerce. This Tech Manager will help scale the practice, ensure delivery excellence, competency management and drive secure, high-quality, enterprise solutions aligned with business goals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and develop Salesforce developers, QAs, administrators, and analysts.
  • Support onboarding, coaching, performance management, and team capability growth.
  • Provide technical leadership for the design and delivery of scalable Salesforce solutions across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, and B2B Commerce.
  • Design and oversee solutions supporting lead-to-opportunity, quoting, order management, and case management processes.
  • Guide development of reusable components using Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Review and optimize Apex development including triggers, batch, queueable, and integration logic.
  • Oversee integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs, Named Credentials, and event-driven patterns.
  • Support and enhance Salesforce Order Management (OMS) and its integration with core applications.
  • Ensure high standards for code quality, security, performance, governance, and Salesforce best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews and establish standards for development, testing, and deployment.
  • Partner with project managers, architects, DevOps managers, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver projects on time and with quality.
  • Serve as a bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders to align requirements, priorities, and expectations.
  • Help define the technical vision, identify improvement opportunities, and support long-term Salesforce practice growth.
  • Stay current on Salesforce trends, releases, and innovations to drive continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience
  • Strong expertise in:Salesforce Platform: Apex, LWC, SOQL, FlowsSales CloudService CloudSalesforce B2B Commerce
  • Proven experience delivering enterprise Salesforce solutions in production environments
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce security model, data architecture, integrations, and governor limits
  • Experience leading technical teams, code reviews, and solution delivery
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering and technology steams
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Agile, DevOps practices, and version control
  • Exposure to React, Vue, or headless commerce architectures
  • Experience in large-scale Salesforce environments

Leadership Profile

  • Strong technical leadership with a collaborative mindset
  • Ability to balance strategic planning and hands-on execution
  • Skilled in mentoring teams and driving high performance
  • Patient, adaptable, and effective in a growing, fast-paced environment

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

  • 与其他团队协调解决质量问题，确保客户满意度。

job.description:

job.title: Lead Engineer, Modeling & Simulation
job.description:
Job Description

At [Trane TechnologiesTM](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/) and through our businesses including [Trane®](https://www.trane.com/) and [Thermo King®](https://www.thermoking.com/), we create innovative climate solutions for buildings, homes, and transportation that challenge what’s possible for a sustainable world. We're a team that dares to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities. We believe in a better future when we uplift others and enable our people to thrive at work and at home. We boldly go.

Job Overview

In this Lead Engineer, Modeling & Simulation role, you will work closely with the project team to boldly tackle the industry's cutting-edge challenges. You will utilize advanced simulation software and state-of-the-art testing equipment to design and validate refrigeration systems, while keeping a close eye on competitors and technological trends to continuously enhance customer value. We are looking for candidates with relevant HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) theory and experience, as well as knowledge of simulation and software development, to efficiently advance technical work. If you are passionate about innovation in air conditioning technology and can work effectively in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this position.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Lead modeling and simulation activities in alignment with the company’s product development process, ensuring high-quality system analysis, risk identification, and actionable design recommendations.
  • Define and drive the technical roadmap for 1D system simulation applications, improving simulation capability through new technologies, enhanced methodologies, and practical engineering needs.
  • Develop, review, and refine component mathematical models, system-level architectures, and unit control logic characteristics, ensuring accurate functional implementation and strong correlation with physical behavior.
  • Lead the integration of simulation with experimental validation, using test data to calibrate models, improve prediction accuracy, and support design decisions.
  • Drive standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of refrigeration system design and simulation workflows to increase development efficiency and technical consistency.
  • Provide technical leadership across cross-functional teams, influencing product architecture, simulation strategy, and system optimization decisions.
  • Monitor competitive technologies, industry trends, and emerging modeling approaches to identify innovation opportunities and strengthen customer value propositions.
  • Mentor and guide engineers in modeling and simulation best practices, helping to build team capability and technical depth.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or above
  • Educational background or work experience in Thermal Energy and Power Engineering, Refrigeration and Air Conditioning, or related fields.
  • Over 5 years of experience in model development and applications
  • Proficient in Python/C++/C#/Modelica/Matlab.
  • Good communication skills in both Chinese and English (written and spoken).
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Passion for innovation, continuous improvement, and delivering customer-focused engineering solutions.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

**

Description

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.

We are looking for an experienced ICM Rule and Advanced Workflow Developer to support our SAP-based incentive compensation platform. This role plays a critical part in translating compensation plan design into system configuration, ensuring accurate payouts, strong governance, and efficient approval workflows. You will work closely with Sales Operations, HR, Finance, and IT teams to configure calculation rules, build scalable workflows, and support ongoing compensation processing.

  • Troubleshoot calculation discrepancies and perform root cause analysis
  • Validate inbound data from HR, Finance, and operational systems
  • Design and configure multi-step approval workflows for plan assignments, exceptions, and manual adjustments
  • Implement conditional routing based on business attributes and compensation structures
  • Configure automated notifications and escalation triggers
  • Ensure workflows align with internal control and compliance requirements
  • Improve process efficiency by reducing manual intervention

What We’re Looking For

  • 3 to 6 years of experience working with SAP-based incentive compensation systems

  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally with Sales, HR, Finance, and IT

job.title: Core Technician
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data centre environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data centre HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data centre cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

On-Site (5 days)

在特灵科技，我们凭借旗下两大战略品牌特灵（Trane® ）和冷王（Thermo King®）为楼宇建筑、民用住宅和交通运输领域提供可持续发展的创新温控系统解决方案，大胆挑战可持续发展世界的一切可能性。我们无惧挑战，勇于探索无限可能。我们也相信，通过彼此提升并让我们的员工在工作和生活中茁壮成长，能够共创一个更加美好的未来。为此，我们奋勇前行。

这对您来说意味着：

加入我们的行列！作为全球领先的创造舒适、可持续发展、高效环境的供应商，我们肩负地球未来发展的重任。在特灵科技，我们不仅将可持续发展理念融入了日常运营，更将其视为我们业务的核心。您是否敢于面对全球挑战，探索无限可能？您是否愿意为创造更美好的未来贡献力量？如果您的答案是肯定的，欢迎加入特灵科技，和我们一起大胆挑战可持续发展世界的一切可能性。

在特灵科技公司，销售工程师的主要目的是通过识别机会、直接与客户接触、提供节能解决方案以及达成销售交易来推动收入增长和盈利能力，以实现销售目标并以道德的方式进行。这一角色对于建立和维护牢固的客户关系、确保客户满意度以及为公司的整体成功做出贡献至关重要。

这是一个利用您的技术专长和商业能力创造客户价值并对可持续性产生影响的激动人心的机会。

您将会履行：

市场拓展与机会识别：

  • 通过市场情报和竞争对手分析了解市场
  • 了解公司的增长战略
  • 积极识别和追求与公司增长战略一致的商业机会，以扩大市场覆盖范围
  • 使用公司的销售管理系统建立项目管道。

客户参与、需求评估与解决方案开发：

  • 与物业所有者、总承包商和设计院接触，了解客户需求，并与技术支持团队合作开发定制的HVAC系统技术解决方案，包括成本估算和规格
  • 向客户展示提案，突出解决方案的优势和特点，并与技术支持团队合作创建具有竞争力的技术解决方案
  • 建立和维护牢固的客户关系，以确保项目机会。

协作与项目履行：

  • 与工程、制造和其他各部门合作，确保项目完成
  • 与其他团队协调解决质量问题，确保客户满意度。

合同执行与收款：

  • 监督合同条款的执行并确保收款。

遵守公司的销售流程、治理和合规标准：

  • 根据公司的要求完成日常销售活动
  • 报告和系统更新。

希望您具备：

  • 本科及以上学历，优先考虑暖通空调、建筑环境与设备工程、机电一体化或其他科学与工程学科。
  • 拥有3年以上工业产品和解决方案销售经验者优先。
  • 技术熟练度：对所销售产品或服务的技术方面有深刻理解。能够理解并解释复杂的技术概念和解决方案。
  • 销售敏锐度：理解直接销售流程，并能够将技术解决方案与业务需求对齐。能够影响和说服客户采用所提议的解决方案。
  • 以客户为中心：具备强大的客户服务技能，专注于理解和满足客户需求；能够建立信任并作为客户可靠的技术顾问。
  • 协作与团队合作：能够与跨团队（包括产品开发、工程和客户支持）有效合作。
  • 沟通能力：优秀的口头和书面沟通能力，能够用简单的术语解释复杂的技术概念。能够与客户和内部团队建立牢固的关系。
  • 问题解决能力：强大的分析和问题解决能力，能够为客户设计有效的解决方案。能够创造性地思考并提出创新的解决方案。
  • 项目管理：强大的组织能力，能够同时管理多个项目和客户参与。能够在压力下工作并满足紧迫的截止日期。
  • 财务敏锐度：理解基本的会计原理和应收账款流程。能够有效管理发票、付款和信用评估。

担心自己并不完全符合职位描述中的每项要求？在特灵科技，我们对您的工作能力和过往工作经验同样感兴趣。因此，只要您对这个职位充满热情，即便过往工作经验与职位描述并不完全吻合，我们依然欢迎您提交职位申请。或许您正是我们一直寻找的最佳人选。

平等就业机会：

我们提供有竞争力的薪酬和全面的福利计划。作为一家倡议“机会均等”的全球雇主，我们欢迎所有符合条件的申请者，不因其种族、肤色、宗教、性别、性取向、性别认同、国籍、生育情况、年龄、婚姻状况、残疾状况，或是受保护的退伍军人，或其他任何受法律保护的身份而区别对待。

在工作和生活中不断进步:

  • 具有市场竞争性的薪资和奖金；
  • 帮助您和家人保持健康的相关福利计划，包括员工援助计划(EAP)和健康管理(Be Well)资源；

  • 寿险，意外伤害和医疗保险以及体检等保障计划；
  • 公司为退休金/储蓄账户提供的退休福利。

job.title: Controls & Contracting Fulfillment Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

Project Management leader is required to drive service excellence for high demand project management requirements of Data Center and other customers. The incumbent shall be required to understand Projects requirements of data center, large Semi-con customers and commercial customers, lead a team of project Engineers and work closely with country service operations leader and sales leaders to implement project delivery models to meet the high demand project management requirements. The people shall be single point of contact for these customers and shall also engage with regional teams to deliver the projects successfully. Incumbent shall be fully responsible to project-based P&L, Manage projects costs, ensure timely achievement of project milestones, Manage customer side processes and run a proper project management process for Trane DC and other customers

Principal Responsibilities:

  • To build and manage dedicated DC and other segments project management team.
  • Implement and standardize DC, KAM Specific processes which can help meet customer demands at field level.
  • Incumbent shall be leadership level SPOC for Data center customers to support DC sales growth and handle escalations
  • Work in close coordination with local entities to provideProject Management progress assessment (including controls). Dynamically deploy project engineers and other resources in case of deviation from scheduled timelines.
  • Manage full-project life cycle in close coordination with department leaders including all stages of testing and commission which require post sales engagement ( L3 to L5 levels of T&C).
  • Support parts management for Critical sites
  • Post commissioning support required to be provided to DC customers during warranty period.
  • Support in manpower planning based on projects workload
  • Optimize costs to ensure that service demands are met in the most cost effective manner w/o impacting profitability of projects business
  • Support service business growth by driving Linkage and Capture of customer contracts, repairs, upgrades working closely with service sales teams

Engage with TNSA, AP quality, Engineering and factory actively to solve project related issues.

Key Competencies:

  • Experience of managing projects organization
  • Strong customer communication skills
  • Ability to work with key stakeholders at country level and also interface with regional engineering and regional leaders
  • Knowledge of Airside and controls is an advantage
  • Knowledge of chillers servicing is an advantage

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Engineering

job.title: Cybersecurity Engineer - OT
job.description:
What you will do

  • Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality

What you will bring:

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in Cybersecurity Engineering and Operations

Job Summary

The Junior OT Security Engineer supports the Operational Technology (OT) Security program by assisting in the management, monitoring, and continuous improvement of security technologies that protect manufacturing and industrial environments.

This role is focused on foundational OT cybersecurity operations, execution of Run & Maintain (R&M) activities, and maintaining strong asset visibility across OT environments. The engineer will work under the guidance of senior OT engineers to execute operational tasks, improve data quality, and help sustain OT security controls at scale.

This position plays a critical role in maintaining the health, accuracy, and reliability of OT security platforms and metrics, ensuring the program continues to mature and operate effectively.

Responsibilities

  • Support daily operations of OT security technologies, with a primary focus on OT asset visibility and detection platform, maintenance, and data quality
  • Execute Run & Maintain (R&M) activities, including device classification, asset reconciliation, exception handling, and rule tuning
  • Assist with maintaining high-quality OT asset inventory
  • Perform basic troubleshooting for discovery configurations, integrations, and platform health issues, escalating as needed
  • Monitor OT security alerts, identify anomalies, and support investigation and escalation processes
  • Support ongoing improvement of OT metrics (e.g., asset designation, collector health, visibility gaps) through continuous data cleanup and validation
  • Assist with onboarding new sites, validating OT asset inventory, and supporting enforcement or audit readiness activities
  • Contribute to development and improvement of standard work procedures, documentation, and operational playbooks
  • Partner with OT Administrators, Network Engineering, and Security Engineering teams to support secure and stable OT environments
  • Participate in OT Office Hours and assist site teams with operational questions and issue resolution
  • Support improvements, changes, and configurations to our security suite.
  • Provide backup and support for other security capabilities managed by the Security Engineering Team.
  • Manage and track security metrics to be included in Monthly Operating Reviews (MORs), Project Status Reviews (PSRs), and workshops.
  • Up to 10% travel required based on business and project needs, including visits to manufacturing and distribution sites.

Required Qualifications and Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 1–3 years of experience in cybersecurity, IT operations, or a related technical discipline
  • Foundational understanding of networking concepts, including:IP addressing, subnets, routing, and switching fundamentals
  • VLANs and network segmentation concepts (especially IT vs OT separation)
  • Firewall rules and how traffic flows between systems

Preferred Qualifications and Competencies:

  • Basic troubleshooting skills for connectivity issues (e.g., device communication failures, segmentation impacts)
  • Understanding of how asset discovery tools use network traffic and integrations to identify devices
  • Exposure to OT/ICS environments or manufacturing systems
  • Familiarity with asset discovery, monitoring, or security tools (e.g Armis, Claroty, Dragos, and Nozomi)
  • Experience supporting operational platforms or infrastructure tools
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly with asset data, classification, and system accuracy
  • Ability to follow defined processes and execute repeatable operational tasks with consistency
  • Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills for troubleshooting and data validation
  • Effective communication and collaboration across IT, OT, and security teams
  • Willingness to learn OT-specific technologies, environments, and security practices

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Engineer
job.description:
Summary

The Modeling & Simulation team is seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Senior Engineer – Acoustics to lead advanced predictive modeling efforts. In this role, you will apply state-of-the-art numerical methodologies to solve complex noise and vibration challenges across our diverse product portfolios.

The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise spanning both vibro-acoustics and aero-acoustics. This role requires a unique balance of rigorous engineering execution alongside a global perspective—focusing on commonizing acoustic methodologies and simulation standards across different regional engineering teams to meet varying regional customer and regulatory requirements.

.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Modeling & Simulation: Develop, validate, and execute high-fidelity numerical models to predict and optimize the acoustic performance of HVAC systems, transport refrigeration units, and components (such as compressors, fans, structures, and air handlers).

ü Aero-Acoustics & Fluid-Structure Interaction: Conduct Computational Aero-Acoustics (CAA) simulations to predict flow-induced noise, fan noise, and turbulence-driven acoustic phenomena.

ü Vibro-Acoustics & Structural Dynamics: Analyze structural-acoustic coupling, structure-borne noise transmission, and vibration propagation using Finite Element Method (FEM) and Boundary Element Method (BEM) solvers.

ü Regional Commonization & Standards: Champion efforts to standardize and commonize acoustics simulation methodologies globally. Collaborate with international design centers to harmonize workflows while addressing varying regional regulations and market requirements.

ü Experimental Correlation: Collaborate closely with physical testing laboratories to design validation tests, analyze dynamic measurement data (sound power, vibration, modal testing), and correlate experimental results with simulation models.

ü Design Optimization: Partner with product development teams to provide actionable, physics-based design recommendations early in the development cycle to reduce noise and enhance sound quality.

ü Innovation: Keep abreast of emerging simulation technologies, and drive continuous improvement in simulation capability and speed.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree (M.S./M.Tech) in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Acoustics, or a highly related technical discipline.
  • PhD will be a plus.
  • 3–5+ years of hands-on industrial experience in acoustics modeling and simulation..
  • Knowledge in Acoustics and noise control (specific to HVAC products is desirable).
  • Should be able to perform Acoustics (Aero/Vibro) simulations, with emphasis on fan/blowers.
  • Good depth in CFD (or) FEA with experience in performing simulations is an added advantage
  • Hands-on experience on Acoustics/CFD/FEA tool preferably Actran, ANSYS Mechanical, Fluent, CFX, or Simcenter.
  • Theoretical knowledge of Acoustics, Numerical methods, Fluid dynamics and FEA.
  • Experience in Acoustics testing is desirable.
  • Experience in the HVAC industry is desirable.
  • Knowledge of AI/ML, IIOT and digital twin is preferred.
  • Strong teamwork, interpersonal, communication, and project management skills required.
  • Knowledge of programming languages and proven examples of improving productivity using various scripts.
  • Ability to work in a matrix team environment for the common objectives
  • Be part of org initiatives and contribute to ensure progressive, diverse and inclusive environment imbibing Trane values and culture.

.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly analytical with strong problem‑solving capability.
  • Self-driven, with the ability to manage work priorities independently.
  • Collaborative mindset with strong initiative to influence design improvements.
  • Proven ability to apply best‑practice approaches and engage in continuous learning.
  • Ability to lead technically within cross-functional programs and drive engineering clarity.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.title: Visualization & Product Development Analyst
job.description:
The Role

The Visualization & Product Development Analyst supports dashboard delivery and analytics product development that convert priority data into usable business insights. This role is important to sustaining dashboard delivery and pipeline development that convert priority data into usable business insights across the organization.

This position is a development and delivery role that combines visualization expertise, analytical capability, and product-oriented execution. The individual will build dashboards, reporting products, and analytics solutions using platforms such as Tableau, Google Looker, and Dataiku in ways that are scalable, reliable, and aligned to business needs. This role will work closely with stakeholders and partner teams to translate defined requirements into intuitive, business-facing outputs that support effective decision-making.

The ideal candidate is detail-focused, quality-minded, and skilled in data storytelling, testing, documentation, and reporting execution. This role is well suited for someone who enjoys building polished analytics products, validating data accuracy, and ensuring delivered solutions are reliable, maintainable, and easy for end users to understand and adopt.

This role will be based at our Bangalore, India office and will report directly to the Visualization & Product Development Leader for ISC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate defined business requirements into dashboards, visualizations, and analytical outputs that support business priorities by converting data into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Build analytics and reporting solutions using Tableau, Google Looker, Dataiku, and related tools in a scalable, reliable, and maintainable manner.
  • Apply strong data storytelling practices to create intuitive, user-friendly, and decision-oriented reporting products.
  • Perform data validation, testing, and quality checks to ensure dashboards, reports, and analytics products are accurate and reliable.
  • Partner with stakeholders to understand reporting needs, dashboard enhancement opportunities, and user experience requirements.
  • Identify gaps in dashboards, reporting processes, and data structures, and recommend practical improvements to strengthen usability and performance.
  • Document dashboard logic, metric display rules, testing outcomes, reporting requirements, and related processes to support consistency and scalability.
  • Present visualizations, findings, and recommendations in a clear and business-relevant manner to stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple deliverables effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail, quality, and delivery timelines.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, Supply Chain, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2–4 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, dashboard development, reporting, or a related field.
  • Experience working with Tableau, Google Looker, Dataiku, or similar analytics and visualization platforms.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality in reporting and analytics delivery.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with testing, validation, and documentation practices for dashboards and analytics solutions.
  • Experience with SQL, Python, or other data analysis and automation tools is preferred.
  • Exposure to data quality, reporting standards, and visualization best practices is a plus.
  • Experience in supply chain, operations, or manufacturing environments is a plus.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Service Engineer will be responsible for service, maintenance, troubleshooting, and commissioning of Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chiller systems in data center environments. The role also includes supporting and executing data center HVAC projects, ensuring timely delivery, quality compliance, and seamless customer communication. This position requires deep technical expertise in chiller operations, system optimization, and data center cooling infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, preventive maintenance, and corrective actions on Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, including screw, scroll, and centrifugal systems.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and control-related issues in chiller and HVAC systems.
  • Conduct chiller start-up, commissioning, performance testing, and system optimization.
  • Manage site execution for data center cooling projects, including planning, installation oversight, and coordination with contractors and OEM teams.
  • Support upgrades, retrofits, and energy‑efficiency improvements in existing data centre cooling infrastructure.
  • Review technical drawings, submittals, and project documents for accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain detailed service reports, performance logs, and documentation for all equipment.
  • Ensure strict adherence to safety standards, regulatory requirements, and customer operational protocols.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers and technicians.
  • Interface with customers regularly to provide updates, clarify technical issues, and ensure completion of service and project tasks.
  • Participate in root‑cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions for recurring issues.
  • Coordinate with internal teams (sales, project management, engineering) for seamless service and project delivery.
  • Timely submission of Root cause analysis & 8D reports to customers
  • Willing to work in Shift available to work on Holidays & public holidays to meet agreed SLA
  • Monthly MOR, Quarterly QBR meetings required to be attended with DC customers

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or relevant technical field.
  • 5–10 years of hands-on experience servicing Air‑Cooled and Water‑Cooled Chillers, preferably in data centre applications.
  • Strong knowledge of refrigeration cycles, HVAC controls, BMS/EMS integration, and cooling redundancy concepts.
  • Experience in project execution, installation supervision, and commissioning of HVAC equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wiring diagrams, P&IDs, and equipment manuals.
  • Proficient in diagnosing mechanical, electrical, and control faults using service tools and diagnostic software.
  • Strong customer communication skills and ability to work in critical data centre environments.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and industry best practices.
  • Good problem‑solving skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with mission‑critical data centres or large industrial cooling systems.
  • OEM-specific chiller training or certifications (e.g., Trane, Carrier, Daikin).
  • Knowledge of energy‑efficiency programs, retrofits, and system performance optimization.
  • Project management experience or certification is a plus.

We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. We are an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, pregnancy, age, marital status, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any legally protected status.

job.description:
Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at [Trane Technologies](https://www.tranetechnologies.com/), and through our businesses including [Trane®](http://www.trane.com/index.html) and [Thermo King](http://www.thermoking.com/na/en.html), sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. We boldly go.

Where is the work:

On-Site (5 days)

工作概述：

根据业务发展及增长需求，对于爱科产品销售业务的开展及方向给予明确指导，达成业务指标并促进业务持续增长。以直销形式，与内部团队跨部门协作，通过与最终用户、工程总包公司、机电分包及设计院的关系维护与拓展，提供专业的销售方案。在满足客户需求的情况下，实现爱科产品在区域内的市场推广和销售的任务。

关键岗位职责：

  • 结合公司战略目标及所负责地区的市场情况，开发主产品项目销售业务和客户商机，负责制定长期及短期发展方向，开拓所在地区市场，优化团队，并带领团队高效执行；
  • 合理制定及分配年度业绩指标，带领团队达成预定目标，即实现业务的增长，同时有效管理部门预算和人员/项目成本；
  • 与相关部门（市场，服务，商务，PM）等部门密切合作，提供客户的推广支持，提升客户服务质量并帮助AR部门及时收回账款；
  • 运用公司销售管理体系及工具，培养高效率的团队和人才梯队负责推广爱科产品，建立和维护良好的客户关系。

任职资格:

  • 本科及以上学历，暖通空调、制冷、建筑环境、机电、管理等相关专业，具备丰富项目操作经验；
  • 5年以上暖通及其他公用设备、机电或净化工程行业相关销售经验，2年以上项目销售业务及团队管理经验；
  • 有能力带领团队在一定压力下实现业绩目标且曾有多次成功经验；
  • 优秀的沟通、适应和变革管理能力；
  • 以结果为导向，以数据为依据，具备快速决策能力。

领导胜任力:

  • 激情 求变：对未来有明确目标，敢于挑战，创新求变；敢于承担风险，坚决推动变革；带动团队快速适应变化；
  • 学习 求进：开发新思路；乐于接受反馈，不断自我提升；快速学习，学以致用；
  • 执行 求果：心口合一，言行一致；方向统一，结果导向，落地执行；求突破，求增长（出货，利润，团队人才梯队培养，员工敬业度等）

job.title: Engineering Project Leader, Maglev Compressors
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Responsible for planning and managing the maglev compressor design through engineering design release using Trane Technologies formal stage gate process.
  • Identifies and requests engineering personnel needed for the project team.
  • Collaborates with system engineering, controls, heat exchanger, product, manufacturing, and other teams to ensure seamless compressor integration.
  • Provides project updates and manages communications to leadership and other stakeholders.
  • Coordinates purchasing, machining, inspection, build and test of prototype compressors used in lab validation.
  • Transfers the design to the production implementation team and provides support as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering or directly-related engineering discipline and at least 10 years of experience in engineering and/or project leadership
  • Ability to travel both domestically and abroad up to one month at a time. Traveling we will be dependent the needs of the project.

Key Competencies:

  • Able to work with a diverse, global team primarily in North America, Europe, and the Asia Pacific regions
  • Broad understanding of maglev compressors and their integration into the HVAC system
  • Outstanding verbal communication, technical writing, documentation, and presentation skills
  • Can adjust project strategy based on project risks, design tradeoffs, schedule, project budget, product costs, and product reliability
  • Able to understand, condense, and organize information necessary for effective team and leadership decisions
  • Can mentor less experienced team members while working as an effective member of the team

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support, servicing, and maintenance of HVAC systems, including data centre cooling solutions and mission-critical equipment.
  • Carry out corrective and preventive maintenance for chillers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, cooling towers, and associated HVAC infrastructure.
  • Perform system diagnostics, troubleshooting, commissioning, and performance optimization for HVAC and data centre cooling systems.
  • Lead and supervise technicians or subcontractors to ensure timely and quality completion of assigned tasks.
  • Communicate with data centre customers to coordinate work schedules, address concerns, provide updates, and resolve technical issues effectively.
  • Support planning, documentation, and reporting for maintenance schedules and operational activities.
  • Work closely with vendors and contractors for job coordination and materials sourcing.
  • Ensure all work follows relevant EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) standards and internal quality requirements.
  • Respond to urgent or unplanned maintenance needs; willingness to work extended or irregular hours as required by data centre operations.
  • Perform any other duties assigned from time to time.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of HVAC experience, preferably supporting data centre operations or mission-critical cooling systems.
  • Strong technical expertise in chillers, CRAC/CRAH units, HVAC system controls, and cooling optimization.
  • Experience engaging with data centre customers and managing customer expectations in a high-demand environment.
  • Willingness to work long hours, including after-hours support when required.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills.
  • Positive attitude, good teamwork, and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Based in Johor Bahru & Shah Alam and able to support regional operations as needed.

Where is the work:

Prioritize engaging with customers. When not directly interacting with customers; collaborate with colleagues in your office.

一、岗位职责

  • 全面负责分配工程项目的全流程管理，包括项目前期对接、施工方案编制、现场施工组织、进度把控、质量监督、安全管理及竣工验收等全周期工作，确保项目按计划、按标准顺利交付
  • 统筹项目团队、施工班组、供应商及甲方等多方资源，协调各方沟通对接，及时解决项目施工过程中出现的技术、进度、协调类问题，保障项目高效推进
  • 协助确认暖通设备选型、技术方案优化，主导图纸会审与技术交底工作，针对施工中的技术难题提供专业解决方案，保障施工技术合规、工艺达标
  • 协助完成电气相关配套工作，参与项目电气系统与暖通系统的联动调试、简单电气线路规划及现场电气施工协调，配合电气专业人员完成相关配套任务
  • 负责项目资料整理归档，包括施工日志、技术资料、验收资料、签证变更文件等，确保项目资料完整、规范，符合归档及审计要求。
  • 及时响应客户需求，定期汇报项目进展情况，提升客户满意度，配合完成项目回款相关工作。
  • 严格落实施工现场安全管理规范，开展安全培训、安全巡查，排查安全隐患，杜绝安全事故发生。

二、任职资格

  • 学历与专业：大专及以上学历，建筑环境与能源应用工程、暖通空调、制冷、机电安装等相关专业优先
  • 工作经验：5-8年暖通工程项目管理全职工作经验，有独立负责中型暖通工程、机电安装工程项目全程管理的成功案例，熟悉暖通施工全流程与行业规范。

job.title: Data Engineering Analyst
job.description:
The Role

Trane Technologies is seeking a Data Engineering Analyst to join our ISC Data Architecture & Governance team based in Bangalore, India. This is a hands-on role for a candidate who can build scalable data engineering pipelines, analyze legacy systems and workflows, and help modernize our data landscape on Google Cloud Platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for ingesting data from internal and external sources into our enterprise data lake, with a strong focus on the bronze layer of a medallion architecture. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data analysts, and technical teams to gather requirements, clarify business logic, support testing, and design practical solutions that improve reliability, usability, and scalability.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical data engineering skills with the ability to work independently, determine next steps, and communicate effectively with customers and stakeholders throughout the solution lifecycle.

This role is based in our Bangalore, India corporate office and reports directly to the Data Architecture & Governance Manager for ISC.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, integrations, and ETL/ELT workflows on Google Cloud Platform using BigQuery, Airflow, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Ingest data from internal and external sources into the enterprise data lake, with primary ownership of the bronze layer within a medallion architecture.
  • Analyze legacy systems, databases, workflows, and transformation logic to understand current-state processes, dependencies, and opportunities for modernization.
  • Document current-state data flows and system behavior and develop recommendations for process improvement, architecture simplification, and legacy-to-cloud modernization.
  • Use strong SQL skills to analyze source data, validate transformations, understand embedded business logic, and support data analysts with trusted datasets.
  • Partner with business stakeholders and internal customers to gather requirements, clarify needs, support testing, and translate business needs into scalable technical solutions.
  • Work independently to identify next steps, resolve technical and process issues, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality data solutions.
  • Apply data quality, governance, documentation, and security standards while continuously improving pipeline reliability, scalability, and performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in data engineering, cloud data platforms, data integration, or related roles.
  • Hands-on experience building data pipelines in Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong working knowledge of BigQuery, Cloud Composer, and Cloud Data Fusion.
  • Strong SQL skills, including the ability to analyze legacy systems, investigate data issues, validate transformations, and support analytics users.
  • Knowledge of Python and Data Engineering packages such as PySpark and Airflow
  • Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines for structured and semi-structured data.
  • Familiarity with data lake concepts and medallion architecture, especially bronze-layer ingestion patterns.
  • Familiarity with data governance, metadata, lineage, and data quality practices.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, communication, and self-management skills.
  • Experience working in cross-functional or global teams.
  • Google Cloud certifications are a plus.

**

What You Will Bring

  • A hands-on engineering mindset with the ability to move from analysis to design to delivery.
  • Strong curiosity and comfort working through ambiguity in legacy environments.
  • The ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • A proactive, self-directed approach to identifying priorities and driving work forward.
  • A passion for building scalable, maintainable data solutions that support business value.

At Trane Technologies, we offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs that help our employees thrive in both their professional and personal lives. We are proud of our winning culture, which is inclusive and respectful at its core. We share a passion for serving customers, caring for others, and boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world.

We are committed to achieving workforce diversity reflective of our communities. We are an equal opportunity employer. job.title: Engineer, Modeling & Simulation
job.description:
Job Overview

In this Modeling & Simulation Engineer role, you will work closely with the project team to boldly tackle the industry's cutting-edge challenges. You will utilize advanced simulation software and state-of-the-art testing equipment to design and validate refrigeration systems, while keeping a close eye on industry and technological trends to continuously enhance customer value.

We are looking for candidates with relevant HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning) theory, as well as knowledge of simulation and application development to efficiently advance technical work. If you are passionate about innovation in air conditioning technology and can work effectively in a collaborative environment, we encourage you to apply for this position.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Follow the company's product development process, utilizing advanced simulation software and testing equipment to ensure optimal system performance, and deliver validated, high-quality refrigeration system designs and air conditioning products.
  • Utilize advanced simulation tools and software to create simulation models of systems and components. Develop and optimize simulation models to accurately reflect the behavior and performance of systems. Conduct system performance analysis, identify potential issues, and propose improvement suggestions.
  • Develop mathematical models to accurately reflect the control logic of the unit and promote the standardization and modular design of models.
  • Continuously promote the intelligence of refrigeration system development process and develop automation tools to optimize design workflows.

Requirements

  • Master's degree or above in Thermodynamics, Refrigeration, Cryogenic, Air Conditioning, heat Transfer, or related fields.
  • CET 6 or equivalent level in English, with good written and verbal communication in both Chinese and English.
  • Strong foundation in refrigeration principle and extensive experience in 1D modeling and simulation of refrigeration systems and components using computer languages such as C++, Python, VBA, etc.
  • Good problem-solving skills and teamwork spirit, able to effectively coordinate and cooperate with other departments.

job.title: Senior Manager, Mechanical (GERA)
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Regional Mechanical Operations Leadership: Lead and coordinate mechanical operations support across South East Asia data center sites, ensuring consistent operating standards, maintenance practices, risk controls, and performance expectations.
  • Liquid Cooling Operations: Own regional operational readiness for liquid cooling systems, including CDUs, secondary cooling loops, manifolds, heat exchangers, leak detection, water quality management, commissioning support, and maintenance procedures.
  • Technical Support to Site Operations: Provide second-level technical support to local DCO and facilities teams for complex mechanical issues, including chilled water systems, CRAH/CRAC units, cooling towers, pumps, valves, controls, fire protection interfaces, and high-density cooling environments.
  • Reliability and Availability: Drive mechanical system reliability through preventive and predictive maintenance programs, failure trend analysis, root cause investigation, corrective action tracking, and lessons learned implementation.
  • Standards and Governance: Develop and maintain regional mechanical operating standards, Basic of Design review & regional maintenance playbooks
  • Commissioning and Handover: Support new site commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness reviews, and handover from project delivery teams to operations, with particular attention to cooling system resilience and maintainability.
  • Performance Optimization: Monitor mechanical system performance, identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency, PUE, water usage, cooling capacity, redundancy, and lifecycle cost while maintaining uptime and customer commitments.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Coordinate with OEMs, service providers, consultants, and contractors to ensure maintenance quality, technical compliance, timely issue resolution, and safe execution of works in live data center environments.
  • Risk, Compliance, and Safety: Ensure mechanical activities comply with applicable local regulations, health and safety requirements, environmental obligations, permit-to-work processes, and DayOne operational risk controls.
  • Regional Capability Building: Coach site teams, share best practices, conduct technical training, and build regional competency in chilled water, HVAC, and liquid cooling operations.

##

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of experience in mechanical engineering, facilities operations, or critical infrastructure, preferably within data centers, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, industrial, or other mission-critical environments.
  • demonstrated experience leading regional programs, managing multiple sites, or providing technical governance across complex operational environments is preferred.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of chilled water plants, cooling towers, CRAH/CRAC units, pumps, valves, heat exchangers, BMS controls, fire protection interfaces, and mechanical redundancy strategies.
  • Practical experience with data center liquid cooling systems, including CDUs, direct-to-chip cooling, rear-door heat exchangers, secondary water loops, leak detection, water treatment, and operational risk management.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex mechanical failures, lead root cause analysis, and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
  • Experience supporting commissioning, integrated systems testing, operational readiness, maintenance strategy development, and live-site change management.
  • Strong understanding of data center uptime requirements, operational risk, energy efficiency, PUE improvement, EHS standards, and regional regulatory requirements across South East Asia.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with site operations teams, project teams, customers, vendors, consultants, and senior management.
  • Willingness to travel across South East Asia to support site operations, incident response, commissioning activities, audits, and technical reviews.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About DayOne

Behind every app, every AI tool, every connected experience, there is a data center. DayOne builds them. In Japan, we build them to the standard this market demands. DayOne is developing an 80MW hyperscale campus at Fuchu Intelligent Park, 30 kilometres west of central Tokyo, set to be among the largest IT capacity deployments in the city when it opens in 2028. Backed by US US$4.5B+ in Series C funding and operating across seven countries, our entry into Japan is a long-term commitment built on precision and reliability.

Why DayOne

At DayOne Japan, technical excellence is the foundation everything is built on. You will work on infrastructure held to the highest standards of precision and reliability, with a clear path for development: structured training, meaningful scope, and career progression that is earned and respected. We are building here for the long term and growing the people who will carry that forward.

##

What You Will Own

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Data Center Commissioning Manager​ to lead the technical verification and operational readiness of our hyperscale facilities. This role is pivotal in ensuring that all MEP systems perform according to design intent, safety standards, and client expectations.

Job Responsibilities

1. Holistic Commissioning Management

  • Lead, plan, and execute end-to-end commissioning (Cx) activities for hyperscale data center projects.
  • Directly manage and mentor the Commissioning Authority (CxA), ensuring all deliverables strictly adhere to client standards and corporate quality systems.

2. Test Script Validation & Execution

  • Rigorously review, approve, and oversee the execution of all on-site Functional Performance Testing (FPT) scripts.
  • Ensure testing procedures are precise and that results accurately reflect system performance while fully aligning with project design specifications.

3. Schedule & Milestone Control

  • Develop and enforce strict commissioning schedules, ensuring all critical milestones are achieved on time to meet corporate project delivery deadlines.
  • Proactively identify potential schedule delay risks and formulate effective mitigation and corrective action plans.

4. Technical Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Serve as the Technical Lead for the commissioning team, providing deep technical guidance and support.
  • Maintain close communication and collaboration with Project Management, General Contractors, Equipment Vendors, and End-Clients to remove technical roadblocks and ensure on-time project delivery.

5. Quality Assurance & Safety Compliance

  • Establish and enforce standardized commissioning test procedures and Safety Protocols (SOPs).
  • Ensure all commissioning activities are conducted safely and compliantly, targeting zero incidents and high-quality delivery.

Requirements

  • Foundation:​ Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or related fields.
  • Experience:​ 7–10 years of proven, hands-on experience specifically in data center or mission critical facility testing and commissioning.
  • Technical Knowledge:​ Deep domain expertise in power systems​ (UPS, Generators, Switchgear), HVAC, and network operations.
  • Leadership:​ Demonstrated experience managing teams and balancing multiple large-scale projects simultaneously.
  • Communication:​ Ability to translate complex technical issues into clear, concise language for clients and stakeholders.
  • Language: Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Japanese and English.
  • Local Savvy:​ In-depth understanding of the Japanese business and regulatory environment.
  • The Drive:​ Proactive mindset with a willingness to travel regionally between construction sites as needed.
  • Bonus Points:​ Professional certifications (like PMP, CDCP, CSCP, CPP, or equivalent professional certification) will help you stand out.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Senior Manager, Electrical (GERA)
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Role and Responsibilities

  • Regional Electrical Leadership: Provide regional technical leadership and governance for electrical infrastructure across Southeast Asia data center operations. Drive consistency in engineering standards, operational practices, maintenance strategies, risk management across the regional portfolio.
  • Electrical Infrastructure Operations: Provide technical oversight for the operation, maintenance, and lifecycle management of critical electrical infrastructure, including utility intake systems, HV/MV/LV distribution, transformers, switchgear, protection systems, generators, UPS systems, batteries, STS, PDU/RPP, busway, earthing systems, and electrical monitoring platforms.
  • Technical Support: Act as the regional Electrical SME and escalation point for complex electrical issues and critical incidents. Provide advanced technical support to site operations teams for protection trips, electrical faults, UPS and generator abnormalities, switching events, power quality issues, equipment failures, degraded operating modes, and other conditions that may impact data center availability.
  • Reliability and Risk Management: Drive electrical system reliability and availability through preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance strategies. Analyze equipment health, performance data, alarms, and failure trends; lead RCA’s for incidents; and ensure corrective and preventive actions and lessons learned are implemented consistently across the region.
  • Standards and Governance: Develop Operational standards – switching standards, Maintenance standards, BOD and Maintenance play book.
  • Commissioning and Handover: Support commissioning, energization, IST, operational readiness reviews, and handover from project delivery to operations.
  • Electrical Safety and Compliance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, permit to work, lockout/tagout, arc flash controls, electrical safety procedures, and DayOne operational risk requirements.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify opportunities to improve power reliability, energy efficiency, PUE, power quality, load utilization, redundancy, and lifecycle cost.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Coordinate with Internal stake holders, OEMs, service providers, consultants, and contractors to ensure maintenance quality, safe execution, and timely issue resolution.
  • Regional Capability Building: Coach site teams, share best practices, and build regional competency in electrical operations, switching discipline, UPS/generator systems, protection coordination, and incident response.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Power Engineering or related discipline.
  • Minimum 8-12 years of experience in electrical engineering, facilities operations, or critical infrastructure, preferably in data centers or mission-critical environments.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for the complete electrical infrastructure lifecycle, from Utility/Grid Interface (HV/EHV), Substations, MV distribution, transformers, protection systems, standby generation, UPS systems, through to LV distribution and critical loads. Strong knowledge of MV/LV power distribution, transformers, switchgear, protection relays, generators, UPS, batteries, STS, PDU/RPP, busway, earthing, and electrical monitoring systems.
  • Deep technical expertise in:Utility interfaces, HV/MV substations, GIS/AIS switchgear, RMUs, LV switchboards, busbar/busduct systems, system configurations, redundancy architectures, switching philosophy, and operational failure modes.

job.title: Human Resources Coordinator (APAC)
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

Human Resources Coordinator, APAC

EdgeConneX is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Human Resources Coordinator to join our team in Malaysia. As a key member of the HR team, the Human Resources Coordinator will support day-to-day HR operations across the APAC region, ensuring smooth employee experience while maintaining compliance with local employment requirements. This position reports to the Human Resources Generalist, APAC and is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Main Responsibilities

  • Coordinate and execute onboarding activities across APAC jurisdictions, ensuring a seamless, consistent, and compliant onboarding experience for new hires from offer acceptance through successful integration into the business.
  • Manage pre-employment requirements, including background check coordination, document collection and verification, onboarding communications, system access requests, equipment coordination, and new hire orientation activities.
  • Serve as the first point of contact for routine HR inquiries, providing timely support to employees and managers on HR processes, policies, benefits, and employment-related matters, while escalating complex issues as appropriate.
  • Provide administrative support for employee lifecycle activities across APAC, including employment changes, promotions, transfers, manager changes, organizational updates, and offboarding coordination.

  • Support immigration and mobility processes across APAC jurisdictions, including visa applications, work permit renewals, dependent pass applications, document collection, compliance tracking, and coordination with external immigration providers.
  • Assist with HR compliance activities across APAC by maintaining required documentation, monitoring compliance-related deadlines, supporting statutory requirements, and ensuring records are audit-ready.
  • Coordinate with external HR vendors and service providers, including immigration counsel, insurance brokers, medical providers, background screening vendors, and other third-party partners.
  • Maintain HR documentation, templates, employee records, and other HR resources in accordance with company policies, local regulations, and data privacy requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain HR reports, dashboards, trackers, organizational charts, and other HR documentation to support business and compliance needs.
  • Maintain and update job descriptions, organizational documentation, and HR resources to ensure accuracy and alignment with business requirements.
  • Support employee engagement initiatives, wellbeing programs, learning activities, new hire check-ins, and regional HR communications.
  • Assist with internal and external audits and compliance reviews, by gathering documentation and supporting audit requirements.
  • Support HR projects, process improvements, system enhancements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the APAC region.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 2-4 years of experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR Administration, or a similar role.
  • Experience supporting multiple countries or jurisdictions within APAC is preferred.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion when handling sensitive employee information.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
  • Experience working with HR systems, HRIS platforms, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
