job.title: Senior Analyst , Accounts Receivable
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Senior Accounts Receivable (AR) Analyst is a senior individual-contributor role responsible for the accuracy, integrity, and timeliness of AR accounting across the company’s multi-entity, multi-currency data center platform. This role owns the more complex and judgmental areas of the AR cycle — including cross-entity and intercompany billing, reserve and bad debt analysis, and audit-facing reconciliations — while also reviewing and quality-checking the work of AR Analysts. The Senior Analyst acts as a key point of escalation for billing and collections issues, partners closely with Treasury, Billing, Revenue, and the broader Global Close & Reporting teams, and helps drive continuous improvement of AR processes and controls in a fast-growing, multi-entity environment.

Responsibilities

  • Own the invoicing and billing process for higher-complexity customer and intercompany arrangements, ensuring accuracy against contract terms across multiple entities and currencies.
  • Review and approve cash application performed by AR Analysts; independently resolve complex unapplied cash and payment discrepancies in NetSuite.
  • Own the monthly AR sub-ledger to general ledger reconciliation across multiple legal entities, investigating and resolving complex or aged variances.
  • Lead the review of aging reports and collections status; escalate delinquent accounts to management, Legal, or Sales/Contracts as needed and drive resolution.
  • Review and approve customer credit memos, adjustments, and write-offs above Analyst approval thresholds, ensuring compliance with internal control policies.
  • Own intercompany billing, reconciliation, and elimination processes across the multi-entity, multi-currency structure, partnering with the Global Close team.
  • Lead AR-related month-end close deliverables, including accruals, bad debt/reserve calculations, and management reporting packages.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for complex customer billing inquiries, coordinating with Sales, Contracts, and Legal to resolve disputes.
  • Act as the main point of contact for internal and external auditors on AR matters, maintaining clean, well-organized, audit-ready documentation.
  • Identify, propose, and lead process improvement and automation initiatives to reduce manual work and strengthen AR controls.
  • Mentor, train, and review the work of AR Analysts, providing quality assurance and supporting their development.
  • Support ad hoc analysis for Finance leadership, including DSO trends, aging analysis, and bad debt reserve reporting.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
  • 3–5 years of progressive experience in Accounts Receivable, billing, or general accounting, ideally within a shared services or multi-entity, multinational environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of ERP systems (NetSuite experience strongly preferred).
  • Solid technical understanding of the AR/cash application cycle, reserve and bad debt methodology, and intercompany billing/elimination concepts.
  • Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, lookups, complex reconciliations); comfortable working with large, multi-entity data sets.
  • Demonstrated ability to review and quality-check the work of others, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with Finance leadership, auditors, and customers.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring monthly deadlines with minimal supervision.

EdgeConneX believes inclusion – of thought, backgrounds and experiences – affects all that we do, from our employees to the solutions we deliver. Our goal is to create an environment where embracing differences helps deepen the lives and work experience of our employees, enhances our innovation and creativity, and enriches our involvement in our communities. EdgeConneX is an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability, as well as any other category protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

job.title: Engineer - Customer Interaction Suite
job.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Automation Test Engineer / Quality Engineer with strong technical expertise in web and API automation, complete test lifecycle ownership, and a deep understanding of Agile methodologies.

The ideal candidate will play an integral role in the product development lifecycle, working closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers to ensure that every release meets the highest quality standards through automation, continuous testing, and data-driven validation.

Key Responsibilities:**

1. Test Strategy and Planning

Define and implement comprehensive test strategies and test plans aligned with product requirements, user stories, and sprint goals.

  • Create detailed test cases, test data, and test environments for functional, regression, integration, load, and automation testing.
  • Perform complete test lifecycle activities including requirement analysis, test design, test execution, defect management, and test closure reporting.
  • Ensure traceability between user stories, test cases, and defects.

2. Automation Framework Design and Maintenance

Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for both Web UI and API services using tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Postman/Newman.

  • Develop reusable automation scripts and integrate them within the CI/CD pipeline to enable continuous testing.
  • Configure and maintain automated test execution as part of the merge and deployment process to validate builds in lower and higher environments.
  • Implement version control and review mechanisms for automation code using Git-based repositories.
  • Track automation coverage and integrate reports with dashboards for visibility.

3. Collaboration and Agile Delivery

Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.

  • Work closely with developers during sprints to clarify acceptance criteria and ensure early detection of defects.
  • Collaborate with developers during debugging sessions and reproduce defects effectively with detailed logs and evidence.
  • Participate in user story creation and refinement using BDD and Gherkin syntax, ensuring test coverage and acceptance criteria are clear and measurable.
  • Contribute to Test Driven Development (TDD) and Behavior Driven Development (BDD) initiatives to improve code quality and reliability.

4. Testing Types and Execution

Execute different forms of testing including sanity testing, regression testing, hotfix validation, load and performance testing, and full automation testing.

  • Perform root cause analysis for recurring issues and help implement preventive measures.
  • Conduct end-to-end testing across multiple environments and integrations.
  • Ensure quality gates are met before each release.

5. CI/CD Integration and Tooling

Integrate test automation with CI/CD systems like Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI.

  • Configure automated build validation, smoke test runs, and regression tests during deployment pipelines.
  • Manage environment setup for test execution including containerized test environments using Docker or Kubernetes.
  • Use monitoring tools to track build health and test results.

6. Data and Database Validation

Perform data validation and integrity testing across systems involving both RDBMS and document-based storage.

  • Work with databases like MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB for test data creation, verification, and validation of business logic.
  • Write SQL and NoSQL queries to validate backend data consistency and performance.

7. Release and Quality Governance

Participate in release management processes and coordinate test readiness before deployment.

  • Provide test summary reports and present quality metrics in release readiness meetings.
  • Conduct release demos to product and business teams, showcasing test results and automation coverage.
  • Ensure quality compliance and documentation for all production releases.

Required Skills and Experience

2–4 years of strong hands-on experience in test automation for web and API-based systems.

  • Proficiency in programming languages ; Java, TypeScript, or JavaScript.
  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or RestAssured ( With Selenium and Playwright being mandatory )

Deep understanding of Agile practices and ceremonies.

  • Proven experience collaborating with large, cross-functional teams, developers, and DevOps engineers.
  • Knowledge of BDD tools like Cucumber, SpecFlow, or Behave with Gherkin syntax.
  • Familiarity with TDD approaches and integration with CI/CD systems.
  • Practical experience in integrating test automation with tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, or GitHub Actions.
  • Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as JIRA, TestRail, Zephyr, or Xray.
  • Exposure to load and performance testing tools like JMeter, Locust, or LoadRunner.
  • Strong database skills in both RDBMS and NoSQL systems (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB).

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a product-based company with end-to-end ownership of testing and automation processes.

  • Familiarity with API mocking and simulation tools like Postman, WireMock, or Swagger.
  • Experience executing automated tests in cloud-based test platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs for browser compatiblity

Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities with attention to detail.

We are seeking an experienced F5 Load Balancer L3 Engineer to manage, maintain, and optimize network load balancing infrastructure. As an L3 engineer, you will work on complex troubleshooting, configuration, and implementation tasks, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless service delivery.

Responsibilities

Troubleshooting:

Collaboration:

Security:

Skills

job.title: Services Manager/Engineer - Mechanical (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Position Summary

The Services Manager/Engineer - Mechanical is the client-side technical and delivery lead for mechanical and hydraulic services on hyperscale and mission-critical data-centre projects. The role provides senior leadership from concept and design through procurement, manufacture, construction, commissioning and handover, ensuring the cooling and hydraulic infrastructure achieves the required capacity, resilience, maintainability, energy performance and programme outcomes.

The position requires proven data-centre experience and the ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, engage credibly with designers, contractors and OEMs, and make sound technical and commercial decisions. A core focus is the integration of air-cooled chiller systems, liquid-cooled racks, hydraulic services and associated heat-rejection, distribution, controls and monitoring infrastructure, including phased deployment in live or operationally sensitive environments.

The role also leads the client interface for modular and off-site construction, including prefabricated plantrooms, skids, containerised systems and factory-tested assemblies. It establishes the assurance regime from factory acceptance through site integration and integrated systems testing.

#

Key Responsibilities

Services leadership and client representation

  • Lead the mechanical-services workstream on behalf of the client, setting technical priorities, delivery expectations, reporting and assurance activities.
  • Coordinate designers, principal contractors, specialist mechanical contractors, OEMs, commissioning providers and internal delivery, operations and commercial teams.
  • Provide clear advice on technical risk, programme, cost, constructability, resilience and operational impacts; escalate material issues with practical recommendations.
  • Promote a safety-first culture across design, factory and site activities, including safe commissioning and transition to operations.

Technical leadership and design assurance

  • Assist reviews of basis of design, drawings, specifications, calculations, equipment selections and design changes for critical cooling and hydraulic systems.
  • Provide technical assurance for air-cooled chiller systems, chilled-water distribution, pumps, heat exchangers, CRAH/CRAC equipment, ventilation, water treatment, hydraulic services, in-ground services, drainage, leak detection and BMS/DCIM interfaces.
  • Manage the coordination and delivery assurance of in-ground hydraulic services, including site water, fire-water interfaces, sanitary drainage, trade waste where applicable, stormwater interfaces, pits, pipework routes and connections to building systems.
  • Lead the mechanical integration strategy for liquid-cooled racks, including CDU architecture, secondary-loop distribution, water quality, containment, leak detection, controls, redundancy, maintainability and staged capacity deployment.
  • Review BMS architecture, points lists, control narratives, sequences of operation, alarms, trending and integration with electrical, fire, security and DCIM systems.
  • Contribute to design workshops, constructability reviews, HAZOP-style risk reviews, failure-mode assessments, value engineering and operational-readiness reviews.

Procurement, commercial and programme support

  • Lead technical evaluation of mechanical and controls tender submissions, identifying scope gaps, qualifications, programme risks and departures from requirements.
  • Support procurement and commercial teams with technical clarifications, vendor assessments, equipment lead-time strategies and package award recommendations.
  • Review progress against design, manufacture, delivery and installation milestones; intervene early where recovery actions are required.

Modular and off-site delivery

  • Lead the client-side approach to modular construction for mechanical infrastructure, including prefabricated plantrooms, skids, pipe-rack modules and factory-integrated controls systems.
  • Review modular design interfaces, logistics, lifting and installation methodology, tolerances, access, maintainability, in-ground services interfaces and site tie-in strategies.
  • Plan and witness factory acceptance tests, pre-functional checks and controls integration testing, ensuring documented close-out before shipment and site energisation.
  • Ensure modular systems are properly integrated with on-site services, controls, structural, electrical and commissioning interfaces.

Construction, commissioning and handover

  • Review contractor methodologies, inspection and test plans, quality records, commissioning plans and completion documentation.
  • Undertake site inspections and witness hold points, functional performance testing, integrated systems testing and reliability demonstrations.
  • Verify that defects, outstanding works, control issues and documentation gaps are closed before handover.
  • Support operational-readiness activities, including training, spares, maintenance information, asset data and as-built records.

Essential experience

  • 10+ years of relevant mechanical and hydraulic services delivery experience, including a services management, engineering management or client-side leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering data centres, mission-critical facilities or similarly resilient high-availability infrastructure.
  • Strong practical and technical understanding of air-cooled chiller plants, associated chilled-water systems, hydraulic services and in-ground services, controls and commissioning.
  • Demonstrated understanding of liquid cooling for data-centre racks, including CDUs, distribution systems, heat rejection, controls, leak management and operational interfaces.
  • Proven experience with modular or off-site construction methodologies, including factory acceptance testing and site integration.
  • Ability to lead design reviews, resolve complex services interfaces and assess technical, programme and commercial risk.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS and controls integration, sequences of operation and commissioning requirements for critical environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, stakeholder management and leadership skills.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related discipline; trade-qualified HVAC/mechanical background with substantial senior delivery experience will also be considered.
  • Relevant Australian professional registration, chartership or industry memberships are advantageous.

Current construction-induction card and the ability to work on an active construction site.

#

Desirable Experience

  • Hyperscale data-centre experience and familiarity with phased build, live-site works and concurrent commissioning activities.
  • Experience with data-centre cooling standards, reliability frameworks and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience working with major chiller, cooling, controls and liquid-cooling OEMs.
  • Experience in integrated systems testing, seasonal testing and performance verification.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

· Exceptional leadership and communication skills.

· Ability to thrive in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment.

Technical Skills:

· Proficiency with AutoCAD, Sketch Up, MS office and know how of Revit, GIS would be essential.

· Proficiency in building/planning, infra codes for Urban design, planning and building.

· Experience in preparing design brief and feasibility studies.

Non-Negotiable Skills:

· Expertise in master planning, urban design, infrastructure coordination, transportation, landscaping, and sustainable development

· Must have exhibited design and design coordination skills with various design stakeholders like landscape, traffic, infra (including PHE, Electrical etc.) and SMEP

· Demonstrable workplace experience of survey and analysis of sites, preparation of base plans and supporting material required for urban design and master planning work is essential.

· At least one full cycle of experience from concept development to on-site completion

Conclusion:

The Lead Master Planner role at Adani presents an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to lead transformative design initiatives in the real estate and hospitality industry. If you are passionate about creating innovative and sustainable architectural solutions and possess the requisite skills and qualifications, we encourage you to apply and become a valuable contributor to our dynamic team.

job.title: Duty Terminal Manager
job.description:

job.title: Lead - Cybersecurity
job.description:
Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Strategy, Governance & Compliance

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance cybersecurity policies, standards, frameworks, and operational procedures across the business.
  • Establish cybersecurity governance mechanisms and drive periodic cybersecurity performance reviews with business leadership.
  • Define cyber KPIs, KRIs, scorecards, and reporting frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance with cybersecurity regulations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and industry standards.
  • Maintain cyber risk registers and monitor closure of identified risks and audit observations.

Cyber Hygiene & Technology Controls

  • Govern and continuously improve cyber hygiene controls across all operational sites.
  • Ensure effective Identity & Access Management (IAM), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and user access governance.
  • Drive endpoint security, anti-virus management, security patch deployment, and operating system/application security updates.
  • Manage backup infrastructure, restoration testing, and cyber recovery controls.
  • Ensure OEM-supported security configurations and technology lifecycle compliance across critical systems.

Operational Technology (OT) Security

  • Develop and implement cybersecurity controls for Operational Technology environments including BMS, DCIM, IBMS, EPMS, CCTV, Access Control Systems, PLCs, and Building Automation Systems.
  • Ensure secure integration and segregation of IT and OT networks.
  • Lead OT vulnerability assessments, security audits, and remediation programs.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Engineering, and OEM partners to strengthen resilience of mission-critical operational systems.

Network & Endpoint Security

  • Manage enterprise and data center network security architecture.
  • Govern firewalls, IDS/IPS, NAC, VPNs, secure remote access, network segmentation, and threat detection controls.
  • Implement and manage Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR/XDR) solutions.
  • Continuously monitor network and endpoint security posture and drive corrective actions.

Cybersecurity Incident Response & Crisis Management

  • Lead cybersecurity incident detection, investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
  • Develop and maintain incident response plans, cyber playbooks, escalation matrices, and response procedures.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement preventive and corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with leadership, OEMs, customers, service providers, and regulatory agencies during cybersecurity incidents.
  • Conduct cyber crisis simulations, tabletop exercises, and business continuity testing.

Cyber Risk Management & Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct periodic cyber risk assessments for infrastructure, applications, networks, OT systems, and critical business processes.
  • Lead vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, security reviews, and threat exposure assessments.
  • Prioritize and drive remediation of identified vulnerabilities within defined timelines.
  • Monitor emerging cyber threats and ensure timely mitigation of associated risks.

Cybersecurity Solutions & Technology Deployment

  • Evaluate, recommend, and implement cybersecurity technologies aligned with business and operational requirements.
  • Drive deployment and lifecycle management of SIEM, SOAR, PAM, EDR/XDR, threat intelligence, vulnerability management, and other cybersecurity platforms.
  • Collaborate with digital, automation, infrastructure, and project teams for integration of secure technologies.

Cybersecurity Audits & Assurance

  • Lead internal and external cybersecurity audits, assessments, certifications, and customer security reviews.
  • Ensure readiness and compliance with standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, and other relevant industry practices.
  • Maintain cybersecurity documentation, evidence repositories, and compliance records.

Vendor & Third-Party Cyber Risk Management

  • Conduct cybersecurity assessments of OEMs, contractors, managed service providers, consultants, and third-party vendors.
  • Review cybersecurity controls and contractual compliance of suppliers and service providers.
  • Ensure remediation and mitigation of identified third-party cyber risks.
  • Embed cybersecurity requirements into procurement, contracting, and vendor management processes.

Cybersecurity Awareness & Capability Building

  • Develop and implement cybersecurity awareness programs across operational data centers.
  • Conduct periodic employee awareness campaigns, phishing simulations, training sessions, and security workshops.
  • Build cybersecurity competency within operations, engineering, facility management, and support functions.
  • Promote a strong cyber-aware culture across the organization.

ESG, Sustainability & Workplace Safety

  • Demonstrate active commitment to AdaniConneX's Environmental, Social & Governance (ESG) objectives and sustainability agenda.
  • Promote environmentally responsible management of IT and electronic assets, including e-waste disposal and sustainable technology practices.
  • Comply with all applicable Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) policies, procedures, and statutory requirements.
  • Participate in safety audits, emergency response drills, incident investigations, and risk mitigation initiatives.
  • Ensure safe working practices while executing cybersecurity projects and operational activities at data center facilities.
  • Ensure vendors, contractors, and OEM representatives comply with site safety, environmental, security, and governance requirements.

Key Internal Stakeholders

  • Group Chief Information Security Officer
  • Head – Operations
  • Information Technology team
  • Engineering & Projects Teams
  • Digital & Automation Teams
  • Facility Management Teams
  • Risk & Compliance Teams
  • Procurement Teams
  • Physical Security Teams

  • OEM & technology Partners and cybersecurity consultants
  • Clients
  • Managed Security Service Providers
  • Audit Agencies
  • Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor or master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Electronics, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or related discipline.

Professional Certifications (Preferred)

  • CISSP
  • CISM
  • CISA
  • CEH
  • CCSP
  • ISO 27001 Lead Implementer / Lead Auditor
  • GIAC Certifications
  • GICSP (OT Security)
  • Microsoft Security Certifications
  • Cisco / Palo Alto Security Certifications

Key Competencies Functional Competencies

  • Cybersecurity Governance
  • OT Security
  • Network Security Architecture
  • Endpoint Security
  • Incident Response & Crisis Management
  • Cyber Risk Management
  • Vulnerability Management
  • Security Operations
  • Third-Party Risk Management
  • Regulatory Compliance & Audits
  • Business Continuity & Cyber Resilience

Behavioral Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Leadership & Team Development
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Analytical Problem Solving

  • Communication & Influencing Skills
  • Customer Orientation

job.title: アソシエイト アカウントエグゼクティブ
job.description:
JP

Company: Digital Edge DC

Digital Edgeについて：

パフォーマンスと持続可能性を両立させるDigital Edgeは、アジアのデジタルインフラを変革するために設立された、信頼できる先進的なデータセンタープラットフォーム企業です。インフラおよび実物資産を専門とする大手オルタナティブ投資会社であるStonepeakの支援を受け、Digital Edgeは世界最大級の機関投資家や政府系ファンドを含む投資家から、16億米ドルを超える出資コミットメントを得ています。

Digital Edgeのビジョンは、アジアにおける持続可能なAIおよびハイパースケール中心のデジタルインフラストラクチャのリーディングプロバイダーとなることです。私たちのミッションは、世界のデジタル未来の基盤を構築し、組織の持続可能な成長を支援し、彼らがサービスを提供する人々を力づけることです。

2020年に設立された同社は、地域内の複数の市場で急速に成長を遂げ、現在では日本、韓国、インド、インドネシア、フィリピン、タイ、中国においてデータセンターおよび光ファイバーサービスを提供しています。同社は現在、1.4GWを超える安全なIT電力供給能力を備えた31のデータセンターを所有・運営しています。

このポジションは、アジア全域への事業拡大に伴い、急成長を遂げている当社のチームに加わる絶好の機会です。

私たちの価値観 (Our values)：

**

  • 尊重(Respect)：私たちは多様性と協調性を尊重します。
  • 革新 (Innovation)：私たちはアイデアを共有し、問題を解決します。
  • 挑戦(Strive)：私たちは意欲的で、決意に満ちています。
  • 卓越 (Excellence)：私たちは最高のものを提供することを目指します。
  • 責任 (Responsibility)：私たちは、従業員と地球にとって正しいことを行います。

職務内容：

当社は、日本におけるエンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブチームをサポートするアソシエイトアカウントエグゼクティブを募集しています。このポジションは、将来のエンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブ育成のための役割として設けられており、採用された方は、エンタープライズ顧客の管理、複雑な顧客ニーズの理解、機会の発見から取引の成立までのエンタープライズセールス実行のサポートといった実践的な経験を積むことができます。

この役割では、既存のエンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブと緊密に連携し、エンタープライズ顧客とのエンゲージメント方法、需要の高いビジネスチャンスの発掘方法、顧客関係の構築方法、そして新規ビジネス獲得への貢献方法を学びます。当面は、選定された既存のエンタープライズ顧客を担当しながら、エンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブへの昇進に必要なスキル、市場理解、そして営業規律を身につけることに注力します。この職務は日本の東京を拠点とします。

責任範囲：

エンタープライズAEサポート：既存のエンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブが戦略的な顧客関係を管理し、アカウントプランを作成し、顧客会議を調整し、合意された行動を確実に実行できるよう支援します。

  • エンタープライズ顧客エンゲージメント：エンタープライズ顧客とのエンゲージメント、顧客のビジネス上の優先事項の理解、そしてDigital Edgeのデータセンターおよびデジタルインフラストラクチャソリューションが顧客の成長をどのように支援できるかを特定する実践的な経験を積みます。
  • 機会開発：既存の大企業顧客における需要の発掘、機会の適格性評価、および顧客との最初の話し合いから提案、交渉、契約締結に至るまでの販売プロセスのサポートを行います。
  • アカウント管理：上級アカウントエグゼクティブの指導の下、既存の法人顧客を選定し、タイムリーなフォローアップ、正確な情報共有、質の高い顧客体験の提供に責任を持ちます。
  • パイプライン管理とSFDC規律：パイプラインの可視化、予測、規律ある実行をサポートするために、Salesforceで正確な営業活動、商談、およびアカウントデータを維持します。

**

必要なスキル・経験：

職務経験： B2B営業、アカウント管理、インサイドセールス、または顧客対応の営業職における経験。データセンター、クラウド、ネットワーク、ITインフラストラクチャ、またはテクノロジー分野での経験があれば尚可。

  • エンタープライズ顧客志向：複雑なエンタープライズ顧客の管理方法、ステークホルダーとの関係構築方法、長期的な戦略的アカウントの開発方法を学ぶことに強い関心がある。
  • 商業的好奇心：顧客の課題を理解し、思慮深い質問をし、潜在的な需要を特定し、顧客のニーズをDigital Edgeの価値提案に結びつける能力。
  • 実行規律：非常に組織的で信頼性が高く、フォローアップの管理、正確なSFDC記録の維持、AEや社内チームとの連携によるタスクの進行能力を備えている。
  • コミュニケーション能力：日本語での顧客、同僚、および部門横断的な関係者と明確にコミュニケーションできる能力。ビジネスレベルの英語力があれば尚可。
  • 成長の可能性：積極的で粘り強く、チームワークを重視する人物であり、将来的にはエンタープライズアカウントエグゼクティブの役割へと成長していく意欲のある方。

エンタープライズセールスとしてのキャリアを築きアジアにおけるインフラの未来を共に創り上げませんか。秘密厳守でキャリア相談を承りますので、ぜひご応募ください。

job.title: Vice President, Power Procurement
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Our mission is to build the foundation for the world’s digital future, helping organizations to grow sustainably and empowering the populations they serve. We differentiate through execution – delivering at speed and at scale while combining global standards with deep local expertise. This enables us to provide consistent, sustainable and high-performance infrastructure for hyperscalers and enterprises across the region.

As Asia Pacific’s digital transformation accelerates, Digital Edge is building the infrastructure that powers the next wave of AI and cloud growth. Joining Digital Edge means being part of a high-growth platform at the forefront of AI and cloud infrastructure, where you can make a tangible impact on Asia-Pacific’s digital future.

Our values:

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

Reporting to the Chief Investment and Commercial Officer, the VP, Power Procurement will spearhead the power procurement strategy & contracts across our operations in Asia, integration of renewable energy solutions and support the renewable requirements of hyperscale & cloud customers. The role demands proficiency in procuring power directly from utility grids, acquiring renewable energy through Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs), Virtual Power Purchase Agreements (VPPAs), and other innovative structures. This position is based in Singapore.

Key Responsibilities

1) Grid Power Procurement – Operational & Development Support

  • Develop and implement comprehensive strategies to secure reliable and cost-efficient electricity supply for data centers in multiple markets across Asia Pacific.
  • Support local operations teams in the negotiations with utility providers and local suppliers to procure conventional (i.e., “grid”) power for both operational facilities and new developments.
  • Work closely with the Corporate Development team on new site selection, power due diligence, energization schedule and business plan modelling
  • Drive utility interface, quota negotiations, and execution of energy supply agreements and partner closely with the in-country teams.
  • Provide guidance on securing energy quota and capacity to support site selection and development timelines.
  • Ensure compliance with local energy procurement regulations and internal governance standards.

2) Renewable Power & Storage – Transition Strategy & Execution

  • Drive the adoption of energy solutions, including PPAs, VPPAs, on-site renewables, and battery storage, to meet company-wide ESG and sustainability targets.
  • Identify and implement hybrid renewable power strategies tailored to each market, whether as sole offtaker or in partnership with customer-driven initiatives.
  • Develop a long-term sustainability roadmap, monitor energy market trends, and identify cost-saving or innovation-driven procurement opportunities.
  • Build and manage relationships with renewable energy developers, aggregators, and other key ecosystem partners throughout key markets in Asia Pacific.
  • Track and report on renewable procurement KPIs including carbon intensity, cost performance, and renewable energy adoption.

3) Hyperscale & Cloud Customer Engagement – Renewable Commitments

  • Collaborate with the CCIO and hyperscale sales teams to engage directly with cloud and hyperscale customers on their renewable energy goals.
  • Lead or support negotiations of renewable energy commitments and ensure timely and accurate execution of agreed solutions.
  • Translate customer sustainability objectives / requirements into actionable procurement strategies that align with both regulatory frameworks and our internal power procurement roadmap.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure delivery of renewable energy in line with customer contract terms and reporting needs.

**

**

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Energy Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience in electricity procurement, energy negotiations, and renewable energy acquisition within the Asia Pacific region.
  • Successful candidates will likely come from a similar role within a grid operator, DC platform, infrastructure, renewable Energy or adjacent industry
  • Proven expertise in structuring and negotiating PPAs, VPPAs, and other renewable energy instruments.
  • Strong knowledge of energy markets, regulations, and sustainability practices in the Asia Pacific region.
  • Exceptional negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Analytical mindset with a keen attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated commitment to sustainability and environmental stewardship.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast-growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you!

job.title: System Planning Manager
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Systems Planning Manager for Managed WiFi Services is responsible for the strategic planning, engineering, lifecycle management, and governance of the centralized WiFi service platform and supporting headend infrastructure. The role drives technology evaluation and proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives with key vendors, while working closely with architecture, product management, global competencies, technical pre-sales, and other stakeholders to establish service standards and technology roadmaps.

The incumbent provides technical leadership for platform deployment, feature development, and continuous service enhancement to ensure a secure, scalable, and high-performing WiFi environment. Responsibilities include managing technology lifecycle activities, knowledge transfer, product communications (including End-of-Life notifications), and advanced technical support for complex incidents and escalations (Level 3 and Level 4). The role also leads engineering, capacity planning, and security initiatives to maintain service reliability and support business growth.

Make an impact by:

  • Responsible for the design and build of the managed Wifi Services platforms and Infrastructure
  • Responsible Technologies Proof-of-Concept with principal vendors and supporting Proof-of-Value with customers.
  • Support product management team in defining and coordinating the scope of works with various stakeholders like Architecture Offices, Global Competencies, Product Management, Technical Pre-sale, Global Fulfillment, Global Competencies and so on.
  • Working closely with principal partners for technology knowledge transfer and technology notice broadcast such as End of Life or End of Sale i.e Release Life Cycle Management
  • Responsible for new features development, regression testing, verification checks and ensuring compliance to design specifications.
  • Providing Level 3 & 4 support with principal platform partner over bug or software escalation
  • Managing of Capex/Opex and assets management, ensuring project deliverables.
  • Responsible for technical planning, network/security engineering, and project management/coordination
  • Responsible for providing technical procedures, configuration standards, playbooks and knowledge-based documentation.

job.title: Category Lead – Tech Services, Bangalore
job.description:
IND | Bangalore | Level 10, CITRINE Block, WTC-4, Bagmane World Technology Center

Full time

J0107512

At Iron Mountain we know that work, when done well, makes a positive impact for our customers, our employees, and our planet. That’s why we need smart, committed people to join us. Whether you’re looking to start your career or make a change, talk to us and see how you can elevate the power of your work at Iron Mountain.

We provide expert, sustainable solutions in records and information management, digital transformation services, data centers, asset lifecycle management, and fine art storage, handling, and logistics. We proudly partner every day with our 225,000 customers around the world to preserve their invaluable artifacts, extract more from their inventory, and protect their data privacy in innovative and socially responsible ways.

Are you curious about being part of our growth stor​y while evolving your skills in a culture that will welcome your unique contributions? If so, let's start the conversation.

Job Summary

Iron Mountain is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented, and experienced Category Lead to join our Global Procurement team . In this role, you will be responsible for executing the global category strategy for Business Process Outsourcing and Technology Services, managing complex end-to-end sourcing projects, and transforming vendor relationships into high-value partnerships.

You will join a high-impact Global Procurement function reporting directly to the Head of Outsourced and Technology Services Procurement, serving as a trusted partner to global business leaders.

What You’ll Do

In this role, you will:

  • Category Strategy & Sourcing Execution: Execute the global Business Process Outsourcing and Information Technology Services category roadmap, managing Request for Proposals (RFx), negotiating Master Services Agreements (MSAs) and Statements of Work (SOWs), and optimizing overall spend to deliver best-in-class commercial structures.
  • Stakeholder & Performance Collaboration: Collaborate with Global Business Services, Information Technology, Operations, and executive leadership to align procurement strategies with organizational goals while managing supplier performance through clear Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
  • Risk Management & Compliance: Ensure compliance with Iron Mountain’s rigorous organizational standards, policies, and data privacy regulations by partnering with Legal and Risk teams to mitigate global outsourcing risks.

What You’ll Bring

The ideal candidate will have:

  • 6-10 years of progressive experience in Procurement and Category Management within a global organization, including at least 3 to 4 years focused on Technology and Outsourcing services .
  • Strong knowledge of Technology Services pricing mechanics, complex contractual frameworks, market trends, spend analysis, and financial modeling.
  • Proven ability in strategic vendor management, complex contract negotiations, change leadership, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration.
  • Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) degree or Master of Business Administration (MBA); Chartered Institute of Procurement & Supply (CIPS) certification is highly preferred.

Category: Finance

Iron Mountain is a global leader in storage and information management services trusted by more than 225,000 organizations in 60 countries. We safeguard billions of our customers’ assets, including critical business information, highly sensitive data, and invaluable cultural and historic artifacts. Take a look at our history here.

Iron Mountain helps lower cost and risk, comply with regulations, recover from disaster, and enable digital and sustainable solutions, whether in information management, digital transformation, secure storage and destruction, data center operations, cloud services, or art storage and logistics. Please see our Values and Code of Ethics for a look at our principles and aspirations in elevating the power of our work together.

If you have a physical or mental disability that requires special accommodations, please let us know by sending an email to accommodationrequest@ironmountain.com. See the Supplement to learn more about Equal Employment Opportunity.

job.title: Engine Field Service Technician - Level II
job.description:
Being part of Cummins means working alongside today’s most innovative thinkers to solve the world’s toughest problems. We are proud to offer learning and development opportunities designed to promote individual performance and spark purpose and trust within our teams. We look to hire the best and then help you to become even better. Thank you for your interest in continuing to grow your Cummins career!

We are looking for a talented Engine Field Service Technician, Level II to join our team in Johor Bahru, Malaysia. This will be following Onsite work model.

Diagnoses and completes less complex repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

Key Responsibilities

In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Engages customers in a courteous and professional manner.
  • Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs. Applies the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete less complex repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools.
  • Performs preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field.
  • Escalates unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor.
  • Completes required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identifies additional service opportunities with customer.
  • Completes training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintains service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Develops talent - Developing people to meet both their career goals and the organization’s goals.
  • Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.
  • Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Preferred)
  • Vocational diploma from relevant technical institution
  • Locally valid driving permit
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.
  • Basic level field service work experience
  • Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Customer service experience
  • Experience with electronic engines and PowerGen applications will be an added advantage

job.title: Client Project Supervisor
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Client Project Supervisor is responsible for managing the successful delivery of client projects from initiation through completion. The role ensures project objectives are achieved within agreed scope, schedule, budget, quality, and governance requirements while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibility

Project Delivery:

  • Manage the end-to-end delivery of client projects from planning through execution and handover.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  • Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions as required.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, and vendors.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for assigned projects.
  • Facilitate project meetings and ensure timely communication of project updates, risks, and decisions.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

Commercial & Financial Management:

  • Support project budgeting, forecasting, cost management, and financial reporting activities.
  • Monitor project expenditures and ensure effective budget control.
  • Support procurement activities, contractor engagement, and contract administration processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve project cost efficiency and value delivery.

Risk & Governance:

  • Identify, assess, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies, procedures, and governance requirements.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and records.
  • Escalate significant project risks and issues in a timely manner.

Quality & Compliance:

  • Ensure project deliverables meet agreed quality and operational requirements.
  • Coordinate reviews, inspections, testing, and project handover activities where applicable.
  • Support adherence to health, safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements.
  • Capture lessons learned and contributed to continuous improvement initiatives.

Reporting & Communication:

  • Prepare and maintain project status reports and dashboards.
  • Provide regular updates on project milestones, risks, budgets, and schedules.
  • Communicate project performance and key outcomes to stakeholders and management.

Knowledge and Attributes:

Project Management:

  • Strong understanding of project management principles, methodologies, and delivery frameworks.
  • Experience managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk.

Operations Knowledge:

  • Moderate understanding of Electrical and Mechanical systems and associated building infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with facility operations, maintenance activities, and operational requirements.
  • Ability to effectively collaborate with Operations and Engineering teams during project delivery.
  • Understanding of operational risks and impacts associated with project implementation

Stakeholder Management:

  • Strong influencing, collaboration, and negotiation skills.

Communication:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Detail-oriented with excellent communication and coordination skills

Customer Focus:

Team Player:

  • Ability to work collaboratively across functions and geographies.

Academic Qualifications, Certifications & Required experience:

  • Proficiency in written and spoken English is mandatory.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant project management experience in data center client and facilities projects
  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Project Management, or related discipline.
  • PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent certification is desirable.
  • Experience managing vendors, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders.
  • Experience working in regional or multinational environments is advantageous.
  • Additional beneficial certifications such as CDCP etc.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Sr. CSM, HCLS, AWSI India, AWS Industries, India CSM team
job.description:
Are you passionate about shaping the future of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) services industry through the translation of a customer vision into actions that realize long-term value through innovation? Do you have the business and technical acumen to earn trust with business executives and project team members alike? Are you a savvy problem solver motivated to surprise and delight customers and advocate on their behalf? If yes, then we would love to talk to you.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Customer Solutions Manager (CSM) to come join our Global HCLS Services team to work with one or more of our largest HCLS services industry customers. CSMs help customers realize sustained business value by accelerating their cloud transformation journey.

Global HCLS Services CSMs are trusted advisors, applying experience and industry thought leadership to help customers realize the transformative value of inventing and building in the cloud.

Customer Influence – CSMs build the relationships needed in order to understand the customer, their business context, and their strategic goals in order to proactively guide and mitigate risks in their cloud journey.

Focus on Excellence – We take pride in leveraging the knowledge and expertise of our team in support of customer delivery, and celebrate the enhanced impact we have by bringing the best of AWS and partners in solutioning for customers.

Overcome Complexity through Agility – CSMs bring clarity to complexity. We evangelize experience-based learning and an iterative approach to demonstrate results and value early. job.title: Partner Development Specialist, Data, Amazon Partner Organization
job.description:
Are you passionate about building a thriving partner ecosystem that helps customers unlock the full potential of their data? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Data Partner Development Specialist (PDS) to join our India Amazon Partner Organization (APO) team. In this role, you will be the partner-facing authority on AWS Data and Analytics services — including Amazon Redshift, Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, AWS Glue, Amazon MSK and Amazon S3 Vectors — driving partner capability development, co-sell execution, and go-to-market (GTM) scale across the India market.

As a Data PDS, you will work directly with consulting, technology, and ISV partners to build differentiated data practices and offerings on AWS. You will enable partners to solve complex customer data challenges — from petabyte-scale data lakes and real-time streaming pipelines to enterprise data warehouse modernization — and drive measurable customer outcomes through partner-led and partner-attached motions. You will collaborate with AWS account teams, specialist SAs, services leadership, and partner programs to accelerate partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, increase partner attach rates, and shape the future of the AWS data partner ecosystem in India.

Key job responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary partner development lead for AWS Data and Analytics services across consulting, technology, and ISV partners in India.
  • Identify, recruit, and develop partners with strong data capabilities, enabling them to build scalable practices around AWS data lake, data warehouse, streaming, and analytics services.
  • Drive partner-sourced and partner-attached pipeline by co-developing GTM plans, joint value propositions, and co-sell motions with priority partners.
  • Enable partners through technical readiness programs — including workshops, bootcamps, proof-of-concept (PoC) frameworks, and certification drives — to deepen their AWS data competencies.
  • Collaborate with AWS Specialist SAs, account teams, and services teams to identify customer opportunities where partner engagement accelerates time-to-launch and improves outcomes especially with the AI team.
  • Develop and execute joint business plans with strategic data partners, tracking key metrics such as partner attach rate, launched ARR, and customer impact.
  • Work with AWS Partner Programs (e.g., competency programs, funding mechanisms, AWS Marketplace) to help partners access the right development and GTM support levers.
  • Provide partner and field feedback to AWS product teams to influence service roadmaps and drive feature adoption relevant to the India partner ecosystem.
  • Support competitive positioning by equipping partners with differentiation narratives against on-premises and third-party analytics platforms.
  • Deliver thought leadership through partner summits, blog posts, case studies, and community engagement to elevate the AWS data partner brand in India.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
  • 10+ years of experience in partner development, business development, alliance management, or channel sales in the technology/cloud industry.
  • Demonstrated experience building and scaling partner practices or GTM motions in the data, analytics, or AI/ML domain.
  • Strong understanding of data architectures — data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, streaming, and analytics platforms. Good understanding of how data is the foundation to an Agentic AI paradigm.
  • Experience managing joint business plans, partner pipeline, and co-sell execution with measurable revenue outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
  • Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

job.title: Software Development Manager, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
job.description:
Role Overview

As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.

Strategic Ownership

  • Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
  • Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
  • Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
  • Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making.

Technical Domain Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:

  • Real-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
  • AI/ML-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1,400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
  • Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels.
  • Multi-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML).
  • Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.

People Leadership

  • Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
  • Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
  • Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
  • Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.

Customer & Operational Excellence

  • Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
  • Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.
  • Ensure your team adheres to SLAs and effectively manages software operations.
  • Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks. Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders.

Deliver Results

  • Consistently deliver software with minimal defects and system disruption.
  • Improve the quality of software owned by your team and operational performance metrics under your leadership.
  • Communicate ideas effectively, both verbally and in writing, to all types of audiences — from engineering peers to senior leadership.

A day in the life Strategic Vision & Roadmap Define the strategic vision for your team within the supply chain domain — whether that's demand planning, fulfillment optimization, manufacturing observability, or capacity planning Establish and execute a roadmap that aligns with the end-to-end supply chain lifecycle, translating business needs into engineering deliverables Make crisp, independent decisions about project prioritization, balancing competing demands across systems like RP3, Fulfillment Planner, Build Planner, and Control Tower Author narratives, PR/FAQs, and strategic documents to drive alignment with leadership and stakeholders Technical Delivery & Operational Excellence Deliver high-quality software consistently with minimal defects and system disruption across large-scale distributed systems processing millions of events daily Manage software operations effectively — ensuring uptime, reliability, and performance for systems tracking 100K+ active demands Define and monitor metrics for team development progress, customer experience, and operational excellence (e.g., stage dwell times, on-track/off-track KPIs, manufacturing output trends) Drive continuous improvement — improve software quality and operational performance metrics under your leadership People Management & Development Independently manage a team of SDEs — hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals Assess SDE performance and manage both high and low performers with effective action Hire, develop, and promote SDEs — build a talent pipeline and export talent across the organization Delegate appropriately — assign tasks based on individual strengths and development objectives, stretching engineers into areas like AI/ML forecasting, optimization engines, and real-time observability Customer Engagement & Stakeholder Management Partner effectively with customers and stakeholders — internal service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, GSMs, manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and logistics operators Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to evolving supply chain needs Define metrics to measure customer experience across the fulfillment pipeline — from Purchase Request through Handoff Risk Management & Escalation Proactively identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, and stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks Know when to escalate to Senior Leaders — especially critical in a domain where delays in manufacturing, material shortages, or DC readiness issues can cascade across the global fleet Ensure your team adheres to SLAs across all systems and operational commitments Culture & Process Build an effective development process that enables sustainable, high-quality delivery Use mechanisms, not good intentions — establish trust-and-verify systems for operational excellence, code quality, and team health Drive root cause analysis — instill a culture of asking "5 whys," fixing to root cause, and adding missing metrics after incidents

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of engineering team management experience
  • 7+ years of engineering experience
  • 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
  • Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
  • Experience partnering with product or program management teams
  • Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. We're the people who keep the cloud running — supporting all AWS data centers and the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on.

We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II to join our Infrastructure Supply Chain team, building large-scale distributed systems that power one of the world's most complex physical supply chains. Our systems manage hundreds of thousands of rack demands annually across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions — from demand forecasting and material planning to manufacturing execution, logistics, and data center deployment.

These are greenfield projects offering a rare opportunity to build systems from the ground up using modern technologies including reactive microservices, serverless computing, and distributed NoSQL data stores.

What You'll Do

Design and build highly scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems that support the end-to-end infrastructure supply chain — spanning demand planning, fulfillment, manufacturing, logistics, and DC readiness Solve complex architecture and business problems, delivering extensible solutions that operate at AWS scale Write high-quality, modular, functional, and testable code with a focus on operational excellence Collaborate with cross-functional teams including supply chain planners, hardware engineers, and operations managers to translate business requirements into technical solutions Formally mentor junior engineers on system design, coding best practices, and troubleshooting Contribute to the full software development lifecycle — from design and code reviews through testing, deployment, and operations Drive innovation in areas such as demand forecasting, supply optimization, and end-to-end observability through the Infrastructure Control Tower Basic Qualifications 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture experience (design patterns, reliability, and scaling) of new and existing systems Experience programming with at least one modern software programming language (Java, Python, TypeScript, or equivalent) Strong understanding of fundamental algorithms, data structures, and system design principles

Preferred Qualifications

3+ years of full software development lifecycle experience, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations Experience building distributed systems, microservices architectures, or event-driven platforms at scale Familiarity with AWS services (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, Step Functions, ECS/EKS) Experience with supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing domain systems Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent

Why Join Us

Greenfield opportunity — Build from scratch with technologies and define the architecture from day one Massive scale — Work on systems that manage 130+ hardware categories, global manufacturing partners (Jabil, Foxconn, Quanta), and data center deployments worldwide High impact — Every rack you help deliver powers the AWS services that millions of customers depend on Career growth — Endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and career-advancing resources to help you grow into a senior technical leader About the Team We value diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. We value work-life harmony and strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique.

Key job responsibilities The Key Job Responsibilities section now covers 10 areas:

Design & Build Scalable Systems — end-to-end supply chain applications Solve Complex Architecture Problems — translating ambiguous requirements into solutions Write Production-Quality Code — modular, testable, operationally excellent Own the Full Development Lifecycle — design through production, including on-call Build Supply Chain Domain Expertise — S&OP, VMI, SFGs, fulfillment pipeline, DC readiness Contribute to System Design & Technical Strategy — design reviews, architecture decisions Mentor & Develop Junior Engineers — formal mentorship of SDE Is Collaborate Cross-Functionally — work with planners, hardware engineers, PMs globally Drive Operational Excellence — monitoring, alerting, runbooks, proactive risk mitigation Innovate & Automate — ML-powered forecasting, intelligent observability, automation

About the team As an SDE II on the Infrastructure Supply Chain team, your typical day will include a mix of deep technical work, collaboration, and continuous learning:

Morning Stand-up & Sprint Planning — Start the day with your agile team to review progress, discuss blockers, and align on sprint priorities across supply chain workstreams Design & Architecture Sessions — Participate in or lead design reviews for new features — such as a new fulfillment pipeline stage tracker or a demand forecasting data ingestion service Heads-Down Coding — Spend focused blocks writing, refactoring, and testing code for distributed microservices, serverless functions, and API integrations that power supply chain workflows Code Reviews — Review pull requests from teammates, providing constructive feedback on design patterns, edge cases, performance, and operational readiness Debugging & Troubleshooting — Investigate production issues using CloudWatch dashboards, X-Ray traces, and Control Tower observability tools to identify root causes and deploy fixes Cross-Team Collaboration — Join working sessions with supply chain planners, hardware engineers, or logistics teams to clarify requirements, demo features, or align on data contracts Mentoring — Pair-program with junior engineers, walk through design approaches on a whiteboard, or review their design documents to help them grow technically Operational Reviews — Monitor service health metrics, review alarms, update runbooks, and participate in weekly operational excellence reviews to maintain a high availability bar Documentation & Knowledge Sharing — Write or update design documents, API specs, and wiki pages; present tech talks or brown-bag sessions to share learnings with the broader team Innovation & Experimentation — Dedicate time to explore new approaches — prototyping an ML-based anomaly detector for dwell time spikes, evaluating a new AWS service for event-driven workflows, or contributing to team hackathon projects

Basic Qualifications

  • 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
  • 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
  • Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred Qualifications

  • 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

job.description:
AWS is seeking an exceptional Deal Pursuit Leader to drive our most consequential transformational opportunities across our largest enterprise accounts. This is a high-intensity, time-bound pursuit role with a singular objective: to close $100M+ Total Contract Value (TCV) deals, within a twelve-month sprint across a portfolio of strategically selected accounts. You will operate at the intersection of business development, executive relationship management, complex deal orchestration, and cross-functional leadership, answering one question every day: what must happen today to move these deals forward?

Key job responsibilities

  • Own and drive a portfolio of mega-deal pursuits across APJC’s most strategic enterprise customers.
  • Orchestrate 10+ cross-functional stakeholders including AWS Industry Specialists, GTM Specialists, Pan-Amazon Strategic Business Development, Solution Architects, Strategic Contracts team, Cloud Economics teams and AWS Partners through complex deal cycles.
  • Drive Think Big during Prospecting and Qualification stages, identifying transformational outcomes tailored to each customer’s unique business context, that helps achieve CEO / LOB CxO leader’s business transformation objectives, and for AWS unlocks deal sizes beyond what incremental consumption growth would deliver.
  • Build and own C-suite executive relationships with customer decision-makers, developing trust-based partnerships that reimagine existing relationships beyond consumption-based pricing.
  • Leading the weekly deal-room cadence, run by deal execution leads, maintaining rigorous deal execution discipline with clear progression gates at 60-day, 120-day, and 180-day marks.
  • Make decisive go/no-go calls — if an account has not reached Technical Validation stage by day 90, execute pivot triggers and rotate in pre-qualified replacement accounts to maintain three active pursuits at all times.
  • Deliver monthly business reviews to APJC senior leadership with clear deal progression metrics, risk assessments, and acceleration recommendations.

About the team AWS’s APJC Strategic Enterprise Sales team serves the top strategic enterprise customers across Asia-Pacific, Japan, and Greater China. This role is central to an initiative that will drive APJC’s top-account growth rate - unlocking the next wave of growth across our most consequential customer relationships. You will report directly into APJC Enterprise Sales leadership and operate with full executive sponsorship from APJC senior leaders.

Amazon Web Services is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneer cutting-edge technologies in AI, machine learning, compute, storage, and database services that help organizations of every size transform their businesses. At AWS, you will work backwards from the customer, think big, and have the opportunity to shape the future of cloud computing across the world’s most dynamic markets.

Basic Qualifications

  • 12+ years of enterprise sales, business development, or strategic deal pursuit experience in technology or cloud services.
  • Demonstrated track record of personally closing or directly leading the close of deals valued at $50M+ TCV.
  • Experience orchestrating large, cross-functional deal teams (7+ stakeholders) through complex, multi-month enterprise sales cycles.
  • Proven track record leading AI-driven transformation initiatives within 1-2 major industries across Gaming & Media, Manufacturing, Semi-Conductors, Financial Services, Telco and Conglomerates.
  • Experience working with C-suite executives at Fortune 500 / Nikkei 225 equivalent enterprises.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of at least 1 major industry and existing relationships across Gaming & Media, Manufacturing, Semi-Conductors, Financial Services, Telco and Conglomerates.
  • Track record of converting consumption-based cloud relationships into large committed-spend contracts.
  • Experience with AI/ML GTM strategy, including generative AI, inference workloads, and enterprise AI transformation.
  • Familiarity with cloud service providers’ market value proposition
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree.
