job.title: Associate Manager - Cell Maintenance
job.description:
Responsibilities

Safety Compliance:

  • Ensure that all maintenance procedures for PERC technology comply with safety standards and protocols, focusing on handling and processing sensitive components like passivation layers.

Innovation:

  • Driving continuous improvement by leading R&D efforts to develop advanced solar technologies and identifying market trends to maintain a competitive edge.

Digitalization/Data-Driven Decision Making:

  • Overseeing the implementation of digital tools and smart technologies to optimize manufacturing processes and enhance data-driven decision-making across the organization.

Leadership in Change Management:

  • Leading effective change management strategies to guide the organization through transitions, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and technologies.

People Development:

  • Leading from the front & being accountable for the professional growth of your teams. Developing/conducting/promoting training & learning initiatives to enhance skills & empowering them to take ownership of key processes and decisions.

PERC Technology Management:

  • Oversee maintenance operations specifically for PERC (Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell) solar cells, focusing on the unique aspects of this technology, such as passivation layers and rear surface treatment.

Issue Diagnosis and Repair:

  • Address and resolve issues related to PERC cell performance, including troubleshooting problems with passivation layers, rear surface contact, and overall cell efficiency.

Preventive Maintenance:

  • Develop and execute preventive maintenance schedules tailored to the specific needs of PERC cells, such as ensuring the integrity of the passivation layer and rear contacts.

Quality Assurance:

  • Ensure that maintenance practices uphold the high standards required for PERC cells. Perform detailed inspections to verify the condition of passivation layers and rear surface contacts..

CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions):

  • Identify and address specific issues affecting PERC cells, such as degradation of passivation layers or rear contact problems, and implement corrective and preventive measures to enhance cell performance.

Team Leadership:

  • Lead and coordinate the maintenance team in handling PERC cells, providing specific guidance on handling and maintaining passivation and rear contact systems.

Performance Monitoring:

  • Track performance indicators specific to PERC cells, such as efficiency metrics and degradation rates of passivation layers, to optimize maintenance strategies and improve cell longevity.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Production Team
  • Engineering Department
  • Quality Assurance Team
  • Operations Management

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • PERC Equipment Manufacturers
  • Spare Parts Suppliers
  • Technical Consultants
  • External Auditors

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

Work Experience (Range of years):

  • 12-14 Years of experience in cell maintenance, with specific experience in PERC technology.

job.title: Buyer HO
job.description:
Responsibilities

Purchase Requisition (PR) Review:

Aid in the review of approved Purchase Requests (PR) from the user department; Assist in determining the procurement type and method.

Strategic Sourcing:

Choose the bidding process and develop vendor selection methods and evaluation criteria based on the category.Create the Request for Information (RFI) document for evaluating bidders; Develop commercial estimates using standardized templates and assess technical and commercial proposals. Engage in fact-based negotiations or e-auctions with shortlisted bidders. Draft the Note for Approval (NFA) for the selected bidder and secure necessary approvals as per the Delegation of Authority (DoA).

Contract Management:

Establish and maintain approved contract records within the ERP system, ensuring adherence to system functionalities and policies. Draft, review, and issue rate contracts based on approved decisions. Formulate master outline agreements (OA) in the ERP system based on rate contracts. Generate Purchase Orders (PO) or Sales Orders (SO) for procurement under valid rate contracts.

Post Order Management:

Expedite the delivery of ordered materials to ensure timely arrival. Create Change Orders or Amendments to orders, including adjustments in quantity/rate, additional items, and time extensions. Oversee inbound logistics services for other Ex-Works domestic supplies. Implement contingency plans in response to immediate business needs. Provide assistance to the operations team in managing resources effectively.

Supplier Management:

Formulate vendor evaluation criteria and a vendor segmentation matrix based on annual spending and associated risks. Establish vendor performance evaluation criteria and determine evaluation frequency for each vendor segment. Foster strategic partnerships with suppliers/vendors to benefit Adani from a long-term perspective and leverage them for business value additions.

Documentation & Reporting:

Assist in gathering and analyzing data related to various procurement activities (e.g., commodity analysis, supplier debugging) for respective categories. Identify and pursue efficiency and value improvement opportunities through data analysis. Support action planning and implementation based on data analytics for assigned categories.

Quality Assurance:

Ensure all procured materials and services meet the required quality standards and specifications. Work with the quality control team to address and resolve any quality-related issues with suppliers.

Digital Mindset:

Keep up with digital and AI advancements to enhance business and maintain competitiveness.

Team Development:

Promote a respectful and safe workplace, lead collaborative and productive teams, and mentor for growth and success.Offer guidance, support, and mentorship to team members, facilitating their development and success while maintaining high morale and motivation.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

Site Techno-Commercial Head

Site Buyers

Projects, O&M, Quality and other departments

Finance & Accounts team, Quality/User/Engg Team

Direct Reportees

Key Stakeholders - External:

Customs Handling Agents, Customs Authority, Government Officials, Vendors, Logistics providers

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in engineering in any discipline. MBA qualification will be most preferred.

Work Experience:

3-5 years of experience in supply chain management, procurement, contracts and related area

job.title: Deputy Manager - Environment
job.description:
Responsibilities

Ecological Survey and Monitoring:

Conduct seasonal surveys of terrestrial flora and fauna within a 10 km vicinity of power station, ensuring comprehensive data collection and analysis.

Perform extensive monitoring of avifauna and interpret terrestrial ecology data using various diversity indices to assess ecological health.

Prepare and submit half-yearly terrestrial ecological survey reports, detailing findings and providing insights for ecological management.

Coordinate with the horticulture department for the development and tracking of green zones, aligning with Environmental clearance conditions.

Ecological Reporting and Regulatory Adherence:

Coordinate, collect data, and submit Annual Terrestrial Ecology reports for other operational sites of APL, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

At the site level, manage the collection and submission of data for sustainability reporting, addressing observations raised by auditors and providing necessary backups.

Oversee terrestrial-related ISO certifications, maintaining compliance with international standards and best practices.

Conduct assigned internal audits to ensure adherence to ecological and environmental policies and procedures.

Interact with statutory bodies like State forest departments, government offices, and institutions for data generation and authentication.

Plant Level Engagement and Safety:

Actively participate in plant-level functions such as safety and 5S initiatives, contributing to a culture of operational excellence and workplace organization.

Ensure the safety of business associates and equipment through proper training and adherence to safety protocols, minimizing risks and promoting a safe working environment.

Coordinate with external agencies for conducting Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) studies for upcoming projects, and thorough ecological evaluations.

Conduct training sessions for business associates on legal aspects related to terrestrial ecology, enhancing awareness and compliance.

Business Sustainability:

Ensure adherence to IMS, AWMS, DISHA and CHETNA guidelines within the department, promoting sustainable practices and compliance.

Lead initiatives to reduce environmental impact and promote biodiversity conservation, aligning with the company's sustainability goals.

Implement measures to enhance resource efficiency and reduce waste, contributing to the company's environmental stewardship.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimize operational efficiency, streamlining data collection and analysis processes.

Innovate and implement automation solutions to support overall organizational goals and strategy, enhancing ecological monitoring capabilities.

Review and implement process and system improvements, adopting newer technologies and innovative ideas to advance ecological assessment methods.

Drive the integration of advanced technology and digitization within the department, ensuring the use of cutting-edge tools for ecological surveys.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Master's degree in Ecology, Environmental Science, or a related field with a focus on terrestrial ecosystems/.PhD (preferred)

Work Experience (Range of years):

5+ years of relevant experience in ecological surveying, monitoring, and data analysis.

Preferred Industry:

Experience in the power sector or related industries with a strong background in environmental management and sustainability practices.

job.title: Assistant Manager - Project Overseas
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Process vendor invoices and ensure timely and accurate invoice verification, validation, and payment processing support.
  • Review contracts, commercial agreements, purchase orders, and supporting documentation during invoice processing to ensure compliance with business requirements, policies, and contractual terms.

  • Support SAP transactions related to Accounts Payable (AP) and associated commercial operations.
  • Maintain process documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and audit-compliant records to ensure process governance and knowledge continuity.
  • Ensure adherence to organizational policies, internal controls, compliance requirements, and agreed service-level commitments.
  • Support data extraction, compilation, and reporting from SharePoint and other systems to meet audit, taxation, and business reporting requirements.

Qualifications

  • Commerce Graduate
  • Advanced understanding of contracts and commercial agreements
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in AP / CAD / Billing functions
  • Basic knowledge of SAP
  • Basic proficiency in MS Excel
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, as the role requires regular interaction with Australian stakeholders

job.title: Manager - Engineering
job.description:
Responsibilities

Real-Time Monitoring of Turbine Operations

  • Monitor turbine operations in real-time using SCADA systems, tracking performance metrics such as power output, rotor speed, and grid connection status.
  • Identify and report deviations from normal operating parameters, coordinating with the SCADA lead for further analysis and corrective actions.

Alarm Response and Incident Reporting

  • Respond to alarms generated by the SCADA system, following predefined protocols to assess, document, and escalate incidents as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records of incidents, actions taken, and outcomes to support continuous improvement and compliance reporting.

Data Logging and Analysis

  • Perform data logging and initial analysis of turbine performance data, identifying patterns that may indicate emerging issues or optimization opportunities.
  • Support detailed analysis by preparing data sets and reports for use by engineering teams in root cause analysis and troubleshooting.

System Health Checks and Maintenance Support

  • Conduct regular system health checks to ensure all SCADA components are functioning correctly, including sensors, communication links, and control interfaces.
  • Assist in basic maintenance tasks such as resetting alarms, recalibrating sensors, and updating software as directed by the SCADA lead.

Cybersecurity Compliance and Data Integrity

  • Adhere to cybersecurity protocols within the SCADA environment, ensuring data security and integrity are maintained at all times.
  • Report any suspicious activity or security breaches to the SCADA lead, supporting efforts to safeguard system operations.

Compliance with Operating Procedures

  • Follow all standard operating procedures for SCADA monitoring, including guidelines for alarm management, data handling, and communication with other departments.
  • Participate in regular audits and training sessions to ensure compliance with industry standards and internal policies.

Support for Troubleshooting Activities

  • Assist in troubleshooting activities, providing real-time data and observations to support root cause analysis conducted by SCADA engineers.
  • Document findings and recommendations from troubleshooting activities to contribute to the development of improved response protocols.

Team Collaboration and Communication

  • Work closely with SCADA and operations teams to ensure coordinated responses to system events, sharing information and insights as needed.
  • Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders, including engineers, technicians, and management, to ensure smooth SCADA operations.

Continuous Learning and Development

  • Engage in training and professional development activities to enhance skills in SCADA monitoring, data analysis, and system troubleshooting.
  • Stay informed about updates to SCADA systems and industry best practices to maintain a high level of technical competence.

Contribution to Continuous Improvement

  • Provide feedback on SCADA system performance, alarm settings, and response procedures, suggesting improvements to enhance monitoring effectiveness.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives, supporting the SCADA team in implementing new technologies and optimizing system operations.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Lead - Grid Compliance

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • SCADA Equipment Vendors
  • Field Service Providers

Qualifications

Educational Background:

  • Diploma or BE in Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering.

Work Experience:

  • 1-3 years monitoring SCADA systems, managing system alerts, and assisting in incident response.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Familiarity with SCADA software, basic diagnostic tools, and understanding alarm response procedures.

job.title: Associate Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze large-scale operational and business datasets to identify trends, performance gaps, and improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking tools using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization platforms.

job.title: Assistant Manager - ESG
job.description:
Responsibilities

ESG Analyst

Planning and Execution:

  • Assist in executing the ESG strategy by collecting data on environmental, social, and governance metrics from various departments.
  • Coordinate the submission of monthly data from KPIs across departments, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.
  • Support the planning of sustainability initiatives by providing critical data inputs for environmental and governance frameworks.

Process Optimization and Continuous Improvement:

  • Identify areas for process improvements in data collection, ensuring efficiency and accuracy.
  • Recommend improvements in the existing ESG reporting system to optimize data flow and minimize errors.
  • Implement streamlined data processes to enhance integration between departments for better ESG performance.

HSE and Regulatory Compliance:

  • Ensure adherence to the Environmental Management System (EMS) by collecting data on regulatory compliance for air, water, waste, and safety.
  • Monitor compliance across departments and submit findings to regulatory authorities as required.
  • Review the data for consistency with regulatory requirements, providing input for necessary corrections.

Cost Management and Budgeting:

  • Track costs associated with ESG-related activities, ensuring that data collection and reporting processes are within budget.
  • Assist in budget planning for sustainability and governance projects by analyzing financial data related to ESG initiatives.
  • Identify cost-saving opportunities in the implementation of ESG programs.

Resource and Workforce Management:

  • Coordinate with departments to gather ESG-related data, ensuring all teams are aligned with reporting timelines.
  • Support ESG-related workforce planning by providing data insights for staff involved in sustainability and governance projects.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to manage resources for ESG reporting and compliance activities.

Reporting and Data Analytics:

  • Prepare monthly and quarterly ESG reports, including integrated and sustainability reports, using data collected from various departments.
  • Analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for environmental and governance aspects, identifying trends and areas of concern.
  • Contribute to the development of the governance framework by providing detailed data analysis and insights.

Digitization and Tech Adoption:

  • Utilize digital tools and software for ESG data collection and analysis, improving the efficiency of reporting processes.
  • Implement digital dashboards to track key ESG metrics in real-time, allowing for quicker decision-making.

Key Stakeholders - Internal:

  • Operations Team
  • Finance Team
  • Legal team
  • Secretarial

Key Stakeholders - External:

  • Regulatory Bodies
  • ESG Consultants
  • Environmental Auditors
  • Rating agencies

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

Bachelor's / master’s degree in environmental science, Sustainability, or related field

Work Experience (Range of years):

4-8 years in sustainability, ESG reporting, or data analysis roles

job.title: Deputy Manager- CBO office
job.description:
Responsibilities

Technical Assistant to Chief Business Officer(T1)

Operational Oversight and Compliance:

Evaluate and report on PR quantity, inventory, stock criticality, etc. to ensure operational efficiency.

job.title: SBU Head - Security & Intel.
job.description:
Responsibilities

Regional Security Head

Security Strategy & Governance:

Contribute to the Security Strategy and roadmap, aligning regional security initiatives with corporate policy.

Develop, manage, and monitor security budgets (Capex and Opex) and secure approvals in consultation with the Vertical Security Head.

Participate in governance meetings, reviewing ongoing initiatives, and suggesting improvements.

Security Risk Management & Audit:

Build relationships with local authorities and media to gather intelligence, assessing risks based on current events.

Conduct security risk assessments to identify vulnerabilities, ensuring timely mitigation of gaps in infrastructure, technology, and processes.

Coordinate internal and third-party audits, addressing findings promptly to maintain a reliable security management system.

Crisis & Incident Management:

Design and implement Emergency Response and Control Plans (ERCP) for crisis scenarios, ensuring preparedness and swift recovery.

Supervise Quick Reaction Team (QRT) readiness and refine response plans based on incident learnings.

Security Operations Management:

Monitor adherence to SOPs and SOGs, generating MIS reports for updates to Site CEO and Vertical Security Head.

Oversee Site Security Control Room operations, integrating with the National Security Control Room for seamless incident escalation.

Manage access control, visitor access, traffic flow, and ensure proper surveillance to maintain operational vigilance.

Investigation & Due Diligence:

Lead investigations into incidents such as theft, fraud, and vandalism, and implement corrective actions.

Report findings and provide insights into critical incidents to business units.

Protection & Performance Improvement:

Establish performance metrics for security functions and drive process improvement initiatives.

Conduct security events as per annual plans, ensuring robust protection protocols are maintained.

Outsourced Manpower Management:

Oversee recruitment, performance, and welfare of outsourced security staff, ensuring alignment with defined standards.

Lead recruitment for vacant positions, foster a performance-driven culture, and support talent identification for critical roles.

Project Management:

Drive projects focused on security technology implementation and infrastructure enhancement in line with group security standards.

Ensure seamless project integration into regional operations, engaging stakeholders for effective adoption.

job.title: Senior Manager - Techno Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

TCD Site In-charge (Opex) - Mining

Strategic Procurement and Supplier Management:

Coordinate procurement activities across sites, ensuring strategic planning and alignment with operational needs.

Identify, evaluate, and select suppliers to procure quality OPEX items, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to quality standards.

Manage supplier relationships to negotiate favorable terms and ensure continuous improvement in vendor performance.

Lead process improvement initiatives in purchasing, contract management, supplier selection, and sourcing to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.

Inventory Management:

Monitor and manage inventory levels to ensure availability of OPEX items, minimizing excess stock and obsolescence.

Conduct regular inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to maintain accurate records.

Determine optimal reorder points and quantities to prevent stockouts and ensure uninterrupted site operations.

Generate and analyze inventory reports to identify trends, forecast needs, and inform procurement decisions.

Review inventory levels periodically and take necessary actions to maintain optimal stock at all sites.

Financial and Budget Management:

Conduct cost analysis of procurement activities to identify savings opportunities and drive cost reduction initiatives.

Ensure procurement activities are within budgetary constraints and provide regular updates to management on budget status.

Manage buying processes efficiently, including RFPs, proposal evaluations, negotiations, vendor selection, and contract awards.

Prepare and issue purchase orders for required OPEX items, ensuring adherence to company policies and procedures.

Operational Coordination and Reporting:

Coordinate with site managers and operational teams to understand OPEX requirements and ensure timely delivery of needed items.

Address and resolve procurement or inventory issues to ensure smooth operational activities.

Manage urgent procurement requests to support unplanned operational needs and minimize downtime.

Attend to internal/external audit queries, provide data, and take corrective actions for observations received.

Review commercial/stores SOPs annually, make necessary changes, and update the revision.

Review Pending PRs status with team members and take necessary corrective actions, providing performance feedback.

Attend review meetings conducted by TCD Leads/site head/corporate and prepare necessary data and presentations on OPEX-related procurements and inventory.

Release all e-NFA documents after checking the support documents and follow up for timely approval.

Check and release New Vendor code, VC unblock, and GRN error in MDG portal.

Review reports on inventory stock at all sites and follow up with contractors for monthly consumption reports.

Compliance and Quality Assurance:

Ensure compliance with quality, legal, financial, and safety terms in OPEX purchase and service contracts.

Monitor material/service providers’ performance and take necessary action to bridge gaps and ensure timely renewal of contracts.

Manage all commercial processes and data as per IMS standards, update data, attend audits, and address observations.

Technology Integration:

Deploy digital tools for real-time monitoring and optimization of operational expenditures on site, enhancing cost efficiency and project outcomes.

Implement advanced digital solutions for managing site operations and resource allocation, ensuring effective and efficient use of operational resources.

job.title: Duty Manager - Terminal Operations
job.description:
Responsibilities

Terminal Operations Shift Management:

  • Oversees all terminal operations during the assigned shift, ensuring smooth passenger flow and on-time departures & coordinates with other departments for efficient operations.
  • Manages staff schedules and assignments to optimize resource utilization.

Lounge Management and Customer Service:

  • Delivers exceptional customer service by assisting passengers with their needs and resolving issues promptly & builds positive relationships with passengers to enhance the overall airport experience.
  • Assist in the management of reserved lounges, ensuring a high standard of service and a seamless experience for passengers.

Trolley Operations and Asset Management:

  • Oversee the management and maintenance of trolley operations, ensuring availability and cleanliness.
  • Assist in managing the asset lifecycle, including regular checks and prompt reporting of any defects or damages.

Golf Cart and Inter Terminal Coach Operations:

  • Coordinate the timely deployment and safe operation of golf carts and inter-terminal coaches.
  • Ensure service levels are met, track performance scores, and address any complaints or operational issues promptly.

Staff Supervision:

  • Provides leadership and guidance to the terminal operations team during the shift & monitors staff performance and addresses issues promptly.
  • Ensures adherence to operational procedures and standards among staff members.

Vendor Management:

  • Manage operational aspects related to vendor management, golf cart management, baggage and shopping trolley management, Baggage Handling System (BCS) management, and inter-terminal coach management to ensure smooth operations and enhancing passenger experience within terminal
  • Monitor vendor performance and address any discrepancies to maintain operational standards.

Problem Solving:

  • Identifies and resolves operational issues and challenges that arise during the shift & implements immediate solutions to minimize disruptions.
  • Collaborates with other departments to address complex issues and find effective solutions.

Emergency Response Management:

  • Lead emergency response efforts during shifts, effectively managing situations such as bomb threats, evacuations, medical emergencies, and other contingencies.
  • Ensure all actions are carried out in accordance with laid-down SOPs and conduct post-incident reviews for continuous improvement.

Special Events and VVIP Movements:

  • Support the coordination of special events, ensuring smooth execution, budgeting, and event calendar management.
  • Assist in planning and ensuring security arrangements for VVIP movements, including liaising with relevant authorities for smooth execution.

Safety and Security Compliance:

  • Ensures compliance with safety and security regulations and procedures during the shift & conducts safety checks and responds to incidents.
  • Coordinates with security personnel to address security concerns and maintain a safe environment.

Operational Efficiency:

  • Optimizes resource utilization during the shift to maximize efficiency and minimize costs & implements process improvements to enhance operational performance.
  • Monitors key performance indicators (KPIs) and takes corrective actions to improve performance.

Stakeholder Management:

  • Shift wise coordination will all regulatory agencies, airlines and ground handlers.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Supervise and manage the terminal operations team during shifts, ensuring high levels of employee engagement and discipline.
  • Identify training needs of employees and ensure team members participate in all mandatory classroom training sessions.

Lead - Terminal Operations

IT Department

Security Agencies

Minimum of 5-7 years of experience in airport terminal operations, with a strong focus on managing diverse stakeholders, optimizing passenger experience, and driving operational efficiency.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Land Survey
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Conducting Surveys and Measurements:

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

Measure and record the dimensions, elevations, and contours of mine workings and geological formations, ensuring all data is precise and reliable.

Utilize advanced surveying software to collect, analyze, and process survey data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

Developing and Maintaining Mine Plans:

Create and regularly update accurate mine plans, layouts, and sectional drawings that reflect the current state of mine workings and future development plans.

Ensure all mine plans and layouts comply with statutory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, facilitating smooth regulatory audits and inspections.

Collaborate with mining engineers, geologists, and mine management to adjust and optimize plans based on operational needs and geological findings.

Monitoring Geological Features:

Identify, record, and monitor geological formations, faults, and potential hazards within the mine, providing early warnings of any changes that could impact safety or operations.

Assist in the assessment of ground stability, roof conditions, and potential safety risks by providing accurate geological data and interpretations.

Support geological mapping and modeling efforts with precise survey data, aiding in the prediction and management of geological conditions.

Ensuring Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to all relevant mining regulations, safety standards, and environmental guidelines, ensuring that all surveying activities are conducted legally and ethically.

job.description:

Strategic Vision & Policy Development:

Define and lead the long-term vision for category procurement strategy and policy formulation across all Centers of Excellence (CoEs).

Ensure alignment of procurement objectives with overarching corporate goals, including cost efficiency, process standardization, and development of long-range planning frameworks.

Incorporate risk mitigation strategies, value engineering practices, and future-readiness into policy planning to create resilient and adaptable procurement practices.

Continuously analyze market trends and benchmark against industry standards to create policies and continuously align strategies with global procurement best practices informed procurement decisions and maintain competitive advantage.

Procurement Governance & Frameworks:

Establish governance structures, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and control mechanisms for centralized procurement processes across civil, electrical, mechanical, services, material categories and more.

Ensure comprehensive coverage across all procurement categories including civil, electrical, mechanical, services, and material purchases, while embedding standardization of specifications, documentation, and processes to enable consistency and scale.

Monitor and enforce compliance with sourcing strategies, policies and regulatory requirements across all business units and category teams.

Cost Optimization & Value Engineering:

Lead initiatives to deliver cost reduction and enhanced value creation by consolidating vendor base, leveraging economies of scale, and driving demand aggregation across businesses.

Promote long-term strategic planning, multi-year procurement visibility, and early supplier involvement to capture maximum commercial advantage.

Apply value engineering principles to optimize specifications and eliminate non-essential costs while maintaining functionality and performance.

Facilitate bulk procurement strategies, negotiate long-term contracts, and implement demand consolidation frameworks to unlock sustainable cost savings.

Sourcing & Contracting Strategy:

Design and implement robust sourcing strategies and contract frameworks that support centralized and decentralized buying models across business

Aggregate cross-business procurement needs and implement standardized sourcing and contracting strategies to maximize scale, efficiency, and commercial leverage.

Vendor Relationship Management:

Develop and nurture high-impact relationships with critical suppliers to drive supplier performance, innovation, and continuity of supply.

Oversee governance over vendor development programs, strategic partnerships, performance evaluations, and compliance audits to ensure alignment with organizational objectives.

Drive structured vendor development and engagement programs to build supplier capabilities and long-term collaboration.

Integration & Change Management:

Spearhead the integration of newly acquired businesses into the centralized procurement system, ensuring alignment of tools, processes, and reporting mechanisms.

Oversee transformation initiatives including the deployment of digital procurement platforms, adoption of new policies, and transitions in procurement categories or sourcing strategies.

Drive change management across stakeholders to ensure smooth adoption and sustained improvements.

Team Leadership & Capability Building:

Foster cross-functional collaboration by mentoring category leads, driving team synergy, and ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities.

Develop talent development through structured hiring, training programs, and capability-building initiatives aligned with future procurement needs.

Drive succession planning and organizational resilience within the Global Central Procurement (GCP) team.

Executive Reporting & External Engagement:

Serve as the primary representative of the GCP function in executive management reviews, external audits, and industry conferences or forums.

Ensure senior leadership is informed and aligned with procurement strategies, outcomes, and future plans.

18+ years of experience in strategic procurement, category management, and supply chain operations

Deep familiarity with procurement digital platforms like SAP, ARIBA, SLM, and e-auction tools

job.description:

Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

job.title: Senior Manager - Regulatory and Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead - Commercial (ERCG)

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

Finance Team

Corporate Affairs Team

Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Team

Fuel Management Team

Power Sales Team

Business Development (BD) Team

ABEX Team

Commercial Controller Team

Key Stakeholders - External

DISCOMs/Procurers

Regulatory Authorities

Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

job.title: Associate Manager- Cyber Security
job.description:
Responsibilities

IDAM Specialist

Identity Lifecycle Management:

Support the administration of identity lifecycle processes, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and access reviews.

Implement role-based access control (RBAC), user provisioning policies, and workflows across applications and systems.

Assist in maintaining an accurate inventory of user identities and associated access rights across the enterprise.

Authentication and Authorization Management:

Implement and manage authentication mechanisms such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Single Sign-On (SSO), and other access controls.

Assist with configuring and managing federated identity management solutions, ensuring smooth integration with cloud and on-premises applications.

Ensure that proper access control mechanisms are in place to provide secure, role-appropriate access to critical systems and data.

IAM Tool Support and Maintenance:

Assist in the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including tools like Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, SailPoint, or similar.

Provide technical support for IAM tools and applications, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating with vendors for escalated issues.

Perform regular system health checks, ensuring IAM tools and systems are performing optimally.

Access Reviews and Compliance:

Conduct regular access reviews to ensure compliance with the principle of least privilege and internal security policies.

Assist in ensuring that identity and access management practices are in compliance with relevant regulatory standards (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX).

Prepare reports on user access and permissions for internal audits and compliance requirements.

Incident Response and Support:

Assist in investigating and remediating incidents related to identity and access management, such as unauthorized access, privilege escalation, and account compromise.

Support the resolution of identity-related security incidents, escalating as needed to senior security staff or incident response teams.

Monitor logs and user activity for anomalous behavior, ensuring that any incidents are reported and addressed promptly.

Policy and Process Support:

Assist in the development, implementation, and enforcement of identity management policies, including user access management, authentication protocols, and access control rules.

Collaborate with other teams to implement best practices for managing identity across the organization’s IT infrastructure and cloud platforms.

Collaboration and Stakeholder Communication:

Work closely with IT, HR, compliance, and application teams to understand their requirements and ensure appropriate identity and access controls are in place.

Provide support and guidance to internal teams regarding identity management processes and policies.

Assist with user training and awareness programs on the importance of strong identity management and secure access controls.

Continuous Improvement:

Contribute to the ongoing improvement of identity and access management processes and tools to enhance efficiency, security, and user experience.

Stay up-to-date on industry trends and emerging technologies in the identity and access management space.

Participate in regular training and professional development activities to enhance technical skills and knowledge.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Head of Identity and Access Management (IDAM)

Business Unit Heads and Department Heads

Information Security and IT teams

IT and Network Operations Teams

Legal and Compliance Teams

Audit Teams

Human Resources (HR)

Key Stakeholders - External

Vendors and service providers of IAM solutions

Regulatory bodies

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

Certification:

Relevant certifications such as Certified Identity and Access Manager (CIAM)/ CompTIA Security+, or similar are a plus.

Experience with IAM tools and technologies such as RSA, One Identity, Net IQ, CyberArk, BeyondTrust, Okta, Microsoft Azure AD, SailPoint, or similar platforms with industry standards and regulations related to IAM, such as ISO 27001, NIST etc.

Strong knowledge of IAM technologies and best practices, including SSO, privileged access management (PAM), and user provisioning

Work Experience (Range of years):

5+ years of relevent experience working in Identity and Access Management (IDAM) roles.

job.title: Associate Manager - Regulatory & Commercial
job.description:
Responsibilities

Associate Manager - Regulatory & Commercial (ERCG)

Billing and Revenue Management:

Manage the comprehensive management of revenue, ensuring all billing activities in accordance with the SOP for Power Sale align with organizational financial objectives.

Collect necessary information and inputs for billing, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders.

Issue accurate and timely invoices to customers or power procurers

Monitor payments to ensure they are received by the due date.

Maintain and update all invoicing information on the Ministry of Power portal, responding to any disputes raised by customers.

Continuously monitor replies and communications within the portal.

Verify customer information and address anomalies if any to prevent delays.

Payment Tracking and Dispute Resolution:

Proactively track payments and initiate letters of credit (LC) to encash funds when payments are delayed.

In the event of a dispute, ensure that customers pay 85% of the invoice amount as per contract, providing justification for the payment.

Manage stay orders from the regulatory committee, waiting for resolutions before proceeding with collections.

Communicate with banks regarding payment statuses, letter of credit (LC) issuances.

Ensure the original letter of credit (LC) value is restored within 7 days if utilized.

Portal Management:

Update the Payment Security Portal (PSA) and Praapti portal with necessary information. For e.g. letter of credit (LC) availability.

Monitor power curtailment actions by the System Operator as mandated by the Ministry of Power.

Document payment statuses and upload all bills to the Praapti portal, ensuring accurate and timely updates of procurer details.

Enforce restrictions on short-term power purchases for entities with outstanding payments beyond 75 days as recorded in the Praapti portal.

Interact with the state load dispatch center, central dispatch, and Ministry of Power as necessary, ensuring compliance with operational guidelines.

Financial Reporting and Reconciliation:

Prepare MIS reports detailing expected revenue, expenses for each customer, due bills, and collection targets, comparing actual receipts against targets.

Conduct quarterly or annual reconciliations of bills admitted, signed off, and payments made, reporting reconciliation status.

Draft replies for customer correspondence and ensure accurate entry of bills into the SAP system as payments are made.

Regulatory Support and Tariff Management:

Provide data input to the regulatory team for unresolved disputes and ongoing cases.

Apply for provisional tariffs if petitions are not filed in a timely manner and submit claims for the regulatory team to file petitions.

In cases where section 63 of the PPA applies, ensure the sharing of fuel costs and other expenses for reimbursement.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Finance Team

Corporate Affairs Team

Operations & Maintenance (O&M) Team

Fuel Management Team

Power Sales Team

Business Development (BD) Team

ABEX Team

Commercial Controller Team

Key Stakeholders - External

DISCOMs/Procurers

Regulatory Authorities

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's Degree (Finance, Business Administration, related fields)

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 5 years of experience in billing, financial management, or a relevant commercial role within a corporate setting.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to commercial and regulatory processes pertaining to billing and payments.

job.title: Plant Head - Strategic Precious Metals and Minor Metals
job.description:
Responsibilities

Plant Operations Management

  • Lead daily plant operations to achieve production volume, throughput, recovery, metal yield, plant availability, and dispatch targets as per business plan.
  • Optimize process parameters across smelting, refining, leaching, electrowinning/electrolysis, crystallization, casting, and allied processes based on feed composition and plant conditions.
  • Monitor shift-wise performance, identify bottlenecks, minimize unplanned downtime, and ensure timely troubleshooting of process deviations.
  • Ensure effective coordination between production, maintenance, quality, stores, utilities, logistics, and commercial teams for smooth plant operations.
  • Review and strengthen SOPs, operating discipline, shift handover practices, daily management systems, and production reporting mechanisms.
  • Drive continuous improvement in OEE, equipment reliability, manpower productivity, material flow, and process stability.

Safety, Health and Environment

  • Drive a zero-harm and LTI-free culture across the plant by implementing robust safety systems, behavior-based safety practices, and regular shopfloor engagement.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable statutory requirements including Factories Act, environmental regulations, hazardous waste handling rules, safety standards, and internal EHS guidelines.
  • Oversee management of effluent, emissions, fumes, dust, slag, hazardous material storage, and waste disposal in coordination with EHS and environment teams.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, emergency preparedness, mock drills, and safety audits.
  • Promote disciplined usage of PPE, permit-to-work systems, HIRA/JSA, SOP compliance, and contractor safety management.

Quality, Metallurgy & Process Excellence

  • Ensure achievement of product quality standards including metal purity, impurity control, physical quality, casting quality, and customer specification compliance.
  • Work closely with laboratory, R&D, and process engineering teams to improve yield, recovery, impurity removal, energy efficiency, and process robustness.
  • Review process data, assay results, mass balance, heat balance, and quality trends to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Reduce rework, rejection, customer complaints, off-spec production, and process variability through structured corrective actions.
  • Support new product development, process trials, technology improvements, and scale-up initiatives for minor metals and by-products.

High Value Project

  • Conceive, evaluate, and drive high-value projects related to recovery, processing, and value maximization of minor metals in the copper value chain, including lead (Pb), zinc (Zn), chlorine (Cl), rhodium (Rh), bismuth, selenium, tellurium, and platinum group metals (PGMs).

Cost, Budgeting & CAPEX

  • Own plant OPEX budgets and drive cost optimization across power, fuel, chemicals, consumables, refractory, electrodes, maintenance, manpower, and logistics.
  • Track cost per ton, conversion cost, specific energy consumption, consumable usage, productivity, and variance against budget.
  • Plan and execute plant shutdowns, debottlenecking projects, modification jobs, and CAPEX initiatives within approved cost, quality, safety, and timeline parameters.
  • Support technical evaluation of vendors, contractors, spares, equipment, consumables, and service contracts in coordination with procurement and commercial teams.
  • Identify value engineering opportunities and drive initiatives for capacity enhancement, yield improvement, waste reduction, and cost competitiveness.

People Leadership & Capability Building

  • Lead, guide, and develop teams across production, shift operations, process, quality, maintenance coordination, and support functions.
  • Build a high-performance work culture focused on safety, accountability, operational discipline, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop succession plans for critical roles and ensure capability building of engineers, supervisors, operators, and shift in-charges.
  • Drive training on SOPs, safety practices, process fundamentals, equipment operation, emergency response, and quality requirements.
  • Ensure effective manpower planning, shift rosters, contractor deployment, productivity tracking, and employee engagement across the plant

Systems, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Implement and sustain systems such as TPM, 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, Daily Management, ISO systems, and audit compliance.
  • Coordinate with regulatory bodies, auditors, internal stakeholders, and cross-functional teams for statutory, quality, safety, and environmental compliance.
  • Ensure accurate production reporting, SAP transactions, MIS dashboards, inventory control, and documentation for audit readiness.
  • Leverage DCS/SCADA, process data, digital dashboards, and analytics to improve decision-making and operational visibility.
  • Ensure reliability of all critical equipment through asset optimization and timely corrective actions.
  • Drive process optimization initiatives to improve plant efficiency, productivity, cost effectiveness, and operational stability.

Qualifications

Education Qualification:

  • B.E./B.Tech in Metallurgy, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related discipline. M.Tech/M.E. in Metallurgy, Chemical, Materials Science, or Process Engineering will be preferred.

Experiences:

  • 18 - 20 years of relevant experience in metals, non-ferrous metals, minor metals, smelting, refining, electrolysis/electrowinning, chemical processing, or continuous/process plant operations.
  • 10-15yrs of experience in handling plant at highest level

About Us

The road to empowerment is the one that guards a country’s stride onwards, keeping every hurdle that poses a threat to the constant pace of progress at bay. Yet another milestone in our growth story, is the business of Natural Resources. The scale of our business assures a steady availability of coal, extracted in the most responsible ways, which promises constant supply of power to both urban and rural geographies of India ensuring no hurdles are faced by the citizens in the path to achieving their dreams. The mining industry is considered a major contributor to the growth of the Indian economy. The mining business unit of the Adani group was established in 2007 as the last link in ensuring energy security for India. We are also developing and operating mines in Indonesia and Australia.

In the past few years, we have transformed from a coal trading and importing company to a comprehensive integrated coal management company. We have a diversified trading portfolio and are involved in Coal and Coke trading.

job.title: EBDG - Power Sales & Trading- Senior Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

Team Lead - Sales, Billing and Licence

Tender Analysis and Participation:

Analyze monthly tender data from state-wise utilities to understand requirements and plan for participation.

Assess available capacity based on quarterly and yearly Operations and Maintainence (O&M) projections.

Review tender terms and conditions, identify risk factors, and highlight them for management review.

Float approval notes to the management for tender participation as per the Delegation of Authority (DOA).

Manage one-time registration for new plants on online portals and handle payments for participation.

Address clarifications from utilities and update management on critical points via email.

Coordinate with the Company Secretary for board resolutions required for tender participation.

Oversee the technical and financial bid qualification process, including support for Ernest Money Deposit (EMD) and Bank Guarantee (BG) submissions.

Monitor reverse auction proceedings, perform competitor analysis, and make strategic decisions based on market intelligence.

Prepare and submit Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) drafted by team members for accuracy and compliance.

Communicate effectively with utilities regarding any clarifications and maintain meticulous records of these communications.

Open Access Management:

Manage short-term open access contracts, ensuring compliance with buyer agreements and utility requirements.

Coordinate with utilities to determine the mode of power take-off, whether under General Network Access (GNA) or Temporary General Network Access (TGNA).

Conduct continuous contract monitoring from the start of the power supply, ensuring customer power off-take aligns with contract.

General Network Access (GNA) Contracts

Verify delivery points and create contracts based on the receiving substations' requirements.

Create and approve contracts on the Web-Based Scheduling (WBS) platform and ensure RLDC approval for power flow commencement.

Temeporary General Network Access (TGNA) Contracts

Apply for power flow applications through the National Open Access Registry (NOAR).

Ensure applications are submitted within the stipulated timelines and that Regional Load Dispatch Center (RLDC) approvals are diligently pursued and received.

Contract Monitoring:

Monitor daily power off-take by buyers and record data accurately in the system.

Notify buyers promptly if off-take falls below the contracted 85% threshold.

Ensure uniformity in off-take patterns and manage communication with buyers accordingly.

Request power requirements from buyers two days before execution and coordinate accordingly.

Collective Transactions:

Manage daily bidding activities on Indian Energy Exchange for collective transactions.

Coordinate availability confirmation from plants on Day-2 and Day-1.

Optimize trading strategies based on market dynamics and trade analysis reports from ELECOR.

Facilitate direct negotiations with buyers to secure premium rates and ensure timely trade execution.

Supervise Real-Time Market (RTM), Day Ahead Market (DAM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM) activities as per market conditions.

Long Duration Contracts:

Facilitate the submission and management of long-duration contracts on exchanges, ensuring compliance with timelines and commitments.

Participate in reverse auctions, monitor competing bids, and strategize to secure optimal rates.

Coordinate with buyers for prompt confirmation post-auction and manage power flow commencement timelines.

MIS Management:

Generate and circulate MIS reports to CEO and senior management, detailing power sales, revenue generated, and plant-wise performance.

Compile monthly trading analytics and sales reports across bilateral, term ahead, day ahead, and real-time markets.

Provide insights for future planning and decision-making based on exchange market performance.

Energy Trading (Power Sales to other Adani Group Companies):

Facilitate the purchase of power from wind and solar generators, acting as an intermediary to supply power to other Adani Group companies such as AEML, consumer products, ports, and Ambuja Cement.

Negotiate terms and conditions to establish contracts that meet the needs of both the power generators (sellers) and the end clients (buyers).

Benchmark industry rates to inform pricing decisions and finalize contracts based on competitive market analysis.

Customize standardized contracts to accommodate deviations on a case-by-case basis, ensuring all parties' interests are addressed.

Oversee the uploading of contracts onto the system for digital signing by the power generators.

Manage applications on State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) portals for each power agreement, coordinating agreements by substations as needed.

Evaluate tender terms and conditions, identify potential risks, and seek necessary amendments or clarifications to ensure compliance and favorable contract terms.

Lead the bidding process on buyer-floated tenders, assessing the viability and risks involved.

Secure bank guarantees (BG) and board resolutions through the finance team, and manage the payment of fees to the Power Finance Corporation (PFC).

Monitor reverse auction proceedings and make strategic decisions based on competitor analysis and market intelligence.

Coordinate with utilities for the issuance of Letters of Intent (LOI) and review Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) for accuracy and compliance.

Act as a liaison between the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) , power generators, and buyers, resolving any queries that arise during contract formation.

Circulate the No Objection Certificate (NOC) provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to all parties, ensuring clear communication and agreement on contract terms.

Manage financial transactions between the generator and the buyer, including the issuance of invoices and the processing of payments, while ensuring margins are accounted for.

Handle the credit notes provided by the State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) to the respective generator based on the power generation amount.

Raise invoices to the buyer based on consumption units as per the group credit note (GCN) and manage the payment process, deducting AEL's margins before paying the generator.

Energy Trading (Power Sales of other Adani Group Companies):

Manage daily forecasting for power generation from other Adani Companies such as Adani Green and execute contracts based on agreed terms and conditions, ensuring a smooth contractual process.

Sign power agreements digitally on a daily basis under a blanket contract with defined trading margins, and make informed decisions regarding the inclusion of Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs) in sales.

Oversee and facilitate the power flow from green energy sources to final buyers, handling invoice processes and transaction settlements accordingly.

Analyze market trends for Day Ahead Market (DAM) and Green DAM, deciding on the most favorable strategy for selling Renewable Energy Certificates (RECs).

Prepare comprehensive monthly trading reports detailing all green energy transactions and perform ongoing registration tasks for buyers and generators on national exchanges.

Exchange Bidding and Monitoring:

Monitor residual power for daily bidding in the Indian Energy Exchange across various markets: Day Ahead Market (DAM), Real-Time Market (RTM), and Term Ahead Market (TAM).

Analyze the best times to sell energy for premium rates and coordinate with buyers for one-to-one trades.

Observe market dynamics to capitalize on opportunities for obtaining premium rates.

Manage contingency trading in the RTM and ensure bids are placed within capacity limits.

Track bid validity, contract acceptance, and power flow commencement for long-duration contracts on the exchange.

Supervise long-duration contract applications, assess buyer confirmations, and monitor completion of reverse auctions for price setting.

Engage in Real-Time Market trading as required to manage any unfavorable circumstances which necessitate the buy or sale of power at short notice.

Create detailed sales analytics and allocation reports to aid in future planning and inform the strategic division of power sales channels across bilateral contracts and exchange markets.

Ensure timely completion of all contract performance guarantees and manage follow-ups for power supply commencement.

Manage the distribution of MIS reports to the management, detailing revenue generated, power sold, contract participation, and power availability insights.

Digitization and Automation:

Execute comprehensive digitization strategies to optimise operational efficiency

Implement automation solutions to support overall organisational goals / strategy

People and Team Management:

Foster a constructive team environment, managing team performance, and driving initiatives for continuous development and departmental excellence.

Ensure that all team members are aligned with the business strategy, promoting a culture of innovation and response to changes.

Manage team performance, driving initiatives for continuous development, and ensuring departmental excellence in line with business strategy.

Key Stakeholders - Internal

Adani Green, AEML, Cement, Wilmur, Ports

Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Team

Finance Team

Legal Team

Technical ServicesTeam

Fuel Management Team

Key Stakeholders - External

State and Regional Utilities

SLDC

RLDC

Energy Exchange Platforms

Direct Consumers of Energy

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, related field), Additional Degrees or Cetifications (Energy management, Business Administration, related field) preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 6 years of experience in power trading negotiations, contract management, or related role.

Preferred Industry:

Background in the power and energy sector with exposure to power trading mechanisms, policy landscapes and renewable energy trading.

job.title: Lead Fire & Safety
job.description:
Responsibilities

Lead the planning, engineering, and design of Fire Alarm & Public Address (FAPA) systems, CCTV systems, and associated ELV infrastructure for high-rise and large-scale developments.

Ensure compliance with applicable National and International Fire Safety Codes & Standards, including NBC, NFPA, BS/EN, and other relevant regulations.

Develop and review fire safety solutions for:

  • High-rise buildings
  • Commercial developments
  • Mixed-use developments
  • Large floor area facilities
  • Smart and integrated buildings

Drive the integration of FAPA systems with various building systems to enhance fire safety management and emergency response effectiveness, including:

  • Building Management System (BMS)
  • HVAC & Smoke Management Systems
  • Elevator Recall & Fireman's Lift Operations
  • Access Control Systems
  • CCTV & Video Management Systems
  • Public Address & Voice Evacuation Systems
  • Emergency Lighting Systems
  • Central Monitoring Stations
  • Integrated Command & Control Centers

Establish and optimize centralized fire monitoring and control room operations, ensuring real-time monitoring of:

  • Fire alarms and events
  • System health status
  • Fault management
  • Device connectivity
  • Emergency response workflows

Review cause-and-effect matrices, system architecture, zoning philosophy, network design, and automation logic for integrated fire protection systems.

Provide technical leadership during design reviews, commissioning, testing, and handover stages.

Desired Candidate Profile

✔ Bachelor's Degree in Engineering (Electrical/Electronics/Instrumentation/Fire Engineering or equivalent)

✔ Minimum 12-14 years of proven experience in planning and designing FAPA and CCTV systems.

✔ Demonstrated experience in delivering fire safety technology solutions for high-rise buildings and large-area developments.

✔ Strong knowledge of:

  • NBC India
  • NFPA Standards
  • BS/EN Standards
  • Fire Engineering Principles
  • ELV Systems Design
  • Intelligent Building Systems

✔ Hands-on experience in integrating fire alarm systems with building automation and centralized monitoring platforms.

✔ Strong understanding of command center operations, remote monitoring, system analytics, and fire system health management.

✔ Excellent stakeholder management and multidisciplinary coordination skills.

Qualifications

Educational Qualification:

Bachelor's, Master's Degree, Additional Degrees or Certification in Security Management preferred

Work Experience (Range of years):

Minimum 15 years in the corporate security field, fire , safety field

Performance and Development:

  • Administer performance management systems and work with leaders to ensure regular feedback and development planning.
  • Identify training needs and coordinate relevant learning and development initiatives to upskill employees.
  • Support GCC Towers in execution of the annual review cycles in order to achieve timely competition

Compliance and Policy Implementation:

  • Ensure adherence to all applicable labor laws and internal policies.
  • Review and update HR policies to reflect the dynamic needs of the capability center.
  • Managing Labor law related notices, filing of Monthly/ Quarterly/ Half yearly/ Annual returns (Non-Payroll) (including Apprentice Act)
  • Statutory documentation and recordkeeping team is responsible for the document management of all the sites

Health, Safety, and Wellbeing:

  • Coordinates the communication between the Site HR/Cluster HR Head and GCC LEA team whenever needed on employee health & safety issues
  • Support in incident management with coordination between employee/workmen, regional site manager, reporting manager and BU HR
  • Logging & escalating the required incidents to Group IR team over a call/e-mail in case of critical incidents

Stakeholder management:

  • Cultivate long standing relationships with local departments, regional labor office and other external stakeholders to maintain seamless operations.
  • Develop and implement effective communication strategies to engage stakeholders and keep them informed about site activities, changes, and developments.

Employee Engagement and Culture:

  • Organize events, workshops, and activities to foster a vibrant and inclusive workplace culture.
  • Support the employee engagement events by coordination with established vendors, procurement and administration teams
  • Calendarization of events and designing, communicating and coordinating for all engagement events at the sites

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. A Master’s degree or MBA in HR is advantageous.
  • 3-10 years of HR experience, with at least 2 years in a management role within a manufacturing unit, plant or similar environment.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mine Surveyor
job.description:
Responsibilities

Mine Surveyor - Coal Mining

Conducting Surveys and Measurements:

Perform detailed topographic and underground surveys using the latest surveying equipment and techniques to accurately measure and map the mine’s physical features.

Measure and record the dimensions, elevations, and contours of mine workings and geological formations, ensuring all data is precise and reliable.

Utilize advanced surveying software to collect, analyze, and process survey data, ensuring accurate and timely reporting.

Developing and Maintaining Mine Plans:

Create and regularly update accurate mine plans, layouts, and sectional drawings that reflect the current state of mine workings and future development plans.

Ensure all mine plans and layouts comply with statutory requirements, industry standards, and company policies, facilitating smooth regulatory audits and inspections.

Collaborate with mining engineers, geologists, and mine management to adjust and optimize plans based on operational needs and geological findings.

Monitoring Geological Features:

Identify, record, and monitor geological formations, faults, and potential hazards within the mine, providing early warnings of any changes that could impact safety or operations.

Assist in the assessment of ground stability, roof conditions, and potential safety risks by providing accurate geological data and interpretations.

Support geological mapping and modeling efforts with precise survey data, aiding in the prediction and management of geological conditions.

Ensuring Regulatory Compliance:

Adhere to all relevant mining regulations, safety standards, and environmental guidelines, ensuring that all surveying activities are conducted legally and ethically.

Prepare, maintain, and submit required reports, records, and documentation to regulatory bodies, ensuring all data is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

Participate in safety audits, inspections, and reviews, providing necessary survey data and supporting documentation to demonstrate compliance and identify areas for improvement.

Supporting Mine Planning and Development:

Provide critical survey data and insights to support the design, planning, and optimization of mine development projects, ensuring efficient and safe operations.

Assist in the planning, coordination, and execution of mine expansion and development projects, providing accurate survey data to guide decision-making and project implementation.

Work closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, operations, and safety, to ensure alignment of surveying activities with overall mine operational goals and objectives.

Implement and Optimize Digital Solutions:

Coordinate with cross-functional teams to deploy digital tools that align with business objectives.

Ensure the effective utilization of digital platforms to improve team efficiency and productivity.
