job.title: Business Development Manager - Aftermarket (Gordon Brothers)
job.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Service & Aftermarket Gas Compression

Join a Global Leader in Sustainable Infrastructure and Industrial Refrigeration

At Johnson Controls (JCI), we're transforming how the world manages energy, buildings, and critical industrial operations. As a global leader in smart buildings, thermal management, energy efficiency and decarbonisation, we help customers operate more efficiently, reduce carbon emissions and build resilient, future-ready facilities across industries including data centres, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing and higher education.

For more than 140 years, JCI has delivered innovative solutions where performance matters most. Backed by cutting-edge technology, comprehensive lifecycle services and a world-class field organisation, we help our customers achieve measurable results while creating safer, more sustainable environments.

As part of the JCI family, Gordon Brothers Industries (GBI) brings more than 100 years of industrial refrigeration expertise and is recognised as Australia's largest industrial refrigeration company. With offices across every mainland state, GBI delivers end-to-end refrigeration solutions, including design, engineering, construction, commissioning, servicing and maintenance, supporting leading organisations across the food and beverage, cold storage, mining, chemical and industrial processing sectors.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced and commercially focused Business Development Manager to drive growth across our Gas Compression and Industrial Refrigeration portfolio throughout Australia and New Zealand.

This is a unique opportunity for a qualified Engineer or Senior Technician who combines strong commercial acumen with deep technical expertise. You will be responsible for identifying, developing and securing complex service, overhaul, retrofit and upgrade opportunities while acting as the technical authority throughout the sales cycle.

Working with key customers across oil & gas, industrial processing, mining and refrigeration sectors, you will engage directly with engineering, operations and reliability teams to develop tailored solutions that improve asset performance, reliability and lifecycle value.

The successful candidate will be a qualified Mechanical or Chemical Engineer, or Senior Refrigeration Technician with a minimum of two years' relevant industry experience and strong knowledge of gas compression systems. Experience with Frick and/or Sabroe compressor technologies will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities to achieve designated sales targets.
  • Manage and maintain the Salesforce (SFDC) pipeline in line with business expectations.
  • Lead the identification, development and sale of gas compressor rebuild, overhaul, retrofit and upgrade opportunities.
  • Act as the technical authority throughout the sales process, developing engineered solutions and advising customers on best-practice asset management strategies.
  • Engage directly with customer engineering, reliability and operations teams to identify technical challenges and convert opportunities into funded projects.
  • Provide expert guidance on compressor performance, maintenance strategies, overhaul planning, asset integrity and lifecycle management.
  • Coordinate support from APAC Product Specialists and OEM partners for complex applications, including Mycom compressor commissioning and rebuild projects.
  • Identify and generate spare parts, overhaul and upgrade opportunities based on asset condition and reliability assessment reports.
  • Advise customers on preventative maintenance programmes and long-term asset reliability strategies.
  • Collaborate closely with the Australia and New Zealand Business Development teams to support new equipment sales and convert maintenance opportunities into long-term service agreements.
  • Identify and recommend end-of-life Quantum and Unisab control system upgrade opportunities.
  • Identify and propose refrigeration package upgrade opportunities, including RWB to RWFII/RXFII conversions.
  • Support commissioning activities, major breakdown responses and complex customer projects requiring specialist technical expertise.
  • Provide leadership and direction to internal teams and contractors to ensure customer solutions are delivered safely and effectively.
  • Review project performance and provide technical and commercial insights to senior management.
  • Ensure compliance with all Quality Assurance (QA), Occupational Health, Safety and Environment (OHS&E) and company standards.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for continuous improvement, operational efficiencies and customer-focused solutions.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Essential

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or Chemical Engineering, or demonstrated competency in the industry.
  • Minimum 2 years' relevant experience in gas compression systems, industrial refrigeration, rotating equipment or a related process industry.
  • Strong technical knowledge of compressor technologies, thermodynamics, refrigeration systems and rotating equipment.
  • Demonstrated success in business development, technical sales, applications engineering or solution development.
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to develop opportunities from concept through to contract award.
  • Excellent written, proposal development, presentation and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships with customers and influence technical and commercial stakeholders.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders.
  • A commitment to frontline safety leadership and proactive risk management.

Highly Regarded

  • Experience with Frick and/or Sabroe compressor systems.
  • Experience with Mycom, Howden, Kobelco or similar industrial compressor technologies.
  • Experience within oil & gas, LNG, mining, chemical processing, industrial refrigeration or heavy industrial sectors.
  • Knowledge of Quantum and Unisab control platforms.
  • Experience with ammonia refrigeration systems and industrial process plants.
  • Experience developing overhaul, retrofit, brownfield upgrade and equipment reliability projects.

Why Join Us?

At Johnson Controls and Gordon Brothers Industries, you'll be part of a global organisation that values innovation, safety, sustainability and career development.

You'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies, partner with major industrial customers, collaborate with global technical specialists and contribute to solutions that improve reliability, efficiency and sustainability across critical industries.

Ready to Take the Next Step in Your Career?

Click Apply to submit your application in confidence.

JCI’s Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands. 

To learn more about our industrial refrigeration capabilities, visit [www.gordonbrothers.com.au](http://www.gordonbrothers.com.au).

Applicants must have full working rights in Australia.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug and alcohol screening, will form part of the selection process.

job.title: Senior Sales Manager, Security Solutions
job.description:
Who we are

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do

As a Senior Sales Manager, Security Solutions, you will be responsible for driving growth for Johnson Controls security solutions across assigned vertical markets in Malaysia. Reporting to the Sales Leader, you will focus on securing new projects, managing key accounts and achieving sales targets through consultative and technical selling.

You will:

  • Achieve assigned annual sales revenue and gross margin targets
  • Identify, qualify and develop new business opportunities in targeted verticals
  • Manage and grow relationships with consultants, system integrators, contractors, developers and end users
  • Prepare technical proposals, system designs, tenders and quotations
  • Conduct product presentations and solution demonstrations to customers
  • Ensure proposed solutions comply with tender specifications and technical requirements
  • Negotiate commercial terms and secure contracts in line with company policies
  • Maintain strong pipeline management and provide accurate sales forecasting
  • Monitor market trends, competitor activities and pricing strategies
  • Support project execution teams during handover and participate in key client meetings when required

How you will do it:

  • Apply consultative selling approach to understand customer security risks and recommend appropriate integrated solutions
  • Work closely with pre-sales, engineering and operations teams to develop competitive and technically sound proposals
  • Maintain strong engagement with architects, consultants and M&E engineers to influence project specifications
  • Develop account plans for key customers to drive long-term growth and retention
  • Ensure timely follow-up on quotations and tenders to improve conversion rates
  • Deliver accurate monthly sales forecast and pipeline reports
  • Strengthen Tyco brand positioning in the Malaysian security market

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics or equivalent).
  • Minimum of 5 years of sales experience in electronic security systems (CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion, Integrated Security Solutions)
  • Proven track record in project sales and achieving sales targets
  • Strong understanding of tender processes and project-based selling
  • Good technical knowledge of security system design
  • Strong communication, presentation and negotiation skills
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously

Preferred

  • Experience working in a multinational environment
  • Existing network with consultants, contractors and developers in Malaysia
  • Knowledge of integrated solutions including BMS/ELV systems is an advantage
  • Familiarity with major security brands and enterprise-level systems

Key Competencies

  • Results-driven and customer-focused
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels
  • Team player with cross-functional collaboration capability
  • High level of integrity and professionalism
  • Self-motivated with strong accountability

What we offer

  • Competitive remuneration package
  • Performance-based incentive scheme
  • Comprehensive medical & insurance coverage
  • Learning & development opportunities
  • Career progression within Johnson Controls global network
  • Collaborative and performance-driven environment

job.title: BMS Hardware Design - Datacenter
job.description:
Job Description

Application Engineer (Hardware Design) – Datacenter

What you will do

The primary responsibility of this role is to lead global Data Center Building Management System (BMS) engineering projects, ensuring compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and account-specific standards. The role requires independent ownership and execution of projects throughout the entire lifecycle, while serving as the first point of escalation for technical and project-related issues. Ensure adherence to data center-specific engineering and project execution processes, maintain high quality standards through a "First Time Right" approach, and deliver projects on schedule to achieve operational excellence and maximize customer satisfaction.

How you will do it

  • Review MEP drawings to generate following drawings / documents for systems covered into Datacenter Project

Shop Drawings (ACAD drawings)

  • Detailed IO List contains all hardware points, software points and integration points if applicable, along with trend and alarm details as applicable
  • Creation of Bill of material, selection of sensors, control valves, dampers, air flow stations, controllers etc.
  • Generation of Panel GA
  • Generation of detailed Control devices and controller wiring, terminations, interlock wiring

Engineering Documents

Preparation of BMS Network diagram as per specifications and approved solution

Generation of detailed description of operation control based on specifications and design intent

Generation of various schedules like Valve, Flowmeter, Damper, panel, DDC etc.

Preparation of test scripts for panel factory witness tests

Generation of initial review sheets and RFI’s

  • Coordination with all stakeholders for clarification on RFI’s, tracking progress and with different vendors during finalization of BOQ
  • Ensure quality assurance and defect free hardware package delivery
  • Adherence with all processes and guidelines to execute project within timeline
  • During pre-bid stage support sales team for providing/validating controls solution for systems into Datacenter project.

What we look for

  • BE/ME (Instrumentation / Electrical/ Electronics / Electronics & Communication
  • Hands on experience with Hardware Engineering scope for Datacenter Vertical
  • Good Understanding of Data Centre mechanical / electrical systems with expertise for instrumentation and control, panel wiring, complex relay logic
  • Experience in detailed panel design – power calculation, selection of panel enclosure, terminal blocks, fuses, panel heaters, light etc.
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems from Datacenter vertical like Chilled Water System, Cooling Towers, Primary & Secondary pumping systems, Fluid Coolers, Heat Exchanger, CRAH, CRAC, CDU, Different types of AHUs, FCUs, VAV systems etc.
  • Strong knowledge of BMS architecture with different types of Operator workstations, Supervisory Controllers, DDC controllers, Sensors & Actuators etc.
  • Knowledge of different types of network protocols like BACNet, LON, Modbus, OPC, and other protocols
  • Must be proficient in wiring of starters, field devices, safety interlocks & panels
  • Experience in engineering, installing and commissioning of HVAC & BMS systems for Datacenter projects or other infrastructure projects like pharmaceuticals, airports, commercial buildings, hospitals
  • Must be a quick learner & should have a keen eye for problem solving
  • Proficient in written and verbal communication
  • Ability to demonstrate good leadership skills

Preferred

4 to 8 years of relevant experience in Building Automation Industry Datacenter Vertical, BMS Design Engineering or Industrial Automation.

Johnson Controls is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view EEO is the Law. If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/tomorrowneedsyou).

job.title: Inside Sales Engineer (1 year Contract)
job.description:
About us:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

As Inside Sales Engineer, you will support the customers by identifying their needs, offering standard and specific solutions/ equipment and services in order to retain customers and maximize opportunities and conversion rate. Strong collaboration with sales team, customer service, product management and technical team to ensure proposals including technical solution that accurately address customers’ needs, adhering to JCI’s product standard, quality requirements and specification.

How you will do it:

  • Key point of contact for clients, answering queries, providing basic technical advice and information for new product introduction and modification
  • Build and maintains good customer relationship across all customer’s level, coordinate new and repeat sales to ensure 100% customer satisfaction and account retention
  • Extensive interaction with customer, partners, internal stakeholder via phone and email
  • Enquiry handling, preparation , send and follow up on quotation
  • Address clients’ concerns around technical capabilities and commercial viability.
  • 100% follow up sales opportunity via Salesforce.com and ensuring no overdue and accurate up to date opportunity pipeline.
  • Listen, understand and coney customer requirements to solution and business opportunities.
  • Provide reliable solutions for all commercial and basic technical issues to ensure complete customer satisfaction.
  • Plan and implement strategies, reporting accurately on sales and business activities.
  • Gains customer acceptance by explaining or demonstrating cost reductions and operational improvement of using specific products and/or solution
  • Participation with other regional sales colleagues in sharing marketing intelligence on market growth, movement and opportunities to improve revenue.
  • Submit orders and confers with Customer service executive
  • Coordinate with sales team and demand planner for forecast orders and special pricing (SPR)
  • Maintain professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshop and training.
  • Review professional publication, establishing personal networks.
  • Contribute to sales’ effectiveness by identifying short term and long range issues that must be address, provision of necessary information and commentary pertinent to deliberations, recommending options and course of actions
  • Performance of any ad-hoc duties as assigned

Add on Responsibilities

  • Cross function from Water Mechanical business unit to Special Hazard BU. Added on responsibility to pick up new knowledge for Engineered and Foam system.
  • Process strong and positive working attitude
  • Learn to identify accounts with potential for growth, develop account plans and garner helps from other department to achieve desired goals
  • Adopting additional knowledge in SAP to determine improvement by analyzing cost-benefit ratios of project, supplies, service application
  • Strong involvement with Order Fulfillment at factory level to ensure healthy order backlog and meet monthly target
  • Participate in once weekly night meeting with factory for order fulfillment

What we look for:

  • Minimum Diploma in Mechanical or relevant engineering studies preferred
  • Project management skill
  • Team leadership and facilitation
  • Ability to work independently and possess strong “Can Do attitude”
  • Knowledge of import, export regulation, SAP system, salesforce, MS Office
  • Committed and dedicated to customer satisfaction and enjoy talking to people of all level

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary in a MNC environment
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Project Administrator
job.description:
Project Administrator

Johnson Controls supports customers with building technologies and engineering solutions that help project teams deliver safely and efficiently. In this role, you will support project operations across multiple APAC sites through data management, system maintenance, reporting, coordination, and construction & commissioning document control.

Role Overview

You will keep project tracking systems accurate and up to date, help site teams access the latest documents and templates, and support reporting that improves visibility for decision-making. This role is well suited to someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable coordinating across sites and functions in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and organize construction and commissioning documentation in a structured and systematic manner, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and easy retrieval.
  • Control document workflows including submission, tracking, distribution, and response coordination across GC platforms and internal teams.
  • Maintain document control logs, records, version control, numbering, filing, storage, and retrieval for both electronic and hard copy files.
  • Support document preparation by ensuring proper formatting, compliance, system access, and archiving activities.
  • Monitor and verify data entries from site teams, follow up on gaps, and ensure timely and accurate updates.
  • Maintain and continuously improve data tracking templates and reporting structures, aligning historical data with current standards.
  • Organize project data from multiple sources so it is structured, accessible, and ready for reporting and analysis.
  • Prepare reports on project progress, cost, and performance to support visibility and decision-making.
  • Ensure consistency in data structure and reporting formats across sites or regions.
  • Support issue tracking, data visualization, project schedules, procurement documentation, and office purchasing activities as needed.

How You Will Do It

  • Take ownership of data quality, document control, and daily follow-up with accuracy and accountability.
  • Stay close to site teams and internal partners, respond quickly, and remove obstacles that slow down delivery or reporting.
  • Use a continuous-improvement mindset to refine templates, trackers, and reporting formats as site needs change.
  • Work as one team across APAC by sharing information clearly, building trust, and respecting different perspectives.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s technical degree in engineering or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in project support, data management, or administrative roles; experience in construction, commissioning, or engineering projects is an advantage.
  • Good command of English in listening, speaking, reading, and writing.
  • TOEIC score of 600, IELTS overall score of 5.0, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical and computer skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office, Excel, Power Query, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • High accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to manage large volumes of data.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Good communication and coordination skills when working with cross-functional teams and site personnel.
  • Familiarity with document control processes such as submittals, logs, version control, and archival practices.
  • Willingness to support multiple APAC sites and remote coordination.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting reporting, data visualization, and performance tracking.
  • Exposure to construction, commissioning, or engineering project environments.
  • Experience developing training materials or supporting users with data handling and system usage.
  • Familiarity with issue tracking data or project scheduling tools.

Why Join Us

You will gain broad exposure to project operations across multiple APAC sites, working with cross-functional teams on data, documentation, reporting, and process improvement. This is an opportunity to build practical experience in a structured environment while contributing to reliable project delivery.

If you are ready to bring structure, accuracy, and coordination to project operations, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Project Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

What you will do:

Acts as on-site project leader to plan, execute, and complete assigned projects. Delegates tasks to execute and fully complete assigned projects. Coordinates communication with customer during all phases of the project. Coordinates the work of subcontractors.

How you will do it:

  • Define scope, budget and schedule for projects.
  • Device project implementation methodology.
  • Plan and oversee work schedule for the multiple small to medium scale project under responsibility, in coordination with supervisor.
  • Identify potential project risks and recommend appropriate resolutions.
  • Establish effective communication with customer.
  • Track and update progress, task and project health to supervisors.
  • Ensure and monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
  • Perform regular quality audit for all the suppliers and sub-contractors.
  • Identify and secure variation order.
  • Cost control. Track, monitor and ensure delivery of financial commitment as per KPI.
  • Managing reports and documents.
  • Work closely with Sales team for tender bidding.
  • Supervision of sub-contractors’ work at site.
  • Schedule purchase and deliveries of all materials for the project in a timely manner.
  • Able to work with drawings and submission as per project requirement.
  • Assign task to, and supervise Assistant Project Engineer, Technician, if any.
  • System applications, drafting, data base generation and commissioning.
  • Follow-up on payment from customers and verify payment to our suppliers.
  • Train customer and provide first year maintenance warranty schedule visit.
  • Hand over project to customer and later to service team.
  • And other related works as assigned by your superior.

What we look for:

  • Degree with minimum 3 year relevant working experience in BMS project.
  • Excel, Word and Project essential.
  • Require interaction with clients, consultants and sub-contractors, etc.
  • Need to work odd hours as and when required, whenever the work need to be done on time.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

job.title: Senior Manager, Reliability (GERA)
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

This position represents an in-country operational leadership role within the DayOne Operations team. The incumbent will support the Reliability Director of GERA by providing technical leadership, operational governance, and execution oversight for reliability initiatives across the designated data centre portfolio.

The Manager / Senior Manager will be entrusted with ensuring the safe, reliable, efficient, and scalable operation of mission-critical data centres.

Core responsibilities encompass:

  • taking care equipment reliability and performance Conducting comprehensive operational risk assessments utilizing the Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) methodology.
  • Developing and implementing containment measures, permanent corrective actions, and preventive strategies to mitigate recurrence.
  • Coordinating effectively with internal and external stakeholders to achieve optimal operational outcomes.
  • Driving continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen reliability, resilience, and performance across the portfolio.

Role and Responsibilities

Reliability Governance: Oversee and uphold the reliability governance framework across the assigned data centre portfolio. Establish and maintain a comprehensive systemic risk register with clearly defined risk categories and corresponding mitigation measures. Conduct periodic evaluations of the effectiveness of these measures to drive continuous improvement.

Asset management and critical parts management: Consolidate and maintain system specification information and critical parts following Risk Prioritization Number (RPN) methodology.

Problem Management: Lead the problem management process by conducting thorough technical and holistic root cause analyses, implementing Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA), and overseeing reviews of major incidents. Establish and maintain the Day One Data Centre Known Error Database (KEDB) to ensure systematic documentation and resolution of recurring issues.

Energy and Water Performance Management: Familiar with ISO 50001 Energy Management Scheme, monitor and analyze performance indicators for the data centre portfolio assigned, and apply PDCA methodology for continuous improvement.

Maintenance Governance: Advance system reliability and availability through the implementation of preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance strategies. Evaluate equipment health, performance data, alarms, and failure trends to ensure that all maintenance objectives are appropriately executed and aligned with operational standards.

Operational Engineering Support: Assist with any technical issues arise from operations including customer request, regulatory and legal requirements, design intent fulfillment etc.

Equipment Lifecycle and Obsolescence: Develop and execute strategic plans for major equipment maintenance, overhauls, and cyclic replacements. Manage end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-service-life (EOSL) transitions, and oversee asset refresh programs to ensure sustained reliability, efficiency, and alignment with operational standards.

Vendor and Contractor Management: Coordinate and engage with internal stakeholders, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), service providers, consultants, and contractors to ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality maintenance services in alignment with organizational standards and operational requirements.

Regional Capability Building: Provide coaching and mentorship to site teams, disseminate best practices, and strengthen regional competencies in the operation of mission-critical environments.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/ electrical engineering, Building Services Engineering or related discipline.
  • Candidates with SCEM, GMAP, CDCS or other related professional certificates are preferred.
  • Minimum 8-12 years of experience in in managing critical infrastructure and equipment, preferably in data centers environments.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for the complete electrical and mechanical infrastructure lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of local and international standards on equipment maintenance scope, frequency and operating parameters.
  • Have in depth knowledge of local regulations in operations and maintenance management.
  • Proven experience leading complex incident response, performing advanced fault diagnosis, protection system analysis, forensic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and driving permanent corrective and preventive actions across equipment lifecycle and operations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Willingness to travel across Southeast Asia to support site operations, audits, technical certification, commissioning, incident response, and technical reviews.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

Establish and maintain the Day One Data Centre Known Error Database (KEDB) to ensure systematic documentation and resolution of recurring issues.

Energy and Water Performance Management: Familiar with ISO 50001 Energy Management Scheme, monitor and analyze performance indicators for the data centre portfolio assigned, and apply PDCA methodology for continuous improvement.

Maintenance Governance: Advance system reliability and availability through the implementation of preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance strategies. Evaluate equipment health, performance data, alarms, and failure trends to ensure that all maintenance objectives are appropriately executed and aligned with operational standards.

Operational Engineering Support: Assist with any technical issues arise from operations including customer request, regulatory and legal requirements, design intent fulfillment etc.

Equipment Lifecycle and Obsolescence: Develop and execute strategic plans for major equipment maintenance, overhauls, and cyclic replacements. Manage end-of-life (EOL) and end-of-service-life (EOSL) transitions, and oversee asset refresh programs to ensure sustained reliability, efficiency, and alignment with operational standards.

Vendor and Contractor Management: Coordinate and engage with internal stakeholders, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), service providers, consultants, and contractors to ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality maintenance services in alignment with organizational standards and operational requirements.

Regional Capability Building: Provide coaching and mentorship to site teams, disseminate best practices, and strengthen regional competencies in the operation of mission-critical environments.

Candidate Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical/ electrical engineering, Building Services Engineering or related discipline.
  • Candidates with SCEM, GMAP, CDCS or other related professional certificates are preferred.
  • Minimum 8-12 years of experience in in managing critical infrastructure and equipment, preferably in data centers environments.
  • Demonstrated experience as a Technical Subject Matter Expert (SME) responsible for the complete electrical and mechanical infrastructure lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of local and international standards on equipment maintenance scope, frequency and operating parameters.
  • Have in depth knowledge of local regulations in operations and maintenance management.
  • Proven experience leading complex incident response, performing advanced fault diagnosis, protection system analysis, forensic Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and driving permanent corrective and preventive actions across equipment lifecycle and operations.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Willingness to travel across Southeast Asia to support site operations, audits, technical certification, commissioning, incident response, and technical reviews.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Vice President, Finance
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Vice President, Finance, you will report to the Chief Financial Officer, serve as the most senior finance leader across the AirTrunk Group, and work closely with the Finance, Corporate Development, Treasury and Legal teams, as well as our shareholder partner, Blackstone.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the finance strategy of a leading global hyperscale data centre platform at a critical stage of expansion. The role provides direct exposure to a world-class infrastructure investor, influence over multi-billion-dollar capital allocation decisions, and a clear line of sight to value creation and exit.

This is a strategically critical role, central to growing and protecting enterprise value as AirTrunk scales across multiple jurisdictions. You will operate as a senior enterprise leader within the Group CFO leadership team.

We have grown at remarkable speed, and our ambition is even greater. To realise it, we need to lead the team to the next level, industrialise our operating model and make it scalable for the growth ahead.

Key accountabilities include:

  • Leadership: Lead a team across Financial Control, Financial Operations and Financial Planning & Analysis.
  • CFO partnership: Serve as the CFO’s deputy and act on the CFO’s behalf during periods of leave.
  • Lead and oversee outsourced and offshore finance teams, ensuring the effective delivery of finance activities and alignment with Group requirements.
  • Lead the financial elements of due diligence, asset monetisation and capital recycling initiatives, including valuation, financial modelling, transaction structuring and execution.

Your day to day

Financial Control:

  • Lead the annual statutory reporting and audit process.
  • Manage information undertakings and other requirements under financing arrangements.
  • Lead financial internal controls, delegations, policies and procedures, including the ongoing development of controls appropriate for a growing business across the APAC region.
  • Monitor changes in the operating environment and business developments, and advise on appropriate risk management practices.

Financial Operations:

  • Oversee the Group’s financial operations across Asia Pacific, including accounts receivable and accounts payable.
  • Own the company's financial systems, including the ERP and Integrated Business Planning system.
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of operational best practices in accounting and finance.

Financial Planning & Analysis:

  • Lead the budgeting and forecasting processes alongside the CFO and in partnership with the leadership and management team.
  • Support the development and tracking of performance measures aligned with the company's strategic direction.
  • Lead the ongoing development of financial strategies.

Requirements

  • Previous experience as Deputy CFO or second-in-command to the CFO of a large company, or as CFO of a medium-sized company.
  • Experience helping organisations scale rapidly through better processes, technology and outsourced capability, without unnecessary headcount growth.
  • Preferred industry experience in property, funds management or infrastructure.
  • Preferred experience in private equity-backed or institutionally owned companies.
  • Collaborative, pragmatic and commercially minded, with a strong focus on outcomes and creating value for the business.
  • Builds strong, trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and partners confidently and effectively with Blackstone, exercising sound judgement.
  • A strong people leader who brings out the best in others, builds capability and develops future talent.
  • An enterprise-minded leader who looks beyond Finance and understands the broader business and its strategic priorities.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

job.title: Accountant- Statutory Reporting - Bengaluru, Karnātaka, India
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and draft statutory financial statements, including primary statements, notes and supporting schedules, in accordance with applicable local GAAP requirements.
  • Prepare, manage and submit statistical returns and other recurring regulatory reporting obligations for the selected country portfolio assigned, ensuring outputs are complete, accurate and aligned with local reporting requirements.
  • Develop a strong understanding of the legal entity portfolio, including retail, xScale, joint venture and other group entities, and apply that knowledge to ensure accurate and complete statutory reporting.
  • Analyse US GAAP, IFRS and local GAAP reporting differences, supporting the preparation and documentation of adjustments, reconciliations and disclosure requirements.
  • Partner closely with the country owners within the statutory reporting team, who retain responsibility for managing local audits, to gather inputs, resolve drafting and reporting queries, and support the timely completion of statutory reporting deliverables.
  • Perform analytical reviews of financial statements, trial balances and supporting schedules, identifying unusual movements and ensuring explanations are clear, accurate and well documented.
  • Maintain high-quality working papers, evidence and process documentation to support internal review, external audit and statutory filing requirements.
  • Plan and coordinate assigned work with the wider team, balancing requests from multiple country owners and communicating capacity, priorities and potential bottlenecks to support effective workload distribution.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, including the use of AI, automation and digital tools to improve drafting efficiency, data quality, review workflows and knowledge management.
  • Take ownership of assigned deliverables, anticipate issues, escalate risks appropriately and demonstrate flexibility in supporting ad hoc statutory reporting projects and business changes.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Qualified or part-qualified accountant, or equivalent relevant experience in accounting, statutory reporting, financial reporting or audit.
  • 2+ years experience preparing or drafting statutory financial statements, ideally gained through Big 4 audit or accounting advisory experience, or in a comparable financial statement drafting role within a large, complex multinational organisation.
  • Strong accounting knowledge, with an interest in developing expertise across local GAAP frameworks, IFRS and US GAAP.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to review financial information, investigate variances and present conclusions clearly.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools; experience with ERP systems and reporting platforms is desirable.
  • Curiosity and practical interest in AI-enabled productivity, automation, data quality and process improvement within finance and accounting processes.

Key Competencies

  • Ownership and initiative: Demonstrates a self-starting mindset, takes responsibility for deliverables and proactively follows through to completion.
  • Technical curiosity: Shows genuine interest in statutory reporting, local GAAP, IFRS, US GAAP and the practical application of accounting standards.
  • Accuracy and control focus: Maintains strong attention to detail and produces work that is audit-ready, well supported and compliant with reporting requirements.
  • Global collaboration: Works effectively with stakeholders across countries, functions and time zones, communicating clearly and professionally.
  • Continuous improvement mindset: Looks for opportunities to simplify, standardise and improve processes, including the responsible use of AI and automation.
  • Resilience and adaptability: Manages competing deadlines, responds positively to change and remains focused in a complex global reporting environment.

job.title: NSD Program Director
job.description:
About Vantage

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Position Description

The Program Director is accountable for leading the front-end development lifecycle of new data center opportunities across APAC, progressing projects from initial site identification through land acquisition and execution readiness. Acting as the central coordinator across internal and external stakeholders, this role drives due diligence, investment decision-making, and governance processes to maximize site conversion and ensure development opportunities align with Vantage's strategic growth objectives.

The Program Director will oversee cross-functional due diligence programs spanning site evaluation, technical and infrastructure assessments, commercial analysis, and risk management. A key responsibility will be leading governance frameworks, stage-gate processes, and investment approval pathways to ensure opportunities meet defined criteria before advancing. The role will provide transparency across the APAC project pipeline, develop robust business cases, and lead the preparation and presentation of investment recommendations to the APAC Investment Council and other executive decision-making forums.

Success in this role requires strong collaboration across Leadership, Site Selection, Design & Engineering, Construction, Operations, Finance, Sales, Marketing, and other subject matter experts. Acting as a key integrator, the Program Director will align technical, commercial, operational, and strategic priorities, drive decision-making through effective governance, and ensure Vantage has the right capacity in the right markets at the right time to support customer demand and long-term growth across the APAC region.

Essential Job Functions

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council, driving strategic investment decisions, prioritization of development opportunities and portfolio growth initiatives across the region.
  • Lead and manage all aspects of technical and commercial due diligence and front-end planning for new development projects, including site assessments, feasibility studies, conceptual design, due diligence workstreams, power and fibre strategy development, entitlement, and permitting activities.
  • Provide strategic leadership, thought partnership, and executive-level guidance on key projects and initiatives, including budget management, schedule oversight, risk mitigation, and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive cross-functional alignment between development, investment, operations, legal, finance, and commercial teams to ensure successful project execution and achievement of regional growth objectives.
  • Lead the definition and execution of due diligence programs for complex infrastructure development opportunities, ensuring key technical, commercial, regulatory, and delivery risks are identified, appropriately investigated, and assessed to support investment, acquisition, and development decision-making.

Duties

  • Lead the APAC Investment Council process, providing transparency across the regional development pipeline, developing robust business cases, and preparing and presenting investment recommendations to executive leadership and decision-making forums.
  • Serve as the primary owner of front-end development activities, driving opportunities from site identification through land acquisition by coordinating due diligence, risk management, stakeholder alignment, and investment approvals to improve conversion of site selection opportunities.
  • Lead all early-stage project development and due diligence activities, including site selection, feasibility assessments, conceptual design, utility strategy (power, water, and fiber), permitting pathways, commercial assessments, risk evaluations, and investment approval processes.
  • Interpret technical findings and provide development and commercial recommendations and risk mitigation strategies to support acquisitions.
  • Act as the central point of integration across internal and external stakeholders undertaking due diligence, ensuring alignment, accountability, and timely decision-making throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide executive oversight and portfolio governance across the APAC development pipeline, delivering regular updates to Executive Leadership on project progress, risks, schedules, budgets, quality, financial performance, cash flow, and critical decisions required to achieve business objectives.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration across Site Selection, Development, Operations, Finance, Legal, Commercial, Procurement, Design, Engineering and Construction, and Executive Leadership teams to define project requirements, resolve issues, manage risks, and support informed investment decisions.
  • Lead and manage relationships with external consultants, landowners, contractors, utilities, government authorities, regulatory agencies, and industry stakeholders to secure successful project outcomes and maintain development momentum.
  • Drive project outcomes from concept through execution readiness, establishing scope, schedule, budget, governance frameworks, consultant engagement strategies, and business case approvals while maintaining alignment with strategic objectives and investment criteria.
  • Oversee portfolio reporting and governance, ensuring leadership maintains full visibility of pipeline health, site conversion performance, project risks, costs, schedules, market dynamics, and capital deployment priorities.
  • Identify and mitigate development, permitting, commercial, infrastructure, and execution risks to support successful project advancement and informed investment decisions.
  • Lead contract governance, performance reporting, and financial management activities, ensuring robust controls, risk management, and informed decision-making across the portfolio.

This role will be based in Cikarang, Indonesia.

  • Act as the key campus Health and Safety interface for customers and other external stakeholders, ensuring applicable Health and Safety requirements are understood, appropriately addressed, and met or exceeded, while supporting customer engagements, reviews, and assurance activities.

  • Implement Digital Edge Health and Safety standards, procedures, programs, and critical controls, ensuring effective application across construction and operational environments.

  • Drive contractor and service-provider Health and Safety performance across construction and operational activities, including mobilization, competency, field execution, maintenance works, performance reviews, corrective actions, and escalation where required.

  • Lead the implementation of Health and Safety training, competency, communications, and engagement programs across the campus, ensuring employees and contractors understand applicable requirements and critical controls.
  • Lead campus Health and Safety inspections, audits, assurance activities, performance reviews, and leading indicators, identifying emerging risks and ensuring significant findings and actions are appropriately escalated and closed.
  • Lead and develop campus Health and Safety personnel and coordinate PMCM and other Health and Safety resources, ensuring effective deployment, clear accountability, and consistent standards of execution.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health and safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 8+ years of progressive Health and Safety experience, including significant experience leading Health and Safety across large-scale construction, commissioning, and/or operational environments.
  • Proven experience in Health and Safety and risk management within large-scale, complex or high-risk environments, including data centers, pharmaceutical, chemical, or process industries.
  • Strong practical understanding of Health and Safety risks across construction and live operational environments, including work at height, lifting operations, electrical works, energy isolation, Permit-to-Work, confined spaces, hot work, and contractor maintenance activities.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with Construction, Operations, Facilities Management, and Project Management teams to integrate Health and Safety into work planning and execution and strengthen functional ownership.
  • Proven ability to coach and build Health and Safety capability across functional teams, including practical training, field-based coaching, and influencing leaders and frontline personnel to improve safe execution.
  • Strong experience in contractor and service-provider Health and Safety management, including mobilisation, competency, performance monitoring, field assurance, corrective actions, and escalation.
  • Experience implementing and maintaining Health and Safety and Environmental Management Systems, including ISO 45001 and ISO 14001.
  • Strong experience in incident management and investigation, inspections, audits, assurance activities, leading indicators, and corrective and preventive action management.
  • Proven ability to engage effectively with customers and other external stakeholders, understand their Health and Safety requirements, and support customer reviews and assurance activities.
  • Demonstrated leadership and people-management capabilities, including coaching and developing Health and Safety professionals and coordinating contractors or PMCM Health and Safety resources.
  • Strong knowledge of Indonesian Health and Safety regulatory requirements, together with knowledge of international Health and Safety standards and good industry practice.
  • Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and English, with the ability to communicate effectively across frontline teams, contractors, customers, and senior leadership.

If you’re ready to help shape the next phase of a fast‑growing digital infrastructure platform, we’d like to hear from you.”

  • Act as the senior Health and Safety technical authority for the design and operational lifecycle, setting strategic direction and technical standards and assurance requirements for implementation by Regional, Country and Campus teams.

  • Provide technical Health and Safety leadership and assurance requirements for critical infrastructure and high-risk operational activities, including electrical, mechanical, fire and life safety, high-voltage systems, energy isolation, switching, and other mission-critical hazards.
  • Define and maintain assurance requirements for PTW systems and high-risk activities, and establish and monitor leading Health and Safety indicators across the portfolio, using platform-level dashboards and performance data to identify gaps, trends, and systemic risks and translate these into improvements to standards, assurance priorities, and capability programs.
  • Develop and oversee Health and Safety competency and training programs for Operations personnel, including digital learning and practical onsite training, and define competency requirements for employees and contractors performing safety-critical and high-risk activities.
  • Define and maintain requirements for critical electrical safety controls across the portfolio, including requirements for the review and application of arc flash studies and associated operational controls at site level.
  • Partner with Operations and Facilities Management teams to strengthen Health and Safety standards, safe systems of work, and accountability frameworks across live facilities, particularly for high-risk maintenance and operational activities.
  • Define Health and Safety standards and assurance requirements for internal fit-out works, supporting consistent implementation by Country and Campus teams while maintaining operational continuity.
  • Review operational Health and Safety incidents, including high-potential events, to identify systemic learnings and ensure lessons are incorporated into future designs, Health and Safety standards, training programs, procedures, and operating practices across the portfolio.
  • Drive cross-country learning and continuous improvement, ensuring significant Health and Safety learnings, effective controls and good practices are systematically shared and incorporated into standards, training and operational practices across Regional, Country and Campus teams.
  • Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health and safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • 15+ years of progressive Health and Safety experience, including significant leadership experience across the design, commissioning, and/or operations of data centers or other mission-critical facilities.
  • Proven experience in Design for Safety, operational safety assurance, and risk management within large-scale, complex, mission-critical or high-risk environments, including data centers, pharmaceutical, chemical, or process industries.
  • Strong technical understanding of critical data center systems and associated safety risks, including electrical, mechanical, fire and life safety, high-voltage systems, energy isolation, switching, and commissioning activities.
  • Strong understanding of operational Permit-to-Work systems, high-risk work controls, electrical safety, and management of change in live operational environments.
  • Experience developing and implementing technical Health and Safety standards, assurance frameworks, leading indicators, competency frameworks, training programs, and portfolio-level programs.
  • Proven ability to influence senior Design & Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Operations stakeholders and embed Health and Safety into technical and operational decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of international Health and Safety standards, risk management principles, and relevant regulatory requirements.

job.title: Registration of Interest for #AIDA Talent Acceleration Day (Sept 2026) -Senior AI Harness Engineer
job.description:
Role Summary

At Singtel, we are building AI capabilities across customer experience, network and service operations, enterprise solutions and internal productivity.

As a Lead AI Harness Engineer, you will define and build the engineering foundations around AI models and agents that enable them to operate reliably, safely and at enterprise scale.

You will lead the design of reusable orchestration, context, memory, tool integration, evaluation, simulation, guardrail and instrumentation capabilities that allow AI systems to interact securely with Singtel's data, knowledge, APIs and operational systems.

This is a senior individual-contributor role combining deep hands-on engineering with technical leadership. You will solve complex cross-cutting engineering problems, establish reusable patterns and standards, and shape how production AI systems are engineered across Singtel.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Define the architecture and technical direction for reusable AI harness capabilities across Singtel.
  • Design and build common frameworks for agent orchestration, context engineering, memory, tool integration, evaluation, simulation, instrumentation and runtime controls.
  • Establish engineering patterns for connecting AI agents securely to enterprise data, APIs, MCP servers, workflows and operational systems.
  • Define evaluation strategies and quality gates covering task success, grounding, tool execution, safety, reliability, latency and cost.
  • Design scalable evaluation and experimentation infrastructure supporting automated regression testing, simulation, replay and production feedback loops.
  • Establish instrumentation and observability patterns that enable teams to understand and diagnose AI and agent behaviour end to end.
  • Design mechanisms to capture production failures, user feedback and operational outcomes and convert them into continuously improving evaluation datasets and tests.
  • Define patterns for agent identity, permissions, policy enforcement, human oversight, graceful degradation and fail-safe behaviour.
  • Build reusable SDKs, libraries, services and reference implementations that enable engineering teams to develop production AI systems faster and more consistently.
  • Make architectural trade-offs across model capability, reliability, latency, security, sovereignty, scalability and cost.
  • Lead complex technical investigations and resolve systemic engineering and reliability issues across AI applications.
  • Partner with AI Engineering, Central AI Platform, AI & Agent Operations, Data, Cybersecurity and business engineering teams to establish production engineering standards.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture and design reviews, code reviews, mentoring and hands-on engineering.
  • Evaluate emerging AI infrastructure, agent frameworks and engineering approaches and determine where Singtel should build, adopt or standardise.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI/ML or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 8+ years of software, platform, distributed systems, AI or ML engineering experience, with significant experience designing and operating production-grade systems.
  • Deep software engineering expertise in Python, with strong foundations in APIs, distributed systems, concurrency, testing and system design.
  • Hands-on experience architecting and building production LLM, RAG or agentic systems.
  • Strong understanding of agent architectures, context engineering, retrieval, memory, tool/function calling and orchestration.
  • Strong experience in evaluation, observability, testing or reliability engineering for complex production systems.
  • Strong understanding of integration architectures including REST APIs, event-driven systems and modern agent/tool protocols such as MCP.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security including identity, authentication, authorisation, secrets management and least-privilege access.
  • Experience designing reusable platforms, frameworks, SDKs or developer infrastructure adopted by multiple engineering teams.
  • Strong cloud-native and distributed-systems engineering experience.
  • Experience with agent or LLM frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain or equivalent is advantageous, but deep engineering fundamentals are more important than familiarity with a particular framework.
  • Ability to operate as a senior technical authority, influence engineering decisions across teams and translate rapidly evolving AI capabilities into robust production engineering practices.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Lead Security Architect
job.description:

This role oversees implementation of Artificial Intelligence (AI) architectures, Infrastructure and Application security architectures, Zero Trust secure architecture principles, threat models, security reference architectures and design patterns.
  • This role will partner closely with enterprise architects, solution designers, application teams, technology infrastructure, devsecops, project management and executive leadership to deliver secure and resilient solutions.

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is focused on getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Solutions Architect, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams across the organization, including engineering, operations, security, and business stakeholders, to develop and implement high-level and low-level designs that align with our strategic objectives. You will also play a crucial role in driving technology innovation, lifecycle management, and governance to ensure our network infrastructure remains resilient, scalable, and future proof.

This role requires a blend of technical expertise in muti-technologies areas, leadership, and strategic thinking to design, implement, and manage robust network solutions that support an organization's objectives. The role will report to the Director – IP Core and Access Engineering/Networks.

**

What You’ll Do

  • Own the architecture, roadmap, performance, and lifecycle management of Common Packet Core, IP Access, and Management Networks, ensuring alignment with business and technology objectives.
  • Define strategic direction for network growth, resiliency, modernization, and decommissioning, while driving architectural evolution and platform optimisation.
  • Lead the adoption of emerging IP technologies, automation, and engineering best practices to improve network reliability, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  • Provide end-to-end technical leadership across network design, governance, product integration, vendor management, major upgrades, cutovers, and Tier 3 operational support.

What You Bring

  • Degree-qualified Telecommunications/Network Engineer with 10+ years’ experience designing, implementing, and evolving large-scale, resilient carrier-grade fixed, mobile, and data networks.
  • Deep technical expertise across IP networking, routing and switching, MPLS/SRv6, EVPN/VXLAN, cloud and data centre networking, network automation, QoS, timing and synchronisation, and network security.
  • Strong network architecture and strategy leader with proven success translating business requirements into scalable, cost-effective solutions, driving technology roadmaps, new product introductions, PoCs, and network transformation initiatives.
  • Accomplished technical leader and problem-solver with extensive experience in cross-functional stakeholder engagement, vendor management, regulatory compliance, operational excellence, and delivery of complex telecommunications services across consumer, enterprise, wholesale, and mobile domains.

By empowering one another, backing bold ideas and helping you own your impact, we’ve designed a workplace that gives you the freedom to grow, the support to thrive, and the chance to be part of something bigger – a team that’s shaping a more connected, inclusive and inspired Australia.

**

The good stuff:

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s designed for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers**

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right mindset matter more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)

job.title: Contact Centre Specialist - Network Operations Centre
job.description:
Macquarie Park, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Only applicants with full Australian Citizenship can be considered for this role, due to security requirements.

*After initial onboarding and training this will be on a 24 x 7 rotating roster 5 days required on-site

*

Optus is an Australian telecommunications company, delivering more than 11 million services to our customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

Join Optus as a Contact Centre Specialist, where you’ll deliver high‑quality managed services and technical support across Cloud Contact Centre technologies for a large government client. Working within a mature ITIL environment, you’ll take ownership of escalated issues, support change and incident processes, and collaborate with customer and internal teams to ensure stability, continuity, and exceptional customer experience. This role blends hands‑on technical troubleshooting with strong stakeholder engagement, contributing to customer satisfaction, compliance, process improvement, and seamless delivery of Contact Centre services.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Deliver technical support for Cloud Contact Centre environments, handling escalated incidents and customer issues.
  • Update and maintain ServiceNow records, ensuring accurate tracking of incidents, changes, and customer interactions.
  • Execute complex MACs, transitions, and after‑hours changes in line with agreed processes and maintenance windows.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues and support customer security requirements.
  • Keep technical documentation current to support ongoing operations and knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Participate in service governance meetings, providing updates, insights, and support for incident and problem management.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Strong ICT technical and operational background with experience supporting Contact Centre, Networks and Cloud technologies.
  • Proven troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and ability to manage user‑facing technical issues under pressure.
  • Working to SLAs in a Network Operational Centre (NOC) environment and familiar with service management processes.
  • Experience with ServiceNow, including incident, problem, and change management processes.
  • Ability to work autonomously with strong organisational skills and flexibility to adapt to shifting priorities.
  • Excellent customer and vendor engagement capabilities with a focus on positive outcomes and communication.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including clear documentation and stakeholder updates.
  • Ability to coordinate across cross‑functional teams and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Willingness to learn new technologies and ways of working.
  • Desirable: Cloud skills, knowledge of major CC platforms, and awareness of emerging IP communications technologies

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Flexible working arrangements with opportunities to work three days in the office, two days remote or home.
  • Vibrant and collaborative office campus that includes cafes, convenience store, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.

  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
