job.title: Technician - Field Service
job.description:
We are looking for a talented Diesel Technician to join our high performing team in Darwin, NT. In this role you will diagnose and complete repairs to engines at the customer’s site.

You will make an impact in the following ways:

  • Engage customers in a courteous and professional manner. Anticipates and ensures prompt and efficient attention to customer needs.
  • Apply the use of specialized tools and follows documented procedures and policies to diagnose and complete repairs, including identifying and preparing required parts and tools.
  • Perform preventative maintenance activities as per documented schedules and standards on engine and related components in the field.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to more experienced Field Service Technicians and/or Supervisor.
  • Complete required documentation, such as service worksheets, timesheets, warranty claims, quality documents via handwritten forms or business system input screens.
  • Identify additional service opportunities with customer.
  • Complete training in line with skill and business requirements.
  • Maintain service vehicle and tools for cleanliness and proper operation.
  • Ensure adherence to all relevant Health Safety & Environmental policies, procedures and legislation and reports any issues / incidents to site management and to their supervisor.
  • Complete in workshop repairs as required

Additional Information:

  • Full Time / 38 hours per week
  • On Call Roster 1 week per month
  • Overtime as required – Penalty rates paid for all work above 38 hours
  • All your Safety equipment / PPE and uniforms are provided and laundered
  • Domestic Relocation from across Australia _may_ be offered for the right candidate
  • _Local Valid Drivers License is required_
  • _Remote Area Travel Required_

To be successful in this role you will need the following:

  • Apprentice Trained Engine Technician (Cert III) or equivalent
  • Basic level of workshop or field service experience required
  • Intermediate level knowledge of and/or experience with engine products
  • Heavy Vehicle or Mobile Plant Experience preferred
  • HR License preferred
  • _Cummins experience preferred but not essential_
  • _Remote Work Experience highly preferred_
  • _Power Generation (Mechanical) experience preferred but not essential_

Critical Competencies:

  • Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.
  • Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.
  • Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.
  • Engine Systems Interactions - Interprets and analyzes the interactions of internal and external electrical and mechanical systems (exhaust, heating, cooling, fuel systems, driveline, aftertreatment, controls, sensors, etc.) by applying tools, service publications (Cummins, Original Equipment Manufacturer) and taking measurements to efficiently and correctly diagnose and repair.
  • Product Repair and Maintenance - Repairs and maintains mechanical/electrical products following guidelines, using required tools within standard repair time to ensure a quality repair; disassembles and assembles engines or power generators following guidelines, using required tools to ensure a clean and organized environment; inspects and replaces parts and components following re-use guidelines to minimize customers cost of ownership; performs progressive damage check following guidelines to restore to pre-failure condition.
  • Service Documentation - Creates and verifies customer, equipment and technical information; captures specific data using required service tools; follows procedures and documents required information in the service management system in order to have an accurate record of the work done.
  • Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: 2027 Early Career - Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, testing, and validation of embedded software for engine, powertrain, and vehicle control systems.
  • Participate in software design, coding, debugging, and integration activities under the guidance of experienced engineers.
  • Develop and maintain software models and algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink and implement software functions in C.
  • Support software verification activities, including simulation, unit testing, and system testing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product development and issue resolution.
  • Follow software development processes, quality standards, and engineering best practices.
  • Create and maintain required technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automotive Engineering, Engine Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Software Engineering, Control Engineering, or a related field.
  • Basic knowledge of embedded software development and vehicle or engine control systems.
  • Familiarity with MATLAB/Simulink and C programming.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork skills.
  • Eagerness to learn and grow in automotive software development.

job.title: Production Associate - Level II
job.description:
Job Summary

Operates machines and production equipment in accordance with quality and productivity requirements safely in a manufacturing environment with limited guidance.

Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Stop work and immediately report any major injury hazards. Report any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Comply with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Use appropriate personal protective equipment. Promote interdependence by looking out for one another. Correct hazards within your control and capabilities. Recognize how your work may impact the environment and work to minimize the negative impact. Engage in HSE Training. Quality Follows all applicable standard work, process documentation and quality procedures such as Statistical Process Control (SPC), poka-yoke and visual standards. Raises issues to minimize cost and quality exposures. Performs quality inspections. Identifies and controls non-conforming material. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet production goals. Works with peers, skilled trades and support staff to maintain and identify equipment needing repair. Teamwork Communicates effectively with the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements. Participates actively in ways to improve quality, safety, process, material flow, and employee development.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Courage - Stepping up to address difficult issues, saying what needs to be said.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Ensures accountability - Holding self and others accountable to meet commitments.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

job.title: 管理アソシエイト − レベル III − サービス
job.description:
仕事の概要:

チーム、部門、機能、または他の組織リーダー/グループに対して割り当てられた事務サポート業務に関連する文書を調整し、データを収集して入力する。最小限の監督の下で業務を完了する。

主要な責務:

調査の実施、統計レポートの作成、および日常的および複雑な情報要請の対応を行い、事務サポートを提供する。

情報の収集、編集、検証を行い、報告書、プレゼンテーション、書式などの文書、ならびにデータベースやスプレッドシートなどのオフィスシステムに正確に入力する。

さまざまな部門関連の業務に関するデータ収集、データ入力、レポート作成を完了する。

通信文書の作成、訪問者の対応、電話会議の手配、会議の予定など、アソシエイトの職務を行う。

電話をかけてきた人/訪問者が迅速かつ正確に応対されるように、組織/部門、業務、またはプロセスについて、内外の情報源からの日常的および複雑な問い合わせに応答したり、転送したりする。

該当する場合、ベンダー、サプライヤおよびその他の第三者の支払いのための書類を作成する。書類を提出し、会計システムに支払い要請を入力する。買掛金の取引先と受取人からの問い合わせに対応する。

部門の方針と手順を文書化して管理する。

必要に応じて、部門関連の事業改善のための仕事やプロジェクトにチームメンバーとして参加する。

組織および/または部門の確立された手順に従って、必要に応じて他の日常的および複雑な事務作業を行う。

経験の浅い同僚に対して、非公式の要員としての役割を果たす。

スキル:

多様性の尊重 - 異なる視野や文化が組織にもたらす価値を理解する。

行動指向 - 新しい機会や厳しい課題を緊急感、高いエネルギー、熱意を持って引き受ける。

効果的なコミュニケーション - 多種多様なコミュニケーションを展開して、さまざまな相手のニーズを明確に理解する。

顧客志向 - 顧客と強固な関係を構築し、顧客の立場に立った解決策を提供する。

責務の遂行 - 約束 （コミットメント） を果たすために、自分で責任を持ち、他の人にも責任を持たせる。

的確な計画立案 - 組織目標と整合した方策を推進するために、計画を立案し、業務に優先順位をつける。

データ分析 - 定性データおよび定量データを発見、解釈、伝達する。ビジネスまたは組織のフレームワークに関する知識に基づいて結論を出す。統計、データ妥当性、データ可視化、問題解決のアプローチを同時に適用して、有意義なパターンやビジネスに関する洞察を効果的に抽出する。データ主導型のビジネス上の意思決定を可能にする結論や結果を提示する。

データ通信と可視化 - レポートやダッシュボードなどのデータを可視化することで、ビジネス問題、根本原因、ソリューションのオプション、ビジネス機会などの情報を構築する。

学歴、免許、資格:

高校卒業または中等教育の修了証、または同等の経験（かかる経験が適用される規制に準拠する場合）

この役職では、輸出管理または制裁規則を遵守するためにライセンスが必要になる場合があります。

職歴:

教育、訓練、または実務経験によって得られた、関連職務に関するかなりの経験または専門技能が必要。

100% On-Site No

Here, you'll have the power to determine your future with innovative technology, a focus on sustainability and with a company positioned for long-term growth.

job.title: Service Adminislator
job.description:
Job Summary

Coordinates documents and gathers and inputs data related to assigned administrative support duties for a team, department, function or other organizational leader/group. Completes work with a limited degree of supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provides administrative support by conducting research, preparing statistical reports and addressing routine to complex information requests. Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets.
  • Completes data collection, data entry and report generation on various departmental related activities. Performs associate functions as preparing correspondence, receiving visitors, arranging conference calls and scheduling meetings.
  • Responds to, or redirects, routine to complex inquiries from external or internal sources about the organization/department, its activities, or processes so callers/visitors are answered promptly and accurately.
  • Prepares documentation for payment of vendors, suppliers and other third parties as applicable; submits documentation and enters request for payments into accounting system; responds to inquiries from accounts payable and payees.
  • Documents and maintains departmental policies and procedures.
  • Participates as a team member on departmental related business improvement assignments and projects as needed.
  • Performs other routine to complex administrative activities as needed per the established procedures of the organization and/or department. Act as an informal resource for colleagues with less experience.

当社が日本国内で展開するカミンズ製品（ディーゼルエンジンおよび関連機器）のアフターサービス（保守・メンテナンス・修理）を支えるバックオフィス業務をご担当いただきます。

営業担当者、フィールドテクニシャン（技術者）、および社内関係部署（財務・経理、サプライチェーン、他営業部門など）と連携しながら、見積書や請求書の作成をはじめとする顧客対応を行っていただきます。また、売上・仕入処理や各種経費処理など、サービス営業活動を支える重要な役割を担っていただくポジションです。

業務内容

アフターサービス（保証期間中の修理対応を含む）に関わる各種アシスタント業務をご担当いただきます。

  • 修理・点検に必要な部品の受発注業務、および納期管理
  • 見積書、注文書、請求書などの各種書類作成
  • 顧客、営業担当者、フィールドテクニシャン、関連部署との各種調整・問い合わせ対応

  • 仕入計上および関連費用の処理
  • 各種経費処理（宅配便費用、産業廃棄物処理費用、車両リース費用、事務所賃料など）
  • 業務プロセスの改善および効率化の推進

必須要件（MUST）

  • ビジネスレベルの英語力（主にメール・文書作成などの読み書き）
  • Excel中級レベル以上のスキル（VLOOKUP関数、ピボットテーブル等を使用できる方）
  • Microsoft Teams、Zoom、Outlook、Word、PowerPointなどの基本的なPCスキル

歓迎要件（WANT）

  • SAP、OracleなどERPシステムの使用経験
  • 機械、電気、電子機器などの技術系製品を扱う業界での事務またはアシスタント経験
  • 営業事務、サービス事務、受発注管理業務の経験

求める人物像

  • 多様な関係者と円滑なコミュニケーションを図りながら業務を進められる方（上司・同僚・テクニシャン・営業担当者・エンジニア・サプライチェーン・財務経理など、多くの関係者との調整業務があります）
  • スピード感を持ち、変化する状況にも柔軟に対応できる方
  • 主体的に課題を発見し、業務改善や効率化に取り組める方
  • チームワークを重視し、責任感を持って業務に取り組める方

このポジションの魅力

  • 世界最大級のエンジンメーカーであるCumminsのアフターサービス事業を支える中核業務に携われます。
  • 業務改善やプロセス改革にも積極的に関与でき、自身のアイデアを形にできる環境です。

  • Data Communication and Visualization - Constructs a tale of the business problem, root cause, solution options, and opportunities through illustrating data visually, including reports and dashboards.

job.description:
Job Summary

Ensures products received or produced meet technical specifications trains others and assists in process development. Works under minimal supervision. Supports customer issues resolution at customer end

Key Responsibilities

Support at customer end , SPOC for customer to identify and resolve issues . Provide 8D and issues resolution to customer for any issues , Verifies the final quality of products on the production line at customer end

Compares the physical characteristics of components, materials, equipment and products to technical specifications to identify defects.

Separates products that do not have the desired technical specification, using basic and/or complex measurement techniques and equipment.

Documents products that do not meet technical specifications using specified systems.

Trains others in the use of measurement equipment, segregation of non-conforming product and documentation.

Follows the norms and standards of quality defined by the Company.

Reports progress on problem resolution to management.

Assists in the development of new methods and procedures.

job.title: Data Center Development Manager, Japan

Your role at a glance

This is a highly impactful role that engages from the earliest stages of data center development in Japan, including site identification and selection, while supporting the NTT Group's growth strategy through real estate and infrastructure development.

What we are looking for

Provides sound strategic advice to senior management stakeholders on how NTT can improve its operations to increase profitability Examines financial reports to identify areas of weakness that may require additional investment Monitors industry trends to identify opportunities and threats to the business model Identifies external factors that could affect the success of the business operations Assesses the strengths and weaknesses of competitors so that strategies can be developed to beat the competition Analyses market trends to determine which products and / or services will be most profitable for NTT to invest in Works with senior management stakeholders o create medium-term to long-term strategic plans to achieve business objectives May recommend changes such as changes to organisational structures or business processes etc. that will increase efficiencies Knowledge, Skills and Attributes: Comprehensive understanding required of the specific industry Ability to find solutions to challenging and often complex problems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data and make data-driven strategic recommendations Excellent communication and presentation skills to articulate complex ideas and influence decision-makers Strategic mindset with the ability to think critically, anticipate future challenges, and develop proactive solutions Strong business acumen and understanding of market dynamics and industry trends Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and adapt to changing priorities Collaborative, with the capacity to build positive relationships with stakeholders at all levels Leadership qualities, including a high level of professionalism, integrity, and ethical conduct

job.title: Manager, Security Platform Engineering
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Manager, Security Platform Engineering is a hands-on people leader within the Global Data Centers Office of Information Security (GDC-OIS) organization, reporting to the Vice President of Cybersecurity Operations. This role is responsible for supporting and protecting mission-critical data center environments in Japan and around the globe while coordinating with regional and global cybersecurity teams.

This role combines day-to-day security engineering, platform operations, threat detection, vulnerability management, incident response, and operational technology (OT) security responsibilities with in-country people management, stakeholder engagement, and operational leadership.

The successful candidate will be technically capable of performing engineering and security operations work directly, while also managing, mentoring, and developing potential Japan-based Cybersecurity, ISMS (Information Security Management System) and/or DPP (Data Privacy and Protection) resources and partnering with local operations, engineering, vendors, and business stakeholders.

The role requires professional business fluency in both Japanese and English to operate effectively with Japan-based stakeholders and the global GDC OIS organization.

What we are looking for

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage Japan-based Cybersecurity, ISMS and/or DPP engineering and operations personnel, including day-to-day direction, coaching, workload prioritization, performance input, and professional development.
  • Serve as a hands-on cybersecurity technical leader for enterprise IT, Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and critical infrastructure security in Japan data center environments.
  • Perform and oversee administration, optimization, integration, and lifecycle management of enterprise security platforms, including break-fix support, patching, upgrades, automation, and platform enhancements.
  • Lead and support security monitoring, threat detection, and response activities across on-premises, cloud, enterprise, and operational technology environments.
  • Lead or directly participate in security incident investigations involving endpoint security, malware, identity compromise, network forensics, cloud security events, insider threats, and OT environments, ensuring timely containment, remediation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessment and vulnerability management activities for Japan-based enterprise and OT environments, partnering with local and global stakeholders to prioritize remediation based on business risk, exploitability, and threat intelligence.
  • Support cybersecurity initiatives involving ICS, SCADA, Building Management Systems (BMS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), and other critical facility technologies commonly found in data center environments.
  • Partner with data center operations, infrastructure, engineering, physical security, GID (global infrastructure development), vendors, and business stakeholders to establish and maintain security standards, hardening baselines, mitigation strategies, and operational security best practices.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve detection rules, use cases, dashboards, playbooks, automation workflows, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, and operational metrics.
  • Represent GDC-OIS with Japan-based leadership and operational teams, communicating technical risks, security priorities, remediation requirements, and operational updates in Japanese and English.
  • Lead post-incident reviews, lessons-learned activities, and continuous improvement initiatives designed to strengthen resilience, operational consistency, and security maturity.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams across APAC, India, EMEA, and the Americas to ensure consistent global standards while accounting for Japan-specific operational needs and stakeholder expectations.
  • Contribute to global cybersecurity strategy, platform roadmap planning, process improvement, and regional operating model development.

Knowledge Attributes:

  • Professional business fluency in Japanese and English, including written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Demonstrated people leadership capability, including coaching, prioritization, stakeholder management, and operational accountability.
  • Hands-on technical depth in security engineering, security operations, detection engineering, incident response, vulnerability management, and infrastructure security.
  • Ability to operate effectively in Japan business environments while collaborating across multinational, cross-cultural, and geographically distributed teams.
  • Strong understanding of OT security principles, industrial networking concepts, and cybersecurity controls for critical infrastructure environments.
  • Ability to translate technical risk into clear business impact, remediation options, and executive-ready communications.
  • Familiarity with industry frameworks and standards such as ISA/IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK, and ISO 27001 preferred.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Relevant security certifications such as CySA+, PenTest+, CCSP, GCIH, OSCP, CISM, CISSP, GICSP, GRID, ISA/IEC 62443, or equivalent preferred.
  • Relevant IT or cloud certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, RHCSA, AZ-500, SC-200, or equivalent preferred.
  • People management, leadership, or management training/certification is a plus.

Required Experience:

  • Minimum 8 years of progressive experience in cybersecurity operations, security engineering, threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, infrastructure security, or related disciplines.
  • Minimum 2 years of people leadership, team lead, supervisor, or equivalent management experience preferred, ideally in a technical cybersecurity or infrastructure environment.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with security technologies such as SIEM, SOAR, IAM, PAM, EDR/XDR, vulnerability management platforms, firewalls, proxy technologies, and threat hunting solutions.
  • Experience securing enterprise, data center, critical infrastructure, or operational technology environments.
  • Hands-on experience supporting ICS, SCADA, BMS, EPMS, or other OT environments required.
  • Advanced experience handling security incidents from detection through resolution, including stakeholder communication and post-incident improvement.
  • Advanced knowledge of networking, Windows, Linux, cloud security, and enterprise infrastructure.
  • Experience supporting globally distributed teams and operating across multiple time zones.
  • Experience within data center, cloud, colocation, telecommunications, manufacturing, energy, utilities, or other critical infrastructure environments strongly preferred.
  • Ability to communicate effectively in both Japanese and English in written and verbal business communications.

Work Conditions & Other Requirements

  • Position is intended to be based in Japan, with regular engagement with Japan-based data center operations and business stakeholders.
  • Hybrid work arrangement with flexibility for remote work where business requirements permit.
  • Must be comfortable supporting global operations across APAC, India, EMEA, and Americas time zones.
  • Domestic and international travel may be required up to 25%.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in Japan, as applicable to local hiring requirements.
  • Experience working within multinational, cross-cultural, and geographically distributed organizations is highly desirable

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Do you thrive at the intersection of sales execution, partner development, and public sector impact?

AWS Partner Account Managers (PAMs) work with select large Systems Integrator (SI) partners to develop go-to-market strategies that expand cloud adoption across Public Sector organizations. As a Public Sector PAM based in Singapore, you will lead the joint sales motion between AWS and your assigned SI partner(s) - creating and executing campaigns that align to AWS Worldwide Public Sector (WWPS) strategic initiatives and your partner's market positioning in Singapore's Government, Healthcare, and Education sectors.

You will work closely with AWS Account Executives, Solution Architects, Public Sector Industry Leaders, and Partner Marketing to develop new routes to market - building pipeline through joint offerings, solutions, and strategic initiatives tailored to Singapore's public sector landscape. The ideal candidate possesses a direct sales and partnership/alliance background that enables them to engage, earn trust, and influence at the CxO level with both partner executives and public sector decision-makers. Successful PAMs think strategically about business, policy, and technical challenges to convey compelling partner value propositions that address public sector outcomes.

A day in the life The PAM is an individual contributor role responsible for leading the public sector partner business with partner. You will define CxO relationship strategy - engaging AWS senior leaders for executive sponsorship, coordinating executive business reviews, and developing sales opportunities around partner offerings and solutions for public sector customers. You will build and maintain key relationships across government agencies and institutional buyers, advance strategic sales opportunities, and work with a regional team of Partner Managers to manage pipeline and deliver results. This role requires navigating Singapore's public sector procurement landscape, understanding government technology priorities, and translating them into joint partner-AWS solutions.

job.title: Sales Manager - Low Voltage Systems
job.description:

LVS Sales and Marketing Manager – South East Asia__

As a Sales Manager for ABB's Low Voltage Switchgear business in Singapore, you will be responsible for driving sales growth, market penetration, and customer engagement across ABB's Low Voltage Systems and Solutions portfolio. You will develop and execute sales strategies, build strong customer relationships, identify new business opportunities, and achieve sustainable growth in orders, revenue, profitability, and market share while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

  • ### 至少有3个以上大于100万人民币的数字化项目落地经验。

ABB 运动控制服务事业部面向全球客户提供服务，致力于提升设备运行时间、延长产品生命周期，并优化电气运动解决方案的性能与能效。该事业部通过对电机与变频器进行安全联网，引领数字化转型，以此提高设备运行时长、改善运行效率。我们提供的各类服务持续为客户及合作伙伴创造价值，助力其业务实现盈利、安全且可靠的运营。

job.title: Data Center Project Manager
job.description:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Project Manager (DCPM), you will manage assigned IT projects to meet service delivery objectives as well escalate to appropriate stakeholders to remove obstacles. You will also follow safety policies and procedures and participate in root cause analysis (RCA) of incidents. This job will allow you to build a solid understanding of data center procedures, engage in collaboration across various teams as well as provide mentorship across data centers by sharing outstanding practices.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCPM, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 data centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keep costs reasonable and contribute to staying within budget.
  • Follow and adhere to safety and security policies and procedures. Report immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
  • Perform troubleshooting for service incidents and escalates, as appropriate, to meet SLA/OLAs, with minimal disruption to the client/customer and business.
  • Recognize potential customer impact of other events and issues (e.g., customer lockdown), communicate potential impact, and plan for impact accordingly.
  • Proactively review schedules and avoid conflicts when possible. Identify, coordinate, manage expectations, and offer alternatives when defining customer solutions.
  • Manage relationships with clients and suppliers to ensure that all expectations are clarified, understood, documented, and met.
  • Suggest ways for reducing the risk of performing maintenance; work with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
  • In alignment with management priorities, hold self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). Support escalation of issues to appropriate owner.
  • Embody our[culture](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://careers.microsoft.com/us/en/culture) and [values](https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/%5C%22https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/about/corporate-values).

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High School Qualification or equivalent AND 2+ years experience supporting IT equipment or related technology or delivering server and network deployment projects in large-scale environments OR equivalent experience.

Background Check Requirements:

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's or Technical College Degree in Computer Science, Math, Telecommunications, Electrical/Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management or related field AND 5+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR High School Qualification or equivalent AND 7+ years experience in critical environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU), or working in physical IT infrastructures (e.g., Servers, SANs, Networking, Capacity, DC Rack/Enclosures, structured cabling) OR equivalent experience.
  • Applicable certifications: ASICS/Inventory Control, CompTIA, Microsoft, Network Certifications, PMP, ITIL, CDCP.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about [requesting accommodations.](https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html)

4. Troubleshoot daily electrical technical faults on production lines and job sites, optimize technical procedures and documents to resolve abnormal issues efficiently.

5. Conduct electrical performance testing, data analysis and technical iteration to improve the stability and cost performance of commercial and data center chiller electrical systems.

3录用条件：

1. Solid professional theoretical knowledge and practical capabilities in electrical, refrigeration or mechanical fields, capable of daily work optimization with internal company processes and systems.

2. Proficient in MS Office; familiarity with CAD, SolidWorks and other 3D drawing software is preferred.

3. Fluent in English in listening, speaking, reading and writing for technical communication and document processing.

4. Excellent communication skills, team spirit and detail-oriented working attitude, capable of independent technical work.

5. A minimum of 3 years of relevant professional experience, experience in commercial air conditioning and chiller application is preferred.

job.title: Battery System Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Conduct full-dimensional in-depth analysis of leading competitor battery pack solutions in the global passenger vehicle, new energy commercial vehicle, and construction machinery sectors, and deliver systematic technical assessment reports.
  • Precisely capture cutting-edge design concepts, innovative technical routes, and differentiated advantages in the industry. Combined with the company’s whole-vehicle electrification business scenarios, identify technically viable and implementable directions, and output technical feasibility analyses and application recommendations to guide the team’s R&D innovation.
  • Establish a dynamic tracking database for competitor battery technologies, regularly update industry technology trends and benchmark product iteration information, and prepare monthly/quarterly technical insight reports. This helps the team stay ahead of industry developments and avoid technical homogenization.
  • Lead benchmark testing and validation of competitor technologies. Compare and analyze core indicators such as performance, reliability, cost, and adaptability to identify internal technical gaps and optimization directions, driving the iterative upgrade of the company’s battery solutions.
  • Based on competitor technology research findings and the company’s business need, participate in the planning and design of battery pack system solutions for construction machinery/commercial vehicles, and lead key technology selection, architecture definition, and technical route formulation.
  • Provide technical support throughout the entire battery pack development process, including requirements analysis, solution reviews, key technical problem-solving, and validation strategy formulation. Ensure the technical feasibility, cost competitiveness, and scenario adaptability of the solutions.
  • Combine industry benchmark technologies with the company’s product pain points to deliver actionable technical optimization recommendations. Drive the achievement of key goals such as improved thermal management efficiency, optimized structural integration, cost reduction, and enhanced reliability.
  • Develop and accumulate methodologies and case libraries for competitor analysis, technology benchmarking, and solution optimization. Promote internal knowledge sharing and reuse to build the team’s core technical competitiveness.
  • Participate in cross-departmental technical reviews and project communications, providing professional technical assessment opinions. Facilitate collaboration between design, BMS, validation, and process teams to implement innovative technical solutions.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Vehicle Engineering, Electrochemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering and Engineering Thermophysics, or related fields.
  • 8+ years of relevant working experience in the power battery industry; candidates with practical experience in battery solution design, type selection evaluation, competitor analysis, or electrification projects for commercial vehicles/construction machinery are preferred.
  • Familiar with battery system technologies for passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles, and construction machinery; have full-process experience in battery solution selection, in-depth competitor analysis, or project implementation. Candidates who have led the selection and implementation of battery solutions for at least 3 complete vehicle electrification projects are preferred.
  • Proficient in core technologies of power battery systems; familiar with cell types, performance parameters and applicable scenarios; master mainstream technical routes in battery pack system architecture, thermal management, structural design, and core BMS logic.
  • Possess strong in-depth competitor analysis capabilities, capable of independently completing competitor analysis, technical assessment, cost analysis and value extraction; proficient in using data analysis and benchmarking tools to deliver professional reports.
  • Familiar with domestic and international power battery-related standards (such as ISO 26262, IEC 62660, UN 38.3, etc.) and compliance requirements for construction machinery electrification; understand the battery supply chain system and cost structure.
  • Have solid solution design and optimization capabilities, able to deliver technically feasible and cost-competitive battery system solutions based on competitor research and business needs.

Posting Dates:

September 14, 2026 - September 29, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Technical Project Manager (Back End)
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager with strong experience in agile delivery and backend engineering environments to lead the development and operational rollout of StarHub’s core digital platforms.

You will work cross-functionally with Domain Owners (DOs), Engineering Managers (EMs), DevOps teams, QA, Solution Designers (SDs), and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to drive predictable, high-quality delivery of back-end services that support consumer and enterprise customer journeys.

Your ability to manage modern cloud-native development cycles — across CI/CD pipelines, containerized microservices, and API ecosystems — will be critical to enabling secure, scalable, and resilient platforms that power StarHub’s digital evolution.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Solution Designers (SDs) and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Product/Journey Owners (POs/JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile and DevOps best practices across DXP teams.
  • Analyze delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities in velocity, predictability, and quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and ensure learnings are converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in software delivery or digital product management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience with CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native architecture (e.g., Kubernetes, EKS), and backend service delivery
  • Strong understanding of API management, event-driven architecture, observability tooling and modern deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Feature Flags).
  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Splunk.
  • Experience in telecommunications, digital platform delivery, or large-scale integration programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Technical fluency with backend engineering patterns and delivery pipelines
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Design and maintain a data lake using Apache Hudi to support: Upserts and deletes Incremental queries Time-travel and auditability

  • Collaborate with product and operations teams on data-driven features.

Skills

Mandatory / Primary Skills Apache Pulsar (topics, partitions, subscriptions, geo-replication) Apache Flink (stateful stream processing, windows, checkpoints) Apache Hudi (Merge-On-Read, Copy-On-Write, incremental processing) ClickHouse (real-time analytics, high-cardinality datasets) Event-driven and streaming data architectures Event sourcing and state-transition modeling Idempotent, replay-safe, and failure-tolerant data pipelines Designing systems for high TPS and frequent state updates Multi-region data design and disaster recovery Secondary Skills Redis for low-latency caching, counters, and ephemeral state PostgreSQL for transactional, relational, and reference data MySQL for operational data stores and legacy integrations Low-Level Design (LLD) for scalable, fault-tolerant components High-Level Design (HLD) for distributed, multi-region systems NoSQL stores for hot state (e.g., Mongo, DynamoDB, Cassandra) Relational databases for reference/config data Data lake query engines (Athena, Spark) Observability for data pipelines (lag, freshness, reconciliation) Containerized runtimes and cloud-native deployments Prior experience with CPaaS, telecom, or large-scale messaging platforms Experience & Background 12-14 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering, or distributed systems Proven experience building large-scale, streaming-heavy data platforms Strong hands-on background in real-time analytics and data consistency Comfortable operating at Principal & Staff Engineer level with full technical ownership

The role will own accounting, reporting, reconciliations, and audit coordination related to fixed assets, while partnering with multiple stakeholders to maintain compliance with applicable GAAP and internal policies.

This role will also contribute to process improvement, standardization, and automation initiatives within the fixed assets domain.

Location: India Experience: 5+ years Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Summary

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Developer (DevOps & Network Automation) to design, build, and deploy advanced automation solutions within network environments.

The role focuses on developing scalable DevOps capabilities to streamline network operations, enhance performance, and improve operational efficiency. The ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in automation, scripting, DevOps practices, and network technologies, along with the ability to align solutions with business objectives in a banking/enterprise environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy

  • Align automation initiatives with broader business, economic, and market objectives
  • Contribute to strategic technology decisions supporting network transformation and automation

2. Business Alignment

  • Ensure automation solutions support business goals and operational efficiency
  • Identify opportunities to:
  • Reduce operational costs
  • Improve resource utilization
  • Enhance scalability and reliability

Drive automation as a key enabler for business growth3. Process & Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end automation lifecycle, including:
  • Opportunity identification
  • Solution design
  • Development and implementation
  • Integration with existing network infrastructure

Develop and maintain automation tools and scripts for:

  • Performance optimization
  • Issue detection and resolution

Ensure documentation and adherence to industry best practicesCollaborate with cross-functional teams (network, cloud, security, infrastructure)Drive continuous improvement of automation frameworksProvide training and guidance to engineers and stakeholders on automation tools4. People & Talent

  • Demonstrate strong leadership through collaboration and influence
  • Work closely with teams to build a culture of automation and innovation
  • Support team structure planning and capacity management
  • Maintain strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills

5. Risk Management

  • Identify risks related to automation projects and develop mitigation strategies
  • Ensure adherence to governance, compliance, and control standards
  • Act proactively to address risks and escalate issues when required

Tools & Platforms

  • Experience with DevOps and automation tools (e.g., Ansible, Terraform, Jenkins, etc.)

job.title: Product Owner SMS - Customer Interaction Suite
job.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and driven Product Owner to support the growth and execution of our SMS offering within our CPaaS product portfolio.

You will work closely with the Product Manager, engineering, design, and delivery teams to translate business and market needs into actionable product requirements. Your role is central to ensuring that our SMS roadmap is implemented efficiently, with high quality, and in alignment with the global product strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Product Execution & Delivery

  • Translate product vision and high-level requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and sprint backlogs.
  • Work with engineering teams to ensure clarity, feasibility, and timely delivery of product increments.
  • Manage the SMS product backlog, ensuring it is well-prioritized, refined, and aligned with business outcomes.
  • Participate in sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives to ensure continuous alignment between technical teams and product goals.
  • Validate deliverables against business and technical acceptance criteria to ensure high-quality releases.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Serve as the day-to-day point of contact between engineering, QA, and cross-functional business teams.
  • Collaborate closely with the Product Manager to communicate progress, risks, and dependencies.
  • Support pre-sales and operations teams with product knowledge and technical clarifications when needed.
  • Ensure customer, carrier, and partner feedback is incorporated into product iterations.

Market & Technical Understanding

  • Develop a solid understanding of SMS standards, GSMA specifications, and carrier-level integrations.
  • Stay informed about SMS trends, API developments, and platform capabilities to support informed product decisions.
  • Contribute to use case validation and functional design to ensure product-market fit.

Data & Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor product performance metrics post-launch (e.g., delivery success rates, engagement, adoption).
  • Identify opportunities to improve user experience, efficiency, or technical reliability.
  • Support documentation, release notes, and internal enablement material for SMS product updates.

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or Technical Product Lead, ideally within CPaaS, telecom, or messaging platforms.
  • Strong familiarity with SMS, or other messaging APIs.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with hands-on backlog and sprint management.
  • Excellent ability to translate complex requirements into clear, testable user stories.
  • Solid communication and collaboration skills across technical and business teams.
  • Analytical mindset with a focus on product quality, delivery, and customer impact.
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or related field; Agile certification (CSPO, PSPO) preferred.

Preferred Attributes

  • Experience collaborating with mobile operators, OEMs, or messaging aggregators.
  • Familiarity with API-first development, Postman collections, and JSON workflows.
  • Strong attention to detail, organization, and proactive ownership mindset.
  • Interest in emerging communication technologies and their business applications.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • The SMS product backlog is always clear, prioritized, and ready for execution.
  • Sprint deliverables consistently align with product vision and market expectations.
  • Engineering teams have clarity and support to execute efficiently.
  • High-quality, timely releases that drive adoption and customer satisfaction.

Required Skills

  • product backlog management
  • agile product delivery
  • stakeholder management
  • sms
  • product requirements

job.description:

  • Identify priority segments, partners, and routes to market for accelerated entry and scale.

Customer & Partner Management

Stakeholder & Matrix Management

Forecasting, Reporting & Governance

  • Own sales forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and regular reporting in CRM and management dashboards.

Compliance, Risk & Regulatory Coordination

job.title: Lead - Captive Operations
job.description:
Job Description - L2 SD-WAN Engineer Job Title: L2 SD-WAN Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: Minimum 5-7 years Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience OR BCA/B.Sc.-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience

Certifications Required: OEM certification in at least one SD-WAN technology is preferred/mandatory, such as:

Cisco SD-WAN Fortinet Secure SD-WAN Versa SD-WAN

CCNA/CCNP, NSE/FCP, Versa Certified or equivalent networking/SD-WAN certification will be an added advantage. CEH certified

Job Summary

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 SD-WAN Engineer to join the Network Operations team at the client location. The candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, configuration, maintenance, and implementation of multi-vendor SD-WAN environments. The role requires strong hands-on experience in SD-WAN technologies and enterprise networking, with the ability to work across different OEM platforms such as Cisco SD-WAN, Fortinet Secure SD-WAN, and Versa SD-WAN. The candidate will work closely with L1, L3, Network, Security, ISP, and OEM teams to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and secure connectivity across data centers, branch offices, cloud environments, and remote locations.

  • The candidate should have a good understanding of SD-WAN architecture, centralized orchestration, underlay and overlay networks, routing protocols, VPN/VRF, IPsec tunnels, application-aware routing, QoS, high availability, and Internet/MPLS connectivity.
  • Key Responsibilities:
  • Monitor and manage multi-vendor SD-WAN infrastructure, including Cisco, Fortinet, and Versa SD-WAN solutions.
  • Perform day-to-day operational support and troubleshooting of SD-WAN devices, controllers, orchestrators, and management platforms.
  • Monitor the health and availability of SD-WAN overlay and underlay networks, including WAN links, tunnels, controllers, and edge devices.
  • Troubleshoot SD-WAN connectivity issues involving MPLS, Internet, broadband, LTE/4G/5G, and other WAN transport technologies.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to IPsec tunnels, overlay connectivity, routing, VPN/VRF, BGP, OSPF, static routes, and route propagation.
  • Analyze SD-WAN alarms, events, logs, and performance metrics to identify and resolve network incidents.
  • Configure and troubleshoot application-aware routing, traffic steering, SLA-based path selection, QoS, and bandwidth utilization.
  • Perform configuration and policy changes through centralized SD-WAN management and orchestration platforms.
  • Implement SD-WAN policies, templates, profiles, routing configurations, security policies, and application-based traffic steering as per approved requirements.
  • Support deployment and implementation of new SD-WAN sites, branches, data centers, and cloud connectivity.
  • Participate in SD-WAN migration projects, including migration from traditional MPLS-based networks to SD-WAN solutions.
  • Perform SD-WAN edge device onboarding, provisioning, configuration, and validation activities.
  • Support integration of SD-WAN with existing network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, routers, switches, Internet gateways, and cloud platforms.
  • Perform health checks, configuration backups, software upgrades, firmware upgrades, and patch management for SD-WAN infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot performance issues related to latency, packet loss, jitter, bandwidth utilization, and application performance.
  • Coordinate with ISPs and telecom service providers for resolution of WAN link-related incidents and performance issues.
  • Work with L1 and L3 teams to investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve complex SD-WAN incidents and service-impacting issues.
  • Participate in the incident, problem, and change management processes and ensure compliance with defined ITIL processes and SLAs.
  • Validate and implement approved SD-WAN change requests, including impact assessment, implementation planning, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
  • Support SD-WAN high-availability configurations, redundancy testing, failover testing, and DR drills.
  • Perform planned and emergency changes during maintenance windows and ensure proper post-change validation.
  • Support troubleshooting and implementation of SD-WAN security features, including IPsec encryption, segmentation, secure connectivity, and integration with next-generation firewalls.
  • Support network segmentation using VPN/VRF and SD-WAN segmentation policies based on business and security requirements.
  • Perform configuration-level remediation activities identified through vulnerability assessments, security audits, and compliance reviews.
  • Analyze and act upon OEM advisories, security vulnerabilities, bug notifications, and recommended software upgrades relevant to SD-WAN platforms.

Job Description – L2 Firewall Security Engineer

Job Title: L2 Firewall Security Engineer

Location: Hyderabad

Experience: Minimum 5–7 years

Qualification:

· B.E/B.Tech/MCA with minimum 5 years of relevant experience

· OR BCA/BSc-IT with minimum 7 years of relevant experience

Certifications Required:

· Must possess CEH, CHFI, GSEC, GMON, ITIL (at least one mandatory)

· OEM certification in at least one firewall technology (Checkpoint, Palo Alto, Fortinet)

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly capable and experienced L2 Firewall Security Engineer to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) at client location. The candidate will be responsible for managing, monitoring, and troubleshooting perimeter security devices, including Checkpoint, Palo Alto, and Fortinet firewalls. This role requires advanced technical knowledge of firewall rule configurations, threat mitigation, and hands-on operational support for security infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

· Monitor and manage Checkpoint, Palo Alto, and Fortinet firewall devices in a SOC environment.

· Review and implement firewall rules and access control policies.

· Troubleshoot connectivity and performance issues across security perimeter devices.

· Perform routine health checks, version upgrades, and patch management on firewall devices.

· Analyze and respond to firewall logs and alerts to identify and mitigate threats.

· Act on threat intelligence and advisories related to network and perimeter security.

· Collaborate with L1 and L3 teams to escalate and resolve complex firewall issues.

· Participate in firewall change management process, including request validations and impact assessments.

· Work with audit and compliance teams to support firewall-related reviews and data collection.

· Ensure adherence to standard operating procedures and service-level agreements (SLAs).

· Create documentation and update knowledge base articles for recurring firewall issues and solutions.

· Support the design and implementation of firewall HA, DR drills, and network segmentation strategies.

· Work closely with SOC teams to correlate firewall events with other security incidents.

· Perform VA/PT remediation from firewall configuration perspective.

· Generate reports related to rule usage, dormant rules, and policy cleanup activities.

· Perform backup and restore operations for firewall configuration as per defined schedules.

· Create reports and dashboards for firewall health, incidents, and threat trends.

· Demonstrate proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint to support reporting and presentations.

· Continuously improve firewall performance and coverage through tuning and optimization.

· Maintain awareness of latest security threats and firewall feature enhancements from OEMs.

job.title: Deputy General Manager - Platform Architect , Software & Application Development
job.description:
• Design and own the end-to-end architecture of a telecom lifecycle platform covering onboarding, orchestration, assurance, and decommissioning.
  • Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, resilient platform solutions and roadmaps.
  • Define platform integration patterns and APIs for OSS/BSS, RAN, Core, cloud, and third-party systems.
  • Lead platform development decisions: microservices, containerization (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ensure platform security, compliance, data governance, and multi-tenant isolation across environments.
  • Drive observability: logging, metrics, tracing, automated alerting, and SRE-led runbooks.
  • Mentor engineering teams, set architecture standards, and enforce best practices (DevSecOps, testing, code reviews).
  • Collaborate with product, operations, and customers to prioritize features, SLAs, and lifecycle automation.
  • Optimize cost, performance, and scalability across cloud/on-prem deployments and hybrid topologies.
  • Evaluate emerging telecom technologies (AI/ML, intent-based, TM Forum standards) and incorporate into platform roadmap.
  • TN Forum alignment

Telecom & Domain Skills

  • Deep understanding of telecom architecture: RAN, PS Core, CS Core, IP, transport
  • Familiarity with OSS/BSS, network orchestration, and lifecycle management
  • Knowledge of TM Forum standards (e.g., Open APIs, eTOM, SID)
  • Understanding of intent-based networks, AI/ML in telecom, and automation

Architecture & Design

  • Enterprise architecture and solution design (microservices, event-driven, cloud-native)
  • API design and integration patterns (REST, gRPC, Kafka, messaging queues)
  • Multi-cloud and hybrid architecture (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-prem)

Development & DevOps

  • Containerization & orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
  • CI/CD pipelines, GitOps, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)
  • Software testing, debugging, and automated deployment strategies

Security & Compliance

  • Network and application security, zero-trust architecture
  • Data governance, encryption, identity & access management
  • Compliance with telecom regulations and security standards

Observability & Operations

  • SRE practices, SLI/SLO definition, incident management
  • Automated alerting, runbooks, and operational excellence

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Technical leadership, mentoring, and architecture governance
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
  • Strategic thinking, roadmap planning, and prioritization
  • Strong communication (written and verbal) to technical and non-technical audiences

job.title: Sr Manager- Data Privacy projects - Data Privacy projects
job.description:
The Privacy Manager will lead the integration of privacy-by-design into customer-facing products and services across telecom, SaaS, CPaaS, and cloud solutions. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in application architecture, information security, and access control protocols, enabling proactive privacy risk management and regulatory compliance throughout the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities: Review and embed privacy-by-design and privacy engineering principles into product architecture, development, and deployment. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to define and implement privacy controls. Conduct Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs) and Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) for new and existing products. Evaluate and implement technical safeguards including encryption, pseudonymization, and secure access controls. Monitor and interpret global privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, DPDP Act) and translate them into actionable product requirements. Develop and maintain privacy notices, consent mechanisms, and data handling protocols. Support incident response and breach management for commercial products. Provide technical guidance and training to cross-functional teams on privacy best practices. Qualifications & Skills: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. Minimum 7 years of experience in privacy and data protection roles. Strong understanding of application architecture, data flows, and security protocols. Hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies and privacy governance tools and software. Certifications such as DCPP, CIPP, CIPT, FIP, CISSP, CISA or CISM are highly desirable. Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and analytical skills.

Job Title: L4 Network Engineer - Nokia 7250/7750 Platform

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Network Solution Engineer/ Consultant with expertise in Nokia 7750/ 7250/ &220 platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in network infrastructure design, implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. This role requires proficiency in designing implementing network devices, with a deep understanding of L2, L3 protocols. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the availability, scalability and security of network infrastructure. Ability to work independently and handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment and ready work in flexible timing.

Responsibilities:

Implement, maintain and migrate network infrastructure based on Nokia 7250 and 7750 platforms.

Configure, troubleshoot, and optimize IP routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, ISIS and VPRN.

Configure, troubleshoot, Optimize services like ePipe, IES, VPRN.

Managing NOKIA NSP platform.

Level 3/Level 4 support for network infrastructure on Nokia platforms.

Collaborate with other teams to design and implement network security policies and solutions.

Conduct regular network audits and implement best practices for network performance and security.

Provide technical guidance and support to junior engineers and other team members.

Participate in the evaluation and testing of new hardware, networking technologies.

Document network configurations, procedures, and troubleshooting steps.

Requirements:

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering , Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.

Minimum of 10 years of experience in network engineering roles, with a focus on Nokia 7250 and 7750 platforms.

Strong expertise in IP routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, MPLS, IS-IS along with VPLS , VPRN, IES and VXLAN.

Hands-on experience in configuring and troubleshooting Nokia 7250 and 7750 routers.

Proficiency in network design principles and best practices.

Good understanding of network security principles and protocols (e.g., ACLs, IPSec, VPN).

Experience with network monitoring and management tools (e.g., SNMP, NetFlow, Syslog).

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Experience with Nokia Network Services Platform (NSP) for network management and automation.
