job.title: Engineer, Field Application
job.description:
Tokyo, Tokyo, Japan

In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

What you can help us:

  • Provides pre-sales and post-sales product and technical support the Broadband BU in Japan; assistance to CommScope’s internal and external customers as a contributing team member. Support Product and Account Management and Sales teams for current, modified, and new CommScope applications and configurations.
  • Provide application engineering support for CommScope’s Broadband product portfolio. In addition, introduction of new products, consult with customer to determine and document requirements, develop product specifications, work with product managers on the development of fit for purpose products.
  • Have a working knowledge of Service Provider passive infrastructure inclusive of outdoor aerial and underground fiber networks, FTTX MDU/SDU networks, headend/central office/commercial buildings and copper networks.
  • Provide product expertise and support and have hands-on experience in relation to optical passives, splice closures, outside plant cables, access terminals, cabinets, drop cable assemblies, copper terminals & accessories and other related products to access network cabling.
  • Participate in forums, seminars, customer meetings and public events as a subject matter expert.

Qualification for consideration:

  • Degree or diploma in electrical, optical or telecommunications field.
  • Minimum 8 to 10+ years’ experience in customer consultation or support
  • Knowledge and practical experience using passive fiber optics products highly preferred.

job.title: Data Center Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

The Data Centre Engineer is a subject matter expert typically responsible for providing designs, plans, installs, and maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing.

The Data Centre Engineer possesses a proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.

The incumbent proactively analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.

This role also supports broader initiatives aimed at optimizing Data Center operations and ensuring seamless functionality across all facility systems.

What we are looking for

The Data Centre Engineer is a subject matter expert typically responsible for providing designs, plans, installs, and maintains mechanical, electrical, plumbing.

The Data Centre Engineer possesses a proficient understanding of sensitive facility components that may be impacted by failures or malfunctions of infrastructure systems.

The incumbent proactively analyzes current operating conditions and recommends new preventative and proactive methods for maintaining and monitoring facilities systems.

This role also supports broader initiatives aimed at optimizing Data Center operations and ensuring seamless functionality across all facility systems.

Key Responsibility

  • Leads the design, planning, installation, commissioning, and advanced maintenance of mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and all other mission‑critical infrastructure systems supporting high‑risk, high‑availability data center environments.
  • Maintains expert‑level understanding of sensitive facility components and evaluates the operational impact of system malfunctions or failures, ensuring risks are proactively identified and mitigated.
  • Provides senior technical escalation support, guiding Facility Operations teams during complex or critical system incidents and driving resolution strategies and root‑cause analysis.
  • Conducts comprehensive assessments of facility operating conditions, recommending improvements and implementing advanced preventative and predictive maintenance methodologies.
  • Evaluates, updates, and optimizes facility standards, engineering practices, and operational procedures, ensuring alignment with reliability, capacity, and efficiency goals.
  • Ensures full compliance with organizational, industry, and governmental safety regulations, and champions a culture of safety excellence.
  • Leads and coordinates cross‑functional emergency response efforts, ensuring rapid, effective, and compliant corrective actions.
  • Oversees adherence to operational processes, ensuring that facility services and infrastructure consistently meet or exceed operational SLA commitments.
  • Drives lifecycle management strategies, including system upgrades, replacement planning, and obsolescence mitigation to ensure long‑term infrastructure reliability.
  • Designs and governs maintenance programs for electrical and mechanical systems to improve reliability, reduce downtime, and streamline maintenance complexity.
  • Analyzes facility performance metrics, operational trends, maintenance history, and utilization data to validate maintenance execution and identify strategic enhancements.
  • Provides advanced, non‑routine technical support for data center operations, including diagnosing complex hardware, software, and control system failures.
  • Contributes to and may lead aspects of datacenter infrastructure project development, including design reviews, feasibility assessments, and construction support.
  • Performs any other advanced responsibilities as delegated by the Facility Operations management leadership.

Knowledge and Attributes

  • Expert knowledge of critical infrastructure design intent, sequence of operations, fault logic, and advanced corrective action planning.
  • Strong capability to collect, interpret, and synthesize system performance data to improve facility efficiency, reliability, and resiliency.
  • Able to translate highly technical concepts into clear communication for non‑technical stakeholders, leadership, and cross‑functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Advanced analytical and problem‑solving abilities, with the capability to assess complex issues and recommend strategic solutions.
  • Strong project management capability, including planning, scheduling, risk assessment, and cross‑team coordination.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering from an accredited institution, or equivalent field experience demonstrating ability to perform advanced job functions.
  • Relevant vendor certifications in electrical, mechanical, or control systems.
  • Additional beneficial certifications such as AOS, ATD, CDFOM, CDCDP, or similar industry‑recognized qualifications.

Required Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in Critical Facility/Data Centre technical operations and maintenance and/or engineering design of critical infrastructure systems.
  • Demonstrated, advanced knowledge of mechanical, electrical, life‑safety, and monitoring/control systems used in mission‑critical environments.
  • Strong experience with critical facility operations, maintenance programs, emergency response procedures, and SLA‑driven environments.
  • Proven ability to assess and manage sensitive facility components that may be affected by system failures or operational deviations.
  • Demonstrated advanced analytical capabilities, including the ability to evaluate, interpret, and clearly present complex technical and operational data.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
  • 1+ years of computer networking experience
  • High school or equivalent diploma

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Senior Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team. This is a builder's role. Customers across the region are moving fast on AI and seeking guidance on challenges they have not faced before — how to give autonomous agents an identity, how to defend against prompt injection, how to govern the AI development lifecycle, and how to produce the governance evidence a regulator will trust. You are the architect who helps them get there, working hands-on in their environment to build the prototypes and proofs of concept that turn ambition into validated proof — often in days.

You operate at the frontier, where the path forward is still being defined. Customers have a clear objective: put agentic AI into production while managing risk, regulatory, and data-residency obligations. Your role is to design the way there — creating new approaches where no established pattern exists and applying judgment about each customer's operational context and regulatory environment. You are technically self-sufficient: you write the code, deploy it with IaC, harden it, and demonstrate it live against real data.

Depth alone is not the job — scale is. The hardest problems you solve with one customer should lift the whole field. You independently dive deep on complex, novel Secure AI challenges, produce original technical content (reference architectures, working code, patterns, workshops), and share it so a pattern proven with one customer becomes something every area can reuse. You own the relationship with AWS service teams (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) — you are the voice of the field that shapes the product roadmap, and the voice of the product that shapes field guidance.

Security and governance are what let customers say yes to AI with confidence. You give the CISO the frameworks, evidence, and tooling to move quickly and safely, and you give the CIO/CTO confidence that governance won't slow delivery. You are the proof that AWS is the best place to build securely with AI.

Key job responsibilities Key job responsibilities

  • Build working prototypes and proofs of concept in customer sandbox environments — using AWS AI services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker), AI-augmented development tooling, and IaC (CDK, Terraform) — that prove a Secure AI control works against the customer's data and risk model, in days rather than quarters.
  • Implement directly to unblock decisions: stand up agentic-identity, prompt-injection-defence, AI development lifecycle, guardrail, and audit/evidence patterns that validate what conversations alone cannot.
  • Stay engaged through implementation so the design holds against reality; exercise judgment on when to revise the approach based on what you learn.

Partner with the Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker service teams — you are the voice of APJC field security requirements that shapes what ships, and the voice of the product that shapes what the field advises.

  • Feed customer voices back through feature requests and direct engagement, staying current with a threat and regulatory landscape that moves in hours.
  • Translate service-team roadmap into field-ready guidance, ensuring it gets packaged at scale.
  • Produce original technical content — reference architectures, working code, patterns, blog posts, and workshops — that peers and customers adopt, turning a single customer win into reusable regional IP.
  • Mentor and develop others — area-based Solutions Architects and the wider field community — raising the Secure AI technical bar across the region and growing the next set of specialists.
  • Hand proven patterns to the content and enablement team so guidance reaches the field without requiring your presence.

A day in the life You start the morning in a customer's sandbox, not a slide deck. A financial-services customer wants to launch an agentic application on Bedrock, and overnight the identity and audit controls you built produced exactly the evidence their CISO needed. You tidy the code, capture the pattern, and prep a short summary naming the two guardrail settings that gave them confidence to proceed.

Mid-morning you join your Security Sales partner and the area account team with a manufacturer who wants to build with Bedrock and needs guidance on governing data residency and PII. It is a genuinely new problem — no established pattern exists — so you design the way forward: you whiteboard an agentic-identity and data-residency approach, then commit to prototyping the non-human-identity pattern their builder team will adopt.

After lunch you go heads-down and build it — hands on keyboard, deploying to a sandbox, hardening it — then run a working session with a customer's platform team on prompt-injection defence for a coding-assistant rollout.

You close the day scaling beyond yourself: you package this week's FSI win into a reference architecture the other areas can reuse, hand it to the content team to turn into a workshop, share a write-up with the field, and file a feature request for the AgentCore team based on what you learned. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you help a customer accelerate securely, then turn what you built into something the whole region benefits from.

About the team APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As a Senior Secure AI Solution Architect, you are the deep technical expertise brought directly to where customers need it. You define the approach on novel problems, prove it hands-on, then hand the pattern to the content team and the field to scale. You will have a clear development path, a peer community of specialists, direct leadership visibility, and the autonomy to set technical direction in one of the most consequential areas in the industry.

Basic Qualifications

  • 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
  • Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
  • Knowledge and skills in Securing Generative AI Applications

job.title: Senior Manager, Data Center Commissioning
job.description:
Job Description

Oracle OCI continues to grow aggressively increasing datacenter capacity globally and at significant scale in key markets. We are seeking to recruit a commissioning manager with extensive experience in the datacenter space to join the formed and growing Datacenter Operations team. The team is responsible for setting the commissioning standards for OCI's partners be they colocation providers or developers. The team will be the center of excellence for all aspects of datacenter operations, design and construction supporting the compute, network and storage solutions deployed to deliver OCI's world class and highly secure cloud services to the world’s largest and most successful businesses and the commissioning engineers will ensure our new facilities are fully tested and able to deliver reliable operation for Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Come and join a growing and dynamic team of professionals delivering and growing the outstanding cloud services Oracle offer.

In response to increased concurrent projects for the design and delivery of our datacenters, Oracle is recruiting a Senior Commissioning Quality Manager.  The role is a senior multi-disciplinary datacenter commissioning manager with a focus on IST, quality and commissioning activities, charged with the direct interface between Oracle and our datacenter partners in the completion and testing of building systems to bring a datacenter reliably to ready for service.  With extensive experience delivering mission critical facilities and professional qualifications in mechanical or electrical engineering with a commissioning and quality focus the role is responsible for setting Oracles stance for commissioning and quality activities and working with our design and collocation partners to ensure successful IST and move into operation.

Candidate will be responsible for leading the JAPAC and EMEA (Japan, Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East and Africa) commissioning team.

Travel is required and can be up to two weeks a month.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Leads and manages a team of commissioning engineers in EMEA and JAPAC.  Provides guidance and commissioning leadership in ensuring project or other design and engineering initiatives are meeting or exceeding company expectations.
  • Expert operating knowledge of engineering systems to include advanced diagnostics and repairs. Ability to apply knowledge of Oracle processes and procedures and industry standards to resolve non-routine issues. Utilizes safe working practices at an EXPERT level (e.g. can apply procedure for lockout/tag out, can explain MDS, etc.). Evaluates and assures the safe working practices of others. Interacts with other engineering disciplines. Works with the colocation providers engineering teams to ensure mechanical systems are adequately designed, specified and installed to deliver robust operation for Oracle.
  • Contributes to identifying and developing training programs for newer members of the team as it grows.  Acquires knowledge by expanding experience with systems, vendor training, participation in industry groups or meetings and shadowing others. Is SME with many systems and trains others inside and outside of the group.
  • Provides expert input for effective contract administration including generation and review of contracts, change orders, cost forecasts, and other pertinent documents and documentation.
  • Contributes to mentoring junior team members. Directs all internal and external project team members delivering datacenters or part-datacenters for Oracle in EMEA and JAPAC. Expert level communication to include cross functional SOP development and relevant technical writing. Interactions are primarily to exchange information between departments within the organization.
  • Lead the interaction for Oracle with datacenter partners for successful commissioning of all electrical and mechanical critical systems, including but not limited to primary and back up electrical plant, mechanical plant, life safety and fire suppression systems, building monitoring and controls systems
  • Responsibilities include the design, implementation and documentation of data center commissioning programs and procedures to verify data center facilities systems work as intended as per the basis of design.
  • Implement quality control procedures to ensure all commissioning activities comply with industry standards and regulations, review and approve commissioning documentation, including test results and reports. Conduct regular audits and inspections to ensure adherence to quality standards.
  • Work with the rest of the Design & Construction team to develop/organize O&M documentation to serve as a reference for Data Center Operations personnel.

job.title: Senior Product Manager
job.description:
Job Summary

The Product Manager will partner with the Tax business and technology teams to define, develop, and manage the lifecycle of Tax Technology products and solutions from discovery through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

The role will translate Tax business needs and pain points into a clear product strategy, roadmap, and prioritized product capabilities, working closely with engineering, data, technology, and global Tax stakeholders.

The ideal candidate combines strong Tax domain expertise, product management capability, technology understanding, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate across business and technical teams.

###

Key Responsibilities

Product Roadmap

  • ### Partner with Tax stakeholders to understand business priorities, processes, pain points, and technology opportunities.
  • ### Define and prioritize the Tax Technology product roadmap aligned with business and IT strategy.
  • ### Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve Tax processes through technology and data products.
  • ### Balance business value, technical feasibility, risk, scalability, and delivery priorities.

Product Discovery & Requirements

  • ### Translate Tax business requirements into product capabilities, user stories, and prioritized backlog items.
  • ### Understand end-to-end Tax processes and data flows across Oracle Financials, Oracle TRCS, transfer pricing and related systems.
  • ### Partner with Tax users to identify opportunities for automation, analytics, reconciliation, and improved decision-making.
  • ### Evaluate business needs and define solutions that can scale across global Tax teams.

Product Development & Delivery

  • ### Own product development from discovery and requirements through delivery, UAT, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • ### Partner with engineering, data, and technology teams to define product requirements and delivery priorities.
  • ### Lead backlog refinement, prioritization, dependency management, and release planning.
  • ### Define acceptance criteria, test cases, and UAT requirements to ensure solutions meet business outcomes.
  • ### Monitor product adoption, quality, performance, and user feedback and drive continuous improvements.

Business Value & Stakeholder Management

  • ### Build business cases and articulate the value, ROI, and business impact of product investments.
  • ### Define success metrics such as adoption, automation, efficiency, reporting cycle time, data quality, and user experience.
  • ### Build strong relationships with global Tax stakeholders and manage expectations across business and technology teams.
  • ### Communicate product strategy, roadmap, priorities, risks, and progress to senior stakeholders.

Market & Product Innovation

  • ### Stay current on emerging Tax Technology, AI, automation, analytics
  • ### Evaluate industry solutions and identify opportunities to improve the Tax technology ecosystem.
  • ### Recommend product enhancements and new capabilities based on business needs and market trends.

###

Qualifications

  • ### 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Systems, Technology Consulting, or Functional Consulting.
  • ### Strong experience working with Tax Technology / Direct Tax environments.
  • ### Experience with Oracle TRCS or similar Tax Technology solutions preferred.
  • ### Experience with Oracle Cloud Financials is an advantage.
  • ### Understanding of corporate income tax, tax provision, transfer pricing, and tax data processes.
  • ### Experience translating business needs into product requirements, user stories, roadmaps, and prioritized backlogs.
  • ### Experience managing products or technology solutions through discovery, development, UAT, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.
  • ### Strong understanding of data, analytics, system integrations, and enterprise technology.
  • ### Experience working with global, cross-functional teams across Business, IT, Engineering, and Data.
  • ### Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • ### Demonstrated ability to simplify complex business and technology problems and drive decisions.
  • ### Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Taxation, or a related field; CA/CPA or equivalent professional accounting qualification preferred.

job.title: Data Center Logistics III - Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Data Center Logistics III role supports the efficient movement, storage, and management of materials, equipment, and customer shipments within the data center environment. This role is responsible for coordinating shipping and receiving activities, maintaining inventory accuracy, supporting operational teams and customers, and ensuring logistics processes are executed safely, accurately, and on time.

Working independently on day-to-day logistics activities, the role helps maintain operational readiness, supports customer requirements, and contributes to the overall efficiency of data center operations.

Responsibilities

Documentation & System Updates

  • Maintain accurate records and supporting documentation for inbound and outbound shipments, inventory transactions, and customer deliveries.
  • Update inventory management systems and databases to ensure shipment and stock information remains current and accurate.
  • Verify goods received against purchase orders and delivery documentation, escalating discrepancies when identified.
  • Support reporting activities related to inventory levels, shipment status, and logistics operations.
  • Ensure inventory and logistics records are maintained in accordance with operational standards and compliance requirements.

Shipping & Receiving

  • Receive goods delivered to the Data Center directly or through established site security processes.
  • Inspect received materials and verify shipment accuracy prior to acceptance.
  • Coordinate timely dispatch and delivery of materials, equipment, and customer shipments to the appropriate destination.
  • Obtain delivery confirmations and maintain accurate records of completed deliveries.
  • Utilize shipment tracking tools, dashboards, and operational systems to monitor inbound and outbound shipments.
  • Support warehouse organization and ensure materials are stored safely and efficiently.

Inventory Management

  • Maintain inventory accuracy through proper receiving, storage, allocation, and tracking processes.
  • Allocate inventory and materials to internal customers and operational teams as required.
  • Coordinate inventory transfers between sites and support material movement activities.
  • Maintain appropriate stock levels for operational and project requirements.
  • Assist with inventory counts, stock audits, and reconciliation activities.
  • Communicate inventory shortages, backorder timelines, and replenishment needs to relevant stakeholders.
  • Support spare parts and operational inventory management activities.

Problem Solving

  • Work with suppliers, Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs), logistics providers, and internal stakeholders to resolve shipment and inventory issues.
  • Communicate delivery schedules, inventory availability, and shipment status to customers and operational teams.
  • Investigate inventory discrepancies and logistics-related issues, escalating complex matters when required.
  • Contribute recommendations to improve logistics efficiency, inventory accuracy, and customer service.

Hazardous Materials

  • Follow established procedures for the safe handling, storage, and movement of hazardous materials.
  • Ensure hazardous materials are properly labelled, documented, and stored in accordance with regional regulatory requirements.
  • Support hazardous materials inventory management and compliance activities.
  • Escalate safety concerns and ensure compliance with all applicable site policies and procedures.

Equipment Management

  • Organize and maintain inventory records for stored, staged, and abandoned equipment.
  • Monitor aging shipments and coordinate resolution activities in accordance with established business processes.
  • Support tracking of software licenses, technology assets, and related inventory where applicable.
  • Maintain accurate equipment inventory records and support asset management processes.

Data Center Support

  • Support the delivery and removal of customer equipment within data center environments.
  • Assist with equipment preparation, packaging, and shipment activities in support of customer and operational requirements.
  • Support Smart Hands and operational teams with logistics-related requests.
  • Ensure materials and equipment are handled safely and in accordance with site procedures.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Customer Operations, Critical Facilities, Security, and other operational teams to support business objectives.
  • Coordinate effectively with customers, vendors, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance inventory accuracy, operational efficiency, and customer experience.
  • Share knowledge and assist team members during periods of increased operational demand.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • At least a Higher Nitec / Diploma certification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically requires 1–2 years of relevant experience in logistics, warehousing, inventory management, supply chain operations, or a related environment.
  • Experience supporting operations in a data center, technology, manufacturing, industrial, or mission-critical environment is an advantage.

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Familiarity with inventory management systems, warehouse management systems (WMS), or shipment tracking tools.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to inventory accuracy.
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and manage multiple logistics activities simultaneously.
  • Effective communication and customer service skills.
  • Understanding of shipping, receiving, inventory control, and material handling processes.
  • Regional hazardous materials certification preferred.

job.title: Graduate Engineer
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

STACK Infrastructure is seeking motivated graduates in Engineering and Construction to join our Singapore team and support the development and delivery of data centre projects in Malaysia and across APAC.

This is a full-time opportunity for graduates who want to build a career in the data centre industry. You will gain practical exposure to the design, development, construction, commissioning and handover of mission-critical data centres, supported by experienced colleagues and a structured development approach.

During the selection process, we will assess your interests, strengths and technical background and place successful candidates into the area most suited to them.

Engineering pathway

Engineering graduates may be assigned to teams supporting:

  • Design management and coordination
  • Engineering solutions and technical reviews
  • Commissioning, testing and operational readiness
  • Project coordination, quality assurance and issue resolution

You will work with internal teams, consultants, contractors and vendors to help ensure that systems are designed, tested and ready for safe, reliable operation.

Construction pathway

Construction graduates may be assigned to the Delivery team, supporting the planning and execution of data centre construction projects.

You will gain hands-on exposure to site coordination, programme tracking, contractor management, safety, quality, risk management and project handover.

What you will do

  • Support project teams with technical coordination, documentation and reporting.
  • Participate in site inspections, meetings, testing activities and project walk-downs.
  • Assist with reviewing drawings, technical submissions, work packs, test plans and project records.
  • Help identify, track and resolve technical issues, defects and outstanding works.
  • Work closely with project managers, engineers, consultants, contractors and vendors.
  • Support safety, quality and operational-readiness requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Take on increasing responsibility as your experience, skills and confidence develop.

What we are looking for

  • A recent graduate, or final-year student graduating soon, with a degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Built Environment or a related discipline.
  • For the Engineering pathway, a background in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Controls, Mechatronics or a related engineering discipline is preferred.
  • Strong interest in data centres, critical infrastructure, engineering, construction or project delivery.
  • Practical aptitude, intellectual curiosity and a willingness to learn quickly.
  • Good analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, site-based environment.
  • Good written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with Bluebeam, Microsoft Project or similar tools is advantageous.
  • Willingness to work primarily on project sites and travel within Singapore and occasionally across APAC where required.

STACK is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Commercial FP&A Manager
job.description:
Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading provider of sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Backed by Stonepeak, a global alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets, Digital Edge has over US$1.6 billion in committed equity capital from some of the world’s largest institutional investors and sovereign wealth funds.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

About the role

Reporting to the Associate Director of FP&A, this role owns Commercial FP&A and Growth Analytics across Asia Pacific — bookings-to-revenue conversion, customer economics, pricing, margin and sales commission governance.

The role provides a trusted view of revenue growth drivers, deal and portfolio profitability, customer contract and rent roll performance, and commercial forecast risk.

It challenges assumptions and supports decisions across Commercial, Sales, Customer Success, Sales Operations and Country Finance, ensuring Finance owns the controls over commercial economics, forecasts, pricing, margin and commissions.

This role will be based in Hong Kong and will support operations across Asia Pacific.

**

Key responsibilities

1. Bookings-to-Revenue and Commercial Forecasting

  • Own monthly bookings-to-revenue reporting across forecast, commit, funnel, bookings, churn, backlog, BBNB and revenue conversion.
  • Explain revenue growth by volume, rate, mix, timing and foreign exchange; escalate target shortfalls, slipping deals, backlog build-up and pipeline conversion risk.
  • Maintain complete, accurate and consistently defined bookings data with Sales Operations and Country Finance, linking booked-to-bill reporting to revenue recognition and billing readiness.

**

2. Customer Contracts, Rent Roll and Commission Governance

  • Own monthly customer contract and rent roll reporting across contracted revenue, escalations, renewals, expiries and capacity utilisation.
  • Maintain the rent roll as the single source of truth, reconciled to billing, revenue recognition and Salesforce, and lead the Customer Contract Management project.
  • Build deal and portfolio customer economics, including lifetime value, payback, profitability, customer capex, NRC margin and cost-to-serve.
  • Own commission governance across calculation, accrual, payment support, audit trail and reconciliation to bookings and revenue.

**

3. Pricing, Margin and Customer Economics

  • Analyse pricing, discounting and margin trends across products, customers and markets, and identify margin improvement opportunities across price, volume, mix, contract terms and cost-to-serve.
  • Benchmark unit economics across deals and customer segments, separating controllable performance from market effects.
  • Lead Monthly Revenue Analysis capacity, budgeting and assumption reviews with Revenue Operations, Product and Sales.

**

4. Business Partnering, Controls and Ways of Working

  • Set the commercial FP&A calendar, submission standards, data ownership and escalation process.
  • Reconcile bookings, revenue and commission data with Sales Operations, Country Finance and Accounting; provide executive commentary with clear actions and owners.

**

5. Systems, Automation and Data Quality

  • Automate recurring commercial reporting and Salesforce dashboards using Power BI and AI tools, and set Salesforce data standards with Sales Operations.

**

Key Requirements & Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in FP&A, commercial finance or sales finance, covering B-R reporting, backlog / BBNB monitoring, customer economics, pricing, margin analysis and commission governance.
  • Ability to convert complex commercial data into senior management insights, recommendations and accountable follow-ups.
  • Strong stakeholder management across Sales, Customer Success, Accounting and Country Finance.
  • Hands-on sales commission calculation, accrual and reconciliation experience.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce bookings, contract bookings, pipeline data and booked-to-bill reporting.
  • Advanced Excel / financial modelling, strong PowerPoint executive reporting and hands-on Power BI dashboard automation.
  • Preferred: data centre, telecommunications, utilities, infrastructure, SaaS or subscription-revenue experience.
  • Preferred: OneStream, NetSuite; CPA, CFA, MBA or equivalent qualification.

job.title: Senior Manager, Cyber Strategy & Transformation
job.description:
Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Singtel Group

Be a Part of Something BIG!

We create great technology that can change the future, and we're looking for people to be part of our digital and 5G journey. If you like to work in a dynamic, leading communications technology group to deliver innovations and excellence across the region, come join our digital, software engineering, data and cyber security teams!

We are seeking a highly motivated and hands-on AI & Cyber Transformation professional to accelerate the adoption of emerging technology such as Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation across the Group Cyber organisation.

Reporting to the Director,Cyber Strategy & Transformation, you will identify high-value AI opportunities, design and develop AI-enabled solutions, and lead their implementation to improve cybersecurity operations, governance, and business outcomes.

This is a hybrid role requiring strategic thinking, and technical execution. You will work closely with cybersecurity teams, technology partners, business stakeholders, and external vendors to transform ideas into scalable AI solutions that deliver measurable value.

Make an Impact by

  • Cyber Strategy & Transformation

Support the execution of strategic cyber transformation initiatives across the Group Cyber organisation.

  • Support the development and enhancement of cybersecurity operating models, governance frameworks, strategic roadmaps, and transformation priorities.
  • Conduct research and analysis on emerging cybersecurity trends, technologies, and industry best practices to support strategic decision-making.
  • Develop executive presentations, business cases, strategy papers, and recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Support organisational change initiatives that improve cyber capabilities, processes, governance, and ways of working.
  • AI, Innovation & Reference Architecture

Identify and assess opportunities to leverage AI, Generative AI (GenAI), automation, and emerging technologies to improve cybersecurity operations, governance, and business processes.

  • Develop reference architectures for AI-enabled solutions, including architectural patterns for GenAI applications, intelligent agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), workflow automation, and enterprise integrations.
  • Define reusable architecture components covering application design, data flows, model interaction, identity and access management, security controls, integration patterns, observability, deployment, and lifecycle management.
  • Develop solution blueprints and implementation patterns that can be reused across multiple use cases, cybersecurity domains, and operating companies.
  • Ensure AI reference architectures align with enterprise architecture principles, cybersecurity standards, cloud architecture, data governance, privacy, and responsible AI requirements.
  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for specific AI and automation use cases, translating business and technical requirements into scalable implementation designs.
  • Develop, prototype, and implement AI solutions, including Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs), Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), and production-ready applications.
  • Build AI-powered assistants, intelligent agents, workflow automation, and productivity solutions that address cybersecurity and business challenges.
  • Integrate AI solutions with enterprise platforms, cybersecurity technologies, cloud services, data platforms, and internal applications through APIs and automation frameworks.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, platforms, models, and development frameworks, recommending solutions based on business value, technical feasibility, security, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Contribute to AI governance, development standards, reference implementations, reusable assets, and best practices to support sustainable AI adoption across the organisation.
  • Programme Delivery & Stakeholder Management

Support and coordinate cross-functional cyber transformation and AI initiatives involving cybersecurity, technology, business units, operating companies, and external partners.

  • Coordinate project plans, implementation roadmaps, timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across multiple initiatives.
  • Facilitate workshops, design thinking sessions, requirements gathering, architecture reviews, and solution demonstrations.
  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams, enterprise architects, developers, data engineers, infrastructure teams, vendors, and strategic partners to deliver successful outcomes.
  • Support architecture review and governance processes to ensure proposed solutions align with agreed reference architectures and enterprise standards.
  • Track implementation progress, manage project risks, and provide regular updates to stakeholders and senior management.
  • Governance & Continuous Improvement

Support the development of policies, standards, and operating principles related to cybersecurity, AI adoption, architecture, and digital transformation.

  • Ensure solutions align with organisational security, privacy, governance, regulatory, and risk management requirements.
  • Maintain and continuously enhance AI reference architectures, architecture patterns, and implementation guidance based on lessons learned, technology evolution, and emerging risks.
  • Define success measures and evaluate the operational and business impact of transformation and AI initiatives.
  • Promote knowledge sharing, innovation, and continuous improvement through reusable assets, architecture documentation, implementation guides, and lessons learned.

**

  • Stakeholder Support

Work with internal teams (e.g., IT, security operations, risk, and development teams) to support cybersecurity initiatives.

  • Collaborate with AI and development teams to support the implementation of security controls during development and prior to rollout.
  • Assist in preparing materials for meetings, workshops, and stakeholder updates.

**

  • Continuous Learning & Improvement

Stay updated on cybersecurity fundamentals, tools, and industry trends.

  • Proactively build skills in relevant areas (e.g., cloud security, AI security fundamentals, DevSecOps practices).
  • Support improvements in processes, tooling, and methodologies through research and feedback.

Skills for Success

  • Educational Background:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Cybersecurity, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline.

**

  • Experience

7–10 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology, digital transformation, solution architecture, development, software engineering, or technology consulting.

  • Demonstrated experience delivering technology or transformation initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Experience designing solution architectures or reference architectures within enterprise environments.
  • Experience developing or implementing AI-enabled solutions is highly desirable.
  • Experience working within telecommunications, consulting, or large enterprise environments is advantageous.
  • Knowledge

Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles, practices, and common frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).

  • Familiarity with common security domains (e.g., network security, identity and access management, vulnerability management).
  • Awareness of secure development practices and interest in emerging technologies such as AI.
  • Knowledge developing AI solutions involving Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing (NLP), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent agents, or conversational AI is advantageous.
  • Understanding of prompt engineering, semantic search, embeddings, and document processing techniques for enterprise AI applications is desired
  • Leadership and Collaboration:

Strong collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build effective working relationships across cross-functional teams.

  • Proven ability to engage and influence diverse stakeholders, including senior leadership, business units, operating companies, and external partners within a large enterprise or multi-subsidiary environment.
  • Self-driven, resourceful, and able to work independently with minimal supervision while managing multiple priorities and delivering high-quality outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to take ownership, exercise sound judgement, and proactively drive initiatives from concept through implementation.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities:

Good analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, especially in dynamic and high-pressure situations.

  • Communication Skills:

Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.

  • Able to present and explain technical concepts in a clear and structured manner to different audiences.

Rewards that Go Beyond

Full suite of health and wellness benefits

  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.title: Data Scientist - Senior
job.description:
Leads the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of data and analytics platforms. Develops reliable, scalable, and efficient data pipelines and data processing solutions that enable data to be effectively processed, stored, governed, and made available to analysts and other data consumers. Collaborates with business stakeholders, IT experts, data scientists, architects, and subject-matter experts to deliver enterprise data and analytics solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and automate distributed data ingestion and transformation solutions using data from relational, event-based, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and efficient ETL/ELT data pipelines using appropriate tools, technologies, and scripting languages.
  • Design and implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and alerting frameworks to identify and resolve data integrity issues.
  • Implement data governance practices covering metadata, data access, retention, compliance, and security.
  • Design and implement physical data models, including database structures, indexing, and table relationships, to support performance and scalability.
  • Develop and operate large-scale data storage and processing solutions across cloud and distributed data platforms, including data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse environments.
  • Optimize data pipelines, Spark workloads, databases, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Integrate data from a variety of enterprise applications and source systems and support real-time and event-driven data processing.
  • Develop automation for common and repeatable data preparation, integration, deployment, and platform-management activities to minimize manual and error-prone processes.
  • Implement CI/CD and DevOps practices to support automated deployment, testing, and release management.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, testing, validation, and continuous improvement of data pipelines and platform solutions.
  • Ensure data platforms and solutions meet applicable quality, governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, architects, IT teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Document data solutions, processes, designs, and technical information to support knowledge transfer and operational effectiveness.
  • Apply Agile development methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban to deliver data engineering initiatives.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentor less experienced team members, promoting engineering excellence and collaboration.

Skills

  • Strong technical leadership and decision-making skills, with the ability to lead large-scale data engineering initiatives from concept through production deployment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, including the ability to diagnose complex data pipeline, platform, and performance issues.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts and stakeholder requirements into actionable data solutions.
  • Strong customer focus and ability to develop solutions aligned with business objectives.
  • Ability to balance strategic architecture decisions with hands-on technical execution.
  • Strong project management, prioritization, and organizational skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong understanding of data quality, governance, security, compliance, and data management principles.
  • Passion for continuous improvement, emerging technologies, and modern data engineering practices.
  • Ability to mentor, guide, and develop technical talent while fostering a collaborative engineering culture.

Technical Skills

Data Engineering & Processing

  • Advanced proficiency in Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, and distributed data processing frameworks.
  • Strong expertise in enterprise-scale ETL/ELT and data ingestion pipeline design and development.
  • Experience processing structured, semi-structured, streaming, and large-scale datasets.
  • Strong understanding of Big Data technologies and scalable cloud-native data architectures.

Programming & Development

  • Advanced proficiency in Python and Scala for large-scale data processing and engineering solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, transformation, optimization, and analysis of large datasets.
  • Experience with scripting, automation, version control, testing, and build processes.

Cloud & Platform Technologies

  • Strong experience with Azure data services, including:
  • Azure Databricks
  • Azure Data Lake Storage (ADLS)
  • Azure Blob Storage
  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure SQL Data Warehouse
  • Strong understanding of cloud architecture principles, scalability, reliability, and security best practices.

Data Storage & Lakehouse

  • Experience with modern data storage and lakehouse technologies, including:
  • Delta Lake
  • Apache Iceberg
  • Parquet
  • ORC
  • Strong understanding of data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures.

Streaming & Data Integration

  • Experience with Kafka or similar real-time streaming and event-processing technologies.
  • Experience integrating data from a wide variety of enterprise applications and source systems.
  • Familiarity with Qlik Replicate or similar data replication and ingestion technologies is preferred.

DevOps & Engineering Excellence

  • Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.
  • Strong knowledge of Git, Jenkins, testing methodologies, version control, and release management.
  • Experience establishing coding standards, technical documentation, and engineering governance practices.

Data Quality, Governance & Security

  • Experience implementing data validation frameworks, monitoring solutions, and data quality controls.
  • Knowledge of cloud security, access management, data governance, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Experience designing reliable, auditable, and observable data platforms.

Experience

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, Big Data, or a related discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience leading technical teams, projects, or significant data engineering initiatives.
  • Proven experience building and supporting large-scale cloud-based data ingestion, transformation, and analytics platforms.
  • Experience developing end-to-end ETL/ELT solutions in Azure cloud environments.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering high-performance and scalable distributed data processing solutions using Spark and Databricks.
  • Experience optimizing data pipelines, Spark workloads, databases, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency.
  • Experience working with modern data lake, data warehouse, and lakehouse architectures.
  • Experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment processes.
  • Experience working within Agile software development methodologies.
  • Experience partnering with data scientists, analysts, architects, and business stakeholders to deliver enterprise data solutions.
  • Experience analyzing complex business systems, industry requirements, and data regulations.
  • Experience processing and managing large datasets.
  • Experience designing and developing Big Data platforms using open-source and third-party technologies.
  • Experience with technologies such as Spark, Scala/Java, MapReduce, Hive, HBase, and Kafka or equivalent experience.
  • Experience developing applications requiring large-scale file movement and data extraction from multiple sources.
  • Experience building analytical solutions.

Preferred / Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake and cloud-native data warehousing solutions.
  • Experience with Qlik Replicate or similar enterprise data replication technologies.
  • Experience supporting real-time analytics and streaming data architectures.
  • Experience implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and platform automation frameworks.
  • Knowledge of data observability, data lineage, and metadata management tools.
  • Experience with IoT technologies.
  • Experience supporting AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics workloads on enterprise data platforms.
  • Exposure to multi-cloud data ecosystems and hybrid cloud architectures.
  • Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect, or similar cloud certifications.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • Relevant equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • Relevant cloud or data engineering certifications are preferred.
  • This position may require licensing or other requirements related to export controls or sanctions regulations.

Gathers, compiles and verifies information and enters it accurately into documents such as reports, presentations or forms; and office systems such as databases or spreadsheets. job.title: Data Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Leads the design, development, deployment, and maintenance of data and analytics platforms. Develops reliable, scalable, and efficient data pipelines and data processing solutions that enable data to be effectively processed, stored, governed, and made available to analysts and other data consumers. Collaborates with business stakeholders, IT experts, data scientists, architects, and subject-matter experts to deliver enterprise data and analytics solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and automate distributed data ingestion and transformation solutions using data from relational, event-based, semi-structured, and unstructured sources.
  • Build reliable, scalable, and efficient ETL/ELT data pipelines using appropriate tools, technologies, and scripting languages.
  • Design and implement data quality, validation, monitoring, and alerting frameworks to identify and resolve data integrity issues.
  • Implement data governance practices covering metadata, data access, retention, compliance, and security.
  • Design and implement physical data models, including database structures, indexing, and table relationships, to support performance and scalability.
  • Develop and operate large-scale data storage and processing solutions across cloud and distributed data platforms, including data lakes, warehouses, and lakehouse environments.
  • Optimize data pipelines, Spark workloads, databases, and cloud infrastructure for performance, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Integrate data from a variety of enterprise applications and source systems and support real-time and event-driven data processing.
  • Develop automation for common and repeatable data preparation, integration, deployment, and platform-management activities to minimize manual and error-prone processes.
  • Implement CI/CD and DevOps practices to support automated deployment, testing, and release management.
  • Participate in troubleshooting, testing, validation, and continuous improvement of data pipelines and platform solutions.
  • Ensure data platforms and solutions meet applicable quality, governance, security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, architects, IT teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective data solutions.
  • Document data solutions, processes, designs, and technical information to support knowledge transfer and operational effectiveness.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentor less experienced team members, promoting engineering excellence and collaboration.

Skills

The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.

  • Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
