job.title: Senior Executive, Commercial (Modules)
job.description:
Job Summary

This role supports the preparation of competitive and commercially sound proposals for shipyard, offshore, marine, and module construction projects.

You will work closely with engineering, procurement, operations, finance, and other internal stakeholders to understand project requirements, develop cost estimates, and prepare tender submissions.

The position is suitable for both early-career candidates and experienced professionals. While relevant experience is beneficial, we place strong emphasis on analytical thinking, attention to detail, openness to new ideas, and a willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review client enquiries, tender documents, technical specifications, engineering drawings, and requests for quotation.
  • Prepare project scope summaries and assist management in evaluating tender opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal departments, suppliers, and subcontractors to obtain technical inputs, quotations, labour rates, material costs, and other tender information.
  • Develop project cost estimates and pricing using established costing templates.
  • Identify cost assumptions, commercial qualifications, exclusions, risks, and opportunities associated with each tender.
  • Prepare and compile commercial and technical proposal documents in accordance with client requirements.
  • Support project prequalification submissions and ensure all required documentation is complete and submitted on time.
  • Coordinate tender clarifications with clients and internal stakeholders before and after proposal submission.
  • Maintain proper records of quotations, costing information, tender correspondence, and supporting documents.
  • Assist with tender reviews, management approvals, price revalidation, and project handover following contract award.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering, Marine Engineering, Naval Architecture, Quantity Surveying, Business, or related discipline.
  • Candidates with relevant tendering, estimation, engineering, shipyard, construction, or commercial experience are welcome to apply.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical specifications and engineering drawings would be advantageous.
  • Comfortable working with numbers, cost information.
  • Strong analytical, organisational, communication, and time-management skills.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to coordinate effectively across multiple departments.
  • Positive learning attitude, commercial awareness, and openness to new ideas and working methods.
  • Able to manage multiple tender deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willing to travel overseas when required.

Education

Diploma in Engineering or Marine Engineering

Bachelors in Engineering or Naval Architect

job.title: Security Officer
job.description:
Job Summary

To maintain a safe, secure, and pleasant environment for shoppers, tenants, staff, and visitors through effective surveillance, patrols, access control, incident response, and customer service. The Security Officer serves as the first line of defense in protecting the mall's assets and ensuring compliance with security and safety procedures.

Key Responsibilities

1.Security Patrol & Surveillance

  • Conduct regular patrols of the mall, common areas, car parks, loading bays, and external premises.
  • Monitor CCTV systems, alarm systems, and security equipment to detect and prevent security breaches.
  • Report suspicious activities, safety hazards, and security concerns to supervisors promptly.
  • Ensure all entrances, exits, and restricted areas are properly secured.

2.Access Control

  • Monitor and control access for contractors, vendors, tenants, and visitors entering restricted areas.
  • Verify permits, passes, and authorization documents where required.
  • Assist in key management and access card control procedures.
  • Ensure security procedures are adhered to by all parties within the premises.

3.Incident Response

  • Respond promptly to security incidents, disturbances, emergencies, and customer complaints.
  • Provide immediate assistance during accidents, medical emergencies, fires, and evacuation situations.
  • Assist in crowd control and traffic management during peak periods, events, and festive seasons.
  • Record and report all incidents accurately in the Daily Occurrence Book (DOB) and incident reports.

4.Safety & Emergency Preparedness

  • Conduct routine inspections of emergency exits, fire escape routes, and fire-fighting equipment.
  • Assist in emergency drills and evacuation exercises.
  • Ensure emergency access routes remain clear and unobstructed at all times.
  • Support emergency response efforts in accordance with established procedures.

5.Customer Service

  • Provide directions and assistance to shoppers and visitors when required.
  • Assist with lost-and-found cases and customer enquiries.
  • Maintain a professional, courteous, and helpful attitude while performing security duties.
  • Act as an ambassador of the mall by delivering excellent customer service.

6.Tenant & Contractor Support

  • Monitor tenant renovation works, maintenance activities, and contractor movements.
  • Ensure contractors comply with mall security and safety requirements.
  • Report any non-compliance, unsafe practices, or unauthorized works.

7.General Duties

  • Maintain security logs, patrol records, and incident reports accurately.
  • Attend briefings, training sessions, and emergency drills as required.
  • Maintain proper grooming and appearance in accordance with company standards.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by Management.

Key Requirements

Work Location: Johor Bahru City Square Mall

  • Minimum SPM or equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in security, customer service, hospitality, retail operations, or related field.
  • Able to communicate in Bahasa Malaysia and English. Ability to converse in Mandarin will be an added advantage.
  • Physically fit and willing to work rotating shifts, weekends, and public holidays.
  • Experience in shopping malls, commercial buildings, hotels, transportation hubs, or integrated developments will be an advantage.

job.title: Engineer, Quality Systems
job.description:
Job Summary

This role ensures ISO 9001:2015 compliance by maintaining and improving the QMS, managing audits, training staff, analysing quality data, and addressing nonconformities. It includes overseeing KPIs, customer satisfaction, subcontractor performance, and continuous improvement initiatives while collaborating across departments to adapt the QMS to business needs and drive operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and support the maintenance of ISO 9001:2015 certification by ensuring full compliance with applicable standards, corporate requirements, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Develop, review, update, and continuously improve QMS documents to ensure alignment with ISO 9001 requirements, best practices, and group-wide standardization across sister yards.
  • Manage the nonconformity reporting process, ensuring root cause analysis is conducted, corrective actions are implemented effectively, and closure is achieved within the defined timeframe.
  • Conduct QMS induction briefings for new employees and deliver quality-related training programs to enhance employee awareness, competency, and compliance with QMS requirements.
  • Prepare Management Review presentation materials, perform data analysis on quality performance indicators, and prepare meeting minutes. Follow up on action items and ensure timely closure with clear accountability.
  • Prepare and analyse monthly QS reports, identify key quality trends and recurring issues, and coordinate with relevant departments to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Manage departmental KPI reporting, verify performance data accuracy, analyse trends, and follow up with departments to ensure performance targets are achieved and improvement actions are implemented.
  • Monitor Customer Satisfaction Questionnaire (CSQ) results, analyse feedback, identify improvement opportunities, and coordinate corrective actions to enhance customer satisfaction.
  • Oversee in-house calibration records and ensure measuring and test equipment (e.g., micrometres, pressure gauges) are properly calibrated, maintained, and compliant with calibration schedules and requirements.
  • Conduct subcontractor and supplier qualification audits, evaluate performance, and monitor ongoing compliance with quality requirements.
  • Collaborate with departments to identify, review, and update risks, opportunities, and interested party requirements to ensure the QMS remains effective and aligned with business objectives.
  • Actively participate in and support continuous improvement initiatives, quality improvement projects, and operational excellence programs.
  • Perform any other duties, as assigned by superior.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Quality Management System (QMS), preferably in the maritime or engineering industry.
  • Experience in developing and maintaining procedures and work instructions.
  • Experience in conducting internal quality audits and follow-up on corrective actions.
  • Experience in root cause analysis, CAPA, and nonconformity management.
  • Experience in data analysis and identifying improvement opportunities.
  • Experience in continuous improvement activities.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering or Industrial and System Engineering

job.title: Executive, Marketing Communications
job.description:
Job Summary

The Marketing Communications Executive supports the planning, development and execution of marketing campaigns and promotional activities to drive footfall, tenant sales and shopper engagement. The role also manages the mall’s digital presence and provides timely reporting on campaign performance.

Key Responsibilities

1.Campaign Development & Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns, events and promotional activities in line with the mall’s annual marketing calendar.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, tenants, agencies and vendors to ensure smooth implementation of campaigns.
  • Support on-ground execution including setup, operations and post-event teardown.
  • Ensure campaigns are executed within approved budgets and timelines.

2.Social Media & Digital Management

  • Manage and update the mall’s social media platforms (e.g. Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)
  • Plan and schedule content in line with campaign objectives and brand guidelines
  • Monitor engagement, respond to enquiries and manage community interactions in a timely manner
  • Work with designers and agencies to produce relevant and engaging content

3.Reporting & Analysis

  • Track and compile campaign performance including footfall, sales (where applicable), and digital metrics
  • Prepare regular reports on campaign effectiveness and social media performance
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve future campaigns

4.Stakeholder & Tenant Coordination

  • Liaise with tenants to support their participation in mall campaigns and promotions.
  • Assist in coordinating joint promotions, vouchers, and marketing tie-ups.
  • Maintain good working relationships with tenants and external partners.

5.Administrative & Operational Support

  • Assist in procurement processes including quotation requests, vendor coordination and invoice processing
  • Maintain proper documentation for campaigns, reports and approvals
  • Support any ad-hoc marketing or operational tasks as required

Key Requirements

Job Location: Johor Bahru City Square Mall.

  • Diploma or Degree in Marketing, Communications or related field
  • 5 years of relevant experience, preferably in retail, mall or agency environment
  • Strong execution skills with attention to detail
  • Familiar with social media platforms and basic analytics tools
  • Good communication and coordination skills
  • Able to work weekends and public holidays when required for events

job.title: Data Centre Specialist (Cikarang, Indonesia)
job.description:
Job Summary

On a day-to-day basis, the Data Centre Specialist (DCS) is responsible for the executing and assisting of the maintenance breakdowns and breakdown follow ups. Responsible for delivering a high-quality maintenance service to the Data Centre. The DCS must ensure that maintenance works efficiently, effectively, safely and in line with the maintenance strategy.

Responsible for carrying out planned work. Reporting Directly to the Facility Lead

Key Responsibilities

  • While acting as DCS you are responsible for ensuring the successful operation, maintenance and repair of all critical equipment systems while maintaining 100% uptime on site.
  • Plan completion of planned & reactive work orders, assigned to you, to achieve and maintain 100% compliance every month i.e. all work orders completed on or before due date.
  • Assist in the planning, supervision and handover of any project related changes or improvements within the facility.
  • Ensure that the Facilities Operations Centre (FOC), FOC Library, Stores & Workshop are clean and tidy at all times. Carry out routine housekeeping check of your area and follow a clean as you go approach to your work.
  • Work closely with management and the wider operational team on the review of equipment failures and preparation of detailed root cause analysis and action plan reports.
  • Provide input into and develop site specific procedures associated with Maintenance and operation of critical equipment: SOP’s, EOP’s, Drills etc.
  • Assist in technical issues, project management, vendor management and technical reporting on all critical equipment and computerised systems.
  • Escort and supervise/monitor work of third-party engineers and sub-contractors to ensure their compliance with the site standards when performing maintenance or relevant activities.
  • Operate equipment, monitor and respond to alarms and abnormal conditions in the FOC as required. Ensure that EPMS, BMS, and Fire System alarms are responded to with the highest priority.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 1-3 years of working experience in a Data Centre environment preferred
  • Effective communication and proficiency in spoken and written English preferably.
  • Able to work 12 hours rotating shifts
  • You must be flexible in your working patterns to support requirements dictated by the rhythm of the business & operational demands.
  • Good working ability on Microsoft Office Products, in particular Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint.
  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.

Interpersonal Requirements

  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.
  • Calm Manner, able to work under pressure.
  • Self-motivated, ability to work on own initiative.
  • Punctual and reliable.
  • Good attention to detail.
  • A team player, able to work with colleagues and clients staff at all levels.

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering & Electronics

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
POSH is looking for Lead Engineers to manage and execute the SURF (Subsea Riser Umbilical and Flowline) and diving construction scopes on a project.

The role reports directly to the Project Package Manager on a specific project and works closely with other members of the Project Management Team (PMT) on a day to day basis, such as Engineering Manager, Project Operations Manager, HSE and Quality Managers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinating with other departments and teams to ensure that SURF/Diving package activities are properly integrated into the overall project plan.
  • Provides specialist skills, integrity, and knowledge in key areas of discipline engineering, including design codes, legislative requirements and current good engineering practice.
  • Understands clients' needs; identifies and addresses design parameters and problems; develops and implements solutions.
  • Ensures project and HS&E compliance and adherence to project budget & schedule.
  • Under own supervision, independently evaluates, organises and prioritises work.
  • Undertakes responsibility for production of installation deliverables, which may include engineering support to the Drawing Office, installation procedures, technical bid evaluations, study reports and various 3rd-party submissions.
  • Signs and issues technical documentation as originator or checker, accepting personal responsibility for its adequacy.
  • Ensures all relevant safety objectives and legal requirements are observed.
  • Developing and managing procurement strategies and plans to ensure that equipment and materials are delivered on time and within budget.
  • Coordinating with suppliers and vendors to ensure that equipment and materials are manufactured, tested, and delivered to the required quality standards.
  • Coordinating with offshore installation teams to ensure that the SURF package is installed and commissioned according to the project schedule and quality standards.
  • Providing technical advice and guidance to senior management and other stakeholders.
  • Providing technical guidance and support to the team of engineers and technical professionals working on the package. Trains / mentors more junior engineers.
  • May manage a team of engineers on a project or within a discipline
  • Manage interfaces within a project structure, including other disciplines, drawing office, document control, project management, client and suppliers.
  • Manage change control within own remit on a project. Inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related field
  • At least 10-15 years of experience in SURF/Diving Installation operations
  • Relevant experience working on previous EPCI or T&I offshore construction projects is preferred
  • Previous track record of working on Saudi Aramco LTA Projects of similar scopes is an advantage
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of SURF Installation operations including various lay spreads (horizontal lay for flexibles and umbilicals / basket carousel for cable lay), lay techniques and procedures, as well as relevant installation regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Knowledge: Must have a good understanding of diving operations including DSV and diving spreads, diving techniques, and procedures, as well as relevant diving regulations and standards. Knowledge of project management principles and practices is also required.
  • Skills: Must possess strong leadership, communication and problem-solving skills. Must be able to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Ability to lead and function within a design team and across multiple projects.
  • Ability to prioritise own and others’ workload, manage time accordingly and inform team members where constraints will affect a project in terms of programme or budget.
  • Excellent analytical and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders
  • Fluent in English

job.title: Assistant Manager, Learning & Development
job.description:
Job Summary

The Assistant Manager, Learning & Development is responsible for supporting the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of learning and development initiatives across PaxOcean Group. The role partners with business leaders and stakeholders to identify training needs, develop learning solutions, enhance workforce capabilities, and foster a culture of continuous learning. This position also supports talent development programmes, competency framework initiatives, and training effectiveness measurement to ensure employees are equipped with the skills required to meet current and future business needs.

  • Coordinate and administer learning programmes, workshops, leadership development initiatives, and employee development interventions.

  • Assist in the management and execution of graduate, management trainee, and talent development programmes to support employee growth and succession planning initiatives.
  • Curate, source, and recommend internal and external training programmes that address organisational and employee development needs.
  • Monitor training participation, learning outcomes, and programme effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and data analysis.
  • Prepare training reports, dashboards, and insights to support data-driven learning and talent decisions.
  • Work closely with HR and business stakeholders to promote a culture of continuous learning and professional development.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 4–6 years of relevant experience in Learning & Development, Talent Development, Training, or related HR functions.
  • Experience in conducting training needs analyses and coordinating employee development programmes.
  • Familiarity with competency frameworks, learning management systems (LMS), and adult learning methodologies.
  • Ability to analyse learning data, identify trends, and recommend improvements based on insights.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively with employees and leaders across different levels of the organisation.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and results-driven with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • High level of professionalism, integrity, and credibility.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.

Education

Bachelors in Human Resources or Organization Development

job.title: Accounts Officer (AP)

You will be responsible for the full cycle of accounts payable, from invoice processing to payment execution, ensuring our vendors are paid accurately and on time. job.description:

job.title: Assistant Manager, Food Court
job.description:
Job Summary

The Food Court Assistant Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations of the food court, ensuring smooth tenant operations, compliance with regulatory requirements, high standards of cleanliness, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance. The role will also support the planning, setup, and operational readiness of new food court projects and expansion initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Operations Management
  • Assist in managing the overall operations of the food court to ensure efficient and smooth daily activities.This includes the running and operations of 2 drinks stalls.
  • Monitor tenant compliance with operational standards, lease obligations, and house rules.
  • Ensure adequate manpower deployment and operational coverage.
  • Conduct regular inspections of common areas, facilities, and tenant outlets.
  • Address operational issues, customer complaints, and tenant concerns promptly.
  • Food Court Setup & Project Support
  • Participate in the planning, setup, and commissioning of new food court developments and refurbishment projects.
  • Coordinate with contractors, consultants, tenants, and relevant stakeholders during setup phases.
  • Assist in tenant onboarding, fit-out coordination, and operational readiness assessments.
  • Develop and implement operational procedures and guidelines for new food court operations.
  • Regulatory Compliance
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, licensing requirements, and local authority guidelines.
  • Monitor food hygiene, safety, cleanliness, and environmental health standards.
  • Liaise with relevant government agencies and regulatory authorities when required.
  • Conduct regular compliance audits and implement corrective actions where necessary.
  • Tenant Management
  • Build and maintain positive working relationships with food court tenants.
  • Monitor tenant performance and adherence to operating standards.
  • Support lease administration matters and tenant renewals where required.
  • Coordinate promotional activities and operational campaigns with tenants.
  • Beverage Stall Operations Management
  • Oversee the daily operations of two beverage stalls within the food court to ensure efficient service delivery and profitability.
  • Plan and manage manpower deployment, duty rosters, shift scheduling, leave arrangements, and staff attendance to ensure adequate operational coverage.
  • Supervise beverage stall employees and ensure compliance with company policies, service standards, food safety, and hygiene requirements.
  • Monitor sales performance and implement initiatives to improve productivity and customer satisfaction.
  • Manage inventory levels, stock ordering, receiving, storage, and stock replenishment to minimize shortages and wastage.
  • Conduct regular stock counts and inventory audits to ensure accuracy and accountability.
  • Monitor cost of goods sold (COGS), beverage consumption trends, and inventory variances.
  • Oversee cash handling, daily sales reconciliation, payment collection, and submission of sales reports.
  • Verify supplier invoices, process payments, and ensure timely settlement of operational expenses in accordance with company procedures.
  • Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to ensure uninterrupted supply of products and consumables.
  • Ensure all beverage stall operations comply with relevant food safety regulations, licensing requirements, and company operational standards.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, cost management, and revenue generation.
  • Financial & Commercial Management
  • Monitor operational expenses and recommend cost-control measures.
  • Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and revenue monitoring.
  • Support rental collection processes and follow-up on outstanding payments where necessary.
  • Customer Experience
  • Ensure a safe, clean, and welcoming environment for customers.
  • Monitor customer feedback and implement service improvement initiatives.
  • Support marketing and promotional activities to increase footfall and sales performance.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Food & Beverage Management, Retail Management, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in food court, F&B outlet management, mall food court operations, or similar environment.
  • Experience in setting up, opening, or commissioning a food court will be a strong advantage.
  • Strong knowledge of food safety, hygiene regulations, licensing requirements, and local authority compliance.
  • Proven experience in tenant management and operational supervision.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

job.title: Facility Lead (Sedenak, Johor)
job.description:
Job Summary

To provide leadership and management support of an operational Critical environment shift team providing 24/7/365 on-site support of a production data centre facility. The Facility Lead is responsible for the emergency response and maintenance of critical services within the data center environment. These activities typically include the planning of the shift teams work activities on a daily basis ensuring all aspects of the shift & facility are covered & monitored during your day. All paperwork associated with the planned maintenance visits of vendors - based on the main sub-contractor schedule for each contract year - is ready and in place for your shift team (Locks, tags, procedures etc.) It is the Facility Lead that will coordinate all of this to ensure a smooth running of the shift while also providing a point of contact for the client & management. The Facility Lead reports to the Operations Manager. He is responsible for the supervision of the FOC and the shift during his working day.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, manage and be responsible for the designated shift team, ensuring the successful operation, maintenance and repair of all critical environment systems while always maintaining 100% uptime to all critical power systems on site.
  • Prioritize and assign PPM’s /TT’s planned & unplanned work orders to your shift Data Center Specialists to achieve & maintain 100% compliance every month.
  • Coordinate ongoing maintenance and activities within the Data Centre for your shift team. During your day you will have full overview & awareness of all activities and, in conjunction with the Critical Maintenance Manager, will prioritize these activities.
  • Ensure all subcontractors are inducted and permitted to work within the domain prior to issuing permits to work.
  • You and your team need to review subcontractor method statements, risk assessments, and MSDS to ensure compliance with site health & safety and operating procedures prior to you or your team issuing permit to works.
  • Ensure that the FOC is always monitored and manned and that EPMS, BMS, and Fire Systems alarms are responded to in a timely manner
  • Ensure completion of all your shift team’s scheduled PMs and ensure all your shift Data Centre Specialists carry out their scheduled PMs in a timely manner (PMs as issued through CAFM) to achieve 100% PM compliance.
  • Update and log all activities/time on CAFM. Ensure your shift team update & record all their time/activities on CAFM
  • Issue a daily Shift Handover report via email detailing activities and issues that have taken place and that require escalation. It is the leads responsibility to ensure that the shift report is accurately completed and sent out to the critical environments e-mail alias on time.
  • Adhere to and drive your shift team to achieve acceptable scores on the team KPI Scorecard as located on CAFM.
  • Provide input into and develop site specific procedures including EOPs, SOPs, MOPs, Aps and EOP Drills as issued by Management.
  • Ensure that you are fully conversant with the site Emergency Response Plan and co-operate with the SOC/FOC during site emergencies.
  • Complete a minimum of 4 drills per month
  • Escort and supervise/monitor work of third-party engineers and sub-contractors to ensure their compliance with the site standards when performing maintenance or relevant activity.
  • Carry out Toolbox talks once every shift rotation to achieve & exceed your shift teams monthly target. All toolbox talks need to be signed off and issued to the contract support on completion.
  • Ensure the professional image of K2 is always presented to clients and visitors while on site.
  • Adhere to all K2’s quality, health & safety, and environmental policies and documentation requirements while performing work.
  • Undertake other tasks as defined and requested by local management.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 5-10 years of working experience in a Data Centre environment preferably
  • Strong knowledge and experience in the data centre industry, including development and management of data centres.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, interpersonal, teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communications skills both in English and Bahasa Malay language.
  • Excellent project, planning, change and time management capabilities.
  • Good judgement and decision making skills.
  • Leadership and supervisory skills.
  • Strong organisational skills.
  • Ability to use computer applications effectively.

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering & Electronics or Building Management

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering

job.title: Manager, Technology Solutions
job.description:
Job Summary

The IT Manager is an influential IT Application Owner responsible for delivering IT support operation excellence, continuous improvement, and strong application project delivery. This role emphasises delivering high-quality outcomes, bringing in emerging technologies — including AI and advanced analytics and delivering measurable business value while fostering sustainable growth. Ideal for a motivated individual passionate about driving digital transformation, deploying AI solutions, and delivering excellence in a complex, multi-site maritime and industrial environment.

Key Responsibilities

Application Ownership:

  • End-to-End Management: Serve as the IT owner for designated software applications, managing the full lifecycle including implementation, updates, support & maintenance, and decommissioning. IT owner also to ensure the application continues to meet business needs and performance standards.
  • System Stability and Performance Monitoring: Ensure quality support meeting SLA. Oversee the performance of applications, ensuring uptime, reliability, and continuous improvement to meet evolving business needs.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary point of contact between IT and business stakeholders, ensuring alignment between the organization's objectives and the application's capabilities. Build and maintain strong relationships with vendors, ensuring optimal service delivery, ongoing support, and contract management. Work collaboratively across IT team to ensure seamless data flow and interoperability across systems.
  • Governance & Compliance: Ensure that applications comply with internal policies, industry standards, and legal regulations. Maintain security best practices and manage risks. Oversee VAPT exercises, vulnerability remediation, and security hardening for Application and Hosting environment.
  • Requirements Gathering: Lead the process of gathering business and technical requirements for enhancements or new software solutions, working closely with cross-functional teams to define project scope.

Application Landscape Management & Modernisation

  • Define, Design, Document and continuous modernization of application architecture landscape in partnership with SaaS providers and Developer Partners for bespoke Applications. Drive migration from legacy monoliths toward modern, cloud-native, microservices-based architectures with API and Agentic AI MCP readiness
  • Own availability and disaster recovery (DR) planning for critical applications; test and validate RTO/RPO targets.
  • Access cloud and hybrid deployment models to evaluate fit for applications under management. Assess data sovereignty, cost, and risk trade-offs when recommending hosting options

AI Adoption & Automation

  • Define and execute an AI adoption roadmap for the application support function, identifying high-value use cases for automation, augmentation, and intelligence.
  • Champion the integration of AI/ML-driven observability, AIOps tooling, and intelligent alerting to reduce noise and accelerate diagnostics.
  • Drive a shift-left culture — moving reactive break-fix toward proactive monitoring, self-healing automation, and knowledge management

Key Requirements

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in application management, with a proven track record of performing Support and Project implementations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science.
  • PMP, ITIL or equivalent certifications is an advantage.
  • Cloud or AI certifications (AWS, Azure, Salesforce AI Specialist) are advantageous.
  • Experience with Applications used by maritime related industry is advantageous.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based applications, SaaS solutions, and modern IT architecture.
  • Candidates must possess technical acumen and the ability to develop solutions
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess system performance and implement improvements.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities and changing requirements.

job.title: BO 33KV Chargeman (Sedenak Johor)
job.description:
Job Summary

This role oversees 33kV HV switching, maintenance governance, protection system integrity, and emergency response in full compliance with Suruhanjaya Tenaga (ST) regulations, the Electricity Supply Act 1990, and Electricity Regulations 1994.

Key Responsibilities

Operation & Control •Operate and control 33kV electrical installations including HV switchgear, transformers and protection systems in compliance with the Electricity Supply Act 1990, Electricity Regulations 1994 and DC requirements •Conduct inspections, quality checks, supervise employees, subcontractors and services

Switching & Safety Procedures •Adhere to customer freeze periods and communicate relevant dates •Prepare, review and maintain SOPs and EOPs for 33kV switchgear operations •Perform and supervise HV switching, isolation, earthing, energization and restoration following PTW, LOTO, SJT and DC safety rules •Conduct monthly emergency operating drills •Provide technical assessments for troubleshooting, identifying causes and implementing solutions

Maintenance, Testing & Protection Systems •Maintain and execute the 52-week maintenance schedule •Prepare and review checklists for 33kV switchgear and equipment •Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance, testing and protection relay functionality per regulations •Keep records of relay conditions, calibrations, defects and maintenance activities •Ensure proper maintenance of card access, CCTV, HVAC systems, coordinating third party vendors •Conduct regular inspections of M&E equipment and record readings as per requirements

Fault Response & Incident Management •Respond to electrical faults, failures, and emergencies, perform initial isolation, coordinate restoration, support root cause analysis per ST safety and reporting requirements •Provide 24-hour emergency support and act as first responder following established procedures •Resolve escalated technical issues with data centre facilities leads •Maintain onsite spare parts for uninterrupted operations •Ensure all PTW and MOP/MOS documentation is approved before work execution •Comply with change management and raise tickets for all reported findings, ensuring complete resolution •Address incidents, complaints, breakdowns and repairs promptlSupervision & Competency Control •Brief all personnel on house rules and electrical safety •Review methods of statement and ensure permits are approved before work •Supervise technicians and contractors ensuring only authorized competent individuals work on electrical installations per ST regulations •Oversee term contractors and service providers to ensure work meets SOPs •Provide structured training and ongoing education on electrical operations, safety, regulatory compliance, SOPs and lessons learned, incorporating industry best practices for safe and efficient execution

Documentation & Records •Maintain accurate logbooks, switching records, test reports, single-line diagrams, protection settings, checklists and statutory documents for ST audits •Assist Competent Visiting Engineers during inspections, escalating and resolving reported issues •Keep records updated, file ST reports, prepare summaries and compile monthly submissions

Regulatory Compliance, Licensing & Audits •Ensure continuous compliance with Suruhanjaya Tenaga licensing conditions including timely renewal of the Electrical Installation License prior to each expiry, support ST inspections and internal audits •Ensure safety rules and guidelines are always followed

Risk Management & Safety Leadership •Identify electrical hazards, implement controls and enforce safe work practices to prevent accidents and service interruptions, recommending improvements •Plan and execute preventive and corrective maintenance to minimize downtime through proactive testing and scheduled work

Key Requirements

•Valid Chargeman B0 (33kV) certificate (ST Malaysia) or equivalent; B0 for 11kV considered with 33kV experience; B4 for 11kV/33kV advantageous •Available for emergency response and 24/7 on-call support •5–7 years’ hands-on experience in commercial, industrial, or data centre high-voltage systems (switching, maintenance, protection relays) •Experience managing technical teams and supervising subcontractors •Knowledge of M&E and Facilities Management •Proficient in English; additional languages a plus •Strong leadership, communication, and people management skills •Basic MS Office 365 skills; experience with CMMS, BMS, EPMS •High school diploma/GED with technical certifications; higher electrical engineering qualifications preferred •Strong organizational and analytical skills to deliver reliable, efficient service to stakeholders

Education

Diploma

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

job.title: Assistant Manager, Commercial (Modules)
job.description:
Job Summary

Responsible in preparation of all commercial aspects of Onshore and Offshore Modules Construction Projects tendering, which includes but not limited to Costing, Pricing, Tender Proposal and Prequalification, by coordinating with all relevant departments to collate the correct inputs necessary to prepare a compelling commercial and technical tender proposal for submission, with primary objective to achieve successful project awards.

Key Responsibilities

Project Prequalification

  • Review Pre-qualifications documentation requirements and deliverables received from customers.
  • Work with all relevant departments in the Company to collate the necessary supporting documents for Prequalification.
  • Prepare client’s prequalification questionnaire and supporting documents for submission.
  • Review the Prequalification response with AGM Commercial and Senior Management.
  • Submit deliverable either via client’s portal or email.
  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.

Project Tendering

  • Compile and review customer enquiries, tenders and/ or RFQs and provide a scope summary to Paxocean Management to review for bid decision.
  • Check sanction risk from company portal and credit risk of client company from company Risk and Compliance Team.
  • When bid decision is to proceed, determine the required tender deliverables and coordinate and work will all relevant departments to collate tender inputs for proposal preparations.
  • Review the technical specifications/ requirements/ engineering drawings and prepare commercial proposal/ bid for submission through coordination with various stakeholder in the yard. Collate all clarifications and send to client and follow up for response and advise.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverable

Tender Costing & Pricing

  • Monitor and ensure various deadlines by customer are strictly adhered to.
  • Prepare costing and pricing using the established excel templates with supporting suppliers and subcontractor cost for substantiation.
  • Prepare tender qualifications and exceptions in accordance with the basis of the costing estimates.
  • Collate all material cost received from suppliers and labour cost from subcontractors in the respective disciplines folders, for further reference, price revalidations and project handover after tender award.
  • Review the commercial and tender proposal with AGM commercial when the preparation is completed and incorporate all comments received from AGM Commercial after the review.

Prior Submission and Post Submission

  • Invite Senior Management for Tender review to get approval for tender submission.
  • Upon approval for submission, prepare the clean copy of commercial and technical tender proposal, including cover letter for submission.
  • Follow up with Clients for tender status and feedback on the submitted proposal. Response to all clients clarifications.
  • Upon project award, prepare presentation highlighting scope of work, technical, commercial and contractual information of the project for commercial handover meeting.

Post Project Award

  • Maintain and cultivate good relationship with existing and potential associates/customers through regular communication.
  • Provide advice to Project Managers on any potential variation orders.
  • Compile all inputs from relevant departments for submission based on client’s requirement on tender deliverables.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Engineering from reputable institution.
  • At least 5-8 years of relevant industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in commercial roles and in addition, preferably also with experience in technical or commercial aspects in FPSO projects or module construction and project management.
  • Able to read, interpret and prepare applicable technical / commercial information including proposal, Engineering Drawings and suggest process changes to ensure functional and cost-effective results.

Education

Bachelors in Engineering

job.title: Manager, Quality Assurance & Transformation
job.description:
Overview

The Fleet HSSEQ Quality Manager is a key member of the HSSEQ leadership team, working closely with HSSEQ Superintendents to drive the integration of quality management across operations and project execution.

Responsibilities

  • Responsible for leading and overseeing fleet and group quality performance, ensuring effective non-conformance management, maintaining audit readiness, and promoting a culture of continuous improvement throughout the organization.
  • Lead High Potential (HiPo) incidents, Lost Time Injuries (LTI), and major environmental breaches across the segment, while ensuring the consistent application of investigation methodologies such as TapRooT and 5-Why to support effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Establish, implement, and maintain quality standards across the organization in alignment with company, client, and regulatory requirements.
  • Accountable for maintaining and continuously improving the fleet’s and group’s certification.
  • Responsible for the QA section of the Integrated Management System (IMS) — approve all quality procedures, work instructions, and forms.
  • Develop the fleet-wide quality strategy, policy, and annual objectives in alignment with corporate goals.
  • Responsible for the annual ISO management reviews — present performance data, NCR trends, and strategic recommendations to the POSH Group HSSEQ Head.
  • Lead the root cause analyses for major or recurring quality failures.
  • Oversee and manage the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) system, analyze NCR trends to identify systemic quality risks, and communicate key findings along with recommended strategic interventions.
  • Lead high-risk or client-critical quality audits on vessels, project sites, and key suppliers.
  • Accountable for governance of the master audit finding register, with authority to challenge PICs on delayed closures or inadequate corrective actions to ensure timely and effective resolution.
  • Lead the preparation for major external audits (client, flag state, ISO certification) and coordinate group-wide evidence gathering to ensure audit readiness and compliance.
  • Prepare the HSSEQ input for the ISO/ISM Management Review for presentation by the Head HSSEQ to senior leadership.
  • Provide quality assurance input and approval throughout the tendering and contract negotiation processes, ensuring that client quality requirements are clearly defined, aligned with operational capabilities, and both commercially and operationally feasible.
  • Review and approve all Project Quality Plans for construction, subsea, and installation scopes to ensure compliance with company standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Act as the company’s senior Quality Assurance representative in client meetings, quarterly business reviews, and quality performance discussions, ensuring effective communication of quality performance and commitments.
  • Maintain the approved supplier register and exercise authority to suspend or remove non-performing suppliers based on quality performance evaluations and compliance requirements.
  • Benchmark fleet quality performance against industry peers, ensure integration of quality within the HSSEQ Integrated Management System (IMS), and lead QHSE improvement initiatives, presenting key insights and recommendations to the POSH Group Head HSSEQ.

Qualifications

  • Preferably with a Degree in Nautical Studies, Engineering or any relevant degree.
  • COC Class 1 Master/Engineer

  • Define CI model standards (classes, relationships, naming) to support reliable reporting, automation, and service mapping outcomes.
  • Implement CMDB data quality controls (rules, audits, reconciliation) and partner with upstream owners to improve completeness and accuracy.

  • Configure and deploy NowAssist to enable AI-powered summarisation, resolution recommendations, and agent-assist capabilities across ITSM modules.
  • Design, build, and maintain Virtual Agent (VA) conversation flows for common service requests and IT support scenarios, reducing L1 ticket volumes.
  • Stay current with ServiceNow AI/ML roadmap updates and assess opportunities to expand AI-assisted capabilities.

5. Platform Enhancements & Feature Delivery

  • Design and deliver enhancements across ITSM (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge) aligned to agreed backlog and roadmap.
  • Build and optimise workflows, business rules, UI policies, and client scripts with a focus on automation, performance, and maintainability.

Requirements

  • Proven track record of implementing at least one complete ITSM platform lifecycle (planning, deployment, optimisation).
  • Demonstrated expertise in ServiceNow configuration across core ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge).
  • Strong ServiceNow development/configuration skills with experience delivering enhancements via a structured release lifecycle (dev/test/prod).
  • Hands-on CMDB configuration experience: CI class design, relationship mapping, discovery integration, and data quality management.
  • Virtual Agent (VA) configuration experience: end-to-end design and implementation of chatbot conversation workflows for common IT service requests.
  • NowAssist configuration and deployment experience: setup and operationalisation of AI-powered assistance features to enhance agent productivity.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) integration with ServiceNow — SSO, SCIM provisioning, and group synchronisation.
  • Experience managing end-user service portals with a focus on usability and self-service enablement.

  • Familiarity with ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, or ITOM modules.

Job Summary

This position is for K2 Data Centres, a company under Kuok (Singapore) Limited, based in Johor, Malaysia.

Purpose of the Role:

On a day-to-day basis, the Data Centre Specialist (DCS) is responsible for the executing, and assisting of the maintenance breakdowns and breakdown follow ups. Responsible for delivering a high quality maintenance service to the Data Centre. The DCS must ensure that maintenance works efficiently, effectively, safely and in line with the maintenance strategy.

Reporting Directly to the Facility Lead

Key Responsibilities

  • While acting as DCS you are responsible for ensuring the successful operation, maintenance and repair of all critical equipment systems while maintaining 100% uptime on site.
  • Plan completion of planned & reactive work orders, assigned to you, to achieve and maintain 100% compliance every month i.e. all work orders completed on or before due date.
  • Assist in the planning, supervision and handover of any project related changes or improvements within the facility.
  • Ensure that the Facilities Operations Centre (FOC), FOC Library, Stores & Workshop are clean and tidy at all times. Carry out routine housekeeping check of your area and follow a clean as you go approach to your work.
  • Work closely with management and the wider operational team on the review of equipment failures and preparation of detailed root cause analysis and action plan reports.
  • Provide input into and develop site specific procedures associated with Maintenance and operation of critical equipment: SOP’s, EOP’s, Drills etc.
  • Assist in technical issues, project management, vendor management and technical reporting on all critical equipment and computerised systems.
  • Escort and supervise/monitor work of third-party engineers and sub-contractors to ensure their compliance with the site standards when performing maintenance or relevant activities.
  • Operate equipment, monitor and respond to alarms and abnormal conditions in the FOC as required. Ensure that EPMS, BMS, and Fire System alarms are responded to with the highest priority.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 1-3 years of working experience in a Data Centre environment preferred
  • Effective communication and proficiency in spoken and written Bahasa Malay and English in order to liaise with local counterparts.
  • Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration.
  • You must be flexible in your working patterns to support requirements dictated by the rhythm of the business & operational demands.
  • Good working ability on Microsoft Office Products, in particular Excel, Word, Outlook and PowerPoint.
  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.

Interpersonal Requirements

  • Committed to the delivery of excellent customer service.
  • Calm Manner, able to work under pressure.
  • Self-motivated, ability to work on own initiative.
  • Punctual and reliable.
  • Good attention to detail.
  • A team player, able to work with colleagues and clients staff at all levels.

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering or Mechanical Engineering

Diploma in Electrical Engineering & Electronics or Facilities Management

This position is for K2 Data Centres, a company under Kuok (Singapore) Limited, based in Malaysia.

K2 is an international developer, owner and operator of hyper-scale digital infrastructure assets. We are the specialists in providing critical digital infrastructure in the form of Data Centre environments to leading technology companies, we lay the physical foundations of the internet, cloud services and tomorrow's digital solutions, today.

With a proven track record operating to world leading service levels, we pride ourselves in being technically focused long-term partners, providing our customers peace of mind when investing in significant physical network, storage and computing resources that provide the digital solutions to millions of users around the world every day.

We seek to hire the best talent in the industry, who have the passion and motivation to join the growing team in K2.

job.title: Mobile & Full Stack Application Development Analyst
job.description:
Job Summary

We are an established property and retail organisation managing a portfolio of shopping destinations. Our loyalty programme connects members with participating malls and tenants through a mobile application that supports rewards points and other digital services.

The Loyalty team works closely with marketing teams and technology vendors to enhance the member experience and deliver new digital capabilities. We are looking for a Mobile & Full Stack Application Developer who can take ownership of the application’s technical design, development, testing and deployment across both iOS and Android platforms, as well as contributing to backend services, APIs and web-facing components that power our loyalty ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively analyse and clarify business requirements with the team, and technical requirements with internal and external system owners.
  • Work closely with relevant system owners to support application integration, investigate and troubleshoot production issues across interconnected systems in a timely manner.
  • Take ownership of translating business requirements into user journeys and technical designs for the loyalty programme’s iOS and Android applications, from development, integration, testing to release.
  • Be accountable for the complete testing lifecycle, including preparation of test scenarios and test cases, SIT, regression testing, UAT coordination, defect resolution and production release readiness.
  • Plan quarterly application releases, including submission and deployment through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.
  • Monitor and optimise application performance, reliability, responsiveness and user experience.
  • Apply mobile and full stack development best practices relating to coding standards, security, maintainability, version control and release management, covering both client-side and server-side components.
  • Maintain clear and up-to-date technical documentation, including system designs, integration specifications, deployment procedures and operational support guides.
  • Use artificial intelligence tools to improve development productivity and automate the generation and execution of test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Liaise with backend API vendors and third-party service providers to review integration specifications, validate API contracts, and ensure backend services reliably support mobile application features, loyalty transactions and member data management.
  • Collaborate on web portal or admin dashboard development where applicable, leveraging frontend frameworks such as React or Vue.js alongside backend technologies (Node.js, Python, or equivalent).
  • Ensure data consistency and integrity across mobile, web and backend layers, applying best practices in database design, caching and API versioning.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end mobile and full stack application development. Candidates must demonstrate experience across BOTH iOS and Android mobile platforms.
  • Hands-on experience in React Native or other hybrid mobile development frameworks.
  • Proficiency in full stack development, including backend frameworks (e.g. Node.js, Python/Django, Java Spring Boot) and relational or NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB).
  • Prior experience working in or building digital solutions for hospitality, loyalty programmes, retail, or consumer lifestyle industries is strongly preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure or GCP) and containerisation tools (Docker, Kubernetes) is an advantage.
  • Experience integrating mobile applications with APIs, backend platforms and third-party systems through conducting technical design, development, SIT and production support.
  • Understanding of application security, authentication, data privacy and secure API integration.
  • Experience with source-code management, automated build pipelines and mobile application release processes.
  • Familiarity with Apple and Google Play Store submission, review and deployment processes.
  • Had experience using artificial intelligence tools to generate, automate or maintain test cases for regression and enhancement testing.
  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies is a plus.
  • Able to proactively host collaboration meetings independently with various stakeholders
  • Strong sense of accountability for application quality, stability and successful delivery.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

job.title: Executive, Group Leasing

  • Strong interest and passion for the retail industry are a must.
  • Ability to multi-task, resourcefulness, an eye for details and work within timeline.

job.title: Commissioning Specialist
job.description:
Job Summary

The Commissioning Specialist is responsible for supporting and executing commissioning activities across multiple projects, ensuring systems and equipment are installed, tested, and operating in accordance with design requirements, project specifications, and applicable standards. The role supports the Commissioning Manager in delivering projects safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute commissioning activities from pre-commissioning through final acceptance.
  • Review commissioning procedures, method statements, test scripts, and technical documentation.
  • Witness and support FAT, SAT, functional testing, integrated system testing (IST), and performance testing.
  • Coordinate commissioning activities with contractors, vendors, consultants, and project teams.
  • Monitor Cx1–Cx5 commissioning progress and ensure activities are completed according to the project schedule.
  • Review test results, identify deficiencies, and follow up on punch list items through closure.
  • Verify equipment and system performance against design intent and project requirements.
  • Prepare and maintain commissioning reports, test records, trackers, and close-out documentation.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of technical issues during commissioning.
  • Ensure compliance with project safety requirements and applicable codes and standards.

Key Requirements

  • Diploma/Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Building Services Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant experience in testing, commissioning, construction, or facilities engineering.
  • Experience in data centre / mission-critical projects
  • Familiarity with relevant industry standards and commissioning practices.
  • Experience with electrical and/or mechanical systems such as generators, UPS, switchgear, cooling systems, CDU, CRAH, pumps, and BMS/EPMS is advantageous.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong understanding of testing and commissioning processes.
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings, SLDs, schematics, specifications, and technical documents.
  • Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong coordination and communication skills.
  • Able to manage multiple commissioning activities and priorities concurrently.
  • Detail-oriented with good documentation and reporting skills.
  • Able to work effectively with contractors, vendors, consultants, and internal stakeholders.
  • Willingness to support FAT/commissioning activities outside normal working hours when required.
  • Proactive, responsible, and able to work independently with minimal supervision.

#JR815

Education

Bachelors in Electrical Engineering

Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or Electrical Engineering & Electronics

job.title: Senior Document Controller
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the complete life cycle of construction project documents, including creation, distribution, tracking, and archiving.
  • Conduct thorough reviews of construction documents, including drawings, specifications, contracts, and other project-related documentation, to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to established standards.
  • Maintain and update document control systems to ensure the most recent versions of documents are readily available to the project team while ensuring previous versions are properly archived.
  • Facilitate the efficient distribution of documents to appropriate stakeholders, ensuring timely access to the required information
  • Establish and maintain a comprehensive filing and retrieval system to enable quick and accurate retrieval of project documents as needed.
  • Perform regular audits of project documentation to ensure compliance with project requirements, industry standards, and regulatory guidelines.
  • Manage electronic and physical document repositories, ensuring proper categorization, labeling, and indexing of documents for easy retrieval.
  • Collaborate with project team members, including architects, engineers, contractors, and subcontractors, to address document-related inquiries and resolve issues promptly.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of project-related correspondence, transmittals, requests for information (RFIs), and change orders.
  • Provide guidance and training to project team members on document control procedures, systems, and best practices.

Requirements

  • A high school diploma or equivalent is required. Additional certification or training in document control or construction management is preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in the construction industry or a related field.
  • Familiarity with construction documents, including drawings, specifications, contracts, RFIs, and change orders.
  • Exceptional organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Proficient in using document control software, project management software, and Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy, ensuring the completeness and correctness of all project documents.
  • Strong problem-solving skills to identify issues, propose solutions, and resolve document-related challenges promptly.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively with project team members and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Project Engineer (ICT, Cabling)

As a Project Engineer, you be responsible for providing advanced administrative support to the project management team. This includes documentation preparation, escalation for commitment, financial modeling, financial reconciliations, and reporting.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Program Excellence
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

A Snapshot

As the Senior Manager, Development Program Excellence – Japan, reporting to the Development Director based in Tokyo, you will establish and continuously improve AirTrunk Japan's integrated development programme, planning standards and delivery methodology across the entire project portfolio. You will lead the Scheduling and Program Management function, driving schedule certainty, programme optimisation and continuous improvement from site acquisition through operational handover. You will define how AirTrunk plans, governs and continuously improves the delivery of hyperscale data centres in Japan.

Your Day to Day

Development Program Governance

  • Lead the Development Program Excellence function for Japan and manage the Scheduling / Program Management team.
  • Establish programme governance frameworks, planning standards and schedule quality requirements.
  • Develop programme KPIs, portfolio metrics and executive reporting standards.
  • Lead programme governance meetings and executive programme reviews.
  • Develop programme management policies, procedures and templates.

Baseline Programme Development

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve AirTrunk's integrated baseline development programme from site acquisition through operational handover.
  • Develop programme templates for multiple delivery strategies and project conditions.
  • Develop baseline programmes for Behind the Meter (BTM) on-site power generation facilities.
  • Develop programme models supporting modular, off-site manufactured and containerised delivery.
  • Develop planning assumptions for AI-ready and liquid-cooled hyperscale data centres.
  • Capture lessons learned and continuously improve baseline schedules.

Programme Optimisation

  • Identify opportunities to shorten project duration while maintaining safety and quality.
  • Recommend alternative sequencing, procurement and construction strategies.
  • Quantify programme benefits from modularisation, prefabrication, factory acceptance testing and industrialised construction.
  • Evaluate impacts of procurement strategies on overall programme.
  • Drive continuous programme optimisation initiatives across the portfolio.

Contractor Programme Review

  • Present AirTrunk baseline programmes during procurement and pre-construction.
  • Review contractor programmes and perform detailed gap analyses.
  • Challenge contractor assumptions and negotiate programme improvements.
  • Review programmes for modular construction, containerised solutions and BTM infrastructure.
  • Assess factory production schedules, logistics plans and installation sequences.

Schedule Risk Management

  • Perform Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis.
  • Perform schedule risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Develop and monitor recovery programmes.
  • Identify early warning indicators and support project recovery planning.

Portfolio Planning

  • Maintain portfolio-wide programme visibility.
  • Identify portfolio-level resource constraints, interface risks and milestone conflicts.
  • Support executive decision-making through portfolio analysis and forecasting.

Digital Programme Management

  • Lead digital programme management initiatives.
  • Promote 4D scheduling, Digital Twin integration and AI-assisted programme optimisation.
  • Develop dashboards and automate programme reporting.

Lessons Learned & Best Practice

  • Maintain Japan Programme Best Practice Library.
  • Benchmark programme performance across projects.
  • Work with the Construction Innovation team to embed methodology improvements into baseline schedules.
  • Share Japan programme innovations across the APAC portfolio.

Stakeholder & Executive Support

  • Partner with Design, Procurement, Commercial, Construction, Customer Success and Operations.
  • Prepare executive dashboards, programme reports, and investment papers.
  • Present programme recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Travel domestically and internationally as required.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10+ years' experience in programme management, project controls or planning for major infrastructure, mission-critical or hyperscale data centre developments.
  • Demonstrated experience developing portfolio-level integrated master programmes.
  • Extensive experience performing Critical Path Method (CPM) analysis.
  • Experience performing schedule risk analysis and recovery planning.
  • Strong expertise in programme optimisation and contractor programme review.
  • Hands-on experience with project scheduling software. Oracle Primavera P6 preferred; Microsoft Project acceptable.
  • Experience planning modular industrialised or off-site construction projects.
  • Experience planning Behind the Meter (BTM) power generation or major energy infrastructure is advantageous.
  • Strong stakeholder management, analytical, commercial, and executive communication skills.
  • Fluency in Japanese and English.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience delivering hyperscale data centre developments.
  • Experience leading programme management or programme controls teams.
  • Experience with modular, off-site or containerised infrastructure.
  • Experience with AI-ready or liquid-cooled data centres.
  • Experience with Digital Twin, BIM 4D/5D or AI-enabled planning.
  • Knowledge of Japanese permitting, utilities and construction market.
  • Experience supporting investment committee approvals.
  • Experience working across APAC project portfolios.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a technology company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Snapshot

As our Quality Manager in Mumbai you will be responsible for implementing and operationalising the Global Minimum Standard for Quality (GMS‑Q) and the Quality Playbook across all construction activities within their assigned region. This role provides strategic and technical leadership in quality governance, quality assurance, quality control, documentation management, inspections, testing and handover readiness across AirTrunk’s projects delivery lifecycle. The role ensures that all projects regardless of delivery model, geography, or contractor capability adhere to AirTrunk’s global quality requirements, Technical Requirements (TR), Inspection and Test Plan/Checklist standards (ITP/ITC), and statutory regulations. Drives Lesson Learned, proactive quality risk management, consistent reporting, uplift of supply chain capability, embedding of quality systems, and cross‑regional alignment through the GMS‑Q.

Key Responsibilities

1- Quality Governance & GMS‑Q Implementation

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of the Global minimum standards across all regional projects, ensuring alignment with global standards, ISO 9001 principles and AirTrunk’s Quality Policy.
  • Ensure project teams, GCs, subcontractors and consultants adhere to AirTrunk’s quality governance gates, assurance requirements and documentation workflows.
  • Integrate quality expectations into Pre‑Flight and In‑Flight activities, supporting governance reviews, readiness assessments, and quality‑related approvals.

2- Quality Assurance (QA)

  • Establish QA expectations with GCs and consultants, ensuring clarity on ITP/ITC requirements, hold/witness points, material verification, commissioning protocols and record management.
  • Conduct quarterly quality audits (design reviews, onsite audits, documentation audits, supplier capability assessments) to identify systemic gaps and track corrective actions.
  • Drive regional alignment with enterprise systems including Visibuilt, Procore, Smartsheet, DroneDeploy and digital QA tools.

3- Quality Control (QC) & Site Delivery Support

  • Oversee inspections, testing, verification and surveillance.
  • Ensure the effective implementation of ITPs/ITCs across all trades, identifying non‑conformance trends and systemic issues.
  • Support project teams during construction, commissioning and handover phases with specialist quality advice.
  • Ensure close‑out of CARs, NCRs and Defects within agreed timeframes and to an acceptable standard.

4- Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Maintain and update the Regional Quality Risk Register, ensuring alignment with the Global Quality Risk Register.
  • Identify regional recurring issues and ensure lessons learned are developed and communicated.
  • Proactively identify emerging quality risks and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Undertake quarterly Lessons Learned workshops to capture regional insights, identify recurring issues

5- Documentation, Records & Handover Readiness

  • Ensure that all documentation, test results, QA/QC evidence, and handover packages are complete, traceable, and compliant with GMS‑Q, TRs, and customer requirements.
  • Support the Document Controllers in reinforcing regional compliance with documentation workflows, systems, metadata requirements and archiving standards.
  • Validate the completeness of Quality Records, Manuals, commissioning documentation and customer deliverables.

6- Stakeholder, GC & Vendor Quality Engagement

  • Provide coaching and quality capability uplift to GCs, subcontractors, and consultants.
  • Partner with Regional Delivery, Engineering, Commissioning, Operations, Design, and Development teams to resolve quality issues and strengthen quality culture.
  • Engage with customers as required to demonstrate quality performance and resolve escalations.

7- Regulatory & Standards Compliance

  • Ensure all construction activities meet applicable regional statutory, authority and technical requirements (e.g., NCC Australia, BCA Singapore, Japanese Building Codes, Malaysian UBBL, Hong Kong FSD), while maintaining alignment with AirTrunk’s global standards.
  • Oversee third‑party inspections and certifications to support regulatory approvals.

8- Reporting & Performance Metrics

  • Own regional quality reporting, including weekly dashboards, NCR/defect performance, leading indicators, audit findings, and key risk themes.
  • Contribute to the Global Quality Dashboard and enterprise reporting packs.
  • Track and report against GMS‑Q compliance levels and quality KPIs.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in construction quality, QA/QC management, or technical engineering roles within data centres, critical infrastructure, or large‑scale industrial projects.
  • Strong knowledge of ISO 9001 and quality management systems, with experience embedding quality frameworks in fast‑paced delivery environments.
  • Proven experience conducting audits, managing ITP/ITCs, overseeing commissioning quality, and driving NCR/RCA processes.
  • Familiarity with AirTrunk‑standard systems including SharePoint, Visibuilt, Procore, Smartsheet, and DroneDeploy, or similar QA/QC and construction management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of multidisciplinary construction (architectural, civil, mechanical, electrical, fire, ICT, security, structural, hydraulics).
  • Excellent communication, problem‑solving, and stakeholder management skills across diverse cultural and technical environments.
  • Ability to influence contractors and drive a strong quality culture.
  • Experience managing regional portfolios or multi‑project oversight preferred.
