job.title: Data Center Construction/Project Management
job.description:
Job Description

Data Center Construction/Project Management

Team Overview

The Data Center Infrastructure Construction team at Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) delivers mission-critical facilities at scale and at pace. Our team includes experienced project managers, commissioning experts, and construction specialists who work collaboratively to execute complex data center builds—ensuring OCI data centers meet the highest standards of safety, quality, efficiency, and sustainability.

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Construction Manager – AI Data Center Infrastructure (Construction) to lead and oversee colocation-delivered construction in Johor, Malaysia. This role is accountable for site execution, schedule certainty, quality outcomes, and readiness for commissioning and handover across high-density, AI-ready data center environments. You will manage multi-trade contractors and specialist vendors, while integrating base building delivery with tenant fit-out requirements and network readiness dependencies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Construction Leadership (AI / High-Density): Lead site-based delivery of AI data center infrastructure including base building, MEP, white space readiness, containment, and enabling works.
  • Colocation Provider Oversight: Direct and govern colocation provider execution to ensure work is delivered to OCI standards, with strong accountability for schedule, quality, and coordination.
  • Schedule & Milestone Control: Drive short-interval planning, look-aheads, constraint removal, and recovery actions to protect critical dates and readiness gates.
  • Independent Risk Evaluation: Independently assess delivery plans and actual progress to identify risk early, close gaps in mitigations, and clearly communicate potential business impacts.
  • Tenant Fit-Out & Network Readiness Integration: Coordinate interfaces across design, construction, and commissioning to ensure base building delivery supports tenant fit-out and network deployment readiness (space, power, cooling, cable routes, access windows, cleanliness).
  • Quality Assurance & Closeout: Own QA/QC execution including ITPs, inspections, NCRs, corrective actions, punch lists, progressive turnover, and closeout discipline.
  • Design & Change Coordination: Ensure construction aligns to approved design intent; support disciplined change control, field clarifications, and document governance.
  • Safety & Compliance: Lead safety performance and compliance with local regulations, codes, standards, and OCI requirements; drive audits, incident learnings, and corrective actions.
  • Vendor & Performance Management: Manage contractor and vendor performance, ensure scope compliance, and provide structured provider evaluation inputs for continuous improvement.
  • Reporting & Stakeholder Management: Run site cadence (daily/weekly), provide executive-ready updates, maintain action/issue registers, and escalate blockers quickly.
  • Site Presence: Regular site visits and strong on-the-ground leadership throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Deep data center construction knowledge: Strong expertise across civil, structural, architectural, mechanical, electrical, controls, and plumbing in mission-critical environments.
  • Lifecycle delivery experience: Proven capability through mobilization, construction, commissioning readiness, and turnover/handover.
  • High accountability leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead under pressure, drive delivery discipline, and mentor teams while holding vendors accountable.
  • Risk & problem solving: Strong analytical and practical problem-solving skills in fast-paced, high-dependency construction environments.
  • Commercial awareness: Experience supporting contract administration inputs (variations, claims, EOTs, progress validation) with clear records and evidence.
  • Tools & systems: Strong reporting capability and familiarity with document/project platforms such as Aconex, Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud, SharePoint, or similar.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 10+ years experience in data center and/or colocation construction, gained with a GC, colocation provider, or hyperscaler.
  • Proven track record delivering large-scale construction outcomes across schedule, quality, safety, and stakeholder expectations.

job.title: Data Center Operations Lead ( Kuala Lumpur/ Johor Bahru)
job.description:
1. Process discipline — Must have

Candidate should be strong in data center operational processes, including SOP, MOP, EOP, SOO, change control, incident review, problem management, risk register management, corrective/preventive actions, audit readiness, and compliance tracking.

2. Technical expertise — Must have

Candidate should have strong working knowledge in at least one of the following areas: Mechanical systems, Electrical systems, TCS loop/liquid cooling, Project Management, Server & Network infrastructure, or Commissioning.

You do not need to be the deepest SME in every area, but should have enough technical understanding to challenge, validate, coordinate, and drive closure with Colo, DCFE, Design, NW, Security, Access Management, and other stakeholders.

3. Data center security practices — Must have

Candidate should understand data center security standards and be able to coordinate closely with Access Management, Security Systems, Colo, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance with Oracle’s security policies, access control requirements, audit expectations, and site security procedures.

4. Business continuity and shift coverage — Must have

Candidate should understand 24x7 data center operational expectations, business continuity requirements, backup coverage, cross-training, shift planning, weekend/public holiday support, and escalation management. The role may require support outside normal business hours based on business needs.

5. Colo and stakeholder governance — Must have

Candidate should be able to collaborate effectively with colocation providers and internal stakeholders to maintain 100% data center availability. This includes leading weekly, monthly, and quarterly operations reviews, tracking action items, reviewing performance, and ensuring site-specific processes are established and followed.

6. Incident, change, problem, and risk management — Must have

Candidate should be able to lead and manage incidents, changes, and problems related to data center space, cooling, power, security, and operational readiness. The candidate should proactively identify risks, initiate corrective/preventive actions, and implement global or industry best practices where applicable.

7. Build-to-operations handover — Should have

Candidate should have knowledge of new data center build/deployment support, project-to-operations handover, operational readiness review, site acceptance, as-built documentation, open defect closure, handover checklist, and lessons learned from build-to-operations transition activities.

8. Team leadership and mentoring — Should have

Candidate should be able to oversee, guide, and mentor data center technicians and engineers while supporting team development, operational discipline, and ownership at site level.

9. Reporting, audit, and compliance — Should have

Candidate should be able to provide regular reports and audits on data center performance, security, risks, compliance status, open actions, and operational readiness.

10. Liquid cooling / TCS loop exposure — Good to have

Exposure to liquid cooling, TCS loop, GPU/high-density deployments, or related infrastructure will be an added advantage as Malaysia continues to scale with high-density workloads.

job.title: Program Manager 4
job.description:
Job Description

Principal Program Manager, OCI Transitions and Migrations

Are you a creative problem-solver who thrives on complex challenges? Do you enjoy bringing structure to ambiguity, aligning diverse stakeholders, and driving large-scale programs to successful outcomes? If so, you may be the perfect fit for our team as a Principal Program Manager.

Oracle Cloud Infrastructure is transforming how organizations run their most important applications and workloads. The OCI Transitions and Migrations team helps customers plan and execute complex transitions to Oracle Cloud, coordinating activities across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and other Oracle organizations.

As a Principal Program Manager for OCI Transitions and Migrations, you will lead high-impact migration and transition programs, establish clear execution plans, manage cross-functional dependencies, and ensure successful delivery. You will act as a central point of accountability, communicate program status to senior leadership, and drive resolution of issues that span teams and organizations.

Job Requirements

8+ Years of Related Experience:

Eight or more years of experience in program management, project management, cloud migrations, enterprise technology delivery, consulting, operations, or a related field.

Program Leadership and Execution:

Demonstrated experience leading large, complex programs across multiple teams, workstreams, and organizational boundaries. Proven ability to develop integrated plans, roadmaps, milestones, governance models, and success measures.

Cloud and Migration Experience:

Experience supporting cloud transitions, enterprise migrations, infrastructure programs, application migrations, data migrations, or technology transformation initiatives. Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or other enterprise cloud platforms is preferred.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

Ability to build strong relationships, align stakeholders, resolve competing priorities, and drive shared outcomes across engineering, operations, product, support, sales, customer, and leadership teams.

Risk, Dependency, and Change Management:

Experience identifying risks, managing complex dependencies, developing mitigation and recovery plans, and maintaining progress through changing priorities or ambiguous conditions.

Communication and Influence:

Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills. Demonstrated ability to communicate complex information clearly, influence without direct authority, and represent programs effectively with senior leaders.

Strategic and Analytical Thinking:

Ability to connect program execution to broader customer and business objectives, work with large amounts of qualitative and quantitative information, assess program health, and make sound recommendations.

Educational Background:

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Responsibilities

Lead Program Delivery:

Lead complex OCI transition and migration programs from planning through execution, stabilization, and completion, ensuring delivery aligns with scope, schedule, customer commitments, and business objectives.

Manage Roadmaps, Dependencies, and Resources:

Develop and maintain integrated program roadmaps, milestones, ownership models, dependencies, resource requirements, and success criteria across cross-functional teams.

Drive Stakeholder Alignment and Execution:

Establish alignment and accountability across customer teams, engineering, operations, product management, support, sales, and partner organizations. Remove barriers and drive timely decisions and actions.

Manage Risks and Resolve Issues:

Identify risks, issues, and dependencies early; develop mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans; and independently drive resolution of cross-team and division-level challenges.

Establish Program Governance:

Create and maintain effective governance, including decision-making processes, escalation paths, status reporting, operating cadences, metrics, and executive review mechanisms.

Communicate Program Status and Recommendations:

Provide clear written and verbal updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and customer impact. Present complex issues with relevant data, tradeoffs, options, and recommendations.

Represent the Program With Senior Leadership:

Represent the program and organization independently in discussions through the VP level and support higher-level executive engagements as appropriate.

Maintain Customer and Operational Excellence:

Ensure a consistent Oracle customer experience throughout the transition and migration lifecycle while maintaining high standards for quality, readiness, and execution.

Improve Program Practices:

Identify and implement improvements to planning, governance, reporting, risk management, communications, and execution. Develop reusable templates, dashboards, metrics, and best practices that improve consistency and predictability.

Build Relationships and Mentor Others:

Build trusted partnerships across teams, organizations, cultures, and geographies, while providing guidance and mentorship to other program managers.

Join Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and help customers successfully transition their most important workloads to the cloud. Your leadership, judgment, and ability to drive complex programs will play a critical role in delivering successful migration outcomes and improving how OCI executes transitions at scale.

Responsibilities

Identifies, prioritizes, and successfully executes a broad portfolio of functional initiatives and programs. Plans and directs schedules for multiple programs running simultaneously.  Partners closely with global cross-functional teams to understand and capture requirements for programs. Navigates complex dependencies between cross-functional teams and organizational priorities to optimize the critical path and addresses & mitigates risks.  Effectively influences internal and external teams to prioritize; Drives mitigation plans and ensures ownership for each item and regular follow up through to program closure while ensuring resolution of risk and issues, escalating, as necessary. Provides rigorous management and analysis of overall portfolio budget (including spend and forecasted spend vs. budget, spend per program and historical trends, etc.). Establishes scalable frameworks (process, tools, etc.) for the end-to-end project and manages stakeholders applying project management standards and documentation best practices. Runs standups and sprint planning exercises for programs owned.  Builds and maintains consistent reporting across numerous programs. Determines methods and procedures on new assignments and may coordinate activities of other personnel. Performs other duties as assigned.

job.title: Principal Data Center Site Selection Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Oracle is seeking a Singapore-based Principal Site Selection Manager, reporting to the Director of APAC Site Selection. The successful candidate will lead the origination, structuring, and execution of data center site opportunities across targeted metros and regions. This role will partner closely with Capacity Planning, Engineering, Data Hall Design, Construction, Delivery, Legal, Security, Networking, Compliance, and Operations teams throughout each project and every stage of the transaction lifecycle. The role will also be responsible for preparing and presenting periodic updates for internal governance in collaboration with key stakeholders. The ideal candidate will bring demonstrated strength in deal origination, end-to-end transaction management, stakeholder engagement, commercial negotiations, and disciplined execution.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality metro strategies and originate opportunities that meet business requirements.
  • Partner with capacity planners and network specialists to define capacity needs and site requirements across assigned metros and regions.
  • Lead the end-to-end deal cycle from initial demand signal through general availability, ensuring performance against critical business metrics.
  • Manage multiple concurrent transactions and coordinate internal teams, consultants, vendors, and external stakeholders.
  • Lead cross-functional teams in evaluating, selecting, negotiating, and recommending lease opportunities for approval.
  • Lead commercial negotiations with providers, in partnership with Corporate Procurement, to execute contracts.
  • Partner with Finance to conduct total cost of ownership analyses of lease-versus-build options and recommend the optimal strategy for assigned metros.
  • Maintain systems of record to ensure data accuracy, integrity, and reliable executive reporting.
  • Provide analytical reporting and support day-to-day team activities as needed.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in site selection for industrial-scale projects, including real estate evaluation, acquisition, development, lease agreements, and infrastructure delivery.
  • Knowledge of the data center industry, including market dynamics and key market players, and data center models, including colocation leases and build-to-suit solutions.
  • General understanding of land acquisition, real estate development, utility agreements, sustainable development practices, financial modeling, local regulations, and permitting requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex negotiations and initiatives to successful completion, with strong ownership and a results-oriented approach.

The Construction Manager – Data Center Construction, JAPAC will be based in Bangkok, Thailand and will provide local construction leadership for data center projects across Thailand and the wider JAPAC region. This role will oversee site execution, contractor performance, safety, quality, schedule, cost, and project coordination to ensure successful delivery of data center construction projects.

job.title: Senior Principal Energy Manager APAC
job.description:
Job Description

Oracle is seeking a Singapore-based Senior Principal Energy Program Manager, reporting to the Vice President of APAC site and energy acquisition. As an energy procurement leader, you will have day-to-day responsibility for shaping and driving Oracle’s approach to energy procurement, as well as supporting broader team efforts around energy innovation, hedging strategies, renewable energy and sustainability. Sustainable and scalable energy procurement is growing in focus across our business and this role will provide critical expertise and execution across Oracle Cloud data centers. At Oracle, we are committed to maintaining 100% carbon-free electricity for our offices and public cloud offerings. Additionally, we are setting a new goal to achieve 100% carbon-free electricity for Oracle Custom AI Data Centers by 2035, including our large, custom AI clusters built for a single customer.

Responsibilities

  • Source and negotiate strategic power agreements with utility providers and independent power providers, ensuring the best possible outcome for Oracle.
  • Responsible for day-to-day management of Oracle Cloud’s data center energy strategy across specific markets in APAC region, with priority attention to Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Australia and India.
  • Create and manage requirements around energy sourcing including leveraging expertise of power markets regulation, financial modeling and analysis, managing RFPs, contract negotiations, development and execution of forward purchasing strategies, collection and preparation of high-quality data.
  • Work closely with retail energy providers, energy suppliers, regulated utilities, and internal stakeholders to monitor real-time market conditions that will information short-term and long-term transaction decisions.
  • Engage with energy and sustainability consultant(s) to evolve strategy and reporting.
  • Monitor energy markets and specific utilities, IPPs, and electric grids for opportunities and risks and recommend strategies for Oracle to stay ahead of these challenges.
  • Cross-functionally develop and manage relationships across Oracle including with capacity planning, data center infrastructure build, site selection, supply chain management, data center engineering, data center operations, and corporate sustainability and procurement teams.
  • Coordinate with onsite generation and other solution providers and teams to ensure seamless power delivery across a range of technologies – utility grids, behind the meter solutions, gas plants, renewables etc.
  • Partner with finance on developing annual energy budgets based on knowledge of current and future footprint and changing energy prices.
  • Support team delivering power to new DC sites, including:
  • Developing comprehensive understanding of electricity supply equipment required to energize a given site
  • Developing comprehensive understanding of available utility tariffs
  • Contract negotiations for energy supply
  • Financial modelling
  • Managing RFPs
  • Supplier onboarding into Oracle’s systems
  • Monitor markets conditions to inform team and site negotiations
  • Support consultant/contractor RFPs for various services
  • Utilities and rates and tariff structure

Qualifications

  • Desire to work in the fast-paced environment of AI/GPU computing and hyperscale data center design, construction, and operations.
  • 10-15 years professional experience; 6-10 years managing corporate (C&I) power procurement or utility/IPP power origination, within a large matrix environment.
  • Understanding of regulated and deregulated energy markets, power hedging, energy supply agreements and power purchase agreements.
  • Experience with mark-to-market accounting and managing market exposure.
  • Familiarity with sustainability frameworks and making carbon reduction and renewable energy claims: Global Reporting Initiative (GRI), Science-based Targets, CDP, Greenhouse Gas Protocol, etc.
  • Experience developing annual energy budgets and working with finance teams to project the cost of power.
  • Advanced Excel expertise building financial models and analyzing energy rates, riders, fees etc.
  • Articulate, executive presence, comfort with negotiations and supplier engagement.
  • Willingness to support global time zones.
  • Willingness to travel as required including internationally.

Additional Preferred Qualifications

  • 1-3+ years' experience with utility interconnection processes and familiarity with transmission planning
  • As Oracle also has a renewable energy goal, 1-3+ years executing renewable energy strategies including familiarity with green tariffs, wheeling arrangements, behind the meter deals, and VPPAs.
  • Data center or mission critical expertise developing and executing energy strategies cross-functionally.
  • Experience developing comprehensive understanding of gas transportation and gas molecule supply options, pros/cons, costs, risks
  • Experience developing a comprehensive understanding of available onsite technologies and integration options/ability with DC site requirements

Systems Software Development:

job.title: Hardware Developer 4
job.description:
Job Description

The role is expected to protect manufacturing delivery, outgoing quality, and field reliability by using yield data, component failure trends, supplier quality signals, test coverage, factory inspection findings, RCCA discipline, and risk assessment to support OK-to-Ramp and OK-to-Ship decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor factory quality performance across assigned products and sites, including IQC, OQC, L10/L11 yield, FPY, APY, retest rate, failure pareto, and test stability.

Use factory and component quality signals to identify open quality risks, containment gaps, unresolved issues, supplier exposure, and potential customer escape risks before products ramp or ship.

Drive factory issue containment, failure data review, RCCA follow-up, and corrective action validation with manufacturing partners, suppliers, and Oracle engineering teams.

Track component quality performance across assigned commodities, including supplier DPPM, RPM, AFR/RMA trends, failure pareto, PCN impact, material risk, and recurring factory or field failure modes.

Drive supplier and sub-tier RCCA for component failures found during factory integration, outgoing inspection, field returns, repair, or reliability testing.

Partner with component engineering, silicon engineering, supplier quality, sourcing, and repair teams to connect field failures back to factory outgoing quality and supplier corrective actions.

Ensure process escapes, rework risks, test instability, and recurring failure modes are documented, assigned to clear owners, and tracked to closure.

Review factory test coverage and confirm that known failure modes are detectable before shipment.

Validate that outgoing quality controls are effective in catching workmanship, configuration, labeling, packaging, cosmetic, documentation, and functional escapes.

Review supplier qualification data, reliability information, PCNs, material changes, alternate-source transitions, and factory incoming quality signals for risk to OCI hardware programs.

Partner with Manufacturing and Test teams to reduce yield gaps, debug churn, retest-driven instability, and recurring line failures.

Support NCAT, SSP, program readiness reviews, and executive quality updates with clear data, concise risk summaries, and recommended next actions.

Work frequently with Taiwan factory, process, test, and quality teams to confirm process controls, inspection criteria, rework instructions, escalation paths, and quality gates are in place.

Build and maintain factory quality risk registers for key programs, including containment status, RCCA owner, closure date, and residual risk.

Support OK-to-Ramp and OK-to-Ship decisions by making remaining quality risk clear, current, and actionable

Responsibilities

Required Skills and Experience

Experience in manufacturing quality, process quality, supplier quality, component quality, product quality, hardware quality, or reliability engineering.

Strong working knowledge of IQC, OQC, factory test flow, yield metrics, pareto analysis, retest rate, containment, and corrective action.

Working knowledge of component quality metrics such as DPPM, RPM, AFR, RMA, MTBF, supplier failure pareto, and corrective action effectiveness.

Experience using structured RCCA methods such as 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, CAPA, or other disciplined problem-solving approaches.

Ability to analyze failure data, separate known issues from emerging risks, and drive fact-based closure with manufacturing partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

Experience working with external manufacturers, suppliers, manufacturing engineering, test engineering, field teams, or repair teams.

Experience with server, rack-level, GPU, networking, storage, power, thermal, or other data center infrastructure products, especially cutting-edge AI infrastructure platforms.

Experience with component commodities such as GPUs, CPUs, memory, storage, networking, optics, cables, connectors, power supplies, PDUs, PCBs, fans, thermal components, or rack integration hardware.

Experience supporting NPI, production ramp, OK-to-Ramp, OK-to-Ship, stop-ship, containment, or customer-impacting quality reviews.

Familiarity with GRR, EST, RQT, test coverage validation, FMEA, control plans, SPC, DOE, or reliability qualification.

Experience with high-volume manufacturing partners, ODMs, CMs, EMs, repair operations, supplier factory audits, supplier qualification, PCN review, or component supplier management.

Experience working in Taiwan-based electronics manufacturing, system integration, rack integration, or server manufacturing environments.

Six Sigma, CQE, CRE, Lean, or equivalent quality and reliability training.

job.title: Oracle PaaS Solution Architect
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership:

-Serves as a trusted advisor to customers and a technical expert on technologies across the marketplace (e.g., technical speaking engagements, publications) to shape guidance provided to customers.

  • Recognized as a technical expert with highly specialized knowledge across Oracle and non-Oracle technologies, products, services, and market trends, serving as a go-to expert for complex or high-impact scenarios.
  • Defines or adjusts strategy for highly complex pre-sales activities, contributing to long-term account growth and solution fit.
  • Leads organization-wide and customer fleet-wide optimizations or efficiency efforts (e.g., automation, streamlined processes, elimination of redundant effort), coordinating with the TAM, ASE engineers and others on the Oracle customer team.
  • Works with external partners to ensure appropriate design and implementation of solutions and promote best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.

Service Delivery:

-Acts as internal and/or external expert point of contact and escalation point for critical technical and process issues encountered in the customer's supported environment.

  • Provides proactive and reactive remote or onsite technical assistance in close cooperation with Support and Product Development teams, for problem analysis and investigation and providing and verifying workarounds and acting as a field point of contact for various LOBs.
  • Assists customers with highly complex software updates, upgrades, change management, and incident remediation, identifying key risks and mitigation strategies that may impact project success.
  • Analyzes new and highly complex issues encountered by customers by performing thorough technical root cause investigations.
  • Reviews themes across lessons learned post-project and leads changes to improve technology implementation.

Global Customer Engagement & Education:

-Acts as expert technical lead for customers and partners with customer leadership to, ensuring solutions address business needs and drive long-term business transformation.

  • Educates and mentors junior engineers to educate customers on product features, upgrades, and patches, and drives and shapes adoption of best practices for technology deployment and workloads, and their stability, maintainability, upgradeability, and performance.
  • Provides executive presence for junior team members during customer meetings where technical expertise is required for critical or escalated issues or where expert technical direction is needed for key decisions.
  • Uses holistic view of solutions and contextual understanding of customer solutions to influence customer direction.

Technical Design & Documentation:

-Leads the scoping, creation, and maintenance of customer deliverables, SOPs, and documentation to help customers implement solutions.

  • Leads highly complex problem analysis and investigation, providing documented technical solutions ready for customers to implement, test and maintain.
  • Oversees how solution designs are developed across programs, ensuring the use of appropriate methodologies and adherence to Oracle and enterprise architectural standards.
  • Scopes potential customer requests and clarify value-add for a service during pre-sales.
  • Defines best practices and provides mentorship to engineers across multiple teams.
  • Ensures technical designs are forward-looking, scalable, and aligned with broader strategic direction.
  • Translates market trends into design strategies that prepare the business for future growth.

Influence & Collaboration:

-Drives cross-functional alignment of internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with technology strategy and business goals, facilitating collaboration across multiple programs and senior stakeholders.

  • Identifies opportunities for expanding partnerships and with key contacts across functions and creates opportunities to facilitate networking for lower levels.
  • Works with customer senior leadership to influences priorities based on technical vision to support customer's technical roadmap.

Innovation & Business Development:

-Leverages customer insights and partners with product management to ensure alignment with technical ecosystem when driving new service offerings and engagement methods.

  • Leverages customer insights to shape new service offerings and engagement methods.
  • Leads technical scoping in strategic deals, partnering with sales teams to define the solution approach and ensure business needs are translated into viable technical deliverables.
  • Shapes growth opportunities by aligning Oracle solutions with customer roadmaps and business drivers.
  • Delivers presentations and acts as a technical expert and executive presence during presentations for junior team members and communicates details on integrated solutions that drive strategy.
  • Uses deep technical, functional, and service delivery expertise across technologies to strategically influence customer perception of value.

Additional Responsibilities (as needed)

Technical Solution Design:

-Drives technical strategy and architecture across the organization, mentoring technical leaders and ensuring alignment with business goals using broad knowledge across multiple technologies/ services.

  • Oversees architectural and solution design reviews across programs, ensuring technical excellence and mentoring senior engineers across technologies and services in scalable design principles.
  • Guides teams in applying consistent design practices aligned to current and emerging business needs using expertise across multiple technologies/services.
  • Shapes and maintains architectural principles, introducing innovative approaches and evolving design practices to remain competitive in a rapidly changing market.
  • Drives high-level design (HLD) development by introducing new methods across technologies/services, promoting creativity, and ensuring solutions reflect a deep understanding of organizational technical operations.
  • Creates and establishes internal policies, processes, and standards for security, scalability, and other product/service fundamentals related to solution delivery across a family of technologies or services at the organization or cross-organization level.

Delivery Program Management:

-Owns the planning, execution, and service value creation of delivery engineering projects across multiple customer accounts within a technical domain.

  • Leverages deep project management knowledge to scope delivery engineering projects, design project schedules, and document resource requirements.
  • Manages technical delivery along with Technical Leader, coordinating resources and managing projects to drive results and maximize value to customers.
  • Proactively partners with customers and other account team members (e.g., TAM, Technical Leader) to understand customers' technical projects, goals, and KPIs, and provide required technical guidance to delivery engineering team.
  • Leverages domain expertise to lead escalation calls and assist in managing all aspects of escalations, including situation management and executive communication.
  • Oversees the quality and completeness of deliverables across customers.
  • Acts as a domain technical expert to represent delivery engineering in sales opportunities with customers.

Core Responsibilities

Collaboration & Partnership:

-Influences cross-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives. Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long-term organizational success. Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Continuous Improvement:

-Drives implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the department. Seeks and integrates diverse feedback on approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.

Planning & Execution:

-Manages and provides direction on timelines and budgets for critical high-impact projects, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements. Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

Problem Solving:

-Leads specialized, advanced problem-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for highly complex issues. Guides others to leverage innovative data-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and implement solutions that prevent future issues.

Continuous Learning:

-Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise within a specialty area to serve as a thought leader within the organization. Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices. Champions continuous learning, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

job.title: Data Center Technician
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Install, configure, test, deploy, maintain, upgrade, and decommission data centre equipment and infrastructure.
  • Perform safe and efficient rack and stack activities, server deployments, hardware installations, equipment replacements, upgrades, and decommissioning.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve server, hardware, cabling, network, power, and supporting infrastructure issues, escalating appropriately when additional expertise or support is required.
  • Triage, prioritise, and respond to incoming incidents, service requests, and operational issues in a timely manner.
  • Perform preventative and corrective maintenance, including diagnosing hardware failures, replacing failed components, and applying firmware updates.
  • Monitor and support the reliability and performance of production server hardware and supporting data centre infrastructure.
  • Maintain accurate asset, hardware, and spare-parts inventory using internal systems and support tools.
  • Follow established SOPs, change-management processes, operational procedures, security requirements, and safety standards.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement, operational efficiency, risk reduction, and improved service quality.
  • Plan and organise work effectively, balancing competing priorities and high work demands while maintaining attention to detail and delivery quality.
  • Monitor progress against assigned work, proactively communicate priorities, dependencies, blockers, and risks, and take appropriate action when delivery may be impacted.
  • Demonstrate initiative, accountability, and resourcefulness, independently using available documentation, tools, systems, and technical resources to investigate and resolve problems.
  • Recognise personal capacity and technical limitations and escalate workload, risk, or complexity appropriately before service quality, safety, wellbeing, or delivery is adversely affected.
  • Build collaborative working relationships with engineering teams, vendors, customers, internal stakeholders, and other technical and non-technical teams.
  • Communicate technical information clearly and professionally, adapting communication to the audience and proactively keeping relevant stakeholders informed.
  • Work effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating and influencing across functions, regions, teams, and reporting lines without relying on direct authority.
  • Balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational requirements when prioritising work and making decisions.
  • Maintain professionalism, resilience, and sound judgement when working under pressure or responding to changing operational priorities.
  • Contribute to a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace through constructive communication and behaviour consistent with organisational values and policies.
  • Remain open to feedback, resolve disagreements constructively, and demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and development.
  • Adopt new technologies, processes, tools, and ways of working that improve team and operational performance.
  • Deliver timely, accurate, customer-focused, and high-quality technical support within a mission-critical data centre environment.
  • Participate in a rotating 24x7 shift roster, including on-call responsibilities.

Technical Knowledge and Experience

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Previous hands-on experience working in a Data Centre or comparable mission-critical infrastructure environment.
  • Practical experience across the hardware lifecycle, including rack and stack, deployment, configuration, testing, maintenance, upgrades, break/fix activities, component replacement, and decommissioning.
  • Strong technical troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to systematically identify root causes and determine appropriate corrective actions.
  • Experience following documented operational procedures while exercising sound judgement when situations require investigation or escalation.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when performing physical infrastructure changes, maintaining records, handling assets, and working on production systems.
  • Background in Linux.
  • Knowledge of Data Centre Ecosystem (cooling, electrical, networking, and structured cabling).

Professional Capabilities

Communication and Stakeholder Management

Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to build collaborative relationships across technical and non-technical teams. Able to influence stakeholders, communicate priorities, risks, dependencies, and technical issues proactively, and balance customer, commercial, operational, and organisational needs.

Respectful and Inclusive Behaviour

A demonstrated commitment to fostering a psychologically safe, respectful, ethical, and inclusive workplace. Maintains professional behaviour, communicates constructively, makes responsible decisions, and works consistently with organisational values, policies, and expected standards of conduct.

Resilience, Adaptability and Customer Focus

Able to operate effectively in a dynamic, mission-critical environment, navigate ambiguity, embrace change, and remain resilient under pressure. Demonstrates emotional intelligence and maintains a strong customer focus while delivering required technical and business outcomes.

Planning and Delivery

Strong planning, organisation, prioritisation, and time-management skills. Able to manage competing priorities and high work demands, monitor progress, adjust plans as circumstances change, and consistently deliver safe, accurate, and high-quality outcomes.

Initiative and Accountability

Demonstrates a proactive, self-service mindset with strong initiative, ownership, accountability, and resourcefulness. Independently investigates and solves problems using available tools, documentation, systems, and resources while understanding when escalation or additional support is appropriate.

Recognises personal capacity, workload constraints, and technical complexity and proactively seeks support before quality, safety, wellbeing, customer outcomes, or delivery are adversely affected.

Collaboration in a Matrix Environment

Experience working effectively within a global matrix organisation, collaborating across multiple functions, regions, teams, and reporting structures. Able to build alignment and influence outcomes through credibility, communication, and collaboration rather than direct authority.

Continuous Learning and Improvement

Demonstrates openness to feedback, coaching, continuous learning, and constructive conflict resolution. Willingly adopts new processes, tools, technologies, and ways of working and actively contributes ideas that improve operational effectiveness and support a high-performing team culture.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to safely lift, carry, position, and move IT equipment weighing 15 kg or more.
  • Comfortable working within data centre environments, including standing for extended periods, bending, reaching, and working in confined or restricted spaces.
  • Able to safely and efficiently perform rack and stack, hardware installation, cabling, component replacement, and equipment decommissioning activities.
  • Commitment to following relevant workplace health, safety, and operational procedures.
  • Valid driver’s license and access to a car.

Security Requirements

Applicants must be Australian citizens and either:

  • Hold a current NV1 Security Clearance, or
  • Be eligible and willing to obtain NV1 clearance through the Australian Government security vetting process.

Why ORACLE?

Join a global technology leader operating some of the world's most advanced cloud infrastructure. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies, solve challenging infrastructure problems, collaborate with talented professionals across a global organisation, and contribute directly to the reliability, availability, and performance of critical cloud services used by customers around the world.

You'll join an environment that values technical excellence, customer focus, accountability, collaboration, inclusion, continuous learning, safety, and continuous improvement.

If you're looking for your next challenge and want to develop your career in large-scale, mission-critical data centre and cloud infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today and become part of the team powering ORACLE Cloud Infrastructure.

job.title: Front End Planning Manager, Construction - JAPAC
job.description:
Job Description

The FEP Manager is responsible for developing robust project plans from early concept through construction readiness. The role partners with design, engineering, procurement, commercial, operations, and construction teams to establish project scope, budget, schedule, delivery strategy, risk profile, and governance requirements.

The successful candidate will bring a minimum of 10 years’ construction experience, including at least 5 years in pre-construction or front-end planning. They will have strong knowledge of construction delivery, estimating, scheduling, design coordination, procurement, and risk management. Travel within Australia and the APAC region is required up to 20% of the time.

Responsibilities

  • Lead front-end planning and pre-construction activities for projects across APAC.
  • Define and validate project scope, delivery strategy, budget, schedule, milestones, and resourcing requirements.
  • Lead feasibility studies, site due diligence, constructability reviews, and project-readiness assessments.
  • Identify risks, constraints, dependencies, and opportunities early, and develop appropriate mitigation plans.
  • Partner with design, engineering, procurement, commercial, operations, and construction stakeholders to align project plans and requirements.
  • Coordinate contractor and consultant engagement, including tender strategy, bid evaluation, scope clarification, and pre-construction activities.
  • Establish and maintain project governance, stage-gate deliverables, risk registers, decision logs, and executive reporting.

job.title: Engineering Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
job.description:
About the job

Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Google’s software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team combines software engineering and systems administration to build and operate some of the world's most complex distributed systems. As an SRE Manager, you will lead a team of engineers tasked with ensuring our services are fast, reliable, and available. You will balance the development of new features with the long-term health and stability of the production environment.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and grow a team of SREs, providing technical guidance, career development, and performance management.
  • Partner with Software Development teams to design, build, and maintain scalable and reliable services.
  • Drive the evolution of monitoring, alerting, and incident response frameworks to ensure rapid detection and resolution of production issues.
  • Implement software solutions and automation to eliminate manual tasks and improve the efficiency of systems operations. Manage Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets to balance innovation with system stability.
  • Participate in on-call rotations as a manager-escalation point and lead incident command during critical outages. Advocate a culture of engineering excellence, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement within the Sydney office.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Senior Manager Manufacturing Operations
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

Overseeing programs and practices for hiring, performance management and developing/training the personnel that perform and

support the plant operating functions to deliver the required operational performance.

  • Directing all aspects of manufacturing operations for the plant or facility to produce cost-effective, timely and high-quality products in a safe, secure and sanitary working environment.
  • Managing development, implementation and continual improvement of the operating methods, equipment, systems and other operating infrastructure used to realize operating goals and objectives.
  • Directing development of production work schedules to meet internal goals and customer expectations; monitoring process and personnel performance of scheduled work activities to remove operating impediments and achieve established operating goals.

What You Will Do

  • Safety is a core value; this role will lead the way in ensuring our Safety Commitments are met
  • Manage the production processes in line with Caterpillar production principles, establish and maintain appropriate governance to ensure quality and order delivery commitments are met, whilst leading the teams through changes with effective change management strategies.
  • Participation in the facility demand and orders process, capacity planning, execution of manufacturing run rates to required quality and velocity
  • Provide leadership to the Operations teams, with a focus on talent development and growth, taking a proactive and organized approach
  • Foster and grow existing positive relationships with the on-site trade unions, including leading collective bargaining processes and pay deal

Key Skills Required

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Collaborating: Knowledge of collaborative techniques; ability to work with a variety of individuals and groups in a

constructive and collaborative manner.

Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support

an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.

Performance Management: Knowledge of successful performance management techniques; ability to apply organization's

performance management system, practices, and tools to developing and improving individual, team, and organizational

performance.

Lean Manufacturing: Knowledge of the philosophy, principles and implementation approaches of lean manufacturing;

ability to integrate and implement lean manufacturing philosophy into existing production and management processes.

Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and

organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic time and resources and highly methodical way.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high

levels of precision.

September 10, 2026 - September 24, 2026

  • Strategic Tracking & Action Follow-Up: Attend leadership meetings with or on behalf of the HOD, capture actionable insights, and hold cross-functional team members accountable to commitment timelines and key performance indicators (KPIs).

2. Strategic Initiatives & Project Support

  • Assist the HOD in executing strategic workplace initiatives, workflow automation projects (e.g., onboarding digitization), and continuous improvement programs (WITS).
  • Act as a lead change agent during enterprise system migrations, tool rollouts, and policy changes across supported teams.

3. Employee Lifecycle & Operations

  • Manage end-to-end onboarding/offboarding operational workflows, including hardware provisioning, access privileges, and system deactivations.
  • Audit and continuously optimize operational workflows to eliminate administrative bottlenecks and elevate the overall employee experience.

4. Asset Management & Procurement

  • Maintain and audit the department’s hardware and software inventory list to ensure complete data accuracy and compliance.
  • Oversee asset lifecycle management, end-of-life disposal, Net Book Value (NBV) reviews, and coordination with IS/IT security teams.
  • Execute procurement requests (laptops, supplies, software licenses) via SAP Ariba in strict compliance with corporate governance and budget limits.

5. Department Events & Regional Logistics

  • Plan and execute end-to-end logistics for town halls, leadership off-sites, team-building sessions, and corporate celebrations.
  • Partner with cross-border stakeholders (e.g., Malaysia counterparts and Marketing teams) to execute major regional events, such as the annual Delivery Kick-off (DKO).
  • Oversee general department logistics, including travel itineraries, technical certification tracking, and general administrative requests.

Qualifications

Job Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Advanced Diploma in Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Experience: 3–5 years of progressive experience in an Executive Assistant or Senior Business Support role, directly supporting senior leaders or executive heads.
  • Systems & Tools: Proficiency with procurement suites (e.g., SAP Ariba), calendar management tools, and asset management platforms.
  • Executive Presence & Discretion: Exceptional professionalism, emotional intelligence, and absolute discretion when handling highly confidential strategic matters.
  • Advanced Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills; adept at writing formal memos, editing executive decks, and communicating across regional teams.
  • Organization & Time Management: Outstanding organizational skills with a proven track record of managing competing priorities for senior leadership under tight deadlines.
  • Process & Technical Aptitude: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel, Teams); familiar with process optimization methodologies or automation tools.

job.title: Sales Account Manager (Senior Connectivity Sales Specialist)
job.description:
Job Description

Job purpose

We are looking for a motivated Enterprise Connectivity Sales Specialist to drive revenue growth by selling both core infrastructure and advanced networking and connectivity solutions to C-level executives and IT leaders. You will own the full client sales lifecycle—from lead discovery and solution scoping to closing complex, multi-year service contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Account Acquisition & Expansion: Target and close mid-market and enterprise prospects through strategic prospecting, executive networking, and consultative selling.
  • Account Ownership and Supported : Own targeted key Enterprise Connectivity accounts and support rest of EBG base
  • Responsible for meeting and exceeding Orderbook, Revenue and Gross Margin targets
  • Solution Architecture & Scoping: Partner with Solutions Engineers to design tailored connectivity solutions addressing client needs around bandwidth, latency, redundancy, and security.
  • Pipeline & Deal Management: Build and manage a strong sales pipeline using CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), providing accurate revenue forecasting.
  • Contract & Negotiation: Lead contract negotiations, service level agreement (SLA) terms, and pricing strategies for high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Market & Product Expertise: Maintain deep subject matter expertise in core enterprise connectivity solutions:
  • Network & Transit: Layer 1-3 services including but not limited to Dedicated Internet, Dark Fiber, Ethernet/MPLS
  • Cloud & Edge: Direct Cloud Connect (AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute), SD-WAN, SASE
  • Platform and Managed Services: Managed CPE solution eg Managed Router, Managed Firewall

Qualifications

  • Diploma in IT/Engineering/ICT related field with at least 5 years of B2B sales experience within telecommunications, network service providers, or cloud connectivity vendors.
  • Advantageous to possess experience managing accounts in Healthcare, Education (Institutes of Higher Learning) and Hospitality
  • Proven understanding of WAN architectures, SD-WAN, multi-cloud interconnectivity, and enterprise networking hardware for both domestic and international connectivity.
  • Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue and order book quotas with complex, multi-stakeholder deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to pitch and build trust with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, and VP-level decision-makers.

Plus a range of personal and professional benefits, including discounts with select private health insurance, PC software/hardware and a range of vehicles.

If you require any reasonable adjustments to accommodate a health condition or disability, please let us know. Your journey with us matters._

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Diagnostics Application - Translates customer complaints to develop troubleshooting plan; troubleshoots issue following guided work flows, procedures, specialized equipment such as mechanical and electronic service tools, and diagnoses computer software to isolate failed components to enable a successful repair; validates repair by duplicating complaint to ensure it has been resolved; documents results of troubleshooting in business systems to communicate what has been done for payment and historical tracking.

Electrical Knowledge - Demonstrates knowledge of Cummins and industry standards on working with low and/or high voltage by complying with all safe work procedures including Personal Protective Equipment to create a safe work environment; applies basic electrical theories and electronics components knowledge using appropriate tools and procedures to diagnose and repair products safely and efficiently.

Electronic Service Tool Application - Identifies the suite of available hardware and software tools required for a service event; utilizes the appropriate electronic tool set to maintain the product or diagnose and troubleshoot an issue; interprets electronic tool results or recommendations to determine next steps for service resolution.

Technical Escalation - Obtains product technical issue information and utilizes available resources including data management tools; elevates issues to a higher level of expertise, balancing timeliness of customer response with investigation efforts; captures all troubleshooting steps in the appropriate database in order to ensure seamless transitions and accurate response to ticket resolution in a timely manner.

job.title: Regional Capability Trainer - Western
job.description:
Completes troubleshooting, repairs and rebuilds on engine products in a service workshop independently while coaching and developing less experienced technicians

Key Responsibilities

1. Hands-On Workshop Coaching

  • Teach apprentices how to use hand tools, power tools, torque tools, and precision measurement gear correctly.
  • Show them how to dismantle, inspect, and reassemble components safely and cleanly.
  • Demonstrate how engines, fuel systems, air systems, and aftertreatment systems work—using real examples in the shop.
  • Walk apprentices through “what goes wrong” and how to identify faults, damage, wear, and failure modes.
  • Build foundational troubleshooting skills using real units, real jobs, and real failures.

2. Apprentice Readiness & Confidence Building

  • Help first-years get comfortable in the workshop—how to move safely, set up their workspace, and think like a technician.
  • Teach shop etiquette: teamwork, communication, keeping a tidy bay, and respecting the craft.
  • Support apprentices who may lack confidence or exposure by giving them structured, achievable tasks.

3. Capability Tracking & Individualised Support

  • Use the standardised capability tracker to guide development, set expectations, and maintain consistency across regions.
  • Adapt coaching approaches to each apprentice—ensuring flexibility to address gaps, strengths, and real-time needs.
  • Provide apprentices with targeted support in areas flagged through the tracker or identified in the workshop.

4. Branch Support & Integration

  • Work closely with Service Managers, Supervisors, and Technicians to ensure apprentices are developing the right skills.
  • Identify capability gaps at each branch and provide targeted hands-on coaching sessions.
  • Support the embedding of standard work practices and safe working methods in day-to-day workshop tasks.
  • Travel to nearby or regional sites when required —usually infrequent and planned (<10%), but may increase as program needs evolve.

  • Run short, practical mini-sessions in the workshop (e.g., correct measuring techniques, wear pattern identification, torque procedures).
  • Set up hands-on problem‑solving activities using failed components or stripped-down engines.
  • Guide apprentices through real diagnostic processes using actual customer units when appropriate.

job.title: Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

job.description:
仕事の概要:

営業サイクル全体を通じて、カミンズの製品やサービスの営業サポートを提供する。対応の調整や広範な調査が必要なより複雑な顧客アカウントをサポートする場合もある。追加営業の機会を独自に開拓し、獲得する場合もある。

主要な責務:

直販（該当する場合）

外部からの予定外の見込みの電話に対応し、これらの機会を営業に振り分ける。

電話やその他の手法による新規見込み客の開拓、外部ソースから生れる見込み客への売り込み電話を行い、会社の製品/サービスの販売機会を開拓する。

リピートビジネス、クロスセリング、アップセリングについて、既存顧客へのフォローアップの電話やEメールを通じて、補足的な営業を推進する。

会社のガイドラインに沿って交渉を行う。

売上、マージン目標を達成する。カミンズの営業プロセスの使用および新規見込み客から営業までの営業サイクルの実行を通じて、顧客満足度を確保する。

営業サポート

必要に応じて、適格な新規見込み客から営業までを行う担当者を立て、担当させる。

必要に応じて、見積／RFP管理その他の営業サイクル業務に関して、営業チームを支援する。

ロイヤルティや将来の売上を生み出す、ポジティブな顧客関係を構築、維持する。

会社のガイドラインに沿って交渉をサポートする。売掛金業務を支援する。

より複雑な上申された社内、営業顧客からの問い合わせに回答し、会社のガイドラインに従って、問い合わせに正確かつ迅速に対応できるようにする。顧客からの問い合わせを分析し、再発するユーザーの問題を見極め、ソリューションを推奨する。より複雑なアカウントや、広範な調査を必要とする顧客の質問に対して、付加的なサポートを与える場合もある。

新規顧客データを入力し、会社のデータベースにある既存の取引先への変更を更新する。

カミンズのガイドラインに従って、新規顧客アカウントの設定をサポートする。カミンズをサプライヤーとして設定するための新規アカウントをサポートする。

カミンズのツール／プロセス（カミンズの営業サイクル、顧客関係管理システムなど）を活用して、正確な売上入力、報告、予測を維持する。

ビジネスを成長させ、顧客価値とロイヤルティを高めることを目的としたプロセス、手順、イニシアティブを活用する機会を模索する。社内営業による、関連する会社のプロセス、システム、手順の適切な活用を担保する。結果を評価し、改善提案を行う。

顧客満足度、営業目標、カミンズの文化目標をサポートするため、営業機能その他の部門全体にわたる良好なコミュニケーションや調整を保証する。

営業スタッフからの情報を調整し、顧客に対する積極的なコミュニケーションを展開する。

社内営業の活動やリソースの計画、優先順位付け、スケジューリングを行い、サービスの継続性を担保する。社内営業スタッフをメンタリング、能力開発し、営業サポート目標を確実に達成する。

販売予測を維持し、予測に対する進捗状況と精度を追跡する。

必要に応じて、社内のステークホルダー、顧客と協力して、顧客の期待に沿って在庫、サービス、および配送機能をバランスさせる。

スキル:

効果的なコミュニケーション - 多種多様なコミュニケーションを展開して、さまざまな相手のニーズを明確に理解する。

顧客志向 - 顧客と強固な関係を構築し、顧客の立場に立った解決策を提供する。

説得力の発揮 - 説得力のある議論を展開して、他の人の支持と参画を得る。

的確な計画立案 - 組織目標と整合した方策を推進するために、計画を立案し、業務に優先順位をつける。

明確な価値の提示 - 関連する要望に基づいて、内外の顧客ニーズを明らかにする。競合他社と差別化するため、特定の顧客ニーズを満たし、強みと弱みを明確にした製品、ソリューション、サービスを説明し、実践する。

販路（チャネル）認識 - 組織目標を改善するため、業界の構造、力学、市場への行程を説明し、状況に当てはめる。

価格戦略 - ビジネス目標を達成するため、部門を超えて主要なステークホルダーとのコンセンサスを調整、形成することにより、価格を決定する。

アカウントプランニング - 目的を明確にし、目的が必要となる場面の状況について検討し、その達成までの進み具合を追跡できるようにすることで、経営戦略またはアカウント戦略のいずれか、あるいはその両方を実行する。

ターゲットオーディエンスへの適応 - ターゲットオーディエンス（営業担当者、顧客、トレーニングベンダーなど）が情報を理解、保持、および使用できるようなやり方で、複雑なトピック（重要な技術データ、対象事項の専門知識など）を説明する。

アカウント戦略の開発 - ビジネス戦略に沿った達成可能な目標を定義するため、関係性、財務、製品競争力、障壁、品質、サービスに関する現状評価を判断し、顧客要件とビジネス能力のバランスをとることによって、望ましい将来像を定義する。

顧客視点を組み入れる - 当社製品および販売活動に対する顧客の視点を理解し、それらを組み入れて販売コンテンツを開発し、顧客ニーズへの対応力および収益改善能力を向上させる。

セールス予測 - 内外の情報源から顧客データを収集し、評価する。過去のデータと比較して、有用なインプットを判断し、今後の消費動向について予測を作成する。

販売パイプラインマネジメント - 現在のパイプラインに基づいて、取引先や地域レベルで販売戦略や販売計画の実行を成功させるため、積極的に計画を策定する。パイプラインの健全性（規模、内容、進捗）を評価する。それに応じて、販売戦略、計画、影響力が大きな活動を調整する。必要であれば、販売目標を達成するために販売人を指導する。

意味を成す - 一連の診断およびプロービングの質問と調査を通じて、顧客のニーズ、行動、購買過程を深く理解し、および/または支援する。社内外のリソースから得られる複雑な情報を統合し、社内外の顧客のためにカスタマイズしたソリューションを提供する。

多様性の尊重 - 異なる視野や文化が組織にもたらす価値を理解する。

学歴、免許、資格:

営業/マーケティング分野における大学/カレッジの学位、または教育と経験を組み合わせた十分な条件が必須。

この役職では、輸出管理または制裁規則を遵守するためにライセンスが必要になる場合があります。

職歴:

先行経験が必須。見積りアナリストその他の営業支援経験があれば望ましい。ある程度の出張が求められる。顧客関係管理ソフトウェアの経験があれば望ましい。他のソフトウェアベースの営業やビジネスツールでの経験があれば望ましい。

job.title: 电子系统工程师 - 软件
job.description:
工作总结:

该初级/职涯早期专业性应用技术职位创造作为康明斯产品不可或缺的部分出售的软件。担任这些职位的人员参与确定和理解利益相关方要求和制定规范，以及软件设计、实施、测试和/或发布的职责，而该软件可控制康明斯产品在各种客户应用情形下的运行。

主要责任:

调查产品软件问题、了解因果机制、提出适当措施、制定问题解决方案并记录结果。

运用并支持改进产品软件的开发流程和工具。相关流程包括编码、编译及测试。相关工具包括代码编辑器、集成工具、策略分析工具、编译器及环路测试工具硬件。有关此角色的详细信息，请参阅本文档末尾部分。

征求产品和软件开发团队意见并与其协作，并向产品团队提供已验证软件功能、组件和构建。

利用系统知识和专业技能，在影响软件构建质量和性能、产品线（平台）及跨事业部集成和协调管理的软件要求、架构、设计及测试方面做出决策。

随着在该职位上获得经验，为技术复杂度和不明确性增加的中等复杂的组件、产品、系统、子系统或服务制定问题解决方案。

负责与跨职能团队互动和协作。

独立执行既定工作流程和系统，同时发展技术或产品知识；参与系统和流程改进。

参与基本的直接人事管理，但可能参与协调和指导技术人员和/或临时学生工之间的工作。

有效促进团队目标，在工作组内产生影响并持续提高对在职位上取得成功至关重要的能力。

技能:

避免产品故障模式 - 通过识别接口、功能、功能要求、交互作用、控制因素、噪音因素以及优先化涉及系统的潜在故障模式和潜在故障原因，有效地提高康明斯产品的可靠性，从而减少潜在的产品故障模式。

产品功能建模、模拟与分析 - 通过使用和/或解释计算工具和方法，预测相对于系统、子系统和/或零件级需求的产品功能能力，影响产品设计决策。

产品平台规划和建造 - 创建和开发整体产品平台，包括与未来目标市场的市场级产品计划相一致所需的关键架构特征和功能变体；生成可追溯到要求的替代架构，并与生命周期利益相关者合作进行权衡分析，确保提供平衡和最佳平台；沟通和维护产品开发团队执行的可追溯信息和计划。

产品软件设计与构建 - 使用行业最佳实践和完善的软件工程原理构建产品软件；验证软件更新以确保产品质量。

产品验证和认证管理 - 根据各种输入来制定产品系统验证计划，以识别故障模式，同时管理产品风险和相对优先级；根据能力来协商产品需求，以指导项目范围；评估分析、模拟和物理测试结果，以核实产品能力和验证要求；评估传统系统解决方案与获提议系统解决方案的功能，并使用技术文档提出建议，以支持产品决策。

系统要求工程 - 利用适当的方法和工具将利益相关方的需求转化为开发设计的可验证需求；通过分析、分配和协商确定涉及系统的验收标准；跟踪整个系统生命周期中的要求状态；评估系统要求变化对项目范围、进度和资源的影响；创建并维护关联相关工件的信息。

系统思考 - 通过绘制边界、确定环境背景、界面以及生命周期以定义涉及系统，帮助规划问题陈述、范围和可交付成果；通过使用合适的方法、模型和结果整合来分析构成涉及系统的要素之间的关联和相互作用，以了解系统、预测其行为并提出改进建议以产生期望的效果。

协作 - 建立合作伙伴关系并与他人协作，以达成共同目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

自我发展 - 使用正式和非正式发展渠道，积极寻找新的方式发展和锻炼自己。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

应用统计方法原理 - 使用描述性统计、概率分布、图形分析和统计推断（总体与样本、置信区间和假设检验）分析技术数据；使用方差分析、回归和实验设计来模拟响应和自变量之间的关系，以作出严谨、基于数据的决策。

跨职能设计整合 - 将包含许多利益相关方意见的价值包要求转化为虚拟设计，并通过获得批准的跨职能设计审核来传达设计的能力。

产品问题解决 - 使用保护客户的流程解决产品问题；确定非随机原因；实施完善、基于数据的解决方案；并确定系统根本原因和建议采取的行动，防止问题再次发生。

技术文档 - 基于作为技术职能活动一部分获得的知识提供文件信息；与利益相关者沟通，目的是提高技术生产力并将知识有效传授给未能获得第一手经验的人员。

产品开发执行、监控和控制 - 计划、安排、协调和执行涉及开发产品以相应地满足需求层次和技术概况的活动；监控并进行跨职能边界的沟通，以满足项目资源和质量预期；确保产品能力达到或超过预期，并在项目风险高于预期时采取缓解措施；了解完整的产品生命周期过程和利益相关者。

教育,资格,认证:

需具备工程或相应 STEM 领域的专科、本科学历或同等学士学位。

特定职位可能要求具备与本专业领域相关的研究生（硕士）学位。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

初级/职涯早期专业人员。具备临时学生就业（实习、合作教育或其他课外团队活动）相关工作经验或在相关技术学科领域作为职涯早期专业人员工作的应聘者优先。掌握 MS Office 工具者也优先

100% On-Site No
