job.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Energy Storage Products
job.description:
Job Summary

This developing technical leadership position develops and delivers technical talent in a research, technology or product development environment. Directly manages the resources that maximize workgroup productivity in support of business needs and implements near term business strategies with a focus on execution. The position also includes maintaining strong working relationships with a wide variety of stakeholders both within the technical function and across the broader business.

Key Responsibilities

Primary responsibility is the development of technically capable people often across multiple technical sites within a business unit or corporate, and making these people available to perform duties necessary to satisfy the businesses technical needs. Provides problem resolution leadership for complex systems with a high degree of ambiguity and often global business impact; helps get teams in place. Leads the development and improvement of work processes and systems across function(s) within a global business unit or managing improvement across business units. Coaches and mentors employees to provide guidance and direction on resolving problems, technical know-how, removing barriers to progress and career path planning. Assesses performance and provides feedback to direct reports. Creates, manages, improves and applies work processes involving activities such as resource allocation and management, organizational and business change, customer/stakeholder management and knowledge management; all used for the purposes of enabling high quality decision making that meets business expectations. Decisions made in this role may include resource deployment cost and timing allocations, project prioritization, personnel staffing, and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) management, the result of which can impact project cost and delivery within a site or across several sites within a business unit. Establishes employee performance standards; works collaboratively to set goals and address areas of deficiency.

Competencies:

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Builds networks - Effectively building formal and informal relationship networks inside and outside the organization.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Cultivates innovation - Creating new and better ways for the organization to be successful.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages ambiguity - Operating effectively, even when things are not certain or the way forward is not clear.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Project Management - Establishes and maintains the balance of scope, schedule and resources for a temporary effort (a “project”). Ensures results/impact from temporary effort are fully realized as possible.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Prior Technical Specialist or entry level Technical/Engineering Management equivalent work experience in a product, technology or engineering service role with demonstrated success leading projects and influencing outcomes through either direct or indirect reporting relationships. Must have a demonstrated track record of technical problem solving, quality decision making, providing technical direction and leadership to a project team(s) and conflict resolution.

job.title: Data Scientist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Solves complex analytical problems using quantitative approaches through a combination of analytical, mathematical and technical skills. Researches, designs, implements and validates complex algorithms to analyze diverse sources of data to achieve targeted outcomes by leveraging complex statistical and predictive modeling concepts.

Key Responsibilities

Participates in projects to support key objectives and business goals through the use of data science methodology. Leverages data science methodology to solve complex business problems. Creates multiple algorithms using complex statistical methodologies through the use of statistical programming languages and tools. Partners with domain experts to verify model capabilities. Partners with Solution Architect to enable appropriate data flow/data model, development using appropriate tools/technology, rapid prototyping and informs the design of analytical products. Partners with less experienced employees on data science tools and methodologies. Clearly articulates results, methodologies and learnings to stakeholder and peer group. Continuous development and advancement of the team through knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Tech savvy - Anticipating and adopting innovations in business-building digital and technology applications.

Data Mining - Extracts insights from data by identifying relationships and patterns through use of a suite of data exploration and data visualization techniques to understand the underlying structure of the data and enable sound conclusions upon model building.

Predictive Modeling - Develops analytical or machine learning models by using appropriate variable transformations, feature selection strategies, imputation strategies, class rebalancing, resampling strategies and quality control measures to generate predictive insights used in solving business questions.

Programming - Creates, writes and tests computer code, test scripts, and build scripts using algorithmic analysis and design, industry standards and tools, version control, and build and test automation to meet business, technical, security, governance and compliance requirements.

Requirements Analysis - Evaluates relationships and interdependencies between requirements based upon their complexity and value to the business in order to determine feasibility and prioritization.

Statistical Modeling - Develops descriptive and explanatory statistical models, and simulations for regression, classification, outlier detection, anomaly detection, time series forecasting using knowledge of foundational statistics such as null hypotheses significance tests, regression models, generalized linear modeling, time series analysis, rank statistics, probability distribution fitting survival analysis, etc. to validate hypotheses for any given statistical or business question.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

job.title: Skilled Technician - Level II - SHOP
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE)

  • Demonstrate a strong commitment to workplace safety by adhering to all Cummins HSE policies, procedures, and standards.
  • Stop work immediately and report unsafe conditions, incidents, near misses, or injury hazards.
  • Follow Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), electrical safety requirements, and safe work practices.
  • Conduct Job Safety Assessments (JSA) and utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Recognize environmental impacts and support sustainability initiatives within manufacturing operations.
  • Promote an interdependent safety culture by identifying, correcting, and escalating hazards.

Maintenance & Equipment Reliability

  • Perform preventive, predictive, corrective, emergency, and breakdown maintenance activities.
  • Troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair electrical systems, industrial controls, automation equipment, PLCs, drives, and production machinery.
  • Support equipment uptime initiatives through effective failure analysis and reliability improvement activities.
  • Maintain and repair production, assembly, and testing equipment according to established standards and procedures.
  • Document maintenance activities and provide feedback into preventive maintenance systems.

Automation, Robotics & Controls

  • Maintain and troubleshoot Siemens S7-1500 PLC-based automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal.
  • Perform PLC programming modifications, upgrades, and system enhancements.
  • Support operation and maintenance of industrial robots including ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, Universal Robots, and collaborative robotics systems.
  • Troubleshoot motion control, servo systems, industrial drives, and machine automation technologies.
  • Support machine communications through PROFINET, OPC UA, TCP/IP, and related industrial networking protocols.
  • Assist with integration of manufacturing systems, machine vision solutions, process controls, and CMES systems.

Quality & Operational Excellence

  • Perform work according to technical specifications, electrical schematics, process documentation, and quality standards.
  • Conduct quality inspections and identify opportunities to reduce quality and cost risks.
  • Analyze equipment failures, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement corrective actions.
  • Participate in Total Productive Maintenance (TPM), continuous improvement, and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Identify manufacturing constraints and contribute to process optimization efforts.

Asset Care & Housekeeping

  • Maintain tools, fixtures, assembly equipment, and testing systems.
  • Support calibration, inspection, and functionality verification activities.
  • Maintain clean, organized, and safe work areas.
  • Support spare parts management and inventory planning for maintenance and automation assets.

Collaboration & Development

  • Collaborate with Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, IT, Maintenance, and support teams to achieve operational goals.
  • Coordinate with vendors and contractors during maintenance and improvement projects.
  • Communicate technical issues, solutions, and improvement opportunities effectively to stakeholders.
  • Support and mentor junior technicians when required.
  • Complete required technical, safety, and professional development training.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma, secondary education certificate, technical diploma, or equivalent applicable experience.
  • Relevant industrial maintenance, automation, electrical, or manufacturing experience.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, control drawings, manuals, and technical documentation.
  • Knowledge of industrial safety practices and electrical safety requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Technical certifications in Electrical Systems, PLC Programming, Robotics, Industrial Automation, Mechatronics, or Maintenance.
  • Experience working within manufacturing or high-volume production environments.
  • Experience with automation, robotics, industrial networking, and machine controls.
  • Knowledge of TPM, Lean Manufacturing, Root Cause Analysis, and reliability-centered maintenance practices.

Licenses & Certifications

  • Additional technical certifications are preferred.
  • Export control or sanctions-related licensing may be required where applicable.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Electrical troubleshooting and fault diagnosis.
  • Industrial automation and control systems maintenance.
  • Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7-1500 PLC programming and troubleshooting.
  • Robotics troubleshooting and maintenance (ABB, FANUC, Yaskawa, Universal Robots).
  • Industrial communication protocols including PROFINET, OPC UA, and TCP/IP.
  • Motion control systems, drives, and servo technologies.
  • Machine vision and manufacturing systems integration.
  • Preventive, predictive, corrective, and reliability-focused maintenance.
  • Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Technical documentation interpretation and problem resolution.

Professional & Behavioral Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams.
  • Sound decision-making and troubleshooting judgment.
  • Customer and business focus.
  • Adaptability and learning agility.
  • Ability to prioritize work and perform effectively under pressure.
  • Commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Ability to coach, support, and work effectively with diverse teams.

Experience

  • Relevant work experience or intermediate to advanced technical knowledge gained through education, training, apprenticeships, or industrial experience.
  • Experience supporting electrical, automation, robotics, manufacturing, or maintenance operations.
  • Hands-on experience with industrial equipment troubleshooting and repair.
  • Experience participating in continuous improvement, TPM, Lean, or reliability initiatives.
  • Previous experience in high-volume manufacturing environments is preferred.
  • Experience supporting automated production systems and industrial controls is considered a strong advantage.

Core Competencies

  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality
  • Drives Results
  • Demonstrates Self-Awareness
  • Nimble Learning
  • Health and Safety Fundamentals
  • Controls Safety
  • Manufacturing Knowledge
  • Values Differences

job.title: Industrial Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

Designs, improves, and installs integrated manufacturing or administrative systems which use people, materials, information, equipment, and energy.

Key Responsibilities

Leads work studies for new and current production lines. Leads standard work methods for new and current production lines. Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Maintains the application of Cummins standards and develops manufacturing standards. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders. Competencies:

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Ergonomic Fundamentals - Understands ergonomic concepts by applying Cummins ergonomic standards, guidelines, controls and tools to reduce ergonomic risk to employees while at work.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Line Balancing - Evaluates work activities performed by individuals or machines to identify opportunities to optimize operating time and distributing of the work content to meet the changes in customer demands while continuing to optimize manufacturing processes.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Layout - Creates and/or modifies an optimized manufacturing process by incorporating knowledge of equipment, human interfaces, sequences of production steps, and facilities requirements in order to reduce process time and waste.

Work Measurement - Quantifies and evaluates the elements of work that make up a process by breaking it down into detailed steps to identify and reduce waste, and redistribute work content to optimize process flows.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Industrial Engineering Knowledge - Integrates the pillars of industrial engineering techniques by applying a comprehensive and quantitative analysis to available data to be used as decision factors for the development or improvement of manufacturing processes to contribute to the most efficient process.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level relevant work experience required.

Job Description: Industrial Engineer Senior

Role Summary: We are seeking an Industrial Engineering professional with strong expertise in discrete manufacturing, industrial engineering, and data analytics. This role will transform manufacturing data into actionable insights, drive continuous improvement, and support the deployment of AI and analytics solutions across plant operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze data from digital manufacturing systems such as CMES, Connected Factory, Maximo, Q-DAS, OEE platforms, and other plant applications to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand process challenges and convert them into data-driven improvement projects.
  • Develop dashboards, analytics models, and performance insights to improve productivity, equipment utilization, quality, cost, and operational efficiency.
  • Support AI and machine learning use cases by providing manufacturing domain expertise, validating data logic, and helping enterprise AI teams translate plant requirements into practical solutions.
  • Perform data validation, root-cause analysis, and performance investigations using SQL, Python, Power BI, and other analytics tools.
  • Identify bottlenecks, waste, process variation, and reliability issues, then recommend practical actions to drive measurable business improvements.
  • Facilitate Industry 4.0 analytics workshops, train plant teams on analytics tools, and build capability for data-driven decision making.
  • Design and support Operations Control Tower concepts by integrating data from manufacturing, maintenance, quality, and ERP systems to provide a consolidated view of operations.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of discrete manufacturing processes, plant operations, lean manufacturing, industrial engineering methods, and continuous improvement practices.
  • Hands-on experience with manufacturing performance metrics such as OEE, throughput, downtime, cycle time, productivity, quality losses, and cost improvement.
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and methods, including SQL, Python, Power BI, statistical analysis, and data visualization.
  • Ability to work with large operational data sets, validate data quality, identify trends, and convert analysis into business actions.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional plant teams and translating shop-floor challenges into analytics or AI use cases.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and project execution skills.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in Industry 4.0, smart manufacturing, connected factory, MES, ERP, or digital manufacturing platforms.
  • Exposure to AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, or advanced operations analytics in a manufacturing environment.
  • Experience leading value stream improvement, or data-driven productivity projects.
  • Ability to influence plant stakeholders and drive adoption of analytics-based improvement actions.

Looking at the data we gather from multiple systems, this position will add value in bringing meaningful insights for effective operations.

job.title: Solution Architect - Senior
job.description:
The Solution Architect - Senior is responsible for assessing, designing, and implementing scalable solution architectures aligned with Cummins enterprise architecture strategies, standards, and principles. This role defines application and solution designs for complex systems in partnership with product and project teams, ensuring technical solutions meet business, security, governance, and compliance requirements. The incumbent provides technical leadership in designing end-to-end analytics and AI architectures, including data pipelines, machine learning systems, and enterprise integrations. The role also drives innovation through proof-of-concepts (POCs), evaluates emerging technologies, and ensures architecture decisions create measurable business value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and own end-to-end scalable solution architectures for analytics, AI, cloud, and enterprise systems aligned with enterprise standards.
  • Define system component architecture, functional allocation, and interfaces between applications, platforms, and infrastructure components.
  • Develop multiple solution design options, perform cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized architectures based on business and technical requirements.
  • Create and maintain reference architectures, reusable design patterns, and architecture building blocks for global adoption.
  • Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, styles, technology stacks, and patterns in solution development.
  • Drive architectural improvements and influence enterprise technical strategy through collaboration with Principal Solution Architects and engineering teams.
  • Architect scalable data pipelines, ML systems, and system integrations to support advanced analytics and AI use cases.
  • Analyze complex business processes, governance requirements, and technical constraints to create practical, scalable solutions.
  • Lead pilot programs and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate technology capabilities and support innovation.
  • Evaluate infrastructure capacity and recommend improvements to support current and future business needs.
  • Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to align technical solutions with strategic business goals.
  • Promote adoption of standard technologies and best practices through strong collaboration with customers, peers, and engineering teams.
  • Identify, assess, and manage architecture-related risks and issues while driving mitigation strategies.
  • Stay current on emerging technologies, software trends, architecture methodologies, and industry best practices.

Skills

  • Enterprise Architecture & Solution Design
  • Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Data Architecture, Data Warehousing & ETL
  • Machine Learning Systems & MLOps
  • System Integration & API Architecture
  • Analytics and AI Platform Design
  • Architecture Frameworks & Reference Models
  • DevSecOps and Agile Delivery Practices
  • Risk and Issue Management
  • Stakeholder Management & Business Relationship Management
  • Cost Optimization and Performance Engineering
  • Technical Leadership and Strategic Thinking

Technical Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
  • Experience with data modeling , ETL frameworks , and data pipeline design
  • Experience with machine learning lifecycle management (MLOps)
  • Knowledge of build automation, version control, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of security, governance, and compliance requirements in architecture design

Experience

  • Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Demonstrated experience designing architecture for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications .
  • Proven ability to architect complex technical solutions and translate business requirements into scalable technical designs.
  • Experience leading cross-functional technical teams and influencing architecture decisions across stakeholders.
  • Experience in:
  • Analyzing complex business systems and industry requirements
  • Designing scalable enterprise data and analytics solutions
  • Architecting integrations across enterprise applications and data platforms
  • Building AI/ML-enabled solution architectures
  • Preferred experience with:
  • IoT technologies and connected systems
  • Agile software development methodologies
  • DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks , Snowflake , and Neo4j
  • Experience designing Azure-native solutions
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch
  • Knowledge of advanced analytics techniques including predictive modeling and AI-driven decision systems

Competencies

  • Balances stakeholders
  • Collaborates effectively
  • Communicates effectively
  • Decision quality
  • Persuades and influences
  • Strategic mindset
  • Change management
  • Values differences
  • Architecture system design
  • Solution design
  • Solution functional fit analysis
  • System solution architecture
  • Project issue and risk management

Qualifications

  • College, university, or equivalent degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline required.
  • Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of formal education.

job.title: 热流学系统工程师
job.description:
工作总结:

该初级/职涯早期专业性应用科学职位利用热流学方面的核心能力，利用和提出分析及试验方法来回答有关系统或组件性能及架构方面的关键问题。这会推动做出决策和创建技术内容，进而最终带来最先进、高效、环保和具有竞争力的产品。

主要责任:

在经验更加丰富的团队成员指导下，调查与热流学相关的产品、系统和/或技术问题、了解因果机制、提出适当措施、制定问题解决方案并记录结果。

运用并支持改进相关流程（例如前期项目规划（PPP）、领先产品技术（PPT）、价值包引进（VPI）或价值包变更（VPC）、工程标准工作（ESW）、职能部门卓越实践（FEP））和支持相关流程及实现优质决策所需的热流学相关工具（例如 GT-Suite、Boost、Fluent、Converge、Concerto、CyberApps（虚拟应用模型）、康明斯数据分析工具（CDAT）、Mach、测试数据计算、DARTS、测试数据储存、Calterm、电子控制模块（ECM）校准工具、排放数据系统、Integrity 及 ACCEPTS ECM 在环测试台架）。

征求直接利益相关方（例如团队成员、技术经理、项目主管、其他热力学工程师、产品及制造工程师以及供应商合作伙伴）意见并与其磋商，并提供信息和建议以支持项目决策，或提供与进一步分析、设计优化、可行性研究或架构界定相关的意见。

在影响和支持项目顺利发展的日常项目细节（例如开展分析、测试及与利益相关方沟通）方面做出决策。

随着在该职位上获得经验，为技术复杂度和不明确性增加的中等复杂的组件、产品、系统、子系统或服务制定问题解决方案。

独立执行既定工作流程和系统，同时发展技术或产品知识；参与系统和流程改进。

参与基本的直接人事管理，但可能参与协调和指导技术人员和/或临时学生工之间的工作。

有效促进团队目标，在工作组内产生影响并持续提高对在职位上取得成功至关重要的能力。

  • 与美国、印度团队成员紧密协作，高效支持中国本地产品开发工作。
  • 在现有基础上，持续建设CFD能力。开发自动化功能，探索AI工具与流体仿真分析结合可行性。

技能:

应用流体动力学和传热原理 - 通过定量和直观地理解液体和气体的流动、系统元件之间的热能转移以及建模和实验工具的应用，解释和预测流体和热系统的性能，并回答有关系统或组件的关键问题。

应用热力学和能量转换系统原理 - 通过利用对热力学、流体力学、建模工具、控制和实验工具的量化和直观理解，解释和预测 IC 发动机、燃气轮机、燃料电池和电池等能量转换系统的性能，并回答关于系统或组件的关键问题。

避免产品故障模式 - 通过识别接口、功能、功能要求、交互作用、控制因素、噪音因素以及优先化涉及系统的潜在故障模式和潜在故障原因，有效地提高康明斯产品的可靠性，从而减少潜在的产品故障模式。

产品功能建模、模拟与分析 - 通过使用和/或解释计算工具和方法，预测相对于系统、子系统和/或零件级需求的产品功能能力，影响产品设计决策。

产品问题解决 - 使用保护客户的流程解决产品问题；确定非随机原因；实施完善、基于数据的解决方案；并确定系统根本原因和建议采取的行动，防止问题再次发生。

系统要求工程 - 利用适当的方法和工具将利益相关方的需求转化为开发设计的可验证需求；通过分析、分配和协商确定涉及系统的验收标准；跟踪整个系统生命周期中的要求状态；评估系统要求变化对项目范围、进度和资源的影响；创建并维护关联相关工件的信息。

系统思考 - 通过绘制边界、确定环境背景、界面以及生命周期以定义涉及系统，帮助规划问题陈述、范围和可交付成果；通过使用合适的方法、模型和结果整合来分析构成涉及系统的要素之间的关联和相互作用，以了解系统、预测其行为并提出改进建议以产生期望的效果。

协作 - 建立合作伙伴关系并与他人协作，以达成共同目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

自我发展 - 使用正式和非正式发展渠道，积极寻找新的方式发展和锻炼自己。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

应用统计方法原理 - 使用描述性统计、概率分布、图形分析和统计推断（总体与样本、置信区间和假设检验）分析技术数据；使用方差分析、回归和实验设计来模拟响应和自变量之间的关系，以作出严谨、基于数据的决策。

技术文档 - 基于作为技术职能活动一部分获得的知识提供文件信息；与利益相关者沟通，目的是提高技术生产力并将知识有效传授给未能获得第一手经验的人员。

产品开发执行、监控和控制 - 计划、安排、协调和执行涉及开发产品以相应地满足需求层次和技术概况的活动；监控并进行跨职能边界的沟通，以满足项目资源和质量预期；确保产品能力达到或超过预期，并在项目风险高于预期时采取缓解措施；了解完整的产品生命周期过程和利益相关者。

开环／闭环控制的设计与应用 - 详细说明与机械、液压、化学和电子系统互动以提供所需系统状态的软件功能；详细说明控制系统架构，包括康明斯产品的适当测量、正确启动和算法；配置和/或了解康明斯产品的开环/闭环反馈控制功能以及硬件和软件之间的系统交互。

教育,资格,认证:

需具备工程或相应 STEM 领域的专科、本科学历或同等学士学位。

特定职位可能要求具备与本专业领域相关的研究生（硕士）学位。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

初级/职涯早期专业人员。具备临时学生就业（实习、合作教育或其他课外团队活动）相关工作经验或在相关技术学科领域作为职涯早期专业人员工作的应聘者优先。掌握 MS Office 工具者也优先

job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Territory Sales – Field Sales Account Executive – Senior is responsible for driving business growth by identifying new sales opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and executing account strategies within the assigned territory.   • Act as the key interface between Cummins and customers to ensure superior customer experience and satisfaction.
  • Manage strategic key accounts, including large industrial and mining customers such as Tata Steel, Thriveni Earthmovers, and other major private mining customers.

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Sales, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant sales experience.

job.title: 2027 Early Career - Thermal and Fluid Systems Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied science position utilizes the core competencies of thermal and fluid sciences, using and advancing analytical and experimental approaches to answer key questions about the performance and architecture of a system or component. This drives decisions and creates technical content which ultimately leads to state of the art, highly effective, environmentally friendly, and competitive products.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product, system, and/or technology problems that are related to thermal and fluid sciences, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution and documents results with guidance from more experienced team members. Applies and supports the improvement of processes such as Pre Program Planning, (PPP), Product Preceding Technology, (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), or Value Package Change, (VPC), Engineering Standard Work, (ESW), Functional Excellence Practice (FEP) and tools related to thermal and fluid sciences such as GT-Suite, Boost, Fluent, Converge, Concerto, CyberApps (virtual application model), Cummins Data Analysis Tool (CDAT), Mach, test data calculation, DARTS, test data storage, Calterm, Electronic Control Module (ECM) calibration tool, Emissions data system, Integrity, and ACCEPTS ECM in-loop test bench required to support the processes and enable high quality decision making. Obtains input and negotiates with immediate stakeholders, such as team members, technical managers, project leaders, other Thermal Sciences engineers, product and manufacturing engineers, and supplier partners and delivers information and recommendations to support project decisions, or to provide input related to further analysis, design optimization, feasibility studies, or architecture definition. Makes decisions in the areas of day to day project details, such as conducting analysis, testing, and communication with stakeholders that impact and support the successful progression of projects. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Applies Principles of Fluid Dynamics and Heat Transfer - Interprets and predicts the performance of fluid and thermal systems by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of the flow of liquids and gases, the transfer of thermal energy between elements of a system, and the application of modeling and experimental tools, to answer key questions about the system or component.

Applies Principles of Thermodynamics and Energy Conversion Systems - Interprets and predicts the performance of energy conversion systems such as IC engines, gas turbines, fuel cells, and batteries, by leveraging a quantitative and intuitive comprehension of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, modeling tools, controls, and experimental tools to answer key questions about the system or component.

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Design and Application of Open/Closed Loop Controls - Specifies software features that interact with mechanical, hydraulic, chemical and electronic systems to deliver desired system states; specifies control system architectures which include appropriate measurements, correct actuation, and algorithms for Cummins' products; configures and/or understands open/closed loop feedback controls features and the system interactions between hardware and software in Cummins' products.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

job.title: Buying Specialist - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Procurement Specialist is responsible for executing sourcing and procurement strategies that deliver optimal cost, quality, delivery, and supplier performance while supporting business objectives. This role manages regional commodities aligned to global category strategies, develops supplier relationships, conducts sourcing and market analysis, mitigates supply risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives. The position collaborates closely with cross-functional teams and suppliers to ensure a resilient supply base, support global procurement initiatives, and optimize total cost of ownership.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute sourcing and procurement strategies for direct materials, inventory items, capital goods, and services in alignment with global category strategies.
  • Manage assigned commodity portfolios, including casting, forging, stamping, and other manufacturing categories, ensuring optimal supplier performance and cost competitiveness.
  • Conduct supplier sourcing, supplier selection, Request for Quotation (RFQ), eBids, RapidSource activities, and tactical sourcing initiatives.
  • Perform supplier evaluation, price benchmarking, cost analysis, market intelligence, and industry analysis to identify cost reduction and value improvement opportunities.
  • Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships aligned with approved Category Partner Lists while ensuring supplier performance meets business expectations.
  • Lead supplier negotiations within approved commercial frameworks to achieve favorable pricing, quality, delivery, and contractual terms.
  • Monitor supplier performance, quality, delivery, capacity, and responsiveness while driving supplier development and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate supply chain risks by implementing supplier risk management strategies, dual sourcing, and business continuity plans.
  • Support supplier tooling management, ensuring compliance with Cummins tooling ownership procedures, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Analyze procurement data, spend trends, supplier performance metrics, and market conditions to support data-driven sourcing decisions.
  • Prepare procurement reports, presentations, and business recommendations for procurement and supply chain leadership.
  • Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality, finance, logistics, and global procurement teams to support new product introductions and sourcing initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with Cummins procurement policies, sourcing procedures, ethical standards, and Source-to-Pay processes.
  • Support purchase requisition approvals and ensure timely procurement execution to meet operational requirements.
  • Lead or participate in procurement improvement projects while coaching and supporting less experienced team members.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline is required.
  • MBA or postgraduate qualification in Supply Chain Management, Operations, or Procurement is preferred.
  • Knowledge of Casting, Forging, and Stamping commodities is preferred.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export control or sanctions regulations.

Skills

Technical Skills

  • Strategic sourcing and global procurement
  • Commodity management
  • Supplier relationship management
  • Supplier risk management
  • Casting, forging, and stamping commodity knowledge
  • Global sourcing and supplier development
  • RFQ management and supplier evaluation
  • Contract negotiation and commercial management
  • Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis
  • Price benchmarking and cost analysis
  • Spend analysis and procurement analytics
  • Market intelligence and supplier market research
  • Source-to-Pay (S2P) process knowledge
  • Procurement systems and procurement documentation
  • Supplier tooling management
  • Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and procurement reporting tools

Professional Competencies

  • Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills
  • Commercial acumen and negotiation capability
  • Excellent stakeholder and supplier relationship management
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Effective communication and presentation skills
  • Project and priority management
  • Risk assessment and mitigation
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Leadership and coaching ability
  • High ethical standards and procurement governance awareness
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural environment

Experience

  • 8–14 years of relevant experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain, or commodity management within a manufacturing or industrial environment. Exceptional candidates with slightly less experience may also be considered.
  • Experience managing global procurement activities and international supplier networks is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with casting, forging, stamping, or similar manufacturing commodities is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience in supplier negotiations, supplier development, and cost optimization initiatives.
  • Experience performing supplier risk assessments, business continuity planning, and supply base risk management.
  • Strong background in procurement analytics, market analysis, price benchmarking, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) evaluation.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and global cross-functional teams to deliver sourcing strategies and operational excellence.

job.description:
工作总结:

根据职能领域内项目的不同复杂程度及规模，负责相关的管理、开发和实施工作。协助企业股东，保证项目的圆满竣工。

主要责任:

负责多个项目从开始至完成全过程的指导工作；配合企业内股东推进项目计划研讨会的举办，确定项目范围和目标；协助企业股东共同设定项目绩效目标；制定项目计划和时间表，确定项目里程碑，通过绩效目标和时间表跟踪项目实施情况。与他人合作，做好鉴定和跟踪工作，解决项目问题。监管项目，并向项目团队汇报相关情况。计划及监管项目财政，并进行调研分析；为项目计划和时间表的设计和制定提供信息。管理项目风险；使用优质的工具鉴别风险范围；与团队内外成员合作，确定采用何种解决方案。记录团队的学习情况，并与其他团队交流分享；吸取其他团队的优秀经验，提高项目的成功率。做好项目记录、数据库维护以及其他的记录工作；监管各种措施，就具体项目和分派情况与项目赞助商沟通。确定并合理分配资源，完成项目任务；根据项目的不同阶段为团队成员提供指导和培训；为团队成员提供启发性的反馈意见；指导其他项目经理的团队管理。

N/A

技能:

财务敏感 - 解读关键财务指标，并利用对它们的理解做出更好的业务决策。

商业洞察力 - 运用商业和市场知识实现组织目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

管理复杂情况 - 领会复杂的、大量的，有时甚至是相互矛盾的信息，以有效地解决问题。

管理冲突 - 有效处理冲突情况，不至于造成太大的干扰。

计划和协调 - 制定工作计划并安排工作优先顺序，以达成与组织目标一致的承诺。

项目问题和风险管理 - 管理流程，以使用推荐的工具和方法来识别、评估问题和风险并进行优先排序。推动采取行动，最大限度地减少、监控和控制风险和问题，并尽可能地取得最积极的成果。

项目资源管理 - 使用推荐的项目管理工具和流程开发资源（费用和职员总数）计划，以有效管理资源。

项目时间表管理 - 使用推荐的进程管理工具和流程管理项目进度计划，以在议定的时间表内推动项目的完成。

项目范围管理 - 使用推荐的项目管理工具和流程管理项目可交付成果（范围）列表，以确保项目包括所有必要工作，并且只包括成功完成项目所需的工作。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

job.title: Manufacturing Engineer - Senior
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Leads the work for specific projects to create and implement all aspects of a manufacturing processes to ensure safety requirements, manufacturing goals, business goals, and product specifications are met. Leads by applying the knowledge or use of manufacturing principles and practices to improve manufacturing equipment and processes. Impacts the work by utilizing continuous improvement tools, following the Cummins standards, and leading the development of manufacturing standards and working methods. Leads the communications with and influences key external stakeholders, business leaders, and functional members. Works with internal and external resources on specific project assignments. Leads the advanced knowledge of manufacturing principles and practices as they are applied to Cummins. Maintains relationships and coaches key stakeholders.

Competencies:

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Health and Safety Fundamentals - Champions and models proactive health and safety behaviors by identifying, reporting and participating in actions to improve health and safety in order to build an interdependent culture and contribute to an injury-free workplace.

Drawing Interpretation - Integrates product design and manufacturing equipment engineering drawings to support the design and development of an optimal manufacturing process that meets product design specifications.

Equipment/Capital Procurement - Selects manufacturing equipment which meets the Cummins manufacturing specifications and meets the project or program needs.

Manufacturing Analysis Led Design - Uses digital tools to model and simulate manufacturing processes, equipment and performance to make data driven decisions before changes are made and to drive continuous improvements.

Manufacturing Knowledge - Demonstrates the knowledge of manufacturing by correctly implementing changes in current processes, equipment, and applications to meet the function's needs and contribute towards continuous improvement.

Process Documentation - Produces written manufacturing procedures in proper sequence which are followed correctly by all approved stakeholders to establish continuity in processes and standardization.

Tool and Fixture Design - Selects work-piece-holding devices capable of effectively holding parts and products during a manufacturing process to secure their position to meet functional requirements.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Continuous Process Improvement - Recognizes areas in which a process can be improved by properly implementing process improvement and waste reduction methodologies to reduce process cost and improve quality in current manufacturing processes.

Ergonomics Process and Workplace Design - Designs, creates or adapts processes and workstations by implementing ergonomic controls through the application of the Cummins ergonomic design guidelines to reduce risk and deliver ergonomically designed work.

Problem Solving - Solves problems and may mentor others on effective problem solving by using a systematic analysis process by leveraging industry standard methodologies to create problem traceability and protect the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; identifies the systemic root causes and ensures actions to prevent problem reoccurrence are implemented.

Workstation Design - Designs operator work stations that are safe, healthy, and ergonomic while accounting for cost, quality, and delivery to contribute to an efficient work environment.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Math) or related field, or equivalent experience required.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

Structured Responsibility Buckets

1. CAPEX PLANNING & EQUIPMENT PROCUREMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Capex Budget Planning & Tracking: Develop, manage, and track annual and multi-year capital expenditure plans (AOP capex) for manufacturing equipment and infrastructure projects; monitor cash flow against planned vs. actual spend across quarters.
  • Equipment Sourcing & RFQ Management: Prepare detailed RFQs for production equipment (e.g., VPI plants, HRD machines, presses, ovens, conveyors, winding machines, balancing machines); coordinate site visits for vendors; manage techno-commercial bid evaluations.
  • Vendor Selection & Negotiation: Conduct techno-commercial comparisons across multiple vendors (L1/L2 analysis); negotiate pricing, delivery timelines, payment terms, and warranties; finalize vendor selection with procurement and leadership approval.
  • Purchase Order Execution: Issue POs for equipment, utilities, and construction packages; manage advances, milestone payments, NFA (Non-Financial Approval) submissions, and contractor invoicing aligned to project progress.
  • Equipment Delivery & Installation Oversight: Track equipment receipt against delivery schedules; coordinate dismantling (if refurbishing existing assets), transportation, installation, and commissioning activities; ensure adherence to DAP (Delivered at Place) timelines.
  • Factory & Site Acceptance Testing (FAT/SAT): Plan and execute FAT at vendor facilities and SAT at plant; document test results, snag lists, and ensure resolution of technical issues before handover to operations.
  • Cash Flow & Financial Reporting: Prepare monthly/quarterly capex spend reports; reconcile invoices, track payment milestones, and report variances to finance and plant leadership.

2. CIVIL & INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECT MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Plant Layout Design & Optimization: Develop manufacturing facility layouts (including assembly lines, storage, utilities); collaborate with architects and civil consultants to finalize layouts in PREDCR format for MIDC submission.
  • Civil Tender Management: Prepare BOQ, technical specifications, and tender documents for civil construction (building footings, PEB structures, flooring, plaster, painting, waterproofing); evaluate civil contractor bids and finalize L1 vendor.
  • Building Expansion & Construction Supervision: Oversee new building construction, plant expansions (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3), and infrastructure projects (dock, scrap yard, admin blocks); track progress against Gantt charts and milestone completion.
  • Contractor Coordination & Billing: Manage civil, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, and interior contractors; verify work completion, approve RA (Running Account) bills, process mobilization advances, and manage retention payments.
  • Utility Installation Projects: Coordinate installation of plant utilities including transformers, DG sets, UPS, compressors, STP/ETP upgrades, hydrant systems, fire suppression, HVAC, earthing, IT infrastructure, and electrical cabling.
  • Excavation, Grading & Site Preparation: Oversee site grading, excavation, foundation work, and legal clearances for land use; coordinate with legal teams on royalty approvals and excavation permits.

3. STATUTORY COMPLIANCE & LEGAL APPROVALS

Primary Responsibilities

  • MIDC Building Plan Approval: Prepare and submit building plans to MIDC (Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation); obtain approvals for plinth-level construction, building completion certificates, and occupancy certificates (OC).
  • Fire NOC & Safety Clearances: Coordinate with fire consultants to obtain provisional Fire NOC, part-final Fire NOC, and final Fire NOC from Maharashtra Industrial Fire Department; ensure hydrant system installation and inspection readiness.
  • Environmental & Pollution Clearances:
  • CTE (Consent to Establish): Apply for and obtain CTE from MPCB before commencing manufacturing operations.
  • CTO (Consent to Operate): Submit CTO applications post-equipment installation (varnishing ovens, chemical processes); track approval timelines (60–90 days); implement mitigation plans for delays.
  • DISH Layout Approval: Obtain layout approval from Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH) for industrial equipment placement, factory layout, and worker safety compliance.
  • Electrical Load Enhancement Approvals: Coordinate with MSEDCL (Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Ltd.) for load enhancement applications, WCR (Work Completion Report) approvals, demand notes, fixed deposits, and transformer charging permissions.
  • BOCW (Building and Other Construction Workers) Registration: Register construction projects under BOCW Act; ensure labor welfare cess payments and statutory contractor registrations are current.
  • Safety Standards & Compliance Documentation: Ensure compliance with NFPA (National Fire Protection Association) standards, LOTO (Lockout/Tagout) procedures, HSE (Health, Safety, Environment) protocols, and maintain MAITRI portal documentation for legal audits.

4. VENDOR & COMMERCIAL MANAGEMENT

Primary Responsibilities

  • Vendor Identification & Capability Assessment: Identify and assess vendors for equipment supply, civil construction, electrical works, HVAC, interior fit-outs, and specialty services; conduct technical and financial due diligence.
  • Techno-Commercial Evaluation: Prepare comparative techno-commercial matrices for initial offers, final offers, and revised bids; validate technical compliance, delivery schedules, warranty terms, and total cost of ownership.
  • Contract Negotiation & Finalization: Negotiate pricing, payment terms (advances, milestones, retentions), scope changes, and penalty clauses; finalize contracts with legal, procurement, and finance sign-offs.
  • Vendor Performance Management: Monitor vendor adherence to delivery timelines, quality standards, and safety compliance; escalate delays, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
  • Commercial Documentation & Payments: Process vendor invoices, verify work completion against milestones, approve RA certificates, manage advance adjustments, and ensure timely payment releases aligned to contract terms.
  • Supplier Development & Relationship Management: Build long-term relationships with OEMs and contractors; facilitate supplier visits, audits, and capability showcases; maintain vendor databases and performance scorecards.
  • Legal & HR Compliance for Contractors: Ensure contractors maintain valid licenses (architect, plumber, structural engineer), provide labor welfare documentation, safety PPE, and comply with site safety regulations.

Additional Context & Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engg, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • 12-15 years of experience in manufacturing engineering, plant projects, or capex execution
  • Proven track record in managing multi-crore capex projects (₹10–50 Cr range)
  • Strong knowledge of Indian industrial regulations (MIDC, MPCB, Factory Act, BOCW)
  • Experience with equipment procurement (machining centers, assembly lines, utilities)
  • Familiarity with EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) project lifecycles

Reporting Structure:

  • Reports to: Manufacturing Engineering Leader
  • Collaborates with: Procurement, Finance, Legal, HSE, SCM, Operations, Quality, and Facilities teams

Role Category On-site with Flexibility

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

job.title: 电子系统工程师 - 软件
job.description:
工作总结:

该初级/职涯早期专业性应用技术职位创造作为康明斯产品不可或缺的部分出售的软件。担任这些职位的人员参与确定和理解利益相关方要求和制定规范，以及软件设计、实施、测试和/或发布的职责，而该软件可控制康明斯产品在各种客户应用情形下的运行。

主要责任:

调查产品软件问题、了解因果机制、提出适当措施、制定问题解决方案并记录结果。

运用并支持改进产品软件的开发流程和工具。相关流程包括编码、编译及测试。相关工具包括代码编辑器、集成工具、策略分析工具、编译器及环路测试工具硬件。有关此角色的详细信息，请参阅本文档末尾部分。

征求产品和软件开发团队意见并与其协作，并向产品团队提供已验证软件功能、组件和构建。

利用系统知识和专业技能，在影响软件构建质量和性能、产品线（平台）及跨事业部集成和协调管理的软件要求、架构、设计及测试方面做出决策。

随着在该职位上获得经验，为技术复杂度和不明确性增加的中等复杂的组件、产品、系统、子系统或服务制定问题解决方案。

负责与跨职能团队互动和协作。

独立执行既定工作流程和系统，同时发展技术或产品知识；参与系统和流程改进。

参与基本的直接人事管理，但可能参与协调和指导技术人员和/或临时学生工之间的工作。

有效促进团队目标，在工作组内产生影响并持续提高对在职位上取得成功至关重要的能力。

技能:

避免产品故障模式 - 通过识别接口、功能、功能要求、交互作用、控制因素、噪音因素以及优先化涉及系统的潜在故障模式和潜在故障原因，有效地提高康明斯产品的可靠性，从而减少潜在的产品故障模式。

产品功能建模、模拟与分析 - 通过使用和/或解释计算工具和方法，预测相对于系统、子系统和/或零件级需求的产品功能能力，影响产品设计决策。

产品平台规划和建造 - 创建和开发整体产品平台，包括与未来目标市场的市场级产品计划相一致所需的关键架构特征和功能变体；生成可追溯到要求的替代架构，并与生命周期利益相关者合作进行权衡分析，确保提供平衡和最佳平台；沟通和维护产品开发团队执行的可追溯信息和计划。

产品软件设计与构建 - 使用行业最佳实践和完善的软件工程原理构建产品软件；验证软件更新以确保产品质量。

产品验证和认证管理 - 根据各种输入来制定产品系统验证计划，以识别故障模式，同时管理产品风险和相对优先级；根据能力来协商产品需求，以指导项目范围；评估分析、模拟和物理测试结果，以核实产品能力和验证要求；评估传统系统解决方案与获提议系统解决方案的功能，并使用技术文档提出建议，以支持产品决策。

系统要求工程 - 利用适当的方法和工具将利益相关方的需求转化为开发设计的可验证需求；通过分析、分配和协商确定涉及系统的验收标准；跟踪整个系统生命周期中的要求状态；评估系统要求变化对项目范围、进度和资源的影响；创建并维护关联相关工件的信息。

系统思考 - 通过绘制边界、确定环境背景、界面以及生命周期以定义涉及系统，帮助规划问题陈述、范围和可交付成果；通过使用合适的方法、模型和结果整合来分析构成涉及系统的要素之间的关联和相互作用，以了解系统、预测其行为并提出改进建议以产生期望的效果。

协作 - 建立合作伙伴关系并与他人协作，以达成共同目标。

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

决策质量 - 及时作出高质量的决策，推动组织发展。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

自我发展 - 使用正式和非正式发展渠道，积极寻找新的方式发展和锻炼自己。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

应用统计方法原理 - 使用描述性统计、概率分布、图形分析和统计推断（总体与样本、置信区间和假设检验）分析技术数据；使用方差分析、回归和实验设计来模拟响应和自变量之间的关系，以作出严谨、基于数据的决策。

跨职能设计整合 - 将包含许多利益相关方意见的价值包要求转化为虚拟设计，并通过获得批准的跨职能设计审核来传达设计的能力。

产品问题解决 - 使用保护客户的流程解决产品问题；确定非随机原因；实施完善、基于数据的解决方案；并确定系统根本原因和建议采取的行动，防止问题再次发生。

技术文档 - 基于作为技术职能活动一部分获得的知识提供文件信息；与利益相关者沟通，目的是提高技术生产力并将知识有效传授给未能获得第一手经验的人员。

产品开发执行、监控和控制 - 计划、安排、协调和执行涉及开发产品以相应地满足需求层次和技术概况的活动；监控并进行跨职能边界的沟通，以满足项目资源和质量预期；确保产品能力达到或超过预期，并在项目风险高于预期时采取缓解措施；了解完整的产品生命周期过程和利益相关者。

教育,资格,认证:

需具备工程或相应 STEM 领域的专科、本科学历或同等学士学位。

特定职位可能要求具备与本专业领域相关的研究生（硕士）学位。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

初级/职涯早期专业人员。具备临时学生就业（实习、合作教育或其他课外团队活动）相关工作经验或在相关技术学科领域作为职涯早期专业人员工作的应聘者优先。掌握 MS Office 工具者也优先

job.title: Managing Counsel
job.description:
Experience required : 10-12 years

Job Summary

Performs routine legal work. Addresses legal questions and projects under the supervision of others.

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Electronic Systems Engineer - Software
job.description:
Job Summary

This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Cummins’ products. People in these positions have involvement in identification and understanding of stakeholder requirements and developing specifications, and responsibility for design, implementation, testing and/or release of software that controls the operation of Cummins’ products in a variety of customer applications.

Key Responsibilities

Investigates product software problems, understands causal mechanisms, recommends appropriate action, owns problem resolution, and documents results. Applies and supports the improvement of product software development processes and tools. Processes include coding, compiling and test. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Obtains input and collaborates with product and software development teams and delivers verified software features, components, builds to product teams. Uses systems knowledge and expertise to make decisions in the areas of software requirements, architecture, design, and test that impact the quality and performance of software builds, product lines (platforms) and management of cross-BU integration and coordination. Owns problem resolution for moderately complex components, products, systems, subsystems or services with technical complexity and ambiguity increasing as experience is gained in the role. Responsibile for interacting and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role.

Competencies:

Product Failure Mode Avoidance - Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products.

Product Function Modeling, Simulation and Analysis - Impacts product design decisions through the utilization and/or interpretation of computational tools and methods that predict the capability of a product's function relative to its system, sub-system and/or component level requirements.

Product Platform Planning and Architecting - Creates and develops a holistic product platform including key architectural feature and function variants needed to align with market level product plans of future target markets; generates alternative architectures traceable to the requirements and performs trade-off analysis in collaboration with life-cycle stakeholders to ensure a balanced and optimum platform; communicates and maintains traceable information and plans executed by product development teams.

Product Software Design and Construction - Constructs product software using industry best practices and robust software engineering principles; verifies software updates to ensure quality products.

Product Verification and Validation Management - Develops product systems validation plans from a variety of inputs to identify failure modes, while managing product risk and relative priority; negotiates product requirements against capability to guide project scope; evaluates analytical, simulation and physical test results to verify product capability and validate requirements; assesses legacy versus proposed system solution capabilities and produces recommendations with technical documentation to support product decisions.

System Requirements Engineering - Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts.

Systems Thinking - Defines the system of interest by drawing the boundaries, identifying its context within its environment, its interfaces, and that it has a lifecycle to aid in planning the problem statement, scope and deliverables ; analyzes linkages and interactions between elements that comprise the system of interest by using appropriate methods, models and integration of outcomes to understand the system, predict its behavior and devise modifications to it in order to produce the desired effects.

Collaborates - Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others to meet shared objectives.

Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Decision quality - Making good and timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Self-development - Actively seeking new ways to grow and be challenged using both formal and informal development channels.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Applies Principles of Statistical Methods - Analyzes technical data using descriptive statistics, probability distributions, graphical analysis, and statistical inference (population and sample, confidence intervals, and hypothesis testing); models relationships between response and independent variables using analysis of variance, regression, and design of experiments to make rigorous, data-based decisions.

Cross-Functional Design Integration - Translates the value package requirements that include the voices of many stakeholders into virtual designs, and communicates the capability of the design through an approved cross-functional design review.

Product Problem Solving - Solves product problems using a process that protects the customer; determines the assignable cause; implements robust, data-based solutions; and identifies the systemic root causes and recommended actions to prevent problem reoccurrence.

Technical Documentation - Documents information based on knowledge gained as part of technical function activities; communicates to stakeholders with the goal of enabling improved technical productivity and effective knowledge transfer to others who were not originally part of the initial learning.

Product Development Execution, Monitoring and Control - Plans, schedules, coordinates and executes the activities involved in developing a product to a respectively aligned hierarchy of requirements and technical profiles; monitors and communicates across functional boundaries to meet project resource and quality expectations; ensures product capability meets or exceeds expectations and takes mitigating actions when project risks are higher than expected; understands the full product life cycle process and stakeholders.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required.

Post-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles.

This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

Entry level/Early career professional. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred

Key Responsibilities

Software Development & Delivery

  • Develop, implement, and debug embedded software features.
  • Participate in software requirements analysis, design, coding, and testing activities.
  • Support software integration, build generation, and release activities.
  • Execute software configuration and variant management tasks.

Feature Development

  • Understand engine and powertrain control strategies.
  • Support feature requirement analysis and technical solution development.
  • Implement and maintain product features across multiple platforms and programs.
  • Collaborate with systems engineers to ensure correct requirement implementation.

Quality & Problem Solving

  • Investigate software defects and perform root cause analysis.
  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies such as 7-Step and RCA.
  • Participate in design reviews, code reviews, and quality improvement initiatives.
  • Support continuous process and product improvement activities.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Systems, Validation, Calibration, BSW, and global engineering teams.
  • Deliver assigned project tasks with high quality and on schedule.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices within the team.
  • Continuously develop technical and professional capabilities.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or related fields.

Experience

  • New graduate or 1-3 years of embedded software development experience.
  • Experience with AUTOSAR-based development is preferred.

Technical Skills

Knowledge of one or more of the following:

  • Embedded C programming
  • Software debugging and troubleshooting
  • CAN/J1939 communication protocols
  • Vector toolchain (CANoe, DaVinci, etc.)
  • Software configuration management
  • Software testing and validation
  • ECU software architecture
  • ASPICE development process

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Effective communication and teamwork
  • Self-motivated with learning agility
  • Good English reading and writing skills

job.title: 生产助理 - 二级
job.description:
工作总结:

根据质量和生产力要求，在有限指导下并在制造环境中安全地操作机器和生产设备。

主要责任:

健康、安全和环境 (HSE)

停止工作并立即报告任何重大伤害危险。

报告任何与工作有关的伤害、疾病、事件或危害。

遵守 HSE 标准、政策、程序和规定。

使用合适的个人防护装备。

通过互相关照来促进互相依存。

在您的控制和能力范围内消除危害。

认识到您的工作可能对环境产生影响，并努力减少负面影响。

参加 HSE 培训。

质量部

遵循所有适用的标准工作、过程文件和质量程序，例如统计过程控制 (SPC)、防错和视觉标准。

提出问题以最小化成本和质量风险。

执行质量检查。

识别和控制不合格材料。

交付

使用手动和自动化设备来制造和组装产品，以创造符合客户期望所需的独有特性和尺寸。

在核心工作技能方面表现出高水平的能力。

实现生产目标。

在必要的周期时间内或根据定义的工程标准工作。

保持整洁有序的工作区域，包括日常清洁工作和机器清洁工作，并根据计划执行操作员保养和维护工作。

保持灵活性并根据需要执行其他交办的工作，以实现生产目标。

与同事、熟练工人和支持人员合作，维护和识别需要维修的设备。

团队协作

与指派的团队和所有支持团队进行有效沟通。

按照业务要求完成培训和个人发展。

积极参与以促进质量、安全、流程、物流和员工发展。

  • 负责精密机加工成品、半成品的最终全检工作，严格按照图纸尺寸、公差标准、工艺要求及检验规范，对零部件的外观进行全面检测，杜绝不合格产品流入仓库或交付客户。
  • 严格做好检验记录工作，如实填写报表、不合格品单据等各类台账，做到数据可追溯、账目清晰规整，按时提交各类检验报表。
  • 负责不合格品的判定、标识、隔离工作，及时对不良产品进行分类标注，上报不合格问题，配合分析不良原因，跟进返工、返修、报废产品的复检确认工作。
  • 负责检验区域环境卫生整理、检测工具的日常保养、校准与保管，定期维护检测设备，确保量具精度达标、设备正常使用，规范摆放检验物料及工具。

技能:

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

魄力 - 对棘手问题迎难而上，当说必说。

追求结果 - 一贯地达成绩效，即使是在艰难的情况下也是如此。

确保承担责任 - 确保自己和他人为实现承诺负责。

健康与安全基本知识 - 识别、报告并参加能够改善健康与安全的行动，倡导积极的健康与安全行为并发挥楷模作用，以营造相互依存的企业安全文化，促进实现无伤害的工作场所。

制造知识 - 通过正确实施当前流程、设备和应用程序的变更来展现制造知识，以满足职能部门的需求并为持续改进做出贡献。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

教育,资格,认证:

高中毕业证书或中等教育毕业证书或同等经验，只要这些经验符合适用法规。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

需要通过教育、培训或在职经历获得一些工作经验或中级水平的知识。

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Job Summary – JM2

Junior Collection Manager is responsible for managing accounts receivable, ensuring timely collection of outstanding invoices from business clients, performing account reconciliations, and resolving disputes. The role requires strong analytical skills, stakeholder communication, and attention to detail to maintain healthy cash flow and minimize aged receivables

Key Responsibilities

1. Collections

  • Manage an assigned portfolio of customer accounts, ensuring timely collection of outstanding balances and reducing delinquency
  • Handle outbound and inbound calls to customers for payment reminders
  • Conduct proactive outreach to customers via phone and email to resolve past-due invoices and secure payment commitments
  • Maintain detailed and accurate collection notes and account histories within the system to support transparency and continuity
  • Serve as a subject matter expert in collections processes
  • Collaborate with field representatives and internal stakeholders to resolve complex customer issues and support strategic initiatives
  • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of collections policies, procedures, and tools to enhance efficiency and scalability
  • Build strong relationships with customers to improve payment cycles

2. Account Reconciliation (Recon)

  • Perform periodic reconciliation of customer accounts
  • Identify discrepancies between internal records and customer statements
  • Investigate unapplied cash, short payments, or overpayments
  • Work with internal teams (billing, sales, finance) to resolve mismatches
  • Maintain accurate and updated account statements

3. Dispute Management

  • Identify, log, and track customer disputes related to invoices
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders (billing, operations, sales) for resolution
  • Ensure timely closure of disputes to avoid payment delays
  • Maintain dispute logs and provide root cause analysis
  • Work on preventing recurring issues through process improvements

4. Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare daily/weekly/monthly MIS reports on collections, aging, disputes
  • Analyze aging reports to identify trends, highlight at-risk accounts, and provide actionable insights to leadership
  • Provide insights and recommendations to improve collection efficiency
  • Perform monthly and quarterly responsibilities such as Allowance Analysis and journal entry, collection escalation for doubtful accounts and monthly reporting package for collections metrics.
  • Track KPIs such as DSO (Days Sales Outstanding), collection rate, dispute resolution TAT

5. Compliance & Process Adherence

  • Ensure adherence to company credit policies and collection procedures
  • Maintain proper documentation for audits and compliance requirements
  • Support internal and external audit queries related to receivables

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelors or Master’s degree in finance or equivalent
  • 7–8 years of experience in Global Collections, including U.S. customer portfolios
  • Experience managing large, high-volume AR portfolios with measurable impact on DSO
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem‑solving capabilities
  • Ability to negotiate and influence outcomes while remaining tactful and respectful.
  • Excellent time management with the ability to independently prioritize and manage portfolios
  • Proficiency in ERP Systems & Collection Tools – SAP, Oracle, High Radius
  • Demonstrated ownership of high-value, complex AR portfolios with material cash impact
  • Strong analytical judgment and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to work U.S. Shifts

job.title: 驻点维修技师 - I 级
job.description:
工作总结:

在单独的客户现场，在最少的指导下完成对康明斯产品的预防性维护保养和/或基本维修工作。

主要责任:

以礼貌和专业的方式接洽客户。确保对客户的需求予以及时和有效的关注。

使用专业化的工具并遵守书面步骤和政策，以诊断和完成基本维修，包括准备所需的零件和工具。

将未解决的问题呈报至经验更丰富的现场技师和/或主管。

按照书面计划和标准对客户所在地的康明斯产品执行预防性维护保养。

以手写方式或通过业务系统输入屏幕填写要求的文件，如维修工作表、工时表、保修索赔。

按照技能和业务要求完成培训。

对工作区域和工具进行维护保养，以保持其清洁和正常工作。

确保遵守所有相关卫生、安全和环保政策、程序和法规。

适应高海拔作业

技能:

有效沟通 - 发展和实现多模式沟通，清晰了解不同受众的特定需求。

以顾客为中心 - 建立稳固的顾客关系，提供以顾客为中心的解决方案。

确保承担责任 - 确保自己和他人为实现承诺负责。

计划和协调 - 制定工作计划并安排工作优先顺序，以达成与组织目标一致的承诺。

自我发展 - 使用正式和非正式发展渠道，积极寻找新的方式发展和锻炼自己。

健康与安全基本知识 - 识别、报告并参加能够改善健康与安全的行动，倡导积极的健康与安全行为并发挥楷模作用，以营造相互依存的企业安全文化，促进实现无伤害的工作场所。

诊断学应用 - 转化客户投诉以制定故障排除计划；遵循指导工作流程、程序、专用设备（如机械和电子维修工具）排除故障，并诊断计算机软件以隔离故障组件，从而实现成功维修；通过重复投诉确认维修并确保问题得到解决；记录业务系统故障排除的结果，以沟通为付款和历史追踪所做的事情。

电气知识 - 通过遵守所有安全工作程序，包括穿戴个人防护装备以创造一个安全的工作环境，说明对关于在低压和／或高压下工作的康明斯和行业标准的了解；运用基本电气原理和电子组件知识使用适当的工具和程序以安全高效地诊断和维修产品。

电子服务工具应用 - 识别服务事件所需的可用硬件和软件工具套件；利用合适的电子工具组合来维护产品或诊断并排除故障；解释电子工具结果或提供建议以确定服务解决方案的后续步骤。

机械知识 - 通过遵守所有安全工作程序，包括穿戴个人防护装备以创造一个安全的工作环境，说明对康明斯和行业标准的了解；运用基本电气原理和电子组件知识使用适当的工具和程序以安全高效地诊断和维修产品。

产品维修和维护 - 遵循指导方针维修和维护机械／电气产品，在标准维修时间内使用所需工具以确保优质维修服务；遵循指导方针拆卸和装配发动机或发电机，使用所需工具以确保一个整洁有序的环境；遵循再利用指导方针检查及更换零件和组件以最小化客户拥有成本；遵循指导方针实施损坏检查，以恢复至故障前的状况。

服务文档 - 创建并验证客户、设备和技术信息；使用必要的服务工具捕获特定数据；遵循程序并在服务管理系统中记录所需的信息，以便准确记录完成的工作。

技术升级 - 获取产品技术问题信息并利用可用资源，包括数据管理工具；将问题上报给技术水平更高的人员，平衡客户反应的及时性与调查工作；在合适的数据库中记录所有故障排除步骤，以确保无缝过渡并及时准确地响应票证解决方案。

看重差异性 - 认识到不同视角和文化给组织带来的价值。

教育,资格,认证:

接受过学徒培训的发电机和/或发动机技师（优先）。

相关技术机构颁发的职业证书。

当前相关电工证书（可选）。

本地有效的驾驶执照。

该职位可能需要获得有关遵守出口管制或制裁法规的许可证。

经历:

要求最低水平的维修车间相关经验。

基本水平的康明斯产品知识和/或维修该产品的经验。

高压/低压经验（可选）。

100% On-Site No
