job.title: Pricing Analyst - Senior
job.description:
Job Summary

The Pricing Analyst – Senior is responsible for developing, implementing, and optimizing pricing strategies that drive profitable growth while maintaining market competitiveness. This role leads pricing operations, pricing analytics, and cross-functional pricing initiatives by ensuring accurate pricing data, executing strategic price revisions, supporting customer pricing, and delivering actionable business insights. The position collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, and business leadership to align pricing decisions with organizational objectives, enhance pricing processes, and improve customer value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development, implementation, and execution of pricing strategies that support business growth, profitability, and competitive positioning.
  • Plan, analyze, obtain approvals for, and execute annual and mid-year pricing revisions across multiple product lines and market segments.
  • Maintain accurate pricing data across ERP, CRM, order management, rebate, and pricing systems, ensuring data integrity and first-time accuracy.
  • Manage multiple pricing structures and price lists while ensuring synchronization across enterprise systems.
  • Prepare customer quotations and pricing proposals in collaboration with Sales teams and support complex customer pricing negotiations.
  • Analyze pricing performance, market trends, customer behavior, competitive intelligence, and win/loss data to recommend pricing improvements and business actions.
  • Lead pricing governance forums and facilitate collaborative pricing decisions with Sales, Finance, and business leadership.
  • Design and continuously improve pricing methodologies, pricing policies, and pricing philosophies aligned with business objectives.
  • Lead pricing analytics initiatives by leveraging business intelligence, automation, AI, and digital tools to improve pricing effectiveness and decision-making.
  • Develop reports, dashboards, forecasts, and executive presentations that provide meaningful pricing insights and business recommendations.
  • Lead pricing improvement projects, process optimization initiatives, and continuous improvement activities to enhance operational efficiency.
  • Ensure timely resolution of complex pricing issues while providing excellent support to internal and external customers.
  • Maintain confidentiality of pricing information and ensure compliance with company policies, governance requirements, and applicable regulations.
  • Monitor pricing operational KPIs including turnaround time, accuracy, and service levels, implementing corrective actions where required.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop pricing team members while fostering a collaborative, high-performance work environment.

Build strong partnerships across Sales, Finance, Marketing, IT, Supply Chain, and other business functions to achieve shared business goals.

Core Competencies

  • Pricing Strategy & Execution
  • Pricing Analytics & Business Intelligence
  • Market Analysis & Forecasting
  • Financial & Commercial Acumen
  • Customer Pricing & Quotation Management
  • Data Analysis & Decision Making
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Stakeholder Management & Influencing
  • Project Leadership & Continuous Improvement
  • ERP, CRM & Pricing Systems Management
  • AI & Digital Analytics Adoption
  • Problem Solving & Critical Thinking
  • Process Excellence
  • Customer Focus
  • Effective Communication
  • Accountability & Ownership
  • Managing Ambiguity
  • Building Networks
  • Collaboration
  • Coaching & Team Development
  • Valuing Diverse Perspectives

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Marketing, Strategy, Accounting, Business Administration , or a related discipline is required.
  • Master's degree or relevant professional certifications in Pricing, Finance, Analytics, or Business Management are preferred.
  • Position may require compliance with applicable export controls or sanctions regulations.

Skills & Experience

  • Significant experience in pricing, commercial finance, pricing analytics, sales operations, business analytics, or related commercial functions.
  • Experience developing and implementing pricing strategies within manufacturing, automotive, industrial, aftermarket, or B2B environments is preferred.
  • Strong analytical capabilities with experience interpreting large datasets and translating insights into business recommendations.
  • Experience managing complex pricing structures, customer pricing, rebates, quotations, and enterprise pricing systems.
  • Working knowledge of ERP and CRM platforms (such as Oracle, SAP, Salesforce, or equivalent).
  • Experience leading pricing governance, cross-functional projects, and strategic pricing initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and collaborate across multiple business functions.
  • Experience leading or mentoring teams and driving employee development.
  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting/analytics tools; experience with Power BI, Tableau, AI-enabled analytics, or similar platforms is advantageous.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy, quality, and customer focus.
  • The position is for India aftermarket DBU Pricing leader.
  • Lead a team of three office employees – who manage the day to day DBU pricing operations and Pricing analytics.
  • Takes care of the strategic pricing – which involves carrying out all the mass scale annual and mid year price revisions – including planning, analysis, seeking approvals from pricing councils, execution of the actions, providing the right justifications to the market etc.
  • Leads the DBU Pricing councils. Ensures decisions are taken collaboratively by the Pricing, Finance and Sales leaders in this forum.
  • Manage DBU out pricing along with the team for multiple Oracle price lists. Ensure sync with the CRM systems.
  • Manage the DBU Direct customer pricing. Prepare the quotations to these customers in co-ordination with the sales team expectations and sometimes participate in the customer pricing negotiations.
  • Lead business projects to align pricing with market expectations. Support the team to clear price challenges on regular basis.
  • Lead Pricing analytics projects and implement AI analytics and tools in collaboration with the IT team
  • Provide daily guidance to the team for day to day clearances. Ensure right pricing methodologies are followed and accurate pricing set ups are done at the first time.
  • Maintain the team KPIs of Turn around time and accuracy.
  • Design the pricing philosophies for this business in co-ordination with the sales leaders
  • The role involves massive cross functional and leadership collaboration.

job.title: 地区営業 - 現地営業アカウントエグゼクティブ - シニア
job.description:
仕事の概要:

ビジネスを成長させる新たな機会を予測し、開拓する。顧客関係を構築し、担当営業テリトリー、市場セグメント、チャネルパートナー内で営業目標を達成するために、アカウント計画を独自に作成、実行する。

主要な責務:

見込み客を特定、調査し、接触することで、売上を伸ばす機会を拡大する。有力な見込み客のためのアカウント計画を策定、実行し、合意した対面セールスコールを実施する。

顧客のニーズ、ビジネスモデル、購入プロセスを特定できるようにする、新しい顧客関係を開発し、現在の顧客関係を強化する。

顧客のニーズと優先事項を理解した内容を活用し、カミンズのソリューションを特定、提案する。

顧客が既存のデータや情報、価値提案を理解し評価できるよう支援することで、カミンズのソリューションの差別化された利点について共観を得る。

顧客や市場の現在のニーズや新興ニーズをマネージャー／ディレクターに知らせる。

支払い条件などが記載された会社のガイドラインに沿って交渉を行う。売掛金の回収を支援する。支払期限を過ぎた口座の許容レベルを維持する。顧客および社内のステークホルダーと協力して、延滞金を解決する。

売上を促進し、売上目標を達成し、顧客満足度を確かなものとする。顧客関係を維持、強化し、将来の売上とリピートビジネスを創出する。顧客の懸念にタイムリーに対応する。

カミンズの営業プロセスだけでなく、営業、顧客満足度、顧客価値（顧客関係管理や特別プロジェクトなど）をサポートするカミンズのツール、プロセス、イニシアティブを着実に使用する。

管理指示に従い、顧客関係管理ツールを介して活動を報告する。販売予測を維持し、予測に対する進捗状況と精度を追跡する。

自分より経験の浅いアカウントエグゼクティブにリーダーシップとメンタリングを与える。

必要に応じて、社内のステークホルダー、顧客と協力して、顧客の期待に沿って在庫、サービス、および配送機能をバランスさせる。

スキル:

ビジネスの見識 - ビジネスや市場に関する知識を活用して組織の目標を達成させる。

効果的なコミュニケーション - 多種多様なコミュニケーションを展開して、さまざまな相手のニーズを明確に理解する。

顧客志向 - 顧客と強固な関係を構築し、顧客の立場に立った解決策を提供する。

明確な価値の提示 - 関連する要望に基づいて、内外の顧客ニーズを明らかにする。競合他社と差別化するため、特定の顧客ニーズを満たし、強みと弱みを明確にした製品、ソリューション、サービスを説明し、実践する。

販路（チャネル）認識 - 組織目標を改善するため、業界の構造、力学、市場への行程を説明し、状況に当てはめる。

価格戦略 - ビジネス目標を達成するため、部門を超えて主要なステークホルダーとのコンセンサスを調整、形成することにより、価格を決定する。

交渉の優位性 - 交渉に当たり、ツールやメソッドを活用し、カミンズ利害関係者の目標およびすべての当事者間で合意された全契約条件を達成する。

アカウントプランニング - 目的を明確にし、目的が必要となる場面の状況について検討し、その達成までの進み具合を追跡できるようにすることで、経営戦略またはアカウント戦略のいずれか、あるいはその両方を実行する。

ターゲットオーディエンスへの適応 - ターゲットオーディエンス（営業担当者、顧客、トレーニングベンダーなど）が情報を理解、保持、および使用できるようなやり方で、複雑なトピック（重要な技術データ、対象事項の専門知識など）を説明する。

アカウント戦略の開発 - ビジネス戦略に沿った達成可能な目標を定義するため、関係性、財務、製品競争力、障壁、品質、サービスに関する現状評価を判断し、顧客要件とビジネス能力のバランスをとることによって、望ましい将来像を定義する。

顧客視点を組み入れる - 当社製品および販売活動に対する顧客の視点を理解し、それらを組み入れて販売コンテンツを開発し、顧客ニーズへの対応力および収益改善能力を向上させる。

セールス予測 - 内外の情報源から顧客データを収集し、評価する。過去のデータと比較して、有用なインプットを判断し、今後の消費動向について予測を作成する。

販売パイプラインマネジメント - 現在のパイプラインに基づいて、取引先や地域レベルで販売戦略や販売計画の実行を成功させるため、積極的に計画を策定する。パイプラインの健全性（規模、内容、進捗）を評価する。それに応じて、販売戦略、計画、影響力が大きな活動を調整する。必要であれば、販売目標を達成するために販売人を指導する。

意味を成す - 一連の診断およびプロービングの質問と調査を通じて、顧客のニーズ、行動、購買過程を深く理解し、および/または支援する。社内外のリソースから得られる複雑な情報を統合し、社内外の顧客のためにカスタマイズしたソリューションを提供する。

多様性の尊重 - 異なる視野や文化が組織にもたらす価値を理解する。

学歴、免許、資格:

必須条件：マーケティング/営業または関連分野におけるカレッジ/大学の学位もしくは同等の学位、営業関連の十分な実務経験、または教育と経験を組み合わせた十分な条件が必須。

この役職では、輸出管理または制裁規則を遵守するためにライセンスが必要になる場合があります。

職歴:

関連分野における中程度の実務経験を有する方。

100% On-Site No

job.title: Territory Sales - Field Sales Account Executive - Senior
job.description:
Prospects and develops new opportunities to grow the business. Independently develops/executes account plans to build customer relationships and achieve sales goals within the assigned sales territory, market segment or channel partners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develops opportunities to increase sales by identifying, researching and contacting prospective customers.
  • Develops and executes account plans for top prospects and conducts agreed upon face to face sales calls.
  • Develops new customer relationships and strengthens current customer relationships that enable identification of a customer’s needs, business model and buying process.
  • Uses understanding of customer needs and priorities to identify and offer Cummins solutions.
  • Gains agreement on the differential advantage of Cummins solutions by helping the customer understand and evaluate existing data and information and the value proposition.
  • Brings current and emerging needs of the customer and market to their manager/director.
  • Conducts negotiations according to company guidelines, including payment terms.
  • Assists with collection of accounts receivables. Maintains acceptable level of past due accounts.
  • Collaborates with customers and internal stakeholders to resolve delinquent payments.
  • Drives sales, achieving sales targets and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Maintains and strengthens customer relationships to generate future sales and repeat business.
  • Responds to customer concerns in a timely fashion.
  • Consistently uses the Cummins Sales Process as well as Cummins tools, processes, and initiatives that support sales, customer satisfaction, and customer value, e.g., Customer Relationship Management and special projects.
  • Reports activity via the Customer Relationship Management tool per management direction.
  • Maintains Sales forecasts and tracks progress and accuracy against forecast.
  • Provides leadership and mentoring to less experienced account executives.
  • As applicable, works with internal stakeholders and customers to balance inventory, service, and delivery capabilities with customer expectations.

Need speck and listen Japanese fluently as Native speaker

Need to correctly understand Japanese business culture and mentality

Need to support Order Administrators who are in charge of the same Accounts.

Competencies:

  • Business insight - Applying knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization’s goals.
  • Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.
  • Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.
  • Articulating Value Proposition - Interprets internal and external customer needs based on relevant application; explains and demonstrates products, solutions, and services to distinguish strengths and weaknesses to meet customer's specific needs to differentiate against competition.
  • Channel Awareness - Explains and contextualizes industry structure, dynamics, and path to market in order to advance organizational goals.
  • Pricing Strategy - Develops prices by aligning and building consensus with key stakeholders across functions to achieve business targets.
  • Negotiations Excellence - Utilizes tools and methods in negotiations to achieve Cummins stakeholder objectives and achieve a mutually agreed upon all contract terms between all parties.
  • Account Planning - Identifies objectives to drive execution of business and/or account strategy by reviewing the status relative to where it needs to be and enabling tracking of progress against targets.
  • Adapts to target audience - Explains complex topics (significant technical data, subject matter expertise, etc.) in such a way that the target audience (e.g. sales professionals, customers, training vendors, etc.) can understand, retain, and use the information
  • Developing Account Strategy - Determines current status of account in terms of relationship, financial, product competitiveness, barriers, quality, and service and defining desired future state by balancing customer requirements and business capabilities in order to define achievable targets aligned with the business strategy.
  • Integrates Customer Perspective - Incorporates an understanding of the customers' perspective on our products and sales efforts to develop sales content that improves our ability to meet their needs and increase revenue.
  • Sales Forecasting - Collects and assesses customer data from internal and external sources; compares against historical data to determine useful inputs and create a forecast of future consumption patterns.
  • Sales Pipeline Management - Plans proactively for successful execution of account/territory-level sales strategies and plans based on current pipeline; evaluates pipeline health (size, contents, progress); adjusts sales strategy, plans, or high impact activities accordingly; as applicable coaches sellers in order to achieve sales objectives.
  • Sense Making - Through a series of diagnostic and probing questions and research, develops and/or supports an intimate understanding of the customer needs, behaviors, and/or their buying journey. Synthesizes complex information from internal and external resources to deliver tailored solutions for the internal or external customer.
  • Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:

  • Required: College, university, or equivalent degree in Marketing, Sales or a related subject, or acceptable sales related work experience, or an acceptable combination of education and experience.
  • This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience

  • Intermediate level of relevant work experience required.

Job Type Exempt - Experienced

Job Description

As a Territory Manager - Sales (Project), you will be responsible for developing and executing sales strategies to achieve revenue targets. job.description:
![](https://iadugs.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/CandidateExperience/images?imageId=83E4FCC5-14B2-4B46-AD00-8515FF9551FD)![](https://iadugs.fa.ocs.oraclecloud.com/hcmRestApi/CandidateExperience/images?imageId=83E4FCC5-14B2-4B46-AD00-8515FF9551FD)

Buyer

新北市, 台灣(On-site)

職務資訊

  • 職務識別241
  • 公告日期2026/07/02 下午11:30
  • 學位學士學位
  • 工作時程全職
  • 地點5F,No.121,Lane 235,Baoqiao Road Xindian District, New Taipei, 231, TW(On-site)
  • BrandRaritan
  • Employment typeRegular
  • Travel RequiredNo
  • 職務類目Purchasing

職務描述

We are looking for a Buyer to join our Procurement Team and support purchasing execution and supply operations.

This role is responsible for managing purchase orders, coordinating supplier delivery, and supporting stable material supply to meet business and production requirements.

The ideal candidate enjoys organizing information, solving operational issues, and collaborating across functions to move things forward. You do not need to know everything from day one — but we value people who take ownership, follow through, and continuously improve the way work gets done.

This position provides opportunities to develop procurement capability through supplier interaction, operational exposure, and cross-functional collaboration.

職責

ESSENTIAL DUTIES  AND  RESPONSIBILITIES

Procurement & Supply Execution

  • Convert purchase requests into purchase orders and maintain purchasing records in ERP systems.
  • Issue purchase orders and coordinate order execution with suppliers.
  • Monitor delivery schedules and follow up supply status to support business requirements.
  • Support order adjustments, long-term order planning, and pre-order preparation when required.
  • Coordinate operational issues across internal teams and suppliers to ensure smooth order execution.
  • Support pricing discussions for specific purchasing scenarios when applicable.

Supplier Coordination & Operational Support

  • Work with suppliers to confirm delivery commitments and resolve operational issues.
  • Maintain order status visibility and support issue escalation when necessary.
  • Coordinate purchasing-related transactions and support cross-business unit collaboration.
  • Build productive working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Invoice & Procurement Administration

  • Monitor supplier invoice submission and support invoice reconciliation activities.
  • Coordinate with Finance to resolve invoice-related issues and ensure transaction accuracy.
  • Maintain procurement documentation and system records.

Quality Coordination & Issue Follow-up

  • Coordinate supplier responses for quality issues and corrective action follow-up.
  • Support defect return processes and purchasing-related system transactions.
  • Track issue closure and support supplier communication when required.
  • Participate in activities to improve supply quality and operational effectiveness.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Participate in KPI reviews, project meetings, pilot runs, and improvement activities.
  • Follow up agreed actions and support execution alignment across teams.
  • Build and maintain SOPs and operational documentation where applicable.
  • Complete training plans and contribute to internal improvement initiatives.
  • Support additional assignments and cross-functional projects as required.

資格

REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or related disciplines.
  • 0–3 years of experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Supply Chain, Operations, or related functions.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome.
  • Familiar with Microsoft Excel and ERP systems (SAP experience is preferred).
  • Basic understanding of procurement processes and supply chain concepts.
  • Good English communication capability.

DESIRED KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS

We value people who demonstrate：

  • Ownership and accountability
  • Strong attention to detail and execution discipline
  • Ability to organize information and manage priorities
  • Good communication and stakeholder coordination
  • Structured problem-solving mindset
  • Adaptability in a fast-changing environment
  • Curiosity to understand business operations and supply chain flow
  • Willingness to improve processes instead of repeatedly solving the same issues

Success in this role looks like：

  • Purchase orders are executed accurately and on time
  • Supply issues are identified and communicated early
  • Suppliers and internal teams experience efficient coordination
  • Daily operations become more stable and predictable
  • Gradual growth toward independently managing procurement activities
  • We trust people to own outcomes, not just execute tasks.

關於我們

Our comprehensive offering of solutions for residential, commercial, and data center markets makes us a benchmark for customers worldwide. We harness technological and societal trends with lasting impacts on buildings with the purpose of improving life by transforming the spaces where people live, work, and meet with electrical and digital infrastructures and connected solutions that are simple, innovative, and sustainable. Legrand is a global, publicly traded company listed on the Euronext (Legrand SA EPA: LR). For more information, visit www.legrandgroup.com/en

About Legrand’s Data Center Power and Control Division

The industry-leading brands of Approved Networks, Ortronics, Raritan, Server Technology, and Starline empower Legrand’s Data, Power & Control to produce innovative solutions for data centers, building networks, and facility infrastructures. job.title: Sustaining Engineering Manager
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Legrand has an exciting opportunity for a Sustaining Engineering Manager to join the Audio Video Division in Shenzhen, China.

This position leads engineering change activity (ECOs) and design modifications to support manufacturing efficiency, component obsolescence management, product compatibility, quality improvement, and customer-driven engineered solutions. While based in Shenzhen, the role works closely with U.S.-based Product Development, Operations, Quality, and Sourcing teams, as well as directly with contract manufacturing (CM) engineering teams. Design changes are developed locally and recommended for approval through U.S.-based governance.

This role is ideal for an experienced mechanical engineer who enjoys hands-on execution, cross-functional problem solving, and helping establish and mature sustaining engineering practices in a global product organization.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

The Sustaining Engineering Manager is a hands-on technical leader responsible for sustaining, improving, and extending the lifecycle of released products within our Display Infrastructure (mounts) portfolio. This role serves as a player/coach, combining direct technical contribution with day-to-day technical leadership and mentoring of a small local sustaining engineering team.

Sustaining Engineering & Technical Execution

  • Execute sustaining engineering activities for released products to ensure long-term performance, manufacturability, quality, and availability.
  • Create, analyze, and document Engineering Change Orders (ECOs), including problem definition, root-cause analysis, solution development, validation, and implementation support.
  • Develop and recommend design modifications to address component obsolescence, supplier changes, manufacturing improvements, quality issues, regulatory requirements, and product compatibility.
  • Own post-launch Design for Manufacturability (DFM) and Design for Assembly (DFA) improvements in collaboration with manufacturing partners.
  • Support customer-specific configurations and engineered solutions while maintaining alignment with product intent and manufacturing capability.
  • Review, update, and create mechanical CAD models, drawings, specifications, and bills of materials.
  • Perform engineering analysis as needed, including tolerance analysis and basic structural or thermal assessments; finite element analysis (FEA) experience is desirable but not required.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the primary sustaining engineering interface between the Shenzhen team, contract manufacturers, and U.S.-based Product Development, Quality, Sourcing, and Operations teams.
  • Communicate technical issues, proposed solutions, risks, and tradeoffs clearly and concisely in written English; participate in regular meetings across time zones.
  • Work directly with CM engineering teams to investigate production issues, yield challenges, and quality concerns, recommending corrective actions.
  • Support supplier-driven changes and secondary source qualifications in coordination with sourcing and quality partners.

Team Leadership & Process Development

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, mentoring, and task-level guidance to sustaining engineers and drafting resources.
  • Balance individual engineering execution with review and coaching of team deliverables to ensure technical accuracy and completeness.
  • Help define, document, and continuously improve sustaining engineering processes, including ECO workflows, documentation standards, and cross-site handoffs.
  • Encourage disciplined engineering practices, structured problem solving, and clear technical documentation.

General

  • Demonstrate Legrand’s core values of Integrity, Customer Responsiveness, Innovation, Passionate Contribution & Empowerment, and Continuous Improvement.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Essential Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Required:

  • Strong mechanical engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience in sustaining, product, or manufacturing engineering.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple engineering changes and priorities simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Working knowledge of ECO processes, configuration management, and controlled documentation systems.
  • Experience of collaborating directly with contract manufacturers and offshore production partners.
  • Proficiency in 3D CAD; SolidWorks experience strongly preferred.
  • Excellent written English communication skills required; strong spoken English proficiency preferred.
  • Proven problem-solving skills, including root-cause analysis and practical solution development.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while contributing effectively within a global, cross-functional team.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow-through.
  • Proficiency with common engineering and business software tools, including Microsoft Office; familiarity with SAP preferred.

Minimum Education and Experience Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or manufacturing engineering required.
  • 6–10 years of relevant experience in sustaining engineering, product design, or manufacturing engineering.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior technical leadership or people-management experience (preferred but not required).
  • Experience supporting mechanical assemblies such as metal, welded, or fabricated components typical of display and mounting systems.
  • Exposure to finite element analysis (FEA) tools and methods.
  • Experience supporting high-volume manufacturing environments, particularly in Asia.
  • Familiarity with PLM systems and formal change-control processes.

WORKING CONDITIONS / PHYSICAL DEMANDS

  • This role primarily involves seated work and regular use of a computer for design, analysis, and documentation.
  • Occasional domestic and international travel may be required.
  • The role requires scheduling flexibility to support regular collaboration with U.S.-based teams across time zones, which may include meetings outside standard local business hours.

The role establishes and maintains strong relationships throughout the project life cycle.

  • Ability to travel up to 15% on a regular basis and 20% occasionally, mainly in APAC, other locations as required.

Also exposed to certain high working areas like high ceiling or floor level.

description does not alter the at-will nature of employment with Legrand and does not create a contract of employment.

job.title: Deputy Manager - Mould Tool Development (MTDM)
job.description:
Job Description

The Deputy Manager will play a crucial role in developing, validating, and standardizing injection moulding processes for new and existing moulds. They will qualify moulds, support production commissioning, and establish robust parameters to maintain consistent quality and performance. This role is integral to the success of the Mould Tool Development (MTDM) department and the overall research and development efforts of the company.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct T1, T2, and follow-up mould trials at supplier sites to assess mould functionality and process capability.
  • Qualify new injection moulds at suppliers before dispatch, ensuring they meet quality standards.
  • Execute mould commissioning and validation at production plants, aiming for First Time Right (FTR) performance.
  • Optimize moulding process parameters for repeatability and efficiency.
  • Perform root cause analysis to identify and eliminate moulding defects, ensuring defect-free components.
  • Prepare and maintain comprehensive process documentation, including setting sheets, reports, and SOPs.
  • Coordinate with mould suppliers for trials, process optimization, and timely delivery of moulds.
  • Support cross-functional teams, including Production, Tool Room, Quality, and R&D, for successful mould commissioning.
  • Provide technical support and training to production and tool room teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Plastic, Polymer, or Tool & Die Engineering.
  • 8-12 years of experience in injection moulding process development, mould qualification, and production commissioning.
  • Scientific Injection Moulding certification is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience with injection moulding machines from leading manufacturers.
  • Strong knowledge of plastic material processing (PP, ABS, PC, etc.) and hot/cold runner systems.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD and Creo for interpreting engineering drawings and GD&T.
  • Understanding of DFM principles and mould construction.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001/14001/45001 systems and documentation.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and technical troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication and the ability to collaborate across functional teams.

job.title: Senior Manager
job.description:
Job Description

The Senior Manager - Corporate Finance & Controllership is responsible for leading the organization's finance operations, ensuring robust financial governance, regulatory compliance, effective cash management, and accurate financial reporting. The role oversees Accounting, Accounts Payable, Treasury, Direct Taxation, Statutory Audits, Internal Controls, and Internal Audit coordination while partnering closely with cross-functional teams to support business objectives and maintain strong compliance standards.

Responsibilities

Financial Accounting & Reporting

  • Lead and oversee all accounting activities ensuring accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.
  • Ensure timely month-end and year-end closing of books.
  • Review and validate financial statements, reconciliations, and accounting entries.
  • Drive continuous improvement in accounting processes and controls.

Accounts Payable Management

  • Ensure timely verification, approval, and processing of vendor payments.
  • Monitor payable cycles and maintain strong vendor relationships.
  • Ensure adherence to delegation of authority and payment control procedures.
  • Drive efficiencies and automation within the procure-to-pay process.

Treasury & Cash Flow Management

  • Manage working capital, cash flow planning, and liquidity requirements.
  • Monitor banking operations and maintain strong relation with bankers.
  • Ensure timely execution of payments and treasury transactions.
  • Validate EMDs & Bank Guarantee’s as per business requirement.
  • Support EXIM business for compliance and LC related activities where applicable.

Taxation & Regulatory Compliance

  • Oversee direct tax compliance.
  • Coordinate with external consultants for certifications, Form 15CA/CB.
  • Ensure compliance with all statutory, legal, and regulatory requirements with internal and external team.

Audit Management

  • Lead and coordinate statutory audit activities ensuring timely completion and closure of audit observations.
  • Manage internal audit engagements and facilitate implementation of corrective actions.
  • Act as the primary finance liaison with external auditors and internal audit teams.
  • Monitor audit findings and drive sustainable process improvements.

Internal Controls & Governance

  • Establish and maintain a robust internal control framework.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate policies and financial governance requirements and strong adherence to DOA.
  • Drive a strong control environment with a zero-tolerance approach toward compliance violations.
  • Conduct periodic reviews to identify and address financial and operational risks.

SG&A Analysis & Business Performance Monitoring

  • Prepare and present monthly SG&A expense analysis.
  • Analyze cost variances, spending trends, and key financial performance indicators.
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to management for cost optimization.
  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning activities.

Team Leadership & People Management

  • Lead and develop finance teams including plant finance and accounting personnel.
  • Allocate responsibilities, monitor team performance, and support capability development.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
  • Mentor team members and strengthen succession planning within the finance function.

Business Partnering

  • Collaborate closely with operations, procurement, sales, HR, legal, and other functions to support business requirements.
  • Provide financial guidance to stakeholders for strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Participate in business initiatives and transformation projects.
  • Ensure alignment between business objectives and financial governance requirements.

Managing of Numeric Subsidiary and Gratuity trust account

  • Interacting with Bankers for closure of Lanka Technology along with filing of annual income tax returns.
  • Annual filing of Income Tax return for Numeric Trust accounts.

Qualifications

Chartered Accountant with 8 to 10 years of relevant Experience

job.title: Plugs Assembler I
job.description:
Job Description

At a Glance

Starline – a company of Legrand has an exciting opportunity for an Assembler to join the Data, Power, Control Team in Singapore. The Assemblers manufactures and assembles a variety of configurations of mechanical and basic electrical assemblies used in electrical distribution systems.

Responsibilities

What Will You Do?

Essential Functions

  • Read shop drawings and wiring diagrams
  • Read Bills of Materials (BOMs) to determine component parts and assembly sequences of electromechanical units
  • Make electrical connections according to specifications
  • Assemble parts, and position, align, and fasten assemblies, subassemblies, using hand tools and power tools.
  • Modify parts by drilling, tapping, countersinking, etc. machine tools, power and pneumatic hand tools.
  • Position, align, and adjust parts for proper fit and assembly.
  • Measure parts to determine tolerances, using tape measures and precision measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers.
  • Attach labels and mark identifying information on parts.
  • Adhere to all company policies, guidelines and practices including the SECRIT values.

Additional Duties

  • Cross training to work in other functional department of the plant
  • Other duties as assigned by management.

Qualifications

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Tool selection — determining the kind of tools and equipment needed to do a job.
  • Oral Comprehension – The ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
  • Ability to operate cordless hand tools, power tools and pneumatic tools.
  • Ability to read shop drawings and wiring diagrams preferred.
  • Ability to read standard tape measure.
  • Ability to work in a cohesive team environment.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Level/A Level/ ITE or High School Diploma or equivalent
  • One year of experience in manufacturing preferred

Working Conditions / Physical Requirements

  • Lifting:  Ability to lift and carry up to 75 lbs occasionally; ability to lift and carry up to 25 lbs often.
  • Finger Dexterity: The ability to make precisely coordinated movements of the fingers of one or both hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble very small objects.
  • Manual Dexterity: The ability to quickly move hand, hand together with arm, or two hands to grasp, manipulate, or assemble objects.
  • Arm-Hand Steadiness: The ability to keep hand and arm steady while moving arm or while holding arm and hand in one position.
  • Vision: The ability to see details at a close range and have the ability to tell the difference in the colors of wires.

job.title: Process Engineer/ Senior Process Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Responsible for developing, improving, and maintaining manufacturing processes to achieve high productivity, quality, cost efficiency, and safety. Responsibilities

  • Define and maintain process parameters, work instructions, process standards, and specifications.
  • Improve machine, tooling, fixture, and automation concepts to enhance production performance.
  • Monitor and improve OEE, cycle time, scrap rate, downtime, and process capability.
  • Work with Quality to resolve process-related quality issues and implement continuous improvement.
  • Support production trials, engineering changes, and process modifications.

  • Evaluate production capacity and identify opportunities for additional capacity or process improvement.

  • Train and provide technical support to production operators and technicians.
  • Prepare technical reports, process documentation, and improvement proposals.

Qualifications

Educational Background and Experience.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Production Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of practical experience in a manufacturing environment, preferably in process engineering or production engineering.

Specific Requirements

  • Experience in manufacturing or process engineering.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, problem-solving tools, and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to analyze production data and identify improvement opportunities.

job.title: Group Manager - Trade and Experiential Marketing
job.description:
Job Description

A. Trade Marketing & Retail Excellence

  • Own the annual Trade Marketing strategy and calendar, aligned to business priorities, brand strategy, product launches, scheme calendars and regional market opportunities.
  • Develop the retail visibility strategy across Retail, Experience Centres and other relevant channels, including POSM, in-shop branding, display systems, outdoor branding and retail experience assets.
  • Define differentiated retail interventions by outlet/customer segment and ensure the POSM mix reflects priority categories, new launches and premiumization objectives.
  • Drive deployment and compliance of retail assets through the sales network; identify gaps through market visits, audits and data and close them with clear action plans.
  • Develop scalable retail toolkits and standards that improve counter share, shelf/display presence, shopper navigation and brand consistency.
  • Partner with Sales to identify high-potential outlets and markets where focused trade interventions can unlock incremental throughput, visibility or premium mix.

B. Experience Centres & Strategic Partner Activation

  • Build and manage an engagement calendar for Legrand’s Experience Centres (Studios/ ZIPs)
  • Improve the overall customer and shopper experience through displays, demonstrations, experiences, launch programs and partner-specific activations.
  • Develop programs that support incremental sales, lead generation, conversion and premiumization
  • Create post-activation measurement frameworks linking activity to sales uplift, leads/funnel movement, conversion and partner performance.

C. Experiential Marketing, BTL & Influencer Engagement

  • Own the BTL and experiential activation calendar across electricians, retailers, architects, dealers and other relevant influencers/decision-makers.
  • Develop concepts and execution frameworks for retailer meets, electrician engagement, product demonstrations, roadshows, consumer experiences, launches and other field activations.
  • Lead end-to-end planning of experiential programs: objective, audience, concept, agency brief, production, logistics, on-ground execution, measurement and post-event learning.
  • Ensure every experience is consistent with Legrand's premium brand standards while remaining relevant to the audience and commercial objective.
  • Build repeatable activation properties and playbooks rather than relying only on one-off events.

D. Events, Exhibitions & Brand Experiences

  • Lead Legrand’s participation in major exhibitions, industry events, customer events
  • Own event objectives and success metrics - visibility, engagement, qualified leads, customer/partner participation, sales opportunity and brand impact - rather than measuring events only on attendance.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders, agencies and vendors to ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.
  • Develop post-event reports with learnings, ROI/impact assessment and recommendations for future editions.

E. Agency, Vendor & Budget Management

  • Build and manage a capable ecosystem of regional and national vendors/fabricators/activation agencies to improve speed, quality and scalability of execution.
  • Drive vendor onboarding, rate benchmarking, negotiation, quality control, timelines, service levels and reconciliation.
  • Continuously identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising brand experience or execution quality.
  • Own allocated Trade/BTL/Experiential budgets, ensuring disciplined planning, approvals, utilization and ROI tracking.

F. Data, Measurement & Trade Marketing Dashboard

  • Establish a Trade Marketing dashboard covering deployment, outlet activation, visibility compliance, activation impact, Modern Trade scorecards, competition intelligence and spend.
  • Define simple, decision-oriented KPIs that connect marketing activity with business outcomes such as throughput, incremental sales, counter/shelf share, leads, conversion and premium mix.
  • Use DMS/sales data, retail audits, market intelligence and field feedback to identify opportunities and recommend corrective actions.
  • Institutionalize pre- and post-activity measurement and build a culture of test–learn–scale.

G. Cross-functional Leadership

  • Work closely with Sales, Brand, Product, Commercial, Procurement, Finance, Supply Chain and regional teams to convert business priorities into market execution.
  • Act as the bridge between Brand strategy and last-mile execution, ensuring that what is planned centrally is practical, scalable and measurable in-market.

Influence without authority and build strong relationships with sales leaders, channel partners, agencies and Vendors.

Responsibilities

  • Should have independently managed multi-city activations, retail visibility programs, exhibitions/events and external agencies/vendors.
  • Strong commercial orientation with the ability to connect marketing interventions to sales, throughput, conversion and ROI.
  • Comfort with data and dashboards; strong Excel and PowerPoint skills. Exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools is an advantage.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, vendors, timelines and budgets simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High ownership, attention to detail and willingness to travel extensively across India.

Qualifications

  • 4-5 years of relevant experience in Trade Marketing, Shopper Marketing, BTL, Experiential Marketing, Retail Marketing or Channel Marketing.
  • Experience in Building Materials & allied categories is preferred. Also open to Telecomm, Baggage, etc.

job.title: Lead Program Administrator
job.description:
Job Description

Project Coordinator (Lead Program Administrator) will oversee and support industrial automation projects within PAS-Power & Process Vertical from inception to completion. The Project Coordinator will assist in the planning, execution, and completion of the assigned projects. This role involves coordinating with various stakeholders, ensuring project milestones are met within time & budget, and maintaining high standards of quality and efficiency. The Project Coordinator will also be responsible for maintaining project documentation, tracking progress, and communicating updates to stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in industrial automation, power plant operations, project management, and excellent communication skills.

Responsibilities

The fulfillment of this role is essential due to the project volume and complexity. The lead program administrator shall handle and be responsible for:

•Project coordination for multiple clients and related vendors.

•Customer satisfaction, ensuring smooth execution and delivery.

•Coordination with Factory and Other Stake Holders for readiness of Control System for FAT at Shope floor.

•Monitor project progress and handle any issues that arise.

•Efficient execution of new projects to achieve targeted business numbers.

•Closure of legacy projects to maintain revenue flow and avoid penalties. Stakeholder management, including clients, vendors, and internal teams.

•Operational excellence, compliance, and safety management to reduce risks.

Core Activities* Work with Project manager closely to understand project requirement and support project execution from inception till closure.

  • Reporting daily progress to Project Manager and taking proactive actions.
  • Proactively identifying potential quality and efficiency improvements within assigned work.
  • Co-ordinate with the internal cross functional team like Factory, Procurements, Logistics, Stores and other relevant functions to keep day to day operations going on.
  • Project Planning, Scheduling and Execution:Support Project Managers to Develop detailed project plans, including timelines, budgets, and resource allocation. Ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards.
  • Stakeholder Coordination:Liaise with clients, vendors, and internal teams to ensure clear communication and alignment with project goals and deliverables.
  • Risk Management:Identify potential risks and develop a mitigation plan to ensure project success.
  • Quality Assurance:Implement and monitor quality control processes to ensure the highest standards of project delivery.
  • Documentation and Reporting:Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including progress reports, meeting minutes, and other project related documentation.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies. Monitor project progress to anticipate and resolve any issues that may arise.
  • Compliance:Ensure all projects comply with relevant industry standards, regulations, and safety protocols. CORA, GPMO, SAP etc. to be followed and maintained. Conduct regular reviews to ensure compliance throughout the project lifecycle.

Qualifications

  • Education:Bachelor’s degree/ or BBA, Project co-ordination experience in Industrial Automation DCS/ PLC/ SCADA projects, or a related field. CAPM certification is an added advantage.
  • Experience:Minimum of 8-12 years of experience in industrial automation and project management.
  • Skills:
  • Strong understanding of commercial T&C.
  • Strong understanding of industrial automation systems (DCS, PLC, SCADA & Cyber Security Products) and technologies.
  • Excellent project management skills, including planning, execution, and risk management.
  • Proficient in project management software (e.g., MS Project, Primavera).
  • Proficient in MS office software (e.g. MS Excel, Power Points, Word etc.)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Working Conditions:

job.title: Director User Exp Design
job.description:
Job Description

Honeywell User Experience (HUE) design studios lead the creation of next-generation experiences for the connected world. Leveraging well-established human-centered design principles, HUE ensures that Honeywell products and applications are the most useful, usable, and desirable in the marketplace. The studios operate globally across North America, Europe, China, and Australia, fostering a collegial,

ROLE OVERVIEW

The PA HUE Leader at HTCS is a senior design executive responsible for two interconnected capabilities: (1) leading the HUE Design Studio for the Process Automation (PA) business, driving the UX vision, strategy, and delivery aligned with the PA SBG and GBE leadership; and (2) overseeing the Technical Writer team, ensuring that product knowledge is translated into accurate, user-centered documentation that enhances the overall customer experience.

This dual mandate positions the PA HUE Leader as a key steward of both visual-interactive experience design and content-driven experience design — recognizing that great products must be equally well-designed and well-documented.

Responsibilities

SCOPE OF LEADERSHIP

A. HUE Design Studio — Process Automation

Lead a growing, multidisciplinary team of User Experience designers delivering next-generation, delightful solutions across the PA product portfolio. Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing design capability and infrastructure aligned with PA business strategy.
  • Recruiting, developing, and managing UX design talent; managing resources and operational plans.
  • Overseeing multidisciplinary competencies: design research, experience design, interaction design, visual design, and industrial design.
  • Driving 2–3 high-impact, innovative offerings based on a UX-led approach.
  • Delivering design projects on time to support business growth and enhance product value.
  • Collaborating with PA Global Experience Design teams to implement a design strategy aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Contributing to HUE best practices for User Experience Design throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Participating as a decision-maker at project reviews; providing a clear, consistent UX perspective to teams and stakeholders.
  • Creating and executing human-centered designs that differentiate Honeywell brands globally.
  • Applying, building, and evolving the Honeywell Design Language System (DLS) and brand identity program.
  • Contributing to management updates, operational reviews, and leadership dialogue at HUE Global Leadership and HTS India Leadership.
  • Collaborating with all Honeywell functions that interact with customers to deliver end-to-end journey alignment.
  • Establishing a framework for regular usability testing with dedicated UX researchers embedded across studios.
  • Overseeing co-creation workshops with end users to inform new product and service development.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data visualization and interpretability through design.
  • Promoting a holistic, end-to-end user experience strategy across all product touchpoints.
  • Championing system thinking and storytelling techniques to align product vision with user needs.

B. Technical Writer Team — Documentation & Content Experience

Provide leadership and strategic direction to the Technical Writer team, ensuring product documentation is accurate, structured, and user-centered. This team is integral to the customer experience and works at the intersection of product knowledge and communication design. Key responsibilities include:

  • Overseeing end-to-end documentation for products and programs, covering user guides, installation manuals, administrator guides, and troubleshooting references.
  • Directing the development of feature walkthroughs, process flow documentation, and security white papers.
  • Ensuring the team effectively uses MadCap Flare to produce high-quality HTML and PDF documentation.
  • Guiding the creation of HTML-based user assistant files that enhance in-product guidance.
  • Building and managing a structured review and feedback cycle with key stakeholders — developers, testing teams, program managers, installation teams, and security teams.
  • Embedding technical writing quality standards focused on content accuracy, clarity, and consistency.
  • Aligning documentation strategy with the broader UX and product experience roadmap, ensuring parity between product design intent and user-facing documentation.
  • Fostering a culture of continuous improvement within the technical writing function, including upskilling in structured authoring and content design principles.

Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

Education

Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) from an institute of repute in Design, Human Factors, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 12 or more years of experience in User Experience design of products and software applications.
  • Demonstrated experience in a senior design leadership role, managing multidisciplinary teams including UX designers, researchers, and/or technical writers.
  • Experience working in Agile environments with lean UX methodologies.
  • International experience working with regional businesses and geographically distributed design teams.
  • Proven track record of delivering innovative, market-released UX design solutions; portfolio required.
  • Experience directing and managing external design and development firms.
  • Exposure to or direct experience overseeing technical documentation functions is an advantage.

Design & Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in UX design tools: Figma, prototyping platforms, interaction and visual design toolsets.
  • Deep understanding of Design Language Systems and brand identity programs.
  • Ability to create low-fidelity to high-fidelity prototypes across the design lifecycle.
  • Demonstrated research skills across qualitative and quantitative methods.
  • Familiarity with technical documentation platforms (e.g., MadCap Flare, HTML/PDF publishing pipelines) is desirable.
  • Understanding of structured content principles, single-source publishing, and content strategy.

Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Ability to translate complex vision into understandable concepts and workable design narratives.
  • Strong ability to influence product, software, hardware, and development teams during early-stage development.

Required Skills

  • B.Des, M.Des
  • Team handling
  • UX design
  • Ux Research

job.title: Construction Manager MEP
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Construction Manager (MEP) oversees the comprehensive lifecycle of MEP construction projects, ensuring efficient project planning, execution, and handover. This role requires expertise in managing mechanical and electrical systems, coordinating with site teams and contractors, and maintaining effective communication with all stakeholders to meet project objectives.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Management & Leadership

  • Oversee the entire MEP construction lifecycle, including planning, execution, and handover phases.
  • Coordinate with site and contractor teams to ensure timely completion of M&E project milestones.
  • Identify and mitigate project risks, ensuring clear communication of updates on schedules, budgets, and technical issues to stakeholders.

Contract & Financial Management

  • Lead MEP specific contract negotiations and oversee amendments with architects, consultants, and subcontractors.
  • Evaluate MEP construction methods for cost-effectiveness, monitor budget adherence, and produce regular progress and financial reports.

Stakeholder & Contractor Relations

  • Manage relationships with key stakeholders, including contractors, consultants, and relevant authorities, ensuring adherence to project standards.
  • Provide support to local teams on customer discussions regarding M&E project progress and any technical challenges.

Design & Systems Coordination

  • Collaborate closely with external consultants to ensure effective design and construction of MEP systems within data centers, covering HVAC, electrical distribution, fire protection, plumbing and other critical infrastructure.
  • Ensure the successful handover of MEP systems to operational teams, addressing any outstanding issues or deficiencies.

Safety & Compliance

  • Lead safety initiatives on-site, ensuring full compliance with MEP regulations and industry standards.
  • Oversee adherence to all relevant permitting and government authority requirements for MEP projects.

Continuous Improvement & Quality Assurance

  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement and collaboration within the project team.
  • Implement advanced project management and quality control techniques to optimize M&E project outcomes.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in construction project management within the MEPor engineering field; additional experience in data center projects is highly preferred.
  • Proven experience in delivering large-scale MEP projects, with strong knowledge of HVAC, power systems, fire protection and plumbing.
  • Expertise in MEP systems, local authority approval processes, and testing and commissioning of critical infrastructure in data centers, including Integrated Systems Testing (IST).
  • Solid understanding of CAPEX planning, cost estimation, and total cost of ownership (TCO) for M&E systems in data centers.
  • Engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or related field.
  • Proficiency in project management tools, MS Project, and MS Office, with excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Demonstrates initiative, collaboration, and resilience under pressure.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages in the APAC region are advantageous.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Construction Manager, CSA
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Construction Manager, CSA Chonburi, Thailand | On-Site | Permanent

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. In Chonburi, we are developing one of Southeast Asia’s most significant greenfield data center campuses on a path to Thailand’s first 1GW platform. The CSA scope on this build is central to everything.

About the Role

You’ll own the civil, structural, and architectural construction scope on a live hyperscale data center project in Chonburi — from design coordination and installation oversight through to first-of-kind sign-off, QA/QC, and handover. This is a technically demanding, hands-on role. You’ll be expected to speak fluently to the specifics of your own project experience, not describe it in general terms.

Design and Planning

  • Review and provide technical input to CSA design plans, specifications, and drawings, ensuring compliance with applicable codes and regulations.
  • Coordinate with architects, engineers, and consultants to integrate CSA requirements into overall facility design.

Construction Oversight

  • Manage installation and construction of CSA systems on site, ensuring adherence to design specifications and safety standards.
  • Conduct site inspections to monitor progress, resolve issues, and verify quality of installations.
  • Manage contractors, subcontractors, and suppliers — coordinate schedules and resolve conflicts to keep the CSA program on track.

Reporting and Program Control

  • Prepare weekly and monthly programme updates including high-level milestone tracking, S-curve reports, and Earned Value Management analysis against plan.
  • Prepare reports on project progress, delays, and defects, along with supporting technical analysis.

First-of-Kind, QA/QC, and Handover

  • Review and sign off on first-of-kind works, mock-ups, and CSA inspections to confirm proper functionality and performance.
  • Coordinate QA/QC verification and defects clearance with contractors and stakeholders before handover.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve operational issues arising during construction and handover phases.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 8 to 10 years of experience in CSA construction management, preferably in data center or comparable mission-critical environments.
  • Demonstrated, specific experience with facade, architectural openings, waterproofing, and interior finishes including walls, floors, and ceilings — candidates should be able to speak to their own project scope in detail.
  • Direct experience preparing and reviewing S-curve reports and Earned Value Management analysis.
  • Direct experience with first-of-kind and mock-up review, QA/QC verification, and defects clearance processes on an active construction site.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or Revit. Familiarity with BIM tools is an advantage.
  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or a related field.
  • English and Thai required for site-level coordination and local authority engagement.

Soft Skills

  • Discusses their own CSA project experience with enough technical specificity to be assessed against real scope, not general project management language.
  • Manages multiple contractors and trades simultaneously without losing oversight of quality or program.
  • Identifies and escalates technical and program risks early, before they affect the broader construction schedule.

Nice to Have

  • Data center or mission-critical project experience specifically.
  • Familiarity with CONQUAS or an equivalent QA framework.
  • Proficiency with MS Project, Primavera, or Power BI for program reporting.

Why DayOne? The Chonburi campus is one of the most significant data center builds in Southeast Asia right now, and CSA is central to it. You’ll have full workstream ownership on a hyperscale facility, work alongside a multinational team operating to international standards, and deliver infrastructure that will run for decades. DayOne is a well-funded company at an active growth stage — the people who build well here build their careers here too.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Senior Director, Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Establish and track delivery against KPIs, SLAs, and metrics (incl. performance, capacity, availability, budget)
  • Oversee on-the-ground incident response, problem resolution, and change management communicating closely with key customers about resolution to support Equinix customer experience
  • Establish critical business continuity plans, including design and implementation of disaster preparedness, detailed project management, and logistics coordination
  • Establish and track safety measures to ensure safety of front-line resources
  • Ensure consistency in experience and on-the-ground response across data centres in the country
  • Contribute to the centres of excellence as and when appropriate and implement policies and procedures to ensure global consistency and effectiveness
  • Contribute to and/or support other departments to achieve endorsed business objectives
  • Coordinate with global design and construction team to ensure global consistency and effectiveness
  • Lead a diverse team - shape a collaborative, transparent, and entrepreneurial culture, in tandem with the extended global operations leadership and the corporate leadership team
  • Motivate employees around shared vision and change story in line with our world-wide transformation agenda
  • Empower front line resources to meet customer needs through incentives and process

Profile Required

  • Excellent experience in cross-functional management and in leading and operating in a matrixed environment
  • Substantial experience in optimising a growing and evolving business – leading a large organisation through a period of rapid growth, merger integration, or business transition
  • Strong focus on execution and results – establishing high standards for performance, setting goals and developing plans, following through and holding people accountable for results

job.title: Manager, Physical Security Enablement - Singapore - Mascot
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Manager, Physical Security Enablement to lead the successful delivery and integration of physical security programs across new data centre developments, expansions and major customer initiatives throughout Asia-Pacific.

Reporting into the regional leadership team, this role combines program leadership, physical security expertise and stakeholder management to ensure security systems, processes and vendors are aligned throughout the design, construction, installation, commissioning and handover phases of our projects.

This is a highly visible regional role supporting construction and expansion projects across Asia, requiring regular travel sites. Candidates who enjoy working in dynamic environments, influencing cross-functional teams and seeing projects come to life from concept through to operational handover will thrive in this position.

Regular travel throughout Asia should be expected, including visits during design validation, installation, commissioning, operational readiness and handover phases. The successful candidate should enjoy being on-site and working directly with project teams, stakeholders and vendors to drive successful outcomes.

Responsibilities

Physical Security Program Enablement

  • Lead the deployment and integration of physical security programs across new data centre builds and expansion projects throughout Asia-Pacific
  • Partner closely with Global Design & Construction (GDC), Data Centre Operations and Security Program teams to ensure security requirements are successfully incorporated into project delivery
  • Support security readiness activities during design, construction, installation, commissioning and operational handover
  • Identify and mitigate physical security risks throughout the project lifecycle
  • Drive consistency and standardisation of physical security practices across the region

Project & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Lead multiple concurrent security enablement initiatives across geographically dispersed locations
  • Partner with internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants and vendors to ensure successful project outcomes
  • Provide guidance and leadership to regional security teams supporting active project sites
  • Influence cross-functional teams to deliver security solutions that support both operational excellence and customer requirements
  • Act as a key escalation point for security-related incidents, project risks and vendor performance issues

Security Systems & Technical Oversight

  • Provide leadership and oversight across physical security technologies including access control, video surveillance, intrusion detection and associated infrastructure
  • Support installation, commissioning, testing and operational acceptance of security systems
  • Manage security vendor relationships responsible for hardware installation, upgrades, maintenance and support
  • Lead SPOF (Single Point of Failure) and End-of-Life (EOL) assessments and remediation initiatives
  • Support issue resolution, root cause analysis and vendor escalation for complex technical security challenges

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop a small regional team, and own performance management with direct reports currently based in Singapore
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability and continuous improvement
  • Provide coaching, mentoring and guidance to security professionals supporting regional programs and projects

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading physical security programs, projects or operations within a data centre, mission-critical, hyperscale, telecommunications, infrastructure or high-security environment
  • Experience supporting large-scale construction, commissioning, fit-out or infrastructure projects
  • Strong stakeholder management capabilities across engineering, construction, operations and vendor organisations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams and influencing cross-functional stakeholders
  • Strong understanding of physical security systems and their deployment within operational environments
  • Experience supporting new builds, expansions and commissioning activities
  • Experience working with security systems integrators, consultants and technology vendors
  • Understanding of project lifecycle delivery from design through operational handover
  • Experience working within highly regulated, operationally critical or customer-facing environments
  • Knowledge of business continuity, security governance and risk management practices

Benefits of the role:

  • Direct impact on some of the largest digital infrastructure projects in Asia-Pacific
  • Opportunity to shape physical security standards across a growing regional portfolio
  • High visibility role with significant stakeholder engagement across Operations, Security, Engineering and Construction teams
  • Leadership opportunity with regional scope and influence, including APAC travel
  • Salary package containing company shares, annual bonus and salary reviews
  • Onsite gyms, access to company wellness, financial and other benefits and initiatives
  • Exposure to industry-leading technology, innovation and mission-critical operations
