job.title: Lead Data Platform Engineer
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Platform Engineering & Operations:

Own AWS infrastructure for DXP Data Platform (multi-AZ, multi-VPC setup).

1.

  • Administer Snowflake environments, including user roles, RBAC, performance optimization, warehouse lifecycle, and cost controls.

1.

  • Manage SageMaker environments (Studio, Canvas, Notebooks) for enabling multi-domain ML use cases.

1.

  • Operate DataPipes (EKS + Airflow) for ingestion orchestration, ensuring high availability and version-controlled configurations via IaC (CloudFormation/CDK).

1.

  • Maintain & enhance logging, monitoring, observability & DevOps automation via modern tools such as CloudWatch, Splunk, PagerDuty, Slack, ServiceNow, Snowflake observability features.
  • Platform Prototyping & Enhancement:

1.

  • Design, prototype, and implement new platform features across AWS, Snowflake, and SageMaker to support innovation in data processing, analytics, and ML operations.
  • Lead rollout and production hardening of new platform components (e.g., new Snowflake Cortex AI features, SageMaker pipelines, AWS-native services).
  • Evaluate and integrate new services or capabilities aligned to StarHub’s data platform roadmap.
  • Develop technical design standards and documentation for new features and automation processes.
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement:

Implement Day 2 platform enhancements including auto-scaling, self-healing workflows, and CI/CD automation.

  • Enhance EKS cluster performance, pipeline automation, and integration efficiency across cloud and on-prem data sources.
  • Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption for all environments and standardize rollout strategies (blue-green/canary).
  • Governance, Security & Compliance:

Enforce enterprise security policies for IAM, VPC isolation, PrivateLink, and encryption (KMS, Secrets Manager).

  • Coordinate vulnerability remediation (EKS upgrades, CVE patching, EC2 AMI refresh, Docker image hardening).
  • Ensure infrastructure audit readiness in partnership with Information Security (ITSec) and Compliance teams.
  • Operations & Cost Management:

Monitor and optimize Snowflake warehouse utilization, compute spend, and S3 data lifecycle management.

  • Maintain tagging, dashboards, and cost visibility frameworks across AWS and Snowflake.
  • Implement cost governance guardrails and usage quotas across platform components.
  • Team & Vendor Leadership:

Lead a blended team of StarHub engineers and partner vendors responsible for platform sustainment and evolution.

  • Manage augmented vendor teams, ensuring consistent delivery quality and knowledge transfer to internal engineers.
  • Build in-house capability in platform engineering, IaC, and automation disciplines.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: DXP Data Platform infrastructure (AWS, Snowflake, SageMaker, Datapipe) supporting C360, AI/ML, and analytics workloads enterprise-wide.
  • Decision Rights: Platform design approval, selection of new AWS/Snowflake/SageMaker capabilities, DevOps tooling and IaC framework choices, and vendor performance oversight.
  • Stakeholders: Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Architecture & Governance, Information Security, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Resources: Hybrid team of ~2-4 engineers (StarHub and partner resources) managing infrastructure, platform automation, enhancements, and operations.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 8-10 years of experience in cloud and platform engineering, with extensive experience on AWS-based data platforms.
  • Proven leadership of cross-functional engineering teams managing production-grade, multi-environment platforms.
  • Hands-on expertise in:

AWS Services: VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, KMS, CloudFormation/CDK, Transfer Family, CloudWatch, CloudTrail.

Snowflake: administration, RBAC, warehouse optimization, DevOps automation, Cortex AI, and Streamlit integration.

EKS / Airflow / Airbyte (Datapipe): container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.

SageMaker: multi-domain setup, pipeline management, Studio/Canvas lifecycle, and MLOps enablement.

Monitoring & Observability: CloudWatch, Splunk, Snowflake Account Usage, cost dashboards, PagerDuty, Slack, ServiceNow.

  • Demonstrated success in prototyping, implementing, and scaling new cloud and data platform features into production.
  • Experience managing Day 2 operations, incident response, and SRE-driven performance stabilization.
  • Familiarity with machine learning integration and model lifecycle management.
  • Experience enforcing ITSec and compliance standards (IAM, KMS, PDPA/GDPR).
  • Proven success in transitioning platform operations from vendor-managed to in-house ownership.

job.title: Senior Client Acquisition Manager
job.description:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Challenger Sales Representative to join our team. As a Challenger, you will play a key role in driving sales growth by challenging customers' thinking, providing valuable insights, and guiding them toward innovative solutions. The ideal candidate is assertive, confident, and excels in complex sales environments.

  • Challenge customer assumptions by proactively engage customers in thought-provoking conversations to challenge their assumptions and broaden their perspective.
  • Provide new insights and industry knowledge that position our products/services as innovative solutions.
  • Lead sales discussions with confidence and take control of the conversation to guide customers through the decision-making process.
  • Conduct in-depth research to understand the customer's business, needs, and challenges.
  • Tailor solutions to address specific customer pain points and demonstrate a deep understanding of their unique requirements.
  • Act as an educator by teaching customers something new about their industry, market trends, or potential areas for improvement.
  • Provide valuable insights that position our offerings as strategic assets.
  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships and develop trusted advisor relationships with key executives and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Holds ownership of bigger sized portfolio revenue and account matrix.
  • Develop new business with existing clients and/or identify areas of new opportunities, present, negotiate and close to meet sales quotas.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional internal departments to ensure that clients requirements are understood and met.
  • Assist with challenging client request or issue escalation as needed.

Requirements

  • At least Diploma in any discipline with preference for technology related discipline and minimum 6 years’ sales experience in telco and solutions selling
  • In-depth knowledge of telco & system integrator environment will be preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to challenge customer thinking and provide unique insights tailored to the specific needs and challenges of enterprise and government clients.
  • Strong understanding of complex sales cycles and the ability to navigate procurement processes within enterprise and government organizations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and establish trust at the executive level.
  • Confidence in leading sales conversations and taking control of the sales process, especially in engagements with enterprise or government decision-makers.
  • Proven success in meeting or exceeding sales targets in a service-oriented and solution-based sales environment.

job.title: Application Specialist SPDM
job.description:
At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse talent with technical acumen to develop tomorrow’s reality. With Engineering Enterprise Apps and Engineering AI solutions, we are uniquely positioned to have an immediate impact on the transformation at our customers to leverage the full value of their simulation analyses and data and AI – and create much better products much faster.

About the role

The Application Specialists team is an essential component of the Engineering Enterprise Apps & Engineering AI product management team by offering top-tier expertise in the solution portfolio as well as the key industry sectors and applications. With the team of application specialists we develop advanced workflows and best practices that boost our customers' productivity. Such workflows and best practices will directly impact our ability to accelerate sales cycles in pre-sales context, as well as being an essential instrument to achieve effective customer adoption and hence create expansion opportunities at our customers.

The work involves connecting the relevant product lines from the Simcenter portfolio, fostering advanced technical thought leadership, and maximizing the visibility and business success of the Simcenter portfolio.

Responsibilities

As Application Specialist you stand in the center of a continuously evolving solution portfolio bringing new features & functionalities with every release, and the dynamics of an equally fast evolving market where new trends and opportunities arise as a result of emerging new technology. The challenge of the application specialist will be to understand our customers’ current and future challenges and to articulate the value of the EEA portfolio through well documented, industry-relevant, example use cases that show our customer the potential of advancing their ways of working with our EEA portfolio.

You will look across the boundaries of individual products and will be able to identify synergies and opportunities for improvement at the interface of our technologies so as to deliver a seamless experience for our end users.

Activities also include

  • Supporting portfolio developers, business development teams, sales and pre-sales teams in customer pursuits with dedicated Proof-of-Concept development and demonstration
  • Relaying customer and market needs and trends to the product management teams
  • Act as a sounding board to the product management teams for new requirement / specification development
  • Active stakeholder in product milestone demonstrations, technical enablement, etc
  • Assisting in the development of collateral for the relevant campaigns and technical marketing initiatives
  • Participating and presenting at internal and external webinars, seminars and user conferences
  • Promoting the portfolio through writing blog posts, posting videos, contributing in discussion forums etc.

Your qualifications

We are looking for someone who is an excellent communicator and capable of translating a value proposition and associated content at the level of different audience. You are self-organized and know how to handle incoming requests from many different angles and varying priority, while creating high-quality deliverables. You are a permanent learner – whether product, market, trends, you stay up to date and well informed.

Specific qualifications we will be looking for :

  • Extensive expertise as application engineer in simulation ; leveraging AI, data and data management, and simulation process orchestration as tools
  • Hands-on experience with Siemens’ Simcenter EEA portfolio is a plus
  • Hands-on experience in engineering verification and validation processes, through simulation and/or physical testing in either automotive, aerospace or defense industry. Awareness about the value of traceable, correctly annotated data to support reuse and improve efficiency and quality of results.
  • Strong written, communication and presentation skills in English
  • Knowledge of applicable solutions for documenting engineering workflows (SolutionLink, …) is a plus
  • Able to travel occasionally

Why us?

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

At Siemens, we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds

Our Benefits & Rewards

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the SIEMENS Benefit [link](http://https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/).

The primary locations for this opportunity are Romania, Belgium, and India. The applicable salary ranges for these locations are:

Romania: RON 145.300 – RON 276.000

Belgium: €53.500 – €96.300

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees (benefits availability varies by country).

This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.

job.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor
job.description:
Position Summary

We are seeking a Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor to strengthen cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance capabilities across business functions and digital solutions. The role will serve as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders, technology teams, and leadership by ensuring cybersecurity requirements, regulatory obligations, and corporate policies are effectively integrated into business operations and digital programs.

The Cybersecurity & Compliance Advisor will assess security risks, define mitigation strategies, support compliance initiatives, and guide teams through security assurance activities across cloud, enterprise, and operational technology environments. The position requires strong expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, security controls, risk management, and regulatory compliance, combined with the ability to translate technical requirements into practical business solutions.

This is a highly collaborative role requiring effective stakeholder engagement, governance leadership, and the ability to drive security awareness and compliance maturity across global and cross-functional teams.

A Snapshot of your Day

A typical day involves collaborating with project teams, solution architects, IT leaders, and business stakeholders to evaluate cybersecurity risks and compliance requirements for ongoing initiatives. You review security assessments, advise on remediation activities, and ensure controls align with enterprise standards and regulatory obligations.

You may participate in governance reviews, support audits, assess cloud and application security designs, and provide recommendations that enable secure business operations while balancing productivity, innovation, and risk management objectives.

How You’ll Make an Impact (responsibilities of role)

Strategic

  • Develop and promote cybersecurity governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls that align with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise business and technology leaders on cybersecurity risks, compliance obligations, and security-by-design principles during digital transformation initiatives.
  • Drive cybersecurity risk management programs by identifying emerging threats, assessing business impact, and recommending pragmatic mitigation strategies.
  • Support the development and execution of compliance roadmaps to improve organizational security maturity and regulatory readiness.
  • Partner with stakeholders to establish security requirements for enterprise applications, cloud services, operational systems, and third-party solutions.
  • Monitor cybersecurity trends, industry standards, and evolving regulations, ensuring the organization remains aligned with best practices and compliance expectations.
  • Promote security awareness and foster a culture of accountability for cybersecurity and data protection throughout the organization.

Operational

  • Conduct security risk assessments, control reviews, and compliance evaluations across applications, infrastructure, cloud environments, and operational processes.
  • Support internal and external audits by coordinating evidence collection, control validation, remediation tracking, and compliance reporting.
  • Review solution architectures, project designs, and implementation plan to identify security gaps and recommend appropriate controls.
  • Perform vendor and third-party security assessments to evaluate cybersecurity posture and contractual compliance requirements.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to implement security controls related to identity management, data protection, network security, monitoring, and incident response.
  • Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, and compliance deviations while driving corrective and preventive actions.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned activities from a governance and compliance perspective.
  • Maintain cybersecurity documentation, risk registers, policy records, and compliance artifacts to support governance and auditability.

What You Bring (required qualification and skill sets)

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, information security governance, compliance, risk management, or related advisory roles.
  • Strong knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and industry standards such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting compliance programs related to data privacy, information security, cloud security, and regulatory requirements.
  • Proven ability to conduct security risk assessments, define mitigation plans, and communicate risk decisions to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with enterprise security controls including identity and access management, data protection, security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident response.
  • Strong understanding of cloud security principles across Azure, AWS, or hybrid environments.
  • Experience collaborating with global cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to balance security requirements with operational and business objectives while driving practical outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CCSP, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting cybersecurity requirements within industrial, energy, engineering, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure environments.
  • Knowledge of Operational Technology (OT) security and industrial cybersecurity controls.
  • Familiarity with data privacy regulations and compliance frameworks such as GDPR and related international standards.
  • Experience with security governance platforms, GRC solutions, and audit management tools.
  • Exposure to DevSecOps practices and secure software development lifecycle methodologies.
  • Experience leading cybersecurity awareness initiatives, compliance assessments, or regulatory audits at enterprise scale.

Tech Stack

  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC): ServiceNow GRC, RSA Archer, MetricStream, or similar platforms for risk management, control monitoring, and audit readiness.
  • Cloud Security: Microsoft Azure Security Center, Microsoft Defender, AWS Security Services, and cloud governance solutions to manage security posture and compliance.
  • Identity & Access Management: Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Privileged Access Management, RBAC, and multi-factor authentication technologies.
  • Security Monitoring & Threat Detection: SIEM and security analytics platforms such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, QRadar, or equivalent solutions.
  • Vulnerability & Risk Management: Tenable, Qualys, Rapid7, or similar solutions for vulnerability assessment, remediation tracking, and risk reporting.
  • Compliance & Audit Management: Policy management, evidence collection, control testing, and regulatory reporting tools supporting governance activities.
  • Collaboration & Reporting: Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint, Power BI, and ServiceNow for stakeholder engagement, reporting, and governance workflows.
  • Methodologies & Frameworks: ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, IEC 62443, Risk Management Frameworks, and Security-by-Design principles.

job.title: Project Manager - Data Centres
job.description:
As Australia's digital economy continues to accelerate, Siemens is playing a critical role in enabling the next generation of data centre infrastructure. Through our Electrification & Automation business, we deliver innovative power distribution, automation, digitalisation and energy solutions that help hyperscale, colocation and enterprise customers build resilient, sustainable and high-performing facilities.

Siemens are looking for a highly experienced Data Centre Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of integrated power solutions across Australia's rapidly growing data centre market. Sitting within Siemens' Electrification & Automation business, you'll drive end-to-end project excellence, technical quality, and customer satisfaction across mission-critical infrastructure — delivering resilient, high-performance solutions aligned to global standards and local market needs. The successful candidate will be responsible for:

  • Leading end-to-end delivery of large-scale data centre projects, ensuring scope, schedule, cost, and quality objectives are consistently achieved across multiple concurrent programs
  • Overseeing the full lifecycle of MV switchgear and integrated power distribution systems, from design through to commissioning, maintaining best-practice standards in testing and lifecycle performance
  • Building and maintain senior relationships with data centre developers, contractors, and operators — acting as a trusted advisor and leading contract negotiations, variation management, and commercial discussions

job.title: 财务控制专家 大连
job.description:
加入西门子，共创明日世界！

西门子传感器与通讯有限公司​（SSCL）成立于2006年10月，是西门子全球智能测量仪器主要的生产制造基地之一。公司专注于智能压力变送器、阀门定位器、流量计等高精度智能测量仪表的研发、生产和服务，为客户提供一站式、全面的创新解决方案。产品广泛应用于水务、化工、OEM、钢铁、电力、制药、数据中心等行业。我们将数字化和精益理念深度融入生产运营的各个环节，为客户提供高效可靠的优质产品和服务，助力客户成功，共同迈向智能未来。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

  • 利用数据分析为管理层提供战略性和决策性见解。
  • 整合预算，包括自上而下和自下而上的计划，并进行滚动中期规划和年度周期性预测。
  • 执行实际与计划的比较，并跟进已商定措施的效果。
  • 分析和评估成本结构，并改进相关的成本核算系统。
  • 提供定期业务报告，说明整体绩效，并向负责管理层提出行动建议。
  • 进行分析和盈利能力计算。
  • 为控制相关的概念和项目工作做出贡献。
  • 牵头实施和优化数字化控制工具和技术，以提高效率和洞察力。

你需要具备的品质：

  • 本科及以上学历。
  • 在高级控制或财务业务伙伴角色中拥有8年以上经验，最好是在制造行业环境中。
  • 对财务规划、分析和报告有透彻的理解，并具备解释和沟通复杂数据的能力。
  • 展示出战略性思维、识别增长机会并为整体业务战略做出贡献的能力。
  • 成长型思维，对持续学习和专业发展充满热情。
  • 强大的沟通和协作能力，能够与不同的利益相关者有效互动。
  • 熟练使用办公工具，包括SAP、Excel、ThinkCell等。精通数字工具者优先，例如：AI、Power BI等
  • 英语听、说、读、写流利。

你将得到这些收获：

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作
  • 带薪享超长15天年假，还有圣诞假等额外福利
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

English Version:

SSCL was established in October 2006 and is one of the main production and manufacturing bases for Siemens' global intelligent measuring instruments. Focusing on the research and development, production, and service of high-precision intelligent measuring instruments such as intelligent pressure transmitters, valve positioners, and flow meters, we provide customers with one-stop and comprehensive innovative solutions. The product is widely used in water, chemical, OEM, steel, electricity, pharmaceuticals, data centers, etc. Deeply rooted in the concepts of digitization and lean in every aspect of production and operation, we provide customers with efficient and reliable high-quality products and services, help them succeed, and jointly move towards an intelligent future.

You'll make an impact by

  • Leverage data analytics to deliver strategic and decision-making insights for management.
  • Consolidate budgets, including top-down and bottom-up plans, and proceed with revolving mid-term planning and periodic forecasts during the year.
  • Perform comparisons of Actual vs. Plan, and pursue the effects of agreed measures.
  • Analyze and evaluate cost structures, and improve the dependent cost accounting system.
  • Provide regular business reports, with respect to overall performance, and recommend actions to accountable management.
  • Carry out analyses and profitability calculations.
  • Contribute to conceptual and project work related to controlling.
  • Spearhead the implementation and optimization of digital controlling tools and technologies to enhance efficiency and insights.

Your defining qualities

  • Bachelor's degree or above.
  • Proven track record of 8+ years in a senior controlling or finance business partnering role, ideally in a manufacturing environment.
  • Thorough understanding of financial planning, analysis, and reporting, with the ability to interpret and communicate complex data.
  • Demonstrated ability to think strategically, identify growth opportunities, and contribute to the overall business strategy.
  • Growth mindset, with a passion for continuous learning and professional development.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively engage with different stakeholders.
  • Professional in using office tool，including SAP，excel，thinkcell etc.Advanced proficiency in digital tools is highly preferred, eg: AI, power BI
  • Fluent in English listening, speaking, reading and writing

You'll benefit from

  • Diverse and inclusive culture, doing the work you like with people who appreciate it.
  • Systematic career development platform, various training courses, and online learning resources for you to help you tailor your growth path based on your strengths.
  • 15 days+ annual leaves, with additional benefits such as Christmas leave.
  • Generous benefits package, long-term care corporate annuity plan, flexible allocation of commercial insurance, employee stock sharing matching plan for mutual growth, etc.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. Solution Engineering Manager – Primary Engineering

Location: Kolkata

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Solution Engineer – Primary Engineering, you will play a key role in the engineering and design of High Voltage (HV) and Extra High Voltage (EHV) substations, supporting the successful execution of power transmission and distribution projects across industries, data centers, utilities, and grid substations.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing primary engineering solutions for AIS substations up to 765kV and GIS substations up to 400kV. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams including Secondary Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Procurement, Project Management, and Customers to deliver technically optimized, compliant, and cost-effective solutions. Your technical expertise will contribute to ensuring quality, reliability, safety, and operational excellence throughout the project lifecycle.

We are looking for a passionate and technically strong electrical engineering professional with experience in substation primary engineering, excellent problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively within diverse project teams.

How You'll Make an Impact

  • Prepare Design Basis Reports and technical specifications for electrical systems.
  • Develop Single Line Diagrams (SLD), substation layouts, sections, and arrangements for various bus configurations.
  • Design electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing systems.
  • Perform DSLP and grounding design calculations in compliance with project requirements and industry standards.
  • Conduct conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations for transmission and substation applications.
  • Perform sizing calculations and equipment selection for Transformers, MV/LV Switchgear, DC Systems, Battery Systems, Battery Chargers, and UPS systems.
  • Support preparation of customer proposals, Bill of Materials (BOM), Request for Quotations (RFQs), and technical documentation.
  • Review customer specifications and perform vendor drawing reviews for EHV equipment, transformers, cables, and associated systems.
  • Collaborate with Secondary Engineering teams and support mechanical system design activities.
  • Coordinate engineering interfaces with Civil, Mechanical, Protection, and Substation Automation System (SAS) teams.
  • Participate in offer reviews, technical discussions, and engineering clarifications with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable Indian and international standards, project specifications, and quality requirements.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing engineering quality, efficiency, and standardization.
  • Contribute to successful project execution by providing innovative and technically optimized engineering solutions.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree (B.E./B.Tech) in Electrical Engineering.
  • Experience in Primary Engineering for AIS and GIS Substation Projects serving Industrial, Data Center, State Electricity Board (SEB), and Grid Substation customers.
  • Experience related to AIS Substations up to 765kV and GIS Substations up to 400kV is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of primary engineering design principles for HV and EHV substations.
  • Expertise in preparation of SLDs, layouts, sections, electrical clearance diagrams, cable containment systems, and earthing designs.
  • Knowledge of equipment sizing and selection for Transformer, MV, LV, DC, Battery, Battery Charger, and UPS systems.
  • Familiarity with conductor sizing, short-circuit force calculations, and sag-tension calculations.
  • Understanding of load flow studies, short-circuit studies, and relay coordination principles will be an added advantage.
  • Basic understanding of Protection Systems, Substation Automation Systems (SAS), and Auxiliary System Design.
  • Working knowledge of Indian and International standards and regulations relevant to substation engineering.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, ETAP, MS Office, and other engineering design tools.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and multicultural project teams.
  • Demonstrated commitment to technical excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous learning.

Key Success Indicators

  • Engineering Quality and Design Accuracy
  • On-Time Engineering Deliverables
  • Compliance with Technical Specifications and Standards
  • Customer Satisfaction
  • Proposal and Tender Quality
  • Design Optimization and Cost Competitiveness

job.title: Account Manager - Digital and Sustainability
job.description:
We're enhancing the way we live and work by intelligently connecting energy systems, buildings and industries!!

Smart infrastructure from Siemens makes the world a more connected and caring place – where resources are valued, where impact on the world is considered, where sustainable energy is delivered reliably and efficiently. It provides the flexible infrastructure to allow society to evolve and respond to changing conditions. Technology and the ingenuity of people come together to be at one with our environments and to care for our world. We do this from the macro to the micro level, from physical products, components and systems to connected, cloud-based digital offerings and services. Siemens offers a broad portfolio of grid control and automation; low- and medium-voltage power distribution, switching and control; and building automation, fire safety and security, HVAC control and energy solutions.

Job Title: Account Manager

Location: Mumbai/Gurugram/Bangalore

Experience: 8+ years

Industry: Smart Infrastructure / Energy Efficiency, Decarbonization and Digital Solutions

Function: Sales – Sustainability Solutions

________

About the Role

As the Sales Manager for Sustainability and Digitalisation for Fleet Vertical, you will drive strategic sales efforts focused on Siemens’ sustainability themes of energy efficiency and decarbonization. You will be responsible for independently generating leads, engaging hospitality, healthcare, aviation and data-centre clients, and driving adoption of Siemens’ integrated solutions that help reduce energy consumption, optimize operations, and support clients’ net-zero goals.

________

Key Responsibilities

Lead Generation & Prospecting

  • Independently identify and qualify manufacturing clients with sustainability ambitions.
  • Develop outreach strategies using industry networks, events, digital platforms, and referrals.
  • Build and maintain a strong pipeline of opportunities aligned with Siemens’ energy efficiency and decarbonization themes.

Sales Strategy & Business Development

  • Execute go-to-market strategies for Siemens’ sustainability offerings in manufacturing.
  • Collaborate with regional and vertical sales teams to expand market reach.
  • Drive strategic account planning and territory development.

Consultative Selling & Client Engagement

  • Conduct discovery sessions to understand client sustainability goals and operational challenges.
  • Present tailored solutions focused on energy optimization, carbon footprint reduction, and sustainable operations.
  • Co-create proposals with technical teams and ensure alignment with client ROI and ESG targets.

Revenue Growth & Target Achievement

  • Own and exceed quarterly and annual sales targets with accurate forecasting.
  • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts.

Market Intelligence & Positioning

  • Stay updated on sustainability trends, regulatory changes, and competitor strategies.
  • Provide feedback to product and marketing teams to refine positioning and messaging.
  • Represent Siemens in industry forums and sustainability events.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with engineering, delivery, and product teams to ensure solution feasibility and client success.
  • Support post-sales implementation and ensure customer satisfaction.
  • Share client insights to influence roadmap and innovation.

________

What You Bring

  • Experience: 8+ years in sales, with strong exposure to sustainability and energy solutions.
  • Sales Expertise: Proven track record in lead generation, consultative selling, and strategic account management.
  • Industry Knowledge: Deep understanding of manufacturing operations, energy systems, and sustainability drivers.
  • Solar Experience: Prior experience in selling solar solutions will be a strong advantage.
  • Tools Proficiency: CRM systems (Salesforce), MS Office is a must
  • Communication: Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Mindset: Entrepreneurial and proactive, with a passion for sustainability and client success.

This role is based in Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Mumbai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

Make your mark in our exciting world of Siemens

We’re Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality and we welcome applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in across Gender, LGBTQ+, Abilities & Ethnicity. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and imagination, and help us shape tomorrow.

job.title: 硬件工程师
job.description:
加入西门子智能基础设施集团智能建筑事业部，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

西门子智能建筑全球研发中心，位于高科技企业林立的北京市海淀区后厂村中关村1号地区，是西门子智能基础设施集团楼宇产品在亚太的研发中心，承担了智能楼宇产品全球研发任务。亚投行总部、水立方、国家速滑馆（冰丝带）、港珠澳大桥、上海环球金融中心、大兴国际机场等建筑里都使用了我们研发的产品。

我们期待擅长电子硬件开发的人才可以推动业务发展。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

  • 完成电子设计和开发，包括原理图设计，生成元器件清单，EMC设计，模拟仿真，元器件选择，布局布线约束设计支持和检查等，以保证高质量产品的按期交付；
  • 构建功能测试计划并完成功能测试搭建以验证电路设计；
  • 依据项目开发需要，独立完成英文技术文档和报告；
  • 管理任务优先级，确定依赖关系，评估工作量；
  • 执行模块级硬件成本分析，找出具体设计层次的成本降低潜力。

你需要具备的品质：

  • 精通数模混合电路设计，特别是高速数字电路分析和约束设计，通讯总线，开关电源（基本拓补，功率级设计和损耗分析），运放频域分析和模数转换器等电路设计
  • 有电机驱动经验者优先具备工业级产品设计，EMC设计，可靠性，安规，热分析，电子器件技术方面的基础知识
  • 英语听、说、写熟练
  • 快速学习及总结设计知识经验的能力
  • 统招本科以上学历，五年以上工作经验。
  • 有消防报警系统电子电路设计经验，并成功交付产品到国际市场者优先考虑

你将得到这些收获：

  • 丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等
  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作
  • 多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

为什么选择我们？

  • 处于行业风口，职业前途广阔

在“2030碳达峰、2060碳中和”的国家战略下，楼宇已成为最重要的绿色低碳和可持续发展的实践场景。加入我们，你将和全球智能楼宇产品研发团队一道，持续站在行业风口，收获广阔的职业前途。

  • 公司历史悠久，技术沉淀深厚

北京西门子楼宇产品全球研发中心成立至今，研发人员300+人，其中软件研发80+人，西门子全球技术专家4人，技术涉及工业物联网、自动化机器人、网络安全、数字孪生与仿真、数据分析和人工智能、智能楼宇、能源管理等高科技领域，员工职业发展前景广阔。

  • 国际研发视野，完善项目流程

我们研发的产品主要服务于欧美市场和亚太六十余个国家和地区，你将主导中国本土核心技术平台并与海外团队协同配合，使用先进的开发流程，向全球客户高效、高质量地提供丰富的智能化产品。

  • 培训资源丰富，注重技术成长

我们向所有员工提供免费的海量网课资源，涵盖专业技能、语言、人际关系、领导力等多个门类。同时，我们还会定期安排内外部讲师授课。在这里，你可以在业余时间持续学习，充分发展自我。

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 “2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50” 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

  • Translate business growth, product roadmap and localization needs into supplier portfolio strategy and sourcing execution.

  • Govern supplier lifecycle management, including qualification, negotiation, performance, development and risk mitigation.
  • Partner with business, engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain and finance teams to enable portfolio competitiveness and business growth.

Your defining qualities

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Engineering, Mechatronics, or Electronics.
  • Business-level English proficiency.
  • 10+ years of strategic procurement experience, covering sourcing, supplier management and category strategy.
  • Strong project coordination capability across functions and regions.
  • ODM/OEM commodity and electronic component experience.
  • Engineering、Technical experience with mechatronics, electro-mechanical, integrated system
  • Negotiation skills.

You'll benefit from

  • Diverse and inclusive culture, doing the work you like with people who appreciate it.
  • Systematic career development platform, various training courses, and online learning resources for you to help you tailor your growth path based on your strengths.
  • 15 days+ annual leaves, with additional benefits such as Christmas leave.
  • Generous benefits package, long-term care corporate annuity plan, flexible allocation of commercial insurance, employee stock sharing matching plan for mutual growth, etc.

Create a better #TomorrowWithUs!

At Siemens, we are human enthusiasts with a diverse set of backgrounds, skills, interests, and needs, united in a unique mission to create a better tomorrow. We believe in a culture of diversity and inclusion, reflecting a society with various backgrounds, nationalities, expertise, and mindsets. Here, you'll find trust and freedom to excel. Here, you'll find peers, mentors, and savvy people, for co-creating and growing. If you have curiosity, breakthroughs, and creativity, looking for an equal opportunity to grow and unleash your full potential, join us, bring your authentic self, and create a better tomorrow with us.

job.title: Channel Partner Manager
job.description:
The Channel Partner Manager leads Siemens EA’s indirect sales strategy and partner ecosystem, driving growth across the low-voltage and medium-voltage portfolio. The role develops channel strategies, expands partner networks, and delivers sales through distributors, system integrators, OEMs, EPCs, panel builders, and value-added resellers.

Accountable for revenue growth, order intake, market share, partner profitability, and capability development, this leadership position also identifies new market opportunities and strengthens Siemens’ presence across utilities, infrastructure, renewable energy, data centers, and industrial sectors.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Driving channel growth strategy by developing and executing a country-wide partner strategy that expands market reach, increases market share, and delivers sustainable growth across Electrification & Automation solutions.
  • Building a high-performing partner ecosystem by recruiting, onboarding, and developing distributors, system integrators, panel builders, OEMs, EPCs, and value-added resellers while strengthening their commercial and technical capabilities.
  • Leading indirect sales performance by establishing strong sales governance, forecasting, pipeline management, and opportunity conversion processes to achieve order intake, revenue, profitability, and market share targets.
  • Accelerating business development opportunities by expanding adoption of protection, automation, power distribution, and medium-voltage solutions while identifying new market opportunities across utilities, infrastructure, renewable energy, industrial, and commercial segments.
  • Enabling partner and market engagement by driving joint marketing initiatives, customer events, technical workshops, and demand generation activities that increase customer awareness and sales opportunities.
  • Leading and developing teams by coaching channel sales professionals, fostering a high-performance culture, and promoting cross-functional collaboration to support business growth and customer success.

Your defining qualities:

  • Educational background in engineering or business with a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline; an MBA is advantageous.
  • Extensive channel sales leadership experience with 10+ years in the electrical industry, channel management, business development, or related commercial roles, including at least 5 years in a leadership position.
  • Strong expertise in indirect sales networks with proven experience managing distributors, panel builders, system integrators, or other channel partners.
  • Technical knowledge of electrification and automation solutions including power distribution, medium-voltage products, protection and control systems, automation technologies, and industrial project business.
  • Commercially driven with a track record of growth demonstrated through achieving revenue, profitability, market share, and business expansion objectives.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities with the ability to influence partners, lead teams, drive change, and collaborate effectively across functions and external customer ecosystems.

In return, we offer you:

  • Flexible mobile working policy that allows for time off for you to recharge and spend more time with your loved ones.
  • Attractive compensation and benefits.
  • Values-driven work culture with inclusive workplace policies and practices that prioritize diversity and inclusion
  • Endless possibilities and opportunities for progression and learning.

Recruitment Process:

  • CV Screening
  • A session with our recruiter to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday through technology!

Siemens is an equal opportunity employer, offering a safe and inclusive work environment, based on mutual respect and the appreciation of uniqueness, guaranteeing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates to unleash their full potential.

job.title: (SSLS) 断路器机械研发工程师 闵行
job.description:
加入西门子智能基础设施集团，成为零碳先锋，共创明日世界！

西门子智能基础设施集团 (Siemens Smart Infrastructure, SI) 的业务涵盖能源系统、楼宇和工业，旨在通过集成软硬件、产品、系统和解决方案，改善人们的生活和工作方式，显著提高效率和可持续性。我们致力于打造更低碳、更智能、更灵活的基础设施，在楼宇科技、智慧园区、数据中心等领域，都有我们成功的项目案例。

在西门子电气及自动化业务单元，我们期待断路器机械研发工程师岗位人才可以推动中压开关设备制造领域发展。

你将在这些领域发挥影响：

根据设计规范开发新产品，同时需基于当前的内外部生产制造能力考虑产品的成本和质量以及项目的时间等要求。

3D建模和图纸创建，以确保设计质量符合项目开发规范。

确保生产数据的可用性，例如车间图纸和SAP主数据可用于生产。

根据研发设计指南和制造SOP标准，保证设计输出的质量。

与采购部门一起澄清采购细节（规格、供应商、期限等）。

与相关部门同步构建制造和物流理念。

确保产品符合相关标准要求（IEC/DL/GB 等）

负责技术和商务项目的控制（DMC 成本、时间周期、技术和经济目标等）。

负责新专利申请的准备。

负责产品设计配置的准备和维护。

负责给相关部门进行产品知识的培训。

执行直线经理分配的其他任务/职责。

本科或以上学历，机械或电力自动化等相关专业。

英语说写流利。

至少3年的输配电业务经验，对市场、竞争对手和西门子产品/服务范围有深入的了解。

了解并具有中压产品、市场需求以及允许有效产品差异化的评估技术的经验。

具有中压产品及应用知识。

具有竞争对手产品应用知识。

具有通用标准知识（如IEC/GB/DL）和中压产品的要求规范。

具有中压产品结构（初级）知识，包括组件和详细应用

具有研发项目流程的知识。

具有3D设计软件和图纸创建技术，包括制造数据管理。

了解产品设计变体，包括其选择应用，例如标准/选配项。

具有LoA 流程和业务行为准则知识，包括合规规则。

专注于项目目标和创新。

能够在与国际团队和不同公司文化的跨文化环境中工作。

具有项目管理经验者优先

你将得到这些收获：

丰厚的福利待遇，长期关怀的企业年金计划、灵活配置的商业保险、共同成长的员工股票计划等

系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径

多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作

带薪享超长10天年假，还有圣诞假等额外福利

多种志愿者和社群活动，为你拓展职业网络，提供跨业务领域的交流机会，找到志同道合的伙伴

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 “2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50” 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

job.title: Sales Manager, Partner Channel
job.description:
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

This role is responsible for driving Siemens Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC Controls, and Digital Building product sales via our partner channel, collaborating closely with System Integrators and Resellers to successfully deliver smart building solutions to the market.

You’ll make a difference by:

  • Drive BMS & HVAC Sales: Lead sales efforts for Building Management Systems, HVAC controls, and digital building solutions through our Partner Channel (System Integrators and Resellers) across greenfield and brownfield projects.
  • Support Integrated Building Solutions: Collaborate with the broader SI Buildings team to identify and develop opportunities combining Building Automation, Fire Safety, Security, and Digital Services.
  • Shape Decision Making Through Education: Engage end customers, consultants, developers, and M&E contractors to build awareness, trust, and preference for Siemens' intelligent building solutions that enhance energy efficiency, occupant comfort, and operational performance.

• Develop New & Existing Partners: Strengthen and expand our partner ecosystem by identifying, onboarding, enabling, and growing strategic partners to successfully promote, design, implement, and support Siemens Building Management and HVAC solutions.

  • Maximize Building Automation Market Potential: Identify high-growth verticals such as commercial buildings, healthcare, data centers, hospitality, industrial facilities, and public infrastructure, positioning Siemens as the preferred smart building technology partner.
  • Deliver Sales & Profit Growth: Achieve business targets through value-based selling of Building Management Systems, HVAC controls, energy optimization, and digital services, focusing on sustainable and high-value solutions.

• Build Trusted Client Relationships: Develop long-term relationships with partners, consultants, developers, and end customers by acting as a trusted advisor for smart, efficient, and future-ready buildings.

  • Drive Smart Building Innovation: Promote digital building technologies including cloud connectivity, analytics, remote services, AI-driven optimization, IoT integration, and sustainability solutions that support customers' decarbonization and ESG objectives.

Your Defining Qualities:

  • Building Automation Sales Expertise: 5–10 years of experience in Building Automation, Building Management Systems (BMS), HVAC Controls, or Smart Building solutions. Experience working with channel partners is highly desirable.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong understanding of BMS architectures, HVAC systems, controls, energy management, open protocols (e.g., BACnet, Modbus), and smart building technologies.
  • Strategic & Agile: Proven ability to align building automation solutions with customer business objectives while adapting to evolving technologies and market trends.
  • Effective Communicator: Skilled at translating technical building automation solutions into compelling business value for consultants, developers, contractors, facility managers, and end users.
  • Collaborative & Accountable: Self-driven team player who thrives in cross-functional, multicultural environments with a strong customer-centric mindset.

What we offer

  • Flexibility: Inclusive and flexible working environment with hybrid and remote options.
  • Welfare: Comprehensive welfare programs and health insurance extendable to your family; professional accident insurance.
  • Growth opportunities: Continuous and individual learning journeys.
  • Inclusive culture: A team culture where you can be yourself.

Recruitment Process:

  • CV Screening
  • Talk with our recruiter to get to know your motivation & your experience
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday through technology!

job.title: Xcelerator_销售与伙伴成功经理
job.description:
职位描述：

我们正在寻找一位经验丰富、结果驱动的高级大客户销售经理，专注于千万级规模的大型数字化集成项目。您将负责开拓和赢取智能制造、智慧园区、工业AI或数据中心等领域的复杂解决方案销售项目，直接对接大型企业客户、政府及重要生态伙伴。成功胜任者将有能力理解并转化客户的关键业务痛点为具体的数字化解决方案，并管理从商机挖掘到合同签署的完整销售周期。

主要职责：

  • 大型业务开发：基于西门子Xcelerator平台内外资源，识别和挖掘潜在大型项目机会，建立并维护有效商机池，确保完成年度业绩目标。
  • 客户关系管理：深入接触并建立与大型企业相关部门决策者（如CEO、CIO、CTO、项目负责人等）的稳固高层关系，推动大型项目落地。
  • 解决方案销售：深刻理解客户在智能制造、智慧园区、工业AI等领域的业务挑战与需求，整合平台中的西门子及外部生态伙伴产品与解决方案资源，并拉通、协助相关产品方完成整体化集成方案。
  • 项目操盘与流程管理：独立主导千万级项目的全流程运作，包括需求分析、方案设计、技术交流、商务谈判、招投标、合同签订及收款，有效管理销售漏斗。
  • 市场与生态洞察：持续跟踪行业发展趋势、竞争动态及相关政策（如“智改数转”政策等），整合内外部资源（如设备厂商、行业协会），共同推动项目落地。

任职要求：

  • 教育背景：本科及以上学历，工科、计算机、自动化、市场营销或相关专业优先。
  • 工作经验：至少8年以上大型B2B企业级软件、解决方案或技术销售经验，必须具备独立操盘千万级大型数字化集成项目（如智能制造、工业互联网平台、智慧园区、数据中心等）的成功经验。
  • 行业知识与资源：

o 具备深度理解智能制造、工业互联网、企业数字化转型等相关领域。

o 对西门子产品组合和技术平台有深入了解，并能够有效整合西门子内部各BU及外部合作伙伴资源，共同完成“One Tech Company”大型数字化集成项目。

o 加分项：有成功服务装备制造、汽车及零部件、电子半导体、食品饮料、园区及数据中心等行业大型客户的经验。

job.title: Technical Consultant (Electrification and Automation)
job.description:
We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make a great addition to our vibrant international team.

At Siemens Smart Infrastructure, we create technology with purpose. We are enabling the energy transition through intelligent power distribution, digitalization, and sustainable infrastructure solutions. As part of our Totally Integrated Power (TIP) organization, you will help shape future-ready electrical infrastructure across industries, utilities, buildings, and data centers.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Building relationships. Develop trusted partnerships with engineering consultants, electrical planners, design institutes and specification authorities, acting as their primary technical advisor throughout project development.
  • Influencing projects at the design stage. Work with regional sales and vertical market teams to shape electrical concepts, specifications and design standards early in the project lifecycle.
  • Delivering power system consulting. Develop Medium Voltage and Low Voltage power distribution concepts, perform network calculations and system dimensioning, and evaluate technically and commercially suitable alternatives.
  • Developing specifications and designs. Prepare technical documentation, project specifications, Bills of Quantities, switchgear layout concepts and arrangement drawings, while supporting design reviews and Building Information Modeling workflows.
  • Advancing digital and sustainable solutions. Promote connected power distribution, digital energy management and energy-efficient infrastructure, including first-level support for Siemens engineering software and digital design tools.
  • Generating market insight and knowledge sharing. Identify projects, monitor market and competitor developments, provide actionable feedback, and deliver technical presentations, seminars and workshops for customers and internal teams.

Your defining qualities:

  • Relevant engineering qualification. Bachelor’s degree or higher in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Power distribution experience. Three to five years of experience in electrical power distribution, consulting, design, application or project engineering, with practical exposure to Medium Voltage and Low Voltage systems.
  • Strong technical capability. Sound knowledge of electrical network design, protection coordination, switchgear, transformers, protection systems, busbar systems and energy management solutions.
  • Industry and digital exposure. Experience with consultants, engineering contractors, panel builders, utilities, data centers, commercial buildings or industrial projects is advantageous; familiarity with Building Information Modeling and digital engineering workflows is desirable.
  • Consultative communication skills. Strong presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical decision makers and connect customer needs with commercially viable solutions.
  • Language and working style. Fluent written and spoken Thai and English, with a proactive, collaborative, customer-focused and self-driven approach.**

In return, we offer you:

  • Flexible mobile working policy that allows for time off for you to recharge and spend more time with your loved ones.
  • Attractive compensation and benefits.
  • Values-driven work culture with inclusive workplace policies and practices that prioritize diversity and inclusion
  • Endless possibilities and opportunities for progression and learning.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening
  • A session with our recruiter to understand your motivation & your past experiences
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer Stage

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday through technology!

Siemens is an equal opportunity employer, offering a safe and inclusive work environment, based on mutual respect and the appreciation of uniqueness, guaranteeing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates to unleash their full potential.

job.title: Critical Power Solution Engineer
job.description:
Are you a creative Critical Power Architect who wants to shape reliable, efficient, and more sustainable power infrastructure for hyperscale and colocation data centres? Join our Center of Competence for Data Centers team at Siemens and help shape the future of smart critical power solutions in a role that combines technical ownership with customer interaction in an international environment.

You'll make a difference by:

  • Designing end-to-end critical power architecture: Taking charge of the main electrical infrastructure for Data Centers (from grid connection and MV distribution down to LV distribution) and translating complex client requirements into engineered solutions.

You will lead go-to-market execution for an integrated portfolio of MV,LV, Building Automation, Digital Solutions, EV charging, and sustainability solutions, working across multiple Siemens businesses.

  • Lead business growth through regional sales organizations and partner ecosystems
  • Develop and execute annual vertical business plans, including GTM strategy and sales/partner enablement
  • Drive business development with developers, customers, consultants, PMCs, and key influencers
  • Increase account penetration and share of wallet through structured account development initiatives
  • Promote digitalization and vertical-specific solutions aligned with customer needs
  • Act as a thought leader for the assigned vertical

Qualifications & Experience

  • Engineering degree or equivalent with 12–15+ years of experience
  • Proven experience in the Buildings segment
  • Understanding of building infrastructure and solution-led selling (deep specialization not mandatory)

  • Willingness to travel PAN India (~40%)

This role is based in Kalwa, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.

job.title: SRE Engineer
job.description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.

Define, monitor, and enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services, understand scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for AI model serving, training pipelines, and data workflows, maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Datadog or Open Telemetry.

Responsibilities

Enforce Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and Error Budgets for AI services

Lead incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and post-mortem processes to minimize downtime and prevent recurrence

Proactively identify and resolve reliability risks before they impact end users

Maintain scalable, fault-tolerant infrastructure for data pipelines, ML workflows and data workflows

Handle cloud infrastructure (Azure) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform

Oversee Kubernetes clusters and containerized workloads (Docker) supporting AI microservices

Maintain comprehensive observability stacks (metrics, logs, traces) using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, or Open Telemetry

Develop intelligent alerting systems to detect anomalies in AI model performance, latency, and efficiency

Automate repetitive operational tasks through scripting and tooling (Python, Bash, Go)

Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for model deployment and service updates

Implement MLOps practices to streamline the deployment and monitoring of ML models in production

Ensure infrastructure and services align with security guidelines and relevant regulatory standards

Partner with data engineers and data scientists to make AI systems production-ready

Foster a reliability-first culture across engineering teams

Contribute to on-call rotations and continuously improve on-call runbooks and playbooks

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field with 6-8 years of meaningful experience.

Demonstrated experience supporting production-grade, high-availability systems

Strong experience with Azure cloud services, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure DevOps, Azure Resource Manager (ARM), and monitoring tools.

Proven expertise in handling multi-tenant, microservices-based architectures and deploying high-availability solutions.

Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or ARM templates for handling and automating cloud resources.

Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps/MLOps) and configuration management.

Solid understanding of containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Secondary experience or familiarity with security practices, such as identity and access management (IAM), threat detection, and compliance standards.

Solid understanding of secure supply chain practices, including management of code dependencies and open-source libraries.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with a proactive approach to operational and security issues.

Preferred Skills

Experience with supervising and logging tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack) for proactive issue resolution.

Familiarity with zero-trust architecture principles

Knowledge of industry compliance standards, such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR, is a plus.

Experience with scripting and automation tools, such as Python, Bash, or PowerShell.

What We Offer

Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.

Opportunities to work on ground breaking projects in cloud infrastructure and MLOps.

A collaborative, innovative work environment with room for career growth.

Working at Siemens Software means flexibility - Choosing between working at home and the office at other times is the norm here. We offer great benefits and rewards, as you'd expect from a world leader in industrial software.

你需要具备的品质：

  • 7年以上工作经验者优先
  • 熟悉功能性组织。较强的部门建设能力以满足公司业务需求
  • 熟悉建筑控制产品者优先
  • 本科以上学历，电子工程、机械工程/自动化、项目管理等相关专业。
  • 优秀的沟通能力和沟通技巧

你将得到这些收获：

  • 系统化的职业发展平台，多方面的课程资源与发展工具，从自身优势出发，个性化定制你的成长路径
  • 灵活的工作模式，使你保持韧性、与时俱进
  • 多元包容的企业氛围，和欣赏的人做喜欢的工作

为什么选择我们？

在“2030碳达峰、2060碳中和”的国家战略下，楼宇已成为最重要的绿色低碳和可持续发展的实践场景。加入我们，你将和全球智能楼宇产品研发团队一道，持续站在行业风口，收获广阔的职业前途。

我们向所有员工提供免费的海量网课资源，涵盖专业技能、语言、人际关系、领导力等多个门类。同时，我们还会定期安排内外部讲师授课。在这里，你可以在业余时间持续学习，充分发展自我。

加入西门子，一起共创明日世界！

西门子明确承诺企业的商业活动应着眼于未来，可持续发展是西门子业务不可或缺的组成部分。自2019年以来，我们已将自身运营中产生的碳排放量减少约46%，并设定2030年的二氧化碳减排目标为相比2019年减少90%。在中国，西门子入选了 “2022福布斯中国可持续发展工业企业TOP50” 。

我们由不同背景、国籍、专业知识和思维方式的伙伴组成。在这里，你会获得信任和自由，尽情地发挥所长。在这里，你会找到同伴、导师和行业大咖，与你共同创造和成长。如果你拥有好奇心、突破力、创造力，寻找一个平等的发展机会并充分释放自己的潜能，加入我们，做你自己，和我们共创明日世界！探索更多发展可能。

job.title: Head of Customer Service Hub, Malaysia
job.description:
The Head of Customer Service Hub, Malaysia will be responsible for leading Siemens' nationwide Data Centre Service organization, ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, profitability, and sustainable growth across service contracts and lifecycle services.

The position leads a multidisciplinary organization comprising Service Engineers, Field Service Teams, Project Engineers, Service Sales, Service Partners, and Vendors to deliver world-class support for mission-critical Data Centre customers. The role is accountable for ensuring service delivery performance in accordance with committed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), including 24/7 support operations, emergency response services, preventive maintenance programs, technical support, modernization projects, and lifecycle management.

The successful candidate will drive business growth through Service Level Agreement (SLA) sales, service portfolio expansion, aftermarket business development, and long-term customer relationship management across Data Centres and other key vertical industries.

You'll make a difference by

  • Leading the Malaysia Data Centre Service Hub by overseeing nationwide service operations for mission-critical customers, ensuring high standards of safety, quality, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction.
  • Delivering reliable 24/7 service performance by managing service level commitments, emergency response, escalation processes, business continuity plans, and key service performance measures.
  • Driving technical excellence across electrical service portfolios by guiding teams on medium voltage, low voltage, protection and automation, power monitoring, digitalization, lifecycle, and modernization solutions
  • Managing field service and project execution by ensuring safe delivery of maintenance, commissioning, retrofit, troubleshooting, modernization, workforce planning, site mobilization, and project outcomes across multiple customer locations.
  • Growing the service business by leading service sales, expanding service contracts, developing lifecycle and modernization opportunities, strengthening customer relationships, and identifying new market opportunities.
  • Building a high-performing service organization by leading managers, engineers, field service teams, sales teams, partners, and vendors while driving profitability, capability development, succession planning, and operational productivity.

Your defining qualities

• Extensive service leadership experience with at least 15 years in service management, customer service operations, or service business leadership, including at least 8 years leading large service organizations.

  • Strong engineering foundation with a degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline; an MBA would be an added advantage.
  • Proven experience in mission-critical environments including Data Centre infrastructure, nationwide multi-site service operations, 24/7 support models, and SLA-based service contracts.
  • Solid technical knowledge of power and automation systems covering medium voltage switchgear, low voltage distribution, protection relays, SCADA, power quality, electrical asset management, and digital service or remote monitoring platforms.
  • Commercial and financial leadership capability with experience in service business growth, customer relationship management, contract negotiation, sales leadership, budgeting, forecasting, and P&L ownership.
  • Confident people and stakeholder leadership with the ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage change, build strong customer relationships, make sound decisions under pressure, and foster a collaborative, customer-focused, safety-led culture.

What we offer

  • Flexibility: Inclusive and flexible working environment with hybrid and remote options.
  • Welfare: Comprehensive welfare programs and health insurance extendable to your family; professional accident insurance.
  • Growth opportunities: Continuous and individual learning journeys.
  • Inclusive culture: A team culture where you can be yourself.

Recruitment Process

  • CV Screening
  • Talk with our recruiter to get to know your motivation & your experience
  • 1-3 Business Interviews
  • Offer

Come join us, and #TransformTheEveryday through technology!

Siemens is an equal opportunity employer, offering a safe and inclusive work environment, based on mutual respect and the appreciation of uniqueness, guaranteeing equal employment opportunities to all qualified candidates to unleash their full potential.

job.title: QAQC Manager (Contract)
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced QA/QC Manager to lead quality assurance and compliance programs across our operations. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring service delivery meets contractual, client, and regulatory requirements while driving continuous improvement initiatives and leading a high-performing quality team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage QA/QC activities, ensuring compliance with client, company, and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems, processes, and standards.
  • Monitor quality performance metrics and identify opportunities for service improvement.
  • Conduct quality audits, inspections, and compliance reviews to ensure operational excellence.
  • Prepare and present quality and compliance reports to clients and key stakeholders.
  • Manage audit readiness programs and support internal and external audits.
  • Investigate quality issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with operational teams to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop the QA/QC team, including performance management and training.
  • Escalate quality and compliance risks to senior management as required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Business, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Compliance, or a related field.
  • Experience managing quality systems, audits, compliance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of quality management principles, standards, and best practices.
  • Proven ability to analyze data, identify trends, and implement effective quality solutions.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Experience leading and developing teams.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
  • Professional quality certifications (e.g., ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, Six Sigma, CQE) are advantageous.

job.title: Retail Consultant, Warriewood
job.description:
Warriewood, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile, broadband and digital solutions.

We’re looking for a vibrant and motivated Casual Retail Service Consultant to join our Wariewood team. If you love helping people, thrive in being a part of a supportive crew, and bring positive energy to every interaction, then we’d love to have you on board!

At Optus, you’ll feel connected to what truly matters. We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the face of Optus, delivering standout customer experiences powered by optimism, curiosity and genuine care.
  • Explore our range of tech products and services, and share your knowledge in a way that’s simple, helpful and accessible.
  • Bring your personality and charm to uncover customer needs and deliver personalised solutions that make their day.
  • Work as one team, crafting a warm, welcoming environment where customers feel supported and memorable moments happen.

What you bring:

  • Service Superpower: You know how to understand customer needs, deliver genuine support, and let phenomenal service drive fantastic outcomes.
  • Tech Explorer: You enjoy helping customers make sense of tech by breaking things down simply and guiding them to the right solutions.
  • Problem Solving Pro: You listen with empathy, act with integrity, and turn challenges into opportunities to help with calm, practical solutions.
  • Composure Under Pressure: You’re confident in navigating difficult enquiries, ease tricky situations with empathy and respect, and work toward the best solution for the customer.
  • Team Spirit: You build strong connections with your teammates, support one another, stay accountable, and create a customer‑first environment where everyone succeeds.

What’s in it for you?

  • $35 p/h + super + applicable loadings.
  • Phenomenal perks, including 25% off Optus products and exclusive access to unique discounts with our retail partners.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Yarn First Nations, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.
  • Flexible rosters that work around the life you live outside of work.

Intrigued, but not sure you tick every box? That’s completely okay! We still encourage you to apply. We all grow, learn and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your career journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit [https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity](https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity)
