job.title: Director, Corporate Systems
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

Reporting to the Head of Corporate Systems, the Director, Corporate Systems is a senior technology leadership role accountable for partnering with Corporate Functions and leading the strategy, transformation, delivery and operations of enterprise corporate platforms across Singtel Group.

The role combines two integrated accountabilities:

IT Business Partner for Corporate Functions. Serve as the trusted technology adviser to the People and Culture and Sustainability leadership teams. Translate business strategy into a prioritised technology roadmap and investment portfolio, with end-to-end accountability for demand, delivery, service performance, cost, risk and value realisation.

Platform Lead for Corporate Systems - People and Culture and Sustainability across Singtel, Optus and NCS. Own the platform strategy, architecture, product roadmap and lifecycle. Drive a secure, resilient and scalable common core while enabling justified local requirements; simplify and modernise the application landscape; strengthen data and integration foundations; and improve speed, employee experience and unit cost.

The Director, Corporate Systems will:

  • Shape and execute multi-year platform and technology strategies aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, cyber security, data and cloud principles.
  • Sponsor major transformation programmes and ensure disciplined delivery, adoption, operational readiness, benefits realisation and sustainable support.
  • Establish clear governance and decision rights for demand, investment, architecture, change, service performance, risk, privacy, resilience and vendor management.
  • Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing regional team and partner ecosystem, supported by a strategic workforce and capability plan.
  • Advise and influence senior stakeholders, resolve competing priorities and make balanced decisions across business value, employee experience, cost, risk and delivery speed.

The successful candidate will combine strategic business insight, enterprise technology depth, commercial acumen and strong people leadership. They will be comfortable operating across a federated Group, influencing at executive level and translating complex technology choices into clear business outcomes.

Make an impact by

Shape Corporate Systems strategy, business partnership and portfolio value

  • Partner with People and Culture, Sustainability and Group/OpCo leadership to understand business outcomes and translate them into an integrated, multi-year technology strategy and roadmap.
  • Lead demand management and portfolio prioritisation across run, grow and transform initiatives, balancing value, risk, regulatory needs, dependencies and capacity.
  • Develop robust business cases, investment proposals and outcome measures; own value and benefits realisation.
  • Provide clear executive advice on technology options, trade-offs and emerging trends.
  • Success measures: stakeholder confidence, roadmap alignment, benefits delivered, demand transparency and portfolio health.

Own platform/product strategy, architecture and lifecycle management

  • Define platform/product vision, roadmap, target architecture and lifecycle for People and Culture and Sustainability platforms across Singtel, Optus and NCS.
  • Establish common-core standards, design principles and decision rights while enabling justified local requirements and regulatory obligations.
  • Drive application rationalisation, technical-debt reduction, cloud/SaaS optimisation, integration and API reuse, and data quality.
  • Lead responsible adoption of automation, analytics and AI-enabled capabilities where they improve employee experience, controls and productivity.
  • Ensure solutions comply with enterprise architecture, security, privacy and data-governance requirements.
  • Success measures: adoption, reuse, simplification, reduced technical debt, data and integration quality, and unit-cost improvement.

Lead transformation delivery, adoption and change

  • Sponsor and govern complex regional programmes from business case through design, delivery, migration, go-live and stabilisation.
  • Set delivery outcomes, milestones, quality gates, controls and accountabilities across internal teams, business owners and partners.
  • Ensure business process, data, integration, testing, change, training and operational-readiness plans are fully integrated.
  • Proactively manage interdependencies, risks, issues and executive escalations.
  • Embed product and agile delivery practices where appropriate and create a culture of continuous improvement.
  • Success measures: delivery to scope, time, budget and quality; user adoption; benefits realisation; and stable transition to operations.

Assure service performance, operational resilience and technology risk

  • Own end-to-end service performance and ensure production systems meet agreed SLAs, availability, performance and experience targets.
  • Establish service, incident, problem, change and release governance; drive root-cause elimination and measurable improvement.
  • Be accountable for cyber security, privacy, technology risk, audit, regulatory compliance and third-party risk within the domain.
  • Define and test business continuity, disaster recovery and operational-resilience arrangements, including critical dependencies.
  • Maintain transparent risk-acceptance and remediation plans and escalate material exposures.
  • Success measures: SLA attainment, availability, incident reduction, recovery readiness, control effectiveness and timely audit/risk closure.

Optimise financial, commercial, vendor and workforce performance

  • Manage approved OPEX and CAPEX, forecast demand and optimise total cost of ownership and unit cost.
  • Define sourcing and vendor strategy; lead commercial negotiations, contract performance, licensing optimisation and strategic partner relationships.
  • Establish KPIs, scorecards and governance to hold internal teams and vendors accountable for outcomes.
  • Build a strategic workforce plan covering organisation design, skills, succession, capacity and partner mix.
  • Coach and develop a diverse, high-performing team that operates as trusted advisers, product owners and change leaders.
  • Success measures: budget performance, savings and value capture, vendor outcomes, capability growth, engagement and retention.

**

Skills for Success

  • Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 12+ years of relevant technology experience, including at least 3-5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven end-to-end ownership of enterprise corporate platforms and services in a large, complex or multi-entity organisation.
  • Track record of leading regional transformation programmes and enterprise SaaS/cloud implementations from strategy through adoption and operations.
  • Experience managing executive stakeholders, cross-functional teams, budgets, vendors and outsourced delivery partners.
  • Strong commercial experience in business cases, sourcing, contracts, licensing and total-cost optimisation.
  • Demonstrated people leadership, organisation development and succession planning.
  • Enterprise platform/product strategy and lifecycle management
  • Business and enterprise architecture; application rationalisation
  • Enterprise SaaS/cloud, integration/API and data-management concepts
  • Portfolio, programme and change management
  • IT service management, operational resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity
  • Cyber security, privacy, technology risk, audit and governance
  • Financial, commercial, sourcing and vendor management
  • Performance management, benefits realisation and continuous improvement

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

The candidate shall be part of technical skilled team providing configuration, implementation, testing, operations and maintenance of the Mobile Core infrastructure supporting Singtel Mobile’s mobile networks and value-added systems including advance 5G services.

Make an impact by:

  • Responsible for the operations of the mobile PNF (Physical Network Function), VNF (Virtualized Network Function) and CNF (Containerized Network Function) platforms are being maintained optimally. As well as performing system migrations from legacy PNF and VNF platforms to CNF-based infrastructure.
  • Carry out Mobile Data Network change management including patch loading, implementation of software, hardware upgrades and configuration changes on mobile data core network elements like Mobility Management Entity (MME), Gateways (SGW/PGW), Domain Name Server (DNS), Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), User Plane Function (UPF), Local Packet Gateway (LPG), Network Repository Function (NRF), and its supporting nodes in a hybrid (Native/Virtualized/Containerized) environment. The service supported by us includes 4G & 5G.
  • Perform new corporate Access Point Name/Data Network Name (APN/DNN) provisioning configurations and updating of existing corporate services to support evolving Enterprise business requirements.
  • Work on network / service automation including testing and rolling out new mobile-related products and services.
  • As upgrades and patch loading may disrupt mobile services the successful candidate will need to work outside normal working hours to carry out such activities.
  • The successful candidate is required to be on 24/7 standby alert to handle unplanned system faults and/or service degradation on mobile data core network elements as such Mobility Management Entity (MME), Gateways (SGW/PGW), Domain Name Server (DNS), Access and Mobility Management Function (AMF), Session Management Function (SMF), User Plane Function (UPF), Local Packet Gateway (LPG), Network Repository Function (NRF), Diameter Edge Agent (DEA), GPRS Tunneling Protocol Proxy (GTP-Proxy), Service Communication Proxy (SCP) and Security Edge Protection Proxy (SEPP).
  • Troubleshoot and perform root causes failure analysis for software & hardware faults related to the network nodes.
  • Liaise and co-ordinate with system vendor(s) for the delivery, testing and timely implementation of new software, hardware and patches.
  • Create and maintain engineering test documentation and guidelines system functional and mobile services testing.
  • Involved in performing disaster recovery activity expeditiously in times of service disruptions to minimize service downtime and revenue loss.
  • Provide engineering support / expertise to Planning and Product Marketing in technical feasibility studies and trials of new products and services.
  • Ensure that service quality & performance of Mobile Data (packet switched) related services are maintained at high quality, with minimum service disruption.
  • Review existing best practices and processes for system acceptance testing and introduce preventive or optimized measures to improve the network quality cum resilience in a proactive manner.

Skills for Success:

  • A good engineering diploma preferably in wireless data communications.
  • Must be a team player coupled with strong communication, organizational and interpersonal skills and be able to work independently.
  • Possess good analytical and systematic troubleshooting skills in the area of technical fault isolation and rectification.
  • Must be self-driven and energized to embrace new technology and develop ways to improve customer experience
  • Strong interest in system and process automation with good knowledge in automation tools e.g. Ansible. Resolve, UI Patch, RPA.
  • Familiar with Mobile technology such as UMTS, LTE and 5G operating in both native, virtualized and containerized environments.
  • Working experience and familiar with best practices in mobile switching equipment (Ericsson) and virtualized / cloud technology like Openstack/NFVI/Container (Kubernetes)/SDN will be an added advantage.
  • Certification in CCNA and/or CCNP is desirable as IP technologies are increasingly being deployed in mobile networks.

job.description:
Job Description

In Schneider Electric everything we do promotes progress and sustainability for all — our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies where we live and work. From the products, software, and services driving the digital transformation of energy management and automation to corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make an impact by helping people and organizations become more resilient and efficient, more electric and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The Role

We are a looking for a Service Engineer to make an impact!

What will you do?

  • Support serviceable Schneider equipment including but not limited to: electrical switchgear, protection relays, PLCs, HMIs, Gateway, Servers, Communication, Networking in ENMCS & IMCS environment.
  • Properly document, label, and return all defective parts utilized in the repair of equipment to the designated disposal/repair location.
  • Develop innovative solutions to more complex technical problems that arise during start-up.
  • Research, evaluate, and recommend new products or equipment upgrades that will meet customer needs.
  • Assist Schneider Electric Service Partners in site visits, evaluating technical and professional performance.
  • When at customer site, look for other business opportunities outside current scope of work and lead them to the sales team
  • As Technical support level 2, solve technical issues arise by other field service rep
  • Escalate to other technical support level within the company when needed
  • Can investigate remotely the origin of the breakdown and submit fixes (in a service bureau for example)
  • Support Consulting Expert, Project Engineer and IOT Integration Digital Execution in all business and operational issues to ensure perfect Business Delivery and Performance.

What qualifications will make you successful?

  • Degree in Electrical & Communication Engineering with at least 3 years in services onsite environment.
  • Possess experience to troubleshoot protection relays, switchgears and power system products like low and medium voltage, transformers 33kV
  • Possess project implementation, testing & commissioning experience is a must
  • ENMCS & IMCS system knowledge is an added advantage
  • Knowledge in PLC,HMI & SCADA knowledge is an added advantage.
  • Strong communication & writing skills.

job.title: Product Manager, Middleware & Integration Platforms
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Own and govern StarHub's enterprise middleware and integration ecosystem, providing a common technology umbrella for integrations connecting BTS and non-BTS systems. The role ensures integrations are designed, delivered and operated through secure, scalable and reusable enterprise patterns, with clear ownership across their full lifecycle.

The role provides product ownership and governance for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and future approved enterprise integration technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Own the enterprise middleware and integration platform portfolio across BTS and the wider StarHub technology ecosystem.
  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance and operating standards for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations across BTS and non-BTS systems are visible, governed and managed under a common enterprise framework.
  • Drive adoption of reusable integration patterns to reduce duplication, manual effort, unmanaged interfaces and point-to-point solutions.
  • Define platform roadmaps, investment priorities and lifecycle strategies aligned with StarHub's modernisation, automation and AI agenda.
  • Partner with application, architecture, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity and service management teams to enable secure and resilient integration.
  • Optimise platform utilisation, licensing, vendor performance and total cost of ownership.

##

Responsibilities

1.Enterprise Middleware & Platform Ownership

  • Own the product lifecycle for enterprise middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and other approved technologies.
  • Maintain an enterprise view of middleware platforms, major interfaces, workflows, automations and dependencies.
  • Ensure platforms remain fit-for-purpose, scalable, supported, secure and aligned to target architecture.
  • Establish clear service ownership, support models and lifecycle controls for critical integration capabilities.
  • Integration Governance & Standards
  • Establish enterprise standards and guardrails for APIs, application-to-application integration, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration and automation.
  • Define decision principles for the use of middleware, native application integration, APIs, RPA and workflow automation.
  • Govern new integration demand to prevent uncontrolled point-to-point development, duplicated tooling and technology sprawl.
  • Drive reuse of approved APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Ensure designs comply with architecture, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, resilience and operational support requirements.
  • Cross-Domain Integration Accountability
  • Provide the governance umbrella for integrations across BTS domains and integrations originating outside BTS that connect into BTS-managed platforms.
  • Support cross-domain integration across Finance, People, Productivity, Identity, Data, Customer and other enterprise technology domains.
  • Identify integration ownership gaps and establish accountable owners for interfaces crossing organisational or technology boundaries.
  • Ensure critical integrations have documented architecture, technical ownership, business ownership, monitoring and support arrangements.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-platform integration risks, dependencies and service issues.

##

  • Automation & Orchestration
  • Govern enterprise use of automation platforms such as UiPath to ensure sustainable, reusable and supportable adoption rather than isolated automations.
  • Identify opportunities to remove repetitive manual work through integration, workflow automation and orchestration.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business value, complexity, risk, scalability and maintainability.
  • Promote reusable automation components and patterns across business functions.
  • Measure realised benefits including effort reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction and productivity gains.
  • Product Roadmap & Portfolio Management
  • Develop and maintain the Middleware & Integration product roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform enhancements, new capabilities, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning based on enterprise demand and value.
  • Manage platform dependencies, risks, releases and delivery priorities.
  • Build business cases for material investments and track measurable value realisation.
  • Continuously assess emerging middleware, integration, automation and AI-enabled orchestration capabilities.
  • Vendor & Commercial Management
  • Manage strategic relationships with middleware, integration and automation technology vendors and delivery partners.
  • Lead platform licensing, consumption, capacity and commercial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for licence optimisation, platform consolidation and cost reduction.
  • Establish vendor performance measures and regular service reviews.
  • AI & Intelligent Integration Enablement
  • Enable governed integration patterns that allow approved AI and agentic capabilities to securely interact with enterprise systems and data.
  • Partner with relevant AI, architecture, cybersecurity and identity teams on connectors, APIs, orchestration and tool-access patterns.
  • Ensure AI-enabled integrations follow least-privilege access, auditability, data protection and appropriate human approval controls.
  • Evolve middleware capabilities to support future agent-to-system and machine-to-machine integration patterns.

##

Scope Boundary

The role owns the middleware capability, platforms, standards and governance. Individual application teams remain accountable for their application functionality and domain-specific requirements, while integrations crossing systems or domains are governed through the Middleware & Integration capability.

Areas of Impact

  • A single governed enterprise approach to middleware and integration across BTS and non-BTS platforms.
  • Reduced proliferation of point-to-point integrations, duplicated automation tools and unmanaged workflows.
  • Increased reuse of enterprise APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Faster and more reliable delivery of cross-platform business capabilities.
  • Improved resilience, observability, supportability and lifecycle ownership of critical integrations.
  • Reduced manual effort and operating cost through governed automation.
  • A secure integration foundation for AI-enabled and agentic business processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, automation, product management or technology transformation.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise integration or automation platforms in a complex organisation.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration, system-to-system connectivity and RPA.
  • Experience with platforms such as Workato, UiPath, MuleSoft, Boomi, ServiceNow IntegrationHub or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience managing technology products across multiple business and technology domains.
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity, ITSM and operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, commercial arrangements, product roadmaps and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Experience with AI-enabled automation, orchestration or agentic integration patterns is advantageous.

job.title: Advanced Software Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

THE FUTURE IS WHAT WE MAKE IT

_Advance Software Engineer (Honeywell Building Operation Center)_

_Singapore, Singapore_

Building Automation \| Honeywell Building Solutions

| | | --- | | Lead the day-to-day technical and operational delivery of a team that monitors Honeywell’s Forge cloud applications. You will guide service-case resolution, strengthen connectivity and service performance, and turn platform data into opportunities that improve customer outcomes. |

THE OPPORTUNITY

In this role, you will combine hands-on technical expertise with team leadership. You will help ensure service-level commitments are met, complex issues are driven to resolution, and operational insights are translated into improvements for customers, field teams, and the platform.

Leadership scope:This position includes people leadership and hands-on technical ownership, with accountability for team execution and service-level performance.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage a team of software engineers, setting clear priorities and helping ensure service-level agreements are met.
  • Oversee remote monitoring of Forge cloud applications, with a focus on system health, connectivity, and service performance.
  • Guide the triage and analysis of Forge-generated service cases, supporting efficient resolution with Field Service Leaders and Field Service Professionals.
  • Take ownership of complex or high-impact connectivity and performance issues, coordinating escalation and follow-through as needed.
  • Use Forge data to identify potential Spot opportunities and ensure clear, actionable recommendations are shared with field service teams.
  • Promote consistent incident-management practices, operational discipline, and effective knowledge sharing across the team.
  • Partner with cross-functional and back-end development teams to improve system reliability, monitoring quality, and customer outcomes.
  • Coach team members through technical problem-solving and support continuous capability development.

YOU MUST HAVE

  • Diploma or bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Controls Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of software engineering experience, with a focus on monitoring and troubleshooting cloud-based applications.
  • Working knowledge of a major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, including cloud-monitoring tools and practices.
  • Experience collaborating with field service teams or comparable operational groups.
  • Experience using logging, alerting, and incident-management systems to support timely issue resolution.
  • Experience with Building Management Systems and Heating, Ventilation and Air-Conditioning (HVAC) systems.

job.title: Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

_Advanced R&D Engr/Scientist – Gas Processing Technologies_

Innovate to solve the world's most important challenges.

The future is what you make it.

When you join Honeywell UOP, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers that are developing sustainable technologies that will accelerate the energy transition to net-zero carbon.

Are you ready to help us shape the future? Become a #futureshaper!

An excellent career opportunity is currently available for anAdvanced R&D Engr/Scientist –Gas Processing Technologiesat Honeywell India Technology Center in Gurugram. This position is dedicated to accelerating the development and commercialization of cutting-edge Hydrogen and Carbon Capture technologies, focusing specifically on solvent-based technology solutions. The selected candidate will spearhead the development of novel technologies and will be responsible for creating integrated solutions that leverage UOP’s Hydrogen and Gas Processing technology portfolio.

Responsibilities

Position Responsibilities:

  • Leadership in New Product Development:Lead and support New Product Development (NPD) initiatives by managing cross-functional teams tasked with creating intricate integrated technology solutions. Conduct research on solvent-based carbon capture technologies, focusing on their effectiveness and efficiency in reducing CO2 footprint.
  • Project Management Excellence:Implement Z21 methodologies and project management best practices to ensure that all technology deliverables are met on schedule and within budget.
  • Pilot Plant Experimentation:Direct and facilitate pilot plant experiments while driving a model-based design of experiments (MBDOE) approach to expedite technology advancement.
  • Innovation and Intellectual Property:Identify and develop innovative solutions, authoring invention disclosures to contribute significantly to Honeywell UOP’s innovation initiatives.
  • Collaboration and Growth Strategies:Engage with business colleagues to effectively develop technologies that bolster existing business lines and support growth strategies.
  • Competitive Landscape Monitoring:Stay informed about competition, monitor advancements in relevant technological areas, and lead projects designed to address gaps.
  • Mentorship Role:Act as a mentor for less experienced scientists and engineers, fostering their growth and professional development.

Qualifications

You Must Have:

  • Bachelor’s degree in chemical engineering.
  • Experience in carbon capture technologies, with a focus on solvent methods, is highly desirable.
  • Strong interest in R&D work.
  • Strong technical skills for leading experimentation and data analysis skills.
  • A self-starter and ability to drive innovation.

We Value:

  • Advanced degree (Masters, PhD) in Chemical Engineering.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in Technology Development, specifically in solvent-based technology commercialization.
  • Profound understanding of chemistry and chemical engineering principles, with applications in process, absorption, catalyst, and adsorbent technology development.
  • Proven experience in formulating and executing experimental plans, with proficiency in statistical tools for comprehensive data analysis. Ability to design experimental set-ups to meet project objectives.
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma principles with practical applications for managing risks and uncertainties; Six Sigma Green Belt certification is preferred; Black Belt certification is ideal.
  • Strong business acumen combined with an entrepreneurial mindset to drive technological development in a fast-paced environment.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to deliver impactful presentations to diverse audiences and effectively manage customer relationships.
  • Familiarity with laboratory techniques, data analysis software, and chemical engineering principles.

job.description:

Continuously identifies new sales opportunities and focuses on providing consultative support by building value propositions for the customer; Manage and build customer contacts; Focal point for relationship strategies, sales plans, proposal strategies, and contract negotiations, for pursuits in play.

job.title: Project Planner, Project Delivery
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

Support the Project Delivery team in project scheduling, risk analysis, performance monitoring, and preparation of reports related to revenue, billing, and operational support.

How you will do it:

A. Project Scheduling & Analysis

  • Develop baseline master work programs and project schedules, including manpower histogram charts.
  • Prepare S-Curve and manpower histograms based on project timelines.
  • Conduct delay analysis, Extension of Time (EOT) assessments, Liquidated Damages (LAD) evaluations, and prepare delay chronology reports.
  • Monitor schedule variances and update revised completion dates in coordination with Lines of Business (LOB).
  • Manage PPM Tollgate processes and upload documentation to SharePoint.

B. Revenue & Billing Monitoring

  • Update SEA Revenue Tracker, backlog, and forelog.
  • Perform revenue bridging analysis to identify gaps in revenue changes.
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly revenue charts.
  • Manage forelog files and analyze sales data.
  • Update UBR feedback, billing plans, total billing plans, and Power BI remaining data.
  • Develop billing trackers and dashboards for daily and monthly monitoring.

C. Operational Support

  • Create timesheet templates for site teams.
  • Provide support for ad-hoc requests, including data updates, report preparation, and analysis for management.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering or related fields with 3–5 years of experience in construction project management (MEP experience preferred).
  • Proficient in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project, and Advanced Microsoft Excel, including:

Pivot Tables

  • VLOOKUP / INDEX-MATCH
  • Conditional Formatting
  • Chart & Dashboard Creation
  • Data Analysis & Forecasting

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and change management skills.

Experience in subcontractor and procurement management.

In-depth understanding of PPM processes, revenue tracking, and billing.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary
  • Paid vacation/holidays/sick time
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • On the job/cross training opportunities
  • Encouraging and collaborative team environment
  • Dedication to safety through our Zero Harm policy

#LI-AA3 #LI-Onsite

job.title: Technician, HVAC Service
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results and help move society forward.

What you will do:

Johnson Controls is seeking a highly skilled and motivated HVAC Service Engineer to join our dynamic team. The successful candidate will possess extensive experience in the installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, ensuring optimal performance and customer satisfaction. This role demands a thorough understanding of HVAC technologies, exceptional troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work independently across a variety of environments, including commercial and residential settings.

How you will do it:

  • Perform comprehensive installation, maintenance, and repair of HVAC systems, including air conditioning units, heating systems, refrigeration units, and ventilation systems, ensuring compliance with manufacturer specifications and industry standards.
  • Conduct detailed inspections and diagnostics of HVAC systems to assess operational efficiency, identify potential problems, and implement corrective actions to mitigate downtime.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex mechanical, electrical, and control system failures, utilizing advanced diagnostic tools and techniques.
  • Execute routine maintenance tasks, such as cleaning and replacing filters, coils, and fans, as well as checking refrigerant levels and electrical connections to enhance system longevity and performance.
  • Provide expert recommendations to clients for system upgrades, repairs, and energy efficiency improvements, ensuring customer understanding of system functionalities and benefits.
  • Adhere to all safety protocols and regulations during installation and service operations to ensure a safe working environment for both the technician and the customer.
  • Respond promptly to service calls and emergencies, delivering timely and effective resolutions to HVAC-related issues while maintaining high levels of customer service.
  • Keep accurate and detailed records of service activities, including specifics of repairs performed, parts utilized, and time spent on each job for billing and tracking purposes.
  • Assist in training and mentoring junior technicians, sharing knowledge and best practices to foster a collaborative and skilled team environment.
  • Collaborate closely with sales and technical teams to ensure seamless service delivery and to identify opportunities for enhancing customer satisfaction.

What we look for

  • A minimum Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or related fields with 3-5 years of proven experience as a Service Engineer specializing in HVAC systems or equivalent technical roles.
  • Extensive knowledge of HVAC equipment, systems, controls, and technologies, with a focus on best practices for installation and maintenance.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot, diagnose, and repair HVAC systems and components efficiently and effectively.
  • Exceptional communication skills with a professional demeanor, capable of building rapport with customers and explaining technical concepts in an understandable manner.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Valid driver's license is required, with the ability to travel to various customer locations as needed.
  • Familiarity with local, state, and federal safety regulations and codes related to HVAC installation and service.
  • Proven problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to challenges.

job.title: Technical Support Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Pre-Sales Technical Support

  • Provide technical consultation and product selection support to customers, sales teams, distributors, and consultants.
  • Analyze customer requirements and recommend appropriate product solutions.
  • Support preparation of technical proposals, specifications, datasheets, and tender documents.

4. Global Product Management Coordination

  • Act as the primary technical liaison with Global Product Managers.
  • Communicate regional market requirements, customer feedback, and business opportunities.
  • Support product roadmap discussions and market intelligence sharing.
  • Assist in product portfolio optimization and lifecycle management activities.
  • Coordinate product changes, feature enhancements, and product launches.

5. Global R&D Coordination

  • Collaborate with Global R&D teams to address product performance, design, and application issues.
  • Participate in technical reviews, product validation, and development projects.
  • Support root cause analysis and corrective action activities for product-related issues.
  • Facilitate communication of regional requirements and field feedback to development teams.
  • Track development progress and ensure alignment with business needs.

6. Technical Documentation & Training

Experience

  • Experience in industrial products, water systems, pumps, valves, HVAC, automation, or related industries is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong technical analysis and problem-solving skills.
  • Good understanding of engineering principles and product applications.
  • Experience with project design review and technical documentation.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to coordinate cross-functional and international teams.
  • Strong customer-oriented mindset and commercial awareness.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and technical reporting tools.

Language Requirements

  • Fluent in Mandarin and English (written and spoken).
  • Ability to communicate effectively with global teams and international customers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Response time and quality of pre-sales technical support.
  • Technical proposal success rate and project win support.
  • Product localization project completion and implementation effectiveness.
  • Customer satisfaction and technical issue resolution rate.
  • Effectiveness of collaboration with Global Product Management and R&D teams.
  • On-time completion of technical documentation and training programs.

job.title: Sales Manager, CFS
job.description:

You will work closely with the sales team to convert leads into opportunities, ensuring customer satisfaction and adherence to sales targets.

Due to continued growth in our service business, we are seeking an experienced HVAC Service Technician to join our Mackay team.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Refrigeration Mechanic or Electrician with commercial HVAC experience who enjoys working autonomously, solving technical challenges, and expanding their expertise across a diverse range of equipment and customer sites.

As part of our team, you'll work on some of the industry's most recognised HVAC systems while receiving ongoing support and training from one of the world's leading building technology companies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Preventative maintenance and reactive service work

  • Maintenance of equipment ranging from package units and split systems through to chillers and central plant
  • Exposure to Johnson Controls' Building Management Systems (BMS)

  • Site coordination and customer engagement
  • Reading plans and supporting small commercial installation projects

About You

We're looking for someone who takes pride in delivering quality workmanship and building strong customer relationships.

Essential

  • Refrigeration or Electrical Trade Qualification
  • HVAC service and maintenance experience
  • Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence
  • Full Australian working rights

Highly Regarded

  • Experience working on chillers and commercial air-conditioning systems
  • Industrial, mining, or large commercial HVAC experience
  • Building Management Systems (BMS) exposure
  • Experience in commissioning and project work

The YORK Advantage

As the OEM for YORK chillers, Johnson Controls provides specialist manufacturer training that few employers can offer. You'll gain access to industry-leading technical resources, in-house chiller training, and opportunities to develop expertise across a broad range of HVAC technologies.

Pre-Employment Requirements

Successful applicants will be required to complete:

  • Reference checks
  • Pre-employment medical assessment
  • Criminal history check
  • Drug and alcohol screening

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

Apply now in confidence.

job.title: Sr HSE Supervisor
job.description:
Job Description

As a Sr. HSE Supervisor here at Honeywell, you will lead and oversee health, safety, and environmental programs to ensure a safe and compliant workplace. You will play a critical role in driving safety culture, managing risk, and ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.

You will report directly to our HSE Manager and you’ll work out of our facility location on an On-site work schedule.

In this role, you will impact the safety and well-being of employees and contractors by implementing effective HSE strategies and fostering a proactive safety environment.

Responsibilities

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of health, safety, and environmental programs in compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and risk assessments to identify hazards and ensure corrective actions are taken promptly.
  • Develop, deliver, and coordinate HSE training programs to enhance employee awareness and competency in safety practices.
  • Investigate incidents, accidents, and near misses to determine root causes and recommend preventive measures.

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. job.description:
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.

You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.

  • Here are some other qualities we are looking for:
  • Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
  • Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep-dive education and design exercises to create world-class solutions built on AWS.

Key job responsibilities

  • Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform

job.title: Cluster Security Manager, DC Security
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Amazon.com serve customers and developers all over the world who rely on storage, compute, and other services that power Amazon’s consumer, digital and AWS businesses. Our customers trust us to handle their data with air-tight security. Customer data security is a given and a guarantee for our businesses. AWS’ Infrastructure team is looking for a detail-oriented, experienced and professional Cluster Security Manager. You will have experience managing security of large critical infrastructure installations, ideally data centers. You will have professional experience managing people with varying skill sets, devising strategies, creating, tracking and controlling budgets, sponsoring projects, and driving improvements of our security readiness. You will report to the Multi-Cluster Security Manager responsible for your area.

Key job responsibilities Your responsibilities include maintaining an extensive knowledge of complex industry trends, current security issues and security technology, and the risks and threats that could impact the Data Centers; performing annual risk analysis for the Data Center sites, particularly with respect to levels of crime, terrorism, workplace violence, and threats from natural and man-made disasters; provide leadership and best practices on security policy and practices; provide leadership, advice, and guidance to AWS Data Center staff as well as contract security staff in achieving current and long-range strategic program objectives; serve as staff support to security management and assist in conducting investigations of significant threats and/or the loss or misappropriation of assets; and liaise with other Amazon, AWS and external security organizations to ensure optimal buy-in for their successful implementation.

You will routinely collaborate with your AWS Data Center Security Managers and other regional security operations personnel to ensure that the data centers under your supervision provide a safe and secure environment and safeguard the vital information within. Your team will also educate stakeholders on the importance of emergency readiness, encourage a culture of security awareness, conduct regular drills and update all plans annually. You will be required to provide periodic performance, program and strategic roadmap briefings to AWS senior leaders.

The ideal candidate will be a confident, decisive, influential and innovative leader who can communicate a compelling and comprehensive set of outcomes to be achieved. You must have the presence and influence to define and enforce high standards for programs you implement and monitor at all levels. You must be comfortable with ambiguity, and can define structure, processes and standards where none yet exist. You must be able to deliver on our customer data security tenets and mission first; minimizing tradeoffs in cost, efficiency and operations friction. Written and verbal communications are comprehensive, clear and precise.

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of process improvement procedure creation experience
  • 5+ years of Microsoft Office tools experience
  • 5+years managing a team of individual contributors in an operational environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 5+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement experience
  • Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Proficiency in Bahasa Melayu language

job.title: Manager, Advertising Sales
job.description:
Senior Ad Sales Manager/ Ad Sales Manager - Indonesia

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Reports to: Regional Head of Advertising

We are seeking a commercially driven Senior Manager, Ad Sales to lead advertising-revenue growth in Indonesia. This role will own client and agency relationships, develop high-value digital-video, CTV, sponsorship, branded-content and programmatic opportunities, and translate Viu’s audience, content and platform strengths into compelling advertiser solutions.

The successful candidate combines strong local-market relationships with strategic selling capability, excellent commercial judgement and a proven record of delivering ambitious revenue targets in a fast-moving media environment.

**

Key responsibilities

  • Deliver assigned advertising-revenue, pipeline, renewal and new-business targets for Indonesia.
  • Build and manage relationships across key media agencies, holding companies, independent agencies, direct advertisers and strategic ad-tech partners.
  • Develop and sell integrated commercial solutions across AVOD, CTV, digital video, mobile, social extensions, sponsorships, branded content, events and advertiser-funded programming.
  • Identify category, client and agency growth opportunities; build account plans that prioritize revenue potential, strategic relevance and long-term partnership value.
  • Lead end-to-end sales conversations, from prospecting and client discovery through proposal development, commercial negotiation, contracting and campaign delivery.
  • Work closely with content, marketing, product, ad operations, data, legal and finance teams to develop feasible, differentiated and profitable client solutions.
  • Use sales, market and campaign data to identify growth opportunities, strengthen account plans, improve forecast accuracy and inform commercial decisions.
  • Leverage AI-enabled sales, research, data-analysis and workflow tools responsibly to improve prospecting, proposal development, client preparation, reporting, pipeline management and productivity.
  • Ensure all use of AI tools follows company policies on confidentiality, data security, intellectual property, client information and brand safety.
  • Create clear, accurate sales forecasts and maintain disciplined CRM hygiene, pipeline reporting and weekly opportunity reviews.
  • Monitor campaign delivery, client satisfaction and post-campaign performance; lead renewal and upsell discussions based on results and learnings.

Qualifications and experience

  • 10+ years of progressive advertising-sales, media-sales, digital-commercial or agency-partnership experience in Indonesia.
  • Established relationships with major Indonesian advertisers, media agencies and agency holding companies.
  • Demonstrated success selling premium digital media, online video, OTT/CTV, mobile, programmatic, sponsorship or branded-content solutions.
  • Strong understanding of the Indonesian advertising ecosystem, including agency planning and buying processes, client decision-makers and major growth categories.
  • Commercially sophisticated, with experience structuring proposals, negotiating pricing and terms, managing revenue forecasts and closing complex deals.
  • Strong understanding of digital-video advertising metrics, including reach, frequency, completion rate, viewability, engagement, brand lift and conversion-oriented measurement.
  • Familiarity with programmatic advertising, including DSPs, SSPs, private marketplaces, programmatic guaranteed and audience/data activation.
  • Demonstrated ability to use CRM and sales-enablement platforms, reporting dashboards and productivity tools to manage accounts, opportunities and forecasts.
  • AI fluency: able to effectively use AI-enabled tools to support sales prospecting, account research, insight generation, proposal drafting, presentation development, forecasting, CRM updates and workflow automation.
  • Sound judgement in using AI responsibly, including the ability to validate outputs, protect confidential information, avoid uploading restricted client or company data, recognize potential bias or inaccuracies, and comply with internal governance requirements.
  • Curious and proactive about adopting new sales, data, automation and collaboration technologies that enhance commercial effectiveness without replacing relationship-led, consultative selling.
  • Excellent presentation, storytelling and negotiation skills; able to engage credibly with C-suite clients and senior agency stakeholders.
  • Highly organized and analytical, with a disciplined approach to pipeline management, forecasting and account planning.
  • Comfortable operating in a cross-functional, regional organization with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
  • Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and professional English are essential.

Preferred experience

  • Experience in a streaming platform, broadcaster, publisher, digital-video business, social platform, ad-tech company or leading media agency.
  • Experience selling sponsorships, branded entertainment, branded content or creator/influencer extensions.
  • Experience commercializing live sports, entertainment franchises or high-impact content moments.

job.title: Network Test & Automation Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Engineer will execute and support existing/new project assignments covering GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs, IoT, and device-management technologies including but not limited to TR-069, TR-181, and TR-369. In addition, the role will support the operation, maintenance and troubleshooting of lab systems infrastructure.

This role focuses more on technical execution and troubleshooting of the above-mentioned requirements without neglecting project management skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams and vendors.

Make an impact by:

  • Develop scripts and tools using languages and/or automation platforms such as Python, or similar technologies to automate network configuration, test execution, monitoring, data collection and troubleshooting.
  • Plan, execute and document testing and validation for GPON, Wi-Fi CPEs and IoT solutions, including functional, interoperability, regression and end-to-end validation as required.
  • Develop, execute and maintain test cases covering device-management technologies and data models, including TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369.
  • Perform troubleshooting, analysis and diagnostics to enable faster failure root-cause identification and fault isolation, with or without vendor support.
  • Develop new test cases to meet new growth requirements and enhance existing test plans and validation coverage.
  • Manage and support lab systems infrastructure required for testing, including servers, operating systems, virtual machines, test platforms/tools, network connectivity, user/access administration and related services.
  • Perform routine administration, monitoring, maintenance, patching, backup/recovery and troubleshooting of lab systems to maintain availability, stability and security.
  • Coordinate with vendor(s) to identify requirements, timelines, dependencies and resources needed for testing improvement, automation and lab infrastructure activities whenever required.
  • Document test procedures, infrastructure configurations, processes, solutions and best practices for knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain periodic updates on progress, issues, risks and key callouts for immediate discussion and solutioning.
  • Manage project timelines and resources to ensure assigned projects and deliverables are completed on time.
  • Ensure lab infra compliance with company Group IT, cybersecurity and/or security requirements for all work performed.
  • Execute and/or support existing/new test project assignments across GPON, Wi-Fi CPE, IoT and associated device-management platforms.
  • Any other tasks assigned by the manager.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Information Technology or a related technical field.
  • Certification in CCNA and ITIL 4 is preferred.
  • Proven experience in GPON/CPE testing in a lab environment.
  • Hands-on experience in testing and validation of IoT and CPE/device-management technologies, with knowledge of TR-069, TR-181 and TR-369 strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of lab test tools, lab operations and test equipment.
  • Good systems infrastructure management skills for lab environments, including administration and troubleshooting of Firewall, Network Switches, Linux and/or Windows systems, servers, virtual machines, applications/services.
  • Strong understanding of IP Networking concepts, protocols and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Familiar with scripting and automation across environments such as Python, Linux shell and Windows-based systems.
  • Good project management skills, including the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse cross-functional teams and external vendors.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve complex technical problems across network, test platform and systems infrastructure layers.
  • Detail-oriented with strong documentation, organizational and analytical skills.

job.title: Network Deployment Build Lead, Global Network Delivery
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Project Lead to join our growing team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The candidate will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to develop innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.

The position responsibilities will include scaling support of several data center locations and be responsible for day to day assistance with capacity management. The Network Project Lead will work closely with both internal stakeholders and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Technical Program Managers, Network Deployment Planning team, infrastructure supply chain & procurement and network engineering team.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.

In addition, this role may require international travels to support other cluster’s projects.

Key job responsibilities

  • Working closely with our Network Engineering & Network Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth rollout of established designs and products.
  • Managing work priorities through ticketing system and workflows & collaborating with various stake holders to remove project obstacles.
  • Troubleshooting networking, routing and inter connectivity issues, including troubleshooting of network device configuration and low-level application interaction.
  • Troubleshooting cabling infrastructure connectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords.
  • Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment.
  • Completing customer requests via Remedy trouble ticketing system and project management workflows.
  • Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware.
  • Reasonable additional hours required as part of the project delivery requirements.

About the team About AWS

Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of computer hardware troubleshooting and repair experience
  • 1+ years of computer networking experience
  • High school or equivalent diploma
  • Expertise in network infrastructure, including cabling systems, fiber optics, diagnostic tools, and network fundamentals. The ideal candidate will leverage this technical knowledge to lead teams and optimize project delivery.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: Engineer II, R&D
job.description:
We are looking for a Highly skilled Engineer II, Product Development to support the sustaining and new product development for fiber connectivity solutions. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve design issues, and recommend and document effective solutions.

How You'll Help Us Connect the World: ##Engineering Expertise##

  • Create documentation of product requirements based on industry standards.
  • Create designs of new components and assemblies.
  • Create documentation to support the release of new and modified products.

-Support the optical and mechanical testing of fiber optic products.

  • Work with Manufacturing on process development and introductions of new products into Manufacturing.
  • Perform data analysis and evaluation.
  • Leads and maintains project scopes, tracks Product Development projects, and ensures timely completion of project timelines and milestones.
  • Conducts Design Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (DFMEA) to assess product criticality and ensure design robustness.
  • Review and approve product design and engineering change documentation for conformance to company, customer, agency and industry specifications and standards

##Collaboration and Communication##

= Accountable to Engineering Management in support of the business unit growth objectives.

  • Collaboration with current staff which includes other engineers and technicians in team
  • Collaborates with global design centers and manufacturing sites to resolve design and manufacturing issues, ensuring effective communication and problem-solving.
  • Develop awareness of corporate, business unit and quality management system documentation.
  • Develop awareness of relevant industry standards for fiber optic products
  • Develop awareness of the range of lab test equipment.
  • Develop knowledge of fiber optic products and technical principals.
  • Develop knowledge of engineering tools such as LEAN and/or 6-sigma, DMAIC or other improvement process, DoE, FMEA, MSA, uncertainty

##Process Excellence##

  • Ensures seamless design, documentation, and product change management processes.
  • Shares best practices and knowledge with global manufacturing sites, promoting standardization and efficiency.

Key Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex issues and implement effective solutions.
  • Solid knowledge and skilled user of 3D CAD software.
  • Solid knowledge of Product Development Process
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of design for manufacturing for sheet metal & Plastic components
  • Skilled at planning and ability to pay attention to details.
  • Ability to effectively work within a team environment.

##Required Qualifications for Consideration:##

Master’s, Bachelor’s, or Associate degree in Mechanical Engineering with 5-7years of relevant experience in product development. Proficiency in leading CAD software such as CREO, AutoCAD. Should demonstrate strong knowledge of 2D drafting and GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, sustaining engineering principles. Familiarity with PLM systems like SAP, ECTR, and Windchill, along with simulation tools such as FEA, ANSYS Workbench, and LS-DYNA, is highly desirable.

##You Will Excite Us If You Have:##

  • Experience with design/test of fiber optic connectors and cable assemblies as per international and Domestic standards (TIA-EIA-568B, GR-326, etc).
  • CREO/CAD experience
  • Solid knowledge and skilled user of SAP
