job.title: Continuous Improvement Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

The role is responsible for delivering accurate and timely business insights while driving projects that improve processes, automate reporting, and strengthen cross-functional collaboration. Working closely with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, IT, and regional leadership, the Specialist identifies improvement opportunities, leads project execution, and implements sustainable solutions that improve productivity, reporting quality, and business performance.

Duties and Responsibilities

Business Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Ensure the accuracy, timeliness, and completeness Operational performance reporting across the region.
  • Prepare, consolidate, analyze, and distribute periodic and ad hoc business reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
  • Develop meaningful business insights by analyzing operational & service performance, pipeline health, win rates, order trends, and key business metrics.
  • Support Service Leaders during monthly SIOP discussions by providing data analysis, trend interpretation, and actionable recommendations.

Continuous Improvement & Project Management

  • Lead and manage continuous improvement initiatives that streamline business processes, improve reporting efficiency, and enhance operational effectiveness.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities through data analysis, stakeholder feedback, and operational reviews, and recommend sustainable solutions.
  • Manage improvement projects from initiation through implementation, including planning, stakeholder engagement, execution, monitoring, risk management, and post-implementation review.
  • Drive automation initiatives using technologies such as Power BI, Vega AI, Excel, and other digital tools to reduce manual effort and improve reporting accuracy.
  • Develop standardized processes, documentation, and governance to support consistent execution across the region.
  • Monitor project progress, communicate status updates to stakeholders, and ensure successful delivery against agreed timelines and objectives.
  • Measure and report the business impact of improvement initiatives through defined performance metrics and KPIs.

Stakeholder & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales, Operations, Finance, HR, IT, and regional leadership to drive alignment on business priorities and operational improvements.
  • Act as the liaison between Sales, Operations, Finance, and IT to support system enhancements, reporting improvements, and process optimization.
  • Collaborate with regional and global teams to support business transformation initiatives and implement best practices across the organization.
  • Challenge existing processes and proactively recommend innovative approaches that improve business performance and productivity.

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5 years of experience in business analytics, engineering, consulting, or a related function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects, process improvement initiatives, and business transformation programs.
  • Project management skills an advantage, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously, prioritize effectively, and deliver results within agreed timelines.
  • Experience applying continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, or similar structured problem-solving approaches is highly desirable.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; experience with AI tools or other reporting automation tools is an advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to consolidate, interpret, and communicate complex business data into actionable insights.

  • Customer-focused mindset with excellent relationship and account management skills.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, adaptable, and committed to driving operational excellence through continuous improvement.

job.title: Manufacturing Quality Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

Product Quality Engineer (NPDI)

Drive product field quality improvements. Provide direction and support for implementation and continued use of tools and methods utilized in the improvement of system reliability.Lead implementation and apply advanced quality processes, methods and tools for all new product development programs.Develop and report critical product metrics for warranty and reliability tracking and projections. Effectively work across all product development areas in the company to drive and sustain a strong quality culture across the overall organization. Lead, coordinate and support multiple quality improvement projects across various departmental areas, driving short term and long term, sustainable corrective actions to address product and process issues.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Determine the data driven top customer field issues list, verify an owner is assigned and status is reported weekly.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to implement corrective actions through problem solving process. Evaluate completed corrective actions and ensure effectiveness of actions. Recommend appropriate remedial activities.
  • Visit customers to proactively see installations and document improvement needs. Visit customers to understand the nature of the issue and get definite corrective action initiated in the organization.
  • Track shipments of new products, Pareto and report issues and assist in assigning ownership to the problems.
  • Support product transfer process and assist with product audit feedback and early field issue reporting.
  • Present reports to organization regarding Quality performance. Present status updates on various quality initiatives to business management.
  • Develop 8D and Customer reports on reported issues. Communicate internally and externally on outcomes of investigations. Work with internal teams, including Engineering, Service, Manufacturing/Operations, Sales, Offering Management, and Supplier Quality to resolve quality issues impacting customers.
  • Execute Quality Engineering responsibilities on New Product Development projects, participating on New Product Development Process (NPDP) teams, tracking issues, and ensuring effective resolution. Ensure risk management plans are in place when issues are identified.
  • Create analytic reporting around warranty data for America’s LOB using Use Excel, SQL, and Power BI
  • Support Warranty administration as needed.
  • Other Duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS

BA or BS or equivalent experience

Engineering or Technical Field

5-8 years of experience

At least 3 years of professional engineering quality related experience.

Requirements

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Excellent organizational, analytical and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Proficient in data analysis; ability to develop performance metrics and goals based on product and process data.
  • Generate and present reports using Excel, PowerPoint and Vertiv system applications.
  • Direct and relative experience conducting Root Causes and Correct Actions using 8D problem solving or similar techniques.
  • Knowledge of Failure Modes and Effects Analysis (FMEA)
  • Process evaluation and capability analysis - Six Sigma (DAMIC) experience a plus
  • Knowledge in electrical, mechanical and firmware design and development, reliability and test validation
  • Experience in product development cycle processes including production release, supplier qualification requirements, production qualification / validation processes and production testing.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • N/A

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

job.description:
AWS Global Sales (AGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

In this role, you will engage with customers in India to determine business needs, identify opportunities and issues, and develop related technical solutions and value propositions leveraging the power of AWS cloud technology.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

#aws-ags-India

Key job responsibilities

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design customer solutions with a focus on the Financial Services industry, collaborating with the AWS Business Development function and internal teams in India to help customers migrate to AWS cloud-based technology solutions.
  • Architect solutions leveraging AWS technology, including solution development and potentially demonstrate technical feasibility through mechanisms including proof-of-concepts and/or prototypes.
  • Serve as a thought leadership, evangelizing AWS services and technologies through forums such as AWS blogs, whitepapers, reference architectures and public-speaking opportunities such as AWS first-party events and third-party industry events.
  • Capture and share best practices and insights internally and with Partners and customers in India.
  • Identifying customer requirements and providing feedback into appropriate AWS services teams. Provide updates on customer progress and ensure plan execution by partners.

They will be able to facilitate relationships with senior executive stakeholders, as well as easily interact with and give guidance to technology experts, software developers, IT professionals, and system architects to ensure better CX and compliance with global AWS standards, practices and policies.
  • The right individual will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, product, and technical challenges. If you are someone who enjoys innovating, likes solving hard problems and working on cutting edge technology, we would love to hear from you.

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

job.title: Partner Success Manager -FED gov, Public Sector
job.description:

Ltd (AISPL), the local seller for cloud services in India. Through these relationships, you will be responsible for growing internal adoption of AWS, as well as broad organizational AWS competency in the partners in India. Ideal candidates will possess both and technical business background that enables them to drive engagements and interact at multiple levels with APN partners and customers of AISPL, including the partner founders/ board. Candidates should also have strong industry experience and demonstrated the ability to think and act strategically on the government customer mission, industry directions, and partner/customer technical challenges. Roles & Responsibilities:

job.title: R&D Software Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Department/Local Unit Lead SBBA China__

What we believe in

At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration - combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities - are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

Your role and responsibilities

For a Building Automation R&D Software Engineer. We are currently seeking an engineer with expertise in the field of Building Management System (BMS) and experience in developing upper-level software. The candidate will be responsible for designing and developing the core management software for the building automation system. They will lead the system integration based on the BACNET protocol, the design of microservice architecture, and the development of cross-platform desktop applications (Electron), ensuring that the upper-level system can efficiently monitor, manage data, and control building equipment.

The work model for the role is: onsite

This role is contributing to the Smart Building division in China.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Requirements Analysis and System Design: Understand the requirements of the building automation business, design the overall architecture of the upper-level machine software, including the front-end interface, communication module, data processing and the microservice backend. The leading integration solution for the BACNET protocol with other industrial protocols (such as Modbus, OPC UA) enables real-time collection and control of device data.
  • Software Development and Implementation: Develop a cross-platform (Windows/MacOS) upper-level machine monitoring interface based on the Electron framework and implement the interaction logic using front-end technologies such as React/Vue. Design and develop the backend services of microservice architecture, responsible for core modules such as device management, data storage, and alarm processing; Develop the BACNET protocol stack or integrate existing libraries to achieve communication and protocol parsing with building equipment (such as air conditioning, lighting, and energy systems).
  • System Integration and Testing: Team collaboration was carried out to complete the joint debugging of the upper computer system with the on-site controllers and sensors, ensuring the stability of data transmission. Design and develop test cases, optimize system performance, and solve technical issues such as compatibility and real-time performance.
  • Technical Optimization and Maintenance: Continuously optimize the software architecture to enhance the system's scalability, security and user experience. Responsible for the writing of technical documents (such as interface documents and development guidelines), and providing technical support to the team.

Qualifications for the role

  • Professional background and industry knowledge of cyber security, and: Bachelor's degree or above, majoring in Computer Science, Automation, Building Automation Control, etc. More than 3 years of software development experience in building automation (BMS) or industrial automation field, familiar with BMS system architecture (such as distributed monitoring, data center management).
  • Protocol and Communication Technology: Have a deep understanding of the BACNET protocol (ANSI/ASHRAE 135) and possess experience in protocol development or integration; Familiar with industrial communication methods such as TCP/IP and serial communication, and those who are familiar with protocols like Modbus and MQTT will be given priority.
  • Software Development Capability: Proficient in the Electron framework and possessing extensive experience in developing cross-platform desktop applications; Proficient in the front-end technology stack (JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3), and familiar with frameworks such as React/Vue; Familiar with microservice architecture design, and proficient in technologies such as Spring Cloud, Docker, and Kubernetes; Have the ability to develop the backend (such as Node.js, Java, Python), and be familiar with database design (MySQL/PostgreSQL/time-series databases).
  • Other Skills: Possessing excellent problem-solving skills and logical thinking abilities, and being capable of independently analyzing complex system issues; Possess excellent teamwork and communication skills, and be able to work efficiently with the hardware, testing and other teams. Has a strong sense of self-motivation and constantly seeks more efficient and optimized solutions.
  • Bonus points: Familiar with IoT protocols such as OPC UA and Matter, or have experience in developing industrial visualizations (such as ECharts, D3.js); Understand energy management systems (EMS) and building energy efficiency analysis, and have relevant project experience; Have experience in contributing to open-source projects or writing technical blogs.
  • Technical Stack Reference: Front-end/Desktop Development: Electron, React/Vue, TypeScript, Webpack, Electron Builder; Back-end/Microservices: Node.js/Java, Spring Cloud, Docker, Kafka/RabbitMQ; Protocols and Tools: BACNET Stack (such as JythonBACnet, node-bacnet), Wireshark, BACnet testing tools; Database: MySQL/PostgreSQL, InfluxDB/TimescaleDB (time series data) . Deployment and Operations: Docker Compose, Kubernetes, CI/CD processes.
  • Work environment: Work closely with application engineers and product managers in the field of building automation to promote the implementation of intelligent building solutions; Support on-site debugging and alignment with customer requirements (based on project needs).

What's in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Benefits

ABB provides competitive benefits, ask us!

More about us ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit [www.abb.com](http://www.abb.com/) to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe. #MyABBStory

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Accounting & Reporting Manager - General Accounting ###

SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting.

Take your next career step at ABB with a global team that is energizing the transformation of society and industry to achieve a more productive, sustainable future.

At ABB, we have the clear goal of driving diversity and inclusion across all dimensions: gender, LGBTQ+, abilities, ethnicity and generations. Together, we are embarking on a journey where each one of us, individually and collectively, welcomes and celebrates individual differences.

You will be working as SME-Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and will be reporting to Accounting & Reporting Manager – GA and will be a part of Bangalore, India. In this role you will be primarily responsible for End-to-End Fixed Assets Accounting & Reporting and Internal Audit and Process Improvements and automation Process as SME or team focused on the complete, accurate, and timely completion of Fixed Assets & Reporting and related activities within the General Accounting (GA) team. Ensure compliance with internal guidelines and procedures as well as external regulatory requirements with strong understanding of USGAP and FA Module.

Fixed Asset Accounting Operations

  • Manage end-to-end fixed asset accounting processes.
  • Ensure accurate capitalization, transfers, retirements, disposals, and depreciation of assets.
  • Review and approve asset creation requests in compliance with accounting policies.
  • Maintain the fixed asset register and ensure completeness and accuracy.
  • Monitor Construction-in-Progress (CIP) accounting and capitalization activities.

Financial Reporting & Month-End Close

  • Execute month-end, quarter-end, and year-end fixed asset close activities.
  • Review depreciation runs and accounting entries.
  • Prepare and validate fixed asset reconciliations between subledger and general ledger.
  • Support financial statement disclosures related to Property, Plant & Equipment (PP&E).
  • Analyze asset balances and investigate significant movements.

Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Ensure compliance with IFRS, US GAAP, local statutory requirements, and company accounting policies.
  • Maintain SOX/internal control documentation and evidence.
  • Identify control gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Support internal and external audits through timely preparation of schedules and explanations.

Asset Lifecycle Management

  • Govern the complete asset lifecycle from acquisition to disposal.
  • Ensure appropriate asset classification and useful life assignment.
  • Review impairment assessments and asset write-offs.
  • Monitor leased assets and right-of-use assets where applicable.

Reconciliation & Data Quality

  • Perform periodic asset register reviews and reconciliations.
  • Resolve discrepancies between procurement, project accounting, and fixed assets records.
  • Ensure asset master data accuracy and integrity.
  • Develop and track key performance metrics related to fixed asset processes.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Prepare management reports on capital expenditures, depreciation, asset additions, and disposals.
  • Support budgeting and forecasting activities related to fixed assets.
  • Provide insights into capital investment trends and asset utilization.
  • Develop dashboards and report solutions for stakeholders.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the primary point of contact for fixed asset-related queries.
  • Partner with Finance, Procurement, Tax, Controllership, and Business Operations teams.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, statutory auditors, and tax advisors.
  • Provide guidance on fixed asset accounting treatments and policy interpretations.

Process Improvement & Automation

  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives.
  • Lead standardization and harmonization of fixed asset processes across entities.
  • Support system implementations, upgrades, and testing activities (e.g., SAP, Oracle, S4-HANA,Trintech)
  • Promote automation opportunities to improve efficiency and control.

SME Governance Responsibilities

  • Serve as the functional expert for fixed asset accounting.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Deliver training and knowledge-sharing sessions to team members.
  • Provide guidance during transitions, migrations, and transformation projects.
  • Review complex accounting transactions and determine appropriate treatment.

Key Skills & Competencies:

  • Strong knowledge of Fixed Assets Accounting, PP&E, Depreciation, Capitalization, and Asset Retirement.
  • Experience with IFRS, US GAAP, and internal controls.
  • ERP knowledge (SAP, Oracle,).
  • Advanced Excel and reporting skills.
  • Analytical problem-solving and stakeholder management.
  • Audit support and compliance expertise.
  • A master’s degree in accounting, Finance or Commerce (MBA/Mcom) is must.
  • Minimum 10to 12 years of experience in Fixed Assets Accounting and Record to Report GA.
  • Experience leading teams in a shared service, GBS, or multinational environment.
  • Strong knowledge of working in SAP & FA Module.

More about us

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who deliver forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operate with the highest standards

job.title: AI Solutions Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Business Process Manager__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will develop and deploy end-to-end AI and machine learning solutions that address complex business challenges across Operations, Sales, and Service functions. This role combines technical expertise in ML/AI with business acumen to translate customer needs into scalable, production-ready AI solutions. The engineer works closely with data engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders to architect, build, test, and optimize AI models while ensuring solution quality, governance, and measurable business impact.

The work model for this role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI solutions to solve business challenges in operations, maintenance, forecasting, and process optimization.
  • Architecting end-to-end ML workflows, including data preparation, feature engineering, model development, validation, and production deployment.
  • Conducting exploratory data analysis, feasibility assessments, and proof-of-concept (POC) initiatives to evaluate business value and technical viability.
  • Collaborating with data engineers and cross-functional teams to build scalable data pipelines and ensure high-quality training datasets.
  • Applying ML engineering and MLOps best practices, including model versioning, CI/CD, containerization, monitoring, governance, and documentation.
  • Monitoring model performance in production, address model drift, and implement retraining strategies to maintain accuracy and business relevance.
  • Communicating AI/ML insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders, contribute to engineering standards, and drive adoption of emerging AI technologies and best practices.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical discipline; Master's degree in Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field is an advantage.
  • Around 5 years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or AI solution development within a commercial or enterprise environment.
  • Demonstrated success in designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models into production environments at scale.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with practical experience using ML frameworks and libraries such as Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch.
  • Experience working with cloud-based machine learning platforms, including AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, or Google Vertex AI.
  • Solid understanding of MLOps, model lifecycle management, and deployment pipelines, with exposure to business-driven AI use cases such as predictive maintenance, forecasting, optimization, or intelligent automation.

What’s in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

More about us

ABB's Service Division partners with our customers to improve the availability, reliability, predictability and sustainability of electrical products and installations. The Division’s extensive service portfolio offers product care, modernization, and advisory services to improve performance, extend equipment lifetime and deliver new levels of operational and sustainable efficiency. We help customers keep resources in use for as long as possible, extracting the maximum value from them, and then recovering and regenerating products and materials at the end of their useful life.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit [https://www.abb.com](https://www.abb.com) to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: R2R and M&A Solution Lead
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Head of Central Finance ###

We are looking for an experienced and technically proficient M&A CFIN Architect to lead the design, integration, and optimization of finance solutions within the Central Finance (CFIN) landscape. This role is responsible for supporting any new company code, mergers, acquisitions, and divestments by ensuring that acquired entities are efficiently integrated into the target CFIN architecture in alignment with business objectives.

The CFIN M&A solution lead will assess the current-state finance and IT landscapes of acquired companies, define target-state architecture, and drive integration activities in CFIN system. The role requires close collaboration with Finance, IS Architecture, M&A integration teams, and external vendors to ensure seamless system integration, data consistency, process standardization, and compliance with ABB standards. The architect will also contribute to automation and optimization initiatives to improve testing automation and operational efficiency within the CFIN environment.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the Finance Services business Finance Process Data Systems division in Bangalore, India.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Delivery Leadership - Lead end-to-end delivery of R2R and M&A-related changes within CFIN from implementation through cutover and stabilization, Ensure delivery milestones, dependencies, risks and issues are actively managed and escalated where required, Drive successful deployment while protecting financial close, reporting and system stability
  • Team Leadership - Lead, mentor and develop the R2R and M&A Solution Architect team, Set clear priorities, accountabilities and delivery expectations across the team, Build strong functional capability and promote effective collaboration across workstreams
  • M&A & Legal Entity Delivery - Lead CFIN delivery for acquisitions, divestments, company-code onboarding and separation activities, Coordinate migration, mapping, reconciliation, testing, cutover and post-go-live activities, Ensure cross-functional dependencies with O2C, P2P, Treasury, Tax, MDG and technical teams are managed effectively
  • Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination - Work closely with Global Process Owners, Process Architects, M&A teams, Finance, MDG, technical teams and external partners, Ensure agreed designs and requirements are translated into executable delivery plans, Resolve delivery blockers and drive alignment across teams where ownership or dependencies span multiple areas
  • Delivery Assurance & Operational Readiness - Ensure solutions are fully tested, documented and operationally ready before deployment, Validate that agreed controls, reconciliation requirements and business acceptance criteria are met, Lead resolution of critical delivery and production issues during cutover and stabilization
  • Continuous Improvement - Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, automation and standardization across R2R and M&A activities, Drive reusable approaches for testing, migration, onboarding and cutover, Use lessons learned from previous deployments to improve future delivery.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in finance, Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science or a related field
  • 12–15+ years of SAP Finance experience with strong knowledge of SAP Central Finance and/or S/4HANA Finance
  • Strong functional expertise in Record-to-Report, including General Ledger, close, reconciliation, intercompany and financial reporting
  • Experience delivering complex M&A, divestment, legal-entity onboarding or Finance transformation initiatives
  • Strong experience across testing, data migration, reconciliation, cutover and stabilization
  • Proven experience leading Architects or senior functional teams
  • Strong delivery management, stakeholder management and decision-making capability
  • Ability to manage complex cross-functional dependencies and drive issues to resolution
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to operate effectively across Finance, business, technical teams and external partners
  • Strong focus on execution, operational stability and successful business outcomes

More about us:

ABB Finance is a trusted partner to the business and a world-class team who delivers forward-looking insights that drive sustainable long-term results and operates with the highest standards. job.title: Project Manager, BAS
job.description:
Project Manager / Senior Project Manager

General Scope of Works

Responsible for the full lifecycle delivery of HVAC / Building Services and BMS projects, including tender support, planning, execution, monitoring, and close-out. Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and in compliance with contractual, quality, and regulatory requirements while achieving financial and customer satisfaction objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary project leader for HVAC / Building Services and BMS projects, responsible for overall project delivery.
  • Lead projects from tender stage through execution, including contract review, planning, scheduling and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage project scope, cost, billing, cash flow and profitability; ensure accurate and timely financial reporting and collections.
  • Review project cost estimates, scope, and risks during pre-tender and pre-execution stages; support value engineering and margin improvement initiatives.
  • Develop and control project schedules, resources, risk registers and recovery plans to ensure successful delivery.
  • Evaluate contractual changes, variation orders and claims; prepare proposals and negotiate with clients for approval and settlement.
  • Manage subcontractors including tendering, negotiation, contract administration and performance monitoring.
  • Oversee procurement, equipment selection, material ordering and delivery schedules.
  • Ensure site execution complies with specifications, safety standards, local codes and quality requirements.
  • Lead coordination with clients, consultants, contractors and internal teams; maintain strong stakeholder relationships.
  • Manage project teams, including resource planning, performance monitoring and capability development.
  • Establish and implement SOPs, cost estimation standards and best practices for HVAC / BMS projects.
  • Monitor project progress, risks, and financial performance; report status to management and resolve issues proactively.
  • Ensure testing, commissioning and handover are completed in accordance with project standards.
  • Perform other ad-hoc duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical / Electrical / Building Services Engineering or equivalent; professional membership is an advantage.
  • Minimum 8-10 years of relevant experience in HVAC / building services project management (8+ years for senior BMS-focused roles).
  • Proven experience in full project lifecycle management including tendering, execution and commissioning.
  • Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, BMS, and related building services disciplines (Fire, ELV, Security).
  • Experience in cost estimation, SOP development and standardization for engineering or BMS systems.
  • Familiarity with local and international codes and practices in building services.
  • Experience in large-scale projects or complex system integration is an advantage.
  • Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to manage financial performance, risks and contract negotiations effectively.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English with strong written communication skills.
  • Ability to present technical information to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Candidates with less experience will be considered as Project Manager.

job.title: Service Engineer
job.description:
Job Summary

The Service Engineer will be responsible for installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and servicing of Building Management Systems (BMS), Fire Alarm Systems, Access Control Systems, CCTV Surveillance Systems, Intrusion Detection Systems, and other ELV/Security solutions. The role requires strong technical expertise, customer interaction skills, and the ability to ensure system uptime and compliance with safety standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform installation, testing, commissioning, and maintenance of Fire & Security Systems.
  • Diagnose and resolve faults in fire alarm, CCTV, access control, intrusion alarm, and control systems.
  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance activities as per service schedules.
  • Attend service calls and ensure timely closure of customer complaints.
  • Maintain service reports, maintenance records, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with customers, subcontractors, and internal teams for project execution and service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations, quality standards, and company procedures.
  • Support system upgrades, modifications, and integration activities.
  • Provide technical training and guidance to customers when required.
  • Participate in on-call support and emergency breakdown response.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Knowledge of Fire Detection & Alarm Systems.
  • Experience with CCTV, Access Control, Intrusion Alarm, and ELV Systems.
  • Understanding of Control Systems, BMS, and PLC basics is preferred.
  • Ability to read electrical schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical drawings.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and customer service skills.
  • Familiarity with safety standards and statutory compliance requirements.

Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation, Mechatronics, or related discipline.
  • Relevant certifications in Fire & Security Systems are an advantage.

Experience

  • 2 to 6 years of experience in installation, commissioning, or servicing of Fire, Security, ELV, or Building Automation Systems.

job.title: Service engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Johnson Controls is a world leader in smart buildings, creating safe, healthy and sustainable spaces. For nearly 140 years, we’ve made buildings better and now we’re transforming them again with our award-winning digital technologies and services. We’re using artificial intelligence and data-driven solutions to give you deeper insight into your building’s health, sustainability and performance. It’s changing the way we design, operates and maintains indoor environments and driving to a new era of autonomous buildings.

We deliver the blueprint of the future for industries such as healthcare, schools, data centers, airports, stadiums, hotels, manufacturing and beyond through OpenBlue, our comprehensive suite of connected solutions.

Johnson Controls offers the world’s largest portfolio of building technology, software and services. Supported by a team of more than 100,000 dedicated employees working across 150 countries, we’re helping customers achieve their sustainability goals and power their mission.

###

Please visit and follow Johnson Controls linkedin for recent exciting activities.

APAC Linkedin [Johnson Controls APAC Linkedin ](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/johnson-controls-asia-pacific/)

Career [The Power Behind Your Mission](https://youtu.be/EwhAYCz6x_4)

OpenBlue [OpenBlue: This is How a Space Comes Alive](https://youtu.be/bFbZIj0Sj6Y)

What you will do:

HVAC Chiller Service Engineer - Troubleshooting

We are seeking an experienced HVAC Chiller Service Engineer to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in diagnosing, troubleshooting, and repairing HVAC chiller systems, ensuring efficient operation and minimizing downtime. The role requires a strong technical background, attention to detail, and a proactive approach to maintenance and service.

What we look for:

  • ### Diagnose and troubleshoot issues with HVAC chiller systems, including compressors, evaporators, condensers, and associated components.
  • ### Perform routine maintenance and repairs on chillers to ensure optimal performance and longevity.
  • ### Identify and resolve mechanical and electrical faults, utilizing diagnostic tools and industry best practices.
  • ### Conduct inspections and testing of HVAC equipment to confirm system functionality and compliance with safety standards.
  • ### Provide on-site technical support to clients, including emergency repairs and troubleshooting.
  • ### Maintain accurate records of services performed, parts used, and recommendations for future maintenance.
  • ### Collaborate with other team members to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
  • ### Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and company policies.
  • ### Stay updated on new technologies and industry developments in HVAC systems

###

Join Johnson Controls and be part of a team that values your contributions, supports your growth, and provides a rewarding work environment.

###

Diversity & Inclusion

Our dedication to diversity and inclusion starts with our values. We lead with integrity and purpose, focusing on the future and aligning with our customers’ vision for success. Our High-Performance Culture ensures that we have the best talent that is highly engaged and eager to innovate. ​​​​​​ Our D&I mission elevates each employee’s responsibility to contribute to our culture. It’s through these contributions that we’ll drive the mindsets and behaviors we need to power our customers’ missions. You have the power. You have the voice. You have the culture in your hands.

job.title: Developer - Enterprise Integration
job.description:
-

Senior Integration Developer (6–9 Years)

Role Summary

A highly experienced, hands-on Senior Integration Developer responsible for designing and delivering complex, enterprise-grade integration solutions. Drives advanced development, owns Low-Level Design (LLDs), and ensures high-quality, CI/CD-driven delivery using Azure Integration Services, while mentoring teams and contributing to architecture alignment.

Key Responsibilities

Core Development (Primary Focus)

Lead the development of complex, large-scale integration solutions using Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Data Factory, Service Bus, Event Grid).

  • Build high-performance, scalable, and production-ready solutions, handling complex enterprise integration scenarios.
  • Develop reusable frameworks, advanced integration patterns, and shared components to accelerate delivery across programs.

API Development & APIM Governance

  • Design and implement enterprise-grade APIs using Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Configure advanced APIM policies including security, transformation, throttling, and routing.
  • Ensure APIs meet performance, security, and governance standards.

Low-Level Design & Technical Ownership

  • Own and drive Low-Level Design (LLDs) for modules and critical components.
  • Translate business and architectural requirements into scalable, well-structured technical designs.
  • Ensure strict adherence to architecture standards, design principles, and best practices.

Azure DevOps & CI/CD (Key Responsibility)

  • Design, implement, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
  • Drive end-to-end automation of build, deployment, and release processes using Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Ensure consistent, reliable, and high-quality releases across environments.
  • Improve deployment efficiency, rollback strategies, and release governance.

Testing, Debugging & Production Support

  • Lead unit testing, integration testing, and validation strategies.
  • Handle complex debugging and root cause analysis across APIs, events, and workflows.
  • Provide strong support for critical production issues and performance bottlenecks.

Monitoring, Reliability & Performance

  • Implement and enhance observability frameworks using Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
  • Ensure solutions meet SLAs for reliability, scalability, and performance.

AI & Copilot-Enabled Development

  • Actively leverage GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot for:
  • Code acceleration and optimization
  • LLD and API documentation generation
  • Debugging and performance insights
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity and delivery quality.
  • Contribute to adoption of AI-driven development practices within the team.

Technical Leadership & Mentoring

  • Provide hands-on technical leadership, guiding developers on design, coding, and best practices.
  • Conduct code reviews, design reviews, and quality checks.
  • Mentor engineers and junior developers, building strong technical capability across the team.

Collaboration in Complex Delivery Programs

  • Work closely with Leads, Architects, QA, DevOps, and business stakeholders.
  • Drive alignment between design, development, and delivery timelines.
  • Actively contribute to high-velocity, agile delivery environments.

Required Skills

  • Experience: 6–9 years with strong focus on hands-on integration development in complex delivery environments.
  • Azure Integration: Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services (AIS).
  • API Development: Advanced experience with Azure API Management (APIM).
  • Programming: Strong coding expertise in C#, .NET, REST APIs, JSON, XML.
  • Design Skills: Proven experience in owning LLDs and contributing to HLDs.
  • Integration Patterns: Strong knowledge of event-driven, distributed, and microservices-based architectures.
  • Azure CI/CD: Hands-on expertise in designing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions.
  • Debugging & Performance: Advanced troubleshooting and optimization skills.
  • AI & Copilot Skills:
  • Active and effective use of GitHub Copilot / M365 Copilot
  • Practical understanding of AI-assisted development workflows

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with MuleSoft (architecture, migrations, or coexistence).
  • Exposure to AI/ML integration use cases and intelligent automation.
  • Knowledge of enterprise security, API governance, and compliance frameworks.

New “About Us” copy:

Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

job.title: OTC Functional Analyst
job.description:
OTC Functional Analyst

At Johnson Controls, you will help support the systems and processes that enable customers to move from order to cash with accuracy, speed, and confidence. You will work with cross-functional teams to improve business performance, strengthen operational reliability, and support the day-to-day flow of Oracle Fusion OTC processes.

Role Overview

As an OTC Functional Analyst, you will support and improve Order-to-Cash processes across areas such as order management, invoicing, receipts, customer master data, and month-end activities. This role is well suited for a professional with 4-6 years of experience who enjoys solving business problems, working closely with stakeholders, and turning functional requirements into effective system support and process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support Oracle Fusion Order-to-Cash processes and contribute to stable, efficient business operations.
  • Analyze functional requirements and help translate them into practical system solutions and process enhancements.
  • Work with business and technical teams to support order management, invoicing, customer receipts, and related OTC activities.
  • Assist with issue resolution, root cause analysis, and post-go-live support for business-critical processes.
  • Support month-end close activities for OTC-related subledger processes, including reconciliation and documentation support.
  • Partner with stakeholders to improve process reliability, data quality, and end-user experience.
  • Contribute to testing, validation, and change support for system updates and process changes.
  • Document functional flows, business rules, and support activities clearly and consistently.

How You Will Do It

  • You will stay close to the business process, listen carefully to user needs, and remove friction where it affects customers or operations.
  • You will own your work with accountability, accuracy, safety-minded thinking, and integrity in every step.
  • You will use a continuous-improvement mindset, asking questions, challenging gaps, and helping the team solve problems early.
  • You will collaborate openly across business and technology teams, building trust and aligning different perspectives toward one outcome.
  • You will support structured issue handling, clear documentation, and disciplined follow-through from analysis through resolution.
  • You will contribute to reliable delivery by working methodically through testing, validation, and operational support activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in an OTC functional analyst, business analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong understanding of Order-to-Cash processes and their impact across the business.
  • Experience supporting Oracle Fusion OTC processes, including order management, invoicing, receipts, or related finance activities.
  • Ability to analyze business requirements, identify process gaps, and support functional solutions.
  • Experience working with customer master data and month-end close activities.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
  • Solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a structured approach to documentation and follow-up.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on exposure to Oracle Fusion Financials AR or Oracle Fusion Order Management.
  • Experience with invoice processing, receipt handling, or AR subledger support.
  • Familiarity with DevOps or Agile ways of working.
  • Experience supporting testing cycles, change requests, or post-go-live operational support.

Why Join Us

You will be part of a team that values practical problem-solving, customer impact, and continuous improvement. At Johnson Controls, your ideas and collaboration can help strengthen the processes that keep business moving and customers supported.

If you are ready to bring your OTC expertise to a role where your work can make a real difference, we encourage you to apply.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Executive, Engineering & Sustainability
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support to the Operations team on tender document review, developing/ reviewing the scope of work and specifications for M&E equipment replacement such as switchgear, genset, etc based on the latest code of practice and authorities’ requirements.

job.title: Cost Engineer, Data Center IT Fit-Out
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the solution to AI’s energy challenge, founded in Australia in 2019 by a visionary team of entrepreneurs. Our mission is to create the most energy-efficient AI infrastructure, combining cutting edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

Through ground-breaking research and development, we invented a verticalized AI Factory - a new class of digital infrastructure that replaces traditional data centres. Built on new approaches to liquid cooling, energy management, water use and modular construction methodology, the Firmus AI Factory delivers low-cost AI tokens across Asia-Pacific.

Firmus AI Cloud

We provide customers access to energy savings via our large-scale GPU cloud, Firmus AI Cloud. Rated Silver in The GPU Cloud ClusterMAX™ Rating System, our cloud empowers developers, enterprise, education and government users to train AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing list of services and applications, we are committed to building a cloud experience for our customers that is market-leading, proprietary and built to scale.

Why you’ll love working here

  • A fast-paced and dynamic environment working with next-gen technology. You’ll be operating at the intersection of sustainability and artificial intelligence – helping to transform an industry.
  • Working with and access to colleagues who are true innovators and leaders in their field.
  • As an emerging company, we work as a close-knit team. Work with the founders, grow a strong network, and witness the impact you make first-hand as we democratise AI tools for everyone – more sustainably, and more affordably.
  • We believe that people from diverse backgrounds come together to do their best work, be their authentic selves, and build great things. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Role Summary

The Cost Engineer is responsible for project cost control, budgeting, forecasting, commercial tracking, and financial reporting for data center IT fit-out projects. This role supports the Project Manager in monitoring project financial performance across procurement, deployment, logistics, installation, and integration activities.

The position will work closely with procurement, vendors, finance, logistics, and project teams to ensure accurate cost visibility, budget control, and timely reporting throughout the project lifecycle.

Experience in data center, mission-critical, or IT infrastructure environments is advantageous but not mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

Cost Control & Budget Management

  • Develop and maintain project cost reports, forecasts, and budget tracking tools.
  • Monitor actual costs against approved budgets and committed spend.
  • Track project expenditures across procurement, logistics, installation, deployment, and related project activities.
  • Support cost allocation across multiple workstreams and project phases.
  • Identify budget variances and recommend corrective actions.

Procurement & Commercial Tracking

  • Work closely with procurement and project teams to track purchase orders, vendor quotations, and committed costs.
  • Review and validate vendor quotations, invoices, and payment applications.
  • Track cost movements, freight costs, taxes, duties, and escalation risks.
  • Maintain visibility of long-lead procurement items and project commitments.
  • Support commercial evaluations and bid comparisons.

Forecasting & Financial Reporting

  • Prepare weekly and monthly cost forecasts and cash flow reports.
  • Provide financial status updates to the Project Manager and stakeholders.
  • Monitor forecast accuracy and update estimates based on project progress.
  • Track accruals, committed costs, and pending variations.
  • Support project financial reporting and earned value tracking where applicable.

Change Management

  • Track project change requests and variation orders.
  • Assess commercial impact of scope changes and technical revisions.
  • Maintain change logs and ensure approval workflows are followed.
  • Support claims analysis and cost impact assessments.

Project Coordination

  • Coordinate with project management, procurement, logistics, deployment, and finance teams.
  • Support schedule-driven cost planning aligned with project milestones.
  • Participate in project review meetings and risk discussions.
  • Assist in identifying commercial and supply chain risks affecting project cost.

Vendor & Contract Support

  • Monitor vendor commercial compliance and contractual obligations.
  • Track delivery milestones tied to payment schedules.
  • Support reconciliation of invoices, delivery records, and received goods.
  • Assist with contract administration and vendor performance tracking.

Skills & Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in cost engineering, quantity surveying, project controls, commercial management, or related project cost functions.
  • Experience in construction, infrastructure, technology, engineering, or fit-out projects.
  • Strong experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost tracking, and financial reporting within project environments.
  • Experience managing vendor costs, procurement tracking, and change management processes.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel for cost tracking, forecasting, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with ERP and project management systems such as:
  • Procore
  • MS Project
  • NetSuite
  • Experience using project cost tracking, procurement, and reporting tools is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical and commercial skills.
  • High attention to detail and financial accuracy.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Proactive problem-solving and risk identification capability.
  • Strong reporting and presentation skills.

Preferred Experience (Advantageous but Not Mandatory)

  • Experience in data center, mission-critical, or IT infrastructure projects.
  • Good understanding of compute, server, storage, and network environments.
  • Familiarity with hardware procurement and deployment lifecycle.
  • Exposure to fast-paced project delivery environments.

Key Deliverables

  • Accurate project cost reports and forecasts.
  • Budget variance analysis and mitigation plans.
  • Timely change order and variation tracking.
  • Cost visibility across procurement and project activities.
  • Financial support to maintain project delivery within approved budget.

Work Environment

  • Combination of office and active project site environment.
  • Coordination with vendors, logistics providers, and project teams.
  • Fast-paced, schedule-driven project environment.

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

About Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the solution to AI’s energy challenge, founded in Australia in 2019 by a visionary team of entrepreneurs and engineers passionate about sustainable computing infrastructure.

Firmus builds and operates AI infrastructure across Asia-Pacific, utilising its proprietary AI Factory platform to deliver transformative cost-effective GPU clusters and AI cloud services for developers, enterprise, education and government users.

We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Google Pay Ads
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward. People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.

Responsibilities

  • Work extensively in a Flutter (Dart) codebase delivering Android and iOS experiences to GPay users.
  • Understand Ad and voucher serving system (Java/C++), recommend, and implement improvements to external systems.
  • Understand ads logging and ML pipelines and how to optimize them for our publisher.
  • Use AI development tools to automate and accelerate your individual work as well as the team's operations.

job.title: Fuji Plant Manager
job.description:
＜部門について＞

長年の主力である東芝、東芝キヤリアブランドでの展開に加え、Carrier日本法人として近年ではCarrierブランドでの製品・ソリューションを提供。遠隔監視やサービス事業でのブランドを導入し、マルチブランド展開を推進しています。日本キヤリアは、家庭用から業務用・産業用に至るまで、空調機器および関連サービスを幅広く提供しています。

富士事業所では、店舗用、ビル用空調機、冷凍機器、それらの心臓部であるコンプレッサ（圧縮機）の製造を行っており、製造の責任者として安全・品質・生産の全般管理及び改善の指揮を取って頂くことと、富士事業所全体(技術及び他部門含む)の責任者が役割となっております。

＜職務概要＞

経験豊富な製造オペレーションチームおよび生産リーダーを率い、工場全体の安全・品質・生産性の最大化を担います。中長期的視点に基づき目標および運営指針を策定し、生産計画・工程管理・技術革新を通じて、競争力のある生産体制を構築・推進します。

＜業務内容＞

  • 工場全体の安全・品質・生産性を統括し、組織運営を主導
  • 生産管理、設備保全、品質管理、労務管理など、製造現場に関わる主要領域の管理最適化
  • 工場損益管理(KPI 管理)及びコスト削減、工程改善などの推進
  • 従業員の育成・評価を含む組織マネジメントおよびリーダーシップの発揮
  • 工場の中期・長期計画の策定および経営層との連携
  • 顧客との連携を通じたニーズ把握とサービス品質の向上
  • コンプライアンス遵守および安全衛生・環境法規への対応

＜必須要件＞

・　　製造業における管理職経験（複数部門を横断したマネジメント経験）

  • 安全・品質・生産性向上に関する改善活動の実績
  • 5S、リーン生産方式等の知識および実践経験、データドリブンに基づく意思決定と継続的改善の推進力
  • 高いリーダーシップおよびコミュニケーション能力
  • 組織全体を統合し、目標達成に向けて統率する高い組織マネジメント力
  • 法令・規格・社内ルールの遵守および適切なリスク管理能力

＜歓迎要件＞

  • 工場長またはそれに準ずるマネジメント経験
  • 英語力：業務対応可能、またはTOEIC 730点以上相当
  • 海外での業務経験またはグローバル環境での就業経験

In addition to our long-established core business under the Toshiba and Toshiba Carrier brands, as the Japanese subsidiary of Carrier, we have recently been offering products and solutions under the Carrier brand. We are promoting a multi-brand strategy by introducing brands in remote monitoring and service businesses. Nippon Carrier offers a wide range of air-conditioning equipment and related services, from residential to commercial and industrial use.

At the Fuji site, we manufacture equipment for stores, air-conditioning units for buildings, refrigeration equipment, and compressors, which are the heart of these products, and as the person responsible for manufacturing, you will be expected to oversee safety, quality, and production management as well as lead improvements; your role will also be to serve as the person responsible for the entire Fuji site, including engineering and other departments.

You will lead an experienced manufacturing operations team and production leaders, and be responsible for maximizing safety, quality, and productivity across the entire factory. Based on a medium- to long-term perspective, you will formulate goals and operating guidelines, and build and promote a competitive production system through production planning, process management, and technological innovation.

  • Overall responsibility for the factory’s safety, quality, and productivity, and leading organizational operations
  • Optimization of management in key areas related to manufacturing operations, such as production control, equipment maintenance, quality control, and labor management
  • Promotion of factory profitability management (KPI management), cost reduction, and process improvement
  • Organizational management and leadership, including employee development and evaluation
  • Formulation of the factory’s medium- to long-term plans and coordination with management
  • Identifying needs through collaboration with customers and improving service quality
  • Compliance with regulations and response to occupational safety and health and environmental laws

Management experience in manufacturing (management experience across multiple departments)

  • Track record of improvement activities related to safety, quality, and productivity enhancement
  • Knowledge of and hands-on experience with 5S, lean manufacturing, etc., and the ability to promote data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement
  • Strong leadership and communication skills
  • Strong organizational management skills to integrate the entire organization and lead it toward achieving goals
  • Ability to comply with laws, regulations, company rules, and to manage risks appropriately
  • Experience as a plant manager or in an equivalent management role
  • English proficiency: capable of handling 업무, or equivalent to TOEIC score of 730 or above
  • Work experience overseas or work experience in a global environment

job.title: Machine Systems Integration Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Systems Integration Engineer

Role Summary

As a Systems Integration Engineer, you will be the technical bridge between machine electronics hardware, embedded software, and application-level features across Caterpillar's off-highway and tracked-machine product lines. You will own the end-to-end integration of Cat ECMs, Displays, and third-party components into a coherent machine electronics architecture — from requirements and architecture definition through HIL/SIL validation, factory support, and field issue resolution. You will work closely with Product Group stakeholders, global cross-functional engineering teams (electrical, mechanical, software), and factory/field teams to deliver reliable, high-quality machine systems on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

  • System Architecture & Requirements
  • Perform Cat architecture studies and develop control system architecture integrating Displays and Cat ECMs.
  • Author technical specifications and system/software requirements for machine application features, including new features, enhancements, and CPIs.
  • Establish integration strategy defining communication protocols (CAN/J1939, Ethernet/TCP-IP, etc.) between ECMs and Display systems.
  • Define and document supporting requirements — interfaces, calibration parameters, boundary diagrams — and drive standard application components for system coherence.
  • Electrical & Software Design Support
  • Support electrical schematic design activities, including ECM pinout design and component selection (sensors, switches, relays) in coordination with the electrical install team.
  • Define software requirements for diagnostics, display, and engine/machine application software teams.
  • Contribute to load studies and starting/charging analysis (battery, starter, alternator selection) where applicable.
  • Integration, Validation & Quality
  • Lead machine electronics system integration and validation, including HIL/SIL bench testing, test plan authoring, and root-cause review of test failures.
  • Integrate Display systems with Cat ECMs and third-party systems; conduct thorough system testing to confirm functionality, reliability, and safety standards.
  • Participate in Built-In-Quality (BIQ) reviews, FMEAs, and Design Verification Plans (DVPs); ensure quality standards are met across the development lifecycle.
  • Factory & Field Support
  • Provide in-person or remote build support for pilot and production machines; advise factory teams on end-of-line test stand design and software flashing setup.
  • Analyze field/telemetry data (e.g., product health data) to determine root cause of field issues and support difficult field escalations via phone/Teams/email.
  • Support machine commissioning, ensuring successful on-site integration of ECM and Display systems.
  • Technology Integration & Obsolescence
  • Support technology integration programs such as Payload, Cycle Segmentation, Operator Assist, Collision Mitigation, Connectivity, and similar features — from requirements through proof-of-concept.
  • Proactively manage obsolescence of electronics components; work with internal component teams and suppliers to identify and validate replacements.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Work closely with electrical, mechanical, and software engineering teams to ensure seamless multi-disciplinary integration.
  • Collaborate with project managers and Product Group stakeholders to meet program timelines, budgets, and quality targets.
  • Document system architecture, programming logic, wiring diagrams, and release notes to support maintenance and future upgrades.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Instrumentation, or a related Engineering discipline.
  • 8 – 12 years of relevant engineering experience in electronics/controls system design, integration, or validation for automotive, off-highway, or industrial machine products (experience range depends on target level — Engineer vs. Senior Engineer).
  • Strong foundation in E&E components (sensors, switches, relays, ECMs) and control systems fundamentals.
  • Working knowledge of datalink protocols such as CAN/J1939 and Ethernet TCP/IP.
  • Ability to write clear, unambiguous technical specifications and requirements documents.
  • Good understanding of diagnostics and troubleshooting methodology for control system failures.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional communication skills — this role requires constant interaction with regional and global development teams.

Preferred / Top Candidate Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with HIL/SIL validation tools (e.g., Vector CANoe/CANalyzer/CANape, dSPACE, MATLAB/Simulink).
  • Familiarity with version control and workflow tools such as GIT/SVN and Azure DevOps.
  • Exposure to AUTOSAR architecture and model-based development practices.
  • Machine-level design and product application knowledge; familiarity with Caterpillar design/Teamcenter release processes and BIQ practices.
  • Project leadership experience, Agile/Scrum exposure, and prior involvement in factory or field support activities.
  • Six Sigma methodology or structured problem-solving experience (e.g., 8D, FMEA).

What Success Looks Like

  • Machine electronics architectures that are robust, standardized, and reusable across product variants.
  • On-time delivery of validated software/system features that meet specification with minimal field escapes.
  • Strong, trusted working relationships with Product Group, factory, and global engineering counterparts.
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of obsolescence and integration risks well ahead of production impact.

Posting Dates:

September 7, 2026 - September 17, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Heat treatment Process Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Summary

This is a heat treatment process engineer position responsible for CAT Tianjin undercarriage facility heat treatment lines operation by providing on-site support with technical engineering team and operators on heat treatment process and metallurgical analysis.

Responsibilities

  • Setup & maintain heat treatment process and solve the related HT issue.
  • Support met lab technicians to conduct daily metallurgical inspection on microstructure, hardness, hardened depth, nondestructive testing.
  • Lead failure analysis for field returned parts, coordinate SEM outsourcing.
  • Ensure & support met lab technicians to follow standards and specs, to perform proper testing procedures, and provide on-site training and periodic class metallurgical training to the met technicians.
  • Summarize and analysis testing data to optimize the HT process.
  • Support NPI & OEM parts development on HT process and metallurgical validation.
  • Support new HT equipment investment projects.
  • Support met lab technical management with facility team leader.
  • Support audit suppliers on HT process and quality improvement.

Must Skills

  • Material Science or related major or heat treatment process working experience is preferred.
  • Product Testing: Knowledge of product testing approaches, techniques and tools; ability to design, plan and execute testing strategies and tactics to ensure product quality at all stages of manufacturing.
  • Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing environment.
  • Good communication and presentation skills in Mandarin and English.

Prefer skills

  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.
