job.title: Data & AI Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Position Summary

The Data & AI Specialist is responsible for developing and enabling the factory's data and AI capabilities through data governance, data architecture, analytics platforms, and AI solution deployment.

This role serves as the subject matter expert for manufacturing data and AI technologies, driving the establishment of data standards, data quality systems, digital platforms, and AI applications that support operational excellence and smart manufacturing transformation.

The position works closely with Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, IT, and business stakeholders to unlock business value from data and AI.

Key Responsibilities

Data Governance & Data Standards

  • Establish and maintain the factory data governance framework, standards, and best practices.
  • Define and manage:

Data quality rules

  • Data quality monitoring KPIs
  • Data ownership and stewardship processes
  • Data lifecycle management standards

Develop and maintain Data Owner and Data Steward responsibility matrices.

Conduct regular data quality assessments and drive corrective actions.

Ensure consistency, accuracy, completeness, and reliability of critical business data.

Data Architecture & Master Data Management

  • Design and maintain manufacturing data models and data architecture.
  • Develop and govern:

Master data standards

  • Data dictionary
  • Metadata management
  • Naming conventions
  • Data flow documentation

Establish common KPI definitions and business metric standards across functions.

Support enterprise-wide master data governance initiatives.

Data Collection & Integration

  • Drive structured digital data collection at the source to reduce manual spreadsheets and offline records.
  • Design and implement automated data acquisition solutions.
  • Integrate data from:

ERP systems

  • MES systems
  • Quality systems
  • Supply chain systems
  • Production equipment
  • IoT devices

Define data interface standards and integration requirements.

Support development of scalable data pipelines and digital platforms.

Analytics Platform & Decision Support

  • Support development and optimization of data warehouse and analytics solutions.
  • Build and maintain data models that enable operational and management reporting.
  • Develop dashboards and visualization solutions using enterprise BI platforms.
  • Translate business requirements into meaningful insights and performance indicators.
  • Enable self-service analytics capabilities for business users.

AI Strategy & Use Case Development

  • Support development of factory AI roadmap aligned with smart manufacturing and business strategies.
  • Identify, evaluate, and prioritize high-value AI use cases.
  • Establish processes for:

AI opportunity assessment

  • Feasibility analysis
  • Solution validation
  • Benefits tracking

Monitor emerging AI technologies and evaluate business applicability.

AI Solution Deployment

Lead and support implementation of manufacturing AI applications, including:

  • Computer Vision
  • Automated Quality Inspection
  • Predictive Maintenance
  • Process Optimization
  • Production Scheduling Optimization
  • Quality Analytics
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Safety Monitoring
  • Energy Management

Work closely with business teams, IT partners, and vendors to ensure successful deployment and adoption.

Generative AI & Productivity Enablement

Drive GenAI adoption across the factory through:

  • Knowledge management solutions
  • Enterprise knowledge bases
  • Digital assistants and AI agents
  • Copilot enablement
  • Workflow automation
  • Power Platform applications
  • Office productivity automation

Promote practical GenAI use cases that improve employee productivity and business efficiency.

AI Governance & Risk Management

  • Support establishment of AI governance processes and standards.
  • Monitor AI solution performance and business outcomes.
  • Assist in managing:

Model lifecycle

  • Compliance requirements
  • Data privacy
  • Risk controls
  • AI usage guidelines

Ensure responsible and sustainable AI implementation.

Data Security & Compliance

  • Support implementation of data security and access control policies.
  • Ensure compliance with corporate data governance requirements.
  • Define data retention and archival standards.
  • Protect sensitive business and operational information.

Capability Building & Training

  • Promote data-driven decision making across the factory.
  • Develop and deliver training programs on:

Data literacy

  • Analytics
  • AI fundamentals
  • GenAI tools
  • Citizen development
  • Power Platform

Coach business teams on data and AI best practices.

Qualifications

Education

Bachelor's degree or higher in:

  • Data Science
  • Computer Science
  • Information Systems
  • Industrial Engineering
  • Manufacturing Engineering
  • Artificial Intelligence
  • Statistics
  • Related disciplines

Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, digital transformation, AI, or manufacturing systems.
  • Experience implementing data governance programs.
  • Experience with manufacturing data environments preferred.
  • Experience delivering analytics or AI solutions in industrial settings preferred.

Technical Skills

Strong experience in:

  • Data Governance
  • Master Data Management
  • Data Modeling
  • SQL
  • Data Warehousing
  • ETL / ELT Processes
  • Power BI
  • Azure Data Platform
  • AI / Machine Learning Fundamentals
  • Generative AI Technologies
  • Microsoft Copilot
  • Power Platform

Knowledge of manufacturing systems:

  • SAP / ERP
  • MES
  • IoT Platforms
  • SCADA
  • Historian Systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional)
  • DAMA Data Governance Knowledge
  • Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI, or equivalent cloud certifications
  • Experience in Industry 4.0 or Smart Manufacturing programs
  • Experience deploying AI solutions in manufacturing environments

This position requires the candidate to work a 5-day-a-week schedule in the office.

About Caterpillar

Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For nearly 100 years, we’ve been helping customers build a better, more sustainable world and are committed and contributing to a reduced-carbon future. Our innovative products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value that helps customers succeed.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Posting Dates:

九月 4, 2026 - 十月 1, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: EBG CRM, OM Domain Owner
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Own and govern StarHub's enterprise middleware and integration ecosystem, providing a common technology umbrella for integrations connecting BTS and non-BTS systems. The role ensures integrations are designed, delivered and operated through secure, scalable and reusable enterprise patterns, with clear ownership across their full lifecycle.

The role provides product ownership and governance for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and future approved enterprise integration technologies.

Accountabilities

  • Own the enterprise middleware and integration platform portfolio across BTS and the wider StarHub technology ecosystem.
  • Establish clear platform ownership, governance and operating standards for middleware, integration, orchestration and automation capabilities.
  • Ensure integrations across BTS and non-BTS systems are visible, governed and managed under a common enterprise framework.
  • Drive adoption of reusable integration patterns to reduce duplication, manual effort, unmanaged interfaces and point-to-point solutions.
  • Define platform roadmaps, investment priorities and lifecycle strategies aligned with StarHub's modernisation, automation and AI agenda.
  • Partner with application, architecture, data, infrastructure, identity, cybersecurity and service management teams to enable secure and resilient integration.
  • Optimise platform utilisation, licensing, vendor performance and total cost of ownership.

##

Responsibilities

  • Enterprise Middleware & Platform Ownership

Own the product lifecycle for enterprise middleware, integration, orchestration and automation platforms, including Workato, UiPath and other approved technologies.

  • Maintain an enterprise view of middleware platforms, major interfaces, workflows, automations and dependencies.
  • Ensure platforms remain fit-for-purpose, scalable, supported, secure and aligned to target architecture.
  • Establish clear service ownership, support models and lifecycle controls for critical integration capabilities.
  • Integration Governance & Standards
  • Establish enterprise standards and guardrails for APIs, application-to-application integration, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration and automation.
  • Define decision principles for the use of middleware, native application integration, APIs, RPA and workflow automation.
  • Govern new integration demand to prevent uncontrolled point-to-point development, duplicated tooling and technology sprawl.
  • Drive reuse of approved APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Ensure designs comply with architecture, cybersecurity, identity, data protection, resilience and operational support requirements.
  • Cross-Domain Integration Accountability
  • Provide the governance umbrella for integrations across BTS domains and integrations originating outside BTS that connect into BTS-managed platforms.
  • Support cross-domain integration across Finance, People, Productivity, Identity, Data, Customer and other enterprise technology domains.
  • Identify integration ownership gaps and establish accountable owners for interfaces crossing organisational or technology boundaries.
  • Ensure critical integrations have documented architecture, technical ownership, business ownership, monitoring and support arrangements.
  • Coordinate resolution of cross-platform integration risks, dependencies and service issues.
  • Automation & Orchestration
  • Govern enterprise use of automation platforms such as UiPath to ensure sustainable, reusable and supportable adoption rather than isolated automations.
  • Identify opportunities to remove repetitive manual work through integration, workflow automation and orchestration.
  • Assess automation opportunities based on business value, complexity, risk, scalability and maintainability.
  • Promote reusable automation components and patterns across business functions.
  • Measure realised benefits including effort reduction, cycle-time improvement, error reduction and productivity gains.
  • Product Roadmap & Portfolio Management
  • Develop and maintain the Middleware & Integration product roadmap and backlog.
  • Prioritise platform enhancements, new capabilities, migrations, rationalisation and decommissioning based on enterprise demand and value.
  • Manage platform dependencies, risks, releases and delivery priorities.
  • Build business cases for material investments and track measurable value realisation.
  • Continuously assess emerging middleware, integration, automation and AI-enabled orchestration capabilities.
  • Vendor & Commercial Management
  • Manage strategic relationships with middleware, integration and automation technology vendors and delivery partners.
  • Lead platform licensing, consumption, capacity and commercial reviews.
  • Identify opportunities for licence optimisation, platform consolidation and cost reduction.
  • Establish vendor performance measures and regular service reviews.

##

  • AI & Intelligent Integration Enablement
  • Enable governed integration patterns that allow approved AI and agentic capabilities to securely interact with enterprise systems and data.
  • Partner with relevant AI, architecture, cybersecurity and identity teams on connectors, APIs, orchestration and tool-access patterns.
  • Ensure AI-enabled integrations follow least-privilege access, auditability, data protection and appropriate human approval controls.
  • Evolve middleware capabilities to support future agent-to-system and machine-to-machine integration patterns.

Scope Boundary The role owns the middleware capability, platforms, standards and governance. Individual application teams remain accountable for their application functionality and domain-specific requirements, while integrations crossing systems or domains are governed through the Middleware & Integration capability.

Areas of Impact

  • A single governed enterprise approach to middleware and integration across BTS and non-BTS platforms.
  • Reduced proliferation of point-to-point integrations, duplicated automation tools and unmanaged workflows.
  • Increased reuse of enterprise APIs, connectors, integration patterns and automation components.
  • Faster and more reliable delivery of cross-platform business capabilities.
  • Improved resilience, observability, supportability and lifecycle ownership of critical integrations.
  • Reduced manual effort and operating cost through governed automation.
  • A secure integration foundation for AI-enabled and agentic business processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 7-10 years of experience in enterprise integration, middleware, automation, product management or technology transformation.
  • Proven experience managing enterprise integration or automation platforms in a complex organisation.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, middleware, workflow orchestration, event-driven integration, system-to-system connectivity and RPA.
  • Experience with platforms such as Workato, UiPath, MuleSoft, Boomi, ServiceNow IntegrationHub or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience managing technology products across multiple business and technology domains.
  • Good understanding of enterprise architecture, cybersecurity, identity, ITSM and operational support requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, commercial arrangements, product roadmaps and senior stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Experience with AI-enabled automation, orchestration or agentic integration patterns is advantageous.

job.title: Lead Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The Lead Engineer supports the operations, maintenance, reliability, security, and capacity management of StarHub's Cable Landing Stations and submarine cable facilities. The role coordinates and overssees technical activities involving submarine cable systems, colocation facilities, interconnection services, and supporting infrastructure while ensuring compliance with regulatory, consortium, and operational requirements. The Lead Engineer provides technical guidance, mentors junior engineers, drives continuous improvement initiatives, and coordinates with internal and external stakeholders to maintain high service availability and operational excellence.

JOB DESCRIPTION

**a. Lead the operations and maintenance of submarine cable systems, cable landing stations, and associated infrastructure. b. Support the implementation and planning of telecommunications system in the StarHub cable landing station. c. Lead fault management, troubleshooting, restoration, and service recovery activities for submarine cable systems and CLS facilities. d. 24 x 7 standby with on call duties for cable station operations requirement, submarine cable systems (dry and wet segment) fault localizations and fault repair supports and coordination. e. Oversee and provide support on the implementation of M&E, building facilities, outside plant infrastructure systems in the cable station f. On-board representatives on vessel for submarine cable projects or repairs. g. Coordinate with and submit reports to submarine cable consortia NOC and NA regarding consortia related activities. h. Lead submarine cable and equipment room projects site survey/inspection, installation, and commissioning. i. Lead the planning, implementation, and management of colocation services, interconnection facilities, cross-connect services, and customer requirements within CLS facilities. j. Oversee equipment room facilities request to ensure efficient planning and allocation of floor space and power in the cable station. k. Support the implementation of colocation projects in the cable station. l. Review the process and procedure, and work with the relevant stakeholders to achieve better efficiency for cable consortia, backhaul and colocation services (space, power, and interconnection) in the cable station. m. Lead the team in maintaining and updating documentation of all submarine cable facilities, test equipment and spare plants including colocation customers’ colocation facilities and interconnection services in the cable station. n. Review and analyze cable station space and power usage and highlights for future requirements. o. Mentor, coach, and develop junior engineers through structured knowledge sharing, technical training, and on-the-job learning.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

a. Degree in Electrical/Electronics/ Communication Engineering b. Minimum 5-8 years of experience in submarine cable systems, transmission networks, cable landing station operations, telecommunications infrastructure, or related engineering fields. c. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing technical operations, projects, and multi-stakeholder environments. d. Strong knowledge of cable landing station operations, colocation facilities, transmission systems, power and cooling infrastructure, and physical security requirements. e. Experience in mentoring, coaching, and developing engineering teams. f. Team player, self-motivated and able to work independently

job.title: Technical Services Manager
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

Your Impact

As Technical Services Manager (TSM) reporting to our Senior Technical Service Manager (STSM), you will work closely with our Operations team, making an impact in a number of ways:

  • Supporting the STSM in relation to all aspects of data centre operations to achieve 100% uptime and compliance with customer SLAs
  • Work as part of a multi-disciplinary team of managers, technicians and third party vendors to plan, manage and supervise maintenance activities, both planned and reactive, on a nominated site.
  • First point of contact for AirTrunk’s customers in respect of works planning, incident management and reporting

What You'll Do

Either a portion of the data centre site or a portfolio of customers will be allocated to each Technical Service Manager (TSM). The TSM then runs this sub-section of the site, reporting and raising issues/tasks to the STSM as required;

  • Lead all aspects of the planning and coordination of all preventive maintenance and repair works, ensure change management and incident management procedures are followed; coordinate activities as required with customers
  • Coordinate with the Development team to run construction activity and installations, to ensure system design, installation and testing adhere to operational standards
  • Ensure adherence to site operating procedures (SOP, MOP, EOP) and any other documentation required by law, e.g. SWMS
  • Ensure compliance with site held accreditations, including, but not limited to, ISMS, ISO, SOC2, PCI.
  • Maintain compliance with local regulatory requirements including environmental, building, fire, electrical, hydraulic, occupational health & safety
  • Primary operational contact for customers and local point of escalation during emergency events and day-to-day operations
  • Attend witness testing of all equipment during commissioning to validate sequence of operations and receipt of all operational documentation
  • Manage the provisioning of data centre services including connectivity, power services, deployment and any additional services to be delivered to customers
  • Lead minor capital projects for customers/internal purposes
  • Supervise operational metrics, data and analyse risks
  • Conduct regular property inspections
  • Take part in the 'on call' incident response roster

What You'll Bring

job.title: Shift Lead, Facility Management
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Job Description

Your main duties and responsibilities are as follows:

  • Daily monitoring of Mechanical system including but not limited to: chiller cooling system, water pumps, cooling towers, AHU units, CRAH units, FCU units, water leak detection, fire alarm systems, VESDA, smoke detector (raised floor/ceiling), liquid cooling etc.
  • Daily monitoring of Electrical system including but not limited to: HV/LV switch rooms, Transformers, UPS system, Generators, Power Distribution Units, etc.
  • Ensure Data Hall colocation temperature and humidity are within range.
  • Response and attend to equipment alarm on site.
  • Troubleshoot abnormal incident / fault for Mechanical and Electrical equipment.
  • Escalate/update accordingly any severity event occurred according to the process and procedures.
  • Escorting and overseeing vendor to ensure PM activities and service repairs are carried out properly and compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of protective equipment. Ensuring all work performed are in adherence to Company policies and contract agreement. Ensure the submitted PTW and MOP are reviewed and approved before the task is carried out.
  • Monthly/Weekly Electrical and Mechanical system consumption report data trending logging and ensuring timely submission of relevant reports on agreed timing such as monthly basis as required under the requirement of our MSA with customer.
  • Maintain lighting in all areas of the building.
  • Assist in maintaining up to date as built drawings, asset and inventory management.
  • Monitor incoming tickets for processing and provide support to clients/users from the ticketing portal or via email and respond based on SLA.
  • Travel overseas for work / assignment as and when necessary or requested by your immediate supervisor / the head of department.
  • Such other duties and responsibilities as may be reasonably requested by your immediate supervisor / the head of department from time to time.

In the event there are substantial changes to the main duties and responsibilities as set out herein (for example, in cases of secondment, transfer or promotion), the Company will communicate such changes to you in writing.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

Qualified candidates will possess the following:

  • Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management, or equivalent field of study required.
  • An excellent understanding and experience of the electrical and mechanical systems used in a data center environment, including: Feeders, Transformers, Generators, Fuel Systems, Switchgear, UPS systems, Battery banks, ATS/STS units, PDU/PMM units, Chillers, Air handling units, Chilled water plant, CRAC units, Fire Alarm systems, and Fire Suppression systems.
  • Experience of complex automatic control equipment, including relay logic, programmable logic controllers (PLC's), building management systems, and their integration with the data center infrastructure.
  • Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite - Word, Excel, Outlook and Visio required; working knowledge of SharePoint preferred.
  • Proficiency in both written and spoken English.
  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in a data center or other Critical Environment required (preference is given to data center, hospital, pharmaceutical production or power plant experience).
  • Working knowledge of mechanical, electrical, life safety monitoring and control systems typically used in critical environments.
  • Proficient knowledge of HVAC and/or Electrical Systems. Team Lead shall be proficient in both Electrical and Mechanical.
  • Able to work rotating shifts and on weekends/public holidays.

BUSINESS SEGMENT

Connectivity

PLATFORM

Operating Division

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

About you

  • Extensive experience supporting large or enterprise customers with engagement with leaders and wider internal & stakeholders

  • Experience working closely with delivery leads to ensure aligned, consistent communication and progress across active projects

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. job.title: E2E Operational Resilience Lead
job.description:
Sydney, Australia

Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it's easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It's not about surface-level change. It's about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

The End-to-End Operational Resilience Lead provides senior cross-functional leadership to strengthen service resilience, operational readiness, and recovery across Optus's mobile and fixed network environments, with a focus on understanding end-to-end service dependencies and customer impacts. Leveraging deep technical and operational expertise, the role supports major incident response, drives organisational learning and continuous improvement, and influences resilience outcomes through judgement, collaboration, and strategic leadership rather than direct operational control.

Your day to day will consist of

  • Provide senior end-to-end operational leadership during significant customer-impacting events, connecting customer experience, service behaviour, and technology dependencies to support coordinated decision-making and effective service outcomes.
  • Assess customer impact, service dependencies, operational risks, and business priorities to support informed decision-making during complex service and operational scenarios.
  • Build and maintain an end-to-end view of customer services across technology, operational, and supplier domains, identifying service dependencies, risks, opportunities for improvement, and readiness considerations before they affect customers.
  • Contribute practical operational insight to service readiness reviews, significant change activity, and operational assurance, including business priorities, operational constraints, and implementation considerations.
  • Lead organisational learning through service reviews and operational assessments, capturing insights and driving improvements in service performance, customer outcomes, and operational effectiveness.
  • Strengthen operational capability by maintaining service knowledge, mentoring teams, and influencing outcomes across Operations, Engineering, Problem Management, and Transformation functions.

What makes you perfect for the role

  • Demonstrates strong operational leadership, sound judgement, and the ability to perform effectively during high-pressure, customer-impacting events.
  • Possesses significant experience in complex telecommunications or critical infrastructure environments, with expertise across multiple network and technology domains.
  • Maintains a broad end-to-end understanding of telecommunications services, including mobile, fixed, IP, core, infrastructure, applications, and supplier ecosystems.
  • Understands network operations, service dependencies, failure modes, recoverability, and the principles of major incident response and service restoration.
  • Applies systems thinking, structured investigation, and evidence-based problem-solving to connect issues across technology, service, and organisational boundaries.
  • Influences outcomes and builds trusted relationships across diverse teams and senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.
  • Drives operational resilience and continuous improvement by enhancing readiness, recovery practices, organisational learning, and capability development through practical operational experience.

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration and employee discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and unique shopping discounts with our retail partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional 'Connected' days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever's important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks.
  • Direct your own development and build future-ready skills with Optus U's industry-focused micro-credentials, developed with La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, 24/7 — in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes' to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

As an experienced Full-Stack AI Engineer, you will design, build, and deploy end-to-end, AI-native applications. You will own the entire feature lifecycle—from designing intuitive frontend user interfaces that handle streaming AI data, to building robust backend architectures, orchestrating complex LLM or agentic workflows, and managing vector databases and cloud infrastructure. You are a generalist with architectural breadth and deep specialization in applying AI to practical software challenges.

Make an Impact by:

  • Applied AI & Intelligent Orchestration
  • Orchestration & Workflow Design: Build complex multi-agent frameworks, task routing systems, and Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) workflows using orchestration engines like LangChain or LangGraph.
  • RAG & Vector Management: Architect high-performance Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Design indexing strategies, chunking mechanisms, and hybrid search (semantic + keyword) utilizing vector databases.
  • Model Integration & Optimization: Integrate state-of-the-art LLMs and foundational models via commercial APIs or self-hosted inference setups. Implement strategies to manage model latency, token constraints, context windows, and fallback mechanisms.
  • Evaluation & Guardrails: Establish AI evaluation frameworks to test for hallucinations, drift, and accuracy. Implement prompt safety, structural validation, and robust guardrails to handle non-deterministic outputs safely.
  • Full-Stack Application Architecture
  • Backend & API Engineering: Design high-concurrency, asynchronous backend services using Python (FastAPI) or Node.js/TypeScript. Develop robust RESTful APIs and optimize interactions using Model Context Protocol (MCP) systems where applicable.
  • AI-Native Frontend Experiences: Build responsive, stateful UIs using React or Next.js. Implement streaming response interfaces (HTTP Stream), chat architectures, agentic UI interaction models, and intuitive data visualizations for complex model outputs.
  • Data Management: Design relational schemas and manage transactional data workflows using databases like PostgreSQL, while pairing them seamlessly with unstructured data pipelines.
  • Infrastructure
  • Containerization & Deployment: Package application layers using Docker
  • Cloud Architecture: Architect scalable, secure, and cost-effective solutions across cloud ecosystems like AWS or Azure
  • CI/CD & Observability: Build automated deployment and test pipelines (e.g., Bitbucket & Bamboo). Implement advanced logging, error tracing, and observability tooling to monitor both typical software failures and LLM costs/latencies.

Skills for Success:

Technical Skill Matrix

  • Category: Core Skills & Technologies
  • AI / LLM Frameworks: LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini APIs
  • Vector Databases: pgvector (PostgreSQL), Azure AI Search
  • Backend Engineering:Python (FastAPI), Node.js, Java, TypeScript, API Gateway
  • Frontend Engineering: React, Next.js, State Management (Zustand/Redux), SSE/WebSockets
  • Databases & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS S3 / Cloud Storage
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Azure, Docker, CI/CD Monitoring (OpenTelemetry)

job.title: Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engrg
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

The Senior Specialist, Radio Network Engineering is responsible for evaluating, validating, and introducing new Radio Access Network (RAN) technologies and features to support the company's network evolution strategy. The role drives the technical assessment of emerging radio technologies through standards analysis, laboratory testing, feature evaluation, field trials, and commercial readiness activities, ensuring new capabilities deliver measurable improvements in network performance, spectrum efficiency, energy consumption, and customer experience.

  • Evaluate emerging RAN technologies, vendor solutions, and 3GPP Releases (e.g., Release 17, Release 18/5G-Advanced and Release 19 features) to support network evolution and technology roadmap planning.
  • Review and assess new 3GPP specifications and industry developments, including AI/ML for RAN optimisation, Ambient IoT, Reduced Capability (RedCap) devices, Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN), Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC), XR optimisation, enhanced Massive MIMO, network energy-saving features, and multi-antenna enhancements.
  • Conduct technical evaluation of new RAN software features, hardware platforms, and vendor releases, including capabilities such as 5G Carrier Aggregation enhancements, MIMO enhancements, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing (DSS), uplink enhancements, network slicing support, positioning services (NR Positioning), and energy-saving functions.
  • Develop, execute, and manage laboratory validation plans to verify feature functionality, interoperability, performance, stability, and standards compliance prior to field deployment.
  • Plan, coordinate, and execute Proof of Concept (PoC), interoperability testing, pilot deployments, and field trials, including defining objectives, KPIs, success criteria, and performance evaluation methodologies.
  • Support commercial rollout of approved radio technologies by developing deployment strategies, implementation guidelines, operational readiness documentation, and rollout acceptance criteria.
  • Analyse trial, benchmarking, and post-deployment performance data to identify improvement opportunities and recommend optimisation or corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Radio Planning, Optimisation, Core Network, Transport, Device, OSS, Automation, and Operations teams, as well as equipment vendors, to ensure successful end-to-end technology introduction.
  • Engage equipment vendors to assess product roadmaps, software maturity, interoperability, and implementation plans, ensuring alignment with the company's network strategy and 3GPP standards evolution.
  • Prepare technical reports, engineering recommendations, standards impact assessments, deployment documentation, and executive presentations to support engineering governance and investment decisions.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 6–8 years of experience in mobile radio network engineering, RAN planning, optimisation, technology introduction, or network performance.
  • Hands-on experience in evaluating, testing, and deploying LTE and 5G NR features.
  • Experience conducting laboratory validation, interoperability testing, field trials, and commercial rollout of radio technologies.
  • Experience working with radio equipment vendors and cross-functional engineering teams.
  • Strong understanding of LTE, LTE-Advanced, and 5G NR radio technologies and architecture.
  • Ability to interpret and assess 3GPP specifications and translate standards into deployment requirements.
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methodologies, feature validation, troubleshooting, and KPI analysis.
  • Knowledge of radio performance metrics, RF engineering principles, and network optimization

job.title: Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC)
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

NTT is currently looking for a Vice President, Regional Construction Execution (APAC). The Vice President, Regional Construction is a key executive role reporting directly to the Vice President, Global Construction. The successful candidate will have direct accountability for the design, supply chain and construction organizations in the region responsible for capital infrastructure investment. This role will provide strategic direction and leadership to enable and execute projects within specified timelines, budgets, and quality standards to enable the regional business goals of the company.

This is a full time remote role based in Malaysia, Singapore or Thailand.

What we are looking for

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Planning: Develop and implement strategic plans for the construction, design and supply chain organizations, aligning with the Global Infrastructure Development (GID) organization's overall goals, the business goals in the region and industry trends/best practices. Identify opportunities for growth, speed to market improvement, and cost optimization.
  • Team Leadership: Manage a team of construction, design and supply chain professionals, including project managers, engineers, architects, commercial managers, etc. Foster a collaborative and high-performing work environment, promoting teamwork and individual development.
  • Regional Leadership: Be the in-region leader of the broader GID team which includes the construction, design and supply chain organizations, but also global teams with in-region resources (safety, power, land, project controls and front end engineering).
  • Project Management: Ensure proper project management is occurring from initiation to completion, ensuring adherence to project plans, schedules, and budgets. Monitor progress, identify potential risks, and implement mitigation strategies as necessary.
  • Vendor and Contractor Management: Monitors the performance of general contractors, architects/engineers and other suppliers to ensure compliance, execution, quality, and safety standards.
  • Supply Base Development: Personally engage with the key principals of supply chain partners to develop a supply chain that can reliably support the business needs of the company in the region.
  • Budgeting and Financial Management: Liaisons with project controls on project funding plans, necessary financial forecasts and reports.
  • Quality Assurance: Work with CX/Quality team to ensure adherence to quality assurance and commissioning programs and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including sales, operations, clients and regulatory authorities. Communicate project updates, resolve issues, and maintain positive relationships with all parties involved.

KNOWLEDGE & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, building codes, safety regulations, and industry best practices.
  • Proven track record of successfully delivering complex construction projects on time and within budget.
  • Ability to build a strong safety culture throughout the organization.
  • Strong financial acumen and experience in budgeting, cost control, and financial analysis.
  • Proficiency in project management software, construction management tools, and MS Office suite.
  • Understanding of design and engineering.
  • Proven experience in implementing processes in a rapid growth environment
  • Knowledgeable of the basics necessary for operating in compliance where NTT is located.
  • Knowledgeable of the key supply chain operating concepts, executive relationships with supply chain partners in the region and claims management.
  • Knowledgeable of construction law and contracts.
  • Skilled at creating and maintaining a collaborative design/construction/operations environment in a global culture.

ACEDEMIC QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in construction management, engineering, or a related field. Master's degree (beneficial).

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

  • Extensive experience (15+ years) in construction management, preferably in a leadership role within the construction industry. Ideally experience with design and supply chain sourcing in addition to construction.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Remain stationery for long periods of time.
  • Operate computer, peripherals, and other office equipment.
  • Perform work during regional business hours and time zones with flexibility for global coordination.

WORK CONDITIONS AND REQUIREMENTS

  • Travel required up to 50%.
  • Perform work from a remote location with stable internet connection.

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

Role purpose

What will you do?

  • Oversee, manage, and implement customer-centric and operational excellence initiatives to drive overall service efficiency and end-to-end customer experience improvements across the organization.
  • Lead and manage the CX and operational governance framework to ensure alignment with strategic priorities, compliance with standards, clear accountability, and timely execution of improvement initiatives across all touchpoints and departments.
  • Lead, develop, and implement programs to build a culture of operational excellence and customer centricity, ensuring all staff understand their role in end-to-end flows and how they can contribute to efficiency and service quality through communication, campaigns, recognition, and training.
  • Proactively identify complaints, performance data, and operational issues to drive root-cause analysis and targeted improvements in service journeys, communication, forms, processes, and overall operational efficiency.

Apply structured problem-solving and Design Thinking approaches to develop and implement practical solutions with stakeholders from different teams.
  • Drive change management and continuous improvement: Collaborate with stakeholders across different departments to enable rapid cross-functional collaboration and execution. Identify process gaps and when a structured change or efficiency improvement plan needs to be developed and implemented. Ensure clear line of accountability and robust planning for implementation.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  • Minimum 15 years of relevant work experience with a strong track record of driving operational excellence, end-to-end process improvement, and customer experience strategies. Experience in Pensions, Insurance, or financial services industry is highly preferred.
  • Excellent customer-centric and operational excellence mindset. Strong analytical skills with proven ability to map complex cross-departmental operation flows, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency. job.title: Sales Operations & Support Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

1\. Export Shipment and Collateral Management

This section focuses on operational oversight and documentation accuracy for technical products.

  • Plan, schedule, and coordinate the export of goods, including transportation, documentation, and customs requirements.
  • Ensure timely shipment and delivery of goods to meet customer expectations and avoid penalties or delays.
  • Oversee the correct preparation of export documentation such as invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin (FTA/AIFTA etc.
  • Ensure to share them in a timely manner with the relevant regional Interco team.
  • Coordinate with Engineering to ensure product specifications, technical manuals, and compliance certificates are included in the export documentation package.

2\. Product and Engineering Interaction

This section defines the collaboration with the technical teams.

  • Lead Cross-Functional Teams: Serve as the liaison between Interco/Commercial teams and the Engineering/Manufacturing departments.
  • Technical Readiness: Work with Engineering to track the design freeze, compliance sign-off, and production readiness of new or updated electrical/mechanical products intended for export.
  • maintain a foundational understanding of the technical side of the export product line to accurately represent technical status and requirements in planning meetings.
  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and proactively communicate product-related risks that could impact export timelines, such as regulatory compliance issues or last-minute design changes.

3\. Risk Mitigation & Process Optimization

This section is focused on continuous process improvement.

  • Identify and mitigate risks in the export process, including issues related to customs, logistics, or international regulations
  • Take the ownership of Developing, refining, and implementing efficient Interco export processes and workflows to streamline export operations
  • Identify bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the export processes and recommend solutions to enhance effectiveness and speed
  • Work with Engineering to define clear handover points (e.g., _Product to Documentation_ or _BOM to Logistics_) to reduce delays.
  • Resolve any issues that arise during the shipment process, such as delays, damaged goods, or customs holds

4\. Inventory, SIOP, and Product Lifecycle Management

This section includes the planning role, incorporating engineering readiness into the SIOP process.

  • Discuss with the regional Interco team and Plan to liquify the inventory in a timely manner.
  • Coordinate with regional Interco team and inform Demand /factory team if any order is expected to delay.
  • Conduct and attend weekly SIOP meeting for product readiness date.
  • Ensure Engineering's inputs on product testing, quality checks, and final assembly schedules are integrated into the SIOP meeting's discussion on the product readiness date.
  • Monitor FOC shipments (in case of need) through periodic credence meeting etc

5\. Export Order Dashboard and Interco Communication Management

  • Maintain export Smartsheet on a regular basis.
  • Share weekly OB and sales reports with LOB/region classification and tables.
  • Upload and maintain Interco order status on EBO for respective region
  • Ownership of maintaining the latest lead time sheet for all the export products on EBO
  • Lead the weekly meeting with Interco teams and effectively and timely communicate the order acknowledgement.

Qualifications: -

Required/ Minimum Qualifications: -

  • Bachelor’s Degree/ Diploma or equivalent of 5-10 years’ experience
  • Proven experience in project management, preferably in process improvement or organizational development projects.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications: -

  • Background in Thermal/ Power
  • Experience in implementing continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Six Sigma / Lean certifications / PMP or any other Project Management certification
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, utilizing data-driven insights for decision-making.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, conveying complex concepts clearly.
  • Ability to create and manage comprehensive documentation systems.
  • Demonstrated project management skills, planning, executing, and overseeing projects from conception to completion.
  • Experience leading change management initiatives, guiding teams through transitions.
  • Proven leadership skills, motivating and guiding cross-functional teams toward common goals.
  • Ability to adapt to a dynamic work environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

job.description:
Job Description

Position Summary:The Strategic Account Manager – Asia is responsible for developing and executing strategic account plans to drive sales growth, increase market share, and strengthen customer relationships across key markets in Asia.

Working closely with major customers, cross-functional teams, and senior leadership, you will identify business opportunities, deliver tailored solutions, and support the achievement of revenue and profitability targets. This individual contributor role requires strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, and a proactive, customer-focused approach to position Vertiv as a preferred partner across the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Execute plans to increase market share and share of wallet in accordance with company targets for orders, revenue, and profitability, under the guidance of senior leadership.
  • Develop a strong understanding of key customers' priorities, challenges, and business objectives.
  • Develop and implement comprehensive account plans to achieve sales targets and revenue growth for assigned strategic accounts across the region.
  • Establish and maintain strong, long-term relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders within customer organisations.
  • Understand customer requirements and collaborate with internal teams to tailor solutions that meet their specific needs, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
  • Work closely with internal functions, including Marketing, Product Management, and Operations, to align strategies, deliver value, and provide seamless support to key accounts.
  • Analyse market trends, competitor activity, and industry developments to identify new business opportunities and recommend growth initiatives.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with key accounts, providing insights, performance updates, and recommendations for continuous improvement.
  • Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions with customers, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that comply with company policies and profitability objectives.
  • Manage and resolve customer issues or disputes that may arise, maintaining open communication and a proactive approach to issue resolution.
  • Prepare accurate and timely reports, forecasts, and updates on key account activities, highlighting progress, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Remain up to date with industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance expertise and identify innovative strategies and best practices.
  • Contribute to medium and long-term strategies to strengthen brand awareness, customer engagement, and recognition of Vertiv's capabilities, expertise, and technology leadership among targeted accounts.
  • Recommend new practices, processes, and performance measures to improve account management effectiveness and sales outcomes.
  • Act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues where appropriate, sharing knowledge and best practices to support team development.

job.title: Customer Service Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

  • The Customer Service Specialist leads customer-facing projects from sales handover to completion. Acting as the main contact for customers and internal teams, this role manages planning, delivery, installation, invoicing, and project closure. It also ensures timely shipment updates to support sales forecasting and requires strong coordination and communication skills.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Coordinate & Clarify the handover process from Sales to CMO to ensure a smooth project start.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for customers regarding delivery, installation, invoicing, and project closure.
  • Collaborate with internal teams such as Supply Chain, COP,  Warehouse, and Service, as well as third-party vendors, to ensure project milestones are met.
  • Update and manage shipment schedules for both inventory and non-inventory items to support accurate sales forecasting.
  • Develop and maintain project plans, timelines, and communication strategies to ensure successful project execution.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks or delays, and implement corrective actions as needed.
  • Generate regular reports (Customer survey) and forecasts to keep stakeholders informed of project status and financial performance.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Strong communication skills to coordinate with teams, vendors, and management
  • Analytical, computer, math, and problem-solving skills
  • Organizational and time management skills to keep projects on track
  • Experience in technical project management or engineering roles
  • Bachelor's degree in project management or related technical field
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies and tools
  • Leadership experience in coaching and developing technical teams

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Primarily office-based work, with occasional travel to customer sites or project locations.
  • Prolonged use of computers and standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit, attend meetings, and work at a computer for extended periods.
  • Must be able to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks and stakeholders simultaneously.
  • Work environment is professional, collaborative, and fast-paced.
  • May require working outside of regular business hours during critical project phases such as installation or delivery.

Job Title

AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer

Department

Engineering / Projects / HVAC Design

Location

As per business requirement

Reporting To

Project Manager / HVAC Design Engineer

Job Summary

The AutoCAD HVAC & Revit Draftsman/Designer is responsible for preparing detailed HVAC engineering drawings, layouts, and 3D BIM models using AutoCAD and Revit software. The role involves supporting the design, installation, and commissioning teams by developing accurate drawings in compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities HVAC Design & Drafting

  • Prepare HVAC layout drawings, ducting layouts, piping layouts, equipment placement drawings, and coordination drawings using AutoCAD.
  • Develop and maintain HVAC BIM models using Revit.
  • Generate shop drawings, installation drawings, as-built drawings, and fabrication drawings.
  • Create HVAC schematics, mechanical room layouts, and equipment schedules.
  • Prepare BOQ support drawings and material quantity take-offs.

BIM & Revit Modeling

  • Develop 3D HVAC models for commercial, industrial, and data center projects.
  • Perform clash detection and coordination with electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and architectural teams.
  • Update and modify BIM models based on project revisions and site feedback.
  • Ensure adherence to BIM execution plans and project standards.

Documentation & Coordination

  • Review engineering sketches, specifications, and design calculations.
  • Coordinate with project engineers, consultants, customers, and site teams.
  • Maintain drawing registers and revision control records.
  • Support project documentation during design, installation, and commissioning phases.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure drawings comply with applicable HVAC codes, standards, and company guidelines.
  • Verify drawing accuracy before release.
  • Incorporate client comments and design changes promptly.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Certification in AutoCAD and Revit preferred.
  • Additional BIM certification is an advantage.

Experience

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in HVAC drafting and BIM modeling.
  • Experience in commercial buildings, industrial facilities, data centers, or critical infrastructure projects preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD (2D & 3D).
  • Strong working knowledge of Revit MEP.
  • Knowledge of HVAC systems including:
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Systems
  • VRF/VRV Systems
  • PAC Units
  • AHUs and FCUs
  • Ventilation Systems
  • Understanding of HVAC design standards and construction drawings.
  • Familiarity with Navisworks and BIM coordination tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.

Key Competencies

  • Attention to detail.
  • Strong drafting and visualization skills.
  • Problem-solving ability.
  • Effective communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Team-oriented approach.

Key Deliverables

  • HVAC Layout Drawings
  • Ducting and Piping Shop Drawings
  • Revit BIM Models
  • Coordination Drawings
  • Equipment Schedules
  • As-Built Drawings
  • Quantity Take-Off Documentation

Preferred Industry Experience: HVAC, Data Centers, Commercial Buildings, Manufacturing Facilities, Critical Infrastructure, and MEP Projects.

job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

Job Title

Service Engineer – Precision Air Conditioning (PAC)

Department

Service Operations – Thermal Management

Reporting To

Service Manager / Regional Service Manager

Job Summary

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.
  • Ensure timely closure of breakdown calls as per SLA commitments.
  • Support emergency and critical site requirements during breakdown situations.

Customer Support

  • Provide technical support and guidance to customers.
  • Maintain professional communication during service visits.
  • Ensure customer concerns are addressed promptly and effectively.
  • Prepare service reports and obtain customer sign-off upon activity completion.

Spare Parts & Inventory Management

  • Identify and recommend replacement parts and consumables.
  • Maintain service inventory and tools in good condition.
  • Support quotation preparation for repairs and spare replacement requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Follow all EHS (Environment, Health & Safety) guidelines.
  • Ensure proper usage of PPE during service activities.
  • Maintain compliance with customer safety regulations and permit systems.
  • Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Refrigeration & Air Conditioning, or related field.
  • ITI (RAC/Electrical) with relevant experience may also be considered.

Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of experience in HVAC, Precision Cooling, or Critical Cooling Systems.
  • Experience in data centers, telecom infrastructure, IT facilities, healthcare facilities, or commercial buildings preferred.

Technical Skills

  • Good understanding of refrigeration cycle and HVAC principles.
  • Experience with:
  • Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) Units
  • CRAC / CRAH Systems
  • Chilled Water Systems
  • DX Cooling Systems
  • Air-Cooled and Water-Cooled Condensers
  • CDU and FWU Systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot:
  • Compressors
  • EEV/TEV Valves
  • Refrigerant Circuits
  • PLC and Microprocessor Controllers
  • Electrical Panels and Drives
  • Sensors and Communication Networks
  • Knowledge of refrigerants and safe handling procedures.
  • Familiarity with BMS and remote monitoring systems.

Key Competencies

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Customer-focused approach.
  • Good verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently at remote sites.
  • Time management and SLA adherence.
  • Teamwork and collaboration.

Key Performance Indicators (KPI)

  • Preventive Maintenance Compliance.
  • First-Time Fix Rate (FTFR).
  • Breakdown Response Time (RT).
  • Turnaround Time (TAT) for call closure.
  • Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT).
  • Service Revenue through spare parts identification.
  • Safety Compliance and Zero Incident Record.

Travel Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively across assigned geographical regions.
  • Availability for emergency breakdown support, weekend work, and on-call duty when required.

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Data Centers
  • Telecom Facilities
  • IT Parks
  • Critical Infrastructure Projects
  • Pharmaceutical Facilities
  • Manufacturing Plants
  • Commercial Buildings

Preferred Certification: HVAC/R, Refrigerant Handling, Electrical Safety, Working at Height, and OEM-specific PAC product training (Vertiv, Stulz, Schneider, Rittal, Climaveneta, etc.).

job.title: Customer Management Operations Specialist (Temp)
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Customer Management Operations Specialist is responsible for managing customer order fulfillment, sales operations, forecasting, revenue recognition, and logistics coordination. The role works closely with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure efficient order execution, regulatory compliance, accurate forecasting, revenue achievement, and high customer satisfaction while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Order Management & Customer Operations

  • Manage the end-to-end order process from customer Purchase Order (PO) receipt through system entry, booking, execution, shipment, and delivery.
  • Review and validate order bookings to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with company policies.
  • Assess order-related risks and proactively identify mitigation plans to minimize customer and operational impacts.
  • Manage order amendments, cancellations, split deliveries, and partial shipment requirements.
  • Coordinate order fulfillment activities with factories, planners, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide production lead time guidance to support customer planning and operational scheduling.
  • Facilitate customer communication regarding order status, delivery commitments, and execution risks.

Revenue Recognition & Financial Operations

  • Manage sales recognition activities in accordance with corporate policies and financial reporting requirements.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end closing activities in collaboration with Finance and Operations teams.
  • Process and maintain sales accruals for incomplete transactions with appropriate supporting documentation.
  • Monitor revenue recognition and support achievement of financial targets.
  • Monitor business performance against sales and operational targets.
  • Improve revenue visibility through regular order review and forecast alignment processes.

Logistics & Shipment Management

  • Coordinate end-to-end shipment execution, including transportation planning and freight management.
  • Obtain freight quotations and evaluate logistics solutions to balance service levels and cost efficiency.
  • Work closely with freight forwarders and logistics providers to ensure on-time delivery performance.
  • Proactively escalate critical shipments and implement recovery plans for urgent customer requirements.
  • Monitor shipment milestones and address transportation-related risks.

Customer Support & Documentation

  • Provide customers with required documentation such as:
  • Import Certificates
  • Test Reports
  • Certificates of Conformity
  • Commercial and shipping documents
  • Regulatory compliance documentation
  • Coordinate Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Factory Witness Tests (FWT) with customers and manufacturing facilities.
  • Share inspection reports and documentation in a timely manner.
  • Ensure customer documentation requests are fulfilled accurately and efficiently.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure adherence to regulatory, trade compliance, and customer-specific requirements.
  • Validate mandatory certifications including Electrical Safety Certifications, Radio Type Approvals, and other regulatory requirements.
  • Review tariff classifications and documentation for import/export compliance.
  • Maintain data integrity and documentation accuracy to minimize audit and compliance risks.
  • Identify operational risks and drive preventive and corrective actions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics, Procurement, Manufacturing, Legal, and Customer Service teams.
  • Support timely order booking, execution, revenue recognition, and accrual management.
  • Coordinate legal and contractual requirements related to customer transactions.
  • Facilitate effective communication across functions to ensure successful execution and customer satisfaction.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Finance, Engineering, or related field.

Experience

  • 3-5+ years of experience in Customer Operations, Order Management, Supply Chain, Sales Operations, Logistics, or Customer Service.
  • Experience supporting revenue recognition, forecasting, and month-end close activities.
  • Knowledge of international shipping, import/export processes, and trade compliance requirements.
  • Experience working within ERP systems such as Oracle

Knowledge & Skills

  • Order Management and Customer Operations
  • Sales Forecasting and Revenue Recognition
  • Financial Acumen and Accrual Management
  • Supply Chain and Logistics Coordination
  • Trade Compliance and Regulatory Documentation
  • KPI Management and Performance Analysis
  • Root Cause Analysis and Problem Solving
  • Stakeholder Management and Customer Relationship Management
  • ERP Systems and Data Analytics
  • Process Improvement and SOP Development
  • Strong Communication and Cross-Functional Collaboration Skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel and Reporting Skills

Job Summary

The senior instructional design coordinator performs instructional design and content development work in support of complex learning projects. The role partners with stakeholders to deliver effective learning solutions while promoting quality, consistency, and continuous improvement across learning initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Functional / Technical Expertise

  • Design, develop, implement, and maintain learning solutions that support business and performance objectives.
  • Develop e-learning courses, videos, job aids, learning journeys, assessments, and blended learning solutions using established instructional design methodologies and development standards.
  • Collaborate with project managers, stakeholders, and subject matter experts to gather requirements and support the development of effective learning solutions.
  • Create scalable, reusable, and localization-ready content that supports global audiences and improves development efficiency and consistency.
  • Develop storyboards, scripts, assessments, and supporting multimedia assets that align with learning objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Apply instructional design principles, adult learning concepts, and learning technologies to create engaging and effective learning experiences.
  • Publish, test, maintain, and update learning content within the Learning Management System (LMS) and other supported learning platforms.
  • Develop and maintain digital learning assets, job-aids, course materials, and related resources as required by assigned projects.
  • Ensure deliverables meet established quality standards, accessibility requirements, localization guidelines, and project timelines.
  • Identify project risks, dependencies, and content-related issues and communicate them to the appropriate project team members for resolution.

Project coordination stakeholder collaboration

  • Support instructional design projects from analysis through deployment, ensuring that the team completes deliverables on time and meets quality standards.
  • Track project timelines, milestones, stakeholder communications, and resource requirements using project management tools such as Smartsheet.
  • Participate in discovery sessions, design reviews, and stakeholder meetings to gather requirements and validate learning solutions.
  • Communicate project status, design recommendations, and development updates to stakeholders and project teams.
  • Collaborate with SMEs, business partners, global teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure learning solutions align with business needs.
  • Recommend instructional strategies and learning approaches that support learner performance and business objectives.
  • Identify project risks, dependencies, and potential issues, escalating concerns as appropriate to support successful project delivery.

Team collaboration quality support

  • Own assigned learning projects while collaborating with team members to ensure alignment with established standards, processes, and project goals.
  • Participate in peer reviews and provide feedback to improve the quality and consistency of learning deliverables.
  • Share best practices, tools, templates, and lessons learned with team members.
  • Support onboarding and knowledge transfer activities for new team members as needed.

Continuous improvement

  • Stay current on instructional design methodologies, learning technologies, AI-assisted development tools, and industry best practices and apply them to assigned projects to improve the quality and efficiency of deliverables.
  • Design and develop learning content for global audiences, following localization and translation best practices to support consistency, accessibility, and cultural relevance across regions.
  • Apply established team standards, templates, workflows, and development processes to ensure quality and consistency across learning solutions.
  • Evaluate learner feedback, review results, and project outcomes to identify opportunities to improve future learning deliverables.
  • Demonstrate openness to new tools, processes, and ways of working while maintaining strong instructional design fundamentals and development standards.
  • Participate in team and departmental initiatives that support knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and operational excellence.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in instructional design, information technology, multimedia/Graphics design, organizational development, or equivalent work experience.
  • Awareness of training solution design, instructional design methodologies, curriculum development, learning technologies, and training evaluation.
  • Ability to write effective copies, instructional text, audio scripts, video scripts, and learning assessments.
  • Strong knowledge of computer technologies and technical development processes.
  • Knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, Canva, or related authoring tools.
  • Strong visual design skills with the ability to create engaging and innovative learning experiences.
  • Knowledgeable in adult learning principles/theories, training needs analysis, curriculum design, instructional design learning solutions, and training evaluation projects.
  • Strong verbal, written, presentation, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to simplify and communicate complex concepts to various audiences.
  • Experience working in cross-functional teams.
  • Willing to work full onsite in Mandaluyong and on a mid-shift.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with video editing and animation tools.
  • Experience administering and managing Learning Management Systems (LMS).
  • Experience in both traditional instructor-led and virtual training facilitation.
  • Advanced skills in Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.
