job.title: Engineer, QA QC
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

The Engineer, QA/QC ensures site compliance with approved quality processes, project requirements, and company standards, driving quality performance and supporting the successful delivery of mission-critical data center projects through inspections, audits, and quality data analysis

Key Responsibilities

Work Process & Scope Compliance**

  • Verify that site QA/QC processes follow the approved work process, method statements, mock-ups and Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs) for every activity.
  • Audit field teams to ensure hold points and witness points are not bypassed and that required signoffs are obtained in sequence.

Quality Control Execution

  • Surveillance and monitoring, track, and close Inspection Requests (IRs/RFIs), Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and Site Issue Reports where the process or scope is not met.
  • Verify that site construction QA/QC maintain complete and accurate quality records, ITP signoffs, test packs, and turnover documentation.

Data Collation, Analysis & Reporting

  • Perform basic data crunching and analysis (e.g., NCR counts by trade/contractor/system, first-time-right rates, repeat-defect frequency, inspection pass/fail ratios, etc).
  • Identify emerging trends, recurring issues, and problem areas from the data, and flag them to the QA/QC Manager for action.
  • Prepare clear, data-supported daily/weekly quality reports, dashboards, and NCR statistics for the project location (Campus Level).
  • Capture and document lessons learned at project level and feed them into the database for sharing across projects.

Commissioning & Critical Systems Compliance

  • Verify that L1–L5 commissioning activities (FAT, SAT, pre-functional, functional, IST) are executed per the approved commissioning process.
  • Confirm installation quality and process compliance for UPS, generators, switchgear, busway, CRAC/CRAH, chillers, cooling distribution, and fire detection/suppression.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
  • 3–6 years of QA/QC experience in construction; data center, mission-critical, or MEP-intensive projects strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of ITPs, NCRs, work-process compliance, commissioning, defects management and quality documentation systems.
  • Competence in data handling and analysis using Excel (pivot tables, charts) or equivalent tools; familiarity with dashboards a plus.
  • Familiarity with ISO 9001 and relevant construction/data center standards.
  • Certifications (preferred): CQI/CSWIP, NDT, CWI, CxA, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in MS Office and quality/document control platforms (ACC, Procore, Aconex, BIM 360).

Competencies Attention to detail, field inspection and audit discipline, analytical mindset, firm enforcement of process and scope under schedule pressure, and effective communication across multidisciplinary site teams. Comfortable to be based on-site.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: High Voltage Site Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the HV Site Engineer reporting to the Associate Director, HV Infrastructure, you will work closely with our Technology, Development, Construction, Commissioning and Operations teams, making your mark in several ways:

  • Lead the safe and effective on-site delivery of high voltage (HV) infrastructure across AirTrunk projects, ensuring installations meet approved designs, quality requirements, programme commitments and operational needs
  • Coordinate contractors, consultants, network service providers and internal teams through construction, testing, energisation, commissioning and handover
  • Provide practical site-based engineering solutions to HV issues, with a strong focus on safety, constructability, reliability and continuity of operations

Your Day to Day

  • Manage the on-site delivery of HV networks across new and existing AirTrunk sites, ensuring work is completed safely and in accordance with approved designs, applicable codes, standards and AirTrunk requirements
  • Oversee the installation of HV equipment and systems, including switchgear, transformers, protection relays, SCADA, earthing, cabling and DC systems
  • Review issued-for-construction drawings, specifications, method statements, inspection and test plans, safe work method statements and vendor documentation before site execution
  • Supervise and collaborate with principal contractors, specialist subcontractors and suppliers to achieve safe, practical and high-quality outcomes on time and within budget
  • Complete site inspections, monitor workmanship and quality records, and drive the timely resolution of non-conformances, defects and punch-list items
  • Coordinate HV access, isolations, permits and switching activities with authorised personnel, Site Specialists and Operations teams
  • Act as the site technical interface between designers, consultants, contractors, vendors, network service providers and AirTrunk stakeholders
  • Support testing, energisation and commissioning activities, including witnessing tests, reviewing results and confirming that systems are ready for safe operation
  • Prepare and review methods of procedure, switching plans and other site execution documents in conjunction with the Site Specialist and commissioning teams
  • Resolve site queries, constructability issues, clashes and design discrepancies through timely technical clarification and controlled change processes
  • Support the investigation and resolution of HV incidents, standing issues and emerging technical risks that fall outside local Operations capability
  • Identify opportunities to improve safety, programme, cost, quality and system performance, and share lessons learned across projects
  • Ensure complete project handover, including as-built drawings, test records, operation and maintenance manuals, asset information, training and outstanding-action close-out

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.
  • Minimum five years of experience in HV construction, site engineering or project delivery, preferably within data centres, critical infrastructure, utilities or large-scale industrial projects.
  • Strong practical knowledge of HV equipment and installations, including switchgear, transformers, protection systems, SCADA, earthing, cabling and auxiliary DC systems.
  • Working knowledge of applicable Australian electrical standards, network service provider requirements, workplace health and safety obligations and HV safe systems of work.
  • Demonstrated ability to interpret single-line diagrams, schematics, layouts, specifications and issued-for-construction documentation.
  • Experience reviewing method statements, safe work method statements, inspection and test plans, test documentation and contractor quality records.
  • Sound understanding of HV installation, testing, protection, energisation, commissioning and operational handover requirements.
  • Experience supervising contractors and coordinating multiple work fronts within a live construction environment.
  • Strong commitment to electrical safety, permit-to-work controls, risk management and high-quality site execution.
  • Ability to identify and resolve technical, constructability and interface issues while maintaining programme and operational priorities.
  • Experience managing RFIs, non-conformances, defects, punch lists, red-line mark-ups and as-built documentation.
  • Competency with common engineering and document-control tools; familiarity with AutoCAD, PowerFactory, ETAP or similar applications is advantageous.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to coordinate contractors, consultants, authorities and multidisciplinary internal teams.
  • Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail.
  • A collaborative, accountable and delivery-focused approach, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced site environment.
  • Willingness to travel to AirTrunk project sites as required.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Senior Commercial Manager - Construction & MEP - Mumbai, India
job.description:
Job Summary

This position reports directly to the Director, Commercial Management, India, within the Global Design & Construction organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to provide commercial management oversight across Equinix's portfolio of major expansion and construction projects throughout India. The incumbent will work closely with cross-functional internal project teams and stakeholders at various levels of seniority to support successful project delivery.

The role is expected to provide strategic and day-to-day leadership specifically focused to drive down construction costs, provide assurance against internal financial controls, reporting processes and help manage all major contract risks.

Responsibilities

Pre-Contract

  • Procurement of third-party consultants including Design, Commercial and Pre-Construction Services
  • Development of detailed Request for Proposals (RFP) and service deliverables for the commercial management services
  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Development of General Contractor and supplier procurement strategies in conjunction with the Construction Management (CM) team
  • Working with Legal and Procurement Centre of Excellence (COE) to prepare General Contractor Contracts including negotiation of Contract terms
  • Collation and presentation of market insights for the construction industry in the relevant country including market activity, comparative builds, construction cost indices, key suppliers and benchmarking information
  • Preparation of budgets for all design stages including feasibility estimation, detailed cost modelling, benchmarking analysis and presentation of this to senior management throughout funding approval stages
  • Advice on the most economical design and construction delivery strategy including budget comparisons
  • Identification of market and region-specific commercial risks and development of practical mitigation strategies
  • Ensuring that all cost data is prepared and presented in the Equinix WBS throughout the Project lifecycle
  • Input and action of Value Engineering (VE) exercises at all stages of design. The output must include clear cost evaluation to support decision making
  • Prepare annual and quarterly cashflow forecasts for active and pipeline projects
  • Prepare and oversee monthly reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management

Post Contract

  • Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
  • Monitor adherence against budget throughout the project lifespan including cost checks and reviews, value engineering and cost saving initiatives and evaluation of alternates
  • Oversee and provide guidance on commercial change management and change evaluation efforts on all projects
  • Monitor and report monthly and quarterly on project portfolio cash flow for the region
  • Provide Construction in Place (CIP) data to Finance
  • Pro-actively lead all commercial risk management efforts including commercial audits, contingency analysis and management
  • Prepare and oversee monthly cost reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management
  • Monitor the financial close-out on all projects including settlement of all vendors
  • Prepare lessons learned cost analysis and detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) analysis of outturn costs

Qualifications

Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, construction, business, financial, Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 12 Years of experience in Commercial Management
  • Proven Data Center and strong MEP experience
  • Preferably RICS accreditation

  • Must be able to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
  • Must have strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Must have strong sense of accountability, ownership and urgency
  • Must have strong computer skills, particularly with Excel, Power BI, Cost Management Tools

job.title: Command Center Analyst I
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Operational Monitoring & Support - Deliver Tier I operational support to ensure the continuous, uninterrupted operation of mission-critical 24/7 Data Centers.
  • Incident Management, Triage & Ownership - Serve as the primary operational intake point across all support channels (calls, emails, portal tickets). Efficiently assess business impact to assign accurate priority levels, and take definitive end-to-end ownership of all reported incidents, driving them to resolution or ensuring precise, timely escalation.
  • Critical Stakeholder Communications - Act as the definitive voice of the Command Center by drafting and broadcasting timely notifications for incidents, maintenance events, and regional advisories. Seamlessly translate complex technical jargon into clear, actionable updates for external customers, while maintaining strict technical accuracy when briefing internal engineering and leadership teams.
  • Bridge Facilitation - Lead and coordinate internal bridge calls during P1 incidents, ensuring the rapid mobilization of necessary technical teams, effective stakeholder engagement, and real-time decision-making to drive rapid resolution and minimize downtime.
  • Alarm Monitoring & Site Escalation - Proactively monitor and analyze infrastructure alarms to perform initial remote fault isolation. Rapidly engage and coordinate with local site teams to drive on-the-ground triage and physical mitigation.
  • Cross-Tier Collaboration - Maintain seamless, effective communication channels with advanced support tiers and management to immediately flag critical issues requiring urgent intervention.
  • Enterprise Ticketing & Real-Time Documentation - Leverage enterprise service management platforms to rigorously manage the complete lifecycle of all operational tasks. Comprehensively document all incidents, communications, maintenance, and problem details to ensure near real-time accuracy and traceability.
  • Performance & Compliance - Prioritize and execute daily tasks to consistently meet established KPIs and strictly adhere to customer SLAs.
  • Quality Assurance Adherence - Consistently meet established call quality and documentation scorecards, actively participating in routine QA audits to ensure exceptional, standardized service delivery across the operations floor.
  • Continuous Improvement & Team Development - Actively develop technical skills and industry knowledge through internal training programs, continuing education, and relevant certifications, while contributing to internal SOPs and operational training frameworks to elevate the teams’ overall technical baseline.

Qualifications

Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Diploma in Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent.
  • 3+ years of experience working in a 24/7 Global Command Center, Network Operations Center (NOC), Data Center environment, or Contact Center.
  • 3+ years of proven success in delivering exceptional customer service or technical support.
  • Foundational knowledge of Data Center facility operations, including core mechanical/electrical (M&E) subsystems (UPS, Chiller, CRAC/CRAH, HVAC, Cooling systems, PDU), Building Management Systems (BMS), and physical security protocols.
  • Hands-on proficiency in enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Office Suite, SharePoint, etc.
  • Industry certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, CDCTP, DCCA, DCD, ITIL v4/v5 Foundation, or equivalent Data Center credentials are highly advantageous.

Professional Competencies:

  • Communication - Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to confidently engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Problem Solving - Strong analytical capabilities with a keen attention to detail and a methodical approach to troubleshooting.
  • Attitude & Teamwork - Brings a highly positive, collaborative and professional working attitude to the team, remaining constructive and resilient even during high-pressure incidents.
  • Accountability - Highly self-motivated, organized, and capable of prioritizing tasks independently in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated initiative to see issues through to absolute completion.
  • Discipline - A strong commitment to meeting deadlines and adhering strictly to operational procedures.

job.title: Regional Manager, Data Center Operations (APAC)
job.description:
Led by an experienced management team and supported by a strong investor group, including large and experienced institutions and strategic partners, EdgeConneX offers a dynamic, fast-paced work environment where we are bringing flexibility, proximity, power, and connectivity to some of the world’s key businesses. With major offices in Herndon, Denver, Amsterdam, Singapore and Malaysia, we have a global footprint and a unified team of employees committed to providing a premier customer experience and delivering the full spectrum of data center solutions, from core to edge, like no other data center provider can do.

Focused on driving innovation and helping our customers define and deliver their own unique vision for the Edge, at any scale, in any market worldwide, for any requirement, we are building tomorrow’s data center infrastructure, today for some of the world’s most demanding Network, Content, and Cloud customers.

The Regional Manager, Data Center Operations - APAC works directly with the Regional Directors to monitor, maintain and support EdgeConneX data centers throughout the APAC region. This requires leading scheduled preventive maintenance activities, performing unscheduled maintenance, and supporting any customer requests. He or she will also help manage facility expansions and improvement, new MEP capacity expansions or repairs, and utility upgrades.

While an IT background could be helpful to complement the leadership needed, the background coveted is in MEP. This position reports to the Regional Director of APAC Data Center Operations and will be expected to work closely with the other Regional Managers (across other regions), peers in other departments, Customer Installation Project Managers and with contract vendors to accomplish their tasks.

While this position can be based in Cyberjaya or Johor, travel could be as much as 50%.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Support the Regional Directors in implementing and managing the Preventive Maintenance program at each of our sites and act as on-site lead for any emergency maintenance done at the EDCs
  • Ensure all customer SLA requirements are met and maintained.
  • Manage a team of highly skilled engineers. Support hiring activities for new developments.
  • Work with our computerized maintenance management system (CMMS) and other systems to ensure they are up to date and have the correct information.
  • Effectively manage, supervise, and evaluate contract technical labor
  • Identifying areas of improvement to our existing facilities, particularly efficiency and PUE
  • Evaluate and improve the security of data center facilities
  • Conduct routine, ongoing assessment of the building systems operations
  • Ensuring compliance with all safety procedures as well as utilization of protective equipment
  • Maintain ongoing communication with tenants, owners, property management and vendors
  • Travel can be up to 50% of the time

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Commitment to organizational excellence and constant awareness to seek opportunities to improve processes/quality of deliverables
  • Superb ability to successfully prioritize and manage multiple projects and responsibilities
  • Superb ability to meet committed timelines, leveraging assistance/input from peers
  • Strong and effective team player in working with various disciplines and peer groups; can cover all gamut of tasks required to ‘getting a job done’
  • A high level of commitment to customer service to both co-workers and clients
  • Ability to respond effectively, verbally and in writing, to sensitive issues, complex inquiries or complaints
  • Ability to interact effectively with managers, clients, customers and the general public
  • Translate

job.title: Construction Safety Manager ( Data Centre)
job.description:
Overview

Lead regional Environmental, Health and Safety (EHS) governance for data centre construction projects, ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations and industry best practices. The role provides independent oversight of project safety performance, contractor compliance, incident management and continuous improvement across the project lifecycle.

**

Make an Impact by

EHS Governance & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional construction EHS standards, procedures and governance requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with project HSE plans, environmental requirements, Permit-to-Work systems, Design for Safety principles and local regulations.
  • Review key contractor safety documents such as risk assessments, method statements, lifting plans and emergency response plans.
  • Conduct compliance reviews and audits and track corrective actions to closure.
  • Review and evaluate contractor EHS capability for regional tender including tender evaluation assessment.

Site Safety & Contractor Oversight

  • Conduct regular site inspections and governance reviews across regional projects.
  • Monitor high-risk activities including excavation, lifting, working at height, electrical works, hot work, confined space, MEP works, testing and commissioning.
  • Assess and monitor contractor EHS capability and performance, escalating significant concerns where required.
  • Drive safety improvement initiatives with project and contractor teams.

Risk & Incident Management

  • Oversee project risk assessments and verify appropriate controls are in place before work starts.
  • Ensure Design for Safety principles are integrated into design and construction activities.
  • Review incident investigations and root cause analyses, and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented.
  • Analyse incident trends and share lessons learned across the region.

EHS Performance & Reporting

  • Participate in project and regional EHS governance monthly and quarterly meetings.
  • Prepare EHS dashboards and reports covering incidents, audits, training compliance, safety observations and key performance indicators.
  • Conduct regular EHS performance reviews with project leaders and senior management.

##

Environmental & Commissioning Safety

  • Monitor compliance with environmental requirements, including noise, dust, waste, chemical storage, water discharge and spill prevention.
  • Provide safety oversight for mission-critical works, including HV/LV electrical installation, energisation, testing and commissioning.
  • Review isolation procedures and risk controls before energisation and commissioning activities.

##

Authority

  • Request the Project Lead to stop or suspend unsafe work where there is imminent danger or serious non-compliance.
  • Require corrective actions before work resumes and escalate repeated or severe violations to senior management.
  • Recommend contractor suspension for serious or repeated safety breaches.

##

Skills for Success:

  • Degree or Diploma in Occupational Safety & Health, Engineering, Construction Management, Environmental Management or a related discipline.
  • Preferred certifications include WSH Officer/Manager, NEBOSH, IOSH, ISO 45001/14001 Lead Auditor, CSP, OSHA or equivalent.
  • Minimum 10 years of construction safety experience, including at least 5 years in data centre or mission-critical infrastructure projects.
  • Experience managing EPC/general contractors, safety consultants and multi-country projects within APAC.
  • Proven experience in incident investigation, root cause analysis and contractor performance management.
  • Strong knowledge of construction safety, risk management, environmental compliance and Design for Safety.
  • Strong leadership, communication, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills with sound, independent judgement.
  • Proactive and collaborative working style, with willingness to travel across the region

##

job.title: Director, Group Network Cyber Security
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

**

This is a technical leadership role within Group Strategy, Engineering and Innovation (GSEI) in Group Technology Network, responsible for providing strategic direction and deep expertise in telecommunications network cybersecurity across the Singtel Group, including its regional associates.

The role will lead and collaborate with network and cybersecurity subject matter experts across Singtel Operating Companies (OpCos) and regional associates to ensure alignment with Singtel Group’s broader strategic objectives.

The person will define, develop, and institutionalise network cybersecurity design principles, frameworks, and guidelines across multiple network domains, drawing from industry standards, best practices, and lessons learned from past incidents and operational experience.

Make an Impact by

**

a. Strategy Development

  • Partner closely with Group Cybersecurity to define and evolve the network security strategy and framework in alignment with Singtel Group’s business objectives, risk appetite, and industry trends.
  • Provide thought leadership on network cybersecurity, ensuring long-term resilience, scalability, and regulatory readiness across the Group.

b. Network Architecture & Design Governance

  • Establish and maintain a group-wide network security architecture framework, incorporating industry-recognised standards, specifications, and best-practice design principles.
  • Drive consistent adoption of network security guidelines across multiple network domains (e.g. core, access, transport, cloud, edge) to strengthen the Group’s overall security posture and operational resilience.

c. Technology Evaluation & Future Readiness

  • Identify, assess, and provide strategic guidance on emerging technologies and trends such as 6G, AI for Networks, and Networks for AI.
  • Articulate how evolving network security requirements and capabilities will both influence and be influenced by—the design, deployment, and operation of these technologies.
  • Translate complex technical implications into clear recommendations for leadership and stakeholders.

d. Group Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Foster strong collaboration and knowledge sharing across Singtel Group and regional associates within the network security domain.
  • Create and sustain platforms, forums, and communities of practice to share experiences, expertise, lessons learned, and incident insights.
  • Promote a culture of continuous improvement, collective ownership, and proactive risk and incident management across the Group.

**

Skills for Success

**

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in telecommunications networks, with significant depth in network cybersecurity across large-scale, carrier-grade environments.
  • Proven experience in a technical leadership, architecture, or strategy role, within a telco network environment.
  • Strong track record of defining and implementing network security frameworks, architectures, and design principles across multiple network domains.
  • Hands on experience translating industry standards and best practices (e.g. 3GPP, ETSI, NIST, ISO/IEC, Zero Trust, Security by design) into practical, deployable network security controls.
  • Experience working with or influencing regional operating companies or affiliates, balancing group governance with local regulatory and operational requirements.
  • Experience evaluating and shaping security requirements for emerging technologies such as Quantum safe, 5G/6G, network virtualisation, cloud-native networks, AI-enabled networks, and automation.

**

Technical & Domain Expertise

  • Deep understanding of telecommunications network architectures and protocols, including fixed, mobile, IP, transport, and cloud-native network environments.
  • Strong expertise in network security domains, including network segmentation, identity and access management, encryption, key management, signalling security, API security, and monitoring/detection.
  • Knowledge of secure network design and security tools, resilience engineering, redundancy, and high-availability principles in carrier-grade environments.
  • Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and assurance requirements relevant to telecommunications and critical infrastructure security.

**

Leadership & Collaboration Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organisation, working across multiple OpCos, functions, and geographies without direct authority.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with various layer of stakeholders in various domain as such cybersecurity, network engineering, operations and risk/
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, concise, and actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Proven capability to build communities of practice, encourage knowledge sharing, and foster a culture of security-by-design across the Group.

**

Professional Attributes

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to balance security, business objectives, cost, and operational practicality.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and forward-looking approach to risk management.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and documentation skills.
  • Relevant professional certifications and knowledge (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CIS controls, GSMA security guidelines and control, cloud security controls) are advantageous.

**

**

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

**

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.description:
Job title: Customer Centricity Manager / Senior Customer Centricity Manager

Team: Operational Excellence & Governance

Location: Hong Kong

Department: Customer Relations & Operations Excellence

**

Role purpose

Act as a change management agent to drive complaint-led improvement and preventive measures. To simplify all journey enhancement, communication clarity, process simplification to ensure offering simple, reliable, consistency, accessible service channels to our eMPF employers and members.

What will you do?

  • Oversee, manage, and implement customer-centric and operational excellence initiatives to drive overall service efficiency and end-to-end customer experience improvements across the organization.
  • Lead and manage the CX and operational governance framework to ensure alignment with strategic priorities, compliance with standards, clear accountability, and timely execution of improvement initiatives across all touchpoints and departments.
  • Lead, develop, and implement programs to build a culture of operational excellence and customer centricity, ensuring all staff understand their role in end-to-end flows and how they can contribute to efficiency and service quality through communication, campaigns, recognition, and training.
  • Proactively identify complaints, performance data, and operational issues to drive root-cause analysis and targeted improvements in service journeys, communication, forms, processes, and overall operational efficiency.
  • Lead cross-departmental process mapping and journey mapping (operational, digital, and support functions) to identify pain points, bottlenecks, gaps, and opportunities for efficiency gains. Apply structured problem-solving and Design Thinking approaches to develop and implement practical solutions with stakeholders from different teams.
  • Drive change management and continuous improvement: Collaborate with stakeholders across different departments to enable rapid cross-functional collaboration and execution. Identify process gaps and when a structured change or efficiency improvement plan needs to be developed and implemented. Ensure clear line of accountability and robust planning for implementation.

Minimum Job Requirements:

  • Minimum 15 years of relevant work experience with a strong track record of driving operational excellence, end-to-end process improvement, and customer experience strategies. Experience in Pensions, Insurance, or financial services industry is highly preferred.
  • Excellent customer-centric and operational excellence mindset. Strong analytical skills with proven ability to map complex cross-departmental operation flows, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and deliver measurable improvements in operational efficiency. Good plain language communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills across different functions; avoid unnecessary jargon.
  • Obsessed with data-driven insights, process analytics, and the bigger strategic picture. Strong storytelling and influencing skillset to embed operational excellence and customer centricity across the enterprise and different departments.
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, judgment, and decision-making skills. Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and deliver tangible efficiency and experience outcomes.

job.title: Sales Director
job.description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an ambitious, results-driven commercial leader to drive ad-supported revenue growth and strategic sponsorship deals for Viu. In this role, you will lead end-to-end sales strategies spanning digital media (AVOD), original content integration, high-profile event sponsorships (such as Asian celebrity fan meets and concerts), and bespoke brand activations. You will leverage existing executive relationships across top-tier media agencies and direct brand decision-makers to scale Viu’s commercial footprint across the region.

Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue Generation & Growth

Drive ad sales strategy and hit quarterly/annual revenue targets across Viu digital media, video ad inventory, programmatic channels, and premium sponsorship packages.

  • Structure and close complex, high-value commercial deals combining digital video, content placement, brand integrations, and live fan experience events (e.g., Korean/Thai star fan meetings).
  • Agency & Brand Relationship Management

Cultivate and expand a robust network of senior-level decision-makers at media holding companies, independent agencies, and major regional/global brands.

  • Serve as the trusted media advisor for key accounts, translating advertiser goals into customized Viu content and media solutions.
  • Strategic Campaign Integration & Fan Meets

Partner with the Content, Marketing, and Event Execution teams to design high-impact 360-degree brand partnerships centered around Viu’s core entertainment assets (Originals, top dramas, live events).

  • Monitize celebrity fan meets and regional events through title sponsorships, VIP experience packages, on-ground branding, and digital amplification.
  • Market & Yield Strategy

Develop competitive pricing frameworks, packaging strategies, and yield-management models for media inventory and event assets.

  • Analyze campaign performance data, viewer demographics, and market trends to continuously refine sales pitches and maximize ROI for client renewals.

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience

8+ years of progressive experience in ad sales, media partnerships, or commercial business development within OTT streaming platforms, digital media networks, or entertainment agencies.

  • Proven track record of consistently meeting or exceeding multi-million dollar annual revenue targets.
  • Industry Network

Established, active relationships with key media agencies (GroupM, Publicis, Omnicom, IPG, Dentsu, Havas) and direct brand marketers across consumer electronics, FMCG, telecom, beauty, and e-commerce.

  • Event & Media Expertise

Demonstrated experience closing sponsorships for live entertainment, celebrity fan meets, or major regional events alongside standard digital ad inventory.

  • Deep understanding of digital video advertising formats, programmatics, streaming measurement metrics, and content-integration models.
  • Skills & Mindset

Exceptional negotiation, strategic framing, and high-stakes pitch presentation skills.

  • Entrepreneurial, proactive mindset with the ability to navigate matrixed internal teams (Content, Legal, Marketing, Operations) to execute complex client campaigns seamlessly.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform basic Finite Element Analysis using ANSYS Workbench for mechanical structures and components.

job.title: Engineer I - Field Service
job.description:
Job Description

The PAC Service Engineer is responsible for installation, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repairs, and customer support for Precision Air Conditioning (PAC) systems and associated cooling equipment. The role requires ensuring maximum equipment uptime, meeting SLA commitments, and providing excellent customer service at data centers, telecom sites, IT facilities, and commercial establishments.

Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning

  • Perform installation, testing, and commissioning of PAC units and associated cooling systems.
  • Verify site readiness and ensure compliance with engineering drawings and safety requirements.
  • Conduct performance testing and prepare commissioning reports.
  • Coordinate with project teams, customers, and subcontractors during project execution.

Preventive Maintenance

  • Execute scheduled preventive maintenance activities for PAC units, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, condensers, CDU, FWU, and related systems.
  • Inspect compressors, condensers, evaporators, fans, control panels, sensors, and refrigerant circuits.
  • Submit maintenance reports and recommendations for improving equipment reliability.

Breakdown & Troubleshooting

  • Diagnose and rectify faults in electrical, mechanical, refrigeration, and control systems.
  • Analyze alarms and operational abnormalities using controller logs and monitoring systems.

Customer Support

Safety & Compliance

job.description:
Job Description

Job Title: Governance Risk and Compliance Analyst II

Division: Governance, Risk & Compliance – IT Security

_Position Summary_

The GRC Analyst will act as a key contributor to Vertiv’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance initiatives, driving risk assessments, security reviews, audit readiness, and third-party risk management efforts. This role supports continuous improvement of the risk register and policy exception processes, partners with cross-functional stakeholders, and helps develop a scalable security and compliance posture across the organization.

_Key Responsibilities_

  • Lead IT risk assessments, mitigation planning, and control monitoring activities.
  • Oversee risk register updates and coordinate with risk owners and SMEs to track mitigation actions.
  • Drive third-party risk reviews and assessments using OneTrust and SecurityScorecard, escalating high-risk vendors for action.
  • Conduct contract reviews focused on information security terms and recommend necessary revisions.
  • Respond to customer security questionnaires with input from SMEs using Loopio.
  • Supervise compliance training rollouts (e.g., phishing campaigns, annual security awareness training).
  • Review and recommend changes to IT security policies and standards aligned with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and other frameworks.
  • Generate and present GRC dashboards and KPIs to leadership to inform risk posture and team performance.
  • Act as an escalation point for GRC process inquiries and ticket-related exceptions.
  • Mentor junior analysts and support GRC program maturity through playbooks, SOPs, and process documentation.

_Qualifications_

  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in GRC, IT Risk Management, or Information Security.
  • Strong understanding of ITGC, SOX, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and data privacy regulations (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR).
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as ServiceNow GRC, OneTrust, and SecurityScorecard.
  • Strong documentation and analytical skills with experience preparing audit-ready evidence.
  • Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor (preferred).
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global teams.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deliverables independently.

Job Description

The Thermal Customer Engineer (Technician) – Commissioning is a highly specialised technical role within the APAC ANZ division, responsible for delivering end-to-end commissioning of precision cooling systems including Computer Room Air Conditioning (CRAC), Computer Room Air Handlers (CRAH), Fan Wall Units (FWU), and Coolant Distribution Units (CDU). Reporting directly to the Service Operations Manager – Start Up Services, ANZ, this role is pivotal in ensuring the reliable and efficient operation of mission critical Thermal Infrastructure across large-scale environments, including Tier 1 Data Centres.

Key Responsibilities

Planning & Reporting:

  • Time Sheets - Digital reporting tool to be used to accurately record hours worked each day.
  • Commissioning/Service Reports - to be completed within set timeframes.
  • Proactively communicate project progress and any site issues to the Project Manager & Service Operations Manager.

Operational Delivery:

  • Own the commissioning process from start to finish - You'll lead the full commissioning cycle across Vertiv's complete range of CDU, CRAC, CRAH, FWU & TWU units, delivering critical infrastructure that keeps the world's most important facilities running.
  • Work on landmark projects - Carry out L2, L3, and L4 commissioning tasks alongside experienced Vertiv Project & Commissioning Managers. If you've previously worked on Tier 1 Data Centre sites, you'll feel right at home here.
  • Broaden your expertise - This isn't a one-dimensional role. You'll also support the Service Team with maintenance and time & material works, giving you exposure across the full asset lifecycle.
  • Be the face of Vertiv - Build trusted relationships with our customers through professional, solutions-focused interactions. Your feedback helps shape how we deliver for our clients.
  • Never stop growing - Access ongoing training across multiple Vertiv technologies, keeping your skills sharp and your career moving forward.

Enjoy the perks - A fully maintained company vehicle and the support you need to represent Vertiv at the highest standard, every day.

Daily Work Duties and expectations:

  • Travel to various sites, including remote locations, requiring a valid Driver's Licence.

WHS, Environment & Quality:

  • I dentify, report, and mitigate workplace hazards promptly and effectively.

Job Description

Senior Engineer – Code Compliance

Electrical & Thermal Products \| Vertiv Power and Thermal Management

| | | | | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Experience<br> 5–10 years | Function<br> Code Compliance | Scope<br> Power + Thermal | Level<br> Senior Engineer |

Position Summary

The Senior Engineer – Code Compliance, Electrical & Thermal Products will support Vertiv Power and Thermal Management product lines by ensuring that product designs, engineering documentation, electrical systems, thermal systems, components, submittals, and certification deliverables comply with applicable product safety standards, electrical codes, thermal equipment requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.

This role is intended for a senior engineer with 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal product engineering, safety/compliance, certification support, design review, or code compliance for industrial, data center, HVAC, power, or critical infrastructure products.

Product Scope

| | | | --- | --- | | Vertiv Power Products | Vertiv Thermal Products | | UPS and power systems; power distribution units; switchgear/switchboards; electrical panels; energy storage/battery systems; integrated modular solutions; racks and site monitoring systems. | CRAC units; fan walls; AHUs; XDUs; chillers; air cooling; liquid cooling; heat rejection/reuse equipment; controls and related cooling-system documentation. |

Key Responsibilities Electrical & Power Product Compliance

  • Review electrical schematics, single-line/three-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding and bonding systems, cable management, lighting/power distribution plans, monitoring/control systems, BOMs, installation documents, and maintenance documentation.
  • Ensure electrical designs comply with applicable electrical codes, product safety requirements, customer specifications, and regional regulatory expectations.
  • Support compliance for power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, power distribution systems, energy storage, integrated modular solutions, and site monitoring systems.
  • Support standards alignment for power products such as UL891 switchboards and UL1558 switchgear where applicable.

Thermal Product Compliance

  • Review thermal product designs and documentation for CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chiller, air cooling, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Support compliance review of submittals, airflow summaries, unit drawings, component performance, fan data, filter data, electrical cabinet heat calculations, safety notes, and component specification sheets.
  • Support testing, commissioning, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting documentation, Method Statements, Risk Assessments, Site Acceptance Test procedures, and incident documentation where relevant to compliance deliverables.
  • Support refrigerant and regulatory-readiness reviews for cooling products, including low-GWP refrigerant transition requirements when applicable.

Cross-Product Standards & Certification Support

  • Interpret and apply product safety, electrical, thermal, environmental, and regional standards during NPD, sustaining engineering, customer projects, product changes, and product release activities.
  • Participate in design reviews with engineering, product management, manufacturing, quality, sourcing, and business unit teams to identify compliance risks early and recommend corrective actions.
  • Maintain compliance checklists, standards matrices, technical justifications, evidence packages, compliance reports, and audit-ready documentation.
  • Coordinate with internal compliance teams, certification bodies, suppliers, and product teams for certification evidence, product approvals, component changes, and compliance documentation.

Required Qualifications

| | | | --- | --- | | Area | Requirement | | Education | Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechanical  Engineering, Thermal Engineering, HVAC Engineering, Power Systems, or related engineering discipline. | | Experience | 5–10 years of experience in electrical design, thermal/HVAC product engineering, compliance engineering, product safety, certification support, or code compliance. | | Product exposure | Experience with power systems, power distribution, switchgear/switchboards, UPS, PDUs, racks, electrical panels, HVAC systems, CRAC, AHU, fan wall, XDU, chiller, liquid cooling, or data center infrastructure products. | | Electrical capability | Ability to review schematics, wiring diagrams, power calculations, grounding/bonding, control panels, component selections, BOMs, and installation documents. | | Thermal capability | Understanding of thermal product operation, airflow, cooling performance, hydronic/hydraulic/pneumatic fundamentals, and data center cooling principles. | | Standards knowledge | Working knowledge of NEC, UL, CSA, IEC, CE, NFPA 70E, thermal/HVAC-related standards, and regional compliance requirements relevant to the product scope. | | Documentation | Ability to prepare compliance matrices, design review notes, certification evidence, risk assessments, test documentation, corrective-action records, and technical justifications. | | Collaboration | Ability to work with product engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical/thermal engineering, quality, manufacturing, sourcing, suppliers, certification agencies, and business unit teams. |

Desirable Qualifications

  • Prior experience in data center infrastructure, critical power, thermal management, cooling systems, industrial electrical equipment, or mission-critical products.
  • Experience with power products such as UPS, switchgear, switchboards, PDUs, battery/energy storage systems, power distribution systems, and integrated modular solutions.
  • Experience with thermal products such as CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, direct expansion systems, chilled water systems, liquid cooling, heat rejection, and heat reuse systems.
  • Familiarity with emerging high voltage data center and server rack standards.
  • Familiarity with product certifications and regional compliance requirements across North America, Europe, and global markets.
  • Refrigerant regulations, low-GWP refrigerant readiness, and LEED and BREAM sustainability documentation as applies to Data Centers where applicable.

Main Compliance Standards / Codes to Focus On

| | | | --- | --- | | Category | Standards / Codes | | Electrical installation & safety | NEC / NFPA 70, NFPA 70E, OSHA electrical safety requirements, lockout/tagout/tryout, arc flash, energized-work controls. | | Power product safety | UL508A, UL1995, UL891, UL1558, applicable CSA requirements, NEMA, ANSI, IEEE, IEC, and CE depending on product and market. | | Thermal / HVAC product compliance | Product-specific HVAC and thermal equipment standards relevant to CRAC, fan wall, AHU, XDU, chillers, airflow, filters, heat rejection, cooling performance, electrical cabinet heat, and component performance documentation. | | Quality / management systems | ISO 9001, ISO 45001, and ISO 14001 where applicable to manufacturing, safety, and environmental management systems. | | Data center / integrated systems | Local/regional electrical and construction codes, customer specifications, interoperable power/thermal system integration requirements, and standards playbook alignment. |

Technical Skills Required

  • Product safety standards interpretation |

job.title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech , Rack Lifecycle Team
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities. Your work is foundational to AWS’s ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably, safely, and at the lowest possible cost.

Key job responsibilities 🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling

  • Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
  • Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
  • Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
  • Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities

🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations

  • Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
  • Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
  • Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
  • Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation

🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support

  • Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
  • Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
  • Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines

🔷 Handover & Documentation

  • Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
  • Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
  • Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase

🔷 Rack Decommissioning

  • Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
  • Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
  • Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
  • Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
  • Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool

🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance

  • Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
  • Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
  • Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity

🔷 Cross-Team Coordination

  • Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
  • Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
  • Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately

🔷 Continuous Learning & Development

  • Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
  • Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
  • Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
  • Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
  • Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team

A day in the life As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

job.title: Assistant Manager, Executive, Engineering & Sustainability
job.description:
About Us

CapitaLand Group (CapitaLand) is one of Asia’s largest diversified real estate groups. Headquartered in Singapore, CapitaLand’s portfolio focuses on real estate investment management and real estate development, and spans across 270 cities in 45 countries.

Job Description

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage sustainability initiatives and engineering projects, including but not limited to solar photovoltaic (PV) installations, M&E enhancement works, smart building technologies, and environmental sustainability programs.
  • Coordinate with operations teams, business units, and stakeholders to ensure accurate collection, validation, and reporting of utility and sustainability data. Support GRESB submissions, sustainability disclosures, and periodic reporting of CapitaLand sustainability targets and performance indicators.
  • Identify, evaluate, and implement innovative technologies and sustainability solutions to improve energy efficiency, water conservation, waste management, and recycling performance across the portfolio.
  • Conduct feasibility studies, pilot trials, technical assessments, and performance evaluations of emerging technologies, and oversee project execution from planning through implementation.
  • Collaborate with corporate functions, operations teams, vendors, consultants, and external stakeholders to develop and drive sustainability, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Analyze operational performance and sustainability metrics, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and recommend strategies to enhance environmental performance and resource efficiency.
  • Prepare management reports, business cases, presentations, and recommendations for project approvals and stakeholder decision-making.
  • Undertake any other duties and projects as assigned by manager.

Requirements

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Environmental Engineering, Sustainability, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 to 4 years of relevant experience in sustainability, engineering, facilities management, green building initiatives, or the built environment sector.
  • Familiarity with green building certifications, sustainability reporting frameworks, energy management, and environmental regulations.
  • Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
  • Effective interpersonal, stakeholder engagement, and communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within cross-functional teams.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word. Experience with sustainability data analytics and reporting tools will be an advantage.
  • Knowledge of GRESB, BCA Green Mark, ESG reporting, energy management, or carbon reduction initiatives would be an added advantage.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

  • Proficient in troubleshooting and programming equipment related to PLC systems.

Understanding of fundamental principles of power systems or knowledge of smart grid concepts Project experience with time series forecasting, anomaly detection, or related applications Familiarity with energy sector application scenarios such as microgrids, virtual power plants, and demand-side response
