job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Machine Learning, TPU Workload Optimization
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission is to provide the best possible cloud-based ML pre-training, post-training, and inference solutions to our customers. This team is part of the AI Engine and focuses on the training/inference workloads and the infrastructure. Our team’s mission is to provide the infrastructure and framework support to enable serving of ML models on Cloud GPUs and TPUs. We support external customers for their ML training/inference onboarding and optimizations. We are a team working on an emergent product with the potential to change how customers use Google infrastructure for machine learning training/inference. It is a dynamic and exciting environment that is open to change and is full of growth opportunities. The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving team behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

**

Responsibilities

  • Act as ML software engineer leading the onboarding for stable stack, and optimization for training and serving solutions on the latest TPU NPIs. Work closely with customers to onboard their workloads to production and optimization.
  • Work on the technical details and architect the training/inference onboarding and optimization frameworks for our customer needs.
  • Collaborate with the ML research, ML performance, model optimization tooling, and other optimization teams.
  • Ship stable stack to our customers for training/inference optimization solutions on TPU.
  • Prepare and optimize very large reference models, demonstrating SOTA single-host and multi-host inference solutions, especially at large scale.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Network Implementation Engineer, AutoCAD Drafter
job.description:
About the job

As a Network Implementation Engineer, you will be the initial point of our efforts to execute deployment, maintenance, and operations of private data networks worldwide. You will work with Technical Program Managers, Network Engineers, Design and Infrastructure Engineers, Field Engineers within Google, as well as construction and telecommunications vendors and contractors, all to position your team and organization for success.

You will facilitate faster, better, and more efficient, positive outcomes for the business and our customers. Your objective will be to build the world’s most reliable, cost-effective and scalable network to support all of our current and future customers and users globally.

As a Network Implementation Engineering, you will be responsible for the evaluation, design, and construction of Google's space in colocation facilities across the globe. You will plan, design, and generate construction level Computer Aided Design (CAD) drawings for the spaces we utilize across the globe. You will have a wide scope of background across the data center industry, including operations, engineering (network, electrical, or mechanical), making the time more effective at the work we perform.

Google's network provides services to millions of Internet users around the world. Our metros are on the edge of our network where Google connects to its users. The Network Team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. Our team owns the full life cycle of all space, power, and network assets in all of Google’s data centers and metro points of presence globally. From the foundation, we are involved from site acquisition to construction and are accountable for what space and power is delivered. We're involved in every facet of network delivery from architecture and design to installation, configuration, activation, and commissioning.

Responsibilities

  • Draft Statement Of Work (SOW) design/engineering drawing sets.
  • Design spaces that meet needs along with maintaining flexibility for the future.
  • Create LISP routines to automate and improve drafting efficiencies.
  • Review proposals, costs, and submittals related to the build of the colocation spaces.
  • Understand entry level electrical engineering concepts related to deployments in data centers.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: Data Center Technician, Global Server Operations
job.description:
About the job

Google isn't just a software company. The Hardware Operations team is responsible for monitoring the state-of-the-art physical infrastructure behind Google's powerful search technology. As an Operations Technician, you'll install, configure, test, troubleshoot and maintain hardware (like servers and its components) and server software (like Google's Linux cluster). You'll also take on the configuration of more complex components such as networks, routers, hubs, bridges, switches and networking protocols. You'll participate in or lead small project teams on larger installations and develop project contingency plans. A typical day involves manual movement and installation of racks, and while it can sometimes be physically demanding, you are excited to work with infrastructure that is at the cutting-edge of computer technology.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Deploy and operate new data center infrastructure across projects or functions.
  • Report issues and follow data center procedures to troubleshoot and diagnose issues with equipment or infrastructure as they arise, and apply the resources needed to resolve identified issues.
  • Maintain the security and integrity of data, track various forms of media to check for standard data security issues (e.g., data was not properly erased) handled in accordance with Google security standards.
  • Disassemble specific equipment that has reached its end-of-life via part replacement or maintenance, in a team setting.
  • Repair, fix, and perform preventative maintenance on equipment, servers, machines, or infrastructure based on identified issues with defined solutions and limited guidance.

Information collected and processed as part of your Google Careers profile, and any job applications you choose to submit is subject to Google's [Applicant and Candidate Privacy Policy](./privacy-policy).

job.title: HVAC Service Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Building Technologies

At Johnson Controls, we're shaping the future of smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. As a global leader in HVAC, building automation, energy efficiency, and decarbonization solutions, we help customers operate some of the world's most critical facilities, including hospitals, data centres, universities, pharmaceutical sites, and advanced manufacturing environments.

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been delivering innovative solutions that improve building performance, enhance efficiency, and create better outcomes for our customers and communities. Today, our people continue to lead the way through cutting-edge technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence.

The Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Service HVAC Technician to join our Sunshine Coast team, based in Warana.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technician looking to work on a diverse range of commercial HVAC systems while enjoying the lifestyle benefits of the Sunshine Coast. You'll be supported by a highly experienced national technical network and have access to industry-leading training, development, and career opportunities.

Whether you're currently servicing commercial HVAC systems, working with chillers, refrigeration, or mechanical services, this role offers the chance to broaden your technical expertise and grow your career with a global organisation.

Why Technicians Choose Johnson Controls

  • Work-life balance with flexibility built into our culture
  • Variety of work across commercial, healthcare, education, industrial, and critical infrastructure sites
  • Access to advanced technology, systems, and equipment
  • Ongoing technical training and industry-recognised development programs
  • Opportunities to expand into Chillers, Building Management Systems (BMS), Controls, and specialised solutions
  • RDO or overtime options to suit your lifestyle and earning goals
  • Career pathways locally, nationally, and globally
  • Strong team culture backed by one of the world's leading building technology companies

What You'll Be Doing

  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair commercial HVAC equipment
  • Diagnose faults and provide practical, customer-focused solutions
  • Complete preventative and reactive maintenance activities
  • Install, commission, and test HVAC systems and components
  • Provide technical support and recommendations to customers
  • Maintain accurate service reports and compliance documentation
  • Collaborate with a skilled team of technicians and technical specialists
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with industry regulations

What You'll Bring

  • Certificate III in Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (or equivalent)
  • Queensland Restricted Electrical Licence (minimum requirement)
  • Experience servicing and maintaining commercial HVAC systems
  • Strong fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • A customer-focused approach and excellent communication skills
  • Current driver's licence
  • Commitment to workplace safety and quality workmanship

What's On Offer

  • Competitive salary package
  • Company vehicle and tools of trade
  • Ongoing training, certifications, and professional development
  • Exposure to leading-edge HVAC and smart building technologies
  • Supportive leadership and collaborative team environment
  • Long-term career security with a global industry leader

About Johnson Controls Australia

Johnson Controls operates one of Australia's largest HVAC and building services networks, supporting customers nationwide with innovative solutions that improve performance, sustainability, and reliability. Our technicians are at the forefront of delivering critical services that keep buildings operating efficiently and safely.

Ready for Your Next Career Move?

If you're looking for more variety, greater technical exposure, stronger career development, and the backing of a global leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and take the next step in your HVAC career with Johnson Controls on the Sunshine Coast.

Applicants must have full Australian working rights. Pre-employment checks, including medical, reference, police, and drug & alcohol screening, will be required as part of the recruitment process.

job.title: BMS Service Technician
job.description:
Build Your Career. Enjoy the Lifestyle.

Imagine advancing your career while living in one of Australia's most sought-after coastal destinations. With stunning beaches, year-round sunshine, a relaxed lifestyle, and a growing economy, the Sunshine Coast offers the perfect balance between professional growth and quality of life.

At Johnson Controls (JCI), you'll join a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, working on industry-leading building automation technologies while enjoying the lifestyle that makes the Sunshine Coast such a desirable place to call home.

About Johnson Controls

For over 140 years, Johnson Controls has been helping customers create smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable buildings. As a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, we help organizations optimize performance, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with greater resilience across industries such as healthcare, data centers, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education.

Our people are at the heart of everything we do, and we're committed to creating opportunities where careers thrive.

About the Opportunity

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Building Automation Service Technician to join our established and high-performing Sunshine Coast Service Team.

In this role, you'll service, maintain, and optimize complex building automation systems across a diverse portfolio of commercial customer sites, helping to deliver smarter and more energy-efficient buildings.

What's in it for You?

  • Competitive salary package plus fully maintained company vehicle
  • Choice of RDOs or overtime opportunities
  • Genuine commitment to work-life balance and flexibility
  • Access to internal remote technical support from industry experts
  • Structured technical training and ongoing professional development
  • The opportunity to work with industry-leading building automation technologies
  • Career development pathways within a global organization, including leadership and management opportunities
  • Enjoy living and working on the beautiful Sunshine Coast

Key Responsibilities

  • Install, commission, and program building automation and control systems
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve technical faults efficiently
  • Service and maintain installed systems across existing customer sites
  • Conduct preventative maintenance and system optimization activities
  • Build strong customer relationships through exceptional service delivery
  • Ensure compliance with safety standards and company procedures

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Electrical Licence or Restricted Electrical Licence
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in building controls following apprenticeship completion
  • Experience with Building Performance and Energy Efficiency solutions
  • Strong understanding of commercial HVAC operations
  • Knowledge of chiller, boiler, and airside plant performance and design requirements
  • Experience with IT systems, network communications, and PC hardware configuration
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills
  • Strong commitment to safety, including proactive hazard identification and risk resolution

Grow with JCI

As a global organization, we actively support internal career progression. Whether you're looking to deepen your technical expertise, move into project delivery, explore other business areas, or develop into a leadership role, we'll help you achieve your career goals.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking for a rewarding technical career with a global leader and want to enjoy everything the Sunshine Coast lifestyle has to offer, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now to join Johnson Controls and help create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings.

You have the power. You have the voice. You have the opportunity to help shape our culture and our future.

job.title: IT Business Analyst - Intern
job.description:
Job DescriptionJob Overview

We are looking for a proactive and intellectually curious Business Analyst Intern to support our AI-related initiatives and internal projects. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, quick learning ability, and a solid IT background, who is eager to work at the intersection of business and emerging technologies such as AI.

---

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Project Manager (L&D Shared Services)
job.description:
** L&D Shared Services – Project Manager

Job Description

**

What you will do 

Manage end-to-end L&D content delivery projects by owning planning, governance, coordination, execution, tracking, and closure across the project lifecycle. The Project Manager will work closely with internal project coordinators, project leads, instructional designers, QA analysts, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure learning deliverables are delivered on time, within scope, within cost, and with the expected quality. The role requires strong operational discipline, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, intake governance, effort and timeline estimation, reporting, quality governance, analytics-driven planning, conflict resolution, and continuous improvement to support the current L&D Shared Services operating model.

In addition to the above, the Project Manager will be expected to:

Own project governance by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, stakeholder expectations, and delivery commitments across active projects.

Enable smooth coordination between internal teams, external stakeholders, vendors, IDs, QA analysts, and coordinators to ensure clear handoffs and accountability.

Drive operational excellence through intake tracking, POD updates, vendor workflow governance, reporting hygiene, process documentation, and continuous improvement.

How you will do it 

  • Lead project planning, execution, monitoring, and closure for L&D content development and learning delivery projects.
  • Participate in requirement gathering, clarify scope, define delivery approach, and create phase-wise project and communication plans.
  • Support effort, cost, timeline, and resource estimation to enable realistic delivery commitments and project prioritization.
  • Determine and govern the execution strategy across in-house teams and vendors based on scope, capacity, skills, timelines, and delivery complexity.
  • Partner with project coordinators for internal coordination, trackers, meeting logistics, documentation, and follow-ups.
  • Partner with project leads for external stakeholder coordination, requirement alignment, escalations, and delivery commitments.
  • Manage vendor engagement under the hourly model, including initiation, onboarding inputs, effort tracking, communication, and delivery governance.
  • Coordinate with instructional designers, QA analysts, and vendors to ensure content quality, review cycles, rework tracking, and timely sign-offs.
  • Define and track quality expectations, quality metrics, review outcomes, and QA reporting inputs in partnership with QA stakeholders.
  • Maintain project plans, RACI details, trackers, status reports, action logs, risk logs, and project documentation for transparency and continuity.
  • Provide timely updates through stakeholder meetings, project reviews, dashboards, business reports, success stories, and stakeholder escalation management.
  • Use available analytics, project data, and delivery trends to inform project planning, scope discussions, risks, capacity decisions, and improvement actions.
  • Identify risks, blockers, capacity concerns, scope changes, and dependency issues early; escalate with recommended actions where needed.
  • Resolve conflicts, remove execution barriers, and drive alignment across internal teams, vendors, and stakeholders to support successful delivery.
  • Drive intake discipline by supporting requirement clarity, prioritization inputs, delivery readiness, and alignment with shared services processes.
  • Evaluate completed projects, capture lessons learned, track feedback, and recommend process improvements to improve speed, quality, cost discipline, and stakeholder experience.
  • Stay informed on L&D trends, authoring standards, and operational best practices to support scalable and relevant learning solutions.

**

Qualification & Experience

  • Graduate or postgraduate degree in business, learning, project management, operations, or a related field.
  • 8–12+ years of experience in project management, learning operations, content development, shared services, or vendor-managed delivery environments.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects across global stakeholders, vendors, instructional design, QA, and operations teams.

Skills

  • Strong project governance, planning, tracking, risk management, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to manage cross-functional work across PM, coordinator, ID, QA, vendor, and business stakeholder groups.
  • Strong estimation and planning skills, including effort, timeline, cost, resource, and phase-wise delivery planning.
  • Project financial and cost governance mindset with the ability to manage multiple projects within agreed timelines, cost expectations, and quality standards.
  • Strong documentation discipline, including project plans, status reports, trackers, action logs, SOPs, and handover notes.
  • Experience with dashboards, reporting governance, analytics, and tools such as Power BI, MS Project, Planner, SharePoint, Excel, and Jira or equivalent tools.
  • Working knowledge of learning content development processes, authoring tools, SCORM/xAPI standards, review cycles, quality metrics, and QA workflows.
  • Vendor management experience, including execution strategy, workflow coordination, effort tracking, communication, issue resolution, and delivery quality checks.
  • Ability to influence without authority, manage ambiguity, resolve conflicts, drive accountability, and work effectively across time zones.
  • Strong customer orientation with a focus on quality, responsiveness, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Preferred

  • Understanding of instructional design, adult learning principles, learning technologies, and multimedia/content production workflows.
  • Experience working in shared services, GCC, L&D operations, or vendor-partnered delivery models.
  • Familiarity with HVAC, Building Automation, Fire & Security, or similar industrial/technical learning environments.

job.description:
Senior Instructional Designer

The Senior Instructional Designer will play a key execution-focused role in supporting the Senior Manager, Instructional Design, by driving team priorities, operational initiatives, and delivering business-critical learning projects.

This is an Individual Contributor (IC) role. The role is expected to demonstrate operational leadership by driving priorities, influencing outcomes, and enabling effective execution across peers and project teams.

This role combines instructional design expertise with strong consulting, stakeholder management, and operational leadership capabilities. The successful candidate will be highly accountable, self-directed, and comfortable operating with minimal supervision while driving projects, solving problems, and influencing outcomes across the Instructional Design team.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal direction and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when supporting strategic initiatives
  • Strong project and process management skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
  • Continuous improvement and operational excellence mindset.
  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate:

  • Acts as a learning consultant to stakeholders
  • Demonstrates exceptional ownership, accountability, and execution discipline.

  • Balances strategy and execution effectively.
  • Influences outcomes through expertise, credibility, and collaboration rather than formal authority
  • Acts as a trusted partner to the Senior Manager Instruction Design and the broader team.

job.title: IT Analyst
job.description:
Job Code:

Job Code Name: IT Analyst

Region:APAC

Country: India

Grade : 170

As a IT Analyst in IAM/Cybersecurity, you will work alongside experienced professionals to support the design, implementation, and operation of enterprise identity and access management and Active Directory solutions. This internship is designed to provide hands-on exposure to IAM technologies, Windows directory services, cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and real-world business challenges.

What we look for

  • Support Microsoft Active Directory administration, including user and group management, Organizational Unit (OU) administration, security groups, delegated permissions, and directory services operations.
  • Assist with Domain Controller lifecycle activities, including health monitoring, upgrades, decommissioning, replication validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Participate in Domain Controller promotion and demotion activities, following approved change, security, testing, and validation procedures.
  • Support Active Directory Sites and Services administration, including site and subnet configuration, replication topology review, and site migration activities.
  • Assist with Domain Administrator (DA) role administration, privileged account governance, access reviews, and adherence to least-privilege requirements.
  • Support the implementation and administration of security controls such as Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), privileged access management, and policy enforcement.
  • Assist in creating, testing, deploying, and troubleshooting Group Policy Objects (GPOs) aligned with enterprise security baselines and operational requirements.
  • Support Windows server and identity infrastructure patching activities, including pre-checks, deployment coordination, post-patch validation, and documentation.
  • Participate in vulnerability management activities, including reviewing findings, supporting remediation, validating closure, and maintaining evidence for reporting and compliance.
  • Support Disaster Recovery (DR) exercises for Active Directory and IAM services, including preparation, execution, service restoration validation, issue documentation, and follow-up actions.
  • Participate in monitoring system logs, analyzing security events, and responding to incidents under supervision.
  • Collaborate with IT, infrastructure, and security teams to troubleshoot authentication, authorization, replication, DNS, and access-related issues.
  • Help document IAM and Active Directory processes, prepare operational reports, and maintain audit and compliance records.
  • Contribute to PowerShell or Python automation for identity lifecycle management, Active Directory administration, health checks, and reporting.
  • Stay current on cybersecurity trends, threats, identity security practices, Windows infrastructure, and enterprise resilience concepts; participate in team knowledge-sharing sessions.

Eligibility Criteria

  • Currently pursuing a master’s degree (M.Tech/M.Sc) in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell & networking concepts.
  • Understanding of Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, authentication, and authorization concepts.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Preferred Skills

  • Knowledge of Active Directory Domain Services, Domain Controllers, FSMO roles, DNS integration, replication, and health monitoring.
  • Exposure to Domain Controller promotion, demotion, site migration, or recovery activities.
  • Familiarity with Group Policy Management Console (GPMC), GPO configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Understanding of Domain Administrator role governance, privileged access management, and least-privilege principles.
  • Awareness of Windows patching, vulnerability management, remediation tracking, and validation processes.
  • Exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management.
  • Understanding of Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity concepts and experience supporting a DR exercise.
  • Exposure to PowerShell scripting, automation, or data analysis tools.
  • Certifications (if any): Microsoft, Okta, or other relevant security credentials (optional).

We are seeking a proactive and experienced EHS / Safety Officer to support and oversee Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) compliance for IBMS (Integrated Building Management System) projects across Bangalore. The candidate will be responsible for implementing safety programs, conducting site inspections, ensuring statutory compliance, and promoting a strong safety culture across project sites.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure implementation of EHS policies, procedures, and safety standards at project sites.
  • Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and risk assessments for IBMS project activities.
  • Monitor site activities and ensure compliance with statutory, client, and company safety requirements.
  • Develop and implement Job Safety Analysis (JSA), Method Statements, and Risk Assessment documents.
  • Conduct safety induction programs, toolbox talks, and awareness training for employees and contractors.
  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe conditions and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure proper use of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) by all personnel at site.

  • Maintain EHS records, reports, permits, and compliance documentation.

  • Ensure compliance with local safety regulations and industry standards.

Experience Required

job.title: SIOP Transformation Sr. Manager- Data Center Focus
job.description:
SIOP Transformation Job Description (Data Center Focus)

Job Title

SIOP Transformation Sr. Manager

Job Summary

The SIOP Transformation Manager leads the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP) process across the organization, with a strong focus on data center solutions and infrastructure programs.

This role partners cross-functionally with Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, and Finance teams to enable scalable, responsive planning aligned with rapid growth and complexity in the data center business environment.

Additionally, the role is responsible for coordinating lab testing schedules and validation readiness, ensuring alignment between product development, qualification cycles, and supply readiness for data center deployments.

Key Responsibilities

SIOP Transformation (Data Center Focus)

  • Lead SIOP transformation initiatives tailored to data center products and solutions, including cooling systems, infrastructure equipment, and integrated offerings.
  • Drive planning excellence to support high-growth, fast-cycle, and project-driven data center demand patterns.
  • Integrate project-based demand (e.g., hyperscale and colocation customers) into SIOP processes.
  • Enhance visibility and alignment across long lead-time components, capacity constraints, and critical supply risks typical in data center environments.
  • Deploy standardized SIOP governance, KPIs, and reporting to improve responsiveness, service levels, and inventory performance.
  • Enable scenario planning and risk mitigation for volatile demand, supply constraints, and deployment timelines.
  • Partner with regional and global teams to ensure alignment across multi-site manufacturing and data center programs.

Lab Schedule Coordination

  • Coordinate lab testing, validation, and certification schedules aligned with data center product requirements and timelines.
  • Ensure readiness for performance testing, reliability validation, and compliance standards critical for data center applications.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Quality, and Operations to prioritize testing based on customer commitments and launch schedules.
  • Monitor lab capacity, testing bottlenecks, and critical dependencies that may impact data center project delivery.
  • Integrate lab schedules into SIOP to improve visibility of constraints impacting production readiness and customer deployments.
  • Proactively escalate risks related to testing delays that could affect data center project timelines or customer SLAs.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Act as a key connector across planning, engineering, lab operations, manufacturing, and commercial teams.
  • Drive alignment on priorities, especially for strategic data center customers and programs.
  • Lead executive SIOP reviews with clear data-driven insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Facilitate cross-functional workshops to strengthen end-to-end planning capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business, or related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in SIOP/S&OP, supply chain, operations, or transformation roles.

Critical Skills

  • Strong executive communication and storytelling capability for SIOP forums.
  • Ability to simplify complex data center planning challenges into clear, actionable insights.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across regions and functions.
  • Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills.

Success Measures

  • Enhanced alignment between customer demand, lab validation, and supply readiness.
  • Reduced risks and delays impacting data center deployments.
  • Improved service levels, forecast accuracy, and inventory performance.
  • Effective executive communication and decision-making support.

job.title: Digital Factory Leader CSAME
job.description:
Role: Digital Factory Leader CSAME

Location: Bangalore

Full/ Part-time: Full Time

About Carrier

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, life-saving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit [corporate.carrier.com](https://www.carrier.com/) or follow Carrier on social media at @Carrier.

About the role

We are seeking a strategic and operational leader to oversee Digital Technology across our factories in Asia and the Middle East. This role will lead a regional network of Factory IT Site Leaders and drive standardization, operational excellence, and digital transformation across all plants in scope.

This leader will build a high-performing regional organization of Factory Digital Leaders, ensuring technology becomes a strategic enabler for manufacturing excellence, operational resilience, and business growth. The role partners closely with Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Global Digital COEs, and Business Leadership to define and execute a multi-year digital transformation roadmap aligned with enterprise objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Regional Leadership & Governance

  • Develop and execute the regional Digital Technology strategy aligned with the enterprise manufacturing vision and business priorities.
  • Serve as the trusted technology advisor to regional manufacturing and supply chain leadership.
  • Drive long-term digital transformation initiatives that enable Smart Factory capabilities across the region.
  • Lead technology governance and investment planning to maximize business value.
  • Enforce the EDPS operating model, governance cadence, and performance management framework across all sites.
  • Ensure alignment with global Digital / IT strategy, standards, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Act as the primary escalation and decision point for critical IT incidents impacting factory operations.

2. Standardization & Process Excellence

  • Drive standardized processes across factories spanning production, quality, planning, logistics, and maintenance.
  • Eliminate site-by-site variation by enforcing common templates, architectures, and best practices.
  • Lead cross-site benchmarking to identify optimization opportunities and replicate best practices.
  • Promote Carrier Excellence CX principles in IT processes to improve reliability and efficiency.

3. Digital Transformation & Technology Adoption

  • Partner with global manufacturing and supply chain digital teams to deploy enterprise platforms including MES, ERP, analytics, and related capabilities.
  • Ensure consistent adoption of digital solutions across all sites with measurable business outcomes such as OEE, downtime, cost, and quality.
  • Oversee regional digital roadmap execution and ensure alignment with site priorities and global strategy.
  • Drive training, adoption, and change management across factories.

4. End-to-End Factory Visibility & Insights

  • Establish an end-to-end view of factory operations across the region.
  • Enable standardized data models and reporting frameworks for performance visibility.
  • Ensure integration across systems supporting manufacturing and supply chain operations.
  • Promote data-driven decision-making and real-time operational insights.

5. Operational Reliability & IT/OT Excellence

  • Ensure high availability and performance of factory systems, infrastructure, and shopfloor technologies.
  • Drive disciplined incident management, root cause analysis, and preventive actions for critical events.
  • Oversee vendor performance, SLAs, anCSAME Digital d managed services supporting factory operations.
  • Ensure lifecycle management of applications and infrastructure aligned with global strategy.

6. Strategic Roadmap & Investment Planning

  • Lead development of a multi-year digital factory roadmap for the region.
  • Align investments with business priorities, operational constraints, and global platforms.
  • Build and prioritize business cases for digital initiatives, including ROI, cost, and resource requirements.
  • Partner with senior leadership to define the long-term vision for digital manufacturing.

7. Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Manufacturing Operations Leaders, Supply Chain Leadership, Global Digital COEs, Engineering, and Quality teams.
  • Act as the bridge between business operations and digital / IT teams.
  • Ensure technology solutions directly enable production, throughput, quality, and cost objectives.

Leadership Expectations

  • Build strong relationships with factory and BU leaders across cultures and geographies.
  • Develop IT Site Leaders into business-oriented, operations-first leaders.
  • Establish a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.
  • Be highly present in factories, driving credibility through operational engagement.

Requirements

  • 15+ years of experience in IT, digital, or technology leadership within manufacturing or supply chain environments.
  • Proven experience leading multi-site or regional operations.
  • Strong understanding of manufacturing operations including production, quality, logistics, and planning.
  • Experience implementing enterprise platforms such as MES, ERP, analytics, and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive standardization and transformation at scale.

Preferred

  • Experience in IT/OT convergence in industrial environments.
  • Lean / Six Sigma background applied to IT or operations.
  • Experience managing large, distributed global teams.
  • Strong financial acumen and business case development experience.

Benefits

We offer a competitive total rewards package that may include other benefits and well‑being programs. Offerings vary by role and location and are designed to support employees’ health, security, and success.

  • Enjoy your best years with our retirement savings plan
  • Have peace of mind and body with our health insurance
  • Make yourself a priority with flexible schedules, parental leave and our holiday purchase scheme
  • Drive forward your career through professional development opportunities
  • Achieve your personal goals with our Employee Assistance Programme

job.title: Team Leader I, Production
job.description:
Req ID:82505

Location: Suzhou, Jiangsu, China

In our ‘always on’ world, we believe it’s essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.

_This role is based at our site in Suzhou, China and it is responsible for leading production line operations, ensuring process compliance, product quality, and on-time delivery. The position plays a key role in managing shopfloor activities, driving team performance, and supporting continuous improvement initiatives._

How You'll Help Us Connect the World:

  • Lead daily production line operations to ensure output, quality, and delivery targets are met.
  • Manage production process discipline and ensure all activities follow standard operating procedures.
  • Allocate manpower, arrange shifts, assign daily tasks, and monitor production progress.
  • Identify, handle, and escalate production abnormalities in a timely manner.
  • Drive 6S implementation and ensure compliance with safety regulations on site.
  • Perform routine equipment inspection and ensure proper usage and maintenance.
  • Provide training and coaching to team members, especially new hires, to improve skill levels.
  • Maintain good employee relations and foster a positive team environment.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives such as productivity improvement, cost reduction, and quality enhancement.

Required Qualifications for Consideration:

  • College degree or above.
  • Prior experience as a production line leader or team leader in manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Able to work in shifts and adapt to fast-paced production environment.
  • Strong sense of responsibility and execution capability.
  • Basic computer skills, able to complete production reports and documentation.
  • Able to read and understand work instructions or basic technical drawings.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Familiar with safety and production management requirements.

You Will Excite Us If You Have:

  • Experience in electronics manufacturing or assembly environment.
  • Familiarity with lean manufacturing concepts (e.g., 5S, Kaizen, continuous improvement).
  • Basic English reading ability is preferred.

Why CommScope:

CommScope is on a quest to deliver connectivity that empowers how we live, work, and learn.Our employees push the boundaries of communications technology that enables game-changing discoveries like 5G, the Internet of Things, and gigabit speeds for everyone, everywhere.With our unmatched expertise in copper, fiber, and wireless infrastructure, our global clients rely on us to outperform today and be ready for the needs of tomorrow.

If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next…..come connect to your future at CommScope.

CommScope is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans. If you are seeking an accommodation for the application or interview process, please contact us to submit your request at talentacquisition@commscope.com. job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Summary

The Quality Manager is responsible for leading the quality organization at CCMC OSF facility, managing a team of approximately 98 employees across incoming material inspection, manufacturing quality control, product quality assurance, as-delivery inspection, and customer quality support activities. The role supports both internal operations and approximately 20 global customers, driving quality performance, continuous improvement, customer satisfaction, and compliance with Caterpillar quality standards and manufacturing processes.

Main Job Duties

  • Oversee incoming material inspection, manufacturing quality control, final inspection, and customer quality support activities.
  • Drive root cause analysis and corrective actions to resolve recurring quality issues in a complex manufacturing environment.
  • Partner with manufacturing, supply chain, engineering, and supplier teams to improve product quality and operational performance.
  • Manage quality performance metrics and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ensure compliance with quality management systems, company procedures, and industry standards.
  • Facilitate cross-functional communication and collaboration to achieve quality objectives.
  • Lead customer audits, internal audits, and quality improvement programs.
  • Promote a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Required Skills/Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Solid knowledge of manufacturing processes, particularly welding, painting, and assembly operations.
  • Strong leadership experience managing large quality teams within a manufacturing environment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven problem-solving capability and logical thinking to address recurring quality challenges.
  • Strong understanding of quality management principles, quality systems, and quality tools.
  • Good command of written and spoken English.
  • Experience in customer quality management and supplier quality management.
  • Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional and global business environment.

Preferred Skills/Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Certification in Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing, CQE, or equivalent quality disciplines.
  • Experience in heavy equipment, industrial manufacturing, or automotive industries.
  • Experience leading quality transformation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Knowledge of APQP, PPAP, FMEA, SPC, MSA, and other advanced quality methodologies.

Posting Dates:

八月 26, 2026 - 九月 9, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Definition Senior Data Scientist to design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML solutions that drive business impact. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in statistics, machine learning, large language models (LLMs), model evaluation, and Python-based solution development. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and business stakeholders to develop scalable analytics and Generative AI solutions that improve decision-making, automation, and customer experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Apply advanced statistical techniques to analyze large-scale structured and unstructured datasets, identify insights, and quantify business impact.
  • Develop end-to-end ML and GenAI pipelines, including data preparation, model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Build scalable Python-based solutions and reusable ML components that integrate with enterprise platforms and cloud environments.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business problems into analytical solutions and communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging AI, machine learning, and LLM advancements, driving innovation and adoption of best practices.

Skill Descriptors Business Statistics: Knowledge of the statistical tools, processes, and practices to describe business results in measurable scales; ability to use statistical tools and processes to assist in making business decisions. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Explains the basic decision process associated with specific statistics.
  • Works with basic statistical functions on a spreadsheet or a calculator.
  • Explains reasons for common statistical errors, misinterpretations, and misrepresentations.
  • Describes characteristics of sample size, normal distributions, and standard deviation.
  • Generates and interprets basic statistical data.

Accuracy and Attention to Detail: Understanding the necessity and value of accuracy; ability to complete tasks with high levels of precision. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Evaluates and makes contributions to best practices.
  • Processes large quantities of detailed information with high levels of accuracy.
  • Productively balances speed and accuracy.
  • Employs techniques for motivating personnel to meet or exceed accuracy goals.
  • Implements a variety of cross-checking approaches and mechanisms.
  • Demonstrates expertise in quality assurance tools, techniques, and standards.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Approaches a situation or problem by defining the problem or issue and determining its significance.
  • Makes a systematic comparison of two or more alternative solutions.
  • Uses flow charts, Pareto charts, fish diagrams, etc. to disclose meaningful data patterns.
  • Identifies the major forces, events and people impacting and impacted by the situation at hand.
  • Uses logic and intuition to make inferences about the meaning of the data and arrive at conclusions.

Machine Learning: Knowledge of principles, technologies and algorithms of machine learning; ability to develop, implement and deliver related systems, products and services. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Completes specific tasks and initiatives utilizing machine learning technologies, such as search engine optimization.
  • Utilizes specific tools and techniques to process descriptive and inferential statistics.
  • Applies specific computing languages and tools in machine learning, such as R and Python.
  • Explores to use machine learning in one own areas to make business improvements.
  • Conducts data mining and cleaning initiatives.

Programming Languages: Knowledge of basic concepts and capabilities of programming; ability to use tools, techniques and platforms in order to write and modify programming languages. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Participates in the implementation and support of specialized programming languages.
  • Conducts basic reviews on writing a specific programming language within a specific platform.
  • Assists with the design and development of specialized programming languages.
  • Follows an organization's standards, policies and guidelines for structured programming specifications.
  • Diagnoses and reports minor or routine programming language problems.

Query and Database Access Tools: Knowledge of data management systems; ability to use, support and access facilities for searching, extracting and formatting data for further use. Level Extensive Experience:

  • Writes, debugs and implements complex queries involving multiple tables or databases.
  • Works with aggregate functions, complex joins, groupings, dynamic and embedded SQL's (Structured Query Languages).
  • Teaches others about query optimization techniques and facilities.
  • Consults on query optimization, interactive queries, testing and verification.
  • Evaluates all major database access tools and functions for distributed databases.
  • Compares and contrasts the benefits and drawbacks of various SQL products.

Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project. Level Working Knowledge:

  • Follows policies, practices and standards for determining functional and informational requirements.
  • Confirms deliverables associated with requirements analysis.
  • Communicates with customers and users to elicit and gather client requirements.
  • Participates in the preparation of detailed documentation and requirements.
  • Utilizes specific organizational methods, tools and techniques for requirements analysis.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

Posting Dates:

August 27, 2026 - September 3, 2026

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Senior Autonomy Solution Architect (Mining & Quarry), Shanghai
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Role Summary

基于Caterpillar Autonomous Wide Body Truck (WBT) 自动驾驶平台，负责海外采石场（Quarry）客户无人驾驶解决方案的定义、规划、交付和持续优化。该岗位是客户需求与产品开发之间的桥梁，需要深入理解客户生产运营模式，与 Commercial、Dealer 和 Customer 团队紧密合作，定义客户运营场景和 Operational Design Domain (ODD)，与技术团队制定整体无人驾驶解决方案，并领导跨职能团队完成详细方案设计、验证和交付，最终实现客户价值和商业目标。

Key Responsibilities

1. Customer Engagement & Opportunity Development

客户需求分析与商机支持

  • 与 Commercial、Dealer 和 Product 团队合作，支持全球 Quarry Autonomy 商机拓展。
  • 深入了解客户业务目标、生产指标、运营模式及痛点。
  • 参与客户现场调研（Site Survey）和业务流程分析。
  • 支持客户技术交流、方案评审及高层汇报。
  • 将客户需求转化为可执行的技术方案和产品需求。

2. Define Quarry Site ODD (Operational Design Domain)

定义客户运行场景（ODD）， 负责建立并维护客户无人驾驶运行边界，包括：

采场布局（Pit / Quarry Layout）; 道路设计与运行条件; 装载和卸载流程; 车辆交通交互场景; 辅助设备协同作业; 环境与气候条件; 网络通信覆盖要求; 安全要求与风险边界; 基础设施要求

3. Site Solution Architecture Ownership

整体解决方案架构定义

  • 定义Quarry 应用整体解决方案架构。
  • 评估产品能力与客户需求匹配度。
  • 制定场地自动驾驶部署策略。
  • 明确各子系统责任边界与集成要求。

涉及系统包括：

  • Autonomous truck(WBT or OHT)
  • Back Office team: Dispatch; map ;
  • Site Connectivity and V2X communication
  • RTK / GNSS Infrastructure
  • NLOS Remote Operation Solution
  • Site Collaboration System

4. Lead Cross-functional Solution Development from technical solution side

  • 领导跨团队技术评审
  • 协调产品、软件、系统、部署等团队资源。
  • 与commercial以及NPI team，深入理解Quarry 客户需求， 领导团队分解为详细执行方案。
  • 推动关键技术决策和问题解决。
  • 负责总体方案一致性和交付质量。

Degree Required

本科及以上学历：

  • Bachelor or above, major in Mining Engineering； Mechanical Engineering； Electrical and Electronics Engineering； Automation； Robotics； Computer Science etc

Experience

  • 6年以上相关行业经验。
  • 具有以下一个或多个领域经验：

Quarry Operations； Mining Operations； Autonomous Systems； System Engineering

  • 具有客户现场支持或项目交付经验优先。

Technical Competencies

熟悉以下领域中的多个方向：

Mining & Quarry Operations

Quarry生产工艺： Hauling流程； Loading & Dumping流程； Fleet Productivity分析

Autonomous Systems

Autonomous Haulage System (AHS)； Truck Automation； Dispatch Optimization

Site Infrastructure

  • RTK/GNSS； Wireless Communications； Private LTE / 5G； V2X Communication； Edge Computing

System Engineering

  • Requirements Management
  • System Architecture
  • Operational Design Domain (ODD)
  • Risk Assessment
  • Functional Safety Concepts

Communication

  • 优秀的客户沟通能力。
  • 能够在无直接汇报关系情况下推动跨团队协作。
  • 具备优秀的英文口头和书面表达能力。
  • 能够适应国际出差。

September 2, 2026 - October 30, 2026

job.title: Production Supervisor (Machining)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Why you want the job and why it is awesome!

Are you passionate about precision machining and leadership? PT. Caterpillar Indonesia Batam is seeking a dedicated Production Supervisor to lead a talented team of machining workers. In this pivotal role, you will ensure that machining processes CNC milling, Shot Blasting, Heat Treatment, Deburring process and multitask operations, run smoothly and comply with company policies, procedures, norms, and directions.

Additional Info:

Shift: Rotating

Work Location: PT. Caterpillar Indonesia Batam, Kepulauan Riau

Travel Requirement: None

You will work in manufacturing shop-floor environment.

Domestic relocation is available for this position.

What You Will Do

  • Creating reports and records of production processes, tools issues performance, and inventory; sharing them with managers and providing suggestions to improve safety, productivity and quality.
  • Preparing, maintaining, and updating documentation related to operating procedures and safety and quality standards; ensuring all processes and products meet desired safety and quality standards.
  • Supervising and directing the daily activities of production lines workers, assigning tasks, ensuring coordination between different teams, ensuring their safety and monitoring their performance.
  • Training new hires, managing scheduling and work conflicts, monitoring safety, and promoting internal communication to create a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

What Skills You Have:

  • Quality Management: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques and ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.
  • Planning and Organizing: Knowledge of the process of planning and arranging tasks and resources; ability to plan and organize both time and resources to get things completed while structuring and maintaining work in a systematic and highly methodical way.
  • Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintains focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.
  • Talent Management: Knowledge of human resources and talent management processes; ability to lead, motivate, evaluate, and reward employees at the workplace.
  • Machine Shop Operations: Knowledge of manufacturing operations; ability to perform day-to-day operations of a manufacturing plant or facility for products.
  • Manufacturing Safety: Knowledge of manufacturing safety; ability to identify work-related hazards and perform necessary activities to meet regulatory requirements for the safety and protection of workers, environment and site.

What Will Set You Apart:

  • A minimum diploma in engineering with at least 3 years of experience in a leadership or supervisory role in machining, including CNC turning operations, milling operations, and multitask operations.
  • Proficiency in speaking and writing in English, as well as operating Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

Physical Requirements (with or without reasonable accommodation):

  • This job requires extensive active movement throughout the plant including climbing stairs and steps, lifting devices, and pushing and pulling equipment.

Employee Benefit Details

At PT. Caterpillar Indonesia Batam, we aim for you to have a fulfilling career. Our teams are vital to our customers' success in building a better world. Beyond a salaried wage, we value your performance by offering a comprehensive rewards package with benefits like medical, dental, vision coverage, pension, accident and life insurance, plus the potential for an annual bonus.

Final Details

Please frequently check the email associated with your application, including the junk/spam folder, as this is the primary correspondence method. If you wish to know the status of your application – please use the candidate log-in on our career website as it will reflect any updates to your status.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

job.title: Lead Digital Architect, Bangalore
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

JOB DUTIES

Seeking a highly skilled and visionary Data Architect to work with highly skilled engineers to build a robust next gen data platform. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical and functional expertise in Big Data, Data Warehousing, and end-to-end real-time data movement. You will architect and build Caterpillar’s state-of-the-art digital platform, while driving innovation in AI and advanced analytics.

  • Competent to perform all programming and provide oversight for architecture assessment and design for development assignments without close supervision; normally assigned the more complex aspects of systems work.
  • Lead Architecture design of end-to-end enterprise integrations that serves multiple business functions.
  • Design and implement end-to-end near real-time data movement solutions that provide core capabilities for the enterprise.
  • Define the overall data architecture strategy aligned with business goals.
  • Establish data governance policies, standards, and compliance Drives application development focused around delivering business valuable features
  • Maintains high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices and security guardrails per Enterprise standards.
  • Knowledge of target architecture; ability to develop the IT blueprint and roadmap while aligning the architecture and processes with business strategies and objectives
  • Develop and maintain current, planned, and future state architecture blueprints. Lead in the identification and analysis of enterprise business drivers and requirements that drive the future state architecture.
  • Work with business analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders. Translate business requirements into technical data solutions
  • Communicate with end users and stake holders to help direct development, debugging, and testing of application software for accuracy, integrity, interoperability, and completeness.
  • Performs integrated testing and customer acceptance testing of components that requires careful planning and execution to ensure timely, quality results.

Typical customers include Caterpillar customers, dealers, other external companies who purchase services offered by Caterpillar as well as internal business unit and/or service centre groups. The position is challenged to quickly and correctly identify problems that may not be obvious. The incumbent solves problems by determining the best architecture, within departmental guidelines, from many existing solutions.

Basic qualifications:

  • Four-year bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in a Computer Science or Information Technology, or related field
  • 12+ years or more of software development experience or at least 3 years of architecture experience with strong demonstrable experience.
  • 5+ years or more of experience in designing conceptual, logical, and physical data models & data models support scalability, performance, and integration needs.
  • 5+ years of Data Warehousing experience & optimizing database performance, indexing, and storage strategies
  • Expert in implementing security measures for data at rest and in transit and defining access control, encryption, and compliance frameworks
  • Strong in designing data integration solutions across systems ensuring smooth data flow between applications, APIs, and data warehouses
  • Top candidates will also have proven experience in many of the following,
  • Designing, developing, deploying and maintaining software at scale, with good understanding of concurrency.
  • Working experience in Python as an Object-Oriented programming language
  • In-Depth understanding of how Data pipelines work in Big Data & expert in designing architectures for cloud-based data platforms (AWS, Azure) for large-scale processing.
  • Expertise and experience in building Large Data Lakes and Data Warehouse (Snowflake Preferred).
  • Expertise in building end-to-end near real-time data pipelines for OLTP & OLAP.
  • Strong architecture exposure for building robust Data Platforms
  • Expertise in SQL and NO-SQL databases, Message brokers and other AWS services such as Kafka/Kinesis, AWS SQS, AWS SNS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, Aurora, AWS RDS PostgreSQL.
  • Test driven development and behaviour driven development.
  • Ability to work under pressure and within time constraints.
  • Passion for technology and an eagerness to contribute to a team-oriented environment.
  • Demonstrated leadership on medium to large-scale projects impacting strategic priorities.
  • Strong understanding of AI concepts and latest developments (Gen AI, MCP, ATA, etc.).

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO).

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

job.title: Quality Specialist (NDT)
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Pekerjaan Anda Membangun Dunia di Caterpillar.

Ketika Anda bergabung dengan Caterpillar, Anda bergabung dengan tim global yang peduli tidak hanya tentang pekerjaan yang kami lakukan – tetapi juga tentang satu sama lain. Kami adalah pembuat, pemecah masalah, dan pembangun dunia masa depan yang menciptakan komunitas yang lebih kuat dan berkelanjutan. Kami tidak hanya berbicara tentang kemajuan dan inovasi di sini – kami mewujudkannya, bersama dengan pelanggan kami, di tempat kami bekerja dan tinggal. Bersama-sama, kami membangun dunia yang lebih baik, sehingga kita semua dapat menikmati hidup di dalamnya.

Saat ini, kami sedang mencari Quality Specialist (NDT) untuk bergabung dengan tim Quality kami di Caterpillar Indonesia Batam.

Sebagai Quality Specialist (NDT), Anda akan bertanggung jawab atas audit di mana Anda akan menganalisis masalah khusus yang timbul dari metode yang salah dan merekomendasikan tindakan korektif terhadap masalah tersebut. Anda juga bertanggung jawab untuk memenuhi semua standar keselamatan, kualitas dan produktivitas di area produksi kami.

Informasi Tambahan:

Shift: Rotasi

Lokasi Kerja: Batam, Kepulauan Riau

Jenis Pekerjaan: 6 Bulan Kontrak

Anda akan bekerja di lingkungan kantor maupun di area produksi.

Relokasi domestik tidak tersedia untuk posisi ini.

Sebagai seorang Quality Specialist (NDT) Anda akan:

  • Bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan kalibrasi harian MT (Magnetic Particle Inspection) dan mencatat hasilnya.
  • Bertanggung jawab untuk melakukan kalibrasi harian UT (Ultrasonic Inspection) dan mencatat hasilnya.
  • Bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan setiap checklist dilengkapi sebelum bagian tersebut melanjutkan ke proses selanjutnya untuk pemeriksaan VT (Visual Inspection), UT (Ultrasonic Inspection), dan MT (Magnetic Particle Inspection).
  • Bertanggung jawab untuk memperbarui log pemeriksaan harian setiap akhir shift (WAJIB).
  • Bertanggung jawab untuk menandai bagian inspeksi atau struktur dengan kartu penandaan yang diperlukan (kuning/merah/hijau).
  • Bertanggung jawab untuk setiap minggu membuang semua kaleng bahan kimia MT/PT yang kosong ke ruang limbah.
  • Bertanggung jawab atas pemeliharaan peralatan dan peralatan NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) (kebersihan, fungsi, dll).
  • Menyiapkan laporan harian yang diperbarui kepada supervisor.

Kandidat yang berhasil harus memiliki:

  • Minimum Pendidikan Sekolah Menengah Atas atau sederajat.
  • Lulusan baru dipersilakan untuk melamar.
  • Memiliki pengalaman 1 tahun atau kurang di bidang NDT (Non-Destructive Testing) atau dalam proses pengelasan.
  • Memiliki sertifikat valid UT dan MT (ASNT level II).
  • Mampu menggunakan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

Persyaratan Fisik (Dengan atau Tanpa Akomodasi yang Wajar):

  • Pekerjaan ini mungkin memerlukan banyak gerakan aktif di seluruh pabrik termasuk naik turun tangga dan anak tangga, mengangkat peralatan, serta mendorong dan menarik peralatan.

Detail Akhir

Silakan periksa email yang terkait dengan aplikasi Anda secara berkala, termasuk folder sampah/spam, karena ini adalah metode korespondensi utama. Jika Anda ingin mengetahui status aplikasi Anda, silakan gunakan log-in kandidat di situs karir kami untuk mengetahui pembaruan status Anda.

Harap diingat bahwa dalam proses aplikasi, Caterpillar tidak akan pernah meminta pembayaran dalam bentuk apapun. Kami menyarankan Anda untuk mengabaikan tawaran pekerjaan dari individu yang mengaku bekerja untuk atau berafiliasi dengan Caterpillar.
