job.title: Senior Principal Data Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Serve as the senior data architecture authority for DXP Data, translating business, analytics and AI priorities into secure, scalable, operable and cost-aware architecture across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion, analytics and AI. Own target architecture, domain data models, reusable patterns and governance-by-design, and guide engineering teams and partners.

Accountabilities

  • Architecture Strategy: Own the DXP Data target and reference architecture, principles, transition states and multi-year capability roadmap.
  • Data Models and Products: Set direction for enterprise-aligned domain models, design semantic structures, data contracts and reusable data-product architecture supporting C360 and self-service analytics.
  • Design Authority and Governance: Approve material designs, manage exceptions and architecture debt, and ensure security, privacy, quality, lineage, interoperability and operability are designed in.
  • Standards and Paved Roads: Define and drive adoption of reusable patterns across ingestion, storage, modelling, serving, integration, metadata and AI-enabled data use cases.
  • Business and Technology Alignment: Convert stakeholder priorities into sequenced architecture outcomes, explicit trade-offs and actionable decisions.
  • Technical Leadership by Influence: Guide engineering, stewardship, analytics and vendor teams through reviews, prototypes, decision records, mentoring and knowledge transfer.

Responsibilities

  • Architecture Roadmap: Maintain current, target and transition architectures; prioritize architecture runway, modernization, decommissioning and technical-debt reduction.
  • Data Product Design: Lead conceptual and logical modelling, guide physical design, and define data-product boundaries, contracts, ownership, quality and service expectations.
  • Reference Patterns: Define implementable patterns for batch, CDC, streaming and file ingestion; orchestration; warehouse/lakehouse design; sharing; metadata and lineage.
  • Assurance and Operability: Review material designs and changes for correctness, security, resilience, scale, observability, cost and performance before build or release commitment.
  • Technology Evolution: Evaluate and prototype platform choices across AWS, Snowflake, ingestion/orchestration, open formats, semantic or knowledge layers and AI; document evidence, TCO and risks.
  • Stakeholder and Team Enablement: Facilitate decisions, challenge unclear requirements, assess partner designs and uplift internal capability through reusable guidance and coaching.

Qualifications

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: Data architecture and governance across the DXP Data Platform and C360 ecosystem, including AWS, Snowflake, Datapipe/Airflow/Airbyte, SageMaker, metadata, analytics enablement, and evolving data and AI platform capabilities.
  • Decision Rights: Approval of target/reference architecture, strategic data and solution designs, enterprise/domain modelling patterns, data-product architecture, technology recommendations, architecture standards and exceptions; escalation of material security, quality, operational, cost, or architectural risks before delivery or go-live.
  • Stakeholders: DXP Data Domain Owner, Enterprise and Solution Architecture, Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Data Quality Stewards, BI/Analytics, Data Science/AI, Business Data Owners, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity/ISO, Legal/Risk, application domain teams, and strategic partners.
  • Role Boundary / Resources: Senior individual-contributor and design-authority role operating across internal and vendor-augmented teams in Singapore, Malaysia and India. Engineering leads retain people leadership, implementation delivery and Day-2 operational ownership; the architect sets direction, assures design & operational quality, and drives cross-team alignment and capability uplift.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 15+ years of relevant experience is preferred. Candidates with 12+ years may be considered where they demonstrate equivalent principal-level scope. Experience should include at least 7 years owning enterprise or domain data architecture and acting as a senior design authority in production-scale, multi-domain environments.
  • Proven ownership of data-platform strategy, target and reference architecture, modernization roadmaps and architecture governance across internal and partner delivery teams.
  • Deep expertise in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling, including customer/party models, dimensional and relational patterns, semantic layers, data products and data contracts.
  • Strong technical fluency in cloud data-platform architecture - preferably Snowflake and AWS - and modern ingestion, orchestration, warehouse/lakehouse, open-table, metadata, lineage and self-service analytics patterns.
  • Hands-on SQL and Python credibility sufficient to profile data, validate assumptions, prototype critical patterns and review implementation choices. Airflow and relevant ingestion technologies such as Airbyte, NiFi/Openflow or Glue are advantageous.
  • Demonstrated ability to embed security, privacy, classification, access control, quality, resilience, recoverability, observability, cost and regulatory requirements into implementable architecture.
  • Practical understanding of AI/ML and agentic use cases, including AI-ready data, semantic grounding, responsible-AI controls and secure use of enterprise data.
  • Executive-level stakeholder leadership and a track record of leading through influence in vendor-augmented environments. Telecommunications or Customer 360 experience is advantageous.

job.title: Document Control, Specialist
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Scope :

  • To undertake document controlling for DayOne Thailand project, including tracking of authority submissions, consultants’ drawing issuance & version control, contractors’ technical submittals, by means of emails, ACC and/or other means approved by the Project Director.
  • To assist with new vendors’ registration to DayOne system
  • To manage invoicing & payment matters on the SAP and OA systems and coordinate with the associated parties (internally and externally) to ensure timely payment.
  • To coordinate of flight and hotel booking as well as travel arrangements for Thailand office.
  • To manage project administrative matters, such as meeting arrangements, consolidation of reports and meeting minutes writing.
  • To manage the site utilities bills and site office matters.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in project administration, document control, or a similar role.
  • Familiar with document control processes, version control, and handling technical submissions.
  • Experience working with systems such as SAP, OA, ACC, or other project/document management platforms.
  • Strong coordination and administrative skills, with the ability to support project teams and external stakeholders.
  • Good communication skills and ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills, including maintaining records, preparing reports, and scheduling meetings.
  • Ability to manage travel arrangements (flight, hotel, logistics) efficiently.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Detail-oriented, reliable, and able to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in construction, engineering, or project-based environments is an advantage.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Customer Success Specialist, Data Center
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. In Malaysia, that means real scale on the ground. As Johor's largest LEED-certified data center operator, we run two campuses at Nusajaya Tech Park and Kempas Tech Park, at the heart of the SIJORI cross-border digital corridor connecting Singapore, Johor, and Batam. Across both campuses, the infrastructure supports some of the world's most advanced AI and digital technology, and the client partnerships behind it need the same precision as the build itself.

About the Role

You'll support the Customer Success Manager in delivering DayOne's client-facing services and projects. This will involve coordinating daily operations, tracking service performance, and keeping documentation audit-ready across a portfolio of hyperscale infrastructure projects. This is a structured, entry-to-early-career role with genuine exposure to how client relationships and project delivery work in a live data center environment.

Customer Engagement and Support

  • Manage day-to-day customer communications, ensuring timely and professional responses to inquiries and issues.
  • Prepare customer-facing documentation and maintain accurate records to support the relationship the Customer Success Manager owns.

Service Delivery Monitoring

  • Track service performance against SLAs and prepare regular reports and dashboards.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to keep service operations running smoothly and resolve issues on time.

Project Coordination

  • Support the Customer Success Manager on project schedules, documentation, and stakeholder communications.
  • Track project milestones, procurement activities, and flag risks early.

Compliance and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain organized records of service and project activity in line with audit and compliance requirements, including ITIL standards.
  • Liaise with operations, network, IT services, and construction teams to keep tasks moving, and coordinate meetings and follow-ups across teams.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 1 year of experience in the data center industry, MEP consultancy, or construction is preferred. Fresh graduates with relevant internship or project exposure are welcome to apply.
  • Working proficiency in English

Soft Skills

  • Communicates clearly and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders across different seniority levels.
  • Keeps multiple workstreams organized and on track without needing reminders on deadlines.
  • Picks up new processes quickly in an environment where standards are high and details matter.

Nice to Have

  • A second regional language is a strong advantage for engaging clients across different markets.
  • Exposure to ITIL frameworks or service delivery standards.
  • Familiarity with SLA monitoring tools or client-facing reporting dashboards.
  • Prior exposure to hyperscale or mission-critical infrastructure projects.

Why DayOne? This is an early-career role with genuine visibility. You'll work directly alongside the Customer Success Manager on client relationships that matter to DayOne's growth across Southeast Asia. The learning curve is real and the infrastructure you'll help support is among the most significant being built in the region right now. If you want to start a career at the intersection of technology, infrastructure, and client delivery, this is a strong place to do it.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Director, Electrical Systems
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As Director of Electrical Systems based in Sydney or Singapore, you will report to the Senior Director -Technical Operations and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in several ways:

  • You are a multi disciplined data centre technical operations SME
  • Multiskilled with electrical (HV/MV/LV) experience and knowledge across a wide range of asset types and data centre designs.
  • You are a highly experienced technical manager with great communication skills and a leader of leaders.
  • As the Director of Electrical Systems, you will interface with key areas of the business such as Design & innovation, construction, commissioning & procurement as the voice of the customer.

Your Day to Day

  • Manage a team of Electrical specialists to ensure effective solutions implementation and issue resolution.
  • Represent Technical Operations in all design aspects of new builds and upgrades including vendor selection. FWT/FOK, Commissioning and testing as needed.
  • Define & augment when required our product specifications with an “Operational Lens”
  • Define the required maintenance (frequency and scope) on all electrical critical infrastructure & develop standards which will be implemented across the portfolio.
  • Partner with site operations on event RCA’s, product failures, risks and be the central Electrical Systems feedback loop for our design / procurement teams.
  • Oversight and resolution of the Electrical operational aspects of new project deployments.
  • Development of Electrical operations strategies for new sites across APAC, with a focus on local codes & regulations especially in emerging regions where codes are evolving.
  • Support operational incidents and escalation with technical expertise.
  • Effective and timely Problem resolution within Electrical Systems.
  • Vendor engagement on product performance

Requirements

  • You have 10+ years of experience in working in either data centres or mission critical environments
  • Ideally, you have experience working for a data centre operator and have previous hyperscale experience in the APAC market
  • You have tenured experience with managing a team of specialist electrical engineers.
  • You are a strong team player and exceptional communicator with influencing skills – working across partner teams in AirTrunk such as Development, Design/ Procurement.
  • You are the subject matter expert for all aspects of Electrical Systems operations including aspects such Low/Medium/High Voltage installations.
  • Ideally, you have strong commercial acumen to understand the commercial implications of engineering decisions
  • You are willing to travel to other APAC regions on a regular basis

The AirTrunk Culture

job.title: Senior Data Center Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) - Singapore, Central Singapore
job.description:
Job Summary

The Senior Critical Facilities Engineer (Electrical) is a senior technical specialist responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and safe operation of mission-critical power infrastructure within the data center environment. This role provides technical leadership for electrical operations, maintenance, troubleshooting, and incident response activities while supporting the continuous delivery of highly resilient services to customers.

Working with a high degree of independence, the engineer leads complex electrical maintenance activities, supports critical switching operations, identifies operational risks, and drives continuous improvement initiatives that enhance infrastructure reliability, safety, and efficiency.

Responsibilities

Facility / Infrastructure Maintenance

  • Operate, maintain, and support mission-critical electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, breakers, and associated distribution systems
  • Perform advanced preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure the reliability and availability of critical power systems
  • Lead electrical troubleshooting efforts and resolve complex infrastructure issues, minimizing operational risk and customer impact
  • Monitor the Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), responding to alarms and identifying potential risks before service impacts occur
  • Lead and coordinate critical electrical operations, including maintenance windows, switching procedures, energization activities, and infrastructure recovery efforts
  • Conduct site inspections and assess the health and performance of electrical infrastructure, recommending corrective actions and reliability improvements
  • Support electrical capacity planning and load management activities to ensure infrastructure readiness for future growth
  • Identify opportunities to improve system reliability, operational efficiency, and energy performance

Site Administration

  • Prepare, review, and authorize technical documentation including Maintenance Operation Protocols (MOPs), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Emergency Operating Procedures (EOPs), and switching plans
  • Ensure maintenance activities are executed safely and in accordance with operational, regulatory, and company requirements
  • Maintain accurate infrastructure records, maintenance history, and operational documentation

Incident Management

  • Serve as a technical lead during electrical incidents, infrastructure failures, and power-related events
  • Provide guidance to on-site teams during incident response and restoration activities
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) investigations and develop corrective and preventive action plans
  • Lead post-incident reviews and recommend improvements to operational processes and infrastructure resilience

Vendor Management

  • Manage and coordinate electrical service providers, contractors, and vendors performing maintenance and project activities
  • Review vendor work plans, technical proposals, and maintenance recommendations
  • Ensure work is performed in accordance with safety requirements, industry standards, and data center operational procedures

Work Orders & Capacity Management

  • Lead resolution of complex work orders and infrastructure-related requests
  • Support electrical capacity planning, power utilization analysis, and infrastructure growth initiatives
  • Provide technical reviews of customer power requirements and infrastructure impacts
  • Support commissioning, testing, and integration of new electrical systems

Collaboration

  • Act as a technical mentor to engineers and technicians, sharing expertise and supporting team development
  • Partner with Critical Facilities, Customer Operations, Security, Design & Construction, and vendor teams to deliver operational excellence
  • Identify underlying infrastructure issues and recommend long-term reliability improvements
  • Leverage internal and external technical resources to resolve complex electrical challenges

Additional Projects

  • Lead electrical infrastructure projects, including upgrades, capacity expansion, modernization, and reliability improvement initiatives
  • Support lifecycle management and replacement strategies for critical electrical assets
  • Participate in commissioning, integrated systems testing, and acceptance activities for new infrastructure deployments
  • Recommend and champion initiatives that improve uptime, reliability, safety, and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline preferred
  • Minimum 5 years of experience operating and maintaining critical electrical infrastructure in data centers, utilities, industrial facilities, telecommunications, or other mission-critical environments

Preferred Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with mission-critical power systems, including: UPS systems Diesel generators Switchgear and breakers Transformers Low- and medium-voltage distribution systems Power monitoring systems
  • Experience performing electrical switching activities, maintenance planning, and incident response
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults and identify root causes
  • Experience leading maintenance vendors and coordinating infrastructure projects
  • Strong understanding of electrical safety practices, operational risk management, and permit-to-work processes

Equinix is committed to ensuring that our employment process is open to all individuals, including those with a disability. If you are a qualified candidate and need assistance or an accommodation, please let us know by completing [this form](https://forms.office.com/pages/responsepage.aspx?id=cbKtcscv_kql7p3mpZ9r-50RYwLmhPpKtmEYPKOcl8hURTBBN0xMTllDRVc0VkJUSEYxMEk1V0NJQS4u&origin=lprLink).

job.title: Data Center Concierge III - Melbourne, Victoria, Australia
job.description:
Job Summary

The position will suit someone who is a strong communicator, experienced and organised in completing routing and ad-hoc tasks, admin focused and with the ability to deliver outstanding customer service at all times. Applicants may come from multifaceted industries including but not limited to hospitality, reception, administration or other customer centric roles and will be working Monday-Friday in a permanent position.

This is a customer facing role, so applicants should work onsite, enjoy client interaction and have the confidence to identify customer trends, issues or concerns, taking appropriate actions where possible and call out accordingly when needed.

Key responsibilities

Our Concierge will provide support to datacenter facilities and administrative duties following standard procedures:

  • Supports customers by coordinating visits and schedules in the data center; assists on semi-routine inquiries and issues
  • Directly coordinates activities with the Equinix Response Center (ERC), as needed
  • Keeps records of activities within the data center including circuit inventories, installed power inventories and labor hours expended
  • May generate purchase requisitions and coordinate with vendors for delivery and invoicing
  • Generating Siebel Reports for customer SH requests
  • Assist security with supervising the security office, signing in visitors, validation and assignment of access via the Siebel and EACS
  • Work closely with site security and report security related incidents to the Security Operations Control Centre
  • Perform ad hoc support tasks for IBX Operations teams, including but not limited to parking administration, CCTV and access control data retrieval and analysis, event coordination, and maintenance management system administration.
  • Take an active role in emergency response preparedness, including participating in evacuation drills and incidents by coordinating and managing designated muster areas, accounting for personnel, and supporting site emergency procedures.

Customer Support and onsite Customer Liaison

  • Supports the coordination of tasks to the appropriate cross-functional teams
  • Maintains positive business relationships with local vendors in support of customer's administrative needs; provides information about local vendors to customers upon request
  • Maintains customer care areas/conference rooms for cleanliness and fully stocking amenities as the need arises; may provide backup coverage to cross functional teams to support inventory ordering
  • Communicates semi-routine operating datacenter procedures to customers on-site, while building and developing positive customer relationships
  • Coordinates customer work visits with security and escorts customers and/or vendors, within a reasonable vicinity, as required
  • Assists with tracking, following-up, and reporting on routine or new customer inquiries and issues while customers are on-site
  • Provides general induction learning tours to new customers to orient them to the site and escorting customers to their spaces within the data center and unlocking racks where required
  • Resolving issues related to lower customer satisfaction score by coordinating with cross functional team

Benefits of Equinix and the role:

  • Salary package including healthcare allowance and annual bonus
  • Extensive on-job induction, training and continued learning and access to a range of company employee benefits
  • Career development and further opportunities within Equinix
  • Join an industry leader in the Data Centre world
  • Permanent position working Monday-Friday onsite daytime hours

job.title: SG | Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Manager (Service Assurance), Group Data Centre Operations (GDCO), you will be part of the Service Assurance team with responsibilities across data centres in Southeast and Northeast Asia. In this role, you will drive the performance of key operational processes to achieve continuous improvement and operational excellence, manage audit programmes to ensure compliance with required certifications including security (ISMS), processes (SMS & BCMS), and energy and environmental standards, and support the deployment and adoption of IT tools and systems to enable process automation and performance reporting.

  • Plan, schedule, and conduct internal audits for ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 standards, prepare audit reports and follow up with auditees to close findings.
  • Plan, schedule, and complete external audits by engaging certification bodies to achieve and maintain ISO 27001, ISO 20000-1, ISO 22301, and ISO 50001 certifications.
  • Monitor and review operations processes, including incident and change management to drive continuous improvement of key KPIs.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of physical security controls and operations to maintain and enhance overall sites security posture.
  • Support the setup and maintenance of ISMS, BCMS, and SMS management systems.
  • Contribute to the documentation of key operational policies, processes, manuals, SOPs to drive alignment and consistency across countries.
  • Support the automation of operational processes and performance reporting using appropriate IT tools and systems.
  • Provide training and coaching to the data centre operations teams and auditees on audit requirements and processes.
  • Support all service assurance-related activities, initiatives, and projects.
  • Any other tasks as assigned by the Management

Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in IT, Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in a Data Centre environment.
  • Experience in data centre or critical environment operations (e.g., M&E facilities, security operations) and ITSM processes (incident, change, problem management).
  • ISO Lead/Internal Auditor certification (ISO 27001, 22301, 20000-1, or 50001) with hands-on audit and certification experience.
  • Familiarity with ISMS, BCMS, SMS frameworks and ITSM/operations support tools.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and cross-cultural communication skills; bilingual in English and an additional Southeast Asian language is preferred.
  • Self-driven with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver results with minimal supervision.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As the Specialist, Data Centre Site Operations (DCSO), you will be responsible for the following:

  • Work in rotating shifts to support large scale data centre’s 24x7 onsite operations and critical facilities.
  • Perform 24x7 monitoring of BMS systems (upstream to downstream), critical facilities equipment and other equipment associated with the data centre environment including fire safety, plumbing, mechanical, and electrical systems.
  • Act as first responders and the Level 1 escalation point for all onsite operational incidents and issues. Perform hands-on troubleshooting and ad-hoc repair of mechanical and electrical (M&E) equipment.
  • Respond and perform all remote hands requests within the Operational and Service Level Agreements.
  • Document and update accurately and promptly all relevant activities and requests on the STT GDC Web Portal ticketing system (user requests, incidents, change, problems, provisioning, etc.), ITIL (Information Technology Infrastructure Library).
  • Ensure effective implementation of data centre safety, security and customer support policy and procedures.
  • Oversee the security operations onsite, including processes, manpower and ability to use security software systems.
  • Co-ordinate and support all internal contractors and vendors activities onsite, including reviewing of Permit-To-Work (PTW) documents, scheduling of resources, enforcement of house rules, adherence to best practices, compliance to safety procedures, etc.
  • Co-ordinate, plan and support all preventive and reactive maintenance activities with little to no disruption to STT GDC’s services.
  • Create accurate and regular reporting to internal stakeholders when necessary (incident reports, health reports, daily reports, etc.).
  • Write and update Standard Operating Procedures and Emergency Operating Procedures for DSCO related procedures and processes.
  • Provide administrative support in assets inventory and procurement of parts/equipment.
  • Knowledge of copper/fibre deployment and be willing to learn to use tester to perform cabling troubleshooting.
  • Coordinate and supervise the activities of contracted personnel providing services or performing work in the data centre. Coordinate all preventive/contracted/general maintenance, ensuring zero/minimum disruption of building services Carry out any other duties as and when assigned by the Team Leads and Management.

Requirements

  • ITE or Diploma in Computing/Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related fields.
  • At least 1 year of relevant work experience in a 24x7 DC of facility operations environment, or fresh graduate with relevant qualification such building infrastructure.
  • Possess general knowledge of M&E and Network Infrastructure.
  • Meticulous team player with the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
  • Broad knowledge in DC facilities related systems such as PDUs, UPS, DC Rectifier, Generator, DRUPs, CRAUs, Chiller, DX cooling, fire protections, etc.
  • Possess relevant facilities management and/or data centre related certifications, such as ITIL, CDCP, CDCS, etc.
  • Broad knowledge in cloud technology, network, data centre facilities, system applications and IT systems.
  • Familiar with certification standards, such as LEED Gold, BCA-IDA Green Mark Platinum, Uptime Institute Tier III, ISO 20000 / 22301 / 27001, SS564, etc.
  • Prepared to be on 24x7 standby recall to provide extra manpower coverage when necessary.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: SG | Lead, Data Centre Engineering Support (DCES)
job.description:
Key Duties and Responsibilities

As Lead, Data Centre Engineering Support (DCES), you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure cost efficiency, optimal performance, and alignment of energy and water optimisation initiatives with business objectives.

  • Serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Mechanical, Electrical, BMS, and security systems for Singapore Data Centre operations.
  • Champion the Problem Management process and act as a rotating duty Incident Manager in accordance with ITIL framework.
  • Drive energy audits, optimisation programmes, engineering and retrofitting initiatives, as well as financial evaluation of energy efficiency measures.
  • Oversee and be accountable for the procurement of technical services and works, including contract management and administration of service agreements and renewals.
  • Act as program manager for all technical certification programmes (e.g., ANSI/TIA-942, Green Mark, ISO), from planning through to certification.
  • Collaborate with the Technology & Project Delivery team to enhance maintainability and build quality.
  • Develop, review, and validate technical policies, processes, procedures, and work instructions, including maintenance frameworks and best practices.
  • Establish frameworks to ensure full compliance with applicable Acts, regulations, standards and approved codes of practice relating to building operations.
  • Drive technical learning and development initiatives across Singapore Data Centres.
  • Support customer technical audits and provide relevant management information as required.
  • Any other duties or projects as assigned by the Management.

Requirements

  • Diploma in Mechanical & Electrical Engineering, Facilities Management or related field
  • At least 3 years of relevant work experience in managing critical facilities development or operations, as well as project management in 24x7 data centre environment
  • Strong knowledge in MEP operations and building facilities systems (e.g. switchgears, UPS, generators, CRAUs, chiller plants, etc.)
  • Experienced in leading certification programs, including ANSI/TIA-942, Uptime, BCA-IMDA Green Mark for Data Centres, SS 564, LEED and ISO.
  • Relevant certifications in energy and environmental management (e.g. SCEM, SGBC Green Mark Professional, LEED GA/AP) will be an advantage.
  • Professional certifications (e.g., CDFOS, CDCS, ITIL or other related certification) are preferred.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and perform effectively under tight timelines.

We thank you for your interest and effort taken to submit your application. Please be advised that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Legal Counsel, Commercial Operations
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Government & Strategic Partner Engagement
  • Draft, review, and negotiate legal documentation involving government authorities, public utility providers (e.g., power, water, telecom grid connections), and strategic partners, including MOUs, LOIs, concession agreements, and development frameworks.
  • Collaborate closely with the Government Affairs (GR) team to prepare formal communications, regulatory submissions, policy responses, and official letters.
  • Land & Property Execution
  • Provide legal support for site acquisition, land leasing, utility easements, and facility construction documentation.
  • Partner with internal M&A counsels and external legal advisors during due diligence, closing, and post-closing integration for new data center assets.
  • Licensing & Permitting
  • Work independently or with the support of local counsel in studying the requirements and preparing documentations on statutory licensing, environmental and zoning permits, safety approvals, and operational certifications required across all stages of data center development and operation.
  • Support ongoing compliance audits and maintain regulatory filing trackers.
  • Customer & Commercial Contracts
  • Draft, review, and negotiate customer-facing agreements, including Master Services Agreements (MSAs), Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Data Center Colocation Contracts, and Order Forms.
  • Ensure contractual terms align with operational capabilities, risk mitigation standards, revenue recognition objectives, and dispute resolution mechanisms.
  • Regional Regulatory Watch & Study
  • Monitor, research, and analyze regional and local regulatory developments impacting data center investment, energy consumption, telecommunications, environmental standards, and cross-border data transfer.
  • Translate regulatory changes into periodic or ad hoc internal knowhow broadcast, as well as actionable internal compliance advisories and operational risk assessments.
  • General Corporate & Operational Legal Support
  • Deliver day-to-day legal advice across operational functions, including reviewing vendor/procurement contracts, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), and administrative paperwork.
  • Provide legal guidance on standard employment contracts, internal HR policies, labour compliance, and basic intellectual property (IP) protection/trademark management

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree or above in Law.
  • Work Experience: 4–6 years of relevant legal experience at law firm or as in-house counsel (experience in data centers, telecommunications, infrastructure, or real estate development is preferred).
  • Key Competencies: Proven ability to independently draft and review legal documentation and commercial contracts, and excellent communication and collaboration skills to effectively manage cross-departmental alignment and external stakeholders.

job.title: Senior Legal Counsel, M&A
job.description:
Responsibilities

Corporate Development Initiatives:

  • Act as a key legal adviser to the business on corporate development initiatives, including new market expansion, real estate and asset-level acquisitions, sale and leaseback transactions, REIT and other asset recycling structures, and other strategic transactions.
  • Advise on transaction structuring, key legal and commercial risks and execution strategy, and proactively identify and resolve issues to keep transactions on track.

Joint Ventures & Strategic Investments:

  • Support the structuring, negotiation and implementation of joint ventures and strategic investments, including governance arrangements, reserved matters, funding obligations, exit rights and other key shareholder arrangements.

Legal Due Diligence & Advisor Management:

  • Lead or support legal due diligence for acquisitions, divestments, new market opportunities and other strategic transactions; instruct, coordinate and manage external counsel across multiple jurisdictions.

Stakeholder & Project Management:

  • Act as a key legal point of contact for transactions and take ownership of transaction execution, working closely with internal stakeholders across investments, finance, tax and project development teams and supporting negotiations with investors, joint-venture partners and other counterparties.

Legal Process & Knowledge Management:

  • Assist with developing and maintaining standard templates, precedents and playbooks for M&A, joint ventures, asset recycling and other corporate development activities; support continuous improvement and standardisation of legal processes.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree or higher.

Qualifications

  • Admitted to practice in a common law jurisdiction.

Experience

  • 5+ years of post-qualification experience from a top-tier or well-regarded law firm, with demonstrated experience in M&A, joint ventures and/or other complex investment transactions, including significant international and cross-border deal exposure.
  • Experience in real estate transactions, sale and leaseback transactions, REIT structures and/or other asset recycling transactions would be an advantage.
  • Candidates from private practice are welcome to apply; prior in-house experience is an advantage but not necessary.

Core Skills:

  • Strong transaction management skills and a demonstrated ability to independently lead and drive transactions from inception through completion, with appropriate escalation of material legal and commercial issues
  • Excellent legal drafting and negotiation skills, with sound commercial judgement and the ability to provide practical, business-focused advice.

Language and Communication:

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to engage effectively with senior internal stakeholders and external advisers across jurisdictions. Proficiency in Japanese would be an advantage.

Personal Attributes:

  • Proactive, adaptable and able to work independently; strong sense of ownership and responsibility; able to manage multiple complex workstreams in a fast-paced, cross-border environment; collaborative team player with high professional and ethical standards.

job.title: Associate Director, Service Delivery
job.description:
Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is expected to coach and mentor Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Associate Director, Service Delivery is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Associate Director, Service Delivery should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Associate Director, Service Delivery would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,

job.title: Job Redesign Lead
job.description:
Key responsibilities

**

Design & rollout the central Job Redesign Playbook

  • Develop an enterprise playbook using a task-based methodology (principles, step-by-step process, templates, tools and governance) for job redesign and role/ skills reconstruction aligned to AI augmentation.

Create frameworks & artefacts

  • Build standardised role-profile templates, task decomposition templates, grading/regrading guidelines, job family/role cluster schemas, and skills-mapping templates aligned to Singtel Skills Framework.

Enable HR Business Partners (HRBPs) & Business Units (BU)

  • Coach and enable HRBPs and BUs teams to apply the playbook at scale by running workshops, facilitating subject matter expert interviews, reviewing team structures, and guiding workforce and skills redesign.

Deliver pilots & scale-up

  • Lead early job-redesign pilots (including design, measurement and iteration), capture insights and develop repeatable playbooks for enterprise-wide roll-out.

Design career pathways & bridge programmes

  • Work with HRBPs, business leaders and learning partners to design templates and approaches for career ladders, lateral pathways and ‘bridge’ programmes that preserve career continuity and provide clear skill-to-role progression for impacted employees.

Integrate with learning & workforce planning

  • work with Skills/Capability and Learning leads to ensure role redesign outputs map into assessments, training roadmaps and redeployment plans.

Measure & report

  • Define job-redesign success metrics (e.g., % roles redesigned, redeployment rate, skills readiness), maintain dashboards and provide regular updates to the Programme Office and SteerCo.

**

Qualifications, Skills & Attributes:

  • Educated to degree level with professional certifications such as Certified Organisation Design Professional (CODP®), SHRM or IHRP certifications
  • 6-8 years’ experience in organisation design/job architecture/role design in large, matrixed organisations (or consultancy experience delivering large-scale job redesign).
  • Proven experience driving task-based job redesign (decomposition, role reconstruction, grading) and solid understanding of task-to-role analysis frameworks.
  • Practical experience translating role redesign into grading, regrading processes, and redeployment mechanisms.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence HRBPs and senior business leaders effectively.
  • Excellent facilitation capabilities, including SME interviews and co-design workshop delivery.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear playbooks, job design templates, and HRBP/manager toolkits.

  • Validate SD–FICO integration across order-to-cash, billing, receivables, and credit exposure processes.
  • Work closely with Finance, Sales, IT, and business users to understand requirements and translate them into SAP solutions.
  • Support UAT activities, including preparation of test scenarios, test scripts, test data, execution, defect tracking, and resolution.
  • Participate in SAP enhancements, upgrades, rollouts, and post-go-live support.
  • Document business processes, configuration settings, and standard operating procedures.
  • Provide guidance to users and help resolve system or process-related issues.

Skills for Success:

We welcome candidates who are hands-on, analytical, and eager to contribute to business transformation.

  • A degree in Business, Information Systems, Finance, IT, or a related field.
  • At least 4 years of experience in Credit Management, SAP Credit Management, or related order-to-cash processes.
  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA Credit Management.
  • Good understanding of SAP SD and FICO modules, especially customer master, sales orders, billing, accounts receivable, and integration points.
  • Exposure to dunning, collections, credit risk management, or customer account processes.
  • Experience supporting UAT, including test planning, execution, and defect management.
  • Knowledge of customer master data setup and its integration with SD, FI, CRM, MM, or MDG.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • SAP certification in SD, FICO, or Credit Management will be an added advantage, but it is not mandatory.

Join us on our mission to continue defining the future of financial services. Apply Now!

job.title: Client Success Specialist
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

Client Success Specialist is responsible for managing strategic client relationships and acting as a trusted advisor to management-level stakeholders. Drives client adoption, value realization, upsell, cross-sell, and timely contract renewals while minimizing churn. Acts as an escalation point for client issues and coordinates with cross-functional teams to achieve satisfactory outcomes. Maintains client portfolio data quality and contributes to regional and global Client Success practices. Requires strong interpersonal, consultative selling, negotiation, account management, and IT service knowledge, including ITIL practices. Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, relevant certifications, and seasoned client-facing experience in sales, service, consultancy, or large-scale multinational IT services environments.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

Client Nurture / Relationship

  • Develop and maintain the relationship with client representatives to Management level, being recognised as the client’s ‘trusted advisor’ at NTT
  • Ensure the client is able to interact successfully with NTT and to optimise the engagement (measurable through improving CSAT)
  • Act as an escalation point for client issues which are not being resolved though standard process, facilitating a satisfactory client outcome with relevant resolver groups within NTT

Adoption Charter

  • Ensure the client is aware of, and is successfully adopting Offer features and increasing their usage of services (as appropriate)
  • Proactively help the client to realise demonstrable value from the Offers and meet their original business (procurement) objectives

Expansion Charter

  • Drive up-sell of existing Offers/services and close the deals to achieve revenue targets
  • Identify cross-sell opportunities (to extend NTT’s footprint with the client) and facilitate engagement with Sales/GTM functions to engage the client on these opportunities

Renewal Charter

  • Demonstrate the value delivered by NTT throughout the lifetime of the contract and drive a successful and on-time renewal
  • Minimise churn (client, revenue, service) at renewal and seek opportunities to drive up-sell / cross-sell as part of the renewal process

Client Success Practice

  • Be an active member of the Regional and Global CS Management practice(including adopting standard methodologies, platforms/tools, KPIs, best practice activity, sharing experiences with the community)
  • Responsible for Data Quality Management within own client portfolio
  • Build and maintain Client Success Management skills and operating knowledge
  • Build and maintain an up-to-date knowledge of NTT’s Offers

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop and maintain solid stakeholder relationships up to Management level
  • Basic account planning and stakeholder mapping and management techniques
  • Ability to interpret a client’s business strategy / plans and understand opportunities for NTT solutions/services
  • Knowledge of NTT’s Offers and services, including the core functionality and features, linkage within NTT’s service portfolio, pricing structures, client benefits
  • Ability to provide an external industry viewpoint (including industry insights, technology trends and competitor landscape) and to highlight NTT’s expertise and differentiated offerings and position NTT’s “partnership” offerings with the client
  • Strong sales skills (consultative selling and negotiation) with the ability to identify up-sell opportunities and close resulting deals
  • Ability to execute on-time renewals with minimum volume or price churn
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of IT service environment, service operations and ITIL practices
  • Understanding of NTT’s high-level operating model and the ability to develop and maintain relationships across relevant cross-functional teams.
  • Understanding of NTT’s billing processes and client invoicing linked to contracted services
  • Understanding of financial statements and metrics, including revenue, expense control, and growth relative to market in order to hold strategic client conversations.
  • Understanding of contracts and contract management; with the ability to maintain the contract, to discuss with the client and understand how to position as a value exchange

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Typically needs a Bachelor’s or equivalent and entry or basic level experience; or an advanced or equivalent degree without experience; or equivalent work experience
  • Certification and working knowledge of ITIL practices
  • Additional relevant vendor certifications would be advantageous

Required Experience:

  • Seasoned experience in a client-facing role in one or more of Sales, Service or Consultancy disciplines in a large scale (preferably multi-national) IT services environment.
  • Seasoned subject matter and services product expertise within sales and operations

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer Manager
job.description:
We are looking for a professional to join our data management team for Viu, an OTT service based in Hong Kong. With over 66 million monthly active users (MAU) and 12 million paid subscribers, Viu is a leading pan-regional OTT video service with a presence across Asia, the Middle East, and South Africa.

As a Senior Data Engineering Manager, you will be responsible for building best-in-class data infrastructure, business intelligence, and analytics platforms. You will lead and collaborate with a highly skilled team of software, infrastructure, and data professionals to support regional business needs. This involves formulating, communicating, and executing a forward-looking data strategy that leverages industry best practices in AI and technology across all our markets.

Key Responsibilities

● Data Delivery and Lifecycle: Prioritize data requests and collaborate closely with technical, product, and analytics managers to translate business needs into scalable engineering deliverables. Oversee data development, data operations, and L2 data enquiry support. ● Data Engineering Management: Lead and manage the data engineering team, overseeing end-to-end technical solutions, implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. ● Data Product & AI-Driven: Drive data product development leveraging agentic AI and appropriate LLMs to streamline and improve the engineering and operational efficiency ● Data Quality & High Availability: Partner with Analytics team to enforce rigorous data quality standards, optimize system performance, and maintain high data services uptime. ● Governance & Efficiency: Monitor overall data usage and maintain clear guidelines to manage cost controls, security, access, query performance and pipeline efficiency

  • Candidates with less experience will be considered as Data Engineering Manager

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in your new position it is important that you are someone who is forward-thinking and who takes initiative. Also, it is essential to have the following skills:

● 7+ years of experience in data engineering, data platforms, and team leadership ● Degree holder, preferably in statistics, computer science, or related quantitative disciplines ● Proficiency in SQL, Python with hands-on experience applying LLMs or agentic AI to engineering development ● Track record of managing end-to-end data delivery, from requirements gathering to L2 enquiry support ● Expertise in data architecture, data modeling, and pipeline development using Snowflake, Databricks, dbt, or Kafka on AWS or GCP ● Strong background in data governance, data quality, cost control, and query performance optimization ● Domain experience in OTT, digital marketing, e-commerce, CRM, MarTech, or AdTech fields are highly desired ● Strong stakeholder management and team leadership skills in a high-paced environment under tight timelines ● Good command of both written and spoken English and Mandarin

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Eaton is an intelligent power management company dedicated to improving the quality of life and protecting the environment for people everywhere. Every day, all around the world, people depend on technology, transportation, energy, and infrastructure to live and work. With rapid growth in electrification, an energy transition driven by climate change and explosive growth in connectivity, we’re well positioned to solve the world’s toughest electrical and mechanical power management challenges.

We're looking for a Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex electrical infrastructure projects with real customer, commercial, and operational impact. This is an opportunity to take ownership of major projects, influence outcomes, and work alongside experienced professionals delivering some of Australia's most critical infrastructure.

If you enjoy leading teams, navigating complexity, and turning plans into successful project outcomes, we'd love to hear from you.

What you’ll do:

As part of our PMO team, you'll play a critical role in delivering customer projects safely, on time, and within budget. You will:

  • Lead end-to-end project delivery across complex electrical infrastructure projects.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, resource strategies, and delivery frameworks.
  • Manage project budgets, forecasting, reporting, and commercial outcomes.
  • Identify, manage, and mitigate project risks throughout the lifecycle.
  • Build strong customer relationships and act as a trusted project partner.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve quality, safety, and delivery objectives.
  • Drive project governance, stakeholder communication, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What we're looking for

We're open to candidates from critical power, electrical infrastructure, data centres, utilities, industrial automation, building services, or related industries.

You may be:

  • A Project Manager seeking larger or more complex projects.
  • A Senior Project Engineer ready to step into project leadership.

You'll bring:

  • 5+ years' project management experience within the electrical industry.
  • Experience managing budgets, schedules, resources, and project risk.
  • Strong customer relationship management, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • The ability to lead teams and navigate complex project environments.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capability.
  • A Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline.

Why Eaton?

Join a global leader delivering the most critical infrastructure projects, where you'll lead high-impact programs, influence project outcomes, and grow your career in a business shaping the future of electrification and connectivity.

  • Lead complex, mission-critical projects across data centres, utilities, and industrial environments.
  • Take ownership of projects from planning and delivery through to customer handover.
  • Strengthen your commercial, leadership, and project delivery expertise within a fast-growing market.
  • Competitive salary package, car allowance, and bonus.
  • Global opportunities, local decision-making, and career progression pathways.

We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for all job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes encourage diversity by utilising a balanced selection criteria regardless of the applicants age, gender, gender identity, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or any other status protected or required by law. Eaton prides itself in truly representing the people within our communities.

If this sounds like you, please send through your application. We look forward to hearing from you!

job.title: Design Engineer - Power Distribution
job.description:
Eaton’s Electrical Engineering Services & Systems Division (EESS) is currently seeking a Design Engineer - Power Distribution. This role can be based remote within the United States.

The Project Operations Team provides comprehensive engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) services throughout the entire project lifecycle. Our team specializes in handling both greenfield and brownfield turnkey electrical projects and has expertise in designing and constructing high and medium-voltage substations and developing power distribution solutions for utilities, government, data centers, industrial, and commercial facilities. This position is remote within the United Sates.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $97,000 - $143,000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you’ll do:

  • Lead the engineering and design of medium- and high-voltage power distribution and substation projects, delivering safe, reliable, and innovative solutions for our customers.
  • Ability to independently develop complete engineering packages including single/three lines, AC/DC schematics and wiring, cable/conduit plans, equipment layout plans, etc for turnkey projects.
  • Coordinate electrical and civil design packages to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Develop complete engineering packages, coordinating electrical and civil design activities to ensure quality, constructability, and compliance with applicable standards.
  • Drive project success by managing design deliverables, schedules, budgets, and technical accuracy in partnership with project managers, field teams, and customers.
  • Apply value-driven engineering practices to optimize designs, improve efficiency, and deliver cost-effective solutions without compromising quality or performance.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal stakeholders to develop technical solutions that address evolving power system needs.
  • Participate in site assessments and field walkdowns to evaluate existing infrastructure and support the development of engineering proposals and project scopes.
  • Prepare engineering estimates, review technical documentation, and support project planning activities.
  • Mentor and collaborate with fellow engineers and designers, sharing technical expertise and contributing to a culture of continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Support projects across the United States through occasional travel (approximately 10%) for customer meetings, site visits, and project support activities.

Qualifications

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of a BS in electrical or mechanical engineering from an accredited institution
  • Minimum of seven (7) years electrical engineering or electrical design experience
  • Experience in medium voltage power distribution or substation design
  • Must be able to work in the United States without corporate sponsorship now and within the future. Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Professional Engineer qualification
  • Field experience in testing/commissioning medium voltage equipment
  • Working knowledge of NERC/FERC, NESC, NEC, ANSI, NETA
  • Experience with AutoCAD and/or MicroStation

#LI-JM3

#LI-Remote

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

job.title: Senior Engineer - Field Service- CSM
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

The Field Service Engineer:

  • Provide consistent quality and support to customers across the region.

Responsibilities and Measurement Criteria with Time investment Needed on Each:

(This will describe the overall core responsibilities of the role, decision making responsibilities etc.)

  • Assist Delivery of project site works on data center operational equipment's - Installation, commission, test and handover to client over multiple projects.
  • Assist in the completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of  Electrical Panel/UPS/Chiller/PAC/PAHU etc panels.
  • Assist in the completion of preventative maintenance tasks for all aspects of  11KV/33KV sub-station with Transformer and DG set's.
  • Improve data center efficiency (DCiE) and Power usage effectiveness (PUE).
  • Create and review the technical Equipmentmen's SOP/EOP/MOP etc.
  • Analysis and review the site specific Daily/Weekly/Monthly report.
  • Preparation of all tools, test equipment and site documentation for project/maintenance activities.

Qualifications

Required/ Minimum Qualifications:

  • Minimum 6+ years’ experience in data center operation
  • BE/B-Tech in Electrical Engineering discipline.

Additional / Preferred Qualifications: -

  • Experience with dealing with clients/customers in a professional manner.
  • Familiar with all aspects of electrical panel testing & fault finding.
  • Understanding of data center operational support equipment and Protection devices.
  • Good understanding of safe isolation and electrical safety.
  • Familiar with maintaining accurate and detailed completion of test documentation.
  • Experience with Client Factory Acceptance Tests / Site Acceptance Tests.
  • Excellent communicator.
  • Fully flexible to work additional hours on request.
  • This is a site-based role and majority of work time will be based on-site or travelling.
  • Full driving license.

Physical & Environmental Requirements: - (To be used majorly for manufacturing jobs.)

  • A significant number of afterhours and weekend work, frequently scheduled with little notice.
  • Travel on a daily basis to and from customer sites.
  • Will be required to stay away from home or travel long distances.
  • Occasional heavy lifting required.
  • You will be expected to operate as part of a team.
  • May be required to travel abroad from time to time.
  • You will be supplied with a Company uniform, which must be warn at all times while working.

Time Travel Needed:

job.title: Project Manager Services Coordinator I
job.description:
Job Description

Join a High-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence

At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology—and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.

Why Vertiv?

•High-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.

  • Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action-focused culture.

•Limitless Growth Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.

  • A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employees' unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.

POSITION SUMMARY

  • The Project Coordinator must provide support to the Project Management Office. They are required to assist in tracking shipments, provide assistance for internal and external audits, managing of service requests, and assisting the Project Managers for any needed information or requirements they may require for the project.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work with the PMO to develop the processes, tools, training and governance around financials of projects. This includes but not limited to, budget tracking (from Sales), expenses (hours, travel, misc. job expenses), subcontractor PO’s (raising a POR), payment to subcontractors (receipt of PO), can extract report for expense. etc. – OFCI Projects primarily
  • Assist Project Coordinator II in handling major projects.
  • Tasks to assist PMO with any needed information or any requirement they may need for the project.
  • Tasks to assist PMO on managing the SR’s, assigning tasks to resources, etc.
  • Tasks to assist in closing SR when a project is completed, and the Project in the Project Module is closed.
  • Manage project-related paperwork by ensuring all necessary materials are current, properly filed and stored
  • Assist with all internal and external audit requests.
  • Completes workload on time. Monitors if transactions are processed in a timely manner.
  • Implements error-proofing method to ensure all transactions done are accurately
  • Participates in meetings and discussions with customers.
  • Coordinates with other teams/support to complete the request of customers.
  • Plans, executes and manages own workload and projects in cooperation with line leaders.
  • Assists in leading team meetings, huddles and information cascades. Communicates with the team on best practices, lessons learned, processes and product updates during team huddles/meetings.
  • Identifies problems areas and sources, offers possible solutions and escalates to line leaders/seniors when necessary.
  • Completes personal individual development plan and implements agreed training/development activities.
  • Assists the team lead in identifying team opportunities and challenges. Provide sound recommendations to line leaders and/or stakeholders by translating, enhancing and consolidating information into forms that can be used for decision making of the top management.
  • Support projects related to quality improvement.
  • Actively participates in team activities and initiatives.
  • Fulfil other reasonable duties and projects as required.
  • Serves as back-up for next level similar or related function for business continuity.
  • Serves as point-of-escalation for product-specific technical/procedural queries from peers and junior members.
  • Manages/handles at least 1 company/platform/business unit project/initiative.
  • Coordinates and networks with other members of the team to complete assigned tasks.
  • Participates in cross-business unit committees as a contributor.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in business or related discipline
  • 0 – 2 years of experience focused project coordination or related discipline
  • Must have strong proficiency with MS Office, specifically Excel and Word.
  • Must be self-starter, adaptable and flexible to operate with minimal direction and little or no supervision while working in a complex and changing environment
  • Exercise independent judgment and discretion with ability to identify problems and make recommendations for resolution
  • Demonstrated leadership, strong dedication to teamwork and integrity within professional environment
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills
