job.title: Field Service IX - Power
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Senior Customer Service Engineer will support the Operations Manager-Power in ensuring service commitments are met and enhancing customer satisfaction through new initiatives. We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Field Service Engineer with a bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering to join our team. This role focuses on efficient service delivery, providing on-site service, maintenance, and support for critical electrical systems in data centers, including Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication, negotiation, and customer-handling skills, good logical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities, and a solid understanding of electrical systems and data center operation.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, and analysis of UPS systems, PDUs, STS, electrical panels, lithium-ion batteries, BMS, and other critical electrical equipment in data centers.
  • Provide incident reports to customers and prepare required documentation for Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for the regional team. Collaborate with the regional team to ensure timely RCA release.
  • Track daily service activities and pending cases from various customers. Working closely with the team leads to coordinating engineers in resolving on-site issues within SLA, while maintaining clear and proactive communication with customers regarding progress updates.
  • Collaborate with the Service Sales team to provide solutions for system replacement, system enhancements, and procedures for replacements.
  • Offer technical support, resolve electrical system issues, and provide solutions to customer inquiries through Service Sales, including service reports and technical recommendations to enhance system performance and reliability.
  • Develop standardized documents and Sales toolkits to support customer engagement, including standard procedures for service activities.
  • Create internal documentation for onboarding new engineers, such as standard operating procedures for each service activity, and conduct annual reviews to validate and update documentation.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of service activities, including work orders, service reports, incident reports, and technical recommendations, ensuring compliance with QA/QC standards.
  • Adhere to safety regulations and company procedures while working on-site, ensuring a customer-focused and professional approach that aligns with Vertiv’s world-class service standards.
  • Manage product claims and returns within the agreed SLA, conduct monthly stock reviews, update spare parts lists from new project handovers, and ensure timely replenishment for urgent cases.
  • Assist in training junior engineers and technicians on electrical systems and best practices.
  • Stay updated on company products and services through ongoing training (both online and at the Manila Academy) and apply this knowledge to enhance technical proficiency.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor of Engineering; Electrical or related field.
  • Experience with advanced UPS models and other backup power solutions.
  • Familiarity with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools.
  • Certifications in UPS maintenance, electrical safety, or similar fields are a plus

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Diligent, honest, patient, highly disciplined, and with an unlimited commitment to providing service.
  • Proficient in Thai and English communication skills.
  • Capable of working independently with minimal supervision, self-driven, and able to work under pressure.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and detail oriented.
  • Committed to service excellence and goal oriented.
  • Strong interpersonal skills.
  • Capable of working under pressure and being self-driven.
  • Proven experience (7+ years) in field service engineering, specifically with UPS systems and data center electrical systems.
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems, including UPS, Battery Lithium, STS, PDUs, transformers, and power distribution.
  • Ability to troubleshoot, analyze and prepare root cause analysis report (RCA) electrical issues, read and interpret electrical schematics, and perform hands-on repairs.
  • Familiarity with data center operations and critical power systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to interact with clients and internal teams.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
  • Knowledge of safety standards and procedures related to electrical systems.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

50% - 50%

The purpose of this position is to carry out service of equipment, after hours service, commissioning and service contracts as planned and directed by the Service Operations Manager and Service Supervisor – Power.

  • Ensure that service reports, expense claims and any other reports required by Management are completed and submitted by the due date.
  • Time Sheets must be filled out correctly (ie, accurately record of hours worked, and all call out and response times) and submitted to the Operations Manager or Service Supervisor – Power by the due date each week.  A Doctor’s Certificate must be supplied for any more than two days absence from work due to illness/injury.

  • Ensure that a level of competence is maintained to adequately handle the degree of technology required by application to training available and personal updating.

job.title: Sr. Procurement Category Manager, Data Center Sourcing and Procurement (DCSP)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Infrastructure team provides AWS and Amazon.com with the compute, network and datacenter capacity that are the foundations of the retail and cloud business. We are seeking a Procurement professional to support the APAC data center procurement space in India.

As a Sr. Procurement Category Manager, you will create and implement sourcing strategies for the complex construction procurement and related categories and collaborate with internal business partners and suppliers to reduce risks and costs for Amazon. You will develop mechanisms and metrics to hold suppliers accountable for performance and delivery. Additionally, you will drive results through methods that include competitive bidding, negotiating, and analyzing data and market trends for your category. You will also create global Procurement processes and tools to drive innovation across teams.

Key job responsibilities Manage General Contractor and Construction Procurement category Strategy and Delivery for India

Construction material supply chain sourcing and program management

Achieve cost savings through negotiations, value engineering through the supply chain, and strategic initiatives

Analyze category data and metrics to establish and implement procurement category strategies

Understand trends in customers’ needs and concerns across categories and regions to influence customers’ priorities

Provide in-depth knowledge about the supply market and supplier capabilities, technically and geographically, to the business.

Develop mechanisms and metrics to track supplier performance related to delivery, quality, and cost

Create supplier scorecards to measure and track supplier performance

Lead business reviews to discuss best practices and issues and to ultimately improve supplier performance and strengthen business partnerships

Innovate within the procurement space, automating and/or improving tools or processes to better support the Procurement Lifecycle

Provide support throughout the contracting process, as well as management of contracts post-execution

Some travel may be required, up to 25%.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • 2+ years of program, project or product management, or leading product implementation experience
  • 6+ years of related industry experience
  • 8+ years of data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent experience
  • 8+ years of high volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related field
  • Experience in data analysis using tools such as Excel, Pivot Tables, SQL, Tableau, or equivalent
  • Experience in high-volume manufacturing operations or sourcing environments
  • Experience with Continuous Improvement and Six Sigma methodologies
  • Experience in global supply chain management, managing cross-functional teams in a fast-paced consumer electronics product company
  • Experience in program, project or product management, or leading product implementation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience in data centers, infrastructure service providers, or related technology companies
  • Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
  • Experience in procurement practices working with engineering, supply chain and Tier 1 OEM partners
  • Experience practicing best-in-class procurement processes (category management, benchmarking, should-cost models, RFX, reverse auction, contracting, or equivalent)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: ID-LB Cabling Infrastructure Tech, Data Center Operations
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Key job responsibilities Key Job Responsibilities ID-LB Cabling Infrastructure Tech at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • Adhere to security and safety best practices in the data center.
  • Installation and testing of copper and Fiber Optic cabling.
  • Creating/attaching labels and barcodes

. Understanding of test equipment (power meter / light source, OTDR, VFL, Fluke, network analyser, copper / fiber cabling test equipment) . Basic build and troubleshooting of network devices.

  • Managing inventory of related materials by checking and coordinating all materials to be delivered to site daily
  • Adhering to defined escalation processes and standard operating procedures.
  • Work in noisy areas with hotter and colder temperatures than standard office environmental conditions.

. Regularly work at heights and from ladders. . Experience with a ticketing system

  • Ability to travel within geographical work area is required. Occasional work in tight and/or narrow spaces, such as under raised floors

Basic Qualifications

  • Diploma/Graduation in a technical field or equivalent practical experience
  • 1-2 years of project management experience or operations planning experience
  • 1-2 years’ experience with physical network infrastructure deployment and troubleshooting
  • 1-2 years’ experience with network cabling (fiber optic & copper)
  • English language communication ability
  • Basic knowledge of computer hardware and network cabling.
  • Ability to work well with others in a team environment, displaying excellent time management skills and the ability to follow direction.
  • Able to work at heights or use ladders for continued periods
  • Have strong attention to detail, maintain high quality standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Substantial background in large scale datacentre network implementations and support.
  • Knowledge of Copper and Fiber Optic testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read basic layout drawings and floorplans.
  • Industry standard certifications (CompTIA, CITY & GUILDS Cabling cert or equivalent).
  • Previous experience working in a Data Center environment (racking & stacking gear, cable management).

job.description:

You'll build strong relationships with C-level executives and technical leaders, understand their business objectives, and provide tailored cloud solutions to address their unique challenges. Your expertise will help customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and achieve cost optimization. You'll work collaboratively with AWS teams, partners, and customers to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, identify new opportunities, and expand existing relationships.

With a deep understanding of the banking and enterprise landscape, you'll provide thought leadership, drive deal closure, and ensure exceptional customer satisfaction. If you're a motivated relationship-builder with a passion for cloud innovation, this role is a great fit

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives and technical leaders at top bank and enterprise customers
  • Understand customer business objectives, challenges, and cloud adoption goals - Develop tailored AWS solutions to address customer needs and drive business outcomes
  • Drive growth and adoption of AWS services among assigned customers

  • Identify new business opportunities and expand existing relationships
  • Provide thought leadership and expertise on AWS services and cloud innovation

job.title: Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Support, AWS Enterprise Support, ASEAN
job.description:
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.

Would you like to join one of the fastest-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers across all industries and sizes—including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare, Industrial and Manufacturing, Media and Entertainment, Telecom, Big Data, and more—gain the best value and service from AWS?

At AWS Enterprise Support we're looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support and influence our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technology areas including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, AI/ML, Application-level Services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role but rather an opportunity to be the technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start-ups to conglomerates and enterprises—serving as their advocate to AWS product teams.

Key job responsibilities

  • You'll build solutions, provide technical guidance, and advocate for the customer
  • Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy while reducing cost and complexity
  • Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
  • Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you'll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade-offs, and risk management
  • Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C-suite executives
  • Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
  • With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
  • Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed prelaunch planning
  • Being part of a wider Enterprise Support team, you'll provide post-sales consultative expertise
  • Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
  • Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.

A day in the life As a trusted advisor you'll have a direct impact in helping our customers gain the most value from cloud technology. You'll craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services.

Our Technical Account Managers partner with some of the most iconic businesses in the country. These range from rising startups building their business from scratch through to large enterprises going through significant transformation. You'll provide advice on architecture support strategy project and launch planning as well as ongoing operational issues.

Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager team here https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EBA_8o0F9D0

  • Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
  • Bachelor's degree

Preferred Qualifications

job.title: Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team in a content-and-frameworks role. Customers across the region are asking the same questions about building securely with AI — how to give autonomous agents an identity, how to defend against prompt injection, how to govern the AI development lifecycle, how to evidence AI governance for a regulator. The approaches that answer these questions are being proved with customers today; what's missing is the layer that turns them into clean, documented, deployable patterns the whole field can use. You build that layer.

Working hands-on, you take validated approaches and turn them into reference implementations that work out of the box. You test them against real customer requirements, then package them into a published library that Solutions Architects across the region draw on. Your work is the difference between a pattern proved once and a pattern the whole region can reuse.

You are technically self-sufficient: you write the code, build the reference implementation, test it, and document it so a Solutions Architect in any area can adopt it without specialist presence. We are looking for a builder who enjoys taking a defined but difficult technical problem and turning it into an elegant, well-documented answer others can build on. Deep AWS experience helps but is not required at entry; we can teach the services. What we need is strong hands-on technical craft, security depth, and the instinct to build things that scale beyond yourself.

Key job responsibilities

  • Take validated Secure AI approaches (agentic-AI identity patterns, AI security frameworks, AI development lifecycle controls, guardrail and governance-evidence patterns) and build them into clean, deployable reference implementations — working code, not slideware.
  • Test each pattern against real customer requirements to confirm it holds, then package it into the published library that the field draws on.
  • Write the code, reference architectures, and documentation to a standard that a Solutions Architect or partner in any APJC area can adopt without specialist presence.
  • Work with the AWS service teams (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) — bringing field requirements and customer data into the product conversation and taking away clarity to turn into guidance.
  • Stay current on the AWS AI and security product set, translating new and upcoming capability into field-ready reference implementations as it lands.
  • Surface customer needs and gaps as feature requests, contributing to the feedback loop that shapes what ships next.

A day in the life You start the morning building out an agentic-identity reference implementation that two areas have asked for. A customer engagement last week surfaced a gap around cross-account tool-use authorisation; you build the fix, test it, and update the library entry so every area gets the improved version.

Mid-morning you join a session with the AgentCore service team. You bring the field data — what APJC customers are hitting on non-human identity — and take away clarity on what can ship as guidance now versus what needs a product change. You'll turn that into an updated reference architecture this week.

After lunch you go heads-down and build — hands on keyboard — turning an AI development lifecycle control you prototyped into a documented reference implementation with code, deployment steps, and a short workshop a field Solutions Architect could run themselves.

You close the day handing the finished pattern to the go-to-market team to fold into the next immersion-day curriculum, publishing the write-up to the field, and briefing the Associate SA on what's ready to be packaged into next week's community event. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you build it once, and the whole region gets to build on it.

About the team

APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As one of two Solution Architects, you build the reusable technical foundation both programmes scale on. You work with the AWS service teams who build the products and the field teams who take guidance to customers. You will have a clear development path, a peer community of specialists, and see your work reused across the entire region.

Basic Qualifications

  • 4+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
  • 2+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
  • 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working within software development or Internet-related industries
  • Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
  • Experience working with AWS technologies from a dev/ops perspective

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
  • 5+ years of technical engineering experience
  • Experience communicating effectively with senior leadership
  • Experience engaging and presenting to senior executives (CXO level).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
  • Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. job.title: AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect
job.description:
Title: Job Application for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect at SUBMER

Markdown Content: ![Image 1: Banner](https://s101-recruiting.cdn.greenhouse.io/job_board_renderer/job_board_configurations/banners/400/277/210/original/Careers_Header_3.png?1786531541)

[![Image 2: SUBMER Logo](https://s101-recruiting.cdn.greenhouse.io/external_greenhouse_job_boards/logos/400/393/810/original/submer-logo.png?1776345366)](https://www.submer.com/)

[Back to jobs](https://job-boards.eu.greenhouse.io/submer)

AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

India

**Location & work modality: India ( Remote)

About Submer

Submer enables organizations scaling AI to overcome the limits of traditional datacenters across power, compute density and efficiency.

We design and deliver scalable, high-density AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling, supporting everything from early AI deployments to full-scale production environments.**

What Impact you will have

We are looking for AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect

Department: Solutions Engineering / Presales

Position Summary

The AI Infrastructure Solutions Architect is responsible for designing end-to-end AI infrastructure solutions that enable customers to deploy scalable, high-performance AI and HPC environments. The role combines technical presales, solution architecture, infrastructure sizing, and deployment planning to deliver commercially viable and operationally sound AI infrastructure solutions.

The architect serves as the technical authority for compute, networking, storage, AI software stack, and infrastructure integration while working closely with Sales, Delivery, Product Management, OEM partners, and the Facilities Presales & Design teams to ensure that the AI infrastructure requirements are fully aligned with the data center's power, cooling, space, and physical infrastructure capabilities.

This role owns the AI infrastructure architecture and complements the facility design process.

What you will do

Key Responsibilities

  • AI Infrastructure Presales
  • Partner with Sales to qualify AI infrastructure opportunities.
  • Engage with customers to understand AI workloads, performance expectations, scalability requirements, and operational objectives.
  • Conduct technical discovery workshops and architecture discussions.
  • Prepare technical proposals, presentations, and solution demonstrations.
  • Support RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses.
  • Serve as the trusted technical advisor throughout the sales lifecycle.
  • AI Infrastructure Solution Architecture

Design complete AI infrastructure solutions including:

  • GPU compute clusters
  • AI Factory infrastructure
  • HPC platforms
  • High-performance storage
  • AI networking fabrics (Ethernet, InfiniBand, RoCE)
  • Kubernetes and container platforms
  • AI software stack integration
  • Cluster management
  • Security architecture
  • Monitoring and observability
  • Automation platforms
  • Scalability and expansion planning

Develop:

  • Solution architecture
  • Infrastructure sizing
  • Bill of Materials (BoM)
  • Reference architectures
  • Technical specifications
  • Solution documentation
  • Deployment architecture
  • Infrastructure Integration with Data Center Design

Work closely with Facilities Presales, Design, and Engineering teams to ensure the AI infrastructure solution is fully compatible with the proposed data center environment.

Provide technical inputs related to:

  • Rack power density
  • Rack layouts
  • GPU server deployment
  • Network topology
  • Cable density
  • Space requirements
  • Liquid cooling interfaces
  • CDU connectivity requirements
  • Infrastructure dependencies
  • Expansion strategy

Validate that the AI infrastructure can be successfully deployed within the facility constraints without owning the facility design itself.

  • Solution Validation & Delivery Readiness

Collaborate with Delivery and Engineering teams to ensure solution feasibility.

Support:

  • Technical design reviews
  • OEM interoperability validation
  • Deployment planning
  • Installation readiness
  • Factory acceptance planning
  • Site acceptance planning
  • Commissioning support
  • Technical handover to delivery teams

Maintain ownership of the AI infrastructure solution throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Operational Architecture

Ensure the proposed solution is designed for long-term operational success by considering:

  • Serviceability
  • Scalability
  • High availability
  • Redundancy
  • Cluster management
  • Monitoring
  • Capacity management
  • Firmware lifecycle
  • Upgrade strategy
  • Infrastructure observability
  • Operational support requirements
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

  • Sales
  • Product Management
  • Delivery
  • Professional Services
  • Facilities Presales
  • Facilities Design & Engineering
  • OEM partners
  • System Integrators
  • Customer Infrastructure teams
  • AI Engineering teams

Act as the primary technical interface for all AI infrastructure-related discussions.

Technical Expertise

AI Compute

  • NVIDIA GPU platforms
  • AMD GPU platforms
  • Intel AI platforms
  • GPU cluster design
  • AI Factory architectures
  • HPC infrastructure

Networking

  • Ethernet (100/200/400/800G)
  • InfiniBand
  • RoCE
  • Spine-Leaf architectures
  • AI fabric design

Storage

  • Parallel file systems
  • High-performance NAS
  • Object storage
  • NVMe-over-Fabrics
  • AI data pipelines

Software

  • Kubernetes
  • Docker
  • Slurm
  • NVIDIA AI Enterprise
  • GPU scheduling
  • Cluster management
  • Infrastructure automation

Infrastructure

  • Server platforms
  • Rack integration
  • Infrastructure sizing
  • High-density deployments
  • Liquid-cooled server technologies
  • Infrastructure monitoring
  • DCIM integration

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Master's degree is preferred.
  • 8–15 years of experience in enterprise infrastructure, HPC, AI infrastructure, or solution architecture.
  • At least 5 years in a customer-facing Presales or Solutions Architecture role.
  • Experience designing GPU-based AI infrastructure and high-density compute environments is highly desirable.

Preferred Certifications

  • NVIDIA Certified Professional (or equivalent)
  • AWS Solutions Architect
  • Microsoft Azure Solutions Architect
  • Red Hat OpenShift
  • VMware VCP
  • Cisco CCNP/CCIE
  • Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD)
  • ITIL Foundation

Core Competencies

Technical

  • AI Infrastructure Architecture
  • GPU Compute Platforms
  • HPC Infrastructure
  • Infrastructure Sizing
  • Solution Design
  • AI Networking
  • Storage Architecture
  • Kubernetes
  • AI Platform Integration

Business

  • Technical Presales
  • Solution Consulting
  • Proposal Development
  • Technical Bid Management
  • Customer Engagement
  • Executive Presentations

Collaboration

  • Cross-functional leadership
  • Stakeholder management
  • Technical mentoring
  • OEM engagement
  • Customer relationship management

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
  • You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands.

Our inclusive responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

job.title: Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)
job.description:
:

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Houston, Texas

Apply

Group Legal Counsel (Bilingual English/Spanish)

Location: Remote (US-based strongly preferred)

Department: Legal

Reports To: General Counsel

Employment Type: Full-Time

About Submer

Submer designs and delivers end-to-end AI datacenter infrastructure built around industry-leading liquid cooling.

We help organizations scale AI beyond the limits of traditional datacenters by enabling higher density, greater efficiency and lower environmental impact – accelerating time-to-AI from first deployment to full production.

What impact you will have

We are seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive Group Legal Counsel to join our growing team. This role will provide critical support to the Legal Department across a variety of corporate, commercial, compliance, and administrative legal matters. The ideal candidate will ideally be based in the the US and possess professional fluency in both English and Spanish, as they will support legal matters and documentation involving Spanish-speaking stakeholders and operations in Spanish-speaking jurisdictions.

This is an excellent opportunity for a strong, commercially minded, high-performing legal professional who enjoys working in a fast-paced, international business environment and partnering closely with executive leadership, outside counsel, and cross-functional teams.

What you’ll do

Corporate & Commercial Transactional Support

  • Act as a strategic legal partner at the group level, advising, reviewing and supporting negotiations on large client project agreements, partnerships, and vendor/supplier contracts across entities and jurisdictions.
  • Support fundraising activity: coordinate diligence, review and negotiate term sheets, MoUs, subscription agreements, SAFEs/convertible instruments, and related financing documents alongside outside counsel and finance.
  • Review and negotiate a wide range of commercial agreements, from high-value client/vendor contracts to routine administrative documentation.
  • Partner with corporate finance on transactional matters, including entity structuring, intercompany agreements, and support for M&A or investment activity as needed.

Corporate Governance & Compliance

  • Lead entity management, board documentation, and corporate record maintenance across the group's legal entities, spanning multiple jurisdictions (including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India).
  • Own regulatory filings, corporate compliance requirements, and monitoring of key deadlines and renewals across all jurisdictions where the group operates.
  • Design and drive internal compliance initiatives and policy management, ensuring policies are actually usable and adopted, not just written.
  • Flag legal and regulatory risk proactively to leadership, with practical recommendations rather than just issue-spotting.

Global & Cross-Border Legal Support

  • Draft, review, and translate legal, corporate, and business documents between English and Spanish; support Spanish-speaking employees, vendors, customers, and legal advisors.
  • Coordinate with local counsel across the group's jurisdictions; including Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India; to align global agreements with local law and practice. Note: the company is actively expanding internationally, so this footprint will likely grow.
  • Serve as a central point of contact for cross-border legal questions, helping the business navigate differing regulatory, employment, and contracting norms across regions.
  • Proactively build familiarity with the regulatory norms of new jurisdictions as the company expands into them, rather than waiting to be asked.
  • Flag where local law expertise or local counsel input is needed, and manage those relationships efficiently to avoid duplicated or unnecessary external spend.

Legal Operations & Efficiency

  • Own and modernize the company's legal operations function — contract lifecycle management, document repositories, matter tracking, and legal request intake.
  • Identify and implement process improvements, templates, and playbooks that reduce turnaround time and reliance on outside counsel.
  • Build and maintain a library of standard forms (NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements, employment-related documents) to accelerate day-to-day contracting.
  • Set and manage the outside counsel strategy: decide what should be handled in-house vs. externally, negotiate rates/scopes, and review external counsel work product for quality and cost before it reaches leadership.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Work alongside another senior lawyer to cover the full scope of the group's legal needs - this is a genuine partnership role
  • Bring independent judgment to the table: proactively flag risks, propose alternatives, and voice disagreement constructively rather than simply executing instructions.
  • Operate effectively amid organizational change - the company's structure is actively evolving, and this role will need to adapt scope and priorities as that unfolds rather than expecting a fixed mandate.
  • Mentor and potentially oversee paralegal or junior legal support as the function scales.

What you’ll need

  • Law degree and membership in good standing of a bar of a U.S. State, preferably Texas.
  • Minimum 7–15 years of experience as a practicing attorney, ideally with a mix of law firm and in-house/corporate legal department experience.
  • Fully remote role — you can be based anywhere in the world; US preferred and maintaining U.S. business hours (Central Time) required.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Able to operate semi-autonomously with modest supervision
  • Strong commercial legal background
  • Industry experience in technology, fintech, or other relevant commercial sectors
  • Comfort working across a genuinely global legal footprint (currently Spain, the US, Taiwan, Saudi Arabia, Australia, and India, with further international expansion expected) - you don't need to already be an expert in each local law, but you should be willing and able to build familiarity with new regulatory norms as the company grows into new markets.
  • Demonstrated experience drafting, negotiating, and managing a broad range of commercial and corporate contracts across borders.
  • Experience supporting mid-large-scale fundraising, financing, or investment transactions (equity, debt, or venture-style deals).
  • Strong grounding in corporate governance, entity management, and regulatory compliance in a multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction structure.
  • Track record of managing outside/local counsel relationships across multiple countries and controlling legal spend.
  • Excellent judgment, organizational skills, and ability to prioritize across competing demands.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality, professional ethics and handling highly sensitive information.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and document/contract management systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting international, multi-entity business operations across more than one region (e.g., Europe, North America, Middle East, Asia-Pacific), and comfort operating in a company that is actively expanding into new markets.
  • Experience in engineering, manufacturing, technology, infrastructure, construction, or data center industries.
  • Prior experience building or improving a legal operations function from the ground up.
  • Notary Public certification (or willingness to obtain) is a plus.

Key Competencies

  • Multi-Jurisdiction & Cross-Border Coordination
  • Willingness to Learn New Regulatory Environments
  • Spain-Qualified, Bilingual (English/Spanish)
  • Commercial & Transactional Judgment
  • Corporate Governance & Compliance
  • Legal Operations & Process Design
  • Outside Counsel Management & Cost Control
  • Independent Judgment & Constructive Pushback
  • Adaptability & Comfort with Ambiguity
  • Confidentiality & Integrity
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Leadership

What we offer

  • Attractive compensation package reflecting your expertise and experience.
  • Medical Insurance Plan.
  • 401k Employee volunteer contribution Plan.
  • A great work environment characterized by friendliness, international diversity, flexibility, and a hybrid-friendly approach.
  • You´ll be part of a fast-growing scale-up with a mission to make a positive impact, offering an exciting career evolution.

Our job titles may span more than one job level. The actual base pay is dependent on a number of factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands.

Our inclusive responsibility

Submer is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected category under applicable law.

job.title: Associate Director/ Director, Southeast Asia (Real Estate Investment)
job.description:
About Us

Headquartered and listed in Singapore in 2021, CapitaLand Investment Limited (CLI) is a leading global real asset manager with a strong Asia foothold. As at 5 November 2025, CLI had S$120 billion of funds under management. CLI holds stakes in eight listed real estate investment trusts and a suite of private real asset vehicles that invest in demographics, disruption and digitalisation-theme strategies. Its diversified real asset classes include retail, office, lodging, industrial, logistics, business parks, wellness, self-storage, data centres and private credit.

Job Description

As part of the CapitaLand Investment SEA business, you will be part of the SEA Investment team, reporting to the Head of Investment. You will play a pivotal role in supporting and leading investment, M&A, and related activities within the Southeast Asia (SEA) Investment landscape. Your key responsibilities will encompass the following areas:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement comprehensive investment strategies to support existing funds and facilitate the creation of new funds, with the objective of growing Funds Under Management (FUM).
  • Identify and secure pipeline assets for the fund through proactive deal sourcing and origination efforts.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to develop optimal investment structures and capital strategies to enhance investment returns.
  • Perform comprehensive market studies, develop operating assumptions, and conduct financial analyses with investment team to evaluate the feasibility of potential investments.
  • Conduct thorough due diligence and negotiations on potential pipeline assets and fund-related investments, ensuring compliance with investment criteria and risk management standards.
  • Oversee the preparation and submission of investment-related documentation required for internal and fund investment committee approvals.
  • Ensure successful execution of divestment transactions to optimize portfolio performance.
  • Lead and mentor junior investment team members fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement.

Requirements

  • Good understanding in a wide variety of asset classes.
  • The Company may assign additional duties and/or vary the scope of work according to business requirements. Flexibility and adaptability to evolving business needs are essential.
  • Experience in fund management is preferred, but open to exploring candidates with fund management perspective, with a solid track record of deal experience in Southeast Asia.
  • Open to candidates from banking sector but possess good knowledge of Real Estate.
  • Proficient in stakeholder management.
  • Resourceful, solution-oriented with the ability to connect the dots to drive successful investment outcomes in a dynamic and competitive environment.

Benefits

  • Flexible benefits with comprehensive medical coverage for self and family
  • Training and development opportunities
  • Subsidised rates at Ascott serviced residences-
  • Strong advocate of staff volunteerism
  • Wellness programmes

Closing Statement:

At CapitaLand, we advocate fair employment practices, and recruit talents based on merit and fit with our Corporate values. We provide equal opportunity for all qualified persons and build an inclusive workplace regardless of race, gender, age, religious belief or nationality.

Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

job.title: Sales Specialist(Tier 1 Sales)
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager

Mission Statement

Drive profitable sales growth in Auto Tier1 market. Develop, implement, and manage the global/local account strategy focused on share of wallet growth, profitability, and customer satisfaction. Coordinate the sales activities and manage resolution of specific customer problems.

Based in Shanghai.

Your responsibilities

  • Extend and penetrate business with current global and local key accounts.
  • Explore and develop new customers, switch customers and system integrators from competitors, mainly in automotive metal structure parts, such as new energy vehicle (NEV) battery, battery tray, chassis, etc.
  • Establish « Roadmaps » per offering (Robots, Robot Cells, Full Turn-key Solutions and Customer Service) for the end customers and system integrators.
  • Being responsible to deliver the annual sales target in terms of value and margin, drive sustainable business growth.
  • Monitoring and analyzing the competition in the market and collecting market status and trend.
  • Complete the necessary reporting documents and tasks required by the company timely.

Your background

  • Nice and outgoing personality, enterprising, aggressive, love sports, good at teamwork.
  • 6+ years of sales and marketing experience, especially in NEV industry.
  • First-hand knowledge and network of automation in Automotive industry is preferred.
  • Must be willing to travel extensively.
  • A bachelor’s degree or above.
  • Fluency in reading and writing in English is preferred.
  • Proficient in using Microsoft office software.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Regional Senior Customer Support Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking a proactive and customer-focused Regional Senior Customer Support Specialist to support the sales and service activities of ABB Motion business across Malaysia, Singapore, and Thailand Market. In this role, you will work closely with ABB Local Sales Units to provide technical and commercial support, respond to customer inquiries, prepare quotations, and help identify new business opportunities. You will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer service, building strong customer relationships, and supporting the growth of the business within the assigned region.

The Work Model for this role is: #LI-Hybrid

  • Configuring products mechanically and electrically using available tools and systems.
  • Providing professional technical and commercial support to customers and local sales teams.
  • Supporting in achieving sales targets related to revenue, profitability, and product mix.
  • Collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver the best solutions for customers.
  • Supporting in identifying new business opportunities in line with the country sales strategy.
  • Managing sales administration, quotations, customer follow-ups, and support project execution when required.
  • Traveling within the assigned region to engage customers, implement marketing initiatives, build relationships, and contribute to continuous team improvement.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering is required; master’s degree is an advantage.
  • Candidates with a background in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering providing sales support and other techno-commercial activities.
  • Relevant experience in a similar role, ideally within an international or multicultural business environment.
  • Strong commercial awareness with a proactive, customer-focused, and sales-driven mindset.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and stakeholders.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English; proficiency in additional languages is considered an asset.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel within the assigned geographic region for short-term business assignments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and capable of working independently while collaborating effectively within a team environment

What’s in it for you

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Motion provides pioneering technology, products, solutions and related services to industrial customers to increase energy efficiency, improve safety and reliability, and maintain precise control over processes. The portfolio includes motors, generators and drives for a wide range of applications in all industrial sectors.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: ソリューションセールススペシャリスト/Solutions Sales Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Solutions Sales Leader - APAC

__

ポジション概要（Position Overview）

本ポジションは、ABBエナジーインダストリーズ事業（日本）におけるソリューションセールスの担当者として、LNGターミナル、石油化学コンプレックス、製油所、水素製造設備、発電所といった大規模エネルギーインフラ案件に対する戦略的アカウントマネジメントをリードしていただきます。

  • ### 多様なステークホルダーとの信頼関係構築および意思決定への影響力

会社概要（More about us）

ABBエナジーインダストリーズは、石油・ガス、化学、ライフサイエンス、発電、水処理などの分野において、安全性・効率性・持続可能性を向上させるソリューションを提供しています。

50年以上にわたる業界知見を強みに、自動化、デジタル化、電動化を統合したソリューションにより、オペレーション効率の向上、リスク低減、エネルギー消費および廃棄物削減を実現しています。

ぜひご応募をご検討ください。詳細は当社ウェブサイトをご覧ください：

www.abb.com

###

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the execution of small to medium size projects. Each day, you will ensure that all related activities are executed in accordance with procedures, regulations, standards, specifications and targets. You will also showcase your expertise by leading the project team members to achieve project requirements, deliver contracted deliverables, and meet the committed project result.

The work model for the role is: #Li-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Ensuring projects are executed in compliance with ABB policies, contractual requirements, and project management best practices while maintaining high standards of HSE performance.
  • Monitoring and controlling project scope, schedule, resources, risks, and financial performance, including invoicing, costs, expenses, cash flow, and opportunity management.
  • Leading contract and claims management activities, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations and securing Variation Orders for all scope changes and additional work.
  • Collaborating with Supply Chain Management to procure required services, materials, and equipment, while supporting supplier negotiations, claims resolution, and project changes.
  • Serving as the primary customer interface and escalation point, fostering strong stakeholder relationships and ensuring effective communication throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Driving successful project completion through lessons learned, formal customer acceptance, contract close-out, and project closure in accordance with contractual and organizational requirements.

Qualifications for the role

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, electronics, or related engineering discipline.
  • 5 to 8 years of project management experience, preferably in Automation, Electrification, Digital, or industrial projects.
  • Strong understanding of project management principles, including project financials, cash flow management, budgeting, risk management, and contractual administration.
  • Proficiency in project management and enterprise systems, including Microsoft Project and SAP ERP.
  • Experience working within process industries such as Pulp & Paper, Metals, Cement, Mining, or other heavy industries across Southeast Asia is highly advantageous.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills, with strong proficiency in spoken and written English and the ability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and customers.
  • Demonstrated commitment to workplace safety, continuous learning, innovation, and flexibility to travel as required within the region.

What's in it for you?

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day

More about us

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Safe Coding
job.description:
About the job

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Google’s Product Security team is a global force of over 300 engineers in Zurich, Munich, Sunnyvale, Seattle, San Francisco and some other exciting places around the globe.

Our mission is as critical as it gets: Keep Google products secure and their users safe.

The Safe Coding team contributes to that mission by managing some of the biggest risks in software security. We innovate at scale by making secure coding effortless, for everyone.

In this role, you will help anchor our Software Supply Chain security team and co-lead innovation at scale to make secure coding absolutely effortless for everyone.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.

Responsibilities

  • Lead by example, driving engineering excellence across the team while actively mentoring and developing technical talent.
  • Partner closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, and Technical Program Managers (T/PgMs) to define, refine, and execute the team’s goal, roadmap, and broader AI strategy.
  • Stay ahead of the evolving agentic threat landscape and navigate a dynamic AI environment, leading fast-paced, creative problem-solving to address emerging and legacy technical challenges.
  • Cultivate strong, actionable partnerships across internal stakeholders including Google's software supply chain integrity program and executive leadership as well as external industry leaders and academic partners.

job.title: Software Engineer Manager, Netsoft
job.description:
About the job

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams.
  • Set clear expectations with individuals based on their level and role and aligned to the broader organization's goals. Meet regularly with individuals to discuss performance and development and provide feedback and coaching.
  • Develop the mid-term technical goal and roadmap within the scope of your teams. Evolve the roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
  • Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area, and write product or system development code to solve ambiguous problems.
  • Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

job.title: Data Center Facilities Technician I, Electrical
job.description:
About the job

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical engineering, mechanical engineering and HVAC systems in the world. Facilities Technicians at Google data centers operate, monitor and support physical facilities conditions. Some of these duties will include heating and cooling of air and water, power supply, generators, UPS systems, electrical distribution and control and monitoring systems. You regularly help inspect, maintain and repair various data center systems such as piping and non-critical electrical or mechanical system components). You provide daily assistance to senior technicians as you read blueprints/schematics, conduct tours of systems and assess their working order.

As an advocate for best practices, you develop creative approaches to reducing operational costs while improving overall data center efficiency. You ensure that environmental and safety standards are consistently met, identifying problems and making repairs quickly. In emergency situations or abnormal conditions, you manage data center performance issues and outages to minimize the recovery time from failures.

As a Facilities Technician, you will operate, monitor, and support physical facilities conditions for our data centers.

The Data Center team designs and operates some of the most sophisticated electrical and HVAC systems in the world. We are an upbeat, creative, team-oriented group of engineers committed to building and operating powerful data centers.

Responsibilities

  • Co-Lead and ensure the electrical system compliance including local legal and Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) policies.
  • Work proactively for ensuring electrical system reliability.
  • Co-Lead the commissioning activities on Level 4 functional test and Level 5 Integrated System Test (IST).
  • Manage and support electrical system operation.
  • Co-Lead the electrical system maintenance program including preparing the technical specification, procurement and maintenance vendor performance management.

Shape the Future of Smart Buildings with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we're a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings. For more than 140 years, we've helped customers optimise energy performance, reduce carbon emissions, and improve operational efficiency across some of the world's most critical facilities, including data centres, hospitals, pharmaceutical sites, advanced manufacturing facilities, and leading universities.

Backed by industry-leading technology, deep technical expertise, and a world-class service organisation, we deliver innovative solutions that make buildings safer, smarter, and more connected. When you join Johnson Controls, you're joining a team that is redefining the future of the built environment.

About the Opportunity

Due to continued growth, we're seeking an experienced BMS Technician to join our high-performing Queensland Service Team based in Brisbane.

This role is ideal for a seasoned BMS professional who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, working across diverse customer sites, and building trusted relationships with clients. You'll be responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimising sophisticated building automation systems that support mission-critical operations.

You'll have the autonomy to manage your day-to-day work while being backed by a highly skilled national technical support network and a global organisation committed to your professional development.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary package + fully maintained company vehicle
  • Overtime opportunities available
  • Work-life balance and flexible work arrangements
  • Ongoing technical training and development
  • Access to remote specialist engineering support
  • Exposure to complex and high-profile customer sites
  • Clear pathways into senior technical, engineering, project, and leadership roles
  • Stability and career growth with a global industry leader

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform service, maintenance, fault finding, and repairs on Building Management Systems (BMS) and associated HVAC control systems
  • Diagnose and resolve complex system and communication faults
  • Deliver contract servicing and reactive breakdown support
  • Conduct system performance analysis and optimisation
  • Prepare quotations and manage small upgrade projects
  • Commission and validate control system modifications
  • Build and maintain strong customer relationships through technical expertise and responsive service
  • Ensure all work is completed safely and in accordance with company and industry standards

About You

We're looking for an experienced technician who is passionate about technology, customer service, and delivering high-quality outcomes.

You will ideally have:

  • Minimum 3 years' post-apprenticeship experience in Building Automation, BMS, or Building Controls
  • Strong knowledge of commercial HVAC systems and mechanical services
  • Experience diagnosing and servicing BMS controls and field devices
  • Electrical Disconnect/Reconnect Licence (essential)
  • Strong IT, networking, and system integration skills
  • Excellent problem-solving and fault-finding capability
  • Outstanding customer communication skills
  • A proactive approach to safety and continuous improvement
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence

Build Your Career with Johnson Controls

At Johnson Controls, we actively promote from within and invest in our people. Whether your goal is to become a technical specialist, move into project delivery, or develop into a leadership position, we'll provide the training, support, and opportunities to help you get there.

If you're an experienced BMS Technician looking for more challenging work, greater career opportunities, and the backing of a global market leader, we'd love to hear from you.

Only applicants with current Australian working rights will be considered.

Please note that pre-employment checks, including reference checks, medical assessments, criminal history checks, and drug & alcohol testing, form part of our recruitment process.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

At Johnson Controls, diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our success. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and create better outcomes for our customers, communities, and employees. We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to contribute, grow, and succeed.

job.title: Technical Lead
job.description:
Technical Lead

Johnson Controls (JCI) is searching for a highly skilled and experienced Technical Lead to lead a team of developers and testers on the construction of JCI’s internal and customer facing web and mobile applications. The ideal candidate will have 8+ years of technical leadership capable of driving development and testing efforts in an agile environment.

Responsibilities

The Technical Lead will provide technical leadership as we design and build robust, elastic, and maintainable mobile and web-based applications. You must be a self-starter having a thorough understanding of Spring Boot, REST and SOAP services, ReactJS, Oracle or comparable RDBMS systems, SQL, Microsoft Azure software development and deployment tools, design patterns, and deployment strategies.

You will report to the Customer Experience Engineering Manager and work closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Solutions Delivery Leads, Solutions Architects, and partner companies as we deliver fresh and modern customer experience portals and mobile solutions to Johnson Controls North America customers.

The following areas are expected of the Technical Lead:

  • Technical Leadership: Lead end-to-end design, development, and deployment of scalable web applications using modern front-end (ReactJS), back-end (Java/Spring Boot), RDBMS (Preferably Oracle) technologies.
  • Architecture & Strategy: Define system architecture, ensure code quality, and drive adoption of best practices in performance, security, and maintainability.
  • Team Management: Lead developers and testers, conduct code reviews, and foster a collaborative environment to deliver projects on time.
  • Innovation & Upskilling: Stay updated with emerging technologies, introduce new tools/frameworks, and upskill the team to maintain a competitive edge.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required, specializing in computer science, engineering, or related field
  • Minimum 8+ years of experience leading technical teams and architecting web and mobile applications
  • Strong experience with building complex web and mobile applications using onshore and offshore developers
  • Strong experience with providing technical guidelines to developers and performing code reviews
  • Strong experience with ReactJS and Spring Boot development
  • Strong experience in design, construction, and deployment of REST and SOAP services
  • Strong experience with Oracle or comparable RDMBS, SQL, and creating stored procedures
  • Experience with cloud platforms (with a strong preference for Microsoft Azure)
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure App Services, REDIS cache, and other cloud-based development tools
  • Experience with AI development tools, e.g. GitHub Copilot
  • Experience with incorporating Okta authentication and authorization into web and mobile applications
  • Experience with troubleshooting and solving application memory and performance issues
  • Experience with WebSphere Portal (HCL DX), WebSphere Application Server, and WebSphere Content Manager, a plus
  • Experience with JavaServer Pages (JSP) and JavaServer Faces (JSF), a plus
  • Experience with Agile/Scrum development practices and concepts
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
  • Experience and desire to work within a fast-paced, iterative development environment

job.title: RTR Functional Analyst
job.description:
RTR Functional Analyst

At Johnson Controls, we help customers create smarter, healthier, and more sustainable buildings. Our teams work across finance, operations, and technology to support business performance and deliver outcomes that matter.

In this role, you will help strengthen Record to Report processes and support key finance activities in a collaborative environment where accuracy, service, and continuous improvement are valued.

Role Overview

We are looking for an RTR Functional Analyst with 4-6 years of experience to support Oracle Fusion Financials processes, month-end close activities, and finance transformation initiatives. You will work closely with RTR leads and cross-functional stakeholders to improve process performance, support issue resolution, and help ensure reliable financial operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, enhancement, and day-to-day operation of RTR processes and solutions in Oracle Fusion Financials.
  • Work with finance and project teams to analyze current and future-state R2R processes and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Assist with month-end close activities, including process coordination, issue follow-up, and reporting support.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to support general ledger, fixed assets, intercompany, and tax-related process requirements.
  • Participate in UAT by preparing scenarios, executing tests, documenting results, and tracking defects through resolution.
  • Gather business inputs, document process requirements, and help translate them into practical system and process solutions.
  • Prepare reports, validate data, and support decision-making with clear analysis and accurate documentation.
  • Partner with finance, IT, and other functional teams to resolve issues and support successful delivery of enhancements and projects.

How You Will Do It

  • You will own your deliverables with accuracy, accountability, and integrity, especially during month-end and issue resolution.
  • You will stay close to the process, understand upstream and downstream impacts, and remove blockers quickly for finance users and project teams.
  • You will use clear analysis, candor, and continuous improvement to simplify RTR activities, close gaps, and strengthen controls.
  • You will work as one team with finance, IT, and cross-functional partners, sharing knowledge and balancing different perspectives to reach the best outcome.
  • You will use Oracle Fusion Financials and Excel to validate data, analyze results, and support accurate reporting.
  • You will keep documentation current and communicate progress clearly so stakeholders understand risks, dependencies, and next steps.
  • You will bring a structured, proactive approach to testing, issue follow-up, and process coordination.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 4-6 years of experience in RTR, record-to-report, finance operations, or ERP project environments.
  • Good understanding of Oracle Fusion Financials modules, including GL, FA, Intercompany, and Tax.
  • Familiarity with R2R business processes and month-end close processes.
  • Strong Excel skills, including working with data, formulas, and reconciliations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting ERP implementation activities or finance transformation programs.
  • Exposure to UAT, change management, or end-user training support.
  • Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, HFM, or OneStream.

Why Join Us

Join a team that values collaboration, practical problem-solving, and process excellence. At Johnson Controls, you will have the opportunity to support meaningful finance operations while contributing to an organization focused on delivering smarter and more sustainable outcomes.

If you are ready to bring your RTR expertise to a dynamic finance environment, we invite you to apply today.
