job.title: QA Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

We are looking for an experienced Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer with a strong background in both automation and manual testing, particularly using Selenium with Java or C#. The ideal candidate will be a self-motivated and detail-oriented professional with a keen eye for identifying software defects and ensuring the delivery of high-quality products. This role supports a hybrid work model, offering flexibility to work both in the office and remotely.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Automation: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium with Java or C# to ensure the quality and reliability of web applications.

2. Manual Testing: Conduct thorough manual testing, including functional, regression, and exploratory testing, to identify defects and verify software functionality.

3. Test Planning: Create comprehensive test plans and test cases based on project requirements and design specifications.

4. Azure Integration: Leverage knowledge of Azure and Azure DevOps to integrate testing activities into the development and release pipeline.

5. Defect Management: Document and track defects, working closely with developers and stakeholders to ensure timely resolution.

6. Performance Testing: Conduct performance and load testing as required to assess application scalability.

7. Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve testing processes and methodologies and contribute to a culture of quality excellence.

8. Collaboration: Collaborate with development teams to ensure early testing integration and work closely with cross-functional teams to drive product quality.

9. Reporting: Provide clear and concise test reports, highlighting test results, defects, and progress to project stakeholders.

10. Documentation: Maintain up-to-date test documentation, including test cases, test plans, and automation scripts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/MCA or a related field.
  • 4 to 10 years of QA experience, with a strong focus on both manual and automation testing.
  • Proficiency in test automation using Selenium with Java or C#.
  • Experience with Playwright & TypeScript
  • Experience in API testing using Postman, REST Assured, Karate API automation tool, or using similar tools
  • Experience with GitHub
  • Strong knowledge of Azure and Azure DevOps for test management.
  • Experience working with Agile teams.
  • Experience with hybrid work arrangements.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality results.
  • Certifications related to testing and quality assurance are a plus.

任职要求 基本要求

  • 1.本科及以上学历，计算机、自动化、车辆工程、电子信息或相关专业；
  • 2 3年及以上系统测试或复杂系统测试经验，有自动驾驶、智能网联或工程机械相关经验者优先；
  • 3.熟悉软件测试理论、测试流程及缺陷管理流程；

4.具备良好的系统性思维，能够从整体架构角度分析问题。

技能要求技能要求

  • 1.了解自动驾驶系统测试流程与相关技术；
  • 2.熟悉自动驾驶系统功能测试用例设计方法；
  • 3.了解TCP/IP/MQTT/DDS/ROS/HTTP/HTTPS等通信机制；
  • 4.熟练使用Linux环境使用经验，能够进行日志拉取、分析和问题定位；
  • 5.熟悉并使用过矿山自动驾驶测试相关工具者优先；
  • 6.熟悉至少一种测试脚本语（如C++/Python/Shell等）或有测试自动化经验加分；

加分项（可选） 参与过 L2+/L4自动驾驶或无人矿卡项目； 熟悉功能安全（ISO26262）、SOTIF或相关安全测试理念； 有矿山、港口、封闭园区无人驾驶项目经验。

job.title: Lead, Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Client Solutions
job.description:
Job Description

The Director of Enterprise Client Solutions acts as the primary deal architect, story orchestrator, and strategic execution lead for the Chief of Enterprise. He / she leads a team of client-facing orchestrators to align multidisciplinary teams to pitch and convert large complex enterprise opportunities into technically feasible, commercially sound, multi-year deals. This role requires a highly effective communicator who can engage and influence C-suite, procurement, and Board-level stakeholders through clear, compelling executive narratives that articulate EBG’s distinctive value proposition.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology Advisor

  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, including business, technology, procurement, and operational leaders.
  • Works closely with Strategic Account GMs to drive strategic account plans, including client priorities, whitespace opportunities, stakeholder maps, competitive position, and growth actions.
  • Lead executive client engagements, value-discovery workshops, solution briefings, and business reviews.
  • Act as the single orchestration point for strategic clients, ensuring coordinated engagement across internal teams.

Solution and Pursuit Leadership

  • Identify, qualify, and shape complex opportunities across connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, data and AI, digital workplace, managed services, and industry solutions.
  • Translate client challenges into clear value propositions, business cases, solution roadmaps, and commercial propositions.
  • Lead multidisciplinary pursuit teams comprising account managers, solution specialists, architects, bid, pricing, commercial, delivery, and partners.
  • Drive bid strategy, win themes, executive sponsorship, solution governance, risk reviews, and proposal quality for priority pursuits.
  • Ensure solutions are commercially sound, technically deliverable, scalable, and aligned to the client’s target operating model.

Delivery, Service and Value Realisation

  • Ensure a robust handover from pursuit to delivery, with agreed scope, assumptions, risks, commercials, success measures, and executive governance.
  • Partner with delivery and service-management leaders to resolve escalations and protect client outcomes.
  • Lead post-implementation value reviews to identify service improvements, upsell opportunities, renewals, and references.
  • Champion client experience, ensuring commitments made during the sales process are delivered in practice.

Internal and Partner Orchestration

  • Mobilise service lines to define offerings, product roadmaps, and specialist support required for client opportunities.
  • Work with technology services tribes on solution architecture, technical assurance, implementation approach, and managed-service design.
  • Build and activate strategic partnerships with technology providers, system integrators, and regional delivery teams.
  • Develop reusable account insights, industry plays, solution blueprints, and client references.

Experience and Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise technology, telecommunications, consulting, managed services, or complex solution sales.
  • Demonstrated experience leading strategic accounts and multi-service solution pursuits.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise connectivity, cloud, cybersecurity, digital workplace, data/AI, and managed services.
  • Proven commercial acumen, including business-case development, pricing, contract negotiation, and margin management.
  • Experience working with C-suite and senior public-sector, regulated-industry, or large-enterprise stakeholders.
  • Ability to influence cross-functional teams without direct reporting authority.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Win rate for priority pursuits and complex bids
  • Renewal rate, expansion revenue, and customer lifetime value
  • Client satisfaction, executive relationship strength, and referenceability
  • Delivery handover quality, major-escalation resolution, and value-realisation outcomes
  • Forecast accuracy and adherence to commercial and pursuit governance

job.title: Information Security Engineer, Early Career, Product Security
job.description:
About the job

There's no such thing as a "safe system" - only safer systems. Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. As a Security Engineer, you help protect network boundaries, keep computer systems and network devices hardened against attacks and provide security services to protect highly sensitive data like passwords and customer information. Security Engineers work directly with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. You also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

You use your industry experience to own and drive the resolution of complex security incidents, policy questions and technical security issues.

The new Singapore-based team will be dedicated to scaling our operations and risk reduction efforts through advanced automation and remediation.

In this role, you will be a builder and a breaker, fostering a collaborative environment to achieve collective goals. You will have a technical foundation and cross-functional collaboration skills to manage complex security issues and operations. You should have a breadth of application security experience such as web security, mobile security, API security, authentication and access control, threat modeling, conducting security assessments, etc.

The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. job.title: Network Design Engineer
job.description:
About the job

Google is proud to boast a network that provides service to millions of Internet users around the world. The Network Engineering team is responsible for operating that network reliably and at scale. As a member of the team, you have a direct impact on design and feature enhancements to keep our systems running smoothly. You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Google's complex network generates a constant stream of challenges which require you to continually be innovative with an evolving set of technologies. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

In this role, you will plan and design the world's largest Google's production global network. You will be involved in a series of dynamic large scale capacity augments, migrations, and new technology introductions globally to transition to Alphanet. You will execute and build upon our goal of an incredible optical, edge, core and campus network infrastructure for Alphanet to support continuous growing customer and ML demand. You will ensure that the network is efficiently built on-time while meeting our reliability and policy requirements. You will develop network planning and design best practices, processes and tooling. You will promote, create and contribute to automation tooling/scripts into network planning and design. You will drive the software automation roadmap to improve the quality and reduce the cycle time for network planning and design.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Review Google's network architecture standards and design global infrastructure that meets capacity requirements and SLOs while optimizing the CapEx/OpEx balance.
  • Incorporate newly New Product Introduction (NPI)’d solutions into plans and designs, ensure planning and design toolsets and business processes are ready for NPIs.
  • Evolve the business processes throughout their lifecycle (e.g., input gathering, generation, validation, publication, handoff).
  • Support establishing and maintaining business practices and policies in network planning and design (e.g., architectural/topology, hardware lifecycle, capacity/utilization target), improve performance, reliability, and reduce risk.
  • Create and promote automation tooling/scripts into network planning and design, contribute to the automation roadmap of all automatable tasks performed by the team, substantially reducing cycle time and improving quality and consistency.

job.description:

job.title: Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The Manager, Interconnect & Fixed Voice Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities

job.title: P3 Team Coordinator - Weekend Shift
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. May be required to do other reasonable manufacturing duties as assigned.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reduces production bottle necks on manufacturing product line.
  • Address and correct workflow issues.
  • Learns all positions and fills in as needed.
  • Identifies part and resources shortages and provides solutions.
  • Communicates above situations to Supervisors, Engineers and Managers as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or GED and minimal WorkKeys scores for the position.
  • 4+ Years Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead position experience.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Able to lift between 50 and 100 pounds assisted.
  • able to learn to work with all hand tools required of all positions within the area, including general work tools, pneumatic and hydraulic tools, brazing and wiring tools and equipment, forklifts, etc.

  • Able to foster teamwork and resolve conflict.
  • Able to work long hours and a variety of shits as needed.
  • Able to learn and utilize materials tracking system.

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work in an environment with temperatures occasionally above 100 degrees or below 32 degrees.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10% May need to travel when appropriate depending on product line needs.

job.title: Application Development & Support Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Data Quality Developer will play a hands-on technical role in implementing and maintaining data quality controls, monitoring frameworks, and integration solutions across our enterprise MDM ecosystem. This position requires a strong technical background combined with excellent communication skills to work effectively with business stakeholders across the globe.

Working closely with the Data Governance Council Lead, this role will be responsible for configuring data quality platforms, implementing validation rules and workflows, developing dashboards and reports, and remediating data quality incidents across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

Two Data Quality Developers will be hired — one focused primarily on the Ataccama platform (configuration, rules, profiling, monitoring) and the other focused on data quality operations outside of Ataccama (cross-system reconciliation, integrations, dashboards, remediation). Both developers serve as each other's backup and are expected to be cross-trained across all responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Data Quality Platform Configuration & Customization

  • Configure and customize data quality platforms (primarily Ataccama) to ensure optimal user experience for data management
  • Implement data quality rules, validation logic, and automated controls within the DQ platform
  • Develop and maintain workflows to manage reference data across systems
  • Build monitoring capabilities for operational processes and data quality metrics
  • Perform data profiling and analysis using platform-native tools to identify data quality issues and patterns
  • Configure DQ platform integrations with MDM, Snowflake, and enterprise source systems

Data Quality Analysis & Remediation

  • Run reports across systems to calculate data quality dimensions (completeness, accuracy, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness)
  • Execute data reconciliation reports across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • Remediate data quality incidents in a timely manner — triage, investigate root cause, and resolve
  • Identify recurring incidents and implement permanent fixes to resolve root cause issues
  • Manage incident resolution using ServiceNow to meet SLAs
  • Collaborate with MDM developers and integration developers to trace data quality issues across system boundaries
  • Analyze logs and data flows to isolate where quality degradation occurs in the pipeline

Dashboard & Reporting Development

  • Implement and maintain data quality dashboards using Power BI
  • Create business-friendly visualizations of data quality findings and trends
  • Develop reports to track quality metrics across all domains (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Build monitoring reports for operational processes and controls
  • Design health scoring dashboards that provide at-a-glance quality status for each domain

Data Integration & Synchronization

  • Implement data integrations to synchronize data across systems for quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • Develop ETL processes to support data quality and reconciliation needs (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, or platform-native connectors)
  • Work hands-on with MDM, Snowflake, and related systems to implement quality controls
  • Ensure data consistency and accuracy across the enterprise data landscape
  • Build automated data validation checks within integration pipelines

Stakeholder Collaboration & Requirements Gathering

  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions with business users
  • Elicit and document data quality requirements from stakeholders
  • Present data quality findings in a business-friendly format
  • Conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Work effectively with business users across multiple regions and time zones

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to enhance data quality processes and controls
  • Contribute to the evolution of data quality maturity in the organization
  • Support the long-term data quality roadmap
  • Stay current with data quality best practices and emerging technologies

Required Qualifications Experience

  • 8+ years of total experience in data quality, data development, or related fields, preferably in an MDM and data governance environment
  • 5+ years hands-on experience with at least one data quality platform (e.g., Ataccama, Informatica Data Quality, Talend Data Quality, or similar)
  • 5+ years advanced SQL proficiency for data analysis, profiling, quality checks, and reconciliation (e.g., Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake)
  • 4+ years ETL development experience for data integration and transformation (e.g., Informatica PowerCenter, IICS, Talend, or platform-native connectors)
  • 3+ years experience building reports and dashboards using Power BI or similar visualization tools
  • 3+ years experience with data profiling tools and techniques for root cause analysis
  • 3+ years experience with data reconciliation across multiple systems (MDM, ERP, CRM, data lake)
  • 2+ years experience with incident management and SLA-driven resolution using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira)
  • Experience working with business stakeholders across multiple regions and time zones
  • Proven track record of implementing data quality solutions and controls

Communication & Collaboration

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate technical concepts into business-friendly language
  • Experience presenting to diverse audiences including business stakeholders and leadership
  • Proven ability to conduct meetings with large audiences independently
  • Strong requirements elicitation and documentation skills
  • Comfortable working across global teams and time zones

Security & Compliance

  • Working knowledge of data security, information security practices, and SOX compliance procedures for data quality changes

Preferred Qualifications

  • Ataccama Experience: Hands-on experience with Ataccama ONE platform (DQ rules, profiling, monitoring, workflows)
  • Multi-Domain MDM Experience: Experience working with customer, supplier, contact, or item master data domains
  • Manufacturing Industry: Background in manufacturing industry, particularly across multiple countries
  • Snowflake / Data Lake: Experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data platforms for data quality monitoring and reconciliation
  • ServiceNow: Experience using ServiceNow for incident management and meeting SLAs
  • MDM Platforms: Familiarity with MDM platforms (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio) and how DQ integrates with MDM workflows
  • Certifications: Data quality or data management certifications (e.g., CDMP, vendor-specific certifications)
  • Additional Tools: Experience with data governance tools, metadata management platforms, or data catalogs
  • Agile/Scrum: Experience working in Agile delivery environments

job.title: Sr. Manager IT Management
job.description:
Job Description

Position Overview

The Engineering Manager, MDM will lead a team of developers responsible for the ongoing development, support, and enhancement of our enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) platform. This is a hands-on technical leadership role — the Engineering Manager will personally design solutions, write and review code, estimate work from loosely defined requirements, and solve complex technical problems — while also managing team delivery and performance.

This role operates under a "you build it, you support it" model — there is no separation between development and support teams. The Engineering Manager is accountable for platform stability, sprint delivery, code quality, SLA compliance, and team performance across customer, supplier, contact, and item domains.

The successful candidate must be a seasoned technical problem-solver first and a people manager second. They will work closely with the MDM Architect (who drives technical direction and design authority) and the Program Manager (who drives roadmap, stakeholder communication, and cross-functional coordination).

Key Responsibilities Engineering Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and manage a team of developers supporting and enhancing the MDM platform
  • Conduct sprint planning, prioritization, and ensure consistent monthly sprint delivery
  • Perform code reviews to maintain high code quality standards
  • Hire, onboard, and rapidly build capability in new team members
  • Foster a culture of technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement
  • Enforce the "you build it, you support it" model — ensure developers own their features through production support
  • Drive technical debt reduction and code optimization initiatives
  • Monitor and report on platform KPIs and team performance metrics
  • Work with platform vendors to drive open product issues to closure

Platform Development, Enhancement & Support

  • Lead the design and development of new MDM capabilities and features
  • Personally design solutions for complex problems and estimate effort from loosely defined requirements
  • Evaluate user stories, establish story points, and create delivery schedules
  • Oversee requirements gathering, design, development, and testing activities
  • Ensure adherence to software development best practices across the full SDLC
  • Manage incident resolution within established SLAs
  • Triage and resolve complex data issues spanning multiple systems
  • Oversee change management processes and ensure smooth deployments
  • Conduct post-production validation and manage release reversals when needed
  • Drive platform enhancements to improve stability and operational efficiency
  • Lead large-scale data migrations and bulk update operations in the MDM environment
  • Onboard new systems, organizations, and datasets to the MDM platform
  • Handle complex data reconciliation and synchronization across systems

Platform Migration & Modernization

  • Lead the technical execution of MDM modernization
  • Plan and execute phased migration strategy ensuring zero data loss and minimal business disruption
  • Design and validate data mapping between legacy and target platforms
  • Ensure feature parity and regression testing throughout migration phases

Technical Quality & Testing

  • Design and think through complex testing scenarios for platform changes
  • Lead unit testing, system integration testing, UAT, and non-functional testing efforts
  • Maintain and execute regression test cases during significant platform changes
  • Design and implement CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment
  • Conduct DR (Disaster Recovery) testing and ensure business continuity
  • Debug, refactor, and rewrite code to improve performance and maintainability

Security & Compliance

  • Ensure security best practices are followed across all platform development
  • Oversee static and dynamic code analysis to identify and remediate vulnerabilities
  • Ensure SOX compliance for all platform changes and controls
  • Maintain secure coding standards and conduct security reviews as required

Required Qualifications Technical Expertise

  • MDM Platform Experience: 8-10 years hands-on experience working with at least one MDM platform (e.g., Informatica MDM, Reltio, SAP MDM, or similar)
  • SQL Proficiency: 8-10 years of experience and advanced knowledge of SQL for complex queries, data analysis, and troubleshooting
  • Coding Skills: Hands-on ability to write, debug, refactor, and rewrite code — this is not a management-only role
  • Problem-Solving: Proven ability to design solutions for complex problems and triage issues spanning multiple systems
  • Data Migration: Extensive experience with large data migrations and bulk update operations in MDM environments
  • System Integration: Experience onboarding new systems, organizations, and datasets to MDM platforms
  • Data Mapping & Integration: Hands-on experience with data mapping and integration using at least one integration platform
  • Event driven architecture: Experience with event-driven architecture and API-first integration patterns
  • AI/ML: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts for data matching and deduplication
  • Agile: Experience with Service Now agile and project management modules

Software Development Discipline

Deep knowledge of the complete software development lifecycle including:

  • Requirements gathering and analysis
  • Technical design and architecture
  • Development and coding standards
  • Unit testing and test automation, System integration testing (SIT), User acceptance testing (UAT), Non-functional testing (performance, security)
  • CI/CD pipeline implementation and management. Change management and deployment processes
  • Release management including release, post-production validation, roll back planning and execution

Delivery Management

  • Ability to estimate effort, duration, and resource requirements from loosely defined requirements
  • Experience evaluating user stories, establishing story points, and creating delivery schedules
  • Proven track record of sprint planning, prioritization, and consistent delivery
  • Experience managing SLAs and meeting incident resolution targets
  • Discipline to maintain regression test cases and ensure platform stability during significant changes
  • Experience running daily scrums

Leadership & Communication

  • 5+ years of experience managing technical teams of 8+ developers
  • Experience hiring, onboarding, and retaining technical talent
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems in business-friendly language
  • Experience creating design and technical documentation

Preferred Qualifications

  • Multi-domain MDM experience (customer, supplier, contact, item)
  • Manufacturing industry experience across multiple countries
  • Familiarity with AI and ML modeling and production integration

job.title: Sales Operations & Support Senior Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Join a High-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence

At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology—and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.

Why Vertiv?

  • High-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.
  • Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action-focused culture.
  • Limitless Growth & Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
  • A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.

Position Summary

The Sales Operations & Support Senior Analyst is responsible for driving profitable growth through strategic pricing analysis, margin optimization, and discount governance. This role evaluates complex product configurations, develops pricing recommendations, analyzes market and sales trends, and assesses the effectiveness of discount programs to maximize revenue, profitability, and customer value. The position serves as a trusted pricing consultant to Sales Operations and collaborates closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Product Management, and business leaders to support data-driven pricing decisions. Additionally, the role leads process improvement initiatives, develops pricing tools and profitability models, supports pricing-related projects, and provides guidance, training, and escalation support to junior team members while ensuring compliance with established pricing policies and procedures.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Generate and evaluate margin calculations on complicated configuration units using approved standardized methodologies to improve margin and revenue for the business.
  • Conduct rigorous analysis of discount programs' performance, including sales volume, revenue impact, margin contribution, and customer acquisition/retention, to assess effectiveness and inform future strategy refinement.
  • Document all completed evaluations using approved master forms.
  • Obtain data from company applications and other approved sources.
  • Assign commission (if needed) using approved methodology and defined policies.
  • Leads on to updating work instructions as required.
  • Supporting, but not limited to own initiatives geared toward streamlining current processes, assisting, but not limited to creating new processes and using new technologies and systems.
  • Generate monthly reports for pricing realization, sales trends, pricing leakage and other pricing related activities establishing sales prices and opportunities.
  • Function as a reliable pricing consultant for the sales operations department.
  • Grow total gross margin dollars by identifying pricing actions that encourage higher sales values, conversion rates, margin, and customer satisfaction on complicated unit configurations.
  • Determine profit margins to aid the business in assessing the influence of customer and industry composition.
  • Lead / assist pricing-related projects including establishing timelines, defining deliverables and drafting communications or presentations.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product Offering, Order Management, VP of Sales Operations, VP of Product Marketing and the Executive Leadership Team to align discount strategies with overall business objectives and ensure effective execution.
  • Optimize pricing structures, discount strategies, and promotional pricing to maximize revenue and margin while balancing customer value and competitive positioning.
  • Work independently based on work demand notifications or as requested by the Strategic Pricing Manager.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in discount optimization and pricing analytics, and drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance discount strategies' effectiveness and efficiency.
  • Conduct price elasticity analysis to understand the impact of pricing changes on demand, revenue, and profitability.
  • Evaluate new DOP types such as DPAS (Defense Prioritization Allocation System), Large quotes, large projects, Major and GSA (Global Strategic Accounts).
  • Develop / maintain pricing tools and profitability models.
  • Assist Analyst on identifying customer needs through communication and probing.
  • Lead/ participates in conferences calls, meetings, and discussions with Sales Representatives, Sales Coordinators/ Analysts, and Managers.
  • Assists Team Lead on team meetings, huddles, and information cascades.  Communicate with the team on best practices, lessons learned, process and product updates during team huddles/meetings.
  • Execute other reasonable duties and projects as required.
  • Acts as a contingency for the next-tier equivalent or similar function to ensure business continuity.
  • Functions as the point of escalation for product-specific technical or procedural queries from peers and junior team members.
  • Offers direction and guidance to junior employees as required.
  • Conducts product/process/functional training.
  • Creating a training plan for new recruits.
  • Participates in cross-business unit committees as a contributor.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree of any 4-year course
  • Preferably Degree in Finance, Statistics, Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Ecommerce or related technical field.
  • 5-year experience in customer service
  • 2-year experience with Vertiv Customer service environment

job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

To perform CFD Analysis for system and component levels using Different Software’s Such as Celsius EC & Reality DC from Cadence, Ansys Icepak, and has exposure in Electronics cooling. Engineer needs to Conduct model checks and/or creating parametric models with available CAD packages and perform the sensitivity analysis independently with limited assistance. He / She should be able to generate the CFD mesh/model and run steady/ transient flow/thermal analysis using different software’s and analyze the simulation results as well as prepare the reports clearly and independently. Utilize the analytical skill set and simulation tools to analyze the fluid flow systems and recommendations for design improvements. He/ She should have knowledge on fan operation and performance curve as well as flow bench / Wind tunnel testing. He/ She should be clear about temperature measurement and handling thermocouple sensors. He/ She need to Participate and support the potential product development opportunities on a global level and provide technical expertise towards design. One must drive the virtual testing and reducing the physical tests, develop and improve of current best practices of the computational methods / Hand Calculations

  • Should have full time ME/M.Tech with specialization in Thermal Engineering/ Aerospace / heat power from a reputed Institute.
  • Undergone on Fluid Mechanics/CFD/ Heat Transfer / Thermodynamics during masters
  • Minimum 3 years CFD analysis experience  in CFD Analysis software Such as Celsius EC & Reality DC from Cadence, Ansys Icepak
  • Comfortable in working with Creo/Pro-E for model check
  • Desirable to have a knowledge in AI Application and 1D Simulation
  • Knowledge about Datacentre, and its analysis will be added advantage
  • Should be able to Interpret analysis results for base design and suggest modification
  • Sound knowledge of fundamentals of Heat Transfer, Fluid Mechanics & Thermodynamics
  • Knowledge of telecommunication products like cabinets, enclosures, Datacentre, Refrigeration Cycle etc.  & Sheet metal will be added advantage
  • Proactive towards identifying the issues and solving the problems

job.title: P3 Team Coordinator - 2nd Shift
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. May be required to do other reasonable manufacturing duties as assigned.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reduces production bottle necks on manufacturing product line.
  • Address and correct workflow issues.
  • Learns all positions and fills in as needed.
  • Identifies part and resources shortages and provides solutions.
  • Communicates above situations to Supervisors, Engineers and Managers as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or GED and minimal WorkKeys scores for the position.
  • 4+ Years Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead position experience.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Able to lift between 50 and 100 pounds assisted.
  • able to learn to work with all hand tools required of all positions within the area, including general work tools, pneumatic and hydraulic tools, brazing and wiring tools and equipment, forklifts, etc.
  • Able to effectively direct the flow of others.
  • Able to foster teamwork and resolve conflict.
  • Able to work long hours and a variety of shits as needed.
  • Able to learn and utilize materials tracking system.

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work in an environment with temperatures occasionally above 100 degrees or below 32 degrees.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10% May need to travel when appropriate depending on product line needs.

job.title: Engineer II - Field Service - Projects
job.description:
Job Description

Brief Job Description:

A Battery Specialist is responsible for startups, certifications, preventative maintenance and scheduled maintenance for battery systems. The Battery Specialist (BS) is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate. The BS is also required to maintain continuous communication with CRC, Area/District Offices, and direct manager.

At Vertiv, we design, manufacture, and service the mission-critical infrastructure technologies for vital applications in data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial environments. We are the trusted Service Provider for 70%+ of Fortune 500 companies, including industry-leading data centers and providers of colocation and cloud service.

Why Vertiv is the best company for Field Service professionals:

  • Vertiv is an industry leader in Technology and Services with a best-in-class Customer Service and Safety culture
  • Company leaders have many years of hands-on Field Service experience in this industry and many others
  • Tremendous focus is placed on employee technical and leadership development
  • Technical Training takes place in our state of the art Training Academy or Regional Training Center with a strong focus on immersive, hands-on learning
  • Competitive benefits include: Company vehicle, smartphone, laptop, personal protective equipment (PPE), other tools-of-the-trade, 401k, Profit Sharing, & Generous PTO/Vacation Plan, Medical, Vision & Dental & more
  • Abundant technical resources including 24/7 Technical/Factory Support and technical online libraries of product documentation, work instructions, and self-help troubleshooting guides
  • Company-wide commitment to promoting a strong work/life balance
  • An employer-of-choice for Veterans with technical backgrounds

Duties & Responsibilities:

Role:

  • Rely on direction to accomplish goals
  • Perform a number of work related tasks
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training

Technical:

  • Communicate with National Technical Support on issues
  • Perform work related tasks according to company guidelines for scheduled maintenance
  • Inspection of UPS Battery systems to identify problems
  • Maintain customer’s UPS battery system in proper condition
  • Install battery systems according to the manufacturers specifications
  • Implement Field Change Notices according to published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips
  • Render on site and phone assistance to customers.

Safety:

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

Administration:

  • Provide accurate and timely reporting according to company guidelines
  • Time cards, expense reports, mileage reports, ticket closure, forms et al.
  • Maintain individual inventory in accordance with company policy
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the Customer Response Center where applicable
  • Maintain company property according to company policies
  • Vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, pager, et al.

Customer Satisfaction:

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each designated assignment
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer for where applicable
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates according to company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

Performance:

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate according to company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Meet or exceed on-site response time requirements for each customer
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedures
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications
  • Managers, co-workers, Support Services, electronic communications, et al.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities:

  • Required experience (one or more of the following)
  • Excellent working knowledge of electricity and the electro-chemical theory of batteries
  • Strong Mechanical aptitude
  • Equivalent industry experience
  • Interpersonal Skills
  • Professional
  • Reliable
  • Team Player
  • Must be able to read and interpret electrical line diagrams and blueprints
  • Working knowledge of OHM’s law and electronic theory
  • Technical skills
  • Ability to make basic site evaluation skills to include: environmental temperature, and general operating conditions
  • Elementary fix/repair techniques based on directed supervision
  • Capable of completing tasks and return unit to full operating conditions based upon directed supervision
  • Ability to summarize and report all work related tasks performed
  • Strong skill sets:
  • Communication skills
  • Customer service skills
  • Troubleshooting skills
  • Safety procedures
  • Organizational and planning skills
  • Computer skills
  • Mechanical aptitude

Working Conditions:

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

Physical Requirements

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.  Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

job.description:
Job Description

Join a High-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence

At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology—and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.

Why Vertiv?

  • High-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.

  • Limitless Growth & Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
  • A Place for Everyone:Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.

Position Summary

The position is responsible for supporting daily service coordination activities to ensure timely and accurate scheduling/dispatching of field engineers. Working as part of the regional operations team, the role focuses on operational execution, data accuracy, customer coordination, and adherence to service delivery standards.

This position is critical in maintaining operational stability by ensuring all scheduling activities are executed accurately, on time, and aligned with service level commitments.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Scheduling & Service Coordination
  • Support the scheduling and dispatching of field service engineers based on priority, availability, and service level agreements (SLAs).
  • Book service works through phone and email coordination with customers.
  • Ensure accurate and complete entry of job details into the system for engineering execution.
  • Monitor daily scheduling queues and respond to new maintenance contracts and service repair requests.
  • Update systems in real time to reflect appointment confirmations, changes, and completions.
  • Operational Execution & Accuracy
  • Run and review daily reports to capture new service requirements and ensure proper scheduling actions are taken.
  • Ensure all service documentation and job descriptions are complete and accurate.
  • Review engineers’ service reports to ensure all PO line items are completed and validate that charges align before moving orders to “Awaiting Billing.”
  • Verify completeness of service details prior to handoff to billing to prevent delays or rework.
  • Maintain high attention to detail to prevent scheduling conflicts, billing discrepancies, or data inaccuracies.
  • Escalate discrepancies, documentation gaps, or operational issues to Senior Analysts or Supervisors in a timely manner.
  • Customer & Internal Coordination
  • Act as first-level point of contact for scheduling-related enquiries.
  • Coordinate with parts supply, technical teams, and sales when required to ensure readiness for service delivery.
  • Provide timely updates to customers regarding booking confirmations and changes.
  • Always maintain professional and service-oriented communication.
  • Compliance & Process Adherence
  • Perform all activities in compliance with International Trade Compliance (ITC) regulations and company policies.
  • Follow established scheduling processes and standard operating procedures.
  • Support transition activities by actively participating in knowledge transfer sessions and applying learnings in daily operations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field required.
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
  • 1–3 years relevant experience in scheduling, coordination, customer service, or operations support.
  • Experience working with scheduling or service management systems preferred.
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Good communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Comfortable handling phone and email customer interactions.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Basic exposure to service operations, scheduling, or coordination roles
  • Familiarity with operational systems or service management tools
  • Awareness of process improvement practices (e.g., Lean, standard work, checklists
  • Experience supporting cross-functional coordination (e.g., parts, technical teams, customer service)

job.title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

Key job responsibilities As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

  • You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
  • You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
  • You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
  • You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
  • You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:

  • Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
  • Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
  • Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
  • Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
  • Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
  • This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

About the team About AWS Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
  • Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
  • Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
  • Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. job.title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.

Key job responsibilities As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:

  • You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
  • You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
  • You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
  • You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
  • You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:

  • Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
  • Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
  • Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
  • Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
  • Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
  • This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations. The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
  • You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
  • You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
  • You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
  • You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
  • More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
  • This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
  • This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).

  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.

job.title: DCO Tech 3, BOM NORTH - DCO
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Data Center Operations designs, installs & maintains the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure. We are looking for skilled Data Centre Operation Technician at Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”) with a passion for technology to help us expand AWS Cloud offerings to the next level.

To keep up with this demand on both disk and network capacity, we continue to expand our Data Centers in India. Also, our content delivery AWS service, CloudFront, has expanded its Data Centers presence by over 50% worldwide in the last 12 months and are expecting to increase by a similar number over the next 12 months. This requires talented people to build & manage. We hope it is you! Come and work for the world’s most Customer Centric Company. The location for this job to be discussed, as there may be opportunities in several India locations. The Opportunity: Data Centre Operation Technician This role is a unique opportunity to work in some of the most cuttingedge data centers in the world. ADSIPL’s data centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will be working on changing the face of Cloud technology in India.

Key job responsibilities A Data Centre Operation Technician at ADSIPL, expectation from role are:

  • You work as part of the Operations team, whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
  • Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
  • You may be the primary contact point for both internal customers (for example: Network Engineers, Systems Engineers, Software Developers, Technical Operations) and external service partners (Hardware Vendors, Contractors, Service Providers among others).
  • You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.
  • You perform on-call duties and will participate in Data Center operations, handling scheduled maintenance and change management activities that require monitoring of the data center infrastructure.
  • You participate in team meetings for metric analysis and to discuss achieving daily/weekly goals.
  • You possess knowledge of the policies and procedures, including safety and security, within your department, and understand the appropriate application of such knowledge
  • You contribute to documentation on technical issues through root cause analysis for operational issues that occur, and contribute to process improvement initiatives relevant to the data center environment.
  • More experienced technicians may assist in training less experienced members of the team.
  • This position also has a physical component requiring the ability to lift & rack equipment up to 18kg; it may require working in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines.
  • This role involves covering 24x7 shift rotation

job.title: Sr. Data Engineer - Supply Chain Automation
job.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, and low-cost cloud platform that powers thousands of businesses in over 190 countries. AWS’ Infrastructure Services - Supply Chain (AIS - SC) organization works to deliver futuristic solutions to source, build and maintain our socially responsible data center supply chains. We are a team of highly-motivated, engaged, and responsive professionals who enable the core sustainable infrastructure of AWS. Come join our team and be a part of history as we deliver results for the largest cloud services company on Earth !

Do you love problem solving? Do you enjoy learning new ideas and apply them to problems? Are you looking for real world engineering challenges? Do you dream about elegant high quality solutions? Want to be a part of an amazing team that delivers first class automation solutions to our business world-wide?

AWS is seeking a highly motivated and passionate Sr. Data Engineer - Supply Chain Automation who is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and deploying Supply Chain Application and Process Automation. In this role you will collaborate with business leaders, work backwards from customers, identify problems, propose innovative solutions, relentlessly raise standards, and have a positive impact on AWS Infrastructure Services Supply Chain. In this, you will work closely with a team of Data Engineers and Data Scientists to architect the application programming interface (API) and user Interface (UI) in context with the business outcomes. You will be using the best of available tools, including EC2, Lambda, DynamoDB, and Elastic Search. You will be responsible for the full software development life cycle to build scalable application and deploy in AWS Cloud.

In this job, you will:

  • Work with business leaders, Data Engineers, and Data Scientists to ideate business friendly software solutions.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture.
  • Develop visually appealing front end website architecture, including translating designer mock-ups and wireframes into front-end code.
  • Develop functional databases, applications, and servers to support websites on the back end.
  • Write effective APIs.
  • Test software to ensure responsiveness and efficiency.
  • Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade applications.
  • Create security and data protection settings.
  • Build features and applications with a mobile responsive design.
  • Develop technical specifications and write technical documentation.

Basic Qualifications

  • 7+ years of data engineering experience
  • Experience in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Java, Scala, or NodeJS
  • Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, computer engineering, or related field, or PhD
  • - 6+ years of non-internship professional software development experience with 3+ years of in developing Supply Chain Solutions and Software.
  • - Expertise with SQL and NoSQL databases.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
  • - Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and management to collect requirements, describe software product features, and technical designs.
  • - Having working closely with Business on Supply Chain Planning and Procurement system development.

job.description:
Proserve is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Are you interested in working with the largest enterprise organizations in Malaysia as they navigate through some of the most dynamic and disruptive transformation projects in their organization's history? Does the prospect of empowering these organizations cloud transformation success by aligning professional services to critical business and IT outcomes, overseeing and assessing engagement delivery, driving a holistic partner strategy and providing insight to accelerate rate of execution/adoption of cloud technology excite you?

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services team is looking for a Proserve Account Executive ( PAE) that can manage the working relationship with large organizations, develop a long term Professional Services strategy and execute that strategy within those accounts. The PAE is a trusted advisor for our largest and most committed customers. The role includes all aspects of business development, relationship development, delivery oversight and program management in those accounts.   Professional Services engage in a wide variety of projects for customers and partners, providing collective experience from across the AWS customer base and are obsessed about strong success for the Customer. Our team collaborates across the entire AWS organization to bring access to product and service teams, to get the right solution delivered and drive feature innovation based upon customer needs.

We are looking for a professional who has

  • Extensive experience of IT consulting/management experience, with demonstrated IT Digital Transformation experience in customer-facing roles.
  • Business consulting experience in transforming customer operations through technology including cloud adoption , ML/AI, and automation.
  • Experience with account growth, sales quotas, project and program deliveries, etc.
  • Large company account executive experience in the Financial Services Industry in IT and business consulting including relationship management, achieving growth targets, high customer satisfaction achievement, project portfolio management, and contract negotiations.
