job.title: Treasury Specialist
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Treasury Manager

About the Role

You will be a member of the team that manages ABB Robotics' Treasury activities in China and in the future across Asia, optimizing cash flows and liquidity by managing treasury operations and facilitating the execution of the group's regional treasury activities. You will be responsible for monitoring daily treasury activities, including liquidity management, trade finance, intercompany transactions, foreign exchange operations, and other treasury transactions.

The team is responsible for the liquidity, Fx exposure management, banking infrastructure, and bank accounts, and ensures its systems and processes operate efficiently, securely, and in full compliance with local regulatory requirements and Corporate Treasury standards.

You will collaborate closely with the China Treasury Manager, the Global Treasury team, business leaders and  Finance team to ensure that core treasury capabilities are in place and fully scalable for the company's future growth across Asia. This role is part of the Global Treasury organization.

Key Responsibilities

Liquidity Management

  • Monitor liquidity of the group in China and Asia, managing stand-alone and pooled bank accounts.
  • Ensure optimal daily cash positioning.
  • Execute cash centralization processes, ensuring efficient movement of funds within the Group.
  • Conduct cashflow forecasting for China and Asia entities in collaboration with the local business partners.

Foreign Exchange Operations

  • Arrange and execute foreign exchange settlement and purchase transactions per business and payment needs.
  • Monitor FX exposures and support FX risk management initiatives in the region.

Treasury & Payment Operations

  • Maintain standardized, secure, and compliant payment processes across China and relevant Asian countries.
  • Ensure timely confirmation, matching, and settlement of all treasury trades.
  • Execute bank-side operations for bill packages, including bank acceptance drafts (BAD) and commercial drafts.
  • Manage paper-based transfers and counter payments as required.

Online & Offline Banking Services

  • Manage bank reconciliations and ensure accuracy of internal records versus bank statements.
  • Oversee e-banking token-related matters including approval and allocation.
  • Handle receipt and voucher management across all accounts.
  • Maintain local banking portals, manage KYC requirements, and ensure regulatory documentation is current.
  • Manage bank-related seals and agreement documents.

Special Transactions & Accounts

  • Coordinate with banks on special transactions, including letters of guarantee, letters of credit, and other structured instruments.
  • Administer special financial accounts, including Alipay, Dilian, and other designated accounts.

Regulatory Compliance & Governance

  • Maintain a deep understanding of Chinese and regional banking regulations and ensure adherence at all times.
  • Monitor intercompany loan agreements, coordinating documentary requirements with local management.
  • Manage E-Banking portal access and maintain strong security control under the supervisory of the Group Treasury Control function.
  • Engage actively with banking partners and advisors to stay ahead of regulatory changes.
  • Perform bank account reconciliations versus internal records and support internal audit processes.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Education

  • University degree (Bachelor) in Finance, Banking, or Accounting.
  • Further professional treasury qualifications are a plus.

Professional Experience

  • At least 4 years of professional experience in a treasury function within a global company, including currency exposure management, cash management, trade finance, and financial analysis.
  • Hands-on experience with Chinese banking practices, including RMB operations, PBOC regulations, SAFE requirements, and local payment systems.
  • Experience with bill package operations (BAD, commercial drafts, Dilian) is strongly preferred.

Technical & Domain Skills

  • Strong understanding of cash and liquidity management operations such as cash pools and commercial payments.
  • Solid background in payments infrastructure, including both domestic Chinese and cross-border payment systems.
  • Adequate analytical skills and proficiency with financial data tools.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to effectively adhere to strict deadlines in a high-volume operational environment.
  • Team player with a proactive mindset, adaptable to a dynamic multicultural environment.
  • Strong communication skills for effective liaison with banks, regulators, and internal stakeholders.

Languages

  • Fluent in Mandarin Chinese (required for local banking operations and regulatory communications).
  • Proficient in English (required for regional and global coordination).
  • Other Asian languages are a plus.

-

Why Join Us

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a world-class treasury team at a pivotal moment in ABB Robotics' evolution. With SoftBank Group's acquisition creating a new chapter in global robotics, your expertise will directly shape the cash management strategy across China and Asia. You will be exposed to complex financial operations — from local Chinese regulatory requirements to regional treasury strategy — in a fast-paced, innovative environment serving a truly global business.

We offer a dynamic and collaborative culture that values strategic thinking, continuous learning, and professional growth, with strong career development opportunities within a globally recognized technology group.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world

 

This role sits within ABB’s Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We’re entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: E-Next 培训生-工程技术
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

EL Sales Support Manager - Technical Sales Support

__

公司介绍：

ABB是全球技术领导企业，致力于推动社会与行业转型，实现更高效、可持续的未来。ABB 通过软件将智能技术集成到电气、机器人、自动化、运动控制产品及解决方案，不断拓展技术疆界，提升绩效至新高度。

ABB 由两家拥有100 多年历史的国际性企业 —— 瑞典的阿西亚公司和瑞士的布朗勃法瑞公司在1988年合并而成，总部位于瑞士苏黎世。ABB拥有130多年的卓越历史，业务遍布全球100多个国家和地区，员工人数达10.5万。

ABB配电系统业务单元-应势驭能，智联 · 守护未来电网

ABB配电系统业务单元提供中压元器件、开关设备及系统解决方案，应用于不断演进的电网，实现配电网的保护，确保可靠且可预测的能源分配。配电设备是搭建在高压系统与中低压用户之间的桥梁，保障工业、商业和住宅用户的持续电力供应，同时帮助可再生能源并网。采用基于人工智能技术的智慧配电解决方案，持续提升电网韧性，并优化电力系统运行效率。我们支持客户与合作伙伴应对日益增长的电气化需求、技术革新及标准规则的变化，助其在能源转型的快速变革中应势驭能。

您的收获：

-您将与敬业、有能力、有责任心的团队携手创造价值，为未来做出正确的决定

-您将有机会收获信心和多元与包容的团队

-个性化的发展计划，有针对性的培训措施将帮助您不断提高技能

项目介绍：

-在项目过程中，经历轮岗，深度体验ABB配电系统业务单元的业务场景

-通过富有挑战性和影响力的任务发现您的兴趣和不同的职能/角色，深度参与团队合作

-通过培训和发展、导师和项目团队的全方位支持加速成长

-通过建立明确的绩效目标以及定期的绩效反馈发展个人优势

职位描述：

我们正在寻找一位充满热情的工程师，与我们一起推动中压开关柜、中压元器件及定制化解决方案（机械、电气、数字化）从设计到交付的全生命周期。在这个角色中，你将成为技术与业务的桥梁，负责电气设计、机械设计、数字化方案的全面工作，带领跨部门团队将客户需求转化为创新产品。

核心职责：

设计与方案开发：负责中压开关柜的电气/机械/数字化设计，优化方案并推动标准化；主导从客户需求、方案设计、技术验证到工业化落地的完整流程

项目管理与客户协作：把控项目进度、质量与成本，负责与客户谈判及签订技术协议，管理工业化系统（Windchill、SAP、PDM等），建立和优化定制项目标准化流程

技术支持与质量保障：为内外部提供技术支持，协助试生产，管理生产BOM，跟进并解决质量问题

职位要求:

-本科及以上学历，电气自动化、机械或相关工科专业，硕士优先，1-3年工作经验，优秀应届毕业生亦可考虑

-优秀的英语表达能力，流利者优先

-熟练应用办公软件、AutoCAD、Solidwork等工具，掌握基本编程语言

-良好的英语及沟通能力，逻辑思维清晰

-目标导向，具备创新思维、团队合作及跨文化适应能力

-强烈的主动性，善于在复杂情况下找到解决方案

加入我们，开启您的职业生涯！

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

ABB配电系统业务单元-应势驭能，智联 · 守护未来电网

ABB配电系统业务单元提供中压元器件、开关设备及系统解决方案，应用于不断演进的电网，实现配电网的保护，确保可靠且可预测的能源分配。配电设备是搭建在高压系统与中低压用户之间的桥梁，保障工业、商业和住宅用户的持续电力供应，同时帮助可再生能源并网。采用基于人工智能技术的智慧配电解决方案，持续提升电网韧性，并优化电力系统运行效率。我们支持客户与合作伙伴应对日益增长的电气化需求、技术革新及标准规则的变化，助其在能源转型的快速变革中应势驭能。

您的收获：

-您将与敬业、有能力、有责任心的团队携手创造价值，为未来做出正确的决定

-您将有机会收获信心和多元与包容的团队

-个性化的发展计划，有针对性的培训措施将帮助您不断提高技能

项目介绍：

-在项目过程中，经历轮岗，深度体验ABB配电系统业务单元的业务场景

-通过富有挑战性和影响力的任务发现您的兴趣和不同的职能/角色，深度参与团队合作

-通过培训和发展、导师和项目团队的全方位支持加速成长

-通过建立明确的绩效目标以及定期的绩效反馈发展个人优势

职位描述：

我们正在寻找一位充满热情的工程师，与我们一起推动中压开关柜、中压元器件及定制化解决方案（机械、电气、数字化）从设计到交付的全生命周期。在这个角色中，你将成为技术与业务的桥梁，负责电气设计、机械设计、数字化方案的全面工作，带领跨部门团队将客户需求转化为创新产品。

核心职责：

设计与方案开发：负责中压开关柜的电气/机械/数字化设计，优化方案并推动标准化；主导从客户需求、方案设计、技术验证到工业化落地的完整流程

项目管理与客户协作：把控项目进度、质量与成本，负责与客户谈判及签订技术协议，管理工业化系统（Windchill、SAP、PDM等），建立和优化定制项目标准化流程

技术支持与质量保障：为内外部提供技术支持，协助试生产，管理生产BOM，跟进并解决质量问题

职位要求:

-本科及以上学历，电气自动化、机械或相关工科专业，硕士优先，1-3年工作经验，优秀应届毕业生亦可考虑

-优秀的英语表达能力，流利者优先

-熟练应用办公软件、AutoCAD、Solidwork等工具，掌握基本编程语言

-良好的英语及沟通能力，逻辑思维清晰

-目标导向，具备创新思维、团队合作及跨文化适应能力

-强烈的主动性，善于在复杂情况下找到解决方案

加入我们，开启您的职业生涯！

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Business Manager - Connected Care
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Business Manager - E2E

Mission Statement:

To lead the profitable growth of ABB Robotics' Connected Care business in the China market—encompassing services, software, and digital solutions—by driving a cohesive commercial and operational strategy. This role is accountable for overseeing all sales and marketing activities, as well as managing day-to-day service operations, to deliver high-quality offerings that maximize customer equipment performance, uptime, and lifecycle value. The leader will accelerate business expansion through deeper installed-base penetration and a robust go-to-market strategy, including digital market places, leveraging a competitive value proposition anchored in digital connectivity and data-driven services

Main Accountabilities and Duties:

  • Implements the global and local business strategy and ensures business development in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops proactive strategies/initiatives to increase business profits, customer satisfaction and operational effectiveness, and managing resources and competences.
  • Ensures profitable business growth through development of performance targets and leads the Connected Care unit to achieve targets.
  • Evaluates the market opportunities and decides appropriate commercial activities on service portfolio to capture the opportunities.
  • Drives productivity, delivery performance and cost optimization.
  • Delivers operational/project targets (e.g. OTD, lead time, quality, ease of doing business, etc.) to improve net promoter score (NPS).
  • Develops a customer centric and continuous improvement culture. Improves service technology, competence, field engineering tools and capabilities, business processes and procedures in line with the business strategy.
  • Drives installed-base penetration and lifecycle value growth by developing data-driven strategies to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, leveraging equipment performance data, usage analytics, and customer insights to proactively tailor Connected Care offerings (services, software, and digital solutions).
  • Drives the business growth in tight collaboration with peers from local business lines and global Connected Care management team.
  • Ensures Health, Safety and Integrity as a license to operate with adequate processes and controls and sharing functional best practices and lessons learned across the organization.
  • With support from HR, constantly drives people and organization development nurturing talents, engaging and motivating teams within a collaborative environment.

Required Knowledge, Skills, Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with 10+ years of experience in the automation industry, 8+ years of experience in leadership role
  • Sound financial business understanding, experience in P&L responsibilities
  • Demonstrated leadership and experience in managing large industrial equipment installed base
  • Commercially savvy in Annual Recuring Revenue (ARR) based business and digital solutions
  • Exposure to Physical AI is a plus
  • Proven and strong communication, influencing, stakeholder management and change management skills
  • Fluency in both Chinese and English, and ability to work in a multi-cultural environment

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

job.title: Mechanical Engineer
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

At ABB, we help important industries outrun - leaner and cleaner.

Every person here makes that happen. By rethinking, rewiring, and improving, we combine the world’s best minds and technologies to elevate performance to a whole new level.

Your Role and Responsibilities

· Make product outline drawing, connection drawing and other customer drawings and technical documentation, guarantee timeliness and high quality.

· Do detailed mechanical design of generator components, provide all kinds of required drawings and documents, guarantee timeliness and high quality.

· Use engineering specific design software, generate and maintain bill of materials, guarantee the integrity of material information required by order fulfillment process.

· Deal with engineering change and other accidental incidents, support the production process in time. Provide technical support to Production, Purchasing, Sourcing and Service etc.

Qualifications for the Role

· Bachelor and above, Mechanical engineering, mechatronics integration, automation and other related

· over 3 years of experience in motor and generator design

· Knowledge in NX/TC and other 3D design software, AutoCAD, Office programs

· Fluent in written ,reading and oral  English.

· Ownership. Proactive. Good communication and team work skills, willingness and capability to learn.

· Proficient in mechanical design, with experience in the research, development, and design of motors and generators preferred.

What’s in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Benefits

ABB offers a full range of benefits to help you thrive at work and beyond.

More about us

The High Power Division offers a comprehensive product portfolio of large AC motors and generators. The Division’s induction, synchronous and special design motors and synchronous generators power critical applications across industry, infrastructure and marine transportation. Combining the best available materials with superior technology, the large motors and generators are designed to operate efficiently and reliably, even for challenging processes or applications and to have low life cycle costs.

job.title: 计划主管
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Planning & Fulfillment Manager__

工作概述：

电气产品配电系统中压一次成套业务主计划和生产计划团队主管。负责销售与运营规划，制定主生产计划和生产排程；统筹运营和供应，管控项目交付全流程，确保对客户的准时交付；协调项目执行过程异常问题的快速处理，缩短总流转时间，降低在制品和成品库存。

主要职责：

  • 带领团队执行法规以及公司计划相关流程和程序，确保安全、诚信、合规；

job.title: Senior Commercial Operations Manager – Energy Industries
job.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Technical Sales Support Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

The Senior Commercial Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the development of competitive, high-quality techno-commercial proposals, ensuring each bid reflects the optimal solution, accurate costing, and alignment with both customer requirements and business objectives. Reporting to the Commercial Operations Director, this role acts as the custodian of the bid process, ensuring cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Project Execution, and Product Management to deliver compliant, timely, and profitable offers.

The Work Model for this role is: #LI-Hybrid

  • Managing end-to-end bid strategy, defining the optimal technical solution, and commercial positioning for each opportunity.
  • Overseeing all technical, financial, and project-related inputs, including cost models, cash-flow considerations, margin analysis, engineering/commissioning estimates, and resource planning.
  • Coordinating cross-functional contributions from Sales, Engineering, SCM, Finance, Legal, and Project Execution to ensure aligned, timely, and high-quality proposal deliverables.
  • Ensuring full bid governance and documentation control, maintaining accurate records, assumptions, decisions, and version history in compliance with internal audit requirements.
  • Conducting customer-facing commercial discussions, including terms & conditions, clarifications, and negotiation inputs to support Sales.
  • Monitoring and reporting bid progress, providing structured updates, dashboards, and post-bid win/loss analyses to support continuous improvement.
  • Identifying and mitigating commercial, technical, and contractual risks, supporting the formal Risk Review process and ensuring alignment with company policies.

Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, or another related discipline
  • Around 8 to 10 years’ experience in commercial operations, project management, or proposal development within industrial automation, energy, or engineering services.
  • Proficient understanding of industrial automation and control systems, with the ability to interpret technical specifications.
  • Skilled in financial modeling, cost estimation, and margin analysis.
  • Familiarity with contract terms, risk reviews, and compliance requirements.
  • Skilled in communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experienced methodological approach, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple bids under tight deadlines.

More about us

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of specialized knowledge delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

job.title: Site Supervisor, Network & Fibre Installation
job.description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability.

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Supervisor is responsible for the day-to-day site supervision and execution of Network Layer 1 installation works for large-scale data centre deployment projects.

Reporting to the Site Manager, the Site Supervisor will directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews carrying out fibre optic cabling, network rack installation, rack & stack, patching and associated physical network infrastructure works.

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the 4Ms of construction – Manpower, Method, Machine and Money (Change Management) – within assigned work fronts and ensuring daily construction activities are properly planned, resourced and executed.

A key responsibility of this position is maintaining strong control of planned versus actual progress. The Site Supervisor is expected to develop daily and weekly work plans, monitor actual productivity and completed quantities, identify variances early, and implement corrective actions to maintain the project schedule.

This is a full-time site-based position requiring practical fibre installation experience and strong hands-on construction supervision capability.

Key Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Network & Fibre Installation

  • Supervise daily Network Layer 1 installation activities.
  • Supervise fibre optic cable installation, pulling, routing, dressing, termination, splicing, patching and labelling.
  • Supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Coordinate rack & stack activities and physical installation of network equipment.
  • Ensure installations are carried out in accordance with approved drawings, cable schedules, port maps, rack elevations, method statements and project standards.
  • Verify installation quality and ensure defects are identified and rectified promptly.
  • Support fibre testing activities including OTDR, insertion loss and continuity testing.
  • Coordinate physical Layer 1 rectification works arising from network testing and troubleshooting.

4M Construction Management

The Site Supervisor is responsible for managing the following four key construction areas within assigned work fronts:

Manpower

  • Plan daily manpower requirements based on scheduled activities and installation targets.
  • Allocate installation crews to specific work fronts and activities.
  • Monitor subcontractor attendance, manpower deployment and productivity.
  • Identify manpower shortages or productivity issues and escalate them to the Site Manager.
  • Ensure appropriate skilled resources are deployed for specialised activities such as fibre splicing, termination and testing.

Method

  • Ensure construction activities follow approved drawings, method statements, installation procedures and quality requirements.
  • Brief installation teams on the correct sequence and methodology before work commences.
  • Identify buildability and installation issues and coordinate resolutions with the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Ensure approved installation methods are consistently implemented across different work crews.

Machine

  • Ensure required tools, equipment and machinery are available before commencement of planned activities.
  • Coordinate access equipment, lifting equipment, cable pulling equipment, fibre splicing machines, fibre test equipment and other specialist tools.
  • Verify equipment readiness and certification where applicable.
  • Identify equipment constraints that may impact productivity or scheduled activities.

Money / Change Management

  • Identify site conditions, instructions or changes that may result in additional work or variation to the original scope.
  • Maintain records of changes, additional works and associated site instructions.
  • Avoid proceeding with unrecorded or unauthorised additional works without appropriate escalation.
  • Capture supporting information including manpower, materials, equipment, photographs and work records for potential variations.
  • Escalate potential commercial changes promptly to the Site Manager and Project Team.
  • Support verification of subcontractor variation claims and additional work quantities.

Daily & Weekly Planning

  • Develop detailed daily work plans based on the project schedule and Site Manager’s priorities.
  • Develop weekly work plans and short-term look-ahead activities.
  • Break planned activities into measurable installation quantities and targets.
  • Confirm manpower, work fronts, materials, tools, access and information are available before work commences.
  • Coordinate daily activities with subcontractors and installation teams.
  • Conduct daily briefings to communicate work priorities, targets, constraints and safety requirements.

Planned vs Actual Progress Control

The Site Supervisor is expected to maintain clear visibility of what was planned, what was actually completed, and why any variance occurred.

  • Establish measurable daily and weekly installation targets.
  • Record actual completed quantities against planned quantities.
  • Monitor productivity of individual work fronts and installation crews.
  • Identify deviations from the daily and weekly plan as early as possible.
  • Determine causes of delays including manpower, materials, access, design information, equipment, quality issues or other trade dependencies.
  • Implement corrective actions with subcontractors to recover lost productivity.
  • Escalate significant schedule risks and unresolved constraints to the Site Manager.
  • Support development and implementation of recovery plans where required.
  • Maintain accurate records of planned versus actual progress.

Subcontractor Supervision

  • Directly supervise subcontractors and installation crews within assigned work areas.
  • Communicate daily installation targets and priorities.
  • Monitor contractor productivity, workmanship and compliance.
  • Ensure contractors have sufficient manpower, materials, equipment, drawings and access to achieve planned activities.
  • Coordinate multiple installation crews and work fronts where required.
  • Identify poor performance early and drive corrective action.
  • Maintain strong discipline around work completion and closure.

Troubleshooting & Rectification

  • Support the Site Manager in daily network troubleshooting and issue closure.
  • Mobilise fibre installers and subcontractors quickly when Layer 1 faults are identified.
  • Coordinate cable tracing, fibre testing, re-patching, re-termination, cleaning and other physical rectification works.
  • Work closely with Network Engineers during fault isolation where Layer 1 verification is required.
  • Ensure troubleshooting actions assigned to installation contractors are completed within agreed timelines.
  • Report troubleshooting status and unresolved issues to the Site Manager.
  • Capture recurring installation problems and ensure lessons learned are applied to subsequent installations.

Quality & Testing

  • Inspect installation workmanship throughout construction rather than relying solely on final inspection.
  • Ensure fibre installation complies with bend radius, routing, segregation, termination, cleanliness, labelling and cable management requirements.
  • Coordinate inspection and testing activities.
  • Verify fibre test results and ensure failed links are investigated and rectified.
  • Manage punch-list and defect rectification activities.
  • Support preparation of redlines, test records and as-built documentation.

Safety

  • Ensure all site activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Conduct daily toolbox talks and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure subcontractors follow approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Monitor housekeeping and work-area conditions.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe activities where required.

Daily Reporting

Provide clear daily reporting to the Site Manager covering:

  • Planned activities versus actual completed works.
  • Installation quantities achieved.
  • Manpower deployed.
  • Productivity achieved.
  • Active work fronts.
  • Outstanding works.
  • Constraints and blockers.
  • Quality issues and defects.
  • Troubleshooting activities.
  • Changes and potential variations.
  • Required actions for the following shift/day.

Qualifications

  • Diploma, Technical Certificate or relevant vocational qualification in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Network Infrastructure or a related technical discipline is preferred but not mandatory.
  • Candidates without formal technical qualifications will be considered where they can demonstrate strong practical experience in fibre optic installation, network infrastructure deployment and site supervision.
  • Relevant fibre optic installation, splicing, testing, structured cabling or networking certifications are advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Practical field experience and demonstrated installation capability will be given strong consideration.

Experience

  • 3–8 years of site supervision or network installation experience.
  • Practical fibre optic installation experience is required.
  • Strong preference for candidates from structured cabling contractors, fibre installation contractors, telecommunications contractors, network infrastructure contractors or systems integrators.
  • Experience supervising subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Experience with data center, telecommunications or mission-critical infrastructure projects is highly desirable.
  • Experience working in fast-track construction environments is advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

The successful candidate should have practical knowledge of:

  • Fibre optic cable installation.
  • Fibre pulling and routing.
  • Fibre termination and splicing.
  • Fibre patching and labelling.
  • OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Fibre cleaning and inspection.
  • Structured cabling systems.
  • Network racks and cabinets.
  • Rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs and patch panels.
  • Cable containment systems.
  • Cable schedules, port maps and rack elevations.
  • Basic Network Layer 1 troubleshooting.

Location

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap.

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

Considering applying? You don't need a perfect background to join our team. If you're driven and curious, there's a path for you. We back our people to grow into new domains and take on challenges beyond their previous experience.

Role Summary

The Site Manager is responsible for the end-to-end site execution of Network Layer 1 infrastructure for large-scale data center deployment projects. The role leads and coordinates subcontractors responsible for network rack move-in, rack installation, rack & stack activities, fibre optic cabling, patching, labelling, testing and associated physical network infrastructure.

The Site Manager works closely with Network Engineers during Layer 2 configuration, activation and testing, ensuring physical installation issues are rapidly identified, isolated and resolved. The role also coordinates closely with the Mechanical & Electrical (M&E) team to progressively bring up power and cooling infrastructure in line with the network deployment sequence.

A critical part of this role is daily troubleshooting management. The Site Manager is expected to establish clear ownership of faults, coordinate contractors and engineering resources, drive root-cause identification, remove blockers and ensure issues are followed through to closure without allowing unresolved problems to accumulate.

This is a site-based, hands-on delivery role requiring strong contractor management, network installation knowledge and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced data center deployment environment.

Network Layer 1 Construction & Installation

  • Take ownership of site execution for Network Layer 1 infrastructure.
  • Plan, coordinate and supervise network rack move-in, positioning and installation.
  • Manage rack & stack and physical network equipment deployment.
  • Coordinate installation of fibre optic cabling, copper cabling, patch panels, ODFs and associated network infrastructure.
  • Manage fibre pulling, termination, splicing, patching, dressing, labelling and testing activities.
  • Ensure installations comply with approved drawings, rack elevations, cable schedules, port maps, method statements and project standards.
  • Ensure physical installation readiness ahead of network configuration, testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate rectification of installation defects and punch-list items.

Subcontractor & Contractor Management

  • Manage network installation subcontractors and specialist vendors on site.
  • Translate project requirements and construction schedules into clear daily execution plans for contractors.
  • Coordinate contractor manpower, materials, tools, machinery and work fronts.
  • Monitor contractor productivity and installation performance against daily and weekly targets.
  • Ensure contractors have required drawings, materials, access, permits and information before commencing work.
  • Conduct daily coordination meetings and clearly communicate priorities and constraints.
  • Hold contractors accountable for quality, productivity, safety and timely completion.
  • Escalate resource or performance issues and drive corrective or recovery actions.

Construction Planning & Site Coordination

  • Develop detailed daily plans and short-term look-ahead plans aligned with the overall project master schedule.
  • Manage construction sequencing and work-front readiness.
  • Coordinate installation activities with other trades and project stakeholders.
  • Identify access, material, design, resource and sequencing constraints before they impact installation.
  • Coordinate closely with Project Managers, Project Engineers, Site Engineers, Network Engineers, logistics teams and other construction disciplines.
  • Track physical installation progress and maintain accurate site status.

M&E Interface & Progressive Power/Cooling Bring-Up

  • Work closely with the M&E team to coordinate progressive power and cooling readiness in line with the network deployment sequence.
  • Maintain alignment between rack installation, power availability, cooling availability and network equipment activation.
  • Coordinate progressive energisation of network racks and associated infrastructure based on construction and commissioning priorities.
  • Verify rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and associated electrical infrastructure readiness before equipment energisation.
  • Coordinate with the Mechanical team to ensure cooling systems and suitable environmental conditions are available before network equipment is powered and placed under load.
  • Participate in M&E readiness reviews and identify dependencies that could impact network rack bring-up.
  • Establish readiness progression from rack installation to power/cooling readiness, equipment energisation, Layer 1 verification, Layer 2 configuration, network testing and commissioning.
  • Coordinate with M&E, Network Engineering and Commissioning teams to develop rack, row, zone or data hall bring-up sequences.
  • Track and escalate power and cooling constraints that could delay network activation or project milestones.
  • Support troubleshooting where network equipment issues may be related to power, cooling, environmental conditions or other facility infrastructure.

Layer 1 to Layer 2 Integration

  • Act as the primary site interface between physical network installation contractors and Network Engineers.
  • Ensure Layer 1 infrastructure is complete, tested and ready before Layer 2 configuration and activation.
  • Coordinate with Network Engineers during switch configuration, network activation, connectivity testing and commissioning.
  • Support Network Engineers in isolating whether faults originate from physical infrastructure, equipment installation, cabling or configuration.
  • Coordinate physical checks, cable tracing, re-patching, fibre testing, equipment replacement and other field activities required during troubleshooting.
  • Ensure physical installation teams are available to support network activation and commissioning activities when required.

Troubleshooting & Issue Closure

A major responsibility of the Site Manager is to drive troubleshooting activities efficiently from identification through to closure.

  • Lead daily troubleshooting coordination across contractors, installation teams, vendors and Network Engineers.
  • Maintain clear visibility of all open installation, connectivity and commissioning issues.
  • Ensure every issue has a clearly assigned owner, priority and target closure time.
  • Rapidly mobilise the appropriate contractor or engineering resource when faults are identified.
  • Coordinate Layer 1 physical checks and Layer 2 engineering troubleshooting in parallel where appropriate.
  • Drive systematic fault isolation rather than repetitive or unstructured troubleshooting.
  • Remove blockers preventing troubleshooting activities from progressing.
  • Prioritise issues according to their impact on network activation, commissioning and project milestones.
  • Escalate critical or ageing issues promptly.
  • Conduct daily review of outstanding issues and drive actions through to verified closure.
  • Capture recurring issues and lessons learned to prevent repetition across subsequent racks, network zones or deployment phases.

Quality, Testing & Handover

  • Ensure Layer 1 installations meet project quality requirements.
  • Coordinate fibre OTDR, insertion-loss and continuity testing as applicable.
  • Verify rack installation, equipment positioning, cabling, patching and labelling against approved documentation.
  • Manage installation punch lists, defects and non-conformances through closure.
  • Ensure test records, redlines, as-built drawings and installation documentation are completed.
  • Support network readiness reviews and final handover to Network Engineering and Operations teams.

Safety

  • Ensure all installation activities comply with project HSE requirements.
  • Coordinate permits, toolbox meetings and pre-task briefings.
  • Ensure contractors comply with approved method statements and safe working procedures.
  • Stop and escalate unsafe work where required.

Planning & Reporting

  • Maintain daily installation and deployment trackers.
  • Report progress against planned quantities and milestones.
  • Maintain an active troubleshooting and issue register.
  • Provide clear daily reporting covering completed works, upcoming activities, blockers, troubleshooting status and critical actions.
  • Identify schedule risks early and develop recovery plans with contractors and the project team.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Telecommunications, Network Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Construction Management or a related technical discipline.
  • Relevant structured cabling, fibre optic or networking qualifications are advantageous.

Experience

  • 5–10 years of experience in network infrastructure deployment, telecommunications, structured cabling, data center fit-out or related construction environments.
  • Strong preference for candidates with a network installation contractor, structured cabling contractor, telecommunications contractor or systems integrator background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing subcontractors and installation crews.
  • Practical experience with network rack deployment, rack & stack and fibre optic installation.
  • Experience supporting network testing, activation, commissioning and troubleshooting.
  • Experience coordinating with M&E teams for progressive power and cooling bring-up is highly desirable.
  • Data center or mission-critical infrastructure experience is highly desirable.

Technical Knowledge

  • Network Layer 1 infrastructure and structured cabling systems.
  • Fibre optic installation, termination, patching and testing.
  • Network rack and cabinet installation and rack & stack activities.
  • ODFs, patch panels, cable containment and routing.
  • Cable schedules and port maps.
  • Fibre OTDR and insertion-loss testing.
  • Network equipment installation.
  • Basic understanding of Layer 2 networking and switch configuration.
  • Network testing, commissioning and fault isolation processes.
  • Basic understanding of data center rack power, PDUs, grounding/bonding and cooling readiness.

Key Competencies

  • Strong site and subcontractor management capability.
  • Strong understanding of network installation and deployment.
  • Highly effective troubleshooting and issue-management capability.
  • Ability to quickly organise resources around technical problems and drive them to closure.
  • Strong construction planning and sequencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent work fronts and technical issues.
  • Decisive and comfortable working in a fast-moving site environment.
  • Strong communication between construction, network engineering and M&E teams.
  • High level of ownership and accountability.
  • Strong attention to installation quality and detail.
  • Ability to prioritise activities according to their impact on overall project milestones.

Location & Reporting

  • Location: Wesley Vale, Tasmania

Employment Basis

Permanent full-time

Diversity

At Firmus, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds who are passionate about creating a more sustainable future through innovative engineering solutions.

Join us in our mission to revolutionise the AI industry through sustainable practices and cutting-edge engineering. Apply now to be part of shaping the future of sustainable AI infrastructure.

job.title: Fire Technician
job.description:
Join a Global Leader in Smart Building Technologies, Sustainability & Fire Solutions

At Johnson Controls, we're transforming the way the world's buildings perform. As a global leader in smart, healthy, and sustainable buildings, we help customers optimise energy consumption, reduce carbon emissions, and maintain mission-critical environments across industries including healthcare, data centres, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, education, and commercial infrastructure.

With more than 140 years of innovation and industry expertise, Johnson Controls combines world-class technology, leading service capabilities, and a highly skilled workforce to deliver solutions that make a real difference. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping customers achieve better outcomes while building rewarding and successful careers.

Join our team and receive a $10,000 sign-on bonus! This is a fantastic opportunity to be rewarded from day one while building your career with us

(terms and conditions apply).

About the Role

Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Fire Technician to join our Cairns team.

In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for the maintenance, servicing, fault-finding, repairs, and installation of a broad range of fire protection systems and equipment. You will work across a diverse customer base, ensuring systems remain compliant, reliable, and performing at their best.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections of customer sites and recommend appropriate fire protection and safety solutions.
  • Service, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair fire protection systems and equipment.
  • Carry out preventative maintenance activities in accordance with Australian Standards.
  • Complete installations and system upgrades as required.
  • Ensure all work is completed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with relevant WHS requirements.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service and maintain strong client relationships.

What We're Looking For

To be successful in this role, you will bring:

  • A strong customer-focused approach and commitment to service excellence.
  • QBCC licence and relevant industry qualifications.
  • Current Queensland Electrical Licence.
  • Experience servicing and maintaining fire protection systems.
  • Strong planning, scheduling, and time management skills.
  • Sound understanding and practical application of WHS legislation and procedures.
  • The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team environment.

Why Join Johnson Controls?

job.title: Specialist, Strategic Sourcing
job.description:
Job Description – Procurement Specialist**

We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic Procurement Specialist to join our fiber cable manufacturing team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sourcing, negotiating, and procuring critical materials and services essential for our production processes, with a strong emphasis on cost reduction, contract manufacturing, and supply chain efficiency. This role demands expertise in sourcing a diverse range of components.

  • Strategic Sourcing & Cost Reduction:
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies to achieve significant cost savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) improvements across assigned categories (polymers, molded plastics, mechanical components).
  • Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify potential new suppliers, predict cost trends, and assess supply chain risks.
  • Lead renegotiations of existing vendor contracts and terms to ensure the best value and favorable pricing for the company.
  • Implement e-sourcing tools and data analysis techniques to optimize procurement processes and identify ongoing cost-saving opportunities.
  • Market Analysis:Analyze industry and market trends for fiber optic components and raw materials to inform sourcing strategies and identify cost-saving opportunities.
  • Documentation & Reporting:Maintain accurate procurement records and documentation for all transactions, audits, and performance reporting purposes.
  • Supplier & Contract Management:
  • Supplier Management & Sourcing:Identify, evaluate, select & Onboard suppliers for Polymers, molded plastic components, mechanical parts including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks.
  • Negotiation & Contract Management:Manage the entire contract lifecycle, including drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and ensuring compliance with all contractual terms and legal requirements in collaboration with the legal department.
  • Develop and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key suppliers and contract manufacturers to ensure continuous improvement and reliable supply.
  • Monitor and track supplier performance using Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) related to quality, delivery, and cost, addressing any discrepancies proactively.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:Work closely with engineering, manufacturing, finance, and legal departments to align procurement activities with overall business objectives and production schedules.
  • Operational Procurement:
  • Collaborate closely with internal cross-functional teams, including Engineering, Quality Assurance, and Production, to understand material needs and ensure alignment of procurement activities with manufacturing schedules.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Experience:
  • Proven experience as a Procurement Specialist or similar role within a manufacturing environment, preferably in the fiber optics or related industry.
  • Demonstrated expertise in procuring specific commodity types:polymers, molded plastic components, and mechanical components including Sheet Metal & Machined components, Raw fiber, protective jacketing materials, strength members & ensuring they meet quality, cost, and delivery benchmarks
  • Experience in managingcontract manufacturing(CM) relationships and agreements.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementingcost reduction measuresand achieving measurable savings.
  • Skills:
  • Exceptional negotiation communication, and interpersonal skills to build strong vendor relationships.
  • Proficiency in procurement software, ERP systems (e.g., SAP preferred), and Microsoft Office Suite (advanced Excel skills preferred).
  • Expertise in Power BI:Proficiency in using Microsoft Power BI for data visualization, spend analysis, and creating interactive dashboards to track KPIs and cost-saving initiatives would be a significant advantage. This skill will be highly valued for driving data-informed decisions within the procurement function.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail.
  • Strong analytical skills for data analysis, cost modeling, and forecasting.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build rapport with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Education:
  • BE B.TECH – Mech/ Electrical/ Electronics/Instrumentation with Minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, preferably in Telecom Industry.

Learn more about how we're on a quest to connect the future and build what's next.

job.title: Painting Manufacturing Engineer 涂装制造工程师
job.description:
Job Description

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Main Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the development, establishment, optimization, and standardization of topcoat painting processes to ensure product appearance quality meets customer requirements.
  • Analyze and resolve topcoat painting quality issues on the production line, including orange peel, runs and sags, dirt inclusions, pinholes, color variation, poor adhesion, and other coating defects.
  • Validate and continuously optimize paint materials, process parameters, and painting equipment to improve production stability and product consistency.
  • Support new product and new material introductions through process validation and production launch activities to ensure successful implementation.
  • Monitor and improve key performance indicators (KPIs), including First Pass Yield (FPY), rework rate, and paint consumption, while driving cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives.
  • Lead the evaluation, selection, and optimization of painting equipment, paint supply systems, robot programs, and fixtures.
  • Develop, maintain, and update process documentation, work instruction, PFMEA, and Control Plans.
  • Collaborate closely with Production, Quality, Maintenance, and paint suppliers to continuously improve painting process capability and product appearance quality.
  • Drive Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance painting efficiency, material utilization, and production throughput.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in industrial coating/painting processes, preferably in heavy equipment, automotive, or manufacturing environments.
  • Strong knowledge of topcoat painting technologies (e.g., spray coating, electrostatic painting, robotic painting systems).
  • Solid understanding of coating defect analysis and root cause problem-solving methodologies (e.g., 8D, Six Sigma tools).
  • Familiarity with paint materials (solvent-based, water-based coatings) and surface treatment processes.
  • Experience with process control documentation such as PFMEA, Control Plans, and Standard Work.
  • Strong data analysis skills with ability to drive improvements in FPY, scrap, and process stability.
  • Good cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple improvement projects in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • Fluent in English for technical communication and documentation.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in robotic painting programming and automation systems.
  • Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or above preferred).
  • Knowledge of EHS regulations related to coating processes.
  • Familiarity with Caterpillar Production System (CPS) or similar operational excellence frameworks.
  • Proficiency in digital tools such as Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate, with the ability to leverage technology to improve business processes and operational efficiency.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Posting Dates:

八月 28, 2026 - 九月 11, 2026 Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

职位概要

作为发动机零部件设计工程师，您将负责主导新发动机零部件的设计与开发，开展 DFMEA 活动，编制并执行 DVP&R，并创建 TAN、EDR 等工程技术文件。您将推动稳健且具有成本效益的设计方案，同时为零部件资源切换和本地化项目提供工程支持。

我们拥有一支富有才华的团队，正在参与 Caterpillar 一些最令人振奋的工程挑战。我们期待您的加入。

主要职责

  • 设计满足产品性能目标、质量要求和客户期望的发动机零部件。
  • 准备并主持跨职能团队的设计评审会议。
  • 开展 DFMEA 活动，制定设计验证计划与报告（DVP&R），并确保验证活动按计划完成。
  • 与供应商开发工程师（SDE）合作，确保零部件开发全过程完全符合 APQP 流程要求
  • 主导 myNPI 问题的解决，并推动及时采取纠正措施。
  • 推动具有成本效益的设计方案，并主导零部件资源切换及本地化项目的工程验证活动。
  • 编制并维护技术文件，包括技术授权说明（TAN）和发动机设计要求（EDR）。
  • 为跨职能团队和客户提供技术指导并响应工程咨询。关键利益相关方包括 SDE、采购员、应用工程师、产品团队、销售和市场团队。
  • 根据需要拜访供应商，以支持制造过程改进、质量提升和技术问题解决活动。

教育要求

机械工程、车辆工程或相关工程专业本科及以上学历。

所需技能

数据收集与分析

了解数据收集和分析技术，能够从多个来源收集、解读并整合信息，以支持合理的工程决策。

  • 了解多种数据收集方法和分析工具。
  • 采用结构化方法收集和评估数据。
  • 识别数据分析活动的关键目标和成功标准。
  • 基于事实和证据得出客观结论。

分析性思维

能够评估复杂情况、识别根本原因，并制定切实有效的解决方案。

  • 运用结构化问题解决方法和分析工具。
  • 展现逻辑思维能力，用于调查并解决工程问题。
  • 在适当情况下应用业务分析工具和技术。
  • 与他人分享分析方法和最佳实践。

决策制定与批判性思维

能够准确评估情况，并基于良好判断和可获得的信息做出明智决策。

  • 了解有效的决策流程和方法。
  • 识别需要决策的问题，并邀请合适的利益相关方参与。
  • 在职责范围内运用稳健判断。
  • 在提出建议前评估风险、备选方案和潜在结果。

有效沟通

能够面向不同受众清晰、有效地沟通技术和非技术信息。

  • 以专业且尊重的方式提供建设性反馈。
  • 主动寻求并吸收反馈，以提升沟通效果。
  • 编制并交付演示材料、报告和技术文件。
  • 根据受众调整沟通风格，避免不必要的技术术语。
  • 展现积极倾听能力，并关注语言和非语言沟通信号。

技术卓越

体现对工程卓越和持续改进的承诺。

  • 采用系统化方法解决技术挑战。
  • 通过持续学习维护并拓展技术知识。
  • 通过成功的项目执行和问题解决展现技术专长。
  • 积极迎接新的技术挑战和发展机会。

3D 软件

了解 3D CAD 软件及其在零部件设计和开发中的应用。

  • 使用行业标准 CAD 工具创建和修改 3D 模型。
  • 有效运用标准建模、装配和工程图功能。
  • 在需要时支持软件实施、维护和用户协助。
  • 持续学习新兴 CAD 技术和最佳实践。

产品测试

了解产品开发和制造全过程中使用的产品验证方法和测试流程。

  • 了解关键验证和测试方法。
  • 制定并执行测试计划，以验证设计性能和耐久性。
  • 识别常见产品失效和测试相关问题。
  • 保持准确的测试记录和支持性文件。
  • 使用合适的测试工具和行业最佳实践。

技术问题排查

能够在工程和制造环境中识别、分析并解决技术问题。

  • 采用系统化方法进行问题识别和解决。
  • 利用可用的问题排查资源、工具和文件。
  • 必要时支持问题升级和根本原因调查。
  • 与跨职能团队协作实施纠正措施。
  • 有效沟通问题状态、调查发现和建议。

补充信息

  • 该职位出差比例低于 10%。

职位2：发动机系统性能开发工程师 地点：无锡

职位概述：

作为卡特彼勒的发动机系统性能开发工程师，您将深入了解卡特彼勒的产品、技术、流程、服务和系统。职责范围包括学习和遵循卡特彼勒发动机功率开发流程和程序，交付项目以满足客户要求和全球地区性的法规，以及使用先进的仿真技术和分析方法解决富有挑战性的涉及产品、系统和组件的工程问题。我们有一个出色的团队，在卡特彼勒从事着一些最激动人心的工作，我们期待您的加入 ！！

工作职责：

  • 学习和遵循卡特彼勒发动机系统开发流程和程序，交付项目以满足客户要求和全球各地区法规。
  • 根据项目要求，创建发动机测试计划，分析测试数据，优化发动机性能和排放以达到工程目标，完成工程报告，并将结果交付给客户、供应商、团队成Short-Term Incentive Plan员和其他业务部门。
  • 制定和执行新发动机、系统和组件的验证计划。
  • 协助新产品和新工艺的发动机开发；为客户提供技术支持等。
  • 发动机部件、系统和性能的技术认证。

学历要求：

内燃机、车辆工程等相关专业，获得认可的工学本科或以上学位，精通内燃机结构、发动机性能、发动机系统开发等知识。

将获得的技能：

准确并注重细节：

  • 认识精确性在自身职能或单位中的重要性。
  • 识别需要注意精确性和细节的任务或结果。
  • 识别程序确保结果无误。

杰出的技术：

  • 采用结构化方法分析和解决技术问题。
  • 寻求持续学习的机会，以保持技术能力，追求卓越技术。
  • 提供实例或案例研究，在实际业务场景中展示卓越技术。
  • 追求、准备并承担新的技术任务和挑战。

高效的沟通：

  • 提供有益的反馈意见，既关注行为，又不冒犯接受者。
  • 低调谦逊地倾听反馈意见，并利用反馈意见提高自己的沟通效率。
  • 为自己的工作进行口头陈述并撰写报告是必要的技能。
  • 避免使用不恰当的专业术语。
  • 寻找并考虑来自个人和团体的非语言暗示。

问题的解决：

  • 确定并记录具体问题和解决方法。
  • 研究具体问题，了解每个利益相关者的观点。
  • 开发评估信息准确性和相关性的替代技术。
  • 帮助分析替代方法的风险和益处，并就解决方案做出决定。
  • 使用实况调查技术和诊断工具发现问题。

其他信息：

本工作岗位位于无锡。

职位3：发动机进排气系统设计工程师 地点：天津

职位定位：

该助理设计工程师岗位支持大功率发动机进排气系统零部件设计，重点聚焦增压器和隔热罩相关工作。该工程师将与全球工程团队、供应商、制造、采购和服务团队合作，开发可靠、可制造且具有成本竞争力的设计方案。

该岗位是以实际工程交付为主的贡献型岗位，通过标准工程流程支持设计发布、验证、质量改进、供应商准备和问题解决。

工作职责：

  • 开发并发布进排气系统零部件设计，包括布置、接口、热防护、可制造性、可维护性、成本和质量要求。
  • 将产品和设计控制要求转化为清晰的技术要求、图纸、验证计划和发布文件。
  • 支持新产品导入、先期产品质量策划、持续产品改进、设计评审、设计变更以及失效模式及影响分析活动。
  • 支持样件制造、验证测试、检验策划、根因分析，以及针对产品质量或现场问题的纠正措施。
  • 与全球设计控制团队、本地产品团队、采购、供应商开发、供应商、制造和服务团队合作，使技术决策与业务优先级保持一致。
  • 支持供应商准备工作，包括可制造性评审、过程能力检查、检验方法、追溯性、量产准备和质量风险降低。
  • 通过创建或改进标准工作、设计指南、检查清单、验证模板和问题排查方法，沉淀并复用经验教训。

学历和专业要求：机械工程或机械相关专业本科或硕士学历。

技能描述：

数据收集与分析：了解数据收集和分析工具、技术及流程；能够以客观方式从多方利益相关者和不同来源收集并整合数据，从而形成结论、达成目标或作出判断。

  • 能够描述不同的数据收集技术和工具。
  • 能够记录基本的数据收集方法。
  • 能够识别数据收集和分析的目的。
  • 能够识别数据收集和分析中的关键目标。

分析性思维：了解促进有效分析的技术和工具；能够确定组织问题的根本原因，并制定可解决问题的替代方案。

  • 能够列举支持分析性思维过程的具体工具或技术。
  • 能够描述用于业务分析的具体软件应用或产品。
  • 能够举例说明如何运用分析性思维解决问题。
  • 能够帮助他人研究并学习更多业务分析工具和应用。

决策与批判性思维：了解决策流程及相关工具和技术；能够准确分析情况，并基于充分判断作出有效决策。

有效沟通：理解有效沟通的概念、工具和技术；能够通过恰当的沟通行为，有效传递、接收并准确理解观点、信息和需求。

  • 能够提供聚焦行为且不冒犯对方的有益反馈。

技术卓越：了解特定技术及其多种应用方法；能够针对重要技术挑战开发并提供解决方案。

三维软件：了解三维软件的类型、功能和工具；能够在三维模型创建过程中使用、实施、测试和升级相关软件包。

技术问题排查：了解问题排查方法、工具和技术；能够在制造或产品开发环境中预判、发现并解决技术问题。

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:

  • Schedule, design and drive performance tests
  • Improve efficiency of performance tests
  • Improve test reliability and time taken for performance test runs
  • Improve performance of applications in terms of user experience and satisfaction

Responsibilities

  • Designing, implementing and optimising processes for performance testing

  • Establishing and tracking metrics for application and service performance to drive improvement and accountability

Ideal Track Record:

  • Designed dashboards for reporting on performance test results and stats to stakeholders
  • Designed or improved processes to include performance tests regularly

job.title: Domain Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission: This role exists to define and govern the end-to-end solution architecture for the Enterprise Business Group (EBG) CRM and Order Management (OM) domains at a time of continued enterprise platform transformation and growing integration complexity. The role ensures that business priorities across customer lifecycle, order orchestration, fulfilment readiness, and downstream operational handoffs are translated into scalable, secure, and supportable solution designs. It brings architectural consistency across initiatives, reduces fragmentation between platforms, and accelerates delivery by providing clear architecture direction. The role also helps shape the target-state roadmap for CRM and OM modernization while safeguarding business continuity and delivery quality.

**

Accountabilities

  • Own target-state and transitional architecture for EBG CRM and OM.
  • Govern end-to-end solution design across lead-to-order, quote-to-cash, order capture, decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment handoffs.
  • Ensure alignment to enterprise architecture principles, security standards, integration patterns, and domain roadmaps.
  • Drive architecture decisions, design quality, and solution integrity across projects, vendors, and delivery teams.
  • Identify and manage architecture risks, technical debt, dependencies, and modernization opportunities within the CRM and OM domain.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, engineers, and vendors to translate business requirements into architecture options and approved solution designs.
  • Produce and maintain architecture artifacts such as solution blueprints, capability maps, application interaction diagrams, data flows, interface specifications, and transition roadmaps.
  • Define integration and data patterns across CRM, CPQ, product catalog, OM, billing, provisioning, service assurance, and related enterprise platforms.
  • Review business, functional, and technical designs to ensure compliance with approved architecture and non-functional requirements including resilience, security, observability, and supportability.
  • Support delivery governance, impact assessments, platform evaluations, and architecture reviews across change initiatives in the EBG domain.

**

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • This is an individual contributor role with strong matrix influence across business, product, engineering, integration, vendor, and operations teams.
  • Key stakeholders include: EBG business owners, product managers, enterprise architects, CRM and OM delivery teams, integration teams, billing/provisioning teams, program managers, operations/support teams, cybersecurity, and external delivery partners/vendors.

**

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • Ideal Profile desired background: Strong background in solution architecture, preferably in telecommunications, B2B services, or similarly complex industries with multi-system customer and order lifecycle processes.
  • Ideal Profile seniority, skills and certifications: 8+ years in solution/application architecture or large-scale systems delivery; strong experience in CRM and Order Management; deep understanding of domains integration, APIs, event-driven patterns, and domain data models; strong stakeholder management and documentation skills. Must-haves include hands-on architecture delivery across multiple integrated platforms. Preferred: telecom BSS/OSS experience, TM Forum knowledge, cloud-native architecture exposure, and TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification.
  • Ideal track record #1: Proven experience designing and governing end-to-end solutions across CRM, order management, fulfilment, and downstream operational systems for complex enterprise environments.
  • Ideal track record #2: Demonstrated success leading architecture decisions for cross-functional programs involving multiple applications, vendors, and business stakeholders, with clear ownership of non-functional quality and integration design.
  • Ideal track record #3: Strong history of shaping domain roadmaps, reducing architecture fragmentation/technical debt, and enabling delivery teams to execute strategic transformation initiatives with lower rework and improved design consistency.

job.title: Senior SFDC/CS Engineer
job.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with strong DevOps expertise, exposure to Salesforce CPQ, and willingness to work in a rotational support model. The role involves building scalable Salesforce solutions, managing deployments through CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring system stability in a production environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and implement Salesforce solutions using Apex, LWC, Aura, and Visualforce
  • Work on Salesforce CPQ configurations, customization, and enhancements (pricing, quoting, product rules)
  • Lead full software development lifecycle: requirements, design, development, testing, and deployment
  • Implement and maintain DevOps practices including version control, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, and QA teams to deliver high-quality solutions
  • Perform integrations with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs
  • Ensure adherence to Salesforce best practices, coding standards, and governance
  • Provide L2/L3 production support on a rotational basis, including incident resolution and root cause analysis
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure high availability
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to technical leadership

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 6+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience
  • Strong expertise in:
  • Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Aura
  • Salesforce configuration (Flows, Validation Rules, Process Automation)

Proven experience with DevOps tools and practices:

  • Git (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket)
  • CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, Copado, Gearset, etc.)

Experience with Salesforce integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, middleware) Good understanding of Salesforce data model, security, and performance optimization Ability to support production systems in a rotational shift model

Good to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce CPQ (product configuration, pricing rules, quote lifecycle)
  • Salesforce certifications (Platform Developer I/II, CPQ Specialist, App Builder)
  • Experience with Salesforce DX (SFDX)
  • Exposure to telecom domain (preferred for StarHub)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms like AWS or Azure

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission

The Dev-QA Engineer (CRM) is responsible for ensuring the reliability, quality, and stability of CRM platforms across EBG domains, including Whalecloud EBS, Salesforce (SFDC), and telco CRM ecosystems.

This role focuses on end-to-end CRM testing, integration validation, and automation across customer lifecycle processes (e.g., onboarding, billing, order management, customer data synchronization).

The engineer will collaborate closely with developers, integration teams, and business stakeholders to establish robust QA frameworks, automation practices, and quality gates, ensuring high system integrity across cross-platform integrations and cloud migration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated and manual test cases for CRM systems (Whalecloud EBS / SFDC / Telco CRM platforms).
  • Validate end-to-end CRM flows, including:
  • Customer onboarding & lifecycle
  • Order management & fulfillment
  • Billing and charging integrations
  • Customer data synchronization across systems

Perform integration testing across multiple platforms, including:

  • CRM ↔ Billing (e.g., BSCS)
  • CRM ↔ Middleware (Axway / APIs)
  • CRM ↔ Data platforms (EDW, ODS)

Develop and execute API testing (REST/SOAP) for CRM services and integrations. Build and maintain test automation frameworks for:

job.title: Senior Engineer-Commissioning (Malaysia)
job.description:
Job Description

Preferred Experience:

  • Experience with Tier III and IV data centers.
  • Background in systems integration and controls commissioning.
  • Knowledge of sustainability and energy efficiency in data center commissioning.
  • Experience working with design-build and fast-track construction projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage commissioning activities for mechanical, electrical, and controls systems in new and retrofit data center facilities
  • Develop detailed commissioning plans, test procedures, checklists, and protocols specific to data center infrastructure including UPS, generators, switchgear, CRAC/CRAH units, chillers, cooling towers, fire suppression, and BMS
  • Coordinate and oversee Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), Integrated Systems Testing (IST), and Performance Testing
  • Collaborate with design engineers, contractors, vendors, and facility operations to ensure commissioning aligns with project scope, schedule, and quality standards
  • Review design documents and equipment submittals to verify compliance with project requirements and standards (e.g., Uptime Institute Tier certification, ASHRAE, NEC).
  • Identify, document, and track commissioning issues, non-conformances, and deficiencies and lead resolution efforts
  • Provide technical support during handover to operations teams, including developing operational procedures and training
  • Maintain accurate and thorough commissioning documentation, reports, and certifications.
  • Mentor and guide junior commissioning engineers and technicians.
  • Ensure safety compliance and promote best practices throughout commissioning activities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Controls Engineering.
  • 10 years of commissioning experience in data center or mission-critical environments.
  • Strong knowledge of data center mechanical and electrical systems including power distribution, cooling, fire suppression, and building automation.
  • Familiarity with industry standards and guidelines including Uptime Institute, ASHRAE, NFPA, NEC, and TIA-942.
  • Proven experience in leading commissioning teams and managing complex multi-discipline projects.
  • Proficient with commissioning software, project management tools, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills.
  • Relevant certifications such as Certified Commissioning Professional (CCP) or equivalent are a plus.

DAMAC Properties has been shaping the Middle East’s luxury real estate market since 2002, delivering iconic residential, commercial, and leisure properties across the region and beyond.

DAMAC adds vibrancy to the cities in which its projects are located, with a huge and diverse portfolio that includes two world-class master-planned golf developments. To date, DAMAC has delivered 30,000+ quality homes, with 34,000 more underway.

job.title: Project Manager, ICT
job.description:
Role Overview

The Project Manager, ICT takes full end-to-end ownership of planning, executing, and delivering complex, strategic, and medium-to-large-scale ICT projects. Acting as the central bridge between business requirements, technical delivery, and operational teams, you will define comprehensive project management plans to track progress, optimize resource utilization, manage costs, and mitigate delivery risks.

The ideal candidate possesses a deep command of industry-standard project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid) across the full project lifecycle—from initiation through to closure. Operating within established organizational PMO standards and governance frameworks, you will lead cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality, high-value technical solutions on schedule and within budget.

Key Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery & Execution Management

  • End-to-End Delivery: Drive the start-to-finish lifecycle management of high-value, strategic ICT initiatives, ensuring full alignment with business objectives and quality standards.
  • Baseline Tracking: Actively plan, track, and report on project scope, timelines, financials, milestones, and performance metrics/KPIs.
  • Concurrence & Velocity: Maintain a highly organized, proactive, and delivery-focused mindset with the capability to manage multiple concurrent projects under pressure.

2. Stakeholder Engagement & Client Management

  • Primary Point of Contact: Act as the face of the project team for clients and external partners, providing transparent status updates while championing high customer satisfaction.
  • Executive Communication: Distill project progress, complex technical issues, and risks into clear updates for senior management and diverse stakeholder groups.
  • Strategic Influence: Align expectations across cross-functional business, product, and support teams to drive collaboration and minimize overall failure risks.

3. Resource Planning & Matrix Coordination

  • Utilization Optimization: Plan, monitor, and analyze resource allocation and utilization metrics to optimize future scheduling and team capacity.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Orchestrate tasks and workflows among internal teams, third-party vendors, and external partners within matrixed environments.

4. Risk, Issue & Change Governance

  • Proactive Mitigation: Anticipate, assess, and manage project risks and technical issues, implementing swift preventative actions and mitigation strategies.
  • Escalation Control: Actively manage project escalations, schedule slippages, resource shortages, and resolve team or vendor conflicts effectively.
  • Scope Governance: Strictly control scope creep and evaluate changing user requirements through formal organizational Change Control processes.

5. PMO Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Process Adherence: Ensure all project activities and artifacts strictly comply with internal corporate PMO governance standards, processes, and methodologies.
  • Documentation Excellence: Maintain accurate, thorough, and timely project documentation and health reporting.
  • Corporate Value-Add: Contribute to ongoing PMO capability developments, support pre-sales activities, assist in corporate initiatives, and mentor junior project managers.

Qualifications & Experience

1. Background & Experience Requirements

  • Professional Experience: Minimum of 5 years of dedicated project management experience specifically within ICT delivery environments.
  • Track Record: Proven success delivering medium-to-large-scale ICT projects from inception to completion.
  • Organizational Exposure: Prior experience navigating large matrix organizations or multinational corporation (MNC) environments is highly preferred.
  • Target Industries: Proven experience delivering technology solutions across sectors such as Government, Healthcare, Education, Financial Services (FSI), Hospitality/MICE, or Commercial industries.

2. Education & Professional Certifications

  • Academic Degree: An accredited University Degree in Information Technology, Project Management, Computer Science, or a related technical/business discipline. (Equivalent practical, professional experience will be evaluated and considered in lieu of a degree).
  • Mandatory Certification: Must hold at least one recognized professional project management certification: PMP, CITPM, PRINCE2, or Agile/Scrum (e.g., CSM, PMI-ACP, SAFe).

Core Competencies & Soft Skills

  • Methodology Command: Deep understanding and practical application of Agile, Waterfall, and Hybrid frameworks.
  • Analytical Problem-Solving: A highly logical and analytical mindset geared toward troubleshooting, critical decision-making, and crisis management in fast-paced environments.
  • Elite Soft Skills: Exceptional interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Stakeholder Influence: Proven ability to command a room, resolve conflict, and positively influence diverse technical and non-technical stakeholders up to the executive level.

Application Note: We appreciate your interest in this role; please note that only shortlisted candidates will be notified for an interview.
