job.title: Senior Release Manager
job.description:
Job Description

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Release Manager to oversee and manage software releases across the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Agile Release Management processes. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and overseeing the release of applications, updates, and system changes while ensuring minimal risk and disruption to business operations.

This role requires collaboration with development teams, DevOps, QA, product owners, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless deployments and continuous delivery. The candidate must have a strong background in release planning, CI/CD pipelines, risk management, and ITIL processes while being able to navigate both traditional and Agile frameworks.

Key Responsibilities

Release Planning & Coordination

  • Define, manage, and continuously improve the release process across SDLC and Agile methodologies.
  • Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, QA teams, DevOps, and Business Stakeholders to ensure successful releases.
  • Develop and maintain a release calendar to track upcoming releases and dependencies across multiple teams and applications.
  • Align releases with business priorities, security, and compliance requirements.

Agile & DevOps Integration

  • Implement and optimize Agile Release Trains (ARTs) and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
  • Support Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) or other Agile methodologies to improve release cadence.
  • Coordinate with Scrum Masters and Agile teams to streamline releases within sprints and program increments (PIs).
  • Ensure release readiness by conducting Go/No-Go meetings and managing change requests.

Deployment & Environment Management

  • Oversee release packaging, version control, and deployment processes across various environments (Dev, QA, UAT, Prod).
  • Collaborate with DevOps to automate deployments, monitor system health, and resolve deployment issues.
  • Manage configuration changes, rollback strategies, and hotfix releases when required.

Risk & Compliance Management

  • Identify, document, and mitigate release risks to ensure minimal impact on production.
  • Establish and enforce release governance, change management controls, and audit trails.
  • Ensure all releases comply with relevant security standards (e.g., OWASP, SOC 2, GDPR) and participate in security reviews when applicable.

Continuous Improvement & Metrics

  • Define and track release KPIs (e.g., deployment frequency, change failure rate, mean time to restore).
  • Drive post-release retrospectives, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration between Development, QA, Operations, and Business teams.

Qualifications

Technical & Process Expertise

  • 5+ years of experience in Release Management, Change Management, or DevOps roles.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile methodologies (Scrum, SAFe, Kanban), and ITIL processes.
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, Bamboo).
  • Proven experience in managing the release of mobile applications through the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, including app submission, metadata management, release versioning, and phased rollouts. Familiarity with App Store Connect and Google Play Console is required.
  • Experience integrating mobile builds into CI/CD workflows using tools such as Fastlane, Bitrise, or mobile-specific pipelines in GitLab or Jenkins.
  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git, Bitbucket, SVN).
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with observability and alerting tools (e.g., Splunk, Datadog, New Relic) to monitor deployment success and post-release stability.
  • Experience working in a telecom or digital consumer services environment is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of customer-impacting systems such as CRM, billing, e-commerce platforms, and service activation APIs.

Soft Skills & Leadership

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple releases across multiple teams and applications.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, cross-functional environments.
  • Customer-centric mindset with the ability to prioritize releases based on business impact and user experience
  • Ability to mentor junior release managers and contribute to the development of standardized release practices across teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications in ITIL, SAFe, PMI-ACP, or Agile Release Management.
  • Experience in large-scale enterprise environments with distributed teams.
  • Exposure to incident and problem management frameworks.

job.title: AI Transmission & Automation Engineer
job.description:

We are looking for an Engineer to support network design, planning, and implementation, with AI/ML skills used to strengthen forecasting, automation, and decision-making across the network lifecycle. This is a great opportunity for an early-career engineer to build hands-on network engineering experience while applying AI techniques to real planning and implementation challenges. Experience or exposure to the telecommunications industry is preferred but not required.

  • Conduct data analysis to identify network performance trends and planning opportunities

Qualifications

job.title: Domain Solution Architect
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission: This role exists to define and govern the end-to-end solution architecture for the Enterprise Business Group (EBG) CRM and Order Management (OM) domains at a time of continued enterprise platform transformation and growing integration complexity. The role ensures that business priorities across customer lifecycle, order orchestration, fulfilment readiness, and downstream operational handoffs are translated into scalable, secure, and supportable solution designs. It brings architectural consistency across initiatives, reduces fragmentation between platforms, and accelerates delivery by providing clear architecture direction. The role also helps shape the target-state roadmap for CRM and OM modernization while safeguarding business continuity and delivery quality.

Accountabilities

  • Own target-state and transitional architecture for EBG CRM and OM.
  • Govern end-to-end solution design across lead-to-order, quote-to-cash, order capture, decomposition, orchestration, and fulfilment handoffs.
  • Ensure alignment to enterprise architecture principles, security standards, integration patterns, and domain roadmaps.
  • Drive architecture decisions, design quality, and solution integrity across projects, vendors, and delivery teams.
  • Identify and manage architecture risks, technical debt, dependencies, and modernization opportunities within the CRM and OM domain.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, engineers, and vendors to translate business requirements into architecture options and approved solution designs.
  • Produce and maintain architecture artifacts such as solution blueprints, capability maps, application interaction diagrams, data flows, interface specifications, and transition roadmaps.
  • Define integration and data patterns across CRM, CPQ, product catalog, OM, billing, provisioning, service assurance, and related enterprise platforms.
  • Review business, functional, and technical designs to ensure compliance with approved architecture and non-functional requirements including resilience, security, observability, and supportability.
  • Support delivery governance, impact assessments, platform evaluations, and architecture reviews across change initiatives in the EBG domain.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • This is an individual contributor role with strong matrix influence across business, product, engineering, integration, vendor, and operations teams.
  • Key stakeholders include: EBG business owners, product managers, enterprise architects, CRM and OM delivery teams, integration teams, billing/provisioning teams, program managers, operations/support teams, cybersecurity, and external delivery partners/vendors.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • Ideal Profile desired background: Strong background in solution architecture, preferably in telecommunications, B2B services, or similarly complex industries with multi-system customer and order lifecycle processes.
  • Ideal Profile seniority, skills and certifications: 8+ years in solution/application architecture or large-scale systems delivery; strong experience in CRM and Order Management; deep understanding of domains integration, APIs, event-driven patterns, and domain data models; strong stakeholder management and documentation skills. Must-haves include hands-on architecture delivery across multiple integrated platforms. Preferred: telecom BSS/OSS experience, TM Forum knowledge, cloud-native architecture exposure, and TOGAF or equivalent architecture certification.
  • Ideal track record #1: Proven experience designing and governing end-to-end solutions across CRM, order management, fulfilment, and downstream operational systems for complex enterprise environments.
  • Ideal track record #2: Demonstrated success leading architecture decisions for cross-functional programs involving multiple applications, vendors, and business stakeholders, with clear ownership of non-functional quality and integration design.
  • Ideal track record #3: Strong history of shaping domain roadmaps, reducing architecture fragmentation/technical debt, and enabling delivery teams to execute strategic transformation initiatives with lower rework and improved design consistency.

job.title: Cloud Security Manager
job.description:
Role Mission:

The Cloud Security Manager is responsible for leading and managing the security posture of the organization’s cloud environments. This role oversees cloud security architecture, governance, compliance, incident response, and cloud security operations to ensure secure design, implementation, and ongoing management of cloud workloads. The manager will work closely with cloud engineering, DevOps, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and application teams to embed security-by-design across all cloud deployments.

Accountabilities:

  • Cloud Security Governance & Policy
  • Establish, maintain, and enforce cloud security policies, standards, and governance frameworks to ensure secure cloud adoption across the organization.
  • Secure Cloud Architecture & Design Assurance
  • Review and approve cloud solution designs, ensuring secure-by-design principles, threat modeling, and compliance with best practices and reference architectures.
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM) Control

Own and govern cloud IAM strategy, enforcing least privilege, strong authentication, privileged access control, and periodic access reviews.

  • Cloud Security Operations & Monitoring
  • Oversee continuous monitoring of cloud environments, ensuring timely detection and remediation of misconfigurations, vulnerabilities, and security threats.
  • Compliance, Audit & Risk Management
  • Ensure cloud environments meet regulatory, legal, and internal compliance requirements; manage risk assessments, audits, and cloud security reporting.
  • Incident Response & Forensics
  • Lead cloud security incident response, including investigation, containment, recovery, and root cause analysis for cloud-related security events.
  • Leadership, Stakeholder Engagement & Continuous Improvement
  • Provide cloud security expertise to stakeholders, lead security teams, manage security tools/vendors, and drive cloud security capability enhancements.

Responsibilities:

  • Cloud Security Governance & Strategy
  • Develop and maintain AWS cloud security policies, standards, and frameworks; lead security strategy aligned with business and regulatory requirements; enforce AWS Well-Architected, CIS, and Zero Trust principles.
  • Cloud Security Architecture & Engineering
  • Design, review, and approve secure AWS architectures; guide secure cloud-native implementations; govern IAM (RBAC, least privilege, automated remediation); oversee network security controls including WAF, Shield, and service mesh.
  • Cloud Security Operations, Monitoring & Incident Response
  • Manage continuous monitoring with AWS-native tools and SIEM; oversee vulnerability management and misconfiguration remediation; lead incident response including detection, investigation, containment, and recovery; automate security guardrails and remediation workflows.
  • Compliance, Risk Management & Audit Assurance
  • Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal requirements (SOC 2, GDPR, MAS TRM, PDPA); conduct cloud risk assessments and threat modeling; coordinate penetration testing; prepare documentation and evidence for audits.
  • Data Protection & Cloud Security Controls
  • Ensure effective protection of sensitive data through encryption, access governance, classification, and DLP controls; manage cloud data exposure risks and ensure secure storage and handling of information across AWS services.
  • Leadership, Collaboration & Security Culture
  • Serve as AWS cloud security SME; collaborate with Cloud, DevOps, Network, and Cybersecurity teams to embed security-by-design; mentor teams and promote a strong security culture through training and stakeholder engagement

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Reports to the Head of Cybersecurity :

The candidate will work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity to design, implement, support, and maintain cybersecurity systems that safeguard the organization’s digital assets. This includes contributing to architecture design, operational readiness, system optimization, and ensuring alignment with security policies and operational objectives.

  • Vendor & Service Provider Management:

The candidate will lead, manage, and coordinate external vendors responsible for supporting cybersecurity systems. This includes ensuring vendors meet contractual obligations, service levels, operational standards, and deliver quality support for security tools, platforms, and related infrastructure.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

The role will collaborate with internal stakeholders such as IT Infrastructure, Network Engineering, SOC Analysts, Incident Response Teams, Governance/Risk/Compliance (GRC), and Application Teams to ensure the effective operation, integration, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity systems.

  • Business & Operational Stakeholders:

The candidate will engage with business units to understand operational requirements, communicate potential risks, and ensure security systems support business continuity, performance, and compliance needs.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus.
  • 5–10 years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 3+ years focused on AWS cloud security and cloud security architecture.
  • Strong expertise in AWS security services (e.g., IAM, Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Config, Macie, KMS, WAF, Shield).
  • Hands-on experience in cloud security architecture, DevSecOps, and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Proven ability to implement IAM governance, least privilege, encryption controls, network security, and secure cloud design principles.
  • Experience with cloud compliance frameworks and audits (ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS, MAS TRM, NIST) and conducting cloud risk assessments.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with experience managing cloud security initiatives and collaborating with multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Relevant professional certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, CISSP, CISM, or CCSP.

job.title: Principal Engineer, Cybersecurity GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Job DescriptionAs a Principal Engineer (GRC), you will execute and own day‑to‑day cybersecurity governance, risk and compliance activities across StarHub’s business units. You will ensure our digital assets and projects comply with internal security policies and Singapore telco regulatory obligations (e.g., IMDA, CSA, TCS, BCS, CCoPv2) while uplifting our detection and response capabilities. You will collaborate with internal teams, our MSSP, and external consultants to deliver security reviews, exercises, and remediation on time and to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities

1) Regulatory Compliance & Governance (Execution)Maintain Cybersecurity Management (CSM) documentation and contribute to 5G policy development to align with regulatory obligations and deadlines.Plan and execute—together with appointed consultants and internal stakeholders—the following annual/biennial activities, including drafting and socialising reports and tracking remediation to closure:Bi‑Annual Host Configuration Reviews for CII and CII‑supporting assetsAnnual Table‑Top Exercises (TTX) across major stakeholdersBiennial external audits with auditors and key business unitsMaintain audit‑ready artefacts and ensure submissions meet expected timelines and quality.

2) Security Engineering & OperationsPartner with the MSSP and platform owners to ensure comprehensive 24×7 log ingestion and monitoring coverage; onboard new log sources and use cases.Tune SIEM/SOAR detections and playbooks; develop runbooks to reduce mean time to detect/respond.Track and drive vulnerability remediation for assigned systems; ensure adherence to SLA (e.g., critical within 14 days) and report status to stakeholders.Support incident response (IR): triage, containment coordination, evidence preservation, and post‑incident reviews; facilitate lessons learned and control improvements.Develop or enhance automation (e.g., scripts/dashboards) for evidence collection, risk tracking, and compliance reporting.

3) Risk Management & AssurancePerform risk assessments and threat modelling for new/changed business solutions; define security requirements and validate they are tested before go‑live.Maintain accurate risk register entries for owned domains; ensure risks have clear owners, treatments, and review cadences.Evaluate new security solutions/approaches and contribute to policies, standards, and guidelines.

Qualifications

Qualifications

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related field.5–8 years’ hands‑on experience in cybersecurity engineering and/or GRC within a telco or similarly regulated environment.

Familiarity with Singapore regulatory landscape (IMDA, CSA, CII requirements) and enterprise frameworks (e.g., NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001).

Demonstrated experience in one or more of: identity & access management (RBAC, MFA, PAM), cryptographic controls, vulnerability management, firewall policy reviews, log analysis, packet/stream analysis, SIEM/SOAR tuning, and incident handling.

Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to prepare reports for technical and senior, non‑technical stakeholders.Able to participate in on‑call/after‑hours support during critical cybersecurity incidents.

Preferred Certifications (nice‑to‑have): GCIH, GCFA, CISA, CISSP (or equivalent).

job.title: Senior Manager, Enterprise Engineering
job.description:
Job Description

The EBG CRM/OM Domain Owner holds end-to-end accountability for the strategy, delivery, and sustained health of StarHub’s Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms. This includes stewardship of Salesforce CRM, CloudSense CPQ/Order Management, and other bespoke CRM/OM solutions, as well as responsibility for evolving StarHub’s broader CRM/OM landscape.

This role ensures that CRM/OM capabilities enable and empower sales and service channels for SME, Enterprise, Wholesale, and International segments. Acting as both a technology steward and business partner, the role balances operational reliability with innovation, ensuring seamless customer and employee experiences. This position is pivotal in driving automation, platform stability, compliance, and business continuity, while shaping the long-term CRM/OM roadmap to align with enterprise priorities and evolving market needs.

Key Responsibilities

Domain Ownership and Platform Stewardship

  • Own the performance scalability and sustainability of CRMOM systems including Salesforce CloudSense and bespoke solutions
  • Ensure platform reliability compliance and system stability while driving continuous improvements in UX data integrity and integrated workflows
  • Establish monitor and report against key operational KPIs availability performance adoption fulfilment outcomes
  • Lead automation DevSecOps and process optimization initiatives to streamline sales and service workflows

Strategic Stewardship and Leadership

  • Provide longterm leadership and oversight of the domains people systems and outcomes ensuring alignment with organizational strategy
  • Establish and maintain the right leadership structure within the domain to drive accountability ownership and performance
  • Define and manage prioritization of initiatives to ensure the most impactful work is delivered in line with business objectives
  • Take ownership for delivering measurable results across people process and technology dimensions of the domain

Strategic Planning and Roadmap

  • Define and deliver the multiyear CRMOM technology roadmap ensuring alignment with StarHubs enterprise strategy
  • Evaluate prioritize and secure investments that maximize business impact and competitive advantage
  • Drive the endtoend fulfilment journey enablement from order capture through provisioning and support
  • Anticipate emerging needs ensuring the CRMOM domain evolves cohesively with adjacent enterprise systems

Operational Excellence and DevOps Execution

  • Oversee daytoday domain operations to ensure services meet or exceed agreed servicelevel objectives SLOs
  • Run the domain in a DevOps model including oncall schedules incident management monitoring and proactive issue resolution
  • Manage development capacity across competing demandsfeature enhancements technical debt remediation regulatory compliance security obligations operational fixes and audit requirements
  • Champion a culture of accountability postmortems and continuous improvement to enhance resilience and operational maturity

CrossDomain Collaboration and CrossFunctional Leadership

  • Partner closely with other domain owners to ensure interoperability reduce duplication and enable seamless enterprise workflows
  • Proactively manage dependencies across domains eg Billing ERP Digital Channels Data to ensure integrated solutions
  • Collaborate with related leadership roles across the organization clarifying mandates and ensuring seamless alignment of responsibilities
  • Champion knowledge sharing organizational alignment and crossfunctional success

Team and Resource Management

  • Build lead and mentor CRMOMaligned teams ensuring succession coverage for critical roles
  • Develop and implement sourcing and capability strategies including vendor management and internally owned operations
  • Oversee domain budget capacity planning and effective allocation of people and resources to balance delivery and sustainability
  • Foster a healthy highperforming team culture grounded in accountability transparency and continuous learning

Stakeholder Engagement and Senior Management Communication

  • Serve as the senior liaison for CRMOM initiatives across EBG SME Wholesale and International business units
  • Engage with executive stakeholders providing clear and timely communication of roadmaps risks progress and achievements
  • Build consensus on longterm CRMOM platform evolution balancing business demands with technical sustainability
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior management shaping strategic decisionmaking on customer platforms and fulfilment processes

Qualifications

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in CRM/OM platforms, with at least 5 years in senior leadership roles.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to influence senior leadership.

  • Resilient, forward-looking leader with ability to balance delivery velocity and technical sustainability.

job.title: Data Centre Critical Infrastructure Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

The primary responsibility for this role is to:

•Perform day to day operation and maintenance of all the various facilities systems at StarHub Data Centres and Offices, such as Generators, Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS), DC Rectifier System, Static Transfer Switch (STS), Fire Protection System, Building Management System, HT/LT electrical system, all ACMV systems, etc.

•Ensure the routine maintenance of the facilities systems are carried out according to planned schedule and contracted scope of work

•Plan, call and evaluate tenders, and project-manage any expansion projects to cater for users’ requirements

•Ensure strict security system is enforced at the StarHub Data Centres and Offices by managing the physical and electronic security systems eg card access, CCTV surveillance, Visitors Tracking.

•Carry out customer related work orders within the customer’s requested Ready for Service (RFS) Date

•Maintain records and update all M&E, building & schematic drawings of the facilities in and security of the estates under our care

•Conduct regular checks of the premises for potential safety hazards and unsafe conditions, initiate corrective measures to maintain a safe and healthy work environment, in compliance with prevailing legislative and regulatory requirements

•Manage new leases and timely renewal of existing ones, covering offices, shops and technical sites:

o Negotiate with building owners, manage LOIs and agreements, follow-up with all related administration matters

o Conduct regular meetings with respective business units

o Monitor current industry rental rates

o Liaise with relevant authorities to ensure the leases comply with authorities’ requirements, if any

o Liaise with internal business units eg Legal, Finance, Business Units, for any changes of lease terms, rental and service fees, property tax, etc

o Liaise with external tenants in StarHub’s owned-premises, including the generation of billing invoices to tenants

o Ensure timely handover/ takeover of premises to/from building owners

•Carry out risk assessments and management

•Perform 24 x 7 standby duties, respond to and rectify all situations

•Carry out any other assignments from the management

Qualifications

  • Job Requirement

•Appropriate qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Telecommunications or Facilities Management with at least 2 yrs of work experience in facilities area, in particular Data Centre environment.

•Candidates with 2 to 3 years of working experience in supporting facilities operations & maintenance in Data Centre environment are preferred.

•Fresh Diploma graduates with positive attitude and willingness to work in a start-up environment are welcome to apply

•Good understanding and hands-on servicing experience in all facilities systems and building maintenance

•Possesses Class 3 Driving Lesson (Manual Gear)

•Basic networking, broadband access and structure cabling is a plus;

•Computer literate with knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, AutoCAD Able to manage and supervise contractors;

•Hands on experience in provisioning and configuration of network elements switches, CPE and services will be added advantage;

•Self motivated with strong drive and the willingness to take on challenges

•Good written and oral communications skills, with ability to interact will people of all levels, especially with end customers;

•Good working attitude with minimum supervision and ability to perform under pressure

•Possess initiative and professionalism with the ability to multi task.

•Service oriented manner is essential. Must be a team player coupled with strong communication and problem solving skills and shall demonstrate the ability to work independently

job.title: Salesforce/CloudSense Lead
job.description:

job.title: Salesforce / Java Developer - CRM Solutions
job.description:

job.title: Technical Project Manager
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies, ensuring release readiness through Blue/Green deployments, canary releases, and feature flagging.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, and scope stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.

###

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Partner with Domain Owners and Tech Leads to align on architecture, delivery scope, and capacity planning.
  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Support implementation of continuous delivery and observability practices across teams.
  • Define, Monitor and report on key delivery KPIs, including deployment frequency, Mean Time To Recovery, defect Leakage rate, change failure rate ensuring all releases meet defined Service Level Objectives and performance baselines.
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

###

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Journey Solution Designers (SDs) and Release Program Managers (RPMs) to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Journey Owners (JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Communicate risks, decisions, and delivery trade-offs clearly across key stakeholders.

###

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Drive adoption of agile and DevOps best practices across DXP teams.
  • Analyze delivery metrics to identify improvement opportunities in velocity, predictability, and quality.
  • Support incident RCA reviews and ensure learnings are converted into actionable backlog improvements.
  • Contribute to standardized delivery governance, templates, and documentation across domains.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM, SAFe, PMI-ACP) preferred.

###

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in software delivery or digital product management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience with CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native architecture (e.g., Kubernetes, EKS), and backend service delivery
  • Strong understanding of API management, event-driven architecture, observability tooling and modern deployment strategies (Blue/Green, Canary, Feature Flags).
  • Strong familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com, Splunk.
  • Experience in telecommunications, digital platform delivery, or large-scale integration programs is an advantage.

###

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile, DevOps, and continuous delivery practices.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Technical fluency with backend engineering patterns and delivery pipelines
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

job.title: Senior Systems Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The mission of the Senior Systems Analyst is to support the design of scalable and effective systems that meet business needs and technical requirements. The role focuses on translating business requirements into clear solution specifications, supporting end-to-end solution design, and ensuring proposed solutions are feasible, well-integrated, and aligned to business objectives. The role also contributes to business growth and stronger solution outcomes through sound analysis, collaboration, and delivery discipline.

Accountabilities

  • Support the delivery of fit-for-purpose end-to-end solution designs aligned to business and technical objectives.
  • Translate business requirements into clear solution specifications and design inputs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically feasible and integrated across relevant systems and platforms.
  • Provide technical and functional advice to stakeholders on solution options, design impacts, and implementation considerations.
  • Contribute to partner engagements, new business initiatives, and RFP/RFT submissions as needed.
  • Apply digital and customer-centric thinking, including user journey analysis and human-centric design principles, in solution assessment.

Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the end-to-end solution design process, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical requirements.
  • Liaise with business users and stakeholders to gather, clarify, and document requirements.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate requirements into effective system designs.
  • Support analysis of solution feasibility, application design, integration points, and downstream impacts.
  • Understand business models and drivers and translate them into platform configuration or specifications for enhancements or new implementations.
  • Work with partners and internal stakeholders to support technical strategies that improve business effectiveness and service offerings.
  • Assist with RFP/RFT responses by providing technical input and solution analysis.
  • Prepare and maintain required solution design artifacts such as IA documents, sequence diagrams, process flows, and workflows.
  • Follow agreed processes, milestones, and documentation standards established by the team.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Computing, or related field of study with at least 5–7 years of systems analysis, solution design, or related experience.
  • Strong background in the telecommunications industry.
  • Knowledge in areas of mobile and broadband networks, CRM (e.g. Compax), Billing, Provisioning Systems, Inventory, Delivery, and Integrations.
  • Experience in digital-related areas, including user journey analysis during solution assessment, design thinking, and human-centric approaches to solution assessment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong conceptual and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organization skills and comfort with multi-tasking under a dynamic environment.
  • Able to work independently on assigned solution components while escalating issues appropriately.

job.title: Principal Systems Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

The mission of the Principal Systems Analyst is to provide strategic and technical leadership in shaping end-to-end solution designs that meet business goals, technology standards, and customer needs. The role bridges business strategy and technology execution by translating complex requirements into scalable, feasible, and effective solutions across systems and platforms. In addition, the Principal Systems Analyst provides guidance to a team of Solution Designers, ensuring quality of solutioning, consistency of design practices, and capability development within the team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end solution design activities across large, complex, or cross-domain initiatives, ensuring alignment with business priorities and technical standards.
  • Oversee requirement analysis and ensure business needs are accurately translated into robust functional and technical solution specifications.
  • Provide leadership and direction to the team on solutioning approach, issue resolution, stakeholder engagement, and design quality.
  • Review and validate solution designs, specifications, process flows, interface designs, and other key artifacts produced by team members.
  • Coach and mentor team members in systems analysis, design thinking, stakeholder management, and solution documentation.
  • Collaborate with business, architecture, delivery, operations, and partner teams to shape solution strategies and implementation approaches.
  • Drive alignment across impacted systems and domain owners to ensure dependencies, risks, and integration requirements are managed effectively.
  • Lead technical discussions with partners and vendors to define solution strategies that improve business effectiveness and service offerings.
  • Contribute to RFP/RFT responses, business case discussions, and new business opportunities by providing technical insight and solution leadership.
  • Establish and maintain best practices, templates, and governance standards for systems analysis and solution design within the team.
  • Support resource planning, work prioritization, and capability uplift of the Solution Designer team.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Computing or related field of study with at least 10-12 years of systems analysis and design or related experience in providing end to end solution design.
  • Strong background in telecommunications industry.
  • Deep knowledge of mobile and broadband networks, CRM (e.g. Compax), Billing, Provisioning Systems, Inventory, Delivery, and Integrations.
  • Proven experience leading complex cross-functional solutioning initiatives involving multiple systems and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated experience in digital-related areas, including user journey analysis, design thinking, and human-centric approaches to solution assessment and design.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Able to communicate clearly and professionally in a fast-paced, deadline-driven business environment.
  • Strong conceptual and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organization skills and comfortable with multi-tasking under a dynamic environment.

job.title: Delivery Lead, FRCS
job.description:
Role Mission

Enable effective delivery, backlog management, and smooth daily operations across FRCS platforms by bridging Finance and Technology teams to drive quality, compliance, and continuous improvement for both legacy and migrated systems.

Accountabilities

  • Manage and prioritise the FRCS product backlog to ensure delivery of high-value outcomes.
  • Coordinate cross-functional delivery across Finance, Technology, and vendor teams.
  • Ensure operational stability and smooth day-to-day system support.
  • Drive continuous improvement, quality, and governance across FRCS initiatives.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and maintain delivery transparency and team alignment.

Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Product Owners and Functional Leads to refine and prioritise backlog items.
  • Break down epics and features into actionable user stories with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Facilitate sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Identify and remove delivery blockers, risks, and dependencies across teams.
  • Coordinate delivery across legacy finance systems and newly migrated platforms.
  • Maintain transparent delivery reporting, timelines, and stakeholder communication.
  • Ensure adherence to compliance, audit requirements, and internal control policies.
  • Partner with Finance to ensure solutions meet functional needs and reporting accuracy.
  • Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, process refinement, and feedback loops.
  • Support change management, release planning, and readiness activities.
  • Track delivery metrics such as velocity, cycle time, and burn-down to guide planning.

Areas of Impact

  • Delivery predictability and quality across FRCS initiatives.
  • Stability and efficiency of finance system operations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Finance, FRCS, and Technology.
  • Compliance, audit-readiness, and internal controls within delivery processes.

Ideal Track Record

  • Proven experience coordinating cross-functional teams in enterprise environments.
  • Strong understanding of finance systems, ERP workflows, or FRCS processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage backlog, drive sprints, and resolve delivery impediments.
  • Experience supporting both legacy and cloud-based finance platforms.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:
Job Description

The senior data scientist is responsible to work with massive amounts of data to develop ML/GenAI models with Telco and other sets of data to help enterprises realise key business value through the use of Telco Insights. The senior data scientist will work closely with key internal and external stakeholders to develop new Al products or new application areas for Al.

  • Design and develop next generation of scalable Telco Big Data Analytics Models to support commercial projects across various business verticals.

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.

job.title: Internship - Data, AI & Audience Insights
job.description:
Job Description

The internship will support the development of enterprise AI applications that leverage Generative AI and agentic workflows to improve business processes and user productivity. He/She will work with the engineering team to design, develop, and integrate AI-powered capabilities into enterprise platforms, while gaining hands-on experience with modern AI technologies, cloud development, and software engineering best practices.

The intern will work alongside the engineering team to:

  • Design and develop AI agents for enterprise use cases.
  • Build and enhance agentic workflows using modern AI orchestration frameworks.
  • Integrate Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval systems, and external tools into AI applications.
  • Develop prototype applications and user interfaces to demonstrate AI capabilities.
  • Assist in building proof-of-concepts for intelligent automation and decision support solutions.
  • Perform software testing, debugging, and optimisation.
  • Document technical designs and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

Responsibilies:

  • Develop AI-powered applications and intelligent automation solutions.
  • Design and implement AI agent workflows for enterprise use cases.
  • Integrate AI models, APIs, and enterprise systems.
  • Develop lightweight frontend interfaces and application features.
  • Perform testing, debugging, and feature enhancements.

Deliverables

  • Design and develop at least one AI agent or AI-enabled application feature

job.title: Data Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Purpose

The Finance Data Analyst is responsible for enabling data-driven decision-making and supporting Finance's digital transformation through data analytics, automation and modern digital technologies.

The role partners with Finance, Technology and business stakeholders to develop scalable reporting and analytical solutions, implement automation, improve data quality and governance, and deliver actionable insights that enhance operational efficiency, business performance and Finance capabilities.

Responsibilities

Data Analytics & Business Intelligence

Develop and maintain data extraction, transformation and validation processes to support scalable reporting, analytics and automation solutions.

  • Develop SQL queries, reusable datasets and data models to support reporting, automation and business intelligence.
  • Transform enterprise data into meaningful business insights that support strategic and operational decision making.
  • Design, develop and maintain interactive dashboards, visualisations and self-service reporting solutions using enterprise Business Intelligence platforms.
  • Apply descriptive, diagnostic and predictive analytics to identify business trends, risks and opportunities for continuous improvement.

Automation & Digital Technologies

  • Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise and automate Finance processes through workflow automation, digital technologies and AI-enabled solutions.
  • Design, develop, implement and maintain automation solutions that improve productivity, strengthen controls, reduce manual effort and enhance operational efficiency.
  • Develop reusable automation workflows, scripts and digital solutions to improve Finance operations and reporting.
  • Evaluate and leverage emerging technologies, including Artificial Intelligence (AI), to enhance Finance reporting, analytics, forecasting and decision support, ensuring appropriate governance, quality and compliance.
  • Monitor, optimise and continuously enhance automation solutions to ensure reliability, scalability and business value.

Finance Transformation

  • Support Finance transformation initiatives involving ERP, enterprise data platforms, automation, AI and process redesign.
  • Partner with Finance, Technology and business stakeholders to design and implement technology enabled solutions that improve Finance processes and business outcomes.
  • Review existing Finance processes and recommend innovative, technology-enabled improvements to enhance efficiency, controls and user experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Business Analytics, Information Systems, Computer Science, Statistics or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years' experience in Finance Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, Finance Transformation, Automation or Digital Transformation.
  • Experience working with Finance, ERP or enterprise systems is preferred.
  • Experience designing and implementing automation or digital solutions is an advantage.

Technical Competencies

  • SQL, including data querying, extraction, transformation and validation.
  • Data modelling and data preparation.
  • Business Intelligence and data visualisation (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, IBM Cognos Analytics or equivalent).
  • Cloud data platforms and enterprise data warehouses (e.g. Snowflake or equivalent).
  • Workflow automation and low-code automation platforms
  • Robotic Process Automation (RPA) platforms (e.g. UiPath)
  • Programming or scripting languages (e.g. Python).
  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Generative AI tools.
  • API integration and system connectivity concepts.

Core Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights and automation solutions.
  • Good understanding of Finance processes and business operations.
  • Strong process improvement and automation mindset with the ability to identify opportunities to simplify and optimise Finance operations.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technology enabled solutions.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, governance and operational excellence.
  • Self-motivated, innovative and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
  • Curious, adaptable and committed to continuous learning in emerging technologies.

job.title: Presales Technical Consultant (Network/Network Security)

Qualifications

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

The DevOps Engineer will maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud infrastructure on AWS. This role is responsible for supporting development stacks in Java and .NET, automating deployment pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, optimizing system performance, and ensuring reliability through robust monitoring and incident response practices. Working closely with development, platform, and DBA teams, the engineer will enable efficient CI/CD workflows, container orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes, and database performance optimization for relational database systems (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL). The role also drives continuous improvement by adopting cloud-native technologies, enhancing security and compliance standards, and promoting DevOps best practices across the organization.

Accountabilities:

  • Maintain scalable, secure AWS infrastructure supporting diverse application stacks and database engines.
  • Support software development teams by integrating Java and .NET build, test, and release processes into automated delivery pipelines.
  • Build and optimize CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins to enable reliable and automated deployments.
  • Implement and manage containerized environments using Docker and Kubernetes (e.g., EKS).
  • Monitor, analyze, and fine-tune database performance, query execution plans, and resource utilization across enterprise database platforms (Oracle, MS SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
  • Ensure high availability, rapid incident response, and continuous optimization of cloud and database workloads.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve automation, software delivery, database optimization, and security practices.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage application build and deployment lifecycles for Java and .NET applications.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins for automated build, test, and deployment.
  • Provision and manage AWS infrastructure and managed database services.
  • Analyze slow queries, review execution plans, and implement performance fine-tuning strategies (e.g., indexing, query refactoring, table partitioning, parameter group tuning) for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL.
  • Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring proper runtime configuration for JVM memory and .NET application environments.
  • Monitor system and database performance, troubleshooting bottlenecks, high CPU/memory utilization, and connection pooling issues to ensure maximum availability.
  • Implement and enforce security, access control, backup/recovery strategies, and operational best practices across dev, test, and production environments.

Team Scope / Stakeholders:

  • Collaborate with Java and .NET Software Engineering teams to streamline build configurations, application packaging, and release workflows.
  • Work with Database Administration (DBA) teams to optimize SQL queries, improve database performance, and enable efficient release processes.
  • Partner with Cloud/Platform Engineering to design and maintain scalable AWS infrastructure.
  • Work closely with QA and Testing teams to integrate automated performance and integration testing within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Engage with Security teams to ensure compliance with security policies, database access control, and data protection standards.
  • Support Product Owners and Business stakeholders by ensuring reliable, high-performing, and timely delivery of applications and services.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, or database reliability roles.

Programming & Development Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of Java development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., Maven, Gradle, JVM tuning).
  • Strong knowledge of .NET / C# development ecosystems and build tooling (e.g., .NET CLI, MSBuild, .NET Core / .NET 6+).
  • Proficiency in scripting and operational programming (e.g., Python, Bash, Shell) for automation.
  • Proficient in writing, debugging, and optimizing complex SQL queries.

Cloud, DevOps & Database Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, EKS).
  • Strong experience in CI/CD tools, particularly Jenkins, and version control systems (e.g., Git).
  • Strong experience in relational database query optimization and performance fine-tuning for Oracle, MS SQL Server, and PostgreSQL (e.g., execution plan analysis, indexing strategies, deadlocks, lock escalation, buffer pool usage).
  • Proficiency in database performance monitoring tools (e.g., AWS RDS Performance Insights, Oracle AWR/ADDM, SQL Server Execution Plans/Profiler, PostgreSQL EXPLAIN ANALYZE / pg_stat_statements).
  • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with application and infrastructure monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex systems, diagnose performance bottlenecks, and work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

job.title: Principal Data Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

To provide technical leadership within StarHub’s Digital Experience Platform (DXP) Data organization by designing, delivering, and operationalizing complex data pipelines, curated datasets, and reusable engineering patterns on the cloud-native data platform. This role drives technical excellence across data ingestion, transformation, modeling, DataOps, and production reliability to enable trusted, scalable, and self-service analytics across business domains.

Accountabilities:

  • Own technical delivery of complex, high-impact data engineering initiatives across ingestion, transformation, modeling, and operational stabilization.
  • Serve as the senior technical leader within the Data Engineering function, setting implementation direction, reviewing design quality, and uplifting engineering standards across the team.
  • Drive production reliability, observability, and root-cause elimination for critical pipelines and datasets.
  • Develop reusable engineering patterns, frameworks, and automation to improve delivery speed, quality, and maintainability.
  • Partner with Data Architecture, Platform Engineering, Data Quality Stewards, BI, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into trusted and scalable data products.
  • Coach and mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and day-to-day technical guidance without direct people management responsibility.

Responsibilities:

  • Technical Delivery & Solution Design: Lead design and implementation of complex ingestion, transformation, and curated data model solutions across Datapipe, Snowflake, and AWS, ensuring scalable, reusable, and cost-efficient patterns.
  • Engineering Standards & Quality: Establish and enforce practical engineering standards across SQL, Python, DAG design, CI/CD, testing, observability, RBAC-aware implementation, and cost-aware design.
  • Operational Excellence: Own production stability for critical pipelines and datasets, including incident triage, recovery leadership, RCA, and preventative improvement actions.
  • Reusable Enablement: Build reusable components, templates, runbooks, and agentic delivery patterns to reduce duplicated effort, improve maintainability, and raise engineering velocity.
  • Data Quality & Trusted Data: Embed automated data quality controls into pipelines and curated layers, including validation, anomaly detection, reconciliation, and schema drift checks.
  • Collaboration & Enablement: Work with architects, stewards, platform engineers, BI teams, and business stakeholders to shape requirements into implementable data contracts and trusted datasets for self-service analytics.
  • Technical Leadership by Influence: Act as the senior technical escalation point for difficult engineering and production issues, while coaching Senior Data Engineers and Data Engineers through design and implementation guidance.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: Complex pipelines, curated datasets, reusable engineering patterns, and production reliability across the DXP Data Platform (C360, Datapipe ingestion solution based on Apache Airbyte & Airflow, Snowflake, SageMaker, Cloud native skills).
  • Decision Rights: Technical design decisions within assigned initiatives, implementation patterns, code quality expectations, incident recovery actions, and recommendations on engineering prioritization and standards uplift.
  • Stakeholders: Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Architecture & Governance, BI, Data Science, Data Quality Stewards, Business Data Owners, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity/ISO, and Application domain teams.
  • Resources: Individual contributor role operating as the senior-most hands-on engineer within the Data Engineering team, with responsibility to guide and uplift engineers across Singapore, Malaysia and India through technical leadership.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 7–10+ years of experience in cloud-native data engineering, with strong hands-on architecture, delivery, and production support experience on AWS & Snowflake.
  • Strong track record delivering complex data engineering initiatives independently, with the ability to operate across both build and run responsibilities.
  • Experience partnering with BI and business teams to design modelled datasets and enable self-service analytics.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and troubleshooting guidance without formal team management responsibility.
  • Deep hands-on technical expertise, including:
  • Snowflake: schema design, Streams/Tasks, Stored Procedures, UDFs, RBAC-aware development, performance tuning, cost monitoring, Cortex AI, and Streamlit.
  • Airflow or similar data orchestration tools: DAG design, orchestration, scheduling, dependency management, retry patterns, and observability.
  • Python and SQL: pipeline scripting, transformation logic, data validation, and operational tooling.
  • ELT/ETL frameworks: Airbyte, Fivetran, and custom connector understanding or development.
  • AWS services: S3 (data lake structures and archival), Lambda, KMS, Transfer Family, CloudWatch, and SageMaker.
  • Demonstrated success delivering medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and enabling self-service data use cases.
  • Experience implementing automated data quality controls, remediation workflows, and data lineage-aware engineering practices across enterprise datasets.
  • Familiarity with machine learning or AI integration using platforms like AWS SageMaker.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot complex data issues, lead root-cause analysis, and improve production stability through mechanisms rather than repeated manual intervention.
  • Track record of raising team engineering quality through reusable patterns, operational discipline, and technical coaching.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

Establish reliable and scalable quality engineering practices for StarHub’s digital platforms across mobile, web, backend and cloud-native systems. The Senior SDET will partner with engineering, product, architecture, DevOps/SRE, security and delivery teams to shift quality left, build meaningful automated quality gates, transition vendor-owned automation into sustainable in-house ownership, and provide fast, risk-based release confidence during migration, refactoring and platform modernisation initiatives.

Accountabilities

  • Take ownership of the existing test automation from vendors and establish clear quality and governance standards, documentation, CI integration, reliability and maintainability expectations so automation becomes an integral part of product engineering.
  • Improve coverage, reliability and efficiency of automated tests across different platforms like web, mobile and backend
  • Improve quality of releases in terms of user experience and satisfaction by ensuring testability and automated tests are treated as first class citizens in the SDLC

Responsibilities

  • Partner with developers to design and implement tests at the right layer of the test pyramid or testing trophy, including unit, component, contract, API, integration, e2e, visual, accessibility
  • Setup automated quality gates across the SDLC to ensure issues are found as early as possible
  • Establish and track metrics for test automation to drive improvement and accountability
  • Improve test automation coverage, reliability and efficiency.
  • Use AI agents and coding assistants responsibly to assist with test planning, requirements analysis, risk discovery, test design, automation development, test data generation, failure triage, coverage gap analysis, documentation and refactoring.
  • Build internal tools, libraries, and platforms that make quality practices easier for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers to improve testability, observability, data setup, environment reliability and release confidence.
  • Work with stakeholders across engineering and QE to ensure alignment on automation approaches and goals.
  • Work with vendors to deliver automation solutions to the standards defined.
  • Write clear technical documentation, RFCs, test plans, READMEs, onboarding guides and quality playbooks.

Areas of Impact:

  • Stakeholders: QA, Engineering, Program/Delivery Management, Product
  • Decision Rights: Strongly advise QA/Automation tools and license purchase, strongly advise KPIs for the test automation team
  • Resources: ~10 automation resources from vendors as peers, some existing licenses for UiPath, BrowserStack

Ideal Track Record:

  • Delivered automated tests (unit, integration, e2e) covering significant critical user journeys and behaviours, measurable regression improvement times in hours if not in days
  • Designed, or at least significantly contributed to, and implemented automated test frameworks from scratch that have measurably improved test efficiency.
  • Designed dashboards for reporting on test automation stats to stakeholders
  • Integrated tests with CI/CD pipelines
  • Used AI coding assistants or agents such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex or equivalent for testing, automation, documentation, triage or quality analysis.
  • Managed test environments and test automation infrastructure on cloud services like AWS, GCP, Browserstack, LambdaTest.
  • Built internal tools and utilities to make testing and QE easily accessible for both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders improving productivity.

job.title: Lead Data Platform Enginner
job.description:
Responsibilities:

  • Platform Engineering & Operations:

Own AWS infrastructure for DXP Data Platform (multi-AZ, multi-VPC setup).

  • - Administer Snowflake environments, including user roles, RBAC, performance optimization, warehouse lifecycle, and cost controls.
  • - Manage SageMaker environments (Studio, Canvas, Notebooks) for enabling multi-domain ML use cases.
  • - Operate DataPipes (EKS + Airflow) for ingestion orchestration, ensuring high availability and version-controlled configurations via IaC (CloudFormation/CDK).
  • - Maintain & enhance logging, monitoring, observability & DevOps automation via modern tools such as CloudWatch, Splunk, PagerDuty, Slack, ServiceNow, Snowflake observability features.
  • Platform Prototyping & Enhancement:
  • - Design, prototype, and implement new platform features across AWS, Snowflake, and SageMaker to support innovation in data processing, analytics, and ML operations.
  • Lead rollout and production hardening of new platform components (e.g., new Snowflake Cortex AI features, SageMaker pipelines, AWS-native services).
  • Evaluate and integrate new services or capabilities aligned to StarHub’s data platform roadmap.
  • Develop technical design standards and documentation for new features and automation processes.
  • Automation & Continuous Improvement:

Implement Day 2 platform enhancements including auto-scaling, self-healing workflows, and CI/CD automation.

  • Enhance EKS cluster performance, pipeline automation, and integration efficiency across cloud and on-prem data sources.
  • Drive infrastructure-as-code (IaC) adoption for all environments and standardize rollout strategies (blue-green/canary).
  • Governance, Security & Compliance:

Enforce enterprise security policies for IAM, VPC isolation, PrivateLink, and encryption (KMS, Secrets Manager).

  • Coordinate vulnerability remediation (EKS upgrades, CVE patching, EC2 AMI refresh, Docker image hardening).
  • Ensure infrastructure audit readiness in partnership with Information Security (ITSec) and Compliance teams.
  • Operations & Cost Management:

Monitor and optimize Snowflake warehouse utilization, compute spend, and S3 data lifecycle management.

  • Maintain tagging, dashboards, and cost visibility frameworks across AWS and Snowflake.
  • Implement cost governance guardrails and usage quotas across platform components.
  • Team & Vendor Leadership:

Lead a blended team of StarHub engineers and partner vendors responsible for platform sustainment and evolution.

  • Manage augmented vendor teams, ensuring consistent delivery quality and knowledge transfer to internal engineers.
  • Build in-house capability in platform engineering, IaC, and automation disciplines.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: DXP Data Platform infrastructure (AWS, Snowflake, SageMaker, Datapipe) supporting C360, AI/ML, and analytics workloads enterprise-wide.
  • Decision Rights: Platform design approval, selection of new AWS/Snowflake/SageMaker capabilities, DevOps tooling and IaC framework choices, and vendor performance oversight.
  • Stakeholders: Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Data Science, Architecture & Governance, Information Security, and Infrastructure teams.
  • Resources: Hybrid team of ~2-4 engineers (StarHub and partner resources) managing infrastructure, platform automation, enhancements, and operations.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 8-10 years of experience in cloud and platform engineering, with extensive experience on AWS-based data platforms.
  • Proven leadership of cross-functional engineering teams managing production-grade, multi-environment platforms.
  • Hands-on expertise in:

AWS Services: VPC, EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, KMS, CloudFormation/CDK, Transfer Family, CloudWatch, CloudTrail.

Snowflake: administration, RBAC, warehouse optimization, DevOps automation, Cortex AI, and Streamlit integration.

EKS / Airflow / Airbyte (Datapipe): container orchestration, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.

SageMaker: multi-domain setup, pipeline management, Studio/Canvas lifecycle, and MLOps enablement.

Monitoring & Observability: CloudWatch, Splunk, Snowflake Account Usage, cost dashboards, PagerDuty, Slack, ServiceNow.

  • Demonstrated success in prototyping, implementing, and scaling new cloud and data platform features into production.
  • Experience managing Day 2 operations, incident response, and SRE-driven performance stabilization.
  • Familiarity with machine learning integration and model lifecycle management.
  • Experience enforcing ITSec and compliance standards (IAM, KMS, PDPA/GDPR).
  • Proven success in transitioning platform operations from vendor-managed to in-house ownership.

  • Build and maintain long-term partnerships and develop trusted advisor relationships with key executives and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
