job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and closing projects in a secure and regulated environment, with a focus on Singapore government-related initiatives. The role requires strong stakeholder management, disciplined project governance, risk and issue management, and the ability to deliver projects on time, within scope, and within budget while ensuring compliance with security, regulatory, and organizational standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end project management activities from initiation to closure.
  • Work with both internal and external stakeholders to define scope, objectives, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Develop project plan, work breakdown structures, milestones and dependencies, resource planning
  • Prepare and conduct project kick-off meetings, status updates and stakeholder reviews.
  • Track project progress against schedule, scope, budget, and quality targets.
  • Manage project risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies; ensure timely escalation and resolution.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure clear ownership and delivery accountability.
  • Monitor project financials including budget, actuals, commitments, and forecast.
  • Ensure compliance with government security requirements, internal policies, and approved delivery processes.
  • Support documentation needs including SOW, status reports, meeting minutes, and closure reports.
  • Manage vendor and third-party delivery where applicable.
  • Ensure deliverables are completed with proper approvals, testing, and handover.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or Degree in Project Management, Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 3 to 8 years of experience in project management or project coordination.
  • Experience working on government, secure, regulated or enterprise IT projects is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of project governance, scheduling, stakeholder engagement, and risk management.
  • Proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint, Jira, or equivalent.
  • Strong communication, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Requirements

  • Project management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, CAPM, or equivalent.
  • Experience working in secure environments and compliance requirements.
  • Familiarity with government processes and/or security-related delivery standards.

Key Competencies

  • Stakeholder management
  • Planning and organization
  • Risk and issue management
  • Strong written and verbal communication
  • Attention to detail
  • Analytical thinking
  • Ownership and accountability
  • Ability to influence and drive outcomes

Security and Compliance Requirement

  • Possession of relevant security clearance or the ability to obtain required clearance may be necessary, depending on project requirements.

job.title: AVP, TPM Lead
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of TPMs across multiple domains to drive either (a) agile, DevOps-based or (b) waterfall-based delivery excellence
  • Define and maintain a standardized delivery governance framework — covering sprint cadence, backlog hygiene, dependency tracking, and reporting.
  • Oversee delivery execution across DXP domains, ensuring commitments are met with predictable outcomes.
  • Lead monthly delivery health reviews, highlighting key risks, capacity challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Domain Owners (DXP) and Journey SDs (DBE) to balance Product, Tech Debt, and Technical Campaign backlogs across teams.

Cross-Domain Coordination & Governance

  • Act as the central delivery integrator across DBE, ensuring synchronization between journeys, domains, and releases.
  • Collaborate with Release Program Managers (RPMs) to ensure alignment of delivery and release plans.
  • Establish and maintain a cross-domain dependency management framework with clear escalation paths.
  • Monitor delivery performance metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput) and drive corrective actions where needed.
  • Drive adoption of continuous improvement practices across all DXP squads.

People Management & Capability Development

  • Coach and mentor TPMs, supporting their career development, skills growth, and performance reviews.
  • Foster a culture of proactive communication, accountability, and continuous learning across the TPM community.
  • Lead training sessions or playbook initiatives to strengthen agile delivery maturity, tooling proficiency, and reporting discipline.
  • Identify and recruit high-performing TPM talent aligned to StarHub’s transformation roadmap.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior engineering, business, and architecture leaders — ensuring transparency on delivery health and execution status.
  • Communicate program-level risks, trade-offs, and delivery decisions clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Represent the TPM function in enterprise forums, transformation reviews, and cross-functional working groups.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Advanced certifications in Agile, DevOps, or Program Management (e.g., SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, CSM) preferred

Experience

  • 12+ years of total experience in technology delivery, with at least 5 years in managing project/program teams or TPM functions.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale, cross-functional software or platform programs using agile and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in telecommunications, cloud platforms, or enterprise-scale digital transformation preferred.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management, dependency resolution, and performance reporting.

job.title: Associate Network Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

This role will be based at client site. Associate Network Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining mission-critical Wireless network infrastructure. The role involves troubleshooting, maintenance, incident response, preventive maintenance, implementation activities, vendor coordination, and support for large-scale wireless environments operating in a 24/7 environment.

Job Responsibilities

•Support day-to-day operations of wireless infrastructure including Cisco Wireless solutions, Aruba solutions, switches, firewalls, captive portals, and authentication systems.

•Perform troubleshooting for Wireless connectivity issues, DNS, DHCP, captive portal access, OTP login issues, VLAN routing, authentication failures, and internet access problems.

•Manage service technical escalations and support major incident troubleshooting during service disruptions.

•Support preventive maintenance, firmware upgrades, patching, and technology refresh activities for wireless and network infrastructure.

•Support WLC upgrade activities including Access Point image updates, failover testing, rollback planning, and validation activities.

•Work closely with vendor TAC such as Cisco TAC and Aruba TAC for issue analysis and problem resolution.

•Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and prepare incident reports, technical findings, and preventive recommendations.

•Support implementation activities including Access Point deployment, switch replacement, firewall migration, SSL certificate updates, and network migrations.

•Coordinate with stakeholders, vendors, contractors, and facility management teams during maintenance and implementation activities.

•Support testing activities such as congestion testing, failover testing, WiFi roaming optimization, and POE/network validation.

•Monitor infrastructure health using tools such as Catalyst Center, AirWave, SevOne, LogicMonitor, NetAlly.

•Fluent in ITSM Incident, Change Management, Service Request platforms such as ServiceNow.

•Maintain technical documentation including install plans, diagrams, inventory records, validation evidence, and maintenance reports.

•Support after-office-hour maintenance windows, standby support, and emergency troubleshooting activities.

•Ensure compliance with operational governance, safety requirements, and change management procedures.

Qualifications

Diploma, Higher NITEC, or equivalent qualification in IT or related discipline.

Basic knowledge of networking, WiFi, internet connectivity, and endpoint devices.

Experience in Service Desk, Helpdesk, NOC, or customer support environments preferred.

Good communication, coordination, and customer service skills.

Familiarity with ServiceNow or ITSM ticketing systems is advantageous.

Work Arrangement

Onsite support role

May require standby support, shift work, and after-office-hour maintenance activities depending on operational requirements.

job.title: Senior / Manager Cloud FinOps (Based in Malaysia)
job.description:
Job Description

As a Cloud FinOps Lead, you are responsible for developing and implementing a comprehensive framework for cloud cost management. You must possess strong technical expertise and be deeply familiar with public clouds (AWS, Azure) to effectively drive cost optimization initiatives.

This role requires leading efforts to adopt the latest AWS strategies for cost savings. The cost-saving initiatives must be cloud-agnostic, capable of identifying optimization opportunities, distinguishing critical from non-critical workloads and providing recommendations to expedite savings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Analyze Cloud Spending: Continuously monitor and analyze AWS cloud costs to identify trends, inefficiencies, and areas for cost savings.
  • Cost Optimization Strategies: Develop and implement strategies to optimize AWS cloud costs, including rightsizing resources, leveraging reserved instances, savings plans, and eliminating unused resources.
  • Resource Management: Review and manage AWS resources to ensure efficient utilization while aligning with organizational needs and cost objectives.
  • Pricing Model Analysis: Evaluate and recommend suitable AWS pricing models (e.g., on-demand, spot instances, reserved instances) based on workload requirements and cost-efficiency considerations.
  • Reporting: Generate detailed cost reports and forecasts, offering actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders.
  • Cost Governance: Define, establish, and enforce policies and best practices for cloud cost management across the organization.
  • Performance KPIs: Define cloud cost performance KPIs and ensure regular tracking and reporting against agreed benchmarks.
  • Tool Implementation: Configure and utilize AWS tools and third-party solutions such as AWS Cost Explorer, Trusted Advisor, and cloud management platforms for effective cost management.
  • Collaboration: Build strong working relationships with application owners, Finance, and other teams to understand cloud usage patterns and develop cost-effective solutions. Proactively engage with IS and business communities as a visible ambassador of IT initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Stay current with the latest AWS features, cost management tools, and industry best practices to enhance cost optimization strategies continuously.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience with one/more public/private cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, etc.).
  • Experience with capacity forecasting, cloud cost optimization techniques, financial reporting, and workflow management in a large service operations environment. Familiarity with monitoring and reporting tools/APIs.
  • Understanding of cloud providers, platforms and configurations and familiarity with workload usage/consumption patterns on cloud.
  • Good understanding of billing on cloud platforms (incl. impact of usage patterns on TCO)
  • Ability to develop effective reporting schemes/metrics to maintain strong control on usage and billing of cloud services.
  • Ability to liaise with multiple stakeholders (across IS, finance, business functions) and proactively identify opportunities for service improvement.
  • Demonstrated skills in working across multi-functional teams to bring increased business value through seeing the bigger picture, collaboration and alignment of diverse needs
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect certification preferred

job.title: Lead Provisioning DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

As a Lead Provisioning DevOps Engineer at StarHub, you will own the end-to-end DevOps strategy, platform reliability, and release governance for mission-critical DXP Provisioning platforms. You will lead the design and evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platform architecture, cloud infrastructure, observability, and production operations practices that support high-volume telco customer journeys across provisioning, charging, billing, and network activation.

This role requires strong working knowledge of end-to-end telco flows, including CRM -> Order Management -> Provisioning -> Charging -> Network, and hands-on exposure to provisioning or online charging environments such as IN, OCS, PCRF/PCF, UDM, HLR/HSS, CRM/BSS integrations, mediation, balance management, and rating or charging flows. You will work across engineering, operations, product, vendor, and business teams to ensure customer-impacting journeys are delivered safely, monitored effectively, and operated with a strong RCA and revenue-assurance mindset.

The role goes beyond execution. You will drive DevOps best practices, establish SRE capabilities, improve production stability, and guide engineers in delivering faster, safer, and more reliable platform changes across high-availability telco environments.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive DevOps strategy and operating model for DXP Provisioning, CRM/OM, and charging-adjacent platforms, acting as the technical escalation point for complex production issues.
  • Ensure end-to-end reliability of provisioning and telco customer journeys across CRM, order orchestration, provisioning, charging, billing, mediation, and network activation flows.
  • Support and improve integrations with telco network and charging systems, including IN/OCS, PCRF/PCF, HLR/HSS/UDM, CRM/BSS, mediation platforms, and external partner APIs.
  • Lead design reviews and operational readiness for provisioning flow design, order orchestration, service activation, service modification, suspension, restoration, termination, and charging-triggered workflows.
  • Troubleshoot real-time provisioning and charging issues involving SOAP/REST APIs, middleware, Diameter/CAMEL interfaces, event flows, Kafka-based integrations, and microservices.
  • Support production incidents, failed provisioning cases, charging mismatches, balance or rating defects, revenue leakage investigations, reconciliation gaps, and high-severity operational escalations.
  • Architect and govern end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Pipeline-as-Code, GitLab CI, and GitOps practices such as Argo CD or Flux, enabling safe and repeatable releases.
  • Lead trunk-based development adoption, automated testing, quality gates, deployment validation, rollback controls, and release safety mechanisms across microservices.
  • Design and operate multi-cluster Kubernetes platforms such as EKS and OpenShift, including networking, RBAC, scaling, resilience, workload standardization, and platform governance.
  • Govern AWS cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation, ensuring security, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational resilience.
  • Apply SRE practices by defining SLOs/SLIs, improving reliability and performance, leading incident management, and driving structured root-cause analysis and problem management.
  • Establish observability and operational excellence using Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK, alerting, reconciliation dashboards, SLA monitoring, and on-call tooling.
  • Drive automation for provisioning operations, incident response, reconciliation, environment provisioning, release validation, and platform maintenance.
  • Contribute to code improvements, architecture reviews, operational governance, engineering standards, runbooks, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  • Mentor engineers and influence cross-functional teams to improve delivery quality, platform maturity, and production ownership.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience across DevOps, SRE, platform engineering, software engineering, or telco provisioning/charging operations, with at least 2-3 years in a senior or technical leadership role.
  • Strong exposure to provisioning systems and/or online charging platforms in a telco environment, such as IN, OCS, PCRF/PCF, HLR/HSS/UDM, CRM/BSS integrations, mediation, balance management, or rating and charging flows.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end telco flows across CRM, order management, provisioning, charging, billing, mediation, and network systems.
  • Hands-on experience supporting production incidents, failed provisioning cases, charging mismatches, reconciliation issues, revenue assurance investigations, SLA breaches, and high-severity escalations.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with hands-on experience supporting microservices-based and distributed architectures.
  • Good understanding of APIs, middleware, orchestration patterns, event-driven integrations, SOAP/REST services, Kafka, and real-time integration troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with telco protocols and charging/network concepts such as Diameter, CAMEL, real-time rating, balance management, PCRF/PCF policy flows, and subscriber data management.
  • Deep understanding of scalability, reliability engineering, high availability, production system performance, and operational governance.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with:
  • Kubernetes, preferably EKS and/or OpenShift, Helm, and container orchestration
  • CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitLab CI and GitOps practices
  • AWS cloud services and cloud-native architecture
  • Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation
  • Observability tools such as Splunk, Grafana, Prometheus, CloudWatch, ELK, and alerting platforms
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on PostgreSQL administration, query analysis, and performance tuning experience.
  • Proficiency in Python and shell scripting for automation, operational tooling, and platform maintenance.
  • Experience implementing reconciliation, SLA monitoring, observability, dashboarding, and alert tuning across business-critical workflows.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with strong stakeholder management, communication, vendor coordination, and technical leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, production-critical, high-availability telco environment.

job.title: Senior Matrixx SME DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks. Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs). Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements. Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns. Containerization and Deployment: Develop and manage services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes, including defining Dockerfiles and Kubernetes resource configurations (Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, etc.). Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment. Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment. Architecture and Data: Contribute to the architectural design of microservices, focusing on principles like loose coupling, high cohesion, and fault tolerance. Implement various data persistence technologies, including relational (e.g., PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Redis). Integrate services using messaging systems (e.g., Red Hat AMQ) where required. Collaboration and Quality: Perform code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge within the team. Ensure compliance with security standards and industry regulations by performing security vulnerability scans (SAST, DAST, SCA) and disaster recovery exercise. Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision. Knowledge Management: Build technical documentation from scratch, maintaining working documents on architecture overviews, API specifications and system integrations. Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. • Java Expertise: Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in developing enterprise applications using Java and the Spring Boot framework. • Microservices and API: Strong understanding of microservices architecture, principles, and best practices. Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage. • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools. • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering. • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm. • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices. • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript). • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices. • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting. • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams. • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

job.title: Senior Provisioning QA Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance and Testing: Design, prepare, and execute functional, regression, integration, API, system, and end-to-end test cases. Review business requirements, technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria to identify test scenarios and coverage gaps. Validate microservices, RESTful APIs, batch jobs, messaging flows, and system integrations. Perform defect analysis, raise clear and detailed bug reports, and work with delivery teams through resolution and retesting. Support release validation, production verification, and post-deployment quality checks.

Test Automation and CI/CD: Develop and maintain automated test scripts for API, regression, and integration testing. Support automated testing within CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins. Work with tools and frameworks used for test execution, reporting, and defect tracking. Contribute to improving test automation coverage, reliability, and maintainability.

Platform and Technical Validation: Test services deployed on OpenShift/Kubernetes environments. Validate application behavior across deployment, configuration, upgrade, rollback, and recovery scenarios. Monitor and analyze logs, alerts, and system behavior during testing and production issue investigation. Collaboration and Quality Governance: Work closely with development, DevOps, operations, and business teams to ensure quality throughout the delivery lifecycle. Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, release readiness reviews, and sprint ceremonies. Provide clear testing status, risks, blockers, and quality recommendations to stakeholders. Knowledge Management and Documentation: Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test evidence, defect reports, release validation summaries, and QA sign-off documents. Write clear technical and functional documentation that can be understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Maintain QA knowledge materials, testing checklists, operational runbooks, and known issue documentation. Demonstrate strong comprehension skills when interpreting requirements, API specifications, architecture documents, logs, and incident reports.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in QA, software testing, or quality engineering.

Strong experience in functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, API testing, and defect management.

Experience testing Java, Spring Boot, microservices, RESTful APIs, and enterprise integration flows.

Familiarity with Apache Camel, messaging systems such as Red Hat AMQ, and enterprise integration patterns is an advantage.

Experience with test automation tools and API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, Selenium, JUnit, TestNG, Cucumber, or similar.

Working knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, or OpenShift environments.

Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, including the ability to validate data and investigate defects through queries.

Comfortable with Linux commands, log analysis, basic networking concepts, and troubleshooting.

Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and defect investigation skills.

Excellent writing, comprehension, communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

Ability to write clear test cases, defect reports, test summaries, and stakeholder updates.

Ability to understand complex requirements, technical documents, API specifications, and production issues with minimal supervision.

job.title: Senior Engineer, Cyber GRC
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:The role ofCyber GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance)is to ensure that an organization's cybersecurity strategy aligns with its business goals, manages policies/standards/frameworks, manages cyber risks effectively, provides oversight and independent 2nd line control review/testing, and adheres to external regulations.

Accountabilities

  • Drive and lead the end-to-end lifecycle of information security governance & policy management.
  • Drive and lead the cyber risk management and reporting.
  • Drive and lead the 2nd line assurance & compliance monitoring.
  • Drive 2nd line oversight and support for audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders.
  • Drive security culture, advisory & stakeholder engagement

Responsibilities

  • Manage the development of Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies for adoption
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies compliance risk
  • Manage the cyber risk oversight by evaluating the adequacy and effectiveness of risk management practices and controls implemented by 1st line (i.e. risk owner, control owner, control supervisor, control performers) of Starhub to ensure proper adherence to risk assessment processes.
  • Manage the Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies security/risk deviation process
  • Manage the Starhub risk profile and maintain the Starhub risk register for IT Security / Cybersecurity risks relating to CII & Non-CII
  • Develop and drive regular monitoring and reporting of Starhub key risk indicators for Cybersecurity
  • Manage regular risk reporting and risk escalation to Senior Management or other relevant risk forums
  • Manage Control & Compliance Framework through timely updates of industry standards and regulatory compliance requirements
  • Perform 2nd line assurance review (e.g. control review/testing) on 1st line stakeholders to ensure adherence with Starhub policies and Sub-policies / Regulatory compliance requirements, provide actionable, recommendations, and engage stakeholders for implementation
  • Provide timely communication / awareness to stakeholders on Starhub policies and sub-policies for implementation
  • Provide advisory to stakeholders on Starhub Information Security policies and sub-policies requirement
  • Conduct briefings and trainings on Cyber risk / Policy awareness (i.e. Cyber risk management process, Policy compliance, Emerging cyber risk/trend, Issues and Observations from 2nd line control review/testing, and audit related findings) to relevant stakeholders and to support the Starhub Cybersecurity Awareness Programme.
  • Provide 2nd Line oversight and support throughout the audit engagement with 1st line stakeholders: ensuring readiness before the audit begins, facilitating fieldwork execution, and monitoring remediation of findings post-audit.
  • Maintaining a tracker for audit findings (or audit issues registers) to monitor remediation progress, to ensure audit closure issues, to support the scoping for 2nd line assurance review.

Qualifications

1.More than 3 years of experience in information/cybersecurity and risk management Experience in leading cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives

2.Experience in IT/IT-Security policy development and implementation

3.Experience in driving IT-security thematic assessment and IT audits

4.Good knowledge and experience with handling IT-security and cybersecurity audits

5.Good knowledge of experience in driving compliance to meet cybersecurity regulatory requirements

6.Good problem analysis and resolution skills

7.Good and experience stakeholder management skills

job.title: Business Analyst, FRCS
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission

Support the delivery and optimisation of StarHub’s Finance, Risk & Compliance Systems (FRCS) by providing business analysis and delivery support for both StarHub core operations and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).

This role focuses on supporting acquired entities during integration and steady-state operations, while also managing day-to-day partnering with StarHub Finance and FRCS teams to ensure requirements, processes, and system changes are clearly understood and documented.

Accountabilities

  • Support business analysis activities for FRCS initiatives covering both StarHub and acquired entities (e.g. MRBB).
  • Act as a day-to-day analysis support contact for acquired entities, helping them articulate finance, risk, and compliance needs in alignment with StarHub standards.
  • Assist in documenting business and functional requirements for BAU, post-acquisition, and stabilisation activities.
  • Support process understanding and alignment between acquired entities and StarHub FRCS processes.
  • Enable effective communication and partnering between acquired entities, StarHub Finance teams, IS delivery teams, and vendors through clear documentation.

Responsibilities

  • Support acquired entities (e.g. MRBB) by gathering and documenting requirements, issues, and process gaps related to FRCS systems.
  • Assist in documenting current-state processes for acquired entities and comparing them against StarHub target processes, under guidance from Functional Leads.
  • Support StarHub Finance and FRCS teams by documenting change requests, enhancements, and BAU requirements.
  • Translate inputs from Finance users and Functional Leads into clear requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for both StarHub and acquired entities, including test preparation, coordination, and defect tracking.
  • Assist with documenting process and system impacts for acquired entities during post-acquisition changes.
  • Work closely with IS delivery teams and vendors to clarify documented requirements and support issue resolution.
  • Maintain analysis artefacts and documentation in line with FRCS governance standards.

Areas of Impact

  • Smooth day-to-day FRCS support for acquired entities through clearer requirements and process understanding.
  • Improved alignment between acquired entities’ finance processes and StarHub FRCS standards.
  • Reduced misunderstandings and rework during post-acquisition system changes.
  • Effective partnering support for StarHub Finance teams through timely and accurate analysis.
  • Improved readiness of users across StarHub and acquired entities for FRCS system changes.

Ideal Track Record

  • 8–12 years of experience in People Systems functional roles.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into system-enabled process design.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms (e.g. SAP SuccessFactors) from a functional / business perspective.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with various departments and vendors in complex organisations.
  • Experience in regulated or large enterprise environments preferred

job.title: Functional Analyst - RTR, FRCS
job.description:

  • Support system enhancements, testing, and documentation for RTR functionality.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse, document, and translate RTR business requirements into system specifications.
  • Support configuration, testing, and deployment of RTR features in ERP and consolidation systems.
  • Assist Finance with month-end close activities, including reconciliations and reporting validations.
  • Troubleshoot RTR-related issues in journals, GL postings, subledgers, and financial reporting.
  • Validate data flow between ERP, EPM, and other finance-dependent platforms.
  • Participate in UAT planning, test execution, and defect resolution.
  • Work with Technical Analysts to support integration touchpoints.
  • Identify opportunities for RTR process automation and efficiency improvements.
  • Maintain functional documentation, SOPs, and training materials.
  • Support audit, compliance, and internal control requirements related to RTR.

Areas of Impact

  • Timeliness and accuracy of month-end financial close.
  • Quality and reliability of financial data across reporting systems.
  • Standardisation and optimisation of RTR processes.
  • Strengthened compliance and internal controls.
  • Reduced manual effort and improved operational efficiency.

Ideal Track Record

  • 3–7 years of experience in RTR, finance operations, or ERP functional roles.
  • Strong understanding of general ledger, financial reporting, fixed assets, and reconciliations.

job.title: Head, IAM
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Drive the implementation, optimisation, and adoption of identity and access management (IAM) capabilities across StarHub, ensuring secure, compliant, and seamless user access to enterprise platforms, with an initial focus on Google Workspace (GWS) enablement and identity uplift. This role owns the identity product lifecycle, including licensing, configuration, process optimisation, and user experience, while ensuring alignment with security, compliance, and business needs.

Accountabilities Own the Identity product roadmap covering IAM, SSO, and DLP capabilities. Drive successful implementation and adoption of identity services, with GWS as a priority platform. Optimise licensing, access models, and identity-related processes to improve efficiency and control. Ensure identity solutions meet security, compliance, and governance requirements. Partner with Security, IS, and business stakeholders to uplift identity maturity across the organisation.

Responsibilities Lead product ownership for IAM, SSO, and DLP solutions, from requirements through delivery and optimisation. Drive GWS identity integration, including user lifecycle management, access controls, and SSO enablement. Define and manage identity-related licensing models, ensuring cost efficiency and correct entitlement usage. Optimise joiner–mover–leaver (JML) and access provisioning processes through automation and standardisation. Partner with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to embed security, privacy, and compliance controls into identity design. Collaborate with IS delivery teams, vendors, and integrators to ensure quality and timely implementation. Establish identity governance, including access standards, role models, and approval workflows. Monitor product performance, adoption, and risk indicators to drive continuous improvement. Provide clear product guidance and prioritisation to stakeholders and delivery teams.

Areas of Impact Enterprise identity security and access control effectiveness. Successful GWS rollout enabled by robust identity foundations. Reduced access risk through standardised IAM and SSO processes. Improved user experience through seamless and secure access. Cost optimisation and transparency of identity-related licensing

Ideal Track Record 8–12 years of experience in identity management, security platforms, or enterprise product management. Proven experience delivering IAM, SSO, or access-related platforms in large organisations. Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access governance, and security controls. Experience supporting collaboration platforms (e.g. GWS, M365) from an identity perspective preferred. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with Security, IS, and business teams.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist
job.description:

Constantly review and ensure that current methodology conforms and meets industry standards.

Qualifications

job.title: SM, SMO (Test & Quality Engineering)
job.description:
##

Role Mission

Lead and institutionalise enterprise-wide testing strategy, governance, and quality engineering practices to ensure StarHub’s corporate systems are resilient, secure, scalable, and consistently production-ready. Drive a culture of quality-by-design and continuous testing across the BTS ecosystem.

Accountabilities Own and evolve the enterprise testing and quality engineering strategy, aligned with BTS transformation goals. Provide leadership oversight for end-to-end testing governance across all corporate enterprise systems and platforms. Drive adoption of automation-first, continuous testing, and quality engineering practices across delivery teams. Ensure integration quality, release readiness, and production stability across complex, interdependent systems. Establish and govern vendor ecosystem, tooling strategy, and performance outcomes for testing services. Build and scale a Business Applications Testing Centre of Excellence (TCoE) to uplift organisational testing maturity and standardisation.

Responsibilities Define, implement, and continuously enhance the enterprise-wide testing strategy, governance model, and quality standards. Lead centralised test governance and operating model, ensuring consistency across programmes, platforms, and vendors. Establish and track enterprise quality KPIs (e.g., defect leakage, automation coverage, release readiness, system reliability). Provide executive-level visibility on quality health, risks, and release readiness across BTS initiatives. Oversee end-to-end testing lifecycle including planning, design, execution, and production validation across multiple programmes. Ensure comprehensive functional and non-functional testing coverage (performance, resilience, security, usability, scalability). Enforce quality gates and release governance to ensure all deployments meet enterprise standards. Drive large-scale adoption of test automation and continuous testing integrated into CI/CD pipelines. Lead strategy and standardisation of testing tools, frameworks, and platforms across BTS. Champion shift-left and shift-right testing practices, embedding quality early and continuously across the lifecycle. Partner with senior stakeholders (delivery leads, architects, product owners, service managers) to align on quality outcomes and delivery priorities. Provide leadership oversight of QA vendors, ensuring strategic alignment, SLA/KPI adherence, and value realisation. Integrate testing with Service Management processes to ensure seamless transition from delivery to operations. Lead enterprise-level defect management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. Develop and grow internal testing capabilities, including talent development and capability uplift within the TCoE.

Areas of Impact Enterprise-wide quality, testing maturity, and release reliability across corporate systems. System integration integrity, UAT effectiveness, and production stability. Automation adoption and CI/CD pipeline efficiency at scale. Vendor performance optimisation and cost-effectiveness of testing services. Reduction in defects, incidents, and operational risks.

##

Ideal Track Record

12–18 years of experience in software testing, quality engineering, or service management, with significant leadership responsibility. Proven track record of defining and leading enterprise testing strategies in complex, large-scale environments. Strong experience driving test automation, continuous testing, and DevOps quality practices. Deep understanding of Agile, DevOps, and ITIL frameworks in enterprise settings. Demonstrated success in managing multi-vendor ecosystems and cross-functional delivery at scale. Experience building or leading Testing Centres of Excellence or similar capability uplift initiatives.

job.title: Senior Matrixx SME DevOps Engineer
job.description:
Key Responsibilities:

Design and Development: Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and resilient microservices using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks. Hands-on experience with Apache Camel and its core Enterprise Integration Patterns (EIPs). Implement RESTful APIs and ensure services meet performance, security, and stability requirements. Write clean, well-tested, and efficient code following best practices and design patterns. Work with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins) for automated build, test, and deployment. Monitor and troubleshoot services running in the OpenShift environment. Support on-call duty on shift rotation and handle production incident and root cause analysis with minimal supervision. Create and maintain operational runbooks to support the team and internal stakeholders.

Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs. • Containerization: Proficient with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for deployment and orchestration. Experience with OpenShift-specific features is a significant advantage. • Database: Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases. • Tools: Familiarity with Git, Maven/Gradle, and CI/CD tools. • Combined experience in DevOps, SRE, or Software Engineering. • Familiar with containerized environments, Kubernetes internals, and Helm. • Hands-on production experience with Jenkins and CI/CD best practices. • Proficiency in at least one programming language (Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript). • Solid understanding of AWS core services, IAM security, and cost-optimization practices. • Comfortable with Linux internals, networking fundamentals, and shell scripting. • Agile mindset with experience working in Scrum teams. • Excellent communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

job.title: App DevOps
job.description:
Role Mission

The DevOps & Application Engineer will design, automate, and optimize the build-and-release ecosystem while ensuring the reliability, scalability, and security of StarHub’s cloud-native platforms. They will manage Kubernetes operations, infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD pipelines, and GitOps workflows, while contributing production-grade application code across multiple languages. This role accelerates engineering velocity by driving DevOps best practices, strengthening observability, and enabling consistent, high-quality deployments across the IS Division.

Key Responsibilities

• Define and enforce DevOps policies and best practices, with a strong focus on trunk-based development (short-lived feature branches, continuous integration gates, automated code-quality checks). • Design, develop, and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins using Pipeline-as-Code (shared libraries, scripted & declarative). • Write and manage build scripts and infrastructure tooling (Shell, Python, Groovy) to automate the software-delivery lifecycle. • Administer multi-cluster Kubernetes environments (EKS & OCP), including Helm chart development, RBAC, network policies, and autoscaling. • Implement GitOps workflows (Argo CD or Flux) to promote reproducible, auditable deployments. • Provision and manage AWS resources (EKS, RDS/PostgreSQL, EC2, S3, IAM). • Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CloudFormation). • Contribute application code in Python, Go, or TypeScript, participating in design reviews and performance profiling. • Establish observability with Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and incident-response workflows (PagerDuty). • Author technical documentation and provide knowledge transfer to internal teams.

• Maintain Internal Developer Portal - Backstage

Preferred Certifications

• Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)

job.title: Lead Data Quality Steward
job.description:
Role Mission:

To lead DXP C360 Data Platform data quality stewardship execution by combining stewardship, analytical, and practical engineering skills to make trusted data measurable, operational, understandable and sustainable. This role owns the design and upkeep of data quality controls, catalog integrity, trust metadata, and issue-remediation workflows for priority datasets, ensuring business users can rely on governed data products for self-service analytics.

This is a hands-on stewardship role with engineering depth: it is expected to implement DQ automation, analyse data patterns, maintain catalog and trust metadata, and partner with Data Engineering to embed controls into production flows. It is not a pure policy or governance coordinator role.

Accountabilities:

  • Own the data stewardship execution model for priority C360 datasets, including ownership, trust status, certification criteria, and quality controls.
  • Design, implement & improve automated data quality rules, checks, and remediation workflows for governed datasets; include leveraging AI agents where possible.
  • Maintain data catalog hygiene and trust metadata so critical datasets are discoverable, understandable, and certified for use.
  • Analyse data patterns, exceptions, and recurring defects to identify root causes, quality trends, and control gaps.
  • Partner with Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Architecture & Governance, BI, and business owners to translate business definitions into executable quality and trust controls.
  • Lead stewardship operations across domains by setting standards, coaching stewards, and driving consistent issue handling and escalation.
  • Improve data trust & literacy maturity through practical mechanisms, not manual follow-up or documentation alone.

Responsibilities:

  • DQ Automation & Control Design
  • Define, implement and improve automated checks for completeness, uniqueness, validity, referential integrity, reconciliation, freshness, and schema drift.
  • Use SQL, Python, Snowflake, orchestration tooling, and metadata workflows to operationalize DQ checks and issue detection.
  • Build reusable patterns for DQ checks, thresholding, alerting, and exception handling across domains.
  • Catalog & Trust Metadata Upkeep
  • Maintain data catalog entries, glossary alignment, ownership metadata, business definitions, and certification status for priority datasets.
  • Ensure critical datasets have clear descriptions, intended usage, trust state, and stewardship ownership.
  • Work with architects and data engineers to keep lineage notes, business terms, and technical metadata consistent.
  • Data Pattern Analysis & Issue Management
  • Analyse recurring data defects, pattern shifts, anomalies, and control failures to identify whether issues originate from source, pipeline, or business-definition gaps.
  • Triage DQ incidents, prioritize by business impact, and route to the right owner with clear evidence and expected action.
  • Convert repeated manual interventions into durable rules, controls, or monitoring mechanisms.
  • Stewardship Operating Model
  • Run the stewardship workflow for owned domains: review, decision, remediation, escalation, certification, and closure.
  • Define and maintain operating standards for issue classification, trust-state updates, exception handling, and sign-off criteria.
  • Support senior stewardship planning and cross-domain consistency without becoming a paperwork-only role.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Partner closely with Data Engineering to embed DQ checks into pipelines and curated layers, rather than bolting them on after delivery.
  • Work with BI and business owners to align dataset expectations, certification requirements, and acceptable-use boundaries.
  • Collaborate with Platform Engineering on metadata plumbing, access control interpretation, audit evidence, and enablement tooling.
  • Enablement & Coaching
  • Coach and enable domain data users on how to use data, interpret controls, interpret scorecards, and manage data trust issues.
  • Produce practical playbooks, templates, and decision logs that improve consistency and reduce dependency on manual memory.
  • Use AI-assisted summarization, classification, and knowledge retrieval to reduce stewardship toil, with human review for trust or production-impacting decisions.

Team Scope/ Stakeholders:

  • Scope: Priority C360 datasets, stewardship workflows, quality rules, catalog metadata, certification status, and trust controls across the DXP Data Platform.
  • Decision Rights: DQ rule design within stewardship domain, trust-state recommendation, issue routing and severity classification, certification workflow design, and prioritization of stewardship actions.
  • Stakeholders: Data Engineering, Platform Engineering, Architecture & Governance, BI, business data owners, source-system owners, analysts, and domain stewards.
  • Not in Scope: This role does not own downstream BI dashboards, does not own full source-system remediation, and does not replace Data Engineering for heavy pipeline build work.

Minimum Profile/ Track Record:

  • 5–9+ years of experience in data stewardship, data quality, analytics operations, data governance with technical depth, or adjacent data engineering work.
  • Strong ability to work with Snowflake SQL and Python, and to use them for profiling, rule implementation, exception analysis, and control automation.
  • Demonstrated experience implementing or operating DQ frameworks, scorecards, certification workflows, or metadata/catalog processes.
  • Strong practical understanding of how data is modeled, moved, transformed, and checked in cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Airflow, Airbyte, and AWS.
  • Ability to analyse data distributions, data drift, exception patterns, and defect recurrence to identify meaningful control improvements.
  • Experience partnering with engineers to embed quality checks into pipelines and to avoid manual recurring remediation.
  • Strong stakeholder handling: can translate business meaning into technical controls without becoming vague, overly administrative, or over-promising.
  • Comfort working with metadata tools, dashboards, ticketing workflows, and operational evidence.
  • Comfortable using AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual triage and accelerate analysis, while preserving auditability and human accountability.

Core Traits (Non-negotiables)

  • Engineering-minded stewardship: able to implement controls, not just define them.
  • Trust-first mindset: focuses on whether data can be relied on, not just whether a rule exists.
  • Pattern-based problem solving: looks for repeatable causes and converts repeated issues into mechanisms.
  • Collaborative discipline: works with engineers and business owners without over-escalating or hand-waving.
  • Production awareness: understands that stewardship exists to protect operational data use, not to create bureaucracy.

job.title: Technical Project Manager (Back-end)
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager who can combine agile delivery discipline with data platform and cloud engineering literacy to coordinate development and release cycles across StarHub’s C360 data domains.

In this role, you will work closely with Domain Owners (DOs),Data Architects, Engineering Managers (EMs), Platform Engineers, and Biz Data Analysts/Scientists to ensure on-time, high-quality delivery across systems that support StarHub’s analytics, AI, and machine learning journeys.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience with agile project delivery in a DataOps or cloud-native environment, preferably across data ingestion, transformation, and machine learning pipelines— with a solid understanding of Snowflake, AWS, CI/CD,MLOps and observability frameworks,and end-to-end delivery metrics.

![Image 1: Shape](blob:http://localhost/c4d8cdc831cbb03005a7e1f22c0efca9)

Key Responsibilities

Delivery & Agile Management

  • Drive agile ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, retrospectives) and maintain team rhythm and cadence.
  • Manage backlog hygiene, ensuring stories are well-defined, estimated, and prioritized.
  • Plan and execute phased delivery strategies across multiple environments (DEV/SIT/PROD) within AWS and Snowflake ecosystems.
  • Track delivery health through velocity, throughput, data quality SLAs, and pipeline stability metrics.
  • Identify and resolve blockers, risks, and cross-domain dependencies early.
  • Maintain clear delivery dashboards and status reporting to senior stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment between Data Engineering, Platform DevOps, and Analytics/ML teams for synchronized delivery.

Technical Coordination & Planning

  • Coordinate with DevOps and QA/QE teams to ensure readiness for integration, testing, and release.
  • Coordinate delivery dependencies with external partners across ingestion, migration, and ML projects.
  • Support Domain Owners and report on key DataOps KPIs, including ingestion success rate, pipeline failure rate, data freshness, and platform cost utilization..
  • Participate in sprint demos and ensure acceptance criteria are met for each increment.

Stakeholder & Cross-Domain Collaboration

  • Work with Data Owners, Business Unit Data Leads (CBG, EBG, FIN, COPS,SmartHub), and Release Program Managers to align sprint deliverables to journey-level milestones.
  • Collaborate with Journey Owners (JOs) and business stakeholders to clarify priorities and expected outcomes.
  • Coordinate delivery dependencies with external partners across ingestion, migration, and ML projects.

Continuous Improvement & Governance

  • Support incident RCA reviews and platform post-mortems, ensuring learnings are captured and converted into actionable backlog improvements.

![Image 2: Shape](blob:http://localhost/c4d8cdc831cbb03005a7e1f22c0efca9)

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data science, Information Systems,Business Analytics or related field.
  • Agile, PMP, or DevOps certifications (e.g., CSM,SAFe, PMI-ACP,AWS Certified Solutions Architect,SnowPro Core) preferred.

Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data platform delivery,data ops & quality management, or analytics program management, with at least 3 years in a technical project management, delivery lead or scrum master capacity.
  • Proven track record managing data engineering teams delivering pipelines and analytics workloads via CI/CD within AWS and Snowflake architectures..
  • Proven experience coordinating ingestion, modeling, and ML engineering deliveries based on modern data tech stacks such as Snowflake, Apache Airflow,Airbyte,NiFi and AWS SageMaker.
  • Strong understanding of DataOps automation, role-based access control, data security, and cost optimization in cloud data environments..
  • Hands-on level familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, Monday.com,Snowflake, SQL, dashboarding.
  • Experience in telecommunications,data platform delivery, or enterprise analytics programs is an advantage.

Skills

  • Deep understanding of agile data engineering, cloud architecture, and DevOps principles.
  • Demonstrated experience fostering data-driven culture and enabling data literacy across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to translate technical complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Exceptional communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Analytical and detail-oriented mindset with a bias for execution.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for continuous improvement and operational excellence.

job.title: Cloud DevOps Automation
job.description:
Role Summary

The Cloud DevOps Automation Engineer is responsible for building and operating automation-first cloud platforms across AWS environments. This role unifies cloud infrastructure, DevOps practices, and scaffolding frameworks through robust automation to enable scalable, secure, and efficient service delivery.

Acting as the bridge between infrastructure, platform engineering, and developer experience, the engineer will design systems where automation is the primary control plane—powering infrastructure provisioning, EKS operations, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service service onboarding.

The role emphasizes eliminating manual operations, standardizing workflows, and enabling repeatable, production-grade deployments using tools such as CloudFormation, Terraform, AWS AFT, CFCT, Kubernetes (EKS), and Backstage.

Accountabilities

  • Design and implement end-to-end automation frameworks for AWS infrastructure, EKS platforms, and application delivery.
  • Own and operate AWS multi-account environments using AFT and CFCT, driven by automation.
  • Build and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows.
  • Develop reusable scaffolds and templates that are fully automation-enabled.
  • Ensure all infrastructure, deployments, and operations are:
  • Automated
  • Repeatable
  • Version-controlled and auditable

Drive operational excellence through automation of monitoring, recovery, and scaling. Enable self-service capabilities via Backstage and automation pipelines. Reduce manual intervention and improve deployment speed, consistency, and reliability.

Responsibilities

1. Cloud Infrastructure Automation

  • Design and automate AWS infrastructure provisioning:
  • VPCs, EC2s, EKS, subnets, routing, and security groups

Implement automation-driven multi-account management using:

  • AWS Control Tower, AFT, and CFCT

Build and maintain:

  • AFT pipelines for account provisioning and lifecycle automation
  • CFCT pipelines for automated baseline configuration and governance

Automate:

  • Account bootstrapping (IAM, logging, security baselines)
  • Environment provisioning across dev, staging, and production

Ensure infrastructure is deployed and managed exclusively via IaC and automation pipelines

  • Kubernetes & EKS Automation
  • Automate lifecycle management of Amazon EKS clusters
  • Implement automated deployment patterns using:
  • Helm and GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux)

Automate Kubernetes operations:

  • Workload deployments
  • Scaling policies
  • Configuration and secrets management

Build automated workflows for:

  • Cluster upgrades and patching
  • Performance tuning and optimization
  • Failure recovery and resilience

3. Infrastructure as Code & Automation Frameworks

  • Develop and maintain IaC-driven automation frameworks using:
  • Terraform and AWS CloudFormation

Create reusable automation modules:

  • Terraform modules for infrastructure and AFT customization
  • CFCT configuration packages for governance enforcement

Integrate IaC into CI/CD pipelines for fully automated provisioning Enforce:

  • Version control
  • Auditability
  • Security and compliance through automation

4. DevOps Automation & CI/CD

  • Design and implement fully automated CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket Pipelines
  • Automate:
  • Build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows

Containerize applications using Docker and manage images in Amazon ECR Integrate:

  • SAST, DAST, and container security scanning
  • IaC validation and policy enforcement

Enable zero-touch or low-touch deployments for engineering teams

5. Scaffolding & Self-Service Enablement (Secondary Focus)

  • Develop reusable, automation-driven scaffolds:
  • Infrastructure templates (Terraform/CloudFormation)
  • Kubernetes deployment templates (Helm)
  • Application boilerplates

Integrate scaffolds into Backstage Software Templates Ensure scaffolds:

  • Automatically provision infrastructure
  • Configure pipelines
  • Deploy services with minimal manual steps

Align scaffolds with:

  • AFT-provisioned accounts
  • CFCT-enforced baselines

Promote standardized golden paths powered by automation

6. Observability, Security & Compliance Automation

  • Automate observability:
  • Logging, metrics, and alerting (CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus)

Embed security via automation:

  • IAM provisioning and least privilege enforcement
  • IRSA for Kubernetes workloads
  • Secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, SSM)

Implement policy-as-code and automated compliance checks Ensure all environments are continuously monitored and compliant by default

7. Cloud Operations & Reliability Engineering

  • Operate AWS environments with a focus on automation-driven operations
  • Automate:
  • Incident detection and alerting
  • Recovery workflows where possible

Perform advanced troubleshooting:

  • Networking (BGP, routing, hybrid connectivity)
  • Kubernetes and application-level issues

Participate in:

  • On-call rotations
  • Incident response and root cause analysis

Continuously improve reliability by eliminating repetitive manual tasks through automation

Key Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience with AWS (EKS, IAM, VPC, Control Tower)
  • Proven expertise in:
  • AWS Account Factory for Terraform (AFT)
  • Customizations for AWS Control Tower (CFCT)

Deep hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS and Helm Advanced proficiency in Terraform and CloudFormation Strong experience in building automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines Knowledge of AWS networking and hybrid connectivity (Direct Connect, VPN, BGP) Experience with Docker and Amazon ECR Solid Linux system administration and troubleshooting skills Familiarity with observability tools (CloudWatch, Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana) Experience with Backstage or developer platforms (preferred) Strong mindset toward automation-first engineering and operational efficiency

job.title: Lead CRM Engineer

job.title: AVP, Technical Program Management (TPM) Lead
job.description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Technical Project Management Leadto head the TPM function within IS - DBE. This role will define and uphold the delivery standards, metrics, and practices that underpin StarHub’s digital engineering model.

As TPM Lead, you will:

  • Manage a team of Technical Project Managers distributed across DXP domains.
  • Partner closely with IS Senior leadership, Domain & System Owners (DOs & SOs), Journey Solution Designers (SDs), Release Program Managers (RPMs), and Solution Architects (SAs).
  • Drive predictable delivery, visibility, and quality across teams aligned to StarHub’s consumer, enterprise, and operational journeys.

This role reports into the Information Systems – VP of Delivery & Business Enablement (DBE) and is responsible for orchestrating StarHub’s digital delivery model and enabling DevOps-based execution across domains for our Digital Experience Platform (DXP) team.

TheTPM Leadis responsible for managing and developing a team of Technical Project Managers (TPMs) across multiple DXP domains and journeys. This role ensures that delivery practices (both agile and waterfall), engineering alignment, and cross-domain coordination are consistent, predictable, and outcome-driven.

You will play a pivotal role in establishing delivery governance, continuous improvement frameworks, and cross-functional synchronization between business journeys, engineering domains, and architecture.

Key Responsibilities

Delivery Leadership

  • Lead and mentor a team of TPMs across multiple domains to drive either (a) agile, DevOps-based or (b) waterfall-based delivery excellence
  • Define and maintain a standardized delivery governance framework — covering sprint cadence, backlog hygiene, dependency tracking, and reporting.
  • Oversee delivery execution across DXP domains, ensuring commitments are met with predictable outcomes.
  • Lead monthly delivery health reviews, highlighting key risks, capacity challenges, and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Domain Owners (DXP) and Journey SDs (DBE) to balance Product, Tech Debt, and Technical Campaign backlogs across teams.

Cross-Domain Coordination & Governance

  • Act as the central delivery integrator across DBE, ensuring synchronization between journeys, domains, and releases.
  • Collaborate with Release Program Managers (RPMs)to ensure alignment of delivery and release plans.
  • Establish and maintain a cross-domain dependency management framework with clear escalation paths.
  • Monitor delivery performance metrics (velocity, predictability, throughput) and drive corrective actions where needed.
  • Drive adoption of continuous improvement practices across all DXP squads.

People Management & Capability Development

  • Coach and mentor TPMs, supporting their career development, skills growth, and performance reviews.
  • Foster a culture of proactive communication, accountability, and continuous learning across the TPM community.
  • Lead training sessions or playbook initiatives to strengthen agile delivery maturity, tooling proficiency, and reporting discipline.
  • Identify and recruit high-performing TPM talent aligned to StarHub’s transformation roadmap.

Stakeholder Engagement & Communication

  • Serve as a trusted partner to senior engineering, business, and architecture leaders — ensuring transparency on delivery health and execution status.
  • Communicate program-level risks, trade-offs, and delivery decisions clearly to executive stakeholders.
  • Represent the TPM function in enterprise forums, transformation reviews, and cross-functional working groups.

Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or Information Systems.
  • Advanced certifications in Agile, DevOps, or Program Management (e.g., SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, CSM) preferred

Experience

  • 12+ years of total experience in technology delivery, with at least 5 years in managing project/program teams or TPM functions.
  • Proven track record in delivering large-scale, cross-functional software or platform programs using agile and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in telecommunications, cloud platforms, or enterprise-scale digital transformation preferred.
  • Strong background in stakeholder management, dependency resolution, and performance reporting.

Skills & Attributes

  • Deep understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD delivery frameworks and SDLC practices.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret delivery metrics and drive data-informed decisions.
  • Excellent leadership, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Proven ability to align cross-functional teams toward shared goals under time and complexity constraints.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and resilient in a fast-paced environment.

Success Profile

A successful TPM Lead at StarHub is:

  • Delivery-Driven:Ensures every initiative lands predictably, with measurable business impact.
  • Hands-on:Operates across strategy and execution — from stakeholder alignment to sprint-level delivery — can take over a TPM role as exigencies dictate
  • Systematically Agile:Brings structure and consistency to delivery across diverse teams and domains.
  • People-Centric:Builds high-performing, motivated TPM teams through coaching and empowerment.
  • Collaborative:Bridges engineering, product, and business stakeholders to drive alignment.
  • Outcome-Focused:Balances speed, quality, and cost without losing sight of the end goal — customer experience excellence.

job.title: Principal CRM Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Role Mission:

The Principal CRM Engineer defines and evolves the architecture of StarHub’s core Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms that power customer onboarding, sales journeys, and fulfilment for the Consumer Business.

The role focuses on building a scalable, resilient, and future-ready CRM/OM platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end customer experiences and enabling rapid product innovation. Operating within a DevOps model, the Principal CRM Engineer drives platform modernization, architectural standardization, and system-wide reliability, while guiding engineering teams to eliminate systemic issues and scale the platform sustainably.

Responsibilities

  • Define and own the end-to-end architecture of CRM/OM platforms across Customer Management, Product Catalogue, Campaigns, Order Management, and Revenue/Billing integration
  • Establish architectural principles and standards for microservices, API design, workflow orchestration, and data management across CRM/OM domains
  • Design and optimize workflow orchestration strategies for order lifecycle processes, ensuring scalability and fault tolerance
  • Drive platform scalability and performance improvements by identifying system bottlenecks across APIs, databases, and workflows
  • Define and govern data architecture, ensuring consistency, integrity, and efficient data flow across CRM, provisioning, and billing systems
  • Establish API and integration standards, including versioning, idempotency, and reliability patterns for internal and external system integrations
  • Lead platform modernization initiatives, including migration from legacy CRM systems to cloud-native CRM-based architecture
  • Reduce technical debt and system complexity by driving modularization, decoupling, and standardization across services
  • Define and implement observability and reliability strategies across the platform, ensuring proactive monitoring, alerting, and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with DevOps and platform teams to design scalable cloud-native solutions using Kubernetes (EKS), CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code
  • Act as the technical authority for design decisions, conducting architecture reviews and ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and business objectives
  • Mentor CRM Engineers on system design, architectural thinking, and advanced debugging techniques
  • Influence cross-functional teams and stakeholders to adopt consistent engineering standards and best practices
  • Collaborate with Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and vendors to ensure seamless integration and delivery of end-to-end customer journeys

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong emphasis on system architecture and large‑scale distributed systems
  • Demonstrated ability to design, evolve, and operate enterprise‑critical platforms, particularly within CRM,OM,BSS, or comparable domains
  • Deep architectural expertise across:
  • Microservices and distributed system design
  • API design, integration patterns, and service contracts
  • Workflow driven and orchestration-based systems
  • Data architecture,modelling, and database performance optimization
  • Strong hands-on technical experience with:
  • Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful API design/development
  • PostgreSQL and/or Oracle, including query optimization and performance tuning
  • Kubernetes based platforms and cloud environments (AWS preferred)
  • Proven experience working in telecom BSS/OSS environments, including CRM, billing, and order management systems
  • Established track record of leading platform modernization, large scale refactoring, and transformation initiatives in complex enterprise environments

Preferred Certifications

  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate or Professional)

job.title: Lead CRM Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

The Lead CRM Engineer owns the reliability, scalability, and delivery of StarHub’s core Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Order Management (OM) platforms that power customer onboarding, sales journeys, and fulfilment for the Consumer Business.

The role focuses on ensuring stable, high-performing, and resilient CRM/OM platforms, leading engineering execution across customer, product, order lifecycle, and billing integration domains. Operating within a DevOps model, the Lead CRM Engineer drives production excellence through observability, incident management, and engineering best practices, while mentoring engineers and improving system reliability at scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end delivery and reliability of CRM/OM services across Customer Management, Product Catalogue, Campaigns, Order Management, and Revenue/Billing integration
  • Lead design and implementation of scalable backend services and workflow-driven processes for order lifecycle orchestration
  • Review and govern API design and integration patterns across billing, provisioning/OSS systems, digital channels, and external partners
  • Ensure API reliability, versioning, and backward compatibility across services
  • Drive workflow reliability by improving failure handling, retry mechanisms, and state management for long running and asynchronous processes
  • Oversee data integrity and performance across CRM/OM domains, guiding SQL optimization and ensuring consistency across order, provisioning, and billing flows
  • Lead DevOps including on-call support, incident response, root cause analysis (RCA), and implementation of preventive fixes
  • Reduce recurring incidents through systemic improvements and observability insights
  • Ensure stable operation of services on Kubernetes (EKS), including deployment, scaling, and troubleshooting
  • Drive improvements in CI/CD pipelines, release automation, and deployment governance
  • Establish and enhance observability using Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch, ensuring SLA adherence for platform availability and performance
  • Conduct design reviews and code reviews, ensuring adherence to engineering standards and best practices
  • Mentor engineers and guide team in debugging, system design, and production readiness
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Owners, QA, DevOps, and vendors to deliver reliable end-to-end customer experiences

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • 6–10 years of experience in professional software engineering with strong preference CRM, BSS, or other large-scale enterprise platforms
  • Strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs, microservices, and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL expertise in PostgreSQL and/or Oracle including performance tuning, query optimization and database administration
  • Proven experience operating services on Kubernetes-based platforms and cloud environments, preferably AWS
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams within telecom BSS/OSS domains such as CRM, billing, order management
  • Hands-on experience with workflow-driven systems and orchestration engines

job.title: Lead CRM Devops Engineer
job.description:
Role Mission:

As a Lead CRM DevOps Engineer at StarHub, you will own the end-to-end DevOps strategy, platform reliability, and release governance for mission-critical CRM and Order Management (CRM/OM) platforms. You will lead the design and evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes platform architecture, and cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and secure delivery of CRM/OM microservices on AWS EKS.

This role goes beyond execution requiring you to drive DevOps best practices, establish SRE capabilities, and ensure end-to-end stability of customer journeys (order, provisioning, billing). You will act as a technical leader, guiding engineers and working across teams to enable faster, safer, and more reliable platform delivery.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive DevOps strategy and operating model for CRM/OM platforms, acting as the technical escalation point for complex production issues.
  • Architect and govern end‑to‑end CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins (Pipeline‑as‑Code) and GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), enabling safe, repeatable releases.
  • Lead trunk‑based development adoption, automated testing, quality gates, and release safety mechanisms across microservices.
  • Design and operate multi‑cluster Kubernetes platforms (EKS/OCP), including networking, RBAC, scaling, and resilience.
  • Govern AWS cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure‑as‑Code using Terraform and/or CloudFormation, ensuring security, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Apply SRE practices by defining SLOs/SLIs, improving reliability and performance, and leading incident management and RCA.
  • Ensure end‑to‑end reliability of CRM and API integrations across systems.
  • Establish observability and operational excellence using Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, and on‑call tooling.
  • Contribute to automation and code improvements, participate in architecture reviews, mentor engineers, and drive documentation and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience across DevOps, SRE, and platform or software engineering, with at least 2–3 years in a senior or technical leadership role.
  • Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot, with hands-on experience supporting microservices-based and distributed architectures.
  • Deep understanding of scalability, reliability engineering, and production system performance.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with:
  • Kubernetes (EKS preferred), Helm, and container orchestration
  • CI/CD platforms (Jenkins, GitLab CI) and GitOps practices
  • AWS cloud services and architecture
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation)
  • Strong SQL skills with hands-on PostgreSQL administration and performance tuning experience.
  • Proficiency in Python and shell scripting for automation and platform tooling.
  • Experience implementing observability and monitoring using tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
  • Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with strong stakeholder management, communication, and technical leadership skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, production-critical environment.
