job.title: GSP Provisioning Engineer
job.description:
Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL (Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, with a presence across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre.

We are looking for a GSP Provisioning Engineerto support the provisioning, implementation, and operational delivery of enterprise IP and managed network services. In this role, you will work closely with customers, project teams, field engineers, and regional stakeholders to ensure the successful deployment, testing, and activation of network services while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

Make an Impact by:

1. Network Provisioning & Service Implementation

  • Provision, configure, test, and activate enterprise IP and managed network services in collaboration with customers and field engineering teams.
  • Perform technical validation of customer service orders to ensure implementation readiness and service quality.
  • Support the deployment of services including IPVPN, Ethernet, Metro Ethernet, Cloud, Managed Services, and other enterprise connectivity solutions.
  • Ensure implementation activities are completed accurately and within agreed delivery timelines.

2. Technical Support & Service Delivery

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for Service Delivery, Project Management, and In-Country Field Engineering teams during service implementation.
  • Perform remote troubleshooting and fault isolation during service activation to minimise delays and ensure successful service turn-up.
  • Proactively identify technical issues that may impact service quality or delivery schedules and coordinate timely resolution with relevant stakeholders.
  • Escalate and follow through on complex technical issues while working closely with internal teams and external partners.

3. Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with regional teams, overseas partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver seamless customer implementations.
  • Support user acceptance testing (UAT) and implementation of new network products and services.
  • Contribute to knowledge sharing and technical training to support successful product rollouts and operational excellence.
  • Promote continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance service delivery processes and customer experience.

Skills for Success

  • Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Physics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in network engineering, telecommunications, or enterprise network operations.
  • Professional networking knowledge with certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or JNCIA, or equivalent technical expertise.
  • Good understanding of IP networking concepts and enterprise connectivity solutions.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to resolve technical issues efficiently.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional and regional teams.
  • Self-motivated, resourceful, and able to work independently while thriving in a collaborative team environment.

It'll be great if you also have:

  • Experience supporting enterprise network services such as IPVPN, Ethernet, Metro Ethernet, Cloud, or Managed Services.
  • Exposure to customer-facing technical support or service delivery environments.
  • Experience working with regional or multinational teams across different time zones.
  • Hands-on experience with new product implementation, user acceptance testing (UAT), or technical training.
  • Proven ability to build strong customer relationships and contribute to continuous service improvement.

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Senior Solution Designer
job.description:
Date: 30 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Singtel is at the forefront of technological advancements, enhancing customer experiences across mobile, voice, data infrastructure, managed services, cloud computing, IT services, and professional consulting. To support this journey, Singtel is seeking an experienced Senior Solution Designer to join the Group IT – Corporate HR Systems team, with a focus on payroll systems.

This role will act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for payroll technology, responsible for designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise payroll solutions across cloud-based HR platforms. The incumbent will drive solution architecture, ensure compliance with statutory requirements, and lead system enhancements while maintaining high standards of system performance, accuracy, and reliability.

The role requires close collaboration with HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders, as well as external vendors, to deliver scalable, secure, and efficient payroll solutions aligned with business objectives.

Make An Impact By

Delivery & Maintenance of HR Payroll Systems (approximately 90% of time focused)

  • Design and deliver payroll solutions aligned to business requirements across SaaS platforms
  • Drive standardization and adoption of best practices across payroll processes and system implementations
  • Provide primary support for payroll systems including payroll processing cycles, integrations, data validation, and statutory configurations (e.g., taxes, compliance requirements)
  • Manage technical payroll configurations, including schemas, rules, and, ensuring system stability, data accuracy, and compliance with local regulations and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Drive system enhancements and changes, including SIT/UAT coordination, functional documentation, and release management within packaged solution environments.
  • Drive system enhancements and changes, including SIT/UAT coordination, functional documentation, and release management within packaged solution environments.
  • Perform root cause analysis to resolve complex system issues and lead continuous improvement efforts to enhance payroll and HR system performance
  • Act as the key liaison between HR, Finance, and IT stakeholders, collaborating with vendors and partners to facilitate meetings and ensure successful solution adoption.

job.title: Director, Cyber Security Governance, Risk and Assurance
job.description:
Date: 29 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Reporting to the Group Chief Information Security Officer (GCISO), the Group Cyber Governance, Risk & Assurance Director is a senior Group-level leadership role accountable for setting, maintaining, and enforcing Singtel Group’s cyber security policies, standards, and compliance posture. The role owns the Group cyber policy framework, control standards, and assurance mechanisms that ensure cybersecurity risks are consistently identified, assessed, managed, and reported across all Operating Companies and Associates.

Working closely with OpCo risk and security leaders, the role defines Group-wide cyber governance requirements, including policies, minimum control standards, and risk acceptance principles. These policy guardrails establish clear expectations for due care, regulatory compliance, and “secure-by-default” outcomes, while allowing measured flexibility for local operating contexts.

As a policy authority and trusted governance advisor, the Group GRC Director provides independent oversight and challenge on major initiatives and material risk decisions. The role ensures that cybersecurity risks are formally assessed against Group policies and standards, that policy exceptions are governed through defined approval processes, and that residual risks are transparently escalated and accepted at the appropriate level.

This position requires strong risk judgement, regulatory insight, and executive influence, with the ability to translate complex technical and cyber risks into clear policy positions, compliance outcomes, and Board-level risk narratives. The role bridges business, technology, and security by embedding disciplined policy governance, compliance assurance, and accountability into the Group’s operating model.

Make an Impact by

Governance, Policy & Standards

  • Act as the Group owner and governing authority for Singtel Group Cyber Security Policies, Standards, and Control Libraries, ensuring consistent application, resilience, and enforceability across all OpCos and Associates.
  • Establish, maintain, and evolve Group-wide minimum cybersecurity requirements, including approval of material policy updates, standards enhancements, and control baselines.
  • Continuously assess Singtel Group Cyber Security Policies and Standards against industry best practices and regulatory expectations (e.g. ISO/IEC, NIST, CIS Controls, GSMA), ensuring safeguards remain effective against the evolving threat landscape.
  • Own and govern the policy exception and risk acceptance process, including escalation thresholds, decision authorities, and documentation of residual risk.
  • Drive security culture and controls adoption through structured stakeholder engagement, training, and enablement across the Group.

Controls Risk Framework & Risk Visibility

  • Define and own the Group Cybersecurity Controls and Risk Framework, including methodologies to assess inherent risk, control effectiveness, control maturity, and residual risk across cyber domains.
  • Develop and maintain controls risk metrics, KRIs, and gap indicators to provide consistent, risk-based visibility of cybersecurity posture across Singtel Group.
  • Translate controls and compliance outcomes into executive- and Board-level insights, supporting prioritisation, remediation planning, and informed risk decisions.

**

Compliance Assurance, Automation & Continuous Monitoring

**

  • Own the Group Compliance Assurance Framework, defining how compliance with Group Cyber Security Policies and Standards is assessed, validated, and reported across OpCos and Associates.
  • Lead the transition from point-in-time assessments to continuous controls assurance, leveraging technology to provide near-real-time visibility of controls effectiveness and cyber resilience.
  • Establish and execute a Group-wide digital GRC platform strategy as the single source of truth for governance, risk management, compliance, exceptions, and audit evidence.
  • Drive the adoption of automation and agentic AI to scale compliance assessments, evidence collection, and controls monitoring, while maintaining auditability, traceability, and regulator confidence.

**

Business, Regulatory & Cyber Leadership

**

  • Serve as the Group authority on cyber governance and risk, providing trusted advisory and challenge to senior management and Boards on cybersecurity risk posture and material exposures.
  • Maintain awareness of emerging cyber threats, technologies (e.g. AI, quantum), and regulatory developments, translating these into risk-aligned governance and control enhancements.
  • Act as a key interface with auditors, and external assessors on matters related to cyber governance, compliance, and assurance.
  • Provide thought leadership and effective stakeholder engagement, balancing business enablement with risk discipline and regulatory expectations across the Group.

Budget & Resource Stewardship

  • Assist in planning and managing budgets for GRC programs.
  • Recommend resource allocation strategies to optimize cost, scale, and talent effectiveness.

**

Stakeholder Engagement & Influence

  • Lead and contribute to cross-functional governance
  • Collaborate with GRC leads across OpCos to align on Group cyber governance requirements, policy interpretation, risk assessment approaches, and compliance expectations, including the treatment of emerging technologies and new risk paradigms.
  • Engage internal stakeholders across business, technology, and risk functions to ensure cybersecurity governance, risk posture, and compliance priorities are aligned with enterprise objectives and risk appetite.
  • Drive Group-wide alignment and awareness of cyber risk and compliance priorities, promoting consistent understanding of policies, standards, and risk responsibilities across all Operating Companies and Associates.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • At least 10 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, or GRC roles, with demonstrated experience operating in Group-level, regional, or multi-entity environments, overseeing policy, risk, and compliance across complex organisations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and governing large-scale cybersecurity or technology risk initiatives, including setting Group standards, driving compliance programmes, managing material risk issues, and engaging senior executives and Boards.
  • Deep expertise in cybersecurity governance, risk management, and control frameworks, including NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, CIS Controls, and risk-based control models, with the ability to set, interpret, and enforce Group-wide policy and control standards.
  • Strong understanding of telco, cloud, and enterprise IT operating environments, including cloud platforms, identity and access management, data protection, and network security, to enable informed risk-based policy decisions and governance oversight of emerging technologies (e.g. AI and quantum).
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical and cyber risks into clear governance positions, executive briefings, and Board-level risk narratives that support informed decision-making and risk acceptance.
  • Professional certifications preferred: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP, or equivalent credentials supporting senior leadership in governance, risk, and compliance.
  • Demonstrated awareness of emerging cyber threats, regulatory developments, and evolving risk paradigms, with the ability to anticipate impacts to Group policy, controls, and assurance approaches.

Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Exceptional leadership, collaboration, and team management skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders, including subsidiaries in a conglomerate or multi-subsidiary environment.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making, and problem-solving skills, especially in dynamic and high-pressure situations.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

**

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

We are committed to a safe and healthy environment for our employees & customers and will require all prospective employees to be fully vaccinated.

The Director, Strategy & Transformation, acts as 2IC to the Head, Strategy & Transformation and plays a critical role in shaping strategic priorities, driving organisation-wide change, and ensuring alignment of business outcomes with Singtel Singapore’s long-term strategic objectives. They leverage data to diagnose, conceptualise and act as a thought partner to business units and the leadership team.

Leading a fast-paced, high performing team in the CEOs office, the Director is a strong leader, coach and mentor who develops teams to grow their skills and be examples of excellence in this highly visible team. A versatile problem solver, they shift seamlessly between strategy, consulting, engagement, and change management, collaborating across functions and facilitating decision-making at all levels.

The role also drives the business planning process for Singtel Singapore, including the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), performance management frameworks, and leadership communications to support execution and accountability.

Make An Impact By

Strategy Development and Execution

  • Support the Head S&T in leading the definition and refinement of Singtel Singapore’s strategic direction, in collaboration with the Singapore Leadership Team.
  • Conduct data-driven analytics to inform recommendations on strategy and organisational priorities.
  • Be a thought partner to the leadership team to provide objective, business critical analysis and insights to advocate, challenge, and enable business decisions.
  • Oversee the execution of priority strategic initiatives across Singapore business units, ensuring overall alignment and realising business impact.
  • Develop content for strategic CEO communications including SMW, AOP, Board papers, CEO Forums, Investor Releases, and the Annual Report.

Advance Business Performance

  • Set annual objectives, quarterly milestones, and drive strategy and operational excellence across the organization.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs to track effectiveness of transformation initiatives.
  • Align top-level priorities with operational execution and identify areas for improvement.
  • Seek and bring in external best practices, including conducting research, testing emerging ideas and technologies, to identify effective strategies and solutions to achieve transformation objectives.

Transformation governance and delivery

  • Lead enterprise-wide transformation efforts, and other cross-functional programs aimed at improving customer outcomes, productivity, and employee engagement.

Internal Communications and Employee Engagement

  • Annual Innovation Programs
  • Top Executive Workshops

job.title: Information Security Specialist
job.description:
Summary

The purpose of this role is to provide security architecture risk and cloud compliance assurance across technology initiatives, ensuring that security risks are identified early, assessed consistently, and managed effectively throughout the system lifecycle. The role supports secure delivery of business initiatives by ensuring technology solutions, infrastructure services, and cloud services are designed and implemented in compliance with regulatory requirements, enterprise security standards, and the organisation’s risk appetite.

The role acts as a security risk and cloud security advisor to Singtel IT, Telco Networks and Enterprise stakeholders, applying recognized security frameworks and principles to evaluate design decisions, identify control gaps, insecure configurations and recommend risk-based mitigations.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Support comprehensive information security risk assessments for new and existing systems, applications, infrastructure changes, and cloud engagements
  • Assess design documents, architecture diagrams, and technical controls to confirm that technology risks are mitigated prior to go-live.
  • Ensure technology initiatives and controls comply with internal security policies, standards, and governance requirements; proactively highlight gaps and recommend remediation.
  • Review secure related configurations in cloud environments leveraging industry tools and work with application teams to remediate insecure configurations.
  • Collaborate with IT, application teams, and business stakeholders to provide risk advisory for projects and ad hoc reviews.
  • Drive governance oversight and processes for cloud security compliance, best practices and risk management.
  • Support management reporting of cloud security risks, remediation plans and security metrics.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree/Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
  • At least 4 years or more working experience in security assessment, cybersecurity, or related IT roles.
  • Experience working within system integrator or consulting environments, including exposure to multi-client or complex delivery engagements, is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in system and security administration, implementation, and solution design.
  • Experience in application, infrastructure, telco networks, cloud and cybersecurity technologies including CNAPP, DevSecOps, containers.
  • Ability to apply Zero Trust security architecture principles to complex enterprise environments.
  • Cybersecurity risk assessment and risk reduction initiatives.
  • Regulatory requirements, security standards and best practices pertaining to cybersecurity and cloud risk management.
  • Professional security management certifications such as a Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or other similar credentials, will be preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective time management and prioritisation skills.
  • Sound conflict management and negotiation skills.
  • High level of professionalism, commitment, and accountability.
  • Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced or changing environments.
  • Change-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, with remote stakeholders, exercising sound judgement and initiative.

The role is expected to manage day-to-day follow-ups independently, while escalating strategic, commercial, legal or risk-related decisions to the Product Director for review and approval.

Partner Onboarding and Coordination

  • Support the onboarding of assigned partners, including NDA, compliance checks, internal approvals and operational readiness.

Commercial and Pricing Support

  • Compare commercial options and highlight key considerations for management review.
  • Assist in preparing business case materials, approval papers and supporting analysis.
  • Escalate pricing exceptions, non-standard terms or margin concerns to the Product Director.

Contract and Internal Approval Support

  • Coordinate contract review activities with Legal, Finance, Risk and other internal stakeholders.
  • Track outstanding contract issues, approval items and signature status.
  • Support the preparation of product schedules, commercial schedules and related contract inputs.
  • Follow through on contract execution steps until closure.
  • Escalate material legal, risk or commercial issues to the Product Director for decision.

Product Readiness and Sales Enablement

  • Support product readiness activities for assigned partner solutions and IDS-developed products.
  • Prepare and maintain product information, sales enablement materials, FAQs and basic solution documentation.
  • Coordinate UAT activities, defect tracking and launch readiness follow-ups where required.
  • Support Sales with product clarifications, partner information, pricing inputs and proposal-related queries.
  • Help translate partner solution capabilities into simple customer use cases and business value messages.

Partner Performance Tracking and Business Support

  • Prepare partner review decks, pipeline updates, meeting notes and action trackers.
  • Monitor assigned partner progress, sales pipeline, customer feedback and operational issues.
  • Support regular partner business review discussions and follow-up actions.
  • Research potential new partners and prepare initial evaluation materials.
  • Identify potential upsell, cross-sell or co-sell opportunities for further review by the Product Director.

Skills for Success

  • Degree or diploma in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, Computer Science, Marketing or a related discipline.
  • 6 to 8 years of relevant experience in ICT product/solution management, partner management or commercial support roles.
  • Experience coordinating with vendors, partners, internal stakeholders and sales teams.
  • Certification in cloud, product management, project management, Agile or business analysis. Examples include AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, PMP, Scrum or product management certification.
  • Good understanding of ICT products and partner-led solution models.
  • Able to prepare pricing and margin analysis, support commercial discussions, coordinate contract follow-ups and prepare business review materials.
  • Proficient in PowerPoint, Excel and business documentation.
  • Able to understand product features, customer use cases and operational requirements.

job.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

About RE:AI

RE:AI is Singtel Digital InfraCo's sovereign AI platform — GPU-as-a-Service on NVIDIA infrastructure, a Model-as-a-Service catalog spanning open- and closed-weight models (Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and others), and a Token-as-a-Service layer that gives every application one governed gateway into that entire model catalog — unified API, policy-based routing, scoped credentials, spend controls, and a single audit trail, all running inside Singtel's sovereign Nxera data centres. Customers span government, financial services, healthcare, and enterprise across ASEAN, all of whom need to move from AI pilot to production without re-litigating security and compliance for every model or integration.

The role

We're building a customer-facing AI engineering function inside Customer Success to turn AI conversations into signed pilots. AI Engineers sit alongside prospective and existing customers — from the first exploratory meeting through to a live pilot — and are the technical reason a customer says yes.

The work spans two areas, and you will do both. Applied AI engineering: prototypes and custom demos, reference deployments and proofs-of-concept, GPU sizing and architecture, inference benchmarking and model fit. Business value engineering: TCO modelling and commercial structuring, tender and pre-sales support, CXO and strategic engagements, thought leadership and GTM. You will build, and you will build quickly — but what you build exists to win and shape a deal, not to run in production for three years. Production hardening and steady-state run sit with the AI infrastructure and production team. Roughly half this job is technical judgement and half is communication and commercial reasoning.

What you'll do

  • Scope the opportunity. Work with Customer Success and Sales to understand a prospective customer's problem, workflow and constraints — then decide what to build that will move the deal forward.
  • Build the prototype or custom demo that wins the deal. Stand up working prototypes, custom demos and reference deployments on RE:AI — agentic workflows, retrieval, tool use, guardrails — tuned to the customer's actual use case rather than a generic demo. Demonstrate them live wherever possible, not as a slide deck.
  • Size the platform and prove the fit. GPU sizing and architecture, inference benchmarking, and model selection against the customer's latency, throughput and cost targets — and the ability to show your working when their architects ask how you arrived at the number.
  • Support the pilot. Stay technically engaged as a proof-of-concept converts to a pilot: integration guidance, tuning, and being the escalation point the customer trusts — handing over to the AI infrastructure and production team for build and run once the decision is made.
  • Build a reusable asset library. Patterns that show up across three customers should become a reusable demo, template or accelerator, not three bespoke builds. You'll be expected to spot that and push components back into shared pre-sale tooling.
  • Be the technical face of RE:AI. Represent the platform credibly to customer engineers, architects and CXOs — explaining what you built, why, and what tradeoffs you made, in their language.
  • Support tenders and formal pre-sales. Technical content for RFPs, government tenders and compliance responses — solution write-ups, architecture sections and clarification responses, working with bid and commercial teams to deadline.
  • Model the commercial case. TCO modelling, token economics and commercial structuring — quantify what a solution costs to run on RE:AI and what it is worth against a public API or on-premise alternative, in terms a CFO would accept.
  • Contribute to thought leadership and GTM. Reference architectures, customer-facing write-ups, webinars and conference material that make the next deal easier to open — plus internal enablement so Sales can carry the story without you in the room.

What we're looking for

  • Genuinely customer-facing. You can run a technical conversation with a customer's engineers directly, hold your position under pushback, and read a room well enough to know when to go deeper and when to simplify. This is the single most important requirement.
  • AI-native. You have personally built with LLMs and agents — tool-calling, retrieval, orchestration, prompting, evaluation — and you keep up with the field because you're interested in it. Certifications alone won't cover this.
  • Excellent communicator, spoken and written. You can present to a mixed technical and executive audience, and write a clear proposal, tender response or follow-up that stands on its own. Your writing will be seen by customers.
  • Commercial and value judgement. You think about business value, not just the software. You can build or reason about a TCO model, explain where cost sits and what drives it, and articulate why a customer should choose this — and you can say when the right answer is a smaller solution.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and travel. Every customer and every pilot is different. You'll define your own scope more often than you're handed one, and you're fine being on a plane or on-site when the deal needs it.
  • Sound engineering fundamentals. Strong enough in at least one backend stack to build a credible prototype yourself, comfortable with APIs and cloud basics, and able to reason clearly about how a model behaves in production — latency, cost, failure modes. You don't need to have trained a model or run a production platform.

Nice to have

  • Product management or product owner experience — the ability to frame a problem in terms of user value and business outcome.
  • Full-stack capability, enough to make a prototype usable end to end without waiting for anyone.
  • Experience responding to enterprise RFPs or public sector tenders, or building TCO and commercial models.
  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure, inference serving, or benchmarking model performance and cost.
  • Prior forward-deployed, solutions-engineering, or startup generalist engineering experience.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government) — understanding what "production-ready" means when compliance and data residency are non-negotiable.
  • Experience with LLM gateways/routing layers, guardrail/policy systems, or building on top of an internal model-serving platform.
  • A track record of turning one customer's build into a reusable pattern for the next three.

job.title: Director, AI, Data & Enterprise Architecture
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Senior AI Data and Enterprise Architect/Director is responsible for designing and governing the enterprise-wide architecture that enables trusted data, scalable analytics, and production-grade AI—including machine learning and generative AI— across the organization.

This role aligns business strategy, operating models, and technology platforms to deliver secure, compliant, and cost-effective solutions.

You will define target-state architectures, reference patterns, and roadmaps across data platforms, AI/ML lifecycle (MLOps/LLMOps), integration, security, and governance. You will partner with business leaders, product teams, engineering, security, and risk/compliance to ensure AI and data solutions are reliable, explainable, and aligned to enterprise standards.

Make An Impact By

Enterprise Architecture & Strategy

  • Lead end-to-end architecture for enterprise data and AI capabilities aligned to business strategy and measurable outcomes.
  • Produce target-state architectures, current-state assessments, and multiyear roadmaps spanning platforms, applications, integration, and operating model.
  • Define and maintain reference architectures, standards, and guardrails for data, analytics, AI/ML, GenAI, and integration patterns.
  • Facilitate architecture governance: design reviews, standards enforcement, exception handling, and technical decision records.

Modern Data Architecture

  • Architect scalable data solutions (e.g., Lakehouse/data warehouse, streaming/event ingestion, semantic/metrics layer).
  • Establish data modelling standards (conceptual/logical/physical), including domain-oriented data products and/or data mesh patterns as appropriate.
  • Design enterprise-grade metadata management, lineage, Catalog, data quality, MDM, and privacy controls.
  • Create patterns for real-time/near-real-time analytics, including event-driven architectures and streaming (e.g., Kafka/Kinesis/Pub Sub).

AI/ML & Generative AI Architecture

  • Define architecture for the full AI lifecycle: experimentation, training, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Design MLOps/LLMOps frameworks for reproducibility, CI/CD, feature stores, model registries, drift monitoring, and automated evaluation.
  • Architect GenAI solutions (where relevant): RAG, vector search, orchestration, prompt/version management, safety filters, and model evaluation.
  • Establish patterns for model governance: approvals, auditability, explainability, bias testing, and model risk controls.

Data Science & Applied ML

  • Translate business problems into ML solutions (classification, ranking, nextbest- action, anomaly detection, forecasting, summarization).
  • Perform feature engineering for streaming and batch contexts (rolling metrics, aggregations, stateful features).
  • Train, evaluate, and tune models; define KPIs and acceptance criteria (latency, precision/recall, lift, business impact).
  • Develop and iterate on LLM and agent approaches:
  • Prompting and structured context design
  • Evaluation harnesses (offline + online)
  • Guardrails, grounding, and hallucination reduction
  • Design experimentation frameworks (A/B tests, shadow mode, canaries) and model monitoring strategies (drift, bias, stability).

Integration & Platform Architecture

  • Define integration patterns across enterprise systems (APIs, events, ETL/ELT, iPaaS) to enable reliable data and AI workflows.
  • Collaborate with application and infrastructure architects to align data/AI platforms with enterprise principles (observability, resiliency, cost controls).
  • Influence vendor selection and platform decisions; evaluate trade-offs across cloud services, open-source tooling, and commercial platforms.

Leadership & Collaboration

  • Act as a trusted advisor to executives and senior stakeholders—translating business goals into technical architecture and investment strategy.
  • Mentor architects and engineering teams; drive architecture consistency and capability maturity across the organization.
  • Lead cross-functional workshops (capability mapping, domain modelling, solution design, risk reviews).

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related field (Master’s preferred or equivalent experience).
  • 10–12+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, data architecture, and/or platform architecture.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing modern data platforms(Lakehouse/warehouse, ingestion, transformation, governance).
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML deployment architectures, including MLOps concepts (CI/CD, monitoring, reproducibility, model registry).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) and cloud-native architecture (containers, Kubernetes, serverless, IaC).
  • Strong grasp of security, privacy, and governance principles for data and AI systems.
  • Ability to communicate complex architecture to technical and non-technical audiences and drive alignment across teams.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

We are committed to a safe and healthy environment for our employees & customers and will require all prospective employees to be fully vaccinated.

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of enterprise network infrastructure supporting mission-critical and highly resilient data centre environments.

This role requires a comprehensive technical background spanning physical infrastructure (DWDM and Data Centre OT), enterprise IT backbone networking, cybersecurity, and network automation. The successful candidate will oversee the enterprise IT network backbone, lead the Data Centre Cybersecurity team, and drive network architecture reviews for new local and regional data centre developments.

Working closely with Cybersecurity, Data Centre OT, Data Centre Operations, IT Infrastructure, and Data Analytics teams, you will deliver secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions that support business growth and operational excellence.

How You will Make An Impact:

Data Centre Architecture & Physical Infrastructure:

  • Participate as a core member of the design team for new local and regional data centre deployments, ensuring network and security architectures are incorporated throughout the design lifecycle.
  • Act as the primary networking subject matter expert for Data Centre teams, providing structural, logical, and connectivity solutions for enterprise deployments.
  • Lead the physical network design of carrier-neutral colocation facilities, including Meet-Me Room (MMR), Main Distribution Frame (MDF), structured cabling, and interconnection architecture.
  • Collaborate with project stakeholders to ensure network solutions meet business, operational, resilience, and scalability requirements.
  • Manage the enterprise cybersecurity team responsible for network security strategy, architecture, governance, and operational security.
  • Design, implement, and manage secure network segmentation between IT and OT environments.
  • Implement and manage secure one-way communication technologies, such as Data Diodes, to maintain secure data flows from OT to IT environments where applicable.
  • Design and manage enterprise network security infrastructure, including firewalls and centralised authentication platforms such as RADIUS and TACACS+.
  • Ensure network designs comply with organisational cybersecurity policies, recognised industry standards (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001 and SOC 2), applicable regulatory requirements, and internal security assessments, including penetration testing and vulnerability assessments.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve cybersecurity incident response frameworks and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for data centre environments.

Network Engineering & Automation

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise WAN, LAN, WLAN, firewall, and DWDM network solutions.
  • Lead detailed network designs for enterprise IT and Operational Technology (OT) environments across multiple data centres.
  • Manage and optimise the global enterprise network backbone, including DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing) optical transport infrastructure.
  • Configure, manage, and troubleshoot enterprise routing and switching platforms, including Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, or equivalent technologies.
  • Design and support highly available, low-latency, and resilient enterprise network infrastructure for mission-critical environments.
  • Implement network segmentation and security controls to securely isolate OT and IT environments using unidirectional gateway technologies where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Data Centre OT and Data Centre Security teams to align network architecture with operational continuity, safety, cybersecurity, and compliance requirements.
  • Design and implement network automation and orchestration solutions using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, or equivalent technologies to improve provisioning, configuration management, and operational efficiency.
  • Utilise Linux operating systems for network diagnostics, automation, scripting, and systems integration.

Operations, Troubleshooting & Incident Management

  • Serve as the technical escalation point for complex enterprise networking and cybersecurity incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions.
  • Lead network maintenance, upgrades, migrations, and change activities while minimising service disruption.
  • Monitor enterprise network performance, availability, and capacity, recommending continuous improvements where appropriate.
  • Participate in an on-call and technical escalation rotation as required.
  • Leadership, Strategy & Project Management
  • Lead end-to-end infrastructure projects, including planning, budget forecasting (CAPEX/OPEX), resource allocation, scheduling, and delivery.
  • Mentor and develop network engineers through coaching, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.
  • Develop and present strategic network architecture proposals and technical presentations supporting enterprise and cloud-based data centre initiatives.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop network roadmaps that support organisational growth and technology transformation.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, operational excellence, and adoption of industry best practices.

Skills for Success:

  • Extensive experience designing, implementing, and managing mission-critical enterprise networking, data centre infrastructure, and Operational Technology (OT) environments.
  • Proven experience leading technical teams across networking, physical infrastructure deployment, or cybersecurity functions.
  • Experience working in data centre, hyperscale network, or equivalent enterprise environments.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise routing and switching technologies, including BGP, OSPF, MPLS, and SRv6.
  • Experience with enterprise network monitoring and telemetry platforms such as SolarWinds or equivalent tools.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, redundancy, disaster recovery, and network performance optimisation.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with enterprise networking platforms such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, Arista, or equivalent technologies, together with DWDM optical transport, Data Diodes, and enterprise firewall solutions.
  • Proficiency in network automation using Python, Ansible, REST APIs, or similar technologies.
  • Working knowledge of Linux operating systems for networking, automation, and systems integration.
  • Active CCIE certification or an equivalent advanced networking certification is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise routing and switching protocols, including BGP, EVPN, RADIUS/TACACS+, and high-density data centre fabric architectures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to support network capacity planning, optimisation, and budget forecasting.
  • Ability to independently lead complex technical initiatives while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Application Test Engineer
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

![Image 1](https://rmkcdn.successfactors.com/a107d764/0cfc5002-fe67-4ff7-b0cd-9.png)

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

We are seeking an Application Engineer (Testing)who will be responsible to lead the testing of software/applications to ensure they function accordingly to specifications and clients' requirements to meet the business needs. The Application Engineer will conduct testing using preferred organizational practices & established processes contained in the Test Methodology to ensure test objective of the project is met.

What will you do?

Project Delivery

  • Understand and analyze testing requirements to prepare test plan, and test design
  • Advise project team on design consideration to facilitate meeting of requirements. Advise business analysts and/or customers on the testing requirements and test techniques
  • Prepare and ensure readiness of test bed and test environment to carry out the test execution
  • Execute test in accordance to the test design
  • Analyze test results and work with respective teams to resolve issues such as defect open and resolution rate, bottlenecks in performance and other defects
  • Prepare test report for submission
  • Provide regular test results updates
  • Recommend and use automated testing tools where appropriate
  • Manage test activities and ensure the planned test activities are completed as scheduled.

Self / Team / Organization Development

  • Adopt test standards and testing methodology
  • Create awareness; conduct training on test techniques, assists in implementation of test standards, consistent methodology, best practices and principles.
  • Share knowledge within or other NCS teams
  • Self-directed learning & development.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Diploma / Degree in Computer Science / Computer Engineering / Information Technology related field, or IT equivalent
  • Typically 2 or more years of IT/Testing experience with knowledge of test methodology and various test tools
  • Familiar with testing methodologies, tools and techniques
  • Possess initiative and disposition with a strong commitment and orientation towards results and high quality standards
  • Team player with strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Self-motivator with a positive attitude and with high energy
  • Proficient in written and spoken English
  • Customer focused

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs - Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity -and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we _make the extraordinary happen_.

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Engineer, Voice Engineering (Networks)
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations, maintenance, and performance of Singtel’s local fixed voice interconnect systems. This role ensures seamless connectivity between Singtel and local and international operators, while maintaining high service availability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance.

The incumbent will lead operational activities including system administration, fault management, service provisioning, and number portability operations. The role also drives cybersecurity compliance through system patching, vulnerability management, and audit readiness.

In addition, the role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders, external operators, and vendors to resolve service issues, implement system enhancements, and support regulatory directives such as scam call mitigation in partnership with IMDA and SPF.

Make an Impact by:

Operations & Service Management

  • Oversee daily BAU operations of local fixed voice and interconnect systems to ensure high availability and performance
  • Ensure timely service provisioning, system monitoring, and execution of number migration/porting activities
  • Manage interconnect junctions and signalling links between Singtel and local/overseas operators (FBO/SBO/OLO)

Incident & Fault Management

  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis of service issues, including call failures, signalling faults, and number portability issues
  • Manage and resolve escalations from TAC, INOC, ISMC, 1608, and external partners

Ensure timely handling of critical and urgent incidents, including after-office-hours escalations (e.g. VIP/VVIP cases)

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Act as the key point of contact for interconnect-related matters with external operators and partners
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders (Work Order, Product, Account teams) to ensure accurate order capture and timely provisioning
  • Engage vendors for issue escalation, including hardware replacement, software fixes, patching, and system upgrades

System Administration & Lifecycle Management

  • Manage system configuration, software upgrades, patching, and performance optimization
  • Oversee equipment lifecycle management, including refresh planning and execution
  • Review and govern Method of Procedure (MOP) for system changes and upgrades

Security, Compliance & Audit

  • Ensure systems meet cybersecurity standards through regular patching, vulnerability scanning, and mitigation
  • Support internal and external audit exercises and ensure proper documentation and controls
  • Manage IMDA directives related to scam prevention, including testing and implementation

Regulatory & Special Operations Support

  • Work with IAR, IMDA, and SPF to support scam call blocking initiatives and regulatory requirements
  • Support special events and emergency preparedness activities (e.g. SPF contingency planning)

Resource & Capacity Management

  • Manage Interconnect Gateway resource planning, including onboarding of new interconnect partners and capacity expansion

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in IT/Computer or equivalent work experience in telecom, networking and IT
  • Strong knowledge of telecom networking, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP
  • Experience with legacy signaling protocols (SS7/ISDN) and SIP-based voice systems

Linux knowledge

  • Understanding of interconnect architecture, number portability, and call routing

job.title: Director, Finance
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

The Finance Director, Innov8, is a key member of the leadership team responsible for leading the organization’s overall finance function, ensuring strong financial governance, strategic planning, regulatory compliance, and optimal capital management. The role oversees financial planning and analysis, treasury operations, investment portfolio management, tax, legal and corporate secretarial matters, audit coordination, hr support and payroll, and financial reporting to support sustainable business growth and shareholder value creation.

Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer (CEO),Singtel Innov8 Ventures, the Finance Director serves as a trusted advisor to senior management on financial, investment, risk and corporate governance matters. The role also serves as a business partner to the Investment Committee and Board of Directors in providing timely information on investment portfolio, evaluating impairment provisions and safeguarding shareholder assets.The scope covers 6 entities across 4 countries, inclusive of Singapore.

Make An Impact By

Financial Leadership

  • Provide periodic financial insights to the CEO, Board and senior leadership team.
  • Drive financial discipline across the organization.
  • Maintain financial performance and manage manpower issues.
  • Establish and maintain robust financial policies, controls, and governance frameworks.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Ensure accurate and timely preparation of monthly and quarterly consolidated financial report.
  • Oversee statutory reporting and compliance with applicable accounting standards.
  • Present insightful financial performance to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain high standards of financial integrity, transparency, and accountability.

Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Lead annual budgeting, long-range planning, and rolling forecast processes.
  • Monitor business performance against budgets and forecasts.
  • Develop scenario analyses to support strategic decision-making.
  • Provide actionable insights on cost optimization and resource allocation.

Investment Portfolio

  • Support the investment team maintaining overview of the company’s total investment portfolio value.
  • Coordinate with investment team lead on funding, exits, investment performance, liquidity requirements, risk and impairment assessment.
  • Present impairment paper to management and the Board for approval.
  • Coordinate with investment lead and auditors on valuation assessment of portfolio companies.
  • Ensure compliance with investment policies and risk management guidelines.
  • Manage and maintain relationship with security stock broker for quoted shares held.
  • Point of contact for accepting and management of share certificates.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Treasury, Cash & Capital Management

  • Manage treasury operations, cash flow planning, and liquidity management.
  • Oversee cash management and capital structure arrangements with Treasury and Company Secretary.
  • Ensure adequate funding and liquidity to support operational and investment funding activities.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Tax Management

  • Oversee the organization’s tax compliance framework.
  • Ensure timely and accurate submission of all tax filings and regulatory obligations.
  • Manage corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and other tax initiatives including annual FATCA and CRS reporting, MAS declaration and updating Form W8-BenE as required.
  • Liaise with external tax advisors on obtaining tax exemption certificate, overseas tax filings and ad-hoc matters.
  • Identify tax optimization opportunities while ensuring compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Legal & Company Secretarial Oversight

  • Support external legal counsel on investment transactions, KYC and other corporate governance matters.
  • Coordinate with in-house legal counsel on contracts and regulatory matters ensuring compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Support Board and shareholder meetings, coordinating, preparing and reviewing of board resolutions and corporate documentation.
  • Oversee company secretarial activities and maintenance of statutory records.

[](https://groupcareers.singtel.com/job/Director%2C-Finance-Sing/1365703266/)Audit, Risk & Internal Controls

  • Lead relationships with external and internal auditors.
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits and ensure timely completion of audit requirements.
  • Address audit findings and implement corrective actions.
  • Strengthen internal controls and governance processes.
  • Monitor compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.

General HR, Payroll and Administrative matters

  • Provide general HR and office administrative support across the organization.
  • Responsible for payroll processing for US office, employee records management, leave and benefits administration, statutory reporting ensuring compliance with local regulations.
  • Collaborate effectively with external overseas vendors on payroll and leave management issues.
  • Laise with landlord and collaboration partner for office lease renewal.

Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

  • Lead, mentor and develop the finance and related support functions.
  • Foster a high-performance culture focused on accountability, integrity and continuous improvement
  • Collaborate effectively with business leaders and external stakeholders including auditors, legal and tax advisors.
  • Drive process improvements and automation initiatives

Skills to Succeed

  • Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting or related discipline.
  • Professional qualifications such as CPA, CA, ACCA, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of progressive finance leadership experience, including experience in senior finance management level.
  • Experience in investment portfolio management, treasury, financial planning and analysis, tax, audit, hr, admin, payroll and corporate governance.
  • Experience interacting with Boards, shareholders and regulatory authorities.
  • Good understanding of accounting standards, financial regulations, and risk management principles.
  • Experience in managing legal and company secretarial matters is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with cross-border investments and multi-entity structures is advantageous

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Critical Facilities Operations & Incident Response Engineer (Data Centre)
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Join our team at Nxera to unfold the new era! Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future with our dynamic teams!

Make an Impact by

Facilities Monitoring & Operations

  • Monitor and manage critical Data Centre (DC) facilities infrastructure in a 24x7 Centralized Network Operations Centre (CNOC) environment.
  • Perform real-time monitoring of electrical, mechanical and environmental systems including UPS, generators, CRAC/CRAH units, power distribution systems, temperature and humidity monitoring, leak detection systems and access control systems.
  • Respond promptly to facility alarms, incidents and abnormalities, and escalate issues to customer success team, technical specialists and customers based on severity and operational impact.
  • Ensure Building Management Systems (BMS), Environmental Monitoring Systems (EMS), DCIM tools and IoT monitoring devices are functioning accurately and reliably.
  • Coordinate with onsite operations teams during maintenance activities, equipment failures, planned shutdowns and emergency response situations.
  • Monitor facility performance trends and highlight recurring alarms or abnormalities for corrective actions.

Incident, Change & Maintenance Coordination

  • Support facilities incident management processes including incident logging, escalation, tracking and closure within defined SLA timelines.
  • Manage change requests workflow with internal teams
  • Ensure proper documentation and shift handover updates for all incidents, maintenance activities and operational events.
  • Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of facilities-related issues.

Operational Support & Reporting

  • Maintain accurate operational records, alarm logs, escalation reports and facilities documentation.
  • Assist in generating operational and facilities performance reports for management review.
  • Manage OneNxera Portal
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, monitoring effectiveness and service reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with operational procedures, safety requirements and data centre best practices.

Skills for Success

  • ITE, Nitec/Higher Nitec or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Management or related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in Data Centre Operations, Facilities Operations or mission critical infrastructure environments.
  • Candidates with relevant hands-on experience in 24x7 operations environments are encouraged to apply.
  • Basic understanding of Data Centre facilities systems including power, cooling, environmental monitoring and building management systems.
  • Familiarity with facilities monitoring tools such as BMS, EMS, DCIM or Servicenow systems is advantageous.
  • Knowledge of incident management, escalation handling and change management processes.
  • ITIL Foundation certification will be an added advantage.
  • Able to work effectively in a 24x7 shift environment (12-hours shift rotation)
  • Good troubleshooting, coordination and communication skills.
  • Team players with positive attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Able to remain calm and organized during operational incidents and high-pressure situations.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.title: Store Manager, Horsham
job.description:
Optus is one of Australia’s leading telecommunications providers, connecting more than 11 million customers every day across mobile,broadband and digital solutions.

We’re searching for an inspiring mentor and people focusedStore Manager to lead our Horshamteam on a 12 month parental leave cover,with the start date aiming for September/October.If you thrive on crafting high performing, energised teams, love building meaningful customer connections, and enjoy running a store like it’s your own business, then we’d love to hear from you.

We collaborate with purpose, lift each other up, take accountability, act with integrity, and celebrate as one team. Together, we learn, grow, tackle challenges and build genuine relationships with our customers and with each other. At Optus,you’ll feel connected to what truly matters, build your skills and expand your career growth. And as a store leader,you’ll be the key to success.

Your day to day:

  • Lead from the front, creating a positive,high-performance culture where your team feels supported, motivated and confident to shine every day.
  • Coach,mentor and develop your team, building capability and empowering them to deliver exceptional customer experiences, consistently and proudly.
  • Shape an energised, inclusive and customer first environment, that feels welcoming,genuine and inspiring for both customers and your team.
  • Bring Optus’ strategy to life in‑store by running smooth, efficient operations and continuously finding opportunities to uplift outcomes,performance and overall customer experience.
  • Address raised customer concerns with calm professionalism, modelling effective de‑escalation and guiding your team in resolving complex or sensitive situations.
  • Drive team engagement by celebrating wins, setting meaningful goals, fostering continuous learning, and strengthening collaboration across your store and the wider region.

What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Inspirational Leadership:You lead through your actions,beliefs and integrity by motivating those around you, building trust, and bringing your team together to achieve their best.
  • Customer First Approach:You’re passionate about creating memorable experiences and mentoring your team to put customers at the heart of every decision,interaction and solution.
  • Coaching & Development:You know how to coach, upskill and support your people through clear feedback,encouragement and meaningful goal setting, helping them grow with confidence.
  • Calm Under Pressure:You stay composed during difficult or reactive situations, model effective de‑escalation, and help your team handle customer challenges with care and professionalism.
  • Business & Operational Strength:You understand the drivers of high performance and balance strong people leadership with sound operational judgment to deliver great store results.
  • Team Spirit & Adaptability:You foster a workplace where everyone feels included, accountable and supported, staying solutions focused when priorities or customer needs shift.

The good stuff…

  • Competitive remuneration and exclusive access to unique discounts. Make life easier (and more affordable) with $80 monthly credit and 25% off Optus products and special shopping discounts with our retail and corporate partners.
  • Competitive leave policies, including additional'Connected’ day to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever’s important to you.
  • We support growing families with inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 14 weeks.
  • Build future ready skills through Optus U, with industry micro credentials created alongside La Trobe and Macquarie Universities.
  • Build meaningful connections through employee-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women,Yarn First Nations,Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Put your wellbeing first with free access to counselling and support services, available 24/7 across multiple channels.

Curious but still unsure?That’s completely okay as we still encourage you to apply. We all learn,grow and develop together, and this role might be the perfect next step in your leadership journey.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email[AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au)or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Portfolio Manager, hi! Product Marketing
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll have the opportunity to use data, digital products and emerging technologies to shape better customer experiences and unlock new avenues for growth.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Join the hi! by Singtel team and help turn customer growth and digital adoption into measurable commercial impact.

As a Portfolio Manager, hi! Product Marketing, you will work at the intersection of revenue management, digital product thinking and customer growth. You will identify the commercial drivers that matter, use data and experimentation to unlock growth opportunities, and help make the hi! consumer app a stronger destination for customer engagement, self-service and monetisation.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys asking “what moves the number?”, spotting friction in customer journeys and bringing Product, Digital, CLM, Analytics and Marketing teams together to turn insights into measurable results.

How You will Make An Impact:

Revenue & Growth Management

  • Manage and track hi!’s revenue performance across key revenue-generating drivers, with clear targets, forecasts, gap-closing actions and regular performance reviews.
  • Break topline revenue into actionable commercial levers such as revenue-generating subscriber conversion, recharge and top-up behaviour, and ARPU uplift to identify the highest-impact growth opportunities.
  • Use commercial and behavioural data to identify growth opportunities, diagnose underperformance and recommend actions that improve revenue outcomes.
  • Develop and support business cases, size growth opportunities and conduct post-launch reviews to understand what worked, what did not and what should be scaled.
  • Translate performance data into clear commercial insights and actions for key stakeholders.

Consumer App Adoption & Digital Growth

  • Drive adoption and active usage of the hi! consumer app across the full customer funnel, including installs, registrations, monthly active users, repeat visits, digital transactions and self-service behaviour.
  • Track app funnel performance to identify customer drop-offs, friction points and opportunities to improve engagement and conversion.
  • Work closely with Product, IT and Channel Owners to shape and prioritise features that solve customer needs and create stronger commercial outcomes.
  • Develop initiatives that connect app engagement with recharge, retention, upsell, cross-sell and other revenue drivers.
  • Monitor feature adoption and evaluate the customer and commercial impact of new digital capabilities.

Innovation, Experimentation & New Technology

  • Explore practical applications of AI, personalisation, automation, conversational experiences, recommendation engines and emerging technologies to improve customer journeys.
  • Develop and test new ideas and experiments that can improve digital engagement, conversion and revenue.
  • Stay curious about evolving digital, technology and consumer trends and translate relevant opportunities into the hi! brand and product roadmap.
  • Use experiment results and customer behaviour to identify initiatives that can be improved, scaled or further developed.

Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner closely with Product, CLM, Marketing, Analytics, Finance and other teams to move growth initiatives from idea to launch.
  • Create simple and actionable performance views that give stakeholders visibility into revenue, app adoption, experiments, risks and next actions.
  • Establish regular operating rhythms for performance tracking, forecasting and gap-closing initiatives.
  • Follow through on actions, dependencies and blockers to keep growth initiatives moving at pace.
  • Bring different teams together around clear customer and commercial outcomes.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline.
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in digital marketing, growth, product, commercial analytics, Customer Lifecycle Management (CLM) or a related field.
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work confidently with dashboards, funnels, customer behaviour and commercial data.
  • Good business acumen with the ability to connect customer behaviour and digital engagement to commercial outcomes.
  • Experience in revenue management, growth analytics, digital product management or customer lifecycle initiatives is an advantage.
  • Strong interest in consumer apps, digital product experiences, AI, personalisation and emerging technologies.
  • Ability to identify customer journey friction and translate insights into practical improvement opportunities.
  • Comfortable developing business cases, sizing opportunities and evaluating the impact of new initiatives.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the confidence to work across multiple teams.
  • Able to turn analysis into clear recommendations and actionable next steps.
  • Curious, commercially minded and comfortable testing ideas, learning quickly and adapting based on results.
  • Able to thrive in a fast-paced environment while taking ownership and driving initiatives forward.

The role ensures high network availability across Singtel co-owned cable systems within a mission-critical environment.

Responsible for executing technical operations to ensure the availability, reliability and restoration of international submarine cable systems. The incumbent independently performs technical analysis, executes operational activities through authorised Network Management Systems (NMS), and coordinates restoration activities in accordance with established operating procedures and regulatory requirements.

These include:

  • Performing technical assessment of complex submarine cable system alarms to determine probable fault domains and service impact.
  • Executing operational activities through Network Management Systems (NMS) with authorised write access, requiring sound judgement to prevent unintended service disruption.
  • Coordinate incident restoration activities with consortium members, Cable Landing Stations, equipment vendors and internal engineering teams.
  • Execute restoration actions and monitor service recovery until normal operations are restored
  • Preparing and submitting mandatory regulatory notifications within prescribed timelines during submarine cable outages.
  • Maintain accurate incident chronology, operational records and shift documentation.
  • Escalate operational issues, risks and unresolved incidents in accordance with established escalation procedures.
  • Participate in operational readiness activities, disaster recovery exercises and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • These responsibilities require engineers capable of making sound operational decisions independently while maintaining strict adherence to operational governance and regulatory requirements.

Skills for Success:

  • Diploma in Telecommunications Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or equivalent
  • In telecommunications network operations, transmission systems, optical transport networks or submarine cable operations
  • Demonstrated experience in incident management within a mission-critical operational environment
  • Experience operating Network Management Systems (NMS) with configuration or operational write privileges is highly desirable
  • Experience supporting international submarine cable systems, optical transmission networks or carrier-grade infrastructure will be an advantage.

Good to have

  • IP networking protocols knowledge
  • Optical transmission technologies knowledge
  • Microsoft 365 tools knowledge
  • DWDM (Dense Wavelength Division Multiplexing) and SDH (Synchronous Digital Hierarchy) technologies knowledge
  • Proficiency with OTDR (Optical Time-Domain Reflectometer), BER (Bit Error Rate) test and Network Management Systems (NMS) knowledge
