job.title: Senior Information Security Specialist
job.description:
Date: 28 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

**

Role Summary

**

The purpose of this role is to provide independent security architecture and risk assurance across technology initiatives, ensuring that information security risks are identified early, assessed consistently, and managed effectively throughout the system lifecycle. The role enables secure delivery of business initiatives by ensuring technology solutions, infrastructure changes, and third-party services are designed and implemented in compliance with regulatory requirements, enterprise security standards, and the organisation’s risk appetite.

The role acts as a security risk and architecture advisor to Singtel IT, Telco Networks and Enterprise stakeholders, applying recognised security frameworks and threat modelling techniques to evaluate design decisions, identify control gaps, and recommend risk-based mitigations. Through continuous improvement of risk assessment practices and standards, the role strengthens the organisation’s overall security posture while supporting timely and informed decision-making.

**

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Perform comprehensive information security risk assessments for new and existing systems, applications, infrastructure changes, and third-party engagements.
  • Ensure technology initiatives and controls comply with internal security policies, standards, and governance requirements; proactively highlight gaps and recommend remediation.
  • Review and validate security control designs across IT infrastructure, cloud environments, network security, identity and access management, data protection, and application security
  • Assess design documents, architecture diagrams, and technical controls to confirm that technology risks are mitigated prior to go-live.
  • Conduct threat modelling for critical systems and application deployments, identifying attack paths, threat scenarios, and control weaknesses, and recommending design-level mitigations.
  • Collaborate with IT, application teams, and business stakeholders to provide risk advisory for projects and ad hoc reviews.
  • Define, review, and promote secure architecture and security design patterns to guide solution teams in implementing consistent, scalable, and risk-aligned security controls.
  • Drive continuous improvement of security risk assessment and design review frameworks, processes, and templates to enhance consistency, quality, and efficiency across project and solution reviews.
  • Recommend new or enhanced security controls and architecture patterns based on emerging threats, risk assessment outcomes, regulatory changes, and industry best practices, and work with stakeholders to support their implementation.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree/Diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering or related fields
  • At least 6 years or more working experience in security assessment, cybersecurity, or related IT roles.
  • Experience in Systems security, Network Security, Identity Access Management or Virtualization Security is required.
  • Experience working within system integrator or consulting environments, including exposure to multi-client or complex delivery engagements, is an advantage.
  • Hands-on experience in system and security administration, implementation, and solution design across servers, applications and telco networks, will be useful.
  • Ability to apply Zero Trust security architecture principles to complex enterprise environments.
  • Capability in threat modelling and technology risk assessment, including identification of threat scenarios, assessment of control effectiveness, and recommendation of risk mitigation strategies.
  • Strong capability to interpret security baselines and standards and translate them into appropriate architectural and control requirements, aligned with regulatory, enterprise, and technology contexts.
  • Ability to validate systems and solution designs against security and compliance baselines, identify gaps, and recommend appropriate remediation measures.
  • Professional security management certifications such as a Certified Information Systems Security professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM) or other similar credentials, will be preferred.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Effective time management and prioritisation skills.
  • Sound conflict management and negotiation skills.
  • High level of professionalism, commitment, and accountability.
  • Resilience and adaptability in fast-paced or changing environments.
  • Change-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, with remote stakeholders, exercising sound judgement and initiative.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Systems Engineer
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Every day, millions of Australians connect, work, stream, and stay in touch on the Optus network. When it works seamlessly, it’s easy to take for granted. But behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day - decisions that keep people, businesses and communities connected.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right – simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers. It’s not about surface-level change. It’s about how we make decisions, how we work together, and how we deliver.

As a Systems Engineer, you will work closely with technical and business teams to support building, implementing, and operating regulatory systems. These systems must align with telecommunications legislation and national interest requirements.

If you’re looking to do work that matters - and help build what comes next - this is your opportunity to be part of it.

Due to the nature of this role, you must be an Australian Citizen who holds (or be eligible to acquire) an Australian Government security clearance.

What You’ll Do

  • Assist senior engineers in delivering end-to-end solutions across the technology lifecycle, from development through to operations
  • Contribute to highly available, secure, and scalable systems, maintaining reliability of critical regulatory platforms
  • Partner with internal teams and external stakeholders, including government and law enforcement agencies, to support solution delivery and operations
  • Participate in security risk assessments and help maintain security architecture in regulated environments
  • Support continuous improvement through modern engineering practices, automation, and evolving technologies

What You Bring

  • Experience in full stack, end to end, systems support, including infrastructure build and operate
  • Linux experience (essential)
  • Virtualization (Proxmox) and Kubernetes (Rancher) experience
  • Software development using:
  • Go (essential)
  • Rust (familiarity, desire to develop the skillset is essential)
  • Python (desired, not essential)
  • Gitlab CICD and SDLC
  • Experience leveraging modern cloud native builds, tooling and patterns in an entirely on-premises environment. E.g. Terraform, Ansible, Packer etc
  • Datacenter experience including the installation and maintenance of server, network and storage
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Computer Science/Engineering; cybersecurity certifications are an advantage

The good stuff….

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable. Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes, chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s built for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer with free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers.

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right approach matters more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there!

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au or call 1800 309 170.

For more information on Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging at Optus, please visit https://www.optus.com.au/about/inclusion-diversity

job.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer to join our Enterprise Platforms Engineering team. The role is responsible for designing, building and delivering software development infrastructure that supports internal tools and platform development. Working closely with engineering and technology teams, the Senior DevOps Engineer will enable reliable and automated application and infrastructure deployment while ensuring alignment with organisational IT, security, architecture and engineering standards.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise, effective communication skills and the ability to collaborate with teams with different levels of technical experience. They will contribute to the adoption of DevOps best practices, cloud architecture strategies and engineering standards while supporting the continued evolution of cloud and automation capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, implement and automate CI/CD pipelines across development, staging and production environments.
  • Develop and maintain DevOps engineering standards and best practices.
  • Identify opportunities to improve deployment consistency, reliability and automation.
  • Design and implement Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions and automated application deployments.
  • Develop tools and scripts to automate deployment and operational processes.
  • Guide project teams toward solutions aligned with agreed architecture, security, engineering principles and standards.
  • Provide technical guidance to teams on application and infrastructure automation.
  • Mentor engineers and facilitate knowledge sharing across teams.
  • Integrate appropriate security controls and testing into DevOps processes.
  • Drive continuous improvements in application design, development and delivery.
  • Improve system reliability and recovery through monitoring, alerting, automation and self-healing capabilities.
  • Promote an automation-first engineering approach.
  • Apply agile practices to support consistent and transparent delivery.
  • Manage and maintain DevOps pipelines and collaborate with development teams on integrated delivery pipelines.
  • Lead technology evaluations and implementations to address gaps in software build, testing, deployment and scalability capabilities.
  • Develop and implement governance processes and tools to support compliance with applicable technology standards and policies.

Requirements

  • Relevant experience in Information Technology, including significant hands-on experience with DevOps engineering for complex systems.
  • Demonstrated experience designing, implementing and operating CI/CD and infrastructure automation solutions.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Linux operating systems such as Ubuntu.
  • Strong practical experience with Kubernetes and containerised environments.
  • Experience with at least one major public cloud platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VPCs, subnets, VPNs, DNS, load balancing and network protocols.
  • Hands-on experience implementing Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or comparable technologies.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes and Helm.
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD solutions using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins or comparable tools.
  • Experience with configuration-management technologies such as Ansible, Chef, Puppet or comparable tools.
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills in complex distributed computing environments.
  • Proficiency with Git and experience using collaboration and work-management platforms such as Jira and Confluence.
  • Experience working with APIs, command-line interfaces and SDKs.
  • Experience with API gateway technologies such as NGINX, Apigee or comparable platforms.

Preferred Skills

  • REST APIs and GraphQL.
  • Microservices architecture.

  • Relevant professional certifications, such as RHCE/RHCSA or Kubernetes certifications.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Daily, millions of Australians link up, work, stream, and communicate via the Optus network. When it runs flawlessly, it’s easy to underestimate. However, behind it is a team making thousands of decisions every day—choices that maintain connections among people, businesses, and communities.

Right now, Optus is passionate about getting the fundamentals right - simplifying how we work, lifting standards, and building a more reliable, resilient experience for our customers.

The Senior Systems Engineer in the Regulatory Projects team will have a high level of technical expertise to support Optus in meeting a range of regulatory obligations. The role also requires strong stakeholder management skills, as you will regularly meet with representatives from government agencies, vendors, and internal teams. You will be responsible for supporting innovative technical solutions to address customer requirements and government initiatives through the solution’s life cycle.

If you’re looking to do work that matters - and help build what comes next - this is your opportunity to be part of it.

Due to the nature of this role, you must be an Australian Citizen who holds (or be eligible to acquire) an Australian Government security clearance.

What You’ll Do | Your day to day will consist of

  • Developing and supporting solutions for Optus to meet its obligations under the Telecommunications Act to provide industry assistance on national interest matters.
  • Supporting the build, development, and maintenance of regulatory solutions for any of the Optus products or offerings in the market.
  • Supporting existing regulatory solutions, systems, and infrastructure.
  • Acting as a point of contact for support to government agencies using regulatory solutions provided by Optus.
  • Participating in security risk assessments and maintaining the security architecture for regulatory systems.

What You Bring | What makes you perfect for the role?

  • Experience in full stack, end to end, systems design and engineering, including infrastructure build and operate.
  • Strong Linux experience is essential.
  • Virtualization (Proxmox) and Kubernetes (Rancher) experience.
  • Software development using:
  • * Go (essential)
  • * Rust (familiarity, desire to develop the skillset is essential)
  • * Python (desired, not essential)
  • * Gitlab CICD and SDLC
  • Experience leveraging modern cloud native designs, tooling and patterns in an entirely on-premises environment. E.g. Terraform, Ansible, Packer etc.
  • Datacenter experience including the installation and maintenance of server, network and storage equipment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in Computer Science/Engineering; cybersecurity certifications are an advantage.
  • Data analytics abilities desirable.

The good stuff…. | What’s in it for you?

  • Competitive remuneration, plus $80 monthly credit, 25% off Optus products and exclusive shopping discounts with our retail partners — making everyday life a little more affordable.
  • Genuine Flexibility - work three days in the office, two days from wherever works best for you.
  • An office campus that has it all - cafes chill out zones, GP, post office, gym and on-site childcare centre. It’s built for real life.
  • Great leave policies, including additional 'Connected’ days to focus on culture, family, health, community, or whatever matters most to you.
  • Inclusive, carer-neutral paid Parental Leave of up to 16 weeks, because family comes first.
  • Build meaningful connections through colleague-led networks and diversity initiatives including Culture Connect, Elevate Women, Disability Network and Express Yourself (LGBTQIA+).
  • Your wellbeing matters, so we offer free counselling and support services, available 24/7 in-person, by phone, SMS, or video.
  • A free Optus bus from Macquarie University Metro Station (every 6-8 minutes); morning and afternoon. Or, heaps of onsite parking. Plus, end of trip facilities with lockers, showers, irons and hair dryers.

Not every box ticked? Apply anyway. We believe the right approach matters more than a perfect CV. We’ll back you to grow from there.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: Lead Specialist, Cloud Architect
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Make an Impact By

  • Lead the end-to-end architecture and technical governance of Singtel's telco cloud infrastructure, defining the target architecture across cloud platforms, cloud networking and supporting infrastructure.
  • Develop and maintain the technology architecture roadmap for telco cloud platforms, ensuring alignment with Singtel's network transformation strategy, cloud-native adoption and long-term business objectives.
  • Define architecture standards, design principles and reference architectures covering compute, storage, virtualization, container platforms, cloud networking and infrastructure services.
  • Ensure seamless integration between cloud platforms, IP transport networks, network security infrastructure and supporting management systems to deliver scalable, resilient and secure end-to-end cloud infrastructure.
  • Provide architectural leadership for major infrastructure transformation programmes, including cloud platform refresh, technology modernisation and migration to cloud-native platforms.
  • Lead technical architecture reviews and solution governance to ensure proposed infrastructure designs comply with architecture standards, security requirements and operational best practices.
  • Partner with planning managers responsible for cloud platforms, IP transport and cybersecurity to ensure architectural consistency across infrastructure domains.
  • Lead technical evaluation of new technologies and vendor solutions, providing architecture recommendations during RFP/RFQ, technology sourcing and commercial evaluation activities.
  • Drive infrastructure simplification, standardisation and automation by identifying opportunities to optimise architecture, improve operational efficiency and reduce technical debt.
  • Provide architecture guidance and technical consultancy to engineering, operations, cybersecurity and enterprise architecture teams throughout project delivery.
  • Mentor planning engineers and managers by promoting architecture best practices and strengthening technical capability across the organisation.

Skills for Success

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science / Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • 12–15 years of experience in telecommunications, cloud infrastructure, enterprise architecture or network engineering.
  • Strong expertise in telco cloud architecture, including NFVi, cloud-native infrastructure and distributed cloud platforms.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, including routing, switching, software-defined networking, load balancing and network integration within cloud environments.
  • Strong knowledge of virtualization technologies, Kubernetes, OpenShift, ESXI, OpenStack, storage platforms and cloud infrastructure services.
  • Experience developing enterprise or infrastructure architecture roadmaps and governing technical standards across multiple technology domains.
  • Experience leading architecture for large-scale cloud transformation, infrastructure modernisation and technology refresh programmes.
  • Experience supporting vendor sourcing activities, including architecture assessment, technical evaluation and solution recommendation.
  • Strong understanding of high availability, disaster recovery, geo-redundancy, infrastructure security and operational resilience for mission-critical telecommunications platforms.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence architecture decisions across engineering, operations, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture and senior leadership.
  • Competence in the Following Areas
  • Telco Cloud Architecture
  • Cloud Platform Architecture
  • Cloud Networking Architecture
  • NFV / Cloud-native Infrastructure
  • Infrastructure Integration Architecture
  • Enterprise & Solution Architecture
  • Infrastructure Lifecycle & Technology Roadmap
  • High Availability & Geo-Resilient Architecture
  • Infrastructure Security by Design
  • Technology Evaluation & Vendor Assessment
  • Infrastructure Automation & DevOps
  • Architecture Governance & Standards
  • Stakeholder Management

job.title: Sales Manager, Healthcare
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

NCS is a leading technology services firm that operates across the Asia Pacific region in over 20 cities, providing consulting, digital services, technology solutions, and more. We believe in harnessing the power of technology to achieve extraordinary things, creating lasting value and impact for our communities, partners, and people. Our diverse workforce of 13,000 has delivered large-scale, mission-critical, and multi-platform projects for governments and enterprises in Singapore and the APAC region.

As a Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving NCS sales, including account penetration, prospect qualification, supervision of sales activity, sales process planning, and closing all sales opportunities in the industry and/or sector that you are in. You are expected to build deep and trusted business relationships with the client to seed and grow future opportunities and will be focused on developing and closing application centric opportunities.

Beyond managing your own sales, sold margin and Business Centre’s revenue achievements, you also act as trusted client advisors, bringing together the right NCS team with the relevant expertise and thought leadership to coordinate pre-sales, professional services, and support resources to drive successful solutions for clients.

Reporting to the Sales Lead, you will work closely with different teams across NCS such as the Client Service Units, Lines of Businesses (LOBs) and NEXT Services. You will work with the teams to define the solution offerings & value propositions to maximise NCS’ win probability in each and every opportunity. This is achieved by him/her having a deep understanding of the business needs of the clients and working within the CSU and across the LOBs to strategise new growth plans.

What will you do?

  • Lead and grow his/her portfolio of accounts space through strong engagement with key decision makers by selling NCS Application solutions to the target customer base;
  • Have a strong understanding of the latest technology trends and the business needs of the clients, thus being able to coordinate across functional teams within NCS to bring the right winning team to drive successful solutions and contract closure;
  • Meet sales quota through identifying and gaining business from new and existing clients and ensuring customer’s satisfaction through the products and services provided by NCS
  • Manage and coordinate contract terms and conditions internally and externally;
  • Manage and build relationships at all levels with the designated clients that he/she is in charge of;
  • Develop value prepositions and negotiate successfully to close deals;
  • Develop a good understanding of the organisation’s products and services to coordinate pre-sales requirements;
  • Drive profitable wins focused on NCS’ core capabilities and growth strategy;
  • Coordinate and partner across functional teams and Lines of Businesses (LOBs) within NCS to strike innovative deals, get orders provisioned and meet the customers' service expectations;
  • Provide one-stop experience to customers regarding all NCS services.

The Ideal Candidate should possess:

  • 6+ years of sales experience, preferably in IT services.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales quotas.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value propositions.
  • Knowledge of Commercial arrangements.
  • Good interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Exceptional negotiation, presentation and deal maker skills.
  • Experience in managing multiple stakeholders preferred.
  • Dynamic and able to adjust in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to deal with ambiguity.
  • University Degree/ Polytechnic Diploma. Background in Business, Computer Science or Computer Engineering or a related field.

We are driven by our AEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We are committed to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we _make the extraordinary happen_ _._

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Senior Solution Designer, Finance
job.description:
Be a part of something BIG!

SayHELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL(Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre!

We are seeking for aSenior Solution Designer (Finance)candidate who will be responsible for the overall strategy, governance, and evolution of financial systems (mainly SAP S4HANA and others) across the Singtel group, ensuring these systems are secure, well-managed by third-party vendors, and consistently adhere to industry best practices. The role requires close collaboration with Finance business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs and add tangible value.

The candidate will oversee project delivery and drive continuous improvement initiatives, ensuring systems and processes are scalable, flexible, and capable of supporting future business growth. Additionally, the role involves governing the architecture and design, formalising standards, and proactively optimising processes to maintain operational excellence and best-in-class capabilities.

TheSAP S4HANA modules in scope are mainly SAP FICO(CO-PA, CCA, PCA, PS, AP, AR, AM, GL, RE-FX, SL) and SAP BPC. Non-SAP applications include Sungard AvantGard Treasury.

Make an Impact by:

  • Domain Ownership: Establish and oversee a balanced IT project portfolio that meets business objectives and align the strategic plans of both IT and the business. Develop and align a 3-year roadmap for the Singtel group’s financial systems with the business’ strategy. Approve all changes and projects in the financial systems. Ensure that systems, solutions, services, processes are aligned.
  • Client Facing: Establish regular meetings with stakeholders to build up trust, increase collaboration, and IT presence in the eyes of the stakeholders. Provide consultation to business to mature business ideas or provide expert recommendations to stimulate business needs.
  • Project Ownership: Deliver projects with clearly defined and measurable benefits to the business. Deliver projects on time, in scope, and below budget.
  • Operational Excellence: Ensure that systems and services are running according to agreed SLAs. Constantly deliver improvement initiatives that add value to both IT and the business.
  • Team Management: Manage outsourced Application Managed Services (AMS) resources to ensure they deliver the expected L2 support to end users.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, IT or any relevant fields.
  • At least 6 years of hands-on experience with core SAP FICO modules, including Accounts Payable (AP) especially on banking related interfaces, Accounts Receivable (AR), General Ledger (GL), Fixed Assets (FA), Project Systems (PS), and Credit Management.
  • Experience in InvoiceNOW, and other tax or legal solutions is a bonus
  • Strong project management capabilities to lead and deliver complex initiatives are required.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience managing SAP teams (e.g., AMS teams) is highly advantageous.
  • Proven experience in S/4HANA implementation, ideally with prior roles in leading consulting firms.
  • Excellent communication skills to convey complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including technical consultants, functional consultants, and business users, ensuring successful solution delivery.

Join us on our mission to continue defining the future of financial services. Apply now!

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Consultant
job.description:
At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Make an impact by:

  • Act as the Enterprise Cyber Security technical focal point during cyber incidents, working closely with SOC, CISO, infrastructure, network, cloud, application, and vendor teams.
  • Support cyber incident response activities including triage, investigation, containment coordination, evidence gathering, remediation tracking, and post incident review.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting across Enterprise infrastructure using available telemetry from SIEM, EDR, NDR, vulnerability management, asset discovery, and other security tools.
  • Identify suspicious behaviours, attack patterns, lateral movement indicators, privilege misuse, exposed services, anomalous access, and other signs of compromise.
  • Develop and enhance threat hunting hypotheses, detection use cases, investigation playbooks, response procedures, and escalation workflows.
  • Support improvement of security monitoring by identifying gaps in logs, telemetry, asset visibility, EDR/NDR/SIEM coverage, and detection rules.
  • Work with SOC and central security teams to improve alert quality, detection coverage, investigation context, and incident response readiness.
  • Support vulnerability management and risk-based remediation by correlating vulnerabilities with asset criticality, exposure, threat intelligence, and compensating controls.
  • Support Enterprise cybersecurity initiatives including NDR deployment, asset discovery, micro-segmentation, Zero Trust controls, PIAM/IAM adoption, and security tool integration.
  • Participate in security assessments, threat reviews, tabletop exercises, incident simulations, and lessons-learned activities.

job.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering (Data Centre)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Passionate about making a real impact? Join our team at Nxera to unfold the new era! Be at the forefront of the data centre (DC) industry with a unique focus on sustainability, connectivity and AI which sets us apart as the next generation DC operator. You will also get to gain invaluable experience in a fast-growing industry that is powering the digitalisation wave. Be empowered to co-create the future ~~~~ with our dynamic teams!

We are seeking candidate who has experienced in M&E Data Centre subject matter expert to join our team. He/she will be part of the Electrical and Mechanical (M&E) engineering team for the Data Centre Business.

Make an impact by:

Design and Development

  • Develop next generation Mission Critical System to meet company long term strategies.
  • Develop concept Critical Data Centre equipment design with focus on Electrical Power System. i.e. EHT Transformer, Switch Bay, Ring Main Unit, Transformers.
  • Develop concept designs which meet or exceed quality requirements and fall within our budgetary and meet energy efficiency requirements.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, regional vendors and manufacturers to specify the appropriate Electrical system both upstream and downstream infrastructure.
  • Data Centre Electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create construction document set.
  • Proposes some Electrical engineering knowledge that enabling to read and understand SLD, Electrical distribution layout and basic equipment electrical specification requirement to liaise with Electrical and commissioning counterpart for work deliveries.
  • Resourceful in continuously exploring for new engineering system and/or technology for Data Centre application with an aim to enhance or improve overall performance, lower energy, and water consumption, increase operation productivity and reduce total cost of ownership.
  • Liaise with Energy and Sustainability manager to examine and assess systems design and equipment selection are good in operating efficiency with low energy and water consumption to drive low PUE and WUE for all our DCs.

Review

  • Review RFIs documentation submittal from Consultants, Vendor and Manufacturers.
  • Review Data Centre commissioning scripts and ensure that systems are accurately tested to the required modes of operations.
  • Review design and construction drawings and engineering specification for Data Centre

Evaluation

  • Evaluate industry new technology to improve power consumption, quality, and efficiencies.
  • Evaluate the design, construction and operation of mission-critical facilities and associated M&E components.

Skills for Success :

  • Ability to perform complex business case analysis to justify technical decisions and present the justification to Management.
  • Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
  • Ability to travel oversea to support Data Centre construction and implementation.
  • Ability to incorporate Renewable Energy System to the Distribution Network.
  • Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and start-up as needed.
  • Manage Electrical Power System issues during concept design, detailed design, procurement, bidding, manufacturing, delivery, and installation on site.
  • Update and maintain the internal design specifications, drawings, and standards in accordance with the latest configurations and including all 'lessons learned' in relation to all equipment.
  • Provide and prepare documentation such as statement of work, engineering reports, design documents, total cost of ownership analysis, drawing markup, budget, schedule, commissioning, design specification etc.
  • Electrical power fundamental knowledge in load flow, fault analysis and protection
  • Knowledge of local Code of Practice and regulations.
  • Knowledge of large-scale mission critical facility’s M&E infrastructure systems. Ability to think outside of the box to find creative and innovative solutions to reduce costs with no compromise on quality and system reliability.

Qualification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or relevant discipline.
  • 5+ years of M&E design experience in Mission Critical Data Centre environment.
  • Good communication skills, written and verbal, to all levels of Management.
  • Strong organization skills and ability to prioritize workload to meet tight deadline in a fast paced and dynamic work environment.
  • Experience with fast-track design/build project.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice\. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. \Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Singtel Networks, the most established telecommunications infrastructure provider in Singapore is transforming to enable the digital generation of tomorrow. We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

Make an Impact by:

  • Support the transformation project for Singtel’s Next Generation Carrier Ethernet Network (NGCE).
  • Mange operation issues and escalate chronic/technically complex cases to the Vendors and follow-up till closure.
  • Monitor and take remedial action on pro-actively and reactively detected services and network infrastructure faults till closure.
  • Schedule and carry out network maintenance on network Infrastructure such as the new deployment of nodes and trunks to support Core network activities and business growth.

  • Knowledge in Nokia Certified Network Routing Specialists (NRS I, NRS II) or Cisco certifications (CCNA, CCNP) or Juniper certifications (JNCIA, JNCIS) or Huawei certifications (HCNA, HCNP).

job.title: Senior Software Engineer (MCP)
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Be a Part of Something BIG!

Singtel is transforming into an AI-driven digital technology enterprise, delivering scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions across customer, network, and enterprise domains. As part of this transformation, Singtel is strengthening its internal engineering leadership to design and govern enterprise-grade AI platforms and automation capabilities.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to provide technical leadership across for new initatives. This role plays a critical part in shaping solution architecture, guiding delivery standards, and managing vendor and offshore engineering teams to ensure consistent, high-quality outcomes.

Make an Impact by:

AI and MCP agents

  • Design and Develop the MCP agents, tools and architect the MCP governance to be consumed by business flows
  • Design and govern Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, including data ingestion, indexing, retrieval pipelines, and response orchestration.
  • Provide technical direction for development of MCP tools and AI-enabled services delivered by internal, vendor, and offshore teams.
  • Ensure AI solutions are production-ready, scalable, observable, and aligned with Singtel’s enterprise architecture standards.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Own end-to-end technical solution design and architecture decisions for AI and automation initiatives.
  • Establish engineering standards, design principles, and best practices across AI platforms and backend systems.
  • Review and approve detailed technical designs, code structure, and deployment approaches produced by vendors or offshore teams.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, platforms, and technologies, recommending adoption where there is clear business value and operational readiness.
  • Identify and manage technical risks, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs. Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical guidance and reviewing critical designs.

Vendor & Offshore Resource Management

  • Provide technical governance and oversight for vendors and offshore delivery teams, ensuring adherence to Singtel’s architecture, security, and quality standards.
  • Review vendor deliverables, validate designs, and ensure compliance with functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Guide task decomposition, estimation, and prioritisation to support effective offshore delivery.
  • Act as the technical escalation point for delivery issues, architectural deviations, or quality concerns involving external partners.
  • Support capability uplift of vendor and offshore teams through technical guidance, standards, and knowledge transfer.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with product owners, enterprise architects, cybersecurity, data, and operations teams to align AI solutions with business objectives.
  • Communicate technical decisions, risks, and progress clearly to internal stakeholders and leadership.
  • Facilitate alignment across multiple delivery teams operating across time zones.

Operations, Security & Governance

  • Ensure AI systems comply with Singtel’s cybersecurity, data governance, and regulatory requirements.
  • Guide operational readiness, monitoring, and support models for AI-enabled platforms.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and remediation for complex production issues affecting AI services.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering
  • At least 6 years of experience as software developer.
  • 2-4 years AI/ML development; Experience leading complex system design and architecture
  • Experience managing vendors or offshore teams
  • Experience designing and integrating AI/ML solutions into production systems;
  • Ability to evaluate feasibility, risk, and operational impact of AI solutions
  • Significant experience in prompt engineering and prompt design for LLMs and GenAI applications.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Python/Node.js/Go/Java;
  • Strong system design, API architecture, and distributed systems expertise;
  • Ability to conduct technical design and code reviewsStrong experience with AWS/GCP/Azure;
  • Proficiency with container platforms and deployment pipelines;
  • Operational readiness and observability experienceStrong understanding of secure coding, API security, identity/access management, and data governance
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills;
  • Ability to influence vendors and offshore teams;
  • Strong decision-making and problem-solving

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Bid Manager
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • Lead and manage end-to-end bidding pursuit process. Be the overall-in-charge of RFP document development, preparation and to ensure high quality proposals are submitted on time.
  • Direct the pursuit strategy to properly position the firm’s market leadership, capabilities, resources, and overall credentials to win the new business opportunity.
  • To perform effective engagement with bid stakeholders, customers, overseas offices and partners for bid submission.
  • Work closely with Sales to understand customers’ requirements and business environment in order to formulate bid win strategies and value proposition for proposals.
  • Manage and negotiate with partners and vendors' on commitments and commercial terms.
  • Ensure bid proposals adhere to finance and legal guidelines; Manage risk log and mitigation plan.
  • Drive commercial strategy and manage customer contract and commercial deliverables.
  • Work with Pricing and Finance stakeholders to ensure proposed pricing is in line with overall bid strategy, establish pricing structure that meets business/corporate target margins and have gained internal approvals for customer submission.
  • Facilitate deal presentation and contract negotiation with customers.
  • Assess and address commercial and contractual risks relating to the bid being worked on, manage risk register for strategic and complex bids and work with stakeholders on mitigation strategies.
  • Monitor bid trends, maintain reporting on current bid activities, business drivers and future market trends.
  • Support in driving bid related digitalisation initiatives.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from completed bids to identify areas for improvement. Track win/loss outcomes and integrate learnings into future bids to enhance success rates.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Business Studies, IT Engineering or Economics.
  • 8 years of related bid management experience.
  • Project Management Skill and Contract Negotiation Skill
  • Financial Analysis and Modelling
  • Strong analytical skills with ability to understand and interpret data as well as being able to present data in a compelling manner.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Solutions Manager
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL(Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre!

We are seeking a Solutions Manager with deep expertise in telecommunication solutions, SDWAN, and digital transformation to drive technical solutioning for enterprises clients. This role is pivotal in engaging new business opportunities while transforming existing enterprise networks into agile, digitally managed infrastructures. As a key contributor, you will bridge business and technology by designing innovative solutions aligned with customers' transformation journeys, working closely with sales, delivery, and product teams.

Make an Impact by:

  • Collaborate closely with Sales/Account Managers in face-to-face meetings, providing pre-sales technical support to deliver an outstanding customer experience.

  • Translate business needs into network architecture designs that support customers’ LAN/WAN transformation and digital journeys.

  • Understanding of Network as a Service (NaaS) and Software-Defined Cloud Connectivity solutions.
  • Familiarity with IT/OT convergence in industrial environments
  • A consummate and team-based individual
  • Possess good customer handling and presentation skills.
  • Excellent communication skills to interact with stakeholders across technical and non-technical functions.
  • Experience working in agile or cross-functional teams to deliver customer-centric solutions.

job.title: IT Service Desk Support
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

Looking for an opportunity to elevate your career? Our internal mobility program is just what you need!

In Singtel Group, we strongly believe that our employees are our most valuable assets and are committed to creating a culture that supports your professional growth. By exploring new job opportunities within the company, you can expand your skill sets, gain exposure to different areas of the business, and build a diverse and fulfilling career.

If you are keen to explore this position or would like to refer a friend, please apply with an updated resume attached. Should you have any questions or concerns, please do not hesitate to reach out to the Talent Acquisition Manager in charge.

Be a part of something BIG!

TheIT Service Desk Supportis responsible in providing First Call Resolution (FCR) technical support via phone, self-service tickets and live chat. He/She will ensure tickets raised as per above channels are responded in a timely manner. This role also requires first level troubleshooting on all reported incidents and escalate incidents to 2nd level resolver groups as per work instructions.

Make an Impact by:

  • Identifies and resolves customer issues and enquires completely, accurately within the committed turnaround time and in accordance with ServiceDesk standards to ensure contact handling accuracy and operational effectiveness.
  • Furnish and submit timely updates to customers on the status of outstanding issues within targeted Service Level
  • Maintain ownership of cases and follow-up on reported issues until closure and gather accurate and complete relevant information is recorded.
  • Manage customer expectations and notify Team Lead in the event of unusual surge in calls of a specific nature.
  • Handle initial classification/ prioritization of the incidents. Track the progress of resolution and provide regular updates for follow-up actions and incident status.
  • Ensures highest standard of service delivery to our customers.
  • Maintains confidentiality of customer’s data.
  • Uses customer service and sales skills to optimize the opportunity of each customer contact.
  • Educates the customer about available services and directs them toward available resources for self-help.
  • Resolves customer complaints and problems to the satisfaction of the customer, and completes accurately the necessary documentation of complaints, issues and subsequent solutions.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree/ Diploma in any discipline, preferably in IT related field.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply for this position.
  • 1-2 years of experience in IT ServiceDesk, Call Centre, Customer Service (calls and correspondents) environment will be an advantage.
  • Possess a positive mindset with a “CAN-DO” attitude and passion to deliver quality customer service.
  • Possess a pleasant voice, excellent comprehension, communication, interpersonal skills and work etiquette.
  • Good analytical skills, passion for working and is good in multi-tasking.
  • Resourceful, proactive, results-driven, attentive to details and a good team player who likes to work in a fast-paced changing environment.
  • Passion for working, responsible and with good working attitude.
  • Proficient in PC skills including MS Office applications and ServiceNow.
  • Willing to work on staggered/rotational shifts (e.g. 8.5 or 12 hours shift) including weekends and Public Holidays to support 24x7 Contact Centre service operations.

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Cyber Security Consultant (Nucleus Graduate Programme) [Not open for applications]
job.description:
Your role is only the beginning**

Join NCS and experience a collaborative work environment where you can develop and grow your career through our well-defined career tracks. As part of our Nucleus Graduate Programme, you'll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects with a team that shares your passion for making a difference in the world. Our comprehensive training, professional coaching, and technical expertise will help you attain a Master of Technology with NUS-ISS or industry-recognized certifications. You'll also have access to multiple 'playgrounds,' such as Project Teams, Client Tribes, Strategy Groups, and Centers-of-Excellence based in Singapore, Shenzhen, and Melbourne. At NCS, we are committed to empowering our people to achieve their fullest potential and create an extraordinary future together.

Are you excited about the opportunity to tackle complex problems and develop solutions that make a real difference in people's lives? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where you're encouraged to think outside the box? Are you looking to make an impact and contribute to the development of innovative solutions? If you feel any of these describe you, then you might be the one we are looking for!

You will also have the opportunity to have hands-on experience in either of the 3 domain areas:

[Endpoint & Network Security]

  • Firewall Deployment & Management
  • Endpoint Security (e.g. Anti-virus)
  • Network security (e.g. IPS/IDS, proxy)
  • Vulnerability Assessment

[Threat Monitoring]

SIEM / SOC

  • Database Activities Monitoring
  • Endpoint Detect and Response
  • Automation & Orchestration (e.g. SOAR)

[Access Management]

  • Privileged Access & Identity Management
  • Private Key Infrastructure
  • 2 Factor Authentications

What will you do?

  • Support requirement gathering and solution design
  • Assist project management on project deliverables like Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), implementation plan, etc.
  • Provide the configuration, installation and integration
  • Provide the testing and vulnerability remediation (e.g. firmware/software upgrades or minor fixes /patches)
  • Provide problem troubleshooting and resolution
  • Provide knowledge transfer and handover of implemented security solution to the client and/or operations team
  • Provide project documentations for technical design, test cases etc.
  • Work closely with security governance and audit team to ensure the security services compliance with security standards or industry best practices

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Basic technical knowledge in TCP/IP Protocols, IPv4/IPv6 addressing, Static and Dynamic Routing, Network Address Translation (NAT), Concept of Syslog/SMTP/SNMP/NTP, High Availability and Disaster & Recovery, Link redundancy
  • Security product certification or security professional certifications would be an added advantage
  • Degree in Cyber Security or other related disciplines
  • Fresh graduate or less than 2 years of relevant working experience

​

Explore exciting career opportunities with NCS and kick-start your journey towards success. As a fresh graduate, you will have access to our Nucleus Graduate Programme, which offers professional coaching, comprehensive training, and clear career tracks to help you achieve your full potential. Visit our website at ncs.co/opportunities and check out our LinkedIn Career site to discover how you can be part of the extraordinary today. Join our team and experience #ncslife today!

job.title: Business Planning Manager
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

At Singtel, we believe in the strength of a vibrant, diverse and inclusive workforce where backgrounds, perspectives and life experiences of our people help us innovate and create strong connections with our customers. We strive to ensure all our people practices are non-discriminatory and provide a fair, performance-based work culture that is diverse, inclusive and collaborative.

Join us and experience what it’s like to be with an Employer of Choice. Together, let’s create a brighter digital future for all. Awarded at the HR Fest Awards 2020.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

We are looking for Business Planning Manger to partner with Sales Directors & Account Managers to drive financial planning, business analysis, and strategic insights that support effective decision-making and business performance in SEG (Singtel Enterprise GTM) – Singapore and Industrial, as well as analyzing and compiling Go-To-Market (GTM) plans.

The role leads financial and data planning and analysis, including performance tracking through dashboards and reporting, review of organisational structures and preparation of strategic planning and management reporting materials. It also supports cross-functional initiatives and collaboration to strengthen information sharing and success for the whole of Enterprise.

Make an Impact by

  • Collaborate in strategic business planning and budgeting exercises for SEG. Contribute to syndication exercises with key product houses on a regular monthly cadence, as well as the annual AOP cycle.
  • Drive productive business targeting and administer seamless business operations for business through intelligence and insights from management reports, analysis, and data mining.
  • Develop and prepare a forecasting model for regular business monitoring, including relevant sensitivity analysis and scenario planning. Ensure effectiveness and internal control of business unit operations by streamlining processes where necessary.
  • Oversee essential projects as needed and conduct regular cadence reviews, such as funnel management, to ensure visibility of the business. Plan and coordinate interlocks with other business units to promote collaboration
  • Drive timely and accurate management reporting for key business decisions – Growth/BAU Business Forecast and Business Planning Review’s and management dashboards and drivers.
  • Ensure monthly month-end closing procedures are executed to ensure proper book closure.
  • Stay informed of key trends affecting the business, including new developments in the enterprises and government sectors, progress of commercial enterprises, and market environment changes specific to certain vertical industries.
  • Drive the adoption of AI and digital tools to transform and optimize Finance operations and processes

Skills for Success

  • University degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Business, Accountancy, Finance or related discipline
  • At least 3-5 years of experience in Business Planning / Analyst / Sales Operations
  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly in Excel and PowerPoint. Capable of managing and analyzing large volumes of data. Familiarity or experience with PowerBI and Salesforce is preferred.
  • Experience in budgeting and driving accurate management reporting and analysis for key business decisions
  • Demands extensive strong cross-functional collaboration, good communication skills, and a process-focused aptitude that will enable this role to effectively execute multiple responsibilities and deliverables.
  • Strong business acumen with customer-oriented personal, independent and a good team player
  • Meticulous and responsible with sharp analytical, organizational, and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to work well under stressful situations with tight timelines.

Rewards that Go Beyond

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Full suite of health and wellness benefits
  • Ongoing training and development programs
  • Internal mobility opportunities

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!

job.title: Credit Management Executive
job.description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee end-to-end insolvency and debt recovery processes.
  • Coordinate with debt collection agencies, liquidators, official assignees, and other external parties on delinquent accounts.
  • Perform write-off processing, payment allocation, and account reconciliation activities.
  • Handle internal and external enquiries professionally and ensure timely issue resolution.
  • Work closely with IT teams and business stakeholders to investigate and resolve system defects.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support automation initiatives such as RPA and workflow enhancements.
  • Prepare reports, documentation, and operational statistics to support business decisions.
  • Participate in cross-functional projects aimed at improving operational efficiency and customer outcomes.
  • Ensure compliance with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and data protection standards.

What we're looking for

Qualifications

  • Degree in Business, Accountancy, Finance, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in Credit Management, Debt Collection, Debt Recovery, Accounts Receivable, or related finance operations.
  • Fresh graduates with strong analytical skills and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience in Telecommunications, Banking, Financial Services, or Shared Services environments will be advantageous.

Technical Skills

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, functions, Pivot Tables, and data analysis.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Experience working with CRM or finance systems.
  • Exposure to debt recovery, insolvency management, liquidation, proof of debt processes, or collection agencies is an advantage.

Soft Skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Proactive mindset with a continuous improvement approach.

What you'll gain

  • Exposure to regional finance operations within a leading telecommunications group.
  • Opportunities to participate in automation and transformation initiatives.
  • A collaborative and supportive work environment.
  • Career growth opportunities within Singtel's global organization.
