job.title: Director, Application Delivery
job.description:
Summary

The Director, Application Delivery is accountable for the strategy, architecture, roadmap, delivery,modernization, and operational performance of technology platforms that enable customer care operations in Singtel.

The role leads the evolution of customer service systems spanning assisted and digital channels, including contact centre platforms, case management, knowledge management, workforce enablement,conversational AI and integration with billing, order management, network, and digital platforms.

The Director will work closely with Customer Experience, Service Delivery & Ops, Product Development,Technology, Data & AI and business unit leaders to modernize and simplify the customer care ecosystems,technology landscape, improve service outcomes, increase automation and agent productivity and reduce

cost-to-serve.

The Director will oversee solution performance and service continuity across multiple call centre sites.Ensure systems are stable, responsive and aligned with business needs.

There are 4 key portfolio for this role:

a) Contact Center Platform

b) Fulfilment Systems

c) Order Assurance (Fallout Orders Management)

d) L1 support for Consumer IT

The Director, Application Delivery displays a forward-looking perspective, inspirational and decisive in envisioning the future of Care Platforms powered by Digital and AI in Singtel. He/She is an influential leader who is able to communicate his ideas persuasively and engage with team members and other stakeholders.

How You will Make An Impact:

Care and Fulfilment Platform - Technology Strategy & Transformation

  • Define and own the multi-year Care Systems strategy and roadmap, aligned with customer experience, digital transformation, and technology objectives.
  • Modernize legacy care platforms toward scalable, cloud-based, API-driven and AI-enabled architectures.
  • Establish the target architecture for omnichannel customer care across voice, messaging, chat,social, retail and digital channels.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify the application landscape, retire legacy systems, and reduce technology complexity and operating cost.
  • Translate emerging technologies—including generative AI, conversational AI and intelligent automation—into practical customer care capabilities

AI, Automation & Digital Care

  • Lead adoption of AI-enabled customer care, including agent assist, automated summarization, intelligent routing, next-best-action, knowledge retrieval and autonomous service journeys.
  • Expand customer self-service and straight-through processing while maintaining appropriate controls and escalation paths.
  • Partner with Data & AI teams to develop reusable customer intelligence and decisioning capabilities.
  • Establish gatekeeper for responsible and secure use of AI in customer interactions.

Architecture & Engineering Leadership

  • Establish architecture, engineering and platform standards for Care and Fulfilment systems.
  • Ensure systems are resilient, scalable, secure, observable and designed for high-volume telecommunications environments.
  • Drive API-first integration and reusable service capabilities across customer-facing platforms.
  • Balance modernization with the stability and availability requirements of mission-critical customer care services.
  • Ensure appropriate disaster recovery, business continuity and operational resilience.

Delivery & Portfolio Management

  • Own the Care and Fulfilment System; technology portfolio, investment roadmap and delivery priorities.
  • Identify opportunities to expand service capabilities and drive account growth through strategic planning and continuous improvement.
  • Lead large-scale transformation programs involving multiple business units, technology teams, systems integrators and software vendors.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery, ensuring all contractual commitments and project deliverables are achieved in alignment with business objectives.
  • Champion customer experience by adopting industry best practices and delivering high-quality, reliable services.
  • Ensure programs deliver against agreed scope, schedule, quality and financial objectives.
  • Oversee vendor solution delivery, ensuring proposed solutions align with business needs and service expectations.
  • Continuously enhance service offerings to maximize customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business value.
  • Establish measurable business cases and track benefits realization.

Operational Excellence

  • Accountable for the availability, performance and service quality of critical care platforms.
  • Establish and monitor service-level objectives and operational KPIs.
  • Drive reduction in incidents, technical debt and recurring operational issues.
  • Manage service recovery activities and escalations, driving timely resolution and implementing preventive improvements.
  • Analyse service trends and operational metrics to proactively identify improvement opportunities and strengthen platform reliability.
  • Ensure compliance with ITIL service management processes, governance standards, and operational controls
  • Improve release management, automation, observability and DevSecOps practices.
  • Act as the senior escalation point for major incidents, ensuring rapid recovery within agreed SLAs while minimizing business impact.
  • Partner with Customer Operations to rapidly identify and resolve technology-related drivers of customer contacts.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

  • Build trusted relationships with Business, Product, Operations, Architecture, Infrastructure, and executive stakeholders.
  • Provide concise executive updates on programme status, service health, major incidents, risks, and mitigation plans to senior leadership, including VP and CIO levels.
  • Lead governance forums, steering committees, and service review meetings to ensure alignment across all stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor performance, commercial engagements, and third-party partnerships to deliver agreed service levels and continuous value
  • Manage strategic relationships with major technology vendors, cloud providers and systems integrators.
  • Lead technology evaluation, vendor selection and commercial negotiations in partnership with Procurement.
  • Ensure vendor roadmaps and contractual commitments support the company's target architecture and strategic priorities.
  • Drive vendor performance, cost optimization and accountability for delivery outcomes.

Leadership, People Development and Management

  • Hire, lead, mentor and grow a team of architecture, solution design, engineering and operations
  • expertise that possesses business relevancy across Singtel & vendors, both offshore & onshore.
  • Build strong technical leadership and succession pipelines.
  • Foster a culture of customer obsession, engineering excellence, ownership, collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Influence senior executives and align stakeholders across business and technology organizations.
  • Promote continuous learning, engineering excellence, and customer-first delivery across the organisation.

Financial Management

  • Budgeting, tracking and forecasting capital & operational expenditure

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline (preferred).
  • Minimum 15 years experience in the ICT industry, with at least 10 years managing systems; call center platforms (_must have_), CRM, BSS or OSS (_good to have_).
  • People Leadership: Minimum 10 years experience in leading a large scale team responsible for Call Center Platform.
  • Technology leadership: Understands modern architecture, engineering, cloud and AI sufficiently deeply to challenge and guide technical teams.
  • Talent leadership: Builds high-performing teams and develops future technology leaders.
  • Strategic Vision: Ability to align technology initiatives with business goals, ensuring long-term sustainability and relevance in a rapidly evolving market.
  • Customer orientation: Connects technology decisions directly to customer experience and
  • operational outcomes.
  • Complex Project Delivery: Demonstrated ability to lead large-scale, end-to-end implementation projects involving both legacy and modern platfom.
  • Execution discipline: Converts strategy into measurable delivery outcomes and operations resiliency and stability.
  • IT Services Contract Expertise: Deep understanding of IT services contracts and complex implementation projects in both legacy and cloud-managed service environments.
  • Stakeholder Management: Strong track record of engaging with internal and external stakeholders, including vendors and cross-functional teams.
  • Continuous Improvement: Commitment to adopting industry best practices and driving excellence through innovation and process optimization.
  • Strategic thinker who is creative in the design of technology strategy and who has a track record of building scalable and operationally sound Core Telco systems and growing operations teams
  • Deep understanding of Core Telco space with demonstrated success in defining and leading end to end digital telco implementations starting from concept, ideation, design, implementation, delivery to value realization for the business.
  • Expert commercial understanding, analytical, judgment and decision-making skills, along with problem-solving/conflict management skills and ability to filter and prioritize information.
  • Precise, clear and assertive communicator with strong negotiation skills with ability to liaise with stakeholders across the business and partners to facilitate delivery in an agile methodology.
  • Ability to explain technical information in business terms
  • Exceptional leadership skills. Ability to collaborate effectively and work closely with various functions internally and externally.
  • Ability to manage both direct reports and virtual teams to deliver the end results.
  • Highly organized, self-motivated, pro-active, and ability to manage time and projects
  • Result oriented mindset. Possesses passion to innovate, Able to plan and manage program budgets. Strong stakeholder, team and vendor management skills
  • Courageously drives change to achieve entrepreneurial goals

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Senior Database Services Engineer
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

  • The candidate should possess good knowledge and experience with Oracle database from 11g and above .
  • Candidate is responsible for the day-to-day operational aspects of database administration to meet the business needs and service level for database in on Prem & cloud/Azure covering ORACLE (11g,12c,19c +..) including RAC & Non RAC plus plus another db flavour MSSQL/SQLMI/MYSQL/POSTGRES/Mongo including cluster.
  • Knowledge and experience with Oracle Multitenant (CDB/PDB).
  • Manage and troubleshoot the L2 tasks independently
  • Provide 2nd level operational database support on functions associated with maintenance of Oracle Server databases plus MSSQL/SQLMI/MYSQL/POSTGRES/Mongo cluster/standalone onprem/cloud including administration, performance, security &hardening, back-up,dataguard configuration and maintenance, reporting, and recovery procedures
  • Assist and respond promptly to incident, investigate & provide permanent resolution of incidents escalated.
  • Manage database changes through change request process & provide status reports to the relevant parties.
  • Monitor & measure the performance & availability of databases proactively; implement corrective actions identified to improve.
  • Perform regular security patching for the DBs including RAC/Cluster db.
  • Handle service continuity measures, i.e., backup/restore procedures & disaster recovery plan, to ensure continuous operation of the business.
  • Good experience with RMAN backup configuration, troubleshooting backup issues.
  • Good experience in manage with encryption and wallet management.
  • Knowledge with AD integration.
  • Diagnosis knowledge based on alert, cluster listener logs to check for the db core issues.
  • Performance tuning core db &application sql plan, good knowledge in ready AWR &scripting knowledge
  • Manage / maintain &optimise oracle DB space including tablespaces, ASM &database FS, Periodic rebuild to defragment /Space management.
  • Manage DB access. Create, Change, delete users accounts as per request following security guidelines.
  • Good experience in managing oracle data guard and ensure DG/DR in synch all times and manage DR activities with Switchover/failover.Monitor and maintain database backups.
  • Create and maintain database related documents including asset, SOP etc.
  • Review & perform application and core db deployments.
  • Audit related hardening & Support.
  • Prompt 24x7 support.
  • Accommodative for Shift/Roster call out.

Skills for Success:

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Oracle Professional Certification
  • Added advantage if have additional certification like MS SQL /MYSQL/EDB /POSTGRES/MONGO Professional Certification
  • Minimum 3 year of experience in Oracle(Standalone +RAC/Cluster)
  • Plus work experience on MS SQL /MYSQL/EDB/Postgres/MongoDB
  • Extensive experience in managing common Database platform like Oracle, and to have another db flavour PostgreSQL/MSSQL/MYSQL/MONGO/POSTGRES Including Cluster architecture
  • Experience in performing database Patching, backup & recovery as well as excellent troubleshooting and performance tuning skill is a must.(Including cluster architecture)
  • Implement Database hardening as per CIS Benchmarks.
  • Implement and manage DR,Audit, Backup & Monitoring of DBs.
  • Strong analytical skills for problem-solving database-related issues.
  • Big picture thinking - the ability to see how parts interact with the whole
  • Good knowledge of IT governance and operations
  • Ability to influence an outcome without creating conflict
  • Customer service orientation

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Enterprise AI #AIDA
job.description:
Powering the Future with AIDA

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core—augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Senior Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will play a critical role in designing and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions that drive intelligent decision-making across Singtel’s business domains.

This role goes beyond traditional analytics to focus on high-impact AI use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and predictive intelligence across network, customer, and operational environments.

You will develop and operationalize advanced AI/ML models and simulation frameworks to:

  • Optimize pricing strategies and revenue outcomes
  • Detect anomalies and risks in real time across large-scale data systems
  • Enable proactive, automated decisioning across enterprise workflows

You will work closely with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g. Network, Finance, Enterprise Business, Product, and Operations) to translate complex business challenges into scalable AI solutions, leveraging advanced machine learning, optimization techniques, and Generative AI where applicable.

Make an impact by:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives:Drive end-to-end AI programs focused on enterprise use cases, including pricing optimization, anomaly detection, and forecasting. Partner with business and technical stakeholders to define problem statements and architect scalable AI-driven solutions aligned with strategic priorities.
  • AI Solution Development & Integration: Build and productionize scalable AI pipelines and decision systems, integrating models into enterprise platforms and workflows. Ensure robustness in model governance, explainability, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Cross-Domain Data & Insight Generation: Leverage diverse datasets (network, customer, financial, operational) to uncover insights and enable:
  • Root cause analysis via anomaly detection
  • Scenario testing via digital twins
  • Optimization of business levers such as pricing, capacity, and resource allocation
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Telecom or Insurance industries Sales / Marketing analytics experience will be an advantage.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:

a) Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.

b) LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring

c) Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).

d) Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.
  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.
  • Experience in mentoring junior team members through collaborative problem solving, pair programming, and constructive code reviews.

  • Calm Under Pressure: You stay composed during reactive or complex situations, modelling effective de‑escalation and helping your peers to manage challenges with care.
  • Operational & Business Awareness: You have a strong grasp of retail operations, know what drives performance, and showcase balanced step up to leadership with store efficiencies.
  • Team Culture & Adaptability: You support to build an inclusive team environment and stay flexible and solutions focused when priorities shift or customer needs change.

What’s in it for you?

Not sure you meet every requirement? Don’t let that hold you back. We value potential just as much as experience, and this role might be exactly where your next chapter begins.

At Optus, we are strengthened by others and that means valuing diversity and saying ‘yes’ to embracing individual differences. We are committed to ensuring that our application process provides an equal employment opportunity to all job seekers, including individuals from diverse gender, cultural and linguistic backgrounds, individuals with a disability, individuals identifying as being part of the LGBTQIA+ community, individuals who may have served in the armed forces or who identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander. We also want to do our best to make our recruitment process inclusive. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support to participate fairly and equitably in the recruitment process, please email [AccessibleRecruitment@optus.com.au](mailto:accessiblerecruitment@optus.com.au) or call 1800 309 170.

job.title: #EG Project Management Roles
job.description:
Overview

As anInfrastructure Project Manageryou will be responsible for the managing and implementing of Infrastructure-based projects with quality, within scope and to ensure deliverables are on time and conform to processes and standards meeting customer’s requirements.The Infrastructure Project Manager is also responsible for the following scope in addition to project administration, resource scheduling, project financial health monitoring, risk/issue management and quality assurance.

The broad area of your job responsibilities should cover the following:

What will you do?

Project & Service Management

  • Lead, deliver and maintain projects within time, scope, and cost
  • Ensure project delivery quality
  • Plan & establish project schedules, quality plans, budgets, and communication and risk management plans
  • Manage issues arising out of scope definition and disputes that impacted scope, schedule, and cost
  • Manage issues arising from integration of various components of the project, e.g. hardware, software installation, testing, business process review, redesign, application development, migration and data conversion etc
  • Manage project financials, ensuring project cost/ revenue forecast is done accurately
  • Oversee the implementation of the project with regards to schedules, budget, manpower and quality
  • Resolve project overrun issues
  • Track project progress and report to Senior Management and Customer
  • Manage resources in terms of mobilising resources during different periods of time from team to team to maximise productivity or minimise wastage
  • Lead the project and service team on smooth project transition to operation in accordance to customer requirement and processes.
  • Manage project operation and ensure service level is maintained without financial penalty and security incident due to negligent or lack of awareness

Customer/Vendor/ Stakeholder Management

  • Manage contracts and subcontractors
  • Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
  • Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
  • Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
  • Strong customer-service orientation
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (IT operations, engineers, vendors) to ensure project success.
  • Scope and Risk Management: Oversee project scope, budget, and risk, ensuring alignment with network objectives.
  • Experience in managing government-approved vendors and contractors.
  • Understanding of procurement processes and contract management within the public sector.

Team Management

  • Work cohesively, lead, guide, manage and motivate the projects’ team members in delivering quality project works, eliminating project exceptions, and delighting the customers
  • Plan for optimal use of resources across teams comprising of Project and Technical competencies
  • Manage performance review of team and maintain open communication with team for feedback on continuous improvement
  • Ensure high individual and staff billability

Technical Skillsets:

  • Network and Server Infrastructure:Proficiency in designing, implementing, and managing network infrastructure components such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, servers, storage, middleware and VPNs.
  • Cloud Technologies:Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and their infrastructure services.
  • Virtualization:Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware, Hyper-V, KVM) for server consolidation and resource optimization.
  • Storage Solutions:Understanding of storage technologies (SAN, NAS, DAS) and data management.
  • Security:Awareness of security best practices, including access controls, encryption, and vulnerability management.
  • Project Management Tools:Proficiency in using project management software (e.g., Microsoft Project, Jira) for planning, tracking, and reporting.
  • Change Management:Knowledge of change control processes and tools to manage modifications to infrastructure.
  • ITIL Framework:Familiarity with ITIL principles for service management.
  • Scripting and Automation:Basic scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Python) to automate repetitive tasks.
  • Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity:Understanding of DR/BC planning and implementation.

The ideal candidate should possess:

  • Project Management Experience:The candidate should have experience managing public sector projects in Singapore and possess a valid active project management certificate (e.g. PMP, CITPM).
  • Understanding of IT Infrastructure:Familiarity with IT infrastructure components such as WAN, LAN, Internet, Voice, Video services, and structured cabling.
  • Teamwork and Leadership:Strong teamwork, leadership, issue resolution, and negotiation skills.
  • Communication Skills:Excellent communication skills, especially when working across remote teams.
  • Adaptability:Ability to thrive under pressure, handle multiple projects, and adapt to a dynamic environment.
  • Quick Learner:Proven ability to think critically and quickly learn new technologies.
  • Familiar with government regulations, security standards, and compliance requirements specific to Singapore.
  • Knowledge of data protection laws (such as the Personal Data Protection Act) and cybersecurity guidelines.

We are driven by ourAEIOU beliefs—Adventure, Excellence, Integrity, Ownership, and Unity—and we seek individuals who embody these values in both their professional and personal lives. We arecommitted to our Impact: Valuing our clients, Growing our people, and Creating our future.

Together, we_make the extraordinary happen__._

Learn more about us at ncs.co and visit our LinkedIn career site.

job.title: Senior Data Scientist, Marketing AI #AIDA
job.description:
Powering the Future with AIDA

To lead the next phase of our AI evolution, we’ve launched a new business unit AIDA – Artificial Intelligence & Data Analytics – a strategic engine driving our transformation designed to scale our AI ambitions with precision and purpose. This marks a pivotal shift in how we operate, innovate, and serve to embed intelligence into every layer of our business.

At Singtel, this is more than a technology upgrade. It’s a strategic transformation that redefines how value is created across the enterprise core—augmenting human capabilities and unlocking entirely new potential. It is a transformation journey by aligning people, platforms, and processes under one cohesive strategy. Our mission is to build AI literacy and foster a culture where intelligence empowers people.

We welcome you to join us on a transformational journey that’s reshaping the telecommunications industry — and redefining what’s possible with AI at its core. Grow with us in a workplace that champions innovation, embraces agility, and puts human potential at the heart of everything we do.

Be a Part of Something BIG!

As a Senior Data Scientist within the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) business unit, you will assume a key role in driving insights discovery and AI/ML model development to predict and respond to market changes and their impact on Singtel’s business. Your work will influence critical decisions across the organization—enabling data-driven strategies that uncover new customer insights, optimize operations, and unlock new revenue streams.

In this role, you will play a leading part in advancing AI initiatives, where AI is used to personalize and scale telco product and service offerings. You will develop predictive models for customer eligibility, churn/purchase propensity, and cross-sell optimization. This includes close collaboration with internal stakeholders and external partners to co-create data-driven AI/ML solutions.

Make an impact by:

  • Lead Data Science Initiatives: Drive AI/ML initiatives supporting Singtel’s product and service offerings by working closely with stakeholders from Marketing, Product, and external partners. Define problem statements and architect end-to-end solutions—including the use of Generative AI and LLMs where applicable—to align with strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and partner needs.
  • Model Development & Integration: Design, build, and productionize analytical models that enable intelligent decisioning within customer journeys. Integrate these models into customer-centric decision engines while championing best practices around model governance, scalability, explainability, and continuous performance monitoring.
  • Customer Behavior & Lifecycle Analysis: Leverage customer behavioral data across Singtel’s Mobile, Broadband, and entertainment services to uncover actionable insights. Maintain and enhance analytical models that inform segmentation, product targeting, and value-based engagement strategies. Enable data exploration, insight discovery, and controlled experimentation (e.g., A/B testing, uplift modeling) to support lifecycle marketing and campaign optimization.
  • Data Exploration & Experimentation: Enable robust data exploration, insight discovery, and experimentation for lifecycle marketing campaigns. Devise and execute rigorous A/B tests, segmentations, and optimization strategies to continuously improve business outcomes.
  • Technical Mentorship & Code Quality: Provide guidance to junior data scientists and collaborate on code reviews to ensure adherence to best practices, maintain high code quality, and promote knowledge sharing within the team.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate complex analytical findings and recommendations to diverse audiences—ranging from technical teams to senior leadership—in a clear, concise, and compelling manner.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor or Postgraduate degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, or a related field, with at least 3 years of relevant working experience.
  • Telecom or Insurance industries Sales / Marketing analytics experience will be an advantage.
  • Deep technical and data science expertise, demonstrating proficiency in:

a) Machine Learning & Statistical Modelling: Including linear regression, GLMs, time series forecasting, supervised learning (e.g., gradient boosted trees, neural networks), segmentation, clustering, design of experiments, and causal inference.

b) LLMs & Generative AI: Fine-tuning and evaluation of large language models (e.g., GPT, LLaMA), prompt engineering, red-teaming, and performance monitoring

c) Efficient data manipulation (with skills in SQL, Python, Spark, Hadoop/Hive, and Databricks) and data visualization (using tools like Power BI).

d) Familiar with software engineering best practices, including modular code design, reproducibility, and testing. Proficient with version control tools such as GitHub, GitLab, and Bitbucket

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (e.g., Azure AWS, GCP) and ML lifecycle tools (e.g., MLflow, Airflow)
  • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and solve complex business problems through data analysis.
  • A team player with a customer-focused mindset, able to work well in a team and passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences.
  • Excellent data visualization and communication skills, with the ability to present insights and findings in a clear, concise, and compelling manner, both in written and verbal form.
  • Experience in mentoring junior team members through collaborative problem solving, pair programming, and constructive code reviews.

Threat Monitoring

Access Management

Explore exciting career opportunities with NCS and kick-start your journey towards success. Visit our website at ncs.co/opportunities and check out our LinkedIn Career site to discover how you can be part of the extraordinary today. Join our team and experience #ncslife today!

We treat all applications with the utmost confidentiality. While we appreciate the interest in this role, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted given the high volume of applicants.

_Scam Alert_

We are aware of fraudulent job offers and impersonations of NCS recruiters. Phishing emails using convincing-looking but fake addresses are also commonly used to trick you into thinking that they come from official NCS sources.

Please note that all official communications from NCS Group will only be sent from verified corporate email addresses. Always check that the sender’s email address ends with the genuine NCS domain, @ncs.com.sg and beware of extra letters, symbols or misspellings. job.title: WIFI Engineer (Tier 2)
job.description:
Company: Singtel Group

![](<Base64-Image-Removed>)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. The WIFI Tier 2 Engineer plays a hybrid role within the Managed WIFI team, supporting both Day 1 provisioning activities and ongoing WIFI Day 2 operations.

This role is responsible for configuring and activating customer WIFI services, performing detailed diagnostics, and assisting in maintaining a secure, scalable, and high-performing centralized WIFI platform.

The engineer will work closely with delivery teams during service onboarding and provide technical support to the WIFI Operations team for escalations, platform optimization, and process improvement.

The engineer participates in a 24x7 standby rotation and contributes to service improvements through RCA.

Make an impact by:

  • Perform end-to-end configuration and provisioning of WIFI infrastructure components including access points, wireless controllers, SSIDs, VLANs, and policy enforcement rules via centralized platforms
  • Participate in 24x7 standby rotation support.
  • Integrate WIFI services with enterprise systems such as RADIUS, DHCP, DNS, and authentication gateways.
  • Execute technical onboarding procedures, including zero-touch provisioning (ZTP), AP registration, firmware validation, and template-based configuration deployment.
  • Conduct pre-deployment readiness checks, post-deployment verification (connectivity, roaming, signal quality), and validate compliance with design specifications.
  • Document configurations, implementation steps, and test results to support knowledge transfer and future troubleshooting.
  • Serve as Tier 2 escalation for complex wireless issues.
  • Assist WIFI Operations with Tier 2 escalations, platform diagnostics, log analysis and RCA when required.
  • Participate in platform monitoring, firmware reviews, and security patching tasks.
  • Contribute to documentation of configurations, playbooks, and knowledge articles.
  • Test new features, templates, or processes prior to implementation.

Skills for success:

  • Degree in Information Technology/Computer Science
  • 5+ years of relevant experience in WIFI environment, preferably in a managed services or enterprise IT environment
  • Strong understanding of wireless networking standards, RF theory, and LAN/WAN integration.
  • Experience with enterprise or cloud-based WiFi platforms (Meraki, Aruba, Ruckus, Cisco).
  • Knowledge of authentication systems and network security protocols.
  • Industry certifications preferred (e.g., CWNA, CWNP, Cisco Wireless, Aruba ACMA).
  • Good to have experience with provisioning tools, scripting, or automation is a plus.
  • Good to have experience with Huawei & POL

job.title: Software Engineer
job.description:
Be a part of something BIG!

We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-driven Software Engineer (OutSystems) to be responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, support, and maintenance of enterprise applications using the OutSystems platform. The role works closely with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate business requirements into effective technical solutions, provide BAU application support, and deliver Change Requests and Projects.

The role also play an important role in ensuring application quality, stability, performance, and maintainability, while providing technical guidance and coordinating development and testing activities where required.

Make an Impact by:

  • Analyze functional and module specifications and translate business requirements into application and technical designs using established methodologies and guidelines
  • Design, develop, enhance, and maintain applications using the OutSystems platform, covering both front-end and back-end development
  • Work closely with developers and other technical team members to coordinate development activities, track progress, and ensure timely and quality delivery
  • Provide BAU application support, including investigation, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, defect resolution, and production support
  • Support the delivery of Change Requests (CRs) and Projects throughout the development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and development through testing, implementation, and post-production support
  • Manage and support end-to-end testing and implementation activities, including unit testing, SIT, UAT, and integration testing, ensuring test results are documented, defects are tracked and resolved, and solutions are successfully deployed to production
  • Investigate production incidents, application errors, and performance issues and implement appropriate fixes and preventive measures
  • Develop and maintain integrations with internal and external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and other integration technologies
  • Support application deployment, troubleshooting, and hotfix activities using OutSystems Service Center
  • Develop and maintain integrations and extensions using OutSystems Integration Studio where required
  • Evaluate and appropriately use or adapt OutSystems Forge components in accordance with application and security requirements
  • Prepare, review, and maintain technical documentation, application flow diagrams, system documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand business needs and recommend appropriate technical solutions

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or an equivalent discipline
  • At least 5 years of hands-on OutSystems development experience, preferably covering OutSystems 10/11 and Traditional and/or Reactive Web applications
  • Strong hands-on experience in OutSystems 10/11, including Traditional Web and/or Reactive Web application development
  • Strong knowledge of both front-end and back-end OutSystems development

  • Good understanding of software development lifecycles, testing practices, and Agile development methodologies
  • Experience supporting BAU operations, Change Requests, and Projects in an enterprise application environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills with the ability to work effectively within a geographically distributed team

  • Sharp thinking. You break down ambiguous problems and form clear, structured approaches

  • Bias for action. You move fast, test, learn, and adapt

You don’t need prior robotics experience but you do need to learn fast and think independently.

This is an opportunity to build, not inherit… and to be part of a small group shaping what comes next.

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

job.title: Problem Management Engineer
job.description:
Company:Singtel Group

We are looking for a Problem Management Engineer to drive proactive problem management by identifying root causes, reducing recurring incidents, and improving service stability across our network and technology environment. In this role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate complex technical issues, implement long-term solutions, and continuously enhance operational performance through data-driven insights and process improvements.

Make an Impact by:

1. Problem Management & Root Cause Analysis

  • Detect, log, and manage problems by analysing recurring and major incidents.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) using structured methodologies such as 5 Whys, Fishbone Diagram, and Kepner-Tregoe.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to investigate complex technical issues and identify effective resolutions.
  • Recommend and drive the implementation of workarounds and permanent solutions to improve service stability.
  • Lead critical problem investigations and support audit activities when required.

2. Service Improvement & Knowledge Management

  • Conduct trend analysis to identify recurring issues and proactively prevent future incidents.
  • Maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB) and develop knowledge articles to support operational teams.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to optimise processes and implement automation.
  • Track, analyse, and report Problem Management KPIs and operational metrics to support data-driven decision-making.

3. Stakeholder Collaboration & Operational Excellence

  • Work closely with Network Operations, Engineering, Service Management, and other cross-functional teams to coordinate problem resolution activities.
  • Present findings, root cause analyses, and improvement recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Support the adoption of Problem Management best practices across the organisation.
  • For Team Lead roles: Mentor and guide Problem Engineers while serving as the primary escalation point for the Problem Management team.

Skills for Success

  • Diploma or Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Telecommunications, or a related discipline.
  • Up to 3 years of experience in Problem Management, Network Operations, IT Operations, or a related role within a telecommunications or enterprise IT environment.
  • Candidates with strong technical expertise and a demonstrated ability to develop Problem Management capabilities are also encouraged to apply.
  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN/WAN, Routing & Switching, TCP/IP, and Network Security.
  • Exposure to enterprise and telecommunications technologies such as MPLS IPVPN, Cloud Connect, BGP, OSPF, and related networking protocols.
  • Experience working with networking technologies from vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet, or equivalent.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex technical and operational issues.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.

It'll be great if you also have:

  • Professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, JNCIA, or equivalent networking certifications.
  • ITIL v3/v4 Foundation certification or higher.
  • Knowledge of Problem Management methodologies or certifications such as Lean Six Sigma or Kepner-Tregoe.
  • Experience with IT Service Management (ITSM) platforms such as ServiceNow or BMC Remedy.
  • Exposure to SD-WAN technologies such as Cisco SD-WAN, Silver Peak, VMware VeloCloud, or Fortinet Secure SD-WAN.
  • Experience using reporting and data visualisation tools such as Microsoft Excel, Power BI, or Tableau to analyse operational trends and performance metrics.

job.title: Lead, Compute Infra Services
job.description:
Be a part of something BIG!

Say HELLO to BIG Possibilities with Singtel KL (Sudong MY Sdn Bhd)!

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, with operations across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We are driving digital transformation, innovation, and next-generation technology to create a more connected and sustainable future.

As part of our growing Kuala Lumpur Shared Services Centre, we are looking for a Lead, Compute Infra Services to provide both technical and people leadership across our Compute Infrastructure organization.

This is a technical leadership role responsible for leading the OS Platform Services tower, encompassing Windows and Linux platforms, while also serving as the People & Site Leader for all TI Compute Infra Services employees based in Kuala Lumpur. Reporting to the Director, Compute Infra Services, you will drive platform excellence, strengthen leadership presence in KL, and foster a collaborative, high-performing culture across the organization.

Make an Impact by:

OS Platform Services Leadership

  • Lead and manage a high-performing 24x7 OS Platform Services team responsible for supporting mission-critical and business-critical applications across Windows, Unix, and Linux environments.
  • Own end-to-end service delivery, platform availability, operational excellence, service reliability, and customer satisfaction for enterprise operating system platforms.
  • Establish and drive operational governance, service management best practices, and continuous service improvement initiatives to achieve high availability, strong service performance, and operational resilience.
  • Lead major incident response, service recovery, escalation management, root cause analysis, and problem management activities to minimize business impact and prevent recurrence.
  • Drive OS platform engineering, including evaluation, testing, certification, and deployment of operating system releases, patches, and platform standards to ensure secure, stable, and supportable environments.
  • Own platform lifecycle management, vulnerability remediation, patch compliance, and security hardening initiatives to meet cybersecurity, audit, and regulatory requirements.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and Infrastructure-as-Code practices to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance service consistency.
  • Build and develop technical capabilities within the team through coaching, mentoring, workforce planning, succession management, and continuous skills development.
  • Partner closely with infrastructure towers, application teams, cybersecurity teams, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, scalable, and integrated infrastructure services that support business objectives.

People & Site Leadership (KL)

  • Serve as the leadership representative and visible leadership presence for Compute Infra Services in Kuala Lumpur.
  • Act as the People & Site Leader for all KL-based Compute Infrastructure employees.
  • Drive employee engagement, talent development, and workforce planning initiatives.
  • Conduct regular employee engagement and skip-level sessions to understand workforce sentiment and support team development.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and high-performing culture across Compute Infra teams.
  • Coordinate local leadership activities, town halls, employee communications, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Facilitate strong partnership and alignment between Singapore and Kuala Lumpur teams.

Governance & Transformation

  • Promote engineering excellence, organizational values, and leadership behaviours.
  • Support infrastructure modernization, automation, and transformation initiatives.
  • Ensure adherence to security, audit, risk, and governance requirements.
  • Provide leadership insights and workforce updates to senior management on people, operational, and site matters.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 12 years of experience in Infrastructure Engineering, Platform Engineering, or IT Infrastructure Operations within large enterprise environments.
  • At least 5 years of proven technical leadership experience leading large-scale enterprise infrastructure teams, with responsibility for people management, operational governance, service delivery, and workforce development in a 24x7 multi-site environment.
  • Strong operational excellence mindset with demonstrated success managing large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure services in a 24x7 operational environment, with a focus on service reliability, availability, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Strong technical expertise in Unix/Linux platforms (preferably RHEL), with hands-on experience in operating system engineering, platform lifecycle management, security hardening, patching, automation, and operational support.
  • Strong engineering mindset with experience driving platform standardization, automation, infrastructure modernization, and adoption of engineering best practices to improve operational efficiency and service quality.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead major incidents, crisis management, service recovery, and problem management activities within complex enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading geographically distributed or multi-location teams.
  • Proven track record driving infrastructure transformation, automation, and service modernization initiatives.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across infrastructure towers, application teams, cybersecurity teams, vendors, and senior leadership.
  • Excellent leadership, communication, analytical, and decision-making skills, with the ability to balance operational stability, technology transformation, and people leadership priorities.

Good to Have:

  • RHCE, Microsoft Certified, VMware VCP, Red Hat OpenShift, ITIL, or equivalent industry certifications.
  • Experience with virtualization technologies such as VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or Nutanix.
  • Knowledge of container platforms including OpenShift and Kubernetes.
  • Exposure to Public Cloud, Storage, and Backup technologies.
  • Experience with enterprise observability, monitoring, and performance management tools.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, vulnerability management, and compliance standards.

Why Join Us?

  • Lead a critical enterprise infrastructure tower supporting mission-critical services across the Singtel Group.
  • Play a key leadership role in shaping and growing Singtel's Kuala Lumpur technology hub.
  • Drive large-scale infrastructure modernization, automation, and transformation initiatives.
  • Influence both technology strategy and organizational culture through your dual role as Technical Leader and KL Site Leader.
  • Work with highly skilled teams across Singapore and Kuala Lumpur in a collaborative, innovative, and fast-paced environment.

Your Career Growth Starts Here. Apply Now!

job.title: Director, IT Service Delivery
job.description:
![Image 1](blob:http://localhost/c36a9c96962461ce8401974be8e62ca1)

_An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”._

Service Delivery

Service Delivery encompasses the end-to-end deliverables specified in the Service Contract provided by Singtel Group (or its subsidiaries). This includes service governance, client engagement with customers, and managing the expectations and outcomes for both external and internal senior stakeholders. Service Delivery also focuses on account growth and ensuring an excellent customer engagement experience.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for managing multiple account delivery teams in alignment with Singtel's commitments to various service contracts.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to develop strategic and tactical plans to ensure delivery meets contractual obligations to customers. Key responsibilities include (but are not limited to): -

  • Driving service delivery to meet and exceed contractual SLA commitments.
  • Sponsoring delivery teams in implementing digitalization initiatives to enhance efficiency and improve the service engagement experience.
  • Managing senior stakeholders (e.g. CxOs, VPs, and IT Heads) through effective communication and portfolio management during major incidents.
  • Building and strengthening client relationships through in-depth knowledge of customer domains.
  • Identifying opportunities and supporting the Sales Team in pursuing new business prospects to grow the EWO portfolio.

Operations

The Service Delivery Director is expected to lead both the Service and Technical delivery team in day-to-day operations matters, and ensure services are delivered with pride and sustainable model to meet our SLA deliverables. Operation delivery includes leading team on delivery excellence, and drive towards continuous service improvements, and to enhance the service values to the customer.

The Service Delivery Director is also expected to engage and manage 3rd party partners and vendors, to align their delivery competency and capabilities with Singtel service contract to our customers.

Financial Management

The Service Delivery Director is expected to manage the financials for the service portfolios under the purview, in accordance with the Business Case of the service contracts on Cost of Delivery, recovery of cost in respective cost centre in a healthy state.

Financial management responsibilities include but not limited to: -

  • Annual AOP budgeting, financial planning across the portfolio.
  • Manpower and resourcing budgeting
  • Operation run rate and forward planning
  • Monthly financial status tracking and progressive report
  • Operations and Financial optimization

People and Growth

The Service Delivery Director is expected to coach and mentor Associate Directors, Service Delivery Managers, and delivery teams, whether under direct or indirect management (e.g., third-party partners or contractors). This includes providing thought leadership and demonstrating strong people management skills for the various teams within the service portfolios.

The Service Delivery Director is responsible for developing a Portfolio Strategy and Tactical Performance Measurement for the teams under their supervision. They should adopt a top-down approach to KPI setting for the delivery teams within the portfolio.

Additionally, the Service Delivery Director should conduct routine communication sessions with members of the delivery teams and their direct reports to provide directives and guidance. This includes holding weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual meetings, as well as one-on-one sessions and performance assessments, as required.

Corporate Engagement

The Service Delivery Director would support Global Delivery 5 key initiatives within their portfolio: -

  • Customer First,
  • Quality First,
  • People First,
  • Digital First,
  • Security First,

The Service Delivery Director would support any other Singtel and/or SEB corporate program and events, as required.

The Service Delivery Director would support and promote collaboration within the delivery teams, Singtel and/or SEB organization.

Skills for Success:

  • ITIL Foundation
  • Min 8-10 years working in enterprise scale IT environment or 15 years in senior delivery role managing in Cross Domains (multiple technical domains) enterprise environment

Proficient in:

  • Service Delivery Management
  • Project Management
  • ITIL Foundation
  • Proficient in at least 2 or more technical workstreams (Network, System, DB, Storage, Hosting, Cloud, Workplace services, Telco services)
  • Executive Stakeholders Management
  • People management
  • Presentation skills
  • Project P&L & Portfolio Financial Management
  • Coaching / Mentorship skillsets

Singtel is Asia's leading communications technology group, our presence spans across 21 countries in Asia, Australia, and Africa. We thrive on innovation, digital transformation, and harnessing next-generation technology to create a more sustainable and digital future. Now, we are bringing this energy to Kuala Lumpur with the launch of our brand-new Shared Services Centre.

Make an impact by:

  • Based in Singtel GBS Kuala Lumpur, the Associate Director, People & Culture, Malaysia will partner closely with the GBS KL Site Lead as a strategic business partner and people leader responsible for shaping and driving the Human Capital Strategy and People Agenda to enable business growth, organisational effectiveness and long-term workforce sustainability.
  • As a key advisor to the Site Lead and senior business leadership, the role will translate business strategy into forward-looking people, workforce and organisational priorities, ensuring Singtel GBS KL has the leadership, capabilities, talent and culture required to deliver its strategic ambitions. The role will also partner closely with HR leadership and Centres of Excellence to influence and align enterprise HR strategies while ensuring they address the evolving needs and priorities of the Malaysian operations.
  • Leading the People & Culture team at the site level, the Associate Director will provide strategic leadership across workforce strategy and planning, organisation and capability development, leadership and talent, succession planning, employee experience, rewards, engagement and organisational transformation.
  • A key mandate of the role is to anticipate future workforce and capability requirements, identify emerging organisational and talent risks, and develop scalable and future-ready people strategies that support the continued growth and transformation of Singtel GBS KL. The role will champion a high-performance culture, strengthen leadership capability and accountability, enhance employee engagement and retention, and build greater organisational agility.
  • The Associate Director will also play a critical role in challenging existing practices and shaping new ways of working, leveraging workforce insights, market trends and people analytics to influence strategic decisions and continuously strengthen organisational effectiveness and the employee value proposition.
  • The successful candidate will be a strategic thinker, trusted advisor and transformation leader with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, navigate a complex and matrixed organisation, and translate business priorities into impactful people and organisational strategies, while ensuring strong governance and effective execution through the broader People & Culture team.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of progressive HR experience, with at least 7 years in HR Business Partnering, strategic HR advisory or equivalent leadership roles.
  • Proven experience partnering with senior business leaders to shape workforce strategy, talent priorities and organisational effectiveness.
  • Demonstrated success in translating business priorities into impactful people strategies and HR initiatives.
  • Strong experience across workforce planning, talent management, succession, employee relations, performance management, organisational development and leadership coaching.
  • Experience leading and developing HR/P&C teams and working effectively across HR Centres of Excellence.
  • Experience operating within a complex, matrixed and fast-changing organisation; exposure to Global Business Services, technology, telecommunications or professional services environments would be advantageous.
  • Strong knowledge of Malaysian employment legislation, employee relations practices and HR governance requirements.
  • Understanding of contemporary HR practices, workforce trends and evolving talent market dynamics in Malaysia.
  • Knowledge of organisation design, workforce transformation, employee engagement, culture and change management.
  • Ability to operate effectively within a regional/global matrix and partner across business units, countries and HR Centres of Excellence.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
Date: 24 Aug 2026

Location:

Singapore, Singapore

Company: Singtel Group

An empowering career at Singtel begins with a Hello. Our purpose, to Empower Every Generation, connects people to the possibilities they need to excel. Every "hello" at Singtel opens doors to new initiatives, growth, and BIG possibilities that takes your career to new heights. So, when you say hello to us, you are really empowered to say…“Hello BIG Possibilities”.

Singtel is where Technology meets Purpose.

We're building an AI-first telco for the future—connecting people, businesses and communities through trusted networks, intelligent digital services and next-generation technology.

From transforming everyday experiences in mobile, broadband, entertainment and lifestyle services to enabling enterprises with AI, 5G+, cloud, cybersecurity, data centres and digital platforms, we create the technology that powers how millions live, work and connect.

At Singtel, your work creates real impact. You'll solve meaningful challenges, shape critical digital infrastructure and help build secure, resilient and AI-enabled solutions that serve businesses, digital ecosystems and communities across the globe.

This is where BIG Possibilities become reality. Whether you're engineering intelligent networks, advancing sovereign AI cloud platforms, strengthening cybersecurity, designing seamless customer experiences or driving sustainable innovation, you'll be part of teams shaping the future of technology.

Backed by decades of expertise and driven by a culture of continuous learning and innovation, Singtel offers the scale, opportunities and support to help you grow your career while making a difference where it matters most.

How You will Make An Impact:

Senior Quality Engineer plays the Test Lead role and is responsible for driving project-wide quality engineering practices, embedding quality early in software development lifecycle, and leading test strategy, planning, automation, execution, reporting and governance initiatives.

This role defines quality frameworks, develops test solutions across platforms, and integrates robust quality gates within CI/CD pipelines, while fostering cross-functional collaboration and observability through test analytics.

Test Automation Strategy and Implementation:

  • Design, develop, and maintain sophisticated and scalable test automation frameworks, test suites, and solutions for web, API, and mobile applications.
  • Provide architectural guidance and best practices for test automation.
  • Lead the adoption of automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Playwright, RestAssured, Appium) within teams and potentially across multiple projects or the organization.
  • Integrate automation seamlessly into the development lifecycle.
  • Implement, optimize, and oversee CI/CD pipelines with well-defined and automated quality gates
  • Integrate various test types (unit, integration, E2E, non-functional) into the CI/CD process
  • Monitor pipeline effectiveness and provide actionable feedback and insights to development teams
  • Contribute to the evolution and standardization of CI/CD processes.

Strategic Test Planning and Execution:

  • Define and lead the development and execution of comprehensive test strategies for projects and programs.
  • Determine test scope, methodologies, resource estimation, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Effectively apply mocking and contract testing techniques
  • Implement advanced test automation techniques and testing methodologies.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional parties to execute testing.

Test Analytics and Reporting:

  • Develop and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure process efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Leverage test data and metrics to provide insightful reports and identify areas for improvement.
  • Enhance observability through test analytics at the project, program, and potentially organizational levels.
  • Report on the progress and effectiveness of automation and testing efforts.

Skills for Success:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in software testing, including experience in test management.
  • Strong knowledge of testing methodologies, tools, and best practices.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills.
  • Experience in test automation is a plus.
  • Relevant certifications such as ISTQB (International Software Testing Qualifications Board) are beneficial.

Technical Proficiency

  • Expertise in Test Automation: Proven ability to design, develop, and maintain complex and scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile applications using relevant tools (e.g., Playwright, Selenium, RestAssured, Appium).
  • Deep Understanding of CI/CD: Comprehensive knowledge of CI/CD principles, tools, and the integration of automated testing within pipelines (e.g., Bamboo, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of Testing Methodologies: Solid understanding of various testing methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc.) and test design techniques.
  • Experience with Performance Testing: Hands-on with performance test Execution (Jmeter, NeoLoad) and respective toolset.
  • API Testing Skills: Proven ability to test APIs effectively using relevant tools and protocols.
  • Scripting and Programming Skills: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages relevant to test automation (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript).
  • Experience with Test Management Tools: Familiarity with tools like Jira with Qmetry, or similar.

Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?

Join Singtel to shape what's next and accelerate your career through meaningful work, continuous learning, and real impact.

We are introducing new capabilities in 5G, Cloud, Analytics, Digital Commerce, Software Engineering, Cyber Security to enhance our core competencies and deliver innovative and differentiated Mobile and Fixed services (Broadband, TV and Telephony) for our customers. We are committed to celebrating inclusion and diversity and is a strong believer to upskill and nurture all individuals. Come join us today as we build Singtel’s Networks of tomorrow, and Empower Every Generation to live, work and play in new ways!

Make an Impact:

1. Mobile Data Engineering Planning

  • Lead end-to-end planning for mobile data platforms across 4G and 5G environments, including mobile core, packet core, service assurance, probe, analytics, data feeds, and observability platforms.
  • Own the planning roadmap for 4G VNF and 5G CNF domains, ensuring scalability, resiliency, lifecycle readiness, capacity sufficiency, and alignment with business, technology, and operational priorities.
  • Provide domain expertise across 4G EPC, 5G Core, control plane, user plane, roaming, VoLTE, VoNR, IoT, 5G slicing, xDR, session tracing, performance analytics, and end-to-end service correlation.
  • Define architecture, capacity, interface, integration, monitoring, and performance requirements for new mobile data capabilities and platform enhancements.
  • Ensure engineering plans support business growth, customer experience, operational efficiency, automation, security, and cost optimization.

2. End-to-End Architecture and Technical Ownership

  • Lead end-to-end solution planning across mobile core, IP transport, data centre, cloud infrastructure, virtualization, container platforms, monitoring, orchestration, and operational support systems.
  • Ensure complete E2E setup readiness, including IP design, routing, firewall requirements, DNS, load balancing, connectivity, security zones, platform onboarding, operational access, monitoring, logging, backup, and disaster recovery considerations.
  • Provide technical leadership for cloud-native and virtualized environments, including 5G CNF and 4G VNF architecture, platform dependencies, lifecycle management, resource planning, software upgrades, and vendor roadmap alignment.
  • Drive readiness of environments for deployment, testing, integration, commissioning, production acceptance, and operational handover.
  • Serve as the technical planning authority for mobile data use cases that span network, IT, cloud, security, automation, analytics, and business teams.

3. DevOps, GitLab and Automation

  • Lead the adoption of DevOps practices for mobile data engineering, including GitLab-based source control, CI/CD pipelines, configuration management, change traceability, automated testing, and controlled deployment workflows.
  • Drive automation initiatives to improve delivery speed, configuration consistency, service assurance, operational efficiency, and incident response.
  • Promote infrastructure-as-code, pipeline-driven deployment, repeatable testing, automated validation, and standardized rollback practices where applicable.
  • Work with engineering, operations, vendors, and platform teams to industrialize automation for 4G VNF and 5G CNF deployment, upgrade, monitoring, and lifecycle activities.
  • Ensure DevOps and automation practices comply with security, governance, change management, and production control requirements.

4. LMP, Platform and Lifecycle Management

  • Provide planning and domain leadership for LMP-related capabilities, platform onboarding, lifecycle management, orchestration, inventory, performance, and operational readiness.
  • Manage technology lifecycle planning for mobile data platforms, including hardware, software, licences, capacity, support contracts, end-of-life, end-of-support, refresh, migration, and decommissioning.
  • Maintain forward-looking platform roadmaps aligned with business demand, vendor evolution, 5G standalone development, cloud-native transformation, and operational requirements.
  • Identify technical risks, obsolescence risks, security risks, capacity constraints, and cost pressures, and develop mitigation plans.

5. CAPEX, OPEX and P&L Accountability

  • Manage P&L accountability for assigned Mobile Data Engineering platforms, including CAPEX and OPEX planning, forecasting, tracking, optimisation, and reporting.
  • Develop business cases, investment papers, budget submissions, procurement justifications, cost models, and financial impact assessments for new platforms, capacity expansions, renewals, upgrades, and transformation initiatives.
  • Track and manage vendor costs, maintenance charges, software licences, cloud or infrastructure consumption, support services, professional services, hardware refresh, and project delivery costs.
  • Optimise total cost of ownership through platform consolidation, automation, capacity efficiency, vendor negotiation, lifecycle planning, and operational simplification.
  • Ensure spending aligns with approved budgets, business priorities, governance requirements, and measurable value delivery.

6. Business Use Case Leadership

  • Lead conversations with business, product, commercial, enterprise, network, IT, security, finance, and operations stakeholders to convert business ideas into practical mobile data use cases.
  • Translate business opportunities into technical requirements, solution options, cost estimates, implementation plans, KPIs, delivery milestones, and operational acceptance criteria.
  • Assess feasibility, financial impact, security impact, customer experience impact, operational complexity, and delivery risk for proposed business use cases.
  • Drive use cases from ideation through planning, business case approval, design, delivery, testing, launch, and post-launch benefit tracking.
  • Act as the bridge between business ambition and network/platform realisation, ensuring solutions are technically sound, financially justified, secure, and operationally sustainable.

7. Security, Risk and Compliance

  • Apply security-by-design principles across mobile data planning and delivery, including confidentiality, integrity, availability, accountability, authentication, authorisation, least privilege, secure access, network segmentation, and data protection.
  • Ensure mobile data solutions comply with internal security policies, change management processes, vulnerability management requirements, regulatory obligations, and operational governance.
  • Lead security assessment planning for new platforms and major changes, including vulnerability assessment, penetration testing coordination, risk review, remediation tracking, and secure production rollout.
  • Ensure proper management of privileged access, system accounts, logs, audit trails, asset inventory, software licences, patching, backup, restoration, and secure disposal where applicable.
  • Work closely with cybersecurity, network security, architecture, operations, vendors, and governance teams to manage risks and ensure secure implementation.

8. Project and Program Management

  • Lead complex mobile data engineering projects from planning to delivery, including scope definition, budget planning, solution design, procurement, vendor engagement, implementation, testing, commissioning, acceptance, documentation, and handover.
  • Manage project schedules, dependencies, risks, issues, resources, financials, governance forums, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure project delivery follows agreed scope, timeline, budget, quality, change management, security, and operational acceptance requirements.
  • Lead cross-functional project teams across network engineering, operations, IP, cloud, IT, cybersecurity, finance, procurement, vendors, and business units.
  • Drive timely decision-making, issue resolution, escalation management, and stakeholder alignment.

9. Stakeholder and Vendor Management

  • Act as a senior technical and planning interface for internal stakeholders, vendors, suppliers, and delivery partners.
  • Manage vendor performance, roadmap alignment, solution compliance, commercial discussions, technical escalations, support quality, and delivery commitments.
  • Influence stakeholders across business and technology teams to align priorities, resolve conflicts, and deliver outcomes.
  • Prepare and present technical papers, investment proposals, architecture options, risk assessments, financial summaries, project updates, and management recommendations.
  • Build trusted relationships with stakeholders by combining strong technical credibility, financial discipline, business understanding, and clear communication.

Skills for Success:

  • Degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline.
  • 10 or more years of experience in mobile network planning, mobile data engineering, packet core, mobile core, service assurance, cloud-native telecom platforms, or telecom infrastructure delivery.
  • Strong domain knowledge in both 4G and 5G mobile data environments, including 4G VNF and 5G CNF architecture.
  • Experience in mobile core, packet core, EPC, 5GC, control plane, user plane, roaming, VoLTE, VoNR, IoT, slicing, probes, analytics, xDR, KPI monitoring, and service assurance.
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end telecom setup, including IP networking, routing, DNS, firewall, load balancer, data centre, cloud platform, virtualization, containers, orchestration, monitoring, and operational support.
  • Experience with GitLab, DevOps practices, CI/CD, automation, scripting, configuration management, and controlled software delivery processes.
  • Experience managing CAPEX, OPEX, budget planning, cost tracking, procurement support, business cases, and financial governance.
  • Strong project management experience, preferably with exposure to large-scale telecom platform delivery, vendor management, change management, and operational handover.
  • Good security knowledge across telecom networks, cloud-native platforms, access control, vulnerability management, patching, logging, network segmentation, secure change, and production risk management

Detailed deliverables in this role are as follows:

a) Group Procurement Policies and Governance

Leads the setting, alignment and enforcement of procurement policies and processes across the Singtel Group (Singtel, Optus) as follows:

  • Tender Administration – supporting all BU Procurement teams in Singapore in the lifecycle management of Tenders, Waivers of Competition and Direct Sourcing

c) Group Procurement Communications and Engagement

Financial

Strategic

  • Proven willingness to challenge ‘business as usual’; curiosity to think ‘outside the box’ and passion for driving cost improvements.
