Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Manager, Talent Acquisition to lead and strengthen our talent acquisition function. This role is responsible for developing and executing recruitment strategies that enable the organization to attract, assess, and hire high-quality talent across critical business areas.

The Senior Manager will partner closely with business leaders, HR partners, and senior stakeholders to understand workforce priorities, anticipate talent needs, and deliver effective hiring solutions. The role will also drive improvements in recruitment processes, employer branding, talent intelligence, candidate experience, and the use of data and technology.

Key Responsibilities

Talent Acquisition Strategy & Workforce Partnership

  • Develop and execute talent acquisition strategies aligned with business priorities and workforce plans.
  • Partner with senior business and HR leaders to understand current and future talent requirements.
  • Translate workforce needs into targeted sourcing, recruitment, and talent pipeline strategies.
  • Provide market insights and talent intelligence to support hiring and workforce decisions.
  • Identify emerging talent gaps and proactively develop pipelines for critical and hard-to-fill roles.

Recruitment Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end recruitment across assigned business areas, including senior and critical positions.
  • Establish appropriate sourcing strategies across direct sourcing, referrals, agencies, executive search firms, digital channels, and talent communities.
  • Ensure hiring processes are efficient, consistent, inclusive, and aligned with organizational standards.
  • Monitor recruitment performance against agreed service levels and hiring objectives.
  • Support senior-level candidate assessment, selection, offer management, and closing strategies.

Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as a trusted talent advisor to senior leaders, hiring managers, and HR partners.
  • Challenge and influence stakeholders constructively on hiring requirements, candidate profiles, market realities, and selection decisions.
  • Provide regular updates on hiring progress, market conditions, pipeline quality, and recruitment risks.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to improve workforce planning and hiring outcomes.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of talent acquisition professionals.
  • Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans for the team.
  • Build capability in strategic sourcing, stakeholder management, assessment, talent intelligence, and data-driven recruitment.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and candidate-centric culture.

Employer Brand & Talent Sourcing

  • Partner with relevant teams to strengthen the organization's employer value proposition and talent brand.
  • Develop targeted attraction strategies for priority talent segments and Go-to-market for attraction of talent pool.
  • Build sustainable external talent pipelines and communities for future hiring needs.
  • Leverage professional networks, social platforms, industry partnerships, events, and other channels to expand access to talent.

Recruitment Excellence, Data & Technology

  • Track and analyze key recruitment metrics such as time-to-fill, time-to-hire, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, candidate experience, quality of hire, and hiring manager satisfaction.
  • Use recruitment data and market intelligence to identify trends and recommend improvements.
  • Drive continuous improvement and standardization of talent acquisition processes.
  • Optimize the use of applicant tracking systems, recruitment technologies, automation, AI-enabled tools, and analytics.
  • Manage recruitment vendors and external partners, including performance, service quality, and cost effectiveness.
  • Ensure recruitment activities comply with relevant employment legislation, internal policies, governance requirements, and fair hiring practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will also be considered.
  • Possess 10+ years of talent acquisition or recruitment experience, including significant experience in a leadership or senior talent acquisition role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex and senior-level hiring in a large or fast-paced organization.
  • Strong track record of partnering with senior executives and influencing business stakeholders.
  • Experience leading and developing recruitment teams.
  • Strong knowledge of sourcing strategies, talent mapping, assessment methodologies, recruitment operations, and employer branding.
  • Experience using recruitment analytics and talent market intelligence to support decision-making.
  • Strong understanding of applicant tracking systems, recruitment technologies, digital sourcing platforms, and emerging AI applications in talent acquisition.
  • Experience managing recruitment agencies, executive search firms, and other external partners.

  • Update and maintain the internal design specifications, drawings, and standards in accordance with the latest configurations and including all 'lessons learned' in relation to all equipment. Perform design and equipment submittal review for new Data Centers.

  • Knowledgeable in Building Management System/DCIM, able to understand system architect and point schedule. Experience in handling BMS/DCIM enhancement project.

  • Interface with internal stakeholders to promote standards that maintain consistency and reliability in services delivered.

  • Perform technical design reviews and proposal for data centre first of kind systems and equipment.
  • Review data centre commissioning scripts to ensure they accurately test all modes of operations. Witness key commissioning tests on site.
  • Conduct site inspection and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, mechanical systems audits, and start-up as needed.
  • Continually maintain positive and collaborative working relations with partner teams, vendors, teammates, and internal customers.

Success by skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Mechanical Professional Engineering (PE) licensure is preferred.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in designing and maintaining mechanical systems for data centers or similar critical facilities
  • Knowledge of large-scale mission critical facility’s Mechanical infrastructure systems.
  • Experience with fast-track design/build projects and or multiple significant upgrade projects.
  • Fundamental knowledge in of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, and heat transfer principles, fire protection and plumbing and sanitary system.

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong oral, written communication and presentation skills.
  • Possess positive working attitude, ability to work independently and team players.
  • Ability to lead a team of engineers and consultants.
  • Attention to detail and a commitment to safety.

  • Fixed Assets

job.title: Field Service Technician - Shreveport, LA
job.description:
Job Description

At Vertiv, we design, manufacture, and service the mission-critical infrastructure technologies for vital applications in data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial environments. We are the trusted Service Provider for 70%+ of Fortune 500 companies, including industry-leading data centers and providers of colocation and cloud service.

Why Vertiv is the best company for Field Service professionals:

  • Vertiv is an industry leader in Technology and Services with a best-in-class Customer Service and Safety culture
  • Company leaders have many years of hands-on Field Service experience in this industry and many others
  • Tremendous focus is placed on employee technical and leadership development
  • Technical Training takes place in our state of the art Training Academy or Regional Training Center with a strong focus on immersive, hands-on learning
  • Competitive benefits include: Company vehicle, smartphone, laptop, personal protective equipment (PPE), other tools-of-the-trade, 401k, Profit Sharing, & Generous PTO/Vacation Plan, Medical, Vision & Dental & more
  • Abundant technical resources including 24/7 Technical/Factory Support and technical online libraries of product documentation, work instructions, and self-help troubleshooting guides
  • Company-wide commitment to promoting a strong work/life balance
  • An employer-of-choice for Veterans with technical backgrounds

The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible for scheduled and remedial (break-fix) service on Small to Medium UPS, Power Distribution Units & Battery system products serviced by Vertiv, commensurate with appropriate classroom and on-the-job training.  The Field Service Technician is required to establish, promote and maintain excellent rapport with all customers, co-workers, sales representatives and others as appropriate.  The Field Service Technician is primarily responsible to support products and services sold to our “Edge” market segment, including retail, financial, and municipal customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

ROLE

  • Perform service tasks as assigned and as per company policies and procedures
  • Capable of working under direct supervision or independently based upon training completion
  • Render on-site and phone assistance to customers
  • Communicate with Technical Support on technical or procedural issues
  • Implement Field Change Notices per published guidelines
  • Keep current on Safety Bulletins, Safety Field Change Notices, Field Change Notices, and Service Tips

SAFETY

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines
  • Maintain and operate company vehicle in accordance with local laws and company policy
  • Must wear appropriate PPE as per company guidelines and accordance with job duties
  • Adhere to work hours policy guidelines – “14 hours rule”
  • Report all work related accidents or injuries within 24 hours to the appropriate personnel.

ADMINISTRATION

  • Complete accurate and timely administrative tasks (i.e. Time cards, expense report, mileage reports, Service Request task closure, service reports) per company guidelines
  • Maintain individual inventory and perform cycle counts in accordance with company policy
  • Maintain company property (company vehicle, credit cards, PPE, test equipment, laptop, etc.) per company policies

CUSTOMER SATISFACTION

  • Provide proper and adequate communication to internal and external customers
  • Provide estimated time of arrival to the customer where applicable
  • Complete scheduled maintenance documentation properly and provide to the customer and local office upon completion of each assignment
  • Strive to provide all customers a “first time fix” for their equipment
  • Maintain customer satisfaction rates per company guidelines
  • Attend Customer Meetings as required

PERFORMANCE

  • Maximize productivity by combining service opportunities
  • Complete all technical and administrative work in an efficient and timely manner
  • Capable of making technical and commercial decisions under pressure
  • Properly evaluate site and equipment for appropriate billing status
  • Maintain productive utilization rate per company guidelines
  • Perform inventory cycle counts per company guidelines
  • Adhere to company dress code and safety regulations
  • Meet or exceed on-site response time requirements for each customer
  • Understand and comply with company startup/escalation processes and procedures
  • Maintain proper and adequate level of internal communications

QUALIFICATIONS

Experience (one or more of the following)

  • ASEET or AMEET, or progress towards, is preferred
  • High School or Vocational School Diploma
  • 2-4 years military experience in a related technical field
  • 0-2 years of relevant industry experience

Interpersonal and Administrative Skills

  • Communicate professionally and respectfully in both written and verbal forms
  • Manage time effectively by prioritizing and balancing technical tasks with administrative tasks
  • Collaborative with peers, customers, suppliers, and leadership
  • Complete administrative tasks (i.e. report writing, time entry, expense reporting, material debriefing, inventory counting, etc.) in a timely fashion

Technical skills

  • Make basic site evaluation skills to include: environmental temperature, and general operating conditions
  • Familiarity with electrical / electronic test equipment and fundamentals
  • Follow written technical documentation (i.e. procedures and product manuals) to perform service tasks
  • Employ elementary fix/repair techniques based on directed supervision
  • Complete service tasks and return unit to full operating conditions based upon directed supervision
  • Summarize and report all work related tasks performed in written and verbal form
  • Efficient with a personal computer and associated applications (Microsoft Office, Vertiv software, etc.)

WORKING CONDITIONS

  • Travel is required
  • Flexible schedules (weekends, evenings, and holidays)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Due to the safety sensitive aspect of the role, candidates are required to successfully pass a drug test prior to employment. In addition, you will also be required to complete and pass a pre-employment background check and a motor vehicle records check.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

While performing duties of the above jobs, the associate is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel objects, tools or other components; reach with hands and arms; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; talk, hear and smell. The associate frequently is required to sit and climb or balance.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distant vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Must be able to consistently lift up to 50 pounds and occasionally up to 75 pounds.

Notes: Vertiv will make reasonable accommodations whenever necessary for all qualified employees or candidates with disabilities (as defined by applicable law), provided that (1) the individual is otherwise qualified to safely perform the essential functions of the job and (2) such accommodations due not impose an undue hardship.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Responsibilities

  • Perform month-end general accounting close for multiple legal entities across ASEAN countries. Prepare journal entries and account reconciliations for relevant balance sheet accounts to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  • Reconcile and document all general ledger accounts in accordance with established accounting procedures. Review and verify the accuracy of journal entries and ensure appropriate accounting classifications are applied.
  • Maintain and strengthen internal controls for the respective legal entities to ensure compliance with corporate policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage treasury and payroll functions for each country, including payment processing and cash flow management.
  • Oversee in-country compliance activities, including coordination of external audits and preparation of corporate and indirect tax filings. Ensure full compliance with all applicable government regulations.
  • Support the review and enhancement of corporate financial accounting policies and procedures. Recommend and implement improvements to accounting processes, financial reporting, and systems.
  • Lead and participate in special projects as required, such as general ledger enhancements and changes in accounting procedures or systems.

Skills Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related discipline.
  • CPA or equivalent professional qualification preferred.
  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant accounting or finance experience.
  • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, practices, and standards, including Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Familiar with SEC, IRS, and FASB regulations and guidelines.
  • Proven ability to analyze business conditions and assess financial impacts.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to define problems, collect and interpret data, and provide practical solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong interpersonal abilities.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and Power Platform tools (PowerApps, Power BI, Power Automate), with experience in ERP systems and other accounting software.

job.title: Capital Markets Project Manager
job.description:
36770

Job location:

JP

Colt provides network, voice and data centre services to thousands of businesses around the world, allowing them to focus on delivering their business goals instead of the underlying infrastructure.

Why we need this role

The Project Manager will be responsible for delivering Colt’s specialised Capital Markets products ‘MarketPrizm’ and ‘PrizmNet’ as quickly and efficiently as possible and in accordance with Colt-defined process, to either Clients or Internal Sponsors.

‘MarketPrizm’ is Colt’s suite of co-located hosting-related services, including space and power typically in the same data centre as a Stock Exchange, market access (market data & order-entry), hardware procurement & deployment (network & application servers) and all related connectivity requirements.

‘PrizmNet’ is Colt’s financial extranet, that provides one-to-one or one-to-many interconnectivity between data Providers like a Stock Exchange and Consuming clients.

The Project Manager will clarify the solution scope for each project or client order, determine what resource is required, procure all required services, arrange delivery, installation and testing, to the required cost, quality & agreed timescale. Delivery is completed once the solution details are fully documented and the solution is ‘accepted’ by the client or project sponsor. The order is then closed, which transfers responsibility to Colt’s Service Assurance team for ongoing ‘In-Life’ Production support.

What you will do

  • Plan & coordinate all necessary tasks to achieve the deliverable; to time, budget & quality
  • Obtain appropriate resource to conduct the tasks
  • Raise budget and procure all services
  • Manage risks and issues and change management throughout the project life-cycle
  • Track & report project progress, internally and externally to the client
  • Resolve or escalate issues in a timely & appropriate manner
  • Manage third-party relationships i.e. client, data centre, stock exchange, suppliers
  • Complete all the solution documentation
  • Transition the solution from Service Delivery to Service Assurance for production support
  • Close the Order promptly, to generate Monthly Recurring Revenue and to trigger the client billing
  • Recommend lessons learnt

What we're looking for

Must haves:

  • Business level in Japanese and English with strong communication skills
  • Experience in project management, preferably with PRINCE2 or PMP certification
  • ITIL awareness and understanding of service management best practices
  • Typically 10+ years of relevant experience (preferred, not mandatory).
  • Excellent customer service and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive accountability
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional project teams and achieve objectives
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to build strong internal and external relationships

Nice to have

- Additional language skills are an advantage

What we offer you:

Looking to make a mark?

At Colt, you’ll make a difference. Because around here, we empower people. We don’t tell you what to do.

Instead, we employ people we trust, who come together across the globe to create intelligent solutions.

Our global teams are full of ambitious, driven people, all working together towards one shared purpose: to put the power of the digital universe in the hands of our customers wherever, whenever and however they want.

We give our people the opportunity to inspire and lead teams, and work on projects that connect people, cities, businesses, and ideas. We want you to help us change the world, for the better.

Diversity and inclusion

  • Inclusion and valuing diversity of thought and experience are at the heart of our culture here at Colt. From day one, you’ll be encouraged to be yourself because we believe that’s what helps our people to thrive. We welcome people with diverse backgrounds and experiences, regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, disability, neurodiversity, age, marital status, pregnancy status, or place of birth.

Most recently we have:

  • Signed the UN Women Empowerment Principles which guide our Gender Action Plan
  • Trained 60 (and growing) Colties to be Mental Health First Aiders
  • Please speak with a member of our recruitment team if you require adjustments to our recruitment process to support you. For more information about our Inclusion and Diversity agenda, visit our [DEI pages](https://www.colt.net/about/inclusion-diversity/).

Benefits

Our benefits support you through all parts of life, for both physical and mental health.

  • Flexible working hours and the option to work from home.
  • Extensive induction program with experienced mentors and buddies.
  • Opportunities for further development and educational opportunities.
  • Global Family Leave Policy.
  • Employee Assistance Program.
  • Internal inclusion & diversity employee networks.

A global network

  • When you join Colt you become part of our global network. We are proud of our colleagues and the stories and experience they bring – take a look at ‘Our People’ site including our Empowered Women in Tech.

job.title: Supervisor Data Analytics
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected.  With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a Supervisor Data Analytics to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

The Data Analyst Supervisor leads a team of data analysts (on-site and globally distributed) within the Customer Insight function, reporting to the Senior Manager Marketing Data Science. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines people management, project ownership, and deep technical contribution.

The supervisor owns the full BI delivery chain, from designing and optimizing ETL pipelines in Snowflake (in partnership with IT) through building robust Power BI data models and semantic layers, to delivering polished reports and apps to the right audiences. A critical part of the role is ensuring proper data governance: every stakeholder sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational structure, and regional scope.

Beyond technical delivery, the role carries strong project management accountability: scoping, planning, and driving multiple concurrent BI initiatives from concept to production. The supervisor acts as the key bridge between the data team and the wider business, translating requirements Marketing and other functions into scalable, well-architected analytics solutions.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable mentoring junior analysts, challenging a data model design, presenting insights to senior leadership, and building long-term strategic relationships across regions and functions to keep data solutions aligned with where the business is heading.

What kind of work will you be doing?

Team Leadership & Project Management (40%):

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a team of data analysts across multiple locations and time zones.
  • Plan and prioritize team workload, balancing recurring reporting activities with strategic BI projects.
  • Manage BI projects end-to-end: scoping, planning, execution, delivery, and post-launch optimization.
  • Conduct performance reviews, set development goals, and support career growth of team members.
  • Establish and maintain consistent methodologies, standards, and documentation across the team.
  • Gather requirements and align priorities with stakeholders across IT, Sales, Finance, and Operations.
  • Build and nurture strategic relationships with cross-regional and cross-functional partners to drive long-term alignment and unlock collaboration opportunities.

BI Architecture & Hands-On Delivery (30%):

  • Own the BI architecture and semantic layer design, partnering with IT on platform-level decisions and infrastructure while retaining ownership of the analytics and reporting layer.
  • Design and optimize the data flow from source to consumption: ETL pipelines in Snowflake, Power BI datasets, report delivery to end users.
  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports: advanced DAX, data modeling, calculated tables, and performance optimization.
  • Define and manage data access and visibility rules across all reports and apps, ensuring that each stakeholder and audience sees only the information they are authorized to access, based on business policies, organizational roles, and regional scope.
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and consistency across all BI outputs.
  • Identify and implement improvements to reporting processes, automation, and self-service capabilities.

Surveys & Voice of Customer (20%):

  • Coordinate the team's VoC activities, overseeing survey design, execution, and analysis using Qualtrics across regions.
  • Ensure VoC results are translated into actionable insights that inform product, sales, and marketing decisions.
  • Guide the integration of survey data into the broader BI ecosystem to enrich reporting and segmentation.

AI/ML Support (10%):

  • Provide support to AI/ML initiatives when needed, contributing expertise on data readiness, quality, and pipeline integration.
  • Help the team explore opportunities to apply advanced analytics and automation to existing processes.

What will make you successful?

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field (Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics, or related).
  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis, BI development, or analytics roles.
  • Proven experience leading or coordinating a team (even informally).
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI: complex data models, DAX, workspace governance, app deployment, and audience-based access management.
  • Solid SQL skills: writing, optimizing, and troubleshooting queries in Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses.
  • Experience designing or managing ETL/ELT pipelines and understanding of data architecture principles.
  • Experience with data governance, access control, and compliance in BI environments.
  • Strong project management skills: ability to run multiple concurrent projects with clear timelines and deliverables.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication: ability to influence without authority across functions and regions.
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).

Nice-to-Have

  • Python for data manipulation, automation, or analytics.
  • Experience with Qualtrics or similar survey platforms.
  • Exposure to AI/ML concepts and tools.
  • Experience in a global, matrix organization.
  • Knowledge of marketing analytics, customer segmentation, or pricing analysis.

What we are looking for

  • A hands-on leader who can switch between strategic thinking and getting into the detail.
  • Strong ownership mentality: takes accountability for delivery quality and team performance.
  • Ability to build trust and develop strategic relationships across regions and functions.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-changing, global environment.
  • Proactive problem-solver who anticipates issues and drives continuous improvement.
  • Availability for international travel.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment!

job.title: Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The _Electrical Design Engineer_ will develop electrical design HDLC units such as In row CDU and In rack CDU as well as 2 phase products. He/she will closely follow objectives of quality, environment and costs working in cooperation with manufacturing engineering, controls engineering, procurement, suppliers, mechanical engineering, and product marketing. The Electrical Engineer will contribute to the release of new products; will work in a cross-functional development group; manage a variety of tasks and activities in a dynamic environment; and solve complex problems where no precedence exists.

This position will be based onsite at Vertiv's Ironton, OH location (3040 S 9th St., Ironton, OH 45638).

Responsibilities

  • Design new and low voltage electrical enclosures (>240 volts AC).
  • Harness Design, schematic creation and 3D modeling of wiring and cabling inside equipment.
  • Experience with CREO Cabling module is preferred.
  • Capable and proficient at understanding and applying various standards of NEC (NFPA70), CSA/UL, and IEEE to do a proper selection of electrical components that meet agencies requirements.
  • Collaboration and guideline across the disciplines of mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, process engineering, as well as production and offering teams. Work with these teams for design reviews, meeting cost metrics, and brainstorming around customer pain points.
  • Performs a variety of engineering calculations using traditional engineering methods to verify design requirements
  • Extended Responsibilities:
  • Create, revise and audit unit wiring schematics and network connection drawings
  • Create, review and audit electric panel layouts following relevant codes and standards
  • Create, revise and audit wire harnesses

Requirements

  • Bachelor of Science Degree in Electrical Engineering (BSEE) or related degree from an accredited college or university
  • 8+ years of experience in hardware development roles.
  • More than 8 years of expertise with Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) or product documentation management systems.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in drafting functional requirements and preparing design documentation.
  • Skilled in using Creo Schematics or equivalent schematic capture software.
  • Hands-on experience operating DMMs, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and other diagnostic instruments.
  • Capable of executing project schedules throughout hardware board development lifecycles.
  • Adept at debugging, validation, and supporting manufacturing test processes.
  • Proven ability in designing for testability and manufacturability.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal collaboration skills.
  • Reliable team members exhibit a consistently positive attitude and creativity.
  • Able to work in multicultural environments

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Constant / Frequent Standing

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

job.title: Sr. Engineer Reliability Engineering XI
job.description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Sr. Engineer – Reliability Engineering will be responsible for managing and executing product reliability testing and validation activities within the Reliability Lab. The role will ensure that products, components, and systems meet defined reliability, durability, performance, and quality requirements through structured testing, data analysis, failure investigation, and continuous improvement.

The role will work closely with Product Design, Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to plan and execute reliability tests, identify failure modes, determine root causes, and recommend design or process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute reliability, durability, life-cycle, and qualification testing in the Reliability Lab.
  • Develop test plans, test procedures, test setups, and test schedules based on product and customer requirements.
  • Operate and ensure proper utilization of reliability laboratory equipment, test rigs, instrumentation, and data-acquisition systems.
  • Conduct reliability testing under thermal, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and other relevant stress conditions.
  • Monitor tests, capture test data, identify abnormalities, and ensure timely escalation of test failures.
  • Perform detailed analysis of test failures and support Root Cause Analysis (RCA), FMEA, 8D, and corrective actions.
  • Work with Design Engineering to investigate failures and recommend design improvements to enhance product reliability.
  • Ensure proper documentation of test results, observations, failures, corrective actions, and final conclusions.
  • Prepare test reports, reliability reports, qualification reports, and technical presentations for engineering and leadership teams.
  • Support new product development by providing reliability inputs during design verification and validation (DV/PV) activities.
  • Support qualification and validation of design changes, components, materials, and suppliers.
  • Ensure calibration and preventive maintenance of laboratory equipment and test infrastructure.
  • Maintain laboratory standards, safety requirements, testing protocols, and documentation.
  • Coordinate with external laboratories and testing agencies whenever specialized testing is required.
  • Analyze reliability data and identify trends, recurring failures, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Support development and improvement of reliability test methodologies and laboratory capabilities.
  • Mentor junior engineers/technicians on reliability testing, instrumentation, data analysis, and troubleshooting.

Key Technical Skills

  • Strong knowledge of Reliability Engineering and Reliability Testing.
  • Hands-on experience with reliability and environmental testing.
  • Knowledge of FMEA, FTA, RCA, 8D, Weibull analysis, life testing, and accelerated life testing.
  • Understanding of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and environmental stress testing.
  • Experience with data acquisition systems, sensors, instrumentation, and test equipment.
  • Ability to troubleshoot test setups and identify test-system vs. product failures.
  • Strong data analysis and interpretation skills.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry/testing standards and engineering practices.
  • Good understanding of product design and manufacturing processes.
  • Strong technical documentation and reporting skills.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or related Engineering discipline.
  • Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in Reliability Engineering, Product Validation, Testing, or Engineering Laboratory functions.
  • Hands-on experience working in a Reliability/Test/Validation Lab is preferred.
  • Experience in HVAC, thermal management, cooling systems, data-center equipment, power electronics, or similar engineered products will be an advantage.

Key Competencies

  • Reliability & Failure Analysis
  • Laboratory & Test Management
  • Technical Problem Solving
  • Data Analysis
  • Root Cause Analysis
  • Product Testing & Validation
  • Project Ownership
  • Cross-functional Collaboration
  • Attention to Detail
  • Technical Documentation
  • Decision Making

Key KPIs

  • On-time completion of reliability and qualification testing
  • Reliability test execution quality and accuracy
  • Reduction in repeat/recurring test failures
  • Timely identification and closure of reliability issues
  • Effectiveness of RCA and corrective actions
  • Laboratory equipment availability and utilization
  • Compliance with testing, calibration, safety, and documentation requirements
  • Contribution to product reliability and design improvements

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

job.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

As the Solutions Engineer reporting to the Solutions Engineering Manager, you will work closely with the rest of the Technology – Technical Solutions team, as well as the Head of Customer Success, making your mark in a number of ways:

  • Support the team by learning and understanding the customer and market requirements, ensuring business alignment
  • Help to drive the delivery of the customer solution and product through the complete data centre cycle
  • Support translating customer requirements into key design projects of our data centres in the India region and in preparing presentations to customers and executives.

Your Day to Day

  • Provide support to the Solutions Team in the RFP proposal and deliver key technical / engineering documents
  • Provide support in production of key technical and sales collateral – High Level M&E Schematic and Technical presentation materials
  • Assist in high-level space planning and engineering solutions for our customers
  • Involved in pioneering various engineering solutions relating to design, calculations and other engineering aspects
  • Assist in the development of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
  • Support in preparing pitch decks, presentation packs and collateral for customers and executives
  • Support the connectivity team working with carriers in the region

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree/Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering or Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE)
  • 5–8 years’ relevant experience, ideally within data centres, critical infrastructure, engineering consulting or technical solutions.
  • Fluent in MS Office (Power Point, Word, Excel) and good knowledge of BlueBeam and Basic AutoCad
  • Basic knowledge of CFD is an advantage but not required – this only applies if you’re mechanical trade
  • Analytical mindset
  • Good technical writing, documentation, and communication skills
  • Willing to learn, good attitude and proactive

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

job.title: Commercial Manager, Delivery - Global Switch
job.description:
About the Role

As Commercial Manager, Delivery, you must continually and critically monitor the procurement and commercial aspects of their projects and determine strategies and actions to mitigate commercial risk and protect profit margins. Furthermore, working collaboratively with the project teams, the Commercial Manager is responsible for providing input in finding opportunities through value engineering, programme logic and procurement decisions amongst other things, to enhance project profitability.

Working within projects, the Commercial Manager is responsible for liaising with Project Leads to ascertain information and provide accurate and timely submission of commercial information to enable the project monthly reports, to meet finance deadlines. The Commercial Manager will be responsible for managing cash flow and cost to complete forecasting for all projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead all commercial and contractual aspects throughout the tendering process, ensuring robust risk assessment, clear communication of requirements, and alignment with organisational objectives.
  • Conduct comprehensive risk assessments, pricing both technical and commercial risks, and evaluating contractual exposures to ensure tenders are competitive yet protective of the company’s interests.
  • Refine and optimise procurement strategies following contract award, leveraging market intelligence and lessons learned to improve contracting outcomes, supplier relationships, and value delivery.
  • Review and validate project scope, interfaces, contract conditions, and employer requirements prior to tendering, ensuring all documentation accurately reflects project needs.
  • Prepare and coordinate documentation for internal and external approvals, including Requests for Approval, Contract Approval Forms, and supporting schedules, ensuring all stakeholders are informed and aligned.
  • Track and analyse design and delivery performance of consultants and contractors, focusing on early indicators of potential issues and proactively addressing deviations from plan.
  • Maintain rigorous control over project budgets, ensuring all expenditures are tracked, justified, and aligned with financial objectives to maximise profitability.
  • Manage change control processes efficiently, ensuring all project changes are documented and approved in accordance with company procedures.
  • Support the selection and performance review of contractors and consultants, ensuring rigorous evaluation against technical, commercial, and compliance criteria.

About you

You’re a commercially astute and analytically strong professional with extensive experience managing the commercial and procurement aspects of complex construction or infrastructure projects. With a solid grounding in quantity surveying and contract management, you thrive in project‑based environments where protecting margin, managing risk, and driving value are critical. You bring a disciplined approach to cost control, cash flow management, forecasting, and reporting, ensuring commercial data is accurate, timely, and aligned with finance and governance requirements.

You work collaboratively with Project Leads, consultants, and contractors, contributing meaningful insight through tendering, procurement strategy, value engineering, and programme logic to enhance overall project profitability. Confident navigating complex contractual arrangements, you are comfortable leading commercial negotiations, resolving disputes, and managing change control in line with company procedures. Clear, credible, and influential in your communication style, you can translate complex financial and technical information for a wide range of stakeholders, including senior leaders. Detail‑oriented, accountable, and improvement‑focused, you take ownership of commercial outcomes and are motivated by delivering high‑quality results that protect value and support long‑term business objectives.

Key Requirements:

  • Advanced and up-to-date knowledge of Quantity Surveying principles, including cost planning, value engineering and commercial management for complex construction and infrastructure projects.
  • Strong understanding of contract law, procurement frameworks, and industry regulations, including recent developments relevant to the sector.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships with clients, consultants, and contractors.
  • Expertise in identifying process inefficiencies and implementing best-practice solutions, leveraging benchmarking, lessons learned, and industry standards.
  • Exceptional accuracy in cost analysis, contract review, and compliance checks ensuring all commercial outputs are precise and reliable.
  • Demonstrated ability to take full responsibility for commercial deliverables and outcomes. Ensuring tasks are completed correctly and on time.
  • Strong decision-making skills under pressure, ensuring timely and correct execution of tasks.

About Global Switch

Global Switch -Job Applicant Privacy Policy

Date of publication: 06/01/2026

We at Global Switch manage our employer branding and recruitment process through our [career site](https://globalswitch-.teamtailor.com/) (the “Career Site”), and by using a related applicant tracking system.

In this privacy policy, we explain how we collect, use, and protect your personal data during the recruitment process via TeamTailor. The data controller is Global Switch, and this policy may be updated periodically.

Data We Collect

We may collect the following types of data:

  • Personal Information: Name, contact details, CV, cover letter, education, work history, LinkedIn profile, etc.
  • Application Data: Interview notes, assessments, references.
  • Special Category Data (if voluntarily provided): Health, ethnicity, gender, disability status.
  • Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information (via TeamTailor platform).

Candidates Submitted via Recruitment Agencies

If your application is submitted by a recruitment agency or third-party recruiter, we will process your personal data in the same way as if you had applied directly. The agency is responsible for ensuring they have obtained your consent to share your information with us.

We may:

  • Contact you directly to confirm your interest in the role.
  • Retain your data in accordance with our standard retention policy.
  • Share feedback with the agency regarding your application.

If you have concerns about how your data was shared, please contact the agency directly or reach out to us using the contact details below.

How We Use Your Data

We process your data to:

  • Manage your application and assess suitability.
  • Communicate with you during the recruitment process.
  • Comply with legal obligations (e.g., right to work checks).
  • Improve our recruitment practices and diversity monitoring (anonymised).

Legal Basis for Processing

We rely on:

  • Consent: For optional data (e.g., diversity info).
  • Contractual Necessity: To assess and process your application.
  • Legal Obligation: For compliance checks.
  • Legitimate Interests: To manage recruitment efficiently and securely.

Sharing Your Data

Your data may be shared with:

  • Internal HR and hiring managers.
  • Third-party service providers (e.g., TeamTailor, background check providers).
  • Legal or regulatory authorities if required.

All third parties are bound by confidentiality and data protection obligations.

International Transfers

If data is transferred outside the UK/EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place (e.g., Standard Contractual Clauses).

Data Security

We implement technical and organisational measures to protect your data, including encryption, access controls, and secure storage.

Data Retention

  • Unsuccessful applications: Retained for up to 6 months unless you consent to longer storage.
  • Successful applicants: Data retained in line with employment records.
  • You may request deletion at any time.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data.
  • Withdraw consent.
  • Object to or restrict processing.
  • Lodge a complaint with the ICO or relevant authority.

Contact Us

For questions or to exercise your rights, contact:

Recruitment@globalswitch.com

Updates to this Privacy policy

We update this privacy policy when necessary - for example, because we start processing your personal data in a new way, because we want to make the information even clearer to you, or if it’s necessary to do so in order to comply with applicable data protection laws.

We encourage you to regularly check this page for any changes. You can always check the top of this page to see when this privacy policy was last updated.

job.title: Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement
job.description:
• Shape procurement strategy across CDC's large-scale data centre development portfolio
  • Lead and grow a high-performing team of category-focused specialists
  • Newly created role; drive supplier performance, governance, and commercial outcomes

About Us

Established in 2007, CDC Data Centres is Australia and New Zealand’s leading operator of secure, world-class data centre facilities. CDC plays a unique role in the fabric of the nations in which we operate, and we take this responsibility very seriously.

With multiple facilities across Australia and New Zealand, CDC’s diversified operations provide large-scale secure data centre campuses that support co-location, dedicated and hyperscale compute environments, with all campuses interconnected with high-speed carrier grade networks.

At CDC, we are passionate about creating an inclusive workplace that promotes and values diversity. We believe that everyone’s unique experiences enable us to deliver meaningful benefits for our people, our clients and communities. Our mission is to attract, retain and grow the world’s best data centre team.

Our people are committed, tenacious and meticulous in supporting our customers. Together, we configure the landscape to meet the security, reliability, connectivity and sustainability needs for today and tomorrow.

About the Role

As the Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement, you will lead the procurement function supporting CDC's industry-leading data centre developments across Australia and New Zealand. Reporting to the Head of Commercial, you will provide strategic leadership across the end-to-end procurement lifecycle, ensuring the successful engagement of suppliers, contractors and long-lead equipment vendors critical to project delivery. Working closely with Engineering, Delivery, Finance, Legal and Commercial teams, you will drive procurement strategy, governance, and supplier performance, while leading a team of category-focused procurement specialists responsible for supporting some of CDC's most significant capital investments.

  • Lead and develop a team of category specialists across electrical, mechanical, and other key procurement categories.
  • Develop and execute procurement strategies that support CDC's development pipeline and long-term business objectives.
  • Oversee complex sourcing, tendering, evaluation and negotiation activities across major capital projects.
  • Establish and continuously improve procurement governance, processes, reporting and performance frameworks.
  • Partner with project, engineering and commercial teams to ensure procurement activities align with project schedules and budgets.
  • Drive supplier performance, capacity planning and risk management to support successful project delivery.
  • Provide commercial leadership and recommendations to senior stakeholders on critical procurement decisions.

What’s in it for you:

CDC offers excellent employment conditions and benefits such as:

  • CDC Academy - Make your mark by enhancing your professional development with the CDC Academy. Enrol in specialised training courses that will help you develop skills and ensure you thrive in your chosen career.
  • CDC Day - An additional day of paid leave dedicated to nurturing your health and wellbeing.
  • Parental Leave - Inclusive and above legislative tenure of parental leave entitlements to help you start, grow and care for your family.
  • Volunteer Leave - Make a meaningful difference with 2 days of volunteering leave for any cause or charity of your choice.
  • Employment Assistance Program - Be confident that you and your family are supported with access to our comprehensive Employee Assistance Program.
  • CDC Social Events - CDC’s offers staff and their family’s inclusive events that nurtures relationships, connection and friendships across the business. CDC hosts BBQs, family picnics and community events, bringing together CDC staff in different settings.

About You

You are an experienced procurement and commercial leader who thrives in complex project environments. Combining strong commercial acumen with a collaborative leadership style, you have a track record of building high-performing teams, influencing senior stakeholders and delivering strategic procurement outcomes. You excel at balancing commercial, technical and delivery priorities, and enjoy creating structure, governance and long-term supplier partnerships that enable business growth.

  • Significant experience in strategic procurement, sourcing, or commercial management within construction, infrastructure, engineering, utilities, data centres, or major capital projects.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing and developing procurement, commercial or project teams.
  • Strong expertise in procurement planning, tendering, supplier negotiations and commercial governance.
  • The ability to build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across technical, operational and executive functions.
  • Experience in managing high-value supplier relationships and driving supplier performance outcomes.
  • A strategic mindset with strong analytical, planning and problem-solving capabilities.

Essential:

Australian Citizenship with ability to obtain and maintain a NV1 Security Clearance.

How to Apply:

If you are looking for an opportunity to play a vital role in a fast-growing Australian Technology company and be part of our amazing team, please submit your resume and cover letter by clicking Apply.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences leads to innovation and success. We actively promote equality and strive to create a welcoming environment for all employees. We are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of our community and encourages everyone to bring their authentic selves to work.

job.title: IT System Engineer
job.description:
Make an impact at NTT Global Data Centers

Join NTT Global Data Centers and be part of a team that drives innovation and sustainability in the digital world. With over 150 data centers across more than 20 countries globally, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work on cutting-edge technology and transformative projects. Experience a collaborative, innovative, and inclusive workplace where your ideas are valued, and your growth is supported.

Your role at a glance

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on IT Systems Engineer to join our IT team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting, maintaining, and improving the organization's IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, security, and operational excellence across data centre and enterprise environments.

This role requires strong technical knowledge across servers, virtualization, networking, operating systems, cybersecurity, and cloud technologies. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, troubleshooting complex issues, and driving infrastructure improvement initiatives.

What we are looking for

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Manage and support enterprise IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, virtualization platforms, and operating systems.
  • Administer Windows Server and Linux environments.
  • Support virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper-V, or Nutanix.
  • Monitor system performance, capacity, availability, and security.
  • Perform system upgrades, patch management, and vulnerability remediation activities.
  • Support Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and identity management solutions.
  • Manage backup, recovery, and disaster recovery processes.
  • Support network infrastructure, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and wireless networks.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure-related incidents and service requests.
  • Work closely with cybersecurity teams to ensure compliance with security standards and policies.
  • Participate in infrastructure projects, system migrations, data centre deployments, and technology refresh initiatives.
  • Maintain technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and system configurations.
  • Collaborate with vendors and service providers to resolve technical issues and implement solutions.
  • Required Skills and Experience :
  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Minimum 5–8 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, System Administration, or IT Operations.
  • Strong knowledge of:

Windows Server administration Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy VMware, Hyper-V, or other virtualization platforms Enterprise storage and backup solutions Network technologies (TCP/IP, VLANs, Routing, Switching) Firewall technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, or Cisco Microsoft 365 and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)

  • Experience with vulnerability management and cybersecurity best practices.
  • Good understanding of ITIL processes and service management principles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.

Academic Qualifications and Certifications: Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) VMware Certified Professional (VCP) Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Administrator (PCNSA) ITIL Foundation Certification Microsoft Azure Administrator Associate

Who we are

As the third largest data center provider, we operate over 150 data centers in more than 20 countries and regions. We understand that every business – large and small – has its own unique needs and goals. We offer local-to-global data center expertise, aligned with our connected platform of AI-ready data centers to create solutions that enable our clients to seamlessly scale their digital businesses, anywhere and anytime.

NTT Global Data Centers is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

job.title: Director Materials and Manufacturing Planning
job.description:
Job Description

Vertiv is hiring a Director, Materials and Manufacturing Planning in Westerville, OH to lead delivery strategy, daily monitoring, and risk identification, with primary responsibility for delivery and inventory. This role drives operations within SIOP(Sales, Inventory, Operations & Planning), master scheduling, NPDI (New Product Development Introduction), and overall materials management strategy, governance, and continuous improvement. They will improve On-Time Delivery through planning and purchasing enhancements and lead inventory optimization programs. Alongside leadership, they will review, propose, and implement processes from Order to Delivery, including production planning, inventory parameters, and master data. They are responsible for formulating and executing the strategic plan to achieve operational goals.

Responsibilities

  • Organize overall delivery strategy and daily monitoring, risk identification; hold primary responsibility for overall delivery and inventory.
  • Be fully responsible for SIOP , Master Scheduling, NPDI and drive overall materials management strategy and tactics, governance and continuous improvement, Materials Planning and Inventory Control strategy, develop and improve processes and system requirements to improve efficiencies in the overall Materials Management area.
  • Be responsible for the inventory strategy and supporting plants in driving reduction programs.
  • Act as an expert and give directions to improve the overall SIOP, Planning and Purchasing processes with responsibilities between different functions.
  • Responsible for Business Unit Supply & Inventory planning (SIOP); facilitates interactions with Plants, Procurement and LOB during SIOP Process.
  • Lead and Organize SIOP from Materials management per product line.
  • Establish system job standards and organize general business training, share platform best practices.
  • Centrally manage platform-level tasks, such as common data maintenance and support, platform system planning and rollouts, and common Global business interfaces
  • Develop and implement master data quality programs for related planning attributes within our business system.
  • Develop and implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to drive over all improvements in the Inventory and planning areas.
  • Together with our IT organization identify, specify and prioritize business system and process improvements within the area of his responsibility.
  • Supporting the direction and the vital alignment and direct communication between material planning, regional purchasing, order management and customers.

Education & Certifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related discipline.
  • MBA or related advanced degree strongly preferred

Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience in Materials management and Inventory control
  • 8+ years managerial experience
  • Experience in a plant or manufacturing environment
  • Strong analytical skills and expert user at Microsoft Excel.
  • A strong business acumen
  • Ability to work within a matrix management environment
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively.
  • Process improvement skills
  • Project Management Skills - Ability to organize and schedule people and tasks
  • Excellent communications skills – written & verbal
  • Highly organized and can multi-task

Travel Requirements

Up to 25%

job.title: IT Data Analitics Specialist - Reporting
job.description:
Job Description

Who are we?

At Vertiv, we’re on a mission to empower the people that will power the future. From a simple swipe to life-changing medicines, from push notifications to generative AI. We design, manufacture, and service the products and solutions that keep the world connected. With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people.

We are currently seeking a IT Data Analitics Specialist - Reporting to join our dynamic team in Piove di Sacco (PD), Italy!

This role is intended for a highly skilled Senior Analytics & Report Developer with deep experience in Power BI, AWS QuickSight, Streamlit, strong mandatory SQL expertise, and modern data visualization practices.

The ideal candidate will play a critical role in designing, developing, and optimizing analytical dashboards, interactive applications, and data products that support business decision-making across the organization.

This role is central to our strategic journey from Power BI to AI-driven analytics, enabling broader Analytics capabilities alongside Power BI expertise for our relevant business use cases. This position requires a strong blend of technical expertise, analytical thinking, data storytelling, and stakeholder management.

What kind of work will you be doing?

_Reporting & Dashboard Development_

  • Design, develop, and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards, reports, and datasets.
  • Design, develop, and maintain AWS QuickSight dashboards, analyses, and datasets, leveraging the SPICE engine for high-performance analytics.
  • Build interactive Streamlit applications to support advanced analytics and data-driven workflows.
  • Translate business requirements into intuitive, visually compelling, and accurate reporting solutions.
  • Optimize report performance, data models, measures, and queries for scalability and speed.

_Data Modeling & Integration_

  • Develop efficient data models using best practices for semantic layers.
  • Leverage mandatory strong SQL expertise to write complex queries, optimize performance, and ensure data accuracy across all integration layers.
  • Integrate data from multiple sources (databases, APIs, Snowflake, AWS data services, etc.).
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to define and refine data structures enabling analytical consumption across both platforms.

_Business Partnership_

  • Partner with business users to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Provide training, guidance, and best practices for self-service reporting.
  • Present insights and analytical findings in clear, actionable terms to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support the organization's transition from traditional BI to AI-augmented analytics, identifying use cases where AI can enhance decision-making.

_Governance, Quality & Standards_

  • Ensure adherence to data visualization standards, governance policies, and security protocols across environments.
  • Implement version control, documentation, and lifecycle management for analytical assets.
  • Proactively identify data issues and drive remediation initiatives with cross-functional teams.

_Innovation & Continuous Improvement_

  • Evaluate and introduce new features in Power BI (Fabric, DAX advancements, etc.) and AWS QuickSight (ML Insights, QuickSight Q, Generative BI capabilities).
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting processes and leverage AI/ML for predictive and prescriptive analytics.
  • Drive adoption of modern, scalable analytics patterns, supporting the company's PowerBI-to-AI transformation journey.
  • Explore and implement generative AI capabilities within AWS QuickSight to enable natural language querying and automated insight generation for business users.

What will make you successful?

  • 5+ years of experience in BI/report development, with proven expertise in Power BI.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS QuickSight, including dashboard creation, dataset management, SPICE optimization, and analyses.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Streamlit for building interactive Python-based applications.
  • Expert-level knowledge of DAX, Power Query, data modeling, and visualization best practices.
  • Strong SQL knowledge is mandatory — the candidate must demonstrate expert-level proficiency in writing complex queries, performance tuning, and working with enterprise data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake).
  • Solid understanding of data governance, security, and report lifecycle management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex datasets.
  • Excellent communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Familiarity with cloud-based BI and AI/ML analytics platforms.

Nice to have

  • Experience with Python for data manipulation and integration with Streamlit.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric ecosystems.
  • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Data Analytics, AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner).
  • Experience with AWS QuickSight Q (natural language querying) and ML Insights for automated anomaly detection and forecasting.
  • Experience with generative AI tools and their application in business analytics.
  • Experience working in agile environments and using CI/CD tools for BI assets.
  • Background in enterprise reporting for Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial, or Operations.

We are looking for someone who has:

  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to translate technical topics into business language.
  • Attention to detail and passion for clean, intuitive design.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality output under tight timelines.
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for AI-driven innovation in analytics.

If YOU are the person we are looking for, feel free to apply and let's start drafting your future career in a healthy and growing environment.

job.title: Project Manager Services Manager
job.description:
Job Description

Job Description

Experienced Project Management Professional for Data Center with Tier 04 I&C Exp.

Required a highly accomplished Project Manager, an Electrical Engineer with over 15 years of expertise in data center infrastructure and engineering, specialized in the execution and optimization of Tier 4 mission-critical facilities. Experienced in I&C of PAC, CAC, and DG, Chiller, Electrical Panels, Liquid Cooling with a strong focus on implementing strategic project management frameworks to ensure seamless execution, regulatory compliance, and optimal resource utilization. With a comprehensive grasp of the full project lifecycle, from strategic planning and execution to commissioning with L1, L2, L3, L4, L5, ISAT Testing Experience is must. Should be conversant with execution in cost efficiency, risk mitigation, and uncompromising quality control and safety measures.

Responsibilities: -

•Spearheading the end-to-end execution of Tier 4 data center infrastructure projects, ensuring seamless design, construction, commissioning, and operations.

•Managing critical facility components, including Advanced Modular Cooling (AMC), Precision Air Conditioning (PAC), Cold Aisle Containment, Comfort Air Conditioning (CAC), and Air-Cooled Water and Cold Chillers

•Implementing best-in-class mission-critical facility management protocols to ensure 24/7 uptime, reliability, and energy efficiency.

•Driving project risk management strategies, ensuring adherence to industry standards (TIA-942, Uptime Institute, ASHRAE guidelines, and ISO 9001/27001 compliance).

•Leading cross-functional teams, vendor negotiations, and stakeholder coordination, ensuring seamless execution within scope, schedule, and budget constraints.

•Enforcing rigorous health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards, optimizing operational efficiency, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.

Technical: -

  • In-Depth knowledge of Electrical Engineering
  • Provide On-the-Job training and on-site direction to associates for assigned projects
  • Conduct field customer training for assigned projects as required
  • Communicate with Technical Support on equipment issues
  • integrating cutting-edge HVAC, electrical, and structural engineering solutions

Safety (MUST): -

  • Operate in a safe manner in accordance with published safety guidelines

job.title: Customer Relationship Specialist
job.description:
Job Description

JOB SUMMARY

The main function of this position is to ensure operational coverage and service coordination scheduling by reviewing, monitoring, and ensuring completion of all open work orders and service requests.  This includes assistance to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services and providing guidance and handling escalated scheduling / service issues.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Responsible for scheduling and dispatching all service events between Customer Engineers or Service Partners for an assigned territory.
  • Be willing to lead by example – be accountable and dependable, maintain a positive attitude, inspire others to go the extra mile to take care of Customers (internal/external) and achieve Operational Key Results (OKR).
  • Continuously monitor the scheduling efforts of the Regional scheduling team and report team statuses and action plans weekly to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services.
  • Act as a coach/mentor when communicating or addressing performance issues with the team.
  • Demonstrate the ability to remain calm and even-tempered during stressful situations.
  • Close coordination with the Manager, Customer Relationship Services of any behavioral or operational related issues. Present recovery plan(s) with multiple options that will allow the Manager, Customer Relationship Services to make informed decisions.
  • Actively seek and participate in continuous improvements initiatives that impact customer care and coordination of work.
  • Assist the Manager, Customer Relationship Services in the implementation of new processes/policies and systems.
  • Meet with scheduling team on a regular basis to review, coach and train on various Customer Service concerns and opportunities.
  • Handle escalated scheduling issues within the region, including but not limited to sales inquiries and assisting Customer Success Management and Coordinated Services scheduling.
  • Be available after hours to assist with escalations to meet customer/contract SLA (Service Level Agreement).
  • Generate standard and custom reports to monitor workload.
  • Proactively identify schedule risks and present options to resolve critical potential issues to the local team and Manager, Customer Relationship Services.
  • Ensure all billable work is being scheduled and executed and tickets are closed out in a timely basis.
  • Where practical, empower and direct the team to strategically schedule preventive maintenance visits to minimize/ cover costs for the company (take over Customer Engineer Scheduling or large account scheduling).
  • Ensure accurate documentation of all scheduling correspondence in tickets.
  • Maintain regional PTO schedule and ensure responsibilities are covered during absences.
  • Ensure performance results in BetterWorks monthly.
  • Provide content and assist Manager, Customer Relationship Services in quarterly BetterWorks one-on-one conversations related to job performance.
  • Promote recognition and submit positive feedback in BetterWorks and to the Manager, Customer Relationship Services.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee to perform this job.  Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

REQUIREMENTS

Minimum Qualifications:(education, experience level, knowledge, skills, certifications).

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration OR High school education with 5 years minimum same or similar work experience.
  • Minimum of 5 years customer service and coordination of service activities.
  • Self-motivated and possess the ability to lead and direct a diverse team.
  • Must be attentive, patient and strongly skilled in written and verbal communication; clear, professional, positive, and informative communication style.
  • High-level competence in multitasking, time management, organization, critical and analytical thinking, problem solving, and the ability to influence others are required.
  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment and be comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and customer needs.
  • Ability to persuade others in order to change undesirable behaviors and/or achieve the goals of the business.
  • Must be proficient in the business tools used to perform the job and have extensive knowledge of the businesses processes, people, and products.
  • Intermediate/advanced proficiency using Microsoft Excel software, including data analysis, pivot tables, etc.

POSITIONS ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS(travel, location, etc.)

  • Willing to work flexible hours, including before shift/after shift and weekends to support the business.
  • Reports in office full-time Monday-Friday (Westerville, Ohio)
