job.title: Technical lead II
job.description:
JOB PROFILE: Technical Lead II

What you will do

Johnson Controls is developing the next generation of smart and connected. Through a full range of systems and digital solutions, we make buildings smarter. A smarter building is safer, more comfortable, more efficient, and, ultimately, more sustainable.

One of our systems include Miller-Picking® and YORK® Custom Air Handling Units. These systems provide design flexibility that balances performance and economy without compromising quality. With a full line of standard, semi-custom and custom air handling units to choose from, we have a system perfectly aligned to any building's needs and budget.

As a Technical Lead within our sustaining software team, you will interface with internal customers supporting of our engineering, manufacturing, and sales tools. These tools help in managing the designing of units for manufacture through automated engineering rules processing. You will be a key contributor in the maintenance, design, and support of these solutions through process, architecture, and technology advancement.

In this role you will also be exposed to detailed engineering and manufacturing processes which will drive knowledge and experience gains across the business.

How you will do it

Participate in a team responsible for the design, development, testing, and documentation of software solutions across the business

Leverage previous experience to drive innovation in process and technologies used to maintain and develop the software systems.

Support internal customers from design to manufacture through timely and concise communications.

Lead and advise team on technical solutions to support the business.

Design, implement, and test software features and enhancements on a 2 week sprint cadence.

The candidate must be able work with and in the following environments: Microsoft Visual Studio 2022, C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, RESTful Services, Angular, WPF, WCF, Azure DevOps, Microsoft SQL Server and T-SQL are preferred.

The candidate must also have skills in client/server design, multi-tier design, object oriented methodologies, schema design, connectivity methodologies, GUI design & development, agile and waterfall practices(SCRUM/Kanban/SAFe).

To perform this job successfully, the candidate must/have:

-Strong math and/or engineering background.

  • Adhere to the Company’s Code of Conduct and Business Ethics Standards.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to work on more than one project at a time with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to mentor and train team on technical solutions.
  • Facilitate code reviews and recommend best practices.
  • Follow priority and direction for changes/additions to the application.
  • Flexibility to work within a variety of development and product teams.
  • Ability to assimilate and provide recommendations with new and emerging technologies.
  • High degree of interpersonal skills including both oral and written communication.
  • Communicate status of projects and application stability.
  • Communicate effectively with personnel to convert customer requirements into product specifications.
  • Must be able to communicate and understand technical material produced by engineers, programmers, designers,

drafters, and product management personnel.

  • Proficiency with Windows operating systems and MS Office Suite

What we look for

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field
  • 10+ years programming experience in .Net, C#, .Net Core, Angular, SQL, Azure DevOps Cloud, GitHub
  • C#, Visual C++ or other high-level language is recommended
  • 3+ years of experience leading a team of full stack developers in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise applications.
  • Expertise in Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies.
  • 5 years of experience with Business Process Automation
  • Must have strong problem-solving communication skills
  • Ability to travel up to 30%

Johnson Controls International plc. is an equal employment opportunity and affirmative action employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, protected veteran status, genetic information, status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information, please view [EEO is the Law](https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/poster_screen_reader_optimized.pdf?_sm_au_=iVV2tB0sQQSBTDWHkpQ8jKtB7ckcW). If you are an individual with a disability and you require an accommodation during the application process, please visit [www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers](http://www.johnsoncontrols.com/careers).

job.title: Category Manager, Field Material, Japan
job.description:
How you will do it:

Strategic Sourcing & Supplier Management

  • Identify, evaluate, and develop qualified suppliers to strengthen and continuously improve the local and regional supply base.
  • Manage strategic supplier relationships to ensure supply continuity, quality, delivery, and cost competitiveness.
  • Lead supplier performance management activities, including regular business reviews, corrective action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Cost Optimization & Business Support

  • Collaborate closely with engineering, project, and operations teams to drive value engineering and cost reduction initiatives.
  • Support the bidding and proposal process by providing market intelligence, sourcing strategies, and competitive supplier solutions.
  • Drive productivity and working capital improvement initiatives through effective sourcing, inventory optimization, and payment term management.

Category Strategy Deployment

  • Partner with regional and global Category Managers to develop and execute category strategies aligned with local business requirements.
  • Ensure effective implementation of procurement strategies, processes, and compliance standards within the local organization.
  • Provide market insights and supplier intelligence to support strategic decision-making.

Stakeholder Management & Transformation

  • Act as a trusted business partner to local stakeholders, driving procurement transformation and change management initiatives.
  • Foster strong collaboration between procurement, engineering, project management, and business leaders across Japan and the broader APAC region.
  • Influence stakeholders and suppliers to achieve business objectives and procurement targets.

主な業務内容

戦略的調達・サプライヤーマネジメント

  • 日本および地域市場におけるサプライヤーベースの強化・改善のため、適格なサプライヤーを特定・評価・開拓する
  • 供給安定性、品質、納期、コスト競争力を確保するため、戦略的サプライヤーとの関係を管理する
  • 定期的なビジネスレビュー、是正措置計画（CAPA）、継続的改善活動を通じてサプライヤーパフォーマンスを向上させる

コスト最適化・事業支援

  • エンジニアリング、プロジェクト、オペレーション部門と連携し、バリューエンジニアリングやコスト削減施策を推進する
  • 市場情報、調達戦略、および競争力のあるサプライヤーソリューションを提供し、入札・提案活動を支援する
  • 効果的な調達活動、在庫最適化、支払条件管理を通じて、生産性向上および運転資本改善を推進する

カテゴリー戦略の展開

  • APAC地域およびグローバルのCategory Managerと協力し、ローカルビジネスのニーズに合致したカテゴリー戦略策定および実行する
  • 調達戦略、業務プロセス、およびコンプライアンス基準を社内に適切に導入・運用する
  • 戦略的意思決定を支援するため、市場動向やサプライヤー情報を提供する

ステークホルダーマネジメント・組織変革

  • 社内顧客の信頼できるビジネスパートナーとして、調達改革やチェンジマネジメントを推進する
  • 日本およびAPAC地域の調達、エンジニアリング、プロジェクトマネジメント、事業リーダーとの強固な協働体制の構築
  • ステークホルダーやサプライヤーに働きかけ、事業目標および調達目標の達成を支援する

job.title: Customer Success Manager, Data Center Delivery
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

About DayOne DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across nine markets in APAC and Europe. We raised US$4.5B in Series C funding and are in active build across the region. As DayOne's footprint grows across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, the client relationships behind that infrastructure need the same level of accountability as the build itself — this role owns that.

Across Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, and Hong Kong, DayOne operates some of the region's most active hyperscale campuses — from Johor's largest LEED-certified data center footprint to Thailand's build toward its first 1GW platform. This role can be based in any of these markets, working alongside local delivery teams on live client accounts.

About the Role

You'll serve as the primary point of contact for customers across project delivery and ongoing service operations, owning outcomes from initial construction through to live SLA performance. This is a senior, cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of project management, technical delivery, and client relationship management. You'll lead virtual delivery teams, manage the full lifecycle of data center construction and customization projects, and be accountable for service quality once the facility is live.

Client Relationship and Delivery Ownership

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customers across all aspects of project delivery and ongoing service operations.
  • Build trust-based client relationships and act as a strategic advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Manage service delivery in line with SLAs and agreed delivery costs, leading a virtual delivery team to drive customer satisfaction.

Project Delivery

  • Lead data center construction and customization projects end to end, working closely with Sales, Presales, Design, Construction, and Testing and Commissioning teams.
  • Manage project schedules, quality, costs, risks, and escalations through to timely closure and customer acceptance.
  • Coordinate internal resources for both project implementation and service operations in line with company standards and customer requirements.

Service Operations and Continuous Improvement

  • Manage SLA performance and customer satisfaction during the ongoing operations phase, working with data center operations, network, and IT service teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement and proactive risk mitigation across live service delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with internal processes including procurement, audit requirements, and ITIL standards.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • 7 or more years of experience in the data center industry, MEP consultancy, or construction, with direct exposure to project delivery and client management.
  • Strong understanding of data center infrastructure, ITIL frameworks, and SLA management.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects across the full delivery lifecycle, from construction through to live operations.
  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Fluent in Mandarin and English, required for client and stakeholder engagement across DayOne's Mandarin-speaking customer base.

Soft Skills

  • Manages client relationships with the credibility of a trusted advisor, not just a delivery coordinator.
  • Mediates competing priorities and stakeholder conflicts without losing sight of the customer outcome.
  • Communicates clearly in writing, producing reports and updates that keep clients and internal teams aligned without follow-up questions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing hyperscale or mission-critical data center accounts across multiple markets simultaneously.
  • Exposure to cross-border or multi-entity service delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with data center construction customization and handover processes.

Why DayOne? DayOne is expanding fast across Southeast Asia and Hong Kong, and this role sits at the center of how that expansion lands with clients. You'll own the full relationship, from construction through to live SLA performance, work across some of the most technically demanding infrastructure in the region, and have real cross-functional scope from day one.

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

job.title: Manager, Compliance
job.description:
Join DayOne – Shaping the Future of Data Infrastructure

DayOne is a global leader in the development and operation of high-performance data centers. As one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry, we’ve built a robust presence across Asia and Europe — and we’re just getting started.

As we expand into new international markets, we’re looking for talented, driven individuals to join us on this exciting journey. This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to be a key contributor to our dynamic team and help shape the future of global data infrastructure.

If you're passionate about innovation, technology, and growth, we invite you to be part of DayOne’s next chapter.

Job Summary

The Manager, Compliance is a senior individual contributor who serves as a key deputy to the Director, Compliance. The role leads the design, implementation and ongoing enhancement of the company’s global corporate compliance programme, with particular emphasis on compliance risk assessment, policy and procedure development, governance reporting, and oversight of core compliance processes.

Working independently and collaboratively across jurisdictions and business functions, the Manager translates regulatory and ethical requirements into practical controls and helps foster a culture of integrity across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Compliance Risk Assessment: Spearhead global compliance risk assessments by working with subject-matter experts and business units to identify, evaluate and prioritise compliance risks. Develop risk methodologies, dashboards and heat maps, track mitigation actions, and prepare clear updates for senior management, the Risk Committee and the Board.
  • Policies and Procedures: Lead the review, drafting, creation, implementation and ongoing maintenance of compliance policies, procedures and desk instructions. Provide practical guidance to business teams and monitor key policy areas, including conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, related-party transactions, personal account dealing and insider trading.
  • Compliance Registers and Controls: Establish and oversee key compliance registers, including conflicts of interest, related-party transactions, and gifts and hospitality. Ensure declarations are assessed, decisions and conditions are documented, periodic reviews are completed, and issues are escalated and resolved appropriately.
  • Screening and Monitoring Oversight: Oversee risk-based screening and ongoing monitoring of vendors, customers and other third parties in collaboration with onboarding teams. Review higher-risk findings, adverse information, sanctions and politically exposed person matches, determine appropriate risk treatment, and ensure monitoring requirements are documented and completed.
  • Regulatory and Requirements Monitoring: Monitor and interpret emerging local and international laws, regulations and standards affecting the business. Assess their impact and partner with relevant functions to implement requirements across the company’s jurisdictions.
  • Training and Advisory: Develop and deliver practical compliance training for employees and management. Advise stakeholders on the application of policies and coordinate recurring training, attestations, and completion tracking.
  • Incident Management and Investigations: Lead or support investigations into suspected compliance breaches and whistleblower reports. Maintain appropriate audit trails, conduct root-cause analysis, recommend corrective actions, track remediation and liaise with relevant authorities when required.
  • Programme Development and Collaboration: Support the Director, Compliance in building a scalable global compliance function. Work closely with Legal, Risk, Finance, Procurement, onboarding teams and other stakeholders, while providing guidance to colleagues responsible for day-to-day compliance operations.

Requirements and Qualifications

  • Education: A recognised bachelor’s degree in law, business, finance, audit, risk management or a related field. A law degree may be helpful for regulatory interpretation and drafting but is not required.
  • Experience: Approximately 8–12 years of progressive experience in core corporate compliance, compliance risk, operational risk, audit or a closely related field, with demonstrated ability to operate independently and lead complex compliance work.
  • Risk Assessment: Substantial hands-on experience designing, conducting, and reporting compliance risk assessments. Experience translating assessments into dashboards, heat maps, action plans and senior governance reporting is strongly preferred.
  • Policy and Governance: Strong experience drafting policies and procedures and communicating complex requirements in clear, precise English. Experience preparing materials for senior management, risk committees or Boards is highly advantageous.
  • Industry Background: Experience in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry is preferred. Candidates from multinational, pharmaceutical, medical, manufacturing or other sectors will be considered where they can demonstrate extensive compliance risk-assessment and core compliance experience.
  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of corporate governance, third-party risk, sanctions and AML screening, and relevant data privacy requirements such as GDPR and PDPA. Cross-border or multi-jurisdictional experience is advantageous.
  • Capabilities: Excellent analytical judgement, problem-solving, stakeholder management, writing and communication skills. Highly organised, ethical and discreet, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and handle sensitive information.
  • Ways of Working: A responsible, driven and collaborative team player who can work with limited supervision, take ownership of outcomes and contribute effectively in a growing function.

Added Advantage

  • Practical experience using artificial intelligence to improve compliance processes, analysis or reporting. Experience with agentic AI capabilities would be a significant advantage but is not a mandatory requirement.

job.title: Director, Water Infrastructure Strategy
job.description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?

AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.

Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…

Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.

A Snapshot

At AirTrunk, we’ve all come together to deliver Data Centres that meet and grow with the needs of our large cloud, content and enterprise customers.

Water management is a key pillar of our sustainability commitments. We design and operate our Data Centers to source water responsibly, reduce reliance on potable water where appropriate, limit usage in water-stressed areas and improve water productivity to support energy, carbon and community outcomes. Through strong water stewardship, we seek to balance business growth with catchment-level resilience, responsible resource use and measurable sustainability impact.

In this leadership role, you will define and lead AirTrunk’s water strategy across the portfolio, managing a team of managers to deliver sustainable, commercially robust and operationally resilient water outcomes.

You will make your mark in a number of ways:

  • Set and own the regional water strategy for Data Center sites, ensuring scalable, sustainable and resilient water supply solutions across existing and future markets.
  • Lead, coach and develop a team of managers responsible for utility connections, upgrades, alternative supply options, water infrastructure delivery and site-level optimisation.
  • Oversee portfolio-wide assessment of water stress, supply risk and regulatory conditions, translating insights into long-term strategic plans and investment priorities.
  • Build executive-level partnerships with utilities, authorities, customers and solution providers to unlock recycled, industrial and alternative water sourcing opportunities.
  • Define the roadmap to water positivity, including on-site and off-site water solutions, reuse strategies, discharge optimisation and measurable sustainability outcomes.
  • Develop and implement a water stewardship framework that aligns site-level water decisions with regional sustainability objectives, local catchment conditions, stakeholder expectations and long-term operational resilience.
  • Establish governance, performance metrics and reporting cadence for water usage, metering, efficiency, risk management and delivery performance across the portfolio.
  • Influence design, site selection, development, commercial and operations decisions to ensure water strategy is embedded into major business and customer commitments.

Your Day to Day

  • Lead a team of managers, setting priorities, removing barriers, allocating resources and ensuring consistent delivery across markets and projects.
  • Represent AirTrunk with senior utility, government, customer and strategic partner stakeholders to shape water supply, infrastructure and sustainability outcomes.
  • Provide executive oversight of water projects, including supply connections and upgrades, infrastructure investments, commercial contracts, risk mitigation and delivery milestones.
  • Partner with customers at senior levels to understand water requirements, influence commitments and ensure AirTrunk’s water strategy supports customer growth and sustainability expectations.
  • Translate water sustainability strategy into practical implementation plans, including recycled water adoption, water reuse, efficiency initiatives, catchment partnerships, performance targets and transparent reporting.
  • Work with Design, Site Selection, Development, Commercial and Operations leaders to align water decisions with business strategy, technical requirements and long-term operating performance.
  • Prepare and present executive-level recommendations, investment papers, governance updates and performance reports for senior leadership forums.
  • Establish operating rhythms for the team, including portfolio reviews, cross-functional escalation, performance tracking and continuous improvement of water strategy delivery.

Requirements

  • Minimally 10 years of relevant experience e.g. water utilities, water project development and delivery, water sustainability water infrastructure services, water consulting, water treatment and recycled water, etc.
  • Strong understanding of the water supply landscape in several of our Asia-Pacific and Japan markets (including Singapore, Malaysia, Australia, Hong Kong and Japan)
  • Strong expertise in water supply design principles and various water technologies such as water treatment/recycling/recovery/capture
  • Relationships and networks in the water industry in the above markets
  • Strong analytical thinking and comfortable with data analysis and presentation (especially in PowerPoint and Excel)
  • Provide leadership, mentoring, and technical guidance to the regional team.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multiple concurrent large-scale projects or programs.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, leadership, and problem-solving skills. Ie. Build and maintain strong working relationships with consultants, contractors, suppliers, customer representatives, and internal stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.

The AirTrunk Culture

Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.

The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.

Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.

Now’s your chance to [Grow@Hyperscale](mailto:Grow@Hyperscale).

To all recruitment agencies: AirTrunk does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, AirTrunk employees or any other organisation location. AirTrunk is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

job.title: Intern, Accounting and Finance Services
job.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

About the Internship

This internship goes beyond traditional finance operations by providing opportunities to participate in finance transformation, process governance, Shared Service Centre (SSC) oversight, data analytics, automation and AI initiatives.

The intern will work closely with stakeholders to improve finance processes, strengthen controls and support the digitalisation of finance operations.

Scope of Exposure

The responsibilities and learning opportunities described below represent potential areas of exposure during the internship. Actual assignments will be determined based on business priorities, project availability and operational needs during the internship period. While every effort will be made to provide a meaningful and well-rounded experience, interns may be exposed to only some of the areas listed and their responsibilities may evolve based on ongoing business requirements and projects.

Key Responsibilities

Finance Operations & Reporting

  • Support month-end, quarter-end and year-end finance activities.
  • Assist in the preparation, review and analysis of financial information and management reports.
  • Support accounting processes and financial reporting activities.
  • Perform data extraction, reconciliations and validation exercises.
  • Assist in documenting finance processes, workflows and standard operating procedures.

Process Improvement, Automation & AI

  • Participate in the design and implementation of automation and AI-enabled solutions for finance processes.
  • Conduct process reviews to identify inefficiencies, manual activities and opportunities for digitalisation.
  • Assist in developing dashboards, analytical tools and automation solutions to improve productivity, controls and reporting.

Compliance, Controls & Data Analytics

  • Perform data analysis to identify policy non-compliance, control exceptions and unusual transaction patterns.
  • Support monitoring activities through review of transactional data and key risk indicators.
  • Assist in developing management reports and dashboards that provide insights into compliance, operational performance and process effectiveness.

Shared Service Centre (SSC) Governance & Quality Review

  • Support the review and validation of work performed by the Shared Service Centre (SSC) to ensure completeness, accuracy and compliance with established procedures.
  • Perform quality checks on SSC deliverables before final approval by Keppel process owners or team leads.
  • Assist in reviewing Master Data Management (MDM) requests by validating supporting documentation, data accuracy and compliance with governance requirements.
  • Identify exceptions, recurring issues and process gaps, and escalate observations to the relevant stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Work with stakeholders on operational and transformation initiatives.
  • Gather business requirements, document feedback and support implementation of improvement projects.
  • Prepare analysis papers, presentations and management updates for decision-making and governance discussions.

What You Will Learn

During the internship, you will gain hands-on exposure to:

Accounting & Finance Operations

  • End-to-end finance processes including Record-to-Report (R2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Order-to-Cash (O2C).
  • Financial reporting, reconciliations and finance operations in a large corporate environment.

Data Analytics & Business Insights

  • Techniques for analysing large datasets to identify trends, anomalies, control weaknesses and compliance gaps.
  • Development of management dashboards and performance reporting.

AI & Automation in Finance

  • Practical experience in identifying and implementing automation opportunities.
  • Exposure to AI tools, workflow automation projects.
  • Understanding how technology can enhance efficiency, controls, governance and decision-making within finance functions.

Shared Services Governance & Performance Management

  • Understanding how organisations govern and oversee Shared Service Centre operations.
  • Exposure to quality assurance reviews, management approvals and control monitoring activities.
  • Experience in reviewing SSC deliverables, service performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives.

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Application of finance policies, internal controls and governance frameworks.
  • Experience in identifying risks, monitoring compliance and supporting audit activities.

Professional & Business Skills

  • Stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration.
  • Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
  • Business communication, presentation and project management skills.
  • Participation in real business transformation initiatives.

This internship is ideal for students interested in combining Finance, Data Analytics, Governance, Shared Services Management, Automation and AI to solve real business challenges and drive meaningful improvements across finance operations.

job.title: Senior ICT Server Infrastructure Project Engineer (Australia)
job.description:
Company Overview

STACK Infrastructure builds, owns, and operates hyperscale and colocation data centers that power the world’s most ambitious technology companies. With a rapidly expanding footprint across APAC, STACK combines deep development expertise, flexible capital, and operational discipline to deliver critical digital infrastructure at scale.

Our clients include the largest hyperscale cloud platforms. We are building a regional platform defined by speed of delivery, power reliability, and long-term partnership — and we are assembling the team to lead that effort.

Summary/Objective

STACK is seeking an experienced Senior ICT Server Infrastructure Project Engineer to lead the design, deployment, commissioning and operational handover of highly available server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure for new data centre projects. Reporting to the Senior Manager, ICT Engineering, this delivery-focused role requires strong System Integrator project experience and hands-on expertise in server hardware, SAN/NAS storage, virtualisation and clustered platforms.

Key Responsibility

  • Support the OT Engineering team to design highly available, fault-tolerant platforms, including VMware vSphere clusters, Microsoft Hyper-V failover clusters, and SAN/NAS storage layouts.
  • Work closely with the OT Engineering team to produce compute and storage sizing calculations, hardware Bills of Materials, rack elevations, and cabling/port schedules for server, storage and virtualisation builds for new project tenders.
  • Manage and coordinate with ICT vendors to ensure the intended server, storage and virtualisation design for the campus is successfully deployed to meet project timelines.
  • Develop and execute test scripts for server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure Testing & Commissioning, including HA/failover, replication, backup/restore and performance validation.
  • Oversee the transition and successful handover of Network, Server and Storage services to operations and support teams.

Qualification and required technical and working experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Information Technology or Computer Science.
  • At least five years of hands-on experience within a System Integrator project-delivery team, delivering successful implementations of server, storage and virtualisation infrastructure for data centres or large, complex IT infrastructure projects.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of server hardware architecture, including Dell PowerEdge, HPE ProLiant, Cisco UCS or Lenovo, and out-of-band management.
  • Core skills in enterprise SAN/NAS storage arrays, with hands-on experience across NetApp ONTAP and/or Pure Storage FlashArray.
  • Strong virtualisation skills across VMware and Microsoft Hyper-V, including clustering, HA, DRS, vMotion, Live Migration and Hyper-V Replica.

Equal Opportunity Employer

STACK provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.

job.title: Commercial & Procurement Manager, Korea
job.description:
Date: 27 Aug 2026

Location:

KR

Company: Digital Edge DC

Who we are

Where performance meets sustainability, Digital Edge is a leading data center platform in Asia Pacific, delivering sustainable, next-generation, AI-ready digital infrastructure at scale. Headquartered in Singapore and backed by Stonepeak, we operate a rapidly expanding platform with over 30 data centers and 1.8GW of secured IT power across key markets.

Since our founding in 2020, we have rapidly scaled across key Asia markets, operating 31 data centers with over 1.8GW of secured IT power. We operate as a regional platform delivering consistent global standards, combining scale with strong local execution across every market.

This role is an exciting opportunity to join our fast-growing team as we further expand our footprint across Asia.**

**

Our values:

**

  • Respect: We embrace diversity and collaboration.
  • Innovation: We share ideas and solve problems.
  • Strive: We are driven and determined.
  • Excellence: We seek to deliver the best.
  • Responsibility: We do what’s right for our people and the planet.

What we need:

**

About the role

We are seeking a Commercial & Procurement Manager to join our Design & Construction (D&C) team in Korea. This role is responsible for commercial governance and cost control on data center construction projects in-country. The role operates under minimal supervision, manages local external consultants and works closely with internal stakeholders from early design through construction close-out.

You will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Project Delivery, and Corporate Development to ensure cost certainty, contractual compliance, and risk mitigation across all projects.

This role will be based in Seoul Metro, Korea and will report to the Regional Commercial Lead.

Key responsibilities

**

  • Commercial Strategy & Governance
  • Apply the platform commercial management framework locally, covering cost planning, contracting models (GMP, cost-plus, hybrid), procurement strategy and risk management.
  • Provide commercial input during feasibility and early design stages, ensuring budgets, benchmarks, and cash-flow forecasts align with project and business objectives.
  • Maintain comprehensive, audit-ready records of all contract documentation, commercial correspondence, and amendments.
  • Drive consistent implementation of the commercial playbook, processes, and reporting frameworks across the Korea portfolio and ensure alignment with commercial standards.Contract Management & Risk Control
  • Drive end-to-end contract administration - from pre-contract strategy, tender review support, and commercial negotiations to final account settlement across all D&C projects in Korea.
  • Administer major EPC, D&B, and framework agreements, including change-order management, claims avoidance, and dispute resolution.
  • Monitor commercial risk exposure across all projects and escalate issues with clear mitigation plans.
  • Tendering & Procurement
  • Request fee proposals from multi-disciplinary consultants, evaluate submissions, recommend suitable candidates to Management and manage the onboarding of successful consultants.
  • Liaise with consultants throughout the tendering exercise, including strategizing tender packages and evaluating the suitability of the Form of Contract and specific conditions of tendering.
  • Review tender and contract documents prepared by consultants.
  • Oversee tendering exercise carried out by consultants, including reviewing tender reports, attending tender interviews, negotiating, and finalizing tender recommendation with supporting documentation for internal approval processes and follow-up to obtain sign-off.
  • Cost Planning & Reporting
  • Lead local cost planning and benchmarking for all major construction and MEP packages.
  • Liaise with the consultant QS to obtain the monthly project financial statement for reporting purposes and follow up on payments submitted by contractors and consultants.
  • Maintain a standardized reporting dashboard tracking CAPEX burn, S+X months vs. T+X months spend buckets, forecast-to-complete, and variance analysis, providing leadership with clear portfolio-wide visibility.
  • Review the Statement of Final Accounts prepared by consultants.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Act as the primary in-country point of commercial contact for Engineering, Project Delivery, and Operations, ensuring design-to-budget alignment.
  • Support Corporate Development / Finance on funding calls and cash-flow management by providing accurate spend projections and scenario modelling.
  • Partner with Supply Chain to ensure sourcing strategies and vendor selections meet D&C technical and schedule requirements.
  • Support due diligence and business case development for new investment opportunities in Korea, in coordination with Corporate Development and Regional teams
  • Interface with JV partners, lenders, and hyperscale customers on commercial matters and reporting.

Actively champion and implement the organization’s policies on health & safety, environment, energy, quality, information security, and business continuity, ensuring adherence to incident reporting, legal, and regulatory requirements.

The successful candidate:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or related discipline.
  • 5+ years of commercial management experience in data-center, mission-critical infrastructure, or major construction projects, with a track record of working independently and delivering results under minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge of contract law, cost control methodologies, and procurement frameworks.
  • Familiarity with international contract standards (e.g., FIDIC) and local construction norms.
  • Excellent negotiation, stakeholder management, and executive reporting skills.
  • RICS, MRICS, or equivalent commercial management certification preferred.
  • This role is based in Seoul and requires flexibility to travel to project sites as needed.

Join us to shape the future of Digital Infrastructure in Asia. Apply now for a confidential career discussion.

job.title: Sales Operations & Support Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

Join a High-Performance Culture That Drives Innovation and Excellence

At Vertiv, we don’t just hire talent—we cultivate leaders who drive innovation and engage teams to push the limits of what’s possible. As a global leader in critical digital infrastructure, we are scaling up to meet the demands of AI, data centers, and next-gen technology—and we need bold, high-performing individuals like YOU to take us to the next level.

Why Vertiv?

  • High-Performance Culture: We empower you to think big, execute with excellence, and deliver impact. Our performance-driven mindset rewards those who challenge the status quo and drive meaningful change. Over 50 CEO Awards are given annually to recognize top talent moving the needle forward.
  • Leadership Without Limits: Leadership at Vertiv goes beyond just titles—it’s about accountability, trust, and ownership. Our leaders engage and drive with collaboration, innovation, and customer-centric thinking, setting the foundation for an action-focused culture.
  • Limitless Growth & Learning: We believe in continuous development. Whether through rotational programs or high-impact projects, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your expertise and grow your career.
  • A Place for Everyone: Our commitment to inclusion ensures that all employee’s unique strengths and perspectives are valued. Your voice matters, your growth is prioritized, and your success is celebrated.

Position Summary

The Sales Operations & Support Analyst for Sales Contracts is an entry-level professional role responsible for developing, maintaining, and enhancing reporting solutions that support Sales Contract operations. Using AppSheet, Smartsheet, Power BI, and approved AI-enabled tools, the role develops and maintains dashboards, trackers, reports, and automated workflows that provide visibility into contract status, operational performance, workload, and team metrics.

The analyst applies foundational analytical and technical skills to develop standardized and AI-assisted reporting solutions, maintain automation logic, and validate data accuracy across operational systems. Working within established frameworks and under guidance, the role leverages available AI and automation capabilities to enhance reporting outputs, identify data issues and trends, and progressively develop greater ownership of assigned reporting solutions.

The position develops technical competence in business analytics, AI-augmented automation, low-code/no-code solution development, and data visualization within Vertiv's global Sales Operations environment. The role provides a foundation for progressively taking on more complex reporting, automation, and analytical responsibilities while supporting accurate, timely, and reliable operational reporting.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Build, maintain, and enhance dashboards, trackers, and automated reports using AppSheet, Smartsheet, Power BI, and other approved reporting tools to present key performance indicators and operational trends to support Supervisor- and Manager-led analysis.
  • Extract, consolidate, and validate data from designated source systems to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of reporting outputs delivered to management.
  • Monitor reporting outputs and identify data anomalies, inconsistencies, or recurring issues that may impact reporting accuracy, escalating concerns to the appropriate process or functional owner.
  • Maintain reporting records, transaction data, project logs, and supporting documentation to ensure data traceability, reporting continuity, and audit readiness.
  • Develop and maintain automated workflows and leverage available AI-enabled capabilities to reduce manual effort and improve the timeliness and reliability of reporting.
  • Create and maintain reporting and process documentation to support standardized reporting practices, knowledge transfer, and consistent use of reporting tools across supported functions.
  • Develop and refine data visualizations, dashboards, process flows, and other communication tools that present operational information clearly and effectively for Supervisors, Managers, and leadership.

Qualifications

  • Experience with reporting tools, dashboards, or workflow automation is an advantage.
  • Education:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field preferred.
  • Equivalent relevant experience, technical training, or demonstrated skills may be considered in place of a degree.
  • Technical Skills:

  • Basic knowledge of Excel data functions, data organization, and reporting; familiarity with Power BI, Smartsheet, or AppSheet is an advantage.
  • Comfortable working with data sets, generating reports, validating information, and presenting data through basic visualizations.
  • Familiarity with databases, dashboards, CRM, or enterprise systems such as Oracle or Salesforce is an advantage.
  • Interest in learning low-code/no-code platforms, workflow automation, and AI-enabled reporting tools.
  • Ability to follow established technical procedures, maintain system documentation, and learn new applications and reporting tools.

job.title: Application Engineering Analyst
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Application Engineering Analyst provides technical sales support for the Switchgear and Busbar business by reviewing, validating, and approving Engineer-to-Order (ETO) Workbench and K2 pricing requests. This role manages quotation activities, pricing approvals, proposal documentation, and workflow coordination while collaborating closely with the North America Global Strategic Accounts (GSA) team, Inside Sales Representatives, Engineering, and other cross-functional stakeholders. The position ensures accurate and timely execution, compliance with pricing policies, and effective support of business objectives while delivering a high level of customer service and operational excellence.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review, validate, and approve Engineer-to-Order Workbench requests and K2 pricing transactions.
  • Process change requests and verify pricing details submitted through Configure, Price, Quote notes and proposal documentation.
  • Ensure pricing accuracy, consistency, and compliance with company policies and approval processes.
  • Support the North America sales organization in achieving customer commitments and business objectives.
  • Coordinate with Global Strategic Accounts, Inside Sales, Engineering, and other stakeholders to gather technical and commercial requirements.
  • Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Assist with project tracking and status reporting.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of requests, approvals, and project records.
  • Provide timely status updates and communicate effectively with stakeholders regarding approvals and pricing activities.
  • Ensure timely completion of assigned workload while maintaining service-level expectations.
  • Prepare and maintain transaction records, trackers, reports, and dashboards.
  • Participate in team meetings, information cascades, and knowledge-sharing activities.
  • Assist with special projects, business reviews, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives and operational excellence programs.
  • Support training and knowledge transfer activities for team members.
  • Serve as backup support for related functions to ensure business continuity.
  • Contribute to cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives as required.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in electrical systems, power distribution, switchgear, busbar, busway, data center operations, manufacturing, facilities, construction, design, or field service.
  • Minimum of one year of experience in customer service, technical sales support, or a related commercial support role.
  • Ability to interpret electrical drawings, specifications, and technical documentation.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with pricing, quotation, or proposal management systems.
  • Familiarity with Engineer-to-Order processes and Configure, Price, Quote platforms.
  • Exposure to North American sales operations or Global Strategic Accounts environments.
  • Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • Strong interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • No specific demands.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • No Specific demands

job.title: Operations Finance Senior Analyst
job.description:
About the Role

This is a core plant finance role — you'll be sitting at the plant, working closely with operations, and owning the numbers that drive manufacturing performance. From tracking hourly rates to building the factory P&L, you'll be the finance partner the plant relies on daily. If you've worked in a manufacturing setup and enjoy being close to the action, this is your kind of role.

Key Responsibilities

1.  Factory P&L Ownership

  • Prepare and maintain the monthly Factory P&L for the Ambernath Annex — IS & Switchgear Factory
  • Track fixed vs. variable costs, analyse deviations, and flag margin risks early
  • Ensure timely and accurate monthly cost closure

2.  Hourly Rate Tracking & Analysis

  • Capture, compute, and monitor the plant hourly rate (cost per hour) on a monthly basis
  • Analyse movement in hourly rates — volume-driven vs. cost-driven variances
  • Present hourly rate trends and bridge analysis to plant leadership

3.  Plant KPIs & Operational Excellence

  • Own and report key plant KPIs — Efficiency %, Productivity %, Earned Hours, Conversion Cost per Hour
  • Drive Plant Operational Excellence by partnering with operations to identify cost levers and track improvement actions
  • Prepare monthly plant performance scorecards

4.  Productivity Savings

  • Track and validate productivity savings initiatives at the plant level
  • Maintain a savings tracker with clear project-wise breakdowns and YTD impact
  • Coordinate with operations and CI teams to quantify and sign off on realized savings

5.  PDSL (Promise Date Service Level) Analysis

  • Analysis of PDSL Forecast v/s Actuals
  • Gaps in Understanding why PDSL was not met

6.  Rate Contracts & Vendor Rate Management

  • Review and track rate contracts for key plant services (labour, maintenance, logistics, consumables)
  • Monitor vendor rates against benchmarks and flag deviations
  • Support procurement finance in rate negotiations with cost data and spend analytics

7.  Headcount Analysis — Hired vs. Required

  • Maintain and report monthly Headcount Hired vs. Headcount Required for the plant (permanent + contract)
  • Analyse manpower cost per unit and productivity per head
  • Flag over/under-staffing and support workforce planning with data

8.  Budgeting, Forecasting & MIS

  • Support annual budgets and periodic rolling forecasts (4+8, 8+4) for plant costs
  • Prepare plant-level MIS and flash reports
  • Build bridge analysis — Actuals vs. Budget vs. Prior Year

9.  Oracle ERP Operations

  • Handle day-to-day plant accounting transactions in Oracle — JVs, cost uploads, accruals, reconciliations
  • Ensure correct cost centre and account mapping
  • Generate reports and extracts from Oracle for analysis

10.  Compliance & Standards

  • Ensure all plant accounting is in line with applicable Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Cost Accounting Standards (CAS)
  • Support internal/external audits with plant-level documentation
  • Maintain strong internal controls over plant financial processes

Must-Have Skills & Qualifications

AreaRequirement

| | | | --- | --- | | Qualification | CMA (ICMAI) — Qualified | | Experience | 3–4 years in a manufacturing plant finance / plant controlling role | | Accounting Standards | Well-versed with Accounting Standards (Ind AS) and Cost Accounting Standards (CAS) | | Industry | Core manufacturing (mandatory) — preferably heavy engineering, electrical, or process industry | | ERP | Hands-on Oracle ERP experience (GL, Costing, Inventory modules) | | Cost Accounting | Strong understanding of CAS, standard costing, variance analysis, absorption costing | | Communication | Strong verbal and written communication — can present to plant leadership confidently | | Excel | Advanced — pivots, lookups, large data handling, dashboard-level MIS |

Good to Have

  • Exposure to Earned Hours methodology and conversion cost frameworks
  • Experience working with intercompany (ICO) transactions or contract manufacturing setups
  • Familiarity with CapEx tracking and project accounting
  • Understanding of energy cost analysis and utility rate tracking

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who's comfortable on the shop floor — not just behind a desk
  • Can connect the dots between operational actions and financial outcomes
  • Proactive — doesn't wait for month-end to spot issues
  • Can explain cost movements in simple language to non-finance teams
  • Takes ownership of the numbers and drives action, not just reporting

About Us

The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principles & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.

OUR CORE PRINCIPLES: Safety. Integrity. Respect. Teamwork. Inclusion.

OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES

  • High-Performance Culture
  • Customer Focus
  • Operational Excellence
  • Innovation
  • Financial Strength

VERTIV BEHAVIORS

  • Own it
  • Act with urgency
  • Foster a customer-first mindset
  • Think big and execute
  • Lead by example
  • Drive continuous improvement
  • Learn and seek out development
  • Promote transparent & open communication

job.title: Team Coordinator -Integration - P3
job.description:
Job Description

POSITION SUMMARY

The Team Coordinator assists the supervisor in the operation of an area of a department so that the Supervisor may increase focus on the people in the area and not be as involved in daily specific workflow issues.  The Team Coordinator is primarily responsible for ensuring continuous production flow by relieving bottlenecks within the department, filling in positions as needed, identifying part/resource shortages, and finding solutions and/or notifying Supervisors that solutions are needed, facilitating implementation of Lean Manufacturing processes, and requesting non-personnel related assistance of other departments by completing work orders and requesting engineering and SFA assistance. May be required to do other reasonable manufacturing duties as assigned.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Reduces production bottle necks on manufacturing product line.
  • Address and correct workflow issues.
  • Learns all positions and fills in as needed.
  • Identifies part and resources shortages and provides solutions.
  • Communicates above situations to Supervisors, Engineers and Managers as appropriate.

QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Qualifications:

  • High School graduate or GED and minimal WorkKeys scores for the position.
  • 4+ Years Experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous lead position experience.

PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted.
  • Able to lift between 50 and 100 pounds assisted.
  • able to learn to work with all hand tools required of all positions within the area, including general work tools, pneumatic and hydraulic tools, brazing and wiring tools and equipment, forklifts, etc.
  • Able to effectively direct the flow of others.
  • Able to foster teamwork and resolve conflict.
  • Able to work long hours and a variety of shits as needed.
  • Able to learn and utilize materials tracking system.

ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS

  • Ability to work in an environment with temperatures occasionally above 100 degrees or below 32 degrees.

TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED

  • 10% May need to travel when appropriate depending on product line needs.

job.title: Project Coordinator, AWS Data Centre Construction
job.description:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Project Coordinator, you will be a part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry examples of energy efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.

As our Data Center Project Coordinator, you will support the teams that build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site daily interacting with the construction managers and stakeholders and be directly responsible for supporting the fast, high-quality delivery of our data center construction. The Data Center Project Coordinator will be part of the Construction Management team and will own the communication coordination with our vendors, information workflow, and coordination of document management including requests for information (RFI), change orders, monthly progress report, incident report, quality report, and schedule updates.

At Amazon, we are all Owners and leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the design review to construction bidding to construction execution and final hand-off to our customers. We are a diverse, upbeat, creative, team of engineers and managers working on a daily basis to develop innovative data centers for our Customers.

Key job responsibilities Assist the team in the production of monthly project reporting deliverables including:

  • Project Delivery plans
  • Weekly & monthly status reports
  • financial updates
  • schedule updates
  • safety incident reports and updates

Assist the team with document control tasks, including:

  • Monitoring and actioning RFI’s (requests for information),
  • Assisting with producing and tracking change orders across projects
  • Compiling and storing construction data from vendors
  • Updating Project Management software with milestone dates, correspondence, and documents.
  • Assist in the tracking of project status for activity priorities and due dates.

Assist with the development and maintenance of Amazon safety, environmental and quality standards for assigned sites

  • Set up and maintain project management and document management system
  • Preparation of agendas and minutes
  • Onboarding new vendors for badging and orientation as required
  • Monitor delivery of owner furnished material and equipment (OFCI) to site.
  • Assist Construction Managers (CMs) and Pre-construction with administrative tasks.

About the team Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, project management, construction management or similar technical focus
  • Experience reading and interpreting construction drawings and specifications, or experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
  • Experience using computers and Microsoft Office tools such as Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in project management including resource planning, managing schedules, reporting project status and prioritizing tasks
  • Experience with CAD software (AutoCAD, REVIT, BIM 360, etc.)
  • 2+ years' experience working in the construction industry or an engineering organization.
  • Experience with developing workflows and tracking systems including change management, vendor equipment delivery, and document controls across 3 or more organizations/teams.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit [https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations](https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations) for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
